title: Tin Hearts [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Za kazhdym genialnym izobreteniem stoit potryasayushchaya istoriya. Sozdateli priznannoy kritikami serii Fable predstavlyayut vashemu vnimaniyu zakhvatyvayushchuyu priklyuchencheskuyu igru-golovolomku Tin Hearts, v kotoroy rasskazyvaetsya neveroyatnaya istoriya o lyubvi i kompromissakh. 

Provedite otryad besshabashnykh olovyannykh soldatikov cherez mir, polnyy chudes, magii i zagadok. Ispolzuyte tselyy ryad prichudlivykh prisposobleniy, chtoby vashi voiny mogli prygat, strelyat i parit, priblizhayas k tseli. Proydite bolshe 50 urovney, razgadyvaya zagadki, svyazannye so vremenem i novymi putyami, kotorymi vy provedete svoikh soldatikov. Reshayte vsyo bolee slozhnye golovolomki, chtoby uznat trogatelnuyu istoriyu Alberta Battervorta — genialnogo viktorianskogo izobretatelya.

PUTEShESTVUYTE PO GOLOVOLOMNOMU PUTI. Strelyayte iz igrushechnykh pushek, chtoby raschistit put; prygayte na novye vysoty, otskakivaya ot barabanov-batutov, i upravlyayte mekhanizmami, naduvaya vozdushnye shariki i pomogaya soldatikam dobratsya do nuzhnogo mesta!

UZNAYTE ISTORIYu. Otkroyte dlya sebya epicheskiy syuzhet, zatronuvshiy neskolko pokoleniy i izmereniy i masterski vpletennyy v tkan etogo zagadochnogo mira. Zatsepki kroyutsya povsyudu: ishchite ikh vo vremya puteshestviya, chtoby v kontse kontsov polnostyu otkryt dlya sebya chudesnuyu animirovannuyu i ozvuchennuyu skazku.

ISSLEDUYTE VOLShEBNYY MIR. V volshebnoy alternativnoy viktorianskoy epokhe, perepolnennoy nostalgicheskim ocharovaniem, vy vnov pochuvstvuete sebya rebenkom v magazine igrushek.

DAYTE VOLYu FANTAZII. Razblokiruyte sily, chtoby upravlyat obektami: derevyannymi blokami, barabanami, igrushechnymi poezdami i mnogimi drugimi igrovymi predmetami. Nakhodite neobychnye sposoby svyazat obekty, chtoby postroit dorogu, privesti besstrashnykh olovyannykh soldatikov k vykhodu i otkryt tayny proshlogo!

SLUShAYTE NEZABYVAEMYY SAUNDTREK. Ne spesha reshayte golovolomki i slushayte berushchuyu za dushu muzyku udostoennogo nagrad kompozitora Mettyu Chastni, sredi rabot kotorogo chislyatsya saundtreki k filmu «Dzhoker», a takzhe k serialam «Chernobyl» i «Bridzhertony».

title: The Tale of Bistun [NSZ][RUS/Multi12]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 12]
description:
«Skaz o Bistune» priglashaet vas v yarkiy, zhivoy mir, osnovannyy na persidskoy mifologii, vdokhnovlyonnyy klassicheskim tragicheskim literaturnym proizvedeniem XII veka «Khosrov i Shirin» (pers. خسرو و شیرین‎) — vtoroy po schyotu poemoy Nizami Gyandzhevi iz sbornika «Khamse», napisannoy s 1175 po 1191 god. Ona povestvuet o lyubvi sasanidskogo shakha Khosrova, pravivshego Iranom s 591 do 628 goda, k arameyskoy printsesse Shirin.
Glavnyy geroy poemy Khosrov, sasanidskiy tsarevich, zatem shakhinshakh Irana Khosrov II Parviz (590—628), v molodosti posle vosstaniya shakhinshakha Bakhrama Chubina bezhit v Armeniyu, vo dvor Mekhin Banu. Uvidev tam kupayushchuyusya prekrasnuyu Shirin, printsessu iz Bardy, plemyannitsu Mekhin Banu — moguchey pravitelnitsy Arrana, vlyublyaetsya v neyo. Shirin takzhe lyubit Khosrova, no politicheskie soobrazheniya zastavlyayut Khosrova zhenitsya na vizantiyskoy printsesse Mariam, Shirin zhe otvergaet vnebrachnuyu blizost.
V Shirin vlyublyon zodchiy Farkhad. Uznav ob etom, Khosrov nachinaet revnovat, prizyvaet Farkhada, sporit s nim, no Farkhad ne mozhet otrechsya ot mechty o Shirin. Togda Khosrov predlagaet Farkhadu vo slavu Shirin probit prokhod skvoz granitnuyu goru Bisutun. Farkhad soglasen, no pri uslovii, chto Khosrov otkazhetsya ot Shirin. Nesmotrya na nelyogkiy trud, master nachinaet rabotat. Shirin naveshchaet Farkhada u gory Bisutun, privetstvuet, podaet emu chashu s molokom. A kogda kon Shirin ostupaetsya v gorakh, Farkhad nesyot Shirin vmeste s eyo konyom do samogo zamka i vnov vozvrashchaetsya k svoey rabote. Khosrov byl razgnevan izvestiem o vstreche Shirin s Farkhadom, emu donosyat, chto trud blizok k zaversheniyu. Dvizhimyy revnostyu Khosrov posylaet Farkhadu vest o smerti Shirin, iz-za chego Farkhad v otchayanii konchaet s soboy.
Vam predstoit issledovat udivitelnye biomy i podnimatsya po zhivopisnym sklonam gory Bistun. Eti prekrasnye mesta byli porazheny smertelnoy porchey, i teper zdes povsyudu snuyut opasnye vragi i zhestokie tvari. Chtoby spravitsya s nimi, nuzhno budet srazhatsya v dinamichnykh boyakh, ispolzuya raznoobraznye i moshchnye udary i sokrushitelnye sposobnosti. Pokazhite vsemu miru, chto vy ne tolko prostoy kamnetyos, no i nastoyashchaya mificheskaya sila!..

title: Crossing Souls [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Kaliforniya, 1986 god. Kompaniya druzey nakhodit tainstvennyy rozovyy kamen, pozvolyayushchiy peremeshchatsya mezhdu mirami. Etim prekrasnym letom rebyata popadut v istoriyu, kotoraya okazhetsya pravitelstvennym zagovorom. Pod vashim upravleniem pyat podrostkov s osobymi sposobnostyami, kotorym predstoit srazhatsya i reshat golovolomki, chtoby spasti svoi semi i ves mir.

Crossing Souls — igra v zhanre action-adventure s elementami RPG, deystvie kotoroy proiskhodit v pikselnoy Kalifornii. Pod vashim upravleniem pyat personazhey: Kris, Mett, Charli, Bolshoy Dzho i Kevin. U kazhdogo iz nikh unikalnye navyki i stil boya. Srazhaytes v realnom vremeni, reshayte raznoobraznye golovolomki, pobezhdayte moshchnykh bossov i igrayte na spetsialnykh urovnyakh po motivam arkad 80-kh. V techenie igry vy smozhete razblokirovat novye predmety i sposobnosti, kotorye pomogut vam v etoy missii po spaseniyu mira. Boi i zagadki stanut slozhnee, tak chto vam pridetsya razrabotat khoroshuyu strategiyu.

title: Project Nimbus: Complete Edition [NSP][ENG]
description:
Project Nimbus — eto dinamichnyy mekha-ekshen, v kotorom vam predstoit upravlyat vooruzhennoy do zubov gumanoidnoy boevoy obolochkoy universalnogo naznacheniya na razrushennoy Zemle budushchego.

Istreblyayte po-raznomu vooruzhennykh vragov, srazhaytes s gigantskimi bossami i pobezhdayte nepokhozhikh drug na druga pilotov-asov!
Borozdite nebesa, polzuyas svobodoy peremeshcheniya na 360 gradusov, i vstupayte v boy, primenyaya raznoobraznyy arsenal oruzhiya i sposobnostey — ot samonavodyashchikhsya raket do moshchnykh atak klinkom.
Vzhivites v rol yunogo pilota-asa, kotoromu prednachertano stat legendoy.

<Osobennosti igry>
■ Dinamichnye boi v razryvaemykh voynoy nebesakh s ispolzovaniem tyazhelovooruzhennykh boevykh obolochek.
■ 26 zadaniy v unikalnykh mestakh, vklyuchaya letayushchie goroda, okeanskie kreposti, bazy v gorakh, futuristicheskie tyurmy i kosmicheskoe prostranstvo.
■ Bolee desyatka boevykh obolochek s osobym oruzhiem, sredi kotorogo — samonavodyashchiesya rakety, energeticheskie klinki, ionnye pushki, levitiruyushchie energoshchity, relsotrony i avtonomnye psikhodrony.
■ Protyazhennyy futuristicheskiy syuzhet, okhvatyvayushchiy protivostoyanie trekh storon: CFN vo glave s SShA, vozglavlyaemye Rossiey UCN i podpolnaya terroristicheskaya gruppirovka «Deti poverzhennykh natsiy» vedut postoyannye boi drug s drugom.
■ Netrivialnye bossy s unikalnymi stilyami boya: orbitalnye boevye mekhi s yadernymi reaktorami, otryady smertelno opasnykh pilotov, letayushchie korabli s kuchey oruzhiya na bortu i ne tolko.
■ Rakety, relsotrony, pushki dlya atak izdaleka... i fekhtovanie energeticheskimi klinkami v blizhnem boyu.

<Raznoobraznye dopolnitelnye rezhimy>
■ V bonusnom rezhime vyzhivaniya vy mozhete vybrat lyubuyu boevuyu obolochku i vstupit v boy s beskonechnymi volnami vragov, kotorye stanovyatsya vse silnee.
■ Rezhim «LINIYa FRONTA» predlagaet ogromnye vozmozhnosti dlya povtornogo prokhozhdeniya: vas ozhidayut 6 podrezhimov s neogranichennymi zadaniyami (vklyuchaya «Zashchitu bazy», «Perekhvat» i «Likvidatsiyu»), 6 urovney pilota i personalizatsiya boevoy obolochki.

title: Annie Last Hope [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
description:
《安妮：最後的希望》 是一款 HD 體素 俯視角射擊遊戲，故事發生在 1990 年代。未知生物的突然入侵讓安妮與未婚夫失散，為了尋找他，她踏上了一條充滿危險的求生之路。然而，這場看似簡單的尋人旅程，卻逐漸揭開了一場錯綜複雜的陰謀，末日之下的黑暗秘密也將浮現……

爽快射擊 ‧ 末日求生
在屍潮橫行的世界中，拿起你的武器，與無盡的怪物戰鬥，體驗緊張刺激的戰鬥快感！

獨特 HD 體素美術風格
高度風格化的體素世界，場景中的大量物件皆可破壞，帶來沉浸式的探索與戰鬥體驗！

精心設計的 BOSS 戰
變異的廚師長、感染的改裝皮卡、詭計多端的末日勢力首領……面對這些風格各異的強敵，你準備好迎接挑戰了嗎？

多樣化的關卡體驗
森林、學校、伐木場、車流不息的公路，甚至是狹窄的電梯間，每個場景都擁有獨特的挑戰，讓每一次戰鬥都充滿新鮮感！

沉浸式音效與劇情
從槍聲的回響到末日世界的呢喃，每一處細節都營造出逼真的氛圍。搭配扣人心弦的劇情，讓你深陷這場末日冒險。

愛與背叛，陰謀與抉擇，人性與生存……末日世界的真相，等待你來揭曉。

加入安妮，踏上求生之路，尋找最後的希望！

title: Imp of the Sun [NSP][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Imp of the Sun — nelineynyy ekshn-platformer v 2D, sochetayushchiy v sebe dinamichnye boi i puteshestviya po zakhvatyvayushchemu miru, vdokhnovlennomu vershinami And, dzhunglyami Amazonki i peruanskoy kulturoy.

Vy igraete za Nina — besa, rozhdennogo iz posledney iskry Solntsa. On otpravlyaetsya v put, chtoby nayti i odolet chetyrekh Khraniteley, vernut Solntsu ego silu i polozhit konets Vechnomu zatmeniyu, prezhde chem tma okonchatelno poglotit mir.

Zhizn nevozmozhna bez sily Solntsa, kotoruyu Khraniteli ukrali mnogo vekov nazad i spryatali v raznykh ugolkakh Imperii. Iz svoey posledney iskry Solntse sozdal besa po imeni Nin i otpravil ego v put, chtoby vernut svet i vosstanovit balans v Imperii.

Vy porozhdenie Solntsa, napolnennoe siloy ognya. Sovershenstvuyte svoi navyki v uluchshennom igrovom protsesse s plavnymi dvizheniyami i boyami, zavyazannymi na kombo-udarakh. Puteshestvuyte po Imperii Solntsa, otkryvayte novye umeniya, stanovites silnee i unichtozhte chetyrekh Khraniteley.

Otkroyte dlya sebya chetyre oblasti Imperii: belosnezhnye piki And, zarosli v dzhunglyakh Amazonki, issokhshie bezzhalostnye pustyni i temnye nedra podzemnogo mira. Kazhdaya lokatsiya i kazhdoe sushchestvo produmany i narisovany vruchnuyu s uvazheniem k tsivilizatsiyam, kotorye nekogda naselyali territoriyu Peru.

Nashi predki veli khroniki s pomoshchyu artefaktov, nyne izvestnykh kak «kipu». Otyshchite vse kipu, chtoby uznat istoriyu Vechnogo zatmeniya, i soberite kollektsiyu unikalnykh taynykh predmetov, sozdannykh po obrazu nastoyashchikh relikviy andskikh kultur. Stranstvuyte po Imperii Solntsa i pobezhdayte besposhchadnykh bossov s unikalnoy predystoriey i kompleksnymi boevymi mekhanikami; vybor sleduyushchego bossa vsegda za vami.

Osobennosti
- Uluchshennyy igrovoy protsess s plavnymi dvizheniyami i boyami, zavyazannymi na kombo-udarakh.
- Unikalnyy stil i saundtreki, vdokhnovlennye Peru i nastoyashchimi artefaktami andskikh kultur.
- Srazites s pyatyu besposhchadnymi bossami s unikalnoy predystoriey i kompleksnymi boevymi mekhanikami; vybor sleduyushchego bossa vsegda za vami.
- Sovershenstvuyte svoi navyki boya i peredvizheniya, chtoby poluchit polnyy kontrol nad besom i ego silami.

title: Caesar III / Tsezar 3 (na Aurugustus) [NSP][RUS/ENG]
interface_lang: 俄语 (来自 ZoG), 英语 [RUS/ENG]
description:
Caesar III — ekonomicheskaya strategiya, kompyuternaya igra, razrabotannaya kompaniey Impressions Games i izdannaya Sierra Entertainment v 1998 godu.
Caesar III — dostatochno slozhnaya intellektualnaya videoigra, modeliruyushchaya bolshoe kolichestvo vzaimosvyazannykh protsessov po upravleniyu gorodskim khozyaystvom. Igroku prikhoditsya uchityvat mnozhestvo samykh raznoobraznykh faktorov: gorodskoy byudzhet, resursy, kotorymi raspolagaet provintsiya, strategicheskoe polozhenie goroda, nalichie ili otsutstvie rynkov sbyta syrya i tovarov (inogda novye torgovye partnyory poyavlyayutsya po khodu igry). Gubernator obyazan sledit za snabzheniem goroda produktami pitaniya i drugimi tovarami, obespechivat zhiteley razlichnymi razvlecheniyami, obrazovaniem i meditsinskimi uchrezhdeniyami, sledit za nastroeniem naseleniya, regulirovat zanyatost, bespokoitsya o vnutrennem poryadke i vneshnikh voennykh ugrozakh, i ne zabyvat o loyalnosti k imperatoru.
Vozmozhno podklyuchenie USB-myshki i klaviatury cherez dok-stantsiyu Switch, upravlenie geympadom libo tach-interfeysom.

description:

Sozdannaya masterami Obsidian Entertainment, Pillars of Eternity poluchila priznanie kritikov i desyatki nagrad za versiyu dlya PK. Teper fantasticheskiy mir, takticheskiy boy i nezabyvaemyy syuzhet mozhno ispolzovat gde ugodno. Pillars of Eternity: Complete Edition vklyuchaet v sebya ves dopolnitelnyy kontent iz versii dlya PK, vklyuchaya zagruzki i rasshireniya. Versiya byla optimizirovana dlya komfortnoy igry pered ekranom s kontrollerami ili v ruchnom rezhime. Prostaya navigatsiya po sozdaniyu personazhey v igre, boyam v rezhime realnogo vremeni s pauzoy i upravleniyu partiyami blagodarya produmannym obnovleniyam polzovatelskogo interfeysa i elementov upravleniya. Soberite svoyu partiyu, dvigaytes vpered i zhivite priklyucheniyami, pogruzivshis v mir chudes, nostalgii i emotsiy klassicheskikh rolevykh igr s Obsidian's Pillars of Eternity!

Osobennosti:
• Otmechennye nagradami pocherk, istoriya i grafika Pillars of Eternity, a takzhe rasshirennyy mir i kontent The White March: Parts I & II.
• Rasshirennoe sozdanie personazha na vybor, kotoroe vliyaet na vashu lichnuyu istoriyu s rasami, klassami i proiskhozhdeniem personazhey.
• Epicheskaya vselennaya dlya issledovaniya, napolnennaya uvlekatelnymi chlenami partii i kompanonami, razlichnymi fraktsiyami vnutri igry i lyubovno prorisovannym mirom dlya prokhozhdeniya.
• Vse osnovnye obnovleniya iz originalnoy versii dlya PK, v tom chisle povyshennyy maksimalnyy uroven, rasshirennye vozmozhnosti II dlya uchastnikov i novye urovni slozhnosti.
• Glubokaya i klassicheskaya boevaya sistema v rezhime realnogo vremeni s pauzoy, kotoraya podpityvaet vashego vnutrennego taktika.

title: My Girlfriend is a Mermaid [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Our protagonist lives out in the city but one summer decides to return to his rural hometown and it is there he once again meets his childhood friend, Ion... who is now a mermaid!?

Soon after he also meets Petakko, a mermaid who has lost her memory and Rin, a priestess who looks after mermaids but also has a split personality. It is these encounters that brings our protagonist in contact with the legend surrounding mermaid.

Together with Ion, who is at the center of this mysterious legend, as well as Petakko and Rin, our protagonist's strange summer vacation begins...

"My Girlfriend is a Mermaid!?" is a heartwarming visual novel with multiple choices and endings as well as beautiful Live2D animation.

title: Chrono Ark Deluxe edition + DLC Summer Twilight, High Roller [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + optsionalnyy mashinnyy 来自 KOTEHOK, 移植版 most2820 用于 v65536
description:
很久以前，世界被黑色迷霧籠罩，倖存下來的人類為了避難進入了“方舟”。

恢復舊世界的方法只有一個，
那就是收集散落在各地的“時空之影”，啟動鐘樓。
只要啟動鐘樓，世界就可以重新回到和平的年代……

失去記憶的“露西”在“方舟”下面的扭曲之地醒來。
她腦中僅存的記憶告訴她，必須要啟動鐘樓……

玩家和露西一起成立調查團，踏上了去尋找“時空之影”的旅程。

RPG與卡牌遊戲融合

最多招募4名隊員，通過使用卡牌形式的技能和能力與怪物進行戰鬥。您可以制定最佳的策略，通過角色之間的配合，打造最強的組合。隊員和主人公露西的技能是以卡牌形式在戰鬥中使用。當然您可以自己選擇學習哪一個技能！

不要害怕團滅

本作和普通RPG不同，如果隊伍全滅，一切就會回到最初，你能夠發掘的同伴和技能也會有所變化。反覆遊玩，打造只屬於自己的戰略吧。

title: Hob the Definitive edition [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
Razrabotchiki Torchlight™ i Torchlight II™ predlagayut vam preodolet i preobrazit zagadochnyy mir Hob, gde nyne votsarilsya khaos. Proniknite v tayny planety, uznayte pravdu i predotvratite katastrofu v etom zakhvatyvayushchem priklyuchenii. Dannaya versiya otlichaetsya uluchshennoy proizvoditelnostyu i novymi igrovymi osobennostyami, dostupnymi tolko na Nintendo Switch™.

• RASKROYTE TAYNU: Hob polon zagadok i chudes, kotorye vam predstoit otkryt, bluzhdaya po miru i vstrechaya ego prichudlivykh obitateley.

• TsELYY ARSENAL V RUKE: mekhanicheskaya-ruka perchatka, posle nekotoroy dorabotki, posluzhit vam kak oruzhiem, tam i sredstvom peredvizheniya.

• PUTEShESTVUYTE, issleduyte ruiny, znakomtes s dukhami i srazhaytes s ugrozhayushchimi ikh sushchestvovaniyu vrazhdebnymi sushchestvami.

• HOB KAK NIKOGDA PREZhDE: v etu versiyu vklyucheny eksklyuzivnye osobennosti dlya Nintendo Switch™, a imenno, podderzhka sistemy HD Rumble i sensornyy ekran, plyus rasshirennye nastroyki upravleniya kameroy i pererabotannaya kampaniya, prizvannaya sdelat vashe puteshestvie po miru Hob kak nikogda bolee uvlekatelnym!

title: The Oregon Trail + DLC [NSP][RUS/Multi13]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 13]
description:
Gameloft出品的《The Oregon Trail™》為全球知名遊戲的官方續作。歡迎來到奧勒岡小徑暢享前所未有的體驗，盡情沉浸在冒險中。旅途上的考驗與磨難精準地還原歷史，而且刺激度更加極致。你將挑選旅伴、補充旅行物資，再踏上充滿抉擇、危機以及未知的旅途。無論是暴風雪、手腳骨折、蛇咬、體力耗盡、糧食短缺甚至是駭人的痢疾都是路上會遇到的挑戰，想活下來就不可等閒視之。玩家得在荒野中前進，並努力帶領拓荒小隊在寒冬來臨前抵達奧勒岡，以展開新的生活。你還得摸索如何在暴風雪中尋找失蹤旅人、在炙熱的沙漠中運送易燃的火藥、在挑戰性十足的狩獵小遊戲中競爭，並且結識多位歷史人物。玩家必須在隨機出現的事件做抉擇，而每個選擇都會影響隊伍以及未來的發展，且每次玩遊戲都是全新的探險！

無止境的新冒險
• 你可以命名不同職別的旅伴並組建隊伍；他們各自會帶自己的物品上路，而且分別具有獨特的技能和個性，讓你的奧勒岡之旅成為獨一無二的體驗。
• 旅途中會出現上百個隨機事件，而你所做的決定會影響你的小隊以及未來的發展。所選的旅伴技能與個性也會影響事件結果。
• 記得好好照顧你的隊員、篷車與公牛，以免成為小徑亡魂。

嶄新特色
• 15趟旅程供玩家盡情暢玩。
• 體驗7個改編真實歷史事件的任務。
• 隨時觀察隊友的健康、士氣、體力以及衛生狀況。
• 管理你的存貨欄位，盡可能把所有補給品塞進篷車。
• 保養你的篷車，以避免車子拋錨、食物腐壞或是物資掉落。
• 在互動式日誌中認識小徑上的歷史人物與地點。
• 在路上收集有趣的動物並進一步了解牠們。
• 在全新的釣魚小遊戲中盡情捕釣80多種魚。
• 挑戰超過140項成就。

忠於原版
• 令玩家期待許久的狩獵以及乘筏漂流小遊戲重磅回歸。擁有全新視覺效果的兩個小遊戲均保留了經典的原始玩法。
• 痢疾、渡河、骨折等更多典型的考驗在各場景中等你來挑戰！

視覺與聽覺雙重震撼
• 像素角色、3D場景和最新的燈光視覺效果完美融合，創造出既懷舊又現代的獨特美感。
• 遊戲原聲帶將另類鄉村音樂與8位元音效結合在一起，成為一場聽覺饗宴。

向歷史致敬
• 遊戲首次推出美國原住民的角色與劇情，藉此致敬最先居住在這塊土地上的民族，慶祝他們的歷史與文化。
• 透過深入研究與多位學術顧問的參與，我們盡力確保遊戲能呈現出精確的內容，以向當時的歷史人物致意。

官方授權與支援
• 《The Oregon Trail™》為HarperCollins Productions官方授權的遊戲。遊戲開發過程獲得其大力支援。新版的《The Oregon Trail™》有著新鮮玩法以及全新視覺效果，同時又不失原版遊戲的原汁原味。
• 入選2016年的電子遊戲名人堂。

title: CarX Drift Racing [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:

《CarX 甩尾賽車線上版》以簡單直觀的方式帶來操控跑車的獨特體驗

title: CarX Highway Racing [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
成為賽車之王：迷人故事情節、獨家車輛特別活動、多種遊戲模式，以及逼真的 CarX 物理機制。
強大的賽車等你駕馭！

在交通擁擠的公路上賽車的第 1 名遊戲。
結合《CarX 甩尾賽車線上版》中最重要的逼真物理特性，以及在交通擁擠的賽道上進行極限賽車的超吸睛視覺效果，就是《CarX Highway Racing》的最大特色。

劇情模式。讓自己沉浸在街頭賽車的世界。
- 駕車穿越德州沙漠，造訪澳洲、法國、俄羅斯與更多國家，一路駛向成功。
- 揭開地下組織的秘密，摧毀溫斯頓的秘密帝國。
- 揭發財團的所有秘密，並及時阻止他們。
- 結交新朋友，在你努力完成目標時協助你。

超讚車輛選擇。從皮卡車到現代超跑，選擇多元。
- 超過 40 款跑車等著你：經典跑車、一般車輛、強大的肌肉車與超跑。

真實物理特性。感受座駕的強大力量。
- 精心調整的物理特性將讓你感受到車輛的每一匹馬力。
- 升級汽車零件以提高性能。

競技賽車。向別人展示你的實力。
- 與其他玩家爭奪第一
- 獲勝並擊敗對手的時間紀錄以在聯賽中晉級。

多種遊戲模式。你不會感到無聊。
- 選擇「時間攻擊」，在群車中競速，或是毫髮無傷地完成一圈。

警察模式。讓所有人看到這裡是誰說了算。
- 站在正義的一方，在鬧事者逃跑前將對方擊敗。
- 用引擎的轟鳴聲與閃爍的燈光讓罪犯心生恐懼。

獨特活動。把握機會獲得強大車輛。
- 參加不同活動並獲得獨特車輛。

視覺自訂選項。展現你的色彩。
- 更改汽車的每個部分：後照鏡、照明、擋板、保險槓或選擇車身組合！想像力不受限。

自由駕駛模式。感受行動的自由。
- 無限模式可享受駕駛樂趣並在無盡的追逐中喘口氣。
- 與對手競爭並獲得豐厚獎勵。

還不只這些！
- 日/夜模式：徘徊在巴黎的夜晚，也可以在夜間的德州公路上或澳洲烈陽下讓塵土飛揚
- 逃離警察：巡邏車會讓你隨時保持警惕，直到衝過終點線為止，與他們對抗更是另一項考驗。

title: Viviette [NSP][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Ispytayte svoyu logiku raznoobraznymi golovolomkami, naydite razlichnye predmety, no ne poteryaytes – ved sama orientirovka stanet prepyatstviem na vashem puti!

- Zakhvatyvayushchiy opyt issledovaniya v zhanre uzhasov. Raskroyte tayny i zabytye sobytiya mesta, kishashchego privideniyami sekretami, nakhodya zagadochnye dokumenty, kotorye lish namekayut na ego tragichnoe i mrachnoe proshloe... Karty i pomoshchi net. Tolko vy, alkhimicheskaya lampa i... “chto-to” eshche…

- “Chudovishche”. Ono mozhet poyavitsya gde ugodno i v lyuboe vremya. Da, vy mozhete pytatsya sbezhat... no kak dolgo? Vyklyuchite li vy lampu i primenite li teni i estestvennoe osveshchenie sebe na polzu? Obnaruzhit li “ono” vas, esli vy budete stoyat vsego v pare santimetrov absolyutno nepodvizhno? Vy slyshite ego priblizhayushchiesya shagi… Chto vy predprimete?!

- Slozhnye golovolomki. Pri reshenii neordinarnykh i unikalnykh golovolomok, ne imeyushchikh ochevidnykh i prostykh otvetov, vam ponadobitsya ispolzovat vse podskazki iz okruzhayushchey obstanovki, chtoby nayti skrytyy otvet.

- Predmety i inventar. Nakhodite i ispolzuyte raznoobraznyy i nestandartnyy nabor predmetov dlya prodvizheniya v priklyuchenii. Produmannyy inventar akkuratno uporyadochivaet vashi veshchi i daet opisaniya, kotorye v nekotorykh sluchayakh dazhe soderzhat podskazki...

- Neskolko kontsovok. Luchshaya, “KhOROShAYa” kontsovka, yavlyaetsya ne normoy, a isklyucheniem. Eto nagrada dlya igrokov, kotorye myslyat nestandartno, issleduyut kazhduyu ten i zagadku, i dlya tekh, komu ulybnulas udacha...

- Originalnyy i potryasayushchiy audio- i videoryad. Eto sozdannoe vruchnuyu priklyuchenie s vysokokachestvennoy 16-bitnoy pikselnoy grafikoy. Produkt truda odnogo khudozhnika, vlozhivshego v nego dushu. Soderzhit absolyutno unikalnyy dostupnyy dlya issledovaniya osobnyak, v kotorom net dvukh odinakovykh komnat: kazhdaya imeet individualnyy dizayn so svoimi osobennostyami. Vse pikseli, detali i treshchiny v stene razmeshcheny umyshlenno i tshchatelno razrabotany vruchnuyu, chtoby rasskazat igrokam istoriyu bez ispolzovaniya slov. Nasha vydayushchayasya grafika v stile 90-kh usilena svetovymi effektami, trevozhnym pozitsionirovannym 3D-zvukom i absolyutno originalnym atmosfernym saundtrekom.

title: Onimusha 2 Samurai's Destiny [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]

以必殺技「一閃」為首的爽快感超群劍鬥動作。
由各個登場人物交織而成、深刻且硬派的故事。

■復仇的戰鬼——柳生十兵衛。「以松田優作為主角原型」

title: Heroes of Might and Magic I - II (2): A Strategic Quest, The Succession Wars, The Price of Loyalty (HOMM DOSBox JIT, Retroarch) [ENG][NSP]
description:
Heroes of Might and Magic («Geroi mecha i magii») — fenteziynaya seriya videoigr v zhanre poshagovoy strategii s elementami RPG, na dannyy moment vklyuchayushchaya v sebya sem osnovnykh chastey. Vymyshlennaya vselennaya Heroes of Might and Magic osnovana na vselennoy Might and Magic. Sobytiya vsekh igr serii do pyatoy razvorachivayutsya v vymyshlennom mire Enrot.
Heroes of Might and Magic I: A Strategic Quest — kompyuternaya igra v zhanre poshagovoy strategii s elementami RPG, rodonachalnik serii igr Heroes of Might and Magic. Heroes I byla razrabotana i vypushchena 31 avgusta 1995 goda kompaniey New World Computing, kotoraya na tot moment yavlyalas samostoyatelnoy kompaniey (pozzhe ona stala podrazdeleniem The 3DO Company). Pervaya chast Heroes of Might and Magic zalozhila fundamentalnye osnovy geympleya vsey serii, budushchie igry kotoroy preterpevali, po bolshey chasti, lish evolyutsionnye izmeneniya. Zdes razvorachivaetsya borba za vlast mezhdu chetyrmya pravitelyami: lordom Morglinom «Zheleznym Kulakom» (rytsarem), korolevoy Lamandoy (volshebnitsey), vozhdyom Sleyerom (varvarom) i koldunom Alamarom (chernoknizhnikom). V syuzhetnoy kampanii, sostoyashchey iz devyati missiy, igrok mozhet igrat za lyubuyu iz storon.
Heroes of Might and Magic II: The Succession Wars + The Price of Loyalty (sokrashchyonno Heroes II ili HoMM2) — kompyuternaya igra v zhanre poshagovoy strategii s elementami RPG, vtoraya chast v serii fenteziynykh igr Heroes of Might and Magic. Igra byla razrabotana kompaniey New World Computing i izdana The 3DO Company 1 oktyabrya 1996 goda.

title: The Cruel King and the Great Hero [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Prisoedinyaytes k besstrashnoy devushke na ee mnogo priklyucheniy, poskolku ona stremitsya stat geroem s pomoshchyu svoego moguchego zashchitnika drakona.

Po puti vstrechayte novykh druzey, sobirayte predmety i pomogite lyudyam so vsekh progulok! Otkroyte dlya sebya serdechnuyu skazku dobrotoy, obshcheniya i semi v velikolepnom risovannom mire.

title: OSU! + 1236 pesen (移植版 mcOsu) [ENG][NRO]
description:
osu! — muzykalnaya ritm-igra, napisannaya v 2007 godu na yazyke C#, rasprostranyaemaya besplatno. Igra skhozha po printsipu s Tatakae! Ouendan, Elite Beat Agents i Taiko no Tatsujin.
Igrovoy protsess zaklyuchaetsya v nazhatii poyavlyayushchikhsya na ekrane not, vedenii myachika po slayderam, a takzhe vrashchenii spinnera (kursora vokrug tochki po tsentru ekrana) maksimalno bystro. V zavisimosti ot tochnosti popadaniya v takt muzyki, nachislyayutsya ochki, za nepravilnoe vypolnenie deystviy u igroka otnimayutsya «zhizni», po istechenii kotorykh zaschityvaetsya porazhenie.
Igrovye elementy:

title: Xuan Yuan Sword VII (7) [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
developer: DOMO Studio, Catness Game Studios, Playerium
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
軒轅劍柒是一款具有即時戰鬥系統的動作角色扮演遊戲，其中包含動人的 3D 呈現及豐富的動畫劇情。其中展現著中國古代的地形、文明與文化，同時融入了其獨特的神秘傳說，與科技化的設計形成強烈的對比。在這個既熟悉又神秘的世界中，科技與奇幻，都等著你來探索。

玩家將扮演遺孤太史昭，他在旅途中尋求治療妹妹的方法，與故人重逢，並和謀害家族的仇敵展開決戰。軒轅劍的故事以中國歷史中的「新」朝及神話為背景，重新詮譯了此奇幻而混亂的世界。

西漢末年，王莽篡位，並答應世人要帶來和平富貴。然而十年後，此允諾並未成現實，反讓中原民不聊生。在各方勢力角逐之下，太史昭將如何面對這場亂世？

特色：

• 在一場電影般的冒險中橫跨中國古代。
• 在即時戰鬥系統中攻擊、格擋、躲避、反擊！
• 控制天書來減緩時間、收妖或改變環境！
• 升級裝備與武器、鍛鍊被動技能並學習新技能。
• 探索獨立的劇情，無須遊玩軒轅劍前作。
• 融入本系列至今最先進的 3D 視覺效果！

title: Hatsune Miku Connecting Puzzle Tamagotori + 2 DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
A brand new Hatsune Miku puzzle game comes to the Nintendo Switch™!
Connect eggs to clear and solve puzzles!

・About the puzzles
Connect eggs with the same patterns with a line that bends twice or less to clear them. Clear all the eggs to complete the stage!
Look across the entire board to find eggs to clear!

・Complete puzzles to unlock illustrations
Completing a puzzle will flip one illustration panel.
Flip all of the panels to reveal the illustration!
You can view illustrations of Miku and friends drawn by popular artists.

・Take care of the birds
You can use berries you find in the puzzles to call birds into the Bird's Square!
Birds that visit will be recorded in the gallery.
Try to compuete the gallery!

・”piapro” Award-Winning Songs Included!
Five award-winning songs written especially for "Hatsune Miku Connecting Puzzle TAMAGOTORI" are included!
Let's enjoy the puzzle with the wonderful music!

*Not integrated with touch screen controls.

title: Pretty Girls — 17 款游戏 (Klondike, Mahjong, Solitaire, Texas Hold'em, Breakers, Escape, Rivers, Speed, 2048, Match i dr.) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Uklonyaysya ot vragov, zakhvatyvaya kak mozhno bolshe igrovogo polya, chtoby pobedit! Znakomye pravila «zakhvata territorii», populyarnye v yaponskikh arkadakh, stol zhe prosty, skol i pooshchritelny, a blagodarya izobiliyu krasivykh personazhey, ozhidayushchikh svoego raskrytiya, ekshen-golovolomki redko byvayut stol zakhvatyvayushchimi!
Poznakomtes s bolee chem 80 simpatichnymi devushkami na 40 etapakh! Vyberite sebe v sputnitsy Yu ili Asakhi, i prokhozhdenie etapov vmeste s nimi otkroet dlya nikh novye naryady. Posle kazhdogo proydennogo ispytaniya pamyatnye fotografii spasennykh devushek takzhe budut dobavlyatsya v galereyu. Smozhete li vy sobrat vse pikantnye fotografii?..
Raskroyte devushek, spryatannykh za shirmami, okhranyaemymi vragami, prosmatrivayte razblokirovannye izobrazheniya v galeree, zakhvatyvayte zony pobolshe, chtoby nabirat bolshe ochkov! Poznakomtes s devushkami, milo shchebechushchimi na yaponskom yazyke, i naslazhdaytes neogranichennoy vozmozhnostyu povtornogo prokhozhdeniya!..Spisok vklyuchyonnykh igr serii Pretty Girls:

title: Gravity Circuit [NSZ][ENG]
description:
重力迴路：華麗的2D平台動作遊戲，極具經典街機精神。
任務：阻止病毒軍團崛起！
在這個經歷了末日浩劫，且由有意識的機器人組成的世界當中，居民們再次面臨曾經交手過的對手——病毒軍團的威脅。這個軍團曾在幾十年前被打倒，但它又抱著唯一的目標——徹底統治世界，再次悄然地從陰影中現身。受到嚴重打擊的守護者部隊別無選擇，只能求助上一次戰爭中的英雄：那位能夠駕馭神秘的重力迴路的力量的孤獨特務，凱。玩家將化身為這個世界的最後一道防線，穿越各個具有未來主義風格的場景，並擊潰這場混亂背後的邪惡幕後主使。
這款遊戲會讓人想起80、90年代的經典平台遊戲，且將動作要素調整至最大值；將你的力量注入拳頭，把敵人們給打飛，或者把他們抓過來來場近距離接觸吧。在你探索的過程中，將能獲得許多新力量，讓你能夠更進一步超越自我喔！

主要特色
平台動作遊戲 
將你的力量灌注到毀滅性的拳擊當中，把敵人打飛，打出爽快的連擊，並在這個過程中盡情破壞、摧毀敵方！
拯救無辜的人們，增強自己的力量！ 
關卡裡充滿了各種秘密，以及無端被牽連的市民們。揭開秘密、拯救市民，並解鎖新的力量！
單人戰役模式，共有12關
每個關卡都有各自的獨特機制，一連串的敵人和頭目將會考驗你的平台遊戲技術和戰鬥技巧！

title: Cyanide and Happiness Freakpocalypse [NSP][ENG]
description:
You are a weird, unpopular, ginger-headed orphan, and it’s time to save the world.

You play as Coop “Go Away, Weirdo” McCarthy and all you want to do is make the world a better place. The trouble is: Nobody likes you, school sucks, you can't find a prom date, everybody bullies you (including your teachers), and your attempts to help only make things worse. Will you escape high school alive? Who will love you? Do you even deserve love? Why is this game called Freakpocalypse? Find the answers to these questions and more by looking at, talking to, and touching everything within the Cyanide & Happiness universe.

This game is part 1 of Coop’s trilogy of tragedy:
• In this point-and-click adventure, control Coop in his quest to be the hero he always wanted to be by helping the people of Netherton! Talk to, touch, and look at everything in your environment! That sexy looking clock? Ask it to prom! That rotting piece of fruit? Touch it!

Jump into the Cyanide & Happiness universe:
• Did we mention the sheer amount of fully-voiced freaks and friends you’ll see from some of your favorite animated shorts? Feast your eyes on familiar faces as you fetch, find and frolic through your environment! Meet famous folks like Ted Bear, Shark Dad, Señor Cleanfist, and more!

Help with a wide variety of side quests:
• The citizens of Netherton need help. Like, a LOT of help. Fortunately(?) for them, there’s Coop! Enjoy the full gameplay experience by finding dangerous markers, buying frozen drinks, and trying to make people less miserable! (Or at least hate you less)

Discover a plethora of costumes, easter eggs, and secrets
• Netherton is… Charming, if you look in the right places! Explore the town and discover a ton of different clothes, easter eggs and hidden details while you avoid death to freaks and bullies! Unlock special achievements for how good (or bad) you are at exploration!

Enjoy the hallmark Explosm style
• True to the signature art style, Freakpocalypse includes animated shorts that’ll bring you right back to the cartoon series that started it all! On top of that, listen to a set of catchy, original tracks that give life (or death) to your atmosphere!
• Coop's main storyline can be completed in just a few hours, but if you explore more and see all of Netherton, it can take much more than that, even days!

title: Islets [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
Ayko — nachinayushchiy, no podayushchiy nadezhdy voin, kotoryy issleduet nebesa i zemlyu, chtoby obedinit neskolko paryashchikh ostrovov. Usevshis v svoy dryakhlyy vozdushnyy korabl, on puteshestvuet po ostrovam, nadeyas zazhech ogon v dragotsennykh yadrakh. Na puti vstayut mnogochislennye protivniki, s kotorymi pridetsya raspravitsya. 

Islets — na udivlenie polnotsennaya metroidvaniya o vazhnosti svyazey s temi, kto nas okruzhaet. Po mere togo kak Ayko obedinyaet ostrova i zavodit druzhbu s ocharovatelnymi personazhami, mir rasshiryaetsya, i v kazhdoy oblasti otkryvayutsya novye vozmozhnosti dlya issledovaniya. Obyshchite kazhdyy ugolok, chtoby sobrat vsevozmozhnye uluchsheniya i proyti mnogochislennye taynye ispytaniya, skrytye v mire!

Takzhe u vas budet provozhatyy, no budte ostorozhny. Strannyy on kakoy-to...

Vozmozhnosti
- Obedinite ostrova, slovno golovolomku, chtoby otkryt novye sposoby issledovat predydushchie oblasti i obedinit mir v odno tseloe.
- Vstupayte v epicheskie bitvy s bossami: uzhasnymi monstrami i bezzhalostnymi nebesnymi piratami!
- Prokhodite ispytaniya i raskryvayte mnogochislennye tayny ostrova, chtoby poluchit uluchsheniya, kotorye pomogut vam v puteshestvii!
- Zavedite druzhbu so mnozhestvom ocharovatelnykh personazhey, vklyuchaya napyshchennogo odnoklassnika-voina, podozritelno druzhelyubnuyu lyagushku i mnogikh drugikh.
- Pogruzites v prelestnyy, narisovannyy ot ruki mir i polyubuytes ego chudesnymi peyzazhami.

title: OFF the Game [NSZ][ENG]
description:
«Vospominaniya neredko tayat v sebe nechto bolee volnuyushchee i zloveshchee, chem realnost.» ©
Psikhodelicheskaya belgiyskaya rolevaya advenchura, vypushchennaya v 2008 godu Martin Dzhorisom s komandoy. Igra nachinaetsya s tainstvennogo sushchestva izvestnogo kak Batter, o kotorom govoritsya lish to, chto on prizvan zakonchit svoyu «vazhnuyu missiyu». Batter puteshestvuet po chetyryom Zonam v mire, otkryvaya igroku vsyo bolshe sekretov.
Igrok nazyvaetsya Kuklovodom i «rabotaet» sovmestno s nekoy gumanoidnoy sushchnostyu, pomogaya emu zavershit svoyu svyashchennuyu missiyu: ochistit mir OFF.
«OFF» poluchila vysokuyu otsenku za svoy syuzhet, personazhey i prichudlivuyu atmosferu. Khaydi Kemps iz zhurnala «PC Gamer» opisala proekt kak nezabyvaemuyu i zapominayushchuyusya RPG, napolnennuyu khitrymi zagadkami, stranneyshey simvolikoy, i slozhnymi tematicheskimi elementami. Adam Smit na sayte Rock, Paper, Shotgun vysoko otsenil zhutkovatyy mir i ochen rekomendoval eyo svoim chitatelyam.Versiya s perevodom zdes.

title: Touhou Luna Nights [NSP][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 俄语 lyubitelskiy 来自 G02m0n1k, KUsHa
description:
Touhou Luna Nights is a Metroidvania title with a heavy emphasis on exploration and action.　
Developed by Team Ladybug, creators of multiple fantastic action games thus far.

~ Story ~

“...Now, let’s begin my world.”

Remilia Scarlet, head vampire of the Scarlet Devil Mansion sends her maid Sakuya Izayoi with no warning to a world much like Gensokyo, but not quite.

A world full of strange places, filled with strange youkai and her time manipulation sealed.
What could Remilia’s end game be...?

title: Pen and Paper Games Bundle: Knights of Pen and Paper 1 + 2 / Galaxy of Pen & Paper [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
developer: Behold Studios, Kyy Games, Seaven Studios
interface_lang: 俄语 (2-aya igra), 英语 [ENG] + 民间汉化 ZoG, 用于 1-oy igry
description:
Vas zhdut mnogochasovye priklyucheniya v etikh poshagovykh, pikselnykh retro-RPG, polnykh opasnostey, intrig i polu-prilichnykh kulturnykh otsylok! Igry soderzhat vse kogda-libo vypushchennye dopolneniya s novymi personazhami, protivnikami, kvestami i lokatsiyami!
-------
V Knights of Pen and Paper vy isprobuete sebya v roli igrokov, kotorye probuyut sebya v roli svoikh personazhey iz nastolnoy rolevoy igry v potryasayushchem metarolevom priklyuchenii. Igraya za personazhey i geym-mastera, vy smozhete vybirat, v kakikh srazheniyakh prinimat uchastie. Soberite gruppu opasnykh monstrov dlya opasnogo srazheniya, chtoby poluchit dostoynye nagrady!
-------
Prigotovtes k pogruzheniyu v Knights of Pen & Paper 2 — poshagovoe pikselnoe retro-priklyuchenie, polnoe opasnostey, intrig i polu-prilichnykh kulturnykh otsylok!

S novymi rasami gnomov i elfov soberite otryad otvazhnykh geroev, vybirayte kvesty i bitvy, issleduyte podzemelya, sozdavayte moshchnye artefakty i gromko zhaluytes svoemu geym-masteru.
-------
Galaxy of Pen & Paper — eto poshagovaya rolevaya igra, kotoraya vyvodit vashi lyubimye nastolki detstva na kosmicheskiy uroven.

V dalekom 1999 godu gruppa druzey, vooruzhennaya igralnymi kostyami i naborom unikalnykh umeniy, protivostoit opasnostyam strannoy novoy galaktiki.

title: Chroma Squad [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Chroma Squad — eto takticheskaya RPG o pyati kaskaderakh, reshivshikh sozdat sobstvennoe shou. Vybirayte akterov, pokupayte oborudovanie, sozdavayte oruzhie i robotov. Upravlyayte pyatyu boytsami v zakhvatyvayushchikh poshagovykh srazheniyakh pod pritselom kamer!

• SVOYa TELESTUDIYa!
• ZAKhVATYVAYuShchIE TAKTIChESKIE BOI!
• PRODUMANNAYa ROLEVAYa SISTEMA!
• OGROMNYE ChELOVEKOPODOBNYE ROBOTY!
• NOSTALGIYa PO «MOGUChIM REYNDZhERAM», TOKUSATsU I YaPONSKIM SERIALAM IZ DETSTVA!
• OTLIChNAYa PIKSELNAYa GRAFIKA I RETRO-SAUNDTREK!

title: Fate/Stay Night Remastered [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 俄语 来自 Unlimited Silly Works 用于 v589824
description:
Uchenik starshey shkoly, Emiya Shiro, stanovitsya nevolnym uchastnikom tak nazyvaemoy «voyny Svyatogo Graalya», vremya ot vremeni prokhodyashchey v yaponskom gorode Fuyuki. Eto borba semerykh magov za obladanie legendarnym artefaktom — Svyatym Graalem, kotoryy ispolnit lyuboe zhelanie pobeditelya i, takim obrazom, izmenit ego sudbu. Kazhdyy mag s momenta svoego nachala uchastiya v voyne prizyvaet slugu — odnu iz velikikh geroicheskikh dush proshlogo ili budushchego - srazhayushchegosya na storone svoego khozyaina.
Est sem slug, vse oni prinadlezhat k raznym boevym klassam: mechnik (Seyber), luchnik (Archer), kopeyshchik (Lanser), vsadnik (Rayder), berserker, ubiytsa (Assasin) i mag (Kaster). Bitva vedetsya do tekh por, poka ne ostanetsya odna para mastera i slugi. Emiya Shiro protiv sobstvennoy voli prizyvaet mechnitsu — slugu, postavivshuyu sebe tsel dobratsya do Graalya lyubym putyom. Odnako, on ne zhelaet uchastvovat v bitve, tak kak v proshloy voyne poteryal vsekh svoikh rodnykh.

title: Grim Fandango Remastered [NSZ][RUS (Mod.+Voice)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 俄语 lyubitelskiy 来自 djonmarvel
voice_lang: 英语 + 俄语 lyubitelskiy 来自 7Wolf (primer ozvuchki)
description:
Grim Fandango (s angl. — «Mrachnoe fandango», ispanskiy narodnyy tanets, ispolnyaemyy v pare pod penie fandango v soprovozhdenii gitary i kastanet) — videoigra v zhanre graficheskogo kvesta, sozdannaya i vypushchennaya v 1998 godu dlya Windows kompaniey LucasArts pod rukovodstvom amerikanskogo geymdizaynera Tima Sheyfera.
Mir «Grim Fandango» predstavlyaet iz sebya neobychnuyu smes idey atstekskikh mifov i legend o zagrobnoy zhizni, a takzhe depressivno-pessimistichnogo stilya klassicheskiikh proizvedeniy zhanra «film-nuar» — «Maltiyskiy sokol», «Kasablanka» i «V portu».

title: Lifeless Planet [NSP][RUS (Voice Mod.)/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
voice_lang: 俄语, lyubitelskaya 来自 Gav & Kisel & Poleci (primer ozvuchki)
description:
While seeking life on a distant planet, an astronaut discovers an abandoned Russian town. He suspects his mission is a hoax until a mysterious young woman saves him from a strange and deadly phenomenon.

After a hard landing on the planet, the astronaut discovers the planet that was reported to be rich with life is instead a barren wasteland. When he goes searching for his crew, he makes a more startling discovery: evidence that humans have already been to this planet years ago! When he comes upon a deserted Soviet-era Russian town, he struggles to make sense of his mission. Did his light-speed travel to the planet send him back in time? Or is this all some strange Cold War hoax?

Equipped with a limited-use jet-pack and a mobile robotic arm, the player must use wits and skill to solve puzzles, unravel the mystery, and survive the Lifeless Planet!

title: Trigger Witch [NSZ][ENG]
genre: 冒险, 射击, 动作
description:
《Trigger Witch》不但重現了 16 位元動作冒險經典的視覺風格和直觀玩法，更為可愛、多彩的像素藝術帶來超暴力的反差。本作擁有迷人的原創故事、挑戰腦力的環境探索、充滿活力的配樂、雙搖桿射擊機制和有待你轟成碎片的眾多敵人，是一場會讓你從頭血脈噴張到尾的傳奇。

出自《Reverie》創作團隊的《Trigger Witch》是風格獨特的 2D 雙搖桿動作遊戲，在這個奇特的開放世界裡，魔法已經過時，槍械才是新的生存之道。玩家將扮演 Stock 巫術與槍法學院的優秀畢業生—— Colette。一名神祕男子入侵她的國度後，接連發生的事件使得 Colette 的生活大亂，更讓她成為唯一有足夠火力能恢復和平的女英雌。

特色：

• 以經典的動作冒險風格探索開放的世界！
• 在遊戲過程中運用並升級新的槍械。
• 透過有趣的對話認識各種怪奇的人物。
• 血淋淋地將怪物們轟回他們該待的地方！
• 解開週遭環境中的謎題，巧妙克服各種障礙。
• 可單人遊戲或使用隨加單機多人模式。

title: Path of Giants [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description: Rukovodstvo tremya issledovatelyami; Bern, Matchi i Totch v poiskakh poteryannogo sokrovishcha v ledyanykh peshcherakh i pokrytykh snegom skalakh. Pereklyuchaytes mezhdu issledovatelyami, kogda vy ispolzuete ikh komandnuyu rabotu, chtoby pomoch reshit golovolomki.

title: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers Rita's Rewind [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 机器翻译 来自 most2820
description:
Komanda «Moguchikh reyndzherov» stalkivaetsya so svoim starinnym protivnikom, kotoryy teper prevratilsya v robota. Robot Rita sozdala portal v proshloe, chtoby pomoch svoey molodoy versii unichtozhit reyndzherov. Rita Repulsa i Robot Rita vmeste popytayutsya vernut vremya vspyat i perepisat proshloe, chtoby predotvratit poyavlenie geroev i izmenit khod istorii!..
Poluchitsya li u dvukh Rit i ikh armii monstrov iz vsekh epokh MMPR unichtozhit Moguchikh reyndzherov? Ili eti podrostki s kharakterom nauchatsya rabotat vmeste i razrushat etot prostranstvenno-vremennoy soyuz? Igroki vpervye smogut vernutsya k istokam Morphin Power Rangers... eshchyo raz! Proshloe uzhe nikogda ne budet prezhnim…

title: Tricky Towers + 6 DLC [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
Pora v Tricky Towers vam poigrat,
gde mozhno vovsyu magiyu primenyat!

Blok stavte na blok, budet zhdat vas uspekh.
Uznayte, chya bashnya ustoychivey vsekh.

Pomozhet vam magiya stroit umelo,
no budut meshat vam vragi to i delo.

Srazhaytes s druzyami, chtob stat samym pervym,
No tolko svoi beregite vy nervy.

title: Poker Night at the Inventory [NSP][ENG]
description:
Odinochnaya pokernaya videoigra, razrabotannaya kompaniey Telltale Games. V ney uchastvuyut chetyre personazha: Tikho iz komiksa Penny Arcade, Maks iz franshizy Sam & Max, Pulemyotchik Khevi iz Team Fortress 2, i Strong Bed iz Homestar Runner.
«The Inventory» — eto super-sekretnyy klub, postroennyy pod skladom dlya khraneniya videoigr. On byl sozdan v 1919 godu, posle togo, kak gruppa podklyuchennykh igrokov priobrela pervyy proekt 18-y popravki. Bylo obnaruzheno, chto ona mozhet ne tolko zapreshchat vozliyanie, no i razvlecheniya, kotorye mogut snizit proizvoditelnost natsionalnoy rabochey sily. Klub sushchestvuet s tekh por v tayne, na sluchay, esli Kongress popytaetsya ustanovit zapret v zakone. Vpervye vas privetstvuet Redzhinald Van Uinslou, byvshiy kapitan Krichashchego Narvala, i pomoshchnik Gaybrasha Tripvuda v Tales of Monkey Island. On obyasnyaet predystoriyu inventarya i podnimaet blayndy.
Simulyator tekhasskogo kholdema mezhdu igrokom kak nevidimym uchastnikom i chetyrmya drugimi personazhami. Kazhdyy igrok nachinaet s bay-inom v $10,000 i ostaetsya do tekh por, poka ne razoritsya, tsel igroka — ostatsya poslednim. Tut ispolzuyutsya stavki bez ogranicheniy i postepenno uvelichivayushchiesya slepye stavki v techenie neskolkikh raundov. Sluchayno odin iz chetyrekh personazhey ne smozhet poluchit dengi, no predlozhit odno iz svoikh vladeniy v kachestve bay-ina. Telltale otslezhivaet statistiku v techenie neskolkikh igr, i, vypolniv opredelennye tseli, naprimer, kolichestvo ruk ili vyigrannykh igr mozhno razblokirovat razlichnye karty i risunki stola, chtoby nastroit vneshniy vid.

title: Ritual Crown of Horns [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
Ritual: Crown of Horns – eto nastoyashchaya krovavaya boynya, dinamichnyy ekshn, deystvie kotorogo razvrachivaetsya na alternativnom Dikom Zapade, prevrativshemsya v logovo demonov i filial ada na zemle. Vdokhnovlennaya arkadami igra povestvuet o neobychnom soyuze okhotnika za golovami, kotoryy vozvrashchaetsya s togo sveta s zhazhdoy otomstit svoim ubiytsam, i vedmy, kotoraya pomogaet emu moshchnymi ritualami, a takzhe presleduet sobstvennye tseli. 

Otbivaytes ot polchishch vragov, poka vedma provodit ritual. Vybirayte iz tselogo arsenala oruzhiya i zaklinaniy. Otkryvayte novye instrumenty i mogushchestvennye predmety, kotorye usilyat vashego personazha. Puteshestvuyte po Divnomu Zapadu, podbirayte sebe zadaniya i planiruyte marshrut, chtoby nakonets-to osushchestvit svoyu mest!

Igra Ritual: Crown of Horns osnovana na razvitii navykov - zdes vazhnee bystro reagirovat i prinimat pravilnye resheniya na khodu, chem davit na knopki i bezdumno brosatsya na vragov.

title: West of Dead [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
1888年，懷俄明州，煉獄。
瀰漫硝煙與黑暗，充斥罪惡與詛咒，還有魔物與巫師橫行的地方。變幻莫測的混亂世界因逝去靈魂的記憶、文明或信仰而成形。離魂者甦醒，他的記憶僅有一個穿著黑衣的人影，他即將掀起一連串具有神話色彩的事件。

在節奏明快的雙搖桿射擊遊戲中，你化身為離魂者威廉·梅森（由羅恩·珀爾曼配音），來到灰暗又粗獷的煉獄世界。探索程式生成的未知狩獵場，尋找掩護並擊敗敵人，藉以考驗自己的技能。體驗黑暗到極致的西部荒野世界。

title: Trash Sailors [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
Gigantskiy musornyy tsunami zatopil ves mir! K schastyu, est i khoroshie novosti: teper vokrug plavaet polno besplatnogo musora. Musor - glavnyy resurs v etom novom mire. Pererabatyvayte ego v toplivo i stroymaterialy, a esli okruzhat vragi - gotovte musornyy zalp! Gotovtes srazhatsya s bolotnymi krokodilami, yadovitymi akulami, moroznymi piratami i drugimi opasnostyami musornogo okeana!
• Onlayn i lokalnaya igra dlya 4 igrokov
• Narisovannye vruchnuyu priklyucheniya
• Desyatki morey dlya poiskov sokrovishch!
• Srazhaysya do poslednego kuska musora!

title: Swordbreaker the Game / Sword Breaker Origins [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
description:
Mingaltsy uzhe podstupali k granitsam Dorgana, kogda po tu storonu mosta pokazalas korolevskaya armiya. Sredi soldat v blestyashchikh dospekhakh byl i nash geroy — Mechelom. On dolzhen libo pobedit vmeste so vsemi, libo poterpet pozornoe porazhenie i obrech vsyo korolevstvo na istreblenie.
No vsyo eto nemnogo pozzhe…

A seychas, yunyy iskatel priklyucheniy zhivyot mirnoy zhiznyu i dazhe predstavit ne mozhet, chto zhdet ego vperedi… Strannye sobytiya proiskhodyat na territorii korolevstva Dorgan. Lyudi rasskazyvayut o zagadochnykh strannikakh v severnykh bolotakh; kto-to videl kak s neba padali tainstvennye obekty; drugie lyudi slyshali strannyy gul iz pod zemli. A uzh skolko nevedomykh sushchestv krylos v lesnykh chashchakh i temnykh peshcherakh... Vse eto manilo yunoshu brositsya v puchinu neveroyatnykh priklyucheniy.

Igra rasskazhet o priklyucheniyakh Mecheloma, kotorye proizoshli s nim zadolgo do syuzheta pervoy igry. Kak zhe slozhitsya ego sudba i stanet li on imenno tem samym iskatelem priklyucheniy, kotorogo my znaem? Ili ego zhizn poydet po sovershenno inomu puti? Vse eto budet zaviset tolko ot igroka…

Osobennosti igry:
- Nelineynyy syuzhet
- 8 neveroyatnykh kontsovok igry
- Ogromnye prostory korolevstva dlya issledovaniya
- Mnozhestvo interesnykh mest i situatsiy
- Krasivye komiksnye illyustratsii
- Mini-igry

title: Tales from the Dragon Mountain Dilogy: The Strix, (2) The Lair [NSP][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
Mina Lockheart's dreams became unbearable nightmares. She dreamt about her grandmother Kate and their old family house being eaten by flames. One day, Mina decided to travel back to their family estate to make peace with her own memories and feelings of loss and loneliness. 
But after she arrived, not even in her wildest dreams she could imagine what will happen and where the events will take her. What started as a simple trip of search for inner peace, turned out to be the greatest, unimaginable adventure of her life!

- Discover the truth about your grandmother's past
- Explore many unique fantasy locations
- Meet mythical creatures like homely, pixies and more
- Dozens of interesting puzzles to solve
- Beautiful graphics and fantasy atmosphere

title: Minami Lane [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 俄语 mashinnyy 来自 most2820
description:
《南之町》是款迷你療癒經營遊戲，你可以創造並管理日式和風街道，讓大家過得開心，並觀察居民的馳放生活！享受2-4小時的輕鬆遊戲，並跟超萌的狸貓和貓咪互動！

打造夢想街道
先在街道蓋房子吸引居民入住，然後建造各種商店和休閒場所，徹底美化周遭環境，讓大家過得幸福愉快！你可以經營拉麵店、珍奶店、書店等店面，帶來獨一無二的商品與影響。

自主經營商店
配搭美美花束，提供Ｋ歌體驗，運用各種賣點吸引顧客上門！你必須仔細經營商店，推出價格合宜的理想商品，才能帶領商店邁向成功，促進社區的蓬勃發展。

觀察居民日常
新的一天開始後，居民會陸續出現在街道上，除了彼此互動，也會為你提供建設性的建議，幫助你完善環境！你可以記下他們的偏好，然後隔天繼續改善這個社區。

達成任務目標
當你完成任務，將可解鎖全新挑戰、建築、居民類型與其他意外驚喜。

《南之町》的主打特色：
2-4小時的療癒遊戲
隨心打造自己的可愛街道
經營商店，調整品項、配方與定價
善用策略，完成每個關卡的任務目標
清理垃圾，維持街道潔淨
狸貓和貓咪出沒！

《南之町》不會有：
燒腦策略挑戰
多人模式
一大堆任務
發行後追加新關卡

進行《南之町》的任務時，你必須有策略地規劃每一天，利用隨機事件等要素，設法完成各項目標。

沙盒模式旨在提供饒富創意的輕鬆體驗，讓你沉浸在愜意宜人的模擬世界，徹底擺脫任務帶來的壓力。

title: RWBY Arrowfell [NSZ][ENG]
description:
【故事】
在北方大陸「索利塔斯」執行任務的RWBY部隊的4人。
他們在那被捲入了覆蓋整個大陸的陰謀。

為了守護「擎天王國」面臨危機的人們，
露比、懷絲、布蕾克和陽一起對抗新的敵人──　

【遊戲內容】
■補充原作的故事 & 收錄新的動畫！
本作品是延續《RWBY Volume 7》的外傳。
包含了金牌特工或索利塔斯居民的對話等內容，擴張了RWBY世界觀的原創故事。
除了熟悉的角色們以及神秘的獵人「BRIR部隊」等，還有本作品獨有的原創角色也會登場！
故事是由原作製作團隊撰寫，並由原作配音員錄製語音，千萬別錯過只能在本遊戲中才能欣賞到的動畫。

■探索好有趣！2D動作冒險遊戲
本作品是由側面視角進行的2D動作遊戲。
RWBY部隊的4位隊員可以自由交換，活用各自的外像力，對抗多樣化的敵人和障礙物。
「探索索利塔斯大陸」、「利用外像力來解決謎題」、「強化外像力與技能」、「與大型BOSS戰鬥」等，使用精彩豐富的要素，製作出充滿趣味的遊戲。

■本作品獨有的藝術風格與音效！
本作不僅保留了原作特色，還呈現了可愛又繽紛的藝術風格，當然，這也是由原作動畫團隊監製！  
另外，從雄壯音樂類型到人聲流行音樂系列，各式各樣的BGM，為遊戲添加了更多的樂趣。
在與動畫些微不同的美麗世界觀之中，享受冒險的樂趣吧！

title: Psychotic's MechaNika / Agatha Knife [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Otpravtes v zakhvatyvayushchee priklyuchenie vmeste s Agatoy, devochkoy, razryvayushcheysya mezhdu lyubovyu k zhivotnym i ikh myasu. S ney vam predstoit poznat religiyu i sozdat svoyu - "myasoedenie", daby ubedit zhivotnykh, chto samopozhertvovanie est sekret vechnogo schastya.

- Sozdayte sobstvennuyu religiyu kusochek za kusochkom v neveroyatno krasochnom mire, narisovannom ot ruki.
- Razreshayte protivorechivye voprosy, glyadya na nikh glazami rebyonka v satiricheskoy istorii, kotoraya zavedyot vas v tyomnye ugolki povsednevnoy zhizni.
- Vzaimodeystvuyte s razlichnymi personazhami psikhopaticheskoy vselennoy i uznavayte ikh istorii v khode svoego priklyucheniya.
- Issleduyte bezumnyy mir i razblokiruyte okolo tridtsati taynykh dostizheniy.
- Igrayte, kak vam udobno, legko pereklyuchayas mezhdu upravleniem s sensornogo ekrana i s kontrollera.

title: Wintermoor Tactics Club [NSZ][RUS/Multi5]
genre: Role-Playing, Adventure, Board Game, Visual Novel
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
Wintermoor Tactics Club — eto istoriya o borbe starsheklassnikov s obstoyatelstvami, geympley kotoroy vdokhnovlen takticheskimi RPG i vizualnymi romanami.

U Alisii, uchenitsy znamenitoy Akademii Vintermur, i bez togo mnogo problem, a tut eshche i turnir po snezhkam nachalsya! Teper chleny ee kluba vo chto by to ni stalo dolzhny iz zauchek prevratitsya v boytsov.

Raskroy taynu, menyayushchuyu realnost. Potreniruy strategicheskie navyki v srazheniyakh s yarkimi personazhami. I postaraysya zavesti druzey!

● Raskroy svoy potentsial: issleduy sposobnosti 7 igrovykh personazhey i mnozhestvo dostupnykh dlya razblokirovki uluchsheniy — vperedi bolee 40 srazheniy!
● Poznakomsya so shkoloy: uznay bolshe o shkole Vintermur v etoy igre, postroennoy po printsipu vizualnogo romana. Preodoley vrazhdebnost mezhdu slozhivshimisya v shkole gruppami, k primeru Detektivami-ekstrasensami i Yunymi monarkhistami.
● Zavedi novykh druzey: pishi igrovye kampanii, syuzhet kotorykh pomozhet novym uchastnikam kluba spravitsya s problemami i srodnitsya so svoimi geroyami.

title: Avilion Forever [NSZ][ENG]
description:
2004年登場並廣受歡迎的經典手機遊戲《魔法學園AVILION》於 Nintendo Switch™ 復活！
本作已重製為無需連接伺服器、可隨時輕鬆遊玩的單人專用RPG。

除了忠實保留當年的圖像與音效，更加入了當時未實裝的部分素材，並針對單人遊玩進行了絕佳的平衡調整，是為本作特別打造的Special Version！
本作收錄了故事迎來重大轉折的第1章至第7章內容。（後續章節的DLC目前正在評估中。）

敬請享受這充滿懷舊與溫暖氣息的像素風RPG世界！

■ 這是什麼樣的遊戲？
這是一款容易上手的回合制角色扮演遊戲。
最大的特色在於「虛擬形象租借系統（Avatar Rental）」與「行動欄位系統（Action Slot）」！
玩家首先要創建自己的分身並入學。故事中沒有固定的隊伍，你可以從數百名充滿個性的學生中自由挑選冒險夥伴。
戰鬥時，將使用裝備在「行動欄位」上的技能與魔法來對抗怪物。由於欄位數量有限，該學習並裝備什麼技能？該選擇什麼樣的夥伴？只需單手操作的簡單玩法中，蘊含著深奧的戰略性。
此外，還有讓人欲罷不能的迷宮自動繪圖、隱藏在迷宮某處可獲得稀有道具的「古老寶箱」，以及收集硬幣來挑戰強敵「魔神」等豐富有趣的要素！
故事從學園裡的日常小事展開，從第2章開始將前往世界各地解決各種事件。每個章節都有獨立的起承轉合與強大的Boss等待著你，彷彿每個章節都是一款完整的RPG。

■ 最新情報
・原野地圖支援3D顯示！
・擴充倉庫的道具收納上限！
・夥伴的技能更加多樣化，玩家投稿活動的角色也將登場！
・支援提升移動與戰鬥速度！
・調整經驗值、道具掉落率、遇敵率等，讓單人遊玩體驗更加順暢。

■ 與原版的差異
▼ 以單人RPG為前提的平衡性調整
・可選擇的分身顏色從4色增加到8色！
・降低升級難度，讓遊戲節奏更加明快。
・提升擊倒敵人時獲得道具的機率。
・提升從古老寶箱獲得武器防具的機率。
・提升召喚魔神所需硬幣的掉落率，並減少需求數量。
・每日限定1次的課程與古老寶箱等重置時間，增加為每日4次【4時、10時、16時、22時】！

▼ 因應離線化而廢除的功能
・訊息功能／個人信箱
・好友功能／社團功能
・租借其他玩家的分身／冒險日記
・拍賣所

▼ 以虛擬玩家資料進行角色租借
雖然無法再將其他真實玩家的分身加入隊伍，但遊戲內建了數百名虛擬玩家分身！
在「AVILION玩家登場活動」中投稿的玩家分身也會在遊戲中登場，讓您在單人RPG中也能體驗到多人連線遊玩的氛圍。

官方網站除了提供各種情報外，還刊載了遊戲Q&A以及第1、2章的任務攻略。歡迎在冒險時多加利用。
https://www.avilion.jp/en

【 購買前請注意 】
※ 本遊戲不支援繁體中文。
※ 遊戲本篇僅供日文與英文遊玩。

title: Barony + DLC Myths and Outcasts, Legends & Pariahs [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + optsionalnyy 翻译 用于 v524288
description:
Issleduyte podzemelya v odinochku ili s gruppoy iz 4-kh igrokov v kooperativnom multipleere: razdelennyy ekran, lokalnaya besprovodnaya set ili onlayn s kross-platformennoy igroy!

Rogalik-elementy – bessmertie, zagadochnye podzemelya i otsutstvie podskazok

13 ekzoticheskikh i simvolichnykh klassov, kotorye sovershenstvuyutsya v tom, chem oni zanimayutsya, ispolzuya otkrytuyu sistemu navykov

Syurprizy na kazhdom shagu, gotovye ubit vas ili byt pokorennymi po mere vashego sovershenstvovaniya

Glubokie sistemy rolevykh igr s bolshim kolichestvom dobychi i statistiki dlya analiza i sovmestnogo ispolzovaniya

Mnozhestvo priklyuchencheskogo oruzhiya, snaryazheniya, lora i zaklinaniy

Ocharovatelnyy stil iskusstva, nasmeshlivyy yumor i paskhalnye yaytsa

Barony poluchaet regulyarnye besplatnye obnovleniya ot aktivnoy komandy!
Barony – eto pamyatka o klassicheskikh rolevykh igrakh, takikh kak Ultima Underworld, System Shock i Daggerfall, sozdannaya poklonnikami etikh klassicheskikh igr.

Syuzhet:
Khemlet – velichayshiy malenkiy gorod v mire. Ili po krayney mere byl, poka otvratitelnyy Baron Kherks ne prishel i ne obyavil ego svoim baronstvom. On porabotil zhiteley Khemleta i teper stal otvratitelnym nezhityu-lichem. Ves gorod okazalsya zapertym v ego ogromnom podzemele na desyatiletiya, i teper na odnogo geroya ili gruppu iskateley priklyucheniy vozlozhena zadacha vstretit ego v ego adskoy logove i razrushit navsegda. Pogibnete li vy v podzemelyakh ili vosstanete k pobede nad Baronom i ego porozhdeniyami ada – vse zavisit ot vas. Chto nashel Baron Kherks v Khemlete, i budet li ego ubiystvo dostatochnym?

title: Everybody's Golf Hot Shots [NSP][ENG]
description:
Berites za klyushku i vykhodite na pole — khoroshey igry!.. Vsemi lyubimaya igra o golfe s milymi devushkami nakonets poluchila svoyo prodolzhenie.
Fervey zovyot! Vybirayte sredi mnozhestva privlekatelnykh personazhey i poley dlya golfa.

title: Easy Come Easy Golf [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
持續製作高爾夫遊戲的CLAP HANZ，最新作品首次於Nintendo Switch™登場！

可單獨享受或與他人共享高爾夫的樂趣。
在主要模式的巡迴模式中，一邊遊玩比賽，一邊收集角色、服裝、球場吧。
每個球場都會記錄比賽狀態，把更新最佳成績當作挑戰目標吧。

連線上網後，還可以遊玩世界大會與線上對戰。
世界大會每週會舉辦1次，是設有固定規則的大會，可與全世界的玩家以成績一較高下。
透過線上對戰，隨時都能與全世界的對手比賽。
此外，還能建立設有密碼的對戰房，與朋友進行比賽。

title: Projection First Light [NSZ][RUS/Multi13]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 13]
description:
Projection: First Light rasskazyvaet o priklyucheniyakh devochki po imeni Greta, kotoraya zhivet v tainstvennom mire kukol, igrayushchikh v teatre teney. Ona otpravlyaetsya v puteshestvie v soprovozhdenii legendarnykh geroev kultur, kotorye ona izuchaet.
 
 Atmosfernaya grafika i potustoronniy saundtrek, sygrannyy na antikvarnykh instrumentakh, kotorye ispolzovalis v predstavleniyakh kukolnykh teatrov teney, delayut igru Projection: First Light poistine unikalnoy. Igrokam predstoit otpravitsya v puteshestvie i izuchit istoriyu kukolnykh teatrov teney, pobyvav v Indonezii, Kitae, Turtsii i Anglii XIX veka.
 
 Na rannikh etapakh svoego puteshestviya Greta zavladevaet istochnikom sveta i ponimaet, chto sposobna im upravlyat. Teni stanovyatsya platformami i stenami, elegantnye i neobychnye resheniya pomogayut prolit svet na golovolomki, a vragov mozhno rasseyat. V igre Projection: First Light issleduyutsya temy zhiteyskikh zabot, uvazheniya i ponimaniya.

title: Icey [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 俄语 lyubitelskiy 来自 djonmarvel
description:
ICEY is a 2D side-scrolling action game. As you follow the narrator's omnipresent voice, you will see through ICEY's eyes and learn the truth about her world. 

“Alright, you caught me! This ISN'T really just a simple 2D action game, and you WON'T be seeing through ICEY's eyes... NOR will you learn the truth about her world." says the narrator. 

“ICEY is a Meta game in disguise. The narrator will constantly urge you in one direction, but you must ask, "Why? Why am I following his directions? Why can't I learn the truth about this world and ICEY's purpose here?" Fight against his tyranny, and uncover what's really going on for yourself!

In fact, you can become ICEY, and let loose the shackles of your own identity. You are ICEY, and ICEY is you... if you want it that way. Feel free to keep hold of your own self, if you wish. 

Now Is the Time For You to Discover the Truth.

You See? ICEY, I See!

title: Haven Park [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
「親愛的，我越來越老了，再也無法照料公園了…你願意幫幫我，讓這個地方重現朝氣嗎？」

成為弗林特，這位盡心盡力維護並經營奶奶的公園的主角，要讓公園成為適合露營者享樂的地方。了解露營者們的願望，建造他們內心期望的東西，來吸引更多稀奇古怪的角色，並引導出天馬行空的對話和任務。

認識露營者們，了解更多發生在森林附近的古老故事。有人提到遺落的寶藏嗎？

Haven Park是個放鬆、享樂並創造自己所需的地方！

主要特色
‧ 探索小型且安樂的開放性世界，按照自己的步伐建造舒適的營地

‧ 認識許多迷人的角色，了解他們的需求，讓他們愛上Haven Park

title: HammerHelm (Hammer Helm) [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
因為相信矮人也可以在地面生活，你被故鄉放逐——於是你決定建造一座全新的城鎮，吸引有相同想法的矮人前來定居。

title: Under Night In-birth Exe Late Cl-r [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Pravte nochyu! Upravlyayte samym glubokim i temnym boevym iskusstvom, kogda-libo vidennym prezhde. Srazhaytes 21-im unikalnym personazhem, vklyuchaya sovershenno novogo s originalnymi dvizheniyami, istoriey, stsenoy i muzykoy. Vy stanete masterom razrushitelnykh kombo i oslepitelnykh spetsialnykh atak v rezhimakh arkady, istorii i obucheniya. Komanduyte boytsami s razlichnymi metodami drak, demonstriruya bolee 12 000 potryasayushchikh kadrov animatsii!
Sovershenstvuyte svoy boevoy stil s pomoshchyu pochti 1000 nastroek balansa personazha!..
Deystvie igry razvorachivaetsya v vymyshlennom sovremennom XXI veke. Yavlenie Poloy nochi okhvatyvaet otdelnye rayony odin raz v mesyats v techenie neskolkikh stoletiy. Kazhdaya oblast, okhvachennaya Poloy nochyu, okruzhena tenepodobnymi sushchestvami, nazyvaemymi Pustotami, kotorye ispolzuyut i pitayutsya siloy, izvestnoy kak «Sushchestvovanie». Normalnye lyudi ne mogut videt ili vstupat v kontakt s Pustotami, no nekotorye vsyo zhe mogut ikh vosprinimat..Vtoruyu chast, «UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH II Sys:Celes» sm. tut.

title: Grip [NSP][ENG]
description:
GORYaChEE OBNOVLENIE! TEPER V GRIP EST ANTIGRAVITATsIONNYE MAShINY! Vyberite mashinu i dominiruyte na trasse, kogda tyazhelobronirovannye katki vpervye sorevnuyutsya s futuristichnymi airblade'ami, v GRIP — VELIChAYShIKh BOEVYKh GONKAKh!  

Upravlyay zakonami gravitatsii, stan obladatelem vnushitelnogo arsenala unikalnogo oruzhiya i pogruzhaysya s GRIP v samye bystrye i samye goryachie gonki. Vzletay na steny, potolki, - lyubye poverkhnosti, po kotorym mogut nestis kolesa tvoego gonshchika...posle togo, kak osvoish manyashchie trassy, sekrety vozhdeniya i umopomrachitelnye tryuki na svoem puti cherez Galaktiku. 

• Srazhaytes v setevom ili lokalnom komandnom rezhimakh!
• Maksimalnaya skorost do 767 m/ch s vozmozhnostyu gonyat po lyubym poverkhnostyam - po polu, stenam i potolkam
• Marshrut gonki prolegaet po 29 trassam cherez 4 dikovinnye planety
• Vozmozhnost poluchit 9 uskoriteley i boekomplekt - ot shchitov i turbin do raket i vzryvnykh strel.
• Sorevnuytes s konkurentami na avtonomnom razdelennom ekrane s onlayn-multipleerom
• Operezhay vremya v 19 karkurnykh zaezdakh s prepyatstviyami.
• Vozmozhnost vybora iz 30 vidov bronirovannykh avtomobiley po svoemu vkusu

title: Under Night In-birth II (2) Sys Celes + 5 DLC [NSP][ENG]
description:
Novaya zakhvatyvayushchaya chast epicheskoy sagi Under Night In Birth podnimaetsya iz bezdny! Uluchshennaya grafika i boevaya sistema! Stante svidetelem togo, kak opuskaetsya zanaves istorii o Poloy Nochi, borites za prevoskhodstvo v zakhvatyvayushchikh boyakh i glubokoy boevoy sisteme!
Sis: Seles priblizhaetsya k gibeli. Dlya Uvekovechennykh na gorizonte mayachit krakh vsego sushchego. Zanaves podnimaetsya nad posledney glavoy «Pustoy nochi». Katastrofa nadvigaetsya...

title: Death End reQuest / Death End re Quest 2 [NSZ][ENG]
description:
'Death end re;Quest – klassicheskaya poshagovaya rolevaya igra, perevernutaya s nog na golovu. U vas budet vozmozhnost po zhelaniyu pereklyuchatsya mezhdu rolevym ekshenom v virtualnom mire i vdumchivym izucheniem graficheskoy novelly o mire realnom.

Versiya igry dlya Nintendo Switch™ vklyuchaet v sebya vse besplatnye i platnye dopolneniya, iznachalno dostupnye v predydushchikh versiyakh, a takzhe kontent, ranee dostupnyy tolko v yaponskoy versii.

Syuzhet

Programmist videoigr Arata Midzunasi poluchaet elektronnoe pismo ot svoey kollegi Sini Ninomii, kotoraya propala okolo goda nazad. V proshlom oni vmeste rabotali nad sozdaniem World’s Odyssey (W.O.D.) – uvlekatelnogo virtualnogo mira, opirayushchegosya na velikolepnuyu i edinstvennuyu v svoem rode tekhnologiyu. Po krayney mere tak bylo, poka Sina ne ischezla pryamo v razgare raboty. V protsesse rassledovaniya Arata vyyasnyaet, chto Sina Ninomiya vse eto vremya byla zaperta vnutri W.O.D. Togda on s golovoy pogruzhaetsya v strochki koda zabroshennogo proekta i vskore vyyasnyaet, chto igru navodnili oshibki, a Sina – ee edinstvennyy aktivnyy polzovatel.

Kak zhe malo oni znayut o tom, kakie uzhasy podzhidayut po obe storony ekrana...

Klyuchevye osobennosti 

Izuchayte realnyy mir v formate graficheskoy novelly, chtoby razgadat taynu World Odyssey, ili pogruzites v virtualnyy mir dlya issledovaniya ego podzemeliy. Kazhdoe reshenie, prinyatoe v lyubom iz dvukh rezhimov, okazhet vliyanie na to, komu predstoit vyzhit, i kto smozhet raskryt mrachnye tayny World’s Odyssey.

Poshagovaya boevaya sistema pozvolit igrokam svobodno peremeshchatsya i srazhatsya. «Ottalkivayte» vragov v napravlenii sten i tovarishchey po komande dlya realizatsii sumasshedshikh kombo. Perelomite khod bitvy, polnostyu smeniv zhanr. Ispolzuyte «polevye oshibki», raskidannye vokrug, chtoby povysit uroven Corruption – klyuchevogo pokazatelya dlya perekhoda v rezhim Glitch Mode!  

World’s Odyssey gotova privetstvovat iskateley priklyucheniy v portativnom rezhime dlya Nintendo Switch™! Novichki i veterany serii smogut pogruzitsya v pervuyu versiyu giperrealistichnogo igrovogo mira, dopolnennogo vsemi besplatnymi i platnymi nadstroykami dlya predydushchikh versiy, vklyuchaya dopolnitelnogo personazha Ripuku!

title: I Was a Teenage Exocolonist [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Ty — eto sdelannyy toboy vybor

Yunost v pervoy chelovecheskoy kolonii za predelami solnechnoy sistemy — eto vozmozhnost uvidet novyy mir, polnyy chudes, opasnostey i krasoty. Issleduyte neizvestnuyu prirodu, uchites, vlyublyaytes, nakhodite neobychnykh sushchestv i stalkivaytes s posledstviyami sobstvennogo vybora. Ot vashikh resheniy napryamuyu zavisyat kak zhizni vashikh druzey, tak i sudba vsey kolonii. Kakoy mir vy postroite? Smozhete li voobshche vyzhit? I pochemu vam kazhetsya, chto nechto podobnoe uzhe proiskhodilo?

Stanovlenie cheloveka na chuzhoy planete

U vas vperedi tselaya zhizn. Posvyatite li vy ee obucheniyu v shkole ili issledovaniyu neznakomoy, no prityagatelnoy flory i fauny? Izobretete li vy novye kosmicheskie tekhnologii ili budete zhit v garmonii s prirodoy? Budete li srazhatsya s gigantskimi chudishchami ili vospityvat budushchie pokoleniya? Akvarelnyy mir Vertumny zhdet vas.

I proshloe, i budushchee odinakovo vazhny

Vse, chemu vy uchites, vse, chto s vami sluchaetsya, delaet vas i vashu koloniyu silnee. Vas zhdut i vzlety, i padeniya. Vazhnye momenty stanovleniya (vospominaniya, resheniya, otnosheniya) stanut kollektsionnymi kartami, kotorye vy smozhete nosit s soboy. S kazhdym sezonom budut poyavlyatsya novye prepyatstviya. Boevye karty, kotorye vy budete poluchat s opytom, pomogut vam preodolet pregrady v otnosheniyakh, obuchenii, issledovanii planety ili vyzhivanii. Kazhdoe reshenie sygraet rol — v etoy zhizni ili v sleduyushchey.

Skolko u vas budet zhizney?

Kosmos khranit v sebe mnozhestvo tayn. I vasha sposobnost pomnit proshlye zhizni — odna iz nikh. Vasha istoriya mozhet zavershitsya kak ugodno. Tak skolko zhe vam ponadobitsya zhizney, chtoby spasti i koloniyu, i planetu? Nu chto, vy gotovy roditsya zanovo?

title: The Murder Hotel [NSZ][ENG]
description:
《The Murder Hotel》是一款互動式謀殺謎題冒險遊戲，其最大反轉在於：持剪惡魔才是真兇，而你必須嫁禍給某位人類飯店客人，編造出他們作案的合理推論。

惡魔雖是真兇，但每樁命案都必須用人類手段解釋。 你敢接受挑戰嗎？

揭開連環兇案的真相，終結這場血腥殺戮。

遊戲包含14位人類住客與數名惡魔角色，各具背景故事與黑暗秘密。

透過紙片文字的提示蒐集線索，重組句子，用以審問嫌疑犯。

每場審判存在多重勝訴路徑與理論。 你能全部發現嗎？

title: Inmost [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
Naydite vykhod iz sumrachnykh labirintov inomirya v etom kinematografichnom priklyuchencheskom platformere.

Vzglyanite na zhutkovato-prekrasnuyu pikselnuyu vselennuyu glazami trekh raznykh geroev, svyazannykh odnoy pugayushchey istoriey...

Izuchayte mrachnyy polurazrushennyy mir, prorubaytes skvoz polchishcha vragov, ustanavlivayte smertelnye lovushki – tolko tak vy smozhete vyrvatsya iz lap zla, kotoroe terpelivo zhdet svoego chasa...
