title: Panda Punch [NSP][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
Panda Punch — platformer-golovolomka, v kotoroy vam predstoit upravlyat bionicheskoy vooruzhennoy krasnoy pandoy i spasti mir ot zlykh inoplanetnykh robotov.

Po puti vy budete reshat golovolomki na urovnyakh, sobirat monety, iskat supermonety i povyshat svoi sposobnosti s pomoshchyu kuznetsa. Prigotovtes pobedit ustrashayushchikh bossov i poluchit novye innovatsionnye sposobnosti. 58 urovney napichkany lovushkami, sekretami i vragami, tak chto est chto issledovat i otkryvat.

Smozhete li vy ispolzovat svoi navyki, chtoby pomoch etoy krasnoy pande stat geroem?


Kharakteristiki:
* Razblokiruemye novye sposobnosti dlya bionicheskoy ruki
* 58 urovney s lovushkami, sekretami i vragami
* Klassicheskaya pikselnaya grafika
* Muzyka v stile chiptyun

title: Lumberhill [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Komanda lesorubov otchayanno pytaetsya vypolnit svoyu rabotu, no bukvalno vse vokrug stavit im palki v kolesa. Vypolnyayte zakazy, ukladyvaytes v sroki, tushite pozhary, srazhaytes s piratami i vrednymi obezyankami! Puteshestvuyte v prostranstve i vremeni, igraya v odinochku, s druzyami ili protiv nikh!
Lesoruby protiv khaosa — topory natocheny, komanda nagotove, rubashki otglazheny! Vse sily prirody obedinilis protiv vas, i edinstvennyy put k pobede — slazhennaya komandnaya rabota. V etoy bezumnoy gonke so vremenem vam nado valit les i zagonyat skotinu v khlev... Zvuchit prosto? Akh da, my zabyli skazat pro meteority, dinozavrov i samu matushku-prirodu, gotovykh ostanovit vas lyuboy tsenoy. Vremya ogranicheno, tak chto prokladyvayte nestandartnye marshruty, rabotayte soobshcha, a glavnoe — budte gotovy ko vsemu!
Cherez prostranstvo i vremya! Esli gde-to vyroslo derevo, lesorubu vsegda est rabota. Eto neveroyatnoe puteshestvie privedet vas v samye raznye epokhi i ugolki Zemli — i ne tolko! Chem dalshe vy prodvinetes, tem bolshe vstretite novykh dekoratsiy, unikalnykh sobytiy i igrovykh mekhanik. Vas budut zhdat novye zhivotnye: bolshie i malenkie, milye i ne ochen — odnikh zakhochetsya potiskat, a ot drugikh spryatatsya v kustakh. V obshchem, skuchat ne pridetsya! A chtoby na pamyat ostalis zabavnye skrinshoty, my prigotovili mnozhestvo smeshnykh oblikov dlya personazhey.

title: Welcome to Empyreum [NSP][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Predstavte otel, gde ekshen sochetaetsya so strategicheskoy simulyatsiey i yarkimi personazhami, vrode otchayavsheysya mamashi Miriam, vezuchey devushki Elizabet, samovlyublyonnogo bloggera Tommi i vpavshego v depressiyu muzykanta Apolo. Vas zhdyot puteshestvie v zakoldovannoe mesto!..
Chtoby vernut utrachennoe, personazhi pod vashim rukovodstvom dolzhny porabotat na kazhdom etazhe otelya «Empirei», poka ne doberutsya do kabineta direktrisy Beatrisy. Predstoit ne tolko stelit posteli i pylesosit — vstrechaetsya i smeshnaya rabota: nyanchitsya s inoplanetnymi mladentsami, begat ot prizrakov, okurivat khishchnye rasteniya i kormit mishek Gammi zheleykoy.
Luchshie osobennosti komandnykh igr proyavlyayutsya v «Empirei», zakoldovannom otele, gde vsyo vremya tvoritsya chto-to neveroyatnoe. Koordinatsiya i svyaz mezhdu chlenami komandy vazhnee vsego dlya sokhraneniya poryadka i kontrolya nad vspyshkam bezumiya.
Zabroniruyte nomer, chtoby sygrat v odinochku, ili pozovite 3 svoikh druzey, chtoby sygrat vmeste!

title: Josh Journey Darkness Totems [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Josh Journey: Darkness Totems — eto narisovannaya ot ruki igra beat’em up o chetyrekh khrabrykh geroyakh, kotorye ispolzuyut svoi navyki, chtoby pobedit Koshmarnykh monstrov, ispolzuya spetsialnye kombo-ataki v kooperativnom igrovom protsesse.

Mir Provintsii kishit koshmarnymi monstrami iz Mira Snov. Ten Tmy, sushchnost, kontroliruyushchaya Temnuyu storonu Snov, posylaet svoikh sushchestv i vnedryaet Totemy Tmy, chtoby kontrolirovat chetyre osnovnye provintsii: Veter, Voda, Pustynya i Promyshlennost. Osnovnaya zadacha nashikh geroev - borotsya s etimi zlymi silami, unichtozhaya Totemy, chtoby vernut mir i garmoniyu v svoy Mir.

Kazhdyy geroy v Josh Journey obladaet unikalnymi navykami: atakovat litsom k litsu, ispolzuya mech ili molot, ili atakovat na rasstoyanii, ispolzuya magiyu ili strelbu. Vy mozhete vybirat mezhdu chetyrmya geroyami vo vremya lokalnoy igry s druzyami!

- Bystro menyayte geroev vo vremya igry, obespechivaya moshchnye kombo v boyu!

- Vse personazhi s traditsionnoy 2D risovannoy animatsiey!

- Sozdayte dosku sposobnostey, chtoby sovershat spetsialnye ataki vo vremya srazheniy.

- Issleduyte krasivye i bolshie prostranstva s otlichnym parallaksom v raznykh provintsiyakh, naprimer
Veter, voda, pustynya i promyshlennost.

- Ogromnyy nabor milykh i zhutkikh vragov s raznym povedeniem i atakami.

- Epicheskie srazheniya s Bolshimi Bossami.

title: Reaper Tale of a Pale Swordsman [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Stante Chernym mechnikom i sokrushite tysyachi vragov v epicheskoy ekshen-RPG!

★ Vypolnyayte beschislennye zadaniya, raskryvayushchie sekrety Debrey.
★ Vybirayte umeniya dlya usileniya svoego personazha.
★ Ispolzuyte sotni mechey, elementov broni i aksessuarov.
★ Podderzhivayte raznye storony, prinimaya svoi sobstvennye resheniya.

title: Rotund Rebound / Zero / Takeoff [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Temnoy morkovke vynesen prigovor. Zaprygivayte v krolichyu noru i derzhites krepche. Epicheskiy retro-platformer, gde tebe pridetsya pogruzitsya v koshmarnye miry i povstrechat prichudlivykh sushchestv na svoem puti, spasaya druzey i pobezhdaya tmu!

- Upravlenie takoe prostoe, chto mozhno srazu nachinat igrat s udovolstviem. A zatem vas zhdet pochti beskonechnoe chislo tryukov i ulovok, kotorye sdelayut vas nastoyashchim masterom.
- Issleduyte zhivye interaktivnye karty s raznoobraznymi zonami i mnozhestvom putey.
- Spasayte svoikh pukhlykh priyateley, igrayte za nikh i ispolzuyte ikh osobye sposobnosti.
- Beytes s opasnymi bossami. Pri etom edinstvennoe vashe oruzhie – pryzhki.
- Zabud pro rezhimy slozhnosti! Kazhdyy uroven mozhno proyti tremya raznymi sposobami: legkim, obychnym ili slozhnym.
- Na tshchatelno prorabotannykh urovnyakh, sozdannye dlya skorostnykh zabegov, vashi rezultaty sokhranyayutsya s tochnostyu do millisekund.
- Mgnovennoe vozrozhdenie ne ostavit vremeni na razdumya i perezhivaniya.
- Saundtrek ot Dzharrela Lanchestera s elementami chiptyuna pomozhet pogruzitsya v atmosferu krasochnogo retro-priklyucheniya.

title: Ampersat [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Ampersat - eto shuter, slesher, RPG igra, v kotoroy sochetayutsya elementy retro i sovremennost. Ampersat - eto sozdannoe vruchnuyu priklyuchenie, no privlekatelnoe dlya poklonnikov Roguelite. Trud i lyubov ot razrabotchika-odinochki, Ampersat prevrashchaet nekotorye lyubimye detskie igry v svezhiy, veselyy gibrid, v kotorom vy ubivaete mnozhestvo monstrov, nakhodite mnogo dobychi, osvobozhdaete zakhvachennye pisma (mmm, chto?) I vyrastaete iz ustavshego ot mira maga-voina v moshchnuyu sokrushitelnuyu mashinu!

Glavnye Osobennosti: 
- Bolee 50 urovney, sozdannykh vruchnuyu, kotorye vam predstoit issledovat poputno reshaya golovolomki.
- Beskonechnaya protsedurnaya oblast
- Originalnye elementy igrovogo protsessa, osnovannye na osvobozhdenii i zakhvate bukv
- Gibkoe razvitie personazha s obshirnym derevom navykov
- Nakhodite, pokupayte, prodavayte i uluchshayte sotni unikalnykh predmetov dobychi
- Prokachivaemyy gorodskoy khab
- Vypolnyayte urovni v vybrannom vami poryadke
- 50 unikalnykh tipov sushchestv s individualnym AI, 10 glavnykh bossov

title: Glitch's Trip [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
A PLANET'S LAST HOPE
Glitch is chilling at his favorite local haunt when he sees something impossible in the sky: his home planet’s moons seem to be hemorrhaging life-giving Moon Juice—and what are those giant breweries sucking it all up? If Glitch doesn’t find out what’s going on and put a stop to it soon, all of the Moon Juice will be siphoned away and his own world won’t survive . Take control of the lovable hero in an action-packed, twitch-paced platformer that’s equal parts relentless and charming.

EXPLORE THE MOONS
Travel around planet Verdo’s four unique moons, each boasting extravagant environments and trippy themes. With 100 handcrafted levels, there’s a lot to experience.

WATCH OUT
Explosive platforms, snipers, gravity wells, charging brutes, lava, lasers, spikes, and so much more. With over 40 unique hazards and 16 killer enemies, you’ll never run out of danger.

GLITCH OUT
Glitch has a unique ability to get out of crazy near-death situations through becoming intangible. Use the ability to affect the environment in wild ways through toggling hidden blocks, flipping gravity, or making areas weightless.

EPIC BOSSES
4 epic bosses stand in your way to save Verdo. Liberate each moon from the tyrant occupying it and unlock the story of how they were corrupted by Moon Juice many years ago.

NO NEED TO WAIT
The four moons are dangerous environments but nothing will deter Glitch from saving his planet. Instant respawns and fast load times make it easier to get you back into the game and improve your progress.

THE RIGHT CHALLENGE
We designed the game to be challenging but with 3 standards of difficulty, you can progress Glitch through our challenges at your own pace. Mastered Glitch's ability? Raise the stakes, play on our highest difficulty and top the leaderboards!

title: Mighty Goose [NSP][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
跨越銀河並趕盡所有邪惡!關於一隻獎金獵鵝的故事，就在宇宙爆發未見其鵝先聞其聲。

「Mighty Goose暴走大鵝」是以射擊動作遊戲為主,玩家要運用技能,時間和反射神經闖關冒險。基本系統采用經典街機的像素風格,多種戰鬥換面，機甲裝備，升級等要素應有盡有。

暴走大鵝將要打倒宇宙統治者空虛王和他無數手下和槍械怪。為了擊敗他們,玩家必須前往遙遠的星球並面臨無盡危機。然而對於傳說中的暴走大鵝來說是小菜一碟而已。

・橫版像素風冒險，以快節奏射擊為主核心，讓玩家體驗無盡的闖關戰鬥！
・鍛煉玩家的技能，緊握時機和快捷閃避前往Boss戰。
・通過戰鬥強化武器,輔助角色的組合來自定玩家的遊戲風格。
・使用強大的武器發揮暴走精神擊退敵人!
・細致的像素圖描繪各種場景地圖,交通工具,人物等。
・「Moonrider」、「Blazing Chrome」和「Gravity Circuit」的作曲家Dominic Ninmark制作的合成搖滾和爵士樂，融合在遊戲背景音樂之中。

title: Chaos Head Noah / Chaos Child [NSP][ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + uluchshennyy angloperevod 来自 Committee Of Zero
description:
Istoriya «Vershiny Khaosa» proiskhodit v Sibuya-ku, odnom iz 23 spetsialnykh rayonov Tokio v 2008-om i razvivayutsya vokrug Takumi Nisidzyo, uchenika srednikh klassov chastnoy Akademii Suimey.
Strannye i zhestokie ubiystva proiskhodyat v rayone Sibui, nazvannye «Bezumiem Novogo Pokoleniya» (yap. ニュージェネレーション). Istorii berut nachalo 28 sentyabrya, kogda Takumi razgovarivaet v onlayne s drugom po imeni Grim (yap. グリム Gurimu). On pytaetsya poskoree soobshchit poslednie sobytiya «Novogo Pokoleniya», no nash gerpoy ne interesuetsya mestnymi i mezhdunarodnymi novostyami. Chelovek po imeni Syogun prisoedinyaetsya k chatu v seredine razgovora. Posle etogo Grim pokidaet chat, i Syogun nachinaet govorit.
Zatem Syogun otsylaet emu kuchu ssylok s fotografiyami: na odnoy iz nikh izobrazheno zhestokoe ubiystvo cheloveka, pribitogo krestoobraznymi kolyami k stene. Takumi ponimaet, chto on yavlyaetsya svidetelem zhestokogo ubiystva, fotografii kotorogo on videl nakanune, i okazyvaetsya v nekoy spirali paranoyi i neponimaniya. On otchayanno pytaetsya obezopasit sebya i vyyasnit, pochemu zhe yavlyaetsya zhertvoy..
Versiya igry «Chaos;Head» dlya Nintendo Switch s ofitsialnym dopolnitelnym kontentom, vklyuchayushchim v sebya eshchyo kontsovki, CG, syuzhetnye detali dlya konsoli nazyvaetsya Chaos;Head Noah (yap. カオスヘッドノア Kaosu Kheddo Noa), predstavlennaya v razdache.Spisok igr serii, svyazany odnoy vselennoy i otsylkami:

title: A Storied Life Tabitha [NSZ][RUS/Multi14]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 14]
description:
一位年老的親人在過世後留給您他的莊園和一封信，鼓勵您賣掉其中所有貴重物品。但一場意外汙損了他即將出版的回憶錄，於是您展開了彌補損害的工作，利用您繼承到的物品來拼湊出他不為人知的過往。

細心清理遺產

探索古色古香的鄉村房屋，然後一個房間一個房間收拾其中內容物。移動家具、掀開地毯、打開紙箱來揭露各種隱藏的和被遺忘的物件。

如何分辨鍾愛之物和待棄之物？慢慢篩選某人的往昔片羽，決定要保留、拍賣或捨棄每一件物件。

紓壓放鬆的打包謎題

您無法保留所有東西，請利用移動和旋轉物品來將它們收進箱子裡。有限的空間和重量考量意味著您始終必須放棄一些東西。

用膠帶穩固箱子，用真空包裝柔軟的物品來容納更多物件，更別忘了用泡泡包裝紙來包裹易碎物品，否則它們可能會破損。

復原親人的回憶錄

您保存的每項物品都會解開一組相關文字，請用這些文字來修補受損回憶錄中的空白，完成這些文句來揭開一個充滿故事的人生。

過去如何被記錄，全賴您的判斷。它們會振奮人心、瘋狂傻氣、震驚駭人、歡樂有趣、還是抑鬱嚴肅？……這些回憶錄有許多潛在的支線，全賴您做出每個決定。

關鍵特色

真實的約克郡場景：一個發生在英國北約克郡，引人入勝的錯綜故事

撫慰人心的如畫世界：17道經過精緻動畫化的手繪關卡，搭配環境天氣與日夜時間效果，相輔相成

多重結局：您寫出的回憶錄將直接影響最後一個房間的謎題，以及您的贈與人在大家的回憶中呈現何種面貌。

物品百科全書：您的日誌會自動記錄所有收集到的物品以及它們解開的文字，並追蹤您在拍賣中募集到的資金

自動調整的文字謎題：忘記好好包裝您的物品嗎？同一件物件的破損和完好版本都會解鎖獨特的文字，供您用在修補回憶錄上

秘密與驚喜：重新遊玩關卡和實驗各種組合，都可能揭開意外的樂趣

title: Cruis N Blast [NSZ][ENG]
description:
火爆街機遊戲巡航爆速正要衝進Nintendo Switch™！
在近30首浮誇曲目下橫衝直撞。駕駛23款自定義座駕，從特許超級跑車，到怪物卡車和獨角獸也包羅萬有！最多四名玩家可以一起比賽，選擇你喜歡的車輛並出發吧！

title: Haven [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Yu i Key sbezhali na vsemi zabytuyu planetu, ostaviv vsyo, chto u nikh bylo. Igrayte odnovremenno za dvukh vlyublyonnykh, kotorye ishchut svoyo mesto v neznakomom mire.
Issleduyte planetu, sobirayte resursy i masterite iz nikh vsyo neobkhodimoe dlya vyzhivaniya. Naslazhdaytes povsednevnoy zhiznyu: vmeste gotovte edu, obustraivayte uyutnoe gnezdyshko i beseduyte.
Srazhaytes s temi, kto khochet vas razluchit, koordiniruya deystviya oboikh personazhey. Tolko idealnaya slazhennost pozvolit im spastis i sokhranit svoi otnosheniya.

Klyuchevye osobennosti:
• Igrayte odnovremenno za dvukh personazhey, razvivaya ikh otnosheniya, issleduya raskolotuyu planetu i otbivayas ot vragov.
• Vybirayte svoyu sudbu. Chem vy pozhertvuete, chtoby byt vmeste? Otkazhetes li vy ot vsego radi lyubvi?
• Skolzite nad travoy, sobirayte potok i schishchayte rzhavchinu, izuchaya mir i ego taynye ugolki.
• Vyberite, kem budut vashi Key i Yu — parnem i devushkoy, dvumya devushkami ili dvumya parnyami.
• Koordiniruyte deystviya oboikh personazhey v dinamichnykh boyakh v realnom vremeni.
• Pogruzites v romanticheskoe priklyuchenie v kosmose. Vas zhdyot saga o vlyublyonnoy pare, kotoraya gotova na vsyo, chtoby byt vmeste.
• Nablyudayte za razvitiem mnogogrannykh otnosheniy ocharovatelnykh personazhey, v kotorykh legko mozhno uznat sebya.
• Lyogkaya v osvoenii igra, kotoraya idealno podkhodit dlya togo, chtoby rasslabitsya posle napryazhyonnogo dnya.
• Igrayte v odinochku ili so svoey polovinkoy: vtoroy igrok mozhet v lyuboy moment podklyuchitsya k priklyucheniyam.
• Emotsionalnuyu atmosferu igry dopolnyaet originalnyy saundtrek izvestnogo elektronnogo muzykanta DANGER.

title: In His Time [NSZ][ENG]
description:
《In His Time》是一款具有皮影木偶般視覺效果的 2D 解謎冒險遊戲。 一邊享受層出不窮的解謎遊戲，一邊重溫主角奧利的冒險與成長。
我再也見不到你了。 但我真的很想再見你並擁抱你。 我的親人現在在哪裡？ 我在想，我們是不是再也不能見面了？
《In His Time》是一款 2D 解謎冒險遊戲，正面回答了這些問題。
主角奧利（Olly）早年失去了父親，與母親萊拉（Lyla）住在一起。 她的母親最近也生病了，所以她一邊上學一邊在家做事。
即便是在那所學校，她也被小將軍鮑比和他的心腹米拉、雨果欺負，天天被老師罵… 男孩被世界逼到了牆角。
有一天，奧利受到鮑比和他的朋友的威脅，並與他們一起潛入一座令人毛骨悚然的豪宅。 他們偷走了某部作品的「零件」並逃跑，但只有來不及逃脫的奧利被宅邸主人約瑟夫老人抓獲。 他自稱是一名鐘錶匠，當他聽說奧利的情況時，他說如果他從鮑比和其他人那裡拿回“零件”，他不會對他做任何壞事。
奧利能和鮑比等人互相理解嗎？ 你媽媽會發生什麼事？ 約瑟是誰？
男孩奧利的冒險開始了。 敬請期待結局和他的成長！

title: Football Manager (FM) Touch: 2018 / 2019 / 2020 / 2021 / 2022 / 2023 [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
在《Football Manager 2023 Touch》中，你可以分區規劃關鍵的足球管理領域，掌管世界級大型足球俱樂部。
首先創建個人經理角色，製定獨特風格，然後在戰術板上彰顯你的指揮技術。插入並使用例如 Gegenpress、Tiki-Taka 等最火熱的戰術風格。 
與教練團隊合作，提升球員招募水平。打造一支由全球超級球星和青年才俊組成的夢之隊，不久後你們就能橫掃國內外獎杯。 
比賽哨聲吹響後，你將決定比賽節奏。使用「即時結果」功能加速遊戲進展，或者觀察數字防護棚邊的多臺攝像來分析行動。 
《FM23 Touch》新增眾多功能，包括：
強化比賽日掌控
全新優化的對局體驗可令你更切身體驗比賽。精簡的用戶界面可幫助你完美地把握住戰術時機，沈浸在熱血澎湃的球場中。 
傳達你的消息
全新的「團隊對話」功能可讓大家聽見你的想法。利用來自多方的反饋，捕捉每一種情緒，不論何時都能改變比賽局面。
記載你的職業生涯
你的精彩個人時刻現在將會以更難以忘懷的形式被記錄下來。動態經理人時間軸將會把你的職業成就可視化，並隨著你的登峰造極之路更新。 
重大的歐洲之夜
參與歐洲冠軍聯賽、歐洲聯賽和歐洲會議聯賽等歐足聯俱樂部比賽，與最強歐洲俱樂部同場競技，測試你的水平能力。比賽今年均獲得全權授權。通過升級的杯賽抽簽機製和真實的比賽日品牌，盛大的歐洲足球之夜就在你的指尖之上。
還有更多全新功能正在遊戲中等你來發現。

title: The Legend of Tianding [NSZ][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
◆ 台灣傳奇廖添丁 ◆
玩家扮演台灣真實人物--廖添丁，一位讓日本殖民政府咬牙切齒的傳奇義賊。廖添丁活躍於二十世紀初的大台北，他喜歡行俠仗義、劫富濟貧，他不畏強權，為台灣百姓伸張正義。遊戲劇本參考眾多廖添丁的鄉野傳說，輔以詳實的史地調查，再搭配扣人心弦的劇情安排，為玩家帶來一部最精彩的廖添丁傳奇。

◆ 神影無蹤展武藝 ◆
廖添丁帶著尺二短刀及跤巾腰帶，以高超武藝打倒惡霸強權。藉由操控廖添丁，玩家可輕鬆使出多段連擊，並能隨意奪取各種敵人武器，以使出多樣化的功夫組合。而強大的輕功及鉤索，更讓玩家在遊戲中能飛簷走壁，穿梭自如，暢快闖蕩於各個精心設計的關卡迷宮中。
還有多個極具特色的強大Boss等著玩家去挑戰，如美豔卻致命的女忍者、貪婪且殘酷的痴肥商人、嫻熟各種武器的冷血軍官，每一位Boss都會用不同的能力與兇殘的手段來挑動玩家的運動神經！

◆ 日治時代懷古情 ◆
遊戲中以復古武俠漫畫的美術風格，呈現二十世紀初的大台北風貌，透過廖添丁的角度，玩家能夠穿梭在繁華燦爛的大稻埕街區，乘坐當時最先進的高速急行列車，探訪氣氛詭譎的陰暗下水道。每個場景都值得讓人再三遊歷。

◆ 神明保庇香火袋 ◆
遊戲中能裝備不同能力的符令，讓廖添丁獲得更強的能力狀態！這些具有法力的符令道具，能讓廖添丁有更多的體力值，更快的內力回復速度，甚至能減輕所受的傷害。玩家可自由搭配不同的符令，打造出心目中最強的台灣英雄。

◆ 傳統桌遊四色牌 ◆
除了爽快的動作格鬥之外，你也可以在廟口大樹下，與街坊鄰居玩一局台灣傳統的棋牌遊戲，放鬆一下心情。

◆ 新增線上排行榜 ◆
與朋友們在線上排行榜上一較高下。

◆ Boss Rush 模式 ◆
在 Boss Rush 模式中連續挑戰廖添丁的對手們，測試自己的實力。

◆ 支援超寬螢幕 ◆
支援超寬螢幕，讓你一覽完整的大稻埕街景。

title: Tales From Space: Mutant Blobs Attack [NSP][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
description:
Megaplatformer-golovolomka! Melkiy blob rastet i pozhiraet goroda! 24 urovnya odinochnoy kampanii. Bonus — urovni s vidom sverkhu i upravleniem naklonami.

Dikoe kovarstvo i mnogoobrazie!
Vozmozhnosti
— Blob rastet v giganta!
— On polzet po trubam, lipnet k stenam, letit po urovnyam, prityagivaet i ottalkivaet metall.
— Grafika i muzyka v stile 50-kh, yumor.

title: Perfect Dark (原生移植版 ) [NSP][ENG]
description:
Perfect Dark («Kromeshnaya Tma») — videoigra v zhanre ekshen shutera ot pervogo litsa, razrabotannaya britanskoy kompaniey Rare i izdannaya Nintendo dlya konsoli Nintendo 64; schitaetsya dukhovnym preemnikom vyshedshey ranee igry «GoldenEye 007» togo zhe razrabotchika. Perfect Dark vpervye vypushchena v Severnoy Amerike 22 maya 2000 goda.
Igrok beryot na sebya rol Dzhoanny Dark, agenta Karringtonskogo instituta, pytayushcheysya ostanovit zagovor konkurentov iz korporatsii dataDyne. S tekhnicheskoy tochki zreniya Perfect Dark byla odnoy iz samykh sovremennykh igr, razrabotannykh dlya Nintendo 64, s vysokim razresheniem, podderzhkoy shirokoekrannogo rezhima i zvukom sistemy Dolby Surround Sound.
«Perfect Dark» razrabatyvalas v techenie tryokh let i ispolzuet modernizirovannuyu versiyu dvizhka ot GoldenEye 007; igra poluchila priznanie kritikov, zasluzhiv vysokie otsenki u mnogikh izdaniy, i kommercheskiy uspekh, prodazhi po vsemu miru prevysili tri milliona edinits. Kritiki vysoko otsenili eyo shiroko nastraivaemye mnogopolzovatelskie rezhimy i tsennost pereigrovki, uspekh igry privyol k razrabotke tseloy serii igr.Goldeneye 007 s emulyatorom N64 sm. tut.

title: Taiji [NSP][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
《TAIJI》是一款冒險解謎遊戲，遊戲的背景是一個充滿謎題的神秘世界。與其他冒險遊戲不同的是，《TAIJI》中的謎題都使用統一的介面：一個網格，網 格上的磚塊可以翻轉。
介面的一致性看似簡單，但實際上能讓玩家不必像其他冒險遊戲那樣胡亂猜測或尋找像素點。 玩家解開謎題要互動的物體總是一目了然，但他們卻永遠無法準確知道自己該怎麼做。 遊戲地圖分為許多不同的區域，每個區域都有獨特的視覺主題和機關。 在探索這個豐富多彩的世界時，一定要認真思考、眼觀八方，因為重要的線索有時就隱藏在眾目睽睽之下。

title: Manifold Garden [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description: 重新發現重力，探索美麗艾雪風格世界的「不可能」建築。幾何體在各方向無窮重複，而墜落會讓您回歸您的開始之處。操縱重力，更改視點，以全新方式觀看世界。掌控宇宙規則，讓荒蕪世界重歸青蔥與生機。

title: Astrea Six Sided Oracles [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
V davnie vremena, kogda na meste drevnikh ruin stoyali protsvetayushchie goroda, a lyudi zhili ne znaya bed, mirom pravila misticheskaya zvezda. Zvezda blagoslovila svoikh vernykh posledovateley, kotorykh zvali shestigrannymi orakulami, darovav im umenie zapechatyvat nebesnye sushchnosti v zagadochnykh relikviyakh.
V mire tsarili pokoy i garmoniya. Do tekh por, poka ne vzoshla Bagrovaya zarya. V nebe zapolykhal chudovishchnyy ognennyy vikhr, v plameni kotorogo sgorela zvezdnaya sistema. Privychnyy mir perestal sushchestvovat, a dushi slabykh porazila skverna. Khaos poglotil posledovateley zvezdy, razbrosav ikh tvoreniya po miru i pokhoroniv ikh v ruinakh. Sushchestvuyut li v mire smelchaki, kotorye smogut obuzdat drevnyuyu silu? Mnogo let spustya potomki shestigrannykh orakulov vstupili v boy, chtoby zavershit bitvu, nachatuyu predshestvennikami, i spasti zvezdnuyu sistemu.

title: Bot Gaiden [NSZ][ENG]
description:
《Bot Gaiden》是款充滿動作、執行力及速度的遊戲，適合膽大包天的玩家！忍者機器人 Robyu 和 Bytron 正盡速追擊 Giorqio 的 6 名機器人黨羽，以一一從他們的手中奪回遭竊的強大骷髏頭。他們一路過關斬將，以迅速抵達目的地。隨著時間的流逝及暴露於這些強大的骷髏頭，這幾名黨羽機器人就會變得越來越強壯。只要越快到達目的地，就能越容易完成戰鬥！然而，前進得更快就代表讓自己身陷危險的處境，也必須嘗試在各階段中找出最有效率的道路。

《Bot Gaiden》的遊戲設計在於經驗共享，無論技能是否並不相符。找到一個還在學習的初學者嗎？趕快組隊吧。身邊有對動作遊戲很不在行的朋友？讓他們一起來同歡吧！您可以隨時傳送夥伴至不同的地點。登入的玩家可立即趕上進度，而經驗老到的玩家也能立即提供協助。

遊戲特色：

• 在充滿挑戰的手製關卡中一路奔跑、跳躍，並過關斬將！
• 在休閒、一般、硬派和荒唐等難度設定間進行選擇。
• 擊敗各魔王，以依序獲得獎勵！
• 立即組隊，以進行快速的本機合作動作遊戲。
• 在令人愛不釋手的遊戲玩法循環中發掘無法解鎖之物。
• 賺取黃金，以在終局之戰中存活下來！

title: LEGO Worlds + 4 DLC [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description: 盡情探索、發現驚奇、創意無限。齊享樂趣。《LEGO® Worlds》是根據程序產生、完全由樂高積木構成的世界，所創造的開放式環境。這些積木除了能夠由你自由組合之外，也能任意構成樂高模型。你可以用積木逐步蓋出想像中的世界，也可以使用大型造景工具塑造壯闊的山峰，或是用熱帶島嶼妝點這個世界。只要放置預鑄結構就能創造並自訂成你想要的世界。如果一時興起，還可利用直昇機、火龍、機車甚至大猩猩探索世界、解開各種寶藏，豐富你的遊戲性。你可以看著一手創造出來的角色和生物動起來並與之互動，帶來一連串的意外驚喜。在《LEGO Worlds》可以讓不可能化為可能！

title: The Procession to Calvary [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Ur-r-r-ra! Svyashchennaya voyna okonchena! Vashi ugnetateli razbity, tserkvi Starogo boga razrusheny, a tysyachi nevinnykh lishilis zhizni! No est i drugie khoroshie novosti: tiran Pyotr Nebesnyy uskolznul ot vas, i teper vam nado ego nayti...

The Procession to Calvary — eto grotesknaya igra-priklyuchenie, v kotoroy vy popadete v bezumnuyu atmosferu, sotkannuyu iz soten kartin epokhi Vozrozhdeniya.

Osobennosti igry:
Navodite i zhmite: v nashey igre traditsionnyy point-and-click interfeys, udobnoe krugovoe menyu vzaimodeystviya i prostoy inventar so vsemi vashimi pozhitkami.

Epokha Vozrozhdeniya ozhivaet: kartiny Rembrandta, Botichelli, Mikelandzhelo i drugikh khudozhnikov skladyvayutsya v tselostnyy mir.

Klassicheskaya muzyka: saundtrek tozhe podobran pod stat kartinam. U nas est muzyka ot Vivaldi, Bakha, Georga Fridrikha Gendelya i drugikh.

Ubivayte, esli nuzhno: ubivayte vsekh, kto vam meshaet, i propuskayte zagadki, kotorye vam ne nravyatsya. No pomnite: u kazhdogo resheniya est posledstviya…

Polnaya chepukha: No my prosledili — pust shutki i absurdnye, zato zagadki logichnee nekuda!

title: Apocalipsis Wormwood edition (Harry at the End of the World / The Tree of the Knowledge of Good and Evil + One Night in the Woods DLC) [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
V igre Apocalipsis vy igraete za Garri, dlya kotorogo poterya vozlyublennoy stala kontsom sveta. Teper emu nuzhno otpravitsya v strannye i negostepriimnye kraya, chtoby vernut ee. Na svoem puti on povstrechaet fantasticheskikh sushchestv pryamikom iz voobrazheniya khudozhnikov Evropy 15 i 16 vekov, kak Gans Golbeyn i Albrekht Dyurer. V Apocalipsis statichnye gravyury nachinayut zhit svoey zhiznyu, sozdavaya tselyy novyy mir, vdokhnovlennyy «Otkroveniem Ioanna Bogoslova» i estetikoy Plyaski smerti – mir, polnyy uzhasa, smerti i bolezney. No dazhe v etikh bogom zabytykh zemlyakh est mesto dlya lyubvi…

vliyanie srednevekovoy filosofii i okkultnogo simvolizma ne ogranichivaetsya grafikoy – oni vdokhnovlyayut samu istoriyu. V etoy igre muzyka i izobrazhenie podderzhivayut drug druga i pogruzhayut vas v tainstvennyy pugayushchiy mir. Wormwood Edition takzhe vklyuchaet «Odnazhdy nochyu v lesu» – prikvel istorii, sluchivsheysya v Apocalipsis: Harry at the End of the World.

Apocalipsis: Harry at the End of the World takzhe yavlyaetsya debyutom populyarnoy blek-metal gruppy Behemoth v mire videoigr. Muzyka Behemoth pryachetsya v geymplee, a Nergal (ustrashayushchiy solist gruppy) ispolnil rol rasskazchika – adskaya atmosfera garantirovana!

Ne propustite Apocalipsis, esli vam kogda-nibud khotelos:
• Uvidet, kak ozhivaet v videoigre srednevekovoe iskusstvo.
• Povstrechatsya s sushchestvami pryamikom iz rukopisey 15 veka.
• Uslyshat, kak Nergal rasskazyvaet istoriyu Garri
• Otpravitsya navstrechu kontsu vremen i stat svidetelem odnoy iz neskolkikh dostupnykh razvyazok.
• Posetit svyshe dvukh desyatkov unikalnykh lokatsiy, gde vam predstoit razgadyvat zagadki i nakhodit skrytyy smysl.
• Vzbodritsya mrachnym saundtrekom, vdokhnovlennym estetikoy Plyaski smerti.

O DLC «Odnazhdy nochyu v lesu»:

«Odnazhdy nochyu v lesu» – eto prikvel istorii, rasskazannoy v Apocalipsis: Harry at the End of the World. Vo vremya puteshestviya Garri snilis trevozhnye sny, v kotorykh ego lyubimaya Zula plyashet u kostra v lesu.  V DLC vy igraete za Zulu, chtoby raskryt podlinnye prichiny ee tainstvennykh ischeznoveniy. V chashche tayatsya demony – etu noch vy ne zabudete…

Ne zhdite, poka Vozrozhdenie zastanet vas vrasplokh i pogruzhaytes v srednevekovoe priklyuchenie s Behemoth uzhe seychas!

title: Shardpunk (Shard Punk) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Voyna proigrana: stolitsa lezhit v ruinakh, vam ostaetsya tolko odno, bezhat! Shardpunk obedinyaet zhanr poshagovoy takticheskoy strategii s elementami RPG, vyzhivaniya i menedzhmenta. Sobirayte komandu, dobyvayte resursy, srazhaytes s ordami vragov i ishchite ukrytiya, chtoby vyzhit — eshchyo odin den.
V mire Shardpunk vy uzhe proigrali. Vasha zadacha — vyzhit, spasaya po doroge kak mozhno bolshe drugikh lyudey i sobiraya kak mozhno bolshe ostatkov snaryazheniya. Ne ostanavlivaytes. Ispolzuyte vse navyki i podruchnye sredstva, v perebezhkakh mezhdu ukrytiyami: bunkerami na termoyadernoy energii. Spasaytes ot ordy i delayte vse, chtoby vyzhit v razrushennoy voynoy ctolitse.

title: Dragon Quest X: Rise of the Five Tribes (Awakening of the Five Walkers, The Five Awakening Races, DQX) Offline Deluxe + 16 DLC / ドラゴンクエストX [NSP][ENG (Mod.)/JAP]
description:
Ranee isklyuchitelno setevaya RPG «Dragon Quest X» byla pererabotana s novoy grafikoy i igrovym balansom, chtoby vy smogli igrat v neyo samostoyatelno i bez podklyucheniya k onlayn internet-serveram, plyus naslazhdayas golosami personazhey!..
Dobro pozhalovat v Astoriyu, mir pyati kontinentov Dragon Quest X! Issleduya ego, vstrechayte zhivushchie tam rasy, i vmeste so svoimi soyuznikami perezhivayte desyatki zamechatelnykh priklyucheniy: puteshestvuyte po roskoshnym korablyam i legendarnym letayushchim drakonam, gde vashe novoe priklyuchenie vot-vot nachnyotsya...
Eto «Deluxe Edition» vklyuchaet v sebya:

title: Infinity Strash: Dragon Quest the Adventure of Dai [NSP][ENG]
description:
漫畫累計發行超過4700萬部的不朽名作《勇者鬥惡龍 達伊的大冒險》，在2020年完全重新製作動畫之後，現在將以動作RPG的形式登場！

透過你的雙手操控小小的勇者達伊和他的夥伴們，去挑戰哈德拉率領的魔王軍，以及在勇者鬥惡龍系列中熟知的怪物們吧！

同時，原作漫畫中的名場面將作為原創道具「羈絆記憶」登場，羈絆記憶會以各種形式強化達伊等人的能力！

另外，本作還會有100多種房間透過隨機選擇組合而成的原創迷宮「記憶神殿」！驅使自身的智慧與勇氣，偶爾再靠一些運氣，嘗試前往記憶神殿的最深處吧！

斬開大地，斬開大海，斬開天空，最後才能斬開萬物……
務必用你的雙手，去體驗一下小小的勇者達伊與他的夥伴們所編織的熱血故事。


故事：
魔王哈德拉曾經掌管著世界，人們苦不堪言。不過，一位被稱為「勇者」的劍士與他的夥伴們打倒了哈德拉，為人們取回了和平。 

時光流逝……不再被魔王控制的怪物們一同居住在南海的一座孤島——迪爾穆林島上，而島上唯一的人類，就是憧憬勇者的少年「達伊」，他與怪物們非常和平地居住在島上。
不過，這和平的生活，也因魔王哈德拉的復活而不復存在。

與恩師的約定、與同伴的相遇、無法逃脫的宿命……
為了拯救再次面臨危險的世界，渴望成為勇者的少年達伊，開啟了自己的冒險！

title: Quartet [NSP][ENG]
description:
Nastoyashchaya yaponskaya rolevaya igra, v kotoruyu mozhno nachat igrat s 1 iz chetyrekh istoriy. Vosem geroev. Odna sudba.
Seriya neveroyatnykh ogrableniy poezdov. Tainstvennaya koloda kart. Flot smertonosnykh dirizhabley. Sluchaynyy mag. Vyberite odnu iz chetyrekh istoriy v lyubom poryadke i uznayte, kak oni perepletayutsya v etoy klassicheskoy rolevoy igre!..
Ot ulits Leornina, vdokhnovlyonnykh stimpankom, do lesov varvarskoy granitsy; ot proklyatykh bolot Tikhe do podzemnykh skladov Serena, «Kvartet» predlagaet mnozhestvo mest dlya issledovaniya. Zdes vy upravlyaete 4 personazhami na peredovoy, a ostalnye 4 gotovy vstupit v boy v lyuboy moment. Gotovy vystavit svoego glavnogo boytsa ili ekstrennogo tselitelya? Pereklyuchaytes mezhdu personazhami iz rezervnoy gruppy bez problem! Pereklyuchivshiesya personazhi srazu zhe nachinayut svoy khod bez kakikh-libo shtrafov. Poka personazhi nakhodyatsya v rezerve, oni takzhe bystree vosstanavlivayut svoi ochki sposobnostey, chto delaet pereklyuchenie mezhdu nimi vazhneyshim elementom boya.
Boi dinamichnye, poshagovye i polny mnozhestva spetsialnykh sposobnostey. Khod kazhdogo personazha i protivnika otobrazhaetsya v ocheredi khodov, chto pozvolyaet igroku planirovat razrushitelnye i svoevremennye takticheskie udary. Mozhno ispolzovat mnozhestvo elementalnykh i fizicheskikh sposobnostey, chtoby ekspluatirovat vse slabosti protivnika. Ochki deystviya avtomaticheski vosstanavlivayutsya posle khoda geroya. Ne ekonomte — ispolzuyte zaklinaniya bez ostanovki!

title: Unepic [NSP][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
平台角色扮演遊戲『Unepic』的劇情舞台，設於中世紀奇幻故事的一座宏偉城堡中。你將在『Unepic』裡探索200多間房間、發現100多種不同武器，並習得70多種法術！找出無數的秘密寶藏，打敗包含7名可怕頭目等的凶惡敵人。

『Unepic』融合80年代風格與現代要素，透過2000行對話完整講述這趟奇幻冒險，並充滿流行文化梗。『Unepic』支援不同的難度設定，且有多種結局，必定會讓你意猶未盡、流連忘返。

遊戲特色：

• 探索超過200間房間
• 發現超過100種不同武器
• 學習超過70種法術
• 發掘不計其數的隱密寶藏
• 擊敗包含駭人頭目在內的凶惡敵人

title: Dragon Quest Heroes I and II / ドラゴンクエストヒーローズI・II (2) [NSP][JAP]
description:
Dragon Quest Heroes I i II dlya Nintendo Switch — eto dilogiya igr, kotoraya vklyuchaet v sebya Dragon Quest Heroes: The World Tree’s Woe and The Blight Below (Dragon Quest Heroes: Yami Ryu to Sekaiju no Shiro) plyus Dragon Quest Heroes II: Twin Kings and the Prophecy's End (Dragon Quest Heroes II: Futago no Oh to Yogen no Owari), a takzhe dopolnitelnogo igrovogo personazha Ragnara Makrayana (ozvuchivaet Tomokadzu Sugita) iz Dragon Quest IV: Chapters of the Chosen (Dragon Warrior IV), novogo monstra-bossa Malrota iz Dragon Quest II: Luminaries of the Legendary Line (Dragon Warrior II), i geympleynye uluchsheniya s regulirovkoy slozhnosti, a takzhe ves prezhde otdelno zagruzhaemyy kontent.
Mesto deystviya pervoy igry — mirnaya strana Elzayz. Lyudi i monstry zhili v garmonii, poka poslednie tainstvennym obrazom ne prishli v yarost! Chelovechestvo razom bylo okruzheno armiey monstrov, ispolzuya vsyo vozmozhnoe, chtoby vyzhit. Zatem otkrylos sleduyushchee: vinovaty podlye plany Velasko pogruzit mir vo tmu, vzyav pod kontrol vsekh monstrov, osvobodiv temnogo drakona Shadrota, Povelitelya Nochi...
Vo vtoroy igre sobytiya razvivayutsya davnym-davno posle etogo, cherez mnogo let posle dolgoy i uzhasnoy voyna. Kogda ona, nakonets, zakonchilas, lyudi vsego mira zaklyuchili torzhestvennyy dogovor — nikogda bolshe ne voevat s monstrami. Mir byl razgranichen na sem tsarstv, i tsaril tam mir tysyachu let. No odnazhdy, dvoyurodnye bratya i rytsari-stazhery Lazarel i Tereza pribyvayut v korolevstvo Kharba, vdali ot svoego dunisskogo doma. Oni i podozrevayut, chto dunisskaya armiya sobiraetsya vtorgnutsya snova vo glave so svoim starym drugom, printsem Tsezarem..Drugie igry serii Dragon Quest.

title: Lost Eidolons: Veil of the Witch [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Na proklyatom ostrove vyzhivanie trebuet ne tolko sily, no i strategicheskogo myshleniya. Pobezhdayte v poshagovykh srazheniyakh, nakhodite soyuznikov, adaptiruytes k menyayushchimsya sobytiyam i stanovites silnee. Udastsya li vam oderzhat pobedu i raskryt taynu zhizni i smerti?
V mire Lost Eidolons vykhodit takticheskaya rolevaya igra v zhanre rouglayt, v kotoroy smert — eto tolko nachalo. Poteryav zhizn v korablekrushenii, vy zaklyuchaete sdelku s tainstvennoy vedmoy i poluchaete eshche odin shans. Chto potrebuetsya vzamen ot vas? Stat ee zashchitnikom i raspravitsya s ee vragami.

title: Modern Tales: Age of Invention [NSP][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description: Parizh, 1900. Neizvestnye pokhishchayut samye blestyashchie umy stoletiya so vsemirnoy vystavki. S kakoy zloveshchey tselyu? V obraze Emili Patterson, docheri odnogo iz pokhishchennykh uchenykh, vam predstoit provesti rassledovanie, proyti po sledu prestupnika i narushit ego zlobnye plany po zakhvatu vsego mira.

title: In Celebration of Violence [NSZ][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
踏入險惡的旅程，穿越相互連接的平原，沼澤，城市和地牢，提供無數的路徑，以到達你最終的目標。程序生成使每一次執行時都變得不可預測且獨特，而永久死亡則不斷威脅你來之不易的進步。改善你的數據，購買物品以幫助你進行後續的嘗試，以及提升技能去面對一眾的首領。

輕鬆的復古演示掩蓋了風險與回報的無情體驗，但是如何應對未來的艱鉅挑戰完全取決於你。無論你是敏捷，隱秘，聰明又善於操縱，還是對自己的戰鬥技巧充滿信心，你都可以通過遊戲系統自由地表現自己的風格。

特色：

•每次進入時都探索一個不同的世界！
•向神殿祈禱以獲得增強，但要提防每個神都有獨特的性質。
•收集武器，物品，咒語和紀念品。
•積累經驗並進行永久升級，以增加生存機會。
•解鎖新角色和隱藏的獎勵！

title: Radiant Guardians of Light [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
赫莉亞王國陷入黑暗。扮演昆恩與艾納，踏上拯救艾納妹妹的冒險旅程，她擁有元素之力並被神秘勢力綁架。

Radiant: Guardians of Light 是一款融合經典清版動作與RPG成長系統的2D奇幻遊戲。

單人或與好友一起遊玩，探索充滿魔法與危機的世界。擊敗傳說中的魔王，鍛造強力裝備，掌握元素魔法，揭開精靈的秘密。穿越森林、遺跡與神秘空間，打造屬於你的英雄傳說。

體驗懷舊又現代的節奏戰鬥與敘事冒險！

title: Wicce [NSP][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
和女兒一起住在森林深處一座孤零零房子裡的魔女——Wicce。

有一天，她讓女兒幫自己跑腿，
但是女兒到了傍晚還沒有回來，魔女便到森林中去尋找女兒。

走在通往村莊的路上，映入眼簾的是
染上傳染病後臥床不起的村裡人和充滿了不祥之氣的妖怪！
她用魔法治好了行將斷氣的人們，驅趕走了妖怪。

但是，聽到這一消息的[教皇]誣陷她才是傳染病的源頭，要把她抓起來......

• 魔法、連續攻擊、滑行、飛行！使用魔女的掃把做出多樣且獨特的動作！
• 拯救病倒的人們，衝出充滿陷阱的詭異林中小路！
• 激烈的Boss大戰！分析Boss的類型來躲避敵人的攻擊，掌握其弱點發起攻擊！
• 調查寶箱會有特殊道具？讓我們一起來調查舞台的每個角落吧！

傳染病肆虐的森林和村莊裡到處是各種攔路的陷阱和身份不明的妖怪！
Wicce能否避開教皇的耳目打敗妖怪，平安找回女兒？
營救女兒的魔女冒險即將開始！

title: Grave Keeper [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语, 西班牙语, 法语, 意大利语, 葡萄牙语
description:
Stante geroem i srazites protiv velichayshikh vragov.
Razvivayte glavnogo personazha, srazhayas protiv chudovishch, temnykh skeletov, magov i drugikh zlodeev v glubinakh podzemeliy.

- Beytes s vragami, pobezhdayte bossov, poluchayte zoloto
- Ishchite novye predmety i ispytyvayte ikh v boyu 
- Uluchshayte navyki i nichego ne boytes 
- Rezhim skhvatki – pomeryaytes silami s drugimi rytsaryami

Grave Keeper – igra v zhanre «rubilovo» (Hack & Slash) pro srazhenie s Korolem-skeletom v fenteziynom mire.

title: Glittering Sword [NSP][RUS/Multi3]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 3]
description: Not every game can be rated solely by screenshots. It's like a human's essence that can’t be measured by a staged photo. And thus Glittering Sword is not that kind of game that some may think judging by screenshots or trailer. On the first glance it looks like typical action-adventure, like many other classic titles from the 90's. Glittering Sword is full with the spiritual references to these classical gaming brands, and it’s shiny and balanced graphical setting helps the player to dive into the memorable adventure. Best way to describe this game by phrase: «fantasy adventure set in a cozy world with Sokoban-style puzzles». Here, each screen is the individual location with traps, enemies, portals and switches, and the player needs to learn the exact order of completing things the right way. The more you play Glittering Sword, the harder it gets with traps being more and more deadly, and the enemies become tougher. We hope that players who are addicted to adventure games will fall in love with this small but very entertaining game.

title: Shiro [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
description:
Holo 和 Shiro 是雙胞胎姐妹，他們從小就環遊世界尋找冒險。 有一次他們被邪惡的女巫薩泰拉襲擊，把白帶到她陰暗的洞穴裡。 現在Holo必須找到他的妹妹。

幫助 Holo 找到她的妹妹。 在這款像素化冒險平台遊戲中，克服茂密的森林、古老的寺廟、危險的地牢並消滅敵人！

特徵：
平衡戰鬥和平台
超過 25 個級別
獨特的活動和迷你遊戲
具有挑戰性的遊戲玩法
有趣的兔子
一個充滿活力和活力的世界

title: Treachery in Beatdown City Ultra Remix [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
Treachery in Beatdown City - Ultra Remix is the massive 2.0 update to Treachery in Beatdown City featuring all new enemies, attacks, levels, music, and more! Join Bruce, Lisa and Brad on a DLC add-on thrill ride that takes them into new depths of treachery against hordes of new enemies with all new levels of strategy. From angry tourists, obnoxious influencers, and washed up MMA fighters, all the way to the heart of evil, the ninja dragon terrorists themselves! The heroes are getting big upgrades as well, and you’ll unlock a bunch of new attacks and defensive options that will truly change the way you fight! 

• From piledrivers to backflip kicks and distance closing dashing strikes, Brad, Bruce and Lisa will all get gameplay redefining attacks. 

• Introducing fighting game favorites - rolls and parries - to the defensive arsenal. Use these wisely!

• Featuring a massive new cast of new enemies bringing all new weapons and elemental attacks which brings an all new level of difficulty and strategy to the fights. 

• Traverse all new levels, spanning big city blocks, tight offices, TV stations, subway stops, and more! 

• Find loads of new items to help you overcome enemies!

title: Okunoka / Okunoka Madness [NSZ][RUS/Multi]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
OkunoKA Madness — platformer pro sinego geroya KA, kotoryy dolzhen spasti mir dush ot svoego smertelnogo vraga Oza.
Prygayte, begayte i preodolevayte prepyatstviya v unikalnykh yarkikh mirakh s bolee chem 100 urovnyami. Srazhaytes s bezumnymi bossami, nakhodite sekrety, otkryvayte syurprizy i popadite v osobenno slozhnyy mir — Bezumie!
Bolee 100 slozhneyshikh urovney
Tri rezhima skorostnogo prokhozhdeniya: vse miry, odin uroven, polzovatelskiy
Neskolko razblokiruemykh personazhey s unikalnymi umeniyami
Lokalnyy i globalnyy reytingi

title: Super Tux Kart (移植版 STK/Supertux) [NSP][RUS/Multi72]
developer: Joerg Henrichs, Marianne Gagnon, Jean-Manuel Clemençon, Stephen Just, FreeGameDev, GotM team, Steve Baker, Oliver Baker i dr.
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 72]
description:
SuperTuxKart — otkrytaya i svobodnaya arkadnaya gonochnaya igra na kartakh, gonshchikami kotorykh yavlyayutsya talismany yadra Linux Tux i drugie maskoty Free Software, naprimer, Syuzanna iz Blender ili Beastie iz FreeBSD; uluchshennyy fork TuxKart, napisannyy na C++, ispolzuetsya Antarctica, modifitsirovannaya versiya dvizhka Irrlicht dlya grafiki i OpenAL dlya zvuka.
V SuperTuxKart mozhno igrat v odinochnom rezhime, vklyuchaya odinochnuyu kampaniyu, v lokalnom multipleere s razdelyonnym ekranom (onlayn-multipleer na Switch poka ne podderzhivaetsya). V rezhime istorii igrok otkryvaet novykh personazhey za ochki, nabrannye za dostizhenie zadannogo reytinga v gonke s ustanovlennym urovnem slozhnosti. Zavershenie vsekh gonok otkryvaet dver v gonku s bossami protiv Noloka.

title: Electro Ride The Neon Racing [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Electro Ride is a Soviet Bloc Arcade Racer with neon lights. Become the fastest racer in Neon-alternative East Bloc from the Berlin Wall to Moscow. Neon lights, unique classic East Bloc cars, color-sensitive boosts strips, phisics, synthwave and beloved splitscreen. 100% adrenaline!

In an alternate Europe in which the Eastern Bloc did not fall, but transformed into a center of eternal wealth and progress - this is where fame awaits you. No ABS, no traction control, no modern electronic system. Only you and a beautiful, classic vehicle with super-powerful neon lights. Show your driving and drifting skills!

- Collect the stars to change your neon’s color
- Hit the stripes in your neon’s color at the turns
- Reach the speeds your good ol’ Lada has never moved at
- Unlock 20 racetracks in quick race and win 15 races in story mode. 
- Try 20+ cars inspired by Eastern Bloc classics
- Choose from many game modes including the beloved splitscreen
- Race, fight and bounce to the Synthwave rhythms!

title: Another Crab's Treasure [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
您將扮演寄居蟹克里歐，將週遭的垃圾當成殼穿在身上，以抵擋體型比您巨大數倍的敵人攻擊。踏上一段史詩級的尋寶之旅，設法買回您一度失去的棲身貝殼，同時發掘埋藏在受汙染海洋深處的黑暗秘密。

是垃圾，還是寶藏？
在這個海底社會，垃圾不僅是一種維生方式，同時也等同於寶貴的資源，從時尚到武器等等，諸多用途不勝枚舉。但伴隨著垃圾的出現，一種被稱為油汙的神祕傳染病也跟著現身，對整片海洋造成毀滅性的威脅。

從自然中學習成長
克里歐在探索海洋的途中，將可獲得各式各樣的鮮味招式──由大海居民身上學到的強力攻擊技。例如利用螳螂蝦的壓倒性威力給敵人迎頭痛擊，或是用駭人的博比特蟲誘捕敵方，多種技能等您體驗。

充滿未知的深海
海洋的深邃超乎想像。您必須在海帶森林、珊瑚礁、沙堡都市等地穿梭，殺出一條生路，甚至投身進入無底海溝裡深不可測的黑暗，一切的一切，都是為了取回那珍貴的棲身之殼。

照自己的步調玩
遊戲設計理念在於，為類魂系列新玩家帶來平易近人的體驗，不用在意遊戲技巧，也無須投入大量時間，您就可以在《Another Crab's Treasure》裡發現樂趣。遊戲內部的輔助選項，可讓玩家免於持續受挫的遊戲體驗，不過就愛被虐這一味的玩家，應該能從預設遊戲難度感受到他們想要的挑戰性。

-受類魂系作品啟發的戰鬥系統十分適合新玩家嘗試，也能讓老手粉絲們追求挑戰

-遼闊的海底世界等著您來探索，五花八門的生物等著與您一戰，而其中的秘密等著您發現

-超過60種具備各種特殊能力的背殼，讓你用來抵禦海洋中的威脅

-當你逐漸揭露被汙染海洋背後的黑暗秘密時，會遭遇到多位海底朋友和敵人

-學習世界各地生物的順應妙招，將牠們的力量變成你自己的

title: Sonic the Hedgehog 1 i 2 Classic (2013 decompilation remake) [NSP][ENG]
description:
Sonic the Hedgehog (yap. ソニック・ザ・ヘッジホッグ Sonikku dza Khedzikhoggu, rusc. «Yozh Sonik») — videoigra v zhanre platformer, v kotoroy vpervye poyavilsya personazh yozh Sonik, i s kotoroy nachalas karera eyo razrabotchika Sonic Team, odnogo iz podrazdeleniy korporatsii Sega. Igra byla vypushchena letom 1991 goda dlya konsoli Sega Mega Drive/Genesis i pozzhe byla portirovana na razlichnye igrovye platformy neskolkikh pokoleniy i vkhodila v desyatki sbornikov. Po syuzhetu yozh Sonik khochet pomeshat zlodeyu doktoru Robotniku zapoluchit dragotsennye kamni Izumrudy Khaosa i osvobodit svoikh druzey ot robotov-vragov.
Sonic the Hedgehog 2 (yap. ソニック・ザ・ヘッジホッグ２ Sonikku dza Khedzikhoggu: Tsu, rucs. «Yozh Sonik 2») — videoigra v zhanre platformer iz serii Sonic the Hedgehog, razrabotannaya studiey Sonic Team v soavtorstve s eyo podrazdeleniem Sega Technical Institute. Igra byla vypushchena kompaniey Sega dlya igrovoy pristavki Sega Mega Drive/Genesis v kontse noyabrya 1992 goda. Igra yavlyaetsya sikvelom Sonic the Hedgehog. Po syuzhetu, glavnyy geroy yozh Sonik i ego novyy naparnik lis Teylz khotyat narushit kovarnye plany doktora Robotnika po zakhvatu mira i polucheniyu Izumrudov Khaosa.
V 2013 godu dlya ustroystv Android/iOS sostoyalsya vykhod remeyka igry pri podderzhke SEGA Sonic Team ot Kristiana Uaytkheda i Headcannon — ona otlichaetsya ot originala obnovlyonnoy Full HD-grafikoy, korrektnoy podderzhki shirokoekrannykh displeev s ispolzovaniem novogo dvizhka, poyavleniem priyoma spin dash i vozmozhnostyu igrat za personazhey lisyonka Teylza i ekhidnu Naklza.
Tochnyy dekompilyatsionnyy port na Switch etikh uluchshennykh versiy predstavlen v dannoy razdache.Drugie igry o Sonic'e na Switch.

title: New Super Lucky's Tale [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Join Lucky on his thrilling journey through the Book of Ages, a magical artifact that opens doors to amazing worlds. Meet new friends, explore exciting lands, and recover the missing pages from the evil sorcerer Jinx and his villainous family, the dreaded Kitty Litter. 

• Featuring a huge variety of gameplay, from expansive 3D hubs, to story-based adventure levels, 2D side-scrolling challenges, rewarding mini-games, mind-bending puzzles, and thrilling boss battles.

• Thousands of collectibles to gather, tons of rewarding secrets to discover, a cast of memorable characters, and an entire wardrobe of costumes for the stylish adventurer.

• This is the 3D platforming adventure you’ve been looking for, designed to delight and challenge players of all ages and skill levels.

title: Marble It Up + Ultra [NSZ][ENG,RUS]
interface_lang: 俄语 (u 2-oy chasti), 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
Marble It Up! Ultra 是彈珠平台遊戲的巔峰！本遊戲為 Marble It Up! 及 Marble Blast 的製作團隊的最新力作。世界級的關卡設計，順暢精確的控制方式、燦爛華麗的圖像呈現、以及刺激無比的多人模式 - 歡迎來到彈珠遊戲的最頂點！

龐大的戰役模式
單人模式的眾多關卡充滿了危險的障礙物、奇特的路徑、會變化的地心引力、有彈力的地板和強大的道具。

多人混戰模式
暢玩五種競爭激烈的多人混戰模式。合作搶奪寶石、射門得分、躲避喪屍、並在線上證明你的彈珠技術。彈珠高手的榮耀等你來拿！

精美的收藏
解鎖多種美麗豪華的彈珠、軌跡及帽子！在尋找隱藏獎盃、賺取勳章、以及在線上遊玩的同時累積可用於購買彈珠及配件的獎勵。

磨練你的技術
讓你的彈珠技術更上一層樓。不斷解鎖成就和提高全球排名，成為彈珠大師！每周挑戰會對關卡添加新元素，給你帶來不一樣的遊戲體驗！

準備開始遊戲！

title: The Grinch Christmas Adventures + DLC [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + optsionalnyy mashinnyy 来自 most2820 用于 v65356
description:
Prishlo vremya Rozhdestva, a znachit, i prishlo vremya ego ukrast! Pomogite Grinchu osushchestvit ego kovarnyy plan (a zaodno pomogite ego serdtsu nemnogo vyrasti) v etom prazdnichnom platformere!
Kazhdyy Ktoshka v Ktograde lyubit pet, darit podarki i vkusno est: vse eto Grinch terpet ne mozhet! Pomogite emu i ego sobachke Maksu ukrast vse podarki v Ktograde. Chtoby ne natknutsya na boltlivykh pevtsov iz khora Ktograda i izbezhat vsey rozhdestvenskoy mishury, ukrasheniy i prochikh atributov, pridetsya maskirovatsya. K schastyu, Grinchu prishli v golovu chudesnye v svoey uzhasnosti mysli: kostyum Santy dlya maskirovki, karamelnaya trost-lasso i skorostnoy snoubord, na kotorom mozhno katatsya v osobykh gonochnykh lokatsiyakh, i eto eshche ne vse! A eshche Grinch mozhet brosatsya snezhkami i zamorazhivat nadoedlivykh sozdaniy, vstavshikh u nego na puti.
Vesyolaya rozhdestvenskaya skazka, vdokhnovlennaya krasochnymi illyustratsiyami Doktora Syuza, v kotoruyu mozhno igrat vdvoem za odnim ustroystvom, gde vtoroy igrok budet igrat v roli Maksa. Dazhe samye yunye igroki bez problem smogut osvoitsya v upravlenii i reshit vse golovolomki!

title: Brigandine The Legend of Runersia + 2 DLC [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 俄语, lyubitelskiy (beta-版本) 来自 brigandinerunersia
description:
■Conquer the continent in this grand strategy simulation game
The continent of Runersia is home to six major powers with more than 40 bases, 100 knights, and 50 types of monsters.
Select a ruler, compose your platoons of knights and monsters, and march to claim enemy bases.
The player chooses how they will battle, so devise the best strategy to lead your nation toward continental conquest. How will your legend unfold?
■Simple yet deep war simulation game with unit growth and map-based platoon battles
Time passes on Runersia in seasons, each one consisting of an Organization Phase and an Attack phase.
During the Organization Phase, knights and monsters with various classes and skills are organized into platoons in preparation for the upcoming battles.
During the Attack Phase, turn-based platoon battles take place on a map made up of hexagonal spaces. Make use of unit skills, elements, enclosure effects, terrain advantages, and other battle tactics to lead your side to victory!
All nations, knights, and monsters in the game will continue to battle and grow as you do.
The game is also packed with other ways to grow your armies such as class changes, equipment, and various items.
■Immersive gameplay with high replayability
Enemy nations aim to conquer the continent as well and will attack your bases to do so. The battle for the continent will differ with each playthrough.
Accumulate stories and events from the six nations in the Records. After clearing the main mode, The Legend of Runersia, the Alternate Chapter challenge mode will be unlocked, allowing for even more replayability.
■World settings
Runersia - a continent blessed with mana showers from times of old.
Five Mana Stones discovered long ago have been embedded into special armor called Brigandine, each one representing the ideology of the nation possessing it.
These have come to be known as the Brigandine of Justice, Sanctity, Freedom, Glory, and Ego.
The time now is Runersia 781, and a war looms on the horizon for five nations and a small tribe with incompatible ideologies.
Six rulers and their rune knights will throw themselves into the conflict, each with their own hopes and expectations.
Once the land has been unified under a single banner, memories from The Legend of Runersia will be reclaimed and the truth of what happened here on Runersia shall be revealed.

title: Hyperbrawl Tournament [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
My prinyali trudnoe reshenie prekratit prodazhu HyperBrawl Tournament na etoy platforme 30 sentyabrya 2022. S 30 sentyabrya 2022 onlayn-rezhim perestanet rabotat.
Esli vy priobreli tsifrovuyu versiyu igry, ona ostanetsya u vas v biblioteke. Odnako nekotorye funktsii budut neaktivny.
— V onlayn-rezhime (s podklyucheniem cherez internet) igroki ne smogut voyti v igru.
— V oflayn-rezhime (bez podklyucheniya k internetu) igrokam budut dostupny vse igrovye oflayn-rezhimy, naprimer, Kampaniya ili Arkada. Odnako igroki ne smogut poluchat ili otkryvat kontent, a takzhe povyshat uroven.
My ochen blagodarny nashemu soobshchestvu za podderzhku i za to, chto vy s nami.

STANTE LEGENDARNYM BOYTsOM V HYPERBRAWL
Velichayshie geroi vselennoy sobralis, chtoby prinyat uchastie v bitve veka, — legendarnom turnire HyperBrawl! Vooruzhennye unikalnym oruzhiem, oni zhazhdut slavy! Srazites na arenakh s tremya drugimi igrokami po lokalnoy seti ili onlayn v etom arkadnoy sportivnoy igre s elementami faytinga.

OSVOYTE GIPERKRIVUYu
Tolko elitnye chempiony vselennoy mogut ovladet etim neveroyatnym navykom. Giperkrivaya pozvolyaet vam vzyat myach pod svoy kontrol vo vremya poleta, chtoby «magicheskim» obrazom oboyti sopernikov i prepyatstviya i zabit legendarnye goly, kotorye vozmozhny tolko v HyperBrawl. 

ISPOLZUYTE GIPERSILU
Kazhdaya kletka vashego organizma propitana legendarnoy gipersiloy. Ispolzuyte ee, chtoby provodit sokrushitelnye ataki, kotorye v bukvalnom smysle vykinut vashikh vragov s areny s neveroyatnoy siloy.

VSE GEROI V SBORE
Znamenitye v svoikh mirakh geroi sobirayutsya iz samykh otdalennykh ugolkov vselennoy, chtoby prinyat uchastie v turnire HyperBrawl. Vybirayte iz 12 geroev v trekh klassakh, snaryadite ikh smertelnymi kombinatsiyami iz pushek i raskraste ikh bronyu v pobednye kraski. 

OPASNYE ARENY
Otpravtes skvoz prostranstvo i vremya na areny HyperBrawl, kotorye raspolozhilis na rodnykh planetakh geroev. Nasladites vidami vozvyshennogo stadiona Khrom Siti v stile kiberpanka, drevnim stadionom v Stilkhendzhe ili demonicheskim Dvorom Azdricha. Kazhdaya arena napolnena opasnymi prepyatstviyami i lovushkami, kotorye delayut kazhduyu igru eshche bolee zakhvatyvayushchey i nepredskazuemoy.

title: The Executioner [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
description:
Fusing elements of a traditional RPG with investigation, exploration and moral decision-making, it invites players take on the role of a man who must seek a signed confession from those he is about to put to death.

With a predominantly text-based interface unfolding engaging story, The Executioner promises a dark and unsettling atmosphere, and a world filled with moral ambiguity

With the threat of revolution on the cards will you fight for monarchy and tradition or revolt in the name of progress? Do you support emerging science or follow the mystical path? Will you desensitize yourself to the violence you have to inflict or try to preserve your humanity?

The decision is yours. So are the consequences.

Features: 
- The torture chamber: study your victims, find their weak spot, and use your extensive arsenal (or their loved ones) to break them
- An occult underground: a town filled with mysticism built around Medieval artefacts, such as the Hand of Glory and Mandrake Root
- A dark economy: a market in dead flesh with you as its main supplier
- Synesthesia: your character's unique perceptive abilities make him a walking lie detector
- Staying sane: as a professional torturer you'll need to constantly manage your sanity to survive

title: Splatter Zombiecalypse Now [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]

description:
Splatter — eto dinamichnyy shuter s vidom sverkhu, vypolnennyy v estetike nuar-filmov. Vstupayte v neprostye skhvatki s zombi i monstrami, naslazhdayas krovavymi effektami i razrushaemym okruzheniem. Eto vam ne kakaya-to tam zauryadnaya strelyalka. My otpravlyaem vas v put s ogromnym arsenalom uluchshaemogo oruzhiya, kotoroe pomozhet pobedit ordy vragov. Vstrechayte interesnykh personazhey, vypolnyayte desyatki pobochnykh zadaniy i uchastvuyte v zapominayushchikhsya bitvakh s bossami.

Vsegda derzhite vash vernyy fonar pri sebe, ved zombi boyatsya sveta. Ispolzuyte ego, chtoby sozdat prostranstvo mezhdu soboy i vragami i obnaruzhit ikh skrytye slabosti.

Syuzhetnyy rezhim sostoit iz 16 urovney, napolnennykh polnostyu ozvuchennymi NIP i animirovannymi vstavkami.

Beyte rekordy v rezhime vyzhivaniya ili sobirayte komandu iz 4 druzey, chtoby vmeste dat boy orde!

Klyuchevye osobennosti:
Slozhnye skhvatki s raznogo roda zombi i monstrami.
Nuarnaya syuzhetnaya kampaniya dlya odnogo igroka s polnostyu ozvuchennymi dialogami i vstavkami.
Unikalnye bossy, tekhnika i mnozhestvo pobochnykh zadaniy.

Razrushaemoe okruzhenie i uluchshaemoe oruzhie, kotoroe s kazhdym urovnem poluchaet novye funktsii i sposobnosti.
Arkadnye rezhimy igry s onlayn-tablitsami liderov, gde mozhno posorevnovatsya s druzyami.
Lokalnyy mnogopolzovatelskiy rezhim do 4 igrokov.
I poslednee, no ne menee vazhnoe: mnogo i mnogo ekshna

description:
Weedcraft Inc issleduet biznes po proizvodstvu, razvedeniyu i prodazhe marikhuany v Amerike, gluboko vnikaya v finansovye, politicheskie i kulturnye aspekty slozhnykh otnosheniy strany s etim problemnym i mnogoobeshchayushchim rasteniem.

Potentsialnye magnaty marikhuany dolzhny budut tshchatelno rasstavlyat prioritety v resursakh, poskolku oni upravlyayut proizvodstvom i rasprostraneniem svoey travki. Vyrashchivayte rasteniya, skreshchivayte ikh dlya sozdaniya novykh sortov, nanimayte i upravlyayte rastushchim personalom i budte gotovy prinyat uchastie v sorevnovaniyakh. Reshite, kogda i gde vzyat na sebya dopolnitelnyy risk, chtoby maksimizirovat pribyl, no budte ostorozhny, politseyskie i politiki deystvuyut po-svoemu.

Vazhnaya i protivorechivaya tema, predstavlennaya v pronitsatelnoy i podrobnoy manere, Weedcraft Inc brosaet vyzov tem, kto khochet upravlyat refrizheratorom, predlagaya seriyu raznoobraznykh stsenariev i unikalnykh personazhey, s kotorymi (ili ryadom) mozhno rabotat po mere rosta vashey mnogoobeshchayushchey imperii. Nezavisimo ot togo, reshite li vy druzhit s politikami, podkupat politsiyu, borotsya za prava na meditsinskuyu marikhuanu ili rabotat s pravovoy sistemoy, vse eto vo imya lipkoy nepriglyadnosti i vashey besposhchadnoy korporativnoy pribyli.

Funktsii:

- Vklyuchaet nastraivaemyy rezhim pesochnitsy, tri obshirnykh stsenariya i bolee prostoy rezhim Chill Mode.

- Protivorechie predstavleno s ponimaniem.

- Upravlyayte ekonomikoy i rasprostraneniem svoego nachinayushchego biznesa.

- Vybor, kotoryy imeet znachenie, personazhi so svoimi motivami, vse oni predstavleny v istorii s yumorom i serdtsem.

- Oboruduyte svoyu komnatu dlya vyrashchivaniya dlya polucheniya nailuchshikh urozhaev i kontroliruyte kazhdyy element svoego vyrashchivaniya.

- Izmenite zakony, izmenite obshchestvo i izmenite to, kak okruzhayushchiy mir vosprinimaet vash produkt.

- Igrayte po pravilam, narushayte ikh ili prosto nemnogo narushayte. Moral nakhoditsya na skolzyashchey shkale v Weedcraft Inc.

- Nanimayte i uvolnyayte sotrudnikov, narushayte konkurentsiyu i zakon lyubymi dostupnymi vam sredstvami. Ili derzhite svoikh vragov ryadom.

title: Boxing Champs [NSP][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
"Chempiony boksa" — eto bolshe chem prosto boi na ringe. Zdes vas zhdut stremitelnaya i uvlekatelnaya arkadnaya grafika i animatsiya, a takzhe geympley simulyatora, sozdayushchiy realnye oshchushcheniya boksa. Pochuvstvuyte kazhdyy udar blagodarya polnomu kontrolyu udarov dvumya dzhoystikami. Zashchishchaytes ot udarov i beytes s druzyami v mnogopolzovatelskom rezhime ili voydite v istoriyu sporta, proydya vse etapy karery do zvaniya absolyutnogo chempiona mira. Ispolzuyte dzheby i kombiniruyte udary na dalney distantsii ili podoydite k protivniku blizhe i probeyte khuk ili apperkot. Pochuvstvuyte dukh boksa i "pogasite svet" soperniku.

· Odnopolzovatelskiy ili mnogopolzovatelskiy rezhim. Vozmozhnost srazhatsya protiv iskusstvennogo intellekta ili dratsya s druzyami za vse chempionskie poyasa. Prinimayte uchastie v boyakh v Las-Vegase, Nyu-Yorke, Los-Andzhelese, v gorodskom zale ili na arene chempionov boksa.
· Sozdayte boksera: Sozdavayte sobstvennykh bokserov, ispolzuya bolee 70 stiley prichesok, menyayte tsvet volos, tsvet kozhi, tip tela, perchatki, shorty i pokazateli boksera. Vozmozhnosti bezgranichny! V spiske uzhe est 30 gotovykh bokserov.
· Rezhim karery: Sozdayte svoego boksera i vmeste s vashim trenerom podnimaytes po stupenkam mirovogo reytinga. Vy mozhete prinyat uchastie v boyakh za 4 titula. Vyigrayte vse 4 poyasa, obediniv takim obrazom vse tituly.
· Polnyy kontrol udarov! Ispolzuyte sdvoennye dzhoystiki, chtoby peremeshchatsya i nanosit udary. Intuitivnoe upravlenie pozvolit pochuvstvovat kazhdyy udar — prosto peremeshchayte dzhoystik v napravlenii udara. Vibratsiya obespechivaet dopolnitelnuyu obratnuyu svyaz. Te, kto predpochitaet igrat knopkami, takzhe mogut ispolzovat ikh dlya upravleniya udarami.

title: Bish Bash Bots [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 机器翻译 来自 most2820
description:
Bish Bash Bots — eto unikalnoe sochetanie: zashchita bashni, strategiya i kulachnye boi bez tormozov. Soberite komandu dlya igry na odnom ustroystve ili cherez Internet libo spasite mir v odinochku. 

V etoy multyashnoy versii dalyokogo budushchego roboty stali neotemlemoy chastyu zhizni. Vsyo izmenilos, kogda roboty bez vsyakoy, kazalos by, prichiny nachali sboit i krast tekhnologii po vsemu miru.

Nastupil khaos i raznoshyorstnaya komanda reshaet spasti mir. Pravda, oni ne vidyat sebya geroyami. Vooruzhivshis znaniyami i navykami, nashi geroi otpravlyayutsya v bolshoe puteshestvie, chtoby sbrosit nastroyki robotov i spasti mir. Stroyte uluchshaemye tureli, otkryvayte novye gadzhety i beyte robotov ogromnymi molotami.

Puteshestvuyte po yarkim biomam etogo mira, razrabotayte strategiyu oborony ot uymy robotov i spasite chelovechestvo!

> Podvizhnye vragi 
Ogromnye tolpy robotov mogut menyat napravlenie dvizheniya, a igroki i tureli mogut ikh tolkat, pikhat i raskidyvat.

> Strategiya i draki
Unikalnoe sochetanie zhanrov: zashchita kreposti, strategiya i massovaya draka. Oruduyte ogromnym molotom, begayte i prygayte po yarkim urovnyam. Uznayte, kak luchshe vsego primenyat tureli protiv nadvigayushchikhsya tolp vragov.

> Igra s druzyami ili v odinochku
Mozhno odinakovo interesno igrat v odinochnom ili kooperativnom rezhime. Igrayte po seti ili lokalno v komande do 4 igrokov. Lokalnykh i setevykh igrokov mozhno sochetat kak ugodno.

> Raznoobraznye urovni 
Puteshestvuyte po futuristichnomu miru iz 32 yarkikh raznoobraznykh urovney. Spravlyaytes s unikalnymi ispytaniyami v 8 biomakh — ot vulkana, kotoryy peregrevaet tureli, do rasteniy-mutantov, utyagivayushchikh igrokov v dzhungli.

> Novye tekhnologii
Po mere prodvizheniya cherez mir dobavlyayte v kollektsiyu novye tureli i gadzhety. Ispolzuyte ikh v bitvakh s naborom unikalnykh robotov. Vypolnyayte ispytaniya, chtoby otkryvat novye ukrasheniya.

> Neskonchaemoe vesele
Igrokam nekogda otdykhat, i oni ne prosto zhdut, kak razvernutsya sobytiya. Stroyte i uluchshayte tureli, sobirayte metallolom, beyte robotov i polzuytes unikalnymi turelyami v bitve za spasenie mira.

title: Danger Scavenger [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Zaberites vyshe, chem obychno.

Danger Scavenger – eto napryazhennyy rouglayk v stile kiberpank na kryshakh neboskrebov. Vam predstoit dat otpor moguchim protivnikam, kotorymi upravlyaet bezdushnyy iskusstvennyy intellekt.

Zabudte o podzemelyakh, peshcherakh i adskoy mgle. Mir izmenilsya, nastali novye vremena. Vam predstoit otpravitsya na kryshi v poiskakh priklyucheniy i sokrovishch, novykh gorizontov i vozmozhnostey.

Prisoedinyaytes k gruppe izgoev i otpravlyaytes na opasnuyu okhotu za svobodoy i sokrovishchami, spryatannymi na kryshakh ogromnykh neboskrebov. Opasnost tak velika, chto kazhdyy Utilshchik mozhet navsegda pomenyat istoriyu… ili ostatsya ocherednym zabytym sborshchikom metalloloma. Vybirayte put ostorozhno: chem bolshe nagrada, tem vyshe risk!

title: Kero Blaster [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Tebe predstoit igrat za peredvigayushchuyusya na dvukh nogakh lyagushku, rabotayushchuyu v zagadochnoy korporatsii «Koshka i Lyagushka».

Otbivaysya ot meshayushchikh tvoemu prodvizheniyu vragov i peresekay trudnopreodolimye lokatsii na puti k tseli. 

V samom nachale igry tebya, dolzhno byt, udivyat tvoe maloe kolichestvo zhizney i slabenkoe oruzhie. Da eshche i kak tolko zhizni zakanchivayutsya, tvoy personazh okazyvaetsya v bolnitse, a uroven prikhoditsya nachinat s nachala. Odnako na kropotlivo sobrannye dengi mozhno dokupit sebe zhizney i usilit oruzhie s umom, tak, chto vragi, kotorye ranshe tebya pobezhdali, perestayut byt pomekhoy. Chem dalshe poluchaetsya prodvinutsya v igre, tem bolshe poluchaesh udovletvoreniya ot osoznaniya rosta svoey sily. 

Eshche odna zabavnaya osobennost igry — personazhi, s kotorye vstrechayutsya mezhdu urovnyami. Tvoy kollega pochemu-to kot, direktor firmy tozhe koshka, a devushka v ofise voobshche nevedomaya zverushka. Vse oni, kak i my, rabotayut i pererabatyvayut, zhaluyutsya na zhizn, sryvayutsya na krik, no i podbadrivayut drug druga. 

Tshchatelno prorabotannyy nami mir Kero Blaster navernyaka dostavit tebe massu udovolstviya.
