title: Beyond the Ice Palace 2 [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
在這款引人入勝的動作平台遊戲中，從死亡的深淵崛起，奪回你應得的王位。化身「被詛咒的國王」，揮舞曾經禁錮你的枷鎖，現在，這些鎖鏈已變成強大的武器，助你消滅敵人，遊走在殘破王國的險境中。找出隱藏區域、解開謎團，發掘祕寶讓自己實力大增，準備與強大的巨型 BOSS 展開激戰。策略性地提升等級，以擊敗所有阻擋你前進的人，再次登上本應屬於你的王座！

死而復生，奪回屬於你的王位！
化身「被詛咒的國王」，踏上冷酷無情的復仇之路，奪回被搶走的王位。穿越危機四伏的險境，搜尋散落的蒼穹之箭碎片，並將它們合而為一以淨化你的詛咒、解放你真正的力量。

揮舞曾經禁錮你的枷鎖！
擁抱你新獲得的力量，掌控那曾將你束縛在地穴深處的鎖鏈。手持這強大的武器擊退、揮砍膽敢擋路的人，將他們殺得片甲不留。利用你的鎖鏈進一步探索，將之繫上圓環，在峽谷中推進，到達新的區域。

找出隱藏區域，重拾王國的寶藏
探索岌岌可危的王國的每一吋土地，發掘滿是無價之寶的密室及密道。隨著你越來越深入，你將獲得新發現的能力和強化效果，讓自己準備好迎接前方的考驗。

收集水晶與道具，讓自己實力大增！
發掘謎樣的「能量水晶」並吸收其中的精華，就能策略性地增強你的能力，在步步逼近的挑戰中佔盡優勢。

將巨型惡魔驅逐出你的領土！
激烈的戰鬥考驗著你的戰略手腕和時間掌控，唯有嫻熟的操作才能擊敗強大的巨型 BOSS。

經典重現！《Beyond The Ice Palace》強勢回歸！
見證 35 年前的邪門經典重現於世！

title: Morkull Ragast's Rage / Ascend to the Gods [NSZ][ENG]
description:
打破第四面牆的類銀河惡魔城遊戲。

在這個遊戲裡你將操縱魔骨，一個大反派。
他知道自己正在被第四面牆背後的什麼人控制著——也就是你，親愛的玩家。
也知道自己只是一個被創造出來的遊戲角色——沒錯，我們做的。

而你的任務，則是幫助魔骨逃離這個被稱為“拉格斯”的世界，以便他能將邪惡的爪牙伸至整個世界。
就是……刻板印象的超級大反派。

由豐富的技能和連招構建的戰鬥系統。

在遊戲中你能逐漸解鎖魔骨的全部力量。
彈反、升龍、蓄力斬……
巧妙組合主動和被動能力，打出華麗的連招制霸拉格斯吧！

全手繪的場景與動畫。

《魔骨》的全部場景和角色動畫，都由手繪逐幀完成。
就像二十世紀前的老動畫片一樣，希望賦予角色親切自然又栩栩如生的動畫效果。

打破第四面牆！

作為一個多話又搞笑的反派，魔骨會在很多時候主動向你搭話。
灰色幽默、低俗笑話、流行文化無所不聊。
你一定會愛上這個自來熟的反派角色，還有這款有點特別的遊戲！

title: Fitness Boxing - Fist of the North Star: You are already Slim + DLC (Hokuto no Ken Omae wa Mou Yaseteiru, boks) [NSZ][ENG]
voice_lang: 英语, 法语, 意大利语 + kastomnyy LFS-MOD yaponskogo andaba 用于 v0
description:
«..Maybe You And I Should Settle It Right Here On The Ring If You Think You're So Tough?» ©
Treniruytes v realnosti s dzhoykonami i povyshayte fit-uroven svoego tela v mire Fist of the North Star, s dostupom ko vsem funktsiyam Fitness Boxing! Vashimi instruktorami stanut khorosho znakomye personazhi, takie kak Kensiro, samyy mladshiy iz bratev Khokuto i izbrannyy naslednik iskusstva boya Khokuto Sinken «Kulaka Polyarnoy zvezdy».
Krome togo, v igre poyavilsya novyy rezhim, v kotorom mozhno srazhatsya s sopernikami — teper vy smozhete ne tolko trenirovatsya, no i naslazhdatsya uluchshennym geympleem.
Razberites so mnozhestvom vragov na vashem puti i nokautiruyte vsekh zlodeev v bitvakh s bossami!..Eshchyo igr Fitness Boxing.

title: Gunbrella [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
《Gunbrella》是寫實的黑色電影龐克風動作冒險遊戲，描寫某種不可或缺的自然資源迅速減少的世界。

扮演歷經日曬雨淋的嚴肅男子，走出樹林踏上復仇之路，進入陌生小鎮。你唯一的武器就是傘槍，這把威力強大的傘槍名副其實，亦傘亦槍。

堅持追查到底之後，你旋即被捲入了一群恐怖的殘忍之徒、幫派分子、警方、異教徒的陰謀，還要面對大企業濫採資源的後果。

與傘槍合而為一
感受刺激的橫向捲軸戰鬥，善用傘槍獨一無二的操控靈活度與近距離戰鬥能力。傘槍不只是武器，還能四處滑翔、擺盪、衝刺、俯衝，途中探索看似無法解開的祕密。

拿槍追查，鉅細靡遺
探索各種風格鮮明的特別地點，踏入居民被異教徒綁架摧殘的小鎮，再到無情垃圾幫派統治的垃圾場堡壘，審問古怪的角色，找出答案。用可靠的筆記本記下調查發現，別忘了回頭追查去過的地方……

取得物品，裝填子彈，再來一次。
收集廢料與多餘零件，為你固若金湯的武器換取多種彈藥並升級。等你深入追查，碰上越來越駭人的超自然存在之後，任何幫助肯定都派得上用場。

title: Peace, Death! 1-2 Complete edition [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Peace, Death! - eto arkadnyy simulyator, kotoryy okazyvaetsya kuda slozhnee, chem kazhetsya na pervyy vzglyad!

V etoy igre tebe predstoit stat internom v kompanii “Apokalipsis” i porabotat na Smert. Chtoby pravilno opredelit sudbu klienta i otpravit ego v Ray ili Ad, tebe pridetsya vnimatelno rassmotret ego vizualnye osobennosti. 

Zabavnye frazy klientov, mnozhestvo otsylok i paskhalok, bonusy, shtrafy i osobennye klienty - vsyo eto i mnogoe drugoe zhdyot tebya v Peace, Death!

Peace, Death! Polnoe Izdanie vklyuchaet v sebya dopolnenie “Hand of F”, uluchshenie grafiki i igrovogo protsessa!

title: Leo and Tig, Taiga [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
description:
以同名動畫影集為基礎的遊戲《Leo and Tig》，將帶你與動畫中迷人的角色一同展開冒險：阿穆爾豹雷歐、活潑好動的老虎提格、黃鼬米拉、敏捷的猞猁雅拉、開朗的小豬庫巴、松鼠馬爾蒂克、幼鷹基諾，以及勇敢的小兔子威利。

每個角色都擁有獨特的能力，幫助他們克服各種挑戰！遊戲包含七個極其美麗的場景，逐步展開一段關於友情、互助與關愛自然的故事。

《Leo and Tig：Taiga》是一款引人入勝的街機遊戲，匯集了你最喜愛的角色。

獨特的泰加林世界等待著玩家，在這裡可以完成精彩的任務並解開富有挑戰性的謎題。解鎖動物角色的專屬能力，讓他們探索充滿秘密的美麗地點。

title: New Pokemon Snap [NSP][ENG]
description:
在未開拓之地「藍蒂爾地區」裡，一邊發現寶可夢們未曾展現過的表情與動作，一邊拍下照片完成專屬自己的寶可夢寫真圖鑑。
乘坐沿著航線自動移動的「新壹號」，拍下野生寶可夢們的照片。既有藏身於不起眼之處的寶可夢，也有突然從天而降的寶可夢，說不定還能遇見傳說的寶可夢或幻之寶可夢喔……？能否捕捉到決定性的一瞬，就看你的實力了。
不斷拍下大量的寶可夢照片，完成專屬於你的寶可夢照片圖鑑吧！
在調查中所拍攝的照片除了可以登錄到寶可夢寫真圖鑑之外，還可以儲存到相簿。既然可以按照自己的喜好來調整和加工照片，何不就用喜愛的照片來填滿相簿呢？
加入「Nintendo Switch Online」（付費）的玩家除了可以透過排行榜系統與世界各地的人比賽得分之外，還可以體驗分享照片的樂趣。

title: Farewell North [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Pogruzhaytes v atmosferu ostrovov, issleduya ikh v svoem tempe, razgadyvaya tayny proshlogo i otkryvaya novye istorii, kotorye priveli k ukhodu tsveta iz etogo udivitelnogo mira arkhipelagov.
V igre my budem vozvrashchat tsvet na mrachnye ostrova, vzyav na sebya rol border-kolli, kotoryy otpravlyaetsya v zakhvatyvayushchee puteshestvie vmeste so svoim khozyainom. Takzhe my smozhem issledovat sushu i more, otkryvat novye tropy i osvobozhdat dikikh zhivotnykh, chtoby vosstanovit kraski mira i raskryt trogatelnuyu istoriyu proshchaniya.
Aktivatsiya spyashchikh dikikh zhivotnykh privedet k otkrytiyu novykh putey i razblokirovke novykh sekretnykh mest, chtoby pomoch miru vernut tsvet. Bez golovolomok razrabotchiki nas tozhe reshili ne ostavlyat, i sdelali ikh osnovannymi na perspektive i tsvetovoy gamme.Eshchyo pokhozhikh igr pro lisu.

title: Of Blades & Tails [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Vash geroy — Reyk, nakhodchivyy predstavitel lisego plemeni. Tsepochka tragicheskikh sobytiy vtyagivaet vas v nastoyashchee priklyuchenie, iskhod kotorogo vazhen dlya vsekh mirolyubivykh obitateley strany. Chtoby nabratsya sil dlya borby so zlom, vam pridyotsya ostavit rodnuyu derevnyu i otpravitsya skitatsya po svetu.
Po mere priklyucheniy vy budete nabiratsya opyta i poluchat novye sposobnosti. Ne vse obitateli etogo mira k vam druzhelyubny. Kto-to podelitsya s vami poleznoy informatsiey, nekotorykh interesuet lish torgovlya, a ostalnye mogut i napast. Chtoby poluchit reshayushchee preimushchestvo v bitve, uluchshayte snaryazhenie i sobirayte poleznye resursy, kotorye mozhno vstretit povsyudu.
— Neobychnaya vselennaya razumnykh zhivotnykh, vypolnennaya v yarkom pikselnom stile,

title: Slender: The Arrival [NSZ][ENG]
description: Vy predostavleny samomu sebe. Nikto ne pridet vam na pomoshch. Nikto ne uslyshit vashikh krikov. Slender: The Arrival yavlyaetsya ofitsialnoy adaptatsiey videoigry Slender Man, vossozdannoy iz shchekochushchego nervy tvoreniya Marka Khedli. Razrabotannaya v sotrudnichestve s Blue Isle Studios, igra The Arrival imeet sovershenno novyy syuzhet, uluchshennuyu grafiku i, chto samoe glavnoe, bespodobnuyu atmosferu uzhasa v situatsii, kogda chelovek postavlen na gran vyzhivaniya.

title: Zag Heroez Miraculous: Rise of the Sphinx + DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Parizhu nuzhen geroy! Gorod ogney snova v opasnosti, v etot raz emu ugrozhaet samyy opasnyy iz sozdannykh santimonstrov, kotoryy pytaetsya utverdit svoyu vlast nad gorodom!  Upravlyayte odnim iz vsemirno izvestnykh supergeroev: Ladybug i Cat Noir, raskroyte dyavolskiy plan, kotoryy vynashivaet arkhizlodey Hawk Moth— i sorvite ego!  Pogruzites v volshebnyy mir Miraculous, razvivayte sverkhsposobnosti i otpravlyaytes v uvlekatelnoe puteshestvie! 

Klyuchevye osobennosti igry:

• Grandioznoe priklyuchenie! Pogruzites v originalnuyu istoriyu i upravlyayte polyubivshimisya geroyami: Ladybug i Cat Noir. 
• Deystvuyte vmeste! Raskroyte potentsial komandnoy raboty, srazhaytes so zlodeyami i umirotvoryayteakum askumas, igraya v lokalnom kooperative. 
• Bolshe zlodeev! Vstrettes litsom k litsu so znakomymi zlodeyami: Hawk Moth, Gamer, Weredad, i Mr. Pigeon, a takzhe novymi neizvestnymi vragami!
• Otkrytiya! Issleduyte ulitsy Parizha, igraya za Marinette i Adrien i raskroyte istorii ikh taynykh lichnostey: Ladybug i Cat Noir. 
• Supergadzhety! Ispolzuyte bystryy yo-yo Ladybug i volshebnyy universalnyy posokh Cat Noir, chtoby nachat boy na svoikh usloviyakh! Uluchshayte gadzhety i otkryvayte novye silnye priemy!
• Master Fu! Naveshchayte svoego druga i nastavnika Master Fu, chi mudrye izrecheniya pomogut raskryt novye sily. 
• Magazin kwami: Otkroyte dlya sebya sokrovishcha magazina kwami i razblokiruyte ranee nevidannye izobrazheniya, muzyku i mnogoe drugoe.
• Zadaniya druzey: Igraya za Marinette i Adrien, vstrechaytes s druzyami, ishchite zatsepki, chtoby prodvigatsya po istorii i otkryvat osobye vstrechi.

title: Redout Lightspeed edition / Redout Space Assault / Redout 2 [NSZ][RUS/Multi]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
VSTREChAYTE ARKADNYY KOSMIChESKIY ShUTER NOVOGO POKOLENIYa
Redout: Space Assault posadit vas za shturval sverkhorbitalnogo istrebitelya-razvedchika, v 2395 god — epokhu kolonizatsii Marsa: Vas zhdet samoe dinamichnoe, epicheskoe i zakhvatyvayushchee arkadnoe kosmicheskoe srazhenie, kotoroe kogda-libo poyavlyalos dlya. Perekhitrite, pereigrayte, preodoleyte i prevzoydite svoikh sopernikov v molnienosnykh, polnykh adrenalina odnopolzovatelskikh kosmicheskikh bataliyakh.

Vy — Leon Barret, pilot-as sil bezopasnosti Poseydona. Segodnya, kogda chelovechestvo boretsya za svoe vyzhivanie na opalennoy zharoy, pustynnoy Zemle, i v promerzlykh, tesnykh koloniyakh Luny, my — korporatsiya «Poseydon», — pytaemsya otkryt lyudyam put k kolonizatsii Marsa. Vasha zadacha — podderzhivat zakon i poryadok. Unichtozhayte buntovshchikov i kosmicheskikh piratov, obespechte bezopasnost nashikh uchenykh i pomogite v ikh issledovaniyakh, zashchitite nashikh sotrudnikov ot mnogochislennykh ugroz.

Proletayte skvoz gigantskie asteroidnye rudniki, sbivayte bespilotniki i istrebiteli myatezhnikov, zakladyvayte bokovye virazhi, ukhodya ot ognya protivnika, obrushivayte na tsel sverkhmoshchnye raketnye zalpy! I konechno zhe gonyayte na golovokruzhitelnykh skorostyakh s drugimi pilotami i kosmicheskimi musorshchikami — prosto tak, veselya radi.

Kazhdoe vypolnennoe zadanie prinosit vam karty i zhetony, s pomoshchyu kotorykh mozhno uluchshit korpus, shchity, rakety i energeticheskoe oruzhie vashego korablya. Uluchshit nastolko, chto vy v odinochku smozhete raspravitsya s ogromnymi boevymi korablyami, predopredelyaya khod voyny. 

V zhernovakh mezhplanetnoy voyny, gde net khoroshikh i plokhikh, Leonu predstoit rasti po sluzhebnoy lestnitse, uznat, chto takoe «neobkhodimoe zlo», ponyat istinnuyu tsenu chesti i, v itoge, vo chto obkhodyatsya printsipy.

OSOBENNOSTI
Rezhim karery — osvoyte vse navyki, kotorye potrebuyutsya vam dlya vyzhivaniya i pobed vo vselennoy Redout. 43 zadaniy stanut proverkoy vashikh sposobnostey i rasskazhut istoriyu, kotoruyu vam eshche ne dovodilos slyshat.
Mnozhestvo dinamichnykh mirov — neobychnye mesta, grandioznye yavleniya i epicheskie bitvy za kazhdyy rubezh.

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (TMNT) Mutants Unleashed + 4 DLC [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 机器翻译 来自 iks1981
voice_lang: 英语, 法语, 德语, 西班牙语
description:
Mutanty i lyudi neplokho ladili drug s drugom, prozhivaya bok o bok v Nyu-Yorke. No zatem Leonardo, Rafael, Mikelandzhelo i Donatello obnaruzhili, chto neskolko partiy mutagennoy slizi byli razbrosany po gorodu, chto privelo k ego zagryazneniyu. Kazalos by, vse ne tak plokho, poka geroi ne osoznali, chto eto proisshestvie stalo prichinoy poyavleniya novykh mutantov, tak nazyvaemykh Mewbie. Ne vse Mewbie zlye, no nekotorye iz nikh sbilis s puti, otchego lyudi bolshe ne chuvstvuyut sebya v bezopasnosti.
Prisoedinyaytes k legendarnym bratyam-Cherepashkam, zhivushchim v kanalizatsii, i otpravlyaytes v novoe zakhvatyvayushchee priklyuchenie. Prigotovtes k borbe s prestupnostyu i pogruzites v epicheskuyu sagu o spravedlivosti i khaose pod mudrym rukovodstvom Splintera, a takzhe s pomoshchyu podrobnykh aprelskikh otchetov pryamo s ulits!

title: Phantom Breaker Battle Grounds Overdrive / Ultimate [NSZ][ENG,RUS]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description: A spinoff to the fighting game "Phantom Breaker", "Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds" is a cooperative action game for up to four players. Cute versions of the series' characters dash around the screen in this action packed title. Defeat enemies to raise your characters' levels and freely assign skills to your liking. Also enjoy head to head fights in the Battleground mode.

title: Yomawari 1-2: The Long Night Collection (Night Alone / Midnight Shadows), Yomawari 3: Lost in the Dark [NSP][ENG]
description: A young girl must explore a haunted town and search for her missing memories in order to break a curse. She’ll have to rely on only her wits, cunning, and a well-placed hiding spot or two to evade the twisted ghosts that wander the streets.

title: Mind Path to Thalamus [NSP][RUS/Multi10]
developer: Pantumaca Barcelona, Dani Navarro, Carlos Coronado, Luka Nieto
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Wrapped in a mind-bending tale, the gameplay of “MIND” focuses on changing the very weather in order to solve puzzles: the player will cycle between day and night, modify the levels of fog and rain and even travel in time between seasons, changing the environment to advance the gameplay-driven story —indeed, the mechanics are directly related to who the protagonist is, what has happened to him and everything he is doing: a man trapped in his own mind, he must use all the tools at his disposition to escape to reality. Accompanied by the snarky yet heartfelt narration of this comatose patient, the player will guide him through fantastical forests, dark caverns and deceptive worlds of water and ice that directly relate to his emotional state at each point in his journey.

Features

• 4 secret levels, redesigned interactive ending, narration and also an alternative ending.
• More than 40 different, creative puzzles seamlessly integrated into the environment.
• 6 ways to affect the environment in order to solve the puzzles.
• More than 25 distinct landscapes into with which you will be able to interact.
• Turn day to night, make it so everything is covered by a blinding fog, summon incredible storms, travel to the past and make use of even more as of yet unknown mechanics.
• More than an hour of voice acting that, while integrated into the gameplay itself, will tell you a whole story that is not about saving the world but about living through the pain of a father broken by his mistakes.
• Face down imposing enemies by using your creativity and everything you have learnt along the way.

title: Bomb Chicken [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
Kto zhe ne lyubit kuritsu… osobenno pod vkusneyshim ostrym sinim sousom? V rezultate neobychnogo proisshestviya samaya obychnaya kuritsa stala otkladyvat bomby vmesto yaits. Osvoyte universalnuyu mekhaniku zakladki bomb v etom vzryvnom platformere.

- Zakladyvayte tsepochki bomb, chtoby zabiratsya povyshe.
- Brosayte bomby, chtoby smetat prepyatstviya i raspravlyatsya so smertelnymi vragami.
- Ispolzuyte otskoki, chtoby bomby ogibali neprokhodimye zony ili dazhe ugly!
- Ispolzuyte bomby kak gruzilo.
- Stavte zaslony i zashchishchaytes ot vrazheskikh atak.
- Probivaytes vniz, chtoby otkryvat sekretnye zony.
- Podzhigayte, i pust vsyo gorit sinim plamenem!

Otkroyte dlya sebya samuyu temnuyu taynu giganta fast-fuda, izvestnogo kak BFC, i lidera ikh prodazh - vyzyvayushchiy privykanie ostryy siniy sous. I otvette na glavnyy vopros: chto poyavilos ranshe - kuritsa ili bomba?
