title: Mars Survivor [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Posle katastrofy asteroida vy okazalis na Marse. No ne otchaivaytes! Issleduyte tayny planety, produmayte strategiyu pobega i preodolevayte prepyatstviya s kazhdym nazhatiem.
V etoy uvlekatelnoy igre vy:

title: Arcade Game Zone 40 Games [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Prisoedinyaytes k epicheskomu arkadnomu puteshestviyu!
Bezuprechnyy virtualnyy arkadnyy zal! Territoriya arkadnykh igr obedinyaet 40 mini-taytlov, vklyuchaya repliku klassiki, naydennoy v legendarnykh zabroshennykh arkadnykh shkafakh.
No eto eshche ne vsyo — my takzhe vklyuchili syuda 10 kultovykh sportivnykh igr, takie kak darts, futbol, bilyard, bouling i mnogie drugie, kotorye obychno vstrechayutsya v izvestnykh arkadnykh zavedeniyakh po vsemu miru.

title: Mari and Bayu the Road Home [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Mari & Bayu: The Road Home – kooperativnoe 2D-priklyuchenie v mire nasekomykh. Pomogite Mari vernutsya domoy i nayti svoego brata Toma. Obedinite usiliya s ee volshebnym drugom Bayyu, kotoryy razyskivaet svoyu pokhishchennuyu semyu i pomogaet Mari nayti v sebe sily vernutsya domoy.

Pogruzites v uvlekatelnuyu i trogatelnuyu istoriyu o potere i poiske zhiznennogo puti.

Osobennosti

Kroshechnyy mir, ogromnoe priklyuchenie. Reshayte golovolomki, letayte po vetru na peryakh, sedlayte kuznechikov, vzaimodeystvuyte s drugimi nasekomymi, issleduyte okruzhenie i ispolzuyte sverkhsposobnosti Bayyu.

Igra dlya odnogo ili dvukh igrokov. Igrayte za Mari i Bayyu libo v odinochku, libo v kooperativnom rezhime. U kazhdogo iz rezhimov est svoi osobennosti.

Issleduyte porazitelnyy 2D-mir. V yarkoy vselennoy Mari & Bayu: The Road Home sochetayutsya grafika vysshego klassa i spetseffekty.

Nasladites bogatym i unikalnym okruzheniem. Issleduyte mir s tochki zreniya muravya. Odin shag dlya cheloveka – eto grandioznoe i opasnoe priklyuchenie dlya nasekomogo. Ot glubokikh temnykh luzh i mukhoboek do zhestokikh chudovishch. V obshchey slozhnosti vas zhdut 12 raznoobraznykh i unikalnykh mirov.

Vas zhdet ogromnyy mir nasekomykh. Smozhete li vy vernutsya domoy?

title: MLB The Show 2022 Deluxe edition [NSZ][ENG]
description:
每次投球。每次擊球。每場勝利。在 MLB® The Show™ 22 之中留下深刻的印象，並主宰整個球場。  

- 建立並使用多位球員，不僅超越生涯模式 [Road to the Show] 的個人化棒球 RPG 體驗，還能依自己的喜好客製化球員，使其協助於推進遊戲進度。
- Diamond Dynasty 回歸了，而且比以前更臻完美！遊玩、收集並打造出夢幻卡牌收藏，讓棒球場充滿活力朝氣。* 快來嘗試全新的 Mini Seasons 模式，每個賽季都會帶來全新挑戰，你也將迎戰各個競爭對手！
- 在不同平台間與你的朋友對戰。** 搭載跨平台遊戲進度功能，在其他的主機平台上也能繼續你的遊戲進度，並賺取及使用內容。***
- 第一次踏上本壘板嗎？利用不同的遊戲玩法風格及兩種全新的難度設定來量身打造你的遊戲體驗，以協助你瞭解遊戲的基本玩法。
- 全新的介紹風格提供空前絕後最為沉浸的球場體驗。  
- 依自己的風格遊玩賽季模式 [March to October]，並能透過已更新的模式工具來使用客製化的制服、標誌及已建立的體育場。
- 全新傳奇球員加入球場，實現你的夢想棒球賽事。

MLB The Show 22 需要至少 20GB 的下載容量。需有 microSD（單獨販售）。儲存空間需求可能有所改變。

title: MLB® The Show™ 24 [NSZ][ENG]
description:
此版本的 MLB The Show 24 包含：
• 完整遊戲
• 5 個 The Show Pack

解鎖你的時刻

這就是你的主場。準備好大展身手了嗎？
踏上成就偉大歷程的棒球之路——無論想要達到什麼樣的成就，MLB® The Show™ 24 都能協助完成。 
從小型賽事一路挺進大型聯賽，並證明自己擁有登峰造極的實力。向運動界的傳奇人物學習、受到他們英勇的士氣鼓舞，並加以運用來提升自己的比賽實力。繃緊神經迎擊重要時刻，就能讓自己的世界大賽冠軍頭銜實至名歸。
贏得佳績，在輸掉比賽後重振士氣。
無論發生什麼事，要知道你並沒有留下任何遺憾。

利用故事線 [Storylines] 來歡慶歷史
一同歡慶，並了解運動史上的棒球傳奇人物。故事線 [Storylines] 模式帶你回到棒球絢爛的過去，以重溫棒球史上無人知曉的過往及無名英雄的經典時刻。透過身歷其境的遊戲玩法結合，體驗職涯中決定性的時刻，還能教育並激勵你締造屬於自己的歷史。

Road to the Show
在終極的棒球角色扮演體驗中解鎖你的時刻，並打造你的輝煌職涯。成為一名棒球選手，並從小型比賽一路挺進大型賽事，進而定義你的完美傳承。 

Franchise
在 Franchise 模式中，以球隊經理的身份，帶領球隊挺進光榮的世界大賽。在賽季模式 [March to October] 體驗更詳盡及更為動態的遊戲玩法。

March to October
掌控最喜愛的球隊，並專注於重要的流暢賽季內時刻，看看是否能堅持到季後挑戰賽及更後面的階段。 

Diamond Dynasty
在 Diamond Dynasty 回歸另一個賽季之際，利用棒球史上各個時代的棒球員，來打造夢幻球隊。集結球員卡牌、打造夢想中的球隊，並在線上及離線模式與其他玩家正面交鋒，還能自訂球隊的外觀。*

多人遊戲
與好友一同遊玩，並在跨平台遊戲中互相較勁。** 登上排行榜的高名次，並與其他玩家在線上較勁，或透過線上合作模式以一同體驗球隊的光榮時刻。搭載跨平台遊戲進度功能，在其他的主機平台上也能繼續你的遊戲進度，並賺取及使用內容。***

title: Planet Cube Edge [NSP][ENG]
description:
方塊行星被不明軍隊侵略了！對侵略毫無準備的平民百姓均落荒而逃的時候，一位名叫「埃齊」的方型頭實驗室技術人員挺身而出，決心保衛自己的行星。當然，途中他會得到來自同伴及卡達拉德斯博士的協助（還包含了一些試驗性的武器……），一起反抗侵略軍。

不過問題是，為什麼方塊行星被侵略了？侵略方又是何方神聖？答案會隨著我們的救世英雄於水底科學實驗大樓裡過五關斬六將，克服種種危機難關的時候逐一揭曉！

遊戲內容
於水底科學實驗大樓裡收集兵器，邊跑，邊射，邊跳，響起反攻的號角，擊退來歷不明的侵略軍。

這是一個節奏急速，講求反應及技術的平台動作遊戲。救世旅程中我們的英雄會遇上一波又一波的侵略軍，同時需要避開各種陷阱，才可以拯救這個行星！

遊戲內含八個節奏急速，手繪製作的像素關卡，同時有著各種各樣奇奇怪怪但印象鮮刻的角色。《塊塊星球：埃齊》是一款充滿挑戰及趣味的平台跑轟遊戲，而且重玩性極高！


藝術設計
本遊戲經過精心細緻的手繪製作而成，雙色色調的海底世界絕對能夠滿足像素畫風愛好者的要求。從宏大的海底，到實驗大樓的細緻部分，每個像素都經由周密細緻的繪畫而成。

遊戲世界裡充滿各種富表現力，形象鮮明的方塊角色，特別是那群創意力豐富的侵略軍，他們帶來的武器可謂無其不有，從坦克到巨型機甲螃蟹，保證讓您大開眼界！

當然本遊戲的魅力除了精美的手繪像素畫風外，還包含了故事的張力。以流暢的動畫敘述故事的劇情中雖然會有莊重嚴肅的情節，但同時也有讓人會心一笑的時刻，讓您在救世的旅程中也能夠享受本遊戲。

《塊塊星球：埃齊》：

英雄之旅：化身英雄埃齊，抵抗來自神秘外星軍團的侵略，保衛自己的家園。

精確平台移動：本遊戲節奏急速，操控容易但上手難。本遊戲十分考驗玩家的技術，在驚濤駭浪的救世旅程中，您邊跑邊射的時候需要運用您的技巧精確地移動到手繪的平台上。

激烈的Boss戰：四個大Boss各自的難度都截然不同，非常考驗您的技術、反應和決心！

難度高，但不會過於折磨玩家：遊戲內存檔點眾多，也可以即時復活，而且玩家可以無限次進行挑戰，讓玩家獲得驚心動魄但又不太痛苦的平台遊戲體驗。

關卡多樣性：闖入8個極具創意的關卡，踏進水底科學實驗大樓及水上的設施場所，各種水下房間、高速鐵路、外星飛船等著您來體驗。

視覺享受：遊戲的像素藝術經手繪製作而成，再加上流暢的動畫及形象鮮刻的角色設計，為玩家提供一個美好的視覺體驗。

title: Mundaun [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
《Mundaun》是一款使用鉛筆畫風精心繪製的恐怖遊戲，故事背景設定於阿爾卑斯山上與世隔絕的陰暗幽谷中。你能探索充滿秘密的不同區域、在致命敵人手下存活、駕駛載具、裝滿你的物品欄，解開數種手繪謎團。

遊戲簡介：
體驗獨特的手繪美學，沉浸在現實與虛構交織的阿爾卑斯世界中。
從綠茵草地到皚皚雪山，探索各式各樣的開放關卡，但千萬要當心漫山遍野遊蕩的生物。
遊戲提供了強大的物品系統，讓您心無旁騖地收集線索，揭開故事裡的秘密。
遊戲設置的抵抗恐懼機制為玩家創造了一種「因果關係」，您的恐懼越強烈，就會移動得越慢。
在您攀越高山的路上，解開埋藏在這個遊戲世界中的謎題。
與說一口晦澀語言的古怪居民互動。

title: Super Adventure Hand [NSP][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
You, a former gloves sales-hand, suddenly find yourself alone. Your best friend Arm is no longer attached to your wrist!
“It was those nasty feet, I know them like the back of my hand!” you assured yourself.  

Let the hand do the walking and enjoy this gripping 3D platformer where you play as a handsome hand. Avoid dangerous obstacles and find your way to the magic mug at the end of each level.

Enjoy 50 plus exciting, unique levels full of challenges! Avoid saw blades, fires, and other obstacles! Enjoy a handy 5 high friction digits which will allow you to climb walls and tubes, grab objects, explode bombs, and more.

We all know feet stink, but who in their right hand would steal someone’s arm? There must be a reason behind all of this. Lay your hands on Super Adventure Hand now and figure it out!

title: Ape Out [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Ape Out — dinamichnyy i yarkiy smash ‘em up pro velikiy pobeg, shchedro sdobrennyy khoroshim dzhazom. Lovite moment, ispolzuyte svoikh obidchikov kak oruzhie i zhivye shchity, i pust nikto ne ostanovit vas na puti k svobode!

Stilnyy pobeg: postaraytes ne zabluditsya v krasochnykh otkrytykh prostranstvakh, khitrykh labirintakh i uzkikh koridorakh. Na puti k pobede vas zhdut yarostnoe soprotivlenie, khitrye lovushki i razrushaemoe okruzhenie.

Khvatay i lomay: odolet svoikh pleniteley pomogut zhivotnye instinkty i nechelovecheskaya sila. Shvyryayte ikh ob steny, drug o druga, derzhite ikh, slovno shchit — gore chelovechestvu!

Bodryy saundtrek: poymat pravilnyy ritm pomogut barabany i tsimbaly. I zvuk, s kotorym lomaetsya chelovecheskaya sheya.

title: West of Loathing + Reckonin at Gun Manor DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
West of Loathing is a single-player slapstick comedy adventure role-playing game set in the wild west of the Kingdom of Loathing universe. Traverse snake-infested gulches, punch skeletons wearing cowboy hats, grapple with demon cows, and investigate a wide variety of disgusting spittoons.

Talk your way out of trouble as a silver-tongued Snake Oiler, plumb the refried mysteries of the cosmos as a wise and subtle Beanslinger, or let your fists do the talking as a fierce Cow Puncher. Explore a vast open world and encounter a colorful cast of characters, some of whom are good, many of whom are bad, and a few of whom are ugly.

Features:

A sprawling open world, chock full of danger, quests, puzzles, and mysteries
Lush hand-drawn black and white graphics
Thousands of jokes, gags, and goofs
Crunchy turn-based combat (but only if you want it)
Liberal use of the Oxford comma
Over 50 hats
Disreputable saloons
Several gulches
A drunk horse

title: Fatal Twelve [NSP][ENG]
description:
FATAL TWELVE, the highly acclaimed suspense adventure game, is making the move from PC to Nintendo Switch™!
Watch the thrilling story unfold as twelve unique characters, gathered by the Goddess of Destiny, compete against each other for a chance to undo their untimely demise.

Introducing tons of events and CGs exclusive to the console edition!
The original dev team has prepared a whole array of events and CGs exclusively for the console edition. On top of that, some of the existing visuals have been remastered to make this gripping tale all the more compelling!

Available in two languages!
The text can be set to Japanese or English (audio is Japanese only). This includes in-game text, options, and the digital manual. Language settings can be changed at any time.
Play using only the touch screen! Play with one hand!

Play in handheld mode with the Joy-Con™ controllers attached, or detach them and play with just the touch controls! While in tabletop mode or TV mode, everything can be controlled using only the Joy-Con (R), allowing you to play with only one hand!
Also available for the Nintendo Switch™ Lite. (A separate Joy-Con (R) is required to play with one hand.)

Summary
One day, Shishimai Rinka dies in an explosion—yet she finds herself continuing to live her ordinary life as if nothing had happened at all. That is, until a few days later, when she encounters the Goddess Parca in the dream world.
"Good evening, my lovely little slaves to fate."
Rinka discovers that she is one of 12 people the Goddess has invited to her game. A game that could undo their deaths. In this maelstrom of life and death, Rinka must face a myriad different emotions, as well as the truth behind her own demise. What will her final decision be...?

Gameplay
Gameplay in this visual novel involves reading through the story while making choices at certain key points. Different decisions may lead to different outcomes, story branches and endings. 

Staff
Story: Akeo
Original artwork: Shio-Koji
Music: Low

Cast
Rinka Shishimai                  VA: Eriko Matsui
Naomi Hitsuji                    VA: Asuka Kakumoto
Miharu Mishima                 VA: Yuri Komagata
Mao Oguma                      VA: Konomi Fujimura
Parca, Goddess of Destiny  VA: Kanako Nomura
Other
*Fully voiced

title: Nidhogg 2 [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description: Pravila prosty. Doberis do drugoy storony i ubey vsekh, kto vstanet na puti. Iskusno pariruy chuzhie udary i rezh glotki, razdiray vragam kishki strelami ili rastopchi ikh cherepa! Blagorodstvo zmeyu chuzhdo!

title: Into the Restless Ruins [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Kak glasit shotlandskaya legenda, te, chi sokrovennye zhelaniya ne mogut byt udovletvoreny zemnymi sredstvami, dolzhny otyskat Devu Plodorodiya. V obmen na ikh trud ona udovletvorit ikh zhelaniya. Sleduya godami za slukhami i lozhnymi podskazkami vy otyskali vkhod v ruiny, i pered vami predstala Deva. Nakonets-to, zhelanie budet ispolneno...
Ispolzuyte kolodu kart, predstavlyayushchikh komnaty i koridory, chtoby rasshiryat labirint ruin. Probivayte put s pomoshchyu avtoboya, sobiraya kak mozhno bolshe Glimura s proklyatykh obitateley, poka tma ne poglotit svet vashego fakela.
Zasluzhite milost Devy Plodorodiya, otyshchite relikvii dlya torgovli s Kvochkoy, Vulverom i drugimi personazhami shotlandskikh predaniy, chtoby popolnit i uluchshit svoyu kolodu, i nadeytes, chto vy budete dostatochno silny, chtoby protivostoyat Smotritelyu, kogda nakonets doberetes do nego.

title: The Monty Mole ZX Spectrum collection: Wanted Monty Mole / Monty on the Run / Sam Stoat Safebreaker / Moley Christmas [NSZ][ENG]
description:
在這個由五款遊戲組成的奇妙合集中，您將體驗到英國地下哺乳動物黃鼴鼠變身國際罪犯的故事。

黃鼴鼠只想過平靜的生活，但在一個寒冷刺骨的冬天，他發現自己只能靠偷煤炭度日，於是開始了逃亡生涯，足跡遍布整個歐洲！《Monty Mole》系列家用微電腦冒險平台遊戲是彼得·哈拉普的心血結晶，他是一名礦業檢查員的少年兒子，靈感來自 1984 年英國的礦業罷工。

現在，您可以體驗最初的黃鼴鼠傳奇。本系列包括《通緝令》三部曲！《Monty Mole》、《Monty on the Run》和《Auf Wiedersehen Monty》三部曲，外加兩款獎勵遊戲：《Moley Christmas》（最初隨雜誌贈送的季節性冒險遊戲）和《Sam Stoat》：《Safebreaker》（山姆·斯托特的單人冒險遊戲，山姆·斯托特是《Monty Mole》主要遊戲中的一個配角）。

這套遊戲讓你在玩這些經典遊戲的同時也能體驗到許多現代功能，包括
• 難度模式
• 顯示濾鏡，包括 80 年代風格的 CRT 濾鏡
• 暫停點數 - 每個遊戲最多可儲存和恢復 4 個暫停點數
• 即時倒帶 - 只需按一下按鈕，即可倒帶最多 10 秒的即時遊戲時間

通緝令！《Monty Mole》
漫長而寒冷的冬天即將來臨，黃鼴鼠在南約克郡當地的煤礦進行了一次大膽的搶煤突襲。他要與飛來的挑刺、吃哺乳動物的魚、破碎機、漫遊鑽頭、盤旋的髮膠等進行戰鬥。在亞瑟的城堡裡，您必須找到唯一能打敗他的東西：一張選票。

逃亡中的黃鼴
黃鼴鼠被山姆·斯托特從斯卡德莫爾監獄放出來後，現在要爭取自由。躲避狡猾的敵人和危險，收集金幣，到達海峽渡口。

再見黃鼴
逃離英國後，黃鼴繼續受到當局的追捕，現在他已經引起了 Intermole 的注意，後者正在緊追不捨！他必須穿越歐洲，收集足夠的現金，最後在自己的私人地中海島嶼上定居下來，遠離迫害。

獎勵遊戲：莫利聖誕節
聖誕節到了，黃鼴為了慶祝這個節日，推出了一款全新的遊戲，隨電腦雜誌一起贈送。奇怪的是，遊戲本身卻講述了黃鼴把同樣的遊戲送到雜誌社的故事！在四個關卡中跳躍、攀爬、躲避危險並拾取物品。

獎勵遊戲：山姆·斯托特：撬竊保險箱的盜賊
曾經將黃鼴鼠從斯卡德莫爾監獄救出的鼬科動物罪犯山姆·斯托特在他自己的遊戲中捲土重來，想要大幹一場。

title: Llamasoft the Jeff Minter Story [NSP][ENG]
description:
Gridrunner. Revenge of the Mutant Camels. Tempest 2000. Llamatron.在 80 與 90 年代的英國遊戲界，Jeff Minter 所打造的遊戲獨樹一格。現在，在這款來自 Digital Eclipse 的全新互動式紀錄片中，你將能夠遊玩史上最奇怪、最瘋狂的遊戲開發者的歷程——這是一個熱愛射擊遊戲、綿羊、雷射與羊駝的男人。

LLAMASOFT

回到錄音卡帶、自製期刊和 README.TXT 的年代。想當年，那個擁有一台 Commodore VIC-20 和充滿輻射綿羊夢想的孩子，如今竟成為了英國最知名的遊戲創作者之一。此紀錄片猶如一處虛擬博物館，其中展示著設計檔案、可遊玩遊戲和一之全新影片，其中訴說著這名真正的獨立遊戲設計師的心路歷程。

遊玩備受好評的原版遊戲

《Llamasoft: The Jeff Minter Story》包含 8 個不同平台上的 42 款經點遊戲，無論是 Jeff Minter's 早期的作品《Sinclair ZX81》和《Commodore VIC-20》，還是後期的《Spectrum》、《Commodore 64》和《Atari 800》，還有 16 位元年代的《Atari ST》和《Atari Jaguar》。

GRIDRUNNER: REMASTERED

Jeff's 的招牌射擊鉅作《Gridrunner》經過 Digital Eclipse 的翻新後有了全新的面貌，更新至亮麗的現代圖像與音效，但仍然保留 Commodore 64 版的精髓，以確保遊戲玩法絲毫不變。

遊戲、遊戲，更多遊戲

Sheep In Space. Andes Attack. Attack of the Mutant Camels. Matrix. Metagalactic Llamas Battle at the Edge of Time. Hellgate. Laser Zone.和更多內容。大家都熟悉的所有 Minter 經典遊戲（可能也有些你沒聽過的），現在增添了方便性功能，讓它們比以往更加好玩。

Jeff Minter's 的兩款早期「燈光合成器」《Psychedelia》和《Colourspace》也收錄於其中，另外還增添了全新選項與功能優化以支援使用控制器遊玩。最後，Jeff's 為從未推出的 Konix Multi-System 主機所打造的遊戲《Attack of the Mutant Camels》試玩版也包含在內。

THE GOLD MASTER SERIES

Digital Eclipse 最新作品（Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Cowabunga Collection、Atari 50: The Anniversary Celebration、The Making of Karateka），Gold Master Series 以創新的「互動式紀錄片」格式呈現知名的遊戲，並將遊戲本身與其創作者的歷史完整地結合在一起。

title: Saboteur! / Saboteur 2 Avenging Angel / Saboteur SiO [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Saboteur SiO - ofitsialnoe prodolzhenie klassicheskoy retro-igry Saboteur! i Diversant II: Angel-mstitel.
Puteshestvuyte po miru v etoy originalnoy missii nindzya, sozdannoy i razrabotannoy originalnym avtorom Klayvom Taunsendom.

V 1985 godu Diversant! poluchil prestizhnuyu nagradu «The Crash Smash» ot zhurnala Crash i poluchil vysokuyu otsenku s rezultatom 93%. V 1987 godu Klayv snyal sikvel «Diversant II: Angel-mstitel» - pervuyu videoigru, v kotoroy glavnaya geroinya - Nina - sestra nindzya iz pervoy igry. Teper, po proshestvii bolee trekh desyatiletiy, SimFabric v sotrudnichestve s Klayvom Taunsendom podgotovili sleduyushchiy vypusk sagi o sabotazhnike.

- 19 osobykh syuzhetnykh dostizheniy.
- Vse novye urovni, vragi i syuzhet ot Klayva Taunsenda.
- Originalnyy saundtrek: Sean Fountain, Geovarius, Zoltar Dreamusic i Jeroen Tel.
- Originalnaya retro-grafika i dopolnitelnye rezhimy ekrana dlya ZX Spectrum, Commodore 64, Amstrad CPC i Game Boy.
- 9 yazykovykh versiy - angliyskiy, polskiy, frantsuzskiy, italyanskiy, nemetskiy, ispanskiy, russkiy, portugalskiy, cheshskiy.

Retro varianty:
- Skaniruyushchie linii.
- ELT Muar.
- Retro, sovremennoe i originalnoe nazvanie i menyu.
- Retro i sovremennaya igrovaya panel.
- Sovremennye nastroyki slozhnosti, dlya igrokov bez navykov retro ;-)

title: Operation Night Strikers (Operation Wolf, Operation Thunderbolt, Night Striker, Space Gun) [NSP][ENG]
description:
Sbornik arkadnykh igr pryamikom iz 80-kh — Operation Wolf, Operation Thunderbolt, Night Striker i Space Gun.
V Operation Wolf my beryom v ruki pulemyot s granatomyotom i otpravlyaemsya spasat zalozhnikov s vrazheskoy territorii. Relsovyy shuter — strelyay metko i sledi za patronami, chtoby ne ostatsya s pustym magazinom v samyy nepodkhodyashchiy moment.
Night Striker postroena nemnogo po-drugomu. Tut my gonyaem na futuristicheskom sudne na vozdushnoy podushke i boremsya s kakoy-to terroristicheskoy organizatsiey. Srazheniya poluchayutsya dovolno dinamichnymi — vsyo-taki letaem, a ne prosto stoim na meste.
K oldovym igram dobavleny sovremennye udobstva: mozhno sokhranyatsya, est raznye filtry v stile CRT-monitorov, pokazyvaetsya poleznaya informatsiya.
Vklyucheny 4 arkady:

title: 魔法使之夜 [NSP][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 俄语 来自 Living FLCL
description:
■作品簡介
操刀過知名遊戲《Fate/Grand Order》以及長篇傳奇視覺小說《月姬》的「TYPE-MOON」，
為您將2012年發行的視覺小說《魔法使之夜》，呈現在Nintendo Switch™的平台。
本作品是一部以華麗且充滿活力的1980年代為舞台，
由一位涉世未深的少年及兩名被稱為「魔女」的少女所共同編織出的青春物語。
依據PC版的內容加以更新，除加上了所有粉絲引頸期盼的全語音，
遊戲中的所有圖片以及影像素材皆經Full HD處理，呈現出其他遊戲無法比擬的精彩畫面。
遊戲內的演出巧妙地活用各種圖像素材，不僅是緊張刺激的戰鬥場面，
就連日常生活場景也發揮其效，經常能看見猶如動畫般的動作，
讓玩家們更容易沉浸於文字的世界中。

■STORY
―――坡道上的宅邸裡，住著兩位魔女―――

1980年後半。這充滿活力且紙醉金迷的時代，某個黃昏時分。
一位來到大都會的少年，與兩位活在現代的魔女擦肩而過。

少年原在極度自然的環境下生活，
其中一位少女性格驕傲凜然，
另一位則如沉眠般的隱居著。
原本三人的命運理應毫無交集，
會兜在一起實屬離奇。
而為何這三個原本毫無交集的人會開始同居生活呢？這又是另外一個故事了―――

於2012年發售的PC遊戲《魔法使之夜》，
透過全語音、Full HD化讓作品更臻完美，
橫跨10年的歲月再次甦醒。

title: The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker [NSP][ENG]
description:
VY - psikhiatr, kotoryy pytaetsya rassledovat ubiystvo, obsleduya neobychnykh patsientov nedavno umershego doktora Dekkera. Zadavayte lyubye voprosy i sobirayte dokazatelstva v protsesse ustanovleniya lichnosti sluchayno generiruemogo ubiytsy, pytayas razobratsya v sozdavshemsya khaose.

Infektsionnoe bezumie doktora Dekkera eto - igra-zagadka ubiystva Lovecraftian FMV, dayushchaya igrokam polnuyu svobodu podvergat somneniyu podozrevaemykh, vvodya sobstvennye voprosy ili vybiraya voprosy iz zaranee zadannogo spiska.

U nikh tozhe budut voprosy k vam, no budte ostorozhny so svoimi slovami. Ot vashikh slov zavisyat ikh sudby i vasha sobstvennaya!

FMV - 1600+ HD polnoekrannykh videootvetov.
UBIYTsA, GENERIRUEMYY SLUChAYNO - vybiraetsya v nachale igry dlya borby s grabitelyami.
VVOD LYuBOGO TEKSTA - zadavayte lyubye voprosy, vvodite voprosy v vide teksta, fraz ili prosto klyuchevye slova.
PREDLAGAEMYE VOPROSY - dopolnitelnaya sistema voprosov, optimizirovannaya dlya igrovoy konsoli.
MNOZhESTVENNYE VARIANTY ISKhODA - nablyudayte za razvitiem syuzheta detektiva, i uznayte, chto proizoydet s vami i vashimi patsientami...
MNOZhESTVENNYE ISTORII - 6 glavnykh podozrevaemykh i 5 poiskov na storone. Dzhon Gilor (Protivorechie)
PROSTOY INTERFEYS POLZOVATELYa - Izuchayte uliki, delayte zapisi, prosmatrivayte povtor video i istoriyu sobstvennykh voprosov.

title: Best Served Cold [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Bukovitsa – gorod, okhvachennyy volneniyami: zdes tsaryat zabastovki, sokrashcheniya, besporyadki i nadvigayushchayasya smuta voyny, no vmesto togo, chtoby zataitsya v strakhe, zhiteli sobirayutsya v tantsevalnykh zalakh i piteynykh zavedeniyakh. Razvalivayushcheesya velichie mozhet navevat melankholiyu, no net nichego takogo, chto ne vylechila by ryumka krepkogo napitka.
Smozhete li vy prigotovit kokteyl, stolknuvshis litsom k litsu s prestupnikom? Vyyasnite eto v Best Served Cold, igre o zagadochnykh ubiystvakh, deystvie kotoroy razvorachivaetsya v shumnom bare, gde vam predstoit obsluzhivat klientov, zavodit druzey i vragov, a takzhe raskryvat prestupleniya.
«Polunochniki» – posledniy podpolnyy bar v gorode vremen alternativnoy istorii. Vam predstoit razlivat napitki… poka klienty vybaltyvayut svoi sekrety. Smeshivayte i podavayte firmennye kokteyli, perevoplotivshis v detektiva v popytke spasti svoy bar.
Slushayte istorii posetiteley i uznavayte podrobnosti ikh zhizni. Poprobuyte pripodnyat zanaves tayny, zatragivayushchey vse sloi bukovinskogo obshchestva – ot pyanykh shchegoley, spuskayushchikh dengi na kokteyli, do prodazhnykh politseyskikh i merzkikh deltsov, kotorye pytayutsya vtyanut vas v svoi somnitelnye skhemy.
Khoroshiy barmen znaet, chto iskusstvo besedy ne menee vazhno, chem umenie razlivat napitki, poetomu slushayte vnimatelno i ne teryayte samoobladaniya, ocharovyvaya, a inogda dazhe ugrozhaya posetitelyam, chtoby poluchit neobkhodimuyu informatsiyu. V igre 20 personazhey, i vam predstoit opredelit, komu mozhno doveryat, kto prikroet vas… a kto naneset nozh v spinu!

title: Manual Samuel [NSP][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
Manual Samuel — priklyuchencheskaya igra s originalnym syuzhetom. Nuzhno proderzhatsya 24 chasa, vruchnuyu upravlyaya svoim telom.

Osobennosti
• Istoriya lyubvi i smerti.
• Unikalnaya 2D-grafika i animatsiya.
• Odinochnaya igra i kooperativnyy rezhim.
• Rezhim ucheta vremeni.
• Saundtrek ot Sondre Yensena i Ozana Dresdala.
• 600 strok dialogov.

title: One Piece Pirate Warriors 4 + 25 DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
One Piece: Pirate Warriors 4 — chast serii boevikov Pirate Warriors! Okazhites na nastoyashchem pole boya One Piece, gde rushatsya zdaniya i ataki podnimayut oblaka pyli, i pochuvstvuyte sebya chastyu mira One Piece!
Seriya Pirate Warriors — eto rezultat uspeshnogo sliyaniya populyarnogo anime ONE PIECE s zakhvatyvayushchim igrovym protsessom serii Warriors. Na segodnyashniy den prodano uzhe bolee chetyrekh millionov kopiy igr serii!
Srazhaytes s ordami vragov i puteshestvuyte vmeste s predannymi soyuznikami po detalno vossozdannomu miru anime One Piece!
Novye elementy, kotorye nevozmozhno bylo realizovat v predydushchikh igrakh serii, vyvodyat boi v Pirate Warriors na kachestvenno novyy uroven!

title: Battlestar Galactica Deadlock [NSZ][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
V igre BATTLESTAR GALACTICA Deadlock™ vy okazhetes v tsentre sobytiy Pervoy voyny s Saylonami, v kotoroy vam pridetsya proyavit vse svoi takticheskie sposobnosti.
Upravlyayte kolonialnym flotom s mostika mobilnoy verfi «Diadalos» i osvobodite Dvenadtsat koloniy ot saylonskoy ugrozy. Stroyte floty, zashchishchayte alyans Kvoruma i gotovtes pogruzitsya v tayny legendarnogo konflikta.

title: Road 59 A Yakuza's Last Stand (Road59) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
坐落於東京灣的摩天大樓・天海區，
裡面盤踞著一群擁有「神祇」之力的的異能者，展開了一場血腥的生存之戰。

作為狛浪組繼承人，卻渴望「平凡、寧靜生活」的冰室翔，
如今不得不以新任組長的身份，背負起這個家族宿命。

然而，就在翔仍未決意步入極道之際，
據說能實現持有者任何願望的「大蛇之力」，
使得天海區內的鬥爭更加激烈。

此外，最大的黑道勢力・黑條組，開始暗中行動，
企圖吞併失去前任組長而每況愈下的狛浪組。

為了守護家族，在這座充滿慾望與背叛的城市中，
翔獨自反覆著「無法選擇的抉擇」。
——等待他的究竟是救贖，還是毀滅？

慾望、背叛、傳奇——以及仁義!!
作品描繪了新時代俠客物語，以及每位角色錯綜複雜的命運。

title: Fueled Up [NSP][ENG]
description:
Fueled Up – veselaya kooperativnaya ekshn-arkada, v kotoroy kosmicheskiy korabl podvergaetsya napadeniyu ogromnogo inoplanetnogo osminoga. I eto ne vse: na puti zvezdoleta otkryvayutsya smertelnye chervotochiny, nachinayut idti asteroidnye dozhdi, a vse sistemy korablya dayut sboy. Nam predstoit vzyat na sebya roli inzhenerov-spasateley, reanimirovat korabl i perepravit ego v bezopasnoe mesto.
Intensivnyy geympley stavit pered igrokami mnozhestvo zadach: chinit proboiny v korpuse, tushit pozhary, sledit za sostoyaniem reaktora. V rezhime kooperativa igrayut chetyre chlena ekipazha, chto otkroet dostup k dopolnitelnym zadaniyam i novym urovnyam slozhnosti. Problema lish v tom, chto kosmonavty ochen neuklyuzhi, i vse ikh deystviya tolko usugublyayut polozhenie na korable.
Zdes ochen vazhna komandnaya rabota, odnako svoyu leptu vnosit i element sluchaynosti, tak chto nuzhno ne tolko planirovat svoi deystviya, no i momentalno reagirovat v sluchae opasnosti.

title: Dungeon Clawler [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Sobirayte svoyu kolodu, vyigryvayte oruzhie i predmety v avtomate, srazhaytes s vragami, a takzhe otkryvayte moshchnye navyki i sozdavayte iz nikh neveroyatnye kombinatsii, kotorye pomogut probitsya cherez podzemele!..
Ishchite novye predmety i dobavlyayte ikh v avtomat-kleshnyu, chtoby zatem sozdavat silneyshie kombinatsii. Zarabatyvayte zolotye monety, chtoby uluchshat i preobrazovyvat predmety vo chto-to novoe i poleznoe. Vam pridetsya ispolzovat vse tuzy v rukave, chtoby dobratsya do logova zlogo khozyaina podzemelya i vernut ukradennuyu lapku.

title: Slayers X Terminal Aftermath: Vengance of the Slayer [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
developer: Big Z Studios Inc., Axile Studio
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Clabo stat X-Killerom?!.. 7 vidov oruzhiya, krov-kishki, otbitaya muzyka Seepage & Psyko Syndikate, a eshche tut mozhno vzryvat vse. kruto. ya ee nachal delat v 1998 eshche v shkole vmeste s druganom, a shchas mne 37, ya ter opytnyy.
..dobro pozhalovat v.... STALNOY KOLLEKTOR. Samuyu super-puper sekretnuyu bazu, nakh, vo vsey galaktike.
My X-Killery. Nasha zadacha — srazhatsa s Psindikatom.

title: Fe [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 俄语 lyubitelskiy 来自 rusnx
description:
《Fe》是一種新型態的橫向捲軸冒險遊戲，由您自己去發現劇情，沒有貼身的教導，透過您在遊玩過程中的結果不言而喻地告訴您一切。

在陰暗的北歐森林中奔跑、攀爬、翱翔，並走出自己的道路，探索栩栩如生，充滿秘密和神秘生物的生態環境。

體驗的核心是一個觸控式的類比歌唱機制，讓您可與森林中的所有生命溝通與對話。

瞭解各種動物不同叫聲的意義可以讓您親善或操控任何生物 - 甚至包括植物。 鳥類可以引導您、熊能為您戰鬥、而植物可以結出漿果，協助您戰勝 Silent Ones。

成為 Fe 並探索您絕對不會想離開的世界。

SLOVAR TERMINOV:

KLUB IZUChENIYa PRIMATOV: taynaya organizatsiya, chleny kotoroy sutkami naprolet podglyadyvayut za sovershenno neznakomymi lyudmi cherez obektivy skrytykh kamer.
VY: novichok, vstupivshiy v Klub v popytkakh sbezhat ot realnosti, v kotoroy est lish semnaya kvartira, unylaya rabota, bessmyslennoe segodnya i bestselnoe zavtra.

ChASTNAYa ZhIZN: to, chego net u obezyan, no oni pochemu-to uvereny v obratnom.
PERSONALNYY KOMPYuTER: my ustanovili PK vam v igru, kotoraya ustanovlena u vas na Switch, chtoby vy mogli rabotat na PK, kotoryy ustanovlen u vas v igre, kotoraya ustanovlena na vashem Switch.
KORMIT OBEZYaN: vzaimodeystvovat s obektami nablyudeniya lyubymi dostupnymi sposobami. Kormit obezyan zapreshcheno pravilami Kluba.
LYuTAYa ZhEST: eto to, chto mozhet sluchitsya, esli vy vse zhe pokormite obezyan.

Nekotorye chleny Kluba (byvshie, razumeetsya) polagali, chto esli oni pokormyat obezyan vsego odin raz, to nichego strashnogo ne sluchitsya. Oni oshibalis. Ne povtoryayte ikh oshibok! 

Da, u vas budet tekhnicheskaya vozmozhnost vzaimodeystvovat s obektami nablyudeniya; teoreticheski vy mozhete podstavit ikh, pomoch im, razrushit ikh zhizni ili zhe naoborot spasti ikh ot chego-to uzhasnogo. Odnako Komitet Kluba nastoyatelno rekomenduet vam vozderzhatsya ot podobnykh deystviy. NE KORMITE OBEZYaN!

description:

The Gallery soderzhit dva povestvovaniya, kotorye proiskhodyat v 1981 godu (s glavnym geroem zhenshchinoy) i 2021 godu (s glavnym geroem muzhchinoy). Obe epokhi yavlyayutsya znachitelnymi periodami sotsialno-politicheskikh volneniy v Britanii, i mezhdu etimi dvumya istoriyami est skhodstva i razlichiya. Zritel dolzhen prinimat resheniya v popytke ponyat pokhititelya i izbezhat svoego pokhishcheniya. Odnako vskore stanovitsya ponyatno, chto ot etikh resheniy zavisit ne tolko zhizn glavnogo geroya, no i zhizni drugikh.

Osobennosti igry s zhivymi deystviyami interaktivnogo filma

- Mekhanizm osnovan na vybore, vklyuchaya 150 putey resheniy i 18 unikalnykh kontsovok.
- Otslezhivanie otnosheniy, kotorye vliyayut na obshchuyu istoriyu razlichnymi sposobami.
- Otslezhivanie yspekhov/neudach syuzhetnykh liniy vtorostepennykh personazhey, kotorye vliyayut na obshchuyu istoriyu razlichnymi sposobami.
- Dva igrovykh rezhima – «Vybory s Limitom Po Vremeni» dlya bolee zakhvatyvayushchego opyta pod davleniem vremeni i «Vybory s Pauzoy» dlya igry v gruppakh / uchastiya auditorii vo vremya zhivoy translyatsii.
- Razblokiruemaya funktsiya propuska stseny dlya soderzhimogo, kotoroe uzhe bylo prosmotreno.
- Izvestnyy akterskiy sostav, v tom chisle Anna Poppluell («Khroniki Narnii») i Dzhordzh Blagden («Vikingi» i «Versal») v glavnykh rolyakh.

Krome togo, stsenarist-rezhisser Pol Rashid yavlyaetsya odnim iz samykh tvorcheski plodovitykh tvortsov v zhanre videoigr c zhivymi deystviyami. Ego predydushchie filmy «Kompleks» i «Pyat svidaniy» byli vypushcheny v 2020 godu.

description:
Shapeshifting Detective — eto igra-golovolomka v zhanre nuar s polnomasshtabnym video, sverkhestestvennymi elementami i taynoy ubiystva. Vy yavlyaetes detektivom i mozhete rassledovat ubiystvo, prevrashchayas v lyubogo personazha. Dazhe v sleduyushchuyu zhertvu.  

Dorota Shou mertva. I glavnye podozrevaemye — eto tri gadalki na kartakh taro s neveroyatnoy sposobnostyu predskazat ubiystvo — ili sovershit ego. Vasha zadacha zaklyuchaetsya v tom, chtoby uznat, chto eshche im izvestno, no oni ne budut raskryvat svoi temnye sekrety komu popalo... K schastyu, vy mozhete byt tem, kem khotite.

V igre imeetsya bolee 1600 videorolikov vysokogo razresheniya, prostoy interfeys dlya doprosa s unikalnoy mekhanikoy dlya udaleniya i vozmozhnost sluchaynogo vybora ubiytsy v nachale igry. Razrabotano sozdatelyami i mirovymi rekordsmenami igry «Infektsionnoe bezumie doktora Dekkera».

● Prevrashchenie: v vashem rasporyazhenii devyat drugikh personazhey, chtoby rassledovat prestuplenie, manipulirovat otnosheniyami so raznykh storon i uznat vtoruyu polovinu istorii.
● Napryazhenie: rassleduyte ili predotvratite ubiystvo, no ne popadites. Lyuboy iz trekh sluchaynykh ubiyts pomogaet svesti k minimumu spoylery.
● Vopros vybora: poymat ubiytsu, spasti zhertv, naladit i razorvat otnosheniya — ili net. 
● Reshenie problem: vozmozhno li poluchit etot zhiznenno vazhnyy klyuch k razgadke samostoyatelno? Poprobuyte prevratitsya v nachalnika politsii. Ne kazhetsya li vam, chto varianty dialoga — lovushka? Udalite ikh. 
● 100% polnomasshtabnoe video: kompleksnaya igra s bespereboynymi polnomasshtabnymi videorolikami i otvetami ot pervogo litsa.
● Sobytiya-katalizatory: ne vo vsekh perekhodakh imeyutsya lish dva varianta. Zagonite kogo-libo v ugol, i u nego mozhet poyavitsya neskolko sposobov deystviy.

ISSLEDUYTE MORALNO NEODNOZNAChNYY OTKRYTYY MIR

title: Windbound [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
禁忌之島正在呼喚你，去解開那裡的秘密吧
你的船隻失事了，使你獨自一人擱淺在不為人知的島上。你得在此探索、適應環境，並在陸地與危險重重的海洋間找到方向，存活下來。

作為卡拉族的一員，你是一名戰士，並在海上遭逢暴風雨後遇難，遠離自己的部族。你被洶湧的海浪沖出了船，擱淺在稱作禁忌之島，一處神秘天堂的岸邊。

你沒有船，沒有食物或工具，唯有堅強的求生意志與技能，前去挖掘美麗島嶼上的豐富資源。製造工具和武器，藉著打獵自保，對抗週遭充滿野性又迷人的生物。

深入探險更多島嶼，探勘散落每座島上的遺跡，尋覓埋藏已久的祕密，洞見未來。揭開其中謎團，或許不只能找到回家的路，還有更多意外收穫。

揭開謎團
踏上一個人的旅程，探索詩情畫意的禁忌之島，並了解島嶼的歷史；每座島上都有指向謎團的關鍵線索，甚至可能會有意外發現。

舉目所見，盡情探索
向地平線前進、在島嶼間行進，見識每座島上自成一格的多樣生態、景觀與需要克服的挑戰。

在島上求生
探查島上原始地貌，尋找可用資源，製造各種工具與武器，獵捕野生動物並升級船隻。隨之資源減少，揚帆離去無可避免。

建造完美船隻
你的船隻是這趟旅程中最重要的夥伴，請精心建造自製船隻，好戰勝險惡叢生的水域，前往下一座島。在船隻設計上下點功夫，才能戰勝狂風怪浪，還有索命的海中生物。

title: New York Mysteries Collection: Secrets of the Mafia, High Voltage, The Lantern of Souls, The Outbreak, Power of Art [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Smelyy zhurnalist, Lora Dzheyms, nachinaet sobstvennoe rassledovanie tainstvennykh ischeznoveniy bossov mafii i posledovavshey za nimi propazhi detey.

Zagadki Nyu-Yorka. Sekrety Mafii – priklyuchencheskaya igra-kvest s poiskom predmetov, mini-igrami i golovolomkami, rasskazyvayushchaya o misticheskom detektivnom rassledovanii, mafioznykh taynakh i zagadkakh Nyu-Yorka.

Nyu-York, 1955 god. V gorode stalo opasno. Mafiya pytaetsya zakhvatit vlast. No s nedavnikh por, poyavilas novaya sila. I ona na mnogo strashnee. Za poslednie dni, pyat mafioznykh bossov propali pri zagadochnykh obstoyatelstvakh. Na mestakh ischeznoveniya nakhodili lish strannuyu zhidkost i babochku. No ne eto napugalo zhiteley... V gorode stali propadat deti. Vse oni narisovali tochno takikh babochek pered ischeznoveniem. Lora Dzheyms, zhurnalist «Deyli Nyuz», nachinaet sobstvennoe rassledovanie. Kakie mrachnye tayny skryvayut tonneli metro pod gorodom? Smozhet li geroinya spravitsya so vsemi prepyatstviyami i spasti propavshikh?

Osobennosti igry:
• Bolee 50 potryasayushchikh lokatsiy
• Svyshe 40 raznoobraznykh mini-igr
• Interaktivnye stseny s poiskom predmetov

Provedite smeloe zhurnalistskoe rassledovanie

title: Tanky Tanks 1-2 [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Igrayte v odinochku, vmeste s druzyami ili protiv nikh i pokazhite svoi navyki navigatsii i reaktsii v 6 razlichnykh igrovykh rezhimakh i beschislennykh urovnyakh.

Eto bystro. Eto veselo. Eto vyzyvaet privykanie.
Oglushayte vrazheskie tanki, uklonyayas ot ikh smertonosnykh pul.
Sovershenstvuyte svoi navyki pritselivaniya i manevrirovaniya, poka sama voyna pytaetsya polozhit konets vashemu priklyucheniyu.
Uroven za urovnem vrazheskie tanki stanovyatsya bystree, umnee i smertonosnee.
Smozhete li vy doyti do kontsa i pobedit ikh lidera?

Igrat v odinochku. Igrayte s druzyami. Igrayte protiv svoikh druzey.
- Sygrayte v odnopolzovatelskuyu kampaniyu, chtoby ottochit svoi navyki i pobedit v igre samostoyatelno.

title: Battle Suit Aces [NSZ][ENG]

Kartochnaya RPG so srazheniyami: vam predstoit nanimat i uluchshat pilotov-mekhov, kotorye stanut vashimi druzyami i vmeste s vami otpravyatsya na okhotu za znamenitym inoplanetnym oruzhiem: drevnimi kostyumami.
Otpravlyaytes v zakhvatyvayushchee mezhzvezdnoe priklyuchenie na zvezdolete s raznosherstnym ekipazhem i ryskayte po vsey galaktike v poiskakh znamenitykh drevnikh kostyumov. Provedite svoyu komandu cherez galaktiku, polnuyu monstrov, tragediy i zabavnykh kosmicheskikh priklyucheniy.

title: Railway Empire 2 [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
您將在遊戲中化身智慧過人的企業家，於19世紀初期接管一家小型鐵路公司，將您的蒸汽機車變成經濟發展的主力軍。 您要把公司發展成大陸上規模最大的鐵路公司，並通過不斷擴大的鐵路線、橋樑和隧道網路將城市和公司連接起來，從而超越競爭對手。60 輛用來牽引貨運列車和客運列車的著名機車任您調遣。它們在工業革命時期開啟了一個具有重要歷史意義的時代。
《Railway Empire 2》擁有比以往面積更大、細節更豐富、環境更生動的地圖。 兩張龐大的地圖包含了整個美國和歐洲大陸，而每片大陸的重點區域都擁有更加細緻的地圖。 經過改進的軌道建設，可説明您在推動經濟發展並説明城市發展時專注於重要決策。 遊戲中的鐵路信號將自動放置，橋樑可容納 4 條以上軌道，可擴展的車站現在最多能容納 8 條軌道。
從 6 個不同角色中選擇一位來領導您的鐵路公司，每個角色都有自己的長處和短處。 體驗遊戲中的 5 個章節劇情或在 14 個不同場景中選擇。 在完全可定製的自由模式中設置喜歡的難度，或在建設模式中建立完美的鐵路網路。 在多人合作遊戲中，與朋友共同應對您的鐵路帝國遇到的競爭。 您甚至可以登上一輛您擁有的列車，在蒸汽機車沿著軌道疾馳而過的時候，坐下來欣賞過路的美景。
特色：
• 您的成就將載入史冊：在 1830 年這個鐵路時代的黎明，從頭開始建立一個宏偉的鐵路帝國，並從 60 輛細節豐富、歷史悠久的機車中進行選擇 – 這些機車都可以使用您喜愛的顏色與公司首字母進行定制。
• 一望無際的風景：規模龐大而且細節詳盡的遊戲世界分別用一張地圖包含了整個美國和歐洲，同時也包含遍佈美國和歐洲 300 多個城鎮的詳細區域地圖。
• 無盡可能：您可以盡情暢玩 5 個跨越歐美標誌性地域的 5 個章節劇情，更有 14 個場景、可自訂的自由模式、令人心情放鬆的建設模式，以及最多由 4 名玩家控制同一家鐵路公司的多人合作模式。
• 改進的軌道建設：有了可以自動放置的信號、超過 4 條軌道的橋樑、最多擁有 8 條軌道的車站和用於定制自己車站的全新配件，鋪設軌道會比以往任何時候都更加容易。土地會在您的軌道穿越山脈、山谷和平原時自動適應軌道佈局。
• 欣賞美景：您可以乘坐自己的列車，從車廂內部或蒸汽機車駕駛室的前排座位上欣賞沿途匆匆而過的風景。

title: Gimmick Special edition / Gimmick 2 [NSZ][ENG]
description:
SUNSOFT傳說中的8位元平台遊戲續集終於登場。在物理導向的關卡中解開謎題並擊退敵人吧。Yumetaro燦爛的旅程現在開始。
歡迎體驗這個以現代風格詮釋復古風格的遊戲！
你可以在《Gimmick! 2》再次見到前作的主角Yumetaro。自第一場冒險後已經過了數十年，Yumetaro將在充滿有趣挑戰、危險敵人及隱藏寶物的世界中開始全新的冒險。
這次你可以利用支援度高的模式或原版《Gimmick!》模式進行遊戲。《Gimmick!》模式的難度較高，如果你有自信，歡迎隨時來挑戰！
成為星星操作大師吧！
Yumetaro可召喚並投擲強大的星星。Yumetaro所投擲的星星不僅會彈跳，還會維持加速度等，套用現實生活中的物理法則。
並且還能乘坐星星探索世界的祕密，前往平時難以到達的地方。
請利用套用物理法則的星星一起發現寶物，或尋找捷徑吧。你還可以體驗競速破關，解鎖星星無窮無盡的潛力。
請利用星星的力量，讓遊戲變得更加有趣！

title: Rack and Slay [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Rolevoe podzemele v stile roguelike, gde vy — Bilyardnyy Shar!..
Tolkayte shary-monstry v otverstiya ili lovushki na sluchayno sgenerirovannykh urovnyakh. Skladyvayte beschislennoe kolichestvo predmetov, menyayushchikh igru, nakhodite kombinatsii, chtoby sozdavat sinergiyu i nastraivat sobstvennyy stil igry.

title: Disney Magical World 2 Enchanted Edition [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Otpravtes v mir volshebstva s Disney Magical World 2: Enchanted Edition na Nintendo Switch™!

Disney Magical World otkroet vam dver v mir volshebstva i veselya!

title: Chinatown Detective Agency [NSZ][ENG]
description:
新加坡的某個深夜。你的線人放你鴿子，客戶想要得到答案，銀行存款空空如也。這些窘境宛如一把霓虹色的懸頂之劍，即將從你的頭上墜落而下。時間是2037年，歡迎來到《Chinatown Detective Agency》。

這是個動盪不安的世界，全球經濟正面臨崩潰十多年來最糟糕的狀況。新加坡是最後一個尚能維持社會秩序的安身之處，當地政府卻也已經在混亂邊緣做垂死掙扎。現在正是你發揮本領的時候。你的名字是Amira Darma。你曾經是國際刑警組織的明日之星，現在則是在唐人街核心地帶設立了私家偵探社的菜鳥私家偵探。此時，你的第一位客戶正要走進偵探社的大門……

探索崩潰邊緣的世界
雨天的積水映照著霓虹燈的光芒，衰敗的城市街頭隨處可見憤恨不滿的群眾將怒氣發洩在塗鴉之上。倫敦河畔逐漸被黑暗侵蝕，夜上海燈火絢爛。探索超過一百個由Ricardo Juchem繪製的震撼渲染場景，沉浸在2037年的混沌未來之中。從位於新加坡的據點出發，環遊世界尋找線索，並且與許多各具神秘內幕，擁有獨特聲線的人物交談。

收集真實世界的線索解決案件
Amira接手的案件需要靠聰明的思維和直覺才能破案，但毫無線索時該怎麼辦呢？這時就必須到遊戲外面尋找答案了。無論是到網路上搜尋機場代碼，或是找出一則神秘引文，《Chinatown Detective Agency》的謎團都需要在真實世界進行調查才能解開。你不只是在扮演偵探的角色，而是正在成為一名真正的偵探。

千萬別破產！
在《Chinatown Detective Agency》中，時間是相當珍貴的資源。明智地使用時間和金錢維持領先地位，並避免潛在的破產危機。

每個選擇都將影響你周圍的世界，並永遠改變Amira的故事走向。你能將城市從充滿恐慌和混亂的險境中拯救出來嗎？

title: Wildfire [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
V etoy dvumernoy igre v zhanre «stelz» vam predstoit ispolzovat magicheskie sily, chtoby razzhigat ogon, obrashchat vodu v led i ostavlyat suevernykh vragov v durakakh. Otbeyte rodnoy dom, spasaya po puti plennykh sootechestvennikov: umeloe upravlenie okruzhayushchey sredoy pomozhet vam dostich svoikh tseley i ostanovit protivnikov.

Magiya pochti chto ushla iz mira, i potomu vragi, opasayushchiesya vashego mogushchestva, zakleymili vas zlobnym koldunom. Ostavte v durakakh suevernye armii ertsgertsogini, ukhodya ot pogoni skvoz dremuchie chashchi, glubokie peshchery i ledyanye gornye piki. Nakhodite svoikh sootechestvennikov i osvobozhdayte ikh iz plena, chtoby vyvesti v bezopasnoe mesto i, v kontse kontsov, vernut sebe svoy dom.

Klyuchevye osobennosti
- Postavte okruzhayushchiy mir sebe na sluzhbu. Razzhigayte plamya ognennymi sharami; zamorazhivayte vodu, chtoby peresekat beskraynie ozera i ustraivat lovushki dlya vragov; povelevayte samoy zemley, vyrashchivaya travu ili krepkuyu lozu, po kotoroy mozhno vzobratsya na vysotu.
- Podchinite sebe stikhii. So vremenem vasha svyaz so stikhiyami budet rasti, otkryvaya vam novye vozmozhnosti. No pomnite: ogon sposoben poglotit vse, chto okazhetsya na ego puti, — vklyuchaya i vas!
- Deystvuyte s umom. Ispolzuyte preimushchestva okruzhayushchego mira, chtoby skryvatsya ot voysk ertsgertsogini i nanosit udary po vragu. Pomnite: vashi protivniki neglupy i umeyut deystvovat soobshcha.
- Nablyudayte, kak polykhaet mir... vmeste s drugom. Vy mozhete igrat v odinochku ili vmeste s drugom: sochetanie vashikh magicheskikh sposobnostey otkroet vam novye prokhody skvoz nasyshchennyy i detalizirovannyy mir Wildfire.

title: Butcher [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Vy — kiborg, zaprogrammirovannyy unichtozhit poslednie ostatki chelovechestva, i vasha edinstvennaya zadacha... mochit vse, chto dvizhetsya.

Khvatayte lyubimoe oruzhie (ot benzopily i drobovika do granatometa) i prokladyvayte sebe put skvoz podzemnye ubezhishcha, razrushennye voynoy goroda, dzhungli i tak dalee. A esli v vas prosnetsya tvorcheskaya zhilka, raspravlyaytes s protivnikami so vkusom: k vashim uslugam kryuki, yamy s lavoy, tsirkulyarnye pily... kazhdaya smert budet osobennoy.

Esli vam nravitsya stalkivat trupy v lavu i zalivat steny krovyu, to BUTCHER — eto igra dlya vas.

Samyy prostoy rezhim — 'SLOZhNYY'!

title: Hand of Fate 2 [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
genre: Action, Adventure, Role-Playing, Board Game, TCG
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Hand of Fate 2 — eto «polzanie po podzemelyam» v stilistike temnogo fentezi, zhivaya nastolnaya igra, kazhdyy uroven kotoroy sostavlyaetsya iz kart vstrech, podobrannykh vami! Vybirayte s umom: vash sopernik, zagadochnyy Diler, ne sobiraetsya nezhnichat, prevrashchaya vas v instrument otmshcheniya.

Rasklady na stole izmenilis, no stavka ta zhe: zhizn ili smert!

OSNOVNYE VOZMOZhNOSTI IGRY
- Mir preobrazilsya. Proshlo sto let s tekh por, kak byl svergnut staryy Diler i igra zhizni i smerti poluchila novogo mastera...
- 22 novykh uvlekatelnykh ispytaniya stanut sereznoy proverkoy dlya vashego umeniya podbirat kolodu. Budet zdes i okhota na likhikh ubiyts, i vossoedinenie neschastnykh vozlyublennykh, i dazhe postroyka kreposti, sposobnoy vyderzhat vrazheskiy nalet!
- Novye sputniki stanut podsporem kak v boyu, srazhayas plechom k plechu s vami, tak i vne boya, pomogaya oboyti pravila nastolnoy igry! 
- Sotni novykh vstrech, artefaktov i predmetov, kotorye mozhno zarabotat i uluchshit.
- Ottochennye boi v dukhe ekshen-RPG: kromsayte vragov v kapustu paroy kinzhalov i vkolachivayte v zemlyu tyazhelym dvuruchnym molotom. A nabrav kombo-ochki, mozhno vypolnit osobuyu, sverkhmoshchnuyu ataku!
- Vragi budut obedineny v kartochnye masti. Vam predstoit skrestit mechi s vyshkolennymi imperskimi soldatami, pookhotitsya na oskvernennykh mutantov i dat otpor naletchikam-severyanam.

title: God of Rock [NSP][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Zagadochnyy bog roka voskresil dushi velichayshikh muzykantov vselennoy, chtoby oni srazhalis emu na potekhu. Nadelyonnye novymi telami i sposobnostyami, muzykanty budut uchastvovat v ego igre, srazhayas drug s drugom za muzykalnoe pervenstvo na mirovoy arene.

God of Rock sochetaet ritmichnyy igrovoy protsess s boevoy mekhanikoy v napryazhyonnykh poedinkakh. Vybirayte iz dyuzhiny unikalnykh boytsov, kazhdyy s unikalnym vneshnim vidom, mekhanikoy i garmonichnymi atakami. Chtoby oslabit protivnika, nazhimayte noty v takt pesne, delayte obychnye dvizheniya i nabirayte ochki, a zatem potratte ikh, chtoby sdelat eks-ataku i spetsialnye dvizheniya, nanosya uron i uslozhnyaya treki. Nakonets, prikonchite vraga sokrushitelnoy superatakoy! V khode srazheniya muzykalnaya kompozitsiya budet postepenno uslozhnyatsya, poka ne ostanetsya tolko odin boets.

Osobennosti igry
• Srazhaytes v takt: uchastvuyte v ozhestochyonnykh muzykalnykh bitvakh etogo sorevnovatelnogo ritmichnogo faytinga.

• Bez ogranicheniya sposobnostey: treki budut stanovitsya vsyo slozhnee, poka ne ostanetsya lish odin boets. 

• Bolee 40 originalnykh pesen, kazhdaya so svoimi unikalnymi i slozhnymi trekami dlya osvoeniya. 

• Vasha stsena — ves mir. Upravlyayte 12 nepokhozhimi drug na druga personazhami, kazhdyy so svoim stilem igry, na 8 dinamicheskikh stsenakh, raspolozhennykh v raznykh ugolkakh vselennoy.

Igrovye rezhimy
• Syuzhetnyy: sleduyte za lyubimym personazhem po razvetvlyonnomu syuzhetu i sorevnuytes s drugimi muzykantami, chtoby perezhit vsekh.

• Trenirovochnyy: osvoyte samye slozhnye fragmenty kazhdoy pesni i popraktikuytes v vypolnenii osobykh dvizheniy v takt.

• Redaktor trekov: vnesite svoy vklad v lyubimye treki, dobavlyaya i udalyaya noty po svoemu usmotreniyu.

• Lokalnaya igra i setevoy multipleer s reytingom: srazites s igrokami po lokalnoy seti ili cherez Internet v obychnom ili reytingovom mnogopolzovatelskom rezhime.

title: Captain Tsubasa Rise of New Champions + 27 DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Otkroyte dlya sebya mir Kapitana Tsubasy na Nintendo Switch, pozvolyayushchiy vzglyanut na futbolnyy zhanr s novoy storony, vklyuchaya 2 syuzhetnykh rezhima — i soberite svoyu komandu mechty!.. Captain Tsubasa: Rise of New Champions, osnovannaya na vsemirno lyubimom anime-seriale, predstavlyaet soboy arkadnyy ekshn s noveyshey grafikoy i super-syuzhetom!
«Kapitan Tsubasa» (yap. キャプテン翼) — znamenitaya seriya o futbole, sozdannaya Yoiti Takakhasi v 1981 godu, kotoraya kharakterizuetsya anime-stilizovannym i narochito nepravdopodobnym izobrazheniem dvizheniy futbolistov na pole. Captain Tsubasa rasskazyvaet ob igrokakh v futbol, sleduya syuzhetnoy skheme zhanra «spokon». Captain Tsubasa: Golden-23 vykhodit v Young Jump s 2005 goda po nastoyashchee vremya.
Odnoimyonnaya manga sposobstvovala populyarizatsii sporta kak v samoy Yaponii, tak i za eyo predelami, i vdokhnovila na zanyatie futbolom mnogikh izvestnykh igrokov, takikh kak Zinedin Zidan, Franchesko Totti, Khidetosi Nakata, Seygo Naradzaki, Fernando Torres, Kristian Veri, Khames Rodriges, Alessandro Del Pero.

title: Surgeon Simulator CPR: Co-Op Play Ready [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Ne khotite torchat sem let v meditsinskom vuze? 
Stanovites srazu k operatsionnomu stolu! Takuyu 
vozmozhnost vam daet poluchivshaya mnogochislennye 
polozhitelnye otzyvy igra Surgeon Simulator CPR. Ona 
polnostyu vosstanovlena i chuvstvuet sebya luchshe, chem 
prezhde, na pristavke Nintendo Switch™! 

Teper samyy pechalno izvestnyy simulyator khirurga 
otlichaetsya polnym upravleniem dvizheniyami i 
vozmozhnostyu sovmestnoy igry po lokalnoy seti. 
Prishlo vremya pogruzitsya v etu zakhvatyvayushchuyu igru! 

DEZhURNYY 24/7!

Primerte na sebya rol Naydzhela Burka — cheloveka, 
kotoryy mechtaet stat khirurgom i obladaet, myagko govorya, 
neprivychnym naborom instrumentov. Vam predstoit 
provodit uzhasayushchie transplantatsii v teatre, 
protsedury pod vysokim davleniem v mashine skoroy 
pomoshchi i antigravitatsionnye operatsii v kosmose! Da, 
provodit operatsii na khodu teper eshche proshche blagodarya 
Nintendo Switch!

UPRAVLENIE DVIZhENIEM (I MORSKAYa BOLEZN)...

Prishlo vremya vooruzhitsya kontrollerami Joy-Con™ i 
vserez prinyatsya za zdorove patsienta Boba! Igrayte s 
pomoshchyu televizora v portativnom rezhime ili s 
pomoshchyu funktsii upravleniya dvizheniem Nintendo 
Switch, vypolnyaya zhiznenno-vazhnye operatsii s 
pedantichnoy tochnostyu. 

NE KhOTITE IGRAT V ODINOChKU?

Khotite uladit dela vmeste s druzyami? Razdelite Joy-Con i priglasite vtorogo khirurga, chtoby nemedlenno ustroit sovmestnuyu igru po lokalnoy seti, gde by vy ni nakhodilis!

VAS PROBERET DO KOSTEY!

Molotki i toporiki, tsirkulyarnye pily i lazernye 
ukazki, — vsyo eto vam ponadobitsya vo vremya samykh raznykh 
operatsiy, a blagodarya vstroennoy funktsii vibratsii vy 
smozhete pochuvstvovat vsyo proiskhodyashchee, bud to khrust, 
perelom, vsplesk ili bryzgi!

Soderzhit vse iznachalnye operatsii, ot kotorykh serdtse 
provalivaetsya v zheludok (ili v lyuboy drugoy organ po 
vashemu vyboru!), vklyuchaya transplantatsii 
dopolnitelnykh zubov iz vypuska A&E. Krome etogo, 
Surgeon Simulator dlya Nintendo Switch predlagaet vam 
supersekretnyy rezhim: vskrytie inoplanetyan! Tak chego 
zhe vy zhdete, dok? Na konu zhizn cheloveka!

VTOROY VARIANT...

«Eto igra s chernym yumorom, vo vremya kotoroy vy budete 
rezat, issledovat i voskhishchatsya neveroyatnymi 
umeniyami nastoyashchikh khirurgov.» - IGN

title: Bear and Breakfast [NSZ][ENG]
description:
About Bears

Bear and Breakfast is a laid-back management adventure game where you play as a well-meaning bear trying to run a B+B in the woods. Hank and his friends find an abandoned shack and, equipped with their teenage ingenuity, turn it into a money-making bed and breakfast scheme for unsuspecting tourists. As your business expands so do the mysteries of the forest, and Hank soon finds himself uncovering a plot deeper than the wilderness itself.

Build and Manage

- Build and personalize your inn with dozens of guest rooms, bathrooms, parlours, and entertainment. 
- Each room can be individually customized completely from furniture to fixtures.
- Bring guests into the forest to stay at your inn. Keep 'em happy to maintain your reputation, earn money and attract new customers!
- Complete quests and story lines to collect new items and perks for your inn.
- Uncover a world rich in lore, side quests, characters, and secrets.

Friends, Foes, Forage

Moving through the story-rich world of Bear and Breakfast will have you stumbling on dozens of interesting folks and weirdos, much like yourself.
Most of them have something to say about your endeavours and if you take some time out of your day to listen, they might help your build your shack to new heights!

Explore the Woods

Not everyone is as helpful or as needy though. Are you bear enough to search deep within the forest and your soul to find the mysteries that lie within?

title: Dawn of the Monsters + DLC [NSZ][ENG]
NetHack, Angband, Tome, Rogue - sbornik homebrew roguelike-igr pod PPSSPP (PSP) Switch [NRO][ENG]
description:
4 igry zhanra Roguelike (Rogue, Nethack, Angband, ToME), kotorye byli portirovany na portativnuyu konsol PSP i zapuckayutsya na Switch pri pomoshchi emulyatora PPSSPP v1-11.3-2764. Upravlenie cherez kontroller - klaviatura ne trebuetsya.
Roguelike - Kharakternymi osobennostyami klassicheskogo roguelike yavlyayutsya generiruemye sluchaynym obrazom urovni, poshagovost i neobratimost smerti personazha — v sluchae ego gibeli igrok ne mozhet zagruzit igru i dolzhen nachat eyo zanovo. Mnogie roguelike vypolneny v dekoratsiyakh epicheskogo fentezi pod silnym vliyaniem nastolnykh rolevykh igr napodobie Dungeons & Dragons.
Zhanr voskhodit k igre 1980 goda Rogue. Khotya i do neyo vykhodili podobnye igry, takie kak Beneath Apple Manor, imenno Rogue stala obraztsom dlya beschislennykh podrazhaniy. Podobnye igry, rasprostranyavshiesya v vide otkrytogo koda, byli krayne populyarny v srede amerikanskikh programmistov i studentov v 1980-kh — 1990-kh godakh. Pri nalichii mnozhestva variantov i razlichiy mezhdu otdelnymi igrami osnovnye printsipy geympleya roguelike ostavalis neizmennymi. V 2008 godu eti konservativnye printsipy byli opisany v ramkakh tak nazyvaemoy «Berlinskoy interpretatsii».

title: Will a Wonderful World [NSP][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
There was an urban legend. Write your troubles down on a note. Hold it in your hand at midnight and pray. “God, please help me…” Then God will hear your plea and change your fate.

A young girl wakes up, groggy and in an unknown room. A talking dog appears before her and she becomes startled by his revelation: They are gods and it is their duty to change the fate of any humans that ask for their help. Letters appear in the mail and with pen in hand she begins her job.

Dive deep into the story and learn about those that seek out your help but, remember, changing someone’s fate will affect others. Experience each story, edit letters and solve puzzles; perhaps the young girl’s memory will return, but what will she learn about herself and her mission?

WILL: A Wonderful World features a fantastical tale and cast. A quiet nerd stuck in a hopeless, one-sided crush. An impoverished artist who’s lost all hope and contemplates suicide. A rookie police officer who burns with justice and hopes for his first big case. A young woman desperately chasing her dream against all odds. Even a stray cat who would be satisfied with some dried fish to eat! You must guide their fates, find the links between the storylines and find the best path for all of those in need.

Features:
● Redesigned to perfectly tell the tale on Nintendo Switch™.
● Read stories and use deduction to determine how to alter the fate of the game’s cast.
● Each decision opens up the story and may even impact the plotlines of others.
● Progress through the game and also learn more about the two gods, the mysterious girl and her companion.
● Enjoy punchy music and beautifully drawn stills and animations.

title: A Monster's Expedition [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
《怪獸遠征》是一款由全世界最優秀的解謎遊戲設計師傾力打造的傑作，一群對人類充滿好奇的怪獸將在開放世界中展開一場迷人、消閒的解謎冒險。

推倒樹木就能開闢道路，玩家將在遠近數百座島嶼上展開冒險，瞭解「人類」的歷史。

透過「人性英格蘭」挖掘現場的全新展品，玩家將沉浸在人類文化的遊玩體驗中，每個展品都附有專家級解讀*！
*解讀並不具備法律約束力，因此可能包括或不包括無根據的猜測、傳聞和謠言。

- 由《雪人難堆》(A Good Snowman is Hard to Build) 和《宇宙快車》(Cosmic Express) 的同一製作班底打造，一款迷人的開放世界解謎遊戲
- 遊戲機制簡單卻不失深刻，提供有待發現的豐富可能性
- 可拜訪數百座島嶼 – 有些島嶼就在你眼前，但另一些島嶼則不落俗套地隱藏了起來，等待真正的解謎愛好者去發現
- 從好奇怪獸的視角瞭解神秘的人類

「這款遊戲讚爆了我超喜歡《怪獸遠征》。我已經深深地愛上了它。」
《Eurogamer》

「《怪獸遠征》最大的特點就是，它從不逼迫玩家作出既定答案。如果你在遊戲被困，換個方向走就好。」
《USGamer》

「這是一款節奏舒緩的減壓解謎遊戲，透過各種腦筋急轉彎讓你的精神得到放鬆」
《PC Gamer》

title: Persona 4 Arena Ultimax (P4AU) [NSZ][ENG]
Deserted [NSP][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
Deserted 是一款風格化的 3D 動作冒險遊戲，包含輕度 RPG 與敘事元素。靈感來自 8 位元和 16 位元時代遊戲的外星氛圍。Deserted 結合了敘事故事、生存和快節奏的戰略戰鬥，帶來驚心動魄的冒險。

在一個未知的遙遠星系中，您墜落在一個神秘的星球上。當您的任務隊長咽下最後一口氣時，您的旅程將會展開，並開始為生存而戰。

玩家將穿越茂密的森林、巨大的尖塔，以及以色彩豐富的低解析度美學為背景的古代遺跡。遊戲中隱藏著許多秘密和路徑，玩家可以揭開其中的傳說，並升級您的武器庫。

在《荒蕪》中，生存起著舉足輕重的作用，但只要您持續更新您的藥水庫存並升級您的狀態，就不會受到懲罰。探索者將獲得原料和可升級技能的獎勵，以幫助他們在旅途中繼續前進。

戰鬥既有趣又具挑戰性，主要著重於快節奏的策略遊戲。
Deserted 提供許多選項和升級，以符合您的作戰風格。透過獨特的技能樹系統，您可以建立對抗各種敵人的策略。武器和狀態的升級將幫助您扭轉戰局，對抗最強的敵人。

本地合作 - 在 Deserted 中，您不必獨自遊戲。我們提供最多 2 位玩家的本地合作模式，讓您全程參與。您可以選擇扮演女性或男性特務。

主要武器 - 可升級的 Holo-Blade，由您前臂上安裝的模組系統的能量所構成，可切割大部分物質。

次要武器 – 多種物質毀滅武器，可在遠距離或近距離毀滅敵人。這些武器包括手槍、自動步槍和散彈槍。


Gadgets - 手榴彈和可投擲的物品，能產生強力爆炸、擊毀許多敵人，並能衝破障礙物，找出隱藏的通道。

模組 - 裝備不同的模組可讓您進入不同的技能樹，解鎖各種獨特的能力。

製作 - 為了生存，您需要採集資源。利用植物和材料的特性來合成一系列的治療藥水和解毒劑，或是製作手榴彈和槍枝電池。

A.T.0.M. Drone (進階、戰術、操作、模組) - 是您的機械伙伴。使用它的功能來治療、掃描、產生 3D 地圖和入侵裝置。在戰鬥中，它的槍能提供額外的火力。

Drakah - 活在記憶石中的「古老」靈魂。這個精靈能讓您與外星科技互動、進入禁區，並在戰鬥中召喚「幽靈野獸」。

車輛 - 運用 MECHA 的蠻力或 Speeder 所製造的快節奏混亂，讓您克服成群的致命敵人而毫髮無傷。

title: 2048 (khoumbryu na nxjs runtime, JavaScript / QuickJS) [NSP][ENG]
description:
2048 — JavaScript-pazl, napisannaya v marte 2014-go goda 19-letnim italyanskim razrabotchikom Gabriele Chirulli. Igrovoe pole imeet formu kvadrata 4x4. Tselyu igry yavlyaetsya poluchenie plitki nominala «2048», khotya pri zhelanii mozhno prodolzhit dalshe; kod igry polnostyu otkryt po razreshitelnoy litsenzii Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT).
Igra «2048» byla napisana menee chem za dva dnya v kachestve uprazhneniya v programmirovanii; po slovam avtora, privedyonnym gazetoy Los Angeles Times, Chirulli poschital svoyo tvorenie «sluchaynym vtorzheniem v igrovuyu industriyu» i ne planiruet v dalneyshem zanimatsya razrabotkoy igr. Proobrazom «2048» yavlyaetsya kommercheskaya igra Threes.
Po podschyotam, maksimalnoe kolichestvo ochkov, kotoroe mozhno nabrat pri nailuchshem khode igry — 3 932 100 (pri etom kazhdaya vypavshaya «4» umenshaet etu otsenku na 4. Maksimalnyy vozmozhnyy nominal plitki na standartnom pole 4kh4 sostavlyaet 131 072, na pole m*n maksimalnyy nominal plitki — 2(mn+1). Zadacha polucheniya zadannoy konfiguratsii po pravilam 2048 na bolshem pole yavlyaetsya PSPACE-polnoy; zadacha opredeleniya dostizhimosti zadannogo chisla iz tekushchey konfiguratsii na doske m*n yavlyaetsya NP-slozhnoy.
V razdache predstavlen eyo originalnyy khoumbryu-port s pomoshchyu nx.js.

title: Hypercharge Unboxed [NSP][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Upravlyayte plastikovoy figurkoy i vypolnyayte zadaniya Sgt. Max Ammo. Vasha zadacha — ostanovit unichtozhenie GIPERYaDRA. Esli ego unichtozhat, to vam ostanetsya tolko poproshchatsya so svoimi chelovecheskimi druzyami.

Funktsii igry
* Sovmestnaya igra: vmeste srazhaytes za budushchee igrushechnogo naroda. Soberite do trekh igrokov v setevoy ili lokalnoy sovmestnoy igre i spasite GIPERYaDRO ot polnogo unichtozheniya. 

* PvP: plastik protiv plastika. Srazhaytes s drugimi plastikovymi soldatikami na puti k vershine spiska liderov.

* Odinochnyy rezhim: ne vsem geroyam nuzhna komanda. Vy odinokiy volk i predpochitaete igrat samostoyatelno bez podklyucheniya k seti? Ne volnuytes, dlya vas tozhe est podkhodyashchiy rezhim.

* Razdelennyy ekran: kak v starye dobrye vremena. Soberite druzey na divane i odoleyte protivnikov vmeste. (Razdelennyy ekran dlya chetyrekh igrokov pri podklyuchenii dok-stantsii pristavki.)

* Issleduyte: granits net. Nu, krome verkhney polki. V kazhdom ugolke vas zhdut kredity, monety, batareyki i dazhe kollektsionnye predmety, esli u vas khvatit umeniya ikh nayti.

* Stroyte ukrepleniya i oboronyayte to, chto poklyalis zashchishchat. Stroyte tureli, lovushki i steny, a potom otbivayte ataki polchishch vooruzhennykh igrushek. Beregites tirannozavra!

* Progress. Vash malenkiy razmer ne pomeshaet vam vyglyadet kak podobaet voinu. Zarabatyvayte opyt, razblokiruyte unikalnye skiny i nastraivayte svoyu plastikovuyu figurku i oruzhie. 

* Strategii: iskusstvo oborony. Obsuzhdayte taktiku so svoim otryadom i razrabotayte luchshiy plan oborony. Komandnaya rabota ochen vazhna, esli vy khotite zarabotat nailuchshie nagrady.

* Slozhnost: vybor dlya vsey semi. Vybirayte legkiy, obychnyy ili ekspertnyy rezhim: vsyo zavisit ot vashego urovnya navykov.

* Vyigrysh za dengi nevozmozhen, potomu chto v chyom togda smysl? My tsenim nashikh igrokov i obeshchaem prislushivatsya k vashim otzyvam.

* Ofitsialnyy saundtrek: bolee 20 potryasayushchikh unikalnykh muzykalnykh kompozitsiy. Pogruzites v zhivoy i yarkiy mir igry HYPERCHARGE: UNBOXED, slushaya originalnyy saundtrek igry.

title: Bad North [NSP][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Na vashu rodinu napali. Korol pal ot ruk vikingov-okkupantov. Nadezhda slabo mertsaet vdaleke i zatukhaet s kazhdoy sekundoy. Vy prishli k vlasti i zanyali mesto ottsa, no teper na vashi plechi vozlozhena organizatsiya oborony. U vas net prava na oshibku. Eto ne borba za pobedu, a otchayannaya skhvatka za vyzhivanie.

Bad North — eto ocharovatelnyy, no zhestokiy okolorogalik i taktika v realnom vremeni. Zashchitite mirnoe ostrovnoe korolevstvo ot polchishch vikingov i vozglavte otchayannyy iskhod ego zhiteley. Otdavayte prikazy vernym poddannym, ispolzuya takticheskie preimushchestva, obuslovlennye unikalnoy formoy kazhdogo ostrova. Na kartu postavleno bukvalno vse. Odna oshibka — i zemlyu orosit krov vashikh poddannykh.

Ocharovatelnaya zhestokost: krasivye protsedurno generiruemye ostrova i milye soldaty kontrastiruyut s krovavymi realiyami voyny. Vy upravlyaete obshchim khodom srazheniya, otdavaya prikazy na vysshem urovne, poka soldaty izo vsekh sil pytayutsya ispolnyat ikh v pylu bitvy. Ponyatnaya i glubokaya igra: za prostym upravleniem skryvaetsya dinamichnaya boevaya model, chto garantirovanno privlechet novichkov i zainteresuet opytnykh igrokov.

Ne otstupayte, voiny. Vy boretes ne za bogatstvo i slavu, no za nadezhdu, chto v surovye zemli Bad North snova vernetsya mir.

TAKTIKA V REALNOM VREMENI I OKOLOROGALIK:  Rasstavlyayte i perebrasyvayte otryady, chtoby otrazit ataki vikingov, u kotorykh est kozyr na kazhdoe vashe deystvie. Tshchatelno vybirayte voysko i planiruyte evakuatsiyu! Poteryaete komandira i ego uzhe ne vernut. Poteryaete vsekh — igra budet okonchena.

UMNOE UPRAVLENIE OTRYaDAMI:  Vy upravlyaete obshchim khodom oborony i sledite za rasstanovkoy voysk, a soldaty delayut vse ostalnoe: oni peredvigayutsya i napadayut intuitivno v zavisimosti ot tekushchey situatsii.

PROTsEDURNO GENERIRUEMYE OSTROVA:  Kazhdyy ostrov stilisticheski prekrasen i imeet unikalnyy relef. Planiruyte oboronu s uchetom kazhdoy bukhtochki i rasshcheliny, ved u vas est vsego odin shans, chtoby spasti ostrov ot vrazheskogo nashestviya.

ULUChShENIYa:  Chem silnee i effektivnee zashchita, tem bolshe nagrad. Ispolzuyte ikh, chtoby razvivat poddannykh i prevratit raznosherstnykh opolchentsev v zakalennykh voinov.

title: No Heroes Here 1-2 [NSZ][ENG,RUS]
interface_lang: 俄语 (u vtoroy chasti), 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
召集你的朋友，堅守陣地！！！

在這款混亂的合作塔防遊戲中，一群非冒險者成為守護城堡的最後希望。最多可支援4位玩家組隊，你們必須整理城堡、齊心協力製作彈藥，並射擊敵人來保衛王國！

計劃、製作並防禦城堡！

運用團隊合作的力量，在15波兇猛敵人的攻勢中生存下來。每天準備好城堡的各個工作站，加強防禦工事，並根據每種情況選擇最佳的隨機事件來應對挑戰。

沒有英雄？沒關係，我們也能拯救世界！

在這個中世紀世界中，招募更多「非英雄」加入你的臨時守城小隊，包括熟悉的角色如小丑與公主，也有非傳統的角色如鍊金術士與醫生。不是英雄也沒關係，照樣能拯救世界！

王國的命運掌握在你手中！

守護三個各具特色的王國，每個王國都有不同的機制、敵人與趣味設定。保衛典型中世紀王國「菜鳥之地」、冰雪覆蓋的「巨魔利亞」，以及被蘑菇瘋狂侵占的「真菌國」。

中世紀武器庫任你差遣！

遊戲包含30座風格各異的城堡，分為簡單、普通與困難三種難度。選擇你的王國與武器，從大砲、彈弓，甚至是能噴火的小龍中挑選，用猛烈火力對抗敵人的大軍！

title: The Spirit and the Mouse [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Posle uzhasnoy grozy myshka Lila i dukh-khranitel Lyumion obnaruzhili, chto im pridetsya rabotat vmeste, chtoby vernut svoyu derevushku k mirnoy zhizni. K schastyu, u Lily bolshoe serdtse i svezheobretennoe umenie upravlyat elektrichestvom, a znachit, delo ne tak plokho. Speshite vmeste s myshkoy navstrechu trogatelnym priklyucheniyam: podruzhites s igrivymi dukhami elektrichestva kiblinami i osvetite derevnyu Sen-e-Kler!
 
The Spirit and the Mouse — eto syuzhetnaya priklyuchencheskaya igra, v kotoroy vam pridetsya obyskat vse ugolki mira, chtoby dostich tseley, sobrat vsyo neobkhodimoe i pomoch vsem, komu nuzhna pomoshch.
 
Uznayte vsyo o pechalyakh zhiteley derevni, a potom naydite ozornykh kiblinov i ustranite neozhidannye problemy s elektrichestvom. Delaya dobrye dela i sotrudnichaya s prokazlivymi kiblinami, Lila smozhet otpravit Lyumiona domoy na nebo!
 
Osobennosti igry
 - Issleduyte ocharovatelnuyu frantsuzskuyu derevushku Sen-e-Kler i otkroyte ee tayny, nablyudaya za mirom s tochki zreniya kroshechnoy myshi!
 - Upravlyayte elektrichestvom, chtoby peremeshchatsya, reshat golovolomki i pomogat zhitelyam derevni.
 - Vypolnyayte zadaniya i uspokaivayte shalovlivykh kiblinov vo vremya mini-igr, chtoby pomoch mestnym zhitelyam.
 - Sobirayte energiyu i schaste, chtoby razblokirovat novye sposobnosti vo vremya puteshestviya.

title: Famicom Detective Club 3: Emio the Smiling Man [NSP][ENG]
description:
【故事概要】
某個早上，當地男中學生遭到絞殺的屍體被人發現。
他的屍首上套著紙袋，上面繪畫著一個讓人毛骨悚然的笑容。
這副模樣就跟18年前發生的「少女連環殺人事件」的受害者如出一轍。
還有傳言說，這些事件與「笑臉男（ＥＭＩＯ）」這個都市傳說的內容極其相似。
在哭泣的女孩子的眼前出現，以她們的性命作為代價給予她們畫有笑臉的紙袋——究竟這個叫人不寒而慄的傳聞源自哪裡……？
空木偵探事務所全員將竭盡全力，為了解決這個奇異的事件展開挑戰。

【商品介紹】
接續在Famicom Disk System發售的《消失的繼承人》及《站在身後的少女》，本作是「Famicom偵探俱樂部」睽違35年的系列全新作品。
化身為偵探的你，需要根據不同狀況選擇「移動」、「打聽・傾聽」、「查看・調查」等操作指令來推進故事。
本作有著豐富的動畫片段和全語音的會話場景等，帶來充滿沉浸感的表演效果，是一部可讓玩家親自解謎並推進劇情的互動劇場。

title: Cooking Simulator Pizza [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
DELAYTE VKUSNUYu PITsTsU!
Gotovte testo i sousy po nastoyashchim retseptam ili smeshivayte ingredienty i sozdavayte avtorskie proizvedeniya kulinarnogo iskusstva. Zapekayte pitstsu 3 razmerov v kirpichnoy pechi i dobavlyayte shchepotku individualnosti kazhdomu zakazu blagodarya desyatkam nastoyashchikh ingredientov!

title: Overboard [NSZ][ENG]
description:
JULY, 1935. A MURDER HAS BEEN COMMITTED aboard the SS Hook, eight hours out from New York.

Only one problem: you did it.

Can you get away with murder?

GAMEPLAY

Blackmail a spy. Fall in love. Murder a rival. Cheat at cards. Drug a witness. Lie, befriend, betray, console, sneak, seduce, steal, borrow, pray, eavesdrop, kill...

There are clues, evidence, suspects, accusations, secrets and lies.

You’ll need all your cunning, coercion and charisma to ensure that someone else takes the fall.

DYNAMIC NARRATIVE CLOCKWORK

* Next-gen visual novel: go where you want, when you want, and say what you want
* Simulated story-world: other characters move and act independently, remember everything they see and hear, and everything you do
* Every minute counts: you have eight hours to escape justice. Time is always ticking!
* Who can you trust? Some characters are friendly, and some are out to get you. Who will you befriend? Who will you betray?

Built using the award-winning ink narrative engine, Overboard!'s narrative twists itself around every choice you make.

Play once for a thrill, or multiple times to uncover all the secrets and achieve an ideal ending.

HIGHLY REPLAYABLE

One play-through lasts about 30 - 45 minutes, but achieving the perfect crime run will take a lot longer...

CAN YOU GET AWAY WITH MURDER?

title: Elasto Mania Remastered / ElastoMania 2 [NSZ][ENG]
description:
THE GRANDFATHER OF A GENRE

Action SuperCross is the first of its kind - a physics-based motorbike simulator, inspiring many famous franchises. It is the direct predecessor of Elasto Mania, showcasing the evolution of countless fascinating, unique and experimental concepts and gameplay mechanics.

A CHALLENGE OF SKILL AND STYLE

Maybe you can get through the levels, but can you beat world records? Compete with your friends or watch the replays of the world's top players. Going fast is easy, but being the best of the best is the real challenge.

A TIMELESS EXPERIENCE FOR ALL AGES

Dive into the world of Action SuperCross, where the classic gameplay that captivated a generation awaits players both old and new. The timeless appeal of its physics-based motorbike simulation and thrilling level designs continue to entertain and challenge gamers of all ages. Rediscover the excitement of mastering each level, honing your skills, and striving for personal bests. Embrace the nostalgia, or embark on this adventure for the first time, and join the global community of Action SuperCross enthusiasts.

title: Zomb [NSZ][ENG]
description:
ZOMB is a first-person shooter game where the player must survive and save the World from Zombies. ZOMB is single player campaign game that will test your combat skills to the limit.

Having just parachuted from a burning plane into a unknown city swarming with zombies and with limited ammo, the only way to survive is to get the random ammo drops from around the city and become the ultimate action hero,  however as each second passes the zombies increase in number and become stronger, much stronger!

How long will you survive? 

ZOMB is an easy to play, fast action game based on the gameplay of the first-person shooter games of the late 1990's, that will make you want to play again and again!

title: Wolfenstein 3D [NSP][ENG]
description:
Wolfenstein 3D — kompyuternaya igra v zhanre shutera ot pervogo litsa, razrabotannaya kompaniey id Software i izdannaya 3D Realms (aka Apogee Software). Wolfenstein 3D yavlyaetsya tretey igroy v serii igr Wolfenstein — istochnikom vdokhnoveniya dlya eyo sozdateley posluzhila igra 1981 goda Castle Wolfenstein.
Igrok beryot na sebya rol razvedchika soyuznikov Vtoroy mirovoy voyny Uilyama (Bi-Dzheya) Blaskovitsa, kotoryy pytaetsya sbezhat iz mesta svoego zaklyucheniya — zamka Volfenshtayn — i vypolnyaet ryad diversionnykh zadaniy protiv natsistskogo rezhima. Na kazhdom urovne igrok dolzhen srazhatsya s natsistskimi soldatami, sobakami i mutantami, ispolzuya nozh i ognestrelnoe oruzhie.
Wolfenstein 3D poluchila priznanie u kritikov i nagrady ot zhurnalov v razlichnykh nominatsiyakh, a obyom eyo prodazh cherez god otsenivaelsya v 200 000 kopiy. Igra sposobstvovala populyarizatsii zhanra shutera ot pervogo litsa, stala obraztsom dlya bystrykh ekshen-igr i ustanovila planku tekhnologicheskogo ispolneniya dlya posleduyushchikh igr v zhanre..
Ne rabotaet na proshivkakh FW 9.x.x vyshe.
Bolee prodvinutuyu versiyu igry na emulyatore 3DO dlya Switch sm. zdes.

title: Wolfenstein 3D / Star Control II (2) / GEX (na Opera-4DO, Panasonic 3DO, Retroarch) [ENG][NSP]
description:
V razdache nakhoditsya nastroennyy emulyator 3DO Interactive Multiplayer na yadre Opera (byvsh. 4do) pod Retrorach c BIOS'ami plyus 3 originalnykh igry: Wolfenstein 3D, Star Control II, GEX.
3DO Interactive Multiplayer (ili prosto 3DO) — igrovaya pristavka, vypuskavshayasya v 1993—1996 gg. kompaniyami Panasonic, Sanyo, Creative i Goldstar, iznachalno razrabotannykh Dave Needle i RJ Mical iz New Technology Group. Ideya sozdaniya konsoli prinadlezhit predprinimatelyu Tripu Khoukinsu, osnovatelyu EA Games.
Na moment vypuska konsol obladala ochen prodvinutymi apparatnymi vozmozhnostyami: 32-razryadnyy protsessor ARM60 s RISC-arkhitekturoy, rabotayushchiy na chastote 12,5 MGts; dva graficheskikh soprotsessora; 16-razryadnyy tsifrovoy signalnyy protsessor i spetsialnyy matematicheskiy soprotsessor. Vse dopolnitelnye soprotsessory byli razrabotany spetsialno dlya etoy konsoli. Takzhe, konsol imela 2 megabayta OZU, 1 megabayt videopamyati, i dvukhskorostnoy CD-privod. Imelas vozmozhnost odnovremennogo podklyucheniya do 8 dzhoystikov (originalnym sposobom — v tsepochku, odin podklyuchaetsya k drugomu). Pomimo ispolzovaniya spetsialno razrabotannogo PO, konsol mogla proigryvat CD-audio (vklyuchaya podderzhku CD+G), prosmatrivat Photo CD i Video CD. Odnako, tolko neskolko igr polnostyu ispolzovali potentsial konsoli.

title: Jump King [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
「傳聞在那個頂端,有著一位年輕貌美的辣妹......」

Jump King 是瑞典的 Nexile 公司所開發的高難度直向卷軸動作遊戲。為了見到「年輕貌美的辣妹」,一名有著強韌腳力、身穿厚重鎧甲的男人,日以繼夜地朝著頂點向上跳。

遊戲的操作方式只有跳躍及左右移動,但長按跳躍按鈕的時間,會影響跳躍的距離。玩家需要觀察兩個平台間的距離,調整長按的時間,配合方向鍵決定跳躍的方向。一旦跳了出去,就沒辦法再改變方向。

・「New Babe」、「New Babe+」及「Ghost of the Babe」共 3 種遊戲模式,各有不同的美人兒在頂端等候主角光臨。

・有些關卡會有風吹干擾,或是地面濕滑,離頂點越近,難度就越高！

・有時僅僅一次的失誤,將會使你掉落回到好幾個關卡之前......專注在跳躍上面吧！

title: Fitness Boxing [NSZ][ENG]
description:
別窩在沙發上了，享受這款以拳擊為基礎的趣味節奏運動，跟著Lady Gaga、Pitbull和Kesha等知名歌手歌曲的旋律節奏動起來！你可以選擇不同的健身目標，將你的運動個人化，用你自己的方式鍛鍊，不論你是自己鍛鍊和朋友一起、在家還是在外！現在你可以在Nintendo Switch主機上，隨時隨地做運動！ 

一面專心聽20首可供解鎖的熱門金曲樂器演奏版，一面認真打拳擊！歌曲包含LMFAO的《Party Rock Anthem》、Carly Rae Jepson的《Call Me Maybe》、還有Maroon 5的《Sugar》。握好你的Joy-Con，揮拳、深蹲，讓你全身動起來，不需要其他健身設備！ 

每日鍛鍊時間從10分鐘到40分鐘不等，並提供「一般」和「快速」兩種模式。本遊戲軟體會估算你的BMI及每日燃燒的卡路里，讓你可以記錄自己的進度。從眾多各有特色的教練中選一位，並且用可以解鎖的教練服自訂其外觀。隨著你的進步，還能贏得更多歌曲和更具挑戰性的健身循環。如果你喜歡和朋友一起運動，你可以用兩組Joy-Con、或兩人共用一組，一起享受運動，或在虛擬擂台上一較高下，試試自己的身手！

title: Goetia / Goetia 2 [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 俄语, lyubitelskiy Prometheus
description:
Ruiny lyubogo poseleniya — eto tikhiy pamyatnik ego poslednikh dney. Ruiny Oakmarsha ne stali isklyucheniem. Ikh govoryashchaya tishina i pyl, pokryvayushchaya kovrom ostanki nebolshoy derevushki pod Koventri!
Vashe imya Ebigeyl Blekvud i, kak by eto pomyagche prepodnesti… vy umerli pri neyasnykh obstoyatelstvakh okolo soroka let nazad. No, chto interesney, po eshchyo menee ponyatnym prichinam spustya 40 let vy probudilis v forme prizraka rovno na tom meste, gde byli pokhoroneny.
Semeynoe pomeste vse eshchyo na meste, no vashikh rodstvennikov v nyom sovsem net. V nyom voobshche net ni edinoy zhivoy dushi!.. Po krayney mere, tak vam kazhetsya na pervykh porakh...

title: Trollhunters Defenders of Arcadia [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
voice_lang: 英语, 法语, 意大利语, 德语, 西班牙语
description: Voydi v mir Okhotnikov na trolley, sygray za Dzhima Leyka-mladshego, ostanovi trollya-obmanshchika Porgona i ne day svershitsya ego kovarnym planam! Tebe na pomoshchyu pridet Kler v kooperativnoy igre, a takzhe mnozhestvo drugikh lyubimykh personazhey, vmeste s kotorymi tebe pridetsya vstretitsya s silami zla i ostanovit Tempokalipsis! Uluchshay dospekhi, sovershenstvuy sposobnosti i stan silnee, chem byl kogda-libo!Sudba vselennoy v tvoikh rukakh!

title: Amanatsu Perfect edition / Sweet Summer Plus [NSZ][ENG/JAP]
developer: Azarashi Software あざらしそふと
description:
Pogruzites v mir AMANATSU ~Perfect Edition~, gde letniy pereezd v pribrezhnyy gorodok perevorachivaet zhizn glavnogo geroya, Kharuto. Ostaviv suetu bolshogo goroda, on ozhidaet novykh trudnostey, no vmesto etogo nakhodit neozhidannoe teplo i druzhbu.
V etom kazualnom priklyuchenii vas zhdet bolee 5 chasov uvlekatelnoy istorii, ozvuchennoy professionalnymi yaponskimi akterami. Vy poznakomites s tremya ocharovatelnymi devushkami, kazhdaya iz kotorykh sposobna rastopit dazhe samoe kholodnoe serdtse: molchalivoy i zabotlivoy Kazukhoy, energichnoy i solnechnoy Kogane i zagadochnoy i mechtatelnoy Yashiro. Vybor za vami — s kem perepletutsya puti Kharuto, i chi chuvstva rastsvetut pod letnim solntsem.
Eto ne prosto vizualnaya novella, eto istoriya o druzhbe, lyubvi i poiske sebya. Otpravtes v atmosferu pribrezhnogo goroda, gde kazhdyy den napolnen novymi otkrytiyami i emotsiyami. Razvivayte otnosheniya, issleduyte kharaktery personazhey i stante svidetelem zarozhdeniya glubokikh chuvstv.
Esli vy ishchete romanticheskuyu novellu s priyatnoy grafikoy, otlichnym zvukovym soprovozhdeniem i interesnym syuzhetom, AMANATSU ~Perfect Edition~ stanet otlichnym vyborom. Prigotovtes k zakhvatyvayushchemu letnemu priklyucheniyu!..
Roli ozvuchivayut:

title: 托德的靈魂跳躍者 [NSZ][ENG]
description:
突如其來的惡夢！瘋狂科學家・阿涅莫涅的惡作劇，讓奧科特他們全都變成石頭了……！？
身為科學家（武器狂熱者）的托德，為了拯救同伴，使用自製的特製跳躍機「靈魂跳躍者」開始挑戰登頂！

本作是《咕喵怪物》的衍生遊戲，是由系列角色托德大顯身手的小遊戲。
……為了夥伴努力，應該不會覺得辛苦吧？

◇操作非常簡單！
在跳躍裝置著地的瞬間按下按鈕來蓄力。
在蓄力期間調整角度，放開按鈕即可進行大跳躍。

◆難度共有兩種！
提供簡單與困難兩種模式。
選擇適合自己遊玩風格的難度來挑戰吧。

◆跳躍、反彈、墜落……
身體或跳躍裝置側面碰到牆壁或地面時會被彈開。一不小心就會瞬間回到起點……
記得深呼吸，或許就是通關的關鍵！？

◆處處充滿危機的道路
會崩塌的立足點、燃燒的地面等妨礙登頂的機關接連阻擋玩家去路。
超級跳躍！需要的是勇氣！掌握時機，為了夥伴奮力一跳吧！

◇雙人對戰模式（線下）
在雙人遊玩模式中，《咕喵怪物》的元凶——阿涅莫涅登場！
活用跳躍裝置，在時間內收集比對手更多的硬幣吧。
猛烈撞向對手、搶奪硬幣，也是策略之一！

title: Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Stunt Mayhem [NSP][ENG]
description: Budte gotovy k vypolneniyu bezumnykh tryukov na fantasticheskikh arenakh v novoy igre, kotoraya pereneset vashi lyubimye monstr-traki na konchiki paltsev v portativ!

title: Delivery from the Pain [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
某抗癌藥物研究小組聲稱他們發現了能讓人類永生的機制，FaithEnergy公司因此啟動人類補完計畫，但是因為疫苗失控，人類變異成殭屍，而你所在的地方，剛好是重災區，為了活下去也為了揭開整個事件背後的陰謀，你開始了你的探索之旅…

警察局裏可憐的母女，史密斯醫院的醫生，狡猾的小偷，腦袋不靈光的胖子，嫉妒心強的黑妞，自卑感強的雙胞胎弟弟和強勢的雙胞胎哥哥，你能和他們一起活著出去嗎？你又將付出什麼樣的代價？那些探索中你見到的磁帶，報紙，書刊和信件，又隱藏怎樣的玄機？你能在其中找到逃生門的密碼嗎？

-獨特的末日氛圍，巧妙的設計。
-多種結局設計，充滿懸疑和驚喜，幕後真相到底是什麼？
-眾多末日的城市場景充滿危險也佈滿資源。
-NPC擁有自己的時間線和劇情走向。
-極具考驗的對話選擇，讓探索之路更具不確定性。
-10多種各具特點的殭屍和4個大Boss讓冒險充滿壓力。
-庇護所的學習和建造，讓生存策略變得更加多樣化。
-近戰和遠戰武器的搭配以及潛入玩法讓戰鬥更加豐富。

title: Arcade Spirits / Arcade Spirits The New Challengers [NSZ][ENG]
description: Predstavte, chto v 1983 godu ne bylo krizisa industrii videoigr. V takom mire i nachinaetsya deystvie vizualnogo romana Arcade Spirits. 20XX god. Arkady vsyo eshche neveroyatno populyarny. Vash personazh nakhodit rabotu v mestnoy arkade pod nazvaniem Funplex sredi ekstsentrichnykh geroev...

title: Firework (烟火, Yānhuo) [NSZ][ENG]
description: 故事發生在偏遠的山中小鎮，一場發生於葬禮上的火災，意外牽動出一樁早已結案的滅門慘案。新人警察林理洵在因緣際會下重新展開調查，隨著調查逐漸深入，受害者的過往慢慢浮出水面，而案件的真相卻愈發撲朔迷離……

title: Shadows of Adam + Guild of the Artificers [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Tucked away from the outside world by the impenetrable haze of the Misty Woods, the village of Adam has mostly lived in peace since the days of the Wraith War. The dark power that fueled that war has vanished, but darkness is descending once more and Adam's legendary hero, Orazio, is no more. 

10 years ago he left without explanation and never returned, leaving his son and adopted daughter to wrestle with the dark secret he left behind—a secret that must now be revealed if the children hope to save both Adam and their departed father, though its revelation could unhinge the world. 

Shadows of Adam is a creative, humorous and exciting take on the 16-bit JRPG era, but with its own twists and style for the modern day gamer. Fast-paced battles, gorgeous graphics, an awesome soundtrack and the convenience to save anywhere you like make it tough to resist! Whether playing on the TV or in handheld mode, the game’s glorious pixels will immerse you in the adventure and its memorable scenes.

Features:

•	Compelling Character Driven Story: Shadows of Adam’s story is one with a deep narrative and an interesting plot. The story revolves around 4 main characters: Asrael, Kellan, Curtis and Talon.
•	A Strategic AP Management Battle System: AP is restored between each round of battle automatically and through defeating enemies. This allows a unique attrition system that encourages skill use and fast combat.
•	Beautiful Visuals: Shadows of Adam features beautifully modernized visuals inspired by classic JRPGs of the '90s.
•	Original Soundtrack With Over 44 Tracks: An original soundtrack by Tyler Mire that’s inspired by music from the genre's greatest games. This soundtrack includes unique themes for each area and character and has an emphasis on strong melodies and an emotional connection.

title: Lovish [NSZ][ENG]
description:
所羅門爵士與光明救世主們一同從科尼利亞斯城堡出發，要從邪惡的惡魔領主手中解救津奈公主！

然而，騎士卻擔心，公主獲救後，若傾心的不是自己，而是某位同伴，那該如何是好？

於是，被愛情衝昏頭的他，做出了任何人在此情況下都可能做出的事，甩開了所有同伴！

所羅門單槍匹馬冒險進入惡魔領主的城堡，誓言贏得公主芳心！

LABS 與 Matt Kap 共同推出《Lovish》，一款令人驚豔的 8 位元風格動作冒險遊戲！闖過一連串精巧的迷你房間，斬殺怪物、收集道具，並找到出口！每穿過一個房間，都能欣賞一段簡短的事件場景，而在這裡，一切皆有可能！你會發現道具嗎？會突然被捲入一場 RPG 戰嗎？而世界是否會因此分崩離析？逐一征服惡魔領主城堡中的每個房間，一次攻克一個挑戰，尋找最終答案！

遊戲特色：
- 超過 50 個有趣關卡，每一個都有多重挑戰目標！
- 關卡之間的隨機事件場景充滿了數百種可能的結果！永遠都不知道接下來會看到什麼！
- 收集各種道具，升級所羅門的能力，還能以各種有意（或無意）的方式擴展遊戲體驗！
- 在遊戲內商店盡情消費！（澄清一下，只是遊戲內貨幣，沒有微交易）
- 超過 100 名角色，其中一些是由世界知名漫畫家見田龍介（代表作《半龍少女》）設計
- 精彩原創配樂，超過 20 首曲目，由 Matt Kap（《Castle In The Darkness》、《Astalon: Tears of the Earth》）打造
- 由真人美術師精心繪製的像素藝術！就連遊戲內的「AI 美術」也是由真人繪製而成的！
- 比以往任何作品都隱藏著更多秘密！（這是本系列的第一款遊戲，所以這句話可能不代表什麼吧。）
- 意想不到的客串角色
- 以及更多精彩內容！

那麼，就請你行行好，幫助所羅門拯救公主吧！

title: Puss [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
“This game is BANANAS!” — IGN
“This game makes me want to keep trying over and over and over again.” — Jacksepticeye

V etoy igre ty upravlyaesh kotom, kotoryy popal v drugoe izmerenie.
Naydi vykhod otsyuda ili ostansya zdes navsegda!

Osobennosti:
