description: Otkroyte dlya sebya SUPERBEAT XONiC EX — sovershenno novuyu volnuyushchuyu muzykalnuyu igru, kotoraya nesomnenno privedet vas v polnyy vostorg! Nasladites snogsshibatelnoy grafikoy i vizualnymi effektami, igraya pod akkompanement bolee 70 unikalnykh pesen i otkryvaya kuchu taynykh nagrad i predmetov! Vypolnyayte i dovodite do sovershenstva klevye kombo i obyazatelno dokazhite vsemu miru svoe prevoskhodstvo, zabravshis na samuyu vershinu reytingovoy tablitsy!

title: Curse Crackers for Whom the Belle Toils [NSZ][ENG]
description: Pomogite prekrasnoy akrobatke Bell i zhivomu kolokolchiku Chaymu vernut pokhishchennogo parnya ee sopernitse Bonni, kotoraya vnezapno vernulas so strannymi novymi sposobnostyami i komandoy skeletov, lyubyashchikh graffiti! title: Knights and Bikes [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 俄语 来自 Dzhimmi Khopkinsa, 移植版 AlchemistLab.
description:
Nessa i Demeltsiya issleduyut poberezhe ostrova i ishchut sokrovishcha.

Dve podruzhki vmeste s pitomtsem-gusem i golovoy bessmertnogo rytsarya v banke otpravlyayutsya navstrechu priklyucheniyam. Oni gotovy spravitsya s lyubymi opasnostyami, ispolzuya letayushchie tarelki i drugie podruchnye predmety.

Po puti im predstoit sobirat bezdelushki i obmenivat ikh na uluchsheniya dlya velosipedov.

title: Crystal Project + 2 DLC [NSP][ENG]
description:
Crystal Project — eto nelineynaya JRPG, v kotoroy vy sami sozdayote sobstvennoe priklyuchenie. Issleduyte mir, nakhodya kristally, otkryvayte klassy, izuchayte sposobnosti i sozdavayte neobychnuyu strategiyu prokhozhdeniya igry, sposobnuyu pobedit samykh slozhnykh bossov etogo zagadochnogo mira. Issleduyte mir, naydite vse volshebnye kristally i ispolnite drevnee prorochestvo, chtoby vosstanovit balans v strane Sekvoy... A mozhet byt, vy predpochitaete provodit vremya, sobiraya superkrutoe snaryazhenie i starinnye artefakty? Ili priruchit strannykh sushchestv, zapolniv vse zapisi v svoem ogromnom arkhive? Ili, vozmozhno, vy predpochitaete vysledit kazhdogo monstra i pobedit vse samykh silnykh bossov v mire. Ili predpochitaete otpravitsya v samye dalnie ugolki mestnykh zemel, i raskryt velichayshie tayny mirozdaniya?
Vybor zdes tolko za vami, kak i dolzhno byt v khoroshey rolevoy igre! Govoryat, chto te, kto otklonitsya ot generalnoy linii, budut nakazany, ubity — ili chto eshchyo khuzhe.. Mozhet byt, dlya vashego zhe blaga vy budete prodolzhat sobirat sebe kristalliki, kak i vse ostalnye.
No gde zhe togda vo vsyom etom budet nezabyvaemoe priklyuchenie?

title: Planet of Lana II (2) Children of the Leaf [NSZ][RUS/Multi14]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 14]
description:
機械降臨後的世界
在 Lana 與 Mui 的故鄉星球上，新科技雖帶來了進步，卻也滋生了貪婪與失衡。隨著各部族對科技的接納方式產生分歧，局勢日漸緊繃，世界原有的和諧也開始動搖。當渴求力量之人跨越了界線，Lana 與她的小夥伴被迫捲入一段旅程，這將揭開星球塵封已久的真相，以及關於他們自身的祕密。

無聲卻充滿故事的世界
橫越冰封山巔、深邃海洋與被遺忘的廢墟，探索這個大自然與科技交織的手繪世界。本作全程無對白，角色透過異星語言溝通；故事將由環境、音樂與你的抉擇來訴說，邀請你親自領略其中的深意。

旅程核心的羈絆
《Planet of Lana II》是一款以「陪伴」與「信任」為核心的電影級解謎冒險遊戲。引導成長後身手更加靈巧的 Lana，與忠誠夥伴 Mui 攜手合作；在這個美麗與危險並存的世界中，兩人的羈絆將是繼續前行的關鍵。

精妙解謎與流暢動作
謎題自然交織於世界之中，考驗的是觀察力、時機掌控與協作默契，而非艱澀的邏輯運算。善用 Lana 進化後的靈活身手，結合蹬牆跳、流暢位移與慣性運用，在重重危機中闖出一條生路。

情感細膩、節奏優美的冒險
隨著 Lana 與 Mui 深入旅程，新的發現將抽絲剝繭般揭開星球的歷史，以及 Mui 身世背後的真相。這是一段關於共存、責任與進步代價的深刻故事，在動人心弦的管弦配樂襯托下，無論是靜謐時刻或重大轉折，都能在 6 至 8 小時的冒險中感受到每一分情感重量。

獨立完整的體驗
《Planet of Lana II》不僅歡迎新玩家加入，也為回歸的老玩家準備了更具深度的旅程。這是一個關於連結、韌性，以及在變動世界中守護珍視之物的故事。

主要特色

電影級解謎平台冒險
以劇情為驅動，完美融合探索、環境解謎與濃厚的電影氛圍。

羈絆同行的旅程
一段圍繞著 Lana 與忠誠夥伴 Mui 之間深厚羈絆的暖心冒險。

轉變中的手繪世界
探索自然與科技碰撞下的美麗星球，見證不同部族如何回應文明的進步。

流暢的探索與移動
操作更加成熟靈巧的 Lana，透過蹬牆跳、流暢穿梭與動態位移，探索多樣化的環境。

巧思十足的解謎設計
謎題自然融入世界觀，著重於觀察、時機與合作，而非複雜的邏輯推演。

無聲的敘事藝術
全程無對白。故事意義將透過視覺藝術、音樂以及你與世界的互動自然流露。

情感深刻的科幻篇章
在 6 到 8 小時的電影化旅程中，伴隨扣人心弦的管弦配樂，揭開星球與 Mui 過去的真相。

title: Over the Alps [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
Zagadochnaya istoriya raskryvaetsya na pochtovykh otkrytkakh, ispisannykh nevidimymi chernilami...

Otpravtes v puteshestvie v proshloe v debyutnoy igre ot Stave Studios, OVER THE ALPS. Ne vydat sebya, uyti ot politsii i uchastvovat v gonkakh po Shveytsarii 1939 goda: vse eto zhdet vas v shpionskom trillere vremen Vtoroy mirovoy voyny.

Issleduyte vse ukromnye ugolki interaktivnogo narrativa ot Dzhona Ingolda, avtora 80 Days i Heaven's Vault, gde lyuboe vashe deystvie budet imet posledstviya.

Opisanie:
- interaktivnyy narrativ, napolnennyy ekshenom, priklyucheniyami i nostalgiey.

- Prekrasno oformlennye peyzazhi, naveyannye starinnymi plakatami.

- Vychislyayte, kto drug, a kto vrag, iz vsego mnogoobraziya personazhey.

- Vyberite svoy marshrut na karte s realnymi mestami.

title: Wanderlust Travel Stories [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Sidya v bare na samom otdalyonnom ostrove mira, gruppa neznakomtsev delitsya svoimi istoriyami. Postavte sebya na ikh mesto i vzglyanite na puteshestviya s razlichnykh tochek zreniya. Wanderlust Travel Stories — eto kniga, kotoruyu sozdaete vy sami. Esli vy ishchete chto-to neobychnoe, eto to, chto vam nuzhno. I esli vy mozhete eto prochitat, u vas est vsyo neobkhodimoe, chtoby nachat. 

Chetyre dlinnye istorii i pyat korotkikh napisany otdelnymi gruppami avtorov. Kazhdoe puteshestvie predlagaet unikalnyy stil igry. Vzglyanite na puteshestviya glazami rasskazchikov. V ikh chisle student-idealist, izmotannyy zhurnalist i chelovek, ne umeyushchiy planirovat naperyod.

Nastoyashchie mesta, vdokhnovlyonnye realnymi istoriyami sobytiya. Pobyvayte u zagadochnykh statuy na ostrove Paskhi, na shumnykh ulitsakh Bangkoka, netronutykh prostorakh Antarktiki, lugakh Serengeti i vo mnogikh drugikh mestakh. Pogruzites v istorii zayadlykh puteshestvennikov i opytnykh zhurnalistov, vzglyanite na mir s pomoshchyu ikh stranstviy.

Vashi resheniya menyayut nastroenie personazhey. Ot etogo, v svoyu ochered, zavisit to, kakim vy uvidite mir. My ispytyvaem raznye emotsii. Radost i zador — eto eshchyo ne vsyo, ved grustit i ustavat — eto tozhe estestvenno.

Izyashchnaya estetika, kachestvennyy izobrazitelnyy ryad i atmosfernoe zvukovoe soprovozhdenie zadayut ton igre. To chto nado, chtoby probudit vospominaniya i vzbudorazhit voobrazhenie.

Eto spokoynyy i meditativnyy opyt, zamenyayushchiy tikhiy vecher s chashkoy chaya ili knigoy. Vam ne pridyotsya toropitsya ili srazhatsya. Ne speshite i naslazhdaytes momentom. Esli eto vam po dushe, poprobuyte to, chto my nazyvaem «medlennoy igroy».

title: Storm Boy [NSZ][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
Based on Colin Thiele's 1964 children’s book of the same name, Storm Boy takes place on the beaches of South Australia near the mouth of the Murray River, where the titular protagonist rescues orphaned pelican chicks, one of whom later becomes the child’s pet and faithful companion, Mr. Percival.

Experience an interactive retelling of the classic tale by taking control of both Storm Boy and Mr. Percival in key moments, such as when the pair rescued stranded sailors during a storm. Relive their friendship and enjoy seaside activities across a wide assortment of fun and relaxing mini-games, including sand drawing, sailing, cockle hunting, playing fetch, sand surfing, pelican feeding, and more.

title: A Highland Song [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Filosofskaya priklyuchencheskaya igra, deystvie kotoroy razvorachivaetsya v shotlandskom vysokogore.
Vozmite na sebya rol Moyry Makkinnon, otvazhnogo podrostka, vpervye otpravlyayushchuyusya v puteshestvie k moryu. Chtoby dobratsya do mesta naznacheniya, Moyra dolzhna proyti cherez opasnuyu dikuyu mestnost, polnuyu zaputannykh tropinok, vozvyshayushchikhsya pikov, skrytykh putey i pesen!
V igre A Highland Song studiya vykhodit za ramki svoego obychnogo puti chistogo povestvovaniya i vklyuchaet v sebya drugie igrovye mekhaniki. Vyzhivanie stanovitsya klyuchevym aspektom igry, igrokam neobkhodimo adaptirovatsya k postoyanno menyayushchimsya pogodnym usloviyam, urovnyu goloda i energii svoego personazha, a takzhe k vragam, kotorykh Moyra mozhet vstretit na svoem puti.
Poprobuyte dobratsya do mayaka v Beltayne, gde vas navernyaka zhdyot chudesnyy syurpriz..Ot sozdateley 80 Days, Overboard!, Heaven's Vault, Sorcery!, Expelled

title: 80 Days [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Choose your own route around the world, travelling by airship, submarine, mechanical camel, steam-train and more, racing other players and a clock that never stops in TIME Magazine's #1 Game of the Year 2014, now on Nintendo Switch™.

Featuring stunning art by Jaume Illustration, a half-million word script by Meg Jayanth and Jon Ingold, original music by Laurence Chapman, 80 DAYS is an interactive adventure created by your choices, on the fly, and is different every time you play.

Playing as Phileas Fogg's loyal valet, Passepartout, you must balance your master's health, your finances, and the time, as you choose your own path from city to city all the way around the world. Bribe your way onto early departures, but don't let yourself go bankrupt or you'll be sleeping rough and begging for aid! Trade items for profit, and collect the equipment for the conditions you'll face: but too much luggage will slow you down...

80 DAYS is a breakneck race, with an in-game clock that never stops running. Trains, steamers, hot-air balloons, boats, camels, horses and more leave and arrive minute by minute. 

Every city and journey is narrated via an interactive story where you control every action. Will your choices speed you up - or lead you into disaster? Will you earn Fogg's trust and respect? Will you uncover the secrets and short-cuts that can shave days off your time? Murder, romance, rebellion and intrigue await! 

* "We’ve been dreaming about this future for decades. Guess what? It’s here." - New York Times

* "Interactive storytelling as its best" - The Guardian

* "This brilliant interactive novel re-imagines Phileas Fogg's journey around the world... One of the finest examples of branching narrative yet created." - The Telegraph

* "For people who love high adventures and good writing, 80 Days is a voyage that must be taken" - The Verge

* "A brilliantly paced, memorable and quite frankly terrific piece of modern interactive fiction, that masterfully blends strategy, resource management and adventure" - IndieGames.com

* "This is modern storytelling that engages and delights, and the bold, stylish artwork gives 80 Days almost a graphic novel feel. Pack your case, armchair Passepartout - adventure awaits!" - Joystiq

* "Is it a game? Is it a story? Both, really. And a delight." - The Telegraph - Best Novels of 2014

* "Could be the best interactive fiction game out there" - 148 Apps

* "A sublime video game to immerse yourself in" - The Examiner

* "One of the most extraordinarily memorable and unique games I’ve played in years" - Pocket Tactics 

* "Innovative and extraordinary, and unpredictable fun" - Apps Zoom

* "Rich with ideas, brilliantly written, and creates a world that you'll want to visit over and over again" - PocketGamer (gold award)

150 cities to explore. Millions of journeys. Detailed research and techno-fantasy combine in an 1872 of tensions, inventions and exploration. Climb the Burmese mountains, trek the Zulu Federation, sail up the Amazon and disappear under the Indian Ocean - but don't fall behind the time!

title: End of Lines [NSP][ENG]
description:
• Story

End of Lines is an interactive graphic novel, set in the near future. Following a climate-induced apocalypse, a group of survivors centered around a small family wanders in the devastated countryside of Southern Europe, looking for a livable place to settle.

A well-researched, environmental tale that acts as a warning about climate inaction and the collapse of ecosystems.

• Features

— Each choice matters: manage the supplies and the morale of your group in a ruthless environment where death may be encountered at any time.
— A poignant vision of what may lie ahead: the story is set at the end of the 21st century, in a world where nothing has been done to counteract climate change.
— A family unit at the core: follow Camille, Nora, their son Sam, the lively “Uncle” Rafik and the diverse cast of characters they befriend on the trail.
— A beautifully illustrated storybook: with each playthrough, experience a novel-sized adventure and a portion of the hundreds of hand-painted illustrations created for the game.
— An immersive and finely-crafted soundtrack.

Zlobnyy staryy karlik proklinaet ikh i prevrashchaet v snegovikov, berya v plen prekrasnykh printsess Puripuri i Puchipuchi. Esli ne protivostoyat emu vsemi silami, skoro ves Snezhnyy mir prosto rastaet, i vot, Nik i Tom, dazhe zakoldovannye v snegovikov, otpravlyayutsya v dolgoe puteshestvie dlya izgnaniya podlogo vraga so svoey zemli. title: Omochapon [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Gasyapon (yapon. ガシャポン i Gachapon yap. ガチャポン Gatyapon, Gachapon), — yaponskie igrushki iz torgovogo avtomata, pomeshchyonnye v prozrachnye plastmassovye shariki. title: Mody dlya The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim (NSP Alternative J Lite Edition 2.0) [NSP][RUS]
description:
Dannaya sborka predstavlyaet soboy samu igru The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim dlya Nintendo Switch adaptirovannuyu na russkiy yazyk iz yaponskogo regiona i integrirovannye mody posle konvertatsii, dlya raboty na Switch. Alternativnaya Oblegchyonnaya versiya NSP sborki, povyshena stabilnost i proizvoditelnost, obnovleny plaginy do poslednikh aktualnykh versiy, dobavleny dopolnitelnye plaginy. Izmenena ikonka igry na alternativnuyu dlya vizualnogo otlichiya. Vozmozhna ustanovka v NAND. Vklyucheny obnovleniya Anniversary Edition kotorye udalos adaptirovat pod Switch.
Dannaya sborka sdelana otdelnoy razdachey, t.k. u neyo drugoy region, i sootvetstvenno Tittle ID. Sokhraneniya s predydushchikh sborok igra ne uvidit. Perenesti ikh mozhno, tem ne menee ne rekomenduetsya. Kazhdaya sborka sobiraetsya v individualnuyu strukturu esp i bsa, poetomu pri popytke igrat v versii raznykh sborok neizbezhno vozniknovenie nekotorykh bagov. Rekomenduetsya nachalo novoy igry.
Poskolku igra yaponskogo regiona, mozhno stavit parallelno drugoy versii sborok, ili prosto chistuyu igru bez modov.
Fenteziynaya saga The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim®, poluchivshaya bolee 200 nagrad «Igra goda», prikhodit na Nintendo Switch. Prozhivite druguyu zhizn v drugom mire… gde ugodno i kogda ugodno.
Srazhaytes s drevnimi drakonami, pokoryayte gornye piki, postroyte dom i zavedite semyu, ovladeyte professiey, magiey ili obuchites ratnomu delu. Mir igry budet dinamicheski podstraivatsya pod vas. Igrayte tak, kak vam khochetsya, i svoimi deystviyami opredelyayte obraz svoego personazha.
Ustanovka: Vsyo chto nuzhno, eto prosto ustanovit NSP fayl tak, kak vy privykli, naprimer cherez DBI. Takzhe obratite vnimanie, imeetsya fayl zaglushka PsD.nsp. On nuzhen dlya togo, chto by ne vyskakivalo soobshchenie o ne ustanovlennom pakete russkoy ozvuchki.

title: The Isle Tide Hotel [NSP][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
Neradivyy otets staraetsya uspet spasti svoyu doch-podrostka ot predstaviteley religioznogo kulta, kotorye sobirayutsya provesti tseremoniyu v poslednyuyu noch raboty otelya “Ostrov Prilivov”. Igrokam etoy interaktivnoy igry-zagadki, gde lyubye resheniya igroka vliyayut na razvitie syuzheta, predstoit rassledovat strannye sobytiya, chtoby spasti Eleanoru Maloun.

Kak proniknut v otel? Udastsya li vam stat chlenom organizatsii? Smozhete li vy raskryt zagadochnuyu istoriyu, vypolnit dopolnitelnye zadaniya i posmotret vse kontsovki? Izuchayte syuzhet s mnogochislennymi variantami spaseniya docheri, kotoruyu vy nikogda ne videli.

Main Features 
●	7 osnovnykh kontsovok s 14 variantami iskhodov
●	Dopolnitelnye kvesty s otdelnymi kontsovkami
●	Otslezhivanie razvitiya personazha i priverzhennosti k kultu
●	Vozmozhnost poluchit funktsiyu propuska glav
 
Osobennosti povestvovaniya
●	Unikalnyy kult s bogatoy istoriey i svoimi pravilami
●	Razlichnye varianty razvitiya syuzheta
●	Shifrovannye primechaniya k skrytym kontsovkam 
●	Skrytye istorii i “paskhalki”
●	Raznoobraznye varianty dialogov, kotorye pozvolyayut uvidet odnogo i togo zhe personazha v raznom svete

title: OPUS: Prism Peak / The Day We Found Earth / Rocket of Whispers / Echo of Starsong Full Bloom Edition [NSZ][ENG]
description:
「OPUS：心相吾山」是一個關於攝影的冒險故事，你將扮演迷失在「亡土」的中年攝影師，與失去記憶的女孩一同旅行，透過相機破解世界的謎團，兩人一起找到回家的辦法。

■攝影系統
攝影在遊戲中，代表了主角多認真的「看」這世界。你必須了解幻境的每個角落，以及相遇神靈的拍照需求，透過攝影解開世界的秘密。

■神火爐
貌似光圈造型的神火爐，扮演了聯通不同世界的橋樑，隱藏著亡土世界的秘密。玩家需要解讀神火的需求，完成拍攝任務，進而獲得道具或強化拍攝的能力。

■陪伴的少女
眾神靈中唯有一位人類少女。沒有記憶的她，只隱約記得要來協助一位大人度過難關。少女會在冒險過程會提供各種線索，幫助主角看清楚這個世界。

■魔幻寫實的鄉愁
這裡的世界與真實近乎無異，卻沒有人類的足跡，徒有被稱為「神靈」——會說話的動物們居住於此。但隨著玩家越是用心觀看這世界，越會發現人類消失的真相，以及世界存在的意義。

■亡土研究筆記
來歷不明的攝影筆記本，裡面的照片記錄著亡土的興衰與古老的神話。你可以拍攝沿途發現的線索，將照片放入攝影筆記去推敲神靈的身份、拼湊神話的脈絡，更可以嘗試解讀古老的「神火文」，一步步解鎖關於亡土隱藏的奧秘。

■神靈們的羈絆
遊戲中所相遇的神靈，都可能因為你的選擇而產生不同的好感，而這可能為你帶來不同的後果。用心觀看他們！

title: Heart of the Woods [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Maddie Raines has had enough. After years of serving as manager, editor, and general business-handler for her best friend Tara's popular paranormal vlog channel, she's finally ready to move forward with her own life. But when she agrees to take one last trip with Tara to the mysterious village of Eysenfeld, she's suddenly swept up in a dangerous supernatural crisis that will change the course of both of their lives forever. A strange young woman named Morgan has promised them undeniable proof of real paranormal phenomena, and what she has to offer eclipses anything they’d ever seen before.

However, out of all the strange occurrences the three of them bear witness to, one in particular captivates Maddie in a way she’s never been before: the ghost of a young woman. This woman is Abigail, the victim of a centuries-old injustice now bound eternally to the forest surrounding Eysenfeld. Drawn to Maddie in a way she can’t explain, Abigail reveals herself to another person for the first time in more than 200 years.

While Tara and Morgan investigate the mysteries surrounding the village itself, Maddie begins to form a bond with Abigail that grows to be more intense than any bond she’s felt before. As she learns the truth about Abigail’s death and imprisonment, she realizes that it falls to her and her friends to break the curse that has ruled over Eysenfeld for centuries. But more importantly than that, it falls to her to finally free the woman she loves.

title: It's Spring Again [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
developer: Baba Yaga Games (Asya Yurina, Lyuba Nurmukhambetova)
description:
Igra rasschitana na razvitie assotsiativnogo i logicheskogo myshleniya: rebenok, sleduya podskazkam, pomogaet vremenam goda smenyat drug druga, zapominaet ikh posledovatelnost, sozdaet melodiyu kazhdogo sezona. Pomoshchnikami emu sluzhat roditeli i rasskazchik.

Ideya etoy igry byla ranee realizovana na teatralnoy stsene v spektakle dlya detey.
V nem aktery pri pomoshchi kukol rasskazyvali detyam o smene vremen goda. V otlichie ot spektaklya, igra pozvolyaet rebenku prinyat neposredstvennoe uchastie v deystvii.

Nash rasskazchik - zamechatelnaya aktrisa i muzykant Ekaterina Efremova. Rodilas i zhivet v gorode Murmanske. Ekaterina igraet dlya detey i vzroslykh v teatre kukol, poet pesni pod gitaru i ne tolko, s radostyu sotrudnichaet s muzykantami raznykh zhanrov, lyubit improvizirovat i ne boitsya eksperimentov.

title: Corpse Party Blood Covered Repeated Fear [NSP][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 俄语, lyubitelskiy 来自 redteam
description:
Issleduyte temnye koridory shkoly Heavenly Host Elementary v Corpse Party — kultovoy igre v zhanre «khorror», dorabotannoy dlya sistem novogo pokoleniya.

Poshedshiy naperekosyak ritual druzhby perenosit starsheklassnitsu Ayumi Shinozaki i ee druzey v alternativnuyu realnost nachalnoy shkoly s uzhasnoy istoriey, kogda-to stoyavshey na meste ikh nyneshney shkoly. Mstitelnye dukhi shkolnikov ugrozhayut zhizni i razumu Ayumi i ee druzey, i edinstvennyy shans geroev spastis i sbezhat — eto raskryt zhutkie detali ubiystv tekh neschastnykh, kto okazyvalsya v etoy lovushke do nikh.

OSOBENNOSTI IGRY
Atmosfernaya grafika v stile «retro»
Shikarnaya 16-bitnaya grafika, shokiruyushchie opisaniya i napryazhennoe zvukovoe soprovozhdenie — koshmary v vashem voobrazhenii razvernutsya na polnuyu.

Vazhno kazhdoe reshenie
Issleduyte vse ugolki nachalnoy shkoly Heavenly Host Elementary v igre, sochetayushchey elementy point-and-click priklyucheniya i neboevoy RPG. Kazhdoe vashe reshenie vliyaet na khod istorii i sudbu personazhey.

Eshche bolshe materialov
Pomimo pyati osnovnykh syuzhetnykh i chetyrnadtsati dopolnitelnykh glav, v igre est dve novye glavy, kotorye posvyashcheny otnosheniyam mezhdu lyubimtsami publiki — Ayumi i Yoshiki, a takzhe predstavlyayut Miku Shirayume i Ryoka Iwami, dvukh personazhey, kotorye sygrayut svoyu vazhnuyu rol v strashnoy istorii shkoly Heavenly Host Elementary.

Novoe izmerenie uzhasa
Nadente naushniki i pogruzites v mir polnogo yaponskogo ozvuchivaniya i beskonechno strashnykh stereofonicheskikh zvukovykh effektov. Tut vsyo zvuchit nastolko po-nastoyashchemu, chto vy to i delo budete oborachivatsya cherez plecho.

title: The Fable Manga Build Roguelike [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Igra osnovana na populyarnoy mange «Basnya» (The Fable). Syuzhet rasskazyvaet o priklyucheniyakh talantlivogo killera po imeni Akira i ego naparnitsy. Boss organizatsii, na kotoruyu oni rabotayut, otpravlyaet ikh na god v Osaku v svoego roda otpusk. Oni dolzhny na kakoe-to vremya zabyt o kriminalnom mire i nauchitsya zhit samoy prostoy i obychnoy zhiznyu. Nikogo ne ubivat, nayti normalnuyu rabotu, odnim slovom, slitsya s tolpoy i ne otsvechivat. Odnako eto okazyvaetsya ne tak prosto, ved priyutili geroev v Osake mestnye yakudza, a oni rebyata problemnye. Parochke predstoit postaratsya, ved esli oslushatsya prikaza nachalnika, to ikh ozhidaet zhestokoe nakazanie..
Rouglayt-dekbilder, v kotorom vy sozdaete svoyu stranitsu mangi, ispolzuya risovki iz komiksa, kotorye sluchaynym obrazom razdayutsya kak karty.
Glavnaya osobennost zaklyuchaetsya v tom, chto vy razmeshchaete illyustratsii, sozdavaya sobstvennye stsenarii dlya kazhdoy bitvy. Oni obladayut razlichnymi effektami, takimi kak ataka, peremeshchenie i zashchita!

title: Robot Squad Simulator [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Deal with the hardest missions which can't be performed directly by people due to the conditions.
Human life and safety is in your hands!

Game features:
- 4 different robots: 2 terrestrial, aerial and underwater
- 6 training missions
- 16 story missions which take place all over the world, in different settings
- 10 different accessories mounted on robots
- plenty of gameplay elements like: guards, explosives, mechanisms
- upgrading parameters of robots and accessories
- different types of missions: rescue, spy, exploration, military

title: Ship Sim 2020 (Ship Simulator) [NSZ][ENG]
Zxc [NSZ][ENG]
description:
故事開始於無聊的課堂上，某本筆記本上的某一頁中不經意的塗鴉！
畫在小小頁面上的孤獨主人公決心逃出筆記本。但其他塗鴉擋住了他，想逃走並不容易……
 
請加入主人公所描繪的塗鴉冒險吧！
 
【遊戲玩法】
 
- 小筆記本裡的大挑戰
在滿是塗鴉的頁面上，你的目標只有一個：耐心地避開障礙物和陷阱，拚盡全力往上爬！
 
- 各種障礙物將在地圖各處襲擊你！
越往上爬，障礙物就越多！掉下去，拉過來，推過去，扔過去，撞過去，浮起來！
避開複雜的陷阱，闖過每一關吧。
 
- 落地時要慎重
即使稍作休息也不能掉以輕心！
找到好的避難所，以防意外！
 
- 鉛筆素描風的獨特圖案，手繪般的質感！
請自由地探索圍繞各式主題設計的獨特關卡吧！

title: Another Tomorrow [NSP][ENG]
genre: Puzzle, Adventure, Hidden objects, Point & Click
description: Istoriya lyubvi i utraty Another Tomorrow — eto detektivnaya igra dlya odnogo igroka, v kotoroy vy fotografiruete i reshaete golovolomki.

title: Crymachina + 12 DLC [NSP][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 机器翻译 用于 v131072
description:
V mire, gde lyudi vymerli tysyachi let nazad, sinteticheskim sushchestvam, izvestnym kak Dei ex Machina, bylo porucheno vernut chelovechestvo. Prisoedinyaytes k trem E.V.E., vossozdannaya psikhika umershikh lyudey, privitykh sinteticheskimi telami, poskolku oni ishchut svoego polnotsennogo chelovechestva i issleduyut Eden, chtoby obnaruzhit skrytye sekrety.

Kratkiy, nasyshchennyy deystviyami boevye deystviya v sochetanii s podrobnoy nastroykoy oruzhiya sozdaet vizualno potryasayushchiy opyt RPG. Temnye peyzazhi i porazitelnye nauchno-fantasticheskie vizualnye effekty ozhivlyayut mir CRYMACHINA.

title: Please Fix The Road [NSZ][Multi]
description:
道路又再次損毀了。小徑也是，還有人行道、湖泊(???)
天啊，現在你的工作就是解決所有問題！

每個關卡都會提供一組有限的工具，讓你能將所有汽車、船隻、火車或動物從 A 點運送到 B 點。當然了，這些動物包括小貓、小狗以及…可愛到炸的粉紅駱馬。

你的大規模破壞（和修復）工具將讓你摧毀、旋轉、複製、交換、升高、降低、推動或移動道路的不同路段。還有湖泊和小徑，以及更多！

你的道路維修不必非常出色，只要工作完成即可！所以請…好好修路並開心玩吧！

title: Die With Glory [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
description:
Die With Glory is an adventure game where your goal is to basically die in glorious fashion. You must help Sigurd, a brave old viking warrior, find his way to glory and an afterlife in Valhalla.

Reaching Valhalla is not easy at all. You must guide Sigurd through multiple levels of beautifully illustrated landscapes, epic adventures, complex challenges, big battles, and witty dialogue with characters to find the right foe that can provide that perfect glorious and ultimate defeat.

title: Chippy and Noppo [NSP][ENG]
description:
Uyutnaya pazl-golovolomka, v kotoroy dva brata, Chippi i Noppo rabotayut vmeste, chtoby sozdat igrushku!
Ispolzuyte vse vozmozhnosti mashin na fabrike, podbiraya tsveta i menyaya formu, sdelayte to zhe, chto i na chertezhe.

title: All of You [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
跟著動作笨拙的母雞踏上旅途，走遍各地尋找迷途的小雞。

探索充滿有趣角色、意外驚喜與各種隱藏危機的古怪地點，都是為了找到你的每一隻小雞。

創新遊戲玩法

探索獨一無二的遊戲機制，讓你控制周遭環境！

充滿驚喜的新奇體驗

漫遊具有不同新地點、角色與音樂的獨特關卡。

可愛的設計

尋找所有代表著母雞與小雞懷舊時光的收藏物品。

title: Shiftlings Enhanced edition [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Shiftlings is a colorful puzzle platformer with a twist! You’re controlling two quirky custodians who are tethered together; one large and one small. Play alone or work together with a friend to run, bounce and swap size through 55 challenging levels.

Each level challenges you to utilize various mechanics to avoid traps and reach the objective. Collectible cola bottles add replay value by opening up new levels and challenges to experience. 

Warning: Use your wits to turn the tether into an advantage. Failure to comply may lead to hilarious results.

title: Steins Gate Divergence Assorted (Zero, My Darling's Embrace, Linear Bounded Phenogram) [NSP][ENG (Mod.)]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] lyubitelskiy 移植版 perevoda 来自 Come Children of Zero
description:
Istoriya nachinaetsya 28 iyulya 2010 goda v yaponskom rayone Akikhabara. Ctudent Tokiyskogo elektrotekhnicheskogo universiteta, Rintaro Okabe prikhodit v sushchestvuyushchee v realnoy zhizni zdanie «Radio kaykan» vmeste so svoey podrugoy Mayuri Siinoy posetit konferentsiyu po voprosam puteshestviy vo vremeni, gde nakhodit telo ubitoy Kurisu Makise, odnoy iz uchastnits konferentsii, v luzhe krovi...
V etu iznachalno yaponskuyu kollektsiyu Steins;Gate: Divergencies Assort vkhodyat tri chasti Steins;Gate v odnoy kollektsii: Steins;Gate 0, Steins;Gate: Hiyoku Renri no Darling i Steins;Gate Senkei Kousoku no Phenogram.
Ofitsialno perevedyonnuyu na angliyskom versiyu bez Phenogram sm. zdes.

title: Uncharted Tides: Port Royal [NSZ][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
Mertvetsy ne rasskazyvayut istoriy!
Istoriya o legendarnom korable - Proklyatoy Roze - stoila, vozmozhno, znamenitomu moreplavatelyu Meysonu Ouensu zhizni. Ty mozhesh pomoch ego docheri tolko odnim sposobom - nayti proklyatyy korabl i uznat o sudbe ee ottsa.

title: Trinity Trigger + 18 DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Istoriya etoy rolevoy igry vrashchaetsya vokrug trekh personazhey: Tsiana, Elizy i Ksantis. Kak izbrannyy Voin Khaosa, Tsian (to est, Vy) v popytke izmenit svoyu sudbu budete vershit istoriyu!
U kazhdogo personazha imeetsya svoy familyar («Trigger»), Flam, Viz i Ray sootvetstvenno. Primechatelno, chto Viz budet ozvuchivat Ay Fayruz, golos Dzholin iz JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure, a sredi drugikh izvestnykh akterov ozvuchivaniya — Konomi Kokhara, Ryota Ivasaki i Siori Idzava.
Geympley vklyuchaet v sebya bazovye boi v ARPG v realnom vremeni i pozvolyaet igrokam pereklyuchatsya mezhdu raznymi personazhami, dostup k sisteme-kolesu vybora oruzhiya, gde vy smozhete svobodno pereklyuchatsya mezhdu nim, sposobnostyami i predmetami.

title: Here Comes Niko [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Tadpole Inc. is looking for employees. Are you ready to be their next professional friend?

In Here Comes Niko!, the cozy 3D platformer for tired people, you’ll play as Niko traveling across scenic islands. Make new friends, catch fish, solve puzzles, snag bugs, and more! With Here Comes Niko! you're in for the most laid-back adventure of your life!

title: Unturned [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Vy — vyzhivshiy v ruinakh tsivilizatsii, kishashchikh zombi. Vy sredi nemnogikh, kto eshche ne prevratilsya v zombi. No nadolgo li?
Palite iz vsekh stvolov, chtoby vas zametili i zhivye, i mertvye. Ili deytvuyte ostorozhno, pryachtes i otvlekayte ot sebya vnimanie. Uchites protivostoyat osobym sposobnostyam: ot nevidimosti do ognennogo dykhaniya i udarov molniyami!

title: Broadsword Warlord edition [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
Komanduyte odnoy iz pyati srednevekovykh armiy: angliyskoy, frantsuzskoy, ispanskoy, polskoy ili gabsburgskoy, vedite v boy razlichnye tipy otryadov — ot luchnikov, krylatykh gusar, rytsarey, luchnikov, pikinerov i katapult do spetsialnykh otryadov, upravlyayte istoricheskimi geroyami, takimi kak Genrikhom III, Zhannoy d'Ark, Vladislavom I (Polsha) i Petrom Kastilskim, chi osobye sily smogut povliyat na vsyo pole feodalnykh bitv.
Kak obychno, stroyte zdaniya, sobirayte yunitov i kopite resursy dlya svoikh imperiy, a takzhe issleduyte tekhnologii v etoy uvlekatelnoy poshagovoy strategii!..

title: The Ur-Quan Masters MegaMod HD (移植版 uqm-megamod / Star Control II (2) [NSP][ENG]
description: Star Control II — vtoraya igra serii Star Control, yavlyaetsya izvestneyshim kosmicheskim kvestom s elementami RPG i arkadnymi boyami.

title: Earthfall Alien Horde [NSP][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description: Earthfall™ eto 4-igrok kooperativ shuter, gde vy obedinitsya s druzyami ili igrat v odinochku, chtoby spasti mir ot vtorzheniya inostrantsev. Poisk bolee 20 razlichnykh vidov oruzhiya, ili ispolzovat 3D printery dlya pechati sobstvennykh! Avtomaticheskie bashni, razvertyvaemye barrikady ili ustanovlennye orudiya pozvolyayut nastroit oboronu, chtoby napravit protivnika v zony ubiystv. Bitva svoy put cherez 16 epicheskikh urovney, kotorye rasskazyvayut prodolzhayushchuyusya istoriyu borby chelovechestva, chtoby vyzhit. Kazhdoe prokhozhdenie yavlyaetsya unikalnym opytom, s dinamicheskimi ikru i reaktivnymi vragami dlya maksimalnogo znacheniya vosproizvedeniya.

title: Fur Squadron Phoenix [NSZ][ENG]
description:
V etom umopomrachitelnom puteshestvii v okruzhenii retrovolnovoy estetiki i sintveyv-muzyki vy budete prokladyvat sebe put cherez simulyatory (ili net?) yunitov i prispeshnikov zloy imperii Skal. 

+ Ekshen i povestvovanie, upravlyaemoe priklyucheniem po relsam s klassicheskim stilem shutera 90-kh.

+ Plavnyy i bystryy geympley na urovnyakh, polnykh vragov i massivnykh bossov. Raskroyte ikh sekrety i uluchshite svoy zvezdolet dlya dostizheniya maksimalnoy proizvoditelnosti.

+ Shest urovney. Tri urovnya slozhnosti pilotirovaniya razlichnykh korabley.

+ Originalnyy sintezatornyy saundtrek, sootvetstvuyushchiy retrovolnovoy estetike.

+ Prekrasnyy aksolotl!

title: The Suicide of Rachel Foster [NSP][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
1993
美國蒙大拿州路易斯與克拉克郡

十年前，十幾歲的妮可和母親發現父親李奧納德和一名與自己年紀相仿的少女瑞秋發生不倫戀，對方不僅懷孕最後更因此自殺，妮可和母親因而決定離開這間家族經營的旅館。

現在，妮可的父母雙雙去世，妮可希望能完成母親出售旅館的遺願，藉此彌補瑞秋的家人。她與家庭律師一起回到酒店，檢查建築物老舊的狀況。

由於天氣忽然變得非常糟，妮可無法離開這座山中的大木屋，於是用旅館裡那支最早一批問世的無線電話，向年輕的聯邦緊急事務管理署專員厄文尋求協助。

在厄文的幫助下，妮可開始調查這個遠比山谷中的人們想像得更複雜的謎團。這是關於愛情與死亡的故事，憂思與懷舊融成一段驚悚的幽靈傳說。

title: 1979 Revolution Black Friday [NSZ][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
Osnovannaya na realnykh sobytiyakh igra 1979 Revolution: Black Friday — eto interaktivnaya istoricheskaya drama o vybore i posledstviyakh, khaose i poryadke. Deystvie proiskhodit v 1978 godu v stolitse Irana Tegerane. Vy — fotozhurnalist, popavshiy v samuyu gushchu protesta protiv shakhskoy vlasti, i teper vam predstoit vooruzhitsya kameroy i pogruzitsya v opasnyy mir revolyutsii i narodnogo bunta.
• Vybor: vashi resheniya otrazhayutsya na sudbakh lyudey na fone revolyutsii.
• Povestvovanie: yarkaya grafika s ispolzovaniem tekhnologii motion capture i prekrasnoy ozvuchkoy.
• Issledovanie: vzglyanite na gorod na voennom polozhenii iznutri, okazhites v taynom revolyutsionnom shtabe i sredi protestushchikh, a takzhe proydites po bushuyushchim ulitsam.
• Fotosemka: delayte snimki i sravnivayte ikh s realnymi arkhivnymi kadrami.
• Mnogoobrazie: bolee 80 unikalnykh istoriy, rasskazyvayushchikh ob islamskoy revolyutsii v Irane.
• Osnovano na realnykh sobytiyakh: uznayte podlinnuyu istoriyu bortsov za svobodu, ochevidtsev i zhertv revolyutsii.

title: OTTTD Over The Top Tower Defence [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Vozmi na sebya komandovanie HEROCORP™ i nachni Kampaniyu Po Uprezhdayushchey Oborone™ protiv zakhvatchikov iz parallelnogo izmereniya v OTTTD, samoy bezbashennoy bashennoy zashchite.

OTTTD: Bezbashennaya bashennaya zashchita i ty poymesh pochemu ona tak nazyvaetsya, posle unichtozheniya otryada robotizirovannykh akul, kotorye pytayutsya atakovat tvoy shtab.

Ty igraesh rol komandira HEROCORP ™, 4-y po velichine chastnoy voennoy organizatsii v galaktike.

Tvoya zadacha - preventivno zashchitit Zemlyu ot vtorzheniya iz drugikh izmereniy DO togo, kak vtorzhenie nachnetsya. Pri etom tebe obyazatelno ulozhitsya v  byudzhet i otchitatsya obo vsekh tranzaktsiyakh.

Yavlyaetsya li «Uprezhdayushchaya zashchita Zemli» etichnoy? Nevazhno, glavnoe - otchitatsya pered aktsionerami! 

Kharakteristiki
• RPG Mekhanika.
Vybiray iz 7 unikalnykh klassov geroev, chtoby sostavit otryad iz 3kh personazhey. Chem bolshe oni uchastvuyut v boevakh deystviyakh, tem bolshe opyta oni poluchayut. Opyt povyshaet personalnye sposobnosti i umeniya personazha.
• 30+ aktivnykh sposobnostey
• 40+ passivnykh navykov
• Neskolko variantov broni, sootvetstvuyushchey tvoemu stilyu igry.

• Khochesh tysyachi vidov oruzhiya?
Nu, u nas ikh ne tak mnogo, no ... my postaralis sballansirovat 30+, kotorye u nas est, a takzhe dobavili 12 tipov bashen i 6 razlichnykh tipov povrezhdeniy.

My uvereny, chto u HEROCORP ™ est vse oborudovanie, neobkhodimoe tebe chtoby seyat khaos v tvoem sobstvennom stile.

• Vragov bolshe, chem mozhno soschitat
OTTTD napolnen samymi raznoobraznymi vragami, chtoby utomit samuyu silnuyu ruku boytsa. Plavayushchie glaznye yabloki? V nalichii. Vooruzhennye molyuski? Ikh est u nas. Gigantskie boevye cherepakhi? Konechno. I my uvereny, chto my EDINSTVENNAYa igra s kalmarom, ezdyashchim na mototsikle.

SODERZhIMOE DLYa VZROSLYKh
V igre soderzhatsya oshmetki i krov vashikh vragov

title: Inspector Gadget: Mad Time Party [NSZ][RUS/Multi13]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 13]
voice_lang: 法语, 英语, 德语
description:
大都市已落入邪惡的克勞博士和他的瘋狂黨手中。為了拯救城市，神探蓋傑特必須使用時光機回到過去。不幸的是，時光機發生故障，導致神探蓋傑特的祖先被傳送到現代。

你的任務是：探索大都市，與神探蓋傑特的祖先競爭以收集時光機遺失的零件。你需要完成小遊戲以解鎖修復機器所需的螺栓。與三位神探蓋傑特的祖先對戰，以贏得螺栓。 

造訪著名原創系列中的代表性場景，與昆比長官、彭妮和瘋狂黨等角色相遇，並使用神探蓋傑特的各種道具來對抗瘋狂黨勢力。

 踏上一場驚心動魄的冒險，你將扮演傳奇的神探蓋傑特，從克勞博士的魔爪中拯救大都市！

在單人模式中探索知名的大都市，完成任務和挑戰。 

發掘受到神探蓋傑特宇宙啟發的 16 個有趣小遊戲！

與親朋好友在多人模式中一同享樂。

欣賞 Tanis Chalopin 的精彩原聲帶，她是神探蓋傑特特創作者 Jean Chalopin 的女兒。

title: The Smurfs: Colorful Stories / Learn and Play [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Okunites v chudesnyy mir smurfikov dlya samykh malenkikh igrokov!
Dobro pozhalovat v «Krasochnye istorii», mesto, gde vash tvorcheskiy potentsial i voobrazhenie pozvolyat sozdavat skazki. Posetite ikh derevnyu, kak budto vy odin iz nikh, i ispytayte udivitelnye priklyucheniya — Smurfiki s neterpeniem zhdut vstrechi s vami!
Chtoby sdelat kazhduyu istoriyu individualnoy, igra predlagaet mnozhestvo instrumentov na vybor. Vy sami reshaete, kakoy tsvet, razmer kisti ili tip instrumenta ispolzovat. Poprobuyte smeshat raznye varianty, chtoby dobitsya udivitelnogo effekta.Drugie Smurf-igry na Switch.

title: Broken Universe (Tower Defense) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Ee nigde net, i on edinstvennyy, kto mozhet ee spasti.

Kabum!
Vzryv razrushil vsyu Vselennuyu. Mozhno dazhe skazat, chto ona... slomana. Roko s pomoshchyu raznosherstnoy gruppy uchenykh dolzhen zashchitit svoy korabl ot nadvigayushchikhsya atak. 

Strategiya

Pomogite Roko dostich svoey tseli i unichtozhit vrazheskie volny v etoy unikalnoy igre v zhanre tower defence. Vash mozg - vashe glavnoe oruzhie. Reshayte, gde prizemlitsya i kak vyrvatsya iz ruk vraga. 

Tonny lakomstv

Blokiruyte vse puti ili napravlyayte monstrov po dlinnoy linii ognya. Uznayte, kakie bashni i barery luchshe vsego podkhodyat dlya vashego unikalnogo igrovogo stilya.

Klyuchevye osobennosti:

- Desyatki bashen i barerov na vybor
- Simpatichnaya estetika
- Prostoy geympley
- Interesnyy syuzhetnyy rezhim
- Unikalnye karty i ispytaniya
- Gigantskie monstry, menyayushchie igru

title: A Long Way Down [NSZ][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
Soberite kolodu
Karty, kotorye vy vyberete, budut opredelyat, kak vy issleduete podzemele i kak vy zashchishchaete sebya ot uzhasov, kotorye ono skryvaet.

Probeytes cherez labirint ne proshchayushchiy oshibok
Chem glubzhe v podzemele, tem slozhnee ispytanie. Ispolzuyte svoi karty i khitrost, adaptiruyte stil igry i pobedite vragov.

Soberite otryad
Vy vstretite mnogo drugikh iskateley priklyucheniy v temnote. Kem oni stanut dlya vas: soyuznikami ili vragami?

Proberites cherez labirint
Ispolzuyte svoi karty, chtoby zastraivat pustoty i prolamyvatsya skvoz tupiki na vashem puti po labirintu. Speshit ubratsya poskoree ili issledovat kazhdyy ugol — vybor za vami.

Uluchshayte vashe snaryazhenie
Sobirayte nagrady i stanovites silnee, chtoby zatem otpravitsya v glubinu.

Pobedite zlogo vladyku
Kazhdyy vybor, kotoryy vy sdelaete, povliyaet na finalnuyu bitvu. Smozhete li vy pobedit kovarnogo zlodeya v ego logove?

title: Besiege [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description: Osnovannaya na fizike igra, v kotoroy vy stroite mashiny i unichtozhaete s ikh pomoshchyu zamki, tselye armii i khitroumnye pregrady. V vashem rasporyazhenii ponyatnaya sistema stroitelstva s bolshim kolichestvom nastroek i bolee chem 70 blokami. Sozdavayte katapulty, tanki, vertolety — vsyo, chto mozhete voobrazit!

title: Disgaea 6 Defiance of Destiny + 19 DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
The first new DISGAEA game in six years is here! Meet Zed, a zombie that has risen above them all except one - a God of Destruction!

Can a mere Netherworld zombie rise up and destroy a god? Find out in the newest installment of the DISGAEA series! Features such as Super Reincarnation, 3D visuals (a first for this series), and adjustable gameplay settings make this the perfect game for both new and old DISGAEA fans!

title: The Settlers: New Allies [NSP][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
voice_lang: 英语, 法语, 德语
description:
《工人物語：新同盟》是款戰略遊戲，內含富有深度的經營遊戲體驗與即時戰略戰鬥。

- 搭配絕美畫面與精緻動畫，徹底換上新面貌。
- 在三個陣營之中做出選擇：埃拉里、瑪魯與約恩。每個陣營都有獨特的外觀、玩法與背景故事。
- 體驗以《工人物語》世界為背景的劇情導向戰役，或是在獨特的「硬派」模式與其中的額外挑戰放手一搏。
- 線上遊玩刺激的遭遇戰，對抗其他玩家或 AI 來享受回味無窮的樂趣。

透過《工人物語：新同盟》豪華版盡情享受遊戲體驗，內含遊戲本體、豪華組合包與探險家組合包。

title: Stranger Things 3: The Game [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 移植版 ofits. perevoda 来自 AlchemistLab
description:
«Stranger Things 3: The Game» – ofitsialnoe dopolnenie k tretemu sezonu khitovogo originalnogo seriala. Prozhivayte znakomye sobytiya seriala, a takzhe prokhodite sovershenno novye kvesty, vzaimodeystvuyte s raznymi personazhami i raskryvayte sekrety! Eta priklyuchencheskaya igra sochetaet v sebe kharakternyy retrostil i sovremennuyu igrovuyu dinamiku, dostavlyaya nostalgicheskoe udovolstvie s privkusom novizny i svezhesti.

Kak i v seriale, komandnaya rabota – osnova «Stranger Things 3: The Game». Igroki mogut obedinyatsya v pary, chtoby issledovat mir Khokinsa, reshat golovolomki i srazhatsya so zlom «obratnoy storony» v kachestve odnogo iz dvenadtsati izlyublennykh personazhey seriala.

title: Evil Tonight [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Silviya nikogda ne ubegaet ot zla — ona sdelala eto svoey professiey. Ekstsentrichnaya, no dobrodushnaya, eta opytnaya sovremennaya ekzortsistka v sovershenstve ovladela iskusstvom protivostoyaniya sverkhestestvennomu, prevrashchaya proklyatye mesta v osyazaemye koshmary. No v etu rokovuyu noch vsyo idyot ne po planu.

Okunites v besposhchadnyy ekshen na vyzhivanie, gde za kazhdym povorotom vas zhdyot nechto nepredvidennoe. Issleduyte mrachnye koridory zabroshennoy shkoly stsenicheskikh iskusstv — v kazhdoy komnate priotkryvaetsya novaya stranitsa eyo tyomnogo proshlogo. Ishchite skudnye resursy, reshayte khitroumnye golovolomki i srazhaytes v zakhvatyvayushchikh boyakh protiv chudovishchnykh sozdaniy i nezabyvaemykh bossov.

Evil Tonight sochetaet klassicheskie elementy survival horror s dinamichnym ekshenom, uderzhivaya vas v napryazhenii, no ne zabyvaya i o vesele. Pogruzites v mir tshchatelno prorabotannoy pikselnoy grafiki, yarkikh avtorskikh palitr i tonko nastroennykh svetovykh effektov — vsyo eto soprovozhdaetsya ledenyashchim dushu originalnym saundtrekom, usilivayushchim kazhdoe mgnovenie napryazheniya.

Sumeete li vy brosit vyzov… Evil Tonight?

title: Swoosh Cat [NSZ][RUS/Multi17]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 17]
description:
《閃影萌喵》是一款以超萌貓貓為主角的像素風極限平台冒險！單靠跳躍與衝刺，就能展開一場痛快又燒腦的旅程。

斬敵、彈反、破牆、閃陷阱——衝刺不是趕路，是利刃，也是解謎鑰匙！

闖進蓊鬱叢林與灼熱沙漠，每張地圖都包著糖衣毒藥，滿滿的惡意機關等你拆招！

敵人=跳板！斬殺、彈反、衝刺一條龍——把屍體和子彈當二次墊腳石，飛進看似死路的隱藏角落！

一指上手，深度爆表：初心者秒懂，速通大佬也能玩到心跳破表！

絲滑手感＋紮實關卡＝絕對不容錯過的貓貓冒險！

title: Skater XL [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Arkadnyy simulyator skeytborda, v kotorom deystvie proiskhodit na zapadnom poberezhe SShA.
Igra zaklyuchaetsya v vypolnenii tryukov i obedinenii ikh v effektnye kombinatsiiNesomnenno, eto golovokruzhitelnoe pogruzhenie v mir skeytbordinga, gde vy mozhete opredelit stil, kreativnost i idealnyy tryuk.
Sozdavayte, kombiniruyte i stilizuyte tryuki s neprevzoydennym upravleniem doskoy, kogda vy popadaete v kultovye mesta Kalifornii, gde ulichnye legendy ostavili svoy sled.
Uchites u profi skeytbordinga: Tiago Lemosa, Evana Smita, Toma Asty ili Brendona Vestgeyta na vashem puti k tomu, chtoby stat professionalom skeytbordinga — pogruzites v subkulturu tsifrovogo skeyta!

title: Leo's Fortune HD edition [NSP][RUS/Mult10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Udivitelnaya platformennaya priklyuchencheskaya istoriya, v kotoroy vy vyslezhivaete zagadochnogo i kovarnogo vora, ukravshego vashe zoloto. Prekrasno prorisovannye urovni delayut priklyuchenie dobrogo Leo po-nastoyashchemu realistichnym!
— Puteshestvuyte po krasochnym urovnyam: ot bolotistykh lesov do zasushlivykh pustyn, ot piratskikh gorodov do zasnezhennykh gor.
— Vyzhivayte sredi opasnykh lovushek i reshayte osnovannye na fizike golovolomki na 24 urovnyakh priklyucheniy.
— Idite po zolotomu sledu i otkroyte zagadku ischeznoveniya bogatstva Leo.
— Proydite vsyu igru Leo's Fortune, chtoby razblokirovat rezhim khardkora.
— Priznannoe kritikami proizvedenie videoigrovogo iskusstva vozvrashchaetsya: teper na Nintendo Switch v polnom FullHD!..

title: Lost Sphear [NSZ][ENG]
description:
The adventure of LOST SPHEAR begins in a remote town of Elgarthe where a young boy, Kanata, awakens from a devastating dream to find his hometown disappearing. 
Facing an ominous power that threatens the fabric of reality he must awaken the power of Memory to restore the ‘LOST’.
To stop the world from disappearing forever, Kanata and his comrades set out to rebuild the world mustering different Memory and crafting the world around them.

title: Linn Path of Orchards [NSZ][ENG]
description:
You are in control of Aban, an exotic guardian of nature, on her journey through a lost sky temple. Help Aban on her divine mission to rejuvenate the ancient Tree of Light.
Levels consist of treacherous dynamic platforms that make you rethink every move before you press any button. Completing each level needs both timely reactions and logical thinking.

Features:

- Beautiful environments with a soft and relaxing soundtrack
- 56 rotating levels to complete across 4 chapters each with unique visuals
- 20 night levels to unlock, built for hardcore players
- 3 challenging objectives to complete in each level
- Play with buttons or touch screen

title: The Lightbringer [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Dear brother, 
when this letter reaches your hands, I will no longer be protecting our lands. 
With great sorrow I pass this duty onto you. 
Do not be afraid, as I will guide you through.

You will travel these lands across the shores, across the skies.
I’ll be there for you, with all of my heart, kind words and eyes.

Ancient puzzles will challenge the mind.
Solve them all and see what you’ll find.

On your journey, you’ll face the corruption.
Fight it my brother, there’s no other option.

Lightbringer, your story is about to begin. 
Do you have enough courage and light within?

title: Timelie [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
這是一隻神秘的貓咪，以及一位擁有預知能力的小女孩之間的奇妙旅途；在這趟旅程當中，您必須預見未來發生的事件，藉此安排以過去為起點的逃跑計劃、偷襲敵人，甚至操縱時間。

●預知未來，回到過去
玩家可透過稱為「時間軸」的能力，以操作影片播放器的感覺來操控時間。將時間軸向左拖動，就能讓時間倒流，消除您在過去犯的錯誤。將時間軸向右拖動，則能觀察您的未來，取得有價值的資訊，並將之用於改變過去。

●在單人遊戲中體驗合作
玩家必須同時操作女孩和貓咪，抓準移動或採取各類行動的時機，互補對方的不足、避開敵人的偵測、分散敵人的注意力，藉此達成逃離困住他們的這個世界的最終目標。您將可在單人遊戲中感受到前所未有的合作體驗。

●超越時間限制的世界
請沉浸於這個充滿活力的世界，感受多彩的抽象風格及超現實的視覺效果，並盡情探索這個滿是危險與新發現的奇妙境界。

title: Underland the Climb [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Underland: The Climb 是一款平台益智遊戲，是前作 Underland 的直接續集，玩家幫助 Ivy 在外星人襲擊中倖存下來。 在旅途中，玩家必須使用不同種類的工具才能挖掘地面、避開酸液、敵人並穿越非常陌生的地方。

使用風景元素，例如鎬和許多其他元素，將土壤鑽到指定的位置。 必須正確處理破壞性地形、流體力學和物理定律才能解決難題。

遊戲特色
- 完成 30 個不同的關卡；
- 美麗的像素藝術；
- 比以前的遊戲更精心構建和複雜的謎題；
- 提供良好而有趣的挑戰；


由 MiniCactus Games 開發並由 QUByte Interactive 發行

title: Underland [NSZ][ENG]
description:
出發尋找新的宜居行星的宇航員剛剛從失敗的任務中返回。然而，地球表面不再適合居住，他們發現剩餘的人口現在生活在地下。那裡假設的路徑被掩埋，唯一的選擇是挖掘和挖掘地下城。

在每個階段，玩家必須使用環境中可用的元素，例如使用挖掘機、泵、管道、大砲、無人機和動態平台到達下一個電梯。到達那裡的方法很少，所以玩家必須將路徑的方向與元素的物理結合起來才能成功。因此，每個場景都是一個大難題，必須解決才能到達旅程的終點。

特徵：

- 挑戰涉及物理的謎題
- 簡單的控制
- 獨特的遊戲玩法
- 像素藝術風格
- 多首歌曲的驚人配樂

title: Where's Samantha [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Help George as he searches for his lost love Samantha (wind is a heck of a thing when you’re a little piece of fabric)! Overcome puzzles and obstacles in this hand-drawn textile world and unfold George’s whimsically narrated tale.

Features: 
•	An endearing and delightfully comedic storybook-style tale of two swatches of fabric looking to reunite.
•	A vibrant textile 2D world of hand-drawn artwork full of whimsy.
•	Venture through 45 levels of physics-based puzzles of varying complexity.
•	Narrated by award-winning actor, presenter, and comedian Rufus Hound.

title: Sheltered [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Sheltered na Nintendo Switch™ vklyuchaet v sebya bazovuyu igru i dopolnitelnye materialy: Surrounded i Stasis.

Proizoshel apokalipsis, i teper vam predstoit zashchishchat chlenov svoey semi, zhivushchikh v zabroshennom podzemnom ubezhishche. Imenno ot vas zavisit ikh vyzhivanie i blagopoluchie. Odno nevernoe reshenie — i blizkiy chelovek pokinet vas navsegda.

Postaraytes prevratit kholodnoe i tesnoe ubezhishche v nastoyashchiy dom, srazhayas s klaustrofobiey, radiatsiey i emotsionalnym istoshcheniem. Tseplyaytes za zhizn, zashchishchayte ubezhishche ot atak i otpravlyayte chlenov semi v opasnye pustoshi na poiski neobkhodimykh pripasov. Srazhayas za vyzhivanie, vy ochutites v zabroshennykh gorodakh, stolknetes s brodyachimi gruppirovkami i dikimi zveryami.

Ot vashikh resheniy zavisit to, umret vasha semya ili zhe ostanetsya v zhivykh. Smozhete li vy vyzhit v nedruzhelyubnom novom mire, kogda nadezhdy bolshe net?

title: Wanna Survive [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
Ty eshche zhiv, no s kazhdym dnem ostavatsya takim stanovitsya vse trudnee. Vy brodite po selskoy mestnosti v
otchayannyy, no metodichnyy poisk edy, pripasov i, po slukham, ubezhishcha, gde zhivushchie
mozhet byt zashchishchen ot khodyachikh mertvetsov. Kogda vy srazhaetes s bezzhalostnymi legionami zombi, vy
vstrechatsya i obedinyatsya s drugimi, kto tseplyaetsya za svoyu chelovechnost. Mnogie iz nikh imeyut raznye
oruzhie i sposobnosti, no vsekh vas obedinyaet odno: vy khotite vyzhit.
Wanna Survive - eto slozhnaya strategicheskaya / takticheskaya igra, deystvie kotoroy proiskhodit v prodolzhayushchemsya zombi-apokalipsise.
otlazhennyy poshagovyy boy. Legko chitaemaya ikonografiya i tsvetovoe kodirovanie pozvolyayut
igroki, chtoby bystro otsenit kazhdyy razvivayushchiysya stsenariy bitvy i otsenit status i vozmozhnosti soyuznikov
i vragov s legkostyu. Sleduyte syuzhetnym liniyam neskolkikh personazhey v raznoobraznykh unikalnykh boyakh.
stsenarii i postaraytes sokhranit im zhizn, poka oni ne dostignut svoey tseli: goroda Borealis!

• Optimizirovannyy poshagovyy takticheskiy boy s
sosredotochitsya na razmeshchenii yunitov i sinergii
• Bystroe odnovremennoe dvizhenie protivnika obespechivaet
nastoyashchiy opyt «zombi-mafii»
• Slozhnye etapy s konkretnymi pobednymi tselyami.
i pobezhdayte v usloviyakh, chtoby proverit svoi takticheskie navyki
• Permadeath: personazhi, kotorye umirayut, ushli navsegda!
• Upravlenie resursami: tshchatelno vybirayte, kto poluchit
est i kto goloden!
• Tri urovnya slozhnosti: «Intensivnyy» (po umolchaniyu),
«Povsednevnyy» i «Kholodnyy»
• Prekrasnaya pikselnaya grafika i animatsiya.
• Vklyuchaet originalnuyu muzyku Ridikulona (The Binding
iz serii Isaak, konets blizok)

title: Kona II (2) Brume [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
《Kona II: Brume》（《KONA II: 薄霧》）延續了互動遊戲《Kona》的故事，並以獨特的講故事機制為玩家提供了身臨其境的第一人稱敘事體驗。
探索1970年加拿大北部鄉下礦村的質樸環境，揭開吞噬該地區的怪異霧氣──迷霧──的神秘面紗。

1970年，魁北克北部。詭異的霧氣──迷霧──正破壞著某座鄉下礦村平靜的生活，並打破了自然界的平衡。但霧是從哪裡來的呢？

再次化身卡爾·福伯特偵探，深入走進《Kona》的超現實之謎。

在加拿大北部的雪地中跋涉，發現自己並不完全是孤身一人。尋找其他受困者──包括毀滅性雪崩的受害者和倖存者──並揭開迷霧隱藏的黑暗真相。

title: Jet Kave Adventure [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 俄语, lyubitelskiy 来自 redteam
description:
Jet Kave Adventure brings everything you love about 2.5D platformers. Enjoy the skill-based action, challenging boss fights, clever secrets and thrilling set-pieces in a game where the Stone Age and science fiction collide.

Meet Kave, the jet-powered caveman. A has-been chief banished by his own tribe, he stumbles upon… a jetpack! The device turns him into the only prehistoric man who stands a chance against “the alien invader” – a rather unlikable guy from the sky who’ll readily kick off a disastrous volcanic eruption just so he can repair his spaceship. So begins Kave’s quest to save the whole island and prove his worth to the tribe.

Who needs double jumps when you’ve got a jetpack?! This piece of extraterrestrial tech is a real game changer – both for Kave and the player. Master jet-fueled platforming and fly over pitfalls, smash through walls, knock out enemies, and manipulate objects as you halt the alien threat once and for all.

GAME FEATURES:
●	Save the island and Kave’s honor in a playful “Stone fiction” adventure
●	Jetpack through 36 colorful levels riddled with hazards and rich with secrets
●	Use your trusty club and alien jetpack to smack and whack 30 types of enemies
●	Show what you’re made of in breakneck flight sequences and boss fights
●	Master jet-fueled platforming to find collectibles and upgrade your gear
●	Enjoy a 2.5D adventure platformer tailor-made for Nintendo Switch™!

title: QUBE 2 / Q.U.B.E 10th Anniversary Director's Cut [NSP][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Vystupaya v kachestve okonchatelnogo prazdnovaniya desyatiletiya, razzhigayushchikh mozgovykh deystviy ot pervogo litsa, Q.U.B.E. 10 -ya godovshchina dobavlyaet izyskannye vizualnye effekty, polnostyu pererabotannye i peresmotrennye razdely geympleya i tseluyu novuyu glavu v novyy vzglyad na klassicheskiy golovolomku, polnostyu vosstanovlennyy s nulya.

Novaya glava - Dublirovannyy Sektor 8 - predlagaet dopolnitelno 4-6 chasov igrovogo protsessa, dobaviv svezhiy kontent v godovshchinu, kotoroe takzhe pozvolit igrokam prinyat libo originalnuyu versiyu igry 2012 goda, libo rezhisser 2014 goda s ego golosom v komplekte s ego golosom -Vyrnoe povestvovanie i peresmotrennyy saundtrek - oba s Q.U.B.E. Potryasayushchie novye vizualnye effekty 10 -y godovshchiny.

title: Golf Club Wasteland [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Bogachi sbezhali na Mars, no inogda navedyvayutsya na opustoshennuyu Zemlyu, chtoby poigrat v golf. Kazhdaya lunka – eto otdelnaya mini-istoriya, a takzhe svoego roda golovolomka, kotoruyu neobkhodimo razgadat, chtoby myachik dostig tseli. Igrat predstoit posredi pamyatnikov brutalizmu, razvalivayushchikhsya torgovykh tsentrov i zabroshennykh muzeev, na fone neonovykh vyvesok i glubokomyslennykh graffiti, posvyashchennykh sovremennym mirovym sobytiyam, Kremnievoy doline i chelovechestvu v tselom. 

Apokalipsis v trekh chastyakh
Chtoby ponyat, kak nastupil zakat tsivilizatsii, vam nuzhno budet sopostavit informatsiyu iz trekh raznykh istochnikov: istorii odinokogo golfista, pribyvshego sygrat «odin posledniy raz», translyatsiy marsianskoy radiostantsii «Nostalgiya» i povestvovaniya ot litsa «taynogo nablyudatelya».

Vo vsem vinite tolstosumov
Zvukovym soprovozhdeniem vam posluzhit vdumchivyy saundtrek, a takzhe rasskazy, zvuchashchie na volnakh «Nostalgii»: zdes vykhodtsy s Zemli mogut ne tolko poslushat muzyku 2020-kh godov, no i podelitsya vospominaniyami o planete – esli dozvonyatsya v efir. A v kachestve perebivki vedushchiy ozvuchivaet novosti i obyavleniya, po kotorym mozhno sostavit vpechatlenie ob otnyud ne roskoshnykh usloviyakh zhizni na Marse.

Kazhdomu vporu
Blagodarya trem nepokhozhim rezhimam zdes naydetsya razvlecheniya na lyuboy vkus. Rasslablennym golfistam, zhelayushchim prosto polyubovatsya vidami i vniknut v sut istorii, podoydet «Syuzhetnyy rezhim». Te, kto ne boitsya trudnostey, mogut poprobovat svoi sily v «Rezhime ispytaniy», gde nuzhno ulozhitsya v zadannoe chislo udarov. A nastoyashchim masteram pryamaya doroga v «Zheleznyy rezhim», gde u igroka fakticheski net prava na oshibku. Blagodarya minimalisticheskomu interfeysu i prostomu, intuitivno ponyatnomu upravleniyu igru bystro osvoit kazhdyy. 

Na pamyat
K kazhdomu ekzemplyaru igry prilagaetsya ofitsialnyy tsifrovoy saundtrek Golf Club Nostalgia, a takzhe khudozhestvennyy albom v vide graficheskogo romana, gde podrobnee raskryvaetsya istoriya odinokogo golfista Charli.

title: Highwater [NSP][ENG]
description:
《Highwater》是一款奇幻3D冒險遊戲，採用45度視角回合制解謎戰鬥系統，故事發生在一個被洪水淹沒的後末日世界中。玩家將乘船航行，探索島嶼，尋找新的盟友來對抗敵人，並在這場有著濃重憂鬱氛圍的逃亡中體驗一個關於友誼的幽默故事。

氣候大災變讓洪水淹沒的Hightower地區成為了兩個陸地區之間的安全區。這兩個陸地區中，一個是幾乎遭到全面破壞的戰區，另一個則是居住著超級富豪，周圍被高聳入雲的城牆環繞的 Alphaville。

地球越來越不適宜人類居住，而能夠逃往火星避難的傳言日盛。在這種情況下，尼可斯踏上了一場危險的旅程，首先前往Hightower，然後翻過Alphaville難以逾越的高牆邊界，一路上結交朋友，與叛亂者戰鬥並竊取食物。尼可斯和朋友們能否及時潛入火箭呢？

title: Please be Happy [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Zharkaya, sogrevayushchaya dolgimi zimnimi vecherami uyutnaya yuri-novella, deystvie kotoroy proiskhodit v vymyshlennoy versii Vellingtona, v Novoy Zelandii.
Rodivshis lisoy v lesu Korei, Mikho khranit pamyat o puteshestvennike, kotoryy proyavil k ney dobrotu i rasskazyval o svoem dome. S godami, stav uzhe bolshe chelovekom, chem lisoy, Mikho dolgoe vremya iskala svoego cheloveka. Ona pribyvaet na dirizhable v Vellington, odnu iz zhemchuzhin paryashchego ostrova Polinezii.
Nesmotrya na gody nablyudeniya za lyudmi, ey vse eshche predstoit mnogomu nauchitsya ob ikh kulture i obshchestve. Do sikh por ona zarabatyvala na zhizn vorovstvom, tak kak eyo obostrennye chuvstva pozvolyayut legko manipulirovat lyudmi. Ona chasto videla ne samye luchshie storony lyudey i eto otrazilos na ney.
Tolko posle vstrechi s Dzhulettoy, vladelitsey malenkoy biblioteki, i Aspen, nachinayushchim pisatelem, Mikho nachinaet ponimat, chto takoe dobrota, i chto lyudi, vozmozhno, ne takie uzh i plokhie, kak ey kazalos..Eshchyo vizualnykh novell na Switch (renpy).

title: Taxi Sim 2020 (Taxi Simulator) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Primerte na sebya rol taksista v nashem novom simulyatore taksi. Vypolnyayte voditelskie zadaniya raznykh vidov v kachestve taksi ili voditelya-chastnika i vybirayte lyubimuyu mashinu iz podborki, v kotoroy bolee 30 neveroyatnykh avtomobiley.

Peremeshchaytes po ogromnym gorodam, takim kak Nyu-York, Mayami, Rim ili Los-Andzheles, i menyayte svoy stil vozhdeniya v zavisimosti ot klientov – nekotorye speshat i ne zabotyatsya o tom, edete li vy na krasnyy, a drugie v uzhase ot opasnogo vozhdeniya. My vyvodim simulyatory taksi na novyy uroven s VIP-klientami, neopredelivshimisya klientami i razlichnymi ezhednevnymi i dolgosrochnymi tselyami.

Nachnite svoyu kareru voditelya taksi s prostykh avtomobiley i proydite put naverkh – k vnedorozhnikam, avto klassa lyuks, sportkaram i superkaram. Pokupayte luchshie mashiny, chtoby imet vozmozhnost vozit VIP-klientov i bolshe zarabatyvat na kazhdom zadanii. Kazhdaya mashina, kotoruyu vy pokupaete, mozhet ispolzovatsya kak v rezhime taksi, tak i v rezhime voditelya-chastnika.
Naslazhdaytes potryasayushchey grafikoy i okruzhayushchimi peyzazhami vo vremya vozhdeniya v etoy igre s otkrytym mirom. My dobavili funktsii, kotorykh vy ne naydete ni v odnom drugom simulyatore taksi: peshekhody otkryvayut zonty, kogda idet dozhd, sotni obektov mozhno razrushat, mashiny i lyudi na trotuarakh vyglyadyat kak realnye. Pochuvstvuyte sebya nastoyashchim taksistom s realistichnym upravleniem i zvukovym soprovozhdeniem!

Osobennosti

◾ Neveroyatnaya podborka razlichnykh mashin
◾ Ogromnye goroda dlya izucheniya
◾ Realistichnoe upravlenie (rulevoe upravlenie pri naklone, knopki, libo virtualnyy rul)
◾ Realistichnye osobennosti avtomobilya (vasha mashina budet stanovitsya gryaznoy ili trebovat remonta)
◾ Nastroyki vizualnogo tyuninga
◾ Zrelishchnye okruzhayushchie peyzazhi i pogoda
◾ Realistichnoe gorodskoe dorozhnoe dvizhenie (mashiny, mikroavtobusy, gruzoviki, mototsikly, velosipedy)
◾ Rezhimy Karery, Svobodnoy poezdki

title: Cyber Taxi [NSZ][ENG]
description:
You play as a cab driver who works in a dark-noir Hindenburg city and strives to escape this hellish location.

As a taxi driver you have to complete dozens of various missions for different factions and gain access to further districts of Hindenburg city. During your dangerous roam you will have an opportunity to buy various weapons, shields and gadgets for your taxi. During your journey you will come across hundreds of customers - talk with them in order to get valuable information. Perhaps you may have a chance to survive and escape this unsafe post-apocalyptic urban area.

KEY GAME FEATURES:

- Complete over 300 random missions in 4 different districts!
- Earn money to purchase dozens of weapons and repair your cab!
- Select your favorite cab color and customize your taxi!
- Gigantic playing environment set in a dark-noir futuristic city!
- Speak with various customers to find out more about dystopian future!
- An ironic comics-like graphics style and humorous visuals!
- Combines best elements of FPS, car racing games and demolition derbies!
- Search for hidden collectibles and additional activities around the city!
- Cool, cyber-punk and funky synth-wave music tracks included!
- Fatally eject customers who offend you!
- Dozen of amazing effects like refractive rain drops & dynamic lens flares!
- All above… and a lot more awaits!

Year 2128. The corrupted Gambricorp organization has led mankind to the verge of self-destruction due to new types of drugs which turned residents of European cities into lunatic maniacs. Once a noble town, Hindenburg city transformed into ruined metropolis which has been contaminated by overwhelming level of pollution, high crime rate and illegal drugs. In their madness, residents have equipped their hover vehicles with deadly weapons and explosive charges in order to wreak havoc on the littered streets of Hindenburg. Many people have decided to become criminals and forgot about their conscience...

title: Taxi Driver The Simulation [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Start your day behind the wheel of a yellow taxicab and begin your career as a taxi driver in the US City Hamside. Carry your customers safely and on time to their final destination. Good reliability and consistency will be rewarded. Deliver satisfied customers from pickup to setdown. Tnlock additional vehicles and become the best driver in the City!

Features
- 4 realistic taxis
- Realistic Driving
- A well animated and detailed city
- Dynamic Day and Night cycle
- Realistic simulated traffic

title: Prison Architect: Nintendo Switch Edition + 6 DLC [NSP][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description: 在『Prison Architect』中，你的宏觀設計將會全面影響囚犯們的生活；是要打造成烏托邦式的更生中心、殘酷的超高度安全管理監獄，或是兩者之間的折衷方案？

title: Sky Gamblers 1-4: Storm Raiders 1-2 / Afterburner / Air Supremacy 2 [NSZ][RUS,ENG]
interface_lang: 俄语 (3 igry), 英语 [RUS / ENG]
description:
THIS IS THE ULTIMATE JET FIGHTER COMBAT GAME! With an extensive single player campaign and delightful multiplayer modes, the non-stop action will keep you at the edge of your seat! 

Sky Gamblers: Air Supremacy 2 is a dogfight simulator taking its roots from the original classic hit. Rich combat mechanics and a spot-on balance between simulation and arcade make it accessible to all player types and allows for a personalized experience with varied control schemes and play styles.
The single player campaign takes the player into a dark and grim future where air supremacy is all that prevents the world balance of power from collapsing. The 14 missions take you through different challenges across the world with both air to ground and air to air engagements.
Action takes place across multiple locations from dense urban areas like San Francisco and Rio de Janeiro to lush locations like archipelagos and sandstone pillars. Each map has its own vibe and set of challenges while favoring different flight styles.
Online multiplayer allows players to compete in real-time in a variety of game modes and trully push your skills to the limit.
Features:
    18 different aircraft choices, each with 4 loadout variants
    Extensive story driven campaign spanning across 14 missions
            Online     multiplayer with up to 7v7 battles     
    Three difficulty levels for replay challenge
    Customizable paint jobs and jet badges
    7 custom game modes on 7 different maps with varied objective layout
    Varied arsenal of missiles and rockets     
    Easy to use evasive flight maneuvers

title: The Beast Inside [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
V 1979 godu Adam, kriptoanalitik, rabotayushchiy na TsRU, pereezzhaet iz Bostona v zagorodnyy domik vmeste so svoey zhenoy Emmoy. Kuratory somnevayutsya, chto tam on budet v bezopasnosti, tem ne mene Adam schitaet, chto rasshifrovat voennyy kod emu udastsya lish nakhodyas v tishine na prirode. Ot ego raboty mozhet zaviset iskhod Kholodnoy voyny. K sozhaleniyu, otyskat spokoystvie emu ne udalos...
Na cherdake Adam nashel tainstvennyy dnevnik, napisannyy nekim Nikolasom Khaydom, kotoryy, sudya po vsemu, prozhival v etom dome v 18 veke. Posle obnaruzheniya dnevnika zhizn Adama i Emmy okazalos v bolshoy opasnosti, poskolku koshmary proshlogo pereneslis i v nastoyashchee. Sobytiya nachinayut razvivatsya s pugayushchey skorostyu, stalkivaya mezhdu soboy dalekoe proshloe i ego vechnogo plennika – Nikolasa protiv Adama, kriptoanalitika vremen Kholodnoy voyny. K chemu eto privedet? I komu zhe mozhno doveryat v stol zaputannye vremena?
Pogruzites v istoriyu, polnuyu tayn proshlogo, lichnykh tragediy i bezumiya. Igrayte za dvukh geroev s odnim mrachnym naslediem. Srazhaytes, reshayte golovolomki i ispytayte uzhas v 3D.

title: Hokko Life [NSP][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
搭火車來到 Hokko 小鎮，在新家安頓下來！
這個僻靜的村莊需要您的幫忙，讓它變成一個受歡迎的迷人鄉村小鎮。帶著鐵鎚和油漆，您將能隨心所欲地為所有的新朋友設計、建造和裝飾房屋。

發揮想像力！

在布滿灰塵的老舊工作室全心投入，盡情發揮創意！
加工製作材料並依自己想要的方式組合，為小鎮創作出新穎精美的家具和物品。收集花朵、混合不同的油漆，並用這些材料來設計壁紙、地板甚至是服裝！

想要設計都市工業風的家具系列，還是充滿花朵圖樣的絢麗壁紙組合呢？工作室的一切全都任您使用，您能完全照自己的想法設計一個讓居民讚嘆不已的小鎮。

遊戲特色

加工：前往森林砍伐，取得木材；或到廢棄的礦山開採並挖掘資源。將您收集到的材料帶回鎮上，並將其加工製成可用來實現您設計的材料。

設計：收集好材料帶回工作室，在遊戲中的各個物件上展現個人特色。利用工作桌來打造自己的家具，在簡單但功能強大的編輯器中結合不同的形狀和材料。

上色：穿上工作服，拿起刷子添上繽紛色彩。您可以自行設計壁紙、地板，甚至設計 T 恤給自己和小鎮居民穿著。讓鎮上所有人都穿上您獨特的設計吧！

 建造：尋求鎮上建築工人的協助，開始擴建小鎮。依照您的喜好選擇建築物的位置，並將一切安排妥當，準備迎接新的居民移居小鎮。

裝飾：自由裝飾所有房屋的內外部，選擇喜歡的設計並放置家具，打造會讓新朋友眼睛一亮的房屋。

 種植：將任何一塊土地變成種植蔬菜和其他植物的農地，發揮園藝才能來種出絕佳的農產品並銷售出去。

釣魚：在 Hokko 村莊的各個釣魚點度過一個安靜的早晨，並建立自己的釣魚收藏。每條魚都有各自獨特的習性，所以必須隨機應變，每次釣魚收線都是一次新的挑戰。

捕蟲：Hokko 村莊中有各式各樣的昆蟲四處蹦跳飛舞，您可以想辦法捕捉並建立收藏。多留心周遭環境，灌木叢中可能藏著意想不到的獨特生物！

title: Sonic the Hedgehog 3 Angel Island Revisited (A.I.R.) + mody [NSP][ENG]
description:
Sonic the Hedgehog 3 (yap. ソニック・ザ・ヘッジホッグ３ Sonikku dza Khedzikhoggu Suri:, rusc. «Yozh Sonik 3») — tretya videoigra v zhanre platformer iz serii Sonic the Hedgehog na igrovuyu pristavku Sega Mega Drive, razrabotannaya i vypushchennaya 2 fevralya 1994 goda kompaniey Sega Technical Institute — amerikanskim podrazdeleniem kompanii Sonic Team. Po syuzhetu igry glavnyy geroy yozh Sonik, vmeste so svoim drugom lisyonkom Teylzom, prodolzhayut borbu protiv zlodeya doktora Robotnika na misticheskom, paryashchem v oblakakh ostrove. V Sonic the Hedgehog 3 vpervye poyavlyaetsya personazh ekhidna Naklz, khranitel ostrova, nastroennyy doktorom Robotnikom protivostoyat glavnym geroyam.
Sonic & Knuckles (yap. ソニック＆ナックルズ Sonikku ando Nakkurudzu, russ. «Sonik i Naklz») — videoigra v zhanre platformer, yavlyayushchayasya chetvyortoy v serii igr Sonic the Hedgehog na igrovoy pristavke Sega Mega Drive/Genesis. Igra byla razrabotana komandoy Sonic Team i Sega Technical Institute (STI) — podrazdeleniyami kompanii Sega, vypustivshey eyo osenyu 1994 goda.

title: Alternate Jake Hunter Daedalus The Awakening of Golden Jazz [NSZ][ENG]
description:
That was one month ago today.
Someone has murdered Saburo's grandfather, Kyosuke, while he was living in New York.

Saburo sets off to New York to sort through the belongings and memories his grandfather left behind.
The nostalgia of the cityscape and reunions with old friends is fleeting, however.
He soon discovers that his grandfather's last word was, 'Daedalus.'

What does it mean?
Why was my grandfather killed?

"Remember, Saburo: tend the orchard of your mind."

Kyosuke's words and teachings on the art of thinking are just distant memories.
And yet, young Jinguji Saburo who is alone in the world, takes up the gauntlet for himself and for his late grandfather!

title: Phantom Brave The Hermuda Triangle Remastered / Soul Nomad & the World Eaters / Makai Kingdom Reclaimed and Rebound / ZHP Unlosing Ranger vs. Darkdeath Evilman / La Pucelle Ragnarok Rhapsody A Musical Adventure (Prinny Presents NIS Classics Volume 1-2-3) [NSZ][ENG]
description: For the first time ever, Phantom Brave: The Hermuda Triangle Remastered and Soul Nomad & the World Eaters are coming to Nintendo Switch™! With unique gameplay mechanics, memorable characters, and up-scaled artwork, this is a must-have for Strategy RPG fans and NIS fans alike!

title: Batbarian Testament of the Primordials [NSZ][RUS/Multi4]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 4]
description:
*轟*...那就是你於充滿怪物、陷阱和怪異險惡的深淵中墜落的聲音。但是野蠻人並不孤單，有好友皮皮——會發光的蝙蝠夥伴“照”著你。和皮皮一起合作解開怪異的“謎”宮，打敗其凶惡的居民，發現其真正的目的，並且與古代種之秘密逃離深淵！

為自己的野蠻人和（魔法）蝙蝠皮皮取得新的技能和屬性能力！

圍繞著幽默諷刺故事的動作冒險遊戲。

大數字！400個以上的房間、20小時以上不斷進化的遊戲性、10個以上的頭目、60分鐘以上的音樂和幾乎3萬個野蠻人不會讀的字！

解謎。

角色扮演要素與升級迷你遊戲。

可能是史上最多水果投擲的遊戲。

會幫助戰鬥的同伴。

多個根據選擇和行動而變動的結局。

被投擲的水果不會被浪費，（魔法的）蝙蝠會吃這些水果。

一大堆秘密和隱藏的戰利品。

（魔法的）蝙蝠有5種不同的吱吱叫聲！

重複的笑話比這個描述少。

推薦使用控制器。

title: Cook, Serve, Delicious 1 / 2 / 3 [NSP][ENG]
description:
Otpravlyaytes v put po Amerike v etom grandioznom prodolzhenii populyarnoy igry “Cook, Serve, Delicious!”. Primite uchastie v chempionate po skorostnoy gotovke edy vmeste so svoimi vernymi pomoshchnikami – robotami Whisk i Cleaver.

Deystvie proiskhodit v 2042 godu v radikalno izmenivsheysya Amerike, razorennoy voynoy. Proydite sovershenno novuyu syuzhetnuyu kampaniyu, gotovya sotni blyud, v tom chisle absolyutno novykh. Zdes est mnozhestvo urovney. Polnostyu izmenennaya struktura igrovogo protsessa dlya maksimalnoy dinamichnosti. Takzhe, v lyuboy moment mozhno vklyuchit ili vyklyuchit novyy rezhim Chill Mode, prednaznachennyy dlya snizheniya tempa!

• Prokhodite kampaniyu v odinochnoy igre ili s drugom v lokalnom kooperativnom rezhime (s vozmozhnostyu izmeneniya po khodu).
• Prokachayte svoyu kukhnyu na kolesakh s pomoshchyu desyatkov moduley, vliyayushchikh na igrovoy protsess!
• Rasshirte svoe menyu bolee chem dvumya sotnyami blyud!
• Ukraste svoy peredvizhnoy restoran desyatkami bezdelushek, sobrannykh v raznykh ugolkakh Ameriki!
• Mnozhestvo spetsialnykh vozmozhnostey, kotorye pozvolyat vam igrat s maksimalnym komfortom, v tom chisle nastroyki dvizheniya, miganiya/stroboskopa, zvuka i funktsiya, predusmotrennaya dlya lyudey, stradayushchikh daltonizmom, i mnogoe drugoe.
• Bolee sta chasov igry na bolee 380 urovnyakh!
• Potryasayushchiy originalnyy saundtrek ot znamenitogo Dzhonatana Gira.

title: Lemon Cake [NSP][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
雖然麵包店最初可能會是一副廢棄的、雜草叢生、甚至鬧鬼的樣子，但是別擔心！你可以去修理、裝潢並且裝飾麵包店的每一個房間。從蜂巢裡去收集蜂蜜，養一頭牛來產新鮮的牛奶，領養幾隻雞來為食譜貢獻雞蛋，還可以種植樹木和植物來收穫各種不同的水果。 

將各種配料混合在一起，就可以製作出各式各樣的食譜了，包括烘焙糕點、糖果和冷凍甜品！一定要確保快速地為顧客提供服務，並且保持櫥窗陳列的庫存充足，以免錯過訂單！為不耐煩的顧客提供咖啡讓他們在店裡留得久一些，打造一個可愛的貓咪咖啡館，讓每個人的一天都變得更加美好吧！

title: Leila [NSZ][RUS/Multi13]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 13]
description:
「通常我會在自己的心裡挖個洞，然後不小心墜入其中。但這次我決定不要再不小心地墜入其中，而是要心甘情願地跳進去。於是我就來到這裡，漂流到我人生的海岸上。」

扮演 Leila 並跨越她人生的每個階段，發掘定義她人生旅程的每個轉捩點。透過解開充斥在她敘事碎片中的謎題，玩家將能看到 Leila 每個決策背後的動機。隨著玩家逐漸深入她精神和情緒的景象當中，從這個看似尋常的女性的經驗中，也反映出玩家能自我探索出的面向。

踏上穿越 Leila 每個面向的旅程，這款令人愉悅的劇情性冒險遊戲利用其迷人的敘事和絕美的美術讓故事更加栩栩如生。沉浸在用傳統動畫精心打造過的世界當中，每幅畫面都宛若傑作，而有了令人回味無窮的原聲帶，更是讓遊戲表現更上一層樓。
在 Leila 面對愛情、信任與過往陰影等複雜問題時，加入這段旅程。無數發人省思、具挑戰性且迷人的謎題，讓玩家在體驗這引人入勝的故事同時，還能更進一步地沉浸在劇情當中。

特點：
♥ 4 個章節，
♥ 與劇情相關的謎題與小遊戲，
♥ 手繪過場動畫，
♥ 原聲帶，
♥ 英語配音

title: Retro Revengers [NSZ][ENG]
description:
V nevedomoy glushi u dalnego predela Tyubu stoit Zamok lyudenov, otkuda pyatero druzey, prozvannykh retromstitelyami, popadayut v strannye kraya, kotorye nesut ugrozu ne tolko ikh igram, no i samomu sushchestvovaniyu ikh mira.

Otpravlyaytes v puteshestvie vmeste s Ossanom, Mao, Taycho, Matchanom i Notchi, ispolzuya novye sposobnosti, kotorymi ikh nagradila boginya Retro. Vstrechayte sputnikov iz proshlogo, zashchishchaytes ot vrazheskikh atak i pobezhdayte bossov, kotorye pregrazhdayut vam put k Verkhovnomu vladyke demonov. 

Issleduyte raznoobraznye varianty igrovogo okruzheniya i razlichnye sposobnosti s kazhdym iz sputnikov v 16-bitnoy pikselnoy grafike pod muzyku retro. Ovladevayte razlichnymi sposobnostyami personazhey v raznoobraznom igrovom okruzhenii, srazhayas s besposhchadnymi protivnikami v etom platformere v stile retro.

Po mere prodvizheniya v igre okruzhenie i mekhanika menyayutsya. Pereklyuchaytes mezhdu personazhami, chtoby nayti samyy bystryy sposob prokhozhdeniya kazhdogo urovnya. Bodryashchaya muzyka i povestvovanie, izobiluyushchee otsylkami i paskhalkami, budut derzhat vas v tonuse do samogo kontsa!

title: Max: The Curse of Brotherhood [NSP][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + lyubitelskiy 俄语 翻译 来自 djonmarvel
voice_lang: 英语 + lyubitelskaya 俄语 语音 来自 «A'den Ne'tra & Siviel Fleym» covmestno s R. G. MVO
description:
Max: The Curse of Brotherhood – zrelishchnoe priklyuchenie, polnoe dinamiki, pryzhkov i neobychnykh zagadok. Vooruzhennyy odnim lish Chudo-flomasterom, sposobnym upravlyat stikhiyami i sozdavat volshebnye predmety, Maks vykhodit na bitvu so zlom v prichudlivom vrazhdebnom mire, chtoby spasti svoego mladshego brata Feliksa. 

Osobennosti igry
- Platformer, kakim on dolzhen byt: begayte, prygayte, karabkaytes i lazayte v strannom Chuzhemire.
- Upravlyayte silami stikhiy s pomoshchyu Chudo-flomastera.

title: Big Rumble Boxing Creed Champions [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Gotovy zavoevat titul chempiona po boksu? Pokorite ring v roli odnogo iz dvadtsati legendarnykh boytsov seriy filmov «Krid» i «Rokki» v etoy uvlekatelnoy arkadnoy igre! Posetite raznye ugolki mira, broste vyzov luchshim bokseram so vsego sveta ili ustroyte napryazhennye boi odin na odin s druzyami i rodnymi.
 
 Boks dlya vsekh i kazhdogo
 — Prostoe i udobnoe upravlenie 
 — Prorabotannaya mekhanika boksa
 — Dinamicheskie stili i serii udarov
 — Zrelishchnye i unikalnye dobivayushchie priemy u kazhdogo boksera
 
 Obshirnaya vselennaya franshiz «Krid» i «Rokki»
 — Legendarnye istorii 20 znamenitykh i lyubimykh personazhey
 — Razblokiruemye personazhi i kostyumy 
 — Mini-igry, vypolnennye v dukhe klassicheskikh trenirovok iz filmov seriy «Krid» i «Rokki»
 — 13 novykh i originalnykh bokserskikh ringov
 
 Znakomye personazhi iz franshiz «Krid» i «Rokki»:
 — Adonis Krid
 — Rokki Balboa
 — Apollo Krid
 — Klabber Leng
 — Ivan Drago
 — Viktor Drago
 i mnogie drugie...
 
 Veselye i zakhvatyvayushchie dukh matchi dlya druzey i blizkikh 
 — Vyberite svoego chempiona i ploshchadki 
 — Srazites s drugim igrokom v rezhime lokalnoy igry 
 
Big Rumble Boxing: Creed Champions — vtoroy sovmestnyy proekt studii Survios, kotoraya podarila vam igru Creed: Rise to Glory dlya VR-platform, i MGM Studios. Vpervye oshchutite ves nakal i azart bokserskikh poedinkov iz serii filmov «Krid» na konsoli.

title: Those Games 1-2 (Yeah! You Want «Those Games», Right? So Here You Go! Now, Let's See You Clear Them) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
似曾相識的「那些遊戲」都換火柴人當主角了，你真的能夠順利通關嗎？2 「那些遊戲2」是以逗趣可愛的火柴人為主角，讓大家享受樂趣並盡情遊玩曾勾起大家好奇心的小遊戲合集第2彈！

在「遊玩小遊戲」中通過各種小遊戲的關卡並完成任務吧！
通過各小遊戲內的所有關卡後，就會解鎖該遊戲的「排名大挑戰」！
可以和全國玩家切磋通關時間和分數，競爭每個月的排名！

還可以使用獲得的金幣來進行轉蛋！
獲得各種名牌和稱號後，就來製作專屬於自己的名牌吧！
名牌和稱號的組合竟然多達30,375,000種！
不管是帥氣有型還是令人會心一笑的名牌都隨你發揮喔！

主要內容
・將火柴人放進似曾相識的「那些遊戲2」裡！
・逗趣又可愛的3D造型和動作！
・「遊玩小遊戲」帶你充分享受「那些遊戲」的樂趣
・在「排名大挑戰」中和全國玩家比賽誰擅長「那些遊戲」
・使用金幣進行「轉蛋」獲得名牌和稱號
・使用在轉蛋獲得的名牌和稱號「製作專屬名牌」
・「最新排名」可以查看全國玩家的每月排名
・完成「任務」給予的各種指令即可獲得報酬！

title: Ty the Tasmanian Tiger HD / Tiger 2 Bush Rescue HD / Tiger 4 Bush Rescue Returns [NSZ][ENG]
description:
TY BERETSYa za BUMERANG! TY the Tasmanian Tiger™ 2: Bush Rescue™ — eto prodolzhenie zakhvatyvayushchey videoigry ot Krome Studios. Teper v etom klassicheskom platformere, obnovlennom dlya Nintendo Switch™, eshche bolshe bumerangov, tachek, robotov i VSEGO ostalnogo... sredi beskraynikh prostorov avstraliyskogo priklyucheniya. 

Zapuskay bumerangi, kusaysya, krushi i skolzi skvoz avstraliyskie debri, chtoby razrushit zlye plany kovarnogo Bossa Kazza i pomoch dobrym zhitelyam malenkogo gorodka BURRAMUDZhI. 

Eto grandioznoe prodolzhenie populyarnoy igry TY the Tasmanian Tiger. Krome elementov klassicheskogo platformera, tebe pridetsya tushit pozhary v bushe s vertoleta, mchatsya vdol Yuzhnykh rek na bagazhnike vnedorozhnika i polzovatsya botami, srazhayas s vragami i reshaya golovolomki, pri etom ne zabyvaya sobirat po puti kollektsiyu nuzhnykh veshchey. V novoy HD-versii mozhno menyat prikid TY, a kruche vsego to, chto v ney est dva NOVYKh, nevidannykh ranee bumeranga.

* Issleduy zemli ot poberezhya do pustyni i mertvoy reki v gigantskom otkrytom mire starogo dobrogo trekhmernogo platformera.
* Vooruzhis 20 razlichnymi bumerangami, sredi kotorykh klassicheskiy Chugunok, Plamerang i dva NOVYKh bumeranga!
* Noveyshiy foto-rezhim.
* Bolshoy vybor transporta, v tom chisle vnedorozhnik, kart i mekh.
* 7 urovney gonok na kartakh dlya dvukh igrokov s razdelennym ekranom.
* Uluchshennaya kamera i grafika, prorisovannye teni i otrazheniya, a takzhe vysokoe kachestvo razresheniya.
* Novyy rezhim igry «Khardkor».
* Nastroyka personazhey s NOVYMI skinami dlya TY i kraskoy dlya vnedorozhnika!
* Igray raznymi sposobami s kontrollerami Nintendo Switch Joy-Con™ i raspoznavaniem zhestov.
* Rezhisserskaya versiya zvuka.

ISTORIYa
Davnym-davno byla velikaya bitva. BOSS KAZZ iskal pyat misticheskikh talismanov, chtoby izgnat vsekh teplokrovnykh v STRANU SNOV.

No nashelsya smelchak, kotoryy vystupil protiv KAZZA i pomeshal emu zavladet talismanami. On risknul vsem radi spaseniya svoey semi i druzey.

I v kontse kontsov... emu eto udalos. KAZZA izgnali, i na zemlyu snova vernulsya mir. Vse blagodarya nashemu geroyu — TY the Tasmanian Tiger — i ego druzyam po operatsii SPASENIE V BUShE.

Seychas zlo snova podnimaet golovu — gorodok KURRAVONG podvergsya napadeniyu, i nam opyat nuzhna pomoshch geroya...

title: Super Phantom Cat Remake [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Super Phantom Cat is a "Pawsome" retro platformer, or what we like to call "Catformer," in which you explore quirky environments, clear purrrfect colorful levels, solve the mysteries shrouding the Phantom world and rescue your kidnapped little sister, Ina.

Key Features:

Five chapters with 35 highly imaginative storyline levels

A unique experience each chapter with tons of environments to explore: forest, meadow, lakeside, underwater, desert—you’ll even get to hop onto trains!
A progress bar for each level. If you love exploring environments, you’ll have the time of your life!

Explore in all four directions! The levels may seem short, but there’s actually lots of hidden content for you to dig up.

Collect gold coins and brew powerful potions- Scale mountains, go swimming, climb through tunnels… the world is your oyster!
Enjoy a progress bar for each level. If you love exploring environments, you’ll have the time of your life!

Gain five insane, unpredictable but super fun skills

Toss some seeds in the game world and see what sprouts out of them. Freeze your enemies… and use those poor frozen guys as traps!
Teleportation may be convenient, but you’ll never know when you’ll land in somewhere strange and unfamiliar…

Countless wacky Easter eggs to discover

A cat that walks backward, a rapping bear… 
Try skating on ice and see what craziness ensues!

Enjoy a highly acclaimed original soundtrack
Last but not least:

We’ve also got heaps of skins for you to unlock and collect!
Meet adorable cats of all shapes and sizes, each with their outrageous skills!
A production system where you brew a variety of potions for your use.
You can also produce keys using gold coins you collect from around the Phantom world!

title: Grapple Dog / Grapple Dogs Cosmic Canines [NSZ][ENG,RUS (Mod.)]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 机器翻译 来自 RomVC
description:
Grapple Dog is an exhilarating 2D pixel art platformer. Use your awesome grappling hook to clear tricky challenges as Pablo, the Grapple Dog!

Exhilarating action - Jumping! Swinging! Collecting gems! Dogs! Grapples! Driving a little boat around! And most exciting of all, dog petting!

6 colorful worlds - Sail across the map to explore 6 worlds, featuring 33 levels filled with hidden collectibles to find, secret areas to investigate, spectacular boss battles to overcome, and bonus levels to master

Go, go, Grapple Dog! - A lighthearted adventure with tons of fun characters, you play as Pablo, the Grapple Dog! Sail with your merry band of fearless adventurers on your quest to stop the robotic overlord Nul from destroying the world

Play your way - Hone your grapple skills with optional collectibles and a testing speedrun Time Trial mode, or utilise the many in-built accessibility options to play without restrictions - have fun however you see fit

Bold & funky - A bold, colorful art style from a pixel art veteran makes Grapple Dog pop from start to finish, with a funky fresh soundtrack that's sure to stick in your head

title: Ziggurat 1-2 + DLC [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Zlo taitsya v glubinakh.

Kak chlen samogo moshchnogo magicheskogo ordena, vashe zadanie - zashchishchat chelovechestvo ot sil zla.
