«Tolko nastoyashchiĭ master znaet podlinnuyu anatomiyu uzhasnogo, fiziologicheskogo strakha — tochnye linii proportsii togo roda, kotorye svyazuyutsya s dremlyushchimi instinktami. unasledovannymi strakhami; pravilnoe sopolozhenie tsvetov v kontrastnykh garmoniyakh i sgushchenie teneĭ, sposobnoe razberedit usnuvshee chuvstvo strannogo..» ©
Predstavte sebe bezumnuyu smes iz bodikhorrora i biomekhaniki, obilno pripravlennuyu estetikoy Khansa Rudolfa Gigera. Pod stat vizualu, v Baroque i mrachnaya istoriya. Eyo avtor, yaponets Kadzunari Yonemitsu, pridumal zhestokiy mir post-apokalipsisa, v kotorom vsyo bylo unichtozheno chudovishchnym kataklizmom, a na poverkhnosti Zemli vyzhili tolko strannye, iskazhennye sushchestva, plyus tainstvennaya bashnya, skryvayushchaya ostavshiesya sekrety mirozdaniya..
V etom arkadnom spin-offe vy igraete za Gru, odnogo iz vtorostepennykh vragov, poyavlyayushchikhsya v originalnoy BAROQUE. Ispolzuyte pryzhki i bystrye dvizheniya vo vsekh napravleniyakh v stile Frogger, chtoby prodvigatsya po podzemelyu. Budete li vy delat ostorozhnye shagi, ili srazu smelo prygat vperyod? A blagodarya prostomu upravleniyu, lyuboy smozhet nasladitsya arkadnym ispytaniem — teper i v portative na Nintendo Switch.
Takzhe vy vstretite zdes mnozhestvo znakomykh personazhey, takikh kak Mun i Kato!

title: Path of Mystery a Brush with Death (Mystery no Arukikata) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Desyatiletiya nazad izvestnyy khudozhnik-peyzazhist byl zhestoko ubit vo vremya nochnoy raboty nad kartinoy. V khode rassledovaniya byli obnaruzheny nesootvetstviya, a glavnyy podozrevaemyy pogib pri zagadochnykh obstoyatelstvakh, pokhozhikh na samoubiystvo. Delo zakryli i so vremenem pochti zabyli.
Tridtsat let spustya vash universitetskiy klub, «Klub issledovateley tayn», reshaet vskryt starye rany, vzyavshis za eto neraskrytoe delo v kachestve issledovatelskogo proekta. Neozhidanno poyavlyayutsya novye uliki, a vy ispolzuete svoyu taynuyu sposobnost zaglyadyvat v proshloe, chtoby po-novomu vzglyanut na klyuchevye predmety i sobytiya. Ispolzuyte poluchennye znaniya, chtoby napravlyat besedy s svidetelyami i potentsialnymi podozrevaemymi. Khranite svoi sekrety, raskryvaya seriyu davno zabytykh tayn, kotorye privedut vas k nastoyashchemu ubiytse..
Misticheskaya detektivnaya vizualnaya novella deystvie kotoroy razvorachivaetsya v vymyshlennom gorodke Narumizave, gde 30 let nazad v pomeste Yamabiki byl ubit znamenityy khudozhnik Mizuru Uchida, telo kotorogo bylo naydeno ryadom s prudom v strannom sostoyanii.
V tsentre syuzheta — obychnyy student pervogo kursa Doppo Akazava, kotoryy prisoedinyaetsya k universitetskomu «Klubu issledovaniya tayn», kotorye reshayut rassledovat eto zagadochnoe delo. Kazalos by, uzhe proshlo slishkom mnogo vremeni, i raskryt delo nevozmozhno, odnako Doppo obladaet tem, chego ne bylo u togdashnikh sledovateley — sposobnostyu zaglyadyvat v proshloe…
Videotreyler.
Ot sozdateley World End Syndrome.

title: Asfalia: The Cranky Volcano, Panic at the Mansion [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
V etoy prichudlivoy i shustroy igre v zhanre «kvest» vas zhdyot Asfaliya — volshebnyy mir, kotoromu ugrozhaet vulkan. Vmeste s Charli vy vstretite zamechatelnykh personazhey, reshite mnogo vesyolykh golovolomok i soberyote kuchu priyatnykh glazu nakleek! Igra s zakhvatyvayushchey istoriey dlya vsey semi.
Vy smozhete issledovat interesnye mesta i vstretit tam chudakovatykh personazhey. Ikh komichnye problemy s lyogkostyu reshatsya resheniem neslozhnykh golovolomok! Nuzhno budet vnimatelno issledovat okruzhenie i obshchatsya s obitatelyami Asfalii, chtoby predotvratit izverzhenie vulkana!
Dialogi napolneny yumorom, ironiey i raznoobraznymi otsylkami, chtoby vzroslym tozhe bylo interesno prokhodit cherez eto puteshestvie. V Asfalii naydyotsya mesto dlya vsekh! Asfalia natselena na detey ot 6 let, no vzroslym budet ne menee interesno igrat v neyo iz-za obiliya yumora.

title: Cauldron [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Poshagovaya rolevaya arkada s uporom na mini-igry. Usilivayte svoyu komandu, i pobezhdayte v bitvakh, chtoby otkryt novykh geroev, karty, zadachki, i vsyo ostalnoe! Esli vashe lyubimoe derevo — v pervuyu ochered drevo uluchsheniy navykov, eta igra tochno dlya vas!
Igrayte za Niks, moloduyu vedmochku, popavshuyu v okutannyy tmoy mir. Razyshchite pravdu i soberite soyuznikov, kotorye pomogut vam v vashem puteshestvii!..

title: Redex (Red Ex) [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
description:
《REDEX》是一款像素風格的生存射擊遊戲，在節奏明快的橫向戰鬥中對抗一波又一波的敵人。收集金幣，從自動販賣機購買彈藥、手榴彈、防具等裝備，並用稀有黃金兌換永久的升級與新角色。

解鎖新區域，從屋頂到實驗室，利用空投補給箱部署砲塔或挖礦終端機。使用假人分散敵人注意力，靈活調整戰術以求生存。沒有規則，只為成為最後的倖存者而戰！

• 抵禦敵人浪潮，解鎖越來越艱難的戰鬥。
• 射擊方向不受角色移動影響。
• 以橫向平台風格探索戰鬥區域。
• 永久升級技能，收集新型火器。
• 利用販賣機獲取彈藥箱與手榴彈盒。
• 設置電腦終端機以挖掘更多金幣。

title: Wrack Reclamation [NSP][ENG]
description:
《Wrack》是一款受《DOOM》和《Quake》等經典遊戲啟發而創作的街機風格第一人稱射擊遊戲。一路橫掃敵人，殺敵越多，實力越強。收集致命武器，發掘隱藏力量…拯救你的世界！

在這款2014年《Wrack》的重製版中，你將扮演凱恩，用射擊、砍殺和超能爆破一路殺出一條血路，對抗成群入侵的外星人和機器人，守護你的星球。

主要特色：

- 連殺獎勵：不斷擊殺敵人，累積連殺獎勵！你對敵人造成的傷害越高，敵人的死亡方式就越極端，你的連殺獎勵持續時間就越長。

- 重置：將敵人的屍體炸成碎片，即可重置你的連殺獎勵！使用你目前的武器或近戰攻擊將屍體炸成碎片。

- 快速移動：利用你的快速移動速度和超級跳躍等技能，躲避敵人的攻擊，並發現秘密和寶藏！

- 首領戰：當你累積了驚人的連殺數後，就去挑戰小首領和最終首領…檢驗你的實力吧！

title: Stellar Wanderer DX [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
《宇宙探索家 DX》 是個靈感來自 Freelancer 等遊戲，設置在廣闊的開放宇宙中的復古太空戰鬥模擬遊戲。

在四種不同的職業中進行選擇——戰士、商人、坦克或工程師，每個職業都有自己的特殊能力和獎勵。

與敵對派系作戰、開採和交易資源、定制您的船隻等等。
玩家可以選擇跟隨故事，或者跟著自己的節奏探索宇宙並完成支線任務。

• 驚險刺激的太空戰鬥!
以第三、第一、或駕駛艙視角與敵對派系、殘酷的海盜和神秘的外星人進行激烈的混戰。 利用您的駕駛技能、戰術和武器庫取得勝利。 無論您喜歡精確打擊還是全力火力，戰鬥系統都能為每位有抱負的太空戰士提供激動人心的體驗。

• 無盡的定制和升級
從十幾艘獨特的飛船中進行選擇，並用超過 100 種不同的物品定制每艘飛船，以滿足您的需求。 升級你的武器、護盾或引擎，成為宇宙中最危險的戰士，或者選擇牽引梁、隱藏隔間或客艙等交易設備走上走私路線。

• 交易致富
在宇宙市場交易商品、提取有價值的礦物或走私非法商品來致富。 如果你選擇走私路線，小心警察巡邏！

• 釋放你內心的探索者
在您自己的星船上啓航。在各種華麗的空間場景中航行。每個場景都會帶來不同的興趣點。 在安全穩定的星系之間漫遊、在獨立的邊界星球中進行貿易、或者選擇海盜星系的冒險。 發現隱藏在宇宙最深處角落的緩存。

• 體驗豐富的宇宙故事
讓自己沈浸在《宇宙探索家 DX》引人10小時的遊戲和完整配音。 結識魅力四射的人物，揭開古老的秘密，並參與最史詩般的太空戰鬥。 人類和宇宙的命運掌握在你的手中。

• 華麗的視覺效果
通過華麗的視覺效果和獨特的氛圍設計，探索栩栩如生令人驚嘆的宇宙。 從廣闊的太空到熙熙攘攘的太空港和行星景觀，每一個細節都經過精心打造，營造出真正身臨其境的體驗。

• 在支線任務中獲得獎勵
從開採礦物和護送友好船隻通過危險區域，到贏得太空競賽冠軍，執行各種支線任務來獲取獎勵。

• 全新豪華體驗
《宇宙探索家 DX》對其空間系統、視覺效果和遊戲玩法進行了許多改進，以提供全新的豪華體驗。 空間系統得到了擴展，增加了新的興趣點，船隻、環境和效果得到了更高層次的重新設計，並且對各種遊戲機制、控制和設置進行了改進。

title: Bean Beasts [NSP][ENG]
description:
Milaya ekshn-arkada v stile «zashchity bashen»!..
10 zverushek, kazhdaya s 3 stadiyami evolyutsii, 12 vidov lovushek s 2 putyami uluchsheniya, 21 individualnaya aktiviruemaya sposobnost, vklyuchaya 5 rezhimov prizyva.
40 urovney, sozdannykh polnostyu vruchnuyu v 5 biomakh, 8 epicheskikh srazheniy s bossami plyus eshchyo 8 kart v beskonechnom rezhime!

title: Mystic Explorer [NSZ][ENG]
description:
在《秘境探險者》中，你將不再受限於單一武器！透過獨創的「多武裝系統」，你可以在戰鬥中同時操控多把兵器，從近戰揮砍到導彈齊發，體驗戰力爆表的打擊快感。組建你的獵人小隊，在變幻莫測的秘境中殺出血路，擊潰最終大魔王！
【萬千武裝，自成流派】
遊戲提供極其豐富的兵器選擇：基礎、近戰、範圍、導彈、投射物應有盡有！武器不僅具備「物理」與「魔力」屬性差異，更區分為蠻荒、鮮血、閃電等多種流派。你可以自由搭配多把完全不同類型的武器，開創專屬於你的戰鬥風格！

【神兵進化，特效連動】
每一把武器都擁有無限可能！透過升級獲得強化點，解鎖強大的「武器特效」。這正是構筑（Build）的核心——有些特效能產生跨武器的強大聯動，有些則能根據屬性瘋狂疊加角色數值。
例如：獲得「蠻荒錘」特效，可將最大生命值轉化為驚人的傷害與攻擊範圍！

【專屬技能，極限突破】
當你的武器總等級提升，將觸發強力的特色技能！
武器增強類：全方位提升特定類型武器的殺傷力。
屬性成長類：隨著戰鬥進行，屬性將無止境持續增長。
轉化增益類：將一種屬性轉化為另一種強大加持，實現戰力翻倍！

【奪寶生存，命運抉擇】
在怪潮洶湧的戰場上，散落著稀有的命運寶箱。越珍貴的寶箱需要越長的開啟時間，這將是風險與收益的終極博弈！在險象環生的包圍網中奪取神裝，只有活到最後的獵人，才能帶走專屬於他的傳奇寶物。

【職業與夥伴，共建最強獵團】
解鎖多種風格迥異的職業，體會各具特色的職業技能。在秘境中招募強大的夥伴與你並肩作戰，多元化的隊伍組合將助你戰勝強大的 BOSS，最終擊敗超級大魔王！

title: ChildStory (Child Story) [NSP][RUS/ENG]
description:
遠北的一個小鎮照常生活：準備新星節、裝飾街道、慶祝活動。這個節日與每月重複的週期密不可分。而索尼婭正站在其中的中心。她是自己仍在努力理解的故事的一部分。這個善良、聰明且充滿無數疑問的女孩，在雪地與燈光中尋找答案。

索尼婭幫助朋友、結交新朋友、探索隱藏角落、與靈體戰鬥，並解開謎題。她行動著，希望自己的作為能帶來理解。

遊戲特色：

* 細緻像素藝術的等角冒險，呈現溫馨且充滿生命的世界
* 與靈體和頭目戰鬥，考驗你的反應與智慧
* 適合喜歡探索的玩家的謎題與挑戰
* 擁有各自故事的難忘角色：與他們交談、幫助並建立友誼
* 溫暖人心、令人難忘的感性原聲帶

週期持續。

title: Nubia Phobia (Nubiaphobia) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
探索五個獨特區域，打破女巫對你家園的詛咒，每個區域都隱藏著一把神聖鑰匙，用以開啟村莊寶箱。

特色：
- 儘管圖像明亮，但這遊戲絕對不適合兒童！
- 令人難忘且性格鮮明的角色
- 超高解析度美術作品
- 非傳統幽默感
- 一些邪惡生物

title: Spellcaster University [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Otkryvaem shkolu magii! V etoy igre vy vozmete na sebya rol direktora magicheskogo universiteta v krasochnom mire geroicheskoy fantastiki. Vy smozhete postroit svoyu shkolu, upravlyat svoim byudzhetom, nanimat uchiteley, prevratit ego v akademiyu chernoy magii s luchshimi professorami nekromantii i demonologii ili mesto v garmonii s prirodoy dlya obucheniya druidov i shamanov.
Tut budet:

title: Senmomo a Billowing Bladestorm, a Persica Princess (Sen no Hatou Tsukisome no Kouki / Princess of Momoka Dyeing / 千の刃濤、桃花染の皇姫) [NSZ][ENG (Mod.)/JAP]
publisher: Entergram エンターグラム, iMel, Aria, NekoNyan
interface_lang: 日语 [JAP] + anglofikator Operation Bellflower, 移植版 来自 ena2113
description:
Dni mira i spokoystviya prevratilis v pepel - vot uzhe 2 000 let s nachala vremyon imperskoe korolevstvo, upravlyaemoe edinstvennoy liniey imperatorov, nakhoditsya v rukakh varvarov. Kazhdyy den odno za drugim rushitsya to, chto kogda-to schitalos samo soboy razumeyushchimsya. Lyudey shvyryaet techeniem vremeni, no oni uporno prodolzhayut iskat budushchee.
Edinstvennyy ostavshiysya naslednik trona, Miyakuni Syuri, stremitsya k vlasti. On dolzhen unichtozhit svoikh vragov i vernut sebe stranu. Tokita Munekhito, voin, poteryavshiy svoe proshloe, nakhoditsya v poiskakh mastera. Belyy klinok, kotoromu on obuchilsya, dolzhen byt ispolzovan vo imya vernosti.
Sudba svodit ikh v etot den. Privedet li ikh put k razocharovaniyu ili blagosloveniyu? Otveta ne znaet nikto..Eshchyo vizualnykh novell na Switch (renpy).

title: Anthology of The Killer [NSZ][ENG]
developer: Stiven 'thecatamites' Gilmerfi, Tommy Tone, Alex Degen
description:
Zhutko komediynaya irlandskaya khorror-advenchura! Prisoedinyaytes k glavnoy geroine, BiBi, kotoraya sobiraet material dlya svoikh statey v tainstvennom mire adovo pyushchikh ptits, sekretnykh komnat, kurortov mechty, kukol Bort, akvaparkov, immersivnogo teatra, plyazhnykh futbolok s neobychnymi printami, politseyskikh, seriynykh ubiyts, ofshornykh portov i netraditsionnykh metodov lecheniya. Otsyuda nikto eshchyo ne vybralsya zhivym…
Naslazhdaytes absurdnym yumorom, trevozhnoy atmosferoy i iskromyotnymi dialogami v osobo syurrealistichnom vizualnom stile, napominayushchim kultovye tresh-igry 2000-kh godov na Macromedia Flash MX.Eta ofitsialnaya antologiya vklyuchaet v sebya vse 9 vyshedshikh chastey igry:

title: SpiritTea (Spirit Tea) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Vdokhnovlyonnaya v ravnoy stepeni kultovym simulyatorom zhizni Stardew Valley, a takzhe klassicheskimi yokaynymi anime i mangoy, SpiriTTea rasskazyvaet o pisatele, kotoryy sbezhal v selskuyu mestnost, chtoby nayti vdokhnovenie dlya svoego sleduyushchego romana.
Odnako posle togo, kak glavnyy geroy sluchayno vypil iz starogo misticheskogo chaynika, on nachinaet videt, kak mir dukhov nakladyvaetsya na ego realnost. Vonyan, nadoedlivyy koshachiy dukh i vernyy provodnik, pokazyvaet pisatelyu dukhov, kotorye nuzhdaetsya v spasenii, i peredayot klyuchi ot staroy bani, kuda dukhi khodyat otdykhat.
I simulyator zhizni i upravlencheskaya igra: zhivite izo dnya v den, nakhodya mestnykh NPC i dukhov, kotorym mozhno pomoch. Vam zhdyot mnozhestvo mini-igr ot lovli zhukov do karaoke!
Kazhdyy dukh, kotoromu vy pomozhete, poyavitsya v bane, gde vy smozhete predlozhit emu polotentsa, soli, zakuski i prekrasnuyu goryachuyu vannu. Obnovlenie bani s pomoshchyu novoy mebeli, komnat i vann — klyuch k privlecheniyu samykh interesnykh personazhey, vklyuchaya neulovimykh dukhov-lordov!

title: Reptilian Rising [NSZ][ENG]
developer: Gregarious Games, Robot Circus, Hyper Luminal Games
description:
Kogda tri samykh strashnykh zlodeya chelovechestva delyat mezhdu soboy telo odnogo gigantskogo dinozavra, vam ponadobyatsya luchshie predstaviteli nashego vida, chtoby uravnyat shansy. Prizovite na pomoshch geroev s zari istorii, takikh kak Yuliy Tsezar, srednevekovykh masterov voyny, takikh kak Robin Gud, i velikie umy supernauki, kak Albert Eynshteyn.
Reptiloidy prorvali barery vremeni, prinesya s soboy dino-kiborgov, lazernykh raptorov i uzhasnogo Diktatorazavra. Ostanovit ikh mozhet tolko «komanda mechty», sostoyashchaya iz samykh legendarnykh personazhey istorii. «Reptilian Rising» — poshagovaya strategicheskaya rolevaya igra, vdokhnovlennaya klassicheskimi nastolnymi igrami 80-kh godov. Komanduyte otryadom miniatyur v retro-stile na polyakh srazheniy, prostirayushchikhsya ot zarozhdeniya chelovechestva do dalekogo budushchego. Soberite komandu, uluchshayte sposobnosti i izmenyayte samo vremya, chtoby perelomit khod srazheniya.
Dayte otpor v dinamichnykh, reaktivnykh poshagovykh boyakh. Kazhdaya ataka vyzyvaet otvetnuyu reaktsiyu vraga — mudro planiruyte svoi khody, sozdavayte moshchnye sinergii i ispolzuyte relef mestnosti v svoikh interesakh. Blagodarya sluchaynym nastroykam srazheniy i narastayushchim trudnostyam ni odin prokhod ne budet pokhozh na drugoy. Eto ne obychnoe vtorzhenie yashcherits. Srazites so zlobnymi Manborgami, smertonosnymi Lazernymi Raptorami i trekhglavym Tri-Kennonom. A zatem prigotovtes srazitsya s glavnym vragom: Diktatozavrom. Udachi — ona vam ponadobitsya!
Puteshestvie vo vremeni — eto ne tolko pryzhki v Delorian, telefonnuyu budku ili retro-politseyskuyu budku. V Reptilian Rising vy budete ispolzovat energiyu vremeni dlya sposobnostey, izmenyayushchikh vremya, chtoby zaputat reptiloidov. Sozdavayte klonov svoikh voysk, vyzyvayte podkreplenie ili sozdavayte vremennye vrata, chtoby vashi geroi mchalis po karte v dva raza bystree.
Esli vam udastsya perelomit khod sobytiy, ne vyzvav vremennogo paradoksa, vy smozhete pereigrat missii, chtoby vypolnit dopolnitelnye zadachi, peremeshchatsya mezhdu vremennymi periodami, chtoby raskryt sekrety, i mnogoe drugoe..

title: Dunkadillo [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Vy — bronenosets Dill, a vashego luchshego druga Pikla tolko chto pokhitilo tainstvennoe tentakleshchupaltse! Zhivo prevrashchaytes v basketbolnyy myach, chtoby otskakivat ot sten, pola i potolka, spesha drugu na pomoshch.
Sovershayte dvoynye pryzhki cherez vzryvayushchikhsya pchyol, rasseyannykh dikobrazov i chrezmerno druzhelyubnykh lyagushek. Sobirayte redkie kollektsionnye kartochki, chtoby otkryt novykh krutykh personazhey, prokhodya 50 uvlekatelnykh urovney..
Khvatit li u vas sil spasti svoego super-luchshego druga.. i, vozmozhno, plyus zabrosit paru pyatiochkovykh po puti?..Ot sozdatelya serii «Dadish».

title: Lumo 1-2 [NSZ][ENG,RUS]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Vozrozhdenie zhanra klassicheskogo izometricheskogo platformera v novoy igre Lumo – priklyucheniya v sovremennom zvuchanii, kotorye pridutsya po dushe geymeram vsekh pokoleniy!

Kak svezhiy vzglyad na davno zabytyy zhanr izometricheskogo platformera, Lumo ponravitsya vsem, kto tsenit uvlekatelnoe priklyuchenie s interesnymi zadachkami. Tem, kto lichno byl svidetelem «zolotogo veka» videoigr 80-kh – nachala 90-kh godov ili khorosho znaet igry i kulturu togo vremeni, sam dukh etoy epokhi pomozhet bystro, uroven za urovnem, vosstanovit nuzhnye navyki, napolnyaya dushu nostalgicheskim vostorgom!

Bolee 400 komnat v chetyrekh unikalnykh zonakh, shest skrytykh mini-igr i massa vsevozmozhnykh sekretov, kotorye predstoit razgadat: Lumo – eto nastoyashchee puteshestvie radi novykh otkrytyy. I kolichestvo takikh otkrytyy zavisit isklyuchitelno ot vashey vnimatelnosti...

title: Opus Magnum Complete edition (De Re Metallica) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
「毫無疑問，這是我玩過最棒的解謎遊戲之一。」
—— IGN
「可以說是今年，甚至本十年來最頂尖的解謎遊戲。」
—— PC Gamer

《Opus Magnum: Complete Edition》是由曾經開發《SpaceChem》、《Infinifactory》、《TIS-100》和《SHENZHEN I/O》的 Zachtronics 製作的最新開放式解謎遊戲。包含《Opus Magnum》以及全新擴展內容《De Re Metallica》。

玩家需要掌握嬗變引擎（煉金術工程中最先進的工具）符合自然規則的複雜機制，並利用它來製作關鍵的藥物、珍貴的寶石和致命的武器等等。

安納泰俄斯・巴亞被譽為是他那個時代最有前途的煉金術士，而他剛剛接任成為了范塔森家族的首席煉金術士，那是城裡歷史最悠久、家境最富裕的古老家族。可是家族富麗堂皇的門面背後隱藏著危險，而煉金術並不是萬能的。

設計機器 —— 玩家使用可程式化的機械臂、可自訂的軌道以及更神秘的設備，如范貝羅之輪和泛靈之符，來設計和建造進行煉金過程的機器。

豐富的故事情節 —— 圍繞著城裡的幾大古老家族，陰謀詭計在一幕幕上演。煉金術士們擁有著可以創造科學已知的幾乎一切東西的能力，他們因而非常受歡迎，也非常危險。

紙牌小遊戲 —— 煉金術工程講求的是認真和專注。玩幾局《西格瑪花園》來放鬆一下吧，這是一款基於煉金術的原創紙牌遊戲。每一局遊戲都是可以贏的，但不是每一局您都贏得了……

title: Death End Re Quest Code Z [NSZ][ENG (Mod.)/JAP]
interface_lang: 日语 [JAP] + 移植版 angloperevoda s PS4
description:
由於「二之宮椎菜」與「水梨新」的活躍，
「艾莉絲」逃離了充滿Ｂｕｇ的世界
並取回善意，
誕生出她獨自的世界。
這裡是理想的世界，原本爭鬥的人們都變得和善，
所有的齒輪都順利運作。
然而，也有另一個新的危機，即將逼近這個世界──

title: Arc of Alchemist [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Novaya polirovka — v versii dlya zapadnykh igrokov teper mozhno vybirat iz 7 igrovykh personazhey, kazhdyy s unikalnymi atakami, oruzhiem i sposobnostyami!

Upravlenie chetyrmya sferami — vladenie Lunagear pozvolyaet igrokam kombinirovat dve iz chetyrekh elementarnykh sfer (ogon, voda, veter, zemlya), chtoby reshat golovolomki, manipulirovat okruzheniem i vzryvat lyubogo protivnika.

Bazovye preimushchestva — sozdayte svoyu bazu i pobedite! Sobirayte otryady voysk, pokupayte snaryazhenie i sozdavayte obekty dlya usileniya atak i izucheniya novykh sposobnostey.

Predmety i obmen — ishchite spryatannye povsyudu sokrovishcha. Naydennye predmety pomogut ekipirovat i ukrepit svoyu gruppu. Obmenivayte materialy na eshche bolee moshchnoe oruzhie!

title: Nurse Love: Addiction, Syndrome (Re:Therapy) [NSP][ENG]
description:
Znakomtes, Kaori Savai. Yunaya medsestra nedavno zakonchila uchebu i rabotaet v bolnitse Yurigakhama. V detstve ona chut ne umerla i teper khochet lechit lyudey, snimaya bol kasaniem svoikh «volshebnykh ruk».

Eto novaya igra v mire Nurse Love Addiction — istoriya o vzroslenii i lyubvi.

Na svoem puti Kaori vstretit mnozhestvo raznykh personazhey, i vse oni povliyayut na nee.

No tolko ot vas zavisit, kakoy iz 20+ kontsovok vsyo zakonchitsya.

Igra vklyuchaet vse materialy polnoy versii Nurse Love Syndrome Re:Therapy.

title: New Tales from the Borderlands + DLC [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + optsionalnyy 俄语 机器翻译
description:
你將在飽受戰火蹂躪的卓識星（Promethea）大都會中，控制安努（Anu）、歐克塔維歐（Octavio）與法蘭（Fran），經歷他們畢生最糟糕的一天。幫助這三個討人喜歡的魯蛇，看他們如何竭力改變（甚至拯救）全世界！

是時候了！挺身對抗大企業的剝削與貪婪，以製造混亂為己任。

三個小人物出任務
犧牲奉獻的科學家安努（Anu）、她野心勃勃又機靈狡詐的兄弟歐克塔維歐（Octavio），以及愛胡搞瞎搞又兇殘的法蘭（Fran），他們三人的命運掌握在你手中。你雖身處絕境，但也有機會獲得無以倫比的報酬，只要拿出勇氣與機智，闖過充斥著成群結隊的持槍犯罪小嘍囉、異世界猛獸和美味塔可餅的五個精彩刺激章節。

轟轟烈烈的電影式冒險
邊緣禁地不只是寶庫獵人、狂匪瘋子和武器公司總裁的天下，也是底層小市民的家園，他們備受壓迫卻堅韌不拔，只想好好過日子。這則令人難忘的故事不但有老相識也有新面孔，包括走搞笑路線的刺客機器人以及沒那麼愛殺戮的盜匪，包准能讓新玩家和老朋友都玩得盡興。

結局由你來決定
你做的每個決定都會影響故事結局。無論是安努（Anu）希望宇宙中市集比武器興盛的願景，還是歐克塔維歐（Octavio）名利雙收的夢想，又或者是法蘭（Fran）冷酷的復仇計畫—他們的成敗都掌握在你手裡。

title: Vandals [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Vandals is an infiltration game that will transport you to the most emblematic cities of street art. In this turn-based game, the aim is to sneak around police surveillance and spray walls that grow harder and harder to access.

From Paris to Tokyo, via São Paulo, Berlin and New York, follow in the wake of ultra-famous street artists like Blek Le Rat and Keith Haring.
With Vandals, you can bomb your alias on the walls of New York like Lady Pink, paint childlike characters like Keith Haring, or get inspired by the poems of Miss.Tic and write your own. 

After Type:Rider, Vandals is the new project by Cosmografik. It is a video game published and co-produced by ARTE - the European cultural TV and digital channel - and Ex Nihilo.	

It is easy to learn, and the puzzles promise hours of immersion and pleasure.

The game includes:
- 60 puzzles to solve 
- 5 cities with original graphical worlds
- 40 backgrounders on the evolution of street art since the 1960s

title: Exhausted Man [NSZ][RUS/Multi13]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 13]
description:
遊戲中玩家將扮演一個疲憊至極但又不願睡去的人，熬過對他（她）至關重要的一晚。

- 趴著做任何事。
- 異想天開的生活事件。
- 遊戲場景由你親手搭建。

title: Centum [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description: Ty — zaklyuchyonnyy v kamere. Vy khotite bezhat. No deystvitelno li eto vasha tsel? Centum vyglyadit, kak ocherednoy khorror v zhanre point & click, no pod prostoy poverkhnostyu skryvaetsya nechto sovershenno inoe..

title: Pathway [NSZ][ENG]
description:
1936 god. Vliyanie natsistov rastet, i vse chashche nachinayut khodit slukhi o tainstvennykh raskopkakh, zagadochnykh artefaktakh i zhutkikh okkultnykh ritualakh… Prizovite na pomoshch smekalku, chtoby pobedit vragov, i naydite drevnie sokrovishcha, poka oni ne popali ne v te ruki!

• DINAMIChESKIE PRIKLYuChENIYa. Vas zhdut 5 kampaniy raznoy stepeni slozhnosti, prichem kazhdoe prokhozhdenie budet zapuskat novuyu tsepochku sobytiy...

• NEPROSTOY VYBOR. Pishite svoyu istoriyu sami. Obyskat kolodets? Spasti zhiteley derevni? Vam reshat!

• ZhESTOKIE SKhVATKI. Otryad na otryad v poshagovykh boyakh s ispolzovaniem ukrytiy. Vyzhmite vse iz snaryazheniya i sposobnostey vashikh boytsov i sokrushite vragov!

• SOBERITE SVOYu KOMANDU. Kazhdyy iz 16 personazhey obladaet svoim naborom navykov i osobennostey, kotorye mogut povliyat ne tolko na khod boya, no i na razvitie syuzheta v tselom.

• IShchITE SOKROVIShchA. Obmenivayte dorogie trofei i popolnyayte arsenal vashikh geroev redkimi ekzemplyarami broni i oruzhiya.

• OTDYKhAYTE I SNOVA IDITE V BOY. Eksperimentiruyte s sostavom gruppy. Podberite udachnoe sochetanie personazhey i oderzhite pobedu!

Mozhno igrat na angliyskom, nemetskom, yaponskom, kitayskom i frantsuzskom yazykakh.

title: 警察模擬器2023 (Police Simulator 2023) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
這個全新警察模擬器準備了巨大的城市供你探索，並提供多種任務和數之不盡的車輛、升級和警察。 在開放世界地圖中駕車前往各處，或者下車，控制你的警察，在我們的終極警察模擬器遊戲中享受無窮樂趣。

選擇你最喜歡的車子，並完成任務，或者就只是在巨大的地圖上隨心所欲地漫遊。 有多種車輛可供選擇，從普通汽車和經典警車以至更具異國情調的超級跑車和極級跑車，一應俱全。 你甚至可以駕駛一些大型特警裝甲車！

在我們全新的《2023警察模擬器》遊戲中完成各種任務。 追逐任務是你可以擁有的最刺激駕駛體驗之一：追逐並碰撞疑犯的車子，直至你將他們拘捕歸案。 如果你喜歡輕鬆一點的駕駛，你可以嘗試警察護送任務，或在路障任務中用釘刺帶幫助你的小隊攔截可疑車輛。 如果你喜歡發告票，那就試一試泊車和雷達任務吧。

在一系列的特別挑戰中，你還可以擔任臥底，這些挑戰是我們這個新一代警察模擬器所獨有的。 在逃犯任務中感受飛車追逐的刺激，或者在跟蹤任務中，悄悄地開車尾隨疑犯的車子，並保持距離以免打草驚蛇。 你還可以進行監視任務，拍攝非法活動的照片。

遊戲特色：
－有多款不同類型的車輛可供選擇，令人嘆為觀止。
－各種不同的警察。
－有巨大的城市（比以前大4倍）讓你探索。
－提供8種任務類型，還會有更多任務陸續推出！
－逼真的控制裝置
－逼真的車輛功能和物理特性。
－視覺調整選項和警車升級。
－令人嘆為觀止的新一代圖像，包括天氣效果、雨、霧等。
－超現實的城市交通（汽車、貨車、卡車、電單車、單車）。
－熙來攘往的行人，讓城市充滿活力。

title: Deeeer Simulator Your Average Everyday Deer Game + 2 DLC [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description: Ispolzuyte svoyu elastichnuyu sheyu, svoi ostrye roga i vsyo, chto est v arsenale olenya, chtoby prorvatsya cherez gorod. Veselites i igrayte s drugimi zhivotnymi ili opustoshayte gorod, poka ot nego nichego ne ostanetsya!

title: Helheim Hassle [NSZ][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
V drugom ugolke toy zhe samoy vselennoy, v kotoroy proiskhodilo deystvie nashey predydushchey igry, Manuel Samuel (i v tot zhe samyy vtornik!), vas zhdet zagrobnoe priklyuchenie! Sygrayte za Borna, vikinga-patsifista, kotoryy ni za kakie kovrizhki ne khochet umeret i ochutitsya v Valkhalle... i kotoryy umiraet i popadaet imenno v Valkhallu. No kogda Borna voskreshaet zagadochnaya Pesto, chtoby on pomog ey v odnom deltse, vikingu v golovu prikhodit genialnaya mysl dogovoritsya s ney i vybratsya iz nenavistnoy Valkhally. Igrokam predstoit ispolzovat bessmertnoe telo Borna, k kotoromu pri zhelanii prisoedinyayutsya i ot kotorogo s takoy zhe legkostyu otsoedinyayutsya konechnosti, i s ego pomoshchyu reshat neprostye i interesnye golovolomki, a takzhe issledovat zaputannye urovni, chtoby zapoluchit odnu magicheskuyu shtukovinu... A Pesto za eto poprobuet vybit Bornu mestechko v Khelkheyme... Okh i perepolokh podnimetsya! 

14 urovney
90+ golovolomok
80+ personazhey, s kotorymi mozhno pogovorit
3700 replik, ozvuchennykh 24 professionalnymi akterami

title: Kemono Heroes [NSZ][ENG]
description: When the Moon God turns the inhabitants of the forest to stone, four Animal Ninja Masters must fight their way to Mt. Fuji and break his spell. Use swift moves, an arsenal of tools, and each Master’s unique abilities to save your home!

title: Kamiwaza Way of the Thief [NSP][ENG]
description: Prisoedinyaytes k pochetnomu voru Ebizo na ulitsakh Mikado i proverte svoi navyki vorovstva! Budete li vy idti po puti chesti radi semi? Vybor vash, chtoby sdelat.

title: Jitsu Squad [NSP][ENG]
description:
Eto istoriya legendarnogo zavetnogo kamnya Kusanagi i voinov, ishchushchikh ego. Kamen Kusanagi, khranyashchiy v sebe dushu mogushchestvennogo demona, mozhet darovat bozhestvennye sily tem, kto ego probudit. Zloy koldun Origami prizval i zakolodoval drevnikh voinov, chtoby oni nashli dlya nego etot kamen. Hero, Baby, Jazz i Aros - eto komanda Jitsu Squad!

Upravlyayte vsey komandoy Jitsu Squad v odinochnom rezhime ili igrayte vchetverom v lokalnom kooperativnom rezhime. Rezhim Tag Team pozvolyaet igrat lokalno s odnim partnerom, gde kazhdyy igrok vybiraet sebe dvukh personazhey!

title: Gnosia [NSP][ENG]
description:
The crew of a drifting spaceship, facing off against a mysterious and deadly threat known as the “Gnosia” and having no idea who among them is really the enemy, formulate a desperate plan for survival. The most suspicious among them will be put into “cold sleep” one by one, in an effort to rid the ship of Gnosia.

Gnosia is a Sci-Fi Social Deduction RPG in which you will engage in discussion with a variety of unique characters, with the aim of identifying the Gnosia among the group. Players will have to use what information they can gather during the discussions to ascertain whom they think is Gnosia and then vote to put them into cold sleep. As you progress, your abilities will improve - but so will those of the crew. 
As the numbers of crew members, Gnosia, and various “roles” increase, it will become increasingly difficult to determine who is telling the truth. Work in collaboration with or against other crew members to ensure your survival until the end.

・Repeatedly play through “loops”, triggering special events to unravel mysteries in a uniquely original narrative. Certain events will unlock new commands for you to use during discussions.

・Step into a variety of roles to develop different character builds. Your stats will determine how effectively you can sway the group’s opinion or lie, and will also affect your likelihood of being selected for cold sleep.  

・Engage with an engrossing and eclectic cast of characters and experience randomly triggered events, each one unique to its subject. Character events will reveal information about your crewmates in the form of special “Notes”.

title: The Dark Side of the Moon an Interactive FMV Thriller [NSP][ENG]
description:
The Dark Side of the Moon is a fully interactive FMV / Interactive Movie hybrid, featuring live-action video and point & click elements, along with a total of 5 different outcomes.

When his two children randomly vanish throughout the night, it's up to you to help Dean Hamilton bring them back home. As the mystery deepens decisions will need to be made and it's down to you to make the right ones. Who can you trust? Who's doing this? What's the significance of the impending solar eclipse? And what are those strange glowing lights in the sky?

Explore the quaint little village of Marywine, solve puzzles, make some startling discoveries and help unravel what's really going on in this sci-fi thriller.

A family-made game that doesn't take itself too seriously and made for fans of over-the-top FMV games.

Featuring the acting talents of Anarosa Butler (Contradiction: Spot The Liar!, The Shapeshifting Detective) as computer geek conspiracy theorist "Alyx" and Rupert Booth (Contradiction: Spot The Liar!, The Shapeshifting Detective) as the evil "Gedeon", The Dark Side of the Moon promises to bring you a thrilling adventure out of this world!

The clock is ticking, and that eclipse is nearly upon us...and when it is...it's bye-bye children!

KEEP WATCHING THE SKIES.

title: Lacuna [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
又一支煙翻滾著落入萬丈深淵。朝陽緩緩升起，在星羅棋佈的樓宇間投下耀眼的光芒。
我抬頭仰望，告別即將消逝的浩瀚星穹。群星不曾指引我前行。它們對俗世漠不關心。
決斷之時迫在眉睫。可我仍然不知所措。實話實說吧，時至今日，我仍無法洞悉自己行為的原理。
形勢刻不容緩，邁出的腳步是我情非得已。

既來之，則安之。
你是國防情報中心探員尼爾·康拉德。當你被一則關於謀殺的新聞喚醒，倉促接下這個案子之時，完全想像不到它會如何顛覆你的人生，甚至將整個太陽系攪得翻天覆地。你要刨根問底，搜集證據，抽絲剝繭，直至殘酷的真相昭然若揭……抑或不要強求，隨遇而安。

開弓沒有回頭箭
你的行動會導致劇情捲入不同的分支，隨之迎來不同的結局。別想反悔。如果你不介意代價，當然可以橫衝直撞，直奔終點。可只有深思熟慮，英明果斷，才能確保逃出生天。

三千弱水深，你能經受幾浮沉？
不是每個問題都有正確答案。你願為保護家人而出賣朋友嗎？你會為公共安全令所愛之人受難嗎？你要揭露足以驚天動地的殘酷真相，還是要為維持和平而緘默不語？

你是否渴望一場 點擊式解謎 冒險？
經典恒久遠，可Lacuna並沒有全盤繼承解謎類遊戲的傳統做法：

•	切對話選項 不可重複的對話和抉擇
•	管理和反直覺的謎題 身臨其境，劇情驅動的重重謎團
•	可在選項中為所有可互動元素開啟高亮輪廓
•	劇情始終奔流向前
•	貨真價實的選擇和多種結局

title: Hiveswap Friendsim Vol. 1-18 Complete / Pesterquest 1-14: Andrew Hussie's MS Paint Reader Saga [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Vtoraya chast kollektsii MSPA Reader Saga.

Pesterquest – eto epicheskoe priklyuchenie s epicheskoy tselyu v settinge komiksov Homestuck/Hiveswap ot amerikanskogo khudozhnika Endryu Khassi (Andrew Hussie).

S kanonom vse slozhno, i, skoree vsego, eto vasha vina. No graficheskie priklyucheniya v mire Homestuck na etom otnyud ne zakanchivayutsya! Vpishite svoe imya v istoriyu polyubivshikhsya personazhey! Zakazhite stolik v Oliv-Garden (Olive Garden)!

Vas zhdut tselykh 14 tomov s novymi uvlekatelnymi istoriyami iz mira Homestuck i vstrecha s bolee chem 20 zemnymi i inoplanetnymi personazhami, znakomymi po komiksam. 

Prodolzhayte poiski druzey, nachatye v Hiveswap Friendsim, na stranitsakh MSPA Reader: v kazhdom tome vam pridetsya nalazhivat otnosheniya s novymi personazhami.

Novoe izdanie dlya konsoley vklyuchaet v sebya vse 14 tomov seriala. Priobresti ego mozhno kak otdelno, tak i v nabore Pestersim, kuda voshli Hiveswap Friendsim i Pesterquest. Eto luchshee predlozhenie, esli vas interesuet vsya kollektsiya MSPA Reader Saga.

title: My Memory of Us [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Lyutyy korol zakhvatil gorod, i nigde ne ukrytsya ot ego soldatov-robotov. Blizkikh nasilno razdelyayut drug ot druga, prinuzhdayut pokinut doma i poselitsya v otdelnom rayone. Kak obychno i byvaet vo vremya voyny, tragediya zatragivaet vsekh, v tom chisle samykh malenkikh zhiteley goroda.

Vzglyanite na istoriyu, vdokhnovlennuyu realnymi sobytiyami Vtoroy mirovoy voyny, glazami dvukh detey i pomogite im perezhit strashnye vremena. Za kazhdym uglom taitsya absolyutnoe zlo, i odnoy druzhby nedostatochno, chtoby vyzhit. I vse zhe, esli obedinit usiliya, mozhno khotya by popytatsya.

Vam predstoit issledovat mir igry, skryvatsya ot vragov i razgadyvat golovolomki; rasskazchik ozvuchen legendarnym gollivudskim akterom, i on povedet vas navstrechu opasneyshim priklyucheniyam, kotorye nevolno zastavyat vas bolshe tsenit svoikh lyubimykh.

title: The Shrouded Isle [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
developer: Erica Lahaie, FX Bilodeau, Jongwoo Kim, Tanya Short
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description: Eto simulyator kulta, zanimayushchegosya chelovecheskimi zhertvoprinosheniyami. Vam predstoit vzyat na sebya rol glavnogo svyashchennika kulta, k kotoromu prinadlezhat vse zhiteli nebolshogo gorodka. Oni zhdut, poka prosnyotsya ikh tyomnyy bog i ochistit mir ot greshnikov i skverny. Kazhdyy gorozhanin generiruetsya programmno, u nego est skrytye cherty kharaktera: i dobrodeteli, i grekhi. Vasha zadacha kak dukhovnogo lidera — iskat i ubivat eretikov, ne teryaya doveriya i uvazheniya aristokratii.

title: Post Void [NSP][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 移植版 ofits. perevoda c PK 来自 qnezor
description:
POST VOID 是採取早期第一人稱射擊遊戲風格、令人目眩的混戰，速度高於一切。你要保持頭腦清醒並到達終點。盡你所能地殺戮，然後看它修復。獲得高分或重新嘗試。

這是一款不可思議的快節奏、超現實、令人頭痛的 FPS 遊戲，規則非常簡單——到達關卡的盡頭。唯一的生存之道就是不斷殺戮，以防止你的生命偶頭耗盡。在每個關卡結束時獲得升級，並嘗試在單次遊戲中到達虛空的盡頭。POST VOID 是一款快速、瘋狂、刺激腎上腺素的動作遊戲，需要速度、技巧和決心。

從其大膽獨特的視覺美學和眩目動畫，到令人眼花繚亂的閃電般動作，都是對感官的全面攻擊。

title: ChromaGun [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Ty zdes dlya togo, chtoby protestirovat novuyu voennuyu tekhnologiyu podbora krasok: ChromaGun!

Osnovnoy printsip ochen prostoy, no protsess igry mozhet stat ochen uvlekatelnym. S pomoshchyu ChromaGun zakrashivay steny i samikh Vorker Droidov, chtoby pokinut komnatu.Esli v detstve ty kogda-libo eksperimentiroval s tsvetami, tebe eto ne sostavit truda.

Okrashennye obekty prityagivayutsya. Korichnevye net i ikh v posledstvie nelzya okrasit! Obrashchay vnimanie, kuda ty strelyaesh.

Nekotorye dveri otkryt tyazhelee: Ikh mozhno otkryt tolko cherez zadvizhku, kotoraya nakhoditsya na polu i oni tak dolgo nakhodyatsya otkrytymi, poka na nikh stoit predmet. Esli tvoy mozg uzhe seychas nakhoditsya v predvkushenii, i ty khochesh poskoree isprobovat eto prilozhenie, to ty samyy podkhodyashchiy kandidat dlya otkryvaniya dverey!

title: Strike Suit Zero: Director's Cut [NSZ][ENG]
description:
V 2299 godu bushuet mezhgalakticheskaya voyna. Chtoby spasti Zemlyu ot razrusheniya, vy dolzhny vzyat upravlenie nad Strike Suit — revolyutsionnym kosmicheskim istrebitelem, kotoryy sposoben transformirovat v smertonosnuyu boevuyu kosmicheskuyu bronyu. Okunites v masshtabnye srazheniya flotov, v kotorykh sudba kosmosa napryamuyu zavisit ot vashi boevykh navykov.

Otkryvayte dlya sebya yarkuyu i nasyshchennuyu sobytiyami vselennuyu s uvlekatelnoy syuzhetnoy liniey i 17 unikalnymi zadaniyami. Srazhaytes s khitrymi vrazheskimi pilotami, vzryvayte kolossalnye flagmanskie korabli, nakhodya ikh slabye mesta i razrushaya ikh chast za chastyu. Uluchshayte svoy Strike Suit i izmenyayte svoe vooruzhenie, chtoby prisposobit ego pod svoy boevoy stil. Sadites za shturval shesti korabley, vklyuchaya tri Strike Suit, chtoby okunutsya v neveroyatno realistichnye zvezdnye voyny.

Rezhisserskaya versiya yavlyaetsya naibolee polnoy versiey igry i vklyuchaet v sebya grafiku novogo pokoleniya, pererabotannyy syuzhet i dopolnitelnyy kontent, vklyuchaya kampaniyu "Geroi flota".

Eto pererozhdenie kosmicheskikh srazheniy.

title: Vanity Fair the Pursuit [NSP][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
《名利遊戲》是一款以人生“抉擇”和“娛樂圈生存“為主題的虛構的真人互動敘事類產品。
故事背景發生在架空世界觀下的2004~2024年，你為了能完成電影夢而簽署的對賭協議，將一步步捲入“名利場”的漩渦之中，當你置身於兩難境地之時，究竟該如何“抉擇”？ 面對一個個艱難的“抉擇”時是保全自己還是成全別人？ 你將回到那個黃金年代，成為一名“導演”，親身體驗紙醉金迷的人生。

選擇驅動人生：
遊戲覈心是玩家做出的選擇，每個選擇都會帶來不同的故事發展和結果。 在名利的十字路口，每個選擇都是你的劇本。

多重分支劇情：
遊戲設計有多條故事線，十幾種完全不同的大結局，玩家的選擇會導致不同的劇情分支和結局。

電影視聽享受：
沉浸式代入角色人生，人生如戲，全靠演技！ 每一次抉擇都會影響到你的人生走向，一旦進入了名利場，就會體驗到什麼叫“身不由己”

深度情感共鳴：
遊戲專注於創造情感深刻的故事和角色，提供玩家深入的情感參與和體驗跌宕起伏的人生故事，沉浸式體驗作為“導演”的快樂和有時代性的黃金十年

title: Knowledge or Know Lady [NSP][ENG]
developer: Steam Full Studio 蒸汽满满工作室
description:
Vy — edinstvennyy paren v zhenskom obshchezhitii! «Know, or Know Lady» — eto Full Motion View-simulyator romantiki s zhivymi aktrisami, v kotorom vy, po nelepoy ironii sudby stanovites edinstvennym parnem v zhenskoy obshchazhke: okunites v lyubovnoe gnezdo, polnoe komediynykh priklyucheniy ot pervogo litsa, gde vsyudu tsaryat sladostrastnyy khaos.
Pod neustannym obayaniem gruppy ocharovatelnykh devushek ostanetes li vy verny svoey lyubimoy? Ili, mozhet byt, po privychke gordo voskliknite: «Damy!.. Srochno perestante otvlekat menya ot uchyoby!» — legendu vashey zhizni zdes vam i predstoit napisat.

title: Never Give Up [NSZ][ENG]
description: Never Give Up — eto napichkannyy zhutkimi lovushkami i opasnostyami platformer, starayushchiysya prevratit vas v krovavye oshmetki. Kogda idti vpered stanovitsya kruto, krutye ne sdayutsya! Predstavlyaem vam khardkornyy, zatochennyy pod navyki platformer ot sozdateley serii zhestkikh brauzernykh igr, polyubivshikhsya millionam igrokov po vsemu miru. Posle kazhdogo prokhozhdeniya urovnya dobavlyaetsya novyy element dlya bolshey slozhnosti. Tsirkulyarnye pily? Est. Upravlyaemye rakety? Ugu. Gigantskie roboty-nosorogi? Estestvenno. V Never Give Up naydetsya vse eto i dazhe bolshe, vklyuchaya bolee 150 urovney, bitvy s ogromnymi bossami i golos Arina Khansona.

title: Monaco: What's Yours Is Mine Complete edition [NSP][ENG]
description:
Monaco: Complete Edition more than doubles the content from the original release, including a survival campaign, and a zombie mode, and a new ultra-challenging campaign that brings closure and a twist to the epic heist story.

Play with up to four people online or on the same screen. Compete with others via daily leaderboards. Find out why it has been described by PCGamer as "one of the best co-op games of all time."

title: Jim is Moving Out [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Jim is Moving Out! – igra s realnoy fizikoy, gde nuzhno otsenivat okruzhayushchuyu obstanovku, tshchatelno planirovat kazhdoe dvizhenie i byt gotovym ko vsemu! 

Iz betonnykh dzhungley cherez zemli solntsa i peska k severnym pustosham – JIMO stanet nezabyvaemym puteshestviem, osobenno v kooperativnom rezhime. Esli lyubite reshat golovolomki, slushat klassicheskuyu muzyku i igrat slazhennoy komandoy, vam opredelenno stoit poprobovat etu igru.

Pomogite Dzhimu pereekhat i povidat mir!

Sobirayte Vinil v rezhime «Istoriya» i otkryvayte novye urovni v rezhimakh «Laboratoriya» i «Boy nasmert». Krome togo, est rezhim «Gonka na vremya» dlya semeynykh sostyazaniy. Uvidimsya v JIMO!

title: Etherborn [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
voice_lang: 英语 ili 西班牙语

title: Creature in the Well (pinball) [NSP][ENG]
description:
Creature in the Well — slesher s elementami pinbola i vidom sverkhu pro issledovanie podzemeliy. Vy posledniy robot BOT-C, i vam predstoit otpravitsya v glubiny gory, chtoby vosstanovit pitanie drevnego tekhnicheskogo tsentra. Skryvaytes ot vsevidyashchey Tvari, dobyvayte moshchnoe snaryazhenie i uluchshayte ego, chtoby spasti gorod Mirazh ot smertonosnoy peschanoy buri.

- Vospolzuytes sharami energii.
- Odoleyte Tvar.
- Raskroyte tayny vosmi podzemeliy.
- Soberite bolee 20 unikalnykh predmetov.

title: Cryogear [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Cryogear是一款獨特的Metroidvania靈感Pixel Art平台遊戲，坐落在一個開放的科幻世界中，並受到獎勵探索的推動。控制重新編程的克隆G.3.4.R，因為他發現了世界，學習了新的能力並揭開了Emperor AI的神秘面紗。

Cryogear將多功能平台遊戲核心與探索，射擊和RPG元素相結合，營造出獨特的娛樂體驗。探索一個擁有50多個地區的獨特開放世界。不斷變化的世界充滿了障礙，老闆打架，不同的敵人類型，謎語，隱藏區域，迷你游戲和戰利品，以獲得獨特的回報探索體驗。

Cryogear具有全面的RPG庫存，結合設備，技能和製作系統。在行動期間可以在活動能力和武器之間自由切換，從而為每種情況提供動態的，基於技能的策略。在遊戲過程中，您將了解不同的新能力，武器和裝備，以定制您的克隆以匹配您的遊戲風格。

你的克隆G.3.4.R.準備啟動了！

進入Cryogear世界的獨特旅程等待著您......

title: Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma + 15 DLC [NSP][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 机器翻译 来自 yuracher 用于 v393216
description:
Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma — ne prosto prodolzhenie izvestnoy serii, a eshchyo i sverkh-smelyy eksperiment!.. Novaya igra ot potryasayushchie Marvelous, izvestnogo razrabotchika serii predlagaet vam nechto gorazdo bolee ambitsioznoe, chem prezhnie chasti igry.
Vmesto privychnogo simulyatora fermerskoy zhizni s elementami rolevogo priklyucheniya, v novom proekte v fokuse okazalis elementy boevika i romanticheskogo priklyucheniya!.. Spin-off, izvestnyy ranee kak Project Dragon, predstavlyaet soboy nechto napominayushchee miks Genshin Impact i klassicheskoy RF. Tut budut damy ili kavalery, s kotorymi vy smozhete stroit tesnye romanticheskie otnosheniya.
Syuzhet razvorachivaetsya v novom, yarkom mire, gde igroki ne tolko vyrashchivayut rasteniya i vystraivayut otnosheniya, no i aktivno uchastvuyut v srazheniyakh. Eto radikalno novyy podkhod dlya serii s bolee dinamichnoy igrovoy mekhanikoy!Eshchyo drugie Rune Factory tut.

title: Dragon's Lair: Trilogy [NSP][ENG]
description:
V «Logovo Drakona» vy igraete geroicheskogo Dirka Dardzhinga, doblestnogo rytsarya v poiskakh spaseniya spravedlivoy printsessy iz lap zlogo drakona!

«Space Ace» zastavit vas vzyat pod kontrol Ace - Zashchitnika spravedlivosti, pravdy i planety Zemlya! Tuz atakuet zloy komandir Borf. Borba s Deksterom, chtoby vosstanovit ego muzhestvennost. Unichtozhte Infanto-Ray. Porazhenie zlogo borfa! Bud doblestnym kosmicheskim voinom, sudba Zemli v tvoikh rukakh!

«Logovo Logova II II: Vremya Varpa» snova u vas est vedushchiy Dirk v opasnom kvete! Uvolennaya vovremya morshchin zlym volshebnikom Mordrokom, printsessa Dafna budet vynuzhdena vyyti zamuzh za zlobnogo Mordroka, esli Dirk ne smozhet ee spasti. Kak tolko shkatulka obrechena otkrylas, Mordrok pomestit koltso smerti na paltse Dafni v brake, i ona budet poteryana navsegda v Vremennoy voyne.

Vozmite vse tri iz etikh retro-arkadnykh klassikov segodnya!

title: Immerse Land [NSP][ENG]
developer: Tencent Video, Interactive Video Infinity (Beijing) Culture Communication Ltd.
description:
你將會跟隨著艾瑪，你將展開一系列驚險冒險和尋找的任務。在遊戲中，你會面臨多個緊張抉擇時刻，每一個選擇都影響劇情遊戲走向，最終引出不同的遊戲結局。突然出現的男子身份不明，同時受到神秘黑衣人不斷的追擊，女兒下落不明……種種謎團等待你解開。
緊張時刻由你操控
走向哪一種結局？這一次，由你决定。

title: Agarta [NSP][ENG]
description:
Vy kogda-nibud prosypalis odnazhdy utrom, stoya v ocheredi v banke, nablyudaya, kak politiki lgut, glyadya vam v glaza, ili chuvstvuya, chto u vas net sil krichat o nespravedlivosti, cherez kotoruyu vy proshli? Dazhe esli etogo ne proizoshlo, odnazhdy eto obyazatelno proizoydet.
Agarta — interaktivnaya videoistoriya, proiskhodyashchaya v sovremennom mire, osnovannaya na takom krike, sformirovannom na osnove vashikh moralnykh suzhdeniy i resheniy, kotorye delayut nas lyudmi. Agarta — eto istoriya o seriynom ubiytse. Vy budete nablyudat za planami cheloveka, kotoryy stavit pod somnenie temy spravedlivosti i zakona na zemle, chtoby dobitsya rezultata. Vse resheniya, kotorye vy primete s killerom po prozvishchu 'Khirurg', privedut vas k odnomu iz 22 finalov!..
V rolyakh: Berna Adigyuzel, Serkan Akay, Ipek Arkan, Yasar Aydynoglu, Chaglar Bulut, Ali Kan Dogan, Khalil Kan Dyuran, Mustafa Gorgun, Mekhmet Kuchuk, Burak Sarimola, Ozge Sarimola, Andach Semerchi, Idil Tekelioglu, Kyvanch Tekin, Merve Terzi, Alper Turedi, Neslikhan Ulusoy, Onur Yavuz, Mukhait Yylmaz i dr.Eshchyo FMV-igry.

title: Black and White Bushido [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Srazhaytes za vlast nad svetom ili tmoy na mnogochislennykh arenakh, pryachtes ot vragov i zakhvatyvayte tseli. Podbirayte predmety i ispolzuyte ikh, chtoby zastat vrasplokh, pokalechit i zamanit v lovushku vraga, kak podobaet istinnomu voinu. 

Unikalnaya boevaya sistema pozvolyaet vam pereletat po vozdukhu i stalkivatsya s vragami.

- Lokalnaya mnogopolzovatelskaya igra s 1–4 igrokami.
- Sem zakhvatyvayushchikh, dinamichno izmenyayushchikhsya aren.
- Dva uvlekatelnykh boevykh rezhima: komandnaya skhvatka i zakhvat flaga.
- Stavte rekordy i proveryayte sebya v boyu protiv II v rezhime ispytaniya.
- Otkryvayte dostizheniya i urovni.

title: Operate Now Hospital [NSZ][ENG]
description:
進行手術

體驗各種現實手術，如移除異物和修復骨折。了解如何做出關鍵決策！作為外科醫生，你需要一雙穩定的手才能完美地處理切口，小心翼翼地為患者做手術。是時候披上外科手術服了！但體驗還遠不止這些。

建立自己的醫院

本遊戲將考驗你的專業知識和敏捷思維。建立和管理自己的醫院，設立急診室、重症監護室等。擴大和升級醫院，僱用和培訓新的外科醫生，管理資源。得有一位真正幹練的醫院院長，方能管理如此龐大複雜的醫療保健機構！

體驗醫務劇

如同真實的醫療電視節目一樣，你會經歷戲劇性的故事情節。《Operate Now: Hospital》講述了艾米·克拉克等外科醫生和醫院工作人員的生活。隨著故事情節的推進，這場獨特的醫療探索之旅將揭開醫院、患者和醫生之間的神秘面紗。

遊戲特色

• 賞玩最逼真的手術模擬遊戲
• 做出可能影響生命的關鍵決定
• 建立自己的醫院
• 僱用並培訓新的醫務人員，以拯救生命
• 解鎖並開展所有新醫學研究部門的研究
• 沉浸在扣人心絃的故事情節中

title: Big Pharma [NSZ][ENG]
description:
A chto, esli by u tebya byla vozmozhnost ustranit vse bolezni, uluchshit zhizn millionov lyudey, umenshit stradaniya i istselit bolnykh, a pri sluchae khorosho zarabotat? V kachestve predsedatelya svoey farmatsevticheskoy korporatsii ty mozhesh eto! Ispolzuesh li svoyu silu dlya obshchego blaga? Altruizm — redko khoroshiy biznes-plan. Neudobnaya pravda (est li na eto lekarstvo?) takova, chto na nekotorykh preparatakh mozhno zarabotat bolshe, a bolezni khoroshi dlya biznesa. Dobro pozhalovat v mir Big Pharma!

- 35 biznes-zadach, razdelennykh na sem unikalnykh stsenariev
- Personaliziruemyy rezhim igry
- Rezhim «Svobodnaya komponovka» 
- Mnozhestvo ingredientov i pravil dlya otkrytiya
- Prodvinutye mashiny, pomogayushchie v izgotovlenii lekarstv novogo pokoleniya, kotorye menyayut mir
- Mnogo razlichnykh biznes-rezhimov dlya tvoey farmatsevticheskoy korporatsii

title: A Robot Named Fight [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Millennia of peace have passed since the mechanical gods ascended and left the lower order robots to cultivate the world. Unfortunately for those left behind, something forgotten and terrible stirs amidst the stars: the Megabeast, a pulsating moon-sized orb of flesh, eyes, mouths and reproductive organs – unleashing its children onto the world like an unstoppable plague.

A Robot Named Fight is a 2D action adventure roguelite focused on exploration and item collection. Take on the role of a lone robot tasked with stopping the entity known as Megabeast. Explore procedurally-generated labyrinths, uncover randomized power-ups and artifacts, find secrets, and blast meaty creatures in this deliciously gory adventure.

Key Features:
Explore a procedurally-generated labyrinth with more than 4 billion unique runs.
Prove your worth with true permadeath.
Take on over 60 menacing enemies solo or with a friend via local co-op.
Adapt to a different item set every run with more than 100 unique items.
Complete in-game achievements to unlock new content.
Enjoy an unreasonable amount of meat!

title: Virus The Outbreak [NSZ][RUS/Multi4]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 4]
description:
Vam predstoit vozglavit Vsemirnuyu organizatsiyu zdravookhraneniya (VOZ), chtoby ostanovit rasprostranenie virusa i spasti chelovechestvo.

Pomimo obucheniya metodam krizisnogo upravleniya, eta igra daet informatsiyu o tom, kak vesti sebya v sluchae epidemii, kakie mery prinyat i kak effektivnee vsego obezopasit sebya i svoikh blizkikh. Svedeniya, soderzhashchiesya v ney, osnovany na ofitsialnykh rekomendatsiyakh VOZ i dannykh, predostavlennykh ekspertami i konsultantami.

Vy smozhete na sobstvennom opyte uznat, naskolko trudno kontrolirovat situatsiyu v usloviyakh krizisa, kak razlichnye resheniya vliyayut na effektivnost borby s virusom, chto byvaet, esli slushat sharlatanov, i k chemu privodit nekhvatka meditsinskogo oborudovaniya.

title: Makoto Wakaido's Case Files Trilogy Deluxe [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Makoto Wakaido's Case Files is a mystery adventure game with minimalistic pixel art. Your job is to become detective Wakaido and find the culprit behind all kinds of crimes. Question witnesses, collect info, make deductions, and find the truth behind each case.

[Episode1 - The Executioner Linchpin]
What truth hides behind a gruesome series of murders where the victim was beheaded?
Detective Wakaido has to find the culprit in this story inspired by Japan in the '80s and the insurgence of religious cults.

[Episode2 - The Bogeyman's Woods]
Who or what is behind the missing people in this small, secluded village?
Detective Wakaido has to find the real reason why several villagers have been spirited away in this story with a rural setting.

[Episode3 - The Phantom's Foot]
That's one suspect you never expected to investigate.
Detective Wakaido has been accused of a murder. Will he be able to escape capture and prove his innocence?

[Episode4 - The Weeping Hand Manor]
A mansion shut off from the world by a storm. A supernatural presence haunting its halls and terrifying its guests.
Detective Wakaido must find the truth about the ghost who is said to attack those who visit the Weeping Hand Manor.

title: Port Royale 4 + DLC Buccaneers, Bonus Pack [NSP][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Stavte parusa i prisoedinyaytes k odnoy iz kolonialnykh derzhav XVII veka: Ispanii, Anglii, Niderlandam ili Frantsii, chtoby srazhatsya za gospodstvo nad Karibskim morem. 

V igre Port Royale 4 vam predstoit stat yunym i ambitsioznym pravitelem kolonii, kotoryy mechtaet vyyasnit, kak zhe prevratit nebolshoe poselenie v ozhivlennyy torgovyy gorod. 

OSOBENNOSTI:
• Vyberite odnu iz chetyrekh moguchikh kolonialnykh imperiy: Angliyu, Frantsiyu, Ispaniyu ili Niderlandy. Kazhdaya strana obespechivaet svoi preimushchestva i unikalnyy stil igry
• Vyberite geroya svoego priklyucheniya: on mozhet prinadlezhat odnomu iz chetyrekh igrovykh klassov — issledovatel, torgovka, bukaner ili piratka. U kazhdogo klassa est svoi plyusy i minusy.
• Chetyre rasshirennykh kampanii dlya odinochnoy igry. 
• Torgovlya s 60 karibskimi gorodami v 3D. Derzhites podalshe ot utesov, melkovodya i regionov so shtormovoy pogodoy.
• Vybirayte iz 50 zdaniy, vklyuchaya 25 promyshlennykh, chtoby proizvodit tovary.
• Optimiziruyte proizvoditelnost i povyshayte schaste gorozhan.
• 18 istoricheskikh korabley kontsa XVI i XVII vekov.
• Vstupayte v takticheskie poshagovye morskie srazheniya.
• Povyshayte reputatsiyu, chtoby poluchat litsenzii, razresheniya na stroitelstvo, novye zdaniya i korabli.

title: Buccanyar + 4 DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
這款遊戲由兩大模式組成。
航海模式：自己操作船隻，和AI控制的貓（船員）一起前往冒險，和其他的船隻或者海中的怪物進行戰鬥。
港口模式：可以進行船的改造和船員的替換，並可以將通過戰鬥獲得的資源賣掉換成金錢。

航海模式是本作品的核心部分，在推動劇情、攻略劇情的過程中，會接連出現航海航路（關卡），一部分的關卡的敵人配置和報酬，以及尋找新的貓船員的「貓調查」等附屬內容，會隨機進行組合並自動產生。

而在港口模式，除了可以改造船隻之外，還可以僱傭船員。船員是進化了的以貓為首的可愛的動物們。他們一定可以成為值得依靠（？）的部下吧。根據貓的種類不同，外觀和性格也會有所不同。
通過給船員貓下達命令來操縱船隻，推動戰鬥的進行。

title: Remorse the List [NSP][ENG]
description:
陰沈的匈牙利小鎮 Hidegpuszta 中究竟藏著什麼祕密？
等你親自來挖掘！

《悔恨：清單》是一款經典風格的生存恐怖遊戲，採取開放式玩法，兼具道具庫存管理和戰鬥機制。
探索陰森黑暗的 Hidegpuszta 郊區，尋找隱藏其中的祕密。
唯一的線索，是一份神祕的清單。
發揮你的聰明才智解讀這份隱晦不明的文件、破解謎團，並適時利用近戰和遠程武器，解決攻擊力更強一點的難題。
不過記得要計算子彈數量，畢竟子彈比好運更稀有。

你究竟有沒有本事揭開這不幸之地的真實面貌，最後活著回來呢？

特色：
▪ 連通場景：探索匈牙利郊區小鎮相互連通的街道、公園和廢棄建築。
▪ 情報順序：自行選擇想先瞭解的清單項目。
▪ 庫存管理：注意彈藥數量，情勢對你相當不利。
▪ 交戰規則：多種近戰和遠程武器任你選用。
▪ 「聽」起來不妙：利用錄影帶、錄音檔等多種線索，一步步解開劇情謎底。
▪ 其他語言：匈牙利文。

title: Beautiful Desolation [NSZ][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
免費的數位藝術書和原聲帶

包含 80 多頁高分辨率藝術作品和官方配樂的所有 18 首曲目，可免費數位下載。


史詩般的冒險故事

馬克和他的兄弟唐被扔進了一個由高度先進的技術統治的未來時代，既受人尊敬，也受人辱罵。
這個非洲世界末日世界的居民將幫助或阻礙你，因為你有新的發現並駕馭壯觀的景觀。與當地領導人、治療師和戰士談判你的通道，或者發現自己捲入與納米蟲群、巨大的蝎子和火箭的戰鬥——配備的機器人。
從繁華的村莊到搖搖欲墜的城市、石化的森林和乾涸的海床，這個陌生的新世界擁有大量的地形等著你去發現，並在 2D 等距藝術中精美地呈現出來。探索、解決謎題並準備好面對許多艱難的選擇，這些選擇將塑造在你完成旅程很久之後，這片土地。

令人難忘的面孔

你所知道的人類已經被完全重新塑造，這在美麗荒涼中的角色中最為明顯。技術和死亡變得模糊。有意識的宗教機器人盛行。超人類的部落和領袖已經出現奪取權力，以及無情的獵人僱傭兵在平原上漫遊。所有人都適應了這個強大的未知數，並且經常互相矛盾。與四十多個獨特的角色會面並互動，每個角色都由非洲配音演員全程配音，有數千行對話和多種對話路徑。此外，完整的 CGI 過場動畫散佈在整個故事中，讓你更接近迷人的科幻世界及其角色。

大師級樂譜

BEAUTIFUL DESOLATION 擁有由 Mick Gordon 創作的充滿活力和高度實驗性的配樂。

針對控制台控制器進行了改造

BEAUTIFUL DESOLATION 的控件、UI 和動作已經完全重做，可以在控制台控制器上直觀地工作。

title: Tales from Candleforth [NSZ][ENG]
description:
《坎德爾福斯故事集》是一本童話故事集，多年前寫在一本禁書上，以隱藏其內容。 多年後，黑暗的文字滲入了故事的頁面，與它們混合併扭曲了故事。

故事即將開始…

在第一個故事中，我們將遇到莎拉，一個 16 歲的女孩，獨自經營家庭藥劑師。 莎拉的祖母不久前失蹤了，但有一天，她發現了一些線索，顯示她可能還活著。 當莎拉發現只有家裡的女性才能繼承的新力量時，她冒險進入一個神秘、神秘和恐怖的世界，揭開她家人隱藏的秘密，並發現她在這一切中扮演的角色。

特徵：
• 手工製作 - 探索充滿細節、完全手工繪製和動畫的 2D 世界。
• 可怕的民間傳說 - 參觀民間恐怖之地，現實與惡夢世界交織在一起
• 點擊 - 以經典的冒險遊戲形式揭開黑暗故事
• 腦筋急轉彎 - 解決創意謎題並智取複雜的密室逃脫機制

title: The Padre [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Rasputayte taynu propavshego kardinala, razgadav zagadku nevest otkuda vzyavsheysya demonicheskoy sily. Stolknites so svoimi vnutrennimi demonami i srazites so zlom, kotoroe pytaetsya iskusit vashu dushu. Igrayte za samogo ostroumnogo i neravnodushnogo k pop-kulture svyashchennika v istorii videoigr i ne zastavlyayte angelov plakat, inache vam pridet konets.

The Padre — eto trekhmernoe khorror-priklyuchenie v stile retro s otsylkami k klassicheskim khorror-igram. Mrachnaya i davyashchaya atmosfera chasto narushaetsya strannym yumorom neunyvayushchego Padre. Vam pridetsya napryach i mozgi, chtoby reshat neprostye golovolomki, i muskuly, chtoby otbivatsya ot monstrov, poka vy razgadyvaete tayny starogo osobnyaka, svoey dushi i izvechnoy borby dobra so zlom. No beregites: slishkom mnogo promakhov — i igra zakonchitsya dlya vas RAZ I NAVSEGDA!

title: Synaxarion: Acts Part 1 [NSZ][ENG]
description: Nachinaya s Raspyatiya Khrista, vy igraete za uchenika Khrista i stanovites svidetelem klyuchevykh sobytiy ranney Tserkvi. Sobytiya Synaxarion: Acts Part 1 proiskhodyat vo vremya chasti bibleyskoy knigi Deyaniy, kotoraya obogashchena dopolnitelnoy istoriey i traditsiyami iz Sinaksariya.

title: The Hong Kong Massacre [NSZ][ENG]
description:
受經典動作片的啟發，香港大屠殺將您置身於一個殘酷的復仇故事的中心，充滿了殘酷的電影槍戰和生動的黑社會場景。

扮演一名前警探的角色，他一心要為他的伴侶謀殺案進行報復，並使用原始火力、慢動作和俯衝/躲避機制的混合來突破犯罪行列。

潛入窗戶或躲在掩體後面 - 每一次射擊都是致命的，因此請注意周圍環境並儘可能利用環境。

熱火朝天時，您可以放慢時間並計劃下一步行動。 在消滅敵人的同時避開子彈對生存至關重要 - 但請注意，您的慢動作能力是有限的：快速計劃，提前思考並毫髮無損地擊倒壞人。

每個級別都包含一系列挑戰，讓您在前進的過程中解鎖新武器，在一個喜怒無常、犯罪猖獗的城市中從餐廳到屋頂交易子彈。

title: Langrisser I and II (1-2) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
You are the arbiter of fate in a world ravaged by wars through generations of heroes who battle for peace, order, or chaos.

Command Ledin, Elwin, and their companions in their quest to obtain the Sacred Sword Langrisser and restore peace to a war-stricken land. Decide who your allegiance lies with in Langrisser I & II, remastered for modern consoles.

title: Tokyo Clanpool [NSP][ENG]
description:
在近未來的東京市，政府的腐敗導致謎一般的顛倒城市及其延伸出的高聳巨塔出現在都市的正上空，與國會議事堂產生了連結。怪物的出現正威脅著日本的民眾，現在全都要靠新上任的總理大臣 Natsume Kannuki 帶領她的少女內閣團來擊退牠們了！

在《塔樓 Clanpool》這款地下城 RPG 中，你要帶領女英雄團隊前往高塔的深處，應付怪物的威脅並找出牠們的來源之謎。在以第一人稱視角探索迷宮般的地城時，也能裝備虛擬造型來客製化你的角色們的技能與能力。回合制的戰鬥不只快速又講求策略性，且只要搭配隊伍中倚靠乙太發動的能力，就能夠維持漂浮或者挖出地道，改變地城的構造。

但你也得留意市民們的支持率，如果你的行動得到人們的愛戴，就能獲得珍貴的額外獎勵，但如果支持率太低，你的內閣可能就得解散了！你的施政經得起考驗嗎？

特色：

• 體驗設定在近現代東京的動態地城 RPG！
• 扮演日本年輕的總理大臣，以及她可愛的內閣成員們。
• 爭取民眾的支持以獲取珍貴的額外獎勵，或者失去他們對任務的支持！
• 以第一人稱視角探索迷宮般的地城，挑戰回合制的戰鬥。
• 使用 Sacred Union 等特殊攻擊，在面對強大怪物時取得優勢！
• 破壞牆面、漂浮或挖掘隧道來改變地城的結構。
• 使用不同的虛擬造型來客製化職業能力與技能！

title: Criminal Expert [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Kak politseyskiy sledovatel, vy berete na sebya zadachu obyasnit och-ch-chen zagadochnoe sobytie. Kto eta zhenshchina, i chto ona delala? Legko li budet obyasnit vse obstoyatelstva, ili v etoy istorii est chto-to bolee glubokoe?..
U vas est tolko tri dnya, chtoby zavershit svoyo rassledovanie. Oprosite svideteley, soberite uliki, provodite obyski i sledite za podozrevaemymi.. Obrashchayte vnimanie na kazhduyu detal — ot vas zavisit dalneyshaya sudba nashikh geroev!
Criminal Expert — eto detektivnaya videoigra, v kotoroy vy nakhodites pod davleniem neumolimo ukhodyashchego vremeni. Istoriya soderzhit neskolko putey dlya vybora, i tolko vy, v konechnom itoge, reshaete, kak ona slozhitsya.

title: Dead Synchronicity Tomorrow Comes Today [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
'Dead Synchronicity: Tomorrow Comes Today' posvyashchena Mayklu. Emu nado ponyat, kto on, i uznat pro 2 sobytiya: 'velikuyu volnu' katastrof i pandemiyu, nadelyayushchuyu lyudey osobym skladom uma i rastvoryayushchuyu tela v krovi. Esli Maykl ne pospeshit, to dozhivet do momenta 'mertvoy sinkhronnosti', kogda rastvoritsya samo vremya.

Igrokam predstoit stolknutsya s iskazheniyami prostranstva i vremeni, kontslageryami, sverkhestestvennymi sobytiyami, zhutkimi smertyami, slozhnymi zagadkami i vyzovami!

title: Ironcast Est. 1886 [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Komandiry! Otpravlyaytes na pole boya v Ironcast i gotovtes k poshagovoy strategii, kakoy vy eshche ne videli. Kazhdoe vashe reshenie — ot sbora resursov do vybora sleduyushchey missii — budet igrat klyuchevuyu rol v vashey sudbe. Upravlyayte boevoy mashinoy i vedite voyska k pobede v ryade slozhneyshikh srazheniy, torgovykh zadaniy i missiy na vyzhivanie.

Igra Ironcast sozdana v zhanre «rogalik» — eto znachit, chto smert personazha neobratima, no nagrady sushchestvenny, i pri etom ni odna kampaniya ne pokhozha na drugie. V igre vas zhdut sluchayno generiruemye missii, bolee 50 razblokiruemykh predmetov i shans na poluchenie redkoy dobychi iz pavshikh vragov. Kazhdaya igra budet dlya vas kak otdelnaya istoriya.
Blagodarya podderzhke funktsii vibratsii HD vy kak nikogda oshchutite unichtozhenie vraga!

Osobennosti igry:
- Chetyre rezhima igry, vklyuchaya polnyy funktsional sensornogo ekrana.
- Sdelayte svoy Ironcast unikalnym blagodarya razlichnym nepovtoryayushchimsya kombinatsiyam snaryazheniya.
- Sobirayte redkuyu dobychu s pavshikh vragov, chtoby uluchshat svoi sistemy.

title: Fashion Dreamer + 4 DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Probudite svoyu vnutrennyuyu modnitsu! Fashion Dreamer vykhodit na Nintendo Switch! Issleduyte virtualnyy mir Evy, sozdavayte svoi sobstvennye naryady i stante ikonoy mody. Prigotovtes stat nastoyashchey aydolshoy! Etot simulyator svetskoy lvitsy predlagaet uvlekatelnoe priklyuchenie dlya poklonnikov tvorchestva i stilya!
Virtualnyy mir Evy zhdet v igre Fashion Dreamer, gde vy mozhete dat volyu svoemu tvorchestvu. Igroki issleduyut vse grani dizayna, sozdavaya kultovye obrazy ot povsednevnykh do shikarnykh. Blagodarya sotnyam nastraivaemykh optsiy igroki mogut sozdat svoy sobstvennyy brend i stat zakonodatelem mody. Predstavlennyy treyler s prodolzhitelnym geympleem daet predstavlenie o funktsiyakh i tvorcheskikh vozmozhnostyakh.
Gotovy podelitsya svoim stilem i ostavit svoy sled v virtualnom mire vysokoy mody?..

title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel 2: Sen no Kiseki II - KAI (The Erebonian Civil War) [NSZ][ENG (Mod.)/JAP]
interface_lang: 日语 [JAP] + lyubitelskiy anglofikator 来自 masagrator, Graber
voice_lang: 日语 + optsionalnyy ofits. 英语 dublyazh
description:
系列累積銷量超過550萬套的超人氣RPG軌跡系列終於登陸Nintendo Switch™！

《貴族聯盟》趁著《鐵血宰相》遭到暗殺的空檔佔領了帝都，並對包含《軍官學院》的要衝發動攻勢。正規軍之間終於爆發內戰。值此同時，敗給《蒼之騎神》後脫離戰線的黎恩，在山岳地帶醒來──

本作為「閃之軌跡」系列的第二部作品，描寫主角黎恩在內戰爆發的埃雷波尼亞帝國境內找回四散各地的《Ⅶ班》成員的經過。

搭載可在戰鬥、事件過場、原野時切換為2倍速度的「高速略過模式」，
在Nintendo Switch™上提供更舒適順暢的遊玩體驗！

title: The Legend of Heroes: Ao no Kiseki Kai (Trails to Azure) [NSZ][ENG (Mod.)/CHN]
interface_lang: 中文 [CHN] + 英语 lyubitelskiy 来自 EvilGoku & Geofront, Graber
description:
系列累計銷售超過500萬套，大受歡迎的RPG軌跡系列於Nintendo Switch™登場！
克洛斯貝爾篇邁入第二章！新生特務支援課的故事將進入新的階段。
與能用驚人幅度增強人類的感官和體能的藥劑「睿智」相關的一連串事件，在羅伊德等特務支援課一行人的活躍下成功獲得解決。然而，那只不過是壯闊故事的序章。
震撼整座克洛斯貝爾的新事件究竟是……？
本作搭載「改」系列備受好評的新功能「高速略過模式」，讓玩家能以兩倍速度推進事件和在原野上探索，並在戰鬥中切換為四倍速，提供更舒適的遊玩體驗。
此外，作為本作的原創要素，某位與克洛斯貝爾有著深厚淵源的「閃之軌跡」角色也會在作品中登場！

title: The Legend of Heroes: Zero no Kiseki Kai (Trails from Zero) [NSZ][ENG (Mod.)]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] lyubitelskiy 来自 EvilGoku & Geofront
description:
系列累積銷售超過500萬套的人氣RPG軌跡系列登陸Nintendo Switch™！
相當於克洛斯貝爾篇第一章的『零之軌跡：改』以塞姆利亞大陸西部的克洛斯貝爾自治州為舞台，描寫被分發至克洛斯貝爾警察的新部門《特務支援課》的四位年輕人，如何在面對嚴苛現實的同時，合力對抗困難的經過。

title: Arzette the Jewel of Faramore [NSP][ENG]
description:
Arzett: Kamen Feramora — ekshn-platformer, razrabatyvaemyy Setom Falkersonom, izvestnym kak Dopply; igra vdokhnovlena uzhasnymi igrami serii The Legends of Zelda na Philips CD-i: Link: The Faces of Evil i Zelda: The Wand of Gamelon. Ot nikh Arzette perenyala obshchiy geympley i zabavnye animatsionnye roliki.
Spustya 10 let mira obyavilsya zlo vnov obyavilos v korolevstve Feramore. Zlobnyy korol demonov Daymar otpravil svoyu polchishche na zakhvat etikh zemel. Teper printsesse Arzett predstoit ostanovit Daymara i odolet ego merzkikh prispeshnikov.
Saundtrek k igre napisan Dzheykom «Bryatsalshchikom po klavisham» Silvermanom, aktyorami ozvuchki vystupayut prezhnie golosa s davney CD-i: Dzhoffri Rat (golos CD-i Linka) i Bonni Dzhin Uilbur (golos CD-i Zeldy). Khudozhnikom k igre stal Rob Danleyvi.

title: AO Tennis 2 [NSP][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
IGROVAYa PLOShchADKA, KOTORUYu VY SOZDAETE DLYa SEBYa SAMI
• Ispolzuyte prostoy i ponyatnyy paket instrumentov Akademii, chtoby sozdat igroka, pokhozhego na vas kak dve kapli vody, i obustraivayte svoi sobstvennye korty — ili zhe zagruzhayte tysyachi modifikatsiy, sozdannykh drugimi igrokami.

LUChShIE IGROKI V MIRE
• Srazhaytes s samymi izvestnymi tennisistami, v chislo kotorykh vkhodyat Rafael Nadal, Esh Barti, Anzhelika Kerber i mnogie drugie, na arenakh ATP i WTA.

POLNOSTYu PEREDELANNYY KARERNYY REZhIM
• Pokoryayte mirovye reytingi v odinochnom razryade ili vystupite s drugom v parnom. Sledite za svoey reputatsiey, vybirayte sponsorov i sorevnovaniya, chtoby dostignut vershiny.

NOVYE IGROVYE REZhIMY
• Otygryvayte legendarnye matchi ili zhe sozdavayte novye ispytaniya s pomoshchyu redaktora stsenariev.

title: Shadow Warrior + Wanton Destruction (移植版 jfsw-1997) [NSP][ENG]
description:
Shadow Warrior («Voin Teni») — videoigra v zhanre shutera ot pervogo litsa, razrabotannaya 3D Realms i vypushchennaya GT Interactive 13 maya 1997 goda dlya MS-DOS i Mac OS. Igra byla sozdana na osnove dvizhka Build Engine, razrabotannogo Kenom Silvermanom. Novovvedeniya dvizhka igry vklyuchayut v sebya vozmozhnost razmeshcheniya v igrovoy srede odnogo pomeshcheniya nad drugim, ispolzovanie dlya oruzhiya i prochikh predmetov inventarya vokselov vmesto spraytov, prozrachnost vody, vozmozhnost podyoma i spuska po vertikalnym lestnitsam, a takzhe upravlyaemye sredstva peredvizheniya, chast kotorykh mozhet byt ispolzovana dlya boya. V igre s izobiliem predstavleny nasilie, krov, chyornyy yumor i otkrovennaya seksualnaya tematika. 29 maya 2013 goda kompaniya Devolver Digital obyavila, chto igra budet dostupna dlya besplatnogo skachivaniya pozhiznenno.
Prorabotav mnogo let «voinom teni» — telokhranitelem i ispolnitelem razlichnoy gryaznoy raboty — v mogushchestvennoy korporatsii «Zilla», Lo Van uznayot o planakh korporatsii prizvat monstrov iz drugikh izmereniy i zavoevat mir, i pokidaet kompaniyu. Uznav, chto byvshiy nayomnik mozhet pomeshat eyo planam, korporatsiya posylaet svoikh podruchnykh ubit ego. V techenie igry Van obnaruzhivaet, chto lyudi Zilly ubili ego uchitelya, i zadayotsya tselyu otomstit!
V ofitsialnom dopolnenii igry, «Wanton Destruction» v 12 novykh urovnyakh opisyvayutsya priklyucheniya Lo Vana posle kontsa igry. Vy naveshchaete svoikh rodstvennikov v SShA, no vynuzhdeny snova srazhatsya s silami Zilly!.. Igra dostigaet kulminatsii v bitve s Masterom Zilloy nad ulitsami Tokio, kotoraya, estestvenno, zakanchivaetsya smertyu glavgada!..

title: WitchSpring R (Witch Spring) + 5 DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
《魔女之泉R》是一款劇情驅動RPG。結合了養成、收集與冒險3種元素的獨特系統、華麗的特色世界觀，以及童話一般的畫面；讓你置身於絕妙的遊戲體驗之中。
必須在魔女狩獵中生存下來的魔女派莓，她的成長和冒險故事現在正式開始！

title: Lost Dream / Lost Dream Darkness / Memories / Stars / Grand Hike / Hike [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Lost Dream Stars:
Play as the fox and traverse the land collecting quest items and competing puzzles! Are you ready to save the world with the help of the stars?

The World:
Like all the games in the series, this one has many unique and different levels to explore as well. Run through the Frosted fields, Magical forests, Foggy mountains and many more levels!

Soundscape:
The whole game is filled with highest quality sound clips all the way from birds to water flowing alongside the calming music made to fit the scene.

title: Arcadian Atlas [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description: Rolevaya takticheskaya igra o vybore, kotoryy lyudi delayut radi lyubvi i vlasti, i o tom, kak etot vybor razryvaet korolevstvo na chasti.

title: The Savior's Gang [NSP][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 机器翻译 来自 most2820
description:
The player will have to guide his faithful through several dangers that could damage them in the most possible grotesque and cruel ways. These can be dismembered, crushed, burned, drowned, infected and skewered among many other calamities. The skill of each player will come into play to determine how many adepts finish each level alive. 

In The Savior's Gang, the player controls The Savior, a powerful entity that is crucified and trapped between the world of mortals and heaven. This unfair death triggers the wrath of his father, an almighty pidgeon, which unleashes a series of traps, disasters and dangers all over the world. The Savior must negotiate with his Father to stop these catastrophes and save only his worshippers from all these evils and, try to get out of limbo and recover his power. To achieve his goals, he will have his good friend Stan (he hates to be called Satan) and the intermediation of his Mother and Stepfather.

title: Death Coming [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Death Coming — nelineynaya igra-golovolomka, v kotoroy vam predstoit sygrat rol poslantsa Smerti. U vas vsego odna zadacha… Seyat smert i sobirat dushi, podchinyayas dogmatu o svobode voli.

Predystoriya
Vy umerli. 

No smertyu vse ne zakonchilos. Vy stali pomoshchnikom Smerti, zhnetsom dush. Vy obladaete mogushchestvom Smerti, no i u Smerti est svoi pravila.

Smert obryvaet zhizni, no ne mozhet napryamuyu upravlyat lyudmi iz-za dogmata o svobode voli. Vam predstoit planirovat i osushchestvlyat ubiystva, ispolzuya podruchnye predmety i udobnye situatsii. Pri etom sleduet osteregatsya slug sveta, kotorye pytayutsya uberech lyudey ot ugotovannoy im pechalnoy sudby!

title: Kiai Resonance / Divine Ascent / Dissolved Chapter 1 / Railed Up [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Take part in deadly settlings of scores between rival electricity providers, inside futuristic tramways on suspended railways. In Railed Up, everything is upside down. You see the world from below, in order to give a better view of those endless railway networks as well as the oppressively enormous city through which your quest will lead you.

It's a multiplayer game for one to four players. A solo campaign will lead Iskhar on his way up the layers of the lower city, while he faces each electrical gang and discovers all the deadliest weaponry of their tramways. Each gang eliminated means having their arsenal at your disposal, a much needed help against what's coming. The tone is very dark and violent, but tries at the same time to offer a dose of offbeat, cynical humour in its dialogues, which brings some lightness between the the ruthless confrontations.

The gameplay is "on rails", literally. You need to operate your tramway along the tracks of each arena, get ammunition as quickly as you can then shoot and destroy all your opponents in order to be the last one standing. Its challenge is based on restricting the player both in his movements since he can only follow the tracks, and his firing which can only be done perpendicularly to the tramway trajectory – except for some special weapons. So the choice of positioning is crucial.

The universe tries to blend different science fiction subgenres, including steampunk, tech-noir, dystopian fiction, etc. Graphics are entirely in 2D, using a mix of realistic shadings and textures with some hand-drawn elements - such as the characters' portrait animations. As for the music, they're orchestral compositions with a distorted sound, in order to add a dramatic effect to the fights while reinforcing the impression of unease and technological nightmare.

title: Pitfall Planet [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
V igre Pitfall Planet vam predstoit upravlyat paroy samykh milykh robotov po etu storonu Mlechnogo Puti, kotorye issleduyut dalekiy i zabytyy podzemnyy mir.
 Primerte na sebya rol dvukh astrobotov, kotorye ochutilis vdali ot svoego korablya i teper dolzhny peresech podzemnye peshchery na umirayushchey planete, preodolevaya mnozhestvo prepyatstviy.
 
 V igre Pitfall Planet vy i vash naparnik poluchite v svoe rasporyazhenie poslednie novinki kosmicheskoy shakhterskoy promyshlennosti.
 S pomoshchyu kryukov igroki smogut zakhvatyvat predmety (i drug druga!), a potom brosat ikh cherez treshchiny ili utesy.
 Nauchites rabotat v komande, chtoby sobrat rudu na vsekh urovnyakh!
 Naparnik pomozhet vam aktivirovat knopki i rychagi, do kotorykh bez pomoshchi nikak ne dobratsya. Vdvoem vy budete zabiratsya na samye vysokie mesta s pomoshchyu yashchikov, pereprygivat s mesta na mesto blagodarya pruzhinyashchim plitkam, a takzhe razdelyvatsya s raketami, tankami i mnogim drugim!
 
 Mnogie chasy zakhvatyvayushchego igrovogo protsessa s golovolomkami — eto eshche ne vsyo! Takzhe igroki smogut tratit samotsvety na aksessuary dlya geroev, snabzhaya ikh zabavnymi shlyapami. Pust vashi roboty stanut samymi modnymi na planete, a mozhet, i vo vsey galaktike!
 
 - Prokhodite mnozhestvo urovney so slozhnymi golovolomkami i opasnymi vragami vmeste s drugom...
 - ...ili otpravlyaytes v put v odinochku, upravlyaya dvumya astrobotami: eto variant dlya tekh, kto lyubit ispytaniya!
 - Potryasayushchaya grafika ozhivlyaet astrobotov i zhivopisnuyu planetu.
 - Issleduyte zagadochnyy podzemnyy mir, chtoby otyskat vse peshchery i sekrety.
 - Na kazhdom urovne mozhno nayti samotsvety, za kotorye vy kupite modnye shlyapki!
 - Uspokaivayushchaya instrumentalnaya fonovaya muzyka
 - Shvyrnite druzey pryamo v lavu!
 - A teper eshche raz! Ne volnuytes: s nimi vsyo budet v poryadke.

title: Negligee [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Istoriya nezhneyshey yuri-lyubvi, v kotoroy vy igraete rol upravlyayushchego magazina damskogo belya «Penyuar» vmeste s tremya krasivymi zhenshchinami.
Kak novyy menedzher, vy dolzhny nayti podkhodyashchuyu devushku, kotoraya pomozhet vam v upravlenii magazinom i pokupatelyam nayti to, chto oni ishchut, i osvoitsya na novoy dolzhnosti, chtoby dobitsya uspekha.
Rabotayte vmeste s gruppoy krasivykh devushek v etom vysokokachestvennom vizualnom romane so mnozhestvom variantov vybora i kontsovok, kotorye mozhno razblokirovat.Eshchyo vizualnykh novell na Switch (renpy).

title: In Other Waters [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Vy – iskusstvennyy intellekt, vedushchiy odinokogo ksenobiologa po tainstvennomu inoplanetnomu okeanu. Izuchayte nevoobrazimykh sushchestv v raznoobraznykh mestakh obitaniya cherez unikalnyy interfeys i raskryvayte sekrety istorii etoy planety. Kakie otkrytiya sdelaete vy vmeste?

ISSLEDUYTE INOPLANETNYY OKEAN: Svobodno peremeshchaytes mezhdu lokatsiyami i otkryvayte novye territorii vdali ot protorennykh trop. Eti otkrytiya dadut uluchsheniya i obraztsy, kotorye zatem pomogut popast v novye zony uzhe issledovannykh lokatsiy, proyti dopolnitelnye kvesty i otkryt unikalnye dialogi s Elleri.

POSMOTRITE NA MIR GLAZAMI II: Upravlyayte elegantnym intuitivnym interfeysom s pomoshchyu kasaniy ili myshi. Schityvayte signaly, vybirayte marshrut i sostavlyayte kartu okeana s pomoshchyu intuitsii i eksperimentov.

STANTE KSENOBIOLOGOM: Otkryvayte i katalogiziruyte vidy, nablyudayte, skaniruyte, berite proby i vzaimodeystvuyte s inoplanetnoy zhiznyu. Chitayte zametki Elleri, smotrite ee zarisovki i pomogayte ey klassifitsirovat absolyutno neznakomuyu ekosistemu.

PLANIRUYTE POGRUZhENIYa: Vybirayte, kogda izuchat sushchestv, a kogda rassledovat tayny ili nyryat v novye zony. Zatem vozvrashchaytes na bazu, chtoby izuchit vzyatye obraztsy v laboratorii, pogovorit s Elleri ili prochest ee dnevniki, chtoby bolshe uznat ob etom mire.

STROYTE KREPKIE OTNOShENIYa: Polzuyas ogranichennymi sredstvami obshcheniya, uznayte bolshe o cheloveke, v chem akvalange vy zhivete, i pomogite ey prinimat slozhnye resheniya. Sovmestnye perezhivaniya sblizyat vas.

title: Yohane the Parhelion - Blaze in the Deepblue [NSP][ENG]
description:
●何為《幻日夜羽 -湛海耀光-》
《幻日夜羽》是《Love Live!》系列第2部《Love Live! Sunshine!!》的官方衍生作品。
本作則是以夜羽的世界為舞台的探索型2D動作遊戲《幻日夜羽 -湛海耀光-》。

玩家要化身主角「夜羽」，與搭檔「萊拉普斯」一起探索怪物橫行的神祕海底地城，以救出失蹤的同伴為目標前進。
夜羽能夠將地城內取得的素材道具加以組合，藉此製作裝備，並借用救出的同伴的力量，逐步拓展探索的範圍。
地城內的部分地點會隨機變換構造，能夠享受百玩不厭的冒險體驗。

注目特點01：在神祕海底地城尋找道具的大冒險
探索位於海底的神祕地城。借助獲得的道具和同伴們的力量來攻略迷宮吧。諸如神殿與遺跡、沈船等，會有各式各樣的情境登場。

注目特點02：每次經過都會產生變化的「隨機區域」
地城內存在著會隨機變化的區域。每次探索都能提供新的刺激，讓玩家百玩不厭。

注目特點03：製作道具的「創造（Cast）」系統
打倒怪物或是探索地城將可取得素材。夜羽隨時都能透過合成素材製作出武器或飾品等裝備。可製作的裝備超過90種。

注目特點04：各具特色的同伴動作
電視動畫中熟悉的成員將會登場。忠實反映各角色個性的鮮活動作將會為夜羽的冒險增添助力。

【配音陣容】
夜羽（CV.小林愛香）、萊拉普斯（CV.日笠陽子）、花丸（CV.高槻かなこ）、黛雅（CV.小宮有紗）、露比（CV.降幡愛）、千歌（CV.伊波杏樹）、曜（CV.斉藤朱夏）、果南（CV.諏訪ななか）、梨子（CV.逢田梨香子）、鞠莉（CV.鈴木愛奈）

注目特點05：以歌曲的力量逆轉危機！
使用「樂譜」就能讓夜羽得到強化。主題曲《Deep Blue》將炒熱冒險的氣氛！

STORY
在近海忽然出現的「海底地城」目前正在努瑪梓蔚為話題。
鎮上的同伴們懷抱著各自的理由前往調查。
然而，卻沒有任何一人從地城返回──
為了拯救同伴，夜羽也投身探索的行列。
等待著夜羽的，是一群猶如深海魚的怪物，以及每次踏入都會改變構造的神祕迷宮。
夜羽是否能救出同伴，並解開地城的謎團呢？
《幻日夜羽 -湛海耀光-》
──晦暗幽深的海底，照進一縷太陽的光輝。

title: Heroes of the Monkey Tavern [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
Posle beschislennogo kolichestva dney i nochey bezzabotnogo veselya v stenakh pechalno izvestnoy taverny "Obezyana", komanda iskateley priklyucheniy istratila vse svoi dengi, do posledney monety... Odnako, pokhozhe, ikh sudby vot-vot izmenyatsya... 

Kak-budto sami nebesa posylayut im tainstvennogo neznakomtsa, kotoryy ukazyvaet geroyam put k vysokoy bashne, polnoy bestsennykh sokrovishch.

Etogo bylo vpolne dostatochno, chtoby probudit v nikh zhazhdu priklyucheniy. 

Nasladites issledovaniem podzemelya, polnogo zagadok, opasnykh vragov i smertonosnykh lovushek. 
I, esli udacha budet k vam blagosklonna... vy smozhete obnaruzhit sekretnye oblasti, skryvayushchie v sebe legendarnoe oruzhie i bronyu.

Osobennosti igry:

- Issledovanie podzemeliya v klassicheskom stile peremeshcheniya - grid-based movement ("peremeshchenie po plitkam").
- 8 klassov personazhey 
- tri urovnya slozhnosti
- 2 chasa chuvstvennoy, emotsionalnoy muzyki
- Boi v realnom vremeni 
- 22 razlichnykh tipa vragov, vklyuchaya 6 bossov 
- Mnozhestvo lovushek i sekretov 
- Bolee 100 unikalnykh predmetov

title: Gal Gun Double Peace [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Skandalno izvestnyy, pikantnyy relsovyy shuter Gal-Gun: Double Peace, uzhe na Nintendo Switch™! Obychnyy starsheklassnik Khodaya Kudoki, porazhennyy streloy Kupidona, stanovitsya samym populyarnym parnem v shkole. Teper lish s pomoshchyu vystrelov feromonov on mozhet sderzhivat tolpy ocharovannykh odnoklassnits, kotorye pytayutsya priznatsya emu v lyubvi, i otyskat svoyu edinstvennuyu. Yarkiy, smeshnoy i igrivyy shuter Gal*Gun: Double Peace populyaren sredi poklonnikov serii i teplo prinyat kritikami v Yaponii.



* Unikalnyy shuter v anime-stile, gde tebya atakuyut tolpy vlyublennykh devits!
* Metkimi vystrelami dovedi poklonnits do ekstaza!
* U tebya lish odin den na to, chtoby nayti nastoyashchuyu lyubov ili obrech sebya na vechnoe odinochestvo!
* Zabavnye personazhi sozdayut istoriyu, gde vybor imeet znachenie.
* Otkryvay i uluchshay kombinatsii navykov, chtoby usovershenstvovat svoi sposobnosti.
* Neskolko variantov kontsovki, gde ty srazishsya za lyubov svoey edinstvennoy.
* Dopolnitelnye materialy i obliki personazhey iz originalnoy Gal*Gun Double Peace uzhe dostupny v igre!
* Vyberi syuzhetnyy rezhim ili igray na ochki.
* Otkryvay potryasayushchie arty i mnogoe drugoe v galeree.
