description: Geroy neskolko dney nazad poluchil pismo. V pisme byla tolko karta. Geroy otpravlyaetsya v puteshestvie! V skorom vremen, natykaetsya on na neobychnyy ostrov posredi okeana. Vykhodya na bereg, vy ponimaete, chto sami stali chastyu bolshoy golovolomki, i razgadat eyo smozhet tolko istinnyy lyubitel priklyucheniy!..

title: Detective Di The Silk Rose Murders [NSZ][ENG]
description:
有人在唐朝有系統地殺害了中國首都的年輕婦女，在犯罪現場留下了帶有謎語和警告的卡片。在一次大膽破案後，年輕、初出茅廬但才華橫溢的偵探狄仁傑從武則天皇后本人手中接過了查明兇手身份的任務。

具有歷史背景的沉浸式體驗

在唐朝獨特的時代，與中國第一位也是唯一一位皇后合作，發現犯罪背後的真相，了解政治家的真實意圖並擊敗您的惡魔。

使用偵探可用的所有可能性

通過使用可用對話選項與證人交談來調查犯罪現場。查找與調查相關的證據和項目。通過填寫推演板得出正確的結論，以準確再現過去的事件

像素藝術——一如既往的好

這個非凡的故事以華麗的像素藝術展現，向老派的圖形致敬，但具有全新的獨特觸感。

主要特點：
- 引人入勝的故事情節和有趣的角色。
- 中國古代文化和歷史的氛圍。
- 有挑戰性的謎語需要解決，還有許多對話選項可供選擇。
- 復古 2D 像素藝術風格。
- 13 首曲目的原聲帶。

title: Perception [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Perception is a tense psychological thriller where players must uncover the mysteries of a sinister estate with echolocation as their only sight. Creating sound illuminates your environment, but also agitates the house and the entities within. Use Cassie’s Delphi text-to-speech app along with her intuition to uncover the mansion’s history. Each time a mystery is solved, the mansion transforms to reflect the fate of a different generation and the torment they endured.  

Story
Play as Cassie, a young blind woman set on being independent despite the dangers she faces in her search to discover the truth. After months of research, she finds a connection to an abandoned mansion in Gloucester, Massachusetts. Once there, Cassie finds that Echo Bluff is worse than her nightmares—a ghastly Presence has tormented its inhabitants over generations, and it now hunts Cassie. The former inhabitants call out to Cassie from inside Echo Bluff’s walls, but to solve her own mystery, she must first uncover theirs.

Game Features
"See" using echolocation. Every sound creates a visual.
Uncover the truth that has affected the estate across centuries. Each mystery you solve triggers a radical change throughout the house you explore.
Engage in a deadly game of hide and seek with the menacing entities of the house, including The Presence.
Explore as Cassie, an engaging and empathetic heroine. Discover her inner demons and what ties her to Echo Bluffs.
Subtitles available in English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Japanese, Portuguese-Brazil, and Russian.

title: Sweet Witches (Citrouille) [NSZ][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
Sweet Witches — arkadnyy platformer, rasskazyvayushchiy o priklyucheniyakh prelestnykh malenkikh volshebnits, kotorye otpravilis na poiski konfet. Nesmotrya na detskiy oblik igry, v ee protsesse vy stolknetes s bezzhalostnymi ispytaniyami. Poskolku vasha geroinya ne umeet prygat, na puti k pobede vam pridetsya polagatsya na volshebnye lestnitsy, zaklinaniya i usileniya. Odoleyte vse opasnosti, dayte otpor vragam, pokroyte mir tsvetami i poluchite v nagradu zasluzhennoe lakomstvo!

Syuzhetnyy rezhim:
Vyberite odnu iz glavnykh geroin — Praline ili Vanil — i otpravlyaytes v puteshestvie po bolee chem 5 unikalnym miram, naschityvayushchim svyshe 50 urovney. Esli puteshestvie v odinochku okazhetsya vam ne po zubam, vy vsegda mozhete pozvat v igru druga i prokhodit Sweet Witches vmeste s nim v rezhime razdelennogo ekrana. No tolko uchtite: schetchik zhizney budet u vas odin na dvoikh! Krome togo, vashe oruzhie i zaklinaniya budut odinakovo porazhat i druzey, i vragov.

Rezhim sostyazaniya:
Ot dvukh do chetyrekh igrokov mogut srazhatsya v rezhime razdelennogo ekrana. Zdes v bitvu vstupayut vragi glavnykh geroin — Anis i Lakritsa. Sostyazatsya mozhno v dvukh rezhimakh, kazhdyy iz kotorykh soderzhit 5 unikalnykh aren:
- Skhvatka: pobezhdaet posledniy ostavshiysya v zhivykh.
- Na vremya: pobezhdaet igrok, ostavivshiy na ekrane bolshe tsvetov za otvedennoe vremya.

Klyuchevye osobennosti igry:
- Vybirayte lyubuyu iz chetyrekh volshebnits s unikalnym zaklinaniem v arsenale.
- Pokryvayte zemlyu tsvetami, chtoby pobedit i vosstanovit sily.
- Sozdavayte magicheskie lestnitsy, chtoby popast v nuzhnoe mesto — prygat volshebnitsy ne umeyut.
- Otkryvayte korobki s syurprizami, chtoby poluchit smertonosnoe oruzhie i sokrushit vragov.
- Prokhodite syuzhetnyy rezhim igry vmeste s drugom ili vyyasnyayte s nim otnosheniya na razdelennom ekrane.
- Nesites vikhrem po urovnyam — na prokhozhdenie syuzheta uydet vsego 30 minut, esli vy ne umrete. No vy umrete...
- Naslazhdaytes obvorozhitelnoy grafikoy.

title: Uncanny Valley [NSP][ENG]
description: Uncanny Valley — uzhasayushchaya igra na vyzhivanie, sochetayushchaya elementy issledovaniya, resheniya golovolomok i dinamicheskikh deystviy, a takzhe mnozhestvo variantov razvitiya syuzheta. My postaralis sokhranit igrovoy protsess klassicheskogo uzhastika na vyzhivanie vmesto togo, chtoby sozdavat strelyalku ot tretego litsa s elementami uzhastikov.

title: Uurnog Uurnlimited (Unlimited) [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Posetite prichudlivyy mir Uurnog Uurnlimited, gde u vas est vsego odna tsel — probratsya v kazhdyy ugolok etogo mira i ukrast vsekh zhivotnykh! Zachem? Potomu chto oni milye, i potomu chto eto igra.

Uurnog Uurnlimited — eto voskhititelno glupovatyy 2D platformer. Igrayte v odinochku ili s druzyami, issleduyte mir so mnozhestvom taynykh putey, reshayte golovolomki i sobirayte predmety, a takzhe zhivotnykh, kotorye dolzhny okazatsya v komnate sokhraneniya. Budte ostorozhny! Komnata sokhraneniya sokhranyaet i oshibki (uur net!).

Est li chto-to eshche, sprosite vy? Khaotichnye NPC, kotorye mogut vstrevat v vashu igru! Algoritmicheskaya muzyka, kotoraya podstraivaetsya pod protsess igry! Eto nevuuroyatno! Eto neuurbyasnimo! Eto Uurnog Uurnlimited!

•	KLASSIChESKIY 2D PLATFORMER S GOLOVOLOMKAMI:  Reshayte golovolomki i sobirayte zhivotnykh, a zatem prinosite ikh v vashu komnatu sokhraneniya.
•	ZAKhVATYVAYuShchIE BITVY S BOSSAMI:  Prozhivite dostatochno dolgo i mozhet dazhe vstretites s Uurnogom!
•	PRIYaTNAYa ALGORITMIChESKAYa MUZYKA:  Melodiya, temp i tonalnost podstraivayutsya pod protsess igry.
•	IGRAYTE V ODINOChKU ILI S DRUZYaMI:  Teper serezno: vse stanovitsya luchshe, kogda vy igraete s druzyami v forme milogo shchenochka, pravda?
•	NESKOLKO KONTsOVOK: Tss. Khodyat slukhi, chto eto eshche ne vse sekrety... ;)

title: Windosill [NSP][ENG]
description:
Posetite raznoobraznye mesta, dobavte v nikh zhizni i poznakomtes s ikh obitatelyami. Tolkayte, tyanite, tashchite, kidayte i vrashchayte — vas zhdut desyat taktilnykh golovolomok. Reshite ikh, i vashe lyubopytstvo budet po dostoinstvu voznagrazhdeno. Windosill — eto igra, sozdannaya dlya detey i vzroslykh s bogatym voobrazheniem. Proyti eyo mozhno za odin nedlinnyy podkhod.

Osobennosti

– Desyat iskusno prorabotannykh animirovannykh lokatsiy, reagiruyushchikh na vashi deystviya.

– Spokoynyy i rasslablyayushchiy igrovoy protsess: igrayte v Windosill v sobstvennom tempe.

– Srednee vremya prokhozhdeniya igry variruetsya ot 30 minut do chasa.

– Intuitivno ponyatnyy interfeys: ispolzuyte sensornyy displey, kontroller ili oba etikh ustroystva.

– Atmosferu igry dopolnyayut yarkiy saundtrek i priyatnaya vibratsiya.

– Podderzhka mnogopolzovatelskogo rezhima: igrayte vmeste s drugom, podklyuchiv vtoroy kontroller ili nastroiv Joy-Con™ kak otdelnye kontrollery.

– Priyatnye bonusy: posle prokhozhdeniya Windosill vy razblokiruete rezhim dinamicheskoy gravitatsii, zerkalnyy rezhim i galereyu s illyustratsiyami.

title: Rain World + DLC The Watcher, Downpour [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Vy sliznekot. V mire polno opasnostey, i vam pridyotsya spravlyatsya s nimi v odinochku. Strashnoe navodnenie uneslo vas ot rodnykh i blizkikh, i teper vam predstoit dobyvat propitanie i iskat ukrytie ot livnevykh potokov, grozyashchikh smyt vsyo zhivoe s litsa zemli. Probiraytes po ruinam drevney tsivilizatsii, izbegayte klykov zlobnykh khishchnikov i otkryvayte dlya sebya zagadochnye ugolki mira, polnye dikovinnykh sozdaniy i nerazgadannykh tayn. Otyshchite svoyu semyu i postaraytes ne stat chuzhim obedom!

Etot platformer — simulyator vyzhivaniya s lakonichnoy risovkoy v dukhe igr s 16-bitnoy grafikoy potrebuet raschyotlivosti v prinyatii resheniy, chtoby poymat dobychu i ne popastsya v lapy golodnym khishchnikam. Kovarnye, bezzhalostnye i nenasytnye vragi vsegda gotovy vonzit ostrye zuby ne tolko v vas, no i drug v druga. Malenkomu, myagonkomu sliznekotu v pervuyu ochered pridyotsya polagatsya na skrytnost, a ne na silu. Izuchayte okruzhayushchuyu sredu i ispolzuyte eyo preimushchestva sebe na polzu. Vozmozhno, togda vam udastsya vyzhit... v Rain World!

Osobennosti
• Ogromnyy mir: bolee 1600 lokatsiy, razdelennykh na 12 raznykh regionov, polnykh drevnikh tayn i opasnostey.
• Napryazhennye skhvatki s khishchnikami, kotorye ispytayut vashu reaktsiyu. Postoyannaya nekhvatka resursov i ugroza dozhdya ne dadut vam rasslabitsya.
• Protsedurnaya generatsiya urovney i individualisticheskiy iskusstvennyy intellekt sdelayut kazhdoe prokhozhdenie unikalnym!
• Sygrayte za Monakha i Okhotnika! 2 igrovykh personazha dlya bolee prostogo i bolee agressivnogo stiley igry.
• Ispolzuyte nastroyki dostupnosti, skorosti prokhozhdeniya i slozhnosti dlya sozdaniya unikalnoy kampanii, otvechayushchey vashim vkusam i stilyu prokhozhdeniya.
• Mnogopolzovatelskaya arena dlya 4 igrokov s sorevnovatelnym rezhimom i rezhimom svobodnoy igry.
• Zverinets, polnyy opasnykh khishchnikov i vkusnykh zhertv.

title: Everyday Today's Menu for Emiya Family + DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Videoigra-adaptatsiya voskhititelno trogatelnogo mira «Segodnyashnee menyu dlya semi Emii» (Emiya-san Chi no Kyou no Gohan) nakonets-to zdes!..

description:
《扭曲國度的愛麗絲～Recollection》是多元結局型的恐怖小說冒險遊戲。

某一天，我在學校醒來之後，一名自稱「笑臉貓」的謎樣人物這麼對我說……。
「來吧，我們的愛麗絲，去追白兔吧。」

title: The Addams Family: Mansion Mayhem [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Oni zhutkie, oni strannovatye, i tainstvennyy gost khochet zakhvatit ikh zloveshchiy osobnyak! Tolko vy i vashi druzya mozhete pomoch Uenzdi, Pagsli, Gomesu i Mortishe Addams spasti semeynyy osobnyak Addamsov v etom novom veselom priklyuchencheskom 3D-platformere dlya 1–4 igrokov.

Issleduyte samye temnye glubiny osobnyaka i volshebnye tayny, kak nikogda ranshe, chtoby raskryt sekrety i spasti legendarnyy dom. Ispolzuyte osobye sposobnosti kazhdogo znakovogo personazha, takie kak mazurka s sablyami Gomesa ili domashniy osminog Uenzdi Sokrat, chtoby reshat golovolomki i nakhodit relikvii, raskryvayushchie neveroyatnuyu istoriyu osobnyaka. Igrayte s druzyami i protiv nikh v sorevnovatelnykh mnogopolzovatelskikh mini-igrakh, v kotorykh vy budete tolkat i pereprygivat drug druga dlya pobedy. Vecher semeynykh igr skoro stanet uzhasayushche zakhvatyvayushchim!

Eto strakh, eto uzhas, eto lyubimyy dom! Skoree soberites vmeste i spasite semeynyy osobnyak Addamsov, chtoby zhutko veselo provesti vremya!

title: Monster World IV (Wonder Boy 4, SEGA) [NSP][ENG]
description:
Monster World IV — priklyuchencheskiy platformer, razrabotannyy Westone i vypushchennyy eksklyuzivno v Yaponii kompaniey Sega dlya 16-bitnoy konsoli MEGA DRIVE v aprele 1994 goda. Eto shestaya igra v serii Wonder Boy/Monster World. Monster World IV byla posledney igroy Wonder Boy, izdannoy Sega i razrabotannoy Westone Bit Entertainment.
Pered vami zaklyuchitelnaya chast serii Wonder Boy / Monster World, povestvuyushchaya o priklyuchenii zelenovolosoy devushki po imeni Asha. Vmeste so svoim zverkom Pepelogu vy vmeste s ney dolzhny proyti cherez mnogie ispytaniya, posetit strannye zemli i pobedit vsekh uzhasnykh monstrov!
V versii emulyatora dlya Nintendo Switch est vozmozhnost vybora aspekta displeya DAR 4:3, 1:1 PAR, pixel perfect; 3 vida skeylinga: Soft, Crispy, Razor; funktsiya peremotki vremeni Fast Forward i nastraivaemyy CRT-sheyder.Drugie igry serii Wonder Boy sm. zdes.

title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails into Reverie + 5 DLC [NSP][ENG]
description:
Prodolzhenie istorii posle sobytiy Trails of Cold Steel IV: eta chast sluzhit zaversheniem serii Trails, arok Krossbella i Ereboniya.
Ispytayte tri razlichnye syuzhetnye linii i pereklyuchaytes mezhdu nimi v lyuboe vremya s pomoshchyu sistemy Crossroads. Krome togo, otkroyte dlya sebya pobochnye epizody, chtoby polnostyu raskryt personazhey i mir Zemurii.

title: Final Fantasy Legend 1 / 2 / 3 Collection of Saga [NSP][ENG]
description:
The first Game Boy RPG to sell over a million units and the memorable first installment of the series: THE FINAL FANTASY LEGEND.
A title that gained popularity through its refined gameplay system and the journey through a  diverse world: FINAL FANTASY LEGEND II.
A unique story that travelled across time that  featured   a new and an innovative character leveling system.: FINAL FANTASY LEGEND III. 

Experience the origins of the SaGa series with the COLLECTION OF SaGa FINAL FANTASY LEGEND, the first complete port of these hugely popular titles.

The collection includes new enhancements like  high-speed mode as well as features unique to the Nintendo Switch, such as adjustable screen magnification and game screen background customization. Featuring   compatibility with, of course, handheld mode, but also with TV mode and tabletop mode. Furthermore, this game also revives the nostalgia of playing the original by enabling vertical usage of the console after removing the Joy-Con™. Take your collection on the go with handheld mode, share your journey with your Nintendo Switch in TV mode, or remove the Joy-Con and turn your Nintendo Switch vertically for a retro Game Boy experience.

title: The Legend of Dark Witch + DLC, Episode 1-2-4 [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Kristally Seyga otdavali svoyu silu lyudyam, no kto-to pokhitil ikh.

Posle ischeznoveniya kristallov mir pogruzilsya vo tmu. Vozmite na sebya rol temnoy vedmy Zizu i vernite propavshie kristally Seyga.

The Legend of Dark Witch — eto dvukhmernyy platformer. Pobezhdaya bossov, Zizu mozhet popolnit svoy arsenal novymi atakami. Ey prigoditsya kazhdaya ataka, esli ona sobiraetsya spasti mir.

-Magicheskiy mir s prekrasnoy grafikoy.
-Srazhaytes i uluchshayte sposobnosti Zizu.
-Raznoobraznye urovni, kotorye stanut dostoynym ispytaniem.
-Dopolnitelnye bonusy za povtornoe prokhozhdenie igry.
-Tri urovnya slozhnosti.

title: Battle Princess Madelyn + Royal Edition [NSZ][ENG]
description: Battle Princess Madelyn - eto igra, kotoraya sleduet za puteshestviem molodogo rytsarya v obuchenii, Madlen i ee prizrachnoy domashney sobaki, Friti. Oni otpravilis v puteshestvie, chtoby spasti svoe korolevstvo i semyu ot lap zlogo volshebnika.

title: The Library of Babel [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
受Jorge Luis Borjes的同名短篇小說啟發，《巴別圖書館》將帶領你走進人類滅絕2萬年後的世界。在這個世界裡，先進的機器人統治著一切，但它們對「神秘造物主」的事情知之甚少。這裡的一切都是那麼井然有序，直到機器人們發現了這麼一個圖書館，那裡收藏著有關過去、現在和未來的所有書籍，這也預示了即將而來的騷動。 

玩家在遊戲裡扮演探索者Ludovik，因為一樁謀殺案而被派遣去巴比倫進行調查。在毫無預警的情況下，巴比倫宣布進入緊急狀況，Ludovik發現自己正身處危險之中。他將根據兇手留下的蛛絲馬跡，探查巴別圖書館突然被封鎖的秘密！ 

在《巴別圖書館》的世界裡，你可以看見廣闊的叢林、寺廟廢墟並與眾多機器居民們互動。你將體驗一場危機四伏，奇妙引人的冒險，與一段精心安排，令人深思何謂無限的故事。 

◆ 絢麗的2D手繪世界，荒蕪卻充滿未來氣息； 

◆ 運用智慧與靈活潛行避開致命障礙和危險的敵人； 

◆ 復古的對話與背包系統，再現九十年代的冒險遊戲；

◆ 神秘又富有哲學感的科幻故事，靈感源於《巴別圖書館》和《現代啟示錄》

title: MotoGP 24 [NSP][ENG]
voice_lang: 英语, 法语, 德语, 意大利语, 葡萄牙语, 西班牙语
description:
挑戰你在MotoGP™、Moto2™、Moto3™與MotoE™等領域的技術實力，並沉浸在精彩無比的2024年旅程中。體驗官方陣容與賽道的刺激感，MotoGP™24限定！

充滿變化的職業生涯
踏上征途成為MotoGP™的傳奇人物，並締造屬於你自己的史詩故事。從默默無聞的新手，一路耕耘躍升成為斬獲無數勝利的大人物，要開創什麼樣的道路由你自己決定。與對手同場較勁一拚高下、累積聲望，並讓你最喜歡的車隊歷史留名。

等等，精彩的還不只這些！隨著新賽季的到來，維修站的工作人員也迎來全面性的改變。在劃時代的車手市場登場之後，現在車手能夠在車隊之間轉調，讓玩家能夠自由變換陣容，也讓競賽多了更多不確定性的刺激感。

MotoGP™遊戲體驗
你剛才抄捷徑了嗎？還是說AI有不尋常的接觸？在MotoGP™ Stewards的監督下，違反規則的玩家都將面臨嚴峻後果。我們會負責促進MotoGP™24公平競爭的環境，並對違反規則的人進行懲罰，毫無例外！

自訂遊戲
無論你是喜歡尋求刺激感的職業選手，還是初出茅廬的新人，MotoGP™24都竭誠歡迎你的加入！我們將透過MotoGP™24 Academy與神經輔助系統一路輔助你。另外我們還要介紹這次的全新夥伴：適應性難度。這個機制能夠根據你的技術實力與戰績為你量身打造最適合的遊戲體驗，讓你享受在每一場競速比賽中！

展示風格
我們推出四個畫質編輯功能：貼紙、車手貼紙、數字與安全帽，改善你的MotoGP™遊戲體驗，帶你以華麗的姿態瀟灑穿過終點線！

title: OpenXcom (移植版 Open XCOM: X-Com Enemy Unknown UFO Defense i Terror From the Deep) [NSP][RUS/Multi35]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 35]
description:
X-COM: UFO Defense (s angl. v SShA — «Komanda Iks: Zashchita ot NLO», v Evrope byla pod nazvaniem UFO: Enemy Unknown («NLO: Vrag nevedom») — kompyuternaya videoigra, razrabotannaya kompaniey Mythos Games, izdannaya v marte 1994 goda MicroProse dlya PK MS-DOS i Amiga i v 1995 godu dlya konsoli PlayStation.
Iznachalno byla razrabotana Dzhulianom Gollopom v kachestve sikvela Laser Squad, igry 1988 goda ot Mythos Games. X-COM sochetaet zhanry simulyatora stroitelstva i upravleniya, poshagovoy strategii i takticheskoy rolevoy igry. Igrok vypolnyaet rol komandira X-COM — taynoy mezhdunarodnoy voenizirovannoy organizatsii, zashchishchayushchey Zemlyu ot inoplanetnogo vtorzheniya. Vo vremya poshagovykh takticheskikh missiy porucheno otdavat prikazy otdelnym boevym edinitsam X-COM, nakhodyashchimsya na pole boya, v strategicheskom zhe masshtabe upravlyaet issledovaniem i razrabotkoy novykh tekhnologiy, stroit i rasshiryaet bazy X-COM, upravlyaet finansami i personalom organizatsii, i nakonets, kontroliruet deyatelnost NLO i reagiruet na neyo. Proekt poluchil khoroshie otzyvy i byla kommercheski uspeshnoy, zavoevav populyarnost sredi poklonnikov strategiy; neskolko izdaniy vklyuchili X-COM: UFO Defense v spiski luchshikh videoigr za vse vremya, vklyuchaya IGN, nazvavshiy eyo v 2007 godu luchshey PK-igroy vsekh vremyon.
12-go dekabrya 1998-go goda predstaviteli naibolee ekonomicheski razvitykh stran mira sobralis na sekretnom sobranii v Zheneve. Na povestke sobraniya stoyal odin vopros: sozdanie mezhdunarodnogo podrazdeleniya po borbe s inoplanetnoy ugrozoy.

title: Luna The Shadow Dust [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
在現實與魔法的邊緣,矗立著一座古老的高塔,塔中居住的名為守月人的魔法師們,肩負著從遠古洪荒時代便被授予的神聖職責—— 維持世界萬物間光明與黑暗的能量平衡。然而有一天,一場意外的突然降臨,打破了這長久的寧靜。隨著夜空中月亮的突然消失, 封印於黑夜中的暗魘頓時充斥了整個世界, 眼看一切都即將被籠罩在永恆的混沌之中。
從塔底的昏迷中醒來後，為了找回自己丟失的記憶並發掘導致那意外背後的真相，遊戲的主角小男孩將由此和玩家一起，與他的神秘小伙伴一道， 展開一段充滿未知的冒險之旅。

Vam pridetsya polagatsya na svoyu intuitsiyu i vsevozmozhnye metody rassledovaniya, chtoby rasputat klubok intrig i izbezhat smertelno opasnykh posledstviy.

Issleduyte dva mira: tot, kotoryy vy znaete i alternativnuyu realnost, nakhodyashchuyusya za Zerkalnym zalom. Otkroyte sekret drevnego sushchestva, izvestnogo kak Dyavol. Otkroyte istoriyu neschastnykh vlyublennykh i ne dayte Dyavolu izbavitsya ot magicheskikh tsepey i vtorgnutsya v nash mir.

title: Scarlett Mysteries: Cursed Child [NSZ][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
NAKhODITE PODSKAZKI, KOTORYE PRIVEDUT K OTTsU!
Geroinya pytaetsya nayti svoego ottsa, chto privodit ee na vokzal okolo osobnyaka baroneta Stimayra i zabroshennoy fabriki.

ISPOLZUYTE SVOI OSOBYE SPOSOBNOSTI!
Skarlet obladaet unikalnym darom, kotoryy pozvolyaet ey videt, gde byval ee otets v proshlom.

REShAYTE GOLOVOLOMKI V VIKTORIANSKOM OSOBNYaKE!

UZNAYTE PRAVDU O SVOEM TEMNOM PROShLOM!
Chto svyazyvaet geroinyu i semyu Stimeyerov? Kakie syurprizy ugotovila sudba dlya tainstvennoy naslednitsy? Pomogite Skarlet uznat pravdu!

title: Skyland: Heart of the Mountain [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
V mire, pokoyashchemsya na plechakh spyashchikh gigantov, vam predstoit vmeste so svoey sestroy Adrianoy predotvratit strashnuyu katastrofu, grozyashchuyu istrebit vse zhivoe. Otkroyte istoriyu zabytoy tsivilizatsii, spasite zhiteley Nebesnykh zemel i razgadayte taynu smerti vashego ottsa.

Zemli nevedomogo drevnego mira peresokhli i stali mertvymi iz-za yadovitykh ispareniy. Vyzhivshie bezhali i poselilis na plechakh spyashchikh gigantov. Tak zarodilas novaya protsvetayushchaya tsivilizatsiya. 

No odnazhdy v Nebesnye zemli prishla beda. Lyudi stali bessledno ischezat, i vyyasnyaetsya, chto eto mozhet byt svyazano s tragicheskoy smertyu vashego ottsa. Etu taynu predstoit razgadat vam vmeste s komandoy dirizhablya "Solovey". 

Obedinite usiliya so svoey sestroy Adrianoy, chtoby uznat prichinu smerti ottsa i sekrety drevney tsivilizatsii, sformirovavshey etot mir. Vperedi zhdut vragi vo glave s tainstvennym Belom-de-Sol i dazhe voprosy o suti samoy zhizni. 

Kuda by ni zavela vas eta doroga priklyucheniy, pomnite, chto Nebesnye zemli uzhe nikogda ne budut prezhnimi.

title: Sigma Theory [NSZ][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
"ISTORIYa
V blizhayshem budushchem budet soversheno otkrytie s izmeneniem samogo podkhoda k nauke. Ono obeshchaet revolyutsionnye novye tekhnologii. Mirovye lidery ponimayut, chto teper smogut unichtozhit globalnuyu finansovuyu sistemu, zakhvatyvat tselye strany ili dazhe poluchit dostup k bessmertiyu.
Odnako eto otkrytie, poluchivshee nazvanie ""Teoriya Sigmy"", mozhet byt ispolzovano tolko neskolkimi uchenymi. Vy vstali vo glave podrazdeleniya ""Sigma"" v vashey strane. Vasha tsel - obespechit preimushchestvo vashey natsii, vooruzhennoy vsemi dostizheniyami ""Sigmy"", pered drugimi stranami.
Chtoby dostich etogo, u vas budut samye moshchnye resursy: elitnye agenty, peredovye takticheskie bespilotnye drony, sovremennye nauchnye razrabotki i, konechno zhe, vashi sobstvennye navyki v diplomatii.
Eto kholodnaya voyna, v kotoroy chelovechestvo dolzhno protivostoyat svoemu budushchemu.

Luchshiy shpionskiy simulyator
Pokhodovye shpionskie operatsii. Zakhvatite mir rukami svoikh spetsagentov. Soblaznenie, shantazh, intrigi, vzlom... V etoy igre ne byvaet zapretnykh ili nechestnykh priemov.
Dinamichnaya podacha syuzheta. Vystraivayte otnosheniya s bolee chem sotney personazhey: lobbistami, boevikami, politikami... Zaklyuchayte soyuzy, lovchite ili ustranyayte neugodnykh - reshenie za vami.
Polevye operatsii. Rukovodite pokhishcheniem klyuchevykh figur i pomogayte svoim agentam ukhodit ot pogoni po ulitsam mirovykh stolits, polagayas na skrytnost ili na grubuyu silu. Tak ili inache, ikh zhizni budut v vashikh rukakh."

title: Out There: Omega The Alliance [NSP][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Out There – otmechennaya razlichnymi nagradami kosmicheskaya issledovatelskaya igra, v kotoroy vasha zadacha – popytatsya vyzhit v odinochku v dalekom neizvedannom ugolke Galaktiki, uluchshaya svoy korabl i rasporyazhayas dostupnymi resursami. Kosmos — mesto neprivetlivoe; na kazhdom shagu vas zhdut priklyucheniya, polnye zagadok i opasnostey. Vy ne tolko vstretite drugie razumnye tsivilizatsii, no i stolknetes s drevnimi silami, ot kotorykh budet zaviset ne tolko vasha sudba, no i uchast vsego chelovechestva.

ChTO NOVOGO V OUT THERE: Ω THE ALLIANCE?
Te, kto uzhe znakom s Out There, naydut v Out There: Ω The Alliance mnogo novogo dlya sebya: tri novykh korablya, bolee 30 interaktivnykh istoriy, novye trekhmernye landshafty planet, zadaniya na soprovozhdenie inoplanetyan, novuyu tekhnologiyu «Kokon» i eshche odnu kontsovku.

OSOBENNOSTI: 
• Neprostoe i neveseloe strategicheskoe puteshestvie po glubinam kosmosa
• Protsedurnaya generatsiya galaktiki garantiruet: kazhdaya igra budet nepokhozha na predydushchuyu 
• Epicheskiy syuzhet s pyatyu razlichnymi kontsovkami
• 13 kosmicheskikh korabley s razlichnymi svoystvami
• Sozdanie poleznykh veshchey iz podruchnykh materialov po inoplanetnym tekhnologiyam
• Vstrechi s inoplanetnymi formami zhizni i izuchenie ikh yazyka
• Boev i vragov zdes net voobshche – lish vy i besposhchadnyy kosmos
• Fantasticheskaya grafika v stilistike klassicheskikh komiksov
• Zabotlivaya adaptatsiya originalnogo igrovogo protsessa dlya Nintendo Switch™

title: Vlad Circus: Descend Into Madness [NSZ][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
V Vlad Circus: Descend into Madness vy otkroete dlya sebya istoriyu, polnuyu tayn i boli, istoriyu, gde kazhdaya ten skryvaet v sebe zaputannuyu taynu ili zloveshchuyu ugrozu, i nikto ne zastrakhovan ot tragedii.
 
Pogruzites v, ledenyashchuyu ot uzhasa krov, istoriyu tsirka urodov 1920-kh godov, kotoryy sgorel dotla, i pereizobretenie novogo tsirka. Sleduyte za izmuchennym Oliverom Millsom, izo vsekh sil pytayushchegosya sbezhat i vyzhit.
 
Okunites v pikselnuyu grafiku, vyzyvayushchuyu priyatnuyu nostalgiyu, i okunites v prorabotannye dialogi i zvukovoy dizayn.
 
 ● Zakruchennyy psikhologicheskiy khorror s nezabyvaemym finalom
 ● Elementy golovolomok i vyzhivaniya
 ● Osobnyak-labirint iz bolee chem 50 lokatsiy
 ● Ocharovatelnaya pikselnaya grafika i zavorazhivayushchaya sistema 2D-osveshcheniya

title: The Amazing American Circus [NSZ][RUS/Multi4]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 4]
description:
Vash velichayshiy strakh — bezrazlichie publiki. Vashe vernoe oruzhie — oslepitelnyy uspekh. Vasha armiya — tsirkachi. Vstrechayte, tsirk uzhe v gorode!
V igre The Amazing American Circus vy s nulya vozvedyote tsirkovuyu imperiyu. Na puti k uspekhu vam vstretyatsya kak soperniki iz ploti iz krovi, tak i personazhi amerikanskogo folklora. Stav novoispechyonnym vladeltsem malenkogo zanyukhannogo tsirka, so vremenem vam pridyotsya srazitsya s velikanami industrii, takimi kak bratya Ringling i F. T. Barnum. Smozhete li vy ikh oboyti? 

Kolesite po SShA
Kogda-to Soedinyonnye Shtaty byli molodoy i bystro razvivayushcheysya stranoy, granitsy kotoroy medlenno, no verno razdvigali poselentsy... Radi vnimaniya publiki shoumenam prikhodilos pokryvat bolshie rasstoyaniya. Vy posetite mesta, o kotorykh znaet ves mir, i poznakomites s istoricheskimi lichnostyami, stavshimi chastyu naslediya amerikanskogo tsirka. 

Razvlekayte publiku!
Tsirkovoe shou prokhodit v vide osoboy kartochnoy dueli mezhdu vami i publikoy. Vy budete borotsya so skukoy zriteley, a vashim oruzhiem stanut predstavleniya i tryuki. Vdumchivo vybirayte karty i poprobuyte razgadat stremlenie tolpy. To, chto kazhetsya interesnym v yuzhnoy glubinke, mozhet ne srabotat na promyshlennom severe!

Sobirayte unikalnuyu truppu!
Vam, kak vladeltsu brodyachego tsirka, zhiznenno neobkhodimo iskat novykh chlenov truppy, esli vy nadeetes obognat konkurentov. Na puti ot odnogo okeana do drugogo vy soberyote ekzoticheskuyu komandu strannykh lichnostey, kotorye budut vystupat na vashikh shou, no smozhete li vy davat luchshie predstavleniya? 

Vozglavte i rasshiryayte svoy tsirk!
The Amazing American Circus sozdayot unikalnuyu smes rolevoy igry, ekonomicheskogo simulyatora i kartochnoy igry. Sobirayte silnuyu kolodu kart, uluchshayte kharakteristiki svoey truppy i upravlyayte tsirkovym karavanom. Otkryvayte novye furgony i poluchayte dostup k novym navykam, usileniyam i predmetam.

title: Circus Electrique [NSP][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Nazvannaya v chest populyarneyshego razvlecheniya v vo vsem alternativnom Londone, Circus Electrique obedinyaet syuzhetnuyu rolevuyu igru, strategiyu i upravlenie tsirkom v uvlekatelnoe stimpank-priklyuchenie. Obychnye zhiteli Londona ni s togo ni s sego prevratilis v zlobnykh ubiyts, i lish talantlivym artistam Circus Electrique pod silu ostanovit eto sumasshestvie. V etoy «velichayshey kampanii v istorii» vam predstoit srazhatsya v poshagovykh boyakh protiv spyativshikh polismenov, bezumnykh moryakov, agressivnykh fif i drugikh personazhey Viktorianskoy epokhi. Nevidannaya prezhde sistema predannosti v Circus Electrique budet vliyat ne tolko na povedenie artistov v boyu, no i na tsirkovye vystupleniya v pereryvakh mezhdu geroicheskimi pokhozhdeniyami v shesti rayonakh.

Osobennosti igry:
Iskrometnye rolevye boi
Uznayte, na chto sposobny silachi, ukrotitelnitsy ognya, eskapisty, klouny i drugie artisty klassicheskogo tsirka. Vas zhdut 15 arkhetipov, kazhdyy so mnozhestvom taktik. Soberite idealnyy otryad i dayte otpor bezumnym vragam.

Samoe grandioznoe shou Londona v stile stimpank
Pust v gorode bushuet khaos, a predstavleniya po raspisaniyu! Vernite tsirku byluyu slavu, nanimaya i treniruya talantlivykh artistov so vsego sveta. Ot ikh navykov, otnosheniy drug s drugom i predannosti vam zavisit vyruchka ot predstavleniya, a vam prigoditsya kazhdyy shilling — ne tolko dlya trudnoy zadachi Amelii, no i vyplat artistam, inache oni zagrustyat.

Nebyvalyy tsirk
Udivitelnyy mir, vdokhnovlennyy vintazhnymi tsirkovymi afishami, arkhetipami Viktorianskoy epokhi i klassicheskim stimpankom, zovet navstrechu priklyucheniyam.

title: Stories Untold [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
《未訴之事》是一款敘事驅動的實驗性冒險遊戲，它將這種遊戲類型轉變為完全獨特的作品。結合經典文字冒險、點擊式冒險等多種形式，4 個短篇故事結合打包成一本神秘的選集，被描述為“一個奇妙、迷人的互動式視覺敘事典範”（Telegraph 5/5）自發布以來獲得了廣泛的好評。

該遊戲將80年代復古懷舊、創新和實驗性冒險遊戲玩法以及緊張的生理恐怖結合在一起，創造出“今年你可以玩的最迷人、最獨特的故事之一”（GameSpew 9/10）。

《未訴之事》由 No Code所開發，它是一家總部位於格拉斯哥的前3A級開發團隊，由 Jon McKellan（異形：孤立）和Omar Khan所領軍。

遊戲特點：

四段獨特的故事，具有各自的設定、遊戲過程與機制。

遊玩燒腦的文字冒險，處理無線電傳輸，並對詭異的文物進行實驗。

華麗的復古美學帶回生動的回憶，或一瞥過去的形影。

超群的電子合成恐怖配樂，靈感來自80年代的恐怖配樂。

解鎖成就，發現敘事秘密。

類型跳脫：從心理恐怖，到緊張的神秘和恐怖的科幻；《未訴之事》是真正的“4個故事，1個噩夢”。

title: Void Terrarium 2 [NSZ][ENG]
description: Ot razrabotchikov v Nippon Ichi Software vykhodit vtoroy vypusk serii Void Terrarium! S cloudAI pobezhdennym i Toriko spasen ot opredelennoy konchiny, novaya smertelnaya bolezn snova ugrozhaet ee blagopoluchiyu. Chtoby spasti ee, prisoedinyaytes k Robbie i otpravites v proshloe, chtoby opredelit lekarstvo.

title: Void Terrarium + DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description: V mire, zarazhennom toksichnymi gribami, vybroshennyy robot dlya tekhobsluzhivaniya nakhodit odinokuyu chelovecheskuyu devushku sredi vybroshennogo musornogo barakhla na svalke. Chtoby obespechit ee vyzhivanie, robot i spisannyy II, izvestnyy kak factoryAI, dolzhen sozdat dlya nee ubezhishche v terrariume.

title: Wonder Boy: Asha In Monster World [NSZ][ENG]
description:
一個名叫雅莎的少女和她的神秘小伙伴佩佩羅古的冒險即將開始!
共同克服各種動作關卡，拯救危在旦夕的怪物世界!

■故事
這裡是怪物世界。
剛剛成為戰士的少女雅莎，卻被捲入了一場影響世界存在的嚴重事件中。四個靈魂被入侵者俘虜了，他們打算把這個世界據為己有。受女王普拉普利爾的命令去拯救神靈，雅莎與她在王都拉帕達納遇到的神秘生物佩佩羅古一起踏上了冒險之旅。雅莎與佩佩羅古聯手克服各種困難。他們兩人能否拯救世界？

■輕巧易玩的側滾動作遊戲
動作快而脆，但它的調校很容易重試，讓人很容易重複挑戰。

■抓住它！扔！我的藍哥們，佩佩羅古。
這款遊戲的特點是與神秘生物 "佩佩羅古"的各種行動。你可以享受為每個場景準備的獨特動作，比如在緊緊抓住佩佩羅古的同時進行滑翔和雙跳，並按下位於遠處的開關。

■各個行動階段
高原、火山、冰雪世界、天空... ...
讓我們和佩佩羅古一起跑遍各個領域。

■探索浩瀚的世界!
浩瀚的世界，充滿了未知的遭遇、事件和發現。即使你已經清除了一個階段，如果你再次訪問它，你可能會發現一些東西。

■發力攻堅，突破難題。
通過獲得物品和裝備，可以加強自己的攻擊力和防禦力。準備好面對強大的敵人吧。

90年代動作RPG大作《怪物世界IV》的工作人員齊聚一堂，全面重製! 欣賞《神奇男孩・雅莎在怪物世界》重生，新的視覺效果和新的聲音與時代調和。

title: Unexplored [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Pogruzites v glubiny Podzemelya Roka, ukradite amulet Yendora, kotoryy okhranyaet besstrashnyy drakon, i ostantes v zhivykh!
Unexplored — prostaya, no slozhnaya roguelike-igra, zavoevavshaya priznanie igrokov revolyutsionnoy tekhnologiey generatsii urovney. 

Issleduyte opasnye podzemelya, sozdavayte magicheskie predmety, razgadyvayte golovolomki i srazhaytes s sotnyami vragov.
 
V Unexplored: Unlocked Edition vkhodit sama igra i tri nabora DLC: Mithril Run, Ripley Run i The Dark Ritual. 
 
Osobennosti
Issleduyte postoyanno menyayushcheesya podzemele, v kotorom kazhdyy raz vse po-novomu. 
Srazhaytes v blizhnem boyu s goblinami, trollyami, skeletami, drakonami i mnozhestvom drugikh sushchestv i bossov. 
Besshumno kradites po podzemelyu v stels-rezhime.
Neobychnyy igrovoy protsess s mnozhestvom taktik. 
Slozhnye zagadki — kazhdyy raz novye!
7 klassov personazhey.
Originalnyy saundtrek, plavno dopolnyayushchiy atmosferu igry.

title: Yesterday Origins [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Otkroyte dlya sebya noveyshee priklyuchenie ot Pendulo Studios, sozdateley serii Runaway!

1481. Yunogo Dzhona unizhayut i publichno tashchat po ulitse. On obvinen v koldovstve ispanskoy inkvizitsiey i broshen v tyurmu, gde ego podvergnut pytkam

Pozzhe s nim proizoydet alkhimicheskaya transmutatsiya, blagodarya kotoroy on obretet bessmertie. No ne vse proshlo tak, kak predpolagalos. Poetomu posle kazhdogo voskresheniya Dzhon teryaet vsyu pamyat o sebe.

500 let spustya, v nashi dni, Dzhon i Polin ishchut artefakt, neobkhodimyy dlya togo, chtoby vosproizvesti sataninskiy ritual. Vo vremya etogo rassledovaniya im pridetsya protivostoyat novym opasnym personazham, stremyashchimsya vyrvat u nikh ikh sekrety...

Prisoedinites k bessmertnym Dzhonu Yestedeyu i Polin Peti v igre Yesterday Origins i okunites v epicheskoe priklyuchenie v razlichnykh epokhakh i stranakh v etoy istorii, polnoy intrig i neozhidannykh povorotov syuzheta.

* Studiya Pendulo Studios: bolee 20 let v razrabotke igr.
* Originalnyy syuzhet, prokhodyashchiy v neskolkikh epokhakh.
* Sochetanie razlichnykh stiley: detektiv, triller, priklyucheniya, okkultizm.
* Originalnyy chernyy yumor, prisushchiy nashey studii.
* Bolee 10 razlichnykh mest dlya poseshcheniya i bolee 50 peyzazhey.
* Bolee 25 krasochnykh personazhey.
* Originalnyy saundtrek.

title: Dreamcutter [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Dreamcutter 是把來歷不明的神祕鐮刀，它能帶來誘人的獎勵和逃離此地的機會。但在你自己心中，又會有什麼奇妙的危機與怪異的際遇呢？《Dreamcutter》是一款刺激的橫系卷軸動作平臺遊戲，結合了風格殘忍的視覺小說 CG 場景，與口無遮攔的角色對話。你將扮演 Haley，和你的朋友 Lucia 一起探索 Haley 的潛意識中最黑暗的地方。

使用 Dream Combo 來疊加點數、蒐集錢幣來購買升級、用鐮刀勾住牆壁抵達更高的平臺、還能擺盪、練等、漂浮等等！在這如夢似幻的地方，無數誘人的時光等著你，但你夠活著記住這一切嗎？

特色：

• 在橫向轉軸的平臺關卡中奔跑、跳躍、揮舞鐮刀大砍四方！
• 善用神秘莫測的鐮刀 Dreamcutter，它不僅是武器、更是多功能的工具。
• 探索 Haley 內心深處最黑暗的角落，充滿多種誘人的驚喜！
• 隨著故事進行，享受如視覺小說般的劇情對白。
• 解鎖 2D 手繪畫風的誘人 CG 場景。
• 幫助 Haley 和 Lucia 逃出夢世界！

title: Blood [NSP][ENG]
description: Blood — legendarnyy tsinichnyy, atmosfernyy i zhestokiy shuter. Esli vam nravitsya mrachnaya atmosfera, zombi, vampiry i temnaya magiya, pripravlennye svintsovym gradom i litrami krovi, to Blood — eto dlya vas.

title: Felix The Reaper [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Feliks rabotaet v Ministerstve Smerti, a ego vozlyublennaya, Deva Betti, — v Ministerstve Zhizni. Feliks nadeetsya, chto, okazavshis v mire lyudey pod lichinoy Mrachnogo zhnetsa, on obyazatelno vstretitsya s ney. Glavnaya zadacha Feliksa na novom meste — obrekat lyudey na smert. A chtoby pokorit lyubov vsey svoey zhizni, on uchitsya tantsevat.

Poskolku Feliks mozhet dvigatsya tolko v teni, emu prikhoditsya manipulirovat okruzhayushchim mirom. K schastyu, Feliks, kak i drugie zhnetsy, sposoben upravlyat solntsem i menyat ugol padeniya teni. Tak on sozdaet dlya sebya neobkhodimye temnye tropinki. Feliks vynuzhden delat eto, chtoby vypolnyat syuzhetnye zadaniya, v kontse kotorykh lyudi umirayut. Ved vse dolzhno idti soglasno planam Ministerstva.

• Poprobuyte spravitsya s neordinarnymi golovolomkami.
• Pogruzites v uzhasno prekrasnyy mir etoy istorii.
• Vyberite dlya sebya melodiyu v pleere Feliksa iz repertuara bolee 10 indi-artistov.
• Soberite dostizheniya-cherepa, chtoby otkryt zadaniya na vremya.
• Posmotrite, kak Feliks osvaivaet novye dvizheniya, nad kotorymi rabotali professionalnye tantsory.

title: The Exit Project Backstreets [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
description:
你是否意識到自己身處一個非常奇怪的地方？周圍的一切看似正常而平凡，但仔細看看，你看到了什麼？

一步一步地，你又回到了起點。再試一次，仔細環顧四周。又回到了原點嗎？那麼你一定漏掉了什麼。重走一遍你的路，找出這個世界圖景中的異常之處。每個細節和每個矛盾都是打破這個無意義且令人恐懼的循環的關鍵。

這並不容易，但重要的是不要放棄並繼續尋找。答案總是在你面前。停下來，放鬆一下。除了你之外，還有人曾經進入這個奇怪的地方並走了出來。你也可以做到。

來看看 NOSTRA.GAMES 團隊推出的這款有趣新遊戲。

找到逃離這個奇怪地方的方法。

title: Klaus Lee Thunderballs [NSP][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
RETRO-CLASSIC
你記得克勞斯·李對吧？！不記得？唉，你不該忘記啊！他差點就成為比佛利山的警察，但後來在夏威夷應徵當私家偵探，然後百無聊賴的等著是否得到這份工作。他搬回到卡利，擔任沒沒無聞的特技演員，同時管理一支故障排除小組，但這支小組老是被一支更厲害的團隊搶走客戶。有一次，他幾乎要錯過紐約一家新創公司的工作面試，後來一位名叫雷德莫爾的傢伙得到了那份驅靈者的工作。
你知不知道克勞斯教過獨行俠開噴射機，打致命的沙灘排球？這只不過是他體驗人生的一點小點綴而已。克勞斯真的是超忙的啦！

FEATURES
- 有態度的經典精密平台遊戲
- 由我們殘酷的關卡設計師製作的120餘道關卡
- 使用方便的關卡編輯器打造你自己的關卡
- 與世界跨平台分享你的關卡作品
- 探索由使用者產生的無窮無盡的關卡

title: Neverending Nightmares [NSP][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Neverending Nightmares – psikhologicheskiy khorror, sozdannyy po motivam realnoy borby razrabotchika s dushevnoy boleznyu. V igre vy stanovites Tomasom, kotoryy probuzhdaetsya ot zhutkogo koshmara, no soznaet, chto vse eshche spit. Pogruzhayas vse glubzhe skvoz mnogochislennye sloi adskikh peyzazhey i videniy, on vynuzhden pryatatsya ot pugayushchikh prizrakov i skryvatsya ot svoikh vnutrennikh demonov. Tomasu predstoit vyyasnit, kakie iz etikh koshmarov sluzhat proyavleniyami ego sobstvennogo psikhologicheskogo sostoyaniya, a zatem ponyat, kakoy dolzhna byt realnost, kogda on nakonets-to ochnetsya.

* Zhutkie miry nochnykh koshmarov naveyany borboy s depressiey i nevrozom navyazchivykh sostoyaniy v realnoy zhizni.
* Cherno-beloe khudozhestvennoe oformlenie sozdaet mrachnuyu, tyagostnuyu atmosferu. 
* U vetvyashchegosya syuzheta est 3 sovershenno raznykh kontsovki.
* Sistema svetodinamiki pridaet vezdesushchey tme lichnostnye priznaki.
* Kompozitor Skayler Makglotlin, nominant MIGF, sochinil dlya igry vpechatlyayushchuyu, gnetushchuyu muzyku v stile «dark-embient».

title: Natsu-Mon 20th Century Summer Kid + DLC Broadcast Over Sunset (NatsuMon Vacation) [NSP][ENG]
developer: Millennium Kitchen, Kaz Ayabe, Toybox Inc.
description:
Tsirkovaya truppa priezzhaet v gorod Yomogi, zhivopisnyy yaponskiy gorodok, raspolozhennyy mezhdu gorami i okeanom. Stante synom tsirkovogo konduktora i nasladites osobennym letom, polnym ekshena i priklyucheniy! Zheludyovyy shuter — neveroyatno udobnyy instrument! Oglushayte nasekomykh metkimi vystrelami i dobavlyayte ikh v svoyu kollektsiyu. Teper on sovmestim s giroskopicheskim upravleniem!
Ves gorod Yomogi i ego okrestnosti — eto otkrytyy mir, kotoryy vy mozhete issledovat. Pogruzites v nostalgicheskie peyzazhi, napolnennye vysokimi oblakami, krasivymi zakatami, strekotaniem tsikad i tyoplym siyaniem nochnykh ogney domov. Vy mozhete otdokhnut v torgovom rayone, poslushat zhivuyu muzyku dnyom ili otpravitsya v zakhvatyvayushchee priklyuchenie. Vsyo zavisit ot vas. Khotite vzobratsya na vysokuyu krutuyu skalu? Ili prygat s odnoy kryshi na druguyu? Mozhet byt, poiskat spryatannyy dragotsennyy kamen v uedinyonnom meste? Nikakikh problem! Dazhe esli vy upadyote s ochen bolshoy vysoty, vsyo budet v poryadke, ved vy — glavnyy geroy etoy igry. Posmotrite na vsekh poymannykh vami nasekomykh, nazhav na nikh v menyu. Vy mozhete rassmotret ikh poblizhe, izuchiv svoy nabor dlya sbora nasekomykh. Kakaya krasivaya babochka!
Otpravlyaytes na rybalku v reku ili more! Pozhertvuyte redkikh nasekomykh i rybu v muzey dlya eksponatov! Ili zakazhite izyskannoe blyudo iz poymannoy ryby! Prisoedinyaytes k mestnomu detektivnomu agentstvu, vyrastite dikogo kabana, raskopayte okamenelosti, prokatites na poezde, zarabotayte... Zapisyvayte svoi ezhednevnye dela v svoy sobstvennyy vesyolyy fotodnevnik! Vo vremya letnego festivalya noch ozhivlyayut feyerverki i tantsy festivalya Bon. Vy sami reshaete, kuda otpravitsya. Vy dazhe mozhete pomoch organizovat feyerverk! A vo vtoroy polovine letnikh kanikul vam predstoit rukovodit vystupleniem tsirkovoy truppy. Kakaya ogromnaya otvetstvennost! Gotovy?
Sozdayte svoi sobstvennye nezabyvaemye vospominaniya o letnikh kanikulakh, napolnennykh volshebnymi vpechatleniyami! Ayabe zadumal igru kak «nostalgicheskoe priklyuchenie», chastichno osnovannoe na ego sobstvennykh letnikh kanikulakh v detstve. Posle vypuska Boku no Natsuyasumi silno khvalili za vizualnyy stil, nostalgicheskuyu atmosferu i khudozhestvennoe oformlenie, igra stala kultovoy kak vnutri svoey rodiny, tak i za rubezhom.

title: Rainbow Billy The Curse of the Leviathan [NSP][ENG]
description:
Rainbow Billy: The Curse of the Leviathan — dobryy priklyuchencheskiy 2,5D platformer-golovolomka s elementami RPG i lovley sushchestv. Eto priklyuchenie dlya vsey semi, gde vam predstoit vozvrashchat tsvet v nekogda yarkiy mir, chtoby spasti prichudlivykh sozdaniy! 

Rainbow Billy rasskazyvaet nestareyushchuyu istoriyu o vzroslenii, o peremenakh i tom, kak s nimi spravitsya, o prinyatii sebya i okruzhayushchikh! Poroy dlya togo, chtoby izmenit mir, dostatochno prostogo razgovora, sochuvstviya i umeniya posmotret na situatsiyu s drugoy tochki zreniya.

MIR, POLNYY ChUDES!
Temnye peshchery na zagadochnykh ostrovakh, taynye bukhty sredi burnykh morskikh vod... Issleduyte obshirnyy mir, v kotorom vas zhdut sokrovishcha, lovlya ryby (potomu chto rybalka dolzhna byt v kazhdoy khoroshey igre!), druzhba... i opasnosti!

GOLOVOLOMKI V PROSTRANSTVE!
V kazhdoy mestnosti polno zanimatelnykh golovolomok i sekretov, pozvolyayushchikh otkryvat novye oblasti!

DRUZhBA S ZANYaTNYMI SUShchESTVAMI!
Vam predstoit poznakomitsya so strannymi, no milymi sozdaniyami, kotorykh v igre bolee 60! Mirno vzaimodeystvuya s nimi, vy pomozhete etim milashkam! Soberite komandu dlya spaseniya mira!

VERNITE V MIR TsVET!
Raskraste cherno-belyy mir zanovo i pomogite druzyam nayti smelost byt soboy v etoy istorii o lichnostnom roste i empatii.

title: Bakeru (Action Packed the Tanuki the Great Oracle Calamity Festival) [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 可选机翻 来自 most2820 用于 v131072
description:
狸貓少年羽袈流的和風動作大冒險！

惡祭降臨日本！

作惡多端的天啟祭太郎率領祭典軍團在日本各地胡作非為。
狸貓族的少年「羽袈流」為了守護日本的和平，踏上巡遊全日本47都道府縣的冒險之旅！

■以日本的童話與傳說為舞台，精彩盛大的動作冒險！
融合現代日本與復古和風，打造出獨特的「童話日本」世界，帶來超過50個以上的關卡。

■用拿手武器「太鼓」痛快地戰鬥！
羽袈流的太鼓是狸貓族的祖傳秘寶，相傳有祛除邪氣的力量。
以簡單的遊玩操作，突破重重陷阱與敵手！

■變身成童話英雄！
取得童話英雄的變身許可證之後，羽袈流就能變身成不同的童話英雄。
變身成「金太郎」與「桃太郎」等著名的英雄豪傑，活用他們的特殊技能勇闖天下吧。

■中文版獨享追加要素！
・新招式：疾風迅打
・新招式：直排陀螺打
・新增要素：提燈強敵

title: Koa and the Five Pirates of Mara [NSP][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + optsionalnyy mashinnyy 来自 most2820
description:
Otpravlyaytes vmeste s polyubivsheysya vsem Koa i ee drugom Napopo v zakhvatyvayushchee puteshestvie po miru Mary! Peresekayte dikie ostrova, uvorachivaytes ot opasnykh lovushek i pobezhdayte samykh stra-a-a-ashnykh piratov v etoy priklyuchencheskoy igre.

Otkryvayte arkhipelag po chastyam. Ot peschanykh plyazhey do burlyashchikh vulkanov - zdes vy naydete mnozhestvo ocharovatelnykh i krasochnykh ostrovov, kazhdyy iz kotorykh polon sekretov i kollektsionnykh predmetov. Kazhdyy uroven otlichaetsya prekrasnym vizualnym oformleniem, bogatymi detalyami i glubinoy.

Rasslabtes i otdokhnite - ili napryagites i broste sebe vyzov! Koa i pyat piratov - eto zakhvatyvayushchee priklyuchenie dlya vsekh, ot novichkov do lyubiteley pogonyat.

title: Sable's Grimoire 1-3: a Dragon's Treasure, Man and Elf [NSP][ENG]
description:
Kogda Seybl byl prinyat v Akademiyu Magii Amadronii, on poschital, chto ego mechta stat vsemirno izvestnym issledovatelem magii nakonets-to smozhet osushchestvitsya.

K sozhaleniyu dlya Seybla, ego pervyy den v Amadronii bystro dokazyvaet emu, chto eto daleko ne tak. Igrayte za Seybla, nachinayushchego issledovatelya magii, po mere togo, kak on vtyagivaetsya v povsednevnuyu zhizn i problemy svoikh odnoklassnikov-polulyudey.

Smozhet li Seybl vyzhit v etoy yavno neblagopriyatnoy akademii? 

Kharakteristiki
* 6 glavnykh geroin devushek-monstrov s 5 raskhodyashchimisya putyami
* 400 tysyach slov s desyatkami variantov vybora
* 16 razlichnykh kontsovok, zavisyashchikh ot vashego vybora
* Soderzhit putevuyu kartu dlya vizualizatsii vashego vybora i proydennogo vami puti
* Kontrolnye tochki na putevoy karte pozvolyayut perezapustit igru posle prinyatiya klyuchevykh resheniy, dazhe esli vy ne sokhranyali igru
* Vsya originalnaya grafika i muzyka sdelany spetsialno dlya etoy igry

title: Vesta [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 机器翻译 来自 most2820
description:
故事設定於科技先進的末日宇宙中，VESTA結合了傳統的謎題和街機遊戲的挑戰，精心創造出一個迷人的故事。

你扮演Vesta，一個機智敏捷的6歲女孩，在一個荒涼的地下迷宮中醒來。在她的小幫手Bot和她的朋友Droid的幫助下，帶領Vesta通過一系列謎題以逃離巨大的機械體。

裝備，機器人，神秘，幽默，挑戰，樂趣和行動...... Vesta就是這樣，還有更多！

特色：

• 兩個角色--Vesta和Droid，兩個非常不同的角色，擁有獨特的技能。扮演Vesta，一個能夠管理能量的機智敏捷女孩。Droid則是一個強壯和強勁的機械人！利用他們獨特的能力以不同的方式去解決謎題！

• 超過30個關卡 - 解決每個級別的獨特挑戰。所有設置在不同的環境中，並對應各種物件進行互動：平台，傳送帶，艙口等等！

• 敵人 - 與無數機器人對手戰鬥，毫不猶豫地粉碎或將你炸成碎片！然後面對能夠真正測試你勇氣的強大巨頭！但要小心！每層都充滿了陷阱，和任何敵人都一樣危險！酸浴，激光和倒塌地板只是一些你必須克服障礙。時刻保持機智，否則或會成為迷宮的另一個受害者！

• 能源 - 這是VESTA世界的基本資源。找到它，管理它，回收它！

• 收集 - 通過隱藏的秘密和漫畫頁面發現世界，深入了解VESTA的故事。

title: Active Neurons 1 Puzzle Game / 2 / 3 Wonders Of The World [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
透過控制思想的力量，您必須給神經元充電。神經元的電荷越多，大腦就越健康。大腦越健康，人將過上充實的生活。

它可能看起來很簡單，但是並沒有看起來那麼簡單。要選擇運動的方向，思想的力量應該處於靜止狀態，因此正確使用每個級別上出現的障礙對於您來說很重要。

思考，做出決定，並尋找通往神經元的正確路徑，以便為它們充電。

我們的大腦就像沒有晶片的電腦一樣工作。神經元是神經系統的主要組成部分。它們以電訊號的形式從感覺器官發送和接收資訊，從而促進與大腦的溝通。

不要忘記為您的大腦充電！這正是您在遊戲中需要做的，同時在現實生活中為神經元充電！

特性：
-120個邏輯任務
-超過15種獨特的機制
-冥想音樂在遊戲中營造出額外的氛圍
-支援色盲模式

title: Loopers [NSP][ENG]
description:
LOOPERS is science fiction story told through the enthralling writing of Ryukishi07 and the fascinating visuals of Kei Mochizuki.
Follow an ensemble of young people as they try to escape a world in which they relive August 1st over and over again.
Enjoy a visual novel so full of friendship, love, madness, laughs, and emotion it'll leave you breathless!

Available in three languages!
The text can be set to Japanese, English, or Simplified Chinese (audio is in Japanese only). This includes in-game text, options, and the digital manual. Language settings can be changed at any time.

Summary
Tyler is a high schooler with only one thing on his mind—geohunting (GPS-assisted scavenger hunts). One day, while absorbed in a hunt during summer vacation, he and his friends find themselves embroiled in a mysterious phenomenon.
Fantasy and real life become intertwined. Is this the past or the present? Is it reality...or madness?
Sucked into an abnormality known as the Temporal Spiral, Tyler and his friends are forced to relive the same day over and over.
They soon meet others stuck in the same cycle. Along with the leader Simon and the mysterious Mia, this group call themselves the Loopers.
Will Tyler and the others find a way out, or are they doomed to remain in this never-ending loop forever?

*There are no choice-based story branching elements in this game.

Cast
Mia    VA: Sayaka Kaneko
Tyler    VA: Tomohito Takatsuka
Hilda    VA: Hiyori Kono
Leona    VA: Shiori Izawa
Simon    VA: Ryohei Kimura
Joe    VA: Yosuke Eto
Holly    VA: Hina Kino
Ritapon    VA: Anna Yamaki
*Fully voiced

title: Oxenfree [NSP][RUS (Mod.)]
interface_lang: 俄语 [RUS], lyubitelskiy 俄语 翻译 来自 Tolma4 Team
description:
Poluchivshiy priznanie kritikov umopomrachitelnyy kvest teper na Nintendo Switch™!

Oxenfree — eto misticheskiy triller o gruppe druzey, kotorye sluchayno otkryvayut razlom v prizrachnyy mir. Igrayte za Aleks, nakhodchivuyu buntarku-podrostka, kotoraya so svoim svodnym bratom Dzhonasom otpravlyaetsya na nochnuyu vecherinku na staryy voennyy ostrov. Vecherinka prevrashchaetsya v koshmar, kogda vy sluchayno otkryvaete prizrachnye vrata, sozdannye v temnom proshlom etogo ostrova. Vam reshat, kak postupat s proiskhodyashchim, kak vesti sebya s druzyami i zhutkimi sushchestvami, kotorykh vy vypustili. 

Vy opredelite kazhdyy povorot istorii Aleks, izuchaya ostrov Edvards, otkryvaya ego temnoe proshloe i izmenyaya sudby druzey.

• V Oxenfree mozhno igrat kak s sensornogo ekrana, tak i s kontrollera, pereklyuchayas mezhdu rezhimami na khodu.

• Noveyshie effekty HD Rumble sozdayut yarchayshee vpechatlenie ot Oxenfree.

• Blagodarya intellektualnoy sisteme dialogov syuzhet i vashi otnosheniya s drugimi personazhami menyayutsya s kazhdym prinyatym resheniem.

• Unikalnaya mekhanika radio pozvolyaet Aleks obshchatsya s tainstvennymi dukhami i upravlyat mirom vokrug nee.

• Vam predstoit razgadat mnozhestvo tayn, dremlyushchikh desyatiletiyami i tselymi pokoleniyami.

title: No Sleep for Kaname Date (From AI: The Somnium Files) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
網路偶像伊麗絲被外星人綁架了！？

伊麗絲被神祕飛碟綁架，陷入一場匪夷所思的密室逃脫遊戲。
在這樣的危機中，她唯一能依靠的人是──Psyncer「伊達 鍵」！

伊達一邊協助破解逃脫遊戲，一邊尋找伊麗絲的下落，並在調查過程中進行Psync，潛入了某位重要參考人的夢界。
「The Third Eye Game」究竟是什麼？
設法解開謎團，拯救伊麗絲吧！

◇ 搜查
利用伊達左眼的特殊功能收集線索，尋找伊麗絲的下落！
除了玩家熟悉的面孔，還將出現全新的角色！

◇ 夢界
探索重要參考人充滿荒誕色彩的夢界，揭開藏在內心深處的關鍵線索與秘密！

◇ 逃脫
在密室中探索，解開刺激的謎題。當突破常識找出真正的答案之時，通往逃脫的大門便將開啟──！

title: Motorsport Manager [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Igra Motorsport Manager for Nintendo Switch™ stala debyutom serii na etoy platforme. Vam predstoit oderzhat pobedu v devyati urovnyakh na mashinakh trekh razlichnykh klassov, sozdavaya i podgotavlivaya dlya etogo sobstvennuyu gonochnuyu komandu. Zalog pobedy v etom zakhvatyvayushchem simulyatore — strategicheskoe planirovanie i prinyatie vernykh resheniy pryamo v protsesse gonki.

Novyy gonshchik ne vnushaet doveriya? Ishchite novye talanty. Khotite uluchshit pokazateli avtomobiley? Sozdavayte i pokupayte novye komplektuyushchie. Vy upravlyaete vsem: avtomobilyami, inzhenerami, mekhanikami, sobstvennoy shtab-kvartiroy, sponsorami i ne tolko. Glavnoe, sledite za oborotom sredstv! Sumeete osvoit vse aspekty upravleniya gonochnoy komandoy? Sledite za denezhnym balansom, ispolzuya pri etom peredovye gonochnye tekhnologii, rasshiryayte svoyu imperiyu i dobivaytes otlichnykh rezultatov na trasse, chtoby vasha komanda vsegda ostavalas v poul-pozitsii.

EKSKLYuZIVNYE OSOBENNOSTI IGRY NA NINTENDO SWITCH™:
- Blagodarya 17 unikalnym marshrutam po vsemu miru, vklyuchaya eksklyuzivnuyu novozelandskuyu trassu dlya Nintendo Switch™, vam dostupny gonki v samykh raznykh chastyakh sveta.
- Trekhmernye gonki na Nintendo Switch™ otlichayutsya nevidannoy realistichnostyu blagodarya teksturam vysokogo razresheniya i graficheskim usovershenstvovaniyam.
- Vam dostupna polnotsennaya nastroyka kharakteristik lyubogo gonshchika, inzhenera ili mekhanika v komande: ot vneshnosti do kharaktera i navykov!
- Joy-Con™ i sensornoe upravlenie pozvolyat privesti komandu k triumfu kak v uyutnoy domashney obstanovke, tak i v doroge.

title: ShapeHero Factory (Shape Hero) [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
在一間安靜的小巷古老房子裡，空白的卷軸在書桌上攤開，激動人心的戰爭即將展開！和可愛的“小精靈”一起，繪製出你的英雄們，投入這場精彩的戰鬥吧！

《塗鴉英雄工廠》帶你進入一個魔法的世界。在這裡，你發現了封印在魔導書中的“大災厄”復蘇的跡象。為了拯救這個世界，你需要依靠那些誕生於魔法卷軸的小英雄們。與他們並肩作戰，重新封印“大災厄”！

* 遊戲系統
這是一款需要抵禦一波一波敵人的塔防遊戲。你需要完善工廠設施，實現小英雄的量產，阻止大門被破壞。

你無法給小英雄們下達命令。你能做的只有“建設工廠”這一件事。

每一波敵人都會比前一波更強。你將獲得的獎勵是種類豐富的設施，你要使用它們強化工廠，迎接敵人的攻擊。目標是在殘酷的戰鬥中生存，並打倒蟄伏在最深處的“大災厄”！

* 量產英雄!
將卷軸上的〇、△、□等圖形放置到傳送帶上進行組合，創造出各種不同的小英雄吧！每種圖形和顏色的組合都會帶來獨特的小英雄，像是人類、妖精，甚至更強大的盾兵。挑戰更多敵人，探索合成的樂趣！

* 守住大門!
“大災厄”藏在魔導書的深處，它的眷屬將試圖破壞大門，阻擋你的小英雄們前進。快來守衛大門，利用小英雄們的力量，擊退敵人，勇往直前，面對最終的挑戰！ 

* 工廠 × 輕肉鴿，面對無限挑戰!
每次戰鬥勝利後，你都將從隨機選項中獲得獎勵。是解鎖新設施，還是提升現有設施？每一次的選擇都將影響你的工廠建設，享受多樣的玩法和策略，創造屬於你自己的獨特工廠！

* 以「偉大學識」解放潛藏之力!
遊戲結束時，使用獲得的強化點數解鎖“淵博的知識”，獲取永久能力。通過不斷的挑戰和遊玩，你的力量將日益增強，成為真正的英雄！

快來《塗鴉英雄工廠》，和小精靈們一起踏上充滿樂趣與挑戰的冒險旅程吧！

title: Ibb and Obb [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
ibb & obb — eto kooperativnaya igra dlya dvukh chelovek v napolnennom golovolomkami mire, gde gravitatsiya rabotaet v dvukh napravleniyakh. Dobitsya uspekha smozhet tolko splochyonnaya komanda.

Vy mozhete kak igrat s drugom, sidya doma na divane, tak i nayti partnyora onlayn.

Padayte vverkh i prygayte vniz na protyazhenii 15 urovney, napolnennykh golovolomkami dvoynoy gravitatsii. Naydite 8 skrytykh mirov, kotorye budut nastoyashchim ispytaniem dlya vashikh novykh navykov, rabotayushchikh vopreki zakonam Nyutona.

Kazhdyy uroven imeet svoyu unikalnuyu melodiyu, sochinyonnuyu Kettel — priznannym avtorom tyoploy melodichnoy elektronnoy muzyki.

title: Alice Sisters [NSP][ENG]
description:
大山賊掳走了艾麗絲和她的姐妹的母親。請幫助艾麗絲和她的姐妹通過28個關卡，分佈在4個世界中拯救她們的母親，每個世界都有一個終極反派需要對抗！
通過切換角色單獨遊戲，或與2名玩家合作完成每個關卡。
每個姐妹都有自己的能力，艾麗絲可以跳上魔法蘑菇改變大小。她的小尺寸可以讓她穿過狹窄的空間，但要小心，因為她無法跳得很高或很遠！
艾麗絲的姐妹可以扔球擊退敵人或打破阻礙道路的石頭。
通過啟動正確的槓桿，正確的開關以及找到彩色鑰匙來打開不同的門，穿過各個關卡並解決謎題。
四種不同的遊戲模式可供玩家選擇：無死亡的簡單模式，普通模式，需要謹慎使用球投擲的謎題模式和有限生命的困難模式，讓遊戲具有重播價值！

title: GODS Remastered [NSP][ENG]
description:
Join the nameless warrior on a dangerous journey through four worlds to defeat the Great Guardians who have stolen the homes of the gods. As a reward you will receive immortality and a place in the eternal hall of fame…
Experience the 2D-action classic "Gods" by the legendary Bitmap Brothers in a new look! Exciting levels full of monsters and puzzles await you, which you can play either in the original pixel graphics or in a modern 3D mode with an extensive new soundtrack.

title: Touch Detective 1-2-3 the Complete Case Files [NSZ][ENG]
description:
S pribytiem v gorod konkuriruyushchego detektiva Normana Tusha, Makkenzi vynuzhdena raskryvat dela ranshe, chem eto uspeet eyo sopernik!
The Complete Case Files vklyuchaet v sebya vse originalnye igry «Touch Detective» i «Touch Detective 2» i dva bonusnykh keysa s uchastiem Fungi i obshirnuyu galereyu illyustratsiy iz vsey TD. Pomogite nashey geroine i eyo druzyam issledovat vse uliki, doprosit zhutkikh podozrevaemykh i razgadat odnu nelepeyshuyu zagadku za drugoy!..
V etu kollektsiyu takzhe vkhodit Touch Detective 3, samoe bolshoe priklyuchenie mladshego detektiva Makkenzi i eyo vernogo pomoshchnika, Fungi.

title: Not A Hero Super Snazzy Edition [NSZ][ENG]
description: Professionalnyy ubiytsa i po sovmestitelstvu glava izbiratelnogo shtaba Stiv zachishchaet gorod po prikazu svoego kandidata – prishedshego iz budushchego antropomorfnogo krolika po imeni BanniLord, pozhelavshego ballotirovatsya na post mera.

title: Detective Pikachu Returns [NSZ][ENG]
description:
「我是皮卡丘。雖然這麼說有點跩，但……我是個名偵探！」
這次登場的皮卡丘跟平常有點不一樣⁉不但愛喝咖啡，神情舉止也跟大叔沒兩樣。明明擺出一副高高在上的態度和言行，卻總是讓人討厭不起來，這隻會說人話還自稱「名偵探」的皮卡丘（CV：山寺 宏一）和牠的搭檔青年提姆（CV：上村 祐翔），在寶可夢與人類共生的城市「萊姆市」中，與城市裡的寶可夢一起合力解開各種事件的謎團。

■故事
在「偵探搭檔」提姆和皮卡丘尋找提姆失蹤的父親・哈利之際，發生了「寶石竊盜事件」。以這個事件為契機，2人逐步迫近重大謎團的真相。
為什麼哈利會失去了蹤影？
為什麼皮卡丘只能跟提姆對話？
提姆和皮卡丘又能夠找到哈利嗎？
故事最終會走向怎樣的結局……

■借助寶可夢們的力量調查事件
「打聽」是調查事件時的基礎。提姆可從人類身上打聽，而皮卡丘則可從寶可夢身上打聽，蒐集證詞。當中也會有能發揮自己的特殊能力來協助調查的寶可夢。
卡蒂狗能用牠敏銳的嗅覺追蹤氣味。坐在卡蒂狗的背上在萊姆市四處穿梭，找出事件的證據吧。
達摩狒狒（伽勒爾的樣子）強而有力的拳擊連岩石也能粉碎，調查途中被障礙物擋住去路時便可借助牠的力量。
倫琴貓能夠透視牆壁的另一側，利用這個能力便可找出隱藏的線索，或是能隱秘地行動而不被發現。

title: The Game of Life 2 + DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Prepare to live a thousand lives in The Game of Life 2, the award-winning official sequel to the classic board game played by millions around the world. Gather your friends and family and dive into a bright, fun 3D world bursting with adventure!

The Game of Life 2 base game has everything you need to get started:
The Classic World board
3 x outfits unlocked
3 x avatars unlocked
2 x vehicles unlocked
3 x additional outfits to unlock
3 x additional avatars to unlock
2 x additional vehicles to unlock

Plus, as an added bonus, you get two free worlds to play in – the Fairytale Kingdom World and the Haunted Hills World! Each contains a new board, three unlocked outfits, three unlocked avatars, two unlocked vehicles, and eight additional unlockables (three more outfits, three more avatars and two more vehicles).

Spin the iconic spinner and set off on your life journey. You’ll be presented with decisions at every turn, altering your life path. Will you go to college immediately or drive straight into a career? Will you get married or stay single? Have kids or adopt a pet? Buy a house? Make a career change? It’s up to you!

Earn points for choices that bring you Knowledge, Wealth and Happiness. Win rich, maximise your Knowledge or Happiness, or go for a healthy mix of all three and come out on top!

HOW TO PLAY THE GAME OF LIFE 2:
1. When it’s your turn, spin the spinner to travel along your life path.
2. Depending on the space you land on, you’ll experience different life events and choices, such as buying a house, collecting your salary, or drawing an Action card!
3. At crossroads, you’ll have to make big life decisions, so choose wisely!
4. Your turn ends; it’s the next player’s chance to spin the spinner!

FEATURES
CUSTOMISE YOUR CHARACTER – Choose between the pink, blue or the purple peg. Select an outfit and make your peg your own. Browse a selection of cars, bikes and scooters and find a ride to suit your style.
NEW WORLDS – Live life in enchanted worlds! Every new world features new outfits, vehicles, jobs, properties and more! Buy worlds separately in-game, or buy the Ultimate Life Collection to unlock them all!
UNLOCK NEW ITEMS – Unlock new outfits and vehicles by playing the game and earning rewards!
CROSS-PLATFORM – Play with your friends and family, whatever their favourite gaming platform!

Live every life you’ve ever dreamed of in The Game of Life 2 – now on Nintendo Switch!

title: Death Mask (Secret Opera / Xuefeng Shan) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
這是一款融合了中國鄉村宗教儀式與謀殺懸疑的敘事遊戲。當民間信仰和現代恐怖相碰撞，你能揭示面具背後的真相嗎？

豐富而完整的故事篇幅，像一部互動小說的冒險。多元的互動選擇與支線故事，最終走向不同的故事結局。

調查玩法需要你不斷蒐集碎片訊息，體驗緊張刺激的搜索指證過程，一步一步破解這個謎！

title: Battle Brothers + 9 DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Battle Brothers — eto takticheskaya poshagovaya RPG, deystvie kotoroy razvorachivaetsya v surovom srednevekovom fantaziynom mire, gde vam predstoit upravlyat naemnicheskoy kompaniey. Vy reshaete, kuda otpravitsya, kogo nanyat ili s kem srazhatsya, kakie kontrakty brat i kak snaryazhat vashikh lyudey na prostorakh otkrytogo protsedurno sgenerirovannogo mira. Smozhete li vy privesti ikh k pobede cherez cheredu krovavykh bitv?

Igrovoy protsess imeet dve sostavlyayushchie: strategicheskaya karta mira i takticheskie srazheniya. Na karte mire vashe peremeshchenie nichem ne ogranicheno: vy mozhete puteshestvovat, chtoby zaklyuchat kontrakty, kotorye prinesut vam khoroshiy dokhod, nakhodit mesta, gde mozhno razzhitsya dobychey, stoyashchikh presledovaniya vragov ili goroda, gde mozhno popolnit zapasy i nanyat lyudey. Zdes zhe vy osushchestvlyaete upravlenie svoimi naemnikami, povyshaete ikh uroven i snaryazhaete v boy. Kak tolko vy stolknetes s vrazhdebnoy gruppoy, igra pereklyuchitsya na takticheskuyu kartu, gde i proiskhodit boy v vide detalnogo poshagovogo srazheniya.

Upravlyayte srednevekovoy naemnicheskoy kompaniey v otkrytom protsedurno sgenerirovannom mire.
- Primite uchastie v slozhnykh poshagovykh boyakh s istoricheskim snaryazheniem i zhestokimi raneniyami.
- Voskresheniya net. Vse personazhi, pogibshie v boyu, ostanutsya mertvymi — esli tolko ne vosstanut v vide nezhiti.
- Kazhdyy personazh imeet svoyu sobstvennuyu istoriyu i unikalnye talanty. Kak naschet zaikayushchegosya krysolova, zhadnogo okhotnika na vedm ili opustivshegosya spivshegosya aristokrata?
- Razvitie personazha ne ogranicheno strogoy klassovoy sistemoy. Kazhdyy geroy poluchaet opyt v boyu, mozhet povyshat uroven i priobretat moshchnye navyki.
- Snaryazhenie — nashe vsyo. Kazhdoe oruzhie daet vam unikalnye sposobnosti — razrubayte shchity toporami, oglushayte vragov palitsami, sozdavayte stenu iz kopiy s pomoshchyu pik ili raskalyvayte dospekhi boevym molotom.
- Vse protivniki imeyut unikalnoe snaryazhenie, umeniya i osobennosti povedeniya v boyu.
- Dinamichnaya sistema igrovykh sobytiy s atmosfernymi skhvatkami i neprostymi resheniyami za predelami polya boya.
- Tri krizisa na pozdney stadii igry — voyna dvoryanskikh domov, vtorzhenie zelenokozhikh i nashestvie nezhiti — dobavlyayut novuyu ugrozu.

title: Last Mage Survivors [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Survive night creatures and terrible monsters in this roguelite game. 

Let's see if you'll be able to resist so many attacks and endless hordes of enemies, being able to acquire a large amount of upgrades during the game. 

This is a surprising game worth playing and enjoying.

title: Test Expected Behaviour [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
您甚至可以控制時間。 但這有幫助嗎？
你成為了外星科學家手中的實驗老鼠。 你能離開太空實驗室嗎？ 透過數十個關卡和數百個謎題，不僅需要敏捷性和邏輯性，還需要一個特殊的裝置，讓你放慢、加快甚至停止時間。
你的命運取決於這次 .T.E.S.T 的結果。

title: King's Bird [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Sovershite pobeg v mir, spryatannyy tiranom, i uznayte pravdu o sobstvennoy svobode. King’s Bird — eto prekrasnaya igra s mekhanikoy, osnovannoy na inertsii. Ona sochetaet v sebe izlyublennyy platformer i tekhniku skolzheniya v vozdukhe, osnovannuyu na zakonakh fiziki.

· Igra obladaet osobennostyami, kakikh vy eshche ne vstrechali v svoikh lyubimykh platformerakh
· Dinamicheskaya fonovaya muzyka i zvuki, kotorye menyayutsya v zavisimosti ot togo, chto vy delaete
· Tekst v igre polnostyu otsutstvuet, a syuzhet raskryvaetsya cherez vizualnye obrazy i dvizhenie
· Pyat unikalnykh mirov, kotorye mozhno issledovat. Kazhdyy iz nikh polon yarkikh krasochnykh siluetov, vdokhnovlennykh kulturami mayya, Yugo-Vostochnoy Azii i Rima

title: Mr. Driller DrillLand [NSP][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
Populyarnaya priklyuchencheskaya golovolomka Mr. DRILLER DrillLand teper vykhodit i na Zapade dlya Nintendo Switch™!

Vy priglasheny v taynyy podzemnyy park razvlecheniy DrillLand!

• V pervoy igre Mr. DRILLER dlya Nintendo Switch™ vas zhdut uluchshennaya grafika i videovstavki v HD-razreshenii!

• U kazhdogo iz pyati attraktsionov DrillLand unikalnye pravila i igrovoy protsess.

• Na odnoy konsoli mozhet igrat do 4 chelovek srazu!

• Novyy legkiy rezhim dlya tekh, kto khochet ne spesha pogruzitsya v glubiny DrillLand!

title: Cricket Jae's Really Peculiar Game [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Cricket: Jae's Really Peculiar Game 是由 Studio Kumiho 製作的一款搞笑且溫馨的手繪動畫 JRPG。

在經歷了一場毀滅性的失敗後，Jae 願意做任何事情來修復過去。與你的新朋友一起，踏上通往 Yimmelia 大門的旅程，這是月球上一個傳說中的地方，據說可以實現任何願望。

這款 JRPG 從經典類型中汲取了靈感，但加入了多種新的遊戲玩法。你將探索森林、城市、搖滾音樂會等場所，體驗充滿樂趣和動態的旅程；沒有隨機遭遇戰，你可以衝刺並撞擊物體（甚至是人！）以獲得獨特的結果。你與人們的互動將影響遊戲事件和戰鬥。

戰鬥中包含計時攻擊，與出色的隊友合作進行特殊組合。積累能量槽，攻擊和防禦，並釋放驚人的連擊以獲得更好的獎勵！

title: Lynked Banner of the Spark [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + optsionalnyy mashinnyy 来自 most2820 用于 v196608
description:
時值 30XX 年，自然世界已經被邪惡的機器人大軍稱霸...但一切都還有希望。在你拯救一群叫做「和睦機」的機器人夥伴，並決定攜手合作後，你們即將建立起一個無所畏懼的友善社群，同心協力從零開始打造嶄新的未來。

Rogue-Life 玩法的角色扮演遊戲
《超能連結：星火戰旗》將充滿打擊快感的 Roguelite 要素，與極具深度和魅力的模擬生活玩法相結合。在這款充滿活力的 Rogue-Life 角色扮演遊戲中，戰鬥過程與自立發展同樣重要。在對抗充滿敵意的機器人大軍與強悍無比的頭目時，好好琢磨你的戰鬥技巧，並使用它們的零件和各種資源來擴張並升級你的基地。無論你是居家宅宅或是身經百戰的戰士，這裡有無數種方式可以貢獻一己之力：整座村莊通力合作才能拯救世界！

在合作模式或是單人模式強勢連結
獨自一人挑戰千變萬化的砍殺任務，或是以三人隊伍並肩作戰。但請稍等...你的和睦機夥伴也想要參一腳！玩家可以強化機器人，並招募它們以夥伴的身分加入戰鬥。夥伴在戰鬥中可施展各自的專屬能力、戰鬥風格、以及組合技攻擊來把敵人變成廢鐵！

各種武器和鉤鉤手
使用號稱「鉤鉤手」的可靠爪鉤來打爆敵人，還有一拖拉庫的強力武器任你挑選喔！在對抗敵人時，務必好好利用 10 種武器類別、超過 80 種變化改裝、豐富的永久進度系統、以及於任務期間出現的隨機升級選項，讓每次出任務都是截然不同的體驗。

打造繁榮的城鎮
召集機器人以及最多 5 位好友，大家一起齊心合作打造出最繁盛的地方社區。捕魚、收集小動物、採收作物、以及製作物品，讓你的家園獨一無二！除了讓你的城鎮變得更豐富之外，善用你收集到的資源來升級角色，發展出特殊能力和技巧來面對接下來的戰鬥。

妝點你的外觀
以極具深度的個人風格重建整個社會，其中包含多到數不清的外觀選項與裝飾品！

title: VOEZ [NSP][ENG]
description:
◆全世界下載次數突破1000萬次的新感覺節奏遊戲，在Nintendo Switch登場！
以多采多姿的樂曲與美麗繪圖震撼全世界的「Cytus」、「DEEMO」等作品
而嶄露頭角的台灣製作公司Rayark所打造，
全世界下載次數突破1000萬次的新感覺節奏遊戲「VOEZ」，
伴隨著僅於Nintendo Switch版追加的新樂曲，在家用主機上登場！

●各種風格、各種難度的樂曲
本遊戲收錄了日本・台湾等地的創作者製作的各種樂曲，樂曲收錄數達160首以上。
另外，各首樂曲都將有[Easy][Hard][Special]難度的譜面，
不管是高手還是初學者，都可以配合自己的實力享受本遊戲的樂趣。

◆隨著盒裝版的發售，新增支援Joy-Con功能
在VOEZ(Nintendo Switch版)盒裝版中，新增支援搖桿Joy-Con功能。
玩家以往只能用觸控來遊玩，現在起可使用控制器來操作，也能以「TV模式」遊玩。

◆以『蘭空鎮』為舞台的青春故事
本作的舞台是以台灣的宜蘭縣為主題的『蘭空鎮』。
「蘭空鎮」裡「蘭空高中」的六名少年少女組成了樂團，
故事會透過各個樂團成員的視點逐漸向外擴展。
在玩家演奏樂曲的過程中，樂團會隨著故事而有所成長，
他們的歌聲也會漸漸傳遍整個世界。
VOEZ獨特的美術風格以及富含魅力的樂曲，將帶給您不曾有過的美好體驗。

title: Real Myst Masterpiece Edition [NSZ][ENG]
description: It’s been 25 years since Myst became your world. This newly refreshed and rebuilt version is all the things you loved about Myst, but now you are free to investigate this strange world in your own way. You can explore anywhere. Pick your own path through the forest on Myst Island and seek shelter from the thunderstorm in Stoneship Age. Whether you’re visiting Myst Island for the first time, or you’ve been exploring the island for years - there’s never been a better reason to let the surrealistic Ages of realMyst become your world.

title: Sol Cresta + 4 DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
在這款不限形式的射擊遊戲中，駕駛 3 艘飛船從邪惡勢力手中解救太陽系！

白金工作室的 NEO-CLASSIC ARCADE 系列使用現代技術延續經典遊戲的精神與樂趣，實現此壯舉的第一個專案便是《Sol Cresta》。《Sol Cresta》採用經典射擊遊戲《Moon Cresta》和《Terra Cresta》的停靠與組合策略，並以「不限形式的停靠方式」機制強化策略。由天照號、月讀號和素戔嗚尊號組成的旗艦飛船大和號，可根據這三艘飛船的排列方式，來使用不同的攻擊招式。根據需求停靠、分解與重組飛船，是擊敗曼德勒侵略軍的關鍵。

曼德勒侵略太陽系期間，人類在他手中遭遇慘敗。人類失去衛星並遭驅離地球，只好一路撤退至海衛十二，也就是海王星的第十二號衛星。他們帶著最後的希望組成了太陽救援隊「SOL CRESTA」，並將太陽系的命運交給高科技停靠戰艦大和號。

・形式自由的停靠方式
大和號由 3 艘飛船組成。剛開始您只能靠一艘飛船緊急應戰，但挑選正確的物品就會有更多飛船前來幫您強化戰力！停靠與分離可以改變您的攻擊屬性，使用不同組合則可進入令人驚嘆的軍械庫。 

・令人興奮的經典 80 年代風格
《Sol Cresta》的音樂由傳奇晶片音樂作曲家古代祐三操刀，這款遊戲向早期《Cresta》的音效和視覺效果致敬，不只給您滿滿的懷舊感，也讓街機狂熱捲土重來。此外，本遊戲還提供時間限制、高分搶分模式和線上排行榜。 

・白金工作室的全新挑戰
白金工作室開發過《魔兵驚天錄》這種令人滿意且內容豐富的動作遊戲，要是他們嘗試製作射擊遊戲會上演什麼好戲呢？這就是答案。雖然視覺效果走經典風，但原創性、系統深度和遊戲玩法提供了嶄新且深奧的射擊體驗，且每次遊玩都能提升遊戲體驗。

title: Fairune Collection: Fairune / Fairune 2 / Fairune Origin / Fairune Blast [NSZ][ENG]
description:
擊敗怪物，解決地圖中各種謎題，
逐漸擴大探索區域的解謎動作RPG！

本作包含了 "Fairune"系列的四部作品!
包括「Fairune」「Fairune 2」
以及最初的作品「Fairune Origin」
和原創射擊遊戲「Fairune Blast」

8-Bit風的圖像和音樂，將帶給您一個神秘的遊戲體驗。

title: Varlet + 2 DLC [NSP][ENG]
description:
Shkolnaya istoriya o tom, kak nayti sebya. Rolevaya igra o samopoznanii, kotoroe proiskhodit cherez znakomstvo s drugimi lyudmi, kto oni na samom dele.
Istoriya razvorachivaetsya v akademii Kousey, kuda nedavno perevelas glavnaya geroinya. Vokrug etogo mesta khodit mnogo strannykh slukhov.. V ney poyavilsya «drugoy mir», gde obitayut strannye sushchestva, i esli vy tuda zabreli, nazad dorogi net.
Vam predstoit srazhatsya vmeste so svoimi druzyami, chtoby spasti alma mater ot neminuemogo unichtozheniya!

title: When Ski Lifts Go Wrong [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
S golovoy pogruzites v bezumno veselyy i krovavyy stroitelnyy simulyator s zameshannymi na fizike golovolomkami When Ski Lifts Go Wrong, do kraev napolnennyy khitroumnymi ispytaniyami i umoritelnymi katastrofami! 

V When Ski Lifts Go Wrong vy nachnete svoy put na pokatykh kholmakh predgorya i voznesetes k ogolennym sklonam i zubchatym grebnyam gor. 

Stroyte podemniki, kabinki, trampliny i rampy, chtoby provesti lyubiteley zimnego sporta po opasnym urovnyam, — lish ot vas zavisit, ugodyat vashi posetiteli v peredryagu ili net. Vklyuchaytes v bezumie When Ski Lifts Go Wrong!

Stroyte podemniki, trampliny i rampy iz razlichnykh materialov, chtoby provesti posetiteley po urovnyam. Ovladeyte fizikoy kanatnykh dorog i opytnym putem uznayte, kak oni vliyayut na razlichnye stroeniya.

Razgadyvayte khitroumnye stsenarii, chtoby dovesti vsekh posetiteley do mesta naznacheniya. Chtoby zanyat vershinu reytinga, vam pridetsya kontrolirovat svoi raskhody. Konechno, srezaya ugly, mozhno sekonomit, no v takom sluchae u vas vozniknut problemy s bezopasnostyu i komfortom passazhirov, a eto mozhet privesti k krovavym posledstviyam!

Esli proektirovaniya marshruta nedostatochno, vozmite na sebya upravlenie otdelnym sportsmenom i podtolknite ego lichno v storonu punkta naznacheniya, chtoby zanyat vozhdelennoe pervoe mesto.

Izuchiv vse sklony When Ski Lifts Go Wrong, nachnite sozdavat svoi sobstvennye stsenarii v udobnom redaktore urovney — dayte volyu svoey fantazii!

title: Typoman [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Vdokhnoveniem dlya sozdateley igry Typoman posluzhili biografii predannykh svoemu delu pisateley. Ona otpravit vas v puteshestvie, v kotorom vy poznaete silu slov v vechnoy borbe mezhdu dobrom i zlom. Vam predstoit okazatsya v roli personazha, sostoyashchego iz bukv, i prodolzhit sebe dorogu v temnom vrazhdebnom mire. Nesmotrya na nebolshoy rost, vy budete obladat mogushchestvennym darom: 
sozdavat slova, kotorye okazhut vozdeystvie na okruzhayushchiy mir. 
Vybirayte slova mudro: oni mogut okazatsya BLAGOSLOVENIEM... ili PROKLYaTEM! 

Osnovnye osobennosti igry
- Ispolzuyte sposobnost izmenyat mir, sozdavaya, menyaya i unichtozhaya slova 
- Reshayte slozhnye khitroumnye golovolomki v unikalnom mire, stilno oformlennom v tipografskom i rukopisnom stilyakh 
- Zakhvatyvayushchaya i tshchatelno prorabotannaya istoriya, kotoraya postepenno razvorachivaetsya pered vami s pomoshchyu ostroumnykh krossvordov i kalamburov 
- Syurrealistichnyy i atmosfernyy igrovoy mir 
- Osobennaya muzyka, napisannaya spetsialno dlya igry

Nagrady i priznaniya
- Igra byla predstavlena na Indie Game Revolution, muzey EMP, Sietl 
- «Luchshee Inszenierung / luchshee proizvodstvo», German Video Game Awards 2016, Myunkhen 
- Finalist Indie Prize 2016 Showcase, Casual Connect Europe 2016, Amsterdam 
- «Luchshaya kazualnaya igra», Game Connection Development Awards 2015, San-Frantsisko 
- Nominant na «Luchshuyu igru», «Luchshuyu indi-igru», «Luchshiy zvuk», «Luchshiy geym-dizayn», «Luchshuyu konsolnuyu igru», German Dev Awards 2015, Kyoln 
- Pobeditel v nominatsiyakh «Luchshiy graficheskiy stil», «Luchshiy igrovoy trend» na E3 2015 Awards, Los-Andzheles 
- Pobeditel v nominatsii Best of Quo Vadis 2015 (sponsiruemaya Google), Best of Quo Vadis Show, Berlin 
- Nominant na «Luchshuyu indi-igru», gamescom award 2015, Kyoln

Vam nravitsya igrat v Typoman, no vy bespokoites, chto vashikh znaniy angliyskogo yazyka mozhet ne khvatit? Nam by ochen khotelos, chtoby vy poprobovali nashu igru, poetomu my sdelali tak, chto dlya resheniya golovolomok vam potrebuetsya lish bazovoe znanie yazyka. Esli vy gde-nibud zastryanete, to ne volnuytes! Vy smozhete proyti dalshe metodom prob i oshibok, a takzhe posmotret perevod vernogo na vash vzglyad otveta na rodnom yazyke!
No luchshe vsego to, chto vy smozhete uluchshit vashi znaniya angliyskogo yazyka veselo i igrayuchi.

title: Spiral Splatter [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Proydite bolee 100 urovney v 11 raznykh etapakh, kotorye polny raznoobraznykh zadach na logiku i skorost reaktsii. Sledite za dvizhushchimisya prepyatstviyami, ispolzuyte portaly i ubegayte ot prizraka, poka vremya ne vyshlo.

Kazhdyy etap dobavlyaet novye zadachi s vozrastayushchey slozhnostyu. Uzhe k seredine igry Spiral Splatter udivit dazhe samykh iskusnykh poklonnikov golovolomok.

Sokhranyayte spokoystvie, rasslabtes i proverte, smozhete li vy pobedit v Spiral Splatter!

Osobennosti:
- Bolshe 100 raznoobraznykh urovney
- 11 etapov s novymi zadachami na kazhdom iz nikh
- Krasochnaya i stilnaya grafika
- Slozhnyy igrovoy protsess

title: The Fall: Part 1 & 2 Unbound [NSP][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + lyubitelskiy 俄语 翻译 来自 djonmarvel
description:
Ispytayte sebya v roli ARID, iskusstvennogo intellekta, vstroennogo v vysokotekhnologichnyy boevoy kostyum. Programma ARID aktiviruetsya posle avariynoy posadki na neizvestnoy planete. Pilot-chelovek vnutri kostyuma nakhoditsya bez soznaniya, i obyazannostyu ARID yavlyaetsya zashchishchat ego lyuboy tsenoy! Po mere togo kak ARID prodvigaetsya po neizvedannoy i opasnoy territorii v poiskakh meditsinskoy pomoshchi, ona vyyasnyaet, chto proiskhodit na etoy planete, i nachinaet stavit pod somnenie svoi sobstvennye protokoly. Popytka spasti svoego pilota v itoge privedet ARID k podryvu vsego, chto dvizhet eyu.

The Fall – eto unikalnaya kombinatsiya priklyuchencheskogo kvesta i dvukhmernogo platformera s temnoy i atmosfernoy istoriey. Issledovanie okruzheniya stanet glavnym klyuchom k vyzhivaniyu v etom priklyuchenii. Ispolzuyte fonarik ARID, chtoby obnaruzhit mnozhestvo interaktivnykh predmetov. Esli vy stolknetes s opasnostyu, pereklyuchites na lazernoe zrenie i zadayte zharu! Budte gotovy k neprostomu puteshestviyu, v kotorom vam pridetsya srazhatsya, issledovat i lomat golovu nad slozhnymi golovolomkami – vse eto pozvolit vam obogatit mir ARID v obkhod ee protokolov.

title: Dude Stop [NSZ][RUS/Multi4]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 4]
description:
Igray, lomay, krushi, ne chitay instruktsiy, ignoriruy podskazki i - samoe glavnoe! - zatkni rasskazchika. Tak emu i nado. Ty ved luchshe znaesh, kak igrat.

Naprimer, odnoy iz zadach mozhet byt ne chitat etot abzats. Prosto propusti ego. Idi dalshe, von zhe sleduyushchiy. Nachinaesh nadoedat. I… molodets. Pozdravlyayu. Ty narushil svoyo pervoe pravilo. I ved dazhe eshchyo ne kupil igru! Da ty u nas odaryonnyy! Ne dumal zanyatsya etim professionalno?

Soberi vse nagrady i dostizheniya i begi khvastatsya svoim podruzhkam, chto ty tolko chto byl v internete, bessovestno razyaril razrabotchika kakoy-to kompyuternoy igry i zastavil ego krichat na tebya pryam kak v rolike.
V obshchem, delay kak luchshe. Ili khuzhe. Ili vsyo srazu. Kak khochesh.
Osobennosti:
 • Okunis v besschyotnoe* kolichestvo urovney, s userdiem sobrannykh razrabotchikami. Nekotorye pokazhutsya tebe ochen zhiznennymi, nekotorye net. Kakaya raznitsa, kupi uzhe chyortovu igru
 • Polnostyu ozvuchennye khoroshie i plokhie prokhozhdeniya. Mozhesh slushat i ot smekha nadryvat zhivotik, a mozhesh vyklyuchit i sidet v polnoy tishine, preryvayushcheysya razve chto tikhim plachem nashego zvukovika
 • Mnogo raznoobraznykh nagrad i dostizheniy, narisovannykh golodnym nizkooplachivaemym khudozhnikom – my ne skupimsya na to, chtoby ty, opyat sdelav chto-to kaverznoe i pokhikhikav paru sekund, poluchil za eto krasivyy (khot i nevkusnyy) pryanik
 • Khvataet i momentov, kogda budesh vosklitsat: "Aa?", "Chyo?" i "Luchshe poydu Dom2 posmotryu"… Shutim-shutim, nichego takogo ne budet. Ty prosto budesh klikat po vsemu ekranu i shvyryat predmety vo vse storony
 • Lomayushchiy chetvyortuyu stenu yumor, s kotorym my yavno pereborshchili. Syuda zhe vkhodyat i vsevozmozhnye otsylki, kotorye ponimaet tolko nash programmist-botan. Chto-to vrode "42" i "Lozhki net". Vot zadrot, a?

*razve chto kto-to popytaeshsya ikh soschitat. Ne schitayte, pozhaluysta

title: Gabbuchi [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
developer: h.a.n.d. (Hokkaido Artists' Network and Development, Inc. ハ・ン・ド)
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
會吃方塊的不可思議生物「Gabbuchi」。仔細想想要吃方塊還是要留，目標是吃掉最愛的心型餅乾。

Gabbuchi會吃掉跟自己一樣顏色的方塊。不同顏色的方塊，只要變換自己的顏色就吃得下了。還有，可以把不同顏色的方塊當踏板來爬到更高的地方。
能大吃特吃的話Gabbuchi就會很滿足。但是，不小心吃太多的話，可會連到達最愛的心型餅乾的路也被吃掉了。要動腦想想要吃還是要留。

共收錄180道關卡！有很簡單到很深奧的關卡等著Gabbuchi。而且還有能自己製作原創關卡的編輯模式！

利用大量的關卡來讓Gabbuchi吃得過癮吧。

title: Dustoff Heli Rescue 2 / Dustoff Z [NSZ][RUS/Multi]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description: Sadis za shturval boevogo vertoleta, ishchi i spasay zalozhnikov na vrazheskoy territorii! Vypolni 35 riskovannykh missiy, v tom chisle: spasenie zalozhnikov, podderzhka s vozdukha, zashchita kolonny i, konechno, unichtozhenie vraga. Tvoi lyudi zhdut spaseniya v produvaemykh vetrami pustynyakh, sredi snezhnykh bur, v devstvennykh lesakh i sredi bogatoy vyazi podzemnykh peshcher. Ispytay vse 12 vertoletov, osnashchay ikh novymi, usovershenstvovannymi pulemetami i raketami!

title: Aegis Defenders + 4 DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Issleduyte, stroyte i zashchishchayte v etoy unikalnoy igre — ne to v zhanre «ekshen-platformera», ne to «zashchity bashni».

Vam predstoit primerit na sebya rol... tseloy komandy Ruinhunters, kotoroy nuzhno otyskat velichayshee oruzhie Aegis. Tolko s ego pomoshchyu oni smogut spasti svoyu derevnyu.

Pogruzites v zhivoe muzykalnoe puteshestvie s zakhvatyvayushchey muzykoy, napisannoy izvestnymi kompozitorami.

Ispytayte novye oshchushcheniya ot muzyki s novym sochetaniem nazhatiy v ritm i khoreograficheskogo rannera

Vyberite odezhdu, naushniki, shlyapu i skeytbord vashego personazha

title: Epistory Typing Chronicles [NSZ][ENG]
description:
In Epistory you play the muse, a fictional character in a world where everything is untold. Your adventure begins on a blank page, but the world will soon become larger and livelier as you gather inspiration, solve its mysteries and defeat its enemies. From movement to opening chests and fighting in epic battles. 

As you progress and explore the fantasy origami world, the story literally unfolds in the writer’s mind and the mysteries of the magic power of the words are revealed.

Epistory immerses you in an atmospheric action/adventure game where you play a girl riding a giant fox who fights an insectile corruption from an origami world. As you progress and explore this world, the story literally unfolds and the mysteries of the magic power of the words are revealed.


Features:

- Every element in the game can be controlled by typing words on a external keyboard!
- Explore a beautiful paper craft world: play as the muse riding a giant three tailed fox, lost in a fantasy 3D world,
- More than just typing: solve mysterious puzzles, unlock magic powers and defeat enemies in adrenaline pumping epic combats,
- A writer’s block? Collect fragments and inspirations points to unfold the story as you explore the origami world in the writer’s head. But there is more to the story than meets the eye…
- All in same style from movements, combats to even menus, control everything with a one,
- Adaptive difficulty: if your hands fly around or if you are a slow typist, the game features a dynamic difficulty system that evolves to fit each players’ skill set

title: Planetarian the Reverie of a Little Planet + Snow Globe [NSP][ENG]
description:
《planetarian～星之夢～》是出自「Key」的正統科幻視覺小說，而加入了其前傳《planetarian～雪圏球～》的作品在Nintendo Switch™上登場囉！

・全程配音
包含主角在內的所有角色皆全程配音。
Keiko Suzuki、Daisuke Ono和Rina Sato等人氣配音員們，將為優美的故事增添充滿臨場感的配音。

・顯示文字有5種語言可選擇
包含環境設定與電子手冊在內，提供了中文（繁體字、簡體字）、日文、英文、法文等5種語言的顯示文字供您選擇。在遊玩過程中也可隨時切換顯示語言。（僅提供日語配音）

・可全程使用觸控螢幕操作
除了可以將Joy-Con™安裝在主機上以攜帶模式遊玩之外，遊戲全程皆可透過觸控螢幕進行操作，因此也可以在未安裝Joy-Con的狀態下遊玩。

■關於遊戲系統
本作劇情並不會因不同選項而產生分支，請以觀賞動畫、電影，或逐頁閱讀小說般的心情來推進故事。
感人的故事，搭配上美麗的畫面和音樂、充滿臨場感的各式演出，以及實力派配音員們的演技，千萬不容錯過喔。

■故事
・《planetarian～星之夢～》
在不遠的未來。
因戰爭而遭受細菌武器攻擊的都市被人們遺棄後，成了對人用掃蕩機器徘徊的危險地帶。
一名以回收貴重資源為生的「拾荒者」青年潛入了此地。
躲避著掃蕩機器人，藏身於化為廢墟的星象館內的青年，與等候著不會再蒞臨的客人的接待機器人「星野夢美」相遇了……

・《planetarian～雪圏球～》
約30年前的和平時期。
位於鄉村都市的百貨總店中的星象館內，配置了帶有自動型機器人功能的接待機器人「星野夢美」。
一本正經地執行著工作的夢美，從某一天起突然開始無視業務命令，擅離職守……
夢美和星象館職員們的平凡幸福故事就此展開。

■製作人員
劇本：Yuuichi Suzumoto
原畫：E-ji Komatsu
配樂：Shinji Orito／Donmaru／Ryo Mizutsuki／Magome Togoshi

title: Celestian Tales: Realms Beyond [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Celestian Tales is a beautifully hand-painted JRPG set in a world of questionable morals where opposing views clash, with no clear right or wrong. 
Follow the journey of six Companions, knights sworn to serve and protect the heir of a noble house, as they rise and fall in their struggle to survive a world where one's true enemies are often their closest allies. 
Celestian Tales is full of lush hand-painted environments, emotive portraits, memorable characters and a sprawling engaging moralistic storyline that is told through the eyes of six protagonists. 
The game features a turn-based combat system with plenty of character and party customization options, allowing you to play the game at your own pace and in your own style. 

Features:

Moral Confrontations - Situations are presented to the player throughout the game that force players to face moral questions and beliefs.
Unique Story – By avoiding genre cliches, the story brings a fresh approach to RPG storytelling by allowing players to feel the weight of their character’s actions.
Multiple Story Arcs - 6 Selectable Characters allow you to play the game from 6 different perspectives. Play through the game as all 6 characters for a full experience, and enjoy the twists and secrets unmasked as you follow each of their personal journeys and intrigues.
Traditional RPG Gameplay - Inspired by classic JRPGs with a turn-based RPG battle system, players can develop a personal combat style.
Beautiful Art - Lush hand-painted background visuals and environments with detailed emotive character portraits and animated pixel-art characters create a full and complete world experience.
Epic Music - A sweeping score that captures the pace and emotion of the story as it unfolds.
