Take the driver's seat, grab onto the controls of the fabulous flying Frogcopter and pilot it through beautiful maze-like levels in this challenging action puzzle game. Slip, squeeze and spin the Frogcopter though over 60 levels all while trying to avoid the walls and hazards in your flightpath. 

Upgrade the Frogcopter with power-ups and use them to complete missions for the colourful fuzzy friends you will meet on your travels. 

Grab Coins and use them to buy over 50 delightful cosmetics for Geru and the Frogcopter ranging from perfect paintjobs to lovely hats. Complete challenging objectives like time trials and perfect runs to unlock super hard bonus stages to really test your Frogcopter piloting skills.

Open your eyes and see the wonderful vistas of this small delicate world, from the peace and tranquillity of a silent forest to the treacherous waterlogged insides of an abandoned clock tower. 

Come aboard with Geru and his best friend Bauf as they go on an amazing adventure to help Plum Town and its furry residents regain their joy and drive. Whether they are an anxiety ridden, ice-cream selling cat or a toad whose passions have been crushed by the working world, Geru and his Frogcopter are here to try and help them as best they can.

title: Tabe-O-Ja (Tabeoja) / タベオウジャ ミニサイズ [NSZ][ENG (Mod.)/JAP]
interface_lang: 日语 [JAP] + lyubitelskiy anglofikator 来自 Banh Mì
description:
Ekshn-kulinarnaya igra, v kotoroy vy smozhete nasladitsya strategicheskimi srazheniyami!.. Kak spetsialnyy povar «Tabe-O-Dzha», vy budete gotovit razlichnye blyuda, vklyuchaya yaponskie, zapadnye, kitayskie, i drugie s pomoshchyu vernykh Joy-Con i vyzyvat «Tabe-Gami», kotorye obitayut v kazhdom vkusnom blyude!
Prizvav Tabe-Gami, vy mozhete sformirovat svoyu sobstvennuyu silneyshuyu komandu, srazitsya s konkuriruyushchimi shef-povarami (i ikh Tabe-Gami) i brosit vyzov kulinarnomu miru «Samym silnym blyudom v mire»!

title: The Knight and the Dragon [NSZ][ENG]
description:
During a date with Arthur the chevalier, Princess Daphne is kidnapped by Synge the Dragon 
She’ll be turned into a Lady Dragon once Synge finds all the magic Crystals !
Time is running out ! Do you got what it takes to rescue Daphne?
Temple Tower is right ahead, go and face the Dungeon Boss

title: The Wizard of Bug (试玩版) [NSZ][DEMO][ENG]
description:
Rasputayte tayny zaputannogo labirinta, ispolzuya svoy um v kachestve oruzhiya!.. Novaya mozgolomnaya priklyuchenie-golovolomka!..
Tut budut bolee 100+ urovney, zapolnennykh golovolomkami v stile «Helltaker». Pereklyuchaytes mezhdu dvumya geroinyami, Shirli i Elloy, i ispolzuyte ikh spets. navyki, chtoby preodolet osobo slozhnye ispytaniya, a intuitivno ponyatnaya sistema peremotki pozvolit vam spokoyno probovat snova i snova.

title: The War of Genesis Remnants of Gray (창세기전: 회색의 잔영) [NSZ][ENG (Mod.)/KOR]
interface_lang: 韩语 [KOR] + LFS-aktivator ofits. angliyskogo yazyka
description:
Deystvie igry proiskhodit na kontinente Antariya, gde vy smozhete razdelit radosti i pechali beschislennykh chelovecheskikh sudeb, perepletayushchikhsya vokrug printsessy Iolin, chyu stranu pytaetsya zakhvatit zlobnaya imperiya Geysira.
Razvivaytes i srazhaytes yunitami raznykh klassov! Pobezhdayte vraga vezde, gde tolko mozhete, v polnoy mere ispolzuya superpriyomy i boevoy mekhanizm Magical Gear.
Zdes razvernyotsya potryasayushchaya epicheskaya drama! Naslazhdaytes polotnom istorii, kotoraya po pravu schitaetsya luchshey v sonme rolevykh koreyskikh videoigr.Videotreyler igry.

title: Toridama 1-2 Brave Challenge [NSZ][ENG]
description:
測驗膽子多大的遊戲『雞膽』大幅升級後又回來啦！

『雞膽』是一款以膽小遊戲為題材的小遊戲集。

測試膽量的小遊戲增加到有25種之多！
在可以看到世界排名的「瘋狂模式」裡，
除了累積排名之外還追加了當月跟前一個月的排名進去，這下子競爭一定會更加激烈哦。

繼承前作能輕鬆上手的遊戲性，
最適合拿來跟朋友或家人一起當派對遊戲同樂。

◆收錄了多達25種小遊戲！
「讓衝上樓的角色盡可能地煞在懸崖前吧」
「在就要被鬼魂襲擊的前一刻戳破它的真面目」
「讓機車在就要撞到地面之前都在空中旋轉吧」
可以玩到共25種試膽量的情境小遊戲。

遊玩隨機選出的5種小遊戲，目標是獲得高分。
在各種充滿危險的情境下，透過玩家按下按鈕的時機、深度和強度，
就可以診斷出你心中蘊含的懦弱心態，也就是「雞膽等級」。

◆搭載了可以享受猛烈「雞鬥」的「多人遊戲」模式！
可以看到互相的畫面，一邊比較大家的「雞膽等級」。
敬請享受這些極限的對戰，看看誰才是「弱雞」吧。

◆全世界的頂尖玩家們有話要說！就是「瘋狂模式」！
當開放了所有的小遊戲之後，就能夠前往「瘋狂模式」跟全世界榜上有名的人較勁。
這是一個要你持續不手軟地拿下最高評價「CRAZY」的遊戲模式。
快來試試看你的膽量到底能不能打敗各國強者們吧。

title: Vitamin Connection [NSP][ENG]
description:
Vas zhdet bezgranichnoe vesele v mikroskopicheskom mire — v odinochku ili vmeste s partnerom! 

V roli Vita-boya i Miny-gerl vy pilotiruyte korabl-kapsulu, chtoby izgnat zlobnye patogeny iz tela khozyaina. Ispolzuya novatorskuyu sistemu upravleniya, vy srazite vragov vitaminnym luchom, budete razmakhivat udobnoy kleshney korablya i prokhodit raznotsvetnye labirinty, chtoby spasti chlenov semi Seybl — vklyuchaya sobaku! — iz mnozhestva opasnykh i vse bolee bezumnykh zatrudneniy. Kazhdyy etap soderzhit takzhe nabor polnykh raznoobraziya mini-igr, kotorye zastavyat vas naklonyatsya, khvatat i skolzit na puti k pobede! 

V sovmestnoy igre ochen vazhna koordinatsiya, tak kak odin igrok derzhit kontroller Joy-Con™ vertikalno, chtoby dvigatsya i strelyat, a drugoy derzhit Joy-Con gorizontalno, chtoby vrashchatsya i tselitsya. Tolko obedinivshis i ispolzuya silu vitamina Vita-boya i Miny-gerl, vy smozhete ostanovit molekulyarnuyu ugrozu! 

Osobennosti
• Srazites s bakteriyami na korable-kapsule v shesti mnogotsvetnykh mirakh plyus mnogochislennykh bonusnykh istoriyakh!
• Igrayte v mnozhestvo mini-igr s izgibayushchimisya, ritmicheskimi dvizheniyami, infrakrasnymi testami na reaktsiyu i drugimi ispytaniyami! 
• Unikalnoe novatorskoe upravlenie Joy-Con s funktsiey vibratsii HD!
• Improviziruyte internatsionalnuyu podborku muzyki, vklyuchayushchey vse ot J-pop do khip-khopa!
• Igrayte v odinochku ili obedinites s drugom v asimmetrichnom rezhime dlya dvoikh igrokov!
• Razblokiruyte rezhim New Game Pro, chtoby prozhit istoriyu v sovershenno novoy perspektive, v kachestve antigeroya... Pro-Biotika!

title: Voice Mimicry Show [NSZ][ENG]
description:
動物聲音、機械聲音、環境聲音、電視中聽到的聲音…
這是一款派對遊戲，您可以透過 USB 麥克風用自己的聲音發出各種聲音！
這次誰是贏家呢？

title: Vroom In The Night Sky [NSZ][ENG]
description:
"Vroom in the night sky" is a "Magical Bike Action Game".
The features of this game are Fantastic feeling, Speedy feeling, and Realistic feeling by HD rumble.

There are various night skies in this world, and it is work of Magical Girls to collect Stardusts there.
You become the Magical Girl "Luna", ride a Magical Bike, fly around the night sky and collect Stardusts!

The Magical Gate is floating in the night sky.
In order to open the gate, you need to collect the necessary number of Keystars floating in the night sky.
By collecting Keystars faster and entering the gate, you can get more Stardusts.

Besides, by manipulating the motorcycle more technically, the number of Stardusts will get increased.
Let's try various actions and challenge to collect Stardusts.

By using the collected Stardusts, you will be able to get a new Magical Bike.
If you get a powerful Magical Bike, you will be able to more easily collect Stardusts!

title: Worth Life [NSZ][ENG]
description:
水晶的光華已經消失，各地都發生了一些事情。
從全國各地隨機召喚30人。
在國王的要求下，每個人都開始以自己的方式探索這個國家的潛力。

主角（可以改變外觀）耕種旅途中獲得的空地來種植莊稼，建造魚塘，建造房屋並將其出租給有需要的人，有時還會使用劍和弓。刷弓並與魔物對抗。
根據自己的風格定製您的空地並訓練您的戰鬥技能！

title: Zoids Wild Blast Unleashed [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Dayte volyu yarostnomu mogushchestvu i zverinomu instinktu zoidov v zrelishchnykh poedinkakh odin na odin na Nintendo Switch. Potryasayushchaya grafika v stile anime Zoids Wild i intuitivno ponyatnaya boevaya sistema v 3D, pozvolyayushchaya s legkostyu provodit neveroyatnye kombinatsii. Zoids Wild: Blast Unleashed — eto zakhvatyvayushchie srazheniya vashikh lyubimykh pilotov i ikh zoidov!
No kto takie zoidy — prosto oruzhie ili vashi partnery? Vashe masterstvo v boyu opredelit, kto vozmet verkh v konflikte mezhdu komandy «Svoboda» pod predvoditelstvom Arashi i komandy «Temnyy metall» v novoy istorii. Vybirayte geroya, vykhodite na pole bitvy i srazhaytes, chtoby probudit velichayshuyu svyaz mezhdu lyudmi i zoidami — a potom ispolzuyte skrytoe mogushchestvo «Dikogo vzryva», chtoby pobedit protivnikov.
S ogromnym vyborom personazhey, zoidov i igrovykh rezhimov igra Zoids Wild: Blast Unleashed vyvodit srazheniya mekhov na novyy uroven. Svodite schety v srazheniyakh dlya dvukh igrokov, ispytayte masterstvo v rezhimakh zadaniy i srazheniy i ottochite navyki v rezhime praktiki. Vy gotovy komandovat silneyshimi zhiznennymi formami v mire?

title: Earth Defense Force EDF World Brothers 1-2 [NSP][ENG]
description:
- Kvadratnaya Zemlya - novoe pole bitvy.
Novoe pole bitvy EDF - eto kvadratnaya zemlya. V etot raz deystvie razvorachivaetsya v parallelnom mire, gde vse tsifrovoe i kubicheskoe. Etot mir pogruzilsya v khaos, kogda nekogda mirnaya kvadratnaya Zemlya byla raskolota na kuski. Tem ne menee, eto Zemlya, kotoruyu nuzhno zashchishchat. Teper zadacha EDF vosstanovit mir na kvadratnoy planete.

- Sozdayte svoy sobstvennyy otryad EDF.
Zemlya razletelas na kuski. Soldaty EDF otchayanno srazhayutsya v odinochku v raznykh stranakh mira. Spasite etikh soldat, prisoedinites k nim i soberite svoyu unikalnuyu komandu. Kazhduyu missiyu mozhno vypolnit v komande maksimum iz 4 chelovek. Vo vremya missii menyayte tovarishchey po komande, ispolzuya unikalnye cherty kazhdogo personazha, kotorye prigodyatsya v bitve v raznoe vremya.

- Verbuyte soldat iz proshlykh igr EDF.
V igre poyavlyayutsya kubicheskie versii personazhey iz vsekh predydushchikh vypuskov EDF, ot EDF 1 («Monster Attack») do «Earth Defense Force 5», i dazhe dopolnitelnykh vypuskov EDF. Takzhe predstavlen shirokiy spektr oruzhiya i transportnykh sredstv iz proshlykh vypuskov EDF. Znatokam serii ponravyatsya eti znakomye personazhi i oruzhie, a u novichkov v budet vozmozhnost vpervye poznakomitsya s ee bogatoy istoriey.

- Znakomye vragi.
Vragi, vtorgavshivesya na Zemlyu ranshe, poyavlyayutsya v etoy igre, na etot raz v kubicheskoy forme.

- Sovmestnaya onlayn-igra i lokalnyy multipleer.
Eta igra podderzhivaet sovmestnuyu onlayn-igru do 4-kh igrokov, pri etom kazhdyy igrok prisoedinyaetsya k bitve, ispolzuya svoyu komandu. Mnogopolzovatelskaya igra po lokalnoy seti takzhe podderzhivaetsya v versii dlya Nintendo Switch™, chto pozvolyaet zashchishchat Zemlyu vmeste s semey i druzyami.

title: Disaster Report 4 Summer Memories [NSP][ENG]
description: V teni moshchnogo zemletryaseniya vy dolzhny otvazhitsya na razrushennyy gorod, gde vash vybor opredelit, kto vyzhivet.

title: Erra Exordium [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Miru nastal konets. Vy — poslednyaya nadezhda na spasenie roda!
Erra: Exordium — priklyuchencheskiy dvukhmernyy ekshn v settinge dizelpanka. Issleduyte mir, osnovannyy na shumero-akkadskoy mifologii. Vozmite na sebya rol uchenogo kotoryy sumel obmanut smert i srazites s vosstavshey armiey mekhatronov.

title: Transient Extended edition [NSP][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Sozdateli CONARIUM i serii DARKNESS WITHIN predstavlyayut TRANSIENT ― triller, obedinyayushchiy istoriyu v dukhe G. F. Lavkrafta i zhanr kiberpank.

V dalekom postapokalipticheskom budushchem ostatki chelovecheskoy tsivilizatsii zhivut v zakrytoy tsitadeli ― gorode pod kupolom, sozdannom dlya zashchity ot vneshnikh ugroz. Vy okazyvaetes v mire mrachnoy antiutopii. Nechto strannoe tvoritsya vokrug. Reshayte golovolomki, vzlamyvayte sistemy i issleduyte inye izmereniya. Dokopaytes do istiny, kotoraya riskuet poshatnut vash rassudok.
Pogruzites v neizvedannye grani TRANSIENT (Extended Edition). Vyydite za predely izvestnogo: vas zhdet mnozhestvo uluchsheniy, dopolnitelnyy igrovoy protsess i sovershenno novyy final. 

«Vse techet, vse menyaetsya». ― Geraklit

KIBERPANK PO LAVKRAFTU
Vpervye kosmicheskiy ekzistentsializm Lavkrafta sosedstvuet s mrachnym antiutopicheskim mirom kiberpanka. Transient spletaet voedino luchshee ot oboikh zhanrov, predstavlyaya novye vpechatleniya ot znakomoy istorii.

FRAGMENTARNAYa DEYSTVITELNOST
Ot zabytykh pustoshey Kor Shera do neprivetlivykh ulits Provideniya: Transient polon nezabyvaemykh mest, ozhidayushchikh, kogda vy na nikh stupite. Issleduyte privychnyy mir, sobstvennye sny i virtualnuyu realnost. Vas zhdut vstrechi s druzyami, nedobrozhelatelyami i sushchestvami mezhdu mirami.

POBEG IZ REALNOSTI
Sochetanie unikalnykh lokatsiy i originalnogo saundtreka sozdaet effekt polnogo pogruzheniya.

DOPOLNENNYY ChELOVEK V DELE
Vystupite v roli Rendolfa Kartera ― cheloveka, osnashchennogo (chitay: dopolnennogo) dlya zadaniya. V vashem rasporyazhenii prodvinutyy OVI ― obostryayushchiy vospriyatie implant. Ispolzuyte ego dlya issledovaniya okruzheniya, poiska ulik i vzloma prepyatstviy, otdelyayushchikh vas ot istiny.

title: Terminal 81 [NSZ][RUS/Multi12]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 12]
description:
V rezultate mirovogo finansovogo krizisa 2008 goda Lorena prinyala reshenie emigrirovat v bolshoy i bogatyy gorod San-Paulu, chtoby nayti rabotu i pomoch svoey seme. Lorene legko udalos poluchit rabotu v supermarkete, chego ona ne znala, tak eto togo, chto rayon, gde ona budet rabotat, byl Terminalom 81, starym promyshlennym rayonom, stradayushchim ot bednosti, prestupnosti i gryazi .
Cimulyator raboty, detektiv i psikhologicheskiy khorror s retro-vizualnoy estetikoy. Deystvie igry proiskhodit v 2008 godu v vymyshlennom rayone goroda San-Paulu v Brazilii.
Vo vremya svoego prebyvaniya v Terminale 81 Lorena uznaet, chto gruppa molodykh zhenshchin byla pokhishchena. Izuchiv okrestnosti i vstretivshis s ego zhitelyami, ona ponimaet, chto realnost Terminala 81 namnogo temnee, chem kazhetsya. To, chto kazalos prostym latinoamerikanskim rayonom, so vsemi vytekayushchimi otsyuda plokhimi veshchami, predstavlyaet soboy opasnyy rayon, gde dominiruet tainstvennaya «prestupnaya organizatsiya», zanimayushchayasya ubiystvami, prostitutsiey i zapretnaya torgovley lyudmi..

title: Gray Dawn [NSP][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
Sobytiya Gray Dawn proiskhodyat v 1920 godu, v otdalennoy derevne: otpravlyaytes v koshmarnoe priklyuchenie v roli svyatogo ottsa, chtoby dokazat svoyu nevinovnost. Odnako, vinovny vy ili net, popytaytes ne popast v lovushku v tsentre strannykh sobytiy, svyazannykh s oderzhimostyu i tainstvennymi misticheskimi yavleniyami.
Vsyakiy raz, vspominaya maltsa i ego ubiystvo vy vpadaete v trans, podpityvaemyy strakhom.
Bezumie, krov, otvrashchenie ot boga, a inogda i golosa samogo dyavola, pytayushchegosya vas obmanut — no ved on vpolne mozhet i govorit pravdu...

title: Mothered [NSZ][ENG]
description:
故事歷時7天，你將飾演Liana莉安娜——一位剛捱過了一場大手術，回到家中與母親在一起的年輕女孩。

到了新家後，你只看到一個自稱是你母親的奇怪人體模型。透過與這個人體模型對話，你將逐步發掘你在這個世界裡扮演的角色。莉安娜能夠幫助母親將一切回復原狀嗎？還是只會重複過去所犯的錯？

特色：
• 沉重而引人入勝的故事會在7天內逐漸揭開，每天分成早上、下午、黃昏及晚間。
• 令你猶如身歷其境的緊張氣氛，離奇的情節讓你不到最後一刻都看不到故事全貌。
• 你能夠打破循環，找出屬於你的道路嗎？

title: Silver Chains [NSZ][RUS]
interface_lang: 俄语 [RUS], 德语 [DEU], 英语 [ENG], 西班牙语 [ESP], 法语 [FRA], 日语 [JAP], 韩语 [KOR], 葡萄牙语 [POR], 中文 [CHI]
description:
Odnazhdy v nespokoynuyu noch, posle togo, kak mashina Pitera vrezalas v derevo, on prosypaetsya v starom zabroshennom osobnyake, gde-to v Anglii. Piter ne mozhet vspomnit, pochemu i kak on popal syuda, no vskore on ponimaet, chto dom ne takoy uzh i zabroshennyy, kakim kazhetsya.

V popytkakh nayti vykhod iz doma, glavnyy geroy dolzhen raskryt temnye sekrety togo, chto sluchilos v etom meste. Vo vremya poiskov, Piter obnaruzhivaet podskazki, kotorye ukazyvayut na to, chto on uzhe byl zdes ranshe...

title: The Town of Light [NSZ][ENG]
voice_lang: 英语, 意大利语, 德语
description:
Vzglyanite na mir glazami stradayushchey ot simptomov psikhicheskogo zabolevaniya 16-letney Rene. Ona ishchet otvety na mnozhestvo voprosov o svoem proshlom, odnovremenno issleduya mesto, gde provela bolshuyu chast svoey yunosti. Stante provodnikom Rene v temnom i emotsionalnom puteshestvii, v kotorom razmyty grani mezhdu razvlecheniem, syuzhetom i realnostyu.

Eto podarochnoe izdanie soderzhit eksklyuzivnyy dokumentalnyy kontent ob istorii psikhiatricheskoy bolnitsy v Volterre i sozdanii igry The Town of Light.

title: Voodoo Detective [NSZ][ENG]
description:
如果你想追求冒險體驗，精彩刺激的點擊遊戲Voodoo Detective便可滿足你！
新吉能：蘊藏豐富巫毒文化的小島市鎮，連鎖店遍布全鎮，生活優渥的遊客隨處可見。本土特色和腐敗殖民政權爆發一場絕望的生死戰。

在如此引人入勝的背景之下，站在戲劇中心的是一個沒有過去的神秘女人，而與現實有關的各種線索正逐步解開！

加入Voodoo Detective的行列調查最新案件，每個骯髒秘密的背後都隱藏著重重危機，他的每個驚險時刻也很可能會是他人生的最後光景。是時候戴上你的軟呢帽、穿上風衣了，偵探，你還有謎團要解決！

Features
- 取材自《猴島小英雄》系列的點擊冒險遊戲！
- 充滿奇思妙想的豐富故事內容！
- 手繪背景、動畫和用家介面！
- 高解像度圖像！
來自各大遊戲和電影的傑出配音人才，例如《質量效應》系列、《闇龍紀元》、《最終幻想》系列、《異塵餘生》系列、《暗黑破壞神》系列、《降世神通：最後的氣宗》、《星艦迷航記》、《王牌大賤諜》等！
- 現場樂器錄製的精彩配樂，由《神通鬼大》、《猴島小英雄》系列和《腦航員》的著名作曲家彼得·麥康奈爾本人創作！

title: The Wild Case [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Geroy igry – chelovek ishchushchiy sut neobychnykh sobytiy. Odnazhdy on poluchaet pismo s prosboy o pomoshchi iz ochen glukhoy derevni, zateryannoy v glubine lesov. Geroy otpravlyaetsya v put, no priklyucheniya vstretyat ego eshchyo do pribytiya na mesto. Zhiteley derevni derzhat v strakhe zveri, prichyom ne prostye – misticheskie. U nikh svetyatsya krasnym glaza, ikh bessilen poymat dazhe okhotnik.

Prezhde chem popast vglub skryvayushchikh taynu lesov, pridyotsya uglubitsya i v samu zhizn obitateley. Zdes ne rabotayut prostye denezhnye otnosheniya. Za bolshinstvo uslug pridetsya dogovarivatsya. Kto i chto konkretno videl, pochemu podozrevayut nechistuyu silu, chto eto voobshche za naselyonnyy punkt? Vse li podderzhat vashe rassledovanie? Kto okazhetsya soyuznikom, a kto vragom? Vsyo eto vy smozhete nablyudat prodvigayas po syuzhetu. Vas zhdut nemalo interesnykh zadach, dialogov, raskryvayushchikh personazhey.

Zhanr igry – priklyuchenie. Vy, vmeste s geroem, budete razgadyvat taynu. Rassledovanie vynudit reshat razlichnye zadachi, dlya kotorykh ponadobitsya vzaimodeystvie s personazhami.

• Autentichnye personazhi, s kotorymi pridetsya obshchatsya.
• Atmosfernye lokatsii udalennykh poseleniy.
• Uvlekatelnye zagadki, trebuyushchie izucheniya mestnosti i zhiteley.
• V lesakh mozhno vstretit kak otshelnika, tak i vedmu. Kto drug, a kto vrag?
• Issleduyte otkrytyy mir igry.
• Priklyucheniya v atmosfere mistiki.

title: Dexter Stardust Adventures in Outer Space [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Kosmos! Dekster Stardast edva spassya, kogda vriziantsy, zhiteli groznoy planety X, poslali flot robotov, chtoby unichtozhit vse zhivoe na Zemle. Teper, dvadtsat let spustya, mekhanicheskiy chelovek s desyatoy planety khochet peredat Deksteru ochen vazhnoe soobshchenie - on yavlyaetsya klyuchom k spaseniyu i lyudey, i vriziantsev. Igrayte za Dekstera Stardasta, lyubyashchego tako, kogda on i ego khoroshaya podruga Avrora otpravyatsya v velichayshee priklyuchenie v svoey zhizni i otkroyut taynu Robota s planety X!

Klassicheskiy priklyuchencheskiy geympley

Igra sozdana kak klassicheskoe priklyuchenie v stile "navedi i shchelkni", vy mozhete khodit, govorit i vzaimodeystvovat so vsem, chto vas okruzhaet. Ispolzuyte i podbirayte predmety inventarya, chtoby reshit golovolomki v bolee chem 100 unikalnykh stsenakh.

5 epizodov v odnoy igre

Igrat v Dexter Stardust - vse ravno chto smotret odin za drugim epizody utrennego multfilma! Vsego v igre 5 epizodov, i vy mozhete v lyuboy moment pereyti k lyubomu epizodu ili pereigrat ego.

Polnaya ozvuchka

Vse personazhi, stseny i igrovoy protsess polnostyu ozvucheny! 

Priklyuchenie dlya vsekh

Vsya semya mozhet otpravitsya v kosmicheskoe priklyuchenie; blagodarya nenasilstvennomu igrovomu protsessu, neveroyatnomu syuzhetu, logicheskim golovolomkam i prostomu upravleniyu Dekster i banda nepremenno soydut s ekrana i popadut v vashe serdtse.

title: Fire Ungh’s Quest [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
《FIRE》是一款具有直觀謎題設計的探索冒險遊戲。簡單來說，這是一個好笑的原始人故事。進入石器時代，面對這個時代最具挑戰性的任務：尋找火！

故事主角是可愛又有點混亂的尼安德人翁可，他在第一次守夜時就打了瞌睡。第二天早上，災難接踵而至：火熄滅了，翁可被逐出村子。現在你必須幫助翁可尋找新的火焰，尋遍石器時代世界的每一個角落，就算是必須進到恐龍的體內、悶燒的火山，甚至是穿越時空，翁可都不會放棄尋找新火焰的任何機會。

點按或滑一下螢幕，就能在栩栩如生的環境中遊歷。只要靠一點邏輯，就能解決任何謎題，在與遊戲世界互動時，你的探索精神將不受限制：用猛獁象的鼻子射出椰子、變成動物，還是從章魚魔王的魔掌中救出可愛的女孩。

-完全沒有文字或對話
-連貫直觀的操控
-探索可愛生動的石器時代世界
-10 個精美手繪風景

title: Gibbous A Cthulhu Adventure [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description: Choknutye sektanty. Ktulkhu. Govoryashchaya koshka. Gibbous priglashaet vas v uvlekatelnoe, narisovannoe vruchnuyu priklyuchenie. Issleduyte yarkiy lavkraftovskiy mir c drevnimi zagovorami v komediyno-kosmicheskom uzhastike iz Transilvanii!

title: Has Been Heroes [NSP][ENG]
description:
Embark on an epic journey with the Has-Been Heroes, a group of legendary champions once celebrated throughout the kingdom - almost forgotten until the King has one more quest, the most epic of them all:

TO TAKE THE TWIN PRINCESSES TO SCHOOL!

Key features:

* Meet the epic band of heroes as the young and eager Rogue, joining the company of the wise monk Metacles, the giant-wrestling warrior Crux... wait until you meet the others, incl. the Anthropologist turned Mexican Wrestler, the ever-vigilant and paranoid Sheikh, and many more!

* Unlock and collect hundreds of game-changing items and spells, boosting the heroes' powers and making each run unique!

* Combine spells for devastating effects, learning the power of magic as you gain more elements.

* Face countless monsters, each bigger and more menacing than the next. Can you wipe out the army of evil led by the Great Ghoul?

* In roguelike fashion, die and try again - choose your heroes wisely and prepare for battle!

title: Shaolin vs Wutang Eastern Heroes [NSZ][ENG]
developer: J.Bowman, Godspeed Gaming Solutions Private Limited
description:
沒有過分浮華的視覺效果，只有受到經典功夫電影啟發到的格鬥。本遊戲具有電影中的真實對戰聲音與一首從經典功夫電影音樂中獲得許可使用的出色配樂。 

Shaolin vs Wutang真正是一封對經典70與80年代功夫電影院的情書。這是由一個對功夫電影充滿知識與擁有巨大激情的人獨立創造。我們希望提供玩家一個混合了懷舊和傑出功夫電影回憶的滿意遊戲體驗。

特色

近身相搏與武器爭鬥
活躍的人物保衛 動畫
由經典電影中獲得許可使用的功夫配樂
27 種激勵的真實武術風格
20個獨特擂台
每個角色都擁有獨特的動作和移動組合
單人與本地合作遊戲

title: Urbek City Builder [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
In Urbek, you will be able to build a city of your own design! Manage its natural resources, improve the quality of life of the population, and build its neighbourhoods in your own way.

Neighbourhoods
Breathe life into your city by building different neighbourhoods. Do you want a bohemian neighbourhood? Build bars, parks and libraries, but keep a low population density nearby. Do you want a bourgeois neighbourhood? You need parks and luxury shops.

Manage
There is no money in Urbek. Instead, you will have to build everything with your own resources, such as food, coal, or skilled work. There are more than 30 different resources to manage! Manage your natural resources well, so that they do not run out before they can be replaced. How will you choose to produce the energy for your inhabitants and industries?

Educate
Education is fundamental! By producing enough qualified work and scientific work, you will be able to build more advanced buildings.

Observe
Move around at street level in order to get a more intimate sense of the city you are creating. See and feel the differences between neighborhoods the way your city’s residents do!

Organic growth
The growth of your city will be organic. Some constructions will appear according to the surrounding conditions. For example, buildings with more than two floors will appear in densely populated areas and with basic services.

You can place other buildings by yourself, but they need some conditions. For instance, the local market needs to be close to the farms. The university should have some high schools nearby, which, in turn, require nearby schools.

When it comes to designing your city, you have a variety of viable options. There are no buildings that are superior to others. Every decision will have its pros and cons. Bourgeois houses consume more food and need resources that cost more to produce, but will improve the quality of life of the residents there. On the other hand, improving the productivity of industries will produce more resources, but will diminish the quality of life for residents living in the area.

title: Pac-Man 99 (PacMan) + 27 DLC [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
※「Nintendo Switch Online」加入者且持有Nintendo Switch的玩家皆可免費遊玩。

問世邁入40周年的遊戲界金字塔之作「PAC-MAN」，以99人大逃殺殊死戰的形式重出江湖。在舉世聞名的鬼抓PAC-MAN遊戲中，成為活到最後的倖存者吧。

吃下能量球，幽靈就會變身為藍色的「受驚嚇的幽靈」。要是咬到受驚嚇的幽靈，即可派出等同於咬到數量的「搗蛋PAC-MAN」攻擊對手。
咬住「列車幽靈」，朝一舉翻盤邁進吧！

透過切換在左右分別設定4種的「策略」，即可使PAC-MAN速度加快，或是派出更多搗蛋PAC-MAN。配合狀況切換策略，盡可能在戰況之中取得優勢吧。

找找看有沒有您喜愛的經典遊戲吧。

title: Psychic 5 Eternal [NSZ][ENG]
developer: Nihon Maicom Kaihatsu (NMK), Jaleco, CRT Games
description:
「1987年轟動遊戲界的PSYCHIC錘擊強勢回歸！」
『PSYCHIC 5: ETERNAL』

「5位超能力者，用5把錘子拯救世界。」
「快！逃出大迷宮，潛入大魔王的巢穴！」
「快！救出超能力者夥伴，然後合力擊敗大魔王！」

「那時撒旦沒有完全被擊敗。」
「新登場的5位夥伴們！」
「燃著炙烈火焰的PSYCHIC錘擊變得更強大了！」

而且能夠「2人同時進行遊戲」，

並且還具有可將遊戲畫面設定為綠色、黑白，以及出現圖像掃瞄線的各種顯示功能，能夠在進行遊戲的同時體驗復古情懷！

「睽違近36年的遊戲傑作《PSYCHIC 5: ETERNAL》回來了！」

title: Rumble Sus [NSP][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
*為了正常體驗基於振動機能設計的遊戲玩法，Nintendo Switch Lite 用戶在遊玩本地多人模式時，需要使用額外的支持振動的手柄。

《內鬼搞搞震》是一個快節奏的社交推理聚會遊戲。玩家在遊戲開始時可以通過手柄是否振動得知自己的身份，而不被其他人知道。遊戲開始後，內鬼玩家需要尋找隊友，並試圖在不暴露的情況下打敗所有好人。而好人則需要通過道具和場上其他玩家的可疑行為找出內鬼並打敗內鬼。拿起手柄，跟你的朋友們來一場充滿歡笑與猜疑的亂戰吧！

-> 1台機器最多支持8人本地遊玩
-> 遊戲開始前，通過手柄振動知道自己是好人還是內鬼
-> 使用雷達，感應手柄振動來找出附近的內鬼
-> 無需投票，直接出拳或者扔炸彈來打倒敵人
-> 通過團隊合作來制勝的友盡遊戲

title: Royal Watch the Throne's Duty [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
在這款引人入勝的策略與洞察力遊戲中登上王座。Royal Watch: The Throne's Duty 挑戰你成為王國無所不見的眼睛。
作為皇家觀察者,你的職責是監視宮廷中的每一個動作。分析行為、偵測模式、做出裁決。你的目光即是法律,你的關注塑造著王國的命運。
受經典觀察遊戲啟發,Royal Watch 提供全新體驗:

深度且具策略性的「觀察與推理」核心玩法
為你的王國注入生命的獨特藝術風格
獎勵細心觀察與邏輯思維的新機制
考驗你觀察力的挑戰性場景

王冠沉重,王座的職責永無止境。你準備好接受守望了嗎?

title: Sludge Life [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Izuchite krokhotnyy ostrovok, zateryannyy na pokrytoy slizyu planete. Posmotrite, skoro li vam nadoest postoyannaya reklama korporatsiy, poobshchaytes s drugimi teggerami, ukradite kakuyu-nibud khren i paru serdechek zaodno. Chto vas zhdet? Stanete korolem ostrova, pokroete graffiti kazhdyy dyuym svobodnoy poverkhnosti? Proniknite v korporatsiyu «GLYuK», pomeshaete ey kachat sliz? Ili prosto spalite vse k chertu?

* Pokhuligante vslast, sidya v bezopasnosti za kompyuterom.

* Nikto vam ne ukaz, tolko lyubopytstvo i svobodnaya volya. Brodite po malenkomu otkrytomu miru, kuda khotite.

* Ishchite i zagruzhayte prilozheniya, tratte svoyu dragotsennuyu zhizn na vstroennye igry vnutri igry.

* Kurite firmennye SIGI. Kurite-kurite!

* Fotkayte ekzoticheskikh zhivotnykh i stremnykh NPC.

* Dlya perdezha est otdelnaya knopka!

* Ogromnyy mladenets, otkrytaya basketbolnaya ploshchadka i koshka s dvumya dyrkami v zadnitse — vse bez dopolnitelnoy platy.

* Tri raznykh kontsovki i surovye titry.

title: Broken Lines [NSZ][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
您的小隊已經墜毀在敵方防線後方，在另類東歐歷史中所載的中心腹地。由於沒有任何情報或領導層的支援，這些士兵必須在被戰爭所帶來的恐懼徹底撕裂前，克服重重困難回到祖國。團隊合作和策略至關重要。
每個士兵都有自己的個性和想法，對於下一步需要做什麼他們各懷己見。有些人想調查是什麼原因導致墜機事故，使他們深陷敵方領土，而另一些人則想低調潛伏，等待救援。甚至還有人竊竊私語，想要一逃了之。
您是那雙「看不見的手」 ，可以指導這群軍紀散漫的士兵，採取安全和可能的營救措施。無論是對於選擇下一步該往哪條路走這樣簡單的決定，還是大敵當前要採取哪種周密的戰術，您所做的每個決定都關乎生死存亡。

《Broken Lines》將戰術 RPG 與故事情節推動的遊戲合為一體。您的士兵正承受著戰爭所帶來的巨大精神壓力，您需要指揮他們參加戰鬥——他們會避開與敵人交火，還是會與敵人正面交鋒？

戰鬥類似於基於回合的戰術 RPG，但是士兵僅在行動階段開始時才能移動。然而，當出現新的敵人和危險時，遊戲會暫停，以允許您深思熟慮，對突如其來的變化做出回應。您會繼續向敵軍發起衝鋒，還是退縮以尋求掩護？

您將根據自己的喜好做出選擇，不斷推動故事的發展，從而產生不同的戰役結局。明智地做出抉擇，因為您在遊戲中的進度不僅會影響您所指揮的士兵，還會影響整個地區的形勢以及住在這裡的每個人。但是，您還應牢記，哪些事情對自己的小隊有利，每位士兵都有自己的想法，因此您必須在希望他們做的事情和與如何使小隊保持高昂鬥志之間找到最佳平衡。

title: Dungeon Warfare [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Dungeon Warfare — slozhnaya igra po strategicheskoy oborone bashen, gde vy stanovites lordom podzemeliy dlya zashchity svoikh vladeniy ot zhadnykh avantyuristov-grabiteley.

Po mere togo kak vy uspeshno ochishchaete podzemelya ot nazoylivykh zakhvatchikov, vy poluchaete dostup ko vsyo bolee moshchnym lovushkam i izoshchryonnym prisposobleniyam.
Unichtozhayte vragov, chtoby nabiratsya opyta i postoyanno uluchshat svoi lovushki. 
 
Osobennosti igry 
 
* 26 unikalnykh lovushek s 3 urovnyami obnovleniy dlya kazhdoy.
* Passivnye obnovleniya dlya lovushek.
* Bolee 40 urovney, sozdannykh vruchnuyu.
* 22 tipa vragov.
* Vozmozhnost sozdat sobstvennyy uroven slozhnosti, sochetaya 12 run dlya uboynykh rezhimov igry.
* Beskonechnyy rezhim igry (dostupen posle polucheniya runy Beskonechnosti).
* Zapustite ogromnuyu glybu, smetayushchuyu vsyo na svoyom puti.
* Perenapravte potok vragov navstrechu treku vagonetok, chtoby razmazat vragov na meste. 
* Rasstavte lovushki, kotorye bezzhalostno sbrosyat moguchikh voinov v kromeshnuyu chyornuyu bezdnu.
* Obedinite dlya borby sobstvennye sily, ispolzuya portaly dlya prizyva podkrepleniya i nachala khaotichnoy potasovki.
* Bolee 30 dostizheniy.
* Sochnaya pikselnaya grafika.
* Sochnye zvukovye effekty.
* Sochnye priklyucheniya!

title: Game Center CX Arino's Retro Game Challenge 1+2 Replay (ゲームセンターCX 有野の挑戦状) [NSZ][JAP]
developer: Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc., indieszero, Namco Bandai Games
description:
Lyubimyy sbornik arkad s Nintendo DS otmechaet svoyo 20-letie! Ispytanie Arino Sinya, yaponskogo aktyora, komedianta i uchastnika komediynogo dueta Yoiko snova s nami — teper na Nintendo Switch!
V oznamenovanie 20-letiya obe chasti Game Center CX 1/2, vypushchennye na NDS, byli obedineny v odnu igru i reliznuty snova. Ura!..

title: Harvest Moon: The Lost Valley and Skytree Village [NSZ][ENG]
description:
曾被稱為「Harvest Goddess 綠洲」的土地，如今早已今非昔比。過去，天空之樹村熱鬧非凡，土地翠綠肥沃。然而，Harvest Goddess（豐收女神）的力量逐漸衰退，使得大地乾涸、生命枯竭。

現在輪到你站出來，挑戰重建這座村莊的象徵——七棵傳說中的天空之樹，讓它們重新綻放力量，為周圍的土地帶來希望與繁榮。在這段旅程中，你將遇見一群新登場的角色（也有幾位熟面孔回歸）、直觀易用的操作方式，以及可以自由塑造地形、打造夢想農場的系統！

•	在熱鬧的村莊裡，認識各式各樣有趣又獨特的角色！
•	自由調整地形，打造屬於你的理想農場！
•	向你喜愛的對象展開追求，結婚並組成家庭！
•	探索全新作物與花卉，體驗進階的釣魚玩法！
•	擴展水域、挑戰稀有魚種，享受更豐富的釣魚體驗！
•	解鎖所有 DLC 內容，包括全新外觀道具與兩位追加角色！

title: Sword and Fairy Inn 2 [NSZ][ENG]
description:
《仙劍客棧二》是款可愛的休閒生活模擬 RPG，Q 版的畫風結合多樣化的遊戲機制，讓《仙劍》系列中熟悉的面孔能夠齊聚一堂，一同快樂地經營客棧！管理家庭餐廳、環遊世界找出傳奇廚具、交易特殊食材、種植農作、遊玩小遊戲等等！除此之外，也得確保顧客滿意你的服務品質，才能讓更多人來到村子，讓客棧生意蒸蒸日上。

經營客棧時，可以指派每個你遇見並招募到的角色到特定的職位，隨著進度推進，你會更加認識你的夥伴們－－他們的目標、個性、能力和令人會心一笑的小缺點。以輕鬆的方式踏入《仙劍客棧二》的世界，讓老玩家感到懷念又熟悉，新玩家也能輕易上手。

特色：

• 管理客棧的每日經營！
• 輕鬆的方式體驗生活模擬與 RPG 的結合。
• 選擇角色來負責內場與外場的工作。
• 見到《仙劍》世界中熟悉的面孔，了解更多他們的故事！
• 好好照料你的花園，到鄰近地區探險來找出珍貴的原料和廚具！
• 探索周遭的村莊，結識鄰居和顧客！

title: The Stillness of the Wind [NSP][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
人們一個接一個地離開了一度繁榮的村莊而去往城市，只留下塔爾瑪。如今，步入晚年的她孤身一人照料著莊園與山羊，過著艱難而樸素的生活。

你將扮演塔爾瑪，在遊戲中照料農場與動物，制定每天日程，還可以照看山羊，用山羊奶制作奶酪，收集雞蛋，做飯，種植蔬菜，與旅行商人交換物品。旅行商人還會給塔爾瑪捎來城裡家人們令人越發不安的書信。

《風之寂靜》（Stillness of the Wind）是備受好評的Where the Goats Are之後的最新力作，是在寂靜中對生命與失落的沈思。


特點

照料農場
養殖並照看山羊，用山羊奶制作奶酪，種植蔬菜，給植物澆水，收集雞蛋，打發野鳥，體驗艱難但樸素靜谧的生活。

制定日程
玩家將制定塔爾瑪的日程，決定她如何度過每一天。無論是完成每天的任務、在沙漠漫步，還是追憶往事、在沙土中畫圖，全都由你決定。

與商人交換物品
用奶酪及其他物品與商人交換用于餵養山羊的草料、植物種子、民間故事、異國珍品、獵槍子彈。塔爾瑪還將與除了她之外的唯一人影——旅行商人進行對話。

得到關于家人的消息
旅行商人將帶給你來自家人與朋友的信。你將由此了解到那座陌生城市的故事。然而在那裡發生的事，似乎正要卷走你所認知的世界。

title: Castaway Paradise [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Instant vacation on your own tropical island! Decorate the island, dress up, collect insects, grow crops and help your new neighbors. On Castaway Paradise you can do whatever you want.

    ♥ Fun activities 
    ♥ Grow plants
    ♥ Create your own outfit
    ♥ Decorate your island
    ♥ Help the villager out
    ♥ Enjoy the seasons and various events

What would you like to do today in Castaway Paradise?

title: The Keep [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Voydite v Tsitadel nevospetym geroem i popytaytes unichtozhit podlogo kolduna Vatrisa. Issleduyte kamennye zastenki v etoy igre ot pervogo litsa v podzemnykh labirintakh s boyami v realnom vremeni, unikalnoy sistemoy runicheskoy magii, poiskami dobychi i resheniem golovolomok. Vspomnite vse to, chto delalo stol uvlekatelnymi «oldskulnye» RPG v podzemelyakh: srazheniya, spryatannye sokrovishcha i smertonosnye lovushki. Vspomnite vse to, chto delalo stol uvlekatelnymi igry v podzemelyakh: srazheniya, spryatannye sokrovishcha i smertonosnye lovushki. Poznavayte svoikh vragov, nakhodite iz uyazvimye mesta - i pobezhdayte. Eksperimentiruyte s magiey i otkryvayte moshchnye zaklinaniya. Vyzhivut tolko silneyshie! 

Chtoby odolet nepobedimogo Vatrisa, ponadobitsya povysit uroven svoego personazha, nayti krepkuyu bronyu i moshchnoe oruzhie. Itak, u vas est vse, chto nuzhno dlya skhvatki so zlom. Ne meshkayte i vkhodite! Tsitadel zhdet...

title: Love A Puzzle Box Filled with Stories [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
LOVE — eto igra-golovolomka o poiske togo, chto my teryaem v zhizni, a takzhe o lyudyakh, kotorye pomogayut nam obresti eto vnov.

Vy uznaete o proshlom i nastoyashchem zhiltsov mnogokvartirnogo doma — i povliyaete na sobytiya, izmenivshie ikh zhizn.

LOVE — eto eksperimentalnoe povestvovanie, gibrid dioramy i priklyucheniya v stile point-and-click. LOVE predlagaet ne tolko uvlekatelnye zadachi, no i temy dlya soperezhivaniya i razmyshleniya.

Osobennosti:

– ISSLEDUYTE mnogokvartirnyy dom, uznayte bolshe o ego zhiltsakh
– IZUChAYTE sobytiya proshlogo, kotorye do sikh por trevozhat vashikh sosedey
– VRAShchAYTE kvartiry, chtoby peremeshchat ikh vo vremeni dlya resheniya zadach
– VNOSITE izmeneniya v zhizn svoikh sosedey, ispravlyaya ikh proshloe i uluchshaya nastoyashchee

title: Lucy Dreaming [NSP][ENG]
description:
Ride your bike around the small British town of Figgington to meet its sardonic residents. Use your map to explore every corner, from its run-down town centre to the local pub as you discover the town's deepest, darkest secrets.

Learn techniques for dream control and enter Lucy's mind to unlock hidden memories, discover the past and unearth the disturbing truth behind her recurring nightmares.

Along the way, you'll need to solve a huge variety of puzzles, so pour yourself a nice cup of tea and bring your powers of observation, logic and lateral thinking.

From her dysfunctional family and the cynical Figgington townsfolk to the myriad of extraordinary characters from the depths of Lucy's subconscious, do you have what it takes to pacify giant crabs, interrogate old ladies, satisfy toddlers and bargain with trolls? Just don’t forget your teddy bear.

Game Features:
A wide variety of pixel art dreams and real-world locations.
An exceptional voice cast including Dominic Armato (Monkey Island's own Guybrush Threepwood).
Detailed scenes with witty responses to almost everything.
Collect badges.
Hotspot finder.

title: Boxville [NSZ][Multi]
description:
Boxville 是二合一的：一部動畫電影和一款益智遊戲。

Boxville 是一款冒險益智遊戲，講述了生活在盒子之城中的無言罐頭和在紙板上塗鴉來講述故事的故事。
Boxville 非常適合一個人玩，通過複雜的邏輯謎題和謎語潛入氛圍並挑戰您的大腦，或者與朋友或家人一起玩，分享獨特的視聽體驗並一起解決謎題。

設計
遊戲的核心理念是它不僅僅是一款遊戲——還是一部可以邊看邊玩的動畫電影。
我們設計 Boxville 的遊戲玩法是為了消除您的焦慮和壓力。 您可以在沒有匆忙和壓力的情況下探索和觀察世界。
遊戲中充滿了我們從數百個選項中精心挑選的環境任務和邏輯謎題。

故事
Boxville 是一個充滿舊罐頭的盒子城市。 他們按照自己的日常生活和習慣過著平靜而幸福的生活。 但是有一天，不明原因的地震打亂了他們的田園生活……
Blue Can（我們的英雄）因此失去了他最好的朋友。 他開始尋找，但地震過後要穿過這座城市並不那麼容易。 他必須找到前進的方法，將朋友送回家，並找出所有這些地震的真正原因。 有很多冒險，新朋友，而且在路上等他的不僅僅是朋友。
他必須好奇、有創造力、細心並樂於助人，才能實現自己的目標。


您可以期待在 Boxville 看到和聽到的內容：
- 手繪圖形——所有背景和角色均由我們的藝術家精心繪製。
- 每個動畫和聲音都是專門為每次交互創建的。
- 為每個場景創建了獨特的音樂曲目，以營造遊戲氛圍。
- 數十個邏輯謎題和迷你遊戲與遊戲故事緊密結合。
- 遊戲中沒有文字——所有角色都通過卡通對話泡泡進行交流。

title: Boxville 2 [NSZ][Multi]
description:
Triomatica Games 出品的《Boxville 2》是一款關於盒子城市中的罐頭生活的冒險遊戲的下一部分。
兩個罐頭朋友接受了市長的重要工作，為該市的慶祝活動燃放煙火。但由於失誤，煙火放錯了，造成了城市的混亂。更糟的是，其中一位朋友失蹤了。現在，主角，一個紅罐頭，必須探索博克斯維爾的不同區域和秘密地點，甚至出城去修復一切並找到他的朋友。

您在博克斯維爾可以看到和聽到什麼：
- 手繪圖形－所有背景和人物都是由我們的藝術家精心繪製的。
- 每個動畫和聲音都是專門為每次互動創建的。
- 為每個場景製作了獨特的音樂來烘托遊戲氣氛。
- 數十個邏輯謎題和小遊戲緊密融入遊戲故事中。
- 遊戲中沒有文字－所有角色都透過卡通草圖進行溝通。

title: MofuMofu Sensen (mofumofusensen) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
MofuMofu Sensen — bezumno mrachnyy klassicheskiy arkadnyy 2D-fayting v tyomnom stile, polnostyu razrabotannyy nezavisimoy yaponskoy studiey BURNSOUCOU, v kotorom predstavleny antropomorfnye personazhi v raznykh superkostyumakh, srazhayushchikhsya v otchayannykh boyakh za pobedu!
Imeyutsya pyat tipov osnovnykh atak plyus 5 osobykh: slabaya ataka, srednyaya ataka, silnaya ataka, spetsialnaya ataka i brosok, u kazhdogo takzhe est 5 svoikh sobstvennykh spetspriyomov. Auto Advancing Guard (AAG), sistema, avtomaticheski razdelyayushchaya rasstoyanie mezhdu protivnikami pri zashchite v zavisimosti ot velichiny shkaly AAG. Eto pozvolyaet ispolzovat improvizirovannuyu taktiku, kotoraya predotvrashchaet odnoobrazie v sparringe, i prednaznachen dlya togo, chtoby vse, ot novichkov do prodvinutykh igrokov, khoteli srazhatsya chestno i s azartom!
Dostupnye boytsy:

title: Luna 3X [NSZ][ENG]
description:
透過“魔力”能源，文化興盛，人類與自然共存的幸福時代。
然而有一天……「大海嘯要來了!!!」雖然沒有人相信那位神秘的預言者『吉·伊桑二世』的預言，但機器人露娜和少年尤納聽從了他的占卜，帶上了釣具，開始了一場神秘的救援行動……

〇玩法說明
當你左右傾斜 Joy-Con™ (L)時，露娜會相應地傾斜魚竿，讓尤納左右搖晃。你可以有節奏地按下A鍵，或者揮動 Joy-Con™ (R)，讓尤納跟著節奏打手鼓。把靠近的“生物”們聚集並救出來！按住L鍵避開障礙物，順利釣起尤納和“生物”們！如果撞得太猛，“生物”們會生氣並離開，所以要小心哦。有時會有強風吹來，或者有東西掉下來，但只要兩人配合好，保持平衡，一定能順利完成任務！

〇拯救這個星球上的“生物”們
在這個世界裡，生活著許多叫做凱莫農（ケモノン）和普蘭普蘭（プランプラン）的“生物”！他們只要聽到手鼓聲就會靠近你！你可能在不同的地方找到更稀有的凱莫農和普蘭普蘭！在大海嘯來臨前，盡可能多地拯救這些生物吧！

〇多樣化的關卡
海洋、雪地、風暴等不同場景中包含三個任務，完成後可以把許多“生物”送上火箭救出！多次挑戰後，還可能發現稀有的生物哦！

〇換裝功能
透過完成任務或在商店購買，可以收集到獨特的服裝！更換服裝不僅可以幫助你更容易地收集到特定的“生物”，還能提升抗風能力等各種效果！

title: Love Elysium Secret of the Goddess + 5 DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
參加彩票活動，與你最好的朋友——由以你為評委的漂亮女孩Yuina一起，開啟你一生中最難忘的假期。在這個島上，你將與競爭對手一同參加美容比賽——有藝術感的Eimiko、嚴肅而優雅的Haru、指揮家Tomoe和風騷的Aimi。啟動你的戀愛遊戲，比賽現在開始！

她們的秘密是什麼？
當你與女孩們共度時光時，你會注意到她們的奇怪行為。她們對你隱瞞了什麼？為什麼你特別贏得了比賽？這是否與你的記憶喪失有關？

讓她們迷住你
在島上的逗留期間，你將有機會與每個女孩共度時光。通過各種活動，如慢跑或游泳，更好地了解她們的故事和個性。她們可能會試圖賄賂你，不公平地玩……但這可以留給你和她們之間。你會保守她們的秘密嗎？

只有一個贏家
儘管所有女孩都美麗迷人，但只有一個人能贏得比賽。她們中的哪一個會給你留下深刻的印象，使你授予她金色的蘋果？你會跟隨內心還是會公平比賽？

最重要的是：你會在愛情之至福樂土中找到愛嗎？

主要特色：

- 等待你的精彩故事
- 發現5個結局= 5倍的遊戲體驗
- 女孩們獨特的個性和氣質
- 您可以選擇的許多對話選項
- 充滿魔力的島嶼
- 女孩們根據你的言語有不同的反應

title: Mini Golf Simulator [NSZ][ENG]
description:
採用掛上Joy-Con™揮桿的「宮澤式推桿控制器」的新型態高爾夫遊戲！
勝利將花落誰家？

title: Troll and I [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 俄语 lyubitelskiy, 移植版 djonmarvel
description:
Khodyat slukhi, chto v glukhom skandinavskom lesu voditsya nekoe mificheskoe sushchestvo. V poiskakh sushchestva neskolko zhestokikh okhotnikov raznosyat malenkuyu derevushku, vynuzhdaya podrostka po imeni Otto pokinut dom. Spasayas begstvom, Otto vstrechaet to samoe sushchestvo, i oni stanovyatsya druzyami. Tak nachinaetsya opasnoe priklyuchenie trollya i Otto.
Novoispechyonnye druzya otpravlyayutsya v puteshestvie po opasnoy zemle, polnoy vragov. Troll i Otto vyrosli v lesu, i im predstoit dobratsya do doma pri pomoshchi maskirovki, strategii i bitv. Les polon neizvedannogo, i, chtoby vyzhit v nyom, neobkhodimo deystvovat soobshcha.

title: World of One [NSP][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
Predstavte...
Vy zhivete v sobstvennom malenkom mire, v kotorom est vse – uyutnyy domik, dvor s kreslom-kachalkoy, tsvetami i derevyami, i dazhe sobstvennyy park razvlecheniy s muzykoy, beskonechnym zapasom feyerverkov i kolesom obozreniya, s kotorogo mozhno dotyanutsya do zvezd! Nichto ne meshaet Vashemu uedineniyu, i lish malenkoe chuvstvo bespokoystva govorit Vam, chto chto-to idet ne tak. No v odin den vse kardinalno menyaetsya, i teper Vam predstoit vyyasnit, chto zhe na samom dele skryvaet etot mir…
Osobennosti
Vam predstoit puteshestvie po malenkim miram-planetam, slovno Vy popali v mir Malenkogo Printsa, polnyy smertelnykh lovushek, stremyashchikhsya Vas ubit monstrov i zagadok, dlya resheniya kotorykh nuzhno byt nakhodchivym i vnimatelnym. Pogruzites v prichudlivyy i atmosfernyy mir tyomnoy skazki, doberites do ego serdtsa i uznayte, chto zhe skryvaetsya v tumane.

V indii-platformere World of One Vas zhdut urovni i pazzly, mnogie iz kotorykh imeyut neskolko sposobov resheniya, bitvy s ogromnymi bossami i vrazhdebnymi tvaryami i 4 raznykh kontsovki, zavisyashchie ot Vashikh deystviy i resheniy na protyazhenii igry. I tolko reshimost pomozhet Vam zavershit svoe puteshestvie i uznat pravdu o samom sebe.

Budte vnimatelny, World of One brosaet vyzov vashemu umu i navykam. Bolee togo, posle polnogo prokhozhdeniya igry stanovitsya dostupen rezhim «Novaya igra+», v kotorom u Vas budet vsego 3 zhizni. Primete li Vy etot vyzov?

title: Ashwalkers a Survival Journey [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Pogruzites v tayny chelovecheskoy prirody i uznayte, chto skryvaetsya v teni.

Osobennosti igry
- Nelineynoe povestvovanie: kazhdyy vash vybor opredelyaet razvitie igry.
- Mnozhestvo syuzhetnykh razvilok i 34 kontsovki.
- Vam predstoit zabotitsya ne tolko o resursakh dlya svoego otryada, no i eshchyo o fizicheskom i psikhologicheskom sostoyanii boytsov.
- Vzglyanite na tovarishchey po oruzhiyu cherez prizmu vzaimootnosheniy v gruppe.
- Puteshestvuyte i izuchayte nedruzhelyubnyy mir, pogibshiy v ogne vulkanov.
- Sobirayte resursy i sozdavayte vsyo neobkhodimoe v puti.
- 34 raznye kontsovki

Otkryvayte dlya sebya chto-to novoe v kazhdom priklyuchenii (polnoe uspeshnoe prokhozhdenie zanimaet bolee 2 chasov). Vas zhdut 34 varianta finala.

Kontrol nad fizicheskim i psikhicheskim sostoyaniem otryada
Vam predstoit ne tolko podbirat ekipirovku i zabotitsya o propitanii tovarishchey, no i ne dat im soyti s uma ili vpast v depressiyu. Ishchite i sobirayte neobkhodimye dlya vyzhivaniya resursy, chtoby uberech svoy otryad.

Kharakternye personazhi
Postignite vse tonkosti vzaimootnosheniy mezhdu otvazhnoy predvoditelnitsey otryada Petroy (Petra), pragmatichnym boytsom Sinkhom (Sinh), yunoy optimistichnoy uchenitsey Kali (Kali) i ostorozhnym razvedchikom Nadirom (Nadir) i vmeste doberites do kraya sveta.

Bezradostnoe budushchee
Cherez 200 let posle nachala geologicheskogo apokalipsisa mir prevratilsya v vyzhzhennuyu pustynyu. Udastsya li vam perezhit vse kaprizy vzbesivsheysya pogody: pepelnye buri, seruyu purgu i kislotnye dozhdi?

title: Darker Skies [NSP][ENG]
description:
The War is over, but the effects linger. Take control of Jack, a survivor of the War of the Worlds trying to rebuild a working Heat Ray to blow his way to freedom and light the spark that will rebuild civilization. 

Explore the Horrors of the world after interplanetary war, encounter psychotic enemies suffering from prolonged exposure to Red Weed. Collect parts from fallen Tripod's and rebuild your own Heat Ray and maybe even come face to face with the few surviving Martians themselves.

Craft weapons and items and combine them in interesting ways to take out the creatures left by the war, sneak your way past, or just shoot your way through. You decide.

title: RoboPhobik [NSZ][ENG]
description:
當您展開充滿愛，恨和機器的豐富故事時，請運用戰術技巧避免被機器人包圍！

在70年代初期，政府建立了一個秘密的實驗機器人城，由一台名為PAL 9000的超級計算機控制。一天，PAL 9000失控，反抗了他的創造者。他俘虜了科學家，並開始了一個邪惡的計劃來統治世界。
為了重新獲得對PAL 9000及其機器人的控制，已經組建了一支由高技能代理組成的特殊團隊。有些人已經進入了這座城市，只是被困在裡面。
作為新秀特工朱莉（Julie），您的目標是找到所有隊友並擊敗邪惡的PAL 9000。
但是...您確定自己在右邊嗎？您確定機器人是侵略者嗎？

-敵人會對您的行為做出反應！如果您將被包圍，請停下來尋找一個安全的地方...然後去那裡繼續戰鬥！

-6個可玩角色，每個角色都有獨特的玩法！

-一個關於愛情，仇恨和機器的故事，其中有一個多小時的過場動畫！

-拯救80多位科學家，並解鎖10種強大的武器！

title: Witch's Pranks - Frog's Fortune [NSZ][ENG]
description:
邪惡女巫、大量青蛙、無數亂局和扣人心弦的故事在等著你！

你身處於此陷入瘋狂的童話故事世界。被邪惡女巫俘虜，你必須解開巧妙的謎題，逃離她的魔爪。

她的唯一目的是把所有王子變成青蛙。王子們都希望回到家中公主們的身邊。

因此，為你的駿馬（如果你能找到一匹的話）套上韁繩，出發解放貴族青蛙們吧！

- 以現代方式融合點擊冒險和拼圖遊戲
- 有趣巧妙的故事，女巫、青蛙，甚至或許會有駿馬（重申一次，可能不會）登場

title: Titan Glory [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
«Rassvet titanov» — eto nauchno-fantasticheskaya igra o srazheniyakh robotov, v kotoroy vas zhdut bogatyy vybor mekhov i vooruzheniya, raznoobraznye rezhimy igry i vpechatlyayushchie areny dlya boyov.

V nedalekom budushchem sorevnovaniya boevykh mekhov polzuyutsya neveroyatnoy populyarnostyu! Raznoobraznye pravila matchey i postavlennye pered sorevnuyushchimisya zadachi dobavlyayut ostrykh oshchushcheniy grandioznym srazheniyam, polnym vzryvov i svistyashchikh snaryadov.

Za uchastie v turnirakh i pobedy v matchakh vy poluchite tsennye kredity i rangi, kotorye, v svoyu ochered, dadut vam dostup k 12 mekham s unikalnymi kharakteristikami i oruzhiem. Vybirayte sami, kakoy komponent uluchshit i kakie pokazateli svoey mashiny dovesti do predela.

U kazhdogo mekha svoy stil igry i svoe oruzhie. Uluchshite svoyu adskuyu mashinu, chtoby dobitsya prevoskhodstva na arene i sniskat slavu pobeditelya.

Matchi prokhodyat na shesti ogromnykh arenakh, spetsialno sozdannykh dlya raznoobraziya vozmozhnykh stiley igry i situatsiy. U kazhdoy areny svoya atmosfera i oformlenie — ot gorodskikh tsentrov do shirokikh poley i drevnikh khramov.

Igroki mogut ottachivat svoe masterstvo v lokalnykh turnirakh, a zatem poprobovat styazhat slavu v dinamichnykh setevykh matchakh na 12 igrokov. Sorevnuytes s igrokami po vsemu miru ili sozdavayte zakrytye matchi dlya igry s druzyami.

12 mekhov, kotorye mozhno razblokirovat i uluchshit.
Shest ogromnykh raznoobraznykh aren, kotorye nuzhno osvoit, chtoby dominirovat nad drugimi igrokami
Sem vidov osnovnogo oruzhiya dlya totalnogo razrusheniya
Chetyre vida dopolnitelnogo oruzhiya, pozvolyayushchego poluchit takticheskoe preimushchestvo
Devyat rezhimov igry, kotorye ne dadut zaskuchat
12 turnirov, v kotorykh mozhno zavoevat sebe slavu
Setevye matchi na 12 igrokov

title: Mighty Fight Federation + DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Mighty Fight - eto popytka vozvrashcheniya k klassicheskim 3D-faytingam na arene, no s aktsentom na osnovy samogo zhanra faytingov. Vybirayte iz spiska personazhey, kazhdyy iz kotorykh imeet unikalnye vozmozhnosti dlya provedeniya kombo. Ispolzuyte igrovuyu mekhaniku pod nazvaniem «khayp», chtoby vsyacheski ogranichivat, uklonyatsya, protivostoyat i igrat v igry razuma so svoimi protivnikami. Mighty Fight sochetaet v sebe staroe i novoe v svoikh unikalnykh sorevnovatelnykh osobennostyakh zhanra gruppovogo faytinga.

OSOBENNOSTI:

- Mnogopolzovatelskiy bespredel:
Srazhaytes s 4 igrokami maksimum po lokalnoy seti i v rezhime onlayn

- Odinochnaya igra:
Doydite do raznykh kontsovok v arkadnom rezhime i poprobuyte preuspet vo vsem s pomoshchyu vnutriigrovykh rukovodstv i trenirovochnogo rezhima

- Vyberite svoego personazha: 
vybirayte iz spiska 13 neobychnykh personazhey s unikalnymi stilyami igry. Stavte lovushki, brosayte vzryvnye snaryady i atakuyte stremitelnymi kombo. Naydite stil, kotoryy podkhodit imenno vam

- Srazhaytes ili ubegayte:
nakaplivayte energiyu, chtoby potratit ee na kombo-breykery ili na aktivatsiyu khayp-faktora, kotoryy mozhet perelomit khod bitvy. Pravilnyy vybor mozhet sygrat klyuchevuyu rol

- Samyy khaypovyy saundtrek:
Potryasayushchiy saundtrek s muzykoy T Lopesa (Sonic Mania), Dzheymsa Landino (RWBY, No Straight Roads), Vinsa DiKoly (Rocky IV, Transformers), Manami Matsumae (Mega Man, Shovel Knight)

- Postoyanno popolnyayushchiysya spisok personazhey:
Mighty Fight prodolzhit popolnyat spisok boytsov novymi originalnymi i krossovernymi personazhami!

title: The Walking Zombie 2 [NSP][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
description:
殭屍末日之後的世界殘酷無比。生在其中，你必須鬥爭才能生存，與各種各樣的殭屍、土匪和危險的怪獸首領戰鬥。在這個FPS/RPG遊戲中，你將踏上重要的故事征途和許多支線征程，升級你的技能和特權，買賣裝備，與幸運或不幸的倖存者交流。

生存類角色扮演遊戲和第一人稱射擊遊戲
Walking Zombie 2是一款卓越的復古型第一人稱射擊遊戲，具有故事主線、數十個任務以及包含各類武器的大量射擊元素 - 你還可以離線玩這個遊戲，無需網路连接。你的主要敵人是已經主宰世界的殭屍。他們無所不在，類型多樣，最終要的是數量眾多。你要使用配備不同彈藥的槍械、手雷或格鬥武器了結他們。同時，你可以用急救包和食物治愈自己。隨著你完成的任務越來越多，你的角色會越發強大，擁有更精良的裝備、加強的技能和增益的特權。你會獲得更多生命值嗎？更高的開鎖獲獎概率？或者在行經世界各地的時候降低油耗？你將如何限制死者對世界的影響？

特色
- 好玩的復古型末日後單人第一人稱射擊
- 極具吸引力的現代多邊形圖形風格
- 因果報應系統 - 行為的善與惡產生新的選項和遭遇
- 數十個故事和支線任務
- 海量武器、防護裝備和其他裝備 - 打造自己的生存陣容
- 離線生存遊戲
- 遊戲開放世界部分的可選製作和建造
- 武器皮膚
- 各種各樣的敵人 - 殭屍步行者，土匪和巨大的變異首領
- 定居點的貿易商
- 你可以完成殭屍獵人王牌的可選任務
- 汽車和卡車 - 比步行快，你還可以在卡車中存儲更多來自死者的戰利品！
- 有趣的迷你遊戲


故事：有著悲情過往的天選之子
你的故事開頭如此悲劇，結局能否圓滿？你出生之時的周圍環境，決定了你是唯一可以拯救世界的人。你對把人和動物變成殭屍的病毒免疫。這也讓你成為對抗星球上的不死高手的完美武器，而且是美好明天的希望象徵。每個角落都潛伏著危險，你與在征途中結識的朋友一起，探索你的身世真相，尋找創造解藥方法。

不斷擴展的3D殭屍射擊遊戲
我們仍在努力為遊戲開發新內容。更多故事情節，你可以在其中探索危險的殭屍前線，努力使世界變得更加美好和宜居。我們致力於開發新機制，因此你可以在自己所購房屋的加工桌上製作汽油和彈藥等生存物品。另外，你的打擊目標不僅僅是死者，因為你的行動可能引發某些倖存者的仇恨 - 土匪、腐敗的政客、邪教分子、幫派等。殭屍時代還在繼續，但是利用武器庫中的新工具，你能夠承受！

title: Trifox [NSZ][ENG]
description:
《Trifox》是一款色彩豐富、卡通風格的動作冒險遊戲。遊戲的主角是一名身懷各種絕技的厲害狐狸！從戰士、法師、工程師三種職業中選擇一種，或是混搭不同技能來打造專屬於你的英雄！

• 三種不同的職業：化身戰士揮舞巨錘！成為掌握神祕魔法的法師！或當工程師用花樣眾多的發明進行冒險！

• 現代風的復古冒險：透過嶄新新鮮的遊戲體驗來體會經典3D平台動作遊戲的精髓吧！

title: Metallic Child + 7 DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
宇宙船生命之流號內發生了重大叛亂事件。
機械少女――《METALLIC CHILD》洛娜，為了阻止叛亂的主謀，同時也是製造出自己的母親―艾琳博士，將與身為「玩家」的你一同攜手合作，向巨大的機器敵人發起挑戰。

『METALLIC CHILD』是以未來的宇宙實驗室為舞台，描述著機械少女――《METALLIC CHILD》洛娜面對叛亂事件的Rogue-lite・核心動作遊戲。

title: D / DGeneration the Original + D/Generation HD [NSP][ENG]
developer: Robert Cook, James Brown, Mark Knight
description:
Hours after receiving an urgent call in his Paris apartment, the protagonist of D/Generation, a nameless courier, arrives in London via his Jet-Pack, touching down on the 80th floor of Genoq Biolabs' medical research facility with an important package for lead Genoq scientist Jean-Paul Derrida. As soon as he enters, however, the doors shut and seal themselves behind him. This, however, proves to be the least of his problems, as the receptionist soon informs him of Genoq's dire state. All lines of communication to the outside world have been severed, and furthermore the building's security systems and dangerous Neogens have run amok. Despite the perils within and the receptionist's adamant warnings, the courier chooses to proceed, perhaps believing that the item in his possession holds the key to stopping the chaos which grips Genoq.
Over the course of his journey into the building's upper reaches, the courier learns that Genoq had been steeped in the realm of illegal bioweapon development for some time, and that their medical research, which had long ago become unprofitable for them, was little more than a front for their more lucrative practice of creating and selling biological weapons called Neogens. Derrida had been brought on by the company to spearhead a project which would create the ultimate Neogen, and the fruit of his efforts, an artificial organism dubbed D/Generation, was ultimately the source of the disturbances within the building. Further complicating matters, he also learns that Genoq's corporate leaders have authorized an airstrike against the building in order to prevent details of their activities from going public.
Gameplay
The main gameplay of D/Generation consists of traversing interconnected rooms (called "scenes" within the game), accomplishing various tasks within them in order to ascend to the next level of the tower. Each level is comprised of multiple scenes, and each scene typically presents a particular challenge which must be overcome in order to progress. The game alternates between action-based and puzzle-based gameplay, with many scenes requiring some combination of both. On the action side of things, players are constantly harassed by hostile Neogens and security systems, which frequently require quick reflexes in order to defeat. Certain doors will only unlock when an area has been cleared of dangerous entities, and furthermore it is usually not feasible to rescue survivors (who grant additional lives) until an area has been completely cleared of enemies. 

As the game reaches its climax, the tone becomes unexpectedly surreal.

At the same time, there are cases where it is more advantageous to manipulate an enemy rather than killing it outright, which leads into the game's more cerebral leanings. Trackers can be used to kill other Trackers without firing a shot, for instance, and a Neogen that collides with a plasma barrier will permanently disable it. These are just two examples of instances in which the player is rewarded for thinking before they shoot. Most areas contain switches which can open and close doors, activate and deactivate security measures, or both, and success in many scenes comes down to manipulating these switches (as well as other devices, such as computer terminals and teleporters) in such a way as to provide safe passage for ones' self and any civilians. Timing and pattern recognition is also a crucial element throughout the game, since tougher puzzles can require that a series of deliberate actions be performed quickly.
