description: Ne prosto eshchyo odna tsifrovaya adaptatsiya populyarnoy nastolno-rolevoy igry. Eto poistine neobychnoe tvorenie, kotoroe cherpaet vdokhnovenie iz mnozhestva nastolnykh igr, sozdavaya pri etom sovershenno novyy mir i igrovuyu sistemu. Razrabotchiki Ludogram, sozdavshie etot proekt, s lyubovyu i vnimaniem k detalyam perenesli atmosferu klassicheskikh nastolnykh RPG v tsifrovoy format, sokhraniv vsyo eyo ocharovanie, s samogo nachala pogruzhaya igroka v mir, slovno sozdannyy dlya nastoyashchey nastolnoy igry. Personazhi, predstavlennye v vide miniatyur, razmeshchayutsya na igrovom pole, a protivniki poyavlyayutsya v vide kartonnykh vyrezok, kotorye ozhivayut, slovno v rukakh opytnogo mastera igry. Kazhdaya lokatsiya vyglyadit, budto eyo sozdal uvlechyonnyy poklonnik Dungeons & Dragons dlya posledney sessii svoey gruppy. Analogovaya estetika pronizyvaet vsyu igru, sozdavaya illyuziyu togo, chto vy mozhete protyanut ruku k ekranu i vzaimodeystvovat s igrovymi elementami. Sozdayotsya oshchushchenie, chto vy mozhete vzyat svoego personazha, peredvinut ego po stolu i povalit vragov, kak v nastoyashchey nastolnoy igre, masterski vossozdayot atmosferu nastolnoy RPG, pozvolyaya igrokam pogruzitsya v mir, kotoryy oni sozdayut vmeste.

title: Warpips (War Pips) [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
快速流暢的戰鬥
-專注大方向，不鑽牛角尖
-每回合長約10至20分鐘
-上手很簡單，要玩得好卻不容易

誠實營利
-購買遊戲，即可獲得完整遊戲體驗
-沒有其他遊戲內收費道具
-拒絕「撒錢才能贏」

隨機戰鬥
-隨機生成的戰鬥
-每次遊玩都不一樣
-無論怎麼玩都不膩

深度策略
-制訂單位之間互相協調合作的巧妙策略
-具備無限可能的策略組合
-可完整解鎖的升級分支

緊湊戰鬥
-生成步兵、車輛、飛機與直升機
-呼叫空襲、飛彈與火砲支援
-單位會依照戰況來靈活地尋找掩護並作出反應
-所有東西都會爆炸！

title: Raven's Hike [NSP][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Raven's Hike 是一款 2D 精密平台遊戲，具有挑戰性的遊戲，要求玩家找到完成有一點謎題的最佳路線，所有的動作都是基於主角的抓鉤。

隨著遊戲的進行，難度曲線逐漸增加，需要精通控制和更精確的動作。

準備好你的平台技能（當然還有你的抓鉤）來享受這種奇妙的體驗。

由Wired Dream Studio開發，QUByte Interactive發行。

title: Ark Dinosaur Discovery [NSP][ENG]
description:
在《方舟：生存進化（ARK: Survival Evolved）》的世界與遠古時代的恐龍互動吧。

廣大的島嶼中住著多達64種不同的恐龍！遊戲中不但有大量的恐龍登場，還會忠實呈現牠們的生態喔。可以騎乘巨大的霸王龍探索島嶼、乘著翼手龍翱翔天際、跟著巨齒鯊悠游海中，隨心所欲地在島上探索遊歷。

恐龍圖鑑中收錄著許多新奇好玩的恐龍機密資料，搭配HLN-A的全語音解說。不僅如此，歷險結束後更將獲得30種以上的建築零件。動手打造專屬於自己的秘密基地吧。

你能夠找出所有的恐龍，成為究極的恐龍博士嗎？

※本產品是將《方舟：生存進化（ARK: Survival Evolved）》中的部分要素擷取出來，重新構成適合所有年齡層遊玩的作品。不支援多人數遊玩的功能。

title: The Future You've Been Dreaming of [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Take on the role of a Zashiki-Warashi, a house-bound spirit that can bring good fortune, and peer into Sachi's life (though she can't see you). You'll see some of her more vulnerable moments and have no choice but to intervene from time to time, but it's all to guide her toward a bright future!

Give her direction while she's at home and help her grow her parameters in all kinds of ways. Your guidance will determine the future she ultimately heads toward. There are 20 total paths awaiting Sachi, and it's up to you to help her find them!

title: Later Alligator [NSZ][ENG]
description: Hey! You! The hard-boiled reptile I can definitely see holding this game. You’re the perfect person to help Pat the Alligator uncover the secret behind the mysterious “event” his family’s planning for him in the heart of Alligator New York City.

title: Sonic CD Remastered (移植版 rvm soniccd) [NSP][ENG]
description:
Sonic the Hedgehog CD (yap. ソニック・ザ・ヘッジホッグ CD, Sonikku dza Khedzikhoggu Si: Di:), na territoriyakh Evropy i SShA izvestna pod nazvaniem Sonic CD — videoigra v zhanre platformer, razrabotannaya kompaniey Sonic Team i izdannaya Sega osenyu 1993 goda, pervaya i edinstvennaya igra serii Sonic the Hedgehog, vyshedshey na pristavku Sega Mega-CD.
Sonic the Hedgehog CD vypolnena v dvukhmernoy grafike, a igrovoy protsess pokhozh na predydushchie igry serii. Po syuzhetu doktor Robotnik, posetiv Malenkuyu planetu, khochet ispolzovat Kamni Vremeni, sposobnye kontrolirovat khod vremeni. Yozh Sonik, uznav ob etom, otpravlyaetsya na issledovanie planety. Po puti on vstrechaet Emi Rouz, odnako vskore eyo pokhishchaet Metal Sonik, metallicheskaya kopiya sinego ezha..

title: Sagebrush [NSZ][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
Vdokhnovlennaya realnymi kultami mira, Sagebrush — eto priklyuchencheskaya, osnovannaya na povestvovanii igra s deystviem ot pervogo litsa, kotoraya vveryaet igroku missiyu poiska istiny, rassledovaniya tragicheskikh obstoyatelstv massovogo samoubiystva chlenov kulta Perfect Heaven.

Deystvie proiskhodit v shtate Nyu-Meksiko, igroku predstoit issledovat rancho Black Sage, byvshiy dom ottsa Dzheymsa, pochitaemogo proroka kulta Perfect Heaven, chtoby dokopatsya do pravdy.

Kharakteristiki: 
 * Zakhvatyvayushchiy lou-fay 3D-mir
 * Bolshaya territoriya dlya izucheniya
 * Kharakternaya atmosfernaya zvukovaya dorozhka
 * Igra sozdana pod vpechatleniem o mirovykh apokalipticheskikh kultakh

title: Tower of Babel No Mercy [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Who, as a child, didn't enjoy smashing his brother's or sister's carefully built tower?

Tower of Babel is a multiplayer physics-based tower building game. You and your friends will have to build a tower together. But beware! Who makes the tower collapse loses the game. Build with caution then cast magic spells to scupper your friends moves!

Easy to pick up and endless fun! Play with your friends or with your family in 3 crazy modes. You can also play online against another team!

With alliance games and combined magic spells, it won't be an easy ride. Tower of Babel is a game that cements friendships and breaks towers... or the other way around!

title: Genetic Disaster [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Kazhdyy uroven protsedurno generiruetsya dlya bolshego raznoobraziya. Ordy vragov uzhe ozhidayut Vas, no ne zabyvayte ob okruzhenii, zdes polno lovushek. Uluchshayte svoego geroya, chtoby vyrabotat unikalnye stili i kombinatsii personazhey, igraya s druzyami.

Vy ne nastroeny na kooperativnuyu igru? Spetsialnaya PvP arena uzhe zhdyot: "Stool Wars" pozvolit 2-4 igrokam srazitsya mezhdu soboy. Nikakogo oruzhiya, tolko to, chto popadyot pod ruku.

Osobennosti Genetic Disaster:
- Igray sam ili s druzyami (do 4 igrokov)
- Protseduralno generiruemye urovni
- Neobyknovennyy graficheskiy stil
- Bolee 75 vidov oruzhiya
- More vragov i lovushek na kazhdom urovne
- 4 unikalnykh personazha so svoimi sposobnostyami
- Bolee 50 mutatsiy dlya uluchsheniya vashego geroya
- Dopolnitelnyy PvP rezhim (2-4 igrokov)

Deviz igry: "Sotrudnichayte, no ne slishkom!"

title: It's Raining Fists and Metal [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
Pokazhite svoim protivnikam, chto takoe nastoyashchiy metall! Srazhaytes v takt s muzykoy, igraya na svoem instrumente ili ispolzuya ego v kachestve oruzhiya, zadayte zharu svoim protivnikam i sbroste ikh so stseny, sorvav gromkie aplodismenty zriteley v etom zakhvatyvayushchem boevom simulyatore!

Osnovnye vozmozhnosti:
-Ot 1 do 4 igrokov na odnom ekrane
-Igrayte s druzyami ili protiv kompyutera
-Srazhaytes so svoimi protivnikami v takt metalla, zadayte im zharu i raspravtes s nimi, naglo sbrosiv ikh so stseny
-Slushat razlichnye metallicheskie pesni, sozdannye spetsialno dlya etoy igry
-Vyberite svoego gitarista i podberite emu odezhdu i instrument
-Igrayte na raznykh kartakh, kazhdaya iz kotorykh imeet svoi unikalnye bonusy
-Priklyuchencheskiy rezhim (odinochnaya igra i kooperativ)
-Unikalnye personazhi s individualnymi kharakterami

Srazhaytes v takt s muzykoy: atakuyte svoikh vragov, chtoby nanesti im uron, budte bditelny vo vremya igry, chtoby ne propustit otvetnyy udar i, sbroste ikh so stseny, chtoby pobedit.
Sobirayte takie predmety, kak usiliteli i instrumenty, chtoby ispolzovat ikh vo vremya srazheniya.
Dokazhite, kto nastoyashchiy bog metalla, postoyanno nakhodyas v tsentre vnimaniya, poka ne poluchite zaklyuchitelnuyu ataku: gitarnoe solo, kotoroe okonchatelno unichtozhit vashikh protivnikov!

Lokalnyy multipleer trebuet kontrollera dlya kazhdogo igroka!

title: Impossible Mission Remastered Remake Revisited [NSZ][ENG]
description:
A faithful adaptation of the past retro classic that improves on the original in every way. You have just 6 hours to find all the pieces to solve a mad scientist’s puzzle while avoiding devious human-seeking robots and deadly black orbs. Includes three versions, the C64 original classic , a re-skinned classic and the totally updated new version.

The object of the secret mission is to put a stop to the evil genius, Professor Elvin Atombender, who is suspected of hacking into National Security computers. You must penetrate Atombender’s Secret Island bunker. In a race against time, you must search for pieces of a secret password that will shut down the deadly missiles of the deranged Professor. 

Using the elevator system, make your way through the maze of corridors of the secret hideaway, but beware, you will have to outwit the hordes of deadly robots that patrol each area.

The robots all react in different ways, so observe each robot in turn and try and learn its patrol parameters and attack methods.

Once into a safe area, check all objects, furniture and computer terminals for pieces of the Secret Password. 

If you fail to find the Password, life on Earth as we know it will change forever...Atombender has Nuclear missiles pointed at strategic targets around the globe...The count down has begun...you have a matter of hours to save the planet...you have been chosen to undertake the Impossible Mission!

"…another visitor, stay a while, stay forever."

title: Hollow 1-2 [NSZ][ENG,RUS]
interface_lang: 俄语 (Hollow), 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
UZhAS
... vy prosypaetes na palube korablya Shakhter-One. S kazhdoy minutoy, provedennoy zdes, istoriya dushevnoy dramy i semi Marka stanovitsya yasnee... no ves spektr ego emotsiy i stradaniy eshche predstoit poznat, i budet eto uzhasno. Proklyatie opustevshey dobyvayushchey stantsii — eto vechnaya, neskonchaemaya bol. I prekratit ee mozhno lish odnim sposobom... Otkryt istinu. No temnye koridory i vospominaniya Marka revnostno oberegayut svoi tayny.

VYZhIT
... eto koshmar! Issledovaniya i vyzhivanie — eto daleko ne vse, chto predstoit delat v Hollow 2 na puti k svoemu proshlomu. S pomoshchyu novykh dinamichnykh i prostykh mekhanik vam pridetsya zachistit pokinutuyu stantsiyu radi svoey tseli. Ispolzuyte vse naydennye instrumenty i oruzhie i ubedites, chto ni odna meloch ne stoit na vashem puti k pravde. Begite, srazhaytes, pryachtes, issleduyte... Sdelayte vse vozmozhnoe, chtoby unichtozhit Shakhter-One raz i navsegda!

Esli eto voobshche vozmozhno…

title: Cyjin the Cyborg Ninja [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 机器翻译 来自 most2820
description:
Udachnyy simbioza yaponskoy stilistiki anime s kiberpankom, khardkornyy ekshen-platformer s vidom sboku v nauchno-fantasticheskom settinge!
Vam predstoit primerit na sebya rol nindzya-robota po imeni Sidzhin: poterpev porazhenie ot ruk svoego zaklyatogo vraga, Syoguna, glavnyy geroy ostaetsya rzhavet na kladbishche robotov. Prosnuvshis pod goroy oblomkov, on vozvrashchaetsya v realnyy mir s edinstvennoy tselyu: otomstit svoim vragam i zastavit ikh zaplatit..
Ispolzuya razlichnye sposobnosti i umeniya glavnogo geroya vam predstoit dat otpor mnogochislennoy armii vrazhdebnykh robotov, vdokhnovlennykh yokayami!

title: Ninja or Die Shadow of the Sun [NSZ][ENG]
description:
天劫。這就是人類的命運。在日本的江戶，這場大災難已被一位最不可能的靈魂預見——一位大盗，也是你的母親。

你原本只是個平凡的扒手，卻在災難中變成了擁有迅雷不及掩耳之速度的致命忍者。賣拉麵的攤販變成了武士，而舞妓變成了殺手藝妓。你曾經在其中犯小罪的世界，現在變成了一個瘋狂的霓虹世界，充滿了將軍的城堡、魔法陷阱和空降刺客。有人將你捲入這場混亂的循環中……如果不是要殺你，那就是要保護你免受更大的災難。

在這個極速與單鍵控制結合的遊戲中，你需要精通精確又暴力的平台跳躍技巧。這會讓你一次次遭遇挫敗，卻又渴望一再挑戰。


跳躍即移動，跳躍即攻擊
- 一鍵控制所有行動。
- 不走路，不跑步——只有跳躍。
- 躍向敵人，大殺四方。
- 長按使出超級蓄力跳躍，施展更猛烈的攻擊。
- 在跳躍的瞬間變得無敵——精準掌握時間，即使面對最蠻橫的攻擊也能靈活躲避。

一個錯誤的舉動，你就得回到起點
- 面對配備飛彈、魔法和敏捷技巧的地獄級頭目和刺客。
- 避開鋭利的懸崖、致命的毒藥和其他惡劣的陷阱。
- 透過連續攻擊提升你的攻擊力。只要別被打中。

自訂你的遊戲風格
- 解鎖新的可操控角色，如遠程的藝妓和破壞力強大的武士。
- 揮舞苦無、手裏劍、長矛、石頭和其他長短範圍內的武器。
- 穿上盔甲和圍巾以增加你的防禦力。
- 透過找到奇特的靈魂和可疑的食物來獲得特殊能力和提升。
- 使用具有地震、閃電和增強視力等效果的卷軸。
- 建立你的村莊基地。拯救村民以修理和升級有用的建築，包括鍛造屋和密醫。

繼續保持
- 飛快穿越由程序生成和手工打造的各種關卡。
- 迅速死亡，但利用即時復活和永久升級更快再次挑戰。
- 攀登無限瞭望塔，奔波於無限迴廊，永不停歇。
- 豐富你的戰鬥紀錄，挑戰你的高分。
- 用新的挑戰重新進行遊戲，包括一個舞台隨機器。

獨具一格的日式像素風
讓自己沉浸在濃厚的日本像素藝術的懷舊美感中，這種美感將江戶時代的破落城堡、骸骨森林和民間傳說中的角色以粗獷優雅的方式帶到生活中。

title: Samurai Bringer [NSP][ENG]
description:
～ 重獲荒神之力，挑戰八岐大蛇
主角荒神須佐之男為了拯救被選中活祭的櫛名田而挑戰八岐大蛇。

然而，他被八岐大蛇打敗甚至連力量也被奪走了。
太陽神天照及時救了須佐之男，為了奪回力量給予須佐之男試練。

天照大人從時空的縫隙中召喚眾多來自戰國時代的武士和妖怪，
迫使他學習戰鬥心得來提升自我能力……

～ 組合各種戰技，創造個人戰法
擊敗襲來的武士和妖怪來獲取“戰技卷軸”。
學習“橫掃”、“突刺”和“跳躍”等新戰技。
此外，玩家可以自由將戰技組合起來，創造個人的原創動作指令。
如迴旋斬擊、火焰攻擊，甚至組合多個戰技發揮出連擊動作。

～ 討伐過百以上的知名猛將
在主角須佐之男面前，出現織田信長、伊達政宗和真田幸村等超過百位以上傳奇猛將。

擊敗這些猛將後，可以獲得具有各種效果的武具。
裝備武具不僅能在戰鬥中獲得優勢，還能改變須佐之男的外觀。

～ 不管被打敗多少次都能積累武功
各個階段都是自動生成，沿途中每次都要面對不同類型的眾武士和妖怪，
獲得的戰技也因而有所變化。
即使被打敗了也並非一無所獲，因為積累武功可強化須佐之男。
為各種戰鬥做好準備，向討伐八岐大蛇為目標而進發吧！

title: Samurai Warrior [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Samurai Warrior 是一款激動人心且引人入勝的遊戲，讓玩家有機會體驗作為武士在神秘世界中為榮譽和生存而戰的冒險。 該遊戲使用不同的戰鬥風格和特殊能力與對手進行激烈而激動人心的戰鬥。 玩家可以探索不同的地點，解開謎題，與 Boss 戰鬥，揭開這個世界的秘密。 此外，該遊戲具有精美大氣的圖形，可讓您完全沉浸在遊戲世界中，並以武士的身份進行難忘的冒險。

你會接受挑戰並達到最終目標嗎？

特徵：

- 與對手進行激烈而激動人心的戰鬥
- 精美、大氣的畫面
- 單人遊戲

title: Samurai Academy Paws of Fury [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + mashinnyy 来自 most2820 用于 v65536
description:
Po motivami lyubimogo animatsionnogo multfilma «Pyos-samuray»!..
Derevnya Kakamucho podverglas napadeniyu koshachikh armiy syoguna. Prisoedinyaytes k Khenku, psu-samurayu v mire koshek, i ego druzyam, chtoby raskryt zloveshchiy zagovor i spasti polozhenie v samurayskom stile.
Kak tolko oni podumali, chto bitva okonchena, Khenk i Dzhimbo vynuzhdeny vernutsya v boy, na etot raz stolknuvshis s samim mogushchestvennym syogunom. Da, imenno tak: lider mira "Lap Yarosti" zagadochnym obrazom peremenilsya. Ego tsel - sokrushit duet i derevni pod ikh zashchitoy svoimi koshachimi armiyami.
Vam predstoit ovladet navykami samuraya, zashchitit Kakamucho, spasti druzey Khenka i vyyasnit, kto stoit za etim zlym zagovorom.

title: Dice & Spells [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Looking for a thrilling RPG game that combines dice-based gameplay with epic fantasy adventure? Look no further than Dice & Spells, now available on Nintendo Switch™!

Build and upgrade available heroes, and lead them into battle against powerful enemies in a unique blend of dice-based combat and RPG elements. With endless value and strategic depth, this game will keep you engaged for hours on end.

Collect and upgrade various dice, each with unique abilities and effects, and choose from a variety of different heroes, each with their own strengths and weaknesses. As you progress through the game, explore a vast fantasy world filled with challenging enemies and epic loot.

Are you ready to roll the dice and cast spells in an epic darkest fantasy adventure?

Features:
-Heroic battles with various undead opponents
-Magic dice that differ in use and skills, and spells
-Many playable heroes
-Power-Ups that diversify the magic gameplay
-Upgrade the power of magic dice
-Expand the potential of your hero and spells
-A world full of dangers and dark secrets
-100+ unique stages
-Dynamic dungeon Boss fights
-Rewards for each battle won

The time has come. Fight with others for the freedom of the whole world!

title: McPixel 3 [NSP][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
《馬痞先三代》(McPixel 3)是一場過程令人意外的拯救世界冒險，看到一名半吊子英雄屢屢使用無厘頭但滑稽有趣的混亂方法來避免一場又一場災難。

屢屢使用無厘頭但滑稽有趣的混亂方法來避免一場又一場災難 – 這些方法包含但不限於以下方式 – 召喚蜘蛛億萬富翁，在他的褲子巴比Q烤肉，將一隻暴龍揍到外太空，對著跑車撒尿，還有踢福克·派克的蛋蛋。

主要特點
- 100個出乎意料的關卡
- 超過900個惡搞笑話
- 將近1500個互動物件
- 超過20種可以想像得到類型的小遊戲
- 258,924,600個像素
- 史提夫
- 一個很水的關卡

title: Disc Room [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
developer: Doseone, Kitty Calis, Jan Willem Nijman, Terri Vellmann
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
準備好被切成兩半了嗎？本作故事發生在2089年，那時木星的衛星軌道上突然出現了一個巨大的圓盤。玩家要扮演一名勇敢的科學家，穿上寬鬆的太空衣，探索這一不斷生長的星際屠宰場。

記住：殺不死你的，只會讓你更強大。

《碟血房間》由Kitty Calis、Jan Wilem Nijman、Terri Vellmann以及Doseone共同呈現。

title: Terracotta [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Something stirs in the darkness of the underground mausoleum. A terracotta figurine cracks and a soul stirs within, awakened by the energy of the Tao. You wake, surrounded by eight thousand of your terracotta comrades. A curse has been placed upon the army of the first emperor, save yourself… meaning  you are the only one who can lift it and bring peace to one of the greatest spiritual wonders of ancient China.


Terracotta is an action-adventure game based on China's seminal Qin dynasty. Though ruling only for fifteen years, the first imperial dynasty laid the foundations of a state that would endure for over two thousand years. Experience the splendor and drama, as China transforms from a patchwork of warring states to a united empire. Witness the creation of the first Great Wall of China and the grand victories that preserved its legacy.



Explore the Twin Realms

As the sole uncursed warrior of the emperor's Terracotta Army, you'll have to master your ability to channel the Tao, switching between the realms of Yin and Yang to free your fellow soldiers from the spiritual blight.


Shift between the realms of Yin and Yang, within the tomb of the Qin Emperor and his afterlife, looping between death and the afterlife to overcome cursed challenges.
Yin is the domain of solitude and tranquility. The dark, desolate tomb is a fortress, where you can strategize, prepare, and alter the layout to aid your journey.
Yang is the realm of the afterlife, light, and action. Execute combat strategies, evade foes, and overcome the tomb’s defenders to find the source of the curse placed upon the rest of the terracotta.


Solve the Mystery of the Curse

You are one of eight thousand warriors bound to protect the Qin Emperor in his afterlife. Your comrades are not your enemies, even if they do not think so at the moment…


Master your ability to channel the light of Yin, not only for switching realms but also for manipulating surroundings.
Awaken ancient mechanisms and descend into the underworld, overcoming foes through speed and agility, instead of only using brute force.
Defeat nine brutal bosses, requiring the mastery of the nine phases of Qi: The universal energy that forms all parts of living beings.

Witness the Rise of China


The Qin dynasty laid the foundations of China that would endure two thousand years. As an awakened terracotta warrior, you have the opportunity to observe it from within.

Experience an art style based on the timeless aesthetics of guo hua, traditional Chinese painting.
Immerse yourself in the afterlife of the Terracotta Army with a soundtrack inspired by traditional instruments classified through the ancient Chinese ba yin.
Save your fellow eight thousand strong warriors, each with iconic individual appearances - just like the real Terracotta Army!




TERRACOTTA is a project funded by Red.es and the European Regional Development Fund (ERDF) through the Red.es Program to promote the videogame industry. These grants are co-funded by the Spanish ERDF Pluri-Regional Operative Program (POPE) 2014-2020.

title: Vessels of Decay [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
Interesnyy priklyuchencheskiy ekshen v retro-stile o vyzhivanii sestyor Mad i Frei v dremuchikh debryakh postapokalipticheskoy Skandinavii, gde votsarilis chudovishcha iz drevnikh mifov i legend.
Na oblomkakh razrushennoy tsivilizatsii probuzhdaetsya novaya zhizn. Drevnie sushchestva vosstayut iz prakha i stanovyatsya khozyaevami obezlyudevshikh zemel. Vstupite v skhvatku s chudovishchami iz skandinavskogo folklora i issleduyte ruiny pogibshey tsivilizatsii.

title: Help Will Come Tomorrow [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
description:
Igra posvyashchena vyzhivaniyu personazhey: nakopleniyu resursov, zakladke lagerya, obsledovaniyu okrestnostey. Dlya pobedy neobkhodimo naladit otnosheniya personazhey i umelo upravlyat skudnymi resursami.

• Pogruzites v volnuyushchuyu istoriyu, proiskhodyashchuyu v 1917 godu v predbolshevistskoy Rossiyskoy imperii.
• Upravlyayte 9 unikalnymi personazhami razlichnogo proiskhozhdeniya, sgruppirovannymi v tri sotsialnykh klassa.
• Otkroyte dlya sebya 10 lichnykh istoriy i proshloe utselevshikh.
• Delayte postroyki i uluchshayte lager utselevshikh.
• Upravlyayte skudnymi resursami i popytaytes vyzhit v moroznoy Sibiri, poka ne pribudet pomoshch.
• Preodolevayte klassovuyu nepriyazn mezhdu utselevshimi, upravlyayte innovatsionnoy sistemoy postroeniya otnosheniy v zavisimosti ot sotsialnogo klassa.
• Prisposablivaytes k dinamicheski menyayushchimsya pogodnym usloviyam i beskompromissnoy sibirskoy faune, uslozhnyayushchey zhizn vyzhivshim.

title: Party Golf [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Besshabashnaya sorevnovatelnaya arkada, rasschitannaya na sovmestnuyu igru odnovremenno do 8 igrokov. Prostaya 2D grafika i fizika, protsedurno generiruemye urovni i bolee trilliona geympleynykh kombinatsiy!
Zdes vy naydyote bolee 100 igrovykh rezhimov, a takzhe vozmozhnost nastraivat svoi sobstvennye pravila pri pomoshchi variativnoy sistemy nastroyki.
A raznoobraznye bonusy i uluchsheniya v Party Golf mozhno kastomizirovat, menyaya ikh svoystva, usilivaya ili oslablyaya ikh!..

title: Happy Animals Mini Golf / Bowling [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Happy animals Mini Golf — miniatyurnaya versiya golfa s milymi zhivotnymi,v kotoroy uchastniki sorevnuyutsya, zagonyaya malenkiy myachik v lunku udarami klyushek, pytayas proyti distantsiyu za minimalnoe chislo udarov.

Provedi veselo vremya so svoimi pushistymi druzyami i dokazhi,chto ty samyy luchshiy igrok v mini golf! I ne zabud sobrat vse zvezdochki na puti k lunke!

30 LOKATsIY

Igrayte v mini-golf v razlichnykh lokatsiyakh ogromnogo doma!

12 ZhIVOTNYKh

Samye raznye zabavnye zverushki zhdut vas v igre!

IGRA S DRUZYaMI

Igrayte vdvoyom, vtroyom ili vchetverom na odnoy konsoli Nintendo Switch™!

KAMPANIYa

Pobedite vsekh sopernikov i broste vyzov samomu Porosyonku Dzhoffri!

title: Ascendant Hearts [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Novella, kotoraya pereneset vas v zagadochnye zemli!.. V roli geroya po imeni Khayato, vy ochnetes neizvestno gde i obnaruzhite, chto ne pomnite o svoem proshlom sovershenno nichego.
Mag po imeni Shiori predlagaet pomoch vam nayti svoy put, i s eyo pomoshchyu vy stanete uchitsya srazhatsya s monstrami, vypolnyat kvesty i pomeshchat predmety v strannoe metafizicheskoe prostranstvo, nazyvaemoe «inventar». Shiori polna reshimosti vyyasnit, v chyom tut delo, i vy ne ostanovites, poka ne uznaete vsyu pravdu!

title: Maid for Loving You (移植版 RenPy 18+) [NSP][ENG]
developer: iMel, Azarashi Software, Love Lab Inc.
description:
Obychnyy paren Yuma vnezapno obnaruzhivaet, chto ego skuchnaya zhizn stala namnogo interesnee, povstrechav zagadochnuyu moloduyu devushku po imeni Eva. Otkroyte dlya sebya radost zhizni s milovidnoy gornichnoy v etom trogatelnom vizualnom romane!
Yuma Kitami — tipichnyy naemnyy rab: prosypaysya, rabotay, spi, povtorit. Iz-za rutinnoy raboty on pochti lishilsya ambitsiy, a ego povsednevnaya zhizn napolnena beskonechnymi sverkhurochnymi, iz-za chego ostayotsya tak malo vremeni dlya lichnoy zhizni, ne govorya uzhe o zhenitbe. No vse menyaetsya odnoy tikhoy zimney nochyu. Uspev na posledniy sinkansen do doma, vy nakhodite u vkhodnoy dveri devushku vsego v neskolkikh mgnoveniyakh do moroznoy smerti.
Vy zavodite eyo v svoy dom i delaete vsyo, chto v vashikh silakh, chtoby vernut prekrasnuyu neznakomku k zhizni. Kogda ona nakonets prikhodit v sebya, devushka predstavlyaetsya kak Eva i ochen khochet poblagodarit vas za svoyo spasenie. I eshchyo ona predlagaet stat vashey gornichnoy!

title: Petit Island [NSP][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 可选机翻 most2820 用于 v131072
description:
《Petit Island》是一款迷人的開放世界敘事探索遊戲，故事發生在一座美麗的熱帶天堂！跟隨百合的爪印，重新探索她勇敢自由的爺爺不為人知的冒險之旅。 

爺爺年輕時是一隻充滿了無限勇氣和求知慾的貓咪。他在島上揮灑青春，閱遍世間。但自從他搬到城市後，就將冒險的回憶都拋諸腦後。 

如今，爺爺已步入暮年，記憶開始逐漸模糊。他只記得一些與心愛孫女百合分享的故事片段，以及最近找到的舊日記裡的內容。你能幫助爺爺回憶過去，找回自己的冒險精神嗎？ 

遊戲特色 

探索充滿古老秘密、隱藏寶藏、獨特野生動物和活力無限的社群島嶼開放世界。 

在旅途中結識各種古怪有趣的人物。 

用相機捕捉舊日景點，幫助爺爺喚起他的冒險記憶。 

眾多選項訂製你的貓貓角色，展現你的獨特風格和個性。

title: Ruffy and the Riverside [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 机器翻译 用于 v131072
description:
在《Ruffy and the Riverside》中，你可以透過互換魔法複製材質並貼到其他物體上。試著將冰塊變成熔岩、瀑布變成藤蔓吧！進行探險、戰鬥並坐著乾草堆奔馳，在這獨特的開放式世界動作遊戲中，盡情發揮你的想像力吧。能真正改變世界的冒險，正在等待著你！

故事

和路飛一起踏上阻止瑞河塞德陷入混沌、對抗邪惡勢力格羅爾並守護世界核心的旅程吧。在這趟旅程中，你會遇見嘴巴很壞的蜜蜂「嗡嗡」、鼴鼠冒險家「艾德勒隊長」、烏龜賢者「席爾利亞」還有夢幻般的世界。獨特的故事、個性鮮明的角色以及無法預測的劇情都在等待著路飛一一去探險。

獨特的遊戲方式

受選之人「路飛」可以利用互換能力來改變遊戲中的世界。將陽光變成月光、將冰塊變成熔岩，還能解開無數的謎題並自由自在地操控物品。像是將石頭變成木頭或是建造成船，或是將牆壁變成殘骸來開闢新的道路等，替冒險增添了無數的樂趣。「互換」能力可以用來戰鬥、跳躍或坐著乾草堆奔馳，每一刻都將帶給玩家魔法般的驚奇體驗。


2D關卡和謎題

路飛的冒險不會停歇！當3D世界崩塌，路飛便為了尋找寶物而跳進了2D的世界。但是要注意，只有積極地使用互換才能夠克服許多的障礙物。發揮你的創意來利用魔法般的互換機制，變換物品來開創新的道路，並完成一場美麗的冒險之旅！


魔法般的開放式世界探險

在路飛眼前所看到的是瑞河塞德驚人的開放式世界。探險令人震撼的世界，完成有趣的支線任務，並克服眾多試煉，來收集7個地區的魔法寶物吧。搭著乾草堆奔馳或透過隱藏的軌道展開冒險，發現神秘的艾托伊並和魚群幫派聯手一起擊退怪物鯊魚。甚至還可以透過飛克斯親手製作材質，讓整個遊戲都成為你的遊樂場。充滿驚奇和特別的冒險，將會如魔法般降臨在你的眼前。

豐富特色

主要特色：

- 不斷練習互換能力，來改變遊戲世界中的各種要素。
- 以創意的方式操作物品，來解決各式各樣的謎題。
- 來挑戰戰鬥、跳躍、滑行等充滿樂趣的冒險。
- 在艱難的2D關卡中解開謎題並發現寶物。
- 解鎖擁有不同試煉和環境的7大地區。
- 和提供新穎有趣任務的各個角色相遇。
- 使用夢石製作出專屬自己的材質，並套用於遊戲中的石頭、瀑布等要素上。
- 享受透過探險和發現所打造出的魔法般氛圍。
- 收集蝴蝶、夢石、艾托伊、硬幣等收集品，不僅能增添遊戲樂趣，還可以體驗客製化外型的系統。

title: The Darkside Detective / Darkside Detective a Fumble in the Dark [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Tvin Leyks — proklyatyy gorod. Ne to chtoby demony razdirali ego na chasti, no i «kuda opyat propali moi klyuchi?» ili «ya opyat nastupil v luzhu» ne opisyvaet problemu v polnoy mere. Koroche, po shkale proklyatosti on gde-to v seredinke.

Dostatochno proklyatyy, chtoby obratit na eto vnimanie. Chtoby kto-to nakonets chto-to sdelal...

Tut na stsenu i vykhodit detektiv otdela Temnykh tayn. Esli uslyshite nochyu glukhie udary, oshchutite kholodok po spine i voobshche pochuvstvuete chto-to nechistoe, znachit, gde-to ryadom detektiv Frensis Mak-Kvin.
Da net, s gigienoy u nego vse v poryadke. Prosto vyrazhenie takoe, nu...

Po sledam sobytiy The Darkside Detective Mak-Kvin dolzhen spasti iz lap temnykh sil svoego vernogo (pust i ne samogo smyshlenogo) naparnika, ofitsera Duli, chtoby vmeste s nim vernutsya k rassledovaniyu mnozhestva strannykh, zachastuyu paranormalnykh i vsegda paradoksalnykh proisshestviy.

Prisoedinyaytes k nim v etom pugayushche veselom priklyuchenii v stile point-and-click, rassleduyte shest novykh nezavisimykh del, kotorye perenesut geroev v mestnyy dom prestarelykh, boytsovskiy klub dlya nachinayushchikh, na karnaval i dazhe v Irlandiyu! Razveyte vse Temnye tayny.

Osobennosti
• 7 unikalnykh rassledovaniy — vy s takimi eshche ne stalkivalis (no eto ne tochno).
• Ne tolko tekhnologii point, no i tekhnologii click.
• Muzyka ot Tomasa O'Boyla, zhivogo na 100% i tochno ne vosstavshego iz mertvykh.
• Fotorealistichnaya (v zavisimosti ot vashego ponimaniya fotorealistichnosti) pikselnaya grafika.
• Kazhdomu pokupatelyu skidka na uslugi ekzortsizma, kotorye mogut ponadobitsya posle igry.
• Kratkiy obzor sobytiy The Darkside Detective dlya tekh, kto ne igral i ne khochet

title: Interrogation You Will Be Deceived [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Vy — ofitser politsii, protivostoyashchiy opasnoy terroristicheskoy gruppe. Provodite doprosy, upravlyayte komandoy i ee reputatsiey — i pomnite o vremeni. Na chto vy poydete, chtoby ostanovit prestupnikov? Manipulyatsii, ugrozy, pytki? Opravdyvaet li tsel sredstva?

- Reshayte mnogogrannye i vse bolee slozhnye golovolomki-razgovory, chtoby raskryt ledenyashchiy krov zagovor.
- Ispytayte svoi organizatsionnye navyki: upravlyayte delami, komandoy i byudzhetom, a takzhe podderzhivayte otnosheniya politseyskikh s obshchestvom.
- Vyberite svoy sobstvennyy put razvitiya syuzheta: a kuda privedut vas vashi resheniya?
- Poznakomtes s bolee chem 35 realistichnymi personazhami.
- Pogruzites v vyrazitelnuyu nuarnuyu atmosferu, kotoruyu sozdayut igra zhivykh akterov i charuyushchaya muzyka.


Igrovoy protsess
V protivostoyanii s terroristicheskoy organizatsiey «Front osvobozhdeniya» vam predstoit koordinirovat komandu v sbore informatsii, pravilno raspredelyat byudzhet i reshat voprosy s zhazhdushchey novostey pressoy. No eto —lish chast raboty.
Vasha glavnaya zadacha — vesti rassledovanie i doprashivat podozrevaemykh. Izuchiv ikh proshloe i motivatsiyu, vy smozhete podobrat k kazhdomu luchshiy podkhod, bud to ugrozy, obman ili soperezhivanie. V chem slozhnost? Universalnogo resheniya net, a na poiski personalnogo podkhoda tratitsya stol dragotsennoe vremya. 
Chem blizhe vy podbiraetes k prestupnikam, tem bolee nesgovorchivymi budut podozrevaemye i neprostymi doprosy. Chtoby raskryt delo, pridetsya proyavit vse masterstvo vedeniya peregovorov, a takzhe pribegnut k manipulyatsiyam i drugim priemam. 
Nayti i unichtozhit «Front osvobozhdeniya» budet sovsem ne prosto.


Tsel igry
Interrogation: You will be deceived — eto syuzhetno-orientirovannaya detektivnaya igra, kotoraya prizvana vzglyanut s drugogo ugla na rasprostranennye stereotipy o terrorizme, zhestokosti politsii i neravenstve vozmozhnostey mezhdu grazhdanami, gosudarstvom i krupnymi korporatsiyami.

title: Pecaminosa a Deadly Hand / Pecaminosa a Pixel Noir Game [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Dzhon nikogda by ne zapodozril, chto ego sleduyushchee zadanie budet ot ruk prizraka. Prizrak Charli "Dva angela" yavlyaetsya k nemu s zadaniem: poymat ego byvshikh soratnikov, chtoby dobitsya iskupleniya ikh grekhov i poluchit vozmozhnost proyti cherez vrata raya. Okhotitsya na zhivykh, chtoby prinesti mir mertvym.
Dobro pozhalovat v Pekaminosu, pogranichnyy gorod mezhdu SShA i Meksikoy, gde na ego pylnykh ulitsakh tsaryat azartnye igry, korruptsiya i prestupnost. Dom dlya vsekh, kto zhivet vne zakona... i dlya nashego glavnogo geroya, Dzhona Souzy, byvshego detektiva, cheloveka, perezhivshego luchshie vremena, prezhde chem nayti uteshenie na dne butylki.
«Pecaminosa - A Deadly Hand» sochetaet v sebe ocharovanie piksel-arta i mekhaniku rolevoy igry s atmosferoy filma-nuar. Vy eshche ne videli i ne igrali ni vo chto podobnoe. Doprashivayte podozrevaemykh, issleduyte gorod, v kotorom tsaryat prestupnost i grekh, i nikogda ne stesnyaytes ispolzovat kulaki i oruzhie. Eto tyazhelye vremena v ochen tyazhelom gorode. Nastroyte vneshniy vid i snaryazhenie svoego personazha i zastavte ego razvivatsya s pomoshchyu sistemy L.I.F.E., raspredelyayushchey ochki opyta po chetyrem razlichnym parametram: Udacha, Intellekt, Sila i Vynoslivost.
Igrayte v blekdzhek, chtoby zarabotat dopolnitelnye dengi, poseshchayte vinnyy magazin, obshchaytes s otbrosami, poseshchayte politseyskiy uchastok i bordel, a takzhe drugie zavedeniya, vossozdannye s bolshoy graficheskoy detalizatsiey... i nikomu ne doveryayte. Est pulya s vashim imenem, i ona zhazhdet vstrechi s vami!

title: A Case of Distrust [NSZ][ENG]
description: A Case of Distrust is a narrative mystery from 1924 San Francisco. Play as private investigator Phyllis Cadence Malone in this historical 2D adventure game. Explore underground speakeasies, smoke-filled billiard halls, classic barber shops, and more. Catch suspects in lies by using evidence, statements, and your wits. Intrinsic challenges face our heroine, as she struggles against a pushback on emancipation, leading to many doubts, both internal and external. Uncover the truth in a mystery full of deception!

title: Liberated Enhanced edition [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
8/10 - «zatyagivayushchaya atmosfera, nastoyashchiy podarok» – Nintendo Life
9/10 - «deystvitelno velikolepna» – Pure Nintendo
9/10 - «Luchshiy predstavitel kiberpanka na Nintendo Switch» - GamesHedge

Dobro pozhalovat v divnyy novyy mir. Obektivnaya istina i lichnye svobody umirayut. Blizitsya revolyutsiya. Prisoedinyaytes k krovavoy borbe za svobodu.

Zabudte vse, chto vy znali o komiksakh. Pogruzites v mrachnyy, promokshiy ot dozhdya gorod. Perekhitrite vragov, vzlomayte sistemu, peredvigaytes taykom i reshayte golovolomki. A kogda nachnetsya zavarukha, vershite pravosudie i zrelishchno strelyayte pryamo v golovu. Neveroyatnyy stil ruchnoy risovki i ekshn obedinyayutsya na stranitsakh etoy mrachnoy istorii.

V izdanie Liberated: Enhanced Edition vkhodyat:
- Udostoennaya nagradami igra Liberated s uluchshennym geympleem i novym kontentom
- Polnaya angliyskaya ozvuchka: pogruzites v syuzhet s golosami personazhey
- 2 korotkikh dopolneniya: «Za rodinu» i «Slava geroyam».

Za vami sledyat. Kazhdyy den. Kazhdyy chas. Kazhduyu minutu.
Smirites. Ili razozhgite ogon.

title: Lethis Path of Progress [NSP][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 俄语 lyubitelskiy 来自 djonmarvel
description:
Igra:
Lethis - Path of Progress – dvukhmernyy «oldskulnyy» gradostroitelnyy simulyator, pogruzhayushchiy v viktorianskuyu epokhu stimpanka. V igre Vam predstoit stroit goroda i sledit za ikh protsvetaniem, obespechivat zhiteley vsemi neobkhodimymi resursami, a takzhe kontrolirovat razlichnoe proizvodstvo. Torguyte s drugimi gorodami, ispolnyayte prosby Imperatora i prozhivite schastlivyy vek Promyshlennoy Revolyutsii!

Istoriya:
Posle otkrytiya kondensirovannogo para, kotoryy mozhno ispolzovat v kachestve istochnika energii, mir Letis stolknulsya s nevidannoy do tekh por promyshlennoy revolyutsiey. Sledstviem takogo perevorota v Imperii stal vek urbanizatsii. Begstvo zhiteley iz selskoy mestnosti vynuzhdaet praviteley sozdavat v strategicheskikh mestakh novye goroda, kotorye obespechat rost Letis. Vremya bolshikh peremen – samoe podkhodyashchee vremya dlya otkrytiy i izobreteniy v nauke. Goroda razrastayutsya vokrug takikh gigantskikh monumentov, kak Tseppelinov Angar ili Observatoriya.

Osobennosti:
3 urovnya slozhnosti kompanii, sostoyashchey iz 26 missiy
Rezhim pesochnitsy s neogranichennymi vozmozhnostyami
Bolee 24 razlichnykh resursov
4 unikalnykh monumenta i bolee 40 razlichnykh zdaniy
Bolee 15 nepokhozhikh drug na druga zhiteley, kotorykh Vy mozhete vstretit na ulitsakh goroda
Bolshie karty – do 300kh300 kletok
Potryasayushchee muzykalnoe soprovozhdenie – 20 samykh raznykh «atmosfernykh» kompozitsiy

title: The Swindle: a Steampunk Cybercrime Caper [NSZ][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
London, 1849 god. Skotland-Yard skoro aktiviruet  noveyshuyu sistemu slezheniya 'Dyavolskiy Vasilisk' — vashey karere vora konets.
Nuzhno ukrast 'Vasilisk'.
Vooruzhayte svoego vora novymi sposobnostyami i gadzhetami i grabte samye zlachnye zdaniya Londona.
Kontent generiruetsya v proizvolnom poryadke.

title: Another Sight [NSP][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 俄语 民间汉化 来自 djonmavel (otsutstvuet v videovstavkakh)
description:
ANOTHER SIGHT — syurrealistichnoe fentezi-priklyuchenie s elementami stimpanka, sobytiya kotorogo razvorachivayutsya v Londone v 1899 godu, v samom kontse viktorianskoy epokhi. Klyuchevoy aspekt ANOTHER SIGHT — emotsionalno nasyshchennye vzaimootnosheniya mezhdu besstrashnym podrostkom Kit i zagadochnym krasnym kotom Khodzhem. Oni vstrechayutsya vo tme budushchey londonskoy podzemki posle togo, kak Kit slepnet iz-za obrusheniya tonnelya. Vmeste oni otpravlyayutsya v put, i Kit pridetsya nauchitsya polagatsya na svoego zamechatelnogo sputnika.

Kit i Khodzh budut issledovat tainstvennyy i neponyatnyy mir, to vstrechayas, to razdelyayas vnov. U kazhdogo iz nikh est svoy osobyy talant, kotoryy pomozhet reshat golovolomki i probiratsya vse dalshe i dalshe.

title: Dry Drowning [NSZ][ENG]
description: Primer na sebya rol nedobrosovestnogo chastnogo detektiva, presleduemogo ego temnym proshlym, i pogruzis v seriyu uzhasnykh ubiystv. Smozhesh li ty nayti prestupnika?

title: Cultist Simulator Initiate Edition [NSZ][RUS/Multi3]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 3]
description:
Cultist Simulator – igra o kontse sveta i zhazhde zapretnykh znaniy. Igrayte za iskatelya nechestivykh tayn v atmosfere 1920-kh godov, zabytykh bogov i smertelnykh sekretov. Ishchite znaniya, vlast, krasotu ili mest. Ili prosto posmotrite, kakogo tsveta etot mir, esli snyat s nego kozhu.

V etoy syuzhetnoy kartochnoy roguelike-igre to, chto vy nakhodite, menyaet vas navsegda. Kazhdyy mig, kazhdyy sdelannyy vybor ne prosto vedut istoriyu dalshe – oni ee izmenyayut.

Stante znatokom nezrimykh tayn. Vspominayte lishayushchie rassudka ritualy iz svoikh snov. Sozdavayte instrumenty i prizyvayte dukhov. Podchinyayte sebe nevinnykh. Stante vestnikom novogo veka.

• Uvlekatelnaya igra v dukhe roguelike – kazhdyy raz s novoy istoriey.
Cultist Simulator ne vedet vas za ruku. Eksperimentiruyte, umirayte i pobedite smert s sistemoy naslediya. So vremenem vy uznaete dostatochno, chtoby postavit igru na koleni.

• Zakhvatyvayushchiy syuzhet – sobirayte karty i rasskazhite svoyu istoriyu.
Ogromnyy syuzhet ot avtora Fallen London i Sunless Sea – ego khvatilo by na uvesistyy roman. Igra vedet vas dorogami zdorovykh ambitsiy, nezdorovykh appetitov i koshchunstva, i vasha istoriya mozhet zakonchitsya po-raznomu.

• Krasochnyy lavkraftovskiy mir – razvrashchayte druzey i pogloshchayte vragov.
Vspominayte lishayushchie rassudka ritualy iz svoikh snov. Perevodite grimuary i cherpayte iz nikh drevnyuyu mudrost. Proniknite v mir Chasov i sluzhite im i vmeste s nimi. Cultist Simulator – eto uzhas rasskazov Lavkrafta v novom okruzhenii.

• Igrayte s dopolneniyami – uznayte bolshe o mire igry.
V izdanie Cultist Simulator: Initiate Edition vkhodyat tri pervykh dopolneniya. Eto novye naslediya, mekhaniki, personazhi i kontsovki.
- Tantsovshchitsa: pogruzites v vakkhanaliyu. Snimite s sebya kozhu. Obretite bessmertie v mrachnom kabare.-
- Zhrets: stuchite, i vam otkroyut. Otkroyte serdtsa i umy svoey pastvy. Raspalyayte zador fanatikov.
- Upyr: vkusite mogilnykh plodov. Risuyte nevidimye kartiny tsvetami mertvykh. Pogloshchayte trupy posledovateley i pitaytes ikh bolyu.

title: Fhtagn Tales of the Creeping Madness [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Play as one of four cultists intent on destroying the world by summoning an Ancient Horror. 

Decide how you will be preparing for the final ritual by visiting various locations in the unsuspecting town of Arkham and navigating iconic Lovecraftian events. 

Battle investigators, gangs, corrupt cops and horrors from the Depths to bring about the end of the world!

This text-based adventure game boasts:
- 93 000 words.
- Across 113 events with 370 potential story outcomes.
- Fulfil 1 of 24 roles with 56 ritual feedback stories.
- 142 different character endings.
- Short and silly events in a Lovecraftian universe.
- Randomized stories based on location.
- Short gameplay, ideal for those downtime moments or while in a queue for another game.
- Non-linear gameplay.

Play cooperatively or be a backstabbing traitor.

This boardgame-esque game shines in local co-op with friends and it is a casual game that will provide loads of entertainment. 

With snazzy graphics, betrayal is best served with a jazzy/swing soundtrack and neo-noir visuals.

Gameplay in a nutshell:
- You are a cultist intent on destroying the universe by summoning the Ancient One. 
- You can play on your own or with up to 3 friends in couch co-op.
- You have 6 rounds to build up the required stats needed to use the ritual items, but you will need to figure out which stats those are through some trial and error.
- You can visit 1 location per round and attempt the Lovecraftian stories at that location, to improve your stats.
- Finally, put your stats to the test as you try to summon the Ancient One.
- Will everyone pass or fail or will one of you betray the rest and grab all the glory?

title: Flaklypa Grand Prix (The Pinchcliffe) [NSZ][ENG]
developer: Ravn Studio, Rock Pocket, Invictus Games
description:
Join Reodor, Sola, Ludvig and the other villagers on a breathtakingly fast, high-octane adventure.

With captivating story mode, racing in the classic Flåklypa environments for one or two players, and nine fun mini-games, Flåklypa Grand Prix has something for the whole family!

Languages supported: Norwegian, Swedish, Danish, English and Sámigiella.
Audio available in Norwegian, Danish, English and Sámigiella.

title: Scrapnaut [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description: 《Scrapnaut》是採用俯視視角的建造生存遊戲，具備蒸氣龐克風格的要素。探索具備多樣生物群落的開放世界、留意氧氣存量、管理農場、發電、建造自己的家……各種豐富的要素等你來體驗！

title: Lamplight City [NSP][ENG]
description:
The Gateway to Vespuccia, the City of Air and Light, Lamplight City - the thriving port city of New Bretagne is a beacon of progress and industrial advancement in the New World. Yet beneath the promises of a shining 19th-century future, the city rests upon foundations of poverty, class struggle, and crime.
For police detective turned private investigator Miles Fordham, Lamplight City's shadowy corners are just part of the territory. But with his former partner constantly speaking to him from beyond the grave, his grip on sanity is slowly loosening. Can Miles find justice for his clients and track down his partner's killer before his entire world comes apart?
Lamplight City is a detective adventure set in an alternate steampunk-ish "Victorian" past.

FEATURES
• Be the detective you want to be. But prepare to face the consequences. - Investigate crime scenes, interrogate suspects, get information by any means necessary. Follow the law or make your own rules, but how you choose to act will affect people's attitudes towards you.
• Five cases to solve, with multiple suspects, false leads, and different outcomes. - Never find yourself stuck in a dead-end situation. If the case becomes unsolvable, simply move on to the next one. The story will adapt based on your choices.
• Single click interface with no inventory. - Gather clues and documents in your casebook for review. Item manipulation is handled via a context-sensitive cursor.
• A fictional city with four boroughs to explore, each with their own unique flavour. - Players will visit each of these boroughs throughout the game, exploring themes such as class divide and the public's fear of emerging steam tech.
• Inspired by the works of Edgar Allan Poe and Charles Dickens.
• Meet over 50 professionally voiced characters.
• Original score by Mark Benis.


AGS Award 2018 - Best Character (Miles Fordham)
AGS Award 2018 - Best Animation
AGS Award 2018 - Best Puzzles (tied with The Clockwork Labyrinth)
AGS Award 2018 - Best Writing

title: Pendula Swing the Complete Journey [NSZ][ENG]
description:
你扮演Brialynne，最受尊敬的矮人女英雄之一 - 你甚至有自己的粉絲俱樂部！偷走你的斧頭會釋放出一個非凡的事件旋轉木馬！你能在失去你心愛的人時平安嗎？在你拯救它之後，世界發生了什麼變化？為什麼你的貓在喋喋不休地談論一個失敗的咒語？

幻想和迷人的20年代

你會遇到來自一個豐富多彩的宇宙的數百個故事和角色，精靈們正在工業化mithril採礦，妖精們正在為他們的權利而戰 - 所有這些都是在搖擺和爵士樂統治世界的氛圍中進行的！

一堆家務

你的冒險將包括以20世紀20年代的時尚塑造自己和你的家，照顧可愛的動物，解決杜伯登市民的眾多難題和問題，花一個冷靜的時刻釣魚，開始幾段浪漫召喚你前妻的鬼魂等等！

給愛一個機會

這也是一個進步的世界。給愛情一個機會，無論性別或關係偏好如何！從LGBTQ+到輪椅，你會遇到許多具有獨特個性和品味的角色。發現他們的故事，誰知道呢，也許你會在他們中間找到真愛？

特徵：

- 獨特的設置，將幻想人物與禁酒令時代的爵士樂混合在一起
- 超過7小時的內容，充滿160個任務和故事情節
- 各種角色和漸進式約會選項
- 很多可愛的寵物！
- 充滿搖擺和爵士樂的原創配樂

title: Steamburg [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
Steamburg — lavronosnyy kvest-golovolomka s unikalnym igrovym protsessom i syuzhetnoy liniey, privyazannoy k poisku predmetov. Razrabotchik igry — kompaniya Telehorse, rabotayushchaya nad sozdaniem igr v zhanre stimpanka. V marte 2017 goda na Mezhdunarodnom konkurse v oblasti mobilnykh igr (IMGA) v San-Frantsisko Steamburg byla priznana samoy ozhidaemoy igroy.

Glavnyy geroy, professor Vinsent Mur, srazhaetsya s robotami, zakhvativshimi gorod Stimburg. Igrovoy protsess mozhno nazvat unikalnym, ved Vinsent bezoruzhen i dolzhen tshchatelno produmyvat kazhdyy svoy shag. V ego arsenale — lish malenkie elektrobomby, kotorye primanivayut i nenadolgo zamedlyayut robotov. Vinsent dolzhen peredvigatsya po ulitsam takim obrazom, chtoby zamanit robotov v lovushku — transformator Tesla, kotoryy sposoben ikh unichtozhit. Postepenno igra uslozhnyaetsya: Vinsentu protivostoyat neskolko robotov srazu, pri etom oni stanovyatsya vse bolee bystrymi, a nekotorye iz nikh umeyut letat i reagiruyut na kazhdoe dvizhenie geroya.

Otdelnogo vnimaniya zasluzhivaet sposob podachi syuzheta. V 2016 godu na mezhdunarodnoy biznes-konferentsii White Nights v Khelsinki Steamburg udostoilas nagrady za luchshuyu tekhniku povestvovaniya. Iz dialogov igrok uznayot o tom, chto Vinsent — eto uchenyy, kotoromu poruchili provesti ispytanie novogo oruzhiya v Stimburge. Krome togo, on zanyat poiskami svoey nevesty, kotoraya, predpolozhitelno, byla v gorode, kogda ego atakovali roboty. Nekotorye elementy syuzheta neposredstvenno svyazany s igrovym protsessom. Igrok takzhe mozhet sobirat pisma i fotografii, kotorye rasskazhut ob istorii lyubvi Vinsenta i ego nevesty.


Osobennosti:

• Unikalnyy, zakhvatyvayushchiy igrovoy protsess.
• 32 urovnya, oformlennykh v stile stimpanka.
• Neskolko potaynykh mest i sotni predmetov, raskryvayushchikh syuzhet igry.
• Ozvuchivanie s uchastiem znamenitykh amerikanskikh i britanskikh akterov, v tom chisle Bryusa Glovera (ozvuchival filmy «Brillianty — navsegda» i «Kitayskiy kvartal»).
• Muzyka iz originalnogo alboma Silver Rocket.

title: Sunshine Shuffle [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Sunshine Shuffle — eto zakhvatyvayushchaya priklyuchencheskaya igra o milykh govoryashchikh zverushkakh s kriminalnym proshlym, v syuzhet kotoroy tesno vpletyon poker! Sygrayte v tekhasskiy kholdem s ostavshimisya chlenami «Utrenney vakhty» — vatagi nayomnykh rabochikh, kotorym ne dayut pokoya lavry Robina Guda i kotorym (pochti vsem iz nikh) udalos perezhit vstrechu s «Rybnoy bratiey». Okunites v zakhvatyvayushchuyu istoriyu o tom, kak krupneyshiy bank na Vostochnom poberezhe byl ograblen za odin den. Zarabatyvayte zhetony i priobretayte novye svetilniki, stulya, kartochnye kolody i mnogie drugoe dlya parokhodika «Sanshayn». Otorvites pod dinamichnyy ska-saundtrek, ot kotorogo inogda brosaet v drozh (osobenno esli poymat na sebe kholodnyy vzglyad 12-letnego kotyonka, kotoromu bolshe nechego teryat)…

OSOBENNOSTI
- Neobychnoe sochetanie pokera i uvlekatelnogo priklyucheniya, syuzhet kotorogo razvorachivaetsya po khodu igry!
- Vpechatlyayushchaya istoriya v stile neo-nuar, rasskazannaya s volneniem i otchayaniem ot nevozmozhnosti chto-libo izmenit.
- Bonusnye dialogi, iz kotorykh my uznayom istoriyu «Utrenney vakhty» — o tom, s chego nachinalas i kak slozhilas sudba etoy besslavnoy bandy grabiteley.
- Nagrady, kotorye pozvolyat ukrasit parokhodik «Sanshayn» v svoyom stile: bud to plastikovymi skeletami, steklyannymi akvariumami ili raspisnymi kovrami.
- Originalnyy ska-saundtrek ot imenitykh ispolniteley Skatune Network i rj lake!
- Morskoy volchonok Fidelius s povyazkoy na glazu.

title: Rough Justice 84 [NSP][ENG]
description:
在這款單人桌遊啟發的策略遊戲中，解決謎題並使用骰子和卡片來成功經營你的私人保全事務所。當你的探員在處理保全問題、追緝逃犯、收回案件等時，要為他們提供建議。

探員
僱用自由業者來協助完成案件！每個案件都有不同的要求，並且有各式各樣的探員可供選取，為案件找到合適的探員是非常重要的。透過完成案件彙編並獲得獎勵來擴大你的勤務表，以容納更多的探員 。

案件
無論是保全工作、收回、追緝逃犯還是兼職工作，仔細閱讀和制定計劃是成功的關鍵。要好好確定具體的案件要求，並派出最合適的探員來完成工作，好好發揮你的最佳水準。

骰子
每個探員有 5 個不同數值的狀態，範圍從 0 到 5。該數值對應於執行狀態擲骰時分配的骰子數。

謎題
有些案件提供了各種類型和特定時代謎題的多樣化和沉浸式玩法（參閱：迷你遊戲）。這些謎題包括密文、數位和類比機械的綜合：全部都是以反應力為基礎的挑戰和數學方面的挑戰。

裝備卡
透過使用卡片，狀態值會在擲骰子時暫時增加。裝備卡有一個等級值，以此表示卡片的稀有度，以及其耐用性，顯示出該卡片在從庫存中拿出來之前的總使用次數。

殘酷大街
為了根除侵襲這座城市的毒瘤，你可以使用所有的力量和資源：從你的探員和符合時代要求的監控技術到高層的朋友。

但請注意，在這場正義之戰的幕後，一個更大的故事正在上演。一個野心勃勃的秘密組織在塞內卡市內擴張勢力，而你就是他們的目標。

title: Three Minutes to Eight (3 min to 8) [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
《Three Minutes To Eight》的故事背景設定在不久的未來，這款令人費解的像素藝術冒險遊戲打破常規，設計出引人入勝的曲折情節：主角注定在晚上 07:57 遇難。然而，主角仍有逃過一劫的機會。由你解開其中的秘密、發現秘密通道、尋找避死之道，並解開多種結局。每次遊玩都有不同的體驗，遊戲中有隨機元素和獨特事件，迫使你多次重玩，發現其中的所有隱藏之謎。在不斷演變的遊戲體驗中，你將發現自己處於一種意識邊緣的狀態，一切皆有可能，卻又始終難以捉摸。

• 展開獨特冒險，探索哲學主題，例如：自省、自由意志，以及時間與宇宙的本質
• 體驗非比尋常的遊戲循環，主角每次都會在晚上 7 點 57 分死掉
• 想辦法逃離死神的魔掌，探索超過 10 個不同的結局
• 沉浸在變化萬千的劇情敘述中，每次闖關都不一樣，有隨機化的角色、環境與元素
• 賽博龐克的視覺風格：漂亮的像素美術角色及逐幀動畫，加上 3D 立體像素環境，打造獨特的視覺風格

title: One Night Burlesque + 7 DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
One Night: Burlesque predlagaet unikalnuyu vizualnuyu novellu s elementami golovolomki. Stante detektivom i raskroyte taynu predstoyashchego ubiystva. Vash skrytyy talant daet vam preimushchestvo pered ubiytsey, tak chto ispolzuyte ego s umom.


SPETsIALNYY PODAROK
Vstante na kabluki Kholli, talantlivoy tantsovshchitsy, obladayushchey unikalnym darom telepatii.
Zaglyanite v soznanie okruzhayushchikh ee lyudey i popytaytes razgadat etu uvlekatelnuyu zagadku v stile nuar. Razgadayte ikh skrytye motivy i uznayte pravdu. Budte ostorozhny: kazhdyy razum khranit v sebe tayny, i ne vse gotovy podelitsya imi srazu.


KTO UBIYTsA?
Vozmozhno, potentsialnyy ubiytsa i ne yavlyaetsya dvoretskim, no on tochno prisutstvuet v zale. Proydite cherez labirint zaputannykh otnosheniy i razberites v sloyakh obmana. Chasy zloveshche tikayut, i kazhdyy vash vybor mozhet reshit sudbu vashikh druzey.


KLYuChEVYE OSOBENNOSTI:
- Estetika nuara
- Zagadka ubiystva v detektivnom stile
- Unikalnaya obstanovka (klub burleska)
- Neskolko kontsovok v zavisimosti ot vashego vybora
- Neveroyatnaya muzykalnaya dorozhka
- Ocharovatelnaya tantsovshchitsa-telepat

title: Dice Legacy + DLC Corrupted Fates [NSP][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
《Dice Legacy》是以神秘環形世界為舞台的骰子生存城市建造遊戲。您的船隻抵達了一片未知大陸的海岸。擲出您的骰子來收集資源、拓展與防禦您的聚落、在冬季中生存並與這奇異世界中的古怪居民互動。

將信念注入骰子當中，收集資源、建造建築物並拓展國家的疆土。創造符合您遊玩風格的策略來探索荒野。與環形世界中的各種神秘勢力接觸，測試您的運氣。但要注意：有股邪惡正潛伏在您國界之外的迷霧中，等待時機來襲。

特色

您的骰子代表國家的子民。提供糧食、麥酒與藥草來讓他們保持幸福健康，否則他們將會挨餓、生病、在戰鬥中受傷或在冬季的嚴寒暴風雪中凍死。

程序式生成的環形世界等著您探索，您需要因應其環境改變遊玩風格。為荒野畫出地圖、收集資源並建造新建築物來奠定您的統治。一邊招募新臣屬、研發新科技，一邊規劃出度過寒冬的策略。

您的居民最初是卑微的農民，但隨著您投擲骰子發展出精明的策略，他們會進化成為市民、士兵、牧師或商人。與議會合作並通過新政策來保持各個骰子階級幸福快樂，就有可能改變遊戲走向。 

擲骰、犧牲、再重複。解鎖全部 6 位統治者並尋找哪一個最符合您的遊玩風格。面對各種不同開局條件並掌握多種不同賭注能力。《Dice Legacy》的每一次遊玩過程都是獨一無二的，能為您帶來發掘環形世界迷霧中秘密的機會。

探索神秘文明並揭開環形世界的秘密。對抗異己者並保衛聚落。查出他們的身分與來到這片未知大陸的方式，以及他們城市外的迷霧中潛伏的事物。

title: 1912 Titanic Mystery [NSZ][ENG]
description:
A bomb is aboard the Titanic II, a replica of the famous cruise ship! You are the sole person who can find where the bomb is concealed. Save the ship, and all aboard, during its maiden journey across the Atlantic Ocean. Search for Hidden Objects among original locations around the majestic ship to discover hidden diary entries and other clues to uncover the bomb`s location. Solve a century old mystery in 1912- Titanic Mystery!

-Haunting soundtrack
-Puzzling minigames
-Save the Titantic II

title: Steam Tactics (Steamfarer) [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
description:
擔任飛艇機長隊長的角色，購置並升級新艦船和武器，升級你的機組人員。

國王病得很重。王后希望你為其效勞。你是這個國家最有名的雇傭兵戰術家之一。你能回應王國的召喚嗎？

特徵：
- 簡單而深入的戰術戰鬥。 你不必費勁鑽研晦澀的邊緣機制，遊戲過程圍繞清晰的核心規則進行。
- 廣闊的創意決策空間。 由你決定如何為艦艇配備裝備，如何升級機組人員以及如何進行特定戰鬥。
- 不同的進度系統。 收集材料以升級您的艦炮，結合重複使用的設備以創建功能更強大的版本，以升級你的機組人員。
- 適合不同技能水準的挑戰。

title: Steamroll Rustless Edition [NSZ][RUS]
interface_lang: 俄语 [RUS], 英语 [ENG], 西班牙语 [ESP], 法语 [FRA], 韩语 [KOR]
description:
V etom stile stimpank vy budete igrat za molodogo inzhenera v pervyy den ego raboty. Molodoy chelovek nakhodit rabotu? Kak vidite, v videoigrakh vozmozhno vse! Problema v tom, chto shakhta, na kotoroy vy rabotaete, vot-vot rukhnet. K schastyu, u etogo podayushchego nadezhdy inzhenera est Scarabeus - parovoy katyashchiysya avtomobil, nadelennyy kachestvami. I emu ponadobyatsya vse oni, potomu chto nezadolgo do pobega on ponimaet, chto v etom shakhterskom adu est i drugie lyudi.

Upravlyaya svoey neveroyatnoy mashinoy, glavnyy geroy smozhet issledovat okruzhayushchuyu sredu i reshat zagadki, pregrazhdayushchie emu put. Kak i v sluchae s mini-golfom, eto trebuet tochnogo pritselivaniya i izmereniya vashey traektorii. Vam takzhe pridetsya ispolzovat raznye parovye shary, chtoby reshit mnozhestvo slozhnykh golovolomok. Blagodarya etim sharam vy mozhete vyzyvat vzryvy, chtoby razrushat prepyatstviya, ili sozdavat pandusy i steny, chtoby legche bylo tam vnizu. Net somneniy v tom, chto Skarabey budet vazhnym soyuznikom v spasenii zhivym iz glubin shakhty. Smozhete li vy spravitsya s davleniem?

title: Dark Grim Mariupolis [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
description:
Naberites smelosti i sdelayte shag v temnotu…
I vot vy v Mariupolise. Povsyudu temno, i vy sbity s tolku strannoy muzykoy, istochnik kotoroy vy ne mozhete opredelit. Vrode by vy detektiv i vam nuzhno chto-to rassledovat, no zachem? Eto vam tozhe predstoit uznat... ili ne uznat. Vse zavisit ot vas i ot slepoy prikhoti Pentakulyusa, mrachnogo bozhestva, kotoroe rasprosterlo svoi ruki nad gorodom.
Soprotivlyaytes tletvornomu dukhu Mrachnogo Temnogo Mariupolisa, vedite rassledovanie i razgadyvayte zagadki. Budte sarkastichnym i nadmennym, chtoby ogradit sebya ot dushelomnogo vozdeystviya etogo proklyatogo mesta. Budte ostorozhny - vash personazh mozhet pogibnut.

- Pokhishchayte chuzhuyu sobstvennost, chtoby dokopatsya do istiny.
- Reshayte golovolomki i provodite rassledovanie.
- Podbirayte pravilnyy stil obshcheniya, chtoby dostich svoikh tseley.
- Inogda vy smozhete sovershat moralnyy vybor.
- Napuskayte tuman, chtoby skryt svoi istinnye motivy.
- Zhaluytes na zhizn, rabotu i obshchestvo.

title: All Walls Must Fall [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
Berlin, November 2089: The Cold War never ended. For 150 years both sides have used time manipulation technology to observe and counter each other’s every move. Now this fragile state of affairs is approaching a breaking point, as a rogue nuclear strike will send the world into turmoil. Both sides have scrambled to send agents back in time to find who is behind the attack and how to prevent it. If they fail, the whole world will turn to ash, forever.

All Walls Must Fall is an isometric tactics game where actions happen to the pulsing beat of the music. You control time travelling secret agents as they jump and loop through a single night in the city of Berlin. Using a pausable real-time system, carefully plan your decisions and use powerful time manipulation abilities to your advantage, as you carry out your mission in the shadows or in plain sight. Levels are procedurally recombined, giving All Walls Must Fall a highly replayable campaign structure, while still offering individually crafted components and set-pieces.

Features: 

- Isometric action-tactics game.
- Hybrid real-time / simultaneous turn-based tactical gameplay.
- Procedurally generated levels and campaign that plays different every time.
- Sci-Fi noir Berlin as a divided city in which the Cold War never ended.
- Mind-bending time manipulation abilities that allow you to experiment with possible futures and rewind to the past.
- Synaesthetic nightclub environments and audio.
- A simulation sandbox featuring crowd simulation and destructible objects.
- NEW GAME+ mode that allows you to keep upgrading your gear as you increase the challenge - forever.
- A parable that reflects on free will, moral ambiguity and the meaning of freedom.
- Developed by a team of former AAA professionals using Unreal Engine 4.
- Original Soundtrack.

All Walls Must Fall also features a killer soundtrack that reacts to the gameplay, and features original music from talented artists drawn from both the Berlin club scene and the world of video game music: Jukio Kallio, Ben Prunty, Kuedo, The Orion Correlation and Lost & Found, Mona Mur and Muuutsch.

title: We Are OFK [NSZ][ENG]
description:
interaktivnaya novella so sporami o tekstakh, grustnymi soobshcheniyami i interaktivnymi klipami!

Itsumi Sayto tolko chto pereekhala v Dauntaun, no rasstalas s devushkoy i teper mechtaet vyrazit eto v muzyke. Ey prikhoditsya lavirovat mezhdu repetitsiyami, druzyami, polnotsennoy rabotoy i ezhednevnymi poezdkami v Vestsayd. Itsu izo vsekh sil pytaetsya nayti svoe mesto na besposhchadnoy muzykalnoy stsene Los-Andzhelesa. Probivshis na veseluyu gollivudskuyu vecherinku, ona zavodit druzhbu s nachinayushchim muzykalnym prodyuserom i vidit v etom shans ispolnit svoyu mechtu.

Osobennosti:
- 5 epizodov interaktivnogo animirovannogo seriala.
- 5 interaktivnykh klipov s debyutnymi trekami OFK.
- Polnostyu ozvuchennye zvezdami dialogi.
Emotsionalnaya perepiska, flirt, memy i kucha emodzi.
- Nastoyashchie lokatsii iz Los-Andzhelesa. Kafeshka s babbl-ti vam tochno ponravitsya!

title: Alfred Hitchcock Vertigo [NSP][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
Avtomobil pisatelya Eda Millera razbilsya, upav v kanon Broudi v Kalifornii, no sam Ed ostalsya tsel i nevredim.
V razbitoy mashine nikogo ne nashli, no Ed nastaivaet, chto on ekhal s zhenoy i docheryu. Ot perezhitogo koshmara u nego nachinayutsya chudovishchnye golovokruzheniya. Poseshchaya terapevta, on pytaetsya vyyasnit, chto zhe na samom dele sluchilos v tot tragicheskiy den.

Vedite rassledovanie vnutri chelovecheskogo razuma i prigotovtes sdelat strashnoe otkrytie: pravda poroy byvaet khuzhe bezumiya.

- Avtorskaya istoriya ob oderzhimosti, manipulyatsiyakh i bezumii, vdokhnovlennaya shedevrom Vertigo («Golovokruzhenie») Alfreda Khichkoka.

- Pogruzites v igru s zakhvatyvayushchim syuzhetom, kotoraya otdaet dan uvazheniya vizualnym i stsenarnym priemam zhanra trillerov.

- Vedite rassledovanie s tochki zreniya trekh personazhey: kazhdyy iz nikh mozhet rasskazat svoyu istoriyu.

- Issleduyte neskolko vremennykh liniy, chtoby vzglyanut na sobytiya s raznoy perspektivy i otdelit realnost ot obmanchivykh vospominaniy. 

- Igra razrabotana udostoennoy nagrad studiey Pendulo Studios.

title: Above Snakes [NSZ][RUS/Multi12]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 12]
description:
打造你的世界。於荒野中生存。揭開這片土地的秘密。
在這款放鬆系等角視角冒險 RPG 中踏入一個手工打造、受 Wild West 啟發的世界。建造、探索、耕作與戰鬥，在變化萬千的生態系與神秘威脅中，拼湊出屬於你自己的旅程。


塑造你周遭的世界
運用超過 100 個模組化世界拼塊，發揮創意，打造一個有生命的世界。每個生物群系都帶來嶄新的材料、資源與環境挑戰。逐步建造、探索並發展你身處的環境。


生存、製作、繁榮
收集資源、烹煮滋養的餐點，打造必備的工作站如熔爐、鋸木機與鐵砧。精通製作，解鎖強力的武器、工具與裝備，協助你狩獵、釣魚，並面對潛伏的危機。


打造你的邊境基地
使用直觀的模組化系統，創建個人前哨站——從質樸小屋到溫馨農場皆可實現。擺放家具、種植花園，在門廊享受寧靜的夕陽……然後再次踏上荒野探險。


耕作並繁榮發展
種植野生藥草與蔬菜，細心灌溉與施肥，收穫辛勤耕耘的成果。耕作是你客製化世界中生存與美觀的關鍵。


主要特色：
- 利用超過 100 種獨特的世界拼塊與生態區域，自由打造屬於你的世界。
- 在溫馨的生存冒險中進行製作、烹飪、狩獵、釣魚、耕作與戰鬥。
- 提供細緻自訂選項的模組化建築系統。
- 按照自己的節奏完成任務，發掘感人的故事。
- 遇見神秘角色，並對抗迷失的靈魂。
- 支援自訂音效設定與護眼光敏模式。


無論是享受一個靜謐的釣魚夜晚，還是勇闖充滿 Lost Souls 的黑暗生物群系，這個世界由你建構——這是屬於你的故事。

title: Concordia Digital edition + 6 DLC [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + optsionalnyy 俄语 LFS-MOD perevoda 用于 v720896
description:
Concordia — strategicheskaya nastolnaya igra, gde igroki berut na sebya roli mogushchestvennykh rimskikh torgovtsev i sledyat za rasshireniem imperii s ikh torgovymi putyami i proizvodstvennymi predpriyatiyami!
Postroyte velichayshuyu torgovuyu imperiyu Drevnego Rima! Tochnaya adaptatsiya strategicheskoy nastolnoy igry, voshedshey v 20 luchshie iz luchshikh. Planiruyte i prinimayte vazhnye resheniya kazhdyy khod. Vsegda budte gotovy poyti na kompromiss — ved vashi deystviya mogut prinesti polzu ne tolko vam, no i drugim igrokam.

title: Whisker Waters [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Ispolzuyte krutye rybolovnye prinadlezhnosti i lovite ryb vsekh form i razmerov. Kazhdaya ryba znaet sobstvennye priyomchiki, tak chto vas zhdet zakhvatyvayushchaya lovlya i radost ot kazhdoy poymannoy rybki!
Nevazhno, master li vy rybalki ili tolko nachinaete, v etoy igre kazhdyy naydet chto-to dlya sebya. Otlozhite v storonu mechi i nauchites reshat golovolomki s pomoshchyu khitrykh rybatskikh tekhnik!
V Whisker Waters, koty, medvezhata i ptitsy zhivut vmeste v garmonii i soglasii. Prisoedinyaytes -- zavodite druzhbu s mestnymi zhitelyami i pomogayte im. Poluchayte potryasayushchie nagrady i otkryvayte krutoe snaryazhenie, kotoroe prigoditsya vam v puteshestvii!
Sozdayte svoego personazha-kota s kuchey krutykh aksessuarov na vybor. Kastomiziruyte personazha po svoemu usmotreniyu i pokazhite vsemu miru vashego nepovtorimogo puteshestvennika!
Vas ozhidaet novaya glava na kazhdom shagu. Kazhdaya oblast mira nesyot v sebe sobstvennyy syuzhet -- i priglashaet vas stat ego chastyu: chastyu skazki o priklyucheniyakh, zagadkakh i druzhbe. Rasputayte eti istorii, i pust ikh volshebstvo soprovozhdaet vas v puteshestvii.

title: Garden Paws [NSZ][ENG]
description:
In order to expand your home, and build up the nearby town, you're going to need coins. What better way to earn those coins than by running a shop! Explore the islands and caves collecting everything from poop to flowers to sell to the local villagers. Once you have some seeds you can dive into Farming, or many of the other activities on the islands including, Crafting, Fishing, Mining and Questing.

Once you have some spare coin talk to Frank to commission new buildings in town, with each building bringing unique Upgrades, Shops, Quests and even New Areas to explore, you'll have plenty to keep you busy!

- EXPLORE: With each area that you explore there are new items to find, collect, sell and even wear. Around every corner there is a chance to find hidden treasure, so you'll want to explore every chance you get.

- DUNGEON : Dive into the dungeon and battle monsters on 10 epic levels, take on the boss if you dare.

- MULTIPLAYER: You don't have to go alone on this new adventure, invite up to 9 friends to join you online. From shopkeeping to taming and exploring, everything is better with friends.

- CUSTOMIZATION: There are 10 characters to choose from, the Fox, Bunny, Bear, Dragon, Cat, Bird, Badger, Chipmunk, Horse and Dog. Each character has a unique appearance and for all the characters there are over 400 skins and over 150+ dye-able clothing items to customize your character unique to you.

- SHOPKEEPING: Found a flower or rock you think your customers will love? Open your shop between 12:00 and 18:00 and watch the money roll in. There are 1000+ items to sell in your shop, from raw materials to crafted items.

- QUESTING: Don't go too far, the townsfolk will need your help rebuilding their town, especially when a natural disaster strikes. Help build up the town and local buildings introducing new quests, areas and items along the way. There are over 700 quests with a minimum of 30 hours of content to explore, don't worry if you finish all the quests there are new ones every season.

- FARMING: Dig up seeds with flowers and vegetables in the wild or talk to Sammy the Seed Seller to purchase new seeds. Use your hoe to till the soil, then make sure to water it every day until your crops are ready to harvest. After a couple of days, harvest your crops and then cook them up or wrap them in a bouquet to sell in your shop.

- FISHING: There is water everywhere! So it's no surprise that the villagers on these islands like to fish. Whether it's dawn or dusk there is a large variety of fish to catch.

- RAISE ANIMALS: What farm is complete without animals? Talk to Frank about building your first Chicken Coop and Barn. In Garden Paws you can raise and tend to many animals including Chicks, Ducks, Calves, Alpacas, Foxes, Ferrets, Goats, Sheep, Horses, Rabbits and more. All of your larger mature animals can also be mounts to help you get around faster if you want a break from gliding around.

- CRAFTING: There are over 600 crafting recipes, including various chests, furniture and building pieces. You can keep your farm classic with wooden decorations or glam it up with crystal furniture and glass walls. Your Farm, your style! There are over 60 wallpapers and hundreds of items to keep you building all night.

- COOKING: There are multiple cooking stations to make your favorite treats, whether it's grilled fish, pies or salads you can take your shop to the next level by selling your delicious dishes.

- BUILD YOUR HOME: Work with Frank at the local construction shop to upgrade the home your grandparents left you, when they set off to travel the world. Want something bigger or in another location? Build some foundations and walls to build anything from a small fishing shack to a large castle!

- BUILD UP THE TOWN: In Garden Paws you'll have the opportunity to commission new buildings, bringing in new townsfolk and seeing the town grow due to your efforts.

title: Cat Survivors [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Ocherednoy klon Vampire Survivors!
Vam ostalos zhit 20 minut.
Zdes kot srazhaetsya s raznymi sushchestvami, chtoby vyzhit blagodarya novomu oruzhiyu i uluchsheniyam. Strelyayte, uklonyaytes i sozdavayte moshchnye kombo, chtoby stanovitsya silnee s kazhdoy popytkoy perezhit khaos..
Eshchyo kotoigry.

title: World War Prologue, Tank Battle, Combat Guardian, D-Day Part One, Part Two, Battle of the Bulge, Fury Wave, Normandy (Troooze) [NSZ][ENG]
developer: BulletGames Corporation, Hit Games Studio, Troooze
description:
在廣袤的開放世界中，殘酷的歷史拉開帷幕！以令人屏息的逼真度呈現的高畫質圖像，生動重現了歷史時刻的壯烈戰場！這是一款以第二次世界大戰為背景，能滿足軍事迷需求的照相級畫質FPS遊戲。
武器分為突擊、支援、狙擊手三種特性，與隊友協同作戰！通過精確的瞄準和操作，理解每個遊戲模式的任務並參與戰鬥，獲勝後便能前進到下一個戰場的任務。
改變歷史進程的諾曼第登陸戰，在槍聲和鮮血肆虐的慘烈戰場上，那決定命運的關鍵時刻就在你的指尖展開！
體驗緊張刺激的戰鬥與激烈策略融合的最佳FPS！

・如實描繪環境和超高精度圖像，清晰重現戰場上的一粒沙和海洋的動態！
・作為諾曼第登陸戰的一員參與戰場，執行特別任務。
・壓倒性的真實感！採用3D音效和3D物理引擎，享受逼真而刺激的遊戲體驗。
・驚人的視覺美學！完美重現以寫實圖像描繪的充滿現場感的戰場光影！
・在戰鬥中，可以藏身於燃燒的坦克、被破壞的鐵絲網等處，像真實的槍戰一樣作戰，體驗戰場的緊迫感。
・可以享受3個角色（突擊手、支援兵、狙擊手）特性的策略性遊戲。
・通過精確的瞄準和傾斜瞄準系統，像真實戰鬥一樣操作槍支，爭取勝利！
・與友軍的團隊合作和協同作戰，體驗刺激的快感。

請在第二次世界大戰的歷史名場面中與隊友合作，帶領隊伍走向勝利。
讓軍事迷興奮的戰鬥真實感！
在緊張氛圍中閃耀的精確槍支操作！
為您呈現各種3D效果和令人驚嘆的世界大戰級圖像。
與隊友協作作戰的最佳團隊合作單人FPS遊戲「世界大戰: 諾曼第登陸(World At War: Normandy)」
不要錯過這款只在Nintendo Switch™上獨家發售的作品！

劇情簡介
1944年6月6日，諾曼第登陸戰中最激烈的戰鬥發生在奧馬哈海灘。
這條長約10公里的海岸線被30米高的懸崖環繞，德軍在此建立了堅固的防禦陣地。
上午6點30分，美國第1步兵師和第29步兵師的士兵開始登陸。
然而，等待他們的是德軍猛烈的反擊。
許多士兵還未離開登陸艇就喪生，而到達沙灘的士兵也在德軍的集中火力下動彈不得。

海岸佈滿地雷和鐵絲網，士兵們必須穿越300至400米的危險沙灘。
德軍動用88毫米反坦克炮和75毫米野炮，逐一擊毀登陸艇和裝甲車輛。
德軍還從懸崖的隱蔽位置精確狙擊美軍指揮官和通訊兵。
迫擊炮部隊也不斷向到達沙灘的士兵發動炮擊。

然而，勇敢的小股部隊正試圖衝破彈雨突破防線。
他們的勇氣展現了避免此次行動徹底失敗的可能性。
這一天的戰鬥預計會有大量傷亡，但可能為盟軍帶來重要的橋頭堡。
這場可能成為第二次世界大戰轉捩點的歷史性戰鬥即將開始。

title: Modern Combat Blackout [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Novaya bitva zhdet: Modern Combat podnimaet planku kachestva shuterov ot pervogo litsa na Nintendo Switch™!

Vyberite lyuboy iz 9 nastraivaemykh klassov i srazhaytes s igrokami so vsego mira v dinamichnykh boyakh po seti na 12 igrokov, no ne zabyvayte o napryazhennoy odinochnoy kampanii. Naydite druzey, obedinites vo vzvod i srazhaytes vmeste, libo zhe vyberite put volka-odinochki. V lyubom sluchae vy smozhete otkryt moshchnye navyki i krutoe novoe oruzhie. 

URAGANNYE BOI PO SETI 
• Uchastvuyte v bezumnykh onlayn-perestrelkakh v Komandnom boyu ili Svobodnom boyu. 
• Do 12 igrokov v odnom matche.
• 9 unikalnykh kart – ot roskoshnykh kanalov Venetsii do futuristicheskikh ulits Tokio. 
• Probeytes na vershinu individualnogo i vzvodnogo Spiska liderov. 
• Vyigryvayte krutye nagrady v blits-aktsiyakh.

NAPRYaZhENNAYa SOLO-KAMPANIYa 
• Dinamichnye syuzhetnye missii perenesut vas ot Tokio do Venetsii. 
• Prokhodite slozhnye missii Spetsnaza, esli ne khvataet adrenalina. 
• Roskoshnaya grafika i muzyka, optimizirovannye dlya Nintendo Switch, i besshovnye videovstavki. 

KEM VY BUDETE NA VOYNE?
• Vyberite lyuboy iz 9 nastraivaemykh klassov i prokachivayte ego v odinochnykh i onlayn-boyakh. 
• Podberite stil boya na svoy vkus: Shturmovik, Desantnik, Razvedchik, Snayper, Podderzhka, Naemnik, Saper, Morf Kh1 ili Komandor. 

SNARYaDITES DLYa BOYa
• Ukraste oruzhie brelokami, chtoby udivit vragov. 
• Vyberite kamuflyazh dlya oruzhiya i proyavite svoyu individualnost na pole boya.

PERSONALIZIROVANNOE UPRAVLENIE
• Intuitivnoe polnostyu nastraivaemoe upravlenie pozvolit vam igrat tak, kak vam nravitsya. 

2 REZhIMA – 1 PROGRESS
• Nabirayte opyt i povyshayte uroven besshovno v odinochnykh i setevykh boyakh. 
• Ovladev nachalnym arsenalom, poluchite dostup k novym moshchnym pushkam.
• Personaliziruyte svoe oruzhie pri pomoshchi boevykh moduley i kosmeticheskikh ukrasheniy.

title: Offroad Racing [NSP][ENG]
description:
V Offroad Racing vas zhdet shirokiy vybor vnedorozhnikov, na kotorykh vy smozhete umchatsya daleko-daleko ot povsednevnoy rutiny. Zhmite na gaz na kvadrotsikle ili baggi, uchastvuyte v motokrosse — raznoobrazte vpechatleniya, gonyaya po neobychnym i zakhvatyvayushchim vnedorozhnym trassam!

5 rezhimov odinochnoy igry
- Posvyatite svoyu zhizn gonkam po bezdorozhyu v rezhime sezona.
- Stante tem, kem vam prednaznacheno byt, v rezhime chempionata.
- U vas net vremeni? Rezhimy gonki na vremya i odinochnogo zaezda sozdany dlya vas.
- Ne boites zhary? Poprobuyte rezhim Hot Lap!

Potryasayushchie vnedorozhnye trassy
V Offroad Racing odno mozhno skazat tochno: na spokoynye poezdki rasschityvat ne stoit. Trassy izvilisty, polny syurprizov i idealno podkhodyat dlya vypolneniya sumasshedshikh tryukov!
Krome togo, vy nasladites velikolepnymi prirodnymi vidami — slovno s otkrytok iz otpuska mechty.

Bezbashennye piloty
Piloty, kotorykh vy smozhete vybrat, — opytnye gonshchiki so stazhem. Oni zhivut radi gonok po bezdorozhyu, skorosti i riska!

title: Lords of Exile [NSP][ENG]
description:
In ancient times of war in the Far East, the lands of Exilia were overrun by creatures of the night and samurais. Amidst this cruel conflict, only a bloodthirsty cursed knight can bring hope and vanquish the darkness.

Key features

Levels

Explore 8 levels of classic linear design, each featuring challenging obstacles and enemies to overcome. At the end of each level, you'll face off against a powerful boss that will put your skills to the test. And as Gabriel, you'll receive an extra skill after defeating each boss, allowing you to progress even further and take on greater challenges.

Gameplay Variety

Experience a range of mechanics, from throwing weapons to melee combat, down stabs, jumping, and dashing. Unlock the powers of Gabriel's curse to enhance your abilities. Play as both Gabriel and Lyria, each offering a unique and distinct gameplay experience for endless replayability.

Plus, once you've beaten the game with Gabriel, unlock two additional game modes: Speedrunner mode and Boss Rush mode. And the best part? You can play both of these modes with either Gabriel or Lyria for even more variety and fun!

Retro-aesthetic and sound design

Relive the glory days of classic gaming with retro-inspired 16-bit physics and perfectly polished controls. The game's stunning handcrafted 8-bit pixel art and fast anime-style animations, the 8-bit SFX and OST, enriched with sounds from the Megadrive sound chip, complete the immersive retro experience.

title: Tents and Trees [NSP][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
Vasha missiya prosta: stavte palatki vozle derevev na setke-luzhayke. Tsifry vokrug nee ukazyvayut na to, skolko palatok nuzhno razmestit v kazhdom ryadu i stolbike, no budte ostorozhny: palatki ne mogut stoyat ryadom drug s drugom. Dlya kazhdogo urovnya est tolko odno unikalnoe reshenie, tak chto ne toropites i tshchatelno planiruyte kazhdyy khod.

— Po mere prokhozhdeniya igry vy stolknetes s bolee krupnymi setkami i bolee slozhnymi urovnyami, kotorye potrebuyut ot vas razrabotki sobstvennykh strategiy.
— Blagodarya mnozhestvu muzykalnykh trekov i tem, kotorye mozhno otkryt, vklyuchaya temnuyu temu, vy smozhete sozdat v igre svoyu atmosferu.
— Priglasite svoikh druzey po kempingu poveselitsya vmeste v lokalnom mnogopolzovatelskom rezhime, v kotorom mogut sobratsya do 4 igrokov.
— Kazhdyy den vas zhdut novye urovni — pust vesele nikogda ne zakanchivaetsya.

Prigotovtes postavit svoyu palatku i prinyat vyzov! Veselogo kempinga!

title: Fast and Furious Arcade edition [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Super-skorostnye gonki i polnye adrenalina priklyucheniya, perenesennye s arkadnykh avtomatov na konsoli!
Vyberite sebe odin iz litsenzirovannykh superkarov i mchite po zrelishchnym kinematograficheskim trassam, polnym srezov, obektov dlya tryukov, missiy i potryasayushchikh syurprizov. Gonyayte v odinochku ili v uvlekatelnom rezhime razdelennogo ekrana dlya 2 igrokov. Drift, nitro-uskorenie i tochnoe upravlenie nepremenno zavoyuyut serdtsa poklonnikov istinnoy nefiltrovannoy skorosti!

title: Trailblazers [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Prigotovtes k skorostnym i yarkim razvlecheniyam v Trailblazers — pervuyu posekundnuyu arkadnuyu gonku dlya neskolkikh igrokov. Razukraste trassu svoimi dinamichnymi gonochnymi liniyami, uskortes s tsvetom komandy i perekhitrite protivnika v stremlenii k finishnoy linii. Chem bolshe krasite, tem bystree nesetes!

Trailblazers — innovatsionnaya kooperativnaya gonochnaya igra s neprevzoydennym protsessom prokhozhdeniya trassy. Gonyayte v komandakh do trekh igrokov v kazhdoy. Risuyte luchshie gonochnye linii i uskoryaytes do beshenykh skorostey. Zarabotayte ochki umeniya za stilnoe vozhdenie i prolozhite put k pobede! Okunites v stremitelnye skorostnye gonki dlya 6 igrokov po seti ili 4 igrokov na lokalnom razdelennom ekrane s dobavochnymi protivnikami po seti i II. 

• Razukraste trassu vo vremya gonki i sozdayte dinamichnye gonochnye linii dlya uskoreniya... Ni odna gonka ne pokhozha na druguyu!

• Risuyte, uskoryaytes i gonyaytes vmeste s tovarishchami po komande, obgonyaya protivnikov i nabiraya ochki za stilnoe i effektnoe vozhdenie.

• Raznye igrovye rezhimy: 3 na 3, gonki s partnerom, odinochnye zaezdy i ne tolko! A eshche vas zhdet polnotsennaya syuzhetnaya kampaniya.

• Igrayte v odinochku, a takzhe na razdelennom ekrane lokalno s druzyami ili po seti s igrokami so vsego mira — dazhe s drugikh platform!

• Eksklyuzivnyy kontent dlya Nintendo Switch™! Gonyayte drug protiv druga lokalno vmeste s novym personazhem i avtomobilem libo prinimayte uchastie neposredstvenno v kubkovykh turnirakh, chtoby vernutsya domoy s zolotom!

title: Kanon [NSP][ENG]
description:
«Kanon» posvyashchyon neskolkim devushkam, svyazannykh proshlym s Yuiti Aydzavoy, kotoryy spustya sem let otsutstviya vozvrashchaetsya v rodnoy gorod. U nego ne sokhranilos vospominaniy o tom vremeni, kogda on zhil zdes.
Roditeli daleko za granitsey, poetomu geroy ostanavlivaetsya v dome svoey tyoti Akiko Minase i dvoyurodnoy sestry, Nayuki. Ponemnogu, den za dnyom, k Yuiti vozvrashchaetsya pamyat o starykh znakomykh i o tom, chto proizoshlo v ego detstve..
Roli ozvuchivayut:

title: 80's Overdrive [NSP][ENG]
Operation Wolf Returns First Mission [NSZ][ENG]
description:
《Operation Wolf Returns: First Mission》重新演繹於1987年問世的「Rail Shooter」（軌道射手）類型創始遊戲之一，重現原版遊戲的精華之所在（在延續80年代動作片的遊戲氛圍中展開激烈交火），並呈現了全新設計。

幾個月前，一個全新的犯罪組織悄然出現。除了販賣武器和毒品，它還開發了一種全新的強大武器。在發現了該組織多個由神秘的蛇骨大佐所掌控的基地之後，兩名警探被派往當地，以便深入獲取與該武器有關的更多線索，並釋放被囚禁在周邊營地的人質們。

重新演繹於1987年問世的經典動作街機遊戲
全新的藝術指導
添加滑稽風格配音
純粹的不間斷動作遊戲設計
可單人或雙人遊戲
生存模式（對戰大波敵人）
多樣的武器庫（烏茲衝鋒槍、泵動式機槍、榴彈發射器……）

title: DNF Duel: Who's Next (Dungeon and Fighter) + 5 DLC [NSP][ENG]
developer: Arc System Works, Eighting Co., Ltd., Neople Inc.
voice_lang: 韩语, 日语, 中文
description:
動作格鬥遊戲的頂點！世界上最受歡迎且玩家人口最多的角色扮演遊戲之一《Dungeon and Fighter》以 2.5D 格鬥遊戲的姿態捲土重來。16 位迷人的角色供你選擇，每位都有獨特的個性與招式！鬥智鬥力，戰勝你的對手，並成為 Ultimate Will 的掌控者！

【模式與功能】
■ 線上模式：Ranked Match、Player Match、Ranking
■ 本機模式：Free Battle、Story Mode、Arcade Mode、Survival Mode
■ 練習模式：Training Mode、Tutorial
■ 收藏要素：Player Profile、Replay Library、Gallery, Glossary

【支援語言】
■ 系統：中文 (繁体，簡體)、英文、韓文、日文, 西班牙文，德文
■ 語音：韓語、日語、中文


<進一步親近你最愛的《DNF》角色，並使他們更為個人化>
《DNF Duel》完美詮釋了《Dungeon and Fighter》RPG 的經典職業。無論是狡詐的遊俠 (Ranger) 電光石火的槍擊，或是狂戰士 (Berserker) 粗野不羈的原始力量，所有角色的指標特性都經過突出強化與重新設計。
總共有 16 位獨特角色的可供選擇：Berserker、Striker、Grappler、Inquisitor、Dragon Knight、Ranger、Hitman、Kunoichi、Enchantress、Vanguard、Swift Master、Ghostblade、Troubleshooter、Crusader、Launcher，以及一個可解鎖的隱藏人物。

<來自《Dungeon and Fighter》宇宙的絢麗世界>
《DNF Duel》的故事與角色發展整合了十七年的劇情，輔以驚人的圖像細節以及完美融合的 Arad 場景設計。
你可以在八個多樣的場地享受對戰：Sky Tower、Oceanic Express、Moonlight Tavern、Hendon Myre、Ghent City of God、Saint Horn、Zelva、Ruins。

<富戰術性的獨特戰鬥機制>
《DNF Duel》以獨特的戰鬥系統與策略性將格鬥遊戲帶進全新的境界。每位角色都有招牌動作與強項，可以透過「Awakening」效果進一步強化。別忘記留意你的 MP Gauge 和 White Damage Gauge，小心被對手打個措手不及！

<探索豐富的額外內容>
Story Mode 讓你可以體驗每位角色的起源故事，提供充滿沉浸感的《Dungeon and Fighter》世界體驗。自訂你的玩家個人檔案，並解鎖 Gallery 的專屬桌布與音軌！

title: Death Road to Canada [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 俄语 来自 bottleacher, Rainderz 用于 v524288
description:
操縱整車的討厭鬼探索城市、招募怪人、拯救小狗、鬥嘴互嗆並面對海量的慢速喪屍。每次遊玩都能透過隨機生成體驗嶄新劇情和稀有事件！

『Death Road』為重複遊玩而生。遊戲的所有要素皆為隨機，包括：場景、事件、生還者的外表和個性。每次遊玩都能在輕鬆看待一切的遊戲世界中展開全新故事。

title: Get Packed Couch Chaos [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Get Packed: Couch Chaos — eto rasshirennaya versiya kooperativnoy igry o bedstviyakh i nevzgodakh, svyazannykh s pereezdom. Nastoyashchaya boynya dlya 1–4 igrokov po vsem pravilam fiziki. Teper i na Nintendo Switch™!
 
 Alchnaya korporatsiya po dobyche soli zakhvatyvaet Ditchlington, i vstaet vopros o prinuditelnom vyselenii gorozhan. Za etu rabotu beretsya Last Ditch Removals.
 
 Vremeni sovsem malo, a za berezhnoe otnoshenie ne platyat. Vasha komanda po vyvozu khlama dolzhna operativno peremestit tselyy gorod… seya khaos i ostavlyaya za soboy musor i oblomki!
 
 Couch Chaos — eto kampaniya s uvlekatelnoy syuzhetnoy liniey, razrushitelnymi rezhimami igry i bolshim vyborom mini-igr v Drillbyland.

title: Animus / Animus Harbinger / Animus Revenant [NSZ][ENG,RUS]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
跳進先王帶來的悲劇與廢墟吧。要幫助王的傳令嗎？森林裏那女人到底是誰？小丑的褲子到底在哪裏？你的戰鬥用大錘會給你答案的。

守護被遺忘的隱身處的人啊，危險即將來臨了。很久以前簽約的血的契約因為王國的消滅，是時候付出代價了。通過人類最後的吶喊召喚過來的你，獨自站在卡德墨亞上。尋找血染的記憶，阻止那想把人類陷入無盡痛苦的人拿到手上。

特點：
· 單人模式黑暗幻想動作RPG（幻想、冒險）
· 3D俯視角
· 戰略性、劈砍類戰鬥
· 可以隨意變換按鍵
· 線性遊戲玩法（需要地圖間移動）
· 敘述：通過對話與道具的劇情講述
· 20~48小時以上的遊戲時間（以1周目為準）：主線與支線任務、Boss戰、對話
· 道具製作：武器、盔甲、飾品
· 多種技能，狀態異常與屬性攻擊和防禦
· 角色能力值與管理
· 可以根據敵人的狀態異常與屬性，通過分配能力值和道具屬性來進行更有效的戰鬥。
· 材料收集
· 因周目玩法，主線任務與支線任務變得更加豐富

title: Gerda a Flame in Winter + DLC Liva's Story [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Kogda zakonchitsya snegopad, malenkaya datskaya derevnya Tinglev izmenitsya navsegda. Voydite v rol Gerdy, chya zhizn polnostyu perevernulas, kogda ee rodina okazalas okkupirovana vo vremya Vtoroy mirovoy voyny. Vybirayte, kuda idti, kak postupat i komu doveryat v etoy kamernoy syuzhetnoy rolevoy igre, vdokhnovlennoy realnymi sobytiyami. Kak daleko vy zaydete, chtoby zashchitit dorogikh vam lyudey?
«Gerda: ogonek sredi zimy» — eto istoriya o sostradanii, obshchnosti i otvage, vdokhnovlennaya realnymi sobytiyami. Poznakomtes s neznakomoy storonoy proshlogo i rasskazhite sobstvennuyu istoriyu. V etoy trogatelnoy syuzhetnoy igre vam predstoit upravlyat Gerdoy — medsestroy, chya zhizn izmenilas za odnu noch. Eta istoriya razvorachivaetsya ne na linii fronta, a v uyutnoy datskoy derevushke, gde devushka zhila s samogo rozhdeniya. Ispolzuya smekalku i empatiyu, Gerda dolzhna spasti dorogikh ey lyudey, ne postupayas svoimi printsipami.
Vo vremya voyny kazhdoe reshenie okazyvaetsya slozhnym i mozhet izmenit vse. Vybirayte svoy put v igre, smeshivayushchey issledovanie mestnosti, dialogi i upravlenie resursami i otnosheniyami. V etoy syuzhetnoy rolevoy igre cherty vashey lichnosti stanut vashimi navykami, a svyazi s drugimi lyudmi opredelyat razvitie istorii.

title: A Knight's Quest [NSP][ENG]
description:
Reshayte zamyslovatye golovolomki, srazhaytes s opasnymi vragami i ogromnymi bossami i puteshestvuyte po fantasticheskomu otkrytomu miru etogo priklyuchencheskogo boevika.
Nachav priklyuchenie lish s vernym mechom i prostenkim shchitom, Rasti otkroet  v sebe sposobnosti, menyayushchie i ego, i okruzhayushchiy mir. Podchinite sebe ogon, lyod i samo vremya, chtoby pobezhdat vragov i reshat golovolomki.

Vozmozhnosti: 
•	Masshtabnyy priklyuchencheskiy boevik v zakhvatyvayushchem dukh otkrytom mire
•	Ogromnoe kolichestvo zabavnykh personazhey
•	Prostaya sistema boya, s pomoshchyu kotoroy mozhno sozdavat epicheskie kombinatsii priemov
•	Neveroyatnye navyki: begayte po stenam, skolzite i sovershayte golovokruzhitelnye kulbity, izuchaya ogromnyy mir
•	Gromadnye bossy. Da-da, prosto ispoliny

title: Dr. Fetus' Mean Meat Machine [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Syuzhet:
Deystvie v igre Dr. Fetus’ Mean Meat Machine razvorachivaetsya srazu posle sobytiy Super Meat Boy Forever. Pristalno nablyudaya za Meat Boy na protyazhenii vsey Super Meat Boy Forever (pomnish te kamery na urovnyakh?), gnusnyy Dr. Fetus poluchil vse neobkhodimye dannye, chtoby sozdat idealnogo klona Meat Boy! No est odin nyuans: sobrannaya im DNK ne sovsem idealna, i iz neyo poluchayutsya… sovsem ne idealnye klony… 

No ne boysya, Dr. Fetus znaet, kak reshit etu problemu. On nadelal ispytatelnykh kamer i progonyaet cherez nikh vsekh sozdannykh klonov, chtoby otseyat neudachnye obraztsy. Pervye klony niskolko ne pokhozhi na Meat Boy, no so vremenem oni nachinayut vsyo bolshe napominat tu chereschur miluyu mordashku, kotoruyu tak nenavidit Dr. Fetus.
