Ottachivay masterstvo svoego ekipazha vo vsem: ot arkheologii i issledovaniy do diplomatii. Poznavay zakony vrazhdebnoy vselennoy i prinimay neprostye resheniya, kotorye mogut navsegda izmenit ee. Sdelay vse vozmozhnoe, chtoby vernutsya na Zemlyu.

Long Journey Home podarit beskonechnuyu svobodu otkrytogo kosmosa. S novoy otkrytoy sistemoy zadaniy okonchatelnoe reshenie vsegda za toboy. Otvezti popavshego v pereplet Glukkta domoy ili sdat ego tvoim novym druzyam-rabotorgovtsam? Pytatsya druzhit so vsemi ili polozhitsya na soyuz s silneyshimi rasami i nadeyatsya, chto oni ne predadut? Sovershay pryzhok za pryzhkom, prinimay neprostye resheniya, gotovsya nesti otvetstvennost za ikh posledstviya i pomni: nichto v etoy vselennoy ne povtoritsya.

Odna tsel. Beskonechnye priklyucheniya.

Kuda privedet tvoy put?

title: The Plane Effect [NSP][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
這是一款歪曲了時間、令人絞盡腦汁的冒險遊戲

辦公室的工作終於迎來最後一天，是時候下班回家了 - 然而，壓倒性的異世之力帶來的時空異常將你籠罩。在這片時空中，無助的你，只知道自己必須儘快回到家中。

用盡一切手段，找到回家的路吧……
而隨著你在反常的城市景觀中步步前行，你很快就瞭解到 – 一切都已不是原有樣子。回家需要這麼長時間嗎？街道總是像迷宮一樣嗎？
甚至，「家」又在何方？你所知的，只有必須不斷向前。

在反烏托邦的社會中前進
在精心設計的美麗異世風環境中前行，解決非同尋常的謎題，讓 Solo 得以穿越整個區域。
玩家可選擇沒有提示，步步為營解決謎題；或者透過「輔助模式」，在不可能達成的旅程中獲得些許指引。

邪惡存在緊隨其後
不要讓 Solo 停下腳步。前進，回到家中，回到家人身邊。
不要停下，不要回頭。
Solo 被人監視了嗎？

title: Lost Ember [NSP][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
以狼為主角，與可靠的伴侶一起探索一個關於忠誠、絕望和背叛而導致世界分崩離析的故事。

你的精神伴侶-曾經是一個古老文明的一部分-現在引導你穿越一個由大自然重新創造的世界。

在旅途中，你會發現你過去生活的記憶散落在這片土地上，這將有助於你理解曾經發生在你和你的同伴身上的事情。

你擁有附身於任何動物的能力，使你能夠從不同的角度探索世界，尋找隱藏的秘密和地點，同時你會在冒險中經歷一個文明的崛起、衰落，並在其中扮演重要角色。

title: The Enchanted Forest (移植版 Super Elf Jump) [NSP][ENG]
description:
Vozdushnyy mir byl mirnoy stranoy, gde v radostnoy garmonii zhili i fei Vesennego Korolevstva, i ogry Zimnego. Mudryy Sovet upravlyal obeimi liniyami s pomoshchyu dobrozhelatelnykh sil Kristalla Sveta. No odnazhdy, kak i bylo predskazano Prorochestvom, zloy bog Loki razbil kristall na desyat chastey, otraviv zemlyu ogrov. Posleduyushchie zhestokie snezhnye buri bez oslablyayushchego tepla Kristalla unichtozhili bolshuyu chast vyzhivshikh, a ostavshiesya, ustavshie i izmuchennye, stali bezmozglymi rabami zlogo diktatora.
Vy feya — poslednyaya nadezhda Strany Fey, a znachit, i vsego Vozdushnogo Mira. Vashi syostry bezhali v posledniy bastion tvoey rodni, i vasha missiya — vernut vse desyat razbitykh chastey Kristalla Sveta, pobedit Loki i ispolnit Prorochestvo!..

title: Raiders of the Lost Island [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
Soberi kak mozhno bolshe bogatstv, chtoby vyigrat etu gonku! Ne sderzhivaytes i ne stesnyaytes stolknut odnogo ili dvukh pretendentov v okean! Nu i chto, esli oni ne umeyut plavat? Eto vse po uvazhitelnoy prichine, pravda? Vashey prichine!

Odnako ostrov proklyat tonut pod podnimayushchimisya vodami, i skoro vse umrut, esli ni odin iz vas, zhadnykh bestolochey, ne potratit vremya na postroyku spasatelnoy lodki do posledney volny. Konechno, etot trudolyubivyy paren ne obyazatelno dolzhen byt vami. Est mnogo neudachnikov, kotorym eti blestyashchie brillianty ne nuzhny!

Sledite za tem, kto vyydet vpered, i prisoedinyaytes k ostalnym, chtoby srazit lidera i ukrast ego dobychu! Esli kakim-to chudom vasha gruppa vyzhivet, vy smozhete podschitat svoe bogatstvo , vozmozhno, vy vyigraete kak samyy bogatyy igrok. Esli zhadnost ovladevaet vami i vy vse utonete, nu, togda vse eto ne imeet znacheniya ... proigrayut vse!

PRIKLYuChENIE

Ni odin nastoyashchiy reyder ne ostanovitsya na pervoy pobede, kogda ego zhdet stolko sokrovishch. Dlinnyy ryad zateryannykh ostrovov gotov k issledovaniyu odin za drugim v samom opasnom priklyuchenii. Vashi sokrovishcha budut sobrany v ubezhishche, kuda vy vse vernetes posle kazhdogo reyda.

Sobirayte redkie relikvii, uznayte ikh sekrety, ispytayte udachu i dozhivite do kontsa, gde vse vashi trudy budut voznagrazhdeny. No budte ostorozhny, odna oshibka i vse priklyuchenie prevratyatsya v pechalnuyu istoriyu, kotoroy budut pugat detey.

I ne zabyvayte, chto esli vam tyazhelo, chuvstvuya sebya bednym i neschastnym, vy mozhete obedinit usiliya s drugim grustnym reyderom i sozdat komandu. Esli tebe ne udastsya dobitsya bolshego, po krayney mere, u tebya budet komu poplakat v zheletku.

VYIGRAYTE V ODINOChKU ILI UMERET VMESTE!

Beri druzey i otpravlyaysya na Zateryannyy ostrov! Ishchite udachu, vyzhivayte vmeste i razbogateyte v protsesse!

title: Rasenreijo Spiral Hair Super Lady Makina (Spiral Ojosama Chohatsu No Makina) / 螺旋麗嬢 スパイラルお嬢様 超髪のマキナ [NSZ][ENG (Mod.)/JAP]
publisher: シルバースタージャパン
description:
Neobychnyy sluchay proiskhodit v issledovatelskoy laboratorii robotov, direktorom kotoroy yavlyaetsya otets glavnoy geroini. Vse roboty vnutri obekta vykhodyat iz-pod kontrolya, i proekt zakryvaetsya.
Chtoby spasti svoego papu, ostavshegosya v etom NII, yunaya ledi, miss Makina proglatyvaet zagadochnuyu kapsulu — i obretaet sverkhchelovecheskuyu silu i sposobnosti kontrolirovat svoi volosy!..

title: Nuclear Blaze [NSP][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Vas otpravili v samyy tsentr neistovstvuyushchego pozhara – obychnoe delo dlya takogo professionalnogo i opytnogo pozharnogo, kak vy. Vas sbrasyvayut s vozdukha v samoe peklo i stavyat sleduyushchie zadachi: potushit ogon, vyyasnit prichinu pozhara i spasti vyzhivshikh.

No vse idet ne po planu, kogda vy sluchayno nakhodite sekretnuyu voennuyu bazu. Raskroyte taynu sozdaniya Kompleksa 16 i A-█████. Odnako, chtoby vyyasnit eto, mozhet potrebovatsya uroven dostupa ████ i ██...

V dopolnenie k osnovnomu igrovomu rezhimu v Nuclear Blaze est osobyy rezhim dlya detey, sozdannyy dlya samykh malenkikh igrokov (vozrastom ot 3 let i starshe). V etom rezhime est spetsialnye (oblegchennye) urovni, bessmertnyy glavnyy geroy, uproshchennoe upravlenie (avtopritselivanie) i mnozhestvo vertoletov i gruzovikov! V konsolnoy versii igry takzhe est rezhim «Poderzhi moe pivo», kotoryy dobavlyaet skrytye lokatsii na vsekh urovnyakh, a takzhe novye ugrozy, s kotorymi ne spravitsya bez detalno produmannoy taktiki. Na konsolyakh igroki smogut nasladitsya igroy Nuclear Blaze v polnoy mere!

Osobennosti:

 – Unikalnaya 2D-igra pro pozharnykh
 – Komfortnye upravlenie i igrovaya mekhanika
 – Krasochnaya pikselnaya grafika
 – Detalnaya nastroyka urovnya slozhnosti
 – Rezhim dlya detey s osobymi urovnyami i upravleniem, podobrannym dlya malenkikh igrokov
 – Rezhim «Poderzhi moe pivo», dobavlyayushchiy skrytye lokatsii, a takzhe novye ugrozy i takticheskie elementy
 – Mozhno spasat koshechek

title: Mars or Die [NSP][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
《Mars or Die!》是一款輕鬆的休閑戰略遊戲。塔防類型和 Rogue-like類型予以融合，可享受戰鬥和升級雙方面都可以享受的遊戲。通過 9個任務擴展並征服火星世界。

本款遊戲的核心是建立、搜索、戰鬥及升級，在不同的情況下不同的方式來分配這四個元素。為了搜索火星必須需要氧氣，因此建立氧氣發生器時在合適的位置里要建立氧氣發生器。為了建立氧氣發生器，需要開闊資源。已統治火星的火星土著人的戰鬥是不可避免的命運。

遊戲特色
■ 塔防、Rogue-like和戰略的融合
■ 建立，搜索，戰鬥，升級等豐富的遊戲元素
■ 從着陸點附近的小土地開始，到佔領整個火星是最終目的
■ 需要完成 9個主要任務，還需要完成附加的目標

title: Krystopia [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Krystopia 是一款密室逃脫遊戲，通過引人入勝的激光謎題、機器人和隱藏物品來挑戰和吸引你。跟隨Nova Dune，一個太空探險家，去尋找她在飛船上收到的陌生的求救信號。她決心調查它，發現自己在一個荒蕪的星球上，所有的文明都已經消失了。 

特點

精心設計的謎題
身臨其境的遊戲玩法
探索
環境故事
配音敘事

title: Kombinera [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
在這個令人費解的益智平台遊戲中同時控制多個彩色球。結合每個球並完成每個危險關卡由你決定。你能全部解決嗎？你能從 Kaos 的 Kave 中拯救 Kombine 國王嗎？

核心特點：
- 完成 300 個越來越複雜的謎題。
- 遇到新的危險和能力。
- 重播關卡以達到最佳時間。
- 收集收藏品以解鎖新關卡
- 充滿活力的霓虹視覺風格伴隨著環境電子音軌。
- 深入、複雜、扣人心弦的情感故事情節。
- 可訪問的控件。

title: It's a Wrap [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
It's a Wrap! — brosayushchiy vyzov 2D-platformer s elementami golovolomki. Sobytiya igry razvorachivayutsya v Gollivude 1980-kh godov, gde vam predstoit odnovremenno stat rezhissyorom i zvezdoy dinamichnykh nizkobyudzhetnykh filmov.

Vy vsego lish khoteli snyat nezateylivyy film, no vsyo poshlo ne po planu! V roli rezhissyora sinkhroniziruyte deystviya aktyorov s rekvizitom, chtoby vsyo ukladyvalos v taymingi. A zatem v roli zvezdy zapomnite stsenariy i razygrayte stsenu — da tak, chtoby ne okazatsya pod ogromnym bulyzhnikom!

Osobennosti

Faza rezhissyora. Khvatayte megafon i sadites v kreslo rezhissyora, chtoby opredelit idealnye taymingi dlya rekvizita, aktyorov i spetseffektov. Zastavte stsenu rabotat — i zhelatelno ne poteryayte pri etom vashu zvezdu!

Faza syomok. Kogda vy reshite, chto stsena rasplanirovana kak nado, vklyuchayte kamery i pomogite kinozvezde Dzhonni Rashu pokazat svoyu nailuchshuyu aktyorskuyu igru v traditsionnom 2D-platformere s zakhvatyvayushchimi avtomobilnymi pogonyami, pryzhkami i kosmicheskimi srazheniyami.

Sotni yarkikh smertey. Posle kazhdoy neudachnoy stseny bednyy Dzhonni, u kotorogo net dublyora, budet umoritelno pogibat — pryamo kak geroi klassicheskikh multfilmov i priklyuchencheskikh igr. No eto ne beda: prosto peremotayte vremya k nachalu stseny i poprobuyte otsnyat eyo zanovo!

Volny nostalgii. Mnogochislennye urovni igry vdokhnovleny velichayshimi blokbasterami 80-kh v samykh raznykh zhanrakh. Smozhete li vy otyskat vse otsylki k vashim lyubimym vymyshlennym professoram arkheologii, kosmicheskim volshebnikam i ushedshim v otstavku i skryvayushchimsya ot zakona soldatam?

title: Thunder Ray + DLC Forgotten Duels [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Step into the ring and experience the adrenaline-pumping action of our retro arcade boxing game, but with a modern twist! Get ready to throw jabs, hooks, and uppercuts as you face off against a roster of colorful and eccentric opponents. The game features meticulously crafted HD animations, bringing each character to life with stunning detail and fluid movements.

FEATURES:
- Enjoy wonderful 2D Handmade Animations
- Master Thunder special attacks
- Rule the Arcade dynamic boxing
- Travel across Galactic Stages
- Become a Champion of the Universe
- Learn to defeat the most brutal techniques
- Be bloody and wild!

title: Treadnauts [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Treadnauts otlichaetsya ot vsekh ostalnykh boevykh igr velikolepnoy fizikoy, kotoraya pozvolyaet gratsiozno ezdit na tanke po zhivopisnym mestam srazheniy i effektno nanosit smertelnye vystrely vragam! V vashem rasporyazhenii mnozhestvo poleznykh prisposobleniy, v tom chisle gusenitsy, prilipayushchie k lyubym stenam, usiliteli pryzhkov v vozdukh, lyzhi s nulevym treniem i raketnye prygalki, pozvolyayushchie stremitelno vzletet v vozdukh. Vypolnyayte manevry so stilem!

- Chetyre igrovye zony s unikalnymi mekhanicheskimi i fizicheskimi obektami
- Vzryvnoy lokalnyy rezhim boya dlya 2–4 artilleriyskikh raketostroiteley
- Upravlyaemye II kompyuterom tanki s tremya urovnyami slozhnosti
- Testovyy rezhim dlya odnogo igroka s medalyami
- Lazernye pushki, kryuki-zakhvaty, samonavodyashchiesya snaryady i mnozhestvo drugikh bonusov dlya sbora
- Dinamicheskiy saundtrek King Felix, menyayushchiysya pri kazhdoy igre
- Perekhod na novye urovni s polucheniem dopolnitelnykh kart i personazhey
- Krutye modifikatory: nevesomost, otskakivayushchie puli, reaktivnye rantsy — i ne tolko!

title: Xuan Yuan Sword: Mists Beyond the Mountains [NSP][ENG]
developer: Softstar Entertainment, Domo Studio, CubeGame, Gamera Games
description:
Klassicheskaya rolevaya advenchura, sochetayushchaya v sebe kitayskuyu i zapadnuyu kultury i mifologiyu i razvorachivayushchuyusya v epokhu stolknoveniya Vostoka i Zapada. Igrok stanet svidetelem takikh istoricheskikh sobytiy kak Bitva na reke Talas, grazhdanskaya voyna v Aravii, krestovye pokhody i Myatezh An Lushanya, a takzhe stolknetsya s takimi unikalnymi istoricheskimi vragami kak soldaty Merovingov, venetsianskiy flot, Abbasidskiy khalifat, soldaty dinastii Tan i daosy, a takzhe s unikalnymi mificheskimi sushchestvami, takimi kak kentavry, Meduza, Chernye i Belye Zhnetsy i boginya Syuannu Devyati Nebes.
Soglasno kitayskim legendam, vo vremena bitv mezhdu lyudmi i demonami lyudi ispolzovali mech Syuanyuan, legendarnoe oruzhie, blagodarya kotoromu oni neodnokratno oderzhivali pobedu nad demonami. Bog Sozidaniya poschital, chto lyudi i demony ne mogut sosushchestvovat, poetomu on sozdal novyy mir iz khaosa i pereselil tuda demonov, tem samym zakonchiv voynu v epokhu legend i dav start istorii mira lyudey. Eti legendy so vremenem postepenno zabylis, odnako slukhi o legendarnom oruzhii nikogda ne prekrashchalis.
Pomimo mecha Syuanyuan, sushchestvuet takzhe volshebnyy gorshok Sliyaniya Dukhov, kotorym polzovalsya Bog Sozidaniya, peredannyy v ruki drevnikh geroev, pod zashchitoy kogo Kitay vstupil v epokhu kulturnogo rastsveta dinastii Tan, chey velichestvennyy obraz rasprostranilsya ot vsemirno izvestnogo Shelkovogo puti do razlichnykh tsivilizovannykh stran mira.
Syuzhet zhe igry startuet v Venetsii, gde po prikazu Pipina III-go Korotkogo glavnyy geroy, frankskiy rytsar Septim otpravlyaetsya dolgoe i opasnoe puteshestvie na vostok s tselyu nayti traktat «Nepobedimoe Iskusstvo voyny»!

title: Megadimension Neptunia VII (7) + 19 DLC [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 俄语, lyubitelskiy 来自 NepTeam
description:
Kazhetsya, chto novaya gruppa zamenila bogin Gamindustri v odnochase, a Neptuna nigde net! Posle transportirovki v novoe opustoshennoe izmerenie sestry nepa obedinyayut sily s tainstvennoy boginey, chtoby borotsya s novoy ugrozoy i spasti nulevoe izmerenie.

Smogut li oni sokhranit raznye izmereniya i navesti poryadok v Gamindustri?

Osnovnye osobennosti
1. Personazhi mogut obedinyat svoi sily, chtoby usilit svoi ataki, «Razryv chastey» pozvolyaet vam slomat vragov, chtoby umenshit ikh kharakteristiki i neytralizovat ikh spetsialnye ataki, a «Gigantskie bitvy» nakladyvayut ogranicheniya, kotorye stanut nastoyashchim ispytaniem dlya strategov.

2. Podnimite svoikh bogin na sleduyushchiy uroven! Razbeyte merzkikh zlodeev v rezhime NEXT, kotoryy soderzhit spetsialnye navyki, a takzhe spetsialnyy kostyum dlya bogin.

3. Proydite tri izmereniya, chtoby spasti Gamindustri vmeste s vashimi lyubimymi boginyami i znakomymi personazhami!

title: Them's Fighting Herds + 5 DLC [NSP][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Them’s Fightin’ Herds — eto 2D-fayting s uchastiem ocharovatelnykh zveryushek. Ikh narisovala Loren Faust, izvestnyy animator. Pust milyy oblik ne obmanyvaet vas: eto sereznye boytsy!

Klyuchevye osobennosti
● Optimizirovannaya mekhanika boya — 4 knopki, sistema magii, uluchshennaya super-ataka i funktsiya snizheniya stoykosti dlya predotvrashcheniya beskonechnykh kombinatsiy.

● Syuzhetnyy rezhim — priklyucheniya, issledovanie, boevye zadachi, mini-igry i srazheniya s bossami!

● Lokalnye boi odin na odin i podbor protivnikov po seti — srazhaytes v lokalnom rezhime ili ispolzuyte otkat setevogo koda GGPO dlya poiska protivnikov po vsemu miru.

● Praktika i obuchayushchie rezhimy — prokhodite praktikumy, izuchayte kombinatsii, zakreplyayte ikh v trenirovochnom zale, povtorno prosmatrivayte boi.

● Pikselnyy zal — razblokiruyte aksessuary, izmenyayte avatar, soobshcha izuchayte zal vizualnykh resursov.

● Dinamicheskaya muzykalnaya sistema — muzyka adaptiruetsya k deystviyam personazha, blagodarya chemu kazhdyy boy stanovitsya chempionskim.

title: Vestavia Hills Classic (自制程序) [NSP][ENG]
description:
«Vestavia Khillz Klassik» — eto nebolshoy krovavyy arkadnyy myasnoy shuter s vidom sverkhu, vdokhnovlennyy seriey Hotline Miami i Call of Duty: Zombies, gde nuzhno pokupat oruzhie i dratsya na kulakakh, lechitsya, barrikadirovat okna i dveri, sledit za vragom..
Postaraytes dozhit do samoy posledney volny vtorzheniya s nastraivaemym vyborom slozhnosti, na kotoruyu vy sposobny, volnuyushchimi bitvami v stile retroveyv i originalnym, spetsialno napisannym 16-bitnym drayvovym saundtrekom!..

title: Reverie Knights Tactics [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
Reverie Knights Tactics — izometricheskaya poshagovaya RPG s takticheskimi boyami, v kotoroy kazhdoe reshenie mozhet povliyat na razvitie syuzheta i sposobnosti personazhey.

Otpravlyaytes v ekspeditsiyu na kontinent, gde svirepstvuyut opasnye gobliny, otyshchite davno zakhvachennyy vragom elfiyskiy gorod Lenorien i spasite tekh, kto vam dorog!

Vam predstoit vozglavit otryad geroev, kazhdyy iz kotorykh obladaet osobymi navykami, chto pozvolit primenyat samye raznye strategii.

Izuchayte obshirnyy fantasticheskiy mir igry i naslazhdaytes neveroyatnym priklyucheniem v stile vizualnoy novelly!

Sobirayte razlichnye sokrovishcha i sozdavayte iz nikh novye predmety, kotorye prigodyatsya pri razvitii personazhey.
 
Osobennosti:
●	Prekrasnyy vizualnyy stil: otsenite kropotlivuyu rabotu khudozhnikov, chi eskizy sloy za sloem prevrashchalis v polnotsvetnye illyustratsii.
●	Izmenyayushchiysya syuzhet: resheniya, prinyatye vami v khode priklyucheniya, povliyayut i na razvitie istorii, i na otnoshenie personazhey.
●	Personalizatsiya geroev: izmenyayte kharakteristiki, navyki i predmety snaryazheniya, chtoby poluchat novye vozmozhnosti!
●	Izgotovlenie predmetov: sobirayte dobychu i eksperimentiruyte, chtoby sozdavat novoe snaryazhenie.
●	Poiski: issleduyte obshirnyy mir igry, reshayte golovolomki i nakhodite vse bolshe dopolnitelnykh zadach, syuzhetnykh otvetvleniy i opasnykh podzemeliy!
●	Do chetyrekh personazhey v otryade: u kazhdogo geroya svoy nabor navykov i sposobnostey; kombiniruya ikh, vy smozhete ispolzovat v boyu samye raznye strategii.
●	Fazy boya: pytaytes razgadat vrazheskuyu strategiyu i produmyvayte kazhdyy svoy khod — a to i neskolko — napered.
●	Interaktivnye vozmozhnosti: ispolzuyte okruzhenie, chtoby nakladyvat na opponentov razlichnye effekty i poluchat preimushchestvo!
●	Razlichnye zony boya: u kazhdogo polya bitvy svoy unikalnyy izometricheskiy landshaft.

title: Maglam Lord + 35 DLC [NSP][ENG]
description:
Dinamichnyy igrovoy protsess s napryazhennymi yarostnymi bitvami
Vstupite v yarostnoe srazhenie s moguchimi zveryami, chtoby vernut svoyu silu. Zapolnite demonicheskuyu shkalu, chtoby ispolzovat sovershennuyu ataku demona-vladyki mechey i rasshirit raznoobrazie boevykh strategiy. 

Otpravlyaytes navstrechu epicheskim priklyucheniyam, chtoby probudit svoyu istinnuyu silu!  
Issleduyte fantasticheskiy mir Eusdeal i primerte na sebya rol Killizzerk muzhskogo ili zhenskogo pola. Demon-vladyka mechey obnaruzhivaet, chto lishilsya svoey sily i ostalsya poslednim demonom iz svoego vida. Issleduyte mir i pytaytes spasti svoy vid ot vymiraniya. 

Sozdavayte i nastraivayte sotni predmetov oruzhiya
Sozdavayte magicheskoe oruzhie i uluchshayte ego, chtoby ono podkhodilo vashemu igrovomu stilyu! Nastroyka podarit vam beskonechnye preimushchestva v bitve. S pravilnymi materialami mozhno povysit silu ataki, poluchit novye zvukovye effekty i dazhe izmenit svoyu lichnost! 
 
Stroyte otnosheniya i ishchite lyubov sredi mnozhestva chudesnykh personazhey
Est tolko odin sposob izbezhat ischeznoveniya vashego vida: vstupit v brak! Vstrechennye personazhi smogut povysit vashi shansy na pobedu v bitvakh! Podruzhites s nimi ili dazhe priglasite ikh na svidanie, chtoby vernut byluyu silu! 

Neveroyatno talantlivye razrabotchiki 
Ot D3PUBLISHER, razrabotchika FELISTELLA i stsenarista Keya Miyakodzuki, izvestnogo po serii Summon Night, a takzhe s porazitelnymi illyustratsiyami i dizaynom personazhey ot lack — sozdatelya Okada Izo v igre Fate Grand Order!

title: Flat Heroes [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
Kogda v posledniy raz vy chuvstvovali sebya geroem? Igra Flat Heroes podarit vam staroe zabytoe oshchushchenie vyzhivaniya v sumasshedshikh urovnyakh s plavnoy sovremennoy grafikoy i minimalisticheskim dizaynom. Pobezhdayte s prostym naborom dvizheniy: beg, pryzhki, ryvki i ataka. Blagodarya udobnomu upravleniyu igra Flat Heroes vy stilno budete prokhodit i vyzhivat v bolee chem 300 rukotvornykh urovnyakh, unichtozhat samykh slozhnykh bossov i voploshchat svoyu davnyuyu mechtu — stat dvukhmernym geroem (ili geroyami!).

Etu igru prosto ustanovit, da i pravila osvoit ne slozhno, no pust eto ne vvodit vas v zabluzhdenie — chtoby stat masterom, ponadobitsya nemalo usiliy! V khode etogo priklyucheniya vy budete stalkivatsya so vse bolee slozhnymi zadaniyami, kotorye na puti k statusu geroya potrebuyut ot vas nastoyashchego masterstva v upravlenii. I khotya grafika igry Flat Heroes vypolnena v stile minimalizma, ona dopolnyaetsya neveroyatnymi vizualnymi effektami, kotorye obyazatelno poraduyut glaz.

Zastryali pri prokhozhdenii kampanii? Khotite dolshe vyzhivat v rezhimakh sorevnovaniya? Igra slishkom slozhna, chtoby spravitsya samostoyatelno? Zovite druzey na pomoshch, ved Flat Heroes idealno podkhodit dlya sovmestnoy igry s druzyami! Zakazhite pitstsu, priglasite druzey i vypolnyayte zadaniya vmeste!

Osobennosti igry
* Rezhim odinochnoy igry ili sovmestnaya igra s 4 druzyami vo vsekh rezhimakh.
* Rezhim sovmestnoy igry so svobodnym vkhodom i vykhodom.
* Bolee 300 urovney.
* Srazheniya s 10 unikalnymi finalnymi bossami.
* Neogranichennoe kolichestvo urovney na vyzhivanie, ezhednevnye zadaniya i spiski liderov.
* Rezhim srazheniya pozvolit vam s druzyami poprobovat svoi sily v borbe drug s drugom.

title: Embr [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
與好友組隊、進行每日挑戰，步步攀升成為消防業界中的佼佼者吧！

與好友一同成為有「錢」有庇佑的共享消防員吧！衝進燃燒的建築物，裡頭有數不清的危險、貴重物品，和最先進的保安系統。滅火、救命、搶救物品，賺進改變人生的財富。購買有著進階升級的高科技工具和全新服裝，解鎖令人耳目一新的玩法。

要滅的火多到不行！您可以獨自遊玩，或加入最多 4 名線上玩家組成的緊急應變小隊，遊戲難度會根據小隊人數自動調整。

暢玩遍布 3 個地區的 25 道獨特關卡。每道關卡都有陷阱、威脅，和逐步升級的危險等著您。

成為英雄的方法不只有一個。破門而入、砸碎窗戶、修理電路、解決瓦斯外漏，避開保安系統... 盡力完成工作，賺取酬勞吧。

獲取五星好評以吸引有錢客戶的注意。手頭緊缺的時候，不妨趁客戶不注意時偷偷搶些貴重物品，幫自己加薪。

利用多樣化的工具、升級、載具和服裝打造終極的專屬滅火體驗。17 種裝備任您自由挑選運用。假人頭盔能減少掉落傷害，輕鬆跳樓不是夢；擁有專利的二段跳棒球帽可讓您體驗無重力滋味；絕緣手套能斬斷討厭的電力威脅與您之間的緣分。

《Embr》會持續帶來新的任務類型、每日與每週挑戰和大量成就，讓您時不時就想回來滅火救人。

title: Convoy [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Predstavlennyy v pikselnoy grafike i ustanovit v budushchem post-apokalipticheskom nastroyki, Convoy yavlyaetsya otryad na osnove takticheskikh rogalik v ego yadre. Vy puteshestvuete s boevymi mashinami i konvoem cherez pustyr, chtoby nayti chasti, neobkhodimye dlya remonta slomannogo kosmicheskogo korablya. Vo vremya puteshestviya vy budete stalkivatsya s chuzhimi v randomizirovannykh stsenariyakh, podbiraya radiosignaly.

V zavisimosti ot vybora vy delaete, signaly mogut privesti libo k takticheskomu boyu, tekst na osnove dialoga ili sluchaynoy osnove rolevoy igry. Kakoy by vybor vy delaete, vy dolzhny derzhat svoy konvoy i ego gruz v bezopasnosti ot reyderov, chastnikov i drugikh vragov. Derzhite modernizatsiyu vashikh transportnykh sredstv, tak kak smert yavlyaetsya postoyannoy v konvoe.

Kharakteristiki

- Novyy vzglyad na takticheskiy boy: Combat igraet v realnom vremeni, kak vysokoskorostnoy avtomobilnoy pogoni, gde nuzhno raspolozhit bloki i ispolzovat sposobnosti, chtoby obespechit ikh maksimalnuyu effektivnost.
- Exploration platit: Vy stolknetes s mnozhestvom razlichnykh radiosignalov, kazhdyy s sobytiem teksta na osnove. Chto ne ubivaet, to mozhet nagradit vas s nagrablennym.
- Polnostyu nastraivaemye edinitsy izmereniya: Kazhdyy blok mozhet byt modernizirovan i osnashchen razlichnymi vidami oruzhiya i sposobnostey, chto pozvolyaet nastroit ikh dlya vashikh nuzhd.
- randomizirovannye planety: Kazhdaya igra Prokhodnoy predusmotreny razlichnymi osnovnye i pobochnye tseli, sobytie, vybor i razlichnye posledstviya vashikh deystviy.
- Kholodnaya voyna povorot zharko: Tri fraktsii boryutsya za kontrol nad planetoy, vashi deystviya chashu vesov balansa delaet Vas vragom dlya vsekh. Poskolku kazhdaya fraktsiya rastet v sile, vy dolzhny idti v nogu.
- Permadeath v yadre: Znaya odno nevernoe dvizhenie mozhet privesti k opredelennym put smerti vy postoyanno na krayu.

title: Climbros [NSZ][ENG]
description: Climbros is an arcade game with an amazing gameplay. You can explore beautiful and diverse worlds by yourself or together in co-op mode. Climb, discover, cooperate and have fun. Test your skills in various conditions. Snowy rocks, enormous trees or drifting asteroids are just few of many challanges waiting for you. On your way you’ll find tons of unique locations and characters.

title: Spy Drops [NSZ][ENG]
description:
作為反恐精英小隊 Spy Drops 的一員，你的任務是瓦解可能將世界拖入數位黑暗的威脅——卻不知自己正一步步捲入一場更深層的陰謀。

你將被投送至敵方，展開秘密行動，滲透關鍵設施並執行潛藏任務。行動過程中，你必須運用捕夢網從士兵的潛意識中提取情報，協助總部分析並找出下一個目標的位置。

每次任務皆為隨機生成，讓每位玩家都面臨未知挑戰，帶來充滿緊張感的遊戲體驗。每場遊戲都是獨一無二的。

你將一步步探索敵方基地，自由選擇滲透方式——敵人能看到你的影子、聽見你的腳步聲。你可以閃避、駭入或射毀監視攝影機，潛行、擊暈守衛、派出無人機偵查、躲進置物櫃，甚至穿上靜音海綿靴減少移動聲音。

每次任務可自行選擇裝備：無人機、駭客裝置、炸藥、夜視鏡等應有盡有。不同的時間與天氣會影響你的行動——或成為阻礙，或提供掩護，因此你必須靈活配置。隨著遊戲進行，你將解鎖並研發更多新裝備與武器。

還可以與好友展開本地對戰對抗——間諜對間諜，考驗潛行技巧與策略！

title: I Am Dead [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
I AM DEAD – dushevnaya priklyuchencheskaya igra-golovolomka o zagrobnoy zhizni ot sozdateley Hohokum i Wilmot’s Warehouse.

Morris Lapton – nedavno umershiy kurator muzeya na kroshechnom ostrovke Shelmerston. Vstretivshis s prizrakom svoego psa Sparki, on uznaet, chto ego lyubimyy ostrov skoro budet unichtozhen stikhiyami.

Vmeste im predstoit raskryt drevnie tayny Shelmerstona, predotvratit izverzhenie vulkana i spasti to mesto, chto oni nazyvayut domom.

Morrisu i Sparki nuzhno otyskat zateryannykh i pozabytykh prizrakov Shelmerstona. Dlya etogo pridetsya pobyvat tam, gde oni provodili vremya prezhde, pogruzitsya v vospominaniya o svoikh dobrykh znakomykh, izuchit istoriyu ikh zhizni.

Zadachu oblegchaet obretennaya Morrisom sposobnost zaglyadyvat v glub predmetov i dush, poznavat ikh soderzhanie i pamyat – svoego roda sverkhestestvennyy rentgen!

V svoikh iskaniyakh vy uznaete mnogo interesnogo ob istorii i folklore Shelmerstona, o ego zhitelyakh i priezzhikh gostyakh, o pereletnykh vyurkakh, morskom narodtse i morlo, a eshche legendu ob Aggi – toy zhenshchine, chto nekogda utikhomirila vulkan...

title: Daisenryaku Supreme Strategic Battles (大戦略 SSB) + 4 DLC [NSZ][JAP]
description: Daisenryaku (大戦略, angl. «Great Strategy») — stareyshaya seriya globalnykh voenno-strategicheskikh simulyatorov, razrabotannaya SystemSoft, debyutirovavshaya v 1985 godu v Yaponii pod nazvaniem Gendai Daisenryaku Modern Great Strategy 現代大戦略 eksklyuzivno dlya NEC PC-98.

title: Time Loader [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Time Loader - eto syuzhetnyy pazl-platformer, v kotorom vam predstoit vzyat pod svoy kontrol malenkogo robota i otpravitsya nazad v proshloe, chtoby popytatsya predotvratit tragicheskiy intsident. Issleduyte dom vashego sozdatelya, reshayte khitroumnye zagadki, nakhodite unikalnye apgreydy i posmotrite na bytovye predmety s sovershenno novogo rakursa!

No pomnite - igry so vremenem mogut imet seryoznye posledstviya. Vy mozhete uspeshno izmenit proshloe, no smozhete li vy spravitsya s posledstviyami v budushchem?

Osobennosti geympleya:
Drugoy vzglyad na mir
Dazhe samye privychnye predmety vyglyadyat inache, esli vashi razmery ne bolshe igrushechnoy mashinki. Budete li vy vzveshivat kazhdyy svoy shag ili ustremites pryamikom v etot divnyy novyy mir?

Zavidnyy arsenal
Garpuny, otvertki, bustery... v vashem rasporyazhenii budet mnozhestvo uluchsheniy, kotorye pomogut spravitsya s raznymi trudnostyami v igre.

Dinamicheski razvivayushchiysya syuzhet
Vy mozhete menyat proshloe, no budte ostorozhny! Kazhdyy vash vybor budet vliyat na khod vremeni i mozhet izmenit razvitie sobytiy. Puteshestviya vo vremeni - shtuka sereznaya!

Ta samaya atmosfera
V Time Loader vy naydyote mnozhestvo otsylok k epokhe 90-kh: ot muzyki do bytovykh predmetov - vspomnite vashe detstvo i vse ego priyatnye melochi! A esli vy mladshe - ne beda! U vas est otlichnyy shans posmotret na to, kakimi primitivnymi byli tekhnologii vsego neskolko desyatkov let nazad!

title: A Memoir Blue [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
由 Cloisters Interactive 推出的《A Memoir Blue》是一篇互動式詩歌，描寫一名超級運動明星和母女之間的無所不包之愛。

在結合手繪和 3D 藝術的獨特美術風格的幫助下，Miriam 的魔幻現實主義旅程得以呈現 – 她遊入了自己的記憶深處。在一系列將犧牲、心碎、勝利和驕傲融合一體的遊戲片段之下，她得以重拾深藏自己內心的童心，深化自己對母親的愛。  

警告：光敏感性/癲癇
曝露於特定光影圖案或閃光光亮時，有極小部分人群會引發癲癇或眩暈。
遊玩本遊戲期間，玩家將遇到可能誘發此類人群癲癇或喪失意識的多種視覺效果。
如果您，或您的家人曾經歷過癲癇症狀，請在繼續遊玩《A Memoir Blue》前向醫生提出諮詢。
如果您或任何您認識的人在遊玩期間遭遇症狀，請立即停止遊玩並尋求醫療看護。

title: The Persistence [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Deystvie igry The Persistence razvorachivaetsya v 2521 godu na bortu zabroshennogo kolonialnogo korablya v glubokom kosmose. Issleduyte korabl, srazhaytes s uzhasnymi smertonosnymi sushchestvami i vedite sudno obratno na Zemlyu. Sobirayte resursy, uluchshayte sposobnosti i sozdavayte oruzhie v etoy zhestokoy nauchno-fantasticheskoy igre-khorrore.
Klyuchevye osobennosti

Smert — eto tolko nachalo
Edinstvennoe, chto meshaet spasti korabl, — eto polchishcha otvratitelnykh chudovishch, kotorykh bez ostanovki sozdaet slomannyy korabelnyy printer. Esli vstrecha s protivnikami okazhetsya dlya Zimri fatalnoy, to soznanie geroya vozroditsya v drugom tele-nositele, i vsyo nachnetsya s nachala.

Postoyanno menyayushchiysya labirint
Kolonialnyy korabl obladaet samonastraivayushcheysya makrostrukturoy, kotoraya mozhet menyat ego vnutrennyuyu arkhitekturu, a poskolku vse sistemy slomany, to imenno eto i budet proiskhodit. Probudivshis v novom klonirovannom tele ili teleportirovavshis mezhdu palubami, igrok obnaruzhit, chto korabl izmenilsya. Kazhdyy pokhod po The Persistence budet unikalnym: poyavyatsya novoe snaryazhenie i predmety, kotorye mozhno sobrat i uluchshit. 

Usilivayte, uluchshayte i dopolnyayte
Tekhnologii XXVI veka — eto geneticheskie uluchsheniya i manipulyatsii s tyomnoy materiey. Menyayte DNK Zimri, chtoby uluchshit zdorove, vynoslivost i zashchitnye sposobnosti. Vy mozhete dazhe sobirat DNK ekipazha, chtoby klonirovat drugikh lyudey s unikalnymi sposobnostyami i vselyatsya v ikh tela. 

Issleduyte korabl, pryachtes, srazhaytes i sobirayte resursy
Mutanty ne zadumyvayas porvut Zimri v klochya. Ispolzuyte osobennosti okruzhayushchey sredy, chtoby otsenit situatsiyu, sledit za protivnikom i poluchit takticheskoe preimushchestvo, a zatem libo spryatatsya, libo srazit chudovishche. Issleduyte paluby korablya i sobirayte resursy, oruzhie i nastroyki kostyuma, chtoby vyzhit vo vremya puteshestviya v uzhasnykh tyomnykh glubinakh.

Asimmetrichnyy MP-rezhim. 
Podklyuchite telefon ili planshet na IOS ili Android k igre s uchastiem do 2 igrokov, chtoby v realnom vremeni upravlyat Solex — inzhenernoy sistemoy korablya.

title: Train Station Simulator [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Train Station Simulator is a station builder and manager game. Be a creative engineer by planning flooring tiles, building walls and creating emergency routes. Install ticketing machines, monitors, appliances, place benches and dozens of other public space related objects. Hire your staff for a more reliable operating ecosystem. The demand for rail travel is evident: setup the complete timetable for your central station and deploy all local and national bus, tram and taxi connections. Ride the rails and operate your ultimate grand central empire!

Full game interface supported in the following languages: 
* English

* 63+ different objects to place
* 30+ types of trains, locomotives, engines and carriages
* 25+ different staff members in 5 settable categories and an extra 2 categories of shoe-shiners and shop assistants (assistants are part of each cafes and restaurants by default)
* 24+ types of passengers including vandal persons and homeless persons and disabled persons
* 25 different cars from the 70s and 90s and bicycles
* 16+ types of shops/restaurants and other facilities to place
*  9 public transportation vehicles
*  6 doors
*  5 types of rails: standard, advanced, electric, magnetic, light hiber
*  5 flooring
*  4 platform types
*  3 walls
*Not all content available in all game modes at once.


Hire your staff and manage salaries and working shifts:
Keep your station clean of debris, secure all areas by police officers and never ran a train off the track by employing system engineers. Hire your staff for a more reliable operation. A cleaner station makes passengers happy that increases income.

Deliver more tracks and manage all schedules:
As time flies by your terminal hub starts to expand. Set up restaurants, bars and cafés and allow them to grow and bloom into successful businesses. Open up new building wings and connect all areas with corridors so passengers can easily access all spaces.

Select from campaign modes to endless game play
Train Station Simulator will be shipping with over 25 uniquely designed game modes ready to be played not only for days but weeks and months. The game includes "Campaign", "Ready", "Mission", "Survival" and "Endless" play modes.

title: Sclash [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Stremitelnyy ekshn o boyakh samuraev, v kotoroy ot smerti otdelyaet vsego odin udar. Primerte na sebya rol mastera-samuraya i srazites v epichnykh bitvakh, proschityvaya kazhdyy shag. Raspredelyayte vynoslivost, sledite za dykhaniem i vybirayte idealnyy moment dlya smertelnogo udara.
U vas dostatochno vremeni i distantsii dlya planirovaniya ataki. Pochuvstvuyte napryazhenie i azart posledney bitvy v kazhdom dvizhenii.
Obuchenie zanimaet vsego pyat minut. Tri knopki — i nikakikh kombo!

title: Little Friends: Puppy Island [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 机器翻译 来自 most2820
description:
準備好在《小小夥伴：》展開一場令人期待的小狗冒險！你可以在這個熱帶島嶼探索精彩地點、挖掘隱藏的寶藏、建造和擴大屬於你的度假勝地，與許多可愛的小狗伙伴一起體驗這趟難忘的冒險旅程！

- 在探索天堂般島嶼的同時，你可以結識並照顧許多可愛的小狗！
- 發掘並探索8個不同的地點，尋找令人興奮的隱藏寶藏！
- 和9個獨特的品種、超過140種的小狗成為最好的夥伴，當中包括柴犬、拉布拉多、威爾斯柯基、哈士奇、巴哥犬等！
- 找到完美的地點，建造新的配件商店和活動站，打造你的終極小狗天堂！
- 給你的小狗洗澡、餵食、散步和玩耍！
- 訓練你的小狗，提高它們的服從度、敏捷度和友好度等等！
- 為你的小狗穿上超過350件的配件！

小小夥伴們放假啦！
這趟全新的刺激冒險，將令你照顧小狗的體驗更上一層樓！帶著你的新小夥伴一起迎接這場冒險！去探索整座充滿小狗的天堂島，尋找新奇的地點，挖掘寶藏。

探索小狗天堂島！
帶著你可愛的小夥伴穿越一座充滿小狗的島嶼，展開屬於牠的冒險！在途中有沙灘、雪山、櫻花聖地等各種風景等著你們！你們又會在這趟冒險中發現什麼呢？

成為小夥伴的好友！
與9個不同品種的小狗交朋友，找到最適合你的夥伴一起享受冒險！你可以在散步時結識新的小狗，把牠們帶回家照顧。使用遊戲中的相機拍照，留下畢生難忘的回憶。

打造終極的小狗天堂！
在遊戲中發現新的地點，收集資源，在整座島嶼上為你的小夥伴建造各種新的活動場所！建造小狗水療中心、小狗學校、飛盤公園和配件商店等，讓你和當地居民都可以盡情享受島嶼生活！

享受照顧小狗的樂趣！
為你的小狗刷毛、沐浴、餵食和玩耍，為牠們準備好冒險所需的一切！你可以提高牠們的服從度、敏捷度和耐力等，以通往島上更多更刺激的新區域。

給你的小狗穿上可愛服飾！
你可以在超過350種色彩繽紛的衣服和配件中，選擇適合小狗的獨特風格！從頭飾、禮服、龐克毛髮到太陽眼鏡，你都可以隨心所欲地為你的小狗自訂造型！

title: Dude Where is My Beer [NSP][RUS/Multi4]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 4]
description: Smozhete li vy nayti normalnoe pivo v mire kraftovogo piva i raskryt taynu otsutstvuyushchego pilsnera, ispolzuya nostalgicheskiy interfeys zolotogo veka priklyuchencheskikh igr. Razgovarivayte s khipsterami, pyushchimi West Coast IPA i American Black Ale, reshayte golovolomki, svyazannye s pivom, na raznykh stadiyakh pyanstva; issleduyte bary, kabaki i pivovarni goroda Oslo, v poiskakh pilsnera.

title: EchoBlade (Echo Blade) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
失明的你被困在迷宮地牢塔中，發出聲響，你便能照亮前往自由的道路！在《EchoBlade》中，每個黑暗的角落都潛伏著危險，有陷阱門、毒氣室、十字軍騎士鎮守的大廳等等！以第一人稱的方式探索，仔細注意回聲才能發現牆、地板和周遭的敵人。

每一個步伐、每一次盔甲和劍產生的金屬碰撞，都會透過聲音共振的音波來照亮你的道路。小心慢走，避免踩到觸發陷阱的壓力板。每個關卡都會有新的機械與秘密等著去發現、新的謎題等著被解開。替不同種類的危險、環境要素重新配置顏色，讓你擁有獨一無二的冒險體驗。運用你的智慧和所有手邊的資源，抵抗命運並逃出生天！

特色：

• 以第一人稱探索遼闊無際的地牢塔！
• 克服失明的不便，將聲音變為你的優勢。
• 在即時砍殺戰鬥中打敗險惡的敵人！
• 找出各種近戰、遠程武器，並盡情揮舞。
• 以你的偏好設定音波的顏色。
• 避開陷阱、解開謎題、找出前往自由的道路！

title: Alina of the Arena [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
《鬥技場的阿麗娜》是一款帶有策略和肉鴿元素的卡牌構築類遊戲。遊戲融合了眾多同類型傑作的亮點。玩家將飾演阿利娜，令人聞風喪膽的角鬥士。為了滿足觀眾嗜血的慾望，你將不斷浴血奮戰。在輕度肉鴿玩法、卡片組構築元素，以及六角形戰棋機制的加持下，遊戲操作不再侷限於簡單的攻擊和防禦。活用閃避和擊退等功能，在鬥技場殺出一條血路吧！

動態卡牌構築機制
透過對手牌的取捨，創造獨一無二的牌組來應付各種隨機產生的關卡。每一局遊戲都將為你帶來全新的體驗！

六邊形戰棋
卡牌構築遊戲往往只要求玩家進行攻防佈局，但當戰棋元素融入其中，玩家必須靈活地調整自己的位置，藉此引誘敵人走入陷阱，自相殘殺，或巧妙地利用地形，從而贏得優勢。

雙武器系統
雙手武器，戰力加倍！玩家可以藉助雙匕首達到最大傷害，也可以一手持劍一手持盾穩穩打，還可以揮舞雙手巨劍大殺四方。找到適合每場戰鬥的最佳武器組合吧！

title: At Sundown Shots in the Dark [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
At Sundown: Shots In The Dark — eto mnogopolzovatelskiy shuter s vidom sverkhu so stels-sostavlyayushchey, v kotorom do 4 igrokov mogut sorevnovatsya v boyakh nasmert po lokalnoy seti i seti Internet.  Mnozhestvo krutogo oruzhiya dlya ustraneniya protivnikov i neskolko kart v 6 razlichnykh zonakh — tolko LUChShIY smozhet prevzoyti ostalnykh v kazhdom raunde i vyzhit v slozhneyshem ispytanii, chtoby podnyatsya na vershinu na zakate!

UNIKALNYY ARENNYY ShUTER SO STELS-SOSTAVLYaYuShchEY — unikalnyy shuter, v kotorom karty pokryty tmoy, a svet — vash vrag.

MNOGOPOLZOVATELSKAYa IGRA PO LOKALNOY SETI I SETI INTERNET — sorevnuytes s 4 druzyami v boyakh nasmert, chtoby vyyavit bezogovorochnogo pobeditelya!

IGRAYTE V REZhIME ISPYTANIYa ILI V KOOPERATIVNOM REZhIME II — igrayte vmeste protiv II ili prokhodite spetsialnye ispytaniya, chtoby podgotovitsya k boyu s zhivymi protivnikami.

6 UNIKALNYKh ZON S RAZLIChNYMI KARTAMI — dominiruyte nad protivnikom na neskolkikh kartakh s unikalnymi mekhanikami osveshcheniya. Novye zony po mere razvitiya!

title: Hopping Girl Kohane EX Jumping Kingdom Princess of the Black Rabbit [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Hopping Girl Kohane EX.
這是一款動作益智遊戲，玩家只需控制騎著跳桿的小跳到達終點

只需要大拇指的操作，就能獲得有趣的遊戲體驗
遊戲的關鍵是各種不可思議的圖標
通過跳向各種各樣效果不同的圖標，就能瞄準高分數！

【關卡】
共有100個可遊玩關卡!
追加了全新的關卡! 並且有全新的機關!？
從簡單到高難度，
有許多具有挑戰性的關卡在等待你。

【服裝】
追加了大量的全新服裝!
獲得小跳的服裝，盡情享受換裝的樂趣
小跳的服裝可以通過通關獲得或在商店購買。
在富美子商店可以用遊戲中的硬幣購買小跳的服裝。

【分數排名】
僅僅通關並不是結束!
每個關卡都有分數排名。
如果獲得高分，你將獲得更高的分數排名。
以高分排名為目標，不斷的嘗試吧。

title: Drawngeon Dungeons of Ink and Paper [NSP][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
Life went on as usual in the Inkland… until the Tower fell straight from the sky! Many heroes tried to solve its mystery, but none of them succeeded. It’s your turn to prove your worth.
Choose your class - warrior, magician or rogue - each with their own strength and abilities. Loot and buy items, fight with various weapons, create and cast powerful spells. All the ingredients of a good role-playing game are there, but with a unique real-time combat based on grid movement – like on a piece of paper! The hand-drawn graphics especially fit the dark and old-school heroic fantasy settings.
Drawngeon is a RPG adventure that can also be played in short gameplay sessions, thanks to the procedural generation of dungeons, caves, forests and items you will find as you progress and develop your character. 

Features summary:
•    Everything is hand-drawn!
•    Procedural generation of locations and items.
•    Three classes of heroes - each with its own play style.
•    Short gameplay sessions.
•    Strange world and unexpected discoveries.
•    You are able to eat items!

title: Project Highrise Architect's Edition + DLC Modern Design [NSP][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
V etoy igre vy smozhete proektirovat i stroit neboskreby-shedevry, kotorye zastavyat krasnet tselye goroda. No prosto postroit neboskreb malo, nado eshche i upravlyat im tak, chtoby v nyom vsyo rabotalo bespereboyno i effektivno.

● Prorabotannyy simulyator sovremennogo neboskreba.
● Stroyte siyayushchie ofisnye zdaniya i zhilye kompleksy.
● Kontsertnye i vystavochnye zaly, roskoshnye oteli i torgovye tsentry — zdes est vsyo.
● Rezhim «pesochnitsy» i raznye urovni slozhnosti.
● Kampaniya iz 29 stsenariev.

title: Art of Balance [NSZ][ENG]
description:
One of the all-time best physics-puzzlers (88% on Metacritic.com) has finally made its way to Nintendo Switch™: Art of Balance.

Puzzle games must be addictive. That's why we designed 200 levels to not only challenge your skills but also your imagination. With its tight controls, Art of Balance is easy to pick up and hard to put away.

The goal sounds simple at first: Build a balanced stack from all given shapes, but there are plenty of challenges. Some shapes break under load, while others can even reverse gravity and literally turn the stack upside down. With practice, some experimentation and a little bit of luck however you'll quickly master even the most difficult challenges.

Packed with 5 unique game modes, online play and local split-screen, Art of Balance is the ultimate test for aspiring puzzle masters. Three additional players can join in at any time and help you solve the puzzles.

With a relaxing lounge soundtrack and 8 beautiful environments, Art of Balance is the ideal fit for casual gaming sessions alone or with friends. Play at home or on the go and challenge other players on their Nintendo Switch.

Features:
- Play 200 levels spread across 8 worlds, each with its own unique lounge style.
- Build alone or together with up to 3 friends.
- Challenge your friends to split-screen matches at home or on the go.
- Go online and play against other players from all over the world.
- Aim for ever higher scores in the Endurance and Infinity modes.

title: Synthetik Ultimate [NSP][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Srazhaysya s bezzhalostnymi vragami i pobezhday zhestokikh bossov — kazhdoe prokhozhdenie otlichaetsya ot predydushchego. K tvoim uslugam ogromnyy vybor oruzheynykh mekhanik i nerealnoe chislo modifikatsiy. Desyatki vidov oruzhiya, predmetov, moduley i uluchsheniy dlya personazha.

TAKAYa STRELBA TEBE I NE SNILAS
> V SYNTHETIK tebe predstoit osvoit unikalnuyu sistemu izvlecheniya magazina i aktivnoy perezaryadki!
> Oruzhie mozhet zaklinit i peregretsya. Ne obozhgis!
> Pri strelbe na khodu otdacha rastyot — nauchis eyo kontrolirovat. Menyay vidy patronov v goryachke boya.
> Prokachay vladenie oruzhiem i strelyay s bezuprechnoy metkostyu professionala!
> My pervymi dobavili khedshoty v shuter s vidom sverkhu — vot tak!

EKSPERIMENTIRUY
Naydi svyshe 85 vidov oruzhiya. U kazhdogo vida kucha modifikatsiy, usiliteley i apgreydov! Popolni arsenal — tebya zhdut 125 predmetov, chtoby po-novomu atakovat i zashchishchatsya. Riskuy, otkroy dlya sebya massu variantov — kazhdyy iz nikh mozhet srabotat!

NAYDI SVOY STIL
Igray za odin iz 8 klassov: strazha, shturmovika, snaypera, assasina, nalyotchika, tyazhyologo pekhotintsa, inzhenera ili razrushitelya. Kazhdyy klass — eto unikalnyy boevoy stil. U kazhdogo klassa svoyo oruzhie, snaryazhenie i navyki, plyus umeniya, kotorye mozhno nastroit. Posle smerti geroya ves progress sokhranyaetsya!

KONSTRUKTOR UROVNYa SLOZhNOSTI
11 modifikatorov slozhnosti, iz kotorykh mozhno sobrat lyubuyu kombinatsiyu. Riskuy po polnoy — i poluchish bolshe nagrad. Ili ostorozhnichay.

title: Kirakira Stars Idol Project 1-3 Memories: Nagisa / Ai / Reika [NSZ][ENG]
description:
The three titles of the "Kirakira stars" series can be enjoyed in this one package.

Nobuyuki Kinoshita, a fledgling idol producer, and his childhood friend Ai Amane, Nagisa Yukishiro, a top idol, and Reika Aiba, a senior idol.
This is the story of the growth of producers and idols in ODA Production, a weak entertainment company!

-Contents-
Kirakira stars idol project Ai
Kirakira stars idol project Nagisa
Kirakira stars idol project Reika

title: Mind Scanners [NSZ][RUS/Multi4]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 4]
description: Mind Scanners — vypolnennyy v stilistike retrofuturizma simulyator psikhiatra, v kotorom vy budete zanimatsya diagnostikoy zhiteley antiutopicheskogo megapolisa. Nakhodite dushevnobolnykh i pri pomoshchi spetsialnykh ustroystv istselyayte ikh v mini-igrakh. S umom rasporyazhaytes vremenem i resursami, chtoby podderzhivat rabotu Struktury. Pomnite — sudba vashikh patsientov v vashikh rukakh.

title: Drop System Breach [NSZ][ENG]
description:
DROP is an action-strategy hacking simulator with puzzle and roguelike gameplay elements. Challenge yourself to the unique gameplay and intensity offered by Developer Etherfield Studio.

The future is disconnected. The world has recoiled and fractured into countless digital enclaves and virtual fortresses in an era of digital isolation, suspicion, and espionage. In this world, there’s only one truth: hackers get fame, money, and dead if they’re not careful.

You are a promising hacker with huge ambitions, an empty bank account, and the burning desire to prove yourself. When your actions attract the attention of a notorious hacker group, The Swarm, life gets complicated - real quick.

Your world turns upside-down when simple jobs hurl you into a power struggle between The Swarm, different factions, and megacorporations that could decide the fate of the world’s fragmented networks. Use your cunning, stealth, and prowess to stay ahead of what lurks around the next node.

Key features
Drop is a fast-paced action-strategy hacking simulator with puzzle and roguelike gameplay elements, unique visuals and electronic soundscapes that evoke the thrill of hacking.

Hack networks to gain respect and notoriety within the community.

Find solutions to complex puzzles.

Work against time, firewalls, and other nerve-racking hazards to get paid.

Procedurally generated side quests offer unlimited playtime.

Play an unfolding story campaign through unique missions. Explore the opportunities offered by the numerous factions with their agendas and assignments.

title: Pig Eat Ball [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Korol Keyk, monarkh s desertom, reshil, chto pora ego docheri pozhenitsya, no u nee drugie plany!
Korol razrabotal «Korolevskie igry», v kotorykh pobeditel zhenitsya na printsesse Bou. Poskolku ona ne mozhet otgovorit svoego ottsa ot etogo, Bou reshaet zamaskirovatsya i prinyat uchastie v konkurse. Po puti ona obnaruzhivaet gnusnyy zagovor, kotoryy ugrozhaet vsey zhizni na bortu kosmicheskoy stantsii Korolevstvo.
Mozhet li ona dokopatsya do togo, kak stanet slishkom pozdno ... i odnovremenno vyigrat Korolevskie igry?

IZOBRAZhENNYY arkadnyy geympley Stanovites bolshe, kak vy edite. Barf szhat do razmerov. Barf na vse, chto dvizhetsya. Pozhinat plody.

IZUChITE ZAPISNYE MIRY Gigantskie vzaimosvyazannye miry napolneny strannoy zhiznyu i sekretnymi nagradami. Otpravlyaytes v pyat sovershenno unikalnykh rayonov, vklyuchaya Sushi-Gardens, Kukhonnyy khaos i Astro-Farm.

Vyzov vruchnuyu

Massovye, dikie bossy Na vashem puti pridet pochti dyuzhina sumasshedshikh bossov. Kak ty pobesh Akkordeonnuyu Mnogonozhku? Ili zhivaya kucha nachos? Ispolzuyte svoy mozg, svoi navyki i rot!

NEVEROYaTNYY ZVUKOVOY OTVET

Edinstvennye v svoem rode bonusy Vo vsem korolevstve kosmicheskoy stantsii est desyatki spetsialnykh maskirovok. Oni vyglyadyat zdorovo, a takzhe dayut vam osobye sposobnosti! U kazhdoy maskirovki est za i protiv. Pomenyayte maskirovku, chtoby nayti luchshiy variant dlya kazhdoy situatsii.

OTKRYTYY ANTIKOM Ocharovatelnye Pillbugs brodyat eti kosmicheskie stantsii. Oni mogut zakhotet sygrat v khoroshuyu igru v tennis ili ukrast vashi yaytsa! Osteregaytes ikh drotikov, bomb, letayushchikh pirogov i traktorov! Razrezh ikh, podnimi ikh, podozhgi ili vybey v otkrytyy kosmos. Ne volnuytes, oni mogut dolgo zaderzhivat dykhanie!

ChASY PRIKLYuChENIY Osnovnaya istoriya - 8-12 chasov odnogo v pervom prokhozhdenii. Poluchenie «zolotoy medali» za bystroe prokhozhdenie na kazhdom urovne otkryvaet spetsialnyy razdel «VYZOV» v kazhdom mire!

MANIC MULTIPLAYER MAYHEM Konkursnyy rezhim divana dlya 4 igrokov - eto opredelenie PARTY TIME. Desyatki polzovatelskikh urovney dayut vam mnozhestvo tseley, chtoby poborotsya za pobedu. Kazualnye i khardkornye igroki mogut usilit eto, natykayas na zadnitsy, razbivaya kapli i otrygivaya shary!

title: Train Ride Simulator [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Do you like train and railroad driving simulation? Train Ride Simulator lets you drive the iconic locomotives on high-speed services, on long freight runs or in precise commuter traffic.

Show great control, carefully managing power, speed and brakes, and be careful not to derail your train. Feel the thrill of a hyper-realistic train simulation game.

- More than 10 types of trains, each with different skins.
- Drive with passengers and material delivery to real locations in the state of California.
- Select the railroad you want to travel on.
- Weather and day/night effects.
- Connect wagons to complete different quests.
- Track your progression.
- Easy train control.
- Realistic graphics and sound effects.
- Next updates with new quests and trains.

title: Vzerthos the Heir of Thunder [NSP][RUS/Multi3]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 3]
description:
V vashem arsenale umeniya naslednika Boga Groma i pushki tryokh fraktsiy - ispolzuyte ikh, chtoby rubit, vzryvat i szhigat vragov!

Glavnyy geroy pod upravleniem igroka dolzhen spasti pokhishchennuyu zlobnym baronom Vakhzonom printsessu Se'Vera. Ne tolko strazhi barona meshayut Vzertosu, no i ego soratnik Vestnik lishil ego magicheskikh sil po prikazu Boga Groma. Teper naslednik dolzhen vernut svoyu silu, probitsya v zamok Vakhzona i spasti printsessu iz zatocheniya!
(Printsessa tochno v etom zamke!)

title: The Solitaire Conspiracy [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Protego, vedushchee mirovoe shpionskoe agentstvo, na grani unichtozheniya. Tolko odin chelovek sposoben vzyat v svoi ruki upravlenie C.A.R.D.S, sobrat vse razbrosannye otryady Protego i spasti mir.

Eto vy.

S pomoshchyu poslednego analitika Protego Dzhima Rasklada (Greg Miller) vy osvoite unikalnye sposobnosti kazhdogo otryada v igre takticheskogo pasyansa «Soliter». Tak v pasyans vy eshche nikogda ne igrali. Vypolnite svoyu missiyu i vernite vse otryady na bazu v etoy istorii, polnoy obmana i intrig. I pomnite: nikomu nelzya doveryat. Sokhranyayte khladnokrovie v mire shpionov II i agentov s kiberprimochkami.

Poluchiv polnyy kontrol nad Protego, vy smozhete beskonechno igrat v rezhime «Srazhenie» ili ispytat svoi navyki na vremya v rezhime «Obratnyy otschet»: etot rezhim vyzhivaniya potrebuet ot vas vsekh takticheskikh navykov.

Osobennosti igry:
* Tri rezhima. Eto samaya masshtabnaya korotkometrazhka Bithell! V rezhime kampanii vas zhdet napryazhennaya i nasyshchennaya istoriya, a takzhe obuchenie mekhanikam igry. Rezhim «Obratnyy otschet» ispytaet vas na prochnost s tsunami unikalnykh kolod, a v rezhime «Srazhenie» vy smozhete v svoe udovolstvie sygrat so vsemi otkrytymi otryadami.
* Prekrasnyy originalnyy dizayn personazhey i prorabotannaya atmosfera pogruzyat vas v serdtse futuristicheskogo zagovora.
* I, razumeetsya, v etom epicheskom pasyanse vas zhdut polnye vnutriigrovye video s Gregom Millerom i Inelem Tomlinsonom v glavnykh rolyakh v originalnoy istorii ot avtorov Thomas Was Alone, Volume, Subsurface Circular i John Wick Hex.
* A saundtrek dlya vashikh priklyucheniy sozdan kompozitorom Dzhonom Everistom.

title: QSP (Quest Soft Player) + 164 tekstovykh kvesta, Interactive Fiction pod PPSSPP / URQ (Universal Rip Soft Quest, PSP) + 184 interaktivnykh knigi pod Retroarch Dosbox dlya Nintendo Switch [NSP][RUS]
description:
Dorogoy drug! Predlagaem tvoemu vnimaniyu startovyy nabor igroka, kotoryy poznakomit tebya s mirom russkikh tekstovykh igr i vernyot tebe tvoy 2001 god, ispolzuya emulyator PPSSPP i interpretator dlya nego qsPSP, teper — i na Nintendo Switch!..
Interactive Fiction, ili Tolko voobrazhenie…

title: Zombies Ate My Neighbors & and Ghoul Patrol [NSP][ENG]
description:
The cult classic Zombies Ate My Neighbors and its sequel make their long awaited return in Zombies Ate My Neighbors and Ghoul Patrol! Play these classics from the golden age of 16-bit gaming with new enhancements and never before seen museum features.
 
Zombies Ate My Neighbors
Hey, where's that scary music coming from? Yikes! It's Zombies Ate My Neighbors, where you appear in every demented horror flick ever to make you hurl ju-jubes.
 
What are Zeke and Julie, our two wholesome teenage stars doing in a 16-bit game like this?! Trying to save the nice neighbors, cheerleaders and babies from a fate worse than polyester!
 
Who could put this SLICE of suburbia in such goose-pimply hysteria? Zombies, relentless Chainsaw Maniacs, Mummies, Evil Dolls that just won't die, Lizard Men, Blobs, Vampires, Giant Ants, Martians and more.
 
Will these crazy kids survive the night? Find your way through 55 horror-filled levels like a grocery store gone bad, a shopping mall awry, a mysterious island and your own back yard. Don't miss "Weird Kids on the Block", "Mars Needs Cheerleaders" and "Dances With Werewolves".
 
You can fend off the freaks with a virtual candy counter of weapons like uzi squirt guns, exploding soda pop, bazookas, weed wackers and ancient artifacts. Also grab power ups-o-rama like secret potions and bobo clown decoys. Does this game ever end?!
 
Ghoul Patrol
Zeke and Julie, our intrepid teenagers, visit the Ghosts and Ghouls exhibit at the city library, where they find an old treasure chest containing an ancient spirit book. Naturally, they cannot resist reading it. Suddenly, a horrific snaggle-toothed spirit emerges.

Now, this snarling phantom and his dastardly minions are infesting Metropolis and slithering their way into the history books, where they plan to rewrite history with their spooky ways. Only you have the power to go back in time to de-spook an encyclopedia of zombified historic dudes.

Terminate, with prejudice, using crossbows, ping-pong ball machine guns, Martian "Heatseeker" guns, and more.

Vaporize garbage can ghosts and ninja spirits, rescue bug-eyed librarians and wigged-out pirates, dodge flying books and adolescent-eating plants!

Only our two heroes have the power to get the mighty beastly spirit back into his book and stop the madness. Ghoul Patrol to the rescue!


NEW FEATURES
•	Save Feature: Quickly save your progress in either game and continue your adventure wherever and whenever you want
•	Museum Features: Watch a video interview with one of the original Zombies' developers or explore numerous galleries containing game art, previously unreleased concept images and marketing assets
•	2 Player Mode: Play the game with two player local co-op
•	Achievements: Track your game progress with a set of achievements covering both games

Privacy Policy - https://privacy.thewaltdisneycompany.com/
Terms of Use - https://disneytermsofuse.com/

title: The Last Friend [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Ustali ot tipichnykh faytingov i igr v zhanre bashennoy zashchity, v kotorykh vragi tolko layut, no ne kusayutsya? Togda prisoedinyaytes k Alfe (Alpha) i T. Zhuanu (T. Juan) v dinamicheskom priklyuchenii, v kotorom vam pridyotsya srazhatsya s ordami zlodeev i bossov, chtoby spasti vsekh sobakenov!
V mire, stavshem ocherednym postapokalipticheskim budushchim, gde chelovechestvo v khaose i razrushenii, so svirepymi mutantami i vyzhivaniem, nachinaetsya koe-chto eshchyo bolee zloveshchee... Vo vsyom mire nachali ischezat sobakeny!
V igru vstupaet Alfa (eto — vy), kotoryy v rannem vozraste poteryal luchshego druga cheloveka... Puteshestvuya po pustoshi, on vstrechaet mutantov, zamyshlyayushchikh pokhitit poteryavshegosya shchenka! Vo vremya srazheniya on obnaruzhivaet sposobnost ponimat shchenochka i uznayot, chto ego zovut T. Zhuan! Teper T. Zhuan i Alfa — odna komanda, kotoraya otpravitsya v grandioznoe priklyuchenie, chtoby nayti otvet na glavnyy vopros: chto zhe na samom dele priklyuchilos so vsemi sobakenami?
Nastalo vremya prisoedinitsya k nim i podat lapu pomoshchi! Gav!

title: Ib [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 俄语, kastomnyy LFS-MOD 用于 v65536
description:
關於此遊戲
女孩伊布和雙親來到了美術館。
在觀賞各式各樣的作品時，伊布發現這座美術館突然空無一人只剩下了她而已。
當她四處尋找有誰在的同時，也注意到美術館的異變……

◆◆◆◆◆
本作是2D探索性冒險遊戲《Ib》的重製版。
其世界觀設定於一個充滿了奇特藝術品的美術館內。
一邊到處尋找物品，一邊活用藝術品的特點來解開機關謎題等，
以逃出這個奇妙的美術館為目標。

遊戲特色
・在美術館的遊戲舞台中，充滿各種奇妙的解謎要素
・用像素圖來繪畫出美麗而詭異的藝術品
・遊戲的基本操作方法只需移動和調查（對話），讓遊戲初學者也能享受樂趣
・一共有7個分支結局，根據玩家的選擇和行動觸發後將發生變化
・成功通關後，解鎖收集藝術品，以及追加迷宮等要素

重製版變更點
本作品是曾首次在2012年2月發布，為慶祝發布十週年而推出本次重製版本。本作品是以“讓不擅長遊戲的朋友也享受到享受樂趣”"宗旨而開發的遊戲。

・螢幕解析度大幅提高。遊戲畫面變得更大，更方便閱讀，令《Ib》遊戲整體昇華變更漂亮
・地圖、人物和插圖等幾乎遊戲內所有的圖形重新設計，煥然一新
・遊戲中的美術資源都重新繪製，眾多藝術品設計新增/改變，希望大家能感受到本作的魅力和樂趣
・保留了“讓不擅長遊戲的朋友也享受到享受樂趣”"宗旨不變的前提下對遊戲謎題進行各種改變和調整
・在關卡和演出方面做了一些追加/變更。新增在原版本中未曾出現過的全新謎題
・增加了縮放模式。 讓一些小物品更容易查看，藝術品也可以放大來觀賞
・新增對話系統。可以從同行的人物中聊天時得到提示
・變更部分BGM。甚至也包括了特別為重製版而寫下的原創樂曲

title: Frogue [NSP][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
《Frogue》是一款時尚的回合制動作平台遊戲，帶有 Roguelite、彈幕射擊和時間操縱的元素。衝破你的敵人，凍結時間並扔出你的劍來解決你遇到的各種情況。

- 衝刺躲避子彈並殺死你的敵人！
- 丟刀在遠處殺死他們。
- 沒有選擇？沒問題，凍結時間並製定自己的解決方案！

title: Republique Anniversary edition [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Vam zvonit devushka po imeni Khoup, kotoraya pytaetsya sbezhat iz Metamorfozy — taynogo totalitarnogo gosudarstva. Vasha zadacha — vzlomat gosudarstvennuyu sistemu nablyudeniya i vyvesti Khoup iz etoy obiteli strakha i lzhi. Ispolzuyte sistemy bezopasnosti, otvlekayte okhrannikov, reshayte zaputannye golovolomki, nakhodite sekrety i perekhvatyvayte radioperegovory, ozvuchennye takimi znamenitymi aktyorami, kak Rena Strober, Dzhennifer Kheyl, Devid Kheyter i Duayt Shults. 

Pogruzites v zakhvatyvayushchiy povestvovatelnyy priklyuchencheskiy stels-ekshen, podnimayushchiy voprosy opasnosti pravitelstvennoy slezhki v epokhu interneta, i uberegite Khoup ot gibeli.

Izdanie REPUBLIQUE: Anniversary Edition soderzhit novye kommentarii ot razrabotchikov iz studii Camouflaj.

title: Nobunaga's Ambition Awakening + 10 DLC [NSZ][ENG]
developer: Kou Shibusawa, Koei Tecmo Games Co., Ltd.
description:
Period Sengoku (yap. 戦国時代 sengoku dziday, «Epokha voyuyushchikh provintsiy»), so vtoroy poloviny XV do nachala XVII veka. Zavoyuyte i obedinite srednevekovuyu Yaponiyu pod odnim flagom, voploshchaya mechtu Ody Nobunagi!
— Igrokov prikryvayut vernye slugi, kotorye deystvuyut po sobstvennomu usmotreniyu. Sistema «dominionov» pozvolit vam zakhvatyvat i peredavat territorii slugam. Poluchivshie zemlyu slugi v svoyu ochered posvyatyat sebya razvitiyu klana. Razdelite voskhititelno detalizirovannuyu Yaponiyu epokhi Sengoku i vedite ee k protsvetaniyu!

title: Cellular Harvest [NSZ][ENG]
description:
At the edge of explored space, your camera will decide the fate of a world.

Cellular Harvest is a shortform first-person photography exploration game. You are an Auditor. An AI embedded in your suit evaluates the value of every being you encounter for the corporate interests that direct humanity's journey into a wider universe.

Track alien creatures. Catalog their existence with your camera. Follow orders. And enjoy an alien planet - while it's still intact!

title: Dandy Ace [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
《卡牌艾斯》是一款誇大風格的動作遊戲，跟隨這位傳說中的魔術師，力爭將他的魔法卡組合運用，一路戰鬥和獲得戰利品，最終擊敗綠眼幻象師，將自己從被詛咒之鏡中解放出來。

《卡牌艾斯 》是什麼類型? 
《卡牌艾斯》 是一款誇大風格的快節奏 Roguelike 遊戲，您將跟隨一位傳說中的魔術師，力爭將他的魔法卡組合運用，一路戰鬥和獲得戰利品，最終擊敗將囚禁自己於詛咒之鏡中始作俑者『綠眼幻象師』雷雷。在一路戰鬥穿過雷雷千變萬化的宮殿期間，將不同卡片組合起來，獲得超過千種可能性 – 每個都有自己獨有的遊玩風格和力量。每次闖關都會提供全新挑戰和組合，讓玩家在逐步接近雷雷期間進行探索。

扮演迷人的主角卡牌艾斯，在專為擊敗他而建立、充滿奇妙生物和殘暴老怪，擁有無節制奢華的千變萬化宮殿中接受重重挑戰，找出全部魔法卡，收集碎片和金幣，從助手和非同尋常的盟友處獲得幫助，渡過難關。

遊戲特性
輕度 Rogue-like 體驗： 嘗試、死亡，然後再度嘗試，直到擊敗綠眼幻象師為止；可重玩性和擁有永久性升級的 Rogue-like 的緊張體驗，讓你在每每進行闖關、走得更遠之時都會更加強大。

2D 等距快節奏動作： 挑戰多多，但交戰公平。在擊破各種奇妙生物和殘暴老怪，一路前行的同時，構築起自己的魔法儲備。

打造自己獨有的組合： 組合擁有超過千種可能性的各種卡牌，每種組合都有自己獨特的遊玩方式和力量。

千變萬化宮殿的重重挑戰： 在非線性攻略宮殿的過程中，探索遊戲中的無止限奢華美學，在前往擊敗雷雷並逃出詛咒之鏡的遠征中擊退獨特的各色敵人和老怪。

title: Daggerhood [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
每個男人都有其技能，對於Vincent S. Daggerhood來說，他的技能是偷竊。他眼明手快，沒有他無法掠奪的戰利品，也沒有寶箱是他無法獲取的。對於Daggerhood來說，生活一直是美好的，直到命運來到的一天，他終於被抓住，並以正義之名，為了償還他的罪，他被投入了被遺棄的洞穴。但這不是Daggerhood故事的結束，因為這才是剛剛開始。充滿對自由的渴望和對報應的渴求，Daggerhood已經把目光投向了竊取國王的黃金，並擁有一把匕首，他可以通過投擲和回收傳送到特定的位置，在100個關卡中，他需要你的幫助！

你會接受他的請教嗎？

特色：

• 5個世界和100個關卡
• 5個獨特的魔頭
• 需要玩家收集寶藏和仙女的挑戰
• 每個世界都引入了新的遊戲機制
• 快速的動作的平台

title: Atri My Dear Moments [NSP][ENG]
description:
V blizhayshem budushchem vnezapnyy i neobyasnimyy podem morya ostavil bolshuyu chast chelovecheskoy tsivilizatsii pod vodoy. A v malenkom yaponskom gorodke, kotoryy medlenno okutyvaet okean, vot-vot nachnyotsya novoe nezabyvaemoe leto dlya odnogo malchika — i prekrasnoy zagadochnoy devushki-robota..
Ikaruga Natsuki, poteryavshiy mamu i pravuyu nogu v rezultate neschastnogo sluchaya, vozvrashchaetsya razocharovannym surovoy suetlivoy zhiznyu v bolshom gorode, chtoby popytatsya nayti svoy staryy semeynyy dom za chertoy goroda, uzhe napolovinu proglochennyy morem.
Ostavshis sovsem bez semi, vsyo, chto on imeet, krome svoego imeni, — eto staryy korabl i podvodnuyu lodku, ostavlennykh emu ego skonchavsheysya babushkoy-okeanologom, i eyo dolgi..
Atri — ozv. Khikaru Akao,

title: Brok the Investigator / The Brawl Bar / Natal Tail a New Christmas [NSP][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
在這個“近賽博朋克”背景的未來世界中，動物取代了人類延續文明的發展。社會頂層的公民都居住在安全的穹頂市區中，而其他底層人士則居住在環境污染嚴重的郊區。

布羅格是一名私家偵探（兼職拳擊手），他與亡妻的獨子格拉夫相依爲命。雖然布羅格對妻子所遭遇意外事故的記憶已經模糊，但最近發生的一系列事件逐漸讓慘劇的真相浮出水面......甚至影響到了父子倆的人生。

他們究竟能不能從這個頹廢的社會中逆流而上，戰勝自己的命運呢？

遊戲特色：

- 完美支援繁體中文文本！
- 可以通過智力......或者蠻力去解謎！
- 你的每個選擇都會影響劇情走向！
- 支援簡單模式：適合只注重劇情的玩家！（可省略戰鬥）
- 升級角色來對抗更強大的敵人和 BOSS！
- 合成所蒐集到的各個線索來揭開真相！
- 遊戲內提供各種提示。
- 兩個可遊玩的角色，可以在遊戲中隨時切換。
- 遊戲時長高達 15 到 20 個小時。
- 可以遊玩多個周目來解鎖多個不同的結局。
- 劇本全程配音（23000 行文本）
- 包括免費的60頁繪本。

可訪問性

BROK是第一款成熟的冒險遊戲，可以讓盲人或視力受損的玩家完全玩得起

- 通過高質量的文字轉語音和聲音描述（人物、地點和場景）進行完全敘述。
- 適合盲人的謎題。
- 所有的謎題和戰鬥都可以跳過。
- 調整後的教程。
- 重複上一次語音講話和指示的按鈕。
- 打鬥的位置音頻。
- 不需要在線連接（下載後）。
- 不需要特定設備：用控制器玩。
- 額外選項：更大的字體和增加的對比度（背景和敵人。）

要進入無障礙菜單，在標題屏幕上按X，然後按照音頻指示操作。

重要的是：無障礙演講只有英文版本。

title: Almightree The Last Dreamer [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
我認識的人、我所愛的人都已經離我而去。世界在你的腳下崩塌。

這是一款驚心動魄的高難度3D平台解謎遊戲，全能樹：最後的夢想家讓你在這搖搖欲墜的全能樹世界勇往直前，設法喚醒雄偉的全能樹，恢復正常的生活和秩序。

玩家在遊戲中扮演最後的夢想家角色，擁有利用魔法之力與自然進行交流的能力，你需要在你的世界快速移動去尋找全能樹及其樹苗，使它們恢復健康和正常秩序，否則你的世界將不復存在。哎，還有希望，你一定能把事情做好。

· 驚心動魄的3D平台解謎遊戲體驗
· 在20個大型關卡中攻克100+個謎題
· 解決超過6個以上諸如鋼塊、電蒲公英植物等獨特的謎題要素
· 難度可選，可為不同技術等級的玩家提供個性化的遊戲體驗
· 解鎖10+神秘的英雄插圖
· 提供12種語言支持(英語、德語、荷蘭語、法語、意大利語、西班牙語、巴西葡萄牙語、俄語、日語、韓語、簡體中文和繁體中文)

title: One Hand Clapping [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
One Hand Clapping 是一款聲樂 2D 平台遊戲。通過對著麥克風唱歌或哼唱來解決難題，並在改變周圍世界時對自己聲音的力量充滿信心。

One Hand Clapping 是一款輕鬆、鼓舞人心的拼圖平台遊戲，專注於聲音輸入，以在充滿活力的世界中取得進步。當你使用旋律、節奏和和聲作為工具時，建立對你聲音的信心。慢慢來。你沒有什麼可失去的，也不會因為犯錯而受到懲罰。結識可愛的角色，他們將為你提供幫助，為你加油，並激發自我表達而不會咄咄逼人。你不必是歌手天才也能享受單手鼓掌。只需克服你的疑慮，與沈默作鬥爭，並唱出你的歌曲。

需要利用另售的麥克風才能遊玩此遊戲。

* 用你的聲音解決謎題 
* 在六個廣闊、充滿活力的生物群落中玩耍 
* 唱歌、哼唱和節拍器來改變世界 
* 認識三位異想天開的隱士，他們會在整個音樂之旅中幫助你 
* 增強對你聲音的信心 
* 唱你的歌

title: Alder's Blood [NSZ][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
重磅更新:
▪3種新敵人類型。你將與成群野生蝙蝠、森林女巫、元老吸血鬼對戰。
▪武器庫中新增了30種含獨特能力的武器。
▪新增警戒機制，讓伏擊更容易。你可以狙擊進入範圍內的任何敵人。
▪推拉機制。將野獸推入陷阱，或拉入友軍警戒範圍內。
▪調整了侵蝕系統。被詛咒的武器和物品能賦予你巨大力量，但你也必須付出代價，會逐漸喪失理智。
▪新任務線：揭開布萊克威爾家族的陰暗秘密。
▪新獵人外觀，讓你狩獵時更有型。

特徵：
▪隱形，基於伏擊的戰鬥。嘗試智勝和勝過您將要面對的所有恐怖生物，因為它們更強大，而且您沒有機會直接受到攻擊；
▪充滿挑戰的對手。從狼人到吸血鬼，所有怪物都有其獨特的攻擊和技能，可以從遠處輕鬆看到，聽到或聞到您的氣味。因此請注意不要過早透露您的位置；
▪基於耐力的角色。在攻擊，移動和施法之間謹慎管理自己的能量水平。最後，您只是一個人，能量耗盡會嚴重疲勞您；
▪一個嚴峻的世界陷入半黑暗之中。在這個世界上，我們的上帝終於拒絕了我們，他腐敗的存在可以改變戰場的強度。從召喚怪物到改變天氣，再到將其中一個生物轉變成他意志強大的化身；
▪一個流浪者的探索系統。隨身攜帶您的移動基地，環遊世界。避難並管理您的營地，但要警惕敵人的伏擊。
▪黑暗維多利亞時代的幻想與狂野西部的獨特融合。沉浸在與您所知道的世界完全不同的世界中。奮鬥塑造的宇宙，人類沒有發展或進步其任何技術的自由。

描述：
阿爾德之血是一款黑暗，隱身，戰術性的遊戲，其回合製戰鬥著重於避免敵人伏擊並建立自己的戰鬥。使用隱身和戰術來克服怪物永無止境的猛烈攻擊，這是上帝腐朽的表現。

管理您的稀缺資源，與同伴一起冒險，探索世界上的殘餘物，以尋找人類賴以生存的手段。

怪物可以通過氣味來檢測獵人的存在，然後可以使用它們來追踪獵人的位置。隨風而行-保持對手的順風向將有助於您的狩獵。雖然，獵人可以通過使用陷阱準備伏擊，然後將怪物引誘到那裡來利用自己的氣味，從而發揮自己的優勢。

怪物並不是獵人在狩獵過程中面臨的唯一威脅-老神的存在變得越來越強大，它改變了一切。黑暗可以召喚更多的敵人對抗獵人，甚至可以將他們變成意志的化身。

獵人可以裝備不同的武器，重型，更強大的武器會在使用時耗盡他們的耐力。
而較小的則更適合隱形動作。

在他們的營地中，我們的獵人可以製作新物品或休息一下。
另外，我們可以為那裡的獵人分配角色，例如讓他們中的一個守衛營地並保護其免受伏擊，或者讓他們充當拾荒者的角色，他們將在營地附近收集資源。

請記住，這不是您所知道的世界。
這是一個由鬥爭塑造的世界，在這個世界上，人類沒有發展和進步其技術的自由。

您的資源將有限，機會很少。

title: Alchemist Adventure [NSZ][RUS/Multi12]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 12]
description:
Otkryv glaza v neznakomoy laboratorii, ty ponimaesh, chto sovershenno nichego ne pomnish. Tebe predstoit sovershit grandioznoe priklyuchenie po zabroshennomu, no vse eshche polnomu opasnostey regionu Isur, raskryt ego sekrety i uznat mrachnuyu taynu svoego proshlogo.

Vo vremya puteshestviya ty ovladeesh alkhimicheskimi znaniyami, kotorye pozvolyat soedinyat v moshchnye zelya chetyre stikhii — ogon, vodu, vozdukh i zemlyu. Dobavlyaya razlichnye ingredienty, ty smozhesh preodolevat pregrady na svoem puti, reshat golovolomki i srazhatsya s monstrami.

Issleduy Isur
Nekogda protsvetayushchiy kontinent lezhit v ruinakh sobstvennogo velichiya. Issleduy oblasti, polnye sekretov, raskroy tayny mogushchestvennykh alkhimikov i naydi svoy put v etikh opasnykh zemlyakh.

Pochuvstvuy dukh priklyucheniy
Alchemist Adventure pobuzhdaet k nestandartnym resheniyam blagodarya unikalnoy sisteme alkhimicheskoy sinergii elementov. Sozdavay samye raznye zelya — vozmozhnosti ogranicheny tolko tvoey fantaziey!
Chem dalshe ty prodvigaeshsya, tem silnee stanovyatsya vragi i tem rezhe ty smozhesh sokhranyatsya. Tshchatelno produmyvay taktiku i vybiray zelya, chtoby spravlyatsya s vragami i pregradami.

Osobennosti

Issleduy zagadochnyy mir
vo vremya puteshestviya ty posetish samye raznye lokatsii: ot laboratoriy i podzemeliy do zabroshennykh fabrik v samom zherle vulkana!

Sozdavay zelya iz kombinatsiy elementov
v tvoem rasporyazhenii chetyre stikhii, kotorye pri soedinenii sozdayut razlichnye zelya, bomby, eliksiry i masla dlya oruzhiya.

Menyay mir vokrug sebya
alkhimiya pozvolyaet izmenyat mir vokrug: podnimay uroven vody v ozere, sozdavay ledyanye platformy, dvigay predmety pri pomoshchi vetra i mnogoe drugoe!

Razgadyvay alkhimicheskie golovolomki
pri pomoshchi alkhimii ty mozhesh otkryvat sunduki, nakhodit taynye tropy i pronikat v samye potaennye mesta kontinenta.

Uznavay slabosti svoikh vragov
nakhodi uyazvimosti monstrov i vyrabatyvay naibolee podkhodyashchuyu taktiku boya.

Kooperativnyy rezhim
issleduy zemli Isura vmeste s drugom, vernym soratnikom Mii gomunkulom!

title: Airheart Tales of Broken Wings [NSP] [NSP][ENG]
description:
Airheart — eto dizelpankovyy aviaekshn, v kotorom kazhdyy koloritnyy uroven stroitsya na predydushchem vplot do samoy stratosfery.
 
 Dobro pozhalovat v Granariyu, letuchiy gorod v oblakakh. Znakomtes s Ameliey — molodoy letchitsey i rybachkoy, zhelayushchey dobratsya do kraya mira. Zapuskayte dvigateli, vooruzhaytes protiv raspoyasavshikhsya piratov i prigotovtes poymat ulov vsey svoey zhizni!
 
 Airheart stanet nastoyashchim udovolstviem, kak dlya poklonnikov, tak i dlya novichkov v zhanre aviatsionnykh ekshenov.

title: Apple Knight [NSZ][ENG]
description: Apple Knight is a beautiful action platformer RPG for all ages. Explore vast levels filled with secrets, quests and loot. Defeat tough bosses. Fight wizards, knights, and monsters - or use traps to take them out from a safe distance.

title: Ambidextro [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Vedma pokhitila printsa i printsessu. Vy — pridvornyy volshebnik, kotorogo razdelili nadvoe, chtoby vy spasli srazu oboikh. Vot tolko dlya etogo nuzhno nauchitsya upravlyat polovinami vashego tela.
S pomoshchyu serii korotkikh platformennykh urovney, zanimayushchikh strogo odin ekran, «Ambidekstro» nauchit vas upravlyat srazu dvumya personazhami kazhdoy rukoy po otdelnosti. Vy nauchites razdelyat vnimanie i budete prokhodit vsyo bolee slozhnye urovni, kotorye iznachalno kazalis vam zubodrobitelno trudnymi.

title: Aidan in Danger [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Aidan In Danger 是一款令人興奮的平台遊戲，玩家扮演 Aidan，一個紅髮小精靈，他的主要武器是彈弓。任務是保護地球上最後一條龍 Drakor，Aidan 必須穿越充滿挑戰的關卡，面對危險的怪物，穿越未來，並挫敗一個跨維度反派的計劃，阻止其統治世界。憑藉沉浸式遊戲體驗、令人印象深刻的圖形和引人入勝的故事，玩家將踏上充滿危險、勇氣和英雄主義的史詩之旅。加入 Aidan 的任務，拯救 Drakor 並恢復世界的和平！

-充滿挑戰的史詩之旅，考驗玩家的技能。
-復古視覺風格，細節精緻。
-8位風格的芯片音樂。
-面對強大的Boss進行激烈而史詩般的戰鬥，考驗你的敏捷性、策略和決心，在難忘的戰鬥中。
-簡單的控制，直觀的命令跳躍、滾動和衝刺；玩家可以輕鬆流暢地通過挑戰並面對敵人。

title: Adventures of Pip [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Welcome to the next evolution of the classic side-scrolling action platform game! Journey with Pip as he sets out to save Princess Adeline from the evil Queen DeRezzia. Pip’s quest begins when he learns he can absorb the Bitstream from his fallen foes to evolve and devolve between three different forms - single pixel, 8-bit, and 16-bit! Each transformation provides different powers that Pip can use to solve environmental puzzles and blast through enemies. Pip’s tale leads players through five different stylized worlds with up to 10 hours of epic adventuring gameplay.

Inspired by classic platformers, Adventures of Pip basks in a world where players can defeat a huge 32-bit boss as an 8-bit character or even as a single-pixel. Pip’s foes have weaknesses and strengths — pinpoint these, swap to the right form and take them out! Can you help our unlikely fearless hero save his 32-bit world from the clutches of Queen DeRezzia?

title: 9th Dawn Remake / 9th Dawn III (3) Shadow of Erthil [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Otkroyte zanovo magiyu serii 9th Dawn s polnym pereosmysleniem originalnoy igry. Otpravtes v ogromnyy otkrytyy mir 2.5D. Issleduyte 45 novykh podzemeliy v odinochnoy igre ili lokalnom kooperative, sozdavayte oruzhie, vyrashchivayte pitomtsev i razrushte zamok Maltir!
Posle strannogo ischeznoveniya mestnogo smotritelya mayaka vy otpravlyaetes na poiski zloy sily, probudivsheysya na kontinente Montelorn. Zamok Maltir prizyvaet samykh mogushchestvennykh monstrov, predstavlyaya ugrozu dlya blizlezhashchikh zemel. Stante chempionom, sozdavaya i nakhodya luchshee snaryazhenie, povyshaya uroven navykov i sobiraya moguchuyu komandu pomoshchnikov, kotorye budut srazhatsya vmeste s vami!
Vy — spasitel Montelorna?.. Dokazhite eto!

title: Implosion [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
"IMPLOSION" is a Sci-Fi Hack and Slash game where the protagonist fights against enemies known as XADA using WM-Ⅲ(WarMech-3) battle suits.

The story：
20 years after the fall of Earth, the remaining survivors of the human race once again face the threat of extinction from an unknown life form known as XADA.

The humans developed a countermeasure technology, creating a series of battle suits through a program dubbed the War-Mech III. Ride the "Avalon", one of the deadliest battle suits made and defend your people!

Gameplay：
Implosion is a hack and slash action game. Clear each stage of the game to move forward. Combine two action controls (slash attack and heavy blow) to destroy your enemies.

- Fully scored orchestral music
- High quality graphics
- Characters voice-acted
- Explosive gameplay

title: Dropsy [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
在一場致命的馬戲團大火摧毀他的世界並玷汙他的名聲之後，小丑卓普西踏上了藉由愛與不求回報善意故事所推動的自我發現旅程。在他的父親病重，但世界卻棄這位曾經很有名氣小丑於不顧的情況下，卓普西得要幫助那些需要幫助的人，去擁抱完全陌生的人，並在邁向救贖的曲折道路上挖掘出黑暗的秘密。哦，卓普西也能與動物說話。
 
《小丑抱抱》是一款採用經典點擊式冒險遊戲模式的非傳統遊戲，由一位永遠無憂無慮的小丑擔任主角，他會在一個充滿各種多彩多姿角色與險惡秘密等豐富細節的世界中探索，並在過程中付出誠摯的擁抱。《小丑抱抱》並沒有引導玩家走上單一的故事路線，而是讓玩家自己決定要在開放世界環境中採用什麼冒險路線進行探索，並依照自己的節奏拼湊謎題。
 
開放世界冒險 - 玩家可以自己決定要在開放世界環境中採用什麼冒險路線進行探索，並依照自己選擇來拼湊謎題與故事片段。
 
無需文字的遊戲體驗 - 藉由採用視覺圖示而不是傳統文字對話樹的革新手法，來與各種奇異與多彩多姿角色交流溝通。
 
謎題與擁抱 - 阻隔在卓普西與他埋藏在陰暗過去秘密之間的，是具有挑戰性的複雜謎題。憑藉著靈活思考、溫柔的擁抱與他動物朋友的幫助，卓普西可以戰勝邪惡並贏得周圍人們的真心。
 
喚醒回憶的原聲帶 - 從開始區域的柔和電子琴和薩克斯風旋律，到吸血鬼狩獵沼澤村莊的空間回音沉浸感強烈節奏雷鬼音軌，再到遊戲結束階段的誇張朦朧準前衛搖滾，Chris Schlarb與他的遊唱詩人樂隊賦予了遊戲中各個區域的獨特氛圍。

title: Musynx + 3 DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description: Experience MUSYNX, the new music game sensation! Featuring classic hardcore rhythm game play mechanics!

title: Faraday Protocol [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]

title: Captain Velvet Meteor The Jump Plus Dimensions [NSZ][ENG]
description:
個性含蓄的少年Damien在移居日本後，在他的腦海中創造出了名為“Captain Velvet Meteor”的超級英雄。
在他的想像世界中，Damien與他最喜歡的少年Jump＋的英雄們展開了冒險！究竟他們能突破困難，取回心靈的平穩嗎！？

本遊戲穿梭「現實」與「想像」兩個部分，在現實中可自由移動並探索，在想像中則可以享受充滿解謎和潛行要素的策略戰鬥遊戲！

在現實世界的探索中，可體驗Damien移居日本後的奮鬥生活，以及他在祖母家展開的小冒險故事！
在想像世界的戰鬥中，則是能和少年Jump＋的英雄們結伴，協力發動各種「強力連鎖」和「支援連鎖」來打倒敵人吧！
根據發動的技能會產生不同效果，例如能造成巨大傷害或廣範圍攻擊等等，有各種不同的玩法！

無論男女老少皆可暢遊的策略冒險遊戲！

title: Arcana of Paradise the Tower [NSZ][ENG]
description:
從20個孩子的編隊中選出合適的組合，與謎塔中的神祕住民們進行即時對戰。

在分秒必爭的即時卡牌戰鬥中，你得迅速擬定戰略，以跨越謎塔內各種嚴峻試煉。卡片的正逆向有時會為你帶來不同效果。請隨時留心卡片的方向，並配合自身擬定的戰略倒轉卡片，攻克所有迎面而來的敵人。

在途中執行完美防禦，使出強力的連環攻擊，注入強大的魔法力量，一邊尋找食物，一邊收集傳說中的遺物，引導孩子們走向塔底的樂園。

title: Phantom Breaker Omnia [NSZ][ENG]
description:
《Phantom Breaker Omnia》是一款快節奏 2D 動漫格鬥遊戲，其中包括 20 名獨特的角色，為了讓願望成真，他們必須與彼此戰鬥。另外，3 種不同的戰鬥風格將讓老手將體驗更多的樂趣，並幫助新手更快地掌握款遊戲。

●20 名角色！
包含《Phantom Breaker: Extra》中的所有原角色，如《Steins;Gate》的紅莉栖，和為《Phantom Breaker: Omnia》特別打造的兩名全新角色。

●選擇 3 種不同的格鬥風格：迅敏、強硬與全面！
3 種不同的風格能夠大幅改變你角色的速度、力量與機制。

●經過重新調整與平衡！
《Phantom Breaker: Omnia》的格鬥系統經過重製與重新平衡，現在，驚人的連擊與特殊攻擊比以往更容易施展。

●雙語言配音！
《Phantom Breaker》系列將首次為角色推出英文配音。遊戲文字也會被翻譯至英文、日文、法文、義大利文、德文、西班牙文、簡體中文與繁體中文。

●現代混音原聲帶！
每個角色的背景音樂也被重新製作與混音！我們還新增了播放原版背景音樂的選項。

●做好戰鬥準備！
在教學和訓練模式中鍛鍊你的技術，然後扮演不同角色來完成劇情模式，體驗每個人不同的願望！

●完整的體驗！
玩家將能夠沈浸在原版《Phantom Breaker》和《Phantom Breaker: Extra》的劇情之中。

●劇情
一個被稱為「魅影」的神秘人出現在日本首都－－東京，他誘使不同的青年與彼此戰鬥，並給予他們一種稱為「F.A.」的強大魔法武器。他向這些人保證，要是他們能夠存活，他將實現他們的一個願望。

但是這些戰士們卻不知道，他們的 F.A. 碰撞時會造成時空扭曲，並破壞平行宇宙的界線。平行宇宙若是崩塌，這將會解放魅影強大的破壞力。

title: Where the Water Tastes Like Wine [NSP][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
Where the Water Tastes Like Wine is a Narrative-Adventure game about traveling, sharing stories, and surviving manifest destiny. Featuring gorgeous hand-drawn illustrations, Where the Water Tastes Like Wine combines 2D visuals with a 3D overworld US map.

Players wander across a folkloric Depression era United States at their own pace, meeting strangers with their own stories to tell. Through these interactions, players will be able to collect unique stories which can then be re-told to unlock new interactions. In this way the in-game stories themselves act as a currency to progress through the game, and it’s up to the player to pair the right story with the unique needs of each of the characters that you will encounter throughout your travels. Only through these right pairings will characters reveal their true selves, and bestow you with the most powerful stories, the true ones which reveal something about their own lives. In Where The Water Tastes Like Wine, stories organically take on a life of their own as they grow larger and transform as they're told- and re-told.

title: Open Tyrian 2000 (移植版 OpenTyrian 2k) [NSP][ENG]
description:
Tyrian — izvestnyy vertikalnyy skroller-shutepam, razrabotannyy kompaniey Eclipse Productions, pozzhe stavshey World Tree Games i vypushchennyy v 1995 godu izdatelem Epic Megagames dlya MS-DOS. Originalnaya versiya sostoyala iz tryokh epizodov, versiya 2.0 soderzhit novyy chetvyortyy epizod, a v 1999 godu igra poluchila vse vyshedshie patchi i novyy, pyatyy epizod.
Syuzhet nachinaetsya v 20031 godu. Glavnyy geroy — pilot Trent Khokinz — zanimaetsya poiskom prigodnykh dlya zhilya mest na planetakh, nedavno podvergshikhsya terraformirovaniyu. Ego poslednee naznachenie — planeta Tirian, raspolozhennaya okolo territoriy Khazudra — yashcheropodobnoy rasy. Odnazhdy Khazudra Byus Kvezillak, luchshiy drug Trenta, byl podstrelen dronom, bystro ischeznuvshim v nebe. Umiraya, Byus govorit Trentu, chto eto rabota korporatsii Maykrosol, upravlyayushchey terraformirovaniem na Tiriane. Oni reshili ubrat Byusa, potomu chto on znal o «gravitiume» — minerale na Tiriane, sposobnom kontrolirovat gravitatsiyu.
Maykrosol khochet ispolzovat gravitium, chtoby mnogokratno usilit boesposobnost svoikh voennykh korabley, sdelav ikh pochti neuyazvimymi. Oni takzhe pytayutsya ustranit vsekh, kto znaet o sushchestvovanii minerala. Trent — sleduyushchaya tsel v ikh spiske. Byus sovetuet Trentu popytatsya dobratsya do Savary, svobodnogo mira. Trent dobyvaet malenkiy korabl i otbyvaet tuda..
Kompozitor igry — Aleksandr Brendon!..

title: Towerfall [NSP][ENG]
description:
TowerFall – samaya polnaya versiya lyubimogo multipleera so strelboy iz luka. Zdes est ves kontent iz Ascension i Dark World, a v pridachu eshche i dopolneniya tolko dlya Switch!

Igra TowerFall sleduet kanonam «zolotogo veka multipleera na divane» i stavit vo glavu ugla veselye i skorostnye sostyazaniya. V nee luchshe vsego igrat v shumnoy kompanii, sidya na polu i pokhlopyvaya drug druga po plechu.

Osnovnaya mekhanika prosta i ponyatna, no ovladet eyu ne tak prosto, ved tut shirochayshiy vybor variantov geympleya, urovney, usileniy i vidov strel. A kogda zakhochetsya otdokhnut ot sopernichestva, mozhno sobrat komandu ot 1 do 4 igrokov i srazhatsya s raznymi chudishchami, zlymi luchnikami i bossami.

V versiyu dlya Switch dobavleno neskolko novykh, unikalnykh osobennostey: srazheniya dlya 6 igrokov na shirokoekrannykh urovnyakh, novye vozmozhnosti geympleya, a takzhe «priglashennye zvezdy»: luchnitsa Medlin i ee zerkalnoe otrazhenie Bedlin iz polyubivshegosya igrokam platformera Celeste!

title: UFO Robot Grendizer The Feast of the Wolves + 2 DLC [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
voice_lang: 日语, 英语, 法语, 意大利语, arabskaya
description:
Ctante pilotom legendarnogo robota Grendayzera i zashchitite vsyu Zemlyu ot sil zla! Prigotovtes k nezabyvaemomu priklyucheniyu so znamenitym boevym robotom Grendayzerom. Eto ekshn-priklyuchenie, osnovannoe na legendarnom anime-seriale, pogruzit vas v mir, sozdannyy Go Nagai, gde vy smozhete stat pilotom samogo moshchnogo robota i dat otpor silam zla.
Posle togo kak planeta Flid byla unichtozhena imperiey Vega, prints Daysuke Umon nashel ubezhishche na Zemle. Doktor Gendzo Umon usynovil printsa, i teper Daysuke zhivet na rancho «Belaya bereza». No vtorzhenie Vegi – lish vopros vremeni, i Daysuke Umon gotov zashchishchat Zemlyu s pomoshchyu Grendayzera – gigantskogo robota, spryatannogo v observatorii Gendzo Umona. Zaruchivshis pomoshchyu Kodzi Kabuto, Daysuke Umon budet otrazhat napadeniya Vegi i srazhatsya s opasnymi robotami-monstrami, kotorym dan prikaz ubit printsa planety Flid.
Igrayte za Daysuke Umona i upravlyayte gigantskim robotom v epicheskikh srazheniyakh s raznoobraznym geympleem. Vy smozhete upravlyat speyserom, letayushchim modulem, v kotorom khranitsya Grendayzer; letayushchey tarelkoy Kodzi Kabuto, igraya v vertikalnom rezhime; a takzhe samim Grendayzerom v srazheniyakh ot 3-go litsa. Provodite legendarnye moshchnye ataki, chtoby unichtozhit uzhasayushchikh monstrov i spasti Zemlyu. Obshchaytes s klyuchevymi personazhami seriala v dialogovykh stsenakh v uznavaemom okruzhenii, vossozdannom v polnom sootvetstvii s originalom. I nakonets, vypolnyayte zadaniya i zarabatyvayte ochki opyta, chtoby poluchat novye umeniya i uluchshat sposobnosti.
Legendarnyy anime-serial «Grendayzer» vpervye pokazali po frantsuzskomu televideniyu bolee 40 let nazad, i s tekh por eta uvlekatelnaya istoriya uspela polyubitsya neskolkim pokoleniyam zriteley. Milliony chelovek po vsemu miru do sikh por pomnyat perevoploshcheniya Grendayzera i ego moshchnye kulaki.

title: Unsouled [NSZ][ENG]
description: Unsouled is a 2D action RPG game requiring immense elaborate control. Take a break from repetitive attack and dodge action by challenging yourself with the world of Unsouled.

title: Dead Effect 2 [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + aktivator ofits. russkogo perevoda 来自 iks1981
description:
This action sci-fi shooter is looking to push the boundaries of first-person shooters to new levels with slick graphics, rich narrative and RPG elements. Train, develop your character, collect and upgrade countless weapons, gear and body implants and take control of the monster-infested ship.

The story will take you back to the ESS Meridian, right to where the original plot ended. However, you are not meant to take a rest; something is brewing deep within the recesses of the spaceship. It is much more dangerous than a horde of the undead – it is threatening to enslave your mind and bend it to its will. Are you going to fight back?

Core Features

• breathtaking graphics
• exciting gameplay
• clever storyline
• three characters to choose from
• a large variety of enemies
• unique boss fights
• hundreds of items to upgrade your gear
• implants to enhance your character’s body
• more than 100 unique types of upgradable weapons

title: Pile Up Box by Box [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
Koordiniruyte svoi deystviya s druzyami ili polagaytes na sobstvennoe tvorchestvo, chtoby peremeshchatsya po kartonnym miram, v kotorykh mnogo unikalnykh veselykh urovney.
