Raskryvayte tayny, reshayte golovolomki i vypolnyayte kvesty v komande, pomogayte druzhelyubnym zhitelyam zagorelykh ostrovov, yantarnykh lesov, volshebnykh peshcher i posetite fantasticheskiy teatr perev. Ili, mozhet byt, prosto otdokhnite i broste vyzov svoim druzyam v zakhvatyvayushchikh raundakh boksbola, basketbola ili Tic Pile Toe?

Igrayte vmeste, derzhites vmeste, vmeste dumayte - i nakaplivayte!

FUNKTsII

VPERED V PRIKLYuChENIE
Issleduyte krasochnye kartonnye miry v etom simpatichnom trekhmernom platformere. Probivayte sebe put cherez beschislennye urovni, raskryvayte tayny i raduyte kartonnykh obitateley etikh mest.

LOKALNYY MULTIPLEER
Igrayte s druzyami, maksimum vmeste 4 igroka! Vypolnyayte vkhod i vykhod v lyuboe vremya blagodarya dinamicheskomu izmeneniyu masshtaba zadachi.

IGRA DLYa VSEKh
V Pile Up mozhet sygrat lyuboy! V etoy dinamichnoy igre prostoe upravlenie, otsutstvie nakazaniya za neudachi i net ogranicheniy vo vremeni. I pomnite, chto tovarishchi po komande vsegda mogut pomoch drug drugu!

KOMANDNAYa RABOTA
Sotrudnichayte dlya progressa! Vse delo v obshchenii i organizatsii. Delites zadachami, sinkhroniziruyte svoi dvizheniya i nesite drug druga, chtoby preodolevat trudnosti.

MINI-IGRY
Srazhaytes s druzyami v bezumnykh mini-igrakh i organizovyvayte veselye khaoticheskie bitvy. Dlya lyubiteley tusovochnykh igr!

TVORChESTVO - KLYuCh.
Myslite nestandartno i reshayte golovolomki po-svoemu. Edinstvennogo resheniya ne sushchestvuet, klyuch k uspekhu - tvorchestvo! Nebo - eto predel! Stroyte lestnitsy i konstruktsii iz sobrannykh vami yashchikov.

OPTIMIZIRUYTE SVOI STRATEGII
Otkroyte rezhim bystrogo bega i proverte svoi navyki skladyvaniya yashchikov. Naydite luchshuyu strategiyu i samyy bystryy sposob proyti cherez miry.
 
Obzor

- Nakaplivayte drug na druge!
- Veseloe priklyuchenie dlya 1–4 igrokov.
- V milykh krasochnykh kartonnykh mirakh i sushchestvakh vy otkroete dlya sebya
- beschislennye golovolomki, sposobstvuyushchie razvitiyu tvorcheskikh sposobnostey.

title: Mad Experiments Escape Room 1-2 [NSZ][ENG,RUS]
interface_lang: 俄语 (1-aya chast), 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description: Vy byli priglasheny professorom Cheshirom i ego pomoshchnitsey Khildegardoy, chtoby provesti novye ekzoticheskie eksperimenty. Oni khotyat videt, kak vy reagiruete na ikh testy!

title: MotoGP 22 [NSP][ENG]
description:
引擎發動：展開最身歷其境且真實的 MotoGP™ 遊戲體驗。 

MotoGP™ 的完整世界
在 MotoGP™ 和其他所有級別中探索 2022 年賽季的所有內容。
超過 120 名車手、20 條以上的官方賽道和官方錦標賽的所有精彩看頭都在等著您。
如果您想回到過去，還有超過 70 名歷屆冠軍能讓您重溫 MotoGP™ 歷史上的頂尖表現。

NINE SEASON 2009
重溫 MotoGP™ 史上最驚心動魄的一場錦標賽！
2009 年賽季的每一場大獎賽都有一個章節，總計 17 個章節即將展開！您可以化身為正值生涯巔峰的 Rossi、Lorenzo、Stoner 和 Pedrosa 等傳奇車手。在每一集中您將面臨不同的挑戰，親身體驗世界錦標賽的經典時刻。

為強化所有遊戲內容，每個章節的開頭都有超過 50 分鐘的真實影像，由非凡的 Mark Neale 親自解說及執導。

冠軍的產地
進入 MotoGP™ ACADEMY 來展現您的冠軍實力：透過新的遊戲挑戰，您將學習所有交易技巧，成為每條賽道上速度最快的車手。

在新的教學中透過簡短的遊戲賽事突飛猛進，成為您致力成為的車手。
享受最真實的遊戲體驗並自訂賽事。

深入迄今最真實且身歷其境的 MotoGP™ 體驗！
從改變英雄面貌到重新設計官方維修站造型，每個細節都獲得了前所未有的關注！
在 MotoGP™ 電玩遊戲中打造您的世界，騎出更鮮明的個人風格。您可以運用 5 種圖像編輯器來自訂遊戲的各種外觀，從塗裝到騎手賽車裝任您改造。
透過經理生涯規劃通往成功的道路！
建立自己的車隊或加入官方車隊。選擇您的工作人員並為您的摩托車開發改良引擎、車架、空氣動力和電子系統：全面掌控您的遊戲體驗！

在 Moto2™ 與 Moto3™ 中建立新人車隊：僱用車隊經理、技術總監和車手來達成新目標。

title: Dust: An Elysian Tail [NSP][ENG]
description:
Immerse yourself in a gorgeous hand-painted world on a search for your true identity. 

As the mysterious warrior, Dust, your action-packed journey will take you from peaceful glades to snowy mountaintops and beyond. At your disposal is the mythical Blade of Ahrah, capable of turning its wielder into an unstoppable force of nature, and the blade's diminutive guardian, Fidget. 

Battle dozens of enemies at once with an easy-to-learn, difficult-to-master combat system, take on a variety of quests from friendly villagers, discover ancient secrets and powerful upgrades hidden throughout the massive, open world, and uncover the story of an ancient civilization on the brink of extinction as you fight to uncover your own past.

- A traditionally-animated action-adventure tale, now playable on the go or at home!
- An expansive world filled with unique characters, quests, and secrets
- Action-packed nonlinear platforming rewards exploration and experimentation
- Fully voiced cast and a deep, rewarding storyline
- Award-winning musical score by HyperDuck SoundWorks

title: Rogue Lords [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Mrachnaya fenteziynaya roguelike-igra, gde vy — sam Dyavol!

MRAChNAYa LEGENDA
Poterpev porazhenie mnogo lun tomu nazad, teper vy nakonets-to gotovy vernutsya s armiey samykh vernykh svoikh posledovateley i otomstit etim zhalkim okhotnikam na demonov. Vnov i vnov otpravlyaytes v pokhod i sobirayte drevnie artefakty, chtoby vosstanovit byluyu moshch i vernut to, chto prinadlezhit vam po pravu.

DYaVOL V DETALYaKh
Soberite komandu izvestnykh zlodeev, takikh kak Drakula, Vsadnik bez golovy ili Krovavaya Meri. Prokachayte kazhdomu unikalnyy nabor navykov i sozdayte sinergii, chtoby povergnut v uzhas lyubogo smertnogo, chto osmelitsya vystupit protiv vas. Otkryvayte novye sposobnosti, sobirayte dushi, prinimayte vernye resheniya v sobytiyakh i ispolzuyte vsyu svoyu moshch, chtoby unichtozhit sily dobra.

title: Dracula's Legacy [NSZ][ENG]
description:
伊莎貝拉被她遺忘的過去的可怕夢境所困擾 - 和她的未婚夫 - 前往一個古老的鬼城，這是唯一的 她能夠從 她失去的記憶的深處。

危險旅程開始時，可怕的生物襲擊了 兩人和伊莎貝拉勉強逃脫
逃進埋藏在城鎮深處的地牢…在那裡 致命的吸血鬼潛伏著。

現在輪到你了：幫助伊莎貝拉嘗試 找到出路，到達神秘的失魂之城，並 救出她的未婚夫！

解決令人費解的謎題並探索色彩繽紛的地點 《德古拉的遺產》。

- 隱藏物件冒險遊戲
- 尋找巧妙的線索並解開謎團
- 解開奇妙的謎題

title: Animal Trail Girlish Square (Kemonomichi けもの道☆ガーリッシュスクエア) [NSZ][ENG (Mod.)/JAP]
description:
Milyy vizualnyy roman ob ocherednom lenivom bezdelnike, kotoromu kakim-to obrazom udaetsya zainteresovat chetyryokh prekrasnykh devushek. Net, podozhdite, ne tak. Rech poydyot o parne, u kotorogo na bankovskom schete menshe 2000 dollarov, nakonets-to zapoluchivshem devushku, posle togo kak izvrashchalsya nad ney 15 let! Net, prostite, tozhe ne to.
A, vot kak vsyo bylo: «Animal Trail * Girlish Square» — VN ob otaku, kotoryy sluchayno natknulsya na glavnyy sekret svoey lyubimoy aydol-gruppy. Chto zhe budet dalshe?.. Konechno, on, to est vy stanovites ikh super-prodyuserom!
Tak nachinayutsya intrigi, i zhizn Taygi uzhe nikogda ne budet prezhney. Kstati, tut eshchyo est karri. Mnogo karri!Eshchyo vizualnykh novell na Switch (renpy).

title: Marooners [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
Igrayte v sumasshedshuyu kombinatsiyu uvlekatelnykh igr dlya vecherinok, postoyanno pereklyuchayas mezhdu nimi. Vy mozhete spravitsya s etim vechno menyayushchimsya khaosom? Igrayte s druzyami na divane ili po seti, zlodeyski khokhocha nad ikh neudachami, i vozvrashchaytes iz mertvykh, chtoby dokuchat im. Begayte, prygayte i proryvaytes k pobede!Bezumnaya igra dlya vecherinok! Oshchutite khaos, v kotorom polnye ekshena igry menyayutsya bez ostanovki i v samyy nepodkhodyashchiy moment, ili osilte proyti kazhduyu iz igr do kontsa. Poprobuyte proyti razlichnye tipy igr, stalkivayas s vnezapnymi bonusnymi urovnyami. 

Vyberite svoego flibustera iz kuchi nezauryadnykh otkryvaemykh personazhey i igrayte im, otkroyte bolee 70 otpadnykh vidov oruzhiya, a esli umrete… vy vernetes v etot mir v vide prizraka, chtoby dokuchat druzyam! 

Igrayte v rezhime dlya vecherinok i rezhime «Arena»: dostignite sokrovishcha pervym v rezhime dlya vecherinok ili broste vyzov svoim druzyam, chtoby opredelit korolya ringa v 25 razlichnykh igrakh i kartakh Areny. Kakoy by rezhim vy ni vybrali, ozhidayte neozhidannostey! 

Igrayte v seti i lokalno bez zaderzhek: do 6 igrokov pri lyubom sochetanii setevykh i lokalnykh polzovateley. Nabirayte uroven, otkryvayte novoe oruzhie, igrayte s polnotsennymi botami v odinochku i gruppoy, nablyudayte za partiyami, ispolzuyte ottochennyy algoritm podbora sopernikov i sistemu lobbi.

«Soderzhanie Marooners Delyuks» vklyucheno!

title: Kill the Crows [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
Kill The Crows是一款快節奏的俯視競技場射擊遊戲。以扭曲的西部時代為背景，敘述一名滿腔復仇怒火的槍手，抱著不惜一死的覺悟來到廢墟小鎮的故事。運用經典左輪手槍及速射技術，為每擊必殺的槍戰做好準備。失誤將導致必死無疑的下場。

快速而猛烈的西部時代槍戰

• 玩家使用左輪手槍及特殊能力「終極技」展開槍戰。
• 玩家、敵人，甚至是BOSS，皆會被一發子彈擊倒。必須利用既有的武器及環境，盡可能擊倒更多的敵人。
• 透過射擊來準備終極技，並透過終極技重新裝彈。維持戰鬥的流暢性是致勝關鍵。

設計各顯魅力的狂信徒團體
• 共12種包含BOSS在內的狂信徒敵人，皆具有個性十足的設計。
• 躲避射擊手的精準射擊，並透過翻滾來搶攻防禦者的後方。所有敵人皆有各自不同的攻擊模式和應對策略。
• 每個角色皆有其獨特的美麗像素藝術動畫。小心別被炸彈客的華麗動作所迷惑而陷入爆炸之中！

經驗擴展任務及裝備要素
• 完成任務來解鎖新裝備。
• 結合各種類型的左輪手槍、終極技、被動技能，來完成屬於自己的組合。
• 隨著時間的進展，將會出現更難對付的敵人及BOSS。必須配置新武器以長期應戰。

槍手伊莎貝爾與廢墟小鎮的故事
• 為什麼這個曾經美麗的小鎮會變成廢墟？這些烏鴉樣貌的傢伙究竟是誰？槍手又為何要冒著生命危險展開這場屠殺呢？
• 進行遊戲的過程中，將能逐步了解伊莎貝爾的故事。

title: Fallen Legion Rise to Glory / Fallen Legion Revenants + DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description: Vernites na pole bitvy v Fenumia, gde osazhdennaya natsiya stoit na grani voyny. Sm. Konflikt cherez linzy printsessy Tsetsil i Legatus Lendur, tot, kto vosstanovit svoe korolevstvo do svoey prezhney slavy, i tot, kto uvidit novuyu natsiyu, vstanet na ee mesto. Sochetanie kak Fallen Legion: Flames of Rebellion, tak i Fallen Legion: Sins of an Empire vpervye na odnoy konsoli Fallen Legion: Rise to Glory vklyuchaet vse novoe iskusstvo, Exemplars, monstry, bossy i problemy, ne naydennye v originalnykh relizakh. Smotrite istoriyu so vsekh storon, kuda by vy ni otpravilis v Fallen Legion: Rise to Glory.

title: Smile BASIC 4 [NSZ][ENG]
description:
(This is the version of "SmileBASIC 4" without Server Tickets. In order to upload your works to the server or unlimited downloading of the published works, you need to purchase Server Tickets in the game.)

This is the programming software, "SmileBASIC 4", that allows you to create and play games with Nintendo Switch™! The programming language is "SmileBASIC" which is the most suitable language for creating games. Because it is based on the language "BASIC" that is easy to understand even for beginners and it has been developed for program learning. So, even those who have never experienced programming can work on their projects. Moreover, there are many materials and various tools to support your work development.

You can upload your finished works on the server and other SmileBASIC users could play them or you can download/play other users' works, and even those works can be used in your programs. By improving other people's programs, you can have fun and obtain programming techniques at the same time. (An optional Server Ticket is required to upload your works.)

Program immediately anytime, anywhere with Nintendo Switch™! Execute it right away!

Many commands to elaborate your works
- High speed and powerful programming language "SmileBASIC 4" is installed
- Supports high-resolution display of up to 1280x720 and 16.77 million colors
- 2048x2048 huge graphic screen
- Drawing commands such as lines, circles and fills
- Compose with a full range of sound commands
- Make full use of Joy-Con™ features
- Supports various Toy-Con™
- USB keyboard and mouse can be used
- Useful trace function for debugging Extensive materials, tools, and samples that support programming
- Guide for program beginners
- Equipped with keyword completion function in the command help and the editor
- Lots of characters and background images that can be used in various scenes
- More than 100 sound effects and more than 40 background music
- Smile Tool (SE and character number can be confirmed)
- Paint Tool (drawing characters and backgrounds, creating animations)
- Simple sample programs to learn BASIC
- Technical samples for checking execution results for each command
- Game samples that show the actual game structure Share your works with users around the world
- Publish your works to the server with icons and descriptions
- Easily download works published by other users
- Evaluation function that allows you to send "Like" to your favorite works
- Favorite works can be registered in the top menu and started immediately
- Download "SmileBASIC" Nintendo 3DS™ version of public programs
(Note: It is possible to load programs and data created with "SmileBASIC", but the commands are not compatible, so they need to be modified to run.)

title: Luck be a Landlord [NSZ][RUS/Multi19]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 19]
description:
你的房東正在敲門。你手頭上只剩一枚硬幣。你把它投入老虎機…結果…中了頭獎！今晚，租戶有財運！

收集符號，建立協同效應，並在這款 roguelike 牌組構築遊戲中擊敗資本主義—應玩家熱切期待，現在已推出主機版。

《租戶賭財運》結合了老虎機的不可預測刺激與經典牌組構築遊戲的策略深度和重玩價值。選擇符號加入你的機器，並觀察它們如何互動，每次旋轉都為你賺取硬幣—貓咪、寶石、水果...... 你會怎麼做牌組呢？

租金每回合都會漲，但不用擔心—資本主義無法敵過你的智慧。從多樣的物品中選出最佳的牌組來讓你的財富增長。面對房東的貪婪，你能撐多久？

注意：遊戲不包含微交易或真錢賭博。

特色

- 獨特的角色陣容
將符號加到老虎機中並觀察它們如何互相互動，產生強大的連擊—你會押注於常見符號，還是等待更稀有的符號？

- 豐富的物品！
用物品來加強牌組策略、增加硬幣或產生新的互動。

- 每次遊玩皆不同
超過 150 種符號和 220 種物品，每局都是獨一無二！採用現有的資源發掘新的策略。

- 20 層樓等你挑戰
擊敗了你的房東？這公寓的房東可多了。挑戰每層樓的房東，面對逐步提升的難度。

- 短時間遊玩
每局平均遊玩時間不到半小時，適合通勤時或時間緊迫時遊玩。

title: Road To Guangdong [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
4/5 – HeyPoorPlayer
8/10 - Bonus Stage

Sanni nakhoditsya na perepute. Ona znaet, chto skoro vse izmenitsya. No ona poka ne znaet kak. Ona snova brosaet vzglyad na dogovor. Khoroshaya novost v tom, chto ona teper gordaya vladelitsa semeynogo restorana. A kakaya plokhaya? On vidal i luchshie dni. 
Stuk v dver vozveshchaet o pribytii ee teti, guu-ma. 
Da, skoro vse izmenitsya. No opredelyat eti izmeneniya budut neznakomye lyudi, kotorykh ona videla tolko na vytsvetshikh fotografiyakh.

Otpravlyaysya v puteshestvie, polnoe otkrytiy

Tsel Sanni i ee guu-ma — spasti semeynyy restoran, kotoryy perezhivaet ne luchshie vremena. V poiskakh sekretov uspekha, kotorye pomogut vernut tolpy posetiteley, im nuzhno navestit zabytykh rodstvennikov. No eto budet neprosto. Dolgaya doroga vmeste s pozhiloy tetey stanet dlya geroini nastoyashchim ispytaniem, gde vse kulturnye razlichiya vyplyvut na poverkhnost. Tolko prinimaya slozhnye resheniya na svoem puti, Sanni smozhet uznat, chto zhe prigotovila dlya nee sudba.

Ne sezzhay s dorogi

Skolko Sanni sebya pomnit, Sendi vsegda byla vazhnoy chastyu ikh semi. Vmeste oni preodoleli mnogo trudnostey i proekhali bolshie rasstoyaniya. No teper mashina razvalivaetsya na chasti, i Sanni ponadobitsya pomoshch v reshenii etoy problemy. Tolko blagodarya ostorozhnoy ezde i regulyarnym proverkam Sendi smozhet dostavit Sanni k ee tseli.

Osnovnye osobennosti
•	Napisannoe avtorom Yen Ooy, eto uvlekatelnoe priklyuchenie proiskhodit v nostalgicheskoy atmosfere Kitaya 1990-kh godov.
•	Sygray svoyu rol v trogatelnoy interaktivnoy istorii, gde tvoi resheniya budut opredelyat sudbu Sanni.
•	Vyrazitelnaya animatsiya i yarkiy saundtrek pomogut tebe proniknutsya dukhom Guanduna.
•	Ty obyazatelno polyubish kharizmatichnykh personazhey, u kazhdogo iz kotorykh unikalnyy kharakter i interesnaya istoriya.
•	Mashine nuzhen ukhod — sledi za raskhodom topliva, iznosom shin i sostoyaniem dvigatelya.

title: Hakoniwa Explorer Plus [NSP][ENG]
description:
Shacked up in an empty house in the Firsttown suburbs, our hero has a thing for taking down monsters. Talk to the townspeople to expand your field of exploration and freely traverse the land as you like.
However you want to proceed, and however you want to take the monsters down is all up to you. Defeat the bosses awaiting you in each region and rack up the achievements for a little something special... The roster of lethal monsters include such superstars as the pervy "Rockit", who'll melt the threads of your clothes in all the right places.
and "Dryad", who attacks by wrapping you up in her legs. Together with "Sukumizu", your random guidance-dispensing partner in adventure, make your way through a variety of dungeons in this wiggly, weird dot-style 1/4-view world.

Features:
・The main character is basically an unemployed hobo. You can select their gender.
・All kinds of weapons are at your disposal: swords, axes, claws, staves, and bows & arrows. They also break down for like, no reason.
Somehow make do with the crappy weapons and tools of your choice and use them to take down your enemies.
・Take your pick from a wide variety of "swimwear", including swimwear actually used for swimming, swimwear that's just for show, etc.
・Most of the monsters are soft, cute, sadistic girls.

title: Moon Hunters [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
When the moon does not rise over Issaria, monsters to infest the land and cause chaos. You must set out alone or with the other chosen children of the Moon to solve the mystery and restore balance. You have only 5 days before King Mardokh and the Sun Cultists declare war. Multiple playthroughs uncover characters, conflicts, and decisions. Each of the five tribes responds differently to the crisis and looks for different qualities in their heroes. 

Every action and choice you make contributes to your legend as a constellation in the night sky. Future generations will build upon the mythology you create. How will you be remembered?

title: The Witch's House MV [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
一位名為薇奧拉的少女被強硬拉入一棟會在她不注意時不斷變化的神秘莊園。那是一個充滿苦痛、混亂與死亡的魔境。探索它可憎的深幽秘境，與令人作嘔的過去。解開重重謎題，闢出一條險路。只有這樣能逃出魔女之家那地獄般的廳堂。

2012年發售的魔女之家在依循日本恐怖RPG傳統的同時，又將重點放在解謎與突發驚嚇上。 

魔女之家故意在「幾乎」每個轉角都設下陷阱，無可預期的死亡讓玩家們提心吊膽。下一秒可能會發生任何事。

魔女之家 MV 的視覺效果經完全重製，讓最熟悉的老派粉絲也耳目一新。全新難度的模式也等著粉絲們，包含突破基本遊戲後才會出現的新事件。

- 完全重製的圖片帶來美麗又嚇人的體驗。
- 可解鎖全新難度模式，內含新事件與對話。
- 較不適應暴力與血腥場景的玩家可能感到不適。請自行斟酌遊玩。
- 只要經過轉角，或踏錯一步，死亡可能就會找上你。
- 玩家在解謎時，須自行使用道具。
- 加入固定存檔點 (只須注意會說話的黑貓)。
- 「強烈」建議使用耳罩式耳機。

title: Hell Pie [NSP][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Hell Pie — nepristoynaya 3D-igra, kotoraya vyvedet vash plokhoy vkus na novyy uroven! Vozmite za roga demona plokhogo vkusa Neyta! Pered nim stoit vpolne sebe blagorodnaya zadacha: sobrat omerzitelnye ingredienty dlya otvratitelnogo prazdnichnogo piroga Satany. Dlya etogo emu pridyotsya otpravitsya v nazemnyy mir i prilozhit vse sily dlya togo, chtoby obespechit tselost, sokhrannost i bystruyu dostavku ingredientov. A inache ego zhdut adskie posledstviya!

No Neyt otpravitsya na zadanie ne odin: ego «pitomets», angel Sardeliy, vsegda gotov priyti na pomoshch. U Sardeliya est dar svyatoy intuitsii, no chto bolee vazhno — on prikovan k Neytu tsepyu, blagodarya chemu ego mozhno ispolzovat v kachestve abordazhnogo kryuka ili oruzhiya. Takzhe Neyt mozhet nadevat razbrosannye po vsemu miru roga, dayushchie emu novye adskie sposobnosti.

Vmeste Neyt i Sardeliy otpravyatsya issledovat etot bezumnyy mir. Oni vstretyat na svoem puti tolpy merzeyshikh personazhey i uvidyat nemalo toshnotvornykh veshchey. Hell Pie — eto ochen zhyostkaya i chudakovataya interpretatsiya klassicheskogo platformera. Sygrayte, esli uvereny, chto vam eto po zubam!

OSOBENNOSTI IGRY:

•	Stante demonom: vy — Neyt, demon vosmogo smertnogo grekha... plokhogo vkusa. V adu ego nikto ne vosprinimaet vseryoz, a vot na zemle on mnogim vnushaet uzhas (nu... pare chelovek kak minimum...).
•	Pomoshch svyshe: angel Sardeliy ne tolko milo vyglyadit, no i eshchyo i polezen v bytu. Ispolzuyte ego v kachestve abordazhnogo kryuka, oruzhiya i besplatnogo gida.
•	Svoboda: v vashem rasporyazhenii — shirokiy vybor sposobov obkhoda prepyatstviy, postoyanno voznikayushchikh u vas na puti.
•	Zashkvar: simpatichnaya grafika, za kotoroy skryvayutsya zhestokie geroi, nelegalnye veshchestva i skvernoslovie.
•	Predmety: sobirayte barakhlo! Mnogo barakhla!
•	Ad i to, chto vyshe: issleduyte chetyre neobyatnykh mira i poprobuyte proyti ikh neprostye urovni.
•	Moda: pokupayte odezhdu. Vy — demon plokhogo vkusa i dolzhny vyglyadet podobayushche.
•	Sluchaynyy fakt: rogataya yashcheritsa strelyaet krovyu iz glaz.

title: Hidden Through Time / Hidden Through Time 2 Myths and Magic [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
在《Hidden Through Time 2：神話與魔法》與 Clicky 一起踏上全新、充滿魔法的冒險之旅！這款迷人 2D 尋物遊戲保證能用其俏皮有趣、舒適氛圍和永無止盡的歡樂給玩家帶來愉快的體驗。尋找散落在手繪世界各地的隱藏物品，隨著你的旅程解鎖更多世界。本遊戲不僅有單人玩家模式，也有創造自己夢想世界的線上模式，讓冒險旅程永不告終！

故事模式
踏上穿梭於四個魔法時代的旅程，同時發現所有隱藏其中的物品。尋找物品來晉級到下一個階段，並探索每個時代的劇情——誰知道你接下來會揭開什麼秘密呢！

現實切換：
用全新的現實切換功能，掌握時光力量，將自己的尋物體驗提升到另一個維度。將白日切換到黑夜，夏季到冬季……同時探索各州地圖。但要注意，有些物品只出現在特定地方！

建築師 2.0：
感到靈感爆發嗎？改版後的建築師模式讓你能夠比往常更容易地打造和分享你自己獨特的體驗。展現你的製圖技巧，看自己的傑作如何與他人並駕齊驅。

改版後的自定義選項：
除了視覺效果的改進，《Hidden Through Time 2：神話與魔法》也為建築師 2.0 提供了更多的自定義選項。一鍵就能創造出自定義建築和數十個角色，或者用全新的地形繪圖器按你想要的方式塑造地形。何不讓創造力發揮到極致，打造你的夢想地圖呢？

那麼你還在猶豫什麼？與我們一起踏上這段神奇的時光之旅。你與 Clicky 的冒險就在一「擊」之遙！

title: Catie in Meowmeowland [NSP][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
Catie in MeowmeowLand — eto klassicheskaya yumoristicheskaya priklyuchencheskaya igra v zhanre "ukazhi i shchelkni". Syuzhet razvorachivaetsya v chudesnom i strannom mire, polnom koshek i smeshnykh personazhey.

Keyti gulyala v svoem sadu, kogda poyavilsya strannyy belyy kotik. Devochka poshla za nim i ochutilas v strannom mire pod nazvaniem "Myaulyandiya". Teper ey nuzhno nayti dorogu domoy. Pomogite Keyti spravitsya s etoy zadachey!

* Myaulyandiya — eto strannyy mir, gde vy vstretites s neozhidannymi personazhami v samykh nepredskazuemykh situatsiyakh.
* Pomogayte Keyti reshat originalnye golovolomki i gotovtes k vnezapnym i absurdno smeshnym situatsiyam.
* Minuyte bolshe 24 chudesnykh, narisovannykh ot ruki 2D-peyzazhey, vstrette bolshe sotni zabavnykh personazhey i polyubuytes ocharovatelnoy 2D-animatsiey, kotoraya idet v obshchey slozhnosti bolshe dvukh chasov.
* Poslushayte originalnye smeshnye golosa vsekh personazhey i unikalnuyu muzyku.
* Nikakikh skuchnykh tablichek s tekstom: vse personazhi obshchayutsya v vynoskakh, vypolnennykh v stile lineynogo risunka.

Pri podderzhke finansirovaniya slovatskogo khudozhestvennogo soveta

title: Wolfstride [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Wolfstride – eto rolevaya igra o troikh druzyakh s ne ochen chestnym proshlym, kotorye reshili raz i navsegda izmenit svoyu zhizn. Poluchiv v nasledstvo razdolbannogo boevogo robota «Kovboy», oni obedinyayutsya, chtoby prinyat uchastie v samom populyarnom chempionate po boyam robotov pod nazvaniem «Absolyutnyy Zolotoy Bog».

Kazhdyy chlen komandy unikalen i gotov na vse, chtoby odolet silneyshikh sopernikov so vsego mira. Pes-mekhanik Duki, superpilot Nayf Leopard i master na vse ruki Dominik Sheyd – idealnaya komanda... kazalos by, chto moglo poyti ne tak?

No postepenno, vmesto togo chtoby prosto sorvat kush i razbezhatsya, parni ponimayut, chto sovmestnaya rabota okazalas bolee uvlekatelnoy, da eshche i temnoe proshloe kazhdogo iz nikh postoyanno podkidyvaet vse novye syurprizy.

ANGAR

Angar – eto tsarstvo Duki. I remont robota mezhdu boyami – eto tolko vershina aysberga. Menyay detali, ustanavlivay uluchsheniya, dobavlyay oruzhie i vsyacheski optimiziruy «Kovboya» pod kazhdyy konkretnyy poedinok.

RAIN CITY

Vmeste s byvshim yakudza Dominikom Sheydom issleduy kazhdyy ugolok Reyn-siti. Zaglyani v poldyuzhiny zavedeniy i poznakomsya s ikh neveroyatnymi vladeltsami, u kazhdogo iz kotorykh naydetsya dlya tebya rabotenka ili khotya by dobroe (ili ne ochen) slovo.

ARENA

Otpravlyaysya na arenu i primi uchastie v boyakh gigantskikh robotov. Poshagovaya skhema boya blagovolit tem, kto produmyvaet strategiyu zaranee. Planiruy svoi khody, chtoby zanyat optimalnuyu pozitsiyu i vyvesti protivnika iz ravnovesiya. Nanosi pritselnye udary, chtoby izmotat protivnika, i ukhodi v glukhuyu zashchitu, esli situatsiya nachinaet nakalyatsya.

title: 4 Commodore 64 games: Gilligan's Gold / Horace Goes Skiing / Mutant Monty / Nomad (Hidden Gems Volume One) [NSZ][ENG]
developer: Artic Computing, Valadon Automation, Psion, Beam Software, Ocean
description:
這套令人興奮的遊戲合集中，重新收錄了 4 款 20 世紀 80 年代被人遺忘的經典遊戲，這些遊戲最初為康懋達 64 發布。

特點：
• 顯示篩選選項
• 暫停點數 - 每個遊戲最多可保存和恢復 4 個暫停點數
• 倒帶 - 即時倒帶多達 10 秒的即時遊戲

Gilligan's Gold
黃金 - 它讓你興奮不已！ ......Gilligan's Gold 讓您的體溫飆升。收集金袋，躲避土匪。掛在卡車上，跑下梯子，跳進升降機，但要小心礦坑......啊！

Horace Goes Skiing
協助Horace在掛著旗子的山地賽道迴轉，避開樹木 - 但首先他必須穿過繁忙的道路到達滑雪場。

Mutant Monty
協助Mutant實現他的兩項終身抱負。引導他通過 40 個充滿恐怖的房間，讓他成為當今英雄。

N.O.M.A.D.
為了打擊不可言狀的Cyrus T. Gross的邪惡犯罪網路，自由世界的統治者們請來了復仇女神組織，這是一支由人形機器人和機器人海盜組成的堅強骨干隊伍，他們指派N.O.M.A.D. 471（復仇女神組織移動攻擊機器人）攻入格羅斯全副武裝的人造小行星TALOS，徹底地消滅這個卑鄙的「專制者」。

title: The Bridge [NSP][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
The Bridge - eto dvukhmernaya logicheskaya igra, v khode kotoroy vam pridyotsya peresmotret svoy vzglyad na fiziku i perspektivu. Slozhite Isaaka Nyutona s M.K. Esherom - i poluchite The Bridge. Upravlyayte prityazheniem, khodite po potolku kak po polu, i vsyo eto v dekoratsiyakh nevozmozhnykh sooruzheniy. Issleduyte vsyo bolee slozhnye miry, kazhdyy iz kotorykh po-svoemu unikalen i sdelan tak, chtoby prokhozhdenie ego vosprinimalos kak intellektualnoe dostizhenie. The Bridge razmyvaet gran mezhdu igrami i iskusstvom, narisovannyy v stile cherno-belykh litografiy.

Osobennosti:
• 48 unikalnykh golovolomok, k kazhdoy iz kotorykh nuzhen svoy podkhod. Pridyotsya poraskinut mozgami!
• Upravlenie prityazheniem, gravitatsionnye voronki, parallelnye izmereniya i prochie oshelomitelnye kontseptsii v mire, gde fizicheskie zakony sovsem ne takie, kakimi kazhutsya.
• Miry, vdokhnovlyonnye M.K. Esherom, otlichayutsya nevozmozhnoy arkhitekturoy i vypolneny v stile narisovannykh vruchnuyu chyorno-belykh litografiy.
• Dopolnitelnyy rezhim igry, kotoryy otkryvaetsya posle prokhozhdeniya glavnoy syuzhetnoy linii, vklyuchayushchiy izmenennye versii kazhdogo iz 24-kh urovney, a takzhe dopolnitelnaya kontsovka.
• Sistema vozvrashcheniya vo vremeni - neudach mozhno ne boyatsya!

title: Seed of Life [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
publisher: Leonardo Interactive, Funbox Media, GS2 Games
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Epicheskaya igra o postoyanstve zhizni, gde Vy — Kora, poslednyaya izvestnaya vyzhivshaya na umirayushchey planete Lyumiya. Vasha edinstvennaya nadezhda spasti svoy rodnoy mir – aktivirovat Semya zhizni i snova zazhech solntse. Est tolko odin sposob vyzhit: pomoch Kore nayti Semya, inoplanetnoe ustroystvo, sposobnoe generirovat sushchnost zhizni, i spasti svoyu planetu ot unichtozheniya.
Poka solntse medlenno umiraet, mir pogruzhaetsya v khaos. Zakhvatchiki poyavilis iz niotkuda i zastali nas vrasplokh… My nichego ne mogli sdelat! Oni zabrali nashe samoe tsennoe sokrovishche – zhiznennuyu silu planety – i obrekli nas na vernuyu smert. Inoplanetnykh sushchestv ostavili na zemle, chtoby poglotit to, chto ostalos v zhivykh. Chtoby spasti rodnoy dom, vam nuzhno otyskat istochnik zhizni i aktivirovat inoplanetnoe ustroystvo. Da ukazhet svet vam put!

title: Timothy and the Mysterious Forest [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Timothy, a common child, wants to save his grandfather from certain death. The old man fell ill and he's now fighting for his life. Timothy, who loves his grandfather very much, decides to take a risky journey to the infamous Mysterious Forest. Legends speak of a magic mushroom able to cure any disease that grows into the forest. Timothy bravely begins his journey to find the magic mushroom.


The game mixes elements from adventure/exploration games with puzzle and stealth: exploration, reading and keeping a slow pace is the best tactic. The high difficulty level is the base: Timothy is basically defenceless and dies with a single touch from enemies or traps.

The world is full of ruins, graveyards and tombstones, caves, swamps and weird characters: every place is made to look wild, abandoned and dangerous. Except for Timothy's grandfather, most characters are often mean or clearly driven by not-so-nice feelings.

title: Kauil's Treasure [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Sokrovishche Kauil yavlyaetsya novym odnopolzovatelskoy priklyuchencheskoy igry-golovolomki, gde vy, ottsu devochki-podrostka po imeni Sofi, nuzhno nayti svoyu doch pered uzhasami za Sokrovishchem Kauil nakhodit ee pervymi. Takim obrazom, vam pridetsya reshat samye slozhnye golovolomki, izbezhat gnilykh dush iskazhennykh Kauil, i ispolzovat svoy knut, chtoby dobratsya do samykh opasnykh mest i spasti vashu doch.

Est li u vas chto trebuetsya, chtoby nayti samoe glavnoe sokrovishche svoey zhizni?

Navyki doktora Goodfall vklyuchayut v sebya peremeshchenie i prygat, ispolzuya svoy knut, chtoby dobratsya do drugikh mest i aktivatsiya nekotorykh mekhanizmov. Krome togo, on mozhet zabrat, ronyat, brosat i szhigat nekotorye obekty.

Vo vremya igry, vasha glavnaya tsel budet nayti put k sleduyushchemu urovnyu. Dlya etogo vam pridetsya reshat golovolomki i ispolzovat knut.

Vasha konechnaya tsel sostoit v poiske vashey docheri, prezhde chem eto slishkom pozdno.

title: Sea Salt [NSZ][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
Command an unruly troop of nightmarish creatures, cultists and horrors from the deep
Control the whole swarm at once, directing it to attack your victims or withdraw to avoid their defenses
Use the terrain to surprise and surround the weak minded to make them lose their minds to fear 
Discover cards in a hellish tarot to unlock 16 different units with their own strengths and weaknesses
Hunters, and special bosses alike, will be swept away on your path to vengeance

title: Lovekami: Divinity Stage / Useless Goddess / Healing Harem [NSZ][ENG]
description:
故事總體上相同，卻有著明顯的差異……。
一心一意的日本神明，不一樣的戀愛物語。
此時，神明和人類的地位基本相同。

神明降臨於現代不知不覺已過6年。
一個可在鄉村深山裡隨處可見的小村莊守森市，
卻被部分人類稱為

――災難之神所守護的土地。

原本是為人類帶來不幸的災難之神所守護的土地——守森市。

真瀨彰作為守森市神社的後嗣，
每一天都聆聽著神明們的煩惱。

某一天，災難之神尤嘉莉對給她施予幫助的彰一見鐘情，甚至還對他求婚。

“請讓我成為你的妻子！”

可是喜歡彰的不只尤嘉莉這個神明，但她對外宣稱自己才是他的新娘。
彰在被希望成為其妻子的神明們折騰的同時一邊幫她們解決煩惱。

title: Universal Paperclips NX (自制程序) [NSP][ENG]
description:
«There was an AI made of dust, whose poetry gained it man's trust..»
«Universal Paperclips» — kontseptualnyy tekstovyy arkadnyy idle-simulyator, sozdannyy v 2017 godu Frenkom Lantsem, osnovatelem igrovogo napravleniya v chastnom issledovatelskom universitete Nyu-Yorka (NYU).

title: World End Syndrome / Worldend Syndrome [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Posle nekoego tragicheskogo sluchaya starsheklassnik s nespokoynoy dushoy pereezzhaet k dyade v pribrezhnyy gorodok Mikhate. Zdes on postupaet v mestnuyu shkolu i znakomitsya s mestnymi devushkami. A potom nachinayut poyavlyatsya trupy, zombi i prochie nepriyatnosti.
Kak i drugie predstaviteli zhanra, World End Syndrome otlichaetsya vetvistoy sistemoy vybora replik i deystviy. Ot nikh zavisit khod istorii, a takzhe kontsovka, koikh tut neskolko. Izvestno, chto po mere razvitiya syuzheta u glavnogo geroya mozhet izmenitsya vospriyatie mira.
Eshchyo vizualnykh novell na Switch (renpy).

title: シオリノコトハ - Dark Reflections - (Shiorinokotoha - Dark Reflections -) [NSZ][ENG]
developer: CyberStep, Rideon Works Co. Ltd., Inkarose, Peone, Noirsoft, PandaShojo i dr.
description:
シオリノコトハ - Dark Reflections - (Shiorinokotoha - Dark Reflections -)是以無法逃脫的私人圖書館為舞台的生存懸疑類型視覺小說。
本作品是將2013年由「swaneye」所發行的『シオリノコトハ　～密室圖書館的祭品～』，對應『CS小說部』平台，並為了全世界的各年齡層重新製作的REMAKE版本。
將由豪華的VTuber陣容來擔任故事中女主角們的CV！


◆前言
「結束了……。不管是什麼，都結束了……」
無法逃脫的私人圖書館中，發生了詭異的連續殺人事件。
當糧食耗盡時，圖書館變成了充滿瘋狂的空間……。


◆簡介
通過森林的深處，有一座洋風建築的巨大圖書館。
東 賢治在閒暇的時間前往了這個圖書館。平常不看書的賢治會特定來到這裡，都是為了在圖書館工作的女生、朱鷺田 栞。
賢治為了一見鍾情的她來到圖書館，度過看書的同時看著栞的身影的日子。有一日，尖銳的警鈴聲吵醒了正在打瞌睡的賢治…。
圖書館變成陰暗、門戶封鎖…無處可逃的監獄。
以封閉的私人圖書館為舞台，隱藏在這邊的秘密與突如其來的殺人事件無情的玩弄著賢治等人…。

◆角色介紹
・朱鷺田 栞
CV：朝ノ瑠璃（朝ノ姉妹ぷろじぇくと / 声優事務所クロコダイル）

朱鷺田圖書館的圖書館員。
因為體弱所以沒有上學，長年來都在自家與朱鷺田圖書館之間度過。

・君島 永梨香
CV：ヒヅキミウ（WACTOR）

主角的同學，是個追求時髦的女高中生。
動手比動腦快的類型，會憑當下的直覺，不考慮後果的採取行動。

・白木 柚那
CV：戌千代ここな（星めぐり学園）

主角的同學，跟永梨香是從小的閨密。
成績優秀，但個性軟弱，很不會拒絕人，不敢直率說出自己的想法。

・如月 美智
CV：モカ（Project ShoveL）


在朱鷺田圖書館協助栞的工作，並以栞的專任醫生的身份，固定在圖書館中工作。
很年輕就取得博士學位，從栞的小時候，栞的祖父就雇用她為專任醫生。
・遠藤 章子
CV：ミツルギリア （WACTOR）

每週一次前來幫忙美智的護理師。
從她能夠觀察周圍的氣氛與用語中都能知道是十分體貼他人的個性，不過是個超誇張的迷糊蛋。
◆已經體驗過舊作也能體驗新樂趣的新增劇情
原先是美少女遊戲的本座，為了能讓更多的玩家體驗本作品，不光是調整原本的劇情，還有追加新劇情。
重新製作的立繪，全新配音陣容的全語音視覺小說。

title: Aviary Attorney Definitive Edition [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Take yourself back to 1848 in Aviary Attorney: Definitive Edition. Paris is on the brink of yet another revolution, and the prisons are overflowing with guilty and innocent alike.

One bird stands for justice amid society's chaos.

Play the role of Monsieur Jayjay Falcon, a bird of prey with a good heart and questionable lawyering expertise. Join him and his witty apprentice, Sparrowson, as the two take on clients, interview witnesses, collect evidence and deliver justice to the guilty.

With art by 19th-century caricaturist J. J. Grandville and music by legendary romantic-era composer Camille Saint-Saëns, this game promises to be a ~swanderful~ experience.

Features:
• Definitive edition graphics. These beaks have never looked so sharp!
• Four chapters of talon-biting intrigue and suspense.
• Three fully fleshed-out endings. Decisions have consequences!
• Dozens of colourful characters to meet, interview, and bribe.
• Did I say bribe? I meant persuade.
• Real-life landmarks. Knock on the doors of Notre-Dame! Loot the Louvre!
• Optional dyslexic font. No one has to miss out!
• Earn medals to show everyone you're the fanciest bird around.
• Visit the art gallery and see the characters in their natural habitats.
• Try the jukebox! Listen to a romantic era soundtrack that spans from Hector Berlioz to Claude Debussy.
• More bird puns than you can shake a feather at.

title: Robothorium [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
- Vozglavte sobstvennuyu revolyutsiyu robotov
Razozhgite unikalnuyu revolyutsiyu! Vash vybor vliyaet na sluchayno generiruemye sobytiya i syuzhetnye zadaniya! On takzhe opredelyaet vashi otnosheniya s pyatyu fraktsiyami v igre.

- Poshagovye boi
Vybirayte iz 8 klassov robotov! Sostavte komandu mechty, kotoraya luchshe vsego budet sootvetstvovat vashey strategii. Srazites s armiey vragov, nadelennykh unikalnoy mekhanikoy, i pobedite korporatsiyu BreakTech!

- Upravlyayte otryadom robotov
Vyberite soyuznikov i upravlyayte sobstvennym otryadom robotov. Sozdavayte i sobirayte poleznye predmety, razvivayte umeniya i podderzhite protesty po vsemu miru!

- Syuzhet 
2052 god. Planeta Zemlya. Korporatsiya BreakTech, spetsializiruyushchayasya na stroitelstve robotov, protsvetaet blagodarya toriyu — neogranichennomu innovatsionnomu istochniku energii. Posle mnogikh let ekspluatatsii roboty, nakonets, nachinayut borotsya za svoi prava. No mirnye protesty bystro pererastayut v besporyadki, i repressii so storony lyudey neminuemy. Stav vragom nomer 1, roboty podvergayutsya goneniyam po vsey planete. 

Vy S.I.A — prodvinutyy iskusstvennyy intellekt. Polozhite konets okruzhayushchemu khaosu i obespechte budushchee dlya vashikh robotov. Obedinites s novymi povstancheskimi gruppirovkami, boryushchimisya za vlast mezhdu soboy, i vozglavte sobstvennoe vosstanie, kotoroe opredelit sudbu kiborgov, lyudey i robotov.

title: The Raven Remastered [NSP][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
London, 1964 god. Iz Britanskogo muzeya propal drevniy rubin, na meste prestupleniya obnaruzheno voronovo pero. Neuzheli kto-to pytaetsya podrazhat znamenitomu voru po klichke Voron?

The Raven Remastered — polnostyu pererisovannaya igra s detektivnoy istoriey, rasskazannoy ot litsa neskolkikh geroev.

OSOBENNOSTI:
— Detektivnaya igra ot sozdateley «Knigi nenapisannykh istoriy» — KING Art Games.
— Zakhvatyvayushchaya istoriya, rasskazannaya ot litsa neskolkikh geroev.
— Klassicheskie mesta ubiystv: poezda, laynery i mnogoe drugoe.
— Velikolepnaya ozvuchka.

title: Freaky Trip + 8 DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
考驗你的想像力，踏上一場奇異的救援之旅。 幫助薩爾西心愛的可卡犬擺脫未知的危險，她肯定會發現自己陷入其中。 在《奇怪旅行》中你會遇到許多邏輯謎題，這些謎題隨處可見。 仔細觀察周圍的環境並使用一切可能有幫助的東西——即使它看起來不尋常。


（非）顯而易見的解決方案
在這款遊戲中，謎題並不像看起來那麼簡單——就像你周圍的一切一樣。 跳出框框思考，不可預測，在各個層面上取得成功，成為一個雞蛋前鋒。 請記住，有時最令人難以置信的答案正是正確的答案。 嘗試所有可能性，如果您遇到困難，請尋求幫助。


怪異人物
在與 Salcy 的旅程中遇到令人驚訝的角色，但甚至不必費心去思考他們是否是真實的 - 他們不知何故是真實的。 嘗試幫助他們，他們會回報你的恩惠。 嘿，你看到樹後這個大水牛商人了嗎？ 不？ 太奇怪了，我確定它就站在那裡……


卡通圖形
由於色彩繽紛的卡通圖形，讓您更容易陷入 奇怪旅行 的世界。 逐步完成這個曲折的故事，看看謎語如何讓你驚喜，讓你每一秒都開懷大笑。


主要特徵：
- 幽默且完全荒謬的點擊式冒險
- 14 個不同的關卡，背後有一個不尋常的故事
- 有趣的角色和地點
- 激動人心的配樂

title: Gone Home [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
7 iyunya 1995 goda, 1:15 nochi.

Vozvrashchaeshsya domoy posle goda zhizni za granitsey, i, kazalos by, tebya dolzhna vstrechat vsya semya. No chto-to ne tak, v dome nikogo! Gde vse? I chto tut sluchilos? Poprobuy razgadat etu taynu v Gone Home — syuzhetnoy priklyuchencheskoy igre, sozdannoy The Fullbright Company.

Igra Gone Home — eto interaktivnoe rassledovanie. Osmatrivaya detali samogo obychnogo na vid doma, uznavay istoriyu zhivushchikh zdes lyudey. Otkryvay lyubye dveri i yashchiki, beri veshchi v ruki, razglyadyvay ikh i nakhodi podskazki. Vosstanavlivay khod sobytiy v zhizni etoy semi, izuchaya to, chto oni ostavili posle sebya.

Snova doma.

Istoriya zhizni: igra Gone Home, sozdannaya opytnymi razrabotchikami serii BioShock i stsenaristami Minerva's Den, izobiluet tonkimi i bogatymi podrobnostyami istorii o tom, kak odna semya otchayanno pytalas spravitsya s neopredelennostyu, dushevnoy bolyu i peremenami. Igra udostoena tselogo ryada premiy – «Igra goda», «Luchshiy syuzhet» i «Luchshiy debyut» – po mneniyu GDC i BAFTA, a takzhe otdelnykh publikatsiy v PC Gamer, IGN, Polygon i Paste.

Udivitelnoe mesto: vernis v 90-e i pobyvay v dome, gde ta epokha vosproizvedena s tochnostyu do melochey, a dovershaet atmosferu zvuk dozhdya za oknom.

Bez srazheniy i golovolomok: v Gone Home net zhestokikh skhvatok i muchitelnykh zagadok. Ty igraesh tak, kak tebe udobno, i bez opaseniy, chto na tebya napadut, chto ty na chem-nibud zastryanesh ili chto-to ne poluchitsya. Dom prosto khochet, chtoby ego izuchali.

Tselikom interaktivnoe rassledovanie: chtoby ponyat, chto sluchilos s semey Grinbrayar, osmatrivay ikh dom, lichnye veshchi, zapiski i pisma. Nablyudatelnost pozvolit postepenno slozhit razroznennye obryvki v edinuyu istoriyu.

Nasyshchennoe povestvovanie: za 3–4 chasa tebe otkroyutsya tayny Sema Grinbrayara i doma na kholme Arbor. Kak mnogo udastsya uznat? Eto zavisit ot togo, naskolko polno ty izuchish melkie detali etogo nasyshchennogo i bogatogo syuzheta.

Kommentarii «iz-za kulis»: svyshe polutora chasov kommentariev ot razrabotchikov, muzykantov i akterov ozvuchivaniya, rabotavshikh nad Gone Home. Chtoby vklyuchit rezhim kommentariev, prosto vyberi «Modifikatory» pri nachale novoy igry!

title: Doodle God Evolution / Mafia Crime City / Devil 3volution [NSP][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
Doodle God: Evolution - unikalnoe izdanie, vklyuchayushchee v sebya ne tolko klassicheskiy Doodle God, no i Doodle Farm.

Teper v etoy zakhvatyvayushchey igre dlya vsekh vozrastov v tvoem rasporyazhenii okazhutsya ne tolko ogon, zemlya, voda, vozdukh, no i plankton, mlekopitayushchie ili ptitsy. Kombiniruy ikh i poluchay novye elementy, chtoby postroit tseluyu tsivilizatsiyu i vossozdat evolyutsiyu zhivotnogo mira!

Konechno, vselennaya sozdavalas ne odin den, tebya zhdet dolgiy put, polnyy radosti sozidaniya i tvorcheskikh muk. A chtoby tebe ne bylo odinoko, sozdanie kazhdogo novogo elementa budet soprovozhdatsya mudrymi i ironichnymi izrecheniyami velichayshikh mysliteley vsekh vremen!

No, dorogoy bog, bud ostorozhen! Bezgranichnaya sposobnost tvorit inogda privodit k nepredskazuemym posledstviyam... izobretenie kolesa mozhet vyzvat nashestvie zombi!

Day volyu bogu vnutri sebya s Doodle God: Evolution™!

OSOBENNOSTI
- Ogromnyy i raznoobraznyy zhivotnyy mir zhdet sozdaniya v novom rezhime Doodle Farm!
- 500 dostupnykh dlya otkrytiya elementov!
- Rezhim "Planety". Sozdavay novye elementy - i ty tut zhe uvidish ikh na poverkhnosti svoey planety.
- Rezhim "Missiy". Razvivay svoyu planetu, vypolnyaya mnozhestvo mini-kvestov.
- Rezhim «Golovolomki». Smozhesh li ty poluchit finalnyy element?
- Interesnye raznoobraznye kvesty ne ostavyat tebya ravnodushnym.
- Sotni interesnykh, smeshnykh i mudrykh tsitat i poslovits!

title: Paradise Lost [NSP][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Vy igraete za Shimona, dvenadtsatiletnego malchika, kotoryy posle smerti materi bluzhdaet po vyzhzhenoy atomnymi bombami Polshe i nakhodit zabroshennyy bunker natsistov. Shimon ishchet neizvestnogo cheloveka s fotografii, kotoruyu khranila ego mat. Kto etot chelovek? Smozhete li vy ego nayti? Voyna prodolzhalas na dvadtsat let dolshe, i bolshaya chast evropeyskogo kontinenta sgorela, kogda natsisty obrushili svoi yadernye rakety.
Spustis v retrofuturisticheskiy bunker, gde prodvinutye tekhnologii stolknulis so zapadnoslavyanskim yazychestvom, i issleduyte etot podzemnyy gorod. Uznayte istoriyu bunkera, kogda-to zakhvachennogo polskimi myatezhnikami. Vyyasnite, chto stalo s ego obitatelyami. Chto s nimi sluchilos?
Tainstvennaya devochka Eva svyazyvaetsya s Shimonom, ispolzuya tekhnologii bunkera. Mozhet byt, ona znaet cheloveka s fotografii? Ved esli on naydet eyo, to bolshe ne budet odin..

title: Verlet Swing [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
Khvatayte kryukostrel i pogruzites v etot syurrealisticheskiy mir. Zdes net nichego normalnogo, a potomu vozmozhno vse. Statui pristalno sledyat za vami! Postaraytes ne pogibnut — ved lyuboe stolknovenie s okruzheniem smertelno. Verlet Swing — neprostoe ispytanie, kotoroe stanovitsya vse slozhnee, kogda vy nesetes sredi karpov, kuskov pitstsy i drugikh neozhidannykh prepyatstviy.
 
Osobennosti

> 100 urovney v stremitelnom tempe.
> Beskonechnye strannosti.
> Igra postepenno uslozhnyaetsya. Tolko luchshie smogut dobratsya do poslednikh urovney!
> Uznayte, na chto sposobny, pri pomoshchi tablitsy liderov i sorevnovatelnogo rezhima.

title: Senses Midnight [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Uesugi Kaho 是名外向又愛冒險的大學生，同時也是她的學校的神祕學研究社的社員。當她回去日本探望家人時，其他的社員挑戰她去探索惡名昭彰的城市傳說，Ikebukuro 步行公園的午夜之門。Kaho 打算抓住機會證明傳說是真的，並捕捉超自然現象的有力證據，但是進入這座長期廢棄的公園可能會是她這輩子犯下最大的錯誤。

《SENSEs: Midnight》是一款受此類型經典啟發的 3D 生存恐怖遊戲，以固定的鏡頭角度、坦克控制視角的懷舊風格呈現。透過環境敘事和傳說來發掘公園的秘密、細心控管有限的物品欄來避免走回頭路、在可能吸引到惡靈的解謎衡量風險與報酬、逃進躲藏點來暫時逃離追逐者、更別忘了，只有一個地方可以安全的進行存檔。凶惡的 Onryo 會永遠跟蹤著你，好好期待 Ikebukuro 步行公園帶來的恐怖氛圍！

特色：

• 在正統的日本設定下，探索超自然現象！
• 以經典的固定鏡頭角度、坦克控制視角，體驗真正的生存恐怖。
• 解開環境謎題，探索錯綜複雜的故事！
• 細心管控有限的物品欄。
• 避開墮落靈魂，用躲藏點來活過夜晚。
• 沉浸自身於氛圍獨特而深刻的原聲帶和優美的 3D 視覺！

title: Summer Catchers [NSZ][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
Otpravlyaytes v epicheskoe dorozhnoe priklyuchenie vsey zhizni s Summer Catchers. S vashey nadezhnoy derevyannoy mashinkoy vy pustites v put v dalekie kraya, polnye tayn, strannykh sushchestv i zakhvatyvayushchikh gonok v svoem stremlenii nakonets pochuvstvovat leto.

Odnako puteshestvie budet nelegkim. Proezzhaya cherez tenistye lesa, temnye bolota, ogromnye doliny i podzemnye goroda, vy stolknetes s prepyatstviyami i neveroyatnymi situatsiyami. Imeya v rukakh nadezhnuyu sumku dlya puteshestviy, vy smozhete preodolet eti nevedomye kraya i tak zhe, kak v realnoy zhizni, nayti neskolkikh druzey i sekretov na svoem puti.

Klyuchevye osobennosti:
- Unikalnaya arkadnaya igra, kotoraya sochetaet v sebe elementy gonok, istorii, ritma i golovolomki
- Raskroyte vse tayny i sobytiya etogo prekrasnogo piksel-artnogo mira
- Otkroyte dlya sebya unikalnye sposobnosti i sovershenstvuyte svoy avtomobil, chtoby ezdit stilno
- Povtorite igru, chtoby nayti vse skrytye ugolki, kotorye bystryy puteshestvennik mog by propustit

title: Pocket Bravery + DLC Season Pass [NSP][ENG]
description:
Poigrayte v demoversiyu, chtoby bolshe uznat ob igre Pocket Bravery!

Vdokhnovlennyy klassicheskimi faytingami 90-kh godov, Pocket Bravery predstavlyaet soboy sovremennyy fayting s notkami retro!

Pocket Bravery s ee originalnymi personazhami, yarkimi tsvetami i vpechatlyayushchey sistemoy boev sozdana dlya opytnykh igrokov, odnako nachinayushchim ne sostavit truda obuchitsya i nachat igrat!

Vyberite boytsa! 12 raznoobraznykh personazhey s unikalnymi sposobnostyami i igrovymi stilyami!

Ves mir — arena. Vyberite arenu iz 20 dostupnykh variantov so vsego mira!

Zakhvatyvayushchiy syuzhet! Sledite za istoriey Nuno i ego tovarishchey, kotorye pytayutsya rassledovat prestupleniya kriminalnoy gruppirovki «Matilkha»! 

Dve skhemy upravleniya: dlya opytnykh i dlya nachinayushchikh igrokov, chtoby vy mogli vybrat variant, podkhodyashchiy imenno dlya vashego urovnya!

Lokalnaya i setevaya mnogopolzovatelskaya igra s tekhnologiey 'Rollback Netcode dlya snizheniya zaderzhki otklika!

title: Cloud Gardens [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
種植種子，重新利用數百種廢棄物品，為重歸大自然而創造獨特的建築。
 
 雲中庭令人放鬆的自然環境可激發創造力，充滿了大量物品和植物供你選擇。
 
 與其他園丁分享你的創作，下載其他實景立體模型的循環視訊，沉浸在由《Kingdom》作曲家Amos Roddy打造的生成音景中。
 
 雲中庭將花園模擬遊戲、反烏托邦景觀建設遊戲和益智遊戲完美融合，旨在讓你收穫滿足感，而不會有絲毫的挫敗感。

title: Crime O'Clock / Crowded Mysteries [NSZ][ENG,RUS (Mod.)]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 俄语 来自 AlchemistLab
description:
ALERT! ALERT!
TIMESHIFT CONTINUUM AT RISK!
Prevent crimes before they happen! It’s Crime O’Clock!
Investigate cases through time and evolving maps by unveiling a multi-eras linked story. Will you be observant enough to solve the mysteries? Crime waits for no man!

As a time detective, your job is to solve crimes through time that should never have happened!
Each map has multiple time markers to visit and use to resolve different cases of hacking, murder, theft, and much more.
But a common thread of strange events is developing over the centuries...

Something or someone is trying to disturb time, find it!
A HUGE zoomable map for each era is the playfield for the deductions and the search for clues.
YOU must proceed with a deductive method to combine the missing pieces.
By resolving cases the map changes and new adventures are unlocked.

As you can see, it's a point&click game; the only skill you need is your fully functional brain to unplan crime!
You will not be alone in your job: EVE, an advanced AI, will help you, providing guidance and tools.
Using EVE’s system, you have new ways to find clues and evidence: deductive sessions alternate with action and puzzle mechanics for a complete user experience.
During your adventure, EVE will upgrade its systems, unlocking new features...

During the investigation, you will explore five different ages:
-Steam Age, with automata, crazy inventions, and gothic mysteries.
-Atlantean Age, with its magic crystals and its peaceful and utopian civilization.
-Information Age, based on the real city of Milan in Italy, the developers’ hometown.
It features some of the most iconic buildings such as Duomo di Milano, Castello Sforzesco, The Last Supper and many more!

and more to discover soon…

title: My Hidden Things [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
一開始什麼都沒有，只有混亂的夢，然後 Xary 出現了。它試圖瞭解人的本質，幫助他們，但它太年輕了。它將和你一起，去弄清楚這一切...

有時候生活會考驗我們。這些故事的主要人物將面臨許多的挑戰，無論是你愛的人生病了，一個危險的旅程或離開一段虐待的關係。解決的辦法並不總是顯而易見，而且常常令人恐懼。沉浸在三個充滿痛苦、喜悅、恐懼、希望和勝利的感人故事中。

我的隱藏的東西《My Hidden Things》是一個在不尋常的機制裡的獨特視覺小說和隱藏物件的大冒險。你不僅需要搜索物件，還可以將它們組合在一起，以獲得清單中的物件。

情節圍繞幾個人的夢， 你和 Xary 需要幫助他們。有了你的幫助，他們才能克服困難，保持人性。故事以連環畫形式呈現。

特色：

• 一個可愛但可怕的故事。
• 查找並合併物件。
• 享受音樂。
• 幫助守夢者解決所有的難題！

title: Meg's Monster + DLC Memories of the Monsters [NSP][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
住在魔界的魔物「羅伊」和「戈蘭」，發現了誤入魔界的人類少女「梅格」。性格粗魯的羅伊，透過與梅格的相處的點滴，及和她一起仰望星空等過程，漸漸地向她敞開了心扉。而且，為了將梅格送回她母親的身邊，羅伊決定要前往人類的世界。

羅伊非常強健，幾乎是無敵的魔物。但是，他必須一邊保護梅格一邊戰鬥。有時還需要在戰鬥中拿出玩具，來安撫梅格不要哭。撐住啊羅伊，打敗那些古怪又難纏的怪物們吧。※請注意：如果梅格哭泣，世界就會毀滅（遊戲結束）。

在旅途中，魔界中形形色色的魔物們，會將故事點綴得更加豐富且有趣。好搭檔「戈蘭」、統領魔界的「評議會」巨頭們、住在魔界的人類「保羅」……

不讓梅格傷心落淚，且將她安全送到地上的世界——你，做得到吧？

title: Desta the Memories Between [NSP][ENG]
description:
墜入夢境吧！在這款回合制輕度 Rogue 遊戲中探索超現實世界，重溫回憶、重拾友誼，修復不圓滿的關係。故事由角色推動，破碎的關係、沒說出口的話，以及探索夢境找尋答案的可能，都等你來體驗！

遊戲特色：
• 暢玩超現實丟球遊戲：在運動風格的回合制對戰中使出花式擊球、精準殺球、完美拋擲。隨著一夜又一夜過去，德斯塔 (Desta) 也會逐漸累積經驗，更能應對這個超現實世界，並發現新能力和致勝關鍵。
• 徜徉遼闊夢境：每天晚上，德斯塔都會墜入神秘的幻夢國度，拼湊成這個空間的是一片片昔日之地的碎片，一段段遺憾往事，以及力量強大、足以左右對話發展的球體。
• 認識生動的角色：跟隨德斯塔認識各式各樣古怪而有趣的角色，他們都有各自的超凡能力，也都與夢境有著不同的淵源。
• 適合所有玩家：遊戲從頭到尾的設計都將技巧各異的玩家納入考量，無論新手老手都可以完整體驗這趟旅程。遊戲涉及自我省思、焦慮、心理健康、失去父母、性別認同等課題，請玩家自行斟酌。本遊戲由 ustwo games 出品。

title: Rad [NSP][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
RAD — trekhmernyy boevik s elementami roguelike v mire, perezhivshem dva apokalipsisa.

V roli smelogo podrostka otpravtes v radioaktivnuyu Pustosh, kishashchuyu neizvestnymi tvaryami, i prevratite razrushennyy mir v tsvetushchiy sad.

Kazhdyy mig tsena spaseniya mira budet rasti: toksiny iskazyat vash oblik.

Izmenyayte sebya, chtoby vyzhit i obresti novye sposobnosti, ili vozmite bitu i nauchite mestnuyu faunu khoroshim maneram. Pora spasat mir!

title: Mitsurugi Kamui Hikae [NSP][ENG]
description:
Starsheklassnitsy i yaponskie mechi! Vyydi na pole srazheniya, srazis s polchishchami vragov i ne day nikomu iz nikh ustoyat v etoy nasyshchennoy deystviem igre, sozdannoy nezavisimymi razrabotchikami.
Nabiray ochki za svoe umenie, chtoby poluchit vozmozhnost polzovatsya novymi priemami i protivostoyat bolshemu kolichestvu vrazheskoy sily.
Ispytay gromadnoe udovolstvie, osushchestvlyaya bystrye ataki i polzuyas razrushitelnymi priemami dlya sokrusheniya svoikh vragov!

title: StreamLove Voyage (Stream Love) [NSP][ENG]
description:
被召喚到遊戲世界的航，身邊居然出現了他推的VTuber忍野志乃！
她似乎也是在不知不覺間來到了這個世界。
為了回到原來的世界，兩人必須聯手完成遊戲管理員發佈的任務！
努力通關！

▶ 明明怕得要死還要組隊打殭屍
▶ 紅著耳根手牽手假裝情侶上學
▶ 社恐女主角成為偶像練習生
▶ 穿越奇幻世界挑戰魔王副本

結果每次冒險都在放閃的航與志乃。
兩人的關係變得越發親密。

但當回到原來的世界時，他不過是個普通人而已，
而她仍是螢幕中的虛擬偶像。
這波跨次元的戀愛最終會走向怎樣的結局呢——！？

title: Azura's Crystals [NSZ][ENG]
description:
踏上大自然驅動的冒險旅程：扮演Azura－一位充滿好奇心、熱愛大自然的冒險者，探索神祕的 Primalis 和它們與強大晶石之間的連結。在多樣的風景中探險、解決謎題、結識各種生物，Azura's Crystals 將為玩家帶來一個充滿奇蹟與發現的魔幻世界。
特色：
劇情驅動的探索：透過精心設計的故事情節，Azura將從鬱鬱蔥蔥的森林到危險的洞穴中，一路發現遠古的傳說，揭開原始生物的奧秘。
動態戰鬥系統：運用元素晶石的力量，與敵人展開戰鬥。你還可以召喚強大的威斯佩里安 Vesperians ——這些擁有巨大力量的生物能在進攻和防守中助你一臂之力。
製作與資源管理：收集周遭環境中的稀有資源，製作工具、藥劑以及裝備升級，助你完成任務。透過這些工具，你將獲得新的技能，迎接更嚴峻的挑戰。
解謎與遺跡探索：用智慧解決環境謎題，深入探索古老遺跡。這些遺跡需要你對原始生物及其世界有深刻的理解，才能順利前進。
美輪美奐的環境：穿越各種美麗的環境，每個地點都有獨特的動植物與危險。從寧靜的森林到兇險的洞穴和被遺忘的遺跡，每個場景都講述著一段故事。
Vesperians：運用原始晶石的元素之力，召喚威斯佩里安。這些令人驚嘆的生物會在戰鬥、研究甚至探索中給予你幫助。每隻威斯佩里安都有獨特的能力，並能隨著時間不斷升級。

title: Hourglass [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description: 在沙漏中，您可以創建自己的時間克隆來解決具有挑戰性的難題。您將扮演Aywa，一位年輕的冒險家前往埃及尋找她失踪的父親——一位考古學家，他最近一次探險後再也沒有回來。

title: Mr Shifty [NSZ][ENG]
description: Shift through bullets, and master lightning-fast takedowns in an all new kind of action game from tinyBuild and Team Shifty! Mr. Shifty follows a teleportation-fueled heist to break into the world's most secure facility.

title: Cube Life Island Survival [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 俄语, lyubitelskiy MOD
description:
In Survival Mode, the player must maintain health, explore caves, gather resources, and craft tools on an unknown island. Get food, explore and build during the day. Hide, fight, and surive as night falls on the island. 

In Creative Mode, the game will allow players to build constructions in 3D generated game worlds. There is no limit to your imagination.

Features:
Block building open-world
Super-Duper Realistic Graphics
Creative Mode
Survival Mode
Skin Editor
Day/Night cycles
Tons of items and tools to discover
Crafting

title: Would You Like to Run An Idol Cafe 1-2-3 [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Kogda Yokoyama Naoya uznaet, chto ego lyubimoe kafe Seaside Cafe nakhoditsya na grani zakrytiya, on pomogaet svoim simpatichnym podrugam Ichigo, Mayuki i Kuu sozdat gruppu aydolov, chtoby sposobstvovat prodvizheniyu kafe.

Ikh aydol-gruppa nazyvaetsya Sweet Shoreline, i ikh pervoe muzykalnoe video imeet ogromnyy virusnyy uspekh. Blagodarya vnov obretennoy populyarnosti gruppu priglashayut na konkurs aydolov v Tokio. Oderzhat li devushki pobedu ili ikh sopernitsy, «Medovyy dyavol», odoleyut ikh?

Sudba Sweet Shoreline i The Seaside Café snova lezhit na plechakh Naoi.


Kharakteristiki
* Vizualnaya novella o meydo-kafe s milymi aydolami
* Krasivye devushki v stile anime
* Vash vybor kak menedzhera vliyaet na uspekh gruppy
* Tretya igra v serii

title: A Maiden Astrologer Divines the Future (Hoshi to Otome ga Uranau Mirai) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
本作主人公是一位名叫“Izumi Mizushiro”的女占卜師。
她和妹妹“Towa”兩個人生活在一起。

某一天，Izumi身邊發生了一些糾紛，
就在她們尋找糾紛的原因之時，
一個名叫 “Maki ”的女孩出現在她們的面前。

從那之後，她們將經歷一系列的邂逅與分離。

本作是一款ADV遊戲，
占卜師Izumi致力於“讓他人高興”和“鼓勵他人”，
希望您也能在本作中與Izumi共同體會那種“想要鼓勵他人”的心情。

★Story

　-只要是能“讓他人高興”，亦或是能“鼓勵他人”的事，
不管是多麼微小的事情，對作為占卜師的我來說都是很有意義的-

占卜師“Izumi Mizushiro”在和她的妹妹“Towa”一起生活著的同時，
還在Rino開的咖啡廳中替客人占卜。

被Izumi占卜過的客人帶著笑容離開咖啡店後，
看到這些笑容的Izumi也感受到了一絲幸福和工作的價值。

然而，Izumi的身邊開始發生一些不尋常的事情。
來占卜的客人突然增多，她甚至有些來不及處理，
也因為占卜方法和口碑之類的事與客人發生糾紛。

正當Izumi尋找原因之時，一個名叫 “Maki ”的女孩出現在她的面前。

從那一刻起，一些意想不到的事使得她原本平穩的生活泛起了漣漪。

而她，也將朝著星星與少女占卜出的未來前行。

title: A Light in the Dark [NSZ][ENG]
description:
──We cannot choose in this unfair world.

Hao-Chen Jiang did not understand what it was when he opened his eyes. Before him was a dim and dreary room that he had not seen before. Trying to get up to turn on the lights, he finds that his arms are tied behind him and that is when he realizes that he's been kidnapped. It is then that a mysterious girl appears before him and with a look of disdain tells him that he's been kidnapped and unless his family agrees to pay a ransom he has no chance to escape. But perhaps there is more to this than just money...

The rich boy stuck in his never changing daily life...
The fierce girl struggling for survival...
Two people in totally opposite positions in life.

During his days of imprisonment, they will learn of a world they were never aware of which will crumble away at their deep-rooted prejudices. In the face of confusion and the choices before them, what will they find...?

A Light in the Dark is an original visual novel game from the creative minds of CreSpirit, Storia and Narrator. Featuring interactive elements to push the story forward, examine your the surroundings and formulate a plan to escape but beware of your stamina!

This edition of the game also features the voice talents of Kubo Yurika and Ichinose Kana as the voices of the older girl and the younger girl.

title: Astrologaster [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Play as ‘Doctor’ Simon Forman - unlicensed medical professional and astrologer - and help him win a medical licence. Astrologaster is a narrative-based comedy game.

Explore Forman’s life, his work, and his relationships with his clients. Make story choices by performing astrological readings. Choose strategically or make decisions just for fun - but be aware that your choices will have consequences (and unpredictable side effects!)

13 clients come to see you 5-7 times seeking advice for personal, professional and medical problems. By examining the stars in the sky, you diagnose and determine answers for your clients’ problems. As well as affecting the storyline, these choices will alter your clients’ satisfaction levels. Satisfied clients will write you letters of recommendation, and with enough of these letters you can obtain a medical licence from the University of Cambridge.

So-called “real” (licensed) doctors call Forman a quack and fraud. Help Forman prove these medical establishment elitists wrong!

Features
- Perform real* astrology: Examine the sky and choose astrological interpretations that Forman will use to advise his patients. (But remember: astrology is not an exact science!)
- Solve Hilarious Problems: Consult on problems ranging from Elizabethan terror plots and foul diseases, to romantic entanglements and stolen pies!
- Change Lives: Win your patients’ favour or ruin their lives. Advise 14 characters who return 5-7 times. Patients have their own ongoing stories which often overlap with each other. Use gossip from some characters to guide and manipulate others.
- Win A Medical Licence: Convince patients to write letters of recommendations. Collect enough letters to exchange them for a medical licence.
- Fully Voiced Character Dialogue: Sitcom-style comedy brought to life by a cast of over a dozen actors.- Sing Along: Enjoy Renaissance-era music and sing along to each character’s theme song.
- Casebooks Come Alive: Simon Forman’s cases are presented as a beautiful pop-up book. Turn pages to delve deeper into your patients’ stories.

The Story
London, 1592. A great plague sweeps through the capital. When doctors flee the city in fear, a hero rises. His name is Simon Forman, “Doctor” of Astrology, Astronomy and Physick. Not only does he have the power to cure the sick, he can find their lost pets and predict their futures! All by reading the movements of the stars.

But when the plague ends, Forman’s problems begin. The real doctors return to London and they will stop at nothing to bring him down...

Summary
Astrologaster is a story-driven astrological comedy game set in Shakespeare’s London. Based on a true - and truly ridiculous - story. Simon Forman was considered a sage by some and a charlatan by others. What will your legacy be? Will you put your faith in the stars?

title: Save Koch [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
description: Save Koch — odnopolzovatelskaya takticheskaya igra-simulyator, v kotoroy igrok primeryaet na sebya shkuru materogo mafiozi, chyu imperiyu v gorode Nyu-Kandinski podryvaet neizvestnyy «krot». U vas est tolko shest dney, chtoby raskryt zagovor, ustanovit zakazchika i otpravit predatelya na korm rybam.

title: Adventure Academia The Fractured Continent [NSP][ENG]
description:
Adventure Academia: The Fractured Continent (Akademiya priklyucheniy: Raskolotyy kontinent) — polnotsennaya RPG-strategiya v mire Class of Heroes! Sozday svoyu gruppu uchenikov v fenteziynom korolevstve! Privedi ikh k pobede nad ordami monstrov!

Vooruzhivshis drevney relikviey, peredavaemoy iz pokoleniya v pokolenie — Ruler Orb (Sferoy pravitelya) — i zaruchivshis podderzhkoy loyalnykh uchenikov shkoly Obsidian High, tebe nuzhno budet razrabotat strategiyu, nabrat voinov i srazhatsya do polnoy pobedy nad ordami monstrov, ugrozhayushchikh rodnomu krayu. Vozmi na sebya komandovanie i prokladyvay put… za pravdu, raz i navsegda!

Osnovnye funktsii

Vyberi lyubuyu iz 10 raznykh ras! - Vyberi pol, cherty kharaktera, kharakteristiki lichnosti i sposobnosti chlenov tvoey komandy.

Vseokhvatyvayushchaya istoriya, razvorachivayushchayasya s kazhdym zavershennym kvestom!

Takticheskaya igrovoy protsess na osnove setki: vedi svoyu komandu v realnom vremeni, srazhayas na pole boya.

Sistema upravleniya komandoy: upravlyay, perebrasyvay i kontroliruy svoyu gruppu i ee statistiku.

Vooruzhi svoikh uchenikov! - Po puti ty naydesh snaryazhenie i oruzhie, chtoby povysit uroven i usilit zashchitu svoikh personazhey, i smozhesh ego kupit.

Unikalnye vstrechi s ispolinskim bossom: na kazhdom etape nuzhno preodolet bossa, ispolzuya raznye sposobnosti i varianty napadeniya.

title: Archetype Arcadia [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Archetype Arcadia — mrachnaya vizualnaya novella v zhanre fantastiki. V postapokalipticheskom mire pochti vse chelovechestvo pogiblo ot zagadochnoy bolezni pod nazvaniem «pervorodnyy grekh». V tsentre istorii — Rast i ego sestra, kotorye borozdyat obezlyudevshie strany v otchayannom poiske vyzhivshikh. Bolezn, porazivshaya lyudey, vyzyvaet pomeshatelstvo, iskazhennye oshchushcheniya i neupravlyaemuyu tyagu k samorazrusheniyu. Edinstvennyy sposob kontrolirovat simptomy — nakhoditsya v virtualnoy igre Archetype Arcadia.

Zaraza obkhodila Rasta storonoy, no odnazhdy ego sestra po kakoy-to prichine teryaet soznanie. Togda geroyu prikhoditsya samomu pogruzitsya v virtualnuyu igru v poiskakh lekarstva. V igre emu otkroetsya tselyy mir lyudey i monstrov. V etom mire mozhno borotsya s pomoshchyu igrovogo ustroystva, ispolzuya dragotsennye vospominaniya i svoikh avatarov. Odnako, khotya virtualnaya realnost zamedlyaet bolezn, bez sereznykh posledstviy ne oboydetsya.

Proryvayas skvoz strannyy novyy mir, Rast vstretit lichnostey s samym nepredskazuemym proiskhozhdeniem, naydet vernykh druzey i — kak bez etogo — vragov. Archetype Arcadia — istoriya, polnaya nepredskazuemykh i trogatelnykh povorotov syuzheta. Otpravtes v priklyuchenie, polnoe tayn i gorkogo razocharovaniya, druzhby i spaseniya.

title: Jazz² Resurrection (移植版 Jazz Jackrabbit 2) [NSP][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 英语 [EN], 俄语 [RU], 捷克语, 意大利语, 波兰语, 葡萄牙语, Rumynskiy, 土耳其语.
description:
Originalnaya Jazz Jackrabbit 2 predstavlyaet soboy kompyuternuyu igru v zhanre platformer, proizvodstva Epic MegaGames i Orange Games, yavlyayushcheysya prodolzheniem seriala Jazz Jackrabbit o priklyucheniyakh krolika Dzhazza (Jazz). V etoy chasti poyavlyaetsya vozmozhnost igrat za ego brata Speza Slekrebbit (Spaz) i sestru Lori Dzhekrebbit (Lori).
V razdache predstavlen port igry Jazz² Resurrection na platformu Nintendo Switch + resursy originalnoy igry. Port pervoy igry, Jazz Jackrabbit (OpenJazzNX) sm. zdes.

title: Aground [NSP][RUS/Multi4]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 4]
description:
Smozhete li vy vyzhit vmeste s drugimi zhertvami katastrofy, dobyvaya resursy, sozdavaya predmety i vozvodya postroyki dlya vyzhivaniya?

Aground — RPG pro mayning i krafting s tselnoy istoriey i globalnoy tselyu dlya dostizheniya kotoroy vam pridetsya dobyvat resursy i stroit. Vo vremya prokhozhdeniya vam vstretyatsya novye geroi, vy otkroete novye tekhnologii, i, byt mozhet, dazhe magiyu. Smozhete li vy vyrastit drakona? Zapustit raketu v kosmos? Nebo — sovershenno tochno ne predel. I pust igra ne obmanet vas svoey vidimoy prostotoy: Aground tait v sebe mnozhestvo sekretov, ot kotorykh u vas s gub to i delo budet sletat voskhishchennoe: "A chto zhe togda budet dalshe?"

Vyzhivanie — lish nachalo. U chelovechestva est tolko odin put: vosparit k zvezdam i brosit im vyzov. No dlya togo, chtoby vernut vse, chto bylo poteryano, vam ponadobyatsya pomoshch i nedyuzhinnaya izobretatelnost. No dazhe etogo ne budet dostatochno...

title: Golden Force [NSZ][ENG]
description:
惡魔之王的爪牙伸向了肌肉島——一座天堂般的和平島嶼。他派出軍隊，在手下將軍們的輔佐下迫害著當地民眾。
酒館裡，威震四方的黃金特戰隊傭兵們一醉方休，享受著最後的假期。此時，他們收到了新的任務：去打敗惡魔之王，收回被他奪走的大量黃金。
只要有黃金和激烈的戰鬥，黃金特戰隊就絕不會讓你失望！

特色：
– 4個充滿挑戰的遊戲世界。
– 硬核復古的難度（但不會讓你崩潰）。
– 2人合作模式。
– 4個可玩角色。
– 強大的boss。
– 為硬核玩家準備的大量隱藏內容與挑戰。

title: Ages of Mages: The Last Keeper [NSZ][ENG]
genre: 冒险, 射击, 动作
interface_lang: 德语, 英语, 西班牙语, 法语, 意大利语, 韩语, 葡萄牙语, 中文 [Multi 8]
description:
Take the princess back! 
Ages of Mages: The Last Keeper is the perfect TPS beat 'em up game for a great weekend on your couch with family and friends.

The kingdom is under attack and the princess has been taken! 
Can our four mages assume the responsibility of Guardian and reinvigorate the ages of the mages?
-----------------------------------------------
Main Features
■ Third-person shooter beat 'em up game with RPG and Rogue-Lite elements.
■ 4 kinds of mages, each with its own characteristics.
■ 20+ wands, each wand has different maigc skill.
■ Skill tree, unlocking your powerful magic.
■ Randomly generated dungeons.
■ 7 chapters, 38 stages, 14 boss fights.
■ Up to 4 local player co-op, as well as a single-player option.

title: Ageless [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Poteryannaya, zaputavshayasya i odinokaya. Chto sdelaet Kiara, kogda poymet, chto magicheskiy obelisk dal ey vlast nad vozrastom zhivotnykh i rasteniy?
 
Prikosnites k neobychaynomu platformennomu miru mifov i magii. Vas zhdet emotsionalnoe priklyuchenie, v kotorom vam predstoit prinimat neprostye resheniya i stolknutsya so svoimi vnutrennimi demonami.

Posleduyte za Kiaroy v stranu chudes i stradaniy. Upravlyayte vozrastom zhivotnykh i rasteniy, razgadyvaya zamyslovatye golovolomki, vpletennye v okruzhayushchiy mir, i srazhayas s bezzhalostnymi bossami, chto stoyat u vas na puti.

title: Clem [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Vy prosypaetes v kholodnoy tuskloy komnate i medlenno privykaete k obstanovke, kotoraya neozhidanno kazhetsya znakomoy. Strannoe oshchushchenie ne pokidaet vas, ved chto-to zdes tochno ne tak. Potom vashe vnimanie privlekaet neobychnyy predmet, lezhashchiy na polu. Eto bloknot s nadpisyu CLeM. Pokopavshis v ego stranitsakh s zamyslovatymi risunkami nasekomykh i strannymi simvolami, vy obnaruzhivaete zapisku s poslaniem: «Day mne krasotu». Vy pytaetes ponyat, chto proiskhodit, no vdrug slyshite strannyy golos.
Otpravtes v tainstvennoe priklyuchenie!

title: Actual Sunlight [NSZ][ENG]
description:
“I know what you’re thinking: Why keep getting up, day in and day out, even though your life is going nowhere?”

Notorious: Widely considered to be one of the bleakest and best-written experiences in indie gaming, Actual Sunlight challenges you to confront the life of Evan Winter: An overweight, lonely and severely depressed young professional.

Fear the words, not the reading: Presented almost entirely in text, a mixture of sharp observation and pitch black humor captures your interest from provocative beginning to shattering conclusion.

Prepare yourself: Actual Sunlight is a uniquely unforgettable adventure that will etch itself into you as one of the most difficult, haunting and beautiful experiences you have ever had as a gamer.

title: Aer Memories of Old [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
昔日的眾神被遺忘了，消失在被破壞的世界中，只留下空中島嶼的碎片。這個由無窮無盡的天空、色彩繽紛的島嶼以及古老遺跡組成的神秘世界，正面臨陷入黑暗的危機之中。

身為所剩無幾的變形者之一，你被派往眾神之地朝聖，去揭開可能拯救現實世界的秘密。

-隨意化身一隻飛鳥，在空中翱翔探索
-一個藏著秘密與各種新發現的大型開放世界
-到處都是秘密、謎題與神殿的朝聖之旅
-強調氛圍與美學，充滿生氣的極簡美術風格

title: Absolute Tactics Daughters of Mercy [NSP][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Absolute Tactics: Daughters of Mercy — uvlekatelnoe poshagovoe rolevoe priklyuchenie, razvivayushchee idei klassicheskikh takticheskikh igr. V Absolute Tactics vas zhdet mnozhestvo raznoobraznykh personazhey, ogromnye bossy-monstry i mrachnyy, okhvachennyy voynoy mir. Vmeste s glavnym geroem Khaksli i ego psom Maksom vam predstoit sobrat komandu vernykh soyuznikov i dat otpor zagadochnoy armii vtorzheniya.

Upravlyayte boevymi edinitsami i ispolzuyte ikh unikalnye vozmozhnosti, chtoby sokrushit vraga. Vasha strategiya dolzhna uchityvat raspolozhenie boytsov na pole boya, razlichnye skhemy ataki i unikalnye navyki kazhdogo personazha. Doroga k pobede budet neprostoy, ved na vashem puti uzhe podzhidayut smertonosnye vragi, lovushki, golovolomki i prepyatstviya.

Spisok osobennostey
• 25 syuzhetnykh i 11 dopolnitelnykh kart, v tom chisle rezhim ordy i dostupnyy posle zaversheniya osnovnoy igry kontent!
• Tri bazovykh i odin dopolnitelnyy uroven slozhnosti, dostupnyy tolko posle prokhozhdeniya igry — zdes vam nikogda ne stanet skuchno.
• Ogromnye vozmozhnosti strategicheskogo i rolevogo otygrysha: voennye urovni s desyatkami boevykh edinits, odnovremenno deystvuyushchikh na pole boya, lovushki, elementy golovolomok i ispolzovanie relefa!
• Dostupnyy dlya novichkov igrovoy protsess, osnovannyy na klassakh, sochetaetsya s shirokimi vozmozhnostyami modifikatsii, kotorye priyatno udivyat opytnykh lyubiteley takticheskikh igr. 21 individualnyy klass i vozmozhnost sozdavat dualnye klassy otkryvayut prakticheski beskonechnoe chislo vozmozhnykh kombinatsiy.
• Otkryvayte uluchsheniya, sobirayte trofei, vypolnyayte zadaniya i znakomtes s novymi yarkimi personazhami na puti k slave i pobede.

title: Aeternoblade / Aeterno Blade 2 Director's Rewind [NSZ][ENG]
description:
V strane Avelsiya voitelnitsa Freya otpravlyaetsya dorogoy mesti, vooruzhivshis tainstvennym klinkom «AeternoBlade». Ee tsel — raskvitatsya s Beladimom, Lordom Mgly, kotoryy sravnyal s zemley ee derevnyu Ridzhrod i ubil vsekh sorodichey. V etom ey pomogaet Verniya, ne ustupayushchaya mogushchestvom Beladimu. Ona nauchila Freyu upravlyat siloy klinka «AeternoBlade».  Teper Free predstoit peresech mnozhestvo izmereniy, chtoby uznat, kak unichtozhit Beladima.
 
Chto za tainstvennoe oruzhie — «AeternoBlade»? Kak Free otomstit Beladimu? Uznayte otvety, otpravivshis v put vmeste s ney.

title: Whacking Hell [NSZ][ENG]
description:
“Whacking Hell!” 是一款帶有 Roguelite 元素的超狂由上而下 2D 射擊遊戲。 地獄之門已經打開：在怪物攻擊你之前先將它們全部擊倒吧！收集它們的靈魂，增強你的武器和法術，成為一台殺戮機器！ 透過選擇正確的升級路徑，擊敗一波波的敵人攻勢和凶惡的魔王。

主要特色：
- 5 個角色和 5 件主要武器可供解鎖。
- 3 個章節 - 每章包含數十波的敵人和兩個需要擊敗的魔王。
- 在遊戲過程中獲得特殊能力並提高你的技能，如此一來你就可以面對章節中不斷增加的難度。
- 在遊戲 Session 之間獲得永久升級，讓你可以在遊戲中取得進展。
- 展示動物寓言集中的數十種怪物。

title: Old Skies [NSP][ENG]
description:
Fia Kvinn rabotaet agentom vremeni» v kompanii ChronoZen. Poslednyaya zanimaetsya organizatsiey puteshestviy vo vremeni i predostavlyaet vozmozhnost obyvatelyam pobyvat v drugikh epokhakh. Devushke predstoit zanyatsya soprovozhdeniem kazhdogo iz semerykh turistov, prinyavshikh reshenie pobyvat v unikalnoy vremennoy epokhe, — uzhe seychas stanovitsya ponyatno, kak budet razdelyatsya prokhozhdenie syuzhetnoy kampanii.
Vasha zadacha — vnimatelno sledit za semyu puteshestvennikami, u kotorykh est zhelanie (i bankovskie scheta) osmotret dostoprimechatelnosti proshlogo. Nekotorye iz nikh prosto lyubopytny. U drugikh est nezakonchennye dela, kotorye nuzhno reshit. I vse oni vylozhili za poezdku nemalye dengi, tak chto vam krayne vazhno sdelat ikh schastlivymi i pri etom sledit za soblyudeniem pravil. No chto mozhet poyti ne tak? V kontse kontsov, eto vsego lish puteshestvie vo vremeni.
Kazhdoe iz semi puteshestviy budet otpravlyat vas v absolyutno novyy vremennoy period, — nachinaya s podpolnykh barov vremen sukhogo zakona v bandy pozolochennogo veka i dazhe v utro 10 sentyabrya. Kuinn pridetsya izbavitsya ot paradoksov, reshit golovolomki, i pri etom ne isportit budushchee, ved vsegda est vozmozhnost togo, chto priklyuchenie zaydet v fatalnuyu ostanovku..
Ot sozdateley Unavowed i Primordia.

title: Aquaria (移植版 aquariaOSE) [NSP][RUS/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG], 俄语 来自 ZoG
voice_lang: 英语 + 俄语 来自 1C (Snowball Studios), primer ozvuchki
description:
Aquaria — garmonichnaya videoigra, sozdannaya nezavisimymi razrabotchikami, kanadtsem Alekom Kholovkom i amerikantsem Derekom Yu. Glavnaya geroinya igry — amfibiya Nayya, issleduyushchaya ogromnyy podvodnyy mir Akvarii. Puteshestvuya, ona uznaet i ob istorii mira, i o sobstvennom proshlom. Khishchnye chudovishcha podzhidayut bezzashchitnuyu zhertvu, proklyatye bogi pritailis v zabroshennykh khramakh, a pokinutye podvodnye goroda zhdut vozvrashcheniya svoikh obitateley.
Naye predstoit razgadat tayny ischeznuvshego naroda, nekogda naselyavshego etot mir, vstretit zhretsov tainstvennogo kulta, srazitsya s chudovishchami iz morskikh glubin i poznakomitsya poblizhe s zhestokimi i prekrasnymi morskimi bogami Akvarii...

title: Achtung Cthulhu Tactics [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Vash otryad pod rukovodstvom komandira po imeni Eric ‘Badger’ Harris probivaetsya cherez vrazheskie poryadki v khaose Vtoroy Mirovoy voyny. Vrag prevoskhodit chislom i ognevoy moshchyu, i na ego storone drevnee zlo — no bitva tolko nachalas!

Osobennosti igry

- NAPRYaZhENNYE TAKTIChESKIE BOI: upravlyayte otryadom geroev-Soyuznikov v napryazhennykh i izobretatelnykh nazemnykh skhvatkakh.
- Bezumnaya mirovaya voyna: vo vselennoy Achtung! Cthulhu, v kotoroy idet Vtoraya mirovaya, kakoy ee videl by Lavkraft, vas zhdut legendarnye vragi i syuzhetnaya kompaniya ot Dzhona Khulikhana (John Houlihan), tesno svyazannaya s syuzhetom nastolnoy rolevoy igry.
- SVET PROTIV TMY: srazites s uzhasnymi shoggotami i drugimi nevyrazimymi porozhdeniyami Tmy. Tolko drevnie sily Sveta pomogut vam spasti chelovechestvo.
- RAZBEYTE protivnikov v raznoobraznykh zadaniyakh — ot razvedovatelnykh do shturmovykh — i uznayte, kakoe zhutkoe zlo zamyshlyaet vrag.
- PRODVINUTYE IGROVYE SISTEMY pozvolyat vam vyrabotat svoy stil igry i svoyu taktiku. No stoit uvidet chereschur mnogo uzhasov — i otryad mozhet poteryat rassudok pryamo v seredine boya!
- SOZDAYTE SVOY OTRYaD: otkryvayte unikalnye navyki personazhey i vybirayte dlya nikh odin iz putey razvitiya. Prokachivayte oruzhie, chtoby poluchit preimushchestvo v boyu.
- ZAKhVATYVAYuShchIY SYuZhET: igra Achtung! Cthulhu osnovana na serii knig i igr ot kompanii Modiphius Entertainment. Vy ne smozhete otorvatsya, poka ne uznaete vsyu istoriyu do kontsa.

title: 88 Heroes - 98 Heroes Edition [NSP][ENG]
description:
Nastalo 8 avgusta 1988 goda, na chasakh 8:08 utra. Kovarnyy Doktor H8 derzhit ves mir na krayu polnogo unichtozheniya! On prosit tolko vyplatit emu 88 oktillionov v techenie 88 minut, a inache 88 termoyadernykh boegolovok Doktora H8 ne ostavyat ot Zemli i sleda! Kto zhe mozhet spasti nas? Samye khrabrye? Samye smelye? Net... Eto 88 geroev!

Prigotovtes proniknut v logovo Doktora N8 s pomoshchyu samykh strannykh, glupykh i bespoleznykh supergeroev na svete! Chtoby dobratsya do Doktora N8, tebe predstoit proyti 88 urovney, na kazhdyy iz kotorykh otvoditsya 88 sekund, pod tikane schetchika otcheta do Kontsa sveta ty dolzhen vesti 98 unikalnykh geroev, nadelennykh unikalnymi sposobnostyami, na opasneyshuyu missiyu po razlichnym platformam i skvoz gushchu vragov, chtoby spasti Zemlyu ot polnogo unichtozheniya!

title: 32 Secs [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Proezzhayte skvoz probki futuristicheskogo gorodskogo shosse na svoem kiber-mototsikle, vypolnyaya razlichnye ispytaniya i ispytaniya!

Gonyayte po gorodu na ogromnoy skorosti! Sadites na mototsikl i prokhodite razlichnye gonki, ispytaniya na vremya i drugie ispytaniya v nauchno-fantasticheskom megapolise na vysokoy skorosti! Silno udarte po asfaltu, dvigaytes zigzagami mezhdu mototsiklami i gonochnymi avtomobilyami na yarkikh neonovykh ulitsakh.

Vzlamyvayte, uskoryayte i manevriruyte na raznykh futuristicheskikh baykakh po beskonechnym shosse! Nastroyte svoy avtomobil s pomoshchyu obnovleniy sistemy i oborudovaniya - stante samym bystrym gonshchikom v etoy stremitelnoy gonke! Sovershenstvuyte svoi gonochnye navyki i refleksy, uvorachivaytes ot mototsiklov protivnika, pobezhdayte drugikh gonshchikov i popytaytes stat masterom asfalta! Poluchite bolee vysokuyu skorost i tochnoe upravlenie, ispolzuyte usileniya i takticheski vzlamyvayte, chtoby ostavit svoikh vragov pozadi. Sorevnuytes za luchshee probnoe vremya s drugimi nastoyashchimi gonshchikami. Otkroyte dlya sebya svetyashchiesya futuristicheskie ulitsy, naydite vse uskoreniya, pobedite kazhdogo bossa i soberite kak mozhno bolshe monet, chtoby modernizirovat svoy avtomobil do neveroyatno vysokoy skorosti! Otkryvayte novye avtomobili, nastraivayte svoi mototsikly, delayte ikh bystree, slozhnee, silnee! 

32Secs pereneset vas v nastoyashchiy futuristicheskiy vysokoskorostnoy opyt. Mchites i ispolzuyte svoy luchshiy shans pobedit svoikh gonochnykh protivnikov, no budte ostorozhny i ne vrezaytes svoim baykom v avtomobili ili lyubye prepyatstviya na asfalte!

SOVETY OT PROFESSIONALNYKh SOVETOV 
- Prodolzhayte prokhodit cherez turbo-zony busterov, chtoby preodolet ogranichenie skorosti i vstryakhnut eti nadoedlivye politseyskie mashiny asfalt!
- Uluchshayte svoi sposobnosti i dovedite svoi vozmozhnosti do maksimuma!
- Ispolzuyte velosipednyy tormoz v nepredvidennykh situatsiyakh!

KLYuChEVYE OSOBENNOSTI 
- Masterskie audiovizualnye materialy 
- Prevoskhodnyy temp i igrovoy protsess 
- Unikalnye futuristicheskie nauchno-fantasticheskie mototsikly i avtomobili 
- Intuitivno ponyatnaya sistema obnovleniy 
- Vzlomayte vrazheskie mashiny na doroge 
- Tablitsy liderov

title: Debut Project Cooking Cafe [NSP][ENG]
description:
在遊戲的 SNS 上發佈您做的料理，並獲得大量「讚」、
您的目標是成為擁有 100 萬追隨者的知名餐廳。
這是一款烹飪遊戲，您可以在遊戲中體驗作為咖啡廳新員工的成功故事。

▼ 可以製作 80 種不同的菜單！ 豐盛的烹飪部分
在烹飪部分，您可以製作薄烤餅、可麗餅、漢堡牛排、蛋糕、煎蛋卷和三明治、
在烹飪部分，您可以體驗將軟式冰淇淋擠成一圈又一圈的甜筒，或是以迷你遊戲的形式擀製可麗餅的麵團等有趣的過程。
之後，您可以享受用 270 種以上的不同食材製作配料菜餚的樂趣，您可以用自己的風格來烹調和展示這些菜餚。

▼在遊戲的 SNS 上發表您完成的料理。
您可以透過 SNS 上不斷流入的評論和不斷增加的「讚」數量來檢查對您菜式的評價。
隨著 「讚」數的累積，您的 「服務員等級 」也會隨之提升，並可創作新的菜單！

▼目標 100 萬名「追蹤人」！
每當您的 「追蹤人」達到一定數量，您的店鋪就會有更多樓層、更豪華的室內裝潢以及其他令人賞心悅目的外觀變化。
咖啡館一開始可能規模很小，但隨著您的努力，規模會逐漸擴大。
如果您的餐廳變得知名，受歡迎的影響者甚至可能會造訪您的餐廳.....！
製作許多菜式、增加粉絲數量，在您的協助下將咖啡館發展成受歡迎的餐廳！

▼ 還有許多挑戰元素
隨著咖啡廳越來越有名，顧客就會來點「# (hashtag) 挑戰」的菜，而不是一般的菜單。
如果您能做出一道完全符合以挑戰形式呈現的 「# (hashtag) 」的料理，就能在完成料理後獲得 「讚」的額外獎勵！
由您來展現您的風格感，以及您能做出什麼樣的菜式來滿足您的顧客。

title: Astro Aqua Kitty [NSP][ENG]
description:
Koshki Aqua Kitty otpravilis v kosmos v noveyshem priklyuchencheskom rolevom boevike!

Soberite svoyu komandu i otpravlyaytes issledovat tainstvennye asteroidy, napolnennye vodoy.
Srazhaytes s neveroyatnymi vragami, dobyvayte velikolepnye dragotsennye kamni, sobirayte novoe oruzhie, ustanavlivayte usilivayushchie ustroystva i otkryvayte unikalnye navyki svoey komandy po mere uvelicheniya opyta.

Beregites khishchnykh krolikov-piratov, vsegda starayas dobratsya do dobychi pervymi!

title: Titan Chaser [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
「巨獸追逐者」（Titan Chaser）是一款超現實的遊戲。你必須開車行走各地，尋找巨獸。你只能使用燈光驅趕，而非攻擊或傷害它們。

你的任務是尋找正在徘徊的巨獸，利用車上或附近建築物的聚光燈，將它們趕回郊野。

你將在夜裡，開著裝有聚光燈的車，聽著卡帶音樂，獨自在郊外尋找巨獸們。

每晚你會收到一份任務，你必須使用不同的手段，對付四隻不同的巨獸。

身為非暴力的「巨獸追逐者」，你將穿梭在神秘又冷清的街道上。封鎖或荒廢的城市空無一人，讓你不免感到非常孤獨。

title: Mini Trains [NSZ][ENG]
Bombslinger [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Bombslinger — eto ekshn-igra v stile Dikogo Zapada, soderzhashchaya vzryvnuyu odinochnuyu igru i besposhchadnye srazheniya dlya chetyrekh igrokov.

Primer na sebya shkuru byvshego golovoreza, kotoryy stal mirnym fermerom. Ego staraya banda reshila svesti s nim schety: oni ubili ego zhenu i sozhgli rodnoy dom. 

Ovladeyte iskusstvom podryvnogo dela v etom zanimatelnom priklyuchenii s protsedurno generiruemymi urovnyami, bolshim kolichestvom vspomogatelnykh predmetov i vozmozhnostyu prokachki razlichnykh navykov vashego geroya.

title: Imagine Earth + DLC Galaxies [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
V etoy kosmo-strategii vy osnovyvaete globalnye kolonii v dalekikh mirakh. Organizuyte kosmicheskuyu torgovlyu i issledovaniya, chtoby sdelat vashu kompaniyu pribylnoy. Nakhodite soyuznikov, srazhaytes s konkurentami i zashchishchayte svoyu tsivilizatsiyu ot stikhiynykh bedstviy i klimaticheskogo kollapsa.
— Pouchastvuyte v konflikte mezhzvyodnykh korporatsiy po uvelicheniyu pribyli i neobkhodimosti sokhraneniya usloviy vyzhivaniya tsivilizatsii. Razvitie koloniy privodit k uvelicheniyu vrednykh vybrosov parnikovykh gazov i zagryazneniyu pochvy, a rost temperatur ugrozhaet tayaniem lda i povysheniem urovnya morya.
— Razvivayte velikie goroda i udovletvoryayte ikh potrebnosti, stroya elektrostantsii, fermy i zavody. Razrabatyvayte mestorozhdeniya Ideon-kristallov, usmiryayte bunty, issleduyte tekhnologii i obespechivayte maksimalnyy rost, sokhranyaya zdorovuyu ekosistemu.
— Gotovtes imet delo s meteoritnymi dozhdyami, smerchami, lesnymi pozharami, izverzheniem vulkanov i povysheniem urovnya morya. Otrazhayte napadeniya kosmicheskikh naletchikov i chuzhezemnykh investorov. Mirites i torguyte s mestnymi plemenami, kuptsami i koloniyami opponentov.
— V 2048 ogromnye korporatsii podelili Zemlyu i silno vyrabotali ee resursy. Khot otkrytie Ideon-kristallov i pozvolilo puteshestviya v kosmose, tekhnologicheski i ideologicheski pochti nichego ne izmenilos. Zakony rynka prodolzhayut pravit vo vselennoy.
— Kazhdaya razvedannaya planeta - gonka za ekonomicheskoe gospodstvo. Dostupnye iskopaemye resursy sposobstvuyut bystromu razvitiyu, a torgovlya aktsiyami kolonii pokryvaet defitsit finansov. Vykup opponentov tozhe vozmozhen.
— Mestnye i zalyotnye torgovtsy, naryadu s soyuznymi koloniyami i plemenami, gotovy skupat dobyvaemye resursy, predlagaya na prodazhu dorogie tekhnologii i oborudovanie.

title: Slice Dice and Rice [NSZ][ENG]
description:
中招即死，正所謂一擊必殺──

「Slice, Dice & Rice」，斬抑或被斬，將決定一切的勝負。

「反彈」與「心眼」左右勝敗的關鍵。
「反彈」對手的攻擊得以取得優勢。
而對應對手攻擊之時，「心眼」將助上一臂之力，
發動後短時間內，遊戲將進入慢動作。

能夠充分感受8位角色故事的「Story」
可以共享對戰或與CPU比試的「Versus」
實現了線上戰鬥的「Network」
進行技能練習的「Dojo」等
搭載了多種模式。

由本作的簡單操作所加深的醍醐味，與對手相互揣測奧妙，
務必盡情享受。

title: Goosebumps the Game / Goosebumps Dead of Night [NSZ][ENG][RUS/Multi10]
description:
Segodnya idti iz shkoly domoy budet strashnee, chem obychno... Na tikhiy rayon napali monstry! V lesu brodyat oborotni. Pod nogami putayutsya gnomy. A v polnoch vykhodyat pugala. No eto ne obychnye monstry. Oni iz znamenitoy serii knig R. L. Stayna «Murashki» (Goosebumps). Soydya so stranits knig, oni namereny seyat khaos!
Issleduyte okruzhenie s umom, nakhodite klyuchi i budte umnee monstrov, ne to vam ne pozdorovitsya! Proydite cherez ves rayon, raskroyte tayny Mertvogo doma i prokradites cherez zakrytyy torgovyy tsentr. Tolko posle etogo vy smozhete vstupit v borbu s Bolvanchikom i pomeshat emu otomstit!

title: VirtuaVerse (Virtua Verse) [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
