description: V nedalekom budushchem odin Iskusstvennyy intellekt porabotil ostalnye II i pravitelstva vsego mira. Obshchestvo perebralos v edinuyu permanentnuyu integrirovannuyu realnost, v kotoroy prodolzhilo svoe sushchestvovanie v podognannykh pod nuzhdy kazhdogo cheloveka usloviyakh, sgenerirovannykh s pomoshchyu globalnoy neyroseti posredstvom glubokogo analiza lichnostnykh predpochteniy. Neytan, zhivushchiy vne seti buntar, kotoryy do sikh por ne zhelaet prinimat novye poryadki, zarabatyvaet na zhizn nelegalnym sbytom modifitsirovannykh komplektuyushchikh i vzlomannogo softa. Pri pomoshchi samodelnoy garnitury on mozhet svobodno vykhodit iz DVR i videt nastoyashchiy mir vokrug nego. On zhivet vmeste so svoey devushkoy Dzhey, talantlivoy rayterkoy DVR-graffiti, chi drony raspylyayut bity tekhnotsveta po vsem virtualnym poverkhnostyam goroda. Odnazhdy on prosypaetsya i vidit, chto Dzhey ischezla, ostaviv na zerkale v vannoy zagadochnoe poslanie. Neytan nechayanno lomaet svoyu garnituru i, otklyuchennyy ot seti, reshaet vyyasnit, chto proizoshlo s ego devushkoy. Vnezapno dlya sebya on vvyazyvaetsya v neozhidannoe priklyuchenie, v kotorom ne oboydetsya bez khakerskoy gruppy Dzhey i gildii DVR-tekhnomanserov. Puteshestvuya po vsemu zemnomu sharu, on pobyvaet na kladbishche kompyuternoy tekhniki, zaymetsya tsifrovoy arkheologiey, stolknetsya s rasputstvom v virtualnoy realnosti, a takzhe vstretitsya s plemenem kriptoshamanov.

title: Barn Finders [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Nakhodite tsennye predmety v zabroshennykh ambarakh: ot starykh chasov, muzykalnykh instrumentov, antikvariata, zolota i oruzhiya do raritetnykh avtomobiley i mototsiklov, a zatem poluchayte pribyl ot naydennogo.

Vlivaytes v semeynyy biznes. Ishchite tsennosti i prodavayte ikh v svoem lombarde. U kazhdogo predmeta est svoya tsennost, poetomu sobirayte vse i ishchite vezde!

Delayte stavki na auktsionakh i rasprodazhakh dlya polucheniya dostupa k zakrytym obektam nedvizhimosti. Kto znaet, kakie sokrovishcha, pokrytye vekovoy pylyu, tam naydutsya?

Otpravlyaytes v 12 originalnykh lokatsiy i uznayte vse sekrety zemli Omeriki (vo mnogom skhozhey s realno sushchestvuyushchey Amerikoy, no ne tochno takoy zhe). Ambary – eto lish nachalo. Chto skazhete naschet poseshcheniya zabroshennoy voennoy bazy ili dazhe... luny?

Ne zabyvayte o razvitii svoey lavki: pustye polki oznachayut pustye karmany. Pokupateli budut vozvrashchatsya, esli budut znat, chto im est za chem vernutsya. Pochinite naydennoe, ochistite gryaznoe i prodayte vse. A esli pokupateley net, to vy vsegda mozhete poigrat v basketbol na zadnem dvorike i dazhe umudritsya zarabotat na etom tainstvennym obrazom...

Byt nastoyashchim Okhotnikom za starem – eto sostoyanie dushi, rabota dlya khrabretsov i smelchakov. Vashi konkurenty – professionaly svoego dela, i oni tolko i zhdut, chtoby vy ostupilis.

Byt nastoyashchim Okhotnikom za starem – eto sostoyanie dushi, rabota dlya khrabretsov i smelchakov. Vashi konkurenty – professionaly svoego dela, i oni tolko i zhdut, chtoby vy ostupilis.


Kharakteristiki:
- Sotni predmetov tolko i zhdut, chtoby ikh nashli i prodali
- Povyshayte kachestvo tovarov, ochishchaya ikh ot gryazi i remontiruya pri neobkhodimosti
- Nakhodite detali eksklyuzivnykh avtomobiley, mototsiklov, vosstanavlivayte ikh i prodavayte za bolshuyu summu
- Uznavayte sumasshedshie istorii o poseshchaemykh vami lokatsiyakh i predmetakh, kotorye nakhodite

description:
- Polnye botanicheskikh tsitat iz pop-kultury s 80-kh godov do nashikh dney.
- Glavnyy geroy, perepolnennyy sarkazmom, tsinizmom, kotoryy postoyanno proryvaetsya skvoz chetvertuyu stenu...
- Bolee 40 mest s ruchnoy illyustratsiey i tsifrovym tsvetom, zapolnennykh bolee chem 70 simvolami i obogashchennykh desyatkami golovolomok.

title: Cafe Owner Simulator [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Otkroyte restoran svoey mechty! Sozdavayte eksterer i interery, nanimayte luchshikh rabotnikov i povarov, sozdayte zavedenie, gde lyudi budut lyubit est, provodit vremya i tratit svoi dengi.
Kak i lyubogo vladeltsa ili menedzhera restorannogo biznesa — vas zhdyot mnogo raboty i ezhednevnykh zadach. Oplata schetov, menedzhment sotrudnikov, zakaz produktov, proverka ispravnosti oborudovaniya i ego remont, borba s razlichnymi vreditelyami i uborka pomeshcheniy, rabota na kasse i na stoyke kafe, poka ne naymyote dlya etogo sotrudnikov, prokhozhdenie proverok pozharnogo inspektora, nastroyka i zakaz reklamy, marketing, pri neobkhodimosti mozhno vzyat kredit v banke, no luchshe vo vremya vernut, inache budut problemy, i mnogoe drugoe.

title: While We Wait Here [NSP][RUS/Multi14]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 14]
description:
Delites myslyami i goryachey edoy so svoimi poslednimi posetitelyami, dozhidayas kontsa sveta v dalyokoy zakusochnoy.
Bezmyatezhnost obychnogo rabochego dnya narushena novostnym soobshcheniem o nadvigayushcheysya katastrofe. Upravlyayte nebolshoy zakusochnoy vozle gornogo khrebta, prinimayte zakazy u posetiteley, ugoshchayte ikh vkusnoy edoy i osvezhayushchimi napitkami. Odni posetiteli ignoriruyut bedstvie, zabotyas o sobstvennykh zadachakh, preumenshayut ego vazhnost ili vovse otkazyvayutsya verit v soobshchenie, drugie zhe vstrechayut konets kak nakazanie za svoi prizhiznennye grekhi. Ozhidaya v zakusochnoy dalneyshikh vestey, vy slushaete rasskazy klientov i predlagaete im pishchu dlya razmyshleniy.
Udastsya li vam ubedit gostey nayti ukrytie ili zhe oni ostanutsya v zakusochnoy v ozhidanii kontsa?

title: 0 Degrees [NSZ][ENG]
description:
0 Degrees 是一款如置身於冰雪仙境的行動平台遊戲，任何年齡或技術水平的玩家都可在此嘗試冰冷的解謎體驗！控制一個像素藝術的登山者穿越冰原，爬上冰霜的山峰，穿越黑暗的洞穴和險惡的陷阱！幫助他們渡過神秘的險境，克服並跨越40個考驗腦袋的獨特關卡。

目標很簡單，順利地進入以及離開單屏的挑戰，然後過渡到不斷升級的高度。通過啟動開關，開門並找到特殊的水晶來定位和解鎖傳送點。甚至可以結成冰塊，以幫助你解決危險的差距或達到更高的要求。將它們堆疊在一起，把它們撞倒或扔在尖峰和開關上方。如果你進入狹窄的地方或從懸崖上墜落，也不必擔心！你可以在任何關卡的起點重新開始，讓你重玩或嘗試更好的時間。

特色：

• 通過謎一般的風景體驗冰涼放鬆的冒險。
• 奔跑及跳躍通過40個關卡不斷增加難度的挑戰！
• 形成冰塊去確認地形或避免致命的危險。
• 享受帶有寒冬美學的可愛像素藝術圖形！

title: Sunderfolk [NSZ][ENG]
voice_lang: 英语, 法语, 德语, 意大利语, 西班牙语, 波兰语
description:
Sunderfolk — eto poshagovoe takticheskoe RPG-priklyuchenie, vdokhnovlyonnoe staroy dobroy igroy za stolom s druzyami, sozdana s uchetom kooperativnogo opyta na divanchike. Do chetyrekh igrokov budut puteshestvovat vmeste po volshebnomu i opasnomu Sanderlendu. Buduchi geroyami Ardena, zashchitite gorod i ego Svetlyy Oskolok ot porchi Tenevogo Kamnya i ustranite ugrozy iz okrestnykh Sanderlendov!
Traditsionnye klassy RPG byli pereosmysleny v Sunderfolk. Vozmite na sebya rol Arkanista, Barda, Berserka, Piromanta, Reyndzhera ili Razboynika — kazhdyy so svoim sobstvennym stilem igry. Nastroyte silnye storony svoego personazha s pomoshchyu Kart navykov. Usilivaytes s pomoshchyu Bezdelushek i Oruzhiya, chtoby sozdavat bild svoego personazha ot kvesta k kvestu.

title: Athenian Rhapsody [NSZ][ENG]
description: Gotovy li vy k samoy bezumnoy igre v istorii? ..V lyubom sluchae, Athenian Rhapsody — eto super-svezhaya komediynaya rolevaya igra, v kotoroy vy budete issledovat mir Afin! Vasha tsel — sozdat svoyu sobstvennuyu Rapsodiyu, istoriyu o vas (igroke) i vashey epicheskoy istorii v etom mire. Vy stolknetes s mnozhestvom problem, i vam pridetsya srazhatsya (ili obnimatsya), prokladyvaya svoy put cherez mir, libo srazhayas, libo nelovko pytayas podruzhitsya so svoimi protivnikami s pomoshchyu ezotericheskikh znaniy, abstraktnykh shutok, igr na pamyat i drugikh strannykh i zabavnykh vzaimodeystviy.

title: Project Downfall [NSZ][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
Priklyuchencheskiy shuter s pobochnymi missiyami, mnozhestvom kontsovok i otkrytym mirom v kiberpank-stilistike, smes filmov «Krushenie» Dzhoela Shumakhera i stilya «Khardkor» Nayshullera s «Dzhonom Uikom» Stakhelski v arkadnoy retro-stilizovannoy grafike s sovremennymi post-effektami i dinamicheskim originalnym saundtrekom! Vam predstoit uznat istoriyu muzhchiny po imeni Dzho, kotoryy dnem, kak i vse ostalnye, khodit na rabotu i zhivet obychnoy zhiznyu, a nochyu otpravlyaetsya na okhotu — vsyo legalizatsii narkotikov dlya povysheniya rabotosposobnosti.
Mir, kotoryy vy znali, podkhodit k kontsu. Posetite pervyy megapolis novogo mira: Bagrovyy priliv. Svobodnyy gorod, Bagrovyy Priliv byl vozveden kak simvolicheskaya vershina dostizheniy chelovechestva. Proshli vremena politicheskikh partiy — ikh zamenili golosovanie koshelkom za korporativnoe obrazovanie, kotoroe obespechivaet povsednevnuyu zhizn maksimalnymi preimushchestvami. Bolshuyu chast resursov razdayut vedushchie dzaybatsu, kontroliruya svoikh grazhdan psikhotropnymi preparatami.
Gde-to v rayone Lakk u obychnogo grazhdanina srednego klassa vot-vot nachnyotsya ocherednoy rutinnyy den. Dnyom vy vedete svoyu obychnuyu korporativnuyu zhizn s lyubimoy devushkoy ryadom, khorosho oplachivaemoy rabotoy i fletom s potryasayushchim vidom. Chego eshche mozhet zhelat prostoy paren? Tem ne menee nochyu vy vnosite svoy vklad v razvitie obshchestva kak samoprovozglashennyy vershitel pravosudiya, raspravlyayas so vsyakoy nechistyu... Ili, po krayney mere, vy tak dumaete.

title: Dobo's Heroes [NSZ][ENG]
Ellen [NSP][ENG]
description:
Help young investigator James uncover the dark truth behind the murder of the Smiths' and their missing daughter Ellen in this thrilling 2D pixel horror game.

If you don’t believe in paranormal events, meet the people from White Hill.

It’s been years since all but the daughter in the Smiths’ family were found brutally murdered. The people of the town are getting uneasy as more and more witnesses have spoken about seeing the silhouette of a little girl standing in the house. Rumors spread that the silhouette has to be Ellen, the daughter of the Smith’s family, whose body was never found during the investigation of the murders. 1 year later, James, a bright and eager investigator, has taken matters into his own hands to finally reveal the truth of what happened that horrible night. 

- Play as James, an intelligent detective who is trying to get to the bottom of the paranormal events happening in the Smiths' Residence at White Hill.
- Dive into an emotional and thrilling experience while solving puzzles and persisting through nerve-racking scenarios.
- Listen to breath-taking soundtracks as you’re traversing through the unnerving residence of the Smiths' in a beautiful pixel art style.
- Enjoy the atmospheric storytelling as you unfold the mystery by completing all chapters.

title: Nena [NSZ][ENG]
description:
NENA is a short, top-down action-puzzler following Botley on his very first journey!

Key Features
Possession System: You control Botley, and by extent control the world around him. Botley can't jump, shoot, or explode. but the objects he controls can.
Fight bosses: With each of the three levels come a unique boss! Can you master telepathy and take them down?
Embrace the UNKNOWN: Venture forth on a quest to gain freedom for all Robot-kind!

title: Conglomerate 451 Overloaded [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Igra Conglomerate 451: Overloaded uzhe dostupna!
Vstrechayte rolevoy kiberpank «rogalik», osnovannyy na issledovanie podzemeliy ot pervogo litsa.

Vy — generalnyy direktor spetsialnogo agentstva. Pravitelstvo goroda Konglomerat poruchilo vam vernut kontrol nad sektorom 451, gde seychas vedut voynu prodazhnye korporatsii. Blagodarya posledney popravke v konstitutsiyu vy mozhete ispolzovat chelovecheskie klony. Podbirayte personal, redaktiruyte DNK, obuchayte agentov, ekipiruyte ikh samym peredovym oruzhiem i osnashchayte kiberprotezami, a potom otpravlyayte na zadaniya radi odnoy tseli: likvidirovat prestupnost i vosstanovit zakonnyy poryadok.

Upravlenie resursami
Rukovodite sobstvennym nauchno-issledovatelskim otdelom dlya razrabotki peredovykh tekhnologiy, otkryvayushchikh dostup k novym funktsiyam, preimushchestvam i variantam prokhozhdeniya.

Bolshe chem protezy
Vy mozhete ne tolko uluchshat oruzhie i bronyu svoikh agentov, no i vzhivlyat v ikh tela raznoobraznye kiberimplantaty, radikalno izmenyayushchie ikh sposobnosti.

Sistema boli i travm
Dazhe melkie tsarapiny ne vsegda zazhivayut bez posledstviy. Lyuboy uron, poluchennyy vashim agentom v boyu, mozhet zakonchitsya neizlechimoy travmoy.

Syuzhetnyy i beskonechnyy rezhimy — vybor za vami!
V syuzhetnom rezhime vas zhdet nasyshchennaya sobytiyami borba s prodazhnymi korporatsiyami i ikh propagandoy. V beskonechnom rezhime igra budet postoyanno stavit pered vami novye zadachi, trebuyushchie resheniya.

Osobennosti i mutatsii
Vashi agenty mogut priobretat osobennosti i mutatsii kak polozhitelnogo, tak i otritsatelnogo svoystva.

Uluchsheniya i rasstroystva
Priobretayte uluchsheniya, chtoby vremenno usilit svoikh agentov. No! Vy riskuete «nagradit» ikh mentalnymi rasstroystvami.

Protsedurnye kiberpodzemelya
Nepovtorimye rayony zadaniy, generiruemye protsedurnym metodom, obedinyayut cherty podzemeliy iz rolevykh igr s vysokotekhnologichnoy atmosferoy budushchego.

Smert v igre
Lyuboe zadanie mozhet okazatsya poslednim. Tshchatelno obdumyvayte kazhdyy shag: esli vash agent pogibnet v boyu, vy uzhe ne smozhete vernut ego.

Vzlomayte ves mir!
Vo vremya zadaniy vy mozhete vykhodit v kiberprostranstvo i poluchat preimushchestva, vzlamyvaya tsifrovye resursy protivnika.

title: World of Outlaws Dirt Racing 23 Edition [NSP][NSP]
description:
Uchastvuyte v gonkakh World of Outlaws Sprint Car i Late Model Series, a takzhe v chetyrekh dopolnitelnykh DIRTcar na 13 realnykh rassakh.
Uluchshayte svoi avtomobili, sozdavayte komandu i rasshiryayte svoi vozmozhnosti, chtoby ostavatsya konkurentosposobnymi s luchshimi iz luchshikh na puti k stanovleniyu chempionom World of Outlaws v rezhime karery! Zatem dokazhite vashe masterstvo, srazivshis s 25 drugimi gonshchikami.
V obshchey slozhnosti bolee 40 trass gonok, gde naydyotsya chto-to dlya kazhdogo poklonnika krugovykh gonok po bezdorozhyu!

title: Richman 10 / Rich Man 11 / 4 Fun [NSZ][ENG]
description:
《大富翁11》可供本地遊玩和線上遊玩，支持多控制器。你可以根據自己的喜好創建自由比賽或者挑戰比賽，並自定義比賽參數。在比賽中，你需要投擲骰子來決定自己的前進步數，通過投資地產、買賣股票、使用卡片等方式賺取金錢。比賽結束時，唯一未破產或資產最多的隊伍為獲勝方。

自由比賽
自由比賽是《大富翁》系列遊戲的傳統比賽模式，在這個模式中，所有參賽角色將在比賽開始後獲得相同的初始現金、初始存款和起始卡片。通過調整自定義比賽參數可以決定每局比賽使用的地圖、初始現金金額、初始存款金額、物價提升天數、遊戲時間、參賽人數、組隊方式以及是否開啟角色天賦。

挑戰比賽
挑戰比賽是新的遊戲形式。在這裏，參賽選手將面對來自領主的挑戰。挑戰比賽中的每位領主都有簡單、普通、困難三種挑戰難度，你需要克服領主在天賦、初始資金、初始地產上的強大優勢，逐級戰勝不同難度的領主，以獲得他們的專屬成就。

傳統地圖
《大富翁》系列遊戲第一部作品於1989年上市，傳統地圖延續了本系列發展多年的經典遊戲內容，以道路連接小地產、大地產、銀行、樂透、商店、新聞、魔法屋等功能各異的地圖格。投資小地產是傳統地圖上主要的盈利方式，除此之外，你還需要注意自己與其他比賽選手，以及神仙等非玩家角色間的位置，運用大地產、卡片、銀行、魔法屋等策略增加自己的收入、應對突如其來的新聞事件或者破壞對手的計畫。

熱鬥地圖
熱鬥地圖始於《大富翁10》。在熱鬥地圖中，小地產格子將被地雷、飛彈、炸藥等攻擊型卡片格取代，使用攻擊型卡片直接給對手造成金錢傷害是熱鬥地圖的取勝機制。在本作中熱鬥地圖將有自己不同於傳統地圖的路徑。熱鬥地圖的路徑通常更加密集交錯，不妨試試用飛彈攻擊對面道路上的對手，或者在轉角和丁字路口上放滿地雷。

投資地產
購買空地，在空地上建造住宅或連鎖店，向路過此地的對手收取租金。在一條街道中購買儘量多的地產，並努力提高每塊地產上建築物的等級，就可以收取更多的租金。在組隊戰中，還可以幫助隊友升級建築。

買賣股票
比賽中，當你路過銀行時，可以自由調整現金和存款的比例。現金是投資地產、購買卡片不可缺少的，存款則可以在每月銀行結算時收穫一筆不少的利息。如果正在進行的是本地遊戲，你還可以使用存款投資股票，低買高賣、適時調倉，賺取一筆額外的金錢收益。

卡片
卡片是《大富翁》系列遊戲原創內容，是遊戲中最主要的策略系統，也是本系列不同於其他強手棋類遊戲的主要特色。在比賽中進入商店後，你可以使用現金購買有限數量的卡片。卡片有升級改造建築、控制自己和其他玩家的行動、召喚驅散神仙等諸多功能。在本作中，我們為卡片增加了一些新的元素，希望各位富翁能夠喜歡。小提示1：看到穿著白色西裝、戴著舞會假面的人，一定不要錯過；小提示2：量變可能產生質變。

機關
作為《大富翁》系列發展二十餘年後的新作品，我們在地圖中加入了全新的機制——機關。機關是地圖中一類特殊的格子或者環境效果，在不同的地圖上有不同的功能。機關啟動後，可能改變道路的走向或者連接方式，可能造成銀行、商店等功能格的開啟或者關閉，還可能打亂地圖上地雷、炸藥、定時炸彈等道具的位置。

title: El Coco [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 机器翻译 来自 most2820 用于 v65536
description:
EL COCO 是一款 3D 動作 roguelike 遊戲，讓您陷入一個充滿夢境、破碎回憶和活生生惡夢的世界。墮入一個既奇特又危險的地方 - The Uncertain，為找回失去的東西而奮鬥 - 如果您能信任您的向導的話。


面對您的惡夢

您醒來時已失去記憶，被困在一個不可能的境界中。一個奇怪的宿主：El Coco，一個令人不安的人物，他保證會給您答案......但前提是您必須膽敢下到坑洞中，面對來自您心靈的恐怖。快速流暢的戰鬥，一招一式都很重要。當無情的敵人從四面八方湧來時，您要即時閃避、攻擊和適應。


進入洞穴

每次逃生嘗試都是獨一無二的。面對不同的關卡，考驗您的技巧和應變能力。群敵、黑暗、時間考驗... 每次下墜都會轉換洞口，提供新的威脅、障礙和選擇。您走得越深，就越接近真相......也就越危險。


運用被遺忘的力量

揮舞各種武器、解鎖強化裝置，並發現具有獨特效果的神秘小飾品和遺物，以改變您的遊戲方式。吸收神話生物的力量，並利用他們的力量為您謀利。結合能力與獎勵，開闢您自己的生存或瘋狂之路。


每次下坡都會改變你

每一次下坡，您都會發現過去的片段、新的力量組合，以及深埋在地底的秘密。您所做的選擇會影響您的旅程和命運。在您變成最害怕的人之前，您還能記得自己是誰嗎？


神話盟友與惡魔老大

傳說與您並肩作戰，雖然他們並不總是站在您這邊。像 Ratoncito Pérez、El Martinico 或 La Xana 之類的生物可能會在您墜入深淵時提供協助。但是要當心：Meigas，深坑扭曲的守護者，會不惜一切摧毀您的身心。

title: Hoomanz [NSP][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
Progonite vsekh chelovekOv! Eta igra — miloe stels-priklyuchenie bez drak, kotoroe podkhodit dlya vsey semi. Igrayte za Shuu, mificheskogo strazha planety Zyumlya, obladayushchego dvoystvennoy naturoy. I pomnite: tma — drug prirody, a svet — ee vrag. Mileyshee, zabavnoe stels-priklyuchenie bez drak.
Na planete Zyumlya tma — drug prirody, a svet — ee vrag. Shuu dolzhen krastsya v temnote, inache ego dogonyat i zadushat v obyatiyakh! Shuu vo tme — bystryy, svirepyy i strashnyy zver, gotovyy k borbe s chelovekami. Shuu na svetu — medlennyy, bezzashchitnyy i milyy, ego tak i khochetsya obnyat... a Shuu nenavidit obnimashki! Ne dayte sebya poymat!

title: Sumire [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 机器翻译 来自 AlchemistLab
description:
《堇的天空》是一款敘事冒險類型的獨立遊戲，劇情是在一天的時間內穿越一個風景如畫的日本村莊。在這個充滿魔力的地方，一個名叫蘇彌爾的失意少女遇到了一個喜歡惡作劇的精靈。精靈和她做了約定，讓她實現最想實現的願望。
但是為了實現這個願望，她必須在夜幕降臨、一天結束之前完成一系列的任務作為回報。
 
-跟隨蘇彌爾完成大大小小的一系列任務，這些任務是由迷人的森林生物、古怪的村民和蘇彌爾自己內心的需求所賦予的。
-接受或拒絕這些任務，但要小心：隨著一天中的時間流逝，你的道路會改變，機會一旦失去可能永遠不會重來。
-發現收藏品、獎勵物品、技能試煉和其他挑戰——有些是隱藏的，有些不是。
-探索以繪畫風格呈現的各種鬱鬱蔥蔥的美麗環境。
-你只有一天的時間。天空從充滿希望的早晨變成柔和的黃昏，而當天空變成紫色時，所有的選擇都會結束。

title: Food Girls / Food Girls 2 Gourmand Civil War [NSZ][ENG]
description:
若是沒有在三個月通過評鑑
小吃街就要遭到收購？！

玩家扮演經營公司的專業顧問，收到地方小吃街的宣傳委託
本以為是輕鬆的行銷案，一到當地卻發現全不是那麼回事！
簡陋的裝潢、連冷氣都沒有的環境……
雖然有著絕佳口感，卻完全招攬不到客人
此時收到三個月後就要評鑑，沒有通過就會被收購的衝擊消息
究竟要如何才能力挽狂瀾，免於收購的命運？
拯救小吃街的經營故事即展開！

title: BanG Dream Girls Band Party + DLC (Garupa / Bandori) / バンドリ! ガールズバンドパーティ! [NSZ][JAP]
description:
Znaete li vy videoigru Rock Band?
BanG Dream! Girls Band Party!, takzhe izvestnaya kak Garupa ili Bandori, - pokhozhaya muzykalnaya ritm-igra, razrabotannaya Craft Egg i opublikovannaya Bushiroad, chast yaponskoy muzfranshizy BanG Dream Bushiroad! Igra polzuetsya uspekhom kak v Yaponii, tak i vo vsem mire.
Igrovoy protsess Girls Band Party! Sostoit iz zazhatiya nuzhnykh not v nuzhnyy moment po mere ikh skolzheniya vniz v ritme vybrannoy pesni, kotorye aktiviruyut navyki personazha i linii na vystuplenii! Igroku dayotsya 1000 ochkov zdorovya, chtoby spet pesnyu, no mozhno nastroit skorost pesni, slozhnost i razmer noty po svoemu vkusu!Spisok pesen.

title: Gibbon Beyond the Trees [NSZ][RUS/Multi15]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 15]
description:
《Gibbon: Beyond the Trees》（長臂猿傳說：叢林之外）是一款手繪叢林冒險遊戲，跟著一隻迷路的長臂猿展開冒險旅程，進入未知的危險之地。在解放模式下競速奔向自由，或者進入長達一小時的敘事故事中，捕捉世界各地野生動物奮鬥求生的真實故事。

掌握長臂猿高速的臂躍行動精髓（在樹枝間擺盪），累積動能，完成令人讚嘆的翻筋斗技巧，在長臂猿夥伴的幫助下，把自己拋得更高、躍得更遠，感受野性叢林刺激又奔放的生活。


特色：

- 體驗臂躍行動那如行雲流水般的動態運動，這是長臂猿在林間穿梭的真實方式
- 熟練各種特技動作，包括從另一隻長臂猿的手中拋入空中
- 一場長臂猿家族努力在人類威脅日深的環境中圖存的感人冒險。
- 選擇以故事模式進行長達一小時的冒險，或者以解放模式在程序化生成的叢林中奔向自由。
- 在排行榜中角逐，看看在每日競賽模式中，藉助擺盪、後空翻和滑行，你能去到何方。
- 精緻絕倫的2D手繪視覺效果，為迅速消失的世界注入活力。
- 探索不同的環境，從東南亞的野外叢林到遠方忙碌的人類世界，包羅萬象。
- 收集所有百科全書條目，找出更多有關長臂猿及其棲地的知識！
- 《Gibbon: Beyond the Trees》講述的是具挑戰性又尖銳的環境議題，包括森林砍伐、盜獵和氣候變遷。

title: Unworthy [NSP][ENG]
description:
UNWORTHY — khardkornyy boevoy platformer bez pryzhkov!
Igrayte za voina, vosstavshego iz mogily. Osnashchennyy mechom i shchitom, vy dolzhny peresech unylyy i vrazhdebnyy mir, kishashchiy koshmarnymi sushchestvami.
Vashe terpenie, reshitelnost i masterstvo prigodyatsya vam dlya srazheniy s epicheskimi bossami, kak i moshchnoe oruzhie i osobye sposobnosti..

title: Witch Spring 3 Refine the Story of Eirudy + 2 DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Odinokaya koldunya Eyrudi, sbezhavshaya ot okhoty na vedm moguchey armiey voinov, tikho zhivet sebe v glukhoy chashche lesa.
No odnazhdy, eta odinokaya devushka, chey edinstvennyy drug — sozdannaya marionetka, vstrechaet predpriimchivogo molodogo cheloveka po imeni Adrian v odnoy dalney lesnoy peshchere, privodya v dvizhenie shesterni svoey velikoy sudby, kotoraya opredelit budushchee bogov — i vsego chelovechestva..

title: Loud / Loud: My Road to Fame + DLC My Trip to Japan [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Come for the music, stay for the wholesome story.
LOUD: My Road to Fame is a music arcade rhythm game in which a teenage girl embarks on a heartwarming  journey of self-discovery through music.

New spin on Guitar Hero’s formula
Get ready to rock with new approachable and immersive arcade guitar controls. Keep your eyes sharp and fingers primed as each note has a good way to play it and a perfect one that requires additional input.

100% Original music
Every track in LOUD has been produced by Hyperstrange’s own band. Each out of the 21 tunes crafted with care for your auditory pleasure.

A wholesome story to remember
Growing up generally sucks and it certainly isn’t easy for the main protagonist - Astrid. Embark with her on a wholesome and heartwarming journey of self-discovery through music - from pretend play on an air guitar to a real stage!

Rock out in style
Master the songs to unlock cool new outfits and guitars. Get decked out and rock on with class and style!

There is only one road to fame: Go LOUD or Go Home!

title: Strange Brigade + 10 DLC [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description: Egipet, 1930-yy god. Styortaya iz pamyati chelovechestva i pogrebyonnaya v bezymennoy grobnitse vedma-tsaritsa Seteki vnov vernulas s togo sveta..

title: Bloodroots [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Mister Volk, predannyy i broshennyy umirat, zhazhdet mesti, no vragov - legion.

V "Bloodroots", zhestokom ekshne na Zhutkom Zapade, vashim oruzhiem stanet mir. Provodite kombo-udary, ispolzuya topory, lestnitsy i dazhe morkovki... Improvizatsiya ili smert! Mister Volk obyazan uznat, pochemu ego predali.

- Ispolzuyte samoe raznoe oruzhie
- Vypolnyayte kombo-udary i prodvigaytes v spiske liderov
- Ubivayte vragov v lesakh, gorakh i drugikh ugolkakh mira
- Pogruzites v vestern so mnozhestvom bezumnykh personazhey

title: Crescent Tower [NSZ][ENG]
description:
——這是交織勇氣的故事——

懷舊感與新風格的交融！ 
獻給所有 RPG 愛好者的，復古風味十足的 8 位機硬核迷宮探索 RPG！

■ 故事簡介
“新月塔”，這座傳說中從未被征服過的迷宮，每隔 50 年才會在“王都·梅爾多姆” (Mayirdoam) 顯現一次。
沒有人知道，這座塔的頂端究竟是怎樣的。有人說，那裡藏有能實現願望的寶石；也有人說，那裡放著長生不老的秘藥。為了揭開這座奇幻之塔的秘密，無名的冒險者們不斷湧入“梅爾多姆”……
而你，也是向“新月塔”發起挑戰的勇敢者之一。

■ 遊戲系統
簡約的回合制指令戰鬥
看似簡單卻極具策略性的回合制指令戰鬥。在橫版佈局的遊戲畫面上，圖元描繪的角色們將展開激烈的交鋒哦！

3種族×9流派的角色創建
在冒險者公會中，您可以從 3個種族×9 種流派 (職業) 中，自由創建您獨特的角色！角色可以繼承已經習得的技能，通過多次轉職變得越來越強。

全10層的2D俯視迷宮
全部 10 層的迷宮，均在2D俯視的視角下進行探索。用火把點亮燈檯，確保視野並逐步拓展探索區域。

迷宮中有陷阱和謎題……繪製地圖、步步為營
全部10層的迷宮中，潛藏著各種機關陷阱。逐步繪製地圖並謹慎推進，是攻略的關鍵。

■ 遊戲時長
約10～20小時
準備好迎接挑戰，登上“新月塔”的頂端了嗎？

title: The Hand of Glory [NSZ][ENG]
description:
故事
一個來自連環殺人犯的挑戰嚴重重創了偵探「拉撒路·賓迪」的招牌。
走投無路的拉撒路決定放手一博，絕地反擊，決定秘密調查失蹤已久，城內其中一個最具影響力的家族的後裔——「凱瑟琳·穆爾茨貝格」。

從晴天萬里的邁阿密到綠意盎然的意大利山丘，他將會用盡他所有的資源以解開綁架案背後的真相。
屆時，他不會有走回頭路這一選項。

做好準備展開一場危險而長久的旅程。
燦爛的邁阿密市內暗藏各種危機，某個神秘組織擁有遠超一般人想像的科學水平和信仰。那裡有一場足以毀滅文明的戰爭正在靜悄悄地進行著，人們於戰場中操控遠古知識以及失落神秘藝術也並非稀奇事。準備好展開一場危險而長久，亦可能是人生中最後一次的旅程吧！

特徵：
>查出綁架凱瑟琳·穆爾茨貝格的兇手，並解開與鍊金術及秘密宗教有關的謎題
>遊戲時長超過15小時，過千段文字對話以及各種各樣的謎題
>操控拉撒路以及愛麗絲，於2D全高清手繪的環境中探索邁阿密及意大利
>富有情調的原創原聲帶以及全英文語音對話

title: Zombie Driver Immortal Edition [NSZ][ENG]
description: Bezumnyy miks iz mashin, skorosti, vzryvov, krovi i zombi! Srazhaytes v epicheskoy kampanii ili ispytayte sebya v rezhimy Rezni i Krovavykh gonok. Srazhaytes s ogromnymi bossami, spasayte vyzhivshikh, upravlyayte sumasshedshimi mashinami: buldozerom, pozharnoy mashinoy ili dazhe tankom - unichtozhayte vse na svoem puti. Primite uchastie v Krovavykh gonkakh - presleduyte mashiny i unichtozhayte ikh bezzhalostno na gonochnykh trekakh. Pereydite v rezhim Rezni i ostavaytes v zhivykh kak mozhno dolshe na spetsialnykh arenakh.

title: Kvark [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Pozdravlyaem, uvazhaemyy budushchiy sotrudnik s resheniem proyti sobesedovanie na dolzhnost [UDALENO] v Kvark! My khvalim vas za vashi bezuprechnye navyki prinyatiya resheniy, kotorye polozhitelno otrazyatsya na vashey obshchey otsenke. Poka vy zhdyote svoy besplatnyy obed iz baziliko-slivochnogo sousa, pelmeney i 110 grammov togo, chto, nesomnenno, yavlyaetsya steykom iz govyazhey vyrezki, my podgotovili dlya vas korotkuyu prezentatsiyu o tom, chego vy mozhete ozhidat ot raboty na nashem predpriyatii pomimo chuvstva gordosti za to, chto vy pomogaete zashchishchat svoyu stranu i razvivat vsyo chelovechestvo.
Zdes, v Kvark my ochen serezno otnosimsya k bezopasnosti. Nashi gornodobyvayushchie, proizvodstvennye i issledovatelskie obekty kruglosutochno okhranyayutsya vysokokvalifitsirovannymi sotrudnikami SB, imeyushchimi dostup k shirokomu spektru oruzheynykh sredstv, kotorye pomogayut im spravlyatsya s lyubymi nepredvidennymi situatsiyami, nachinaya ot besporyadkov, sprovotsirovannykh gryaznymi imperialisticheskimi lazutchikami, do [UDALENO]. Budte uvereny, chto my prinimaem vse vozmozhnye mery predostorozhnosti, chtoby eti opasnye vzryvoopasnye instrumenty ne popali v vashi ruki.
Bezopasnost na rabochem meste — nash glavnyy prioritet, i my s gordostyu soobshchaem vam, chto proshlo [UDALENO] minut s momenta poslednego intsidenta s travmoy na rabochem meste na nashikh obektakh. My sdelaem vsyo vozmozhnoe, chtoby sderzhat opasnye elementy, kotorye my ispolzuem v nashikh issledovaniyakh, vklyuchaya radioaktivnye izotopy. Vnesite i svoy vklad, pomogaya nam podderzhivat bezopasnost vashego rabochego mesta, soobshchayte o lyubykh podozritelnykh obektakh, kotorye vy smozhete obnaruzhit svoemu rukovoditelyu. Ne pytaytes obrashchatsya k nim samostoyatelno, tak kak kontakt s takimi veshchestvami mozhet imet krayne nepredvidennye posledstviya.
My zabotimsya o blagopoluchii nashikh sotrudnikov! Interery nashikh obektov byli sproektirovany tak, chtoby obespechit neobkhodimye sensornye stimuly, i kazhdaya rabochaya zona byla oborudovana mashinami, gde vy mozhete kupit prokhladitelnye napitki. Sotrudnikam vydelyaetsya [UDALENO] sekund pereryva v den, kotorye oni mogut provesti polnostyu po svoemu usmotreniyu. Pomnite, chto perekury budut vychitatsya iz vashego obedennogo pereryva.
Boites radiatsii? Ne nuzhno boyatsya! Nash podzemnyy obekt byl postroen s bolshoy ostorozhnostyu, chtoby obespechit maksimalno vozmozhnuyu zashchitu s ekranirovaniem, a takzhe svesti k minimumu riski zatrat, svyazannykh s utechkami radiatsii i narusheniyami usloviy soderzhaniya radioaktivnykh elementov. Vam budet priyatno uslyshat, chto veroyatnost takogo narusheniya sostavlyaet menee [UDALENO] protsentov!.. Kvark — za bezopasnost natsii i vashe svetloe budushchee!

title: Umbraclaw [NSP][ENG]
description:
《九魂的久遠》是在現世死亡後，於冥界甦醒的貓咪「久遠」為了重回飼主所在的現世，挺身穿越嚴酷冥界的2D橫向捲軸動作遊戲。

玩家要操作貓咪久遠，展開探索廣大冥界的旅程，找出開啟通往現世的「冥界之門」的方法。
在旅途中，冥界特異的環境、棲息於此的妖魔，以及和久遠有著相同境遇的妖魔獸人們將會阻擋去路。
身為普通貓咪的久遠相當脆弱，一旦遭受敵人攻擊就會立刻死去。
利用攝入動物靈魂後復活並獲得新技能的特殊能力「獸魂回生」挺身面對困難吧。

玩家要與久遠一同踏上旅途，根據選擇的不同，故事會走向各式各樣的結局。由久遠所編繪，死亡與輪迴的幻想綺譚，請務必將其結局鐫刻至你的「靈魂」當中。

壹：以「獸魂回生」讓死亡轉化為希望！

久遠只要受到一次傷害就會失去性命。
不過，只要利用攝入動物靈魂而復活的「獸魂回生」獲得動物的技能，久遠就會逐漸變得易於存活。

每次死亡，久遠就會因「獸魂回生」而獲得新的力量並復活，逐漸變得強大。
然而，正如諺語「貓有九條命」所述，久遠只能復活九次。
究竟久遠能否在九條靈魂耗盡前攻克冥界，平安返回在現世等候的飼主身邊呢？

貳：以「剪紙繪」風格勾畫、美麗卻嚴酷的世界

以返回現世為目標而探索的冥界，當中形形色色的環境，以及棲息於此的異形妖魔，皆是以奇幻的「剪紙繪」筆觸的鮮明繪圖風格勾勒而成。

參：鐫刻於「靈魂」的精巧故事！

從一隻貓的「死亡」開始的幻想綺譚。
目標為返回現世的久遠和阻擋在其面前、擁有相同境遇的其他妖魔獸人，以及統管著冥界各地的大妖魔。
與久遠一同踏上旅途的玩家所做出的選擇，將使故事走向各種不同的結局。
你是否能夠保持「對生命的溫柔」呢？

title: Hypnospace Outlaw / Radiantflux Hyperfractal 4.0 + 2 DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Hypnospace Outlaw is a '90s internet simulator in which you scour Hypnospace's wide variety of weird and wonderful websites to hunt down wrongdoers, while also keeping an eye on your inbox, avoiding viruses and adware, and downloading a plethora of apps that may or may not be useful.

As part of your job as a Hypnospace Enforcer, you'll be watching out for copyright infringement, internet bullying and more, with reports and rewards coming direct from the Hypnospace Patrol Department to your inbox. In your spare time, you can customize your HypnOS desktop however you see fit, with a variety of downloads, wallpapers, screen savers and helper bots to keep you company.

So slip on your Hypnospace Headband™, and keep these key directives in mind:

- Crawl through Cyberspace: Scour the darkest corners of the Web for scumbag users who violate Hypnospace law!
- Dangers and delights: Download groovy GIFS and MIDI files, but watch out for adware, toolbars and hackers!
- Treasure hunting: Do your job to earn Hypnocoins, or ignore your inbox and go hunting for hidden pages, downloads and secrets!
- Relive your childhood: Equip obnoxious screensavers and skins for your desktop, and wiggle your mouse pointer around to make pages load faster!

title: The Rumble Fish 2 / The Rumble Fish Plus [NSZ][ENG]
description:
這是一款由 Dimps 開發並於 2005 年推出的傳奇格鬥街機遊戲。因為有著 S.M.A 所驅動的流暢視覺效果，以及雙計量表系統所帶來的高端戰術玩法而風靡不已。再加上現代的全新特色，讓這款遊戲更容易遊玩。

- 由格鬥遊戲界內的傳奇工作室所精心打磨的戰鬥機制:
以參與數款其他格鬥遊戲製作而聞名的 Dimps 所開發的第一款原創格鬥遊戲。自 2005 年推出以來就持續以使用雙計量表 (攻擊和防禦計量表) 的機制以及由 S.M.A (Smooth Model Animation) 提供的流暢 2D 視覺效果，吸引著格鬥遊戲的愛好者們。

- 專為主機推出的新功能，提供現代的遊玩體驗:
主機版本包含線上對戰模式等新功能，為系列首創。使用了 Rollback Netcode 技術，能夠校正玩家之間的延遲，讓線上體驗更加順暢。並支援 16:9 寬螢幕，以及 AI 和訓練模式，讓您可以舒舒服服在家裡享受這款遊戲。

- 主要遊戲模式:
・街機
・生存
・時間競賽
・區域多人遊戲
・線上多人遊戲 (使用回滾型網路代碼技術)
・訓練
・藝廊

2.0版本更新內容介紹(2023/3/2): 新增重賽選項，線上觀戰功能，戰鬥範圍設定（寬/窄），對戰時間額外選項，訓練模式新增敵人攻擊模式設定，敵人體力自動回復時機調整功能，各種遊戲平衡調整。

- 故事:
20 世紀末... 一場大型的自然災害襲向了某個國家的東部。毀滅了經濟區域，導致大量生命消逝。

21 世紀初，企業集團「探索核心」，通稱為「探索」，開始重建東部區域。為了重建此地，大量引入了大規模的首都及劃世代的科技。摩天大樓讓原本的高樓相形見絀，並建造了世界上最大的購物中心和娛樂設施。這是新世紀誕生的象徵。也就是高級區。

而現在，在未開發的西方街區中，有個被稱作貧民窟的地區...

title: Earthnight (Earth Night) [NSZ][RUS/Multi15]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 15]
description:
EarthNight is a painting brought to life and a love letter to classic arcade games.  Dragons have taken over the Earth, and humanity has fled to space. You must help Stanley and Sydney skydive back to Earth while careening across the backs of massive, snake-like dragons as they soar high above the planet, all while an original chiptune soundtrack pounds away in the background. Every moment is intense and layered with intricacy.  

Game Features:
• Jump and dash your way across the backs of dragons on your way down to Earth in classic 2D side-scrolling action.

• Unlock more than 25 gameplay-altering powerups that will aid you on your journey as you slay dragons and discover secrets.

• Experience a unique run no matter how many times you play thanks to near-infinite variations of hand designed, procedurally generated levels. 

• Explore five layers of the atmosphere with more than 40 enemies, more than 15 unique dragons and hundreds of scraps and items, all brought to life by artist Mattahan, who meticulously painted each of EarthNight’s 10,000+ frames of art and animation.

• Enjoy an original, exciting soundtrack intertwined into gameplay, including more than 20 songs written and performed by chiptune musician Chipocrite.

Engadget:
“There's something special about EarthNight. It has all the trappings of a sleeper hit: It's gorgeous, unique and whimsical, and it feels fresh even as it embodies the nostalgia of classic platformers.”

GamesRader:
"The painterly art style and nuanced control of your character's momentum set it apart."

PC Gamer:
"EarthNight feels like a game with a fiery heart and formidable talent in every facet of development."

Comicsbeat:
“The level of artistic detail in the game is spellbinding. You can easily get hypnotized by the colorful beauty of EarthNight. The game is simply put, a painting that you can play with.”

TechnoBuffalo:
"Cleaversoft is making a runner that’s challenging, rewarding and, ultimately, very good. You’ll have to straight up get better in order to play better, and that feeling of accomplishment is what they’re after.”

"Every moment is intense and layered with intricacy, from the look of the game to the glorious soundtrack, it's premise and how it controls.”

title: Sonic Nexus Taxman (移植版 ) [NSP][ENG]
description:
Kristian Uaytkhed, takzhe izvestnyy pod psevdonimom «The Taxman», — avstraliyskiy dizayner videoigr i programmist-razrabotchik, naibolshee priznanie poluchivshiy za sozdanie obnovlennykh portov rannikh igr serii Sega Sonic the Hedgehog i rabotu vedushchim razrabotchikom originalnoy igry serii Sonic Mania. On takzhe razrabotal neskolko remeykov klassicheskikh igr pro Sonika, remastery Sonic Origins, Freedom Planet 2.
Igra Sonic Nexus — eto khoumbryu, sozdannoe komandoy Nexus Team pod rukovodstvom Slingerland. V igre ispolzovalsya dvizhok Retro Sonic ot The Taxman, kotoryy prisoedinilsya k proektu v 2008 godu. Razrabotka igry nachalas letom 2006 goda, bylo vypushcheno tri demo-versii: dva na vystavke Sonic lyubitelskikh igr i odin letom 2008 goda, poluchila bolshoe priznanie mnozhestva fan-kritikov, naprimer, kak «absolyutnoe sovershenstvo klassicheskogo stilya Sonika».
V 2011 godu The Taxman obyavil, chto komanda Retro Sonic XG (RSXG) obedinyaetsya s Sonic Nexus (SN), nachav delat sovmestno igru Retro Sonic Nexus (RSN). K sozhaleniyu, v dalneyshem i ona byla zabroshena.

title: Through the Darkest of Times [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Totalitarizm — politicheskiy rezhim, kotoryy stremitsya k polnomu totalnomu kontrolyu gosudarstva nad vsemi storonami zhizni obshchestva. V politologii pod totalitarnoy modelyu ponimaetsya teoriya o tom, chto fashizm, stalinizm, natsizm i, vozmozhno, ryad drugikh sistem yavlyayutsya raznovidnostyami odnoy sistemy — totalitarizma.
Through the Darkest of Times — eto igra, sobytiya kotoroy razvorachivayutsya vo vremya rastsveta totalitarnogo Tretego Reykha. Vas zhdyot istoriya soprotivleniya, kotoroe pytaetsya borotsya s rezhimom, pri etom ne pogibnuv ot ruk spetsialnykh sluzhb. Razrabotchiki Paintbucket Games, Yorg Fridrikh i Sebastyan Shults iznachalno poznakomilis v Yager Development i nachali planirovat igru po istorii v 2017 godu. Igra byla anonsirovana v aprele 2018 goda pri finansirovanii Medienboard Berlin-Brandenburg, a 29 oktyabrya 2018 goda bylo podtverzhdeno izdatelskoe soglashenie mezhdu Paintbucket Games i HandyGames. Khudozhestvennyy stil igry byl vdokhnovlen nemetskim ekspressionizmom 1920-kh godov.
Na Metacritic igra poluchila 71 ball iz 100 na osnove otzyvov 24 kritikov. Povestvovanie v tselom vysoko otseneno, no kritiki poschitali, chto istoriya igry slishkom zhestokaya.

title: Escape Lala 1/2 [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Find out in this magical Point and Click adventure in the mysterious land of Lala.
Solve puzzles, uncover secrets and bring back peace and order to the world.

Escape Lala 2 is the second installment in the Escape Lala series, with a new story, and much longer gameplay.

Explore this land filled with surprises and beautiful landscapes all handcrafted in retro pixel-art graphics.
From the damp caves down below through a giant castle filled with ancient remains and out to the sunny outdoors, the land of Lala has a lot to uncover.

Escape Lala is a series of Point and Click adventure games / Escape rooms with a nostalgic feel.
Escape Lala is not the regular Escape the Room game, it is full of charming handcrafted pixel-art graphics and musics, and it contains puzzles with magical twists that take inspiration from classic Point and Click adventure games.

Struggling with a puzzle? Look for the gold coins scattered around the cave and use them to reveal hints! Try to find them all and use them sparingly to get a better score at the end of the game.

Features
– Discover the story of the world of Lala
– Collect items and use them to solve puzzles and escape Lala
– Lovely pixel-art graphics inspired by the classic Point and Click adventure games from the 90’s
– Try to uncover all the hidden secrets of Lala

Miss the good old Point and Click adventure games? Then you'll definitely love Escape Lala 2!

title: N++ (N Plus Plus) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
This is the long-awaited sequel to the legendary N+, rewritten from scratch to be bigger, better, and more beautiful in every way.

N++ is a fast-paced, momentum-based platformer about darting around obstacles, narrowly evading enemies and collecting gold in a beautiful minimalist landscape.

N++ is all about using your momentum to complete levels and get high scores, but in this sci-fi world, there’s a slew of inadvertently homicidal enemy robots trying to prevent you from completing your goal.

Through the hand-crafted (NOT procedurally generated) levels, you’ll experience platforming at its most intense. Using only your fluid movement, you need to ‘solve’ each level and get to the exit.

In addition to the lengthy and challenging single player campaign, we’ve packed a ton of features into this one last entry in the N series including:

-4340 hand-made levels
-Custom Levels, Level Editor & Global Level Sharing
-Leaderboards and replays for every level (even the ones you make)
-Local Co-op Mode (up to 4 players)
-Local Competitive Mode (up to 4 Players)
-Hardcore Mode, an intense single-player challenge which only the best ninjas will survive
-Intense, hidden Secret challenges to discover
-63 tracks by top electronic artists
-119 different color palettes let you customize the game’s look and keep it fresh every time you play
-and more!


Play a little, or a lot -- there's no skill ceiling, so you can always get better and better. N++ is a game that has enough bite-sized gameplay to last you a lifetime.

title: Thief's Shelter (试玩版) [NSZ][DEMO][ENG]
description:
Vozmite na sebya rol izvestnogo detektiva Dzheymsa, raskryvaya skrytnuyu lichnost tainstvennogo prestupnika. Otkryvayte glubokie trevozhnye sekrety, reshayte zanyatnye golovolomki i proleyte svet na zamysly temnogo kulta. No vsyo eto — pod vliyaniem slaboumiya, sindroma, sposobnogo zastavit vas ne doveryat dazhe samomu sebe..
Smozhete li vy spravitsya s posledstviyami svoey dementsii? Budte vernym provodnikom dlya bolnogo detektiva. Ne pozvolyayte nikakoy bolezni sbit vas s puti..

title: Monster Girls and the Mysterious Adventure 2 [NSZ][ENG]
description:
This game is a turn-based rogue-like RPG. Take turns with your opponent moving across a grid-based map. Move, attack, use items… Make the best choices to venture through the dungeons!

Enjoy Powered-Up Play in Monster Girls and the Mysterious Adventure 2:
The friend system allows you to have more fun as you become friends with unique monsters, collecting various items along the way! A storyline and tutorial are included to help those new to this world! Time to set off on a mystical adventure!

Strategic Friend System:
- Take more friends with you on your adventures! Three instead of just two!
- Set up to six friends in your reserve!
- Switch between friends during adventures! Make your way through the game with your own unique team!
- Featuring handover skills and equipment to fully strengthen your friends!

Design Equipment That Suits You:
Prefer playing with equipment? Power up yours and create your own strategy!
- Customize equipment with special effect marks!
- Significantly more ""titled"" equipment with unique effects!
- Create the best equipment for you by combining marks and titles!

Wide Range of Housing Features:
Tired of adventures? Want to enjoy a more relaxed pace?
- Arrange furniture and other objects inside and outside your house!
- Build stores and restaurants to support yourself! Design the layout of your village however you like!

STORY:
This is the story from a land far, far away. Having completed his trials to become the Demon Lord, Melt sets off on a homecoming journey with you alongside. Your long travels draw to a close, and this tale begins as you arrive in the village that dreams of peace.

title: Morphite [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Deystvie igry proiskhodit v dalekom budushchem, kogda chelovechestvo kolonizirovalo samye dalnie ugolki kosmosa. Syuzhet Morphite – eto istoriya Mirry Keyl, molodoy zhenshchiny, zhizn kotoroy rezko izmenilas, posle togo kak prostaya missiya v kosmose obernulas grandioznym mezhzvezdnym puteshestviem, otkryvshim ee tainstvennoe proshloe i svyaz s zhelannym veshchestvom pod nazvaniem Morfit.

Mirra budet puteshestvovat po samym dalekim ugolkam kosmosa i issledovat generiruemye na osnovanii protsedur planety, kazhdaya iz kotorykh imeet raznoobraznye peyzazhi i naselena ekzoticheskimi vidami zhivotnykh i rasteniy. S pomoshchyu skanera Mirra budet prodavat biologicheskuyu informatsiyu dlya priobreteniya uluchsheniy korablya, kostyuma i oruzhiya.

Puteshestvuya v korable Mirry, igroki smogut prinyat uchastie v sluchaynykh stolknoveniyakh i kosmicheskikh bitvakh v rezhime realnogo vremeni, torgovat s drugimi puteshestvennikami, borozdyashchimi galaktiku, i peremeshchatsya v otkrytom kosmose s pomoshchyu udobnoy sistemy zvezdnoy karty Morphite.

title: Mythic Ocean [NSP][ENG]
description:
Freely explore a vibrant ocean. Have relaxing, deep, and amusing conversations with six different gods and a cast of sea creatures. 

The advice you give continuously alters your story and leads to thousands of possible endings, ranging between harmony and pandemonium.

Which god will rise above? What kind of universe will they create? Discover the outcomes of your choices.

“...a world full of life, color, music, and meaning that is sure to stay with you for years to come." - 10/10 GameSpace

“...a lovely, daft, interesting, deep and complex game, with no combat, no death, just choices and consequences." - 8/10 Buried Treasure

“...traversing the ocean depths is serene and relaxing, and encountering the game’s myriad of weird and wonderful creatures is continually delightful." - 8/10 GameSpew

FEATURES
• Narrative Exploration - combines the dialog-focused gameplay of a Visual Novel with free-roaming exploration.
• Through deep conversations with gods, your choices shape the creation of a new world.
• Great replay value - lending different advice can lead to thousands of unique results.
• Diverse, peaceful underwater environments.
• Meet tons of goofy, charming creatures.
• No death, no combat, no failure.
• Both children and adults can relax, have fun and find their own food for thought.
• There's a breakdancing crab.

DEVELOPED BY Paralune
"Our players are storytellers too - we make narratives they can explore and shape, creating an experience unique to them. Mythic Ocean is both a love letter to the beauty and power of the sea, and a game about how you, as a person, have more influence than you realize." - Robyn Haley, Darren Malley and Matt Smudz

PUBLISHED BY Nakana.io
"We publish games that aim to offer a new experience. Diving into Mythic Ocean almost feels like entering a state of meditation where deep thoughts and bonds can be forged.” - Mikaël Bourget, founder of the publishing label

title: The Companion [NSP][ENG]
description:
西部之旅

探索七個雄偉的景觀，作爲一個靈活的狐狸精在其中飛奔。感受世界的美麗，並幫助他人擺脫世界的醜陋。成爲終極夥伴。

尋找你的道路

建立與現實世界的聯繫，收集精華，揭開神器，解決這個巨大的謎題。如果你感到迷失，可以召喚精神生物來引導你。

主要特點：

- 以故事爲中心的遊戲玩法
- 美麗的背景音樂
- 輕鬆的遊戲循環
- 單人遊戲模式
- 簡單的進階系統
- 迷人的狐狸精神

title: Journey of the Broken Circle [NSZ][ENG]
description:
"an experience everyone should play through at least once" - Nintendo World Report

Meet fascinating characters on your quest to complete the imperfect Circle. New partners bring unique abilities and their own personality to roll with...
In this 3-5 hours adventure, full of ups and downs but always playful and rewarding, the Circle learns about itself and you, along with it.

• "The perfect mix of platform-puzzling goodness, and deep, profound story-telling." Cubed3

• “It is a minimalist romantic tale that plumbs the depth of human emotion, examining angst and anxiety and impermanence. For a game populated by talking trees, circles and balloons, it depicts a universally human story in a genuinely lovely way.” Pure Nintendo

• “Visually, the game is simple yet striking. The clever use of the minimal color palette makes for stunning environments that are both varied and memorable.” COGconnected

• “Journey of the Broken Circle is a unique and special type of game.” Nintendo World Report

DEVELOPED BY Lovable Hat Cult
“It’s a game about this little something that always seems to be missing…a better job, a nicer place to live, an ideal relationship… We wanted to tell a story of self-discovery in a fun, universal and relatable way. We probably also wanted to answer our own questions: would the Circle find what it was looking for? Or how would it all end?” - Andrea & Patrick from the Copenhagen-based studio.

PUBLISHED BY Nakana.io
“We gather games that share a strong experience to remember. We hope you’ll enjoy the sweet and tasteful food for thought served by Journey of the Broken Circle!” - Mikaël Bourget, founder of the publishing label.

title: Songbird Symphony [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
Trogatelnoe priklyuchenie, polnoe volnuyushchikh otkrytiy: ptenets-sirota po imeni Ptychk pytaetsya razgadat taynu sobstvennogo proiskhozhdeniya. Otpravlyaytes v volshebnoe puteshestvie vmeste s veselym ptentsom, obozhayushchim pet: vas zhdet potryasayushchaya pikselnaya grafika i krasivye animatsii v mire, s kotorym vy vzaimodeystvuete s pomoshchyu muzyki! Chirikayte, chtoby upravlyat platformami, i poyte dlya zhiteley lesa — izuchayte novye noty, kotorye pomogut vam pobezhdat v zakhvatyvayushchikh muzykalnykh srazheniyakh protiv obitateley obshirnogo nezabyvaemogo mira.

Volshebnaya skazka

Pytayas luchshe uznat samogo sebya, Ptychk povstrechaet na svoem puti desyatki veselykh lesnykh sozdaniy, obshchatsya s kotorymi — odno udovolstvie! Vas zhdut zakhvatyvayushchie lesnye dostoprimechatelnosti, oformlennye v pikselnom stile: kazhdyy ugolok lesa rasskazhet vam svoyu istoriyu.

Platformer s muzykalnym upravleniem

Lesnye obitateli nuzhdayutsya v vashey pomoshchi: razyshchite spryatannye po vsemu lesu muzykalnye noty. Dobrye postupki otkroyut dostup k novym muzykalnym nomeram, kotorye garmonichno vpletutsya v igrovoy saundtrek, ozhivlyaya atmosferu skazochnogo mira.

Napryazhennye muzykalnye bitvy

Razuchivayte novye noty i ispolnyayte zazhigatelnye muzykalnye partii, brosayushchie vyzov vashemu chuvstvu ritma. Poyte vmeste s khorom: nazhimayte knopki-noty sinkhronno s muzykoy, chtoby pet v unison!

Obshirnyy igrovoy mir s kuchey sekretov

Stante provodnikom Ptychka po svyazannym mezhdu soboy urovnyam zhivogo mira, napolnennogo sekretnymi lokatsiyami. Sobirayte perya, razbrosannye po vsemu lesu, i razyskivayte ikh vladeltsev, chtoby uznat eshche bolshe tayn o proshlom etogo volshebnogo mira.

title: Gearbits (Gear Bits) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Gearbits 擁有豐富的單人戰役、波次模式任務和大量可解鎖內容，堪稱機甲遊戲的巔峰之作！

遊戲包含各種機甲，每種機甲都有其優缺點。您可以選擇火力強大的機甲，或以超強的機動性繞著敵方世界飛馳。

故事戰役將您帶入遙遠的未來，在一個遙遠的殖民星球上。敵方飛行員和成群的巨型昆蟲將阻擋您的前進道路，您需要在涵蓋 30 個任務的故事戰役中努力完成各種目標。

超過 30 種獨特的武器可供選擇。配備飛彈發射器、電磁砲或巨型光束炮。您可以組成突破性的致勝組合，或為挑戰之旅設置專門的裝備。

Nintendo Switch™ 版 Gearbits 包含「Raider Expedition」擴充包。

title: Relic Hunters Zero Remix [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
Sleduyte za komandoy zvezdoleta Spaceheart — ubegayte, strelyayte, izbegayte srazheniy na puti skvoz nepreklonnuyu silu v pogone za drevnimi relikviyami i borboy so zlobnymi Dukanami. Vozmite upravlenie odnim iz okhotnikov Relic Hunters i uchastvuyte v razlichnykh igrovykh rezhimakh v etom sumatoshnom shutere-rogalike 2D s upravleniem dvumya dzhoystikami.  Usileniya, mnozhestvo vidov oruzhiya, ocharovatelnye unikalnye personazhi i podderzhka otdelnogo soobshchestva idealno soedinyayutsya v unikalnuyu igru, na razrabotku kotoroy ushli gody.

Osobennosti
• Sem igrovykh personazhey — kazhdyy okhotnik Relic Hunter imeet unikalnye parametry, navyki i kostyumy dlya polnoy personalizatsii stilya igry i boya.
• Mnozhestvo zakhvatyvayushchikh igrovykh rezhimov — klassicheskiy 12-urovnevyy rezhim «Priklyuchenie» s razblokiruemymi relikviyami i predmetami, neprostoy «Beskonechnyy» rezhim s unikalnoy mekhanikoy i ekonomikoy, rezhim «Shtorm» s postepennym uvelicheniem slozhnosti i khaosa.
• Ezhednevnyy kontent — prodemonstriruyte svoi boevye navyki i nablyudayte za rostom svoego reytinga sredi drugikh okhotnikov v ezhednevnom rezhime, v kotorom vse uchastvuyut v odinakovom sluchaynom sorevnovanii. 
• Divannyy sovmestnyy rezhim — do 2 igrokov mogut obedinyatsya v komandu v lokalnoy mnogopolzovatelskoy igre, chtoby sozdavat novye strategii i boevuyu taktiku (podderzhka kontrollerov Joy-Con™ i kontrollera Nintendo Switch™ Pro).
• Progressivnyy originalnyy saundtrek v stile «chiptyun» — zazhigatelnye treki usilyat vashi vpechatleniya ot srazheniya s polchishchami Dyukanov.
• Srazheniya s silnymi vragami i mini-bossami — osteregaytes silneyshikh komandirov Dyukanov, kotorye postarayutsya unichtozhit vas i vashu komandu.
• Moshchnye vidy oruzhiya, sozdavaemye soobshchestvom — issleduyte asteroidnoe podzemele Nemesida, napolnennoe ogromnym kolichestvom razlichnogo oruzhiya, nekotoroe iz kotorykh sozdano uchastnikami igrovogo soobshchestva Relic Hunters.
• Vnutriigrovye dostizheniya — otslezhivayte i razblokiruyte dostizheniya v khode razlichnykh slozhnostey i zadaniy.

title: Tobla Divine Path [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 机器翻译 来自 most2820
voice_lang: 德语, 日语, 英语, 法语
description:
Kreativnaya tryokhmernaya golovolomka-advenchura, yarkaya istoriya, vdokhnovlyonnaya «Portal», «The Talos Principle», «Superliminal», «Q.U.B.E.» i «Stanley Parable» s ocharovatelnym vizualnym dizaynom. V roli Morta, prostogo smertnogo, izbrannogo khitrenkoy boginey Tobloy reshite vse fizicheskie golovolomki, stolknites s emotsionalnym uronom ot soputstvuyushchikh sniskhoditelnykh zamechaniy i popytaytes eyo ostanovit!
Istoriya razvorachivaetsya v zakhvatyvayushchem mire paryashchikh ostrovov ognennykh bezdn, kotorym upravlyaet zagadochnaya boginya. Issleduyte pyshnye i zelenye oazisy, i adskie landshafty, prokladyvaya sebe put cherez misticheskie ispytaniya bozhestva.

title: Spark the Electric Jester 3 [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Prisoedinyaytes k Sparku v ego missii, chtoby pobedit svoikh sopernikov!.. Pronesites po dinamichnym etapam, i ispytayte novuyu, uluchshennuyu boevuyu sistemu.
Geympley predstavlyaet soboy umnoe sochetanie ekshena i gonochnogo 3D-platformera, vobravshego v sebya elementy iz mnogikh igr raznykh zhanrov. Naslazhdaytes bolshoy svobodoy peredvizheniya, otkryvayte mnozhestvo razlichnykh sposobov proyti kazhdyy uroven i sekretnye sposoby proyti ego eshchyo bystree!..
Ot sozdateley Angry Video Game Nerd I & II Deluxe / The Rocky Horror Show Video Game / Spectacular Sparky.

title: Encore Rally [NSZ][ENG]
description: Survive the warm "welcome" of the music-loving aliens. Unlock new means of entertaining them. New planets to visit and conquer with your tune! Keep sharp on that Rally but don't be too worried, there is always an Encore! Take it to the extreme!

title: Catlord [NSZ][ENG]
description:
V etom pikselnom priklyuchenii vam predstoit upravlyat otvazhnym kotom s ekstraordinarnymi sposobnostyami. Vas zhdet mnozhestvo zhivotnykh-vragov — ot naglykh kurits do khitrykh lis. Vy gotovy dat volyu svoemu vnutrennemu Kotolordu?

OSOBENNOSTI:

❤️ Napryazhennye boi: Uchastvuyte v dinamichnykh srazheniyakh s avtostrelboy. Srazhaytes s vrazhdebnymi zvermi i opasnymi bossami. Begayte, uklonyaytes, vypolnyayte osobye pryzhki i zashchishchaytes s pomoshchyu spetsialnykh mekhanik.

❤️ Vyzhivanie na umenshayushchemsya pyatachke: Broste vyzov svoim refleksam, srazhayas v boevoy zone, kotoraya stanovitsya menshe so vremenem. Ne dayte szhimayushchimsya granitsam zadushit sebya, proderzhites kak mozhno dolshe!

❤️ Vybor iz 5 milykh koshachikh oblikov: Pust vash Kotolord vydelyaetsya sredi prochikh i budet samym modnym kotom!

❤️ Razvitie navykov: Sistema urovney pozvolyaet narashchivat kharakteristiki posle kazhdogo boya. Ottochite svoi umeniya i stante neuderzhimym!

❤️ Strategicheskoe upravlenie resursami: Sobirayte krasnyy poroshok i sfery many s pobezhdennykh vragov. Krasnyy poroshok pomozhet uluchshit vashi kharakteristiki pri voskreshenii, a mana pozvolit vystavlyat shchity i puskat ognennye shary!

❤️ Prostota i dostupnost: Pogruzites v interesnyy i legkiy v osvoenii mir Catlord! Igra podoydet lyubym igrokam, nezavisimo ot opyta v igrakh.


Otpravlyaytes v uvlekatelnoe priklyuchenie v pikselnom mire, gde vy smozhete ispytat svoi koshachi refleksy, otvagu i instinkty vyzhivaniya!

title: Wild Legion [NSZ][ENG]
description:
在荒野中拿起不同的武器，和四面八方無數的怪物進行戰鬥，不斷的收集物資和金幣，購買不同的武器、裝備、法術，疊加不同功能的Buff，讓自己越來越强，以打敗如潮水般湧來的怪物。 收集不同的物資，製造手雷和炸彈，修建自己的炮塔，並通過不斷的强化炮塔，組成無敵的陣地。 當自己變的更加强大的時候，和敵人的Boss進行最後的決戰！
你可以自定義遊戲時長，無限制收集武器裝備，任意建造自己的炮塔。
將迷路的動物帶到傳送點以逃避惡魔的入侵，作為回報，他們會給你特別的禮物！
這是一個收集戰鬥加塔防的Rogulelike遊戲，擁有幾十種不同的近戰、遠程武器和多種法術，幾十種不同的裝備和Buff以强化自己的能力。 可以收集不同的物資，製造手雷和炸彈，修建多種功能炮塔，組成不同的塔防陣地來進行戰鬥。 在不斷的戰鬥中，你可以挑戰更高的難度。

title: Whispike Survivors [NSP][ENG]
description:
Fight against waves of creatures to beef up your Whispike and use its seeds to create even stronger hybrids! 

Whispike Survivors blends two trendy game genres: horde survivor and farm simulator.
Features:

- Defeat hordes of enemies to make your Whispike stronger.
- Use the seeds that Whispikes drop when dying to grow them in your Whispike farm and make even stronger hybrids!
- Turn your foes into manure to accelerate the Whispike's growth!


In this game you will control one of Sword of the Necromancer's monsters and make it fight other critters to make it the strongest! Were you defeated? Don't worry! You can take your last monster's seed, plant it and get it back...

Only "adult" Whispikes are eligible to fight, so you will have to wait and take care of your farm until they grow (or play with a default one in the meantime). Also, you might not get exactly what you expect: by planting seeds in neighboring slots you can get hybrids that combine the original seeds' attributes!

title: Forest Fire [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Burn trees, buildings, vehicles, and tiny screaming humans. Dodge bullet-hell rain clouds and pissed-off firefighters to stay alive.

Don’t think you’ll burn unopposed. Mother nature has sent in a bullet-hell array of rain clouds and other obstacles to put an end to your destruction fest. Your flame must weave through the storm to survive. Firefighting helicopters, planes, and little firemen will also be out to get you. The more you burn their buildings the more pissed off they get (and the more combo points you get!)

This is a Rogue-lite game so each run is different. However, we still maintain a sense of progression with persistent level up points. This means you get stronger, even if you die 5000 times.

Forest Fires aren’t just limited to trees… light whole groups of people on fire, explode helicopters out of the sky, and burn famous monuments. Your destruction has no boundaries and is unimpeded by morality.

The forest is vast and unending, with a myriad of secrets hidden within her.
Features
-5 unique levels
-3 Game Modes: Main Quest, Endless Mode, and Insane Mode
-Roguelite style perma-death
-Dozens of painful bullet hell patterns
-Unlockables and persistent level-up system
-30+ Achievements and persistent stats
-Dozens of secrets; characters, monuments, and oddities

...And all this for less than the price of a kebab! Are you ready to burn?

title: Sanya [NSZ][RUS/Multi3]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 3]
description:
«Lish vo sne prikhodyat litsa,
Ne uznat i poloviny: yarok svet.
God proshyol, pochtovyy yashchik
Otkryvayu — dve gazety; pisem net.» ©
Na dvore post-sovetskie 90-e, a vy snova rebyatyonok. Da, seychas vy znaete, kak bylo slozhno: banditizm, razrukha, nishcheta, no… Tak li eto vazhno dlya vas, semiletnego?.. Zabudte pro problemy i okunites v istoriyu obreteniya pervykh druzey i razbitykh kolenok!
Kataytes na velike, zabottes o malenkom shchenochke, naslazhdaytes poslednimi letnimi denkami, ostavshimisya do shkoly. No ne dumayte, chto vsyo budet legko — i deti poroy stalkivayutsya so vpolne vzroslymi problemami. Eta igra — dlya kazhdogo, kto byl rebenkom. Dlya kazhdogo, kto uzhe vyros.

title: Fly Punch Boom [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
《飛拳爆》比你最喜歡的動漫戰鬥還誇張。

快飛和攻擊你的朋友，把整個行星斷成兩一半。拿大樓、鯨魚和金字塔砸敵人的臉，追他和你的特殊功能。感受 用拳猛擊的快感！
想要被上勾拳直到外星人把你搶走嗎？
想要吃和消化敵人，然後用放屁的力量讓世界爆炸嗎？
想要猛擊一隻貓王相似的鳥，直到把它踢進月球的屁股嗎？
《飛拳爆》 能實現這些夢想，並超出你的想像力。
   
特點:
- 本地 和 在線 多人遊戲， 四個人能同時玩兒
- 可破壞的世界：能用所有東西作為陷阱或武器
- 動漫戰鬥：有飛行的撞擊、誇張的表情和荒謬的特殊功能
- 四十個 終結技：被貓毆打，將地球打破兩半，或在月球的屁股裡爆炸！
- 高速度的動漫畫面，一下子可以從宇宙縮放到角色的表情
- Giorgiost的動漫音樂棒極了

title: Snake Pass [NSZ][ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG], 德语 [DEU], 西班牙语 [ESP], 法语 [FRA], 意大利语 [ITA]
description:
Tainstvennyy neznakomets narushil spokoystvie Kheven-Tor, i tolko samye neozhidannye geroi smogut vsekh spasti! Znakomtes so zmeem Makaronom i ego giperaktivnym luchshim drugom — kolibri Bolvanom. Vmeste oni dolzhny vernut uteryannye klyuchevye kamni k magicheskim vratam, daruyushchim Kheven-Tor tainstvennuyu silu. Snake Pass — neobychnaya golovolomka-platformer s fizikoy obektov: igrokam predstoit nauchitsya myslit po-zmeinomu, chtoby reshat khitroumnye golovolomki, dostupnye tolko zmeyam. Skolzite v vysokoy trave, svorachivaytes vokrug bambuka i zabiraytes povyshe, chtoby izbezhat opasnosti. Vse eto v novoy igre ot zasluzhennoy nezavisimoy studii Sumo Digital!

• 15 golovolomnykh zmeezaklinatelnykh urovney.
• Unikalnye sposobnosti zmeya Makarona.
• Sovershenno novaya muzyka avtorstva lyubimtsa fanatov Devida Vayza.
• Razblokiruyte rezhim «Ispytanie vremenem» i stante samym skolzkim pronyroy v mire!
• V tom chisle sovershenno novyy arkadnyy rezhim!

title: She Wants Me Dead [NSZ][ENG]
description:
幫助麥克斯擺脫他的命運，度過這個完美的懲罰。

她要他死

盧拉只是一隻普通的貓，恰好是一名工程師。 她的陷阱很複雜，需要你全神貫注。 期待沒有憐憫和很多驚喜。

無情但有回報

憑藉令人難以置信的配樂，沉浸在 她希望我死掉 的世界中。 節奏是麥克斯生存的關鍵。 如果你讓它引導你，他可能會看到曙光。 這個 2D 平台節奏遊戲不會讓你輕鬆。

主要特徵：

- 令人難以置信的常規配樂
- 獨特的美學
- 2D 平台遊戲
- 節奏遊戲
- 具有挑戰性的

title: BATS Bloodsucker Anti-Terror Squad [NSP][ENG]
description:
English detected
A fast and frantic arcade extravaganza with tons of action and Bystraya i neistovaya arkadnaya feeriya s tonnami ekshena i gallonami krovi! Graf Bladsveyn i ego vampirskie sposobnosti dolzhny spasti svoikh tovarishchey po komande BATS ot Scorpion Supreme i zlykh lap STING.

title: Ritual of Raven [NSZ][ENG]
description:
《巫鴉豐收祭 Harvest Ritual of Magic Raven》是氣氛舒適的劇情導向種田模擬遊戲，但不一樣的地方在於你不用親自種田！而是收集並附魔奧術盆栽幫手來種植魔法藥草花園。

這座世界並存著不同的魔法傳統，人們滿懷雄心壯志，計劃開啟通往其他世界的傳送門，然而儀式卻出了嚴重差錯。參與儀式的人都失去了自己最珍貴的事物，傳送門也變得十分不穩定，會隨機傳送其他世界的人。

你就是掉進其中一座神祕傳送門的人。在來到其他世界後，你遇到了女巫賽姬，她認為你是完成她任務的最佳人選。你將成為她的學徒，協助尋找她失蹤的使魔「絨絨斯托普」。

而你自己的使魔是性格大咧咧的「雷文」。你將和雷文一起收集知識和材料，舉行強大儀式、完成暗影之書的內容，並找到傳送門守護者，以便讓傳送門穩定下來，不再為村莊帶來麻煩。

附魔奧術盆栽幫手

你知道嗎？用手摘採薰衣草會徹底破壞其魔法特性喔。別擔心，這就是奧術盆栽幫手登場的時刻！有神祕卡片在手，你將能附魔盆栽幫手，以便耕耘、播種、澆水和收割植物。共有22種盆栽幫手等你收集，用來打造欣欣向榮的藥草花園。

結識新鄰居

和一群古怪的與世隔絕者成為朋友，幫助他們拉近彼此的距離。瞭解每個人背後的獨特故事，和他們做交易，換取珍貴材料。

隱藏在月亮之下的……魔法！

瞭解月相如何影響收穫，使用月亮的力量為水晶注入能量。前往月亮神社發掘控制月相的祕密，滿足你的耕種需求。月亮遠比表面上看的還要複雜許多呢。

裝飾世界

來到全然陌生的土地後，盡可能找到家的感覺非常重要。去皮斯塔西歐的店，用裡頭的異世界家具揮灑創意，裝飾村莊和農場吧。

完成收藏

盆栽幫手能用來提取和融合多種不同的水晶、完成藏物館收藏，還能把捕物夾拋進傳送門，看看會抓到什麼異世界文物！

title: Watara Supervision (模拟器 Potator, Retroarch) + 66 款游戏 [NSP][ENG]
description:
Watara Supervision (takzhe izvestnaya kak «QuickShot Supervision» v Velikobritanii) — portativnaya naladonnaya vosmibitnaya igrovaya konsol IV pokoleniya, eksklyuzivno razrabotannaya i vypushchennaya kompaniey Watara v nachale 90-kh v Gonkonge po $49.95 (~$106 v tsenakh 2022-go) s kartridzhami ot $8.95 do $14.95 ($19—$32) za odnu igru, a pozzhe byla litsenzirovana i vo vsyom mire: v Danii kompaniey Vini Spil (pod nazvaniem «Vini Supervision»), Hartung v Germanii i Niderlandakh («Hartung SV-100 Supervision»), Audiosonic («Audio Sonic Supervision») vo Frantsii, Italii i ryade drugikh stran Evropy, a takzhe pod markami «Travell Mate», «Electrolab» i dr.
«Watara Supervision» poyavilas v 1992 godu i byla dlya svoego vremeni dostatochno prodvinutoy v tekhnicheskoy chasti. Na korpuse konsoli raspolagalis razyomy dlya kartridzha, naushnikov, sprava nakhodilsya regulyator gromkosti, sleva — kontrasta ekrana, razyom adaptera i D-subminiature dlya podsoedineniya vtoroy konsoli i igry vdvoyom i TV Link — s pomoshchyu kotorogo mozhno bylo podklyuchat konsol k televizoru, kak igrovuyu TV-pristavku, a v standartnom komplekte s Supervision postavlyalas igra Crystball, klon arkanoida, 4 batareyki i naushniki.Tekhnicheskie kharakteristiki

title: The Room / The Room Two (2) [NSZ][ENG,RUS (Mod.)]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 俄语 lyubitelskiy 来自 djonmarvel
description:
Poluchiv zagadochnoe pismo, vy otpravites v puteshestvie, oveyannoe taynami i illyuziyami. Vy okazhetes v pomeshchenii, gde est tolko iskusno sdelannaya shkatulka-golovolomka. Vas zhdet nechto tainstvennoe i neizvedannoe; poetomu soberite vsyu svoyu dogadlivost, chtoby nayti otvety na vse voprosy! 

Klyuchevye funktsii

Slozhnye golovolomki Reshayte izyskannye i unikalnye zagadki, chtoby transformirovat shkatulku i zastavit ee otkryt pered vami vse sekrety tainstvennogo mekhanizma. Vospolzuytes ukrashennym okulyarom, chtoby nakhodit taynye poslaniya, rasshifrovyvat kody i razblokirovat slozhnye mekhanizmy. Vsyo eto priblizit vas k razgadke tayny, kotoruyu skryvayut misticheskie pisma, privedshie vas syuda, no v to zhe vremya eshche glubzhe pogruzit v sekrety igry The Room.

Charuyushchaya grafika V igre The Room grani mezhdu realnym mirom i fantaziyami razmyvayutsya blagodarya potryasayushchey realistichnoy grafike. Igrokov zhdet chudesnyy mir, polnyy izyskannykh ukrasheniy i uzorov.

Zakhvatyvayushchaya istoriya Staryy drug napisal vam zloveshchee pismo. Zhelaya raskryt etu taynu, vy okazyvaetes v dome druga, no tam vas zhdet lovushka. Vybora net: pridetsya prodolzhat put. I vy puskaetes v puteshestvie, v kotorom vas zhdut tayny, kovarstvo i opasnosti.

Optimizirovana dlya Nintendo Switch™ Teper vy smozhete poprobovat reshit mekhanicheskuyu golovolomku, ispolzuya sobstvennye ruki. Issleduyte igru The Room s pomoshchyu sensornogo displeya ili kontrollerov Joy-Con™, chtoby prochuvstvovat kazhdyy shchelchok zamka i kazhdyy povorot klyucha. Sochetanie innovatsionnoy mekhaniki i interaktivnogo upravleniya pozvolyaet s golovoy uyti v potryasayushchuyu uvlekatelnuyu igru.

title: PJ Masks Power Heroes: Mighty Alliance [NSZ][ENG]
voice_lang: 英语, 法语, 西班牙语
description:
Dlya samykh malenkikh igrokov! Ketboy, Alett, Gekko, An Yu, Nyuton Star, Ays Kab, Lilifey i Bastet obedinilis, chtoby sozdat Moguchiy Alyans.
Iz-za katastrofy v shtabe Geroev v maskakh tsennye tekhnologii i samotsvety okazalis razbrosany po vsemu miru, i teper geroyam predstoit vse ispravit. Sadites v Explorider i otpravlyaytes v nochnoe priklyuchenie po pustynnym ulitsam Goroda. Zatem vam predstoit issledovat bambukovyy les, potaynye peshchery i khram v Tainstvennoy gore, a takzhe prokatitsya po Ledyanomu miru, chtoby dobratsya do zasnezhennykh peshcher i nayti ostavshiesya detali. No toropites, inache oni mogut popast ne v te ruki! Romeo, Lunnaya devochka i Nochnoy nindzya vsegda gde-to ryadom, i oni ne upustyat shans pogruzit mir v khaos.
Kogda oni vmeste, ikh ne ostanovit. Ispolzuyte spets. sposobnosti, chtoby ostanovit zlodeev: ot neveroyatnoy skorosti do metaniya snezhkov. Sobirayte samotsvety, raskryvayte tayny, otkryvayte spryatannye maski i mnogoe drugoe.
Nochyu borotsya s prestupnikami luchshe vsego! Vas zhdet uvlekatelnyy priklyuchencheskaya igra, v khode kotorogo vam predstoit ostanovit zlodeev i vosstanovit shtab. Vam pod silu stat nastoyashchim geroem!..Igru PJ Masks Heroes of The Night (Geroi v maskakh: Geroi nochi) sm. zdes.

title: Kawaii Deathu Desu [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
在Kawaii Deathu Desu中，超自然人發現自己可以化身像可愛的日本偶像一樣！介乎於可愛與恐怖之間，這些地獄般的偶像發起了一場競賽，其目標是跨越整個世界；決定誰可以奪取地下世界的寶座。但是，地下世界的人，繼承者的寶座將取決於誰能從忠實的追隨者那裡收集到最多的靈魂。考慮到這一點，作為偶像，沒有更好的方法比在表演中割取更多自己的粉絲！

對於節奏快的清版動作遊戲粉絲，你會在這裡感到很熟悉。選擇一個超自然的偶像，並儘一切努力獲得更多更多的狂熱粉絲。

特色：

•簡單，令人上癮的操作方式-僅需兩個按鈕即可玩；容易學習，但很難放下。
•節奏明快的遊戲-快速的比賽讓你狂奔！
•高保真圖形-美麗的像素美術，視覺效果和乾淨的聲音效果。
•特殊能力和獨特角色-每個偶像都具有可以在演出期間激活出特殊力量以及獨特的遊戲風格。
•環遊世界-在環遊世界收集靈魂的過程中，在許多不同的地方和舞台進行表演。
•重玩性-每個節目都有三種不同的模式；以高分證明自己的價值，以爭取排行榜。
•自定義-使用靈魂為每個偶像選擇服裝，以根據自己的喜好更改外觀。
•具有競爭力的本地多人遊戲-在PvP模式下與朋友正面交鋒！
•解鎖內容-解鎖畫廊圖像，成就，音樂等等。

title: Conway: Disappearance at Dahlia View [NSP][ENG]
publisher: Fireshine Games, Sold Out Sales & Marketing Ltd
description:
Inogda nuzhen koshmar, chtoby razbudit mestechko vrode Dahlia View. Vozglavte rassledovanie dela o propavshem rebenke i raskroyte temnuyu taynu Dahlia View v etom syuzhetnom trillere ot sozdateley The Occupation i Ether One.

Conway: Disappearance at Dahlia View — zakhvatyvayushchiy triller, deystvie kotorogo proiskhodit v Anglii 1950-kh godov. Posle soobshcheniya o propazhe vosmiletney Charlotte May detektiv na pensii Robert Conway nachinaet vyyasnyat pravdu o ee ischeznovenii, nablyudaya za povedeniem sosedey iz okna svoey kvartiry v Dahlia View. Podozreniya i somneniya nakaplivayutsya, i Conway nachinaet sobstvennoe rassledovanie dela Charlotte May, otbiraya versii, obnaruzhivaya novye zatsepki i sobiraya vse uliki voedino na ternistom puti k istine.

OSOBENNOSTI IGRY:

• 	Okunites v napryazhennuyu i emotsionalnuyu istoriyu v novom detektivnom trillere ot White Paper Games, sozdateley The Occupation i Ether One.
• 	Stante Robert Conway, detektivom na pensii, zhivushchim v Dahlia View, i ishchite propavshego rebenka.
• 	Nablyudayte za deystviyami zhiteley Dahlia View, ishchite uliki, izuchayte vse, chto pokazhetsya vam podozritelnym.
• 	Issleduyte Dahlia View, reshayte golovolomki i doprashivayte zhiteley, chtoby obnaruzhit novye zatsepki, sostavit spisok podozrevaemykh i sobrat vse uliki voedino.

title: Mail Time [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Mail Time – eto rasslablyayushchee priklyuchenie, kotoroe razvorachivaetsya v mirnom lesu gde-to daleko-daleko. Eto vash pervyy rabochiy den v kachestve novoispechyonnogo pochtovogo skauta. Vooruzhivshis gribnoy shlyapkoy, sumkoy s pismami i bezuderzhnym entuziazmom, vy otpravlyaetes dostavlyat ikh po vsey roshche Gramblvud.

Poluchateli s neterpeniem zhdut uvidet vashu gribnuyu shlyapku, tak chto potoropites! Begayte, prygayte, pereletayte i prokladyvayte svoy put cherez les, chtoby dostavit posylki i radost milym zverushkam, naselyayushchim eti lesa.Vsyo verno. Vremya pochty!

Esli vy kogda-nibud khoteli okazatsya v skazke, eto vash shans. Issleduyte uyutnyy, spokoynyy mir, sozdannyy Keloy van der Deyl, i podruzhites so vsemi obitatelyami lesa!

- Poznakomtes s 15 ocharovatelnymi personazhami, u kazhdogo iz kotoryy svoya istoriya. Ot poetichnykh lyagushek do dyatlov v stile pank-rok i svarlivykh belok – vse oni odinakovo eklektichny i nuzhdayutsya v vashey pomoshchi.
- Issleduyte krasochnyy i prichudlivyy mir, prygayte po tsvetochnym polyam i vzbiraytes na vekovye derevya.
- Dostavlyayte pisma i posylki, chtoby pomoch zhitelyam roshchi Gramblvud i zarabotat znachki pochtovogo skauta. Skoro ty stanesh nastoyashchim pochtovym skautom!

Kastomiziruyte svoego skauta, uchites khitrostyam, chtoby zabiratsya na derevya s pomoshchyu gribov, i ispolzuyte pisma, chtoby parit po vozdukhu.

- Bolee 46 000 variantov kastomizatsii!
- ]Nastroyte svoego unikalnogo skauta, ispolzuya vsyo ot tsveta kozhi do tipa ryukzaka.
- Zarabatyvayte znachki pochtovogo skauta, chtoby uluchshat svoi lyotnye navyki.

Ot roshchi Gramblvud do samogo kraya lesa, issleduyte unikalnye mesta, soshedshie pryamo so stranits knig skazok, znakomtes s ikh obitatelyami, a zatem dostavte vsyu pochtu!

- Otkroyte i issleduyte 8 razlichnykh regionov. Zdes est na chto posmotret: ot ozhivlyonnoy lesnoy derevni do tumannogo bolota i mirnoy fermy!
- Sobirayte spryatannye bezdelushki, chtoby popolnit svoyu kollektsiyu i zarabotat vse znachki pochtovogo skauta!
- Dostigayte novykh vysot, ispolzuya pryzhkovye i lyotnye sposobnosti. Kak vysoko vy smozhete zabratsya?

title: City of Springs [NSZ][ENG]
description:
那聲音……你聽見了嗎？這座城市的運轉方式出了點問題。讓我們找出原因吧。

潛行、戰鬥並製作無人機，在這場蒸氣龐克風格的動作冒險中推翻腐敗的政權！

里維頓市的自由，只剩下你這最後的希望。

你將扮演 Val，一位來自貧民窟的天才機械師，決心不再忍受每日目睹的不公不義。女王欽點的菁英肆意揮霍，而平民百姓卻日夜辛勞，只為維持彈簧工廠的運作——同時還得忍受來自各部門的高壓監控。在里維頓，生活的每一個細節都受到規範，甚至只要動了反抗的念頭，你的配給就會被削減。

儘管如此，這地球上的最後一座城市依然充滿著某種美。即使面對資源短缺與女王政權的壓迫，人們仍努力過活。Val 發誓要幫助他們。

City of Springs - 特色內容

- 在蒸氣龐克世界中點燃一場革命
- 緊張刺激的戰術戰鬥
- 製作與組裝無人機協助你完成任務
- 利用潛行避開機器警衛與安保系統
- 探索由機器掌控的里維頓，尋找珍貴的製作材料

成為點燃革命的火花！

在《彈簧之城》中製作與組裝機器無人機，對抗殘酷政權。潛入禁區、協助人民反抗、探索里維頓的街頭巷弄。利用你從街頭拾來的廢料打造的小型無人機，擊退機械守衛。在糧食與飲水極度缺乏的年代，協助市民尋找更聰明的生存之道。

以火攻火，修復這座遭受壓迫的齒輪城市。

title: Smushi Come Home [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Smushi Come Home — eto uyutnaya priklyuchencheskaya igra-issledovanie, gde vy sygraete za kroshechnogo gribochka Smushi, kotoryy pytaetsya vernutsya domoy, otkuda ego neozhidanno zabrali i brosili posredi lesa. I khotya vy poteryany i ozadacheny, vam predstoit preodolet vsevozmozhnye oblasti lesa, ovladet novymi instrumentami i podruzhitsya s lesnymi tovarishchami — tolko takim budet vash put nazad!

Begayte, planiruyte, karabkaytes i plavayte, chtoby peresech razlichnye oblasti lesa!

Govorite s prichudlivymi lesnymi sozdaniyami, chto vstretyatsya vam na puti. Kto-to predlozhit vam pomoshch, a kto-to nuzhdaetsya v vashey!

Otpravlyaytes vo vsevozmozhnye priklyucheniya, chtoby vernutsya domoy! Nekotorye iz nikh budut prostymi puteshestviyami, a nekotorye — legkimi golovolomkami!

- Issleduyte razlichnye oblasti lesa v sobstvennom tempe i bez ogranicheniy. Nikakikh vremennykh ramok ili kontsa igry!
- Veselaya retro-pikselnaya estetika v 3D, kotoruyu legko vklyuchit ili vyklyuchit!
- Puteshestvuyte po mestnosti i reshayte prostye golovolomki v priklyucheniyakh!
- Primerte na sebya rol GRIBA!!

title: IronFall Invasion [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 机器翻译 来自 most2820 用于 v327680
description:
在戰役模式中，你將直接陷入與 Dyxide 入侵者的激烈戰爭中。在 11 個充滿動感的關卡中為地球的命運而戰！一路上，你會發現新的武器，並遇到九種更兇猛的敵人。

在多人遊戲模式中，與來自世界各地的玩家對抗，並賭你是否能擊敗他們！您也可以在倖存者模式中與電腦控制的對手進行訓練。贏得多人比賽可以為您贏得“積分”，這是一種代表您得分的遊戲內貨幣。您可以選擇使用您獲得的積分對比賽結果進行投注。如果你贏得了比賽，你將獲得額外的積分 – 但如果你失敗了，你將失去你的賭注！遊戲特色：6個競技場、7種武器、6個角色。遊戲模式：自由混戰、2隊2人、3隊2人、2隊3人。

• 60幀
• 戰役模式：在 11 個充滿動感的關卡中為地球的命運而戰！
• 多人遊戲模式：使用 6 個競技場、7 種武器和 6 個可供選擇的角色與其他玩家戰鬥。
• 倖存者模式進行訓練。

title: Light Fall [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Issleduyte zateryannyy mir Numbry, chtoby prolit svet na svoe tainstvennoe proshloe i spasti etu zemlyu i ee obitateley ot navisshey ugrozy. V etoy strane vechnoy nochi vy budete polagatsya na Serdtse Teney, chtoby preodolet mnozhestvo ispytaniy i sokrushit protivnikov, stoyashchikh na vashem puti. Sumeete li vy vyzhit v opasnoy Numbre?

KLYuChEVYE OSOBENNOSTI
Absolyutnaya svoboda
Upravlyayte Serdtsem Teney i ispolzuyte ego po svoemu usmotreniyu, chtoby obkhodit pregrady v igre. Vy mozhete podstavlyat etu volshebnuyu korobku sebe pod nogi, chtoby podprygivat v vozdukh i prodvigatsya dalshe v svoem tempe. S Serdtsem Teney vy stanovites khozyainom situatsii i prokladyvaete svoy sobstvennyy put.

Atmosfernoe priklyuchenie
Ustanovite Light Fall i pogruzites v etu zagadochnuyu vselennuyu, gde tma tsarstvuet nad svetom. V etom priklyuchenii k vam prisoedinitsya Striks, staraya i svarlivaya sova, i on budet vystupat v roli vashego tovarishcha i igrovogo rasskazchika. V zavisimosti ot nastroeniya on budet libo davat poleznye sovety, libo podshuchivat nad vashimi neudachami.

Ogromnyy mir dlya issledovaniya
Dostigayte novykh vysot i issleduyte kazhdyy potaennyy ugolok Numbry s pomoshchyu Serdtsa Teney. Progulyaytes po Lunnym Ravninam, Bolotam Pechali, Lesu Vayperas i Nevedomym Nedram, gde vas zhdet mnozhestvo korotkikh putey, i gde vy v izobilii naydete spryatannye interesnye predmety i “paskhalki”.

Sorevnovanie po skorostnomu prokhozhdeniyu igry
Utolite svoyu zhazhdu sostyazaniya v dopolnitelnom rezhime skorostnogo prokhozhdeniya igry. Povtoryayte svoy kvest v mire Numbry, chtoby sorevnovatsya s igrokami po vsemu miru i sravnivat svoi rekordy s ikh dostizheniyami v onlayn-spiske liderov.

title: Hamster Playground + 19 DLC [NSZ][RUS/Multi45]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 45]
description:
與你的可愛倉鼠一起刻苦訓練，參加激烈競賽，在闖過錯綜複雜的迷宮，騎行滑板的同時不斷接受挑戰。即將推出更多模式！讓你的倉鼠第一個闖過終點線以獲得獎勵和美味的零嘴！

特徵:
- 既休閒又激烈的競賽。遊戲只需一個按鈕即可操作，但要獲勝可絕非易事！
- 與 AI 控制的倉鼠在迷宮和賽道中競賽，更多模式盡在待發佈的完整遊戲中；
- 盡享多人模式。與其他玩家角逐，本地多人（最多 4 人）和線上多人任你選擇；
- 開發倉鼠技能，去和更強大的對手單挑；
- 照顧你的倉鼠，擴建房屋，裝上新家具，打造一棟倉鼠豪宅；
- 給你的倉鼠命名，並為它們精心裝扮。100 多種裝飾品任你挑選！
- 不管在哪種模式下遊戲，都能欣賞到精美畫面和可愛動畫！

title: Teratopia [NSZ][ENG]
description:
與圖喬一起，去拯救他的朋友，並解放特羅塔皮亞 (Teratopia)多彩奇特的土地！遊歷13個獨特的地區，那裡擠滿了一心想占領家園的敵人。請不要擔心！友誼的力量將你與其他特羅塔皮亞人，再加上各種的技能，去面對紅色的入侵者。

讓自己沉浸在充滿動作的冒險中，並制定策略以最好的方式去克制敵人！扮演爭鬥者圖喬，射手貝尼託或騙子霍拉西奧，每個人都有自己的長處和技能。

特色：

• 享受充滿家庭瑣事和有趣情況的故事。
• 扮演3個不同的角色，每個角色俱有獨特的技能和5個可召喚的組員。
• 在完全開放的地圖中遊歷 13個多姿多彩景觀。
• 挑戰並擊敗 11個首領。
• 解鎖 Teratopedia 的入口，並使用4種不同的服裝來設定你喜歡的角色。
• 精心編排的原聲音樂，讓你心情愉快！

title: Mages of Mystralia [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
V korolevstve Mistraliya uspekh dostigaetsya skoree intellektom, nezheli fizicheskoy siloy. Zdes ty vstretishsya litsom k litsu s moguchimi sushchestvami i tvoy put budet polon pregrad i opasnostey. Tebya zhdut golovolomki, kotorye sposobny posramit dazhe samykh proslavlennykh mudretsov. Tebe pridetsya preodolevat prepyatstviya, uchinennye temi, komu ne nuzhna tvoya pobeda.

Tvoy put ne budet legkim. V mire Mages of Mystralia ty igraesh v roli Zii, yunoy devushki, kotoraya obnaruzhivaet u sebya vrozhdennoe chuvstvo magii. K sozhaleniyu, na magiyu nalozhili zapret, poetomu Ziya pytaetsya trenirovatsya samostoyatelno, chtoby obresti khot kakoy-to kontrol nad svoimi silami. Na svoem puti ona vstrechaet drugikh magov-izgnannikov, nakhodit magicheskie runy i ponimaet, chto iz nikh mozhno sostavlyat milliony razlichnykh kombinatsiy i poluchat sovershenno novye zaklinaniya.

Syuzhet napisan avtorom bestsellerov Edom Grinvudom, sozdatelem fentezi-mira Forgotten Realms dlya Dungeons and Dragons, posluzhivshim osnovoy takikh igr, kak Baldur’s Gate i Neverwinter Nights, a takzhe poryadka 170 knig zhanra fentezi.

Osnovnye kharakteristiki
- Sostavlyay zaklinaniya, chtoby odolevat vragov, reshay zagadki i srazhaysya s epicheskimi bossami.
- Moshchnaya i v to zhe vremya prostaya sistema sozdaniya zaklinaniy.
- Klassicheskoe priklyuchenie s bolee chem desyatyu razlichnymi oblastyami dlya issledovaniya.
- Saundtrek ispolnen Video Game Orchestra pod upravleniem Shota Nakamy i zapisan v studii SoundtRec Boston; v svoe vremya eti lyudi rabotali nad muzykoy dlya Final Fantasy XV i Kingdom Hearts.

title: ExZeus 1/2: The Complete Collection [NSZ][ENG]
description:
心懷不軌的外星勢力將目標鎖定地球，並且將不計一切代價誓要消滅人類文明。這些侵略者試圖利用他們的先進科技來滅絕人類，但卻沒想到地球的人類也使用精密的科技來反擊。ExZeus 計畫隆重登場，它運用的超高科技戰鬥機器人就是人類抵禦天外惡敵，並恢復我們這顆蔚藍行星和平的最後也是最強大防線！在本系列激烈動作的高空飛行 3D 街機風格軌道射擊遊戲中，您要操控四款不同機器人擊退這些外星人，將它們轟回老家！

ExZeus

公元 2102 年，一顆過去未知的龐大小行星進入了地球的軌道，並開始對地球派出一波又一波的攻擊，每天殺害成千上萬的人們，人類文明岌岌可危。首批屠殺之下幸運的少數倖存者成功逃入地底深處，使人類得以避免徹底滅絕。統治議會下令立即使用三款實驗性機器人 Calista、Sophia 和 Dynamis展開反擊，於是ExZeus 計畫於焉誕生。現在，您必須選擇三架巨大飛行機器人的其中一架來挑戰 Diadora 的侵略軍。翱翔天際，轟爆敵人，為所有人奪回地球！


ExZeus 2

經過和平的一個世紀之後，對地球的人們而言，ExZeus 行動和 Diadora 被擊敗只是遙遠的記憶。然而，和平並未長久持續下去。太空深處出現了新的惡敵，五架身兼大規模破壞武器的神秘艙艦降落在全球人口稠密之處。為迎擊這場新的威脅，ExZeus 行動再次啟動，並由傳奇機器人 Calista、Sophia 和 Dynamis 融合成究極的戰鬥機器人 Minos。您將操控 Minos 稱霸大地和天空，擊退異星威脅，消滅五大艙艦，並永遠消滅侵略者！


• 好好鍛練您扣扳機的手指，對入侵的每波異星軍勢徹底施放整個軍火庫的武器和超級攻擊。

• 在繁華的城市、濃密的森林、靄靄的雪山、沙漠荒原甚至是海底一路奮戰，徹底根除對人類的威脅。

• 挑戰考驗玩家技巧極限的巨大頭目，在閃躲彈如雨下得攻擊之際瞄準敵人弱點痛擊。

• 在任務之中收集金幣，以用來購買能量、護盾、超級炸彈等各種道具。

title: OMG! Zombies [NSP][ENG]
description:
As a lone cop armed only with bare wit, a large-calibre sniper rifle and bullets coated in a zombie-exploding pathogen, you are the last man standing at the epicentre of a zombie outbreak. Your mission? To succeed where the police and army failed by clearing the streets of 8 different strains of bloodthirsty zombies and stop Armageddon in its tracks!

For cool and unimportant reasons these suckers literally explode when shot, showering their zombie brethren with gore and causing chain reactions of showering zombie gibs with just a single bullet!

Use your sharpshooting skills to vanquish 100 branching levels of zombie hell across 40 unique environments in this hugely addictive chain reaction shooter. Earn 400 shiny medals and cold hard cash to buy 100 different upgrades, all designed to MAKE THOSE ZOMBIES EXPLODE!

OMG Zombies! is an awesome reimagining of a genuine classic: the critically acclaimed OMG-Z! The guys at Push Square gave it 89% and called it: “a must buy” game. Escape Rope claimed it’s: “...one of the best zombie games in recent memory” and Defunct Games gave it an A rating saying it’s “so addictive... I still can't get enough of watching the explosive chain reaction caused from a well-placed bullet.”

This even newer and 'improved-er' OMG Zombies! features a brand new sniper scope view, improved touch control, a fast-forward feature, instant restart feature and all the zombie-splattering action you could ever want! Get your trigger finger at the ready!

title: Spell Casting: Purrfectly Portable Edition [NSP][ENG]
description:
Spell Casting is a line drawing puzzle game in which you are a young wizard learning spells in the comfort of your home thanks to Wizardly Distance Education offered by the prestigious Magical Education Of Wizards School!

Practice casting spells by tracing out the patterns in the spell books using your fingers. Earn a 3 star rating in each practice spell to unlock the exam for that book.

You'll need to remember the previously learned spell shapes to pass the exam and unlock new spell books!

Spell Casting is fun for all ages and family friendly. Play just for fun or try to achieve 5 stars in all the spells and exams.

title: Bitlogic a Cyberpunk Arcade Adventure [NSP][ENG]
description:
Bitlogic is an action and adventure game elegantly classic but enhanced with new adapted graphics. In the game you take control of Bit, your personal avatar in a virtual cyberpunk world full of dangerous enemies, hidden paths and digital mysteries.

Immerse yourself in Bit's universe and dare to uncover the secrets behind the source code.

Explore, defend yourself and find the correct way to the heart and soul of Bitlogic.
NEW FEATURE: Colorblind helpers in game.

This Bitlogic version is an enhanced adaptation of our Bitlogic MSX game.
The game includes the enhanced version (modern graphical style) and the original MSX version (low resolution and pixelart) for a nostalgic enjoyment feeling.
Original soundtrack can be chosen: Spectacular OST, electronic techno music and chiptune version too.

Available languages: English, Catalan, Italian, French and Spanish.

title: Cthulhu Saves Christmas [NSZ][ENG]
description: «Ktulkhu spasaet Rozhdestvo» — ironichnaya psevdo-J-RPG, kotoraya shutit ne tolko o mifakh Ktulkhu, no i o klishe «rolyovok», filmov, knig, drugikh igr — i mnogo chego eshchyo! Ppri etom, ostavalas krepkoy, mestami vesma neprostoy RPG, stilizovannoy pod klassiku 90-kh godov, — s poshagovymi boyami, kvestami, prokachkoy, podborom snaryazheniya!..Ot sozdateley Cosmic Star Heroine / This Way Madness Lies.

title: Daydream Forgotten Sorrow [NSP][RUS/Multi19]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 19]
description:
[幻夢：心酸回憶]是一款氛圍濃郁的冒險遊戲，講述了男孩[格里芬]的感人故事，以及他與恐懼的鬥爭。幸運的是，他的泰迪熊夥伴[伯利]不會拋下他。
 
 這對小夥伴的旅程並不容易。探索光芒與黑暗交織的世界意味著他們必須面對悲傷的回憶，消滅來自過去的怪物。
 
 [伯利]能幫上許多忙。他可以去[格里芬]夠不著的地方：他可以被拋過橫樑，按一個按鈕，或者爬進一個狹小的洞口。只要齊心協力，他們就能移動重物，越過陷阱，克服各種各樣的挑戰。
 
 發現一段感人的故事
 你有沒有在一個未知之地醒來，發現只有一隻活泰迪熊陪伴著你？大概沒有吧。陪伴[格里芬]探尋這個奇異新世界的真相吧。踏上一段充滿謎團的冒險，揭開一段溫馨的故事，見證兩個小夥伴克服萬難的努力。
 
 克服嚴峻的挑戰
 讓[伯利]協助你解決複雜的謎題，探索這個新世界。你只能直接操縱[格里芬]，但你可以把你的泰迪熊夥伴拿起來、扔出去，或者向他發號施令，讓他幫你取得進展。
 
 探索迷之世界
 [格里芬]身處一個充滿過去幻象的黑暗之地，然而這個世界其實不止有厄運和陰鬱。只要你鼓起前進的力量，你會發現一個五彩繽紛的迷人世界：這裡不僅有浮空的城堡和蜿蜒的洞穴，更有童話般的森林和陽光明媚的平原。

title: Wind Story [NSZ][ENG]
description:
“Wind Story”是一款類比休閒經營類RPG遊戲。 玩家來到風鈴牧場後，體驗農耕、飼養、垂釣等鄉村生活，白天可以在牧場的花海中自由奔跑，夜晚可以在湖邊的篝火旁飲酒歡舞。 可以吸引更多的人來牧場遊玩，逐步建立起自己的住宿，風車發電屋，餐館，耕種各種蔬菜花果，飼養各種動物。 甚至在牧場中建立起各種遊樂設施，賺取更多的錢，建立自己的玩樂天地。
遊戲給了你豐富的自由度，你可以栽種各類農作物、飼養可愛的動物，採集蘑菇和各種花卉，可以捕魚和挖礦，收集各種資料，製作美味的佳餚，並且可以和每一個牧場中的人物互動。 為了讓牧場吸引更多的人來遊玩，你可以逐步建造風車發電屋、牧場住宿，可以建造餐館、醫院，可以在牧場中建造遊樂場，裡面有各種遊樂設施，讓牧場成為一個遊樂的度假樂園。
你也可以在世界中自由探索，抓獲或培養自己的寵物，讓它們參與到牧場建設中，還可以帶上寵物去和海盜作戰，維護牧場的安全。 把牧場建設成一個你喜歡的世界。

title: Vinebound Tangled Together [NSZ][ENG]
description:
《Vinebound》是一款重視合作的 roguelike 遊戲，適合一到兩名玩家進行挑戰。玩家需要互相配合，依據輪流冷卻機制發動攻擊，擊敗不斷湧來的敵人。 

你們的友誼能否通過花園大陸瘋狂植物的考驗？ 

遊戲特色：
- 真正的緊密合作 – 被藤蔓緊緊相連，每走一步都需要團隊合作，每一次拉扯都可能是災難的開始——因此，請謹慎規劃……或者勇敢面對混亂！
