Sozdavay novye urovni s pomoshchyu rezhima konstruktora s podborom igrokov. Vvedi klyuchevoe slovo, chtoby poluchit dinamicheski sgenerirovannyy uroven iz ogromnogo raznoobraziya mirov, skhem, opasnostey i sochetaniy vragov. Vyberi oruzhie po svoemu vkusu i vykhodi na start novogo urovnya.

title: RollerCoaster Tycoon Adventures Deluxe [NSZ][ENG]
description:
最暢銷的控制台過山車模擬器剛剛推出豪華版！您將發現 80 個新遊樂設施和景點，其中包括一些新的季節性主題遊樂設施，使總數達到 200 個！新的現代化介面看起來令人驚嘆，並且可以更輕鬆地使用四種環境中的地形建造公園，包括高山、沙漠峽谷、熱帶叢林，甚至月球月球表面。

RCT Adventures Deluxe 是一款適合所有年齡層的遊戲，適合喜歡主題樂園模擬的玩家和喜歡建造雲霄飛車的粉絲。直覺的雲霄飛車建造者可以讓你創造狂野的、玩命的雲霄飛車，可以扭轉、轉動、俯衝和旋轉。

三種深入的遊戲模式意味著無數小時的遊戲時間，包括冒險模式、場景模式和開放的沙盒模式。

特徵

遊樂設施：80 個新遊樂設施和景點，總數達到 200 個！

模式：冒險、場景和沙盒遊戲模式，提供多樣性和可重玩性。

過山車：建造七種完全客製化的過山車，包括老式木製、鋼製、翼式、超級、倒置、潛水和加速器。

管理：簡化的介面為您提供使用遊戲控制器發展公園所需的所有控制。

繪畫：每個遊樂設施、過山車、商店和餐廳都可以使用一系列顏色進行定制，這樣您就可以使它們脫穎而出，或者在您的公園中創建顏色協調的部分。

景觀美化：對路徑進行超級詳細的設計，在整個公園中添加花朵、灌木叢和樹葉以及清涼的水景。

地形：在山區、沙漠、叢林甚至月球上建造你的房子。

title: Rhythm Sprout: Sick Beats & Bad Sweets [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Rhythm Sprout – uragannyy ritm-ekshen s originalnym saundtrekom i zabavnoy istoriey.

– Dvigaysya v ritm i bey pod bit!
– Sobiray remiksy urovney s pomoshchyu modifikatorov
– Uznay, chem zakonchitsya eta absurdnaya ovoshchnaya istoriya
 
OSOBENNOSTI IGRY:
 
VSE UROVNI SOBRANY VRUChNUYu
Kazhdyy trek idyot v pare s unikalnoy 3D-lokatsiey, kotoraya raskryvaet muzyku i syuzhet. Ne propusti mini-stsenki i paskhalki na urovnyakh!
 
ORIGINALNYY SAUNDTREK
My napisali vsyu muzyku spetsialno dlya igry i pod bitmapy, poetomu zvuk maksimalno sochetaetsya s geympleem – ty eto pochuvstvuesh. Temy urovney vdokhnovleny samymi raznymi stilyami, vklyuchaya elektroniku, K-pop, D'n'B, disko, lou-fay khip-khop i dazhe metal!
 
ABSURDNAYa ISTORIYa
Tebya - otbornyy Luchok - zhdyot polnaya shutok i samoironii istoriya, v antraktakh mezhdu muzykalnymi urovnyami. Vstrechay milykh ovoshchnykh zhiteley i charuyushchikh zlodeev. Sovershay absurdnye vybory v dialogakh i lovi pop-kulturnye otsylki!
 
BESKONEChNYY PROSTOR DLYa POSTGEYMA
Miksuy raznye mody dlya unikalnykh kombinatsiy:
— Uskor lyuboy trek s pomoshchyu Turbo
— Osvezhi motornuyu pamyat v Zazerkale
— Peremeshay noty v rezhime Shafl — i bros vyzov druzyam s lyubimymi variatsiyami urovney
— Beskonechnaya improvizatsiya v rezhime Polnyy random!
 
Krome etogo, v Rhythm Sprout dostupny khardkornye remiksy i prikolnye bonus urovni, chtoby vykrutit fan na maksimum.
 
KASTOMIZATsIYa
My uzhe govorili, chto u Luchka est raznye kostyumy? Ikh mozhno otkryt po mere prokhozhdeniya igry.
A eshchyo skiny dlya mecha!

title: Remains [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
在一次可怕的事件之後，你在你的星球軌道上陷入了完全的沉默和絕對的孤獨。 沒有人可以幫助你，你必須生存並找出導致這一事件的原因。 你只有你和你，你只能靠你自己。
來自同一艘船殘骸的資源將是你的救贖。 把船隻殘骸拆開，也許你會發現一些有用的東西。 但請記住，你需要氧氣和食物，嘗試找到生產它們的方法。

小心，太空是不可預測的......

特徵：
製作 - 您可以從開採和發現的資源中創造對您有用的東西。
生存——你需要注意自己的需求才能不死！
建造 - 建造你的安全空間站。
製造——創建滿足您需求的生產機制。
研究 - 搜索該地區以尋找新資源，但不要飛得太遠。

title: Re Call [NSZ][ENG]
description: Memories are malleable and changing them will modify the present. Tackle mind-bending puzzles that rely on altering your own recollections to shape the future.

title: Rayland 1-2 [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
歡迎來到 Rayland。這座島嶼的居民們會使用特殊雷射光所帶來的能源來生存，並使用他們稱為「反覆方磚」的物品來傳送這股能源。你的任務就是幫助 Rayland 的在地居民利用折射雷射光，將被稱作 Domus 的發射器的能源送到各個小島上。

要達成這個任務，就得要把反覆方磚放在正確的位置並轉動它們，讓能量波抵達顏色相符的貯存器。《Rayland 2》是一款在可旋轉的等角視角場地進行的方位解謎遊戲。要善用不同種類的磚塊和關卡的玄機來折射雷射光，才能擊中它們的目標，在 50 個關卡中，不論是挑戰性還是複雜性都會逐漸升高！

特色：

• 運用各個關卡的資源來將雷射光反射到目標！
• 讓雷射交叉以產生新的軌跡。
• 移動並旋轉如鏡子般的 Reflectus！
• 射過鴻溝以及特殊磚塊。
• 克服各式各樣燒腦的關卡！

title: Railway Islands 1-2 [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
developer: Rising Moon Games, Mens Sana Interactive
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
歡迎來到備受期待的受人喜愛的鐵路拼圖遊戲的續集！
再次，您將扮演管理迷人島嶼景觀中鐵路線的角色，但現在額外的挑戰是協調多達兩列火車，安全地將乘客和包裹運送到目的地。在共享鐵路上，戰略性的路徑規劃和適當的鐵路開關位置至關重要，以防止碰撞。
體驗獨特外觀的極簡和舒緩之旅：

- 解決40個不同島嶼的謎題。
- 沉浸在每個季節的不同環境中。
- 享受令人滿意和放鬆的音樂和音效。

釋放您的創造力和解決問題的能力！使用直觀的級別編輯器設計您自己的島嶼和鐵路。

title: Raid on Taihoku [NSP][ENG]
developer: Mizoriot Creative Company, Fun2 Studio Co.
description:
【關於此遊戲】

「所有戰爭都會打二次，第一次在戰場上，第二次在記憶裡。」
-越南小說家 阮越清

【遊戲方式】

遊戲為 2.5D 敘事冒險遊戲，玩家在日本統治的台北城中，躲避美軍B-24的空襲，並面臨角色的人性掙扎。

在遊玩關卡的安全區中，你可任意進行探索，並跟隨提示收集隱藏於城市中的神秘物件。危險區則強調角色之間的生死合作，躲避包含空襲在內的各種危機。



【故事背景】

二戰後期，美國對日本採取跳島戰術，兩國在台灣海峽進行空戰。 1945 年 5 月 31 日，美軍上百架 B-24 轟炸機朝台灣島首都——台北——飛來。許多居民因空襲喪生，也有更多人活了下來，卻要面對殘破不堪的家園。

在空襲中失去記憶的主角——清子，除了要在被戰火摧殘的城市中求生，也踏上尋找回憶的旅程。台灣犬「小黑」是他最忠心可靠的夥伴。在空襲過後的台北，一人一狗一起冒險。

玩家不僅需要體驗空襲的殘酷和艱難，同時也得拼貼回憶，理出線索，找回關於清子過去的記憶，迎來最終的結局與真相。



【商品特色】

● 軸心國殖民地視角遊戲。
● 台灣第一款以二戰敘事的電玩。
● 採雙主角設定，並透過大量解謎任務，了解其他倖存者的故事。
● 豐富的時代知識和收集品展示。
● 配樂由知名音樂家張衞帆操刀，沉浸感十足
● 以精緻美術細膩還原日治台北，打造身歷其境的空襲體驗。
● 支援中英日三國語言 。

「沒有家的時候，才想回家。」

title: Project Dark / A Western Drama / The Vale Shadow of the Crown [NSP][ENG]
description:
Zakhvatyvayushchaya immersivnaya audialnaya igra s povestvovatelnym syuzhetom i interaktivnymi vetvyashchimisya syuzhetnymi liniyami!.. Slozhnyy binauralnyy zvuk pozvolit Vam pogruzitsya v igrovoy protsess, chtoby igrat s shiroko zakrytymi glazami.
Issleduyte shirotu i glubinu tmy. Prostye mekhaniki sdelayut istoriyu dostupnoy kazhdomu, i my s neterpeniem zhdem, kuda zavedyot vas eto issledovanie! Sygrayte shest epizodov igry vslepuyu v samykh raznykh usloviyakh: ot srednevekovogo fenteziynogo priklyucheniya do pervogo svidaniya. V Project Dark vy poznakomites s interesnym personazhami, uznaete ikh istoriyu i primete vazhnye resheniya — odnim dvizheniem paltsa.
Pered zapuskom obyazatelno nadente naushniki.

title: Project Blue [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Spryatannaya na okraine Dezzony sekretnaya
biooruzheynaya laboratoriya, provodyashchaya nevoobrazimye
eksperimenty nad bezdomnoy molodezhyu v etoy betonnoy pustoshi.

Mnogoobeshchayushchemu testovomu podopytnomu s kodovym imenem PROEKT SINIY, udaetsya vyrvatsya na svobodu blagodarya uspeshnoy bioenergeticheskoy mutatsii.

Teper VAM predstoit pomoch Sinemu sbezhat s Teta Laboratorii i unichtozhit tenevoy mezhnatsionalnyy konglomerat upravlyayushchiysya Neo GonKongom!

Prover svoi navyki, ostroumie i refleksy, prygaya,
plavaya i stranstvuya cherez chetyre zony v etom zakhvatyvayushchem novym ekshn platformere!

- 256 stsen dukhozakhvatyvayushchego ekshena!
- Ogromnaya podborka originalnykh saundtrekov, sostoyashchikh iz 22 trekov!
- 3 vida slozhnosti, so smenoy raspolozheniya obektov!
- Sekretnye komnaty i izobilie alternativnykh putey!

title: Picontier [NSP][ENG]
description:
"Picontier" is a story of mystery and fascinating events that occur on an island as the main character resumes life from scratch and meets many intriguing islanders.

The hero awakens from a long sleep to find that the appearance of the island is quite different from their memory. Start your life in the town "Magmail" in the center of the island, making your way with help from the caring AI character "Aila".

In your island life you can craft items and weapons; you can also fish in the sea and grow crops on the ranch. Use newly created items and weapons to interact with the inhabitants of the island, and as you get to know each other the conversations will change and you will receive crafting recipes.

Materials are required for crafting, and these are collected both in and out of town. The monsters that appear on the field change between day and night, so check recipes for what you want to make and find the right monsters for the job.

By advancing the main quest the story of the entire island will progress and evolve. You’ll learn about the mysterious substance "Piconium", that exists only on this island, and the strange "black fog" that holds the key to the ‘incident’ - including the mysterious disappearance of Professor Jeda after our hero’s awakening. Experience a wondrous story on a mysterious island, where magical things happen!

title: Perseverance Complete edition (Part 1 / 2 / 3) [NSZ][ENG,RUS]
developer: Titanite Novels, Tap It Games, Bit Golem
description:
• BEZ SPEShKI – Raskryvayte sekrety Greyvillya v sobstvennom tempe.
• VOT ETO POVOROT! – Pogruzites v zakhvatyvayushchuyu istoriyu, polnuyu neozhidannostey
• DVE STORONY MEDALI – Uznavayte istoriyu s dvukh protivopolozhnykh tochek zreniya
• BOLShE, ChEM SUMMA SLAGAEMYKh – Bolshaya istoriya raskryvaetsya po chastyam
• VSE V VAShIKh RUKAKh – Vashi resheniya vliyayut na syuzhet i sozdayut unikalnye versii Dzheka i Karen
• ZhNITE, ChTO POSEYaLI – Kazhdyy sdelannyy vybor imeet posledstviya. Smozhete li vy s nimi zhit?

Proyavite svoyu nepokolebimost v polnom izdanii, kotoroe obedinyaet Chasti 1, 2 i 3 v odnom nabore. Prozhivite istorii Dzheka i Karen ot nachala do samogo vzryvnogo kontsa.

Chast 1:
 V pervoy chasti vy igraete za Dzheka Kattera — ottsa, kotoryy izo vsekh sil pytaetsya sokhranit semyu. A eshche on vsegda gotov pomoch sosedyam po rodnomu Greyvillyu. Issledovaniya, provodimye na raspolozhennoy nepodaleku voennoy baze, pridayut gorodu oreol zagadochnosti. Mestnye zhiteli predpochitayut derzhatsya ot bazy podalshe. Dela priobretayut neozhidannyy povorot, kogda odin iz eksperimentov idet ne po planu i zonu zakryvayut na karantin. Tem vremenem nekaya tainstvennaya zhenshchina presleduet begletsa…

Chast 2:
Igrayte za Karen — raschetlivuyu ubiytsu, kotoraya okhotitsya na zagadochnuyu devushku v otdalennom gorodke Greyville. Zhizni nemnogochislennykh mestnykh zhiteley tesno perepleteny mezhdu soboy, i chem blizhe vy k tseli, tem bolshe zaputyvaetes v sotsialnoy pautine. Prostaya zadacha «nayti i unichtozhit» prevrashchaetsya v koshmar, ot kotorogo Karen ne smozhet prosnutsya.

Chast 3:
V tretey chasti vy mozhete vybirat mezhdu Dzhekom i Karen. V finalnom epizode serii vskroyutsya krovavye vnutrennosti Greyvillya. Vam pridetsya prinyat bolee 200 resheniy, kazhdoe iz kotorykh povliyaet na razvitie syuzheta, poetomu vybirayte obdumanno. Chto vazhnee: spasti chelovechestvo ot vspyshki zombi-infektsii ili pozabotitsya o sebe i svoikh blizkikh? Net nepravilnogo otveta. Tolko pomnite, chto kazhdyy sleduyushchiy shag mozhet privesti vas na kray propasti.

title: Passpartout The Starving Artist / Passpartout 2 The Lost Artist [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Ispytayte na sebe vse grani zhizni golodayushchego genialnogo khudozhnika!
Vam predstoit okazatsya v roli nachinayushchego frantsuzskogo khudozhnika, kotoryy izo vsekh sil pytaetsya razobratsya v sebe i udivitelno zaputannom i mnogogrannom mire iskusstva. Pishite kartiny i prodavayte ikh, chtoby vyzhit i udovletvorit svoyu strast k isskustvu i, konechno, k dorogomu dekantnomu vinu i khrustyashchim frantsuzskim bagetam!

title: Paperman Adventure Delivered [NSP][ENG]
description:
黃金慶典
紙片人的郵局已經成功地完成了100萬次的投遞囉。為了慶祝這一特別的成就，郵局決定向他們最忠誠的客戶發送特別的黃金信件。

某個晚上，龍正在看電視時，他看到了關於黃金信件的新聞。貪婪的龍使用他古老的魔法攻擊郵局並竊取所有郵件，當然也包括了黃金信件，以他已經擁有的巨大黃金山更加壯觀。紙片人和他的團隊將盡一切努力取回郵件、並將其送達！

認識 你的團隊
扮演 四個獨特郵件外務中的其中一個，交換角色以解鎖他們各自特別 的能力。紙片人是我們名義上的英雄，以投擲 信件作為攻擊的彈丸，還可以 即時短距離傳送。快遞員是動作最快 的角色，負責處理最緊急的投遞事宜。滾滾用他值得信賴的羽毛平穩地滑過空中，並且可以到達最高的平臺。團隊裡最後一名的成員是卡爾，他是四人裡面最強壯的一個，卡爾  都非常小心地遞送最重的包裹喔！

全球配送
在三個完全不同的世界中尋找失蹤的信件。第一個目的地將帶你到一個充滿雕像的熱帶島嶼，在這裡你將發現這島嶼為什麼被稱為多面之島。接下來，前往沙漠，探索沙谷的金字塔。第三個世界是蜿蜒峯，在這裡將真正考驗你所有的技能。遊戲中，你會遇到許多跑酷平臺，這些平臺需要擁有正確技能的角色才能到達目的地。

尋找遺失的郵件
探索每個世界，試圖尋找黃金信件。某些特殊地點只有特定角色能夠到達，並且需要不同的技能來找到所有的祕密！

每個世界都有額外的信件供你尋找，甚至每個角色都有其獨特的物品喔！在真正的收藏馬拉松探險中，你需要搜索世界的每一個角落才能找到所有的收藏品！

額外的成員
貪婪的龍會有爪牙幫助他，而你也可以得到你朋友的幫助喔！在本地分割畫面多人遊戲中與2名玩家一起遊玩，並在這次合作冒險中互相幫助！

title: Orbital Cargo Division [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Capt'n Christopher Novak works for the Galactic Mining Group in the Orbital Cargo Division. The department responsible for deliveries and supplies between the individual mine sites in a solar system. Together with his crew, consisting of the pilot Zoe Corvin and the technician Henry Talon, they deliver various goods from one orbital station to the next with a cargo ship. The time between the stations can sometimes last for weeks and the job itself is also quite unspectacular.
That changes abruptly when they arrive at what appears to be an abandoned station. Power appears to be there, but no one is responding to their radio messages.

title: On Rusty Trails [NSP][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Eto ptitsa, eto samolyot?.. Net! Nonkonformizm — nashe vsyo v etom molnienosnom ekshn-platformere, budte gotovy menyatsya kazhduyu sekundu! Igra rasskazyvaet istoriyu metallicheskogo sushchestva po imeni Elvis, dom kotorogo byl uzhasno razrushen prirodnymi kataklizmami — no emu vdrug popadaetsya tekhnologicheskiy maskirovochnyy kostyum.
Otkroyte dlya sebya velikolepnye rzhavye prigorody, gibnushchie sotsvetiya gorodov, ogromnye zabroshennye zavody i zagadochno rabotayushchie mashiny. Ispytayte narastayushchiy saspens mezhdu dvumya vidami, begaya po stenam, pereprygivaya propasti i letya skvoz potoki lav..

title: Omen of Sorrow [NSP][ENG]
description:
在夜晚的生物所統治的隱密下層世界裡，一種新的恐怖已經甦醒！《Omen of Sorrow》集結恐怖傳說、文學和神話中的怪物，帶來前所未見的格鬥遊戲體驗。深受眾多街機經典之作的啟發，卻有其獨特的創新和成熟的美感，《Omen of Sorrow》處處都是風格！

本作的陣容靈感來自科學怪人的怪物和埃及大祭司 Imhotep 等知名人物，這個傳統的四鍵格鬥遊戲，將根據玩家遊戲風格的積極程度給予獎勵或懲罰，讓戰鬥更以技巧為重，但新手依然能汲取經驗。在 Unreal Engine 4 驅動下，《Omen of Sorrow》的 2.6D 決戰將呈現許多精緻複製的地點，手繪動畫和電影級的絕招場面，並搭配作曲家 Francisco Cerda 的大師級配樂。

此版本的《Omen of Sorrow》包含完整角色名單、強化版劇情模式和跨平台線上遊戲。

特色：

• 精選靈感來自各式經典恐怖故事的人物。
• 用電影級絕招帥氣擊倒敵人！
• 探索單人模式與電腦決戰，或在線上挑戰朋友。
• 靈活制定戰略，並積極出招以扭轉戰場態勢！

title: Omegabot (Omega Bot) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
OmegaBot – napryazhennyy ekshn-saydskroller s neprostymi bossami-robotami. Igraya za OmegaBota, dobyvayte moshchnoe oruzhie i prolozhite im sebe dorogu v razrushennom mire, polnom smertonosnykh mashin. V OmegaBot, lishitsya energii – znachit umeret.

Izbegayte razlichnykh lovushek i smertonosnykh prepyatstviy, ispolzuya dostupnoe oruzhie i sposobnosti. Prolozhite sebe put cherez metallicheskie lesa, ruiny gorodov budushchego i drugie lokatsii. A esli risknete soyti s protorennykh dorozhek, to smozhete nayti raznye sekrety i dazhe druzey, kotorye pomogut vam snyat proklyatie, porazivshee eti zemli.

Osobennosti:

– Razlichnye lokatsii, vklyuchaya lesa iz metalla i ruiny goroda budushchego
– Stremitelnye, no produmannye boi
– Slozhnye bossy, chi oruzhie i sposobnosti mozhet poluchit igrok
– Krasochnaya pikselnaya grafika

title: Oaken [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Misticheskiy mir Oaken lezhit vne vremeni i prostranstva. Na vetvyakh Velikogo duba (Great Oak) naselyayushchie ego lesnye dukhi izdrevle prislushivayutsya k tainstvennomu golosu, kotoryy oni nazyvayut Pesnyu duba (Oak Song).
I kogda etot golos umolkaet, mezhdu obitatelyami dreva nachinaetsya rasprya, kotoraya libo istselit Velikiy dub, libo okonchatelno ego unichtozhit.

- Kampaniya, orientirovannaya na otdelnykh geroev i sochetayushchaya v sebe elementy kak «rogalika», tak i kollektsionnoy kartochnoy igry.
- Misticheskiy mir, naselennyy dukhami i vdokhnovlennyy mifologiey drevnikh keltov.
- Protsedurno-sgenerirovannyy mir so mnozhestvom urovney, bossov i razlichnogo roda sobytiy.
- Originalnye srazheniya na setke polya boya, gde vazhnuyu rol igraet raspolozhenie vashikh otryadov.
- Gibkaya sistema uluchsheniy vashikh dukhov i dostupnykh im char.
- Legko osvoit, slozhno pokorit, no uroven slozhnosti vybiraete vy sami.

title: Noob the Factionless [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Pomogite neodeyu Basteru, berserku Dreku, kartomantu Mey i elementalistu Logsu poluchit maksimalnyy uroven i  legendarnyy klass v MMORPG Horizon!

Srazhaytes s sotnyami chudovishch i issleduyte fantasticheskie miry, chtoby vasha gildiya zanyala dostoynoe mesto v igre Horizon naryadu s legendarnymi gildiyami Nubov, Spravedlivosti, Pobediteley i Masterov igry.

No predstoyashchie vam ispytaniya ne ogranichivayutsya igroy Horizon: vashi personazhi budut vypolnyat zadaniya i v realnoy zhizni. Tvorite istoriyu kak v igre, tak i v zhizni!

Sumeete li vy privesti komandu k urovnyu 100?

OBShchAYa INFORMATsIYa
- Igrayte za komandu iz 4 uvlechennykh geymerov i upravlyayte ikh avatarami v yarkoy i uvlekatelnoy RPG v dukhe luchshikh igr v zhanre JRPG!
- Issleduyte ogromnyy mir, uchastvuyte v napryazhennykh srazheniyakh i vypolnyayte zadaniya, chtoby povyshat uroven svoey komandy
- Ekipiruyte avatary luchshim snaryazheniem, kotoroe mozhno nayti v podzemelyakh, peshcherakh, sundukakh i gorodskikh lavkakh!
- Delayte komandu silnee i uluchshayte sposobnosti, poluchaya ochki opyta v srazheniyakh. Vybirayte navyki v zavisimosti ot stilya boya ili protivnikov, kotorye vstretilis vam na puti
- Stranstvuyte po miru Olidri i tvorite istoriyu naryadu s samymi silnymi gildiyami v MMORPG Horizon, gde mezhdu soboy sopernichayut luchshie igroki!
- Poznakomtes s realnoy zhiznyu geymerov, za kotorykh igraete, i vyyasnite, kto skryvaetsya za avatarami vashikh druzey… ili vragov!

OSOBYE VOZMOZhNOSTI
- Privlekatelnyy vizualnyy stil i tibi-personazhi kak dan uvazheniya luchshim igram v zhanre JRPG
- Nastoyashchaya RPG na 50+ chasov geympleya, s 750+ avatarov, s kotorymi mozhno vzaimodeystvovat, i 300+ kart dlya issledovaniya

title: No Son of Mine [NSP][ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + mashinnyy 来自 most2820 用于 v196608
description:
"Napryazhennaya i ledenyashchaya dushu igra v zhanre uzhasov, kotoraya zastavit serdtse zamirat kazhdyy raz, kogda gasnet svet." - Alpha Beta Gamer

Osobennosti:
▪ Naydi pravdu ili pozorno umri ot strakha — oshchuti vsyu glubinu uzhasa v etoy khardkornoy igre na vyzhivanie.
▪ Bros vyzov koshmaru — oderzhi pobedu nad nepredskazuemym protivnikom, kotoryy mozhet poyavitsya v lyuboe vremya i v lyubom meste.
▪ Bud nacheku — ispolzuy tekhnologii i izbegay stolknoveniy.
▪ Vyydi na svet — …ili gotovsya k boyu.
▪ Ottochi masterstvo — razvivay svoi navyki, chtoby vyzhit, ved rasschityvat mozhno tolko na sebya.

«No Son Of Mine» — eto survival horror, v kotorom igroka zhdut srazheniya, skrytnost, issledovanie, reshenie golovolomok i razgadka strashnoy tayny. Smozhesh li ty protivostoyat nepredskazuemomu, zhestokomu i smertelno opasnomu vragu i nayti istinu do togo, kak ON naydet tebya?

OTZYVY POLZOVATELEY:
"Dovolno potryasayushche dlya indi-razrabotchika. Esli vy lyubite igry v zhanre survival horror, ne propustite etu malenkuyu zhemchuzhinu». - gyaaft
"Vsya aura i atmosfera igry derzhali menya na grani na protyazhenii vsey moey igry!" - jillbo baggins
"Ya sbilsya so scheta, skolko raz ya umiral. Esli vam nemnogo naskuchila igra uzhasov-golovolomok i vy lyubite nemnogo ekshena, ya by posovetoval poprobovat». - URB4N_D3CAY
"Ya ochen rekomenduyu etu igru 100% ego ne sumasshedshiy dolgo i otlichno rabotaet, esli vy prosto khotite khorosho provesti vremya, chtoby ispugatsya." - GarmanIsBack

title: NeverAwake (Never Awake) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
「NeverAwake」是一款具有獨特世界觀與富有原創性遊戲規則的噩夢類雙搖桿射擊遊戲。
少女將與自己討厭的蔬菜/狗/學校的朋友等各種東西進行戰鬥。
戰鬥結束後少女眼中看到的是……。她會不會醒來呢……？

■關於NeverAwake
「NeverAwake」透過手繪的高品質畫面及精美的動畫，演繹出獨特的世界觀。
作為敵人登場的並不是惡魔……而是少女討厭的蔬菜、牙醫等等。
每個人都曾討厭過的東西或生物化身怪物，攻擊主人公「萊姆」。
80多關的關卡/多達幾十個的BOSS以及獨創遊戲系統所實現的高重玩性，適合從初級到專家級的各水準射擊玩家。
快快嘗試數量眾多的武器及裝飾品的搭配，擊退噩夢中的怪物們吧。
本作品的結局會根據玩家的進度而改變。
一定要玩玩這個遊戲，看看戰鬥結束後少女到底會看到什麼。

■NeverAwake的特點
・踢開蔬菜、牙醫等怪物，忘掉童年的痛苦記憶！
・以「少女的噩夢中」為舞台的獨特世界觀
・手繪的精美畫面與動畫
・獨創的遊戲規則與高重玩性
・快節奏的遊戲玩法和震撼的BOSS戰
・80多關的關卡/多達幾十個的棘手BOSS
・數量眾多的武器、裝飾品以及這些的組合裝備
・完整的故事情節與多種結局

title: NEScape [NSZ][ENG]
description:
NESkeyp kombiniruet vid i oshchushchenie nastoyashchey vosmibitnoy retro igry s elementami sovremennykh eskeyp rum igr. 

Vy v napryazhennoy gonke protiv vremeni, dlya togo, chtoby vybratsya iz komnaty, prezhde chem istechet vremya! 

Dostatochno li u vas stoykosti, chtoby sobrat vse podskazki i svyazat ikh v odno i preodolet ispytaniya, chtoby uvidet chto nakhoditsya po druguyu storonu dverey? 

Naslazhdaytes unikalnym geympleem v zhanre vybratsya iz komnaty i proslezhivayte za svoy progress vidya kak menyaetsya komnata so vremenem! 

Udastsya li vam vybratsya v NESkeype?

- Proyavite svoyu smekalku v chetyrekh tshchatelno produmannykh urovnyakh zapolnennykh golovolomkami
- Proverte svoyu smekalku - nikakikh podskazok!
- Poraduyte vashi glaza nastoyashchey vosmibitnoy grafikoy s kartridzhnoy igrovoy ery
- Vas budet "presledovat" zapominayushchiysya i zhutkiy vosmi bitnyy saundtrek

title: Neon Blight [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Dobro pozhalovat v kiberpankovoe budushchee Neon Blight. Kak novyy vladelets oruzheynogo magazina v stile kiberpank, vasha zadacha - obespechit tolpu podrazhateley geroyami oruzhiem, kotoroe im nuzhno, chtoby dobitsya uspekha v borbe s megakorporatsiyami, pravyashchimi mirom. Voydite v mir besposhchadnoy konkurentsii, besposhchadnogo sopernichestva i bezgranichnykh issledovaniy v roli remontnika.
Vy obespechivaete kiberpankov svoego vozrasta oruzhiem i snaryazheniem, v kotorykh oni nuzhdayutsya. Upravlyayte sobstvennym oruzheynym magazinom, srazhaytes s, kazalos by, beskonechnymi volnami vragov i dobudte sovershennoe oruzhie, probirayas cherez Vneshnyuyu granitsu i tolpy vragov, stremyashchikhsya uderzhat vas ot vashey konechnoy tseli.

Fiksator, kak nikto drugoy
- Upravlyayte sobstvennym oruzheynym magazinom: nastraivayte magazin, kotorym vladeete, i prodavayte priobretennoe oruzhie kiberpankam, stremyashchimsya uluchshit svoyu zhizn.
- Torgovlya oruzhiem budushchego: prodayte sotni moderniziruemykh vidov oruzhiya klientam, kotorye khotyat poluchit preimushchestvo nad konkurentami.
- Loyalnost po premialnoy tsene: vystraivayte otnosheniya so svoimi klientami, udovletvoryaya ikh potrebnosti i, pri neobkhodimosti, berya delo v svoi ruki, vypolnyaya ikh zadaniya.

Poluchenie absolyutnogo oruzhiya
Vas zhdet oruzhie, sposobnoe perevernut balans sil v Edeme. Smozhete li vy nayti klyuchi ot khranilishcha i zabrat absolyutnoe oruzhie?

- Srazhaytes na desyatkakh sozdannykh vruchnuyu urovney, chtoby poluchit komponenty sovershennogo oruzhiya.
- Poluchite sovershennyy instrument voyny, perevorachivayushchiy khrupkiy balans sil v novom Edeme.
- Srazites s unikalnymi bossami, chtoby zakhvatit rynok torgovli oruzhiem v megapolise i postroit sobstvennoe budushchee.

title: Nefasto's Misadventure: Meeting Noeroze [NSZ][ENG]
description:
V etoy svoeobraznoy interpretatsii zhanra point & click vam predstoit sygrat za Nefasto — element povrezhdennykh igrovykh dannykh, zablokirovannykh, kogda konsol vydala oshibku. Vremya na iskhode: sistema vot-vot zavershit rabotu! Sumeete li vy vybratsya naruzhu, poka vas okonchatelno ne sterli iz pamyati?

Priklyucheniya, golovolomki i srazheniya… Pomogite Nefasto v puteshestvii po strannomu i udivitelnomu miru. Razgadyvayte slozhnye zagadki. Obshchaytes s drugimi personazhami s nepovtorimoy vneshnostyu i maneroy rechi. Srazhaytes so strannymi bossami i otkroyte dlya sebya odnu iz mnozhestva kontsovok prezhde, chem zakonchitsya obratnyy otschet.

Neobyknovennyy, ekstsentrichnyy i udivitelnyy kvest Nefasto's Misadventure: Meeting Noeroze polon otsylok i svoeobraznogo yumora. 

- Chetvertaya stena lomaetsya v kazhdom dialoge pod naporom metaironii.
- Besedy s nezabyvaemymi personazhami pomogut nayti put v mire igry.
- Bossy podryvayut sistemu i delayut eto s udovolstviem, a znachit, nuzhno dat im boy!
- Reshit golovolomku ili oboyti prepyatstvie pozvolyat binarnye sily, nuzhnye predmety… ili sovety po prokhozhdeniyu iz interneta. Vas nikto ne osudit!
- Igrovoy protsess to i delo menyaetsya po prikhoti koda Nefasto.
- Mnozhestvo vozmozhnykh variantov razvitiya sobytiy. Dlya vashey konsoli vse obychno zakanchivaetsya khorosho, a vot dlya Nefasto — ne ochen.
- V etoy point & click mozhno prygat. (Kogda otkroete obuchenie — sdelayte vid, chto etogo ne znali).

title: Necroboy Path to Evilship [NSZ][ENG]
description:
《死靈小子：邪王之路》是一個年輕死靈法師的故事，他的目標是成為最偉大的邪惡之王！憑藉著黑暗力量，復活死靈小兵來執行他的命令並且解決謎題，在他最愛的英雄──聲名狼藉的死靈大人地下墓穴中勇敢前進！

■下一個邪惡之王的起源故事？■

跟著死靈小子以及他最近剛復活的僕從，拉奇！哎呀，他們可能對於「僕從」這個詞沒有共識。就跟「拉奇」這個名字一樣。然而，這種小爭吵並不會妨礙他們從彼此身上學習──死靈小子渴望走上邪惡的道路，這個催化劑將兩個人的命運綑綁在一起。

■充滿謎題的地下墓穴！■

死靈小子必須解決大量謎題才能更深入地下墓穴！或者至少，他會讓死靈小兵來替自己完成。
遊戲中禁止使用暴力哦！死靈小子還是個孩子呢，可惡！

title: Nadir a Grimdark Deckbuilder [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
genre: Role-Playing, Strategy, Board Game, Puzzle, TCG
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description: Ostav nadezhdu, vsyak syuda vkhodyashchiy!

title: Mythargia [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Mifargiya - eto 2D retro-priklyuchenie s aktsentom na otkrytie istorii ostrova.

Issleduyte ostrov:
V poiskakh informatsii vy stolknetes s sverkhestestvennym na ostrove. Naydite instrumenty i predmety, chtoby pomoch vam v puteshestvii vglub.

Razgadyvayte tayny:
Ne ostavlyayte kamnya na kamne, kogda puteshestvuete glubzhe v ostrov. Reshayte golovolomki, chtoby nayti vse vozmozhnye uliki i poluchit polnuyu kartinu proizoshedshego na ostrove.

Otkroyte koshmar:
Voydite v drugoe izmerenie i pomogite zhitelyam ostrova zavoevat ikh doverie, chtoby uznat bolshe o nikh i ikh proshlom.

Sobirayte informatsiyu:
Pishite zapisi v dnevnike i fotografiruyte vashe puteshestvie, chtoby ponimat, chto proizoshlo na ostrove Mifargiya i sostavit istoriyu veka.

title: Murderous Muses [NSP][ENG]
description:
Proshel god s tekh por, kak byl ubit skandalnyy khudozhnik Mordekhay Grey.

Teper k godovshchine ego smerti otkrylas novaya vystavka, na kotoroy predstavleny shest ego samykh izvestnykh portretov, kazhdyy iz kotorykh yavlyaetsya potentsialnym podozrevaemym v ego ubiystve.

Vy igraete za nochnogo strazha, issleduya galereyu v gulkie chasy, chtoby nayti podskazki o ego smerti. Reshayte golovolomki i ispolzuyte Glaza Mordekhaya, chtoby ozhivit portrety, vosstanovit proshloe, chtoby nayti ego ubiytsu...

* Raskroyte neraskrytoe delo ob ubiystve, kotoroe povtoryaetsya kazhdyy raz, kogda vy igraete.
* Issleduyte protsedurno sozdannuyu 3D-galereyu s menyayushchimisya komnatami i neozhidannymi povorotami.
* Raskroyte uliki i ispolzuyte deduktsiyu, chtoby nayti ubiytsu
* Reshayte golovolomki i otkryvayte sekretnye lokatsii!

Murderous Muses («Ubiystvennye muzy») ot sozdateley «Zaraznogo bezumiya doktora Dekkera», «Detektiva-oborotnya» i «Temnykh nochey s Po i Manro» — eto sverkhestestvennyy detektiv s beskonechnoy vozmozhnostyu povtornogo vosproizvedeniya, gde vybor sposoba rassledovaniya — eto forma iskusstva...

title: Murder is Game Over [NSP][ENG]
description:
Prisoedinyaytes k detektivu Gayu i ego vernoy ishcheyke Klio v rassledovanii zagadochnoy smerti legendarnogo i bogatogo geym-dizaynera v selskoy mestnosti shtata Vermont v SShA.

Issleduyte zamok, ishchite uliki i oprashivayte podozrevaemykh. Smozhete li vy razgadat zagadku i privlech vinovnikov k otvetstvennosti?

Igrayte v etu zakhvatyvayushchuyu detektivnuyu igru i ispytayte svoi navyki syshchika, chtoby razgadat taynu i razoblachit ubiytsu. 


Kharakteristiki
* Rassledovanie ubiystva v stile «Kto eto sdelal»
* Igrayte za detektiva i ego vernogo psa
* Issleduyte zamok i ishchite uliki
	* Doprashivayte podozrevaemykh
* Razgadayte zagadku i arestuyte prestupnika

title: Princess Farmer [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Princess Farmer is a match3 puzzle and visual novel game with easy to learn action mechanics and different difficulty levels that let you breeze through the game or challenge you to earn more rewards. The story is played in episodes, much like magical-girl anime, with each lasting between 20 minutes to 1 hour, depending on your chosen difficulty level, your skills, and whether you decide to skip dialogue interactions. Different level goals keep you on your toes and bring a fresh approach to the match3 genre. Dialogue options let you choose how Princess Farmer interacts with her friends, affecting your relationships with them. Make them your BFF and they may reward you with gifts!

Princess Farmer was just an ordinary farmer when one day she woke up under the Gaia Tree. Now through the magic of Mother Gaia, she can hoist up whole rows of veggies with ease to make matches and smash obstacles by herself, in co-op, or even with an AI companion! Something mysterious is happening in the woods and it's your job to puzzle your way to uncover it! You'll learn about the world around you as you talk and build relationships with the loveable characters including: Mother Gaia, Garlic, Shoppe Keeper Rowan, and even Bot Bunny!

title: Exitman Deluxe [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
趁天花板還沒降落前，盡快逃到出口處。只要成功逃脫，天花板就會再次升起來並反復落下。出口處的位置會隨機改變。你能夠存活多久呢？

只要成功逃脫到黃色出口處裡，就能夠賺取硬幣，換購各種新造型。

挑戰以下四種遊戲模式：
無盡模式、百人生存模式、對抗電腦模式，以及150個迅速回合的挑戰模式！
你還可以通過線上排行榜與其他玩家對抗一較高下。

你也可以和朋友們進行二至四人的本地對抗模式，來一場魷魚遊戲般的競賽！

title: Cave Bad [NSZ][ENG]
description:
當你以像素化8位元的樣式進入詭異的地牢時，請拿起你的斧頭和大量炸彈！與 Pity Pit 位於同一宇宙中，在Cave Bad裡會看到矮人奧拉蒂奧進行更多充滿動作的探索，這一次是處理從上而下的惡魔，並使用所有可用的工具來對抗地下惡魔。

這次 roguelike 的冒險結合了流派經典的靈感與程序生成的結合，以保持每次都充滿新鮮和不可預知。通過近戰攻擊消滅壞人，或策略性地放置炸彈。解決難題，收集物品，購買新裝備並推動極限以達到更高的分數！

特色：

• 扮演可愛的矮人奧拉蒂奧的角色！
• 探索充滿謎題和敵人的8位元地牢。
• 收集金幣購買醫療包，武器等！
• 克服危險的首領之戰。
• 沿途欣賞動聽的芯片音樂配樂！

title: Clan N [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Fight alone or with your friends, master the art of battle and bring peace back to the land in this arcade inspired epic brawler!

Clan N is a hack'n'slash game which combines the classic arcades gameplay with today's modern brawlers. With a fast paced nature, you have to dodge, block and use your light, heavy and special attacks wisely to progress. With an ancient far east theme, you'll get challenged across 7 different levels with many different enemies, Mid/End level bosses and casual mini games integrated into main gameplay.

About Clan N:

Clan N is an ancient samurai group in the region of “Far East”, sworn to protect the realm from all who seek its destruction. The four group members consist of the shinobigatana-wielding ninja Akira, the staff-striking Reina, the dual sword-swinging Daiki, and the sickle-slashing monk Tarou.

After years of training and dedication to their respective craft, each character has uncovered their own unique magical abilities. Akira shoots pulse-filled lightning bolts, Reina controls the ground with vicious earthquake shocks, Daiki swirls up brutal tornado waves, and Tarou can call for the help of Dragons.

Story:

Akuji is a former samurai of the Clan N that discovered the balance of the world lies in three areas: Peace, Knowledge, and Time. Akuji found that if you knock the world of one of these, you can harness the powers of “spiritual imbalance” and grow stronger from it. As a result of pursuing spiritual imbalance, he was shunned from the samurai temple and kicked out of Clan N.

What Akuji didn’t know was that attaining spiritual imbalance would not only give you dark powers, it consumed your light and the purity of your life. Following his banishment from the temple and Clan N, Akuji was able to destroy peace by slaughtering villages and retain the power of those he killed, thus absorbing conflict and electric sorcery abilities, becoming the most powerful sorcerer warrior in the Far East. While he continued to grow, Akuji formed Seishin Gun, the spirit group, to join his conquest and remove anyone standing in their path.

Once his actions were discovered by Clan N, they set on a journey to stop the villainous pillaging by Akuji and Seishin Gun.

About the Characters:

Reina and Daiki grew as siblings in a southern samurai clan. Reina was not taught the teaching of the clan like her brother Daiki but still observed and learned the ways mastering the staff. She eventually took onto Shamanism as well becoming one of the first shinobi shamans in the land as a young woman.

Akira was a childhood friend adopted into the clan as a lost child wandering in the outer lands chased by a pack of wolves, barely making it to the village. Daiki’s father took the child in and raised them, although Akira typically covers himself from head to after severe scarring.

Tarou was from the same monastery as Akuji (prior to his joining of Clan N) and learned under the same teachers. Akuji returned to the Monk’s temple many years later and stole an ancient scroll that explained how to destroy the pillars of balance and extract their spiritual imbalance. In pursuit of Akuji, Tarou traced his steps to Clan N. After explaining the situation to the existing three members, they all decided to team up and take down Akuji.

title: Candy Raid The Factory [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Candy Raid: The Factory is a retro top-down puzzle and exploration game. You play the candy-happy witch Candy as she uses her elemental powers to solve puzzles and unlock secrets in her never-ending quest to sate her sweet tooth.

Glorious retro pixel art in a top-down adventure style.
Family-friendly non-violent puzzle action and adventure.
Dozens of unique puzzles punctuated by sweet, sweet rewards.
Harness the power of fire, ice, and wind magic as you wander around the world.
Three unique areas to explore: the lively gumdrop gardens, the fiery lava kitchens, and the secret frozen vaults.

title: Haunted Dungeons Hyakki Castle [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Form your party (a group of secret agents) from among 
four races: Human, Oni, Tengu, and Nekomata. Then 
conquer the terrifying and mysterious Yokai-filled castle!

■The Yokai in Hyakki Castle
The game reproduces Yokai from ancient Japanese 
literature, including the giant skeleton Gasha Dokuro 
and a Yokai made up of a woman's head and arm.
Many creepy and terrifying monsters will appear.
They await your secret agents (players) in Hyakki 
Castle.
Powerful bosses will be unleashed at certain points as 
you make your way up through the castle. Aim for the 
tower, where the master of the castle awaits!

■Main Theme: Dan no Ura
Dan no Ura, an original song by the Biwa player Sae 
Ishida, creates a creepy atmosphere.

■About Real Time Dungeon RPGs
"Real time dungeon RPGs play like an action game, in 
which you move around and fight on a floor with a grid 
layout. With the exception of some portions, the game 
plays out in real time.

When in combat, the enemy won't wait for your attack.

Battle by avoiding enemy attacks and timing your own 
attacks at the right moment."

■A Yokai-Filled Castle with Death Looming Around the 
Corner
The player's secret agents will storm Hyakki Castle, 
where formidable Yokai and terrifying traps await.
Be careful. One miss will cost you your life.
Eat the food you find in the castle to survive. An empty 
stomach will lower your stats.

There's nowhere to relax in this castle. Eat, sleep, 
destroy Yokai, and search the castle.

In the Yokai-filled Hyakki Castle, you're always one step 
away from death.

■The 2 Party System
"The game has a split party system that uses the 
Tokugawa treasure item Ishin no Ofuda.
The player can freely split up into two parties at any 
time (the game will go into split screen mode).
When necessary, split into two teams to deal with the 
traps and challenges in the room.
In addition, the party you aren't controlling will use 
spells to temporarily harden themselves, increasing their 
stamina.
Attack enemies from the rear to deal massive damage. 
Use the hardened party with high stamina as a decoy, 
and send the other around to the back."

title: Princess Maker Faery Tales Come True / Go Go Princess / 2 Regeneration [NSZ][ENG]
description:
「美少女夢工廠2」30週年記念作品
「美少女夢工廠」是一款以父親身分養育女兒的養成模擬類型遊戲代表作品，至今仍十分受人歡迎。
在系列作當中，「美少女夢工廠2」是名氣最響亮的作品，第一代「美少女夢工廠2」（PC-9801版）於1993年發售，現今迎向30週年。
本作乃為紀念周年而推出，由GAINAX內主導「美少女夢工廠」系列製作，並參與角色設計的赤井孝美老師重新繪製CG。


關於美少女夢工廠2
「美少女夢工廠2」是一款模擬類型的育兒遊戲，玩家將扮演父親照顧由星星所賜予的女兒。
養育的時間為10歲到18歲的8年。你的女兒會在遊戲中經歷各種體驗並逐漸長大成人。少女的夢想是成為公主，但依據養育方式的不同，未來有著千變萬化的可能性。來吧，看看您要為這位少女編織什麼夢想……？

關於重新繪製CG
本作是以2004年發售的「美少女夢工廠2 Refine」為基礎，格外重要的CG經由赤井孝美之手，以接近初代PC-98版的畫風來重新繪製。新版CG也配合目前的遊戲生態，以高解析度繪製，呈現出極致追求細節的優良品質。

新增片頭動畫
本作新增由米子GAINAX製作的片頭動畫。在赤井孝美老師率領團隊創作出的這部動畫中，能夠讓人感受到「初為人父」的玩家與「女兒」之間的美好未來。

了解女兒的狀態是育兒的第一步
由於本作是養成模擬類型遊戲，養育的關鍵就在於隨時掌握女兒的狀態。
因此在「重生」中，會隨時顯示用以掌握女兒狀態的參數，便於迅速確認女兒的情況。為了女兒的將來，做好決定需要做哪些事情，並細心的養育她吧。

來自赤井孝美老師的訊息
我很感謝誕生於30年前的「美少女夢工廠2」如今也受到許多人的喜愛，甚至發行新的版本。我藉由這次機會實現了之前一直想做的CG更新！請好好享受重新繪製的假期與結局吧。

title: DreamWorks Spirit Lucky's Big Adventure [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Kuda privedet vas karta sokrovishch Laki? Skachite kak Laki na svoem vernom mustange — Spirit i nachnite novoe dikoe priklyuchenie v Miradero. Tam est polnostyu otkrytaya granitsa s zakhvatyvayushchimi kvestami i dikoy prirodoy dlya issledovaniya. Vy obyazatelno poluchite massu udovolstviya, kogda ryadom s vami besstrashnye luchshie druzya Laki: Abigayl i Pru! 

Vam nuzhno budet umet orientirovatsya v opasnostyakh tak zhe, kak i konyukh Khendriks, kotoryy slishkom zainteresovan v vashey okhote za sokrovishchami. Svyaz mezhdu Laki i Spirit stanovitsya vse silnee i eto znachit, chto vmeste s priyatelyami vy gotovy stat nastoyashchim pogranichnym ekspertom. Druzhba, vospitanie i issledovaniya — vot klyuch, chtoby razgadat taynu i perekhitrit zlodeya Khendriksa.

Eto zakhvatyvayushchaya i polnaya priklyucheniy zhizn v derevne. Prokatites po pyati razlichnym regionam Miradero, otkryvaya predmety dlya sbora, skrytye tropy i zhivotnykh – kak druzhelyubnykh, tak i opasnykh. Pomogayte gorozhanam, vzyav na sebya rabotu po ekspress-dostavke i spaseniyu zhivotnykh. Ispolzuyte kameru, chtoby zapechatlet krasotu peyzazha i skachite verkhom na Spirit k pobede v zakhvatyvayushchikh skachkakh.

Kogda pridet vremya rasslablyatsya, izmenyayte svoy vneshniy vid s pomoshchyu veshchey i predmetov, kotorye vy nashli v svoikh priklyucheniyakh ili otpravlyaytes v konyushni Miradero, chtoby ukhazhivat za Spirit i obnimat ego. Chem krepche budet vasha svyaz, tem dalshe Spirit smozhet peresech velikuyu granitsu. Smozhete li vy nayti i zashchitit nastoyashchee sokrovishche Miradero?

• Bud Laki — zvezda v novom priklyuchenii Spirit 

• SVYaZ SO SPIRIT — ukhazhivayte za svoim vernym mustangom i obnimayte ego

• POKAZhITE SVOY STIL — ispolzuyte veshchi i predmety, kotorye vy sobiraete, chtoby polnostyu izmenit vneshniy vid Laki i sdelat ego unikalnym

• ZhIVITE SVOEY ZhIZNYu — spasayte zhivotnykh, pomogayte gorozhanam, fotografiruyte i mnogoe drugoe!

title: Mugen Souls [NSP][ENG]
description:
加入 Chou-Chou 征服宇宙和七大界的征途！在這款動漫風 JRPG 中，你可以指揮信賴的夥伴 Altis、忠僕 Ryuto 等人，跟著 Chou-Chou 一起將各個世界的英雄、惡魔領主都變成都變成她的私人僕役，才能完全掌控並解放這充滿衝突的宇宙。但是真的會照著計劃走嗎？

《Mugen Souls》主打在自由移動的地圖上的回合制戰鬥、可客製化的隊伍和技能、等著你探索的廣大世界、以及粉絲們最愛的「萌萌」要素！破壞戰場上的水晶來啟動 Hyper Mode、打出連擊並使用 Moe Kill 技巧來奴役敵人、抓住弱點來讓他們變成物品。透過客製化身體部位、臉部表情、職業等來創造出你獨一無二的大軍！

這款升級版的《Mugen Souls》包含所有之前的額外內容，並忠實的呈現日版原版內容，絕對是體驗這款經典邪典 JRPG 的最佳方式！

特色：

• 探索七個充滿活力的世界，並征服全宇宙！
• 在自由移動的地圖上與怪物戰鬥，讓他們成為你的僕役。
• 和你的戰友一起發動華麗的連技！
• 客製化身體部位、臉部和職業，創造獨一無二的角色。
• 享受「萌萌」要素，和無可比擬的動漫風格！

title: Monster Loves You / Monster Loves You Too [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Stante monstrom, rozhdennym v pokrytom slizyu chane. Povzrosleyte i prevratites v materoe chudishche. Kazhdyy vash vybor v khode skazochnogo priklyucheniya otrazitsya na mire monstrov i lyudey.
Vy zhivete v derevushke Predvestie i obozhaete kushat palchiki malenkikh detey. Buduchi monstrom, vy umeete okazyvatsya v samykh interesnykh mestakh. Chto vy sdelaete, esli pri vas tri rassvirepevshikh medvedya naydut devochku v svoey izbushke? Ili esli vy natknetes na volka, kotoryy presleduet devushku v krasnoy shapochke?

title: Monorail Stories [NSP][ENG]
description:
Good morning and welcome to the Monorail Transit System connecting the Cities of M and L. This spectacular feat of engineering allows thousands to commute between the Cities each day in the timeliest of mannersEvery day a hundred new stories are born in these cars running on the track suspended above the Bay.
Every day extraordinary things happen to ordinary people.

Silvie and Ahmal, from the City of M and the City of L. Two strangers who unknowingly affect each other's lives through the monorail they share each day.
Commuting between the cities each day at different times, they choose who to talk to on the monorail, how to treat their fellow commuters, and what to do as the monorail makes its run over the Bay. 
Each day is a new chapter in their shared story, one you can write on your own or with a friend, through an asynchronous multiplayer mode.

As Ahmal and Silvie, you'll meet dozens of people during their commute. How they interact with them is up to you.
The choices made on the monorail affect the course of their stories - or rather, the one shared story they inhabit. Every decision and every interaction leads to one of the multiple endings for the traveling pair.
When their story ends, your own can begin. The Season story mode offers you the ability to create an original commuting character and experience the city from another perspective.

As the Monorail Stories unfold, so does the tale of the two cities linked by the track. The two city-states face upheaval and uncertainty, just like the people who pass between them on the monorail each day. Destinies may very well be decided not by what the people do, but by how they treat one another, or rather, how you interact with those around yourself.
Control Ahmal and Silvie in single player, or find a friend to experience a non-linear story through an iconic asynchronous multiplayer mode. Explore each city’s monorail station as you both await for the monorail, each of you immersing in your own interactions and secrets to keep (or share).

title: Mondealy [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
description:
在「Mondealy」的幻想世界中，一個美麗的夜晚，你發現自己在一個名爲達格拉特的地下王國。你很快就會認識它的居民，甚至是公主本人，以後會和她有很多冒險。你可以瞭解到許多關於人物、他們的關係和世界本身的細節。那麼，在這樣一個神奇的、風景如畫的王國裏，會有什麼不幸在等待着人物呢？

特點

• 各種各樣的人物歡迎你進入他們的王國，他們會很高興見到你 (有些會比其他的更高興)

• 充滿了神祕、個人故事、喜劇、悲劇和更多的情節。

• 四個外觀不同的達格拉特區，每個都有自己的外觀和氛圍。

• 「Mondealy」的結局一直都是一樣的，但你通往它的道路是獨一無二的。遊戲爲你提供了不同的機會，你可以利用或忽略這些機會，還有不同的事件和對話，你在其中決定將這個發展中的故事帶到哪裏。

• 「Mondealy」強調細節--許多小對話和文字描述、人物反應和獨特場景。你的追隨者可能會對你的周圍環境作出評論，或對某種情況作出反應，或者他們可能會告訴你他們與你認識的其他人物的關係。「Mondealy」的世界試圖向你所有愚蠢和自發的想法開放。

• 帶有遊戲原聲帶的收藏磁帶，你需要找到它，還有許多其他的收藏品!

• 一個廣泛的畫廊，充滿了各種人物的獨特圖片和關於他們的設計、個性和關係的描述。

• 種類繁多的不同類型和節奏的音樂。

• 各種風景如畫的地方，供喜歡放鬆和欣賞遊戲景色的人使用。

title: Mon-Yu [NSP][ENG]
description:
Poshagovyy danzhen-krouler ot pervogo litsa, sozdannyy v luchshikh traditsiyakh originalnoy serii rolevykh igr Wizardry. Sdelayte svoikh sobstvennykh personazhey, chtoby pobedit sem koroley demonov. Sformiruyte svoyu komandu, zachistite podzemelya, pobedite monstrov i oderzhite pobedu.
Sozdayte samuyu silnuyu komandu geroev na svete i pobedite velikikh Koroley Dyavolov — skolko by raz vy ni umerli!

title: Molly Medusa Queen of Spit [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Poor Molly! A sculptor’s apprentice cursed into a snake-haired Medusa – and so, every living thing she goes near instantly turns into a stone statue. Every living thing! Enemies and friends, bosses and shopkeepers, monsters and allies, even animals and small insects, they all turn to stone.

Molly’s quest takes her through a series of mystical temples, as she struggles with loneliness and alienation. Inside these temples, gravity is “local”. Molly’s “down” is calculated from the surface she’s currently standing on, which means she can easily walk up walls, or upside down in the ceiling. This allows the level design to twist in on itself, and curl into labyrinths that are physically impossible. Petrified enemies accompany gravity puzzles and non-euclidean architecture, in M. C. Escher scavenger hunts.

title: Mirrored Souls [NSZ][ENG]
description:
In this 2D “single-player-coop” puzzle-platformer, players have to reunite Ravi and Daru, two celestial beings separated in a mirrored world. 

Control both characters at the same time in a mirrored screen while jumping and pushing your way through a bevy of beautifully illustrated scenarios to solve challenging, mind-bending Braid-like puzzles.
Discover a variety of pretty locations that brings up the duality of both characters while developing your cognitive skills and spatial vision as you cross portals to bring them together in a thoughtful, sensitive story-driven experience.

Single Player Coop
Control both characters at the same time and challenge your coordination, perception and problem-solving skills.

Handcrafted illustrations
Beautifully drawn scenarios with different challenges and elements that compliments the narrative.

Mind-Bending Puzzles
Explore the possibilities of a unique mirrored mechanic to the maximum to get through each carefully crafted level.

Beautiful Story
Chill and unravel a thoughtful story about the complexities of love and how it can change our lifes.

title: Minabo a Walk Through Life [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
«Minabo – A walk through life» – sotsialno-modeliruyushchaya igra, gde vy idete po zhiznennomu puti, v to vremya kak vasha repka rastet i protsvetaet (ili net), vystraivaya sotsialnye otnosheniya.

Zhizn nachinaetsya, kogda vy prorastaete, a s kazhdym vashim shagom vremya idet vpered, prichem vy mozhete izmenit temp v lyubuyu minutu. Vek zhivi – vek uchis: okruzhayte sebya drugimi repkami i vzaimodeystvuyte s nimi, chtoby sformirovat svoyu lichnost. Poyavivshiesya u vas silnye i slabye storony budut vliyat na vzaimodeystvie s okruzhayushchimi.

Sozdavayte svoy krug obshcheniya, podderzhivaya i razvivaya naibolee tsennye dlya vas otnosheniya, i izbegayte tekh, kotorye vas ne ustraivayut. Vy smozhete priruchit mnozhestvo redisok i provesti zhizn v obshchestve svoikh lyubimtsev, obzavestis semey i rodit malyshey, libo zhit v bystrom tempe i umeret molodym. Est tysyachi sposobov prozhit zhizn, i ni odin iz nikh ne idealen! Prosto zhivite, kak khochetsya! (nu i prinimayte posledstviya svoikh resheniy, kogda nachnete portitsya)

Zhit polnoy zhiznyu, vystraivaya sotsialnye otnosheniya – nelegkiy trud. Poetomu v igre «Minabo - A walk through life» mozhno sobirat kollektsionnye shlyapy. Nosite ikh, vot tolko deystvuyut oni po-raznomu. Variantov khvataet: legko vlyublyatsya, stat obektom vseobshchey nenavisti, obzavestis elegantnymi manerami i dazhe prodlit sebe zhizn...

V igre «Minabo - A walk through life» ne byvaet dvukh pokhozhikh zhizney, a v kontse kazhdoy iz nikh vy poluchite kratkuyu biografiyu, kotoroy smozhete podelitsya s druzyami.

Chto by vam khotelos izmenit v svoem proshlom? Kak by slozhilas vasha zhizn, ne nagrubi vy svoemu drugu v detstve? A mozhet stoilo provodit bolshe vremeni s semey? Blagodarya igre «Minabo - A walk through life» vy poluchite otvety na eti voprosy, esli reshite dvigatsya nazad po osi vremeni vmesto togo, chtoby nachat novuyu zhizn.

title: Midnight is Lost [NSZ][ENG]
description:
午夜是女巫的動物幫手，更準確地說，是一隻意外落入神秘島嶼的貓。 現在他迷失在一個奇怪的世界裡，需要你的幫助才能回家。

在冒險開始之前，還有一件事你必須知道......午夜迷失給你一個獨特而具有挑戰性的體驗，需要向後解決。

準備好用這個遊戲來燃燒你的大腦吧！

特色：
- 30 個手工製作的關卡；
- 獨特且身臨其境的配樂；
- 尋找秘密迷你遊戲；

title: Memorrha [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
開啟一場探索之旅，追隨神秘文化的足跡。解開沉睡機器的謎團，瞭解有關其創造者的更多資訊。等待你的是一個多姿多彩的開放世界，裡面充滿驚心動魄的謎題和秘密。
- 你能破譯古代技術的機制嗎？
- 你會知道關於先人的真相嗎？
- 你會在這個神秘的世界裡找到自己的命運嗎？

遊戲特色
- 探索精心設計的程式化環境
- 解決複雜的邏輯和組合謎題
- 與機器和可移植對象交互
- 使用掃描器登記符號和象形圖

title: Melon Journey Bittersweet Memories [NSZ][ENG]
description:
《Melon Journey: Bittersweet Memories》讓你扮演戴頭巾的兔子「蜜瓜」，這名甜瓜汽水工廠的員工為了尋找近日失蹤的摯友而踏上旅途。但這個持有甜瓜便有可能坐苦牢的小鎮是否真如表面這麼安全呢？還有為何會有一隻倉鼠如此執著於潛入貓咪國王的城堡呢？

試著解開謎團吧！在這款 Froach Club 最新開發的劇情探索遊戲中體驗一個迷人的像素世界，認識一籮筐滿出來的怪趣人物和罪犯，捲入這場古怪又可愛的陰謀。

懸疑不斷
揪出隱藏在刺蝟市大街小巷中的每個線索，跟蹤可疑的人物，暗中穿梭於骯髒污穢的地下世界，活用敏銳的洞察力和機智在千鈞一髮之際拼湊出真相。

背景豐富的傻氣人物
在尋找失蹤好友的途中，你會遇見數十個極具個性的有趣動物角色，有些甚至還有悲慘的過往，留待想要打破砂鍋問到底的玩家揭開謎團。

爵士風 Lo-Fi 配樂
在探案過程中享受超過 90 首由 markeryjane 帶來的電子和爵士配樂。

美妙的復古風格圖像
這個由綠色色階組成的世界充滿著用心的細節，輔以現代技術改良，為傳統掌機世代獻上懷舊情調。

title: Mayhem in Single Valley [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Chto mozhet byt khuzhe, chem prosnutsya poutru i sluchayno nachat apokalipsis? Znakomtes, eto Dzhek — ozornoy parenek so strannoy semeykoy, svoey vernoy rogatkoy i vechnym nevezeniem.

V etoy dinamichnoy, polnoy golovolomok i priklyucheniy igre vam pridetsya perepravlyatsya cherez yadovitye reki, uchitsya v Nachalnoy shkole dlya prizrakov, klonirovat sebya i dazhe — samoe slozhnoe ispytanie — zasluzhit papino odobrenie.

title: Match Ventures 1, 2 [NSZ][ENG]
description:
在這個獨特的全新三消冒險中探索克利夫蒙特城堡的地牢！
穿越巨大的關卡並克服數十個障礙，同時在深處搜索有價值的物品，以幫助重建被黑暗巨龍大師 Dragor 蹂躪的城堡。
擊退敵人、探索洞穴和解決謎題，所有這一切都在您的盟友妖精芬利和他的矮人同伴的幫助下完成。
實現一個古老的傳說，讓這片土地擺脫黑暗。

特徵：
- 穿越巨大的水平。
- 遇到無數需要克服的環境障礙。
- 在城堡中與敵人戰鬥！
- 重建傳說中的克利夫蒙特城堡。
- 華麗的幻想配樂。

title: Mars Base [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Welcome to Mars, adventurer! You have been selected to join the latest Mars colonization mission, establishing a permanent human presence on the enigmatic Red Planet. Your assignment is at Mars Base, located in the scenic Erebus Montes region on the Amazonis Planitia. Your job? Make sure that our nascent colony can sustain itself through agriculture. Achieve the impossible and convert the harsh Martian soil into arable land, to grow everything the colonists need to survive. If successful, you'll mark the beginning of Human-Martian  history.
However, never forget that you'll be working tens of millions of kilometers away from Earth. Resupply is not an option for the most dangerous gardening job ever.


The scenic Erebus Montes region is located in one of the most fascinating regions of Mars, with a rich geological history. Mars Base will be tasked with digging into this rich history and help humanity understand our next home a little better.

The base is a living organism, with dozens of facilities. You will have access to all the necessary essentials upon landing, including crafting facilities, research labs, solar power plants, and your trusty greenhouses.
Every colonist has something to share. Be sure to interact with your fellow expedition members to learn their stories and see if you can't help them with their tasks. Teamwork!
More colonists will join you at the base every two Earth years, bringing with them more job expertise and assisting in growing Mars Base. See it grow from an outpost to humanity's first extraterrestrial city!


As the expedition's main botanist, you'll be responsible for turning a dead planet into a living one, a planter at a time. The other colonists will certainly appreciate your tireless labor to keep them fed and alive.

Martian soil can be toxic and barren, so botanists have to get creative. Starting with raw resources supplied by fellow colonists on a daily basis, you'll be able to gradually turn this sterile land into something much more suited for life to thrive.
A colonist does not live on “poo-tatoes” alone. Expand agriculture endeavors to provide a variety of crops and provide them with all the necessary micronutrients. Scurvy is not fun - and positively lethal when in the red variety instead of yellow.
Utilize a broad range of tools to succeed, from modular planters that can be combined in an infinite variety of configurations to autonomous robots to automate much of the labor.

Mars is more than just humanity's first foothold in the stars. It is also endless wind-swept plains and cyclopean mountains above ground, gigantic pyroducts and vast caverns below, as well as the most hostile environment humanity has set foot upon. Grow your crops, pack them for the journey, and venture out beyond the safe perimeter of Mars Base to explore the Red Planet!

If you brave the dust storms on the surface and the undiscovered mysteries of the underground, you will gain access to valuable resources for crafting tools and supplies. You might even help further the mission's scientific research goals while you're at it.
Crafting is essential. Bring back those resources and see what can be made to help you survive the challenges of Mars - or grow your agricultural projects instead!
During down time, don your iconic chef hat and whip up Martian-cooked meals with freshly grown produce, race Mars rovers for research, or build rockets to explore other celestial bodies beyond the red horizon.
Settle into your assigned living space - a fully customizable home base - to catch up on sleep after a hard day’s work. We would like all colonists to remember that, on Mars, while sleep may be optional, work is not.

title: Mage and Monsters [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Mage & Monsters is an active auto battler, where you must choose wisely between upgrading the might of your army, or increasing the power of your spells.

Features
- 8 mages each with a special bonus and starting spell. And Gus.
- 25 distinct units you can recruit, and 35 different monsters to defeat.
- 11 unique spells you can use in battle to help your army.
- Earn Blood Shards by playing that can be spent on Power Ups before starting a new game.
- An arena and a forest map, each with 30 normal levels followed by 5 levels of endgame.

title: The Good Life + DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
■歡迎來到雨林鎮

受債務所困的攝影師娜奧米·海沃德接到《晨鐘新聞》的委託，去揭開英國一個鄉野小鎮——雨林鎮的秘密。當她奔赴遠離紐約的現場，端起相機開始調查之時，立刻就遭遇了匪夷所思之事。小鎮上的居民們，在夜晚居然會變成貓和狗！就她為解開謎題而東奔西走的時候，小鎮上又發生了一宗離奇的謀殺案……和娜奧米一起，揭露雨林鎮的真相吧！

■變身為貓狗，利用各種能力巧妙地解決難題！

娜奧米變身成動物後，就可以使出千奇百怪的能力！貓咪可以登上小鎮的高處進行探索。而狗狗則可以通過氣味追蹤居民們的蹤跡！靈活運用這些能力來解決你所遇到的難題吧！

■發揮攝影技術，大賺一筆！

娜奧米身為攝影師，可以依照晨鐘社以及居民們的委託來拍攝照片，以此換取報酬。此外，也可以將奪人眼球的照片上傳到攝影論壇“Flamingo”上，從而獲得收入，讓窮鄉僻壤中的生活變得輕鬆一些。

■享受慢節奏的鄉村生活

雨林鎮是個只要有錢，就能輕鬆自由度日的好地方。你可以在庭院中栽培蔬菜、鍛鍊自己的烹飪水平、在野外探險、或是和居民們在酒吧裏舉杯對飲……。但也一定要注意飲食，調整好睡眠，打理好儀容。好好享受雨林鎮的悠哉生活吧。

■在廣闊的雨林鎮來一場大冒險

雨林鎮存在着大量的觀光景點，也有多姿多彩的事件在等待着你。在小鎮周圍探險，解鎖野外營地和祭壇來拓展活動範圍，盡情暢遊這個奇妙的世界。騎上你的小綿羊，在連綿不斷的山丘間暢快馳騁吧！

title: Loop8 (loop 8) Summer of Gods + 5 DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Vy okunetes v zhizn Nini — podrostka, kotoryy tolko chto pribyl na Zemlyu, v prichudlivyy yaponskiy gorodok Asikhara. Na dvore avgust 1983 goda. Issleduyte gorodok, podruzhites s zhitelyami i beytes s kegayami v poshagovykh srazheniyakh. Ikh iskhod zavisit ot otnosheniy, kotorye vy postroite, i resheniy, kotorye vy primete. U Nini osobaya svyaz s bogami — on umeet «perezapuskat» vremya i vozvrashchat mir v iskhodnuyu tochku. V kazhdoy novoy vremennoy petle Nini s soyuznikami budut snova i snova perezhivat 8-y mesyats, poka vsyo ne poluchitsya tak, kak nuzhno… A inache kegai pobedyat. 

 Esli do kontsa sveta ostalsya lish mesyats, kak vy provedete kazhdyy svoy den?

■ Zhivite obychnoy zhiznyu — srazhaytes s neobychnymi vragami
Podruzhites s zhitelyami Asikhary i zashchitite gorodok ot izvechnoy ugrozy kegaev. Prozhivaya odin i tot zhe tsikl snova i snova, vy uznaete, kak vashi povsednevnye dela vliyayut na vashi bitvy v Preispodney, i naoborot.

■ Resheniya, menyayushchie mir
Sistema iskusstvennogo intellekta v Loop8 reagiruet na kazhdoe vashe deystvie i reshenie. Chuvstva personazhey i syuzhet igry budut silno razlichatsya v zavisimosti ot togo, kakoy put vy izberete, — kazhdoe prokhozhdenie budet sovershenno unikalnym.

■ Zhivopisnye vidy provintsialnoy Yaponii
 Vas zhdet puteshestvie po masterski vossozdannym yaponskim gorodkam proshlogo. Otpravlyaytes v tsentr perekusit v restoranchike ili proydites po magazinam vmeste s drugimi personazhami.

■ Perezhivayte proshloe zanovo i menyayte budushchee
Srok vymiraniya chelovechestva uzhe pochti nastupil, no sudba Asikhary v vashikh rukakh. Vernites v nachalo avgusta, sdelayte chto-nibud inache i posmotrite, kak izmenitsya mir, v mnogochislennykh kontsovkakh igry.

title: Loop [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Loop 是一款充滿活力的沉思益智遊戲；您和您的同伴將穿越一座神秘、空靈的神廟。
在這段旅程中，你將穿越重重謎團，直面終極之謎：無限循環能否被打破？

Loop 將幫助您在美麗多樣的環境中放鬆身心。遊戲玩法的重點是與 AI 一起玩，AI 既是穿過寺廟的可靠嚮導，也是探索世界的忠實夥伴。遊戲敘事將帶您穿越豐富的環境和獨特而富有創意的謎題。

這個故事講得很漂亮，沒有任何對話，一切都是視覺的。

title: Local News with Cliff Rockslide [NSZ][ENG]
description:
**Pogruzites v zakhvatyvayushchiy mir mestnykh novostey ot pervogo litsa!**

Kliff Rokslayd — vladelets krupneyshego v Batterflyay-Velli servisa potokovoy peredachi novostey s ogromnym chislom semi podpischikov. Vasha zadacha — pomoch emu razvit svoy kanal, zapisyvaya na kameru vse, chto dazhe otdalenno interesno.

V tikhom malenkom gorodke skoro proizoydet krupneyshee novostnoe sobytie, kotoroe on kogda-libo videl, prevoskhodyashchee dazhe neudachnyy intsident s barsukom i gorodskoy liniey elektroperedach neskolko let nazad.

Local News with Cliff Rockslide — eto komediynaya priklyuchencheskaya igra ot pervogo litsa, v kotoroy vy derzhite kameru. Vladenie etim oruzhiem massovoy informatsii — otvetstvennaya zadacha. Vera kanala lezhit na vashikh velikolepnykh plechakh.

Klyuchevaya osobennost:
- Ispytayte tshchatelno sozdannuyu komediyu o kultakh, ovoshchakh i geometrii, napisannuyu professionalami komedii.
- Nauchites byt uspeshnym zhurnalistom, mediynym litsom, sozdatelem kontenta i vliyatelnym litsom v odnom pakete.
- Eto kak FPS, no s kameroy! Vy upravlyaete translyatsiey
- Nikakikh boev (nu, vrode), smertey (po krayney mere, ne okonchatelnykh), bystrykh posledovatelnostey deystviy (eto naglaya lozh), bystrykh sobytiy (vsego neskolko, izvinite!)

title: Heal: Console Edition [NSZ][RUS/Multi29]
genre: Adventure, Puzzle, Hidden objects, Point & Click
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 29]
description:
Heal - eto eksperimentalnaya priklyuchencheskaya igra ot sozdatelya serii DISTRAINT, v kotoroy zatragivayutsya temy stareniya i slaboumiya.

Povestvovanie vedetsya v tumannoy atmosfere, a instruktsii i dialogi ispolzuyutsya krayne redko.

Probudites ot sna bez snovideniy, issleduyte tayny svoego okruzheniya i reshayte golovolomki. 

Osobennosti
* Dvukhmernaya bokovaya prokrutka s unikalnoy grafikoy ruchnoy raboty
* Atmosfernyy zvukovoy dizayn
* Abstraktnyy mir, napolnennyy golovolomkami
* Povestvovanie, obuslovlennoe atmosferoy

title: Kickback Slug Cosmic Courier [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Ulitki — medlennye. No tolko ne eta ulitka! Slippi — bryukhonogiy mollyusk v kosmose, i on nauchilsya letat, ispolzuya otdachu svoego oruzhiya i dvigateley! Strelyayte v odnom napravlenii, letayte v drugom. No, o bozhe, esli by eto bylo tak veselo, Slippi stalkivaetsya s vse bolee slozhnymi prepyatstviyami na svoem puti — ulitki ne rady, kogda stalkivayutsya s shipami v kosmose...
Slippi i mister MakFlay predany svoey rabote. Kak kurery dlya krupneyshego mezhgalakticheskogo torgovtsa tovarov, oni podchinyayutsya vysokim standartam. Odnako ikh obydennaya ezhednevnaya smena i shans stat sotrudnikami mesyatsa stalkivayutsya s bolshoy problemoy, kogda iz-za mekhanicheskoy neispravnosti ikh korabl sovershaet avariynuyu posadku na planete, kazhushcheysya paryashchey v kosmose! Chto eshche khuzhe, oni poteryali vse posylki, kotorye teper razbrosany po poverkhnosti planety...
Neizvestno vsem prisheltsam v blizlezhashchey galaktike, sudba ikh ozhidaemykh postavok na sleduyushchiy den zavisit ot shchupalets Slippi i MakFlaya. Smozhete li vy provesti ikh cherez planetu i vosstanovit vse poteryannye posylki po puti? Vy (ulitka Slippi) dolzhny letat cherez urovni, polnye vse bolee slozhnykh prepyatstviy, ispolzuya tolko otdachu ot vashego oruzhiya. Sobirayte posylki, dostavlyayte tovary i pobezhdayte bossov na svoem puti. Stante luchshim kosmicheskim kurerom i vyigrayte kosmicheskuyu gonku v pochtovoy rabote.

title: KarmaZoo (Karma Zoo) [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
《KarmaZoo》的核心是助人、協力互助、在合作中找到快樂，即使情況不如預期也一樣。在線上遊戲裡，你將和完全隨機選中的玩家一起經歷獨一無二的遊戲過程，建立起真切的連結，努力合作及收集最珍貴的資源：因果愛心。

挑戰永不結束
循環模式會選出一系列難度漸增的關卡，同時依照隊伍規模、每位玩家選擇的角色、全隊一起選出的獎勵效果來調整內容。每一局遊戲幾乎都不一樣！

因果愛心的力量
助人拿愛心！請待在隊友身邊，幫對方抵達終點吧。有時候也需要發揮友愛，犧牲自己，幫隊友穿越致命障礙。你所做的每一件好事，不論形式，都能換到溫暖的因果愛心，可以解鎖新的角色或能力，用於之後的循環。

單機多人遊戲
在家招待親友？打開圖騰柱單機多人模式，讓眾人在同一個畫面上一起玩遊戲吧。舉辦競賽，讓最多8位玩家同場競技，遊玩一系列節奏快又緊張刺激的迷你遊戲。

為你量身設計
不論是電玩新手還是老玩家，都能用不同方式在遊戲裡幫隊伍獲得因果愛心。你一定也找得到屬於自己的玩法！本作支援22種語言、電腦主機跨平台遊戲，並提供私人線上大廳，讓你和親友一起遊玩循環和圖騰柱模式！我們遊戲裡見！

title: Inhabit [NSZ][ENG]
description:
你醒了。你好幾天沒離開過你的房間，你的地方一團糟。一個多星期以來，您已經忽略了任何形式的自我保健。但今天不一樣！今天是你終於完成某事的日子。

在這個簡短的開放式生活益智遊戲中，在家中和周邊地區走一走，養成健康的習慣並探索世界。您甚至可以在此過程中結識一些朋友！

享受這種平靜、健康的體驗，將您的家和您的思想變成您想要居住的地方！

* 在你的生活中找到平衡！
你的房子亂七八糟！起床，開始工作。通過做這些日常活動養成一些好習慣，每件家務都由一組不同的獨特謎題來代表。

* 和好朋友一起出去玩！
當你完成更多的謎題時，家務活的個性就會在現實生活中顯現出來！您現在可以隨心所欲地與您的伙伴一起出去玩。邀請他們來家裡的任何地方閒逛！

* 裝修你的家！
每次做完家務後，你終於可以收拾你的家，解開新的秘密！完成園藝後，您可以修剪灌木叢。打掃完屋子，垃圾袋沒問題！

* 在你的後院放鬆！
在美麗懷舊的像素藝術中與你的小伙伴一起感受，還有藝術家湯姆·德隆 (Tom Dron) 的原聲配樂！鳥兒飛過，你可以聽到遠處的小溪，你的朋友開玩笑說水仙花。隨著時間的流逝，音樂和氛圍會發生變化以反映時間。

*寵物狗！
有很多可愛的東西可以互動！那隻狗不會寵愛自己。當你探索你家周圍的區域時，你會發現更多的物體、動物和可以一起出去玩的地方！

title: Infinite Guitars [NSZ][ENG]
description:
V mire, razrushennom opustoshitelnoy voynoy protiv metallicheskikh boevykh mashin-mekhov, ostatki chelovechestva boryutsya za vyzhivanie. I metallicheskie boevye mashiny vnov probudilis – no tolko vasha elektrogitara mozhet obratit ritmy protiv nikh!..
Nastroyte svoy lyubimyy gitarnyy «topor» i prigotovtes zazhigat v rolevoy ritm-igry, vdokhnovlyonnoy yaponskimi anime, adrenalinovymi srazheniyami i yarkim originalnym saundtrekom!

title: Inescapable: No Rules No Rescue [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Priklyuchencheskiy sotsialnyy triller eroge-novella, deystvie kotorogo razvorachivaetsya na izolirovannom tropicheskom ostrove, a glavnyy geroy Kharrison Taylor i eshche 10 devushek, kotorykh pokhitili i privezli na etot ostrov, vynuzhdeny prinyat uchastie v izvrashchennom realiti-shou, glavnyy priz v kotorom — polmilliona dollarov dlya tekh, kto ostanetsya v zhivykh k kontsu shou..
Pri etom s ostrova ne sbezhat, a pravil — net!..

title: IIN [NSZ][RUS/Multi25]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 25]
description:
•您可以在本地玩單人遊戲，也可以與兩個球員一起玩；

•80個挑戰供您克服；

•全世界在全球範圍內將您的表現排名；

•當您每15天收到一系列新的挑戰以測試您的表現並在全球排名中顯示的新挑戰時，特殊挑戰

title: Hundred Fires The Rising of Red Star [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Hundred Fires is an action, stealth and infiltration game with an exciting story and incredible cinematics created by David Amado Fernández.

In the middle of the cold war, the Soviet Union is sending nuclear weapons to Cuba, this time they have an ally, a mysterious Japanese developer of nuclear weapons has arrived on the island.

Your mission has a single objective, to assassinate the Japanese developer.

This is a one man infiltration mission, you alone cannot defeat the entire Soviet army, you must use your best skills to hide, sneak away from the enemy and go undetected.

You must use your infiltration skills, hide in remote places, not make noise, use different items to advance in your adventure, you will also find action moments, a variety of weapons and strategies to fulfill your mission

You can access training missions and live an exciting story with important historical figures.

title: Hodgepodge Hunch + 2 DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Posle neozhidannogo povorota sobytiy, byvshiy geroy Kokott menyaet professiyu i nachinaet rabotaet v magazine tushyonogo myasa, boryas za pobedu v konkurse-festivale, gde vse uchastniki vystavlyayut napokaz svoe masterstvo prigotovleniya produktov. Odnako, ottachivaya svoi kulinarnye navyki vmeste so svoimi kollegami, Kokot obnaruzhivaet, chto ikh dragotsennoe varevo prevrashchaetsya v nevkusnuyu edu!
Sotrudnichayte s 3 druzyami ili s II, chtoby sobirat ingredienty v podzemelyakh i gotovit vkusnye shtuki. Est tolko odna problema... Vozmozhno, sredi vas skryvaetsya predatel, kotoryy razrushit vse vashi plany na prekrasnyy uzhin!
Igroki delyatsya na odnu iz dvukh grupp: Personal i Shpiony. Kazhdaya gruppa rabotaet nad vypolneniem opredelennykh usloviy dlya pobedy. Tsel personala — prigotovit vkusnoe tushenoe myasko, otpravlyayas v podzemelya v poiskakh ingredientov i amuletov, kotorye vmeste v opredelyonnom sochetanii mogut prinesti vysokie bally na konkurse. Zadacha shpiona — pomeshat usiliyam vsekh ostalnykh. Nekotorye ingredienty zapreshcheno dobavlyat v kastryulyu, inache blyudo prevratitsya v uzhasnuyu burdu. Konechnaya tsel shpiona — vsyo-taki pronesti v kastryulyu zapreshchennye ingredienty, ne vyzvav podozreniy so storony ostalnykh. On takzhe mozhet rasprostranyat lozhnye slukhi, chtoby vyzvat u personala podozreniya drug k drugu.

title: Hello Goodboy [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Hello Goodboy — eto dobraya i interesnaya istoriya pro priklyucheniya malchika Iko, kotoryy sovsem nedavno v zagrobnom mire. On sovershenno ne pomnit, kak zdes okazalsya. Ostaetsya polagatsya na Koko — udivitelno znakomogo psa, kotoryy pomozhet razgadat tayny ego novogo sushchestvovaniya. 

Puteshestvuyte, po neizvestnym, no takim znakomym mestam, znakomtes s drugimi dushami, u kazhdoy iz kotorykh — svoi priklyucheniya v drugoy zhizni. Pomogayte im i poprobuyte razobratsya, kak zhe samogo Iko ugorazdilo popast na tot svet. No ne zabyvayte o vremeni: ego ne tak mnogo!

- Prozhivite sobstvennuyu dobruyu i atmosfernuyu skazku o puteshestviyakh Iko i Koko po zagrobnomu miru.
- Razgadyvayte tayny i sobirayte nabory radosti.
- Cheshite Koko zhivotik stolko, skolko zakhochetsya! 

- Podruzhites s desyatkami obitateley zagrobnogo mira: odinokim rebenkom, trevozhnoy paroy, ustavshim drovosekom i mnogimi drugimi.
- U kazhdogo iz nikh — svoya interesnaya istoriya i svoya zadacha, s kotoroy mozhet pomoch Iko.
- A kogda problema reshitsya, mozhno vmeste pokushat i nemnogo otdokhnut.

No vremeni u vas ne tak mnogo. Reshayte, s kem provodit vremya: obshchayas s odnimi personazhami, vy ne uspeete podruzhitsya s drugimi. V igre neskolko kontsovok, i imenno vash vybor opredelit final istorii Iko.

- Koko — khoroshiy malchik i vash luchshiy drug v zagrobnoy zhizni! 
- Ego ostryy nyukh i umelye ruki Iko pomogut vam raskryt metafizicheskie tayny mira vokrug.
- Ne zabyvayte chesat psu puziko i rezvitsya s igrushkami, chtoby podderzhivat uroven «Shkaly khoroshego malchika».

title: Haunted House [NSZ][ENG]
description:
鬼屋裡充滿了寒冷和隱秘的刺激，這是對經典 Atari 冒險的重新想像！玩家控制林恩·格雷夫斯，她是傳奇寶藏獵人扎卡里·格雷夫斯早熟的侄女。琳和她最親密的同胞一起參觀了她叔叔的豪宅，卻發現房子裡到處都是食屍鬼和怪物，它們很快就抓住並偷走了她的朋友。為了釋放她的叔叔和她的朋友，並捕獲所有超自然的敵人，琳必須找到魔法甕的碎片並將它們重新組裝起來。

通過程序生成的房間佈局、移動的牆壁、不可預測的敵人位置以及獨特的幽靈遭遇，琳必須在成群的食屍鬼和怪異的靈質中爬行、潛行和衝刺，才能找到她的朋友和叔叔。每個甕碎片都由令人毛骨悚然的 Boss 嚴酷守護——在 3D 等距潛行遊戲中，Lyn 必須快速思考才能克服每項挑戰。當她被一個陰暗的幽靈擊倒時，她會回到鬼屋的入口，必須面對全新的地板佈局和敵人的位置，確保每次運行都是獨一無二的。

特徵

復活的 Roguelite：鬼屋在隱秘和神秘的挑戰上加倍努力，同時添加了 Roguelite 元素，確保沒有兩次遊戲是相同的。

老少皆宜的刺激之旅：異想天開的卡通藝術風格僅薄薄地掩蓋了鬼屋的寒冷和刺激！ 《鬼屋》巧妙地遊走在愚蠢和怪異之間，主要特點是基於潛行的遊戲玩法和輕型戰鬥序列。

可解鎖的角色：當琳探索鬼屋時，她會釋放她被困的朋友，他們將成為可玩的角色，你可以使用它深入鬼屋。每個朋友都擁有不同的屬性，因此根據您與誰一起探索宅邸，這將是一種新的體驗！

雅達利復活節彩蛋：這款遊戲充滿了收藏品和傳說，以原版鬼屋和雅達利黃金時代的其他經典最愛為基礎。

偷偷摸摸的顫抖：隨著戰鬥不再被強調，玩家必須專注於潛行行動和解決陰影中看不見的挑戰，同時利用他們可以使用的陷阱和物品來分散追捕林恩的食屍鬼的注意力。

title: Gunman Tales [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Ty — okhotnik za golovami s Dikogo Zapada, kotoromu nuzhno nayti legendarnoe poteryannoe sokrovishche. Po puti tebe pridetsya pobedit mnogikh prestupnikov, chtoby zavladet ikh zolotom i poleznymi predmetami, chtoby uluchshat svoi sposobnosti. 

No igra predlagaet nechto bolshee, chem prosto byt odinokim reyndzherom. Ty takzhe mozhesh igrat protiv chetyrekh druzhbanov-kovboev — malo ne pokazhetsya! 


OSOBENNOSTI
* Epicheskoe kovboyskoe priklyuchenie na Dikom Zapade
* 12 raznoobraznykh i slozhnykh etapov
* Lokalnyy multipleer dlya 1-4 igrokov
* Elementy RPG, takie kak oruzhie i uluchsheniya

title: Gruta [NSZ][ENG]
description:
V etom platforme s zakhvatyvayushchim syuzhetom vy igraete za devochku, kotoraya sbegaet iz doma, chtoby srazitsya s monstrom, yakoby vinovnym v bedakh ee semi. 

Razgadayte zagadku i raskroyte istinu, otkryvayushchuyusya v originalnykh prorisovannykh vruchnuyu stsenakh-vrezkakh bez kakogo-libo teksta. Ispolzuyte mech i shchit, chtoby srazhatsya so zloveshchimi vragami v protsesse issledovaniya urovney.

Smozhete li vy pobedit chudovishche i spasti svoyu semyu?


Osobennosti
* Stilizovannaya pikselnaya grafika
* Otrisovannye vruchnuyu stseny-vrezki
* Urovni s narastayushchey slozhnostyu
* Sochetanie 2D i 3D grafiki
* Originalnyy saundtrek

title: Growth [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
《Growth》融合了溫馨的探索之美，並有圍繞著山川等障礙物巡航以繁殖肥沃土壤的挑戰，將貧脊的土地開墾成綠意蔥蔥的森林與草地。體驗一場混合探索與策略的難忘旅程。開始發展你的地景，為它寫下專屬的田園詩！

精明的連結野生生物群落，藉此探索、擴展一片生生不息的程序生成地圖。主張新發現的群落或興趣點，以獲得額外的野生生物，某些情況下更有特別獎勵。隨著地景擴展，你將發現新類型的動物，牠們具有獨特能力可以克服障礙。不論你是想在工作之餘尋求片刻休息，或者玩個輕鬆的益智遊戲，《Growth》的直覺式玩法能帶你一階一階探索美麗的景觀。 

- 六角網格的柔性策略益智遊戲
- 戰役模式有隨機生成地圖，能夠測試你解決問題的技巧。
- 溫馨又悠閒的遊戲玩法 
- 8種不同的動物各具獨特能力，能擴充你的工具集以進行探索 
- 興趣點獎勵額外的動物，某些情況下更會獎勵特別的動物 
- 9種不同的圖塊類型，可以製作精美的地圖 
- 推薦一玩再玩

title: Gripper [NSP][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
《疾速摩爪》簡介
一個名為None的被困在崩潰世界中的網絡騎手，需穿越由危險隧道連接而成的後世界末日之地。在同伴機械貓的幫助下探索死亡之地。擊敗無情的BOSS，挖出他們骯臟邪惡的心臟。

駕駛一輛酷炫的摩托車擊敗BOSS
掌握《疾速摩爪》獨特的摩托車運動和戰鬥機製，包括騎行、滑行和躲避。與兇殘的怪物卡車、巨型蛛形綱動物、機械化的泰坦和碎屏蛇對戰。粉碎、奪取他們的武器，並擊敗他們。從能量助推器到可生成的無人機、地雷和小工具，打造你的夢想赛博摩托。

抓取、撕碎
用摩托車的抓鉤控製戰場、控製環境、抓取並投擲炸藥，甚至撕裂敵人。論幹掉敵人的一百萬種方式。

電影故事驅動的動作遊戲
一個神秘而失落的故事。穿越反烏托邦的網絡環境，尋找遺失的答案。幫助None做出重要的選擇。發現的每一個答案都會將你的一位親人置於危險之中，所以去拯救你的家人吧。

累進及定制
殺戮。升級。周而復始。經過的每一場艱難遭遇戰都會獎勵你一種全新的特殊能力，、致命武器，有時還可以獲得稀有的皮膚。自定義你的摩爪體驗，按自己的意願定製並享受遊戲。如果你要抓心撓肝，那你可得讓摩爪狀態絕佳！

title: Gravity Oddity [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Kosmicheskiy «rogalik» s epicheskoy razvyazkoy.
Po vsey galaktike oslabevayut gravitatsionnye polya, iz-za chego vzryvayutsya planety. Povezlo, chto rebyata iz korporatsii «Rio-Grande» pridumali gravisapogi. S ikh pomoshchyu peredvigatsya po planetam — kak progulyatsya v parke.

I vsyo shlo khorosho, no korporatsiya pokhitila vashego soseda — Gari. A za arendu nuzhno komu-to platit, tak chto vam pridetsya otpravitsya na ego poiski. Vmeste so svoim novym naparnikom Nyutonom vy otpravlyaetes na spasatelnuyu operatsiyu: vam predstoit raskryt taynu ischeznoveniya soseda i uznat, chto stoit za deystviyami korporatsii «Rio-Grande».

Vas zhdut srazheniya na postoyanno menyayushchikhsya galakticheskikh kartakh. Nadevayte dzhetpak, obuvayte gravisapogi i otpravlyaytes na poiski Gari! Vperedi — zakhvatyvayushchee kosmicheskoe priklyuchenie!

Zabudte o gravitatsii — khodite po lyuboy poverkhnosti.
Natyagivayte gravisapogi, khvatayte teleport — i prokladyvayte sebe put cherez bossov i vragov na raznykh urovnyakh v razlichnom okruzhenii. Vy budete khodit po lyubym poverkhnostyam i proletat cherez propasti na dzhetpake, a kompaniyu vam sostavit Nyuton.

Proberites cherez polchishcha vragov s pomoshchyu teleporta i spasite svoego soseda iz lap korporatsii «Rio-Grande».

Tolko my mozhete zashchitit Vselennuyu i ee obitateley ot zlobnogo plana, porozhdennogo korporatsiey «Rio-Grande»!

Modifitsiruyte svoy arsenal i spasite Vselennuyu (nu i Gari tozhe)!
Sadites za verstak i prevratite svoy teleport v idealnoe oruzhie spaseniya Vselennoy — s pomoshchyu modov, kotorye vy budete nakhodit v samykh dalekikh ugolkakh galaktiki. S kazhdym modom vash teleport budet stanovitsya vsyo bolee groznym oruzhiem.

Razdelyayushchiesya puli povysyat ognevuyu moshch teleporta, puli s rikoshetom pozvolyat zastat vragov vrasplokh — vybirat vam!

K vashim uslugam — mnozhestvo modifikatorov. Vy mozhete sozdat tselyy arsenal navykov pod sobstvennyy stil igry.

Glavnye osobennosti:
- 130 modov s sumasshedshim vzaimodeystviem: pochuvstvuyte sebya geniem!
- Trudnye bitvy s bossami, kotorye budut derzhat vas v napryazhenii.
- Postoyanno menyayushchiesya urovni — slozhnye i uvlekatelnye.
- Nastroyka vneshnego vida avatara i pomoshchnika: pochti 100 kosmeticheskikh elementov.

title: Glitch Busters Stuck on You + DLC [NSP][ENG]
description:
V Glitch Busters: Stuck on You vam predstoit snova spasti virtualnyy mir, kotoromu ugrozhayut zlobnye kompyuternye virusy. Borotsya s nimi vy smozhete kak v odinochku, tak i vmeste s tremya druzyami!..
V nekom dalekom budushchem virtualnye miry uzhe prakticheski ne otlichayutsya ot nastoyashchikh. Oni obitaemy, zhivy i podverzheny vsyakim nepriyatnostyam. I vot sluchilos chto-to sovsem strashnoe – zaselivshie virtualnyy mir sozdaniya atakovany tainstvennym virusom; on pronikaet vezde, iskazhaya i razrushaya mir. Spravitsya s napastyu dolzhna komanda spetsialnogo naznacheniya.

title: Ginnung [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Ginnung 是一款緊湊的平台遊戲，具有簡單而靈活的動作供您掌握。在 50 多個關卡中完善你的逃生之路，殺掉擋路的怪物！設置在北歐精神和眾神的神秘世界中。

Ginnung 是一款以移動為中心的平台遊戲，具有速度和嚴格的控制。奔跑、跳牆和快速衝刺，同時與等待你的怪物戰鬥。這個世界不屬於你。掌握關卡和動作，最終以時尚的方式逃離你的 Ginnung！

您可以向任何方向衝刺，並會在接觸牆壁或地面時重置。通過彈開任何射彈獲得額外的破折號。你也可以衝向地面以獲得小的速度提升，這將授予更高的跳躍。使用它可以找到隱藏在關卡中的秘密路線和收藏品。

你被這個世界的精神所追捕。使用你可信賴的武器殺死所有擋路的人。包括對你自己的反思，你將在激烈的老闆戰鬥中與之抗爭。

title: Geometric Sniper + Blood in Paris + Z [NSZ][ENG]
description:
突如其來的喪屍化病原體……
社會分崩離析，人類陷入痛苦。
不過，他們可以感到欣慰的是，有一個警惕的狙擊手一直在尋找喪屍。

《GSZ》是一款極具風格的2D等距射擊遊戲，玩家需要在其中扮演一名狙擊手。

在不同的遊戲模式中挑戰自己，使用不同的武器消滅喪屍，拯救並護送生還者，並不斷推進劇情。
（……如果你想扮演反派，也可以扮演零號喪屍感染病人！）

快速思考、快速行動、隨機應變……並記得經常換彈！

title: Gensei Suikoden Plus (GenseiSuikoden) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
獨自在深山中生活的阿塔虎，
由於受到某日登門拜訪的虎拳師務必參加武術對決大會的邀請，
而就此踏上了冒險之旅。
而在路途中，則是發生了一連串讓他意想不到的事情…！

title: Frido [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Frido是一款受2000年代熱門街機遊戲啟發，為兒童和成人設計的簡單遊戲。玩家將控制一台機器人，他穿越時空陷入了過去，你必須盡一切努力幫助他返回家園。隨著遊戲的 進行，你需要收集零件並解決簡單的謎題。

• 迷人的主角！
• 遊戲簡單易懂！
• 喚起懷舊情感！

title: Frank and Drake [NSZ][ENG]
description:
《Frank and Drake》是一款現代哥特式寓言遊戲，通過其非線性分支路徑、小遊戲和解謎，以及獨特的轉描美術，將玩家置於超自然謎團的核心。花點時間，探索並理解所有的謎題。

兩個不同尋常的陌生人
Frank和Drake是兩個不同尋常的陌生人，在一個對兩人造成威脅的陰謀中，未知的力量讓他們聚到了一起。他們共用同一套公寓，雖然註定永遠不會見面，他們還是必須共同努力，揭開籠罩他們兩人存在的謎團。

Frank是金鶯城一棟破舊公寓樓的管理員，他擔心自己正在失去理智，以及與周圍世界僅存的一點聯繫。Drake對陽光過敏，只能在夜間行動。他們兩人都經歷過幻象，並擁有未解的身世之謎。他們能在這些神秘的經歷中找到答案嗎？他們生活割裂，只能通過留在公寓周圍的便利貼來交流。儘管如此，他們必須建立某種聯繫，揭開謎團並活下去。

一個疑竇叢生的陰謀
交替扮演兩個角色：白天是Frank，晚上是Drake。他們做出的選擇將影響對方之後的行動。雖然兩人必須分開工作，但他們的命運相互交織，共同建立的信任和友誼將決定未來的走向。

故事發生在金鶯城，細節豐富，畫面精美，充滿了神秘非凡的角色和有待挖掘的秘密。Frank和Drake必須探索周邊的環境，揭開謎題並尋找線索，以解開他們一直在拚命尋找的答案，與各自痛苦的過去和解。

你會做出什麼選擇？ 
謎團通過分支敘事展開，你所做的選擇將對Frank和Drake的經歷產生深遠的影響。如果多次通關，你將發現故事的新視角，以及獨特的謎題和小遊戲。你會選擇哪條道路？你能夠發現這個世界裏所有隱藏的秘密嗎？

《Frank and Drake》畫面優美，代表了兩個角色對周圍世界所感受到的不安和虛幻。轉描風格是對拍攝的鏡頭進行手繪的艱苦過程。不可思議的結果應對了Frank和Drake面臨的現實：兩個不同尋常的人物試圖融入一個平凡的世界。

title: Back to Bed [NSP][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
通過控制他的潛意識守護者Subob，引導夢遊者Bob安全的回到他的床。 Back to Bed 是一款具有超現實感的藝術3D益智遊戲。Bob是一個不幸的渴睡症患者，他在無聊的辦公室裡入睡，然後夢遊到大城市的危險之中。幸運的是，Bob有一個名叫Subob的潛意識守護者，保護Bob並引導他安全的回到床上。 高警覺性的Subob必須帶領Bob走過一系列超現實主義的繪畫般的都市風景，Bob的夢與現實之間的界限已經消失。

特色：

•獨特的超現實主義和藝術性的遊戲：在數碼框架中融入藝術作品，融合現實和夢中世界的元素，創造出獨特而超現實的遊戲。

•精神錯亂的等距級別：導航於違反物理定律的詳細3D謎題，其中玩家必須在陌生環境中操控著，為Bob創建安全路徑並避免危險。

•兩個角色為一體：體現著扮演潛意識，以小型守護者的形式，試圖將自己夢遊的身體從夢境世界的危險中拯救出來。

title: Almost My Floor [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
description:
Almost My Floor - 在險惡的噩夢的可怕氣氛中點擊偵探。每走一步都可能致命。解開 9 號房子居民的謎團，或者發瘋。迷宮般無窮無盡的地板會讓受害者不戰而敗，有去無回。

對於Alex來說，這是一個漫長的回家之旅的故事。居住在裡面的一切都存在於虛構與現實之間。是時候面對怪物，與其他房屋居民會面並決定他們的命運了。但最重要的是逃離恐怖的深淵……並在事後保持清醒。

對於偵探Adam Trust，解開秘密是畢生的工作。他不想放棄，所以他將學習所有關於 9 號房子的知識。雖然這一次，他的雄心壯志的代價可能會太高。

特徵：
- 兩個對歷史有不同看法的主要人物
- 要透過各種路徑
- 以漫畫藝術風格繪製的地點和人物
- 有趣的謎題會讓你思考片刻
- 死神在每個角落等著你
- 怪物將繼續生活在你的噩夢中

title: A Place for the Unwilling [NSZ][ENG]
description: U vas est vsego lish 21 den, poka tselyy gorod polnostyu ne pogibnet. Chasiki tikayut. Vy ne mozhete razorvatsya i pobyvat vezde, odnovremenno. Reshayte, chto issledovat, s kem vstretitsya, nablyudaya za kazhdym resheniem, formiruya lyubopytnye istorii i raskryvaya strashnye sekrety v etoy razvetvlyonnoy narrativnoy rolevoy advenchure.

title: A Guidebook of Babel [NSZ][ENG]
description:
在四段精心編織的故事當中，你需要回到過去，巧妙地改寫歷史，以便引發蝴蝶效應，解開藏於其中的謎題，甚至改變巴別號的未來！

奇妙世界
從季風肆虐的甲板到喧鬧的中央車站，從忙碌的記憶工廠到人跡罕至的大鍋爐……盡情探索廣袤的巴別號，邂逅驚慌失措的人類與難以對付的船員，調查前所未見的儀器與古靈精怪的生物！

多線敘事
被捲⼊季風的飛⾏員，為罐頭大餐發愁的廚師長，追捕逃犯的游泳隊隊長……噢，還有那位尋找女兒的可憐巴巴的馬戲團小丑！主角們的命運交相輝映，這注定是一出關於離別的悲喜劇。

任務與謎題
你需要幫助受困的主角們渡過難關：逃離審訊室、採集石爐蟹蛋、尋找神秘信號源……可別指望能靠蠻力硬闖！
好在你可以回到過去，尋找讓他們陷入困境的根源。一旦找到那個關鍵的事件，你便能利用手中的鋼筆將其改寫。這一舉動會立即引發蝴蝶效應，改變劇情走向，瞬間扭轉當下的局勢！

title: A Day Without Me [NSZ][ENG]
description:
A Day Without Me is a puzzle adventure game, where you have to find out where everyone is going, why is there only you in the city, why are there so many oddities in the city.

Features:
-Plot mysterious story
-Semi open world
-Lots of challenges and mysteries to solve

title: A Boy and His Blob [NSZ][ENG]
description:
當泡泡隆尼亞星球落入邪惡皇帝的暴政統治時，一個勇敢的泡泡人成功逃離對外求救。迫降在地球上後，泡泡人在某個小男孩身上看到意料之外的英雄特質。他們必須一起返回泡泡隆尼亞擊敗邪惡皇帝。除了友誼的力量和裝滿啫喱豆的袋子外，這對英雄組合一無所有，不過啫喱豆可以把泡泡人變成功能各異的有趣工具——他們有能帶你踏上難忘冒險之旅所需的一切。WayForward重新構建大衛克蘭（David Crane）的任天堂紅白機經典遊戲，橫向卷軸解謎的平台遊戲設計深受大人小朋友喜愛。玩家在遊戲中負責控制小男孩，和友好的泡泡人一起穿梭各種環境和擊敗敵人，並運用勇氣、智慧和一些啫喱豆解開謎題。投身精美的2D手繪動畫之中，踏上從地球前往泡泡隆尼亞的精彩旅程。

遊戲特色：

• 體驗精美的手繪和動畫插圖所敍述的溫馨故事！

• 餵泡泡人食啫喱豆，觸發15種實用變身形態，例如香橙彈床、甘草爬梯和根汁汽水火箭。

• 通過充滿隱藏寶物的40個刺激關卡，穿梭樹林、沼澤、洞穴、泡泡隆尼亞郊區，甚至皇帝的堡壘！

• 收集寶箱，解鎖40個額外挑戰關卡，在終極考驗中測試自己的技能！

title: In Rays of the Light (The Light Remake) [NSZ][RUS/Multi3]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 3]
description:
僅剩下你一人、前人殘留的遺跡，以及兀自繁盛的大自然，在漫無人煙的風景下怡然自得。 這個世界既蒼涼而虛無，卻無比美麗。

在光線中《In rays of the Light》是一位大氣作家的寓言，揭示了我們在這個世界上所處的定位，以及生死議題。探索一個充滿微妙變化的神秘領土，以揭開故事全貌。解決邏輯難題，同時鑽研文字訊息。

遊戲特色：
-第一人稱出發的思索探詢
-深入鑽研細節和周遭環境，以揭示隱喻的哲學故事
-優美的視覺效果和配樂旋律（由 Dmitry Nikolaev 作曲）
-提供兩種結局
-為《The Light》（2012）遊戲的重製版

title: Soccer Story [NSZ][ENG]
description:
It's been a year since The Calamity™ tore apart the very foundations of soccer as we know it, and since then, Soccer Inc. has made dang well sure that not a soul has been allowed to even look at a soccer ball, let alone kick it.

Soccer may have been banned across the world... but now there is hope! A magical soccer ball has chosen you, our Savior of Soccer!

Soccer Story is a physics-driven adventure RPG, where every problem can be solved with your trusty magic ball. Along the way, you'll need to best bad guys in 1v1s, compete in a range of different sports (with your soccer ball, of course), and sometimes use your brain just as much as your balls

In a world that has long forgotten The Beautiful Game, can you remind them why soccer is top of the table, and best the most formidable teams, including the local toddlers and a group of sharks?


-Drop your soccer ball and play anywhere! The world is full of goals, puzzles and secrets - it's up to you to find them!
-Play a single-player story full of quirky characters, quests, rogue refs and wacky soccer-adjacent sports 
-Build your soccer career and do battle against the fiercest soccer teams like literal sharks, toddlers, old-age pensioners and ninjas
-Save soccer and restore peace and harmony to the world
-Grab a friend for a four-player local multiplayer match mode with a full roster of teams and animal captains

Yes, Soccer Story has multiplayer matches too!

Grab up to 3 friends, and convince them that soccer is the ultimate sport by challenging them to local multiplayer matches!

With a whole host of teams and captains to choose from, find your personal playstyle and hold your own tournaments at home across the many pitches, from home matches at Soccertown to the vast Soccer Inc Stadium!

title: Dirt Trackin 2 / 3 / Dirt Tracking Sprint Cars [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Dirt Trackin' 3 pereopredelyaet standarty dlya budushchikh iteratsiy zhanra, predlagaya vam oldskulnoe udovolstvie ot gonok po bezdorozhyu, smeshannoe s peredovymi tekhnologiyami!
 27 tshchatelno prorabotannykh realistichnykh trass, vklyuchaya ofitsialno litsenzirovannye trassy, pereosmyslennye favority serii DT, a takzhe sovershenno novye. 5 realnykh klassov: Super Late Models, Crate Late Models, Modifieds, B-Mods i Street Stock. Bolee 100 odobrennykh realnykh voditeley na vybor. Pochuvstvuyte, kak trassa ozhivaet, poskolku variatsii stsepleniya menyayutsya v techenie dnya.
— Rezhimy igry, vklyuchaya Hotlaps s podderzhkoy Ghost, odinochnye gonki i polnotsennye gonki vykhodnogo dnya.

title: For a Vast Future / Pillars of Dust [NSZ][ENG]
description:
In this retro styled RPG, step into the shoes of Prince Carlton and pauper Gregg as they make their separate ways through a forgotten kingdom. 

Recruit strange companions, find numerous secrets, and complete the quest in the order of your choosing. Can you achieve the coveted 100% completion of this cozy exploration centered RPG?

Features:

- You choose the order! Play through each character's story in the path of your choosing
- Turn based combat... with a twist!
- One-liners, dad jokes, and puns galore
- Explore the countryside, find rare secret items, and level up characters through adventure instead of grinding
- Cozy game world featuring a chicken nugget-based economy and collectible cheese

title: Flooded [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Perevyornuto-reversivnyy gradostroitelnyy simulyator, gde vam nuzhno optimizirovat proizvodstvo na malenkom ostrovke, kotoryy so vremenem zatoplyaetsya!.. Soberite dostatochno resursov, chtoby spastis, poka okruzhayushchiy tonet.
Uroven vody podnyalsya na 100 metrov, ostaviv vsego lish neskolko mest na Zemle, prigodnykh dlya prozhivaniya. Vam, kak nebolshoy gruppe vyzhivshikh neobkhodimo postroit kovcheg i perebratsya v bezopasnoe mesto.
No budte ostorozhny: so vremenem uroven vody stanet eshchyo vyshe, i u vas ostaetsya vsyo menshe zemli!
