Ispolzuyte razlichnye postroyki dlya dobychi dragotsennykh resursov, uluchshayte ikh, chtoby maksimizirovat skorost proizvodstva, nakhodite volshebnye relikvii, kotorye povysyat proizvoditelnost, i investiruyte v NIOKR, umenshaya neobkhodimuyu dlya stankov ploshchad.
Kstati: okazyvaetsya, vy ne odinoki v etoy vrazhdebnoy srede — drugie vyzhivshie obosnovalis na blizlezhashchikh ostrovakh i, konechno zhe, vospolzuyutsya lyubym shansom, chtoby razgrabit vashu zemlyu, ne ostaviv kamnya na kamne. Stroyte oboronitelnye bashni i gotovte lovushki, chtoby obezopasit svoikh lyudey..

title: Fireball Wizard [NSZ][RUS/Multi13]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 13]
description:
作為一名強大的巫師，你將探索一個充滿危險的敵人和障礙的像素化世界。運用你獨特的能力發射致命的火球，擊敗可怕的首領，揭示隱藏在神秘的森林、洞穴和城堡中的秘密。 
《Fireball Wizard》提供了動作、冒險和解謎的獨特結合，是所有尋求真正游戲體驗的人的完美選擇。

《Fireball Wizard》有各種具有挑戰性的敵人和多個環境供玩家探索，提供了一個神奇而緊張的遊戲體驗，能讓你連續數小時保持警覺。隨著你不斷地通過遊戲中的多個關卡，你將掌握技能、升級裝備，成為終極的火球巫師。
在遊戲世界中旅行時，你會遇到各種不同的謎題和障礙，這些將考驗你的技能並推動你達到極限但是不要害怕，隨著遊戲的進展，你會解鎖新的能力和法術，以幫助你完成任務。 

穿上你的巫師袍，拿起你的法杖，準備成為終極的火球巫師吧！ 

主要特色:

• 緊張刺激的動作冒險遊戲玩法：體驗驚心動魄的戰鬥，探索充滿危險和奇蹟的像素化世界。 
• 強大的巫師能力：使用你的魔法發射致命的火球並打敗可怕的首領。 
• 具有挑戰性的謎題：通過各種益智謎題和障礙測試你的技能。 
• 待揭開的隱藏秘密：探索世界的每一個角落，揭開隱藏的秘密。 
• 獨特的遊戲類型融合：享受動作、冒險和解謎的混合體驗，讓你沉浸其中數小時。

title: Evil Wizard [NSP][RUS/Multi12]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 12]
description:
Evil Wizard — eto napolnennaya yumorom rolevaya igra, v kotoroy vy okazhetes na meste byvshego finalnogo bossa. Vosstante posle porazheniya, zanovo otkroyte dlya sebya davno utrachennye sily i srazhaytes, chtoby otvoevat svoy zamok u armii tak nazyvaemykh geroev.
- My polnostyu osvedomleny o probleme s sokhraneniem, kotoraya dostavlyaet problemy vsem igrokam, nam ochen zhal, i budet obnovlenie.
skoro cherez neskolko dney

title: Egglien [NSZ][ENG]
description:
V dalekom budushchem, posle togo kak tekhnologii razvilis nevoobrazimym obrazom, lyudi stali otnositsya k zemle varvarski. 

Oni razrushili to, chto kogda-to bylo prekrasnym mestom, zemlya prevratilas v kamni, i edinstvennoe, chto ostalos, - eto yadro ... posle togo, kak inoplanetyanka po imeni Asteri uslyshala golos, ona poluchila novye sposobnosti i otpravilas na missiyu so svoim drugom, chtoby vosstanovit to, chto kogda-to bylo velikoy planetoy.
	
Idite i pomogite spasti zemlyu!

“Igra Egglien nezamyslovata po suti, no bezuprechno sdelana; s otzyvchivym upravleniem, originalnymi vizualnymi effektami i zapominayushchimsya saundtrekom.”
-VGamingNews

POBEDITEL konkursa YGD BAFTA v 2022 godu

POBEDITEL konkursa Pixel Game Jam na itch.io v kategorii Beginner’s Best 

Kharakteristiki:
* 40 bezostanovochnykh urovney s novoy mekhanikoy i novymi vragami
* Retro-stil, perenosyashiy v proshloe
* Interesnaya istoriya s polnostyu napisannymi zastavkami s sumasshedshimi vstrechami
* Originalnaya zapominayushchayasya muzyka
* Srazhaytes s bossami, chtoby proverit svoi navyki!

title: EarthX [NSZ][ENG]
description:
EarthX - eto rasslablyayushchaya semeynaya igra po upravleniyu kompaniey kosmicheskikh poletov, v kotoroy vy zapuskaete rakety. Mnogo raket.

Proydite put ot zapuska nebolshikh raket na Zemle do sozdaniya kolonii na Marse. Sozdayte svoe sobstvennoe internet-sozvezdie, razvivayte novye tekhnologii, snabzhayte Mezhdunarodnuyu kosmicheskuyu stantsiyu i terraformiruyte Mars! 

Vam pridetsya razrabatyvat vse bolee sovershennye rakety, borotsya za kontrakty s konkurentami i razvivat svoy biznes, chtoby dobitsya uspekha. Priumnozhayte svoy kapital, sobirayte rakety, kapsuly i sputniki i dominiruyte v kosmicheskoy industrii.

Klyuchevye osobennosti
* Zapusk, posadka i povtornoe ispolzovanie vashikh raket! (Pri uslovii, chto oni ne vzorvutsya pri vkhode v atmosferu).
* Razvivayte svoy biznes s pomoshchyu sistemy povysheniya urovnya, kotoraya otkryvaet chto-to novoe kazhdyy raz, kogda vy prodvigaete svoyu kompaniyu!
* Sobirayte kosmicheskie korabli razlichnykh tipov, form i razmerov iz desyatkov otdelnykh detaley!
* Obespechte mir sverkhskorostnym internetom s pomoshchyu spetsializirovannoy sputnikovoy seti!
* Proizvodite desyatki yadernykh bomb i brosayte ikh na polyusa Marsa, chtoby razogret ego. Odnazhdy planeta mozhet stat pokhozhey na Zemlyu!
* Srazhaytes so slozhnymi pogodnymi usloviyami ili stalkivaytes s zaderzhkami, planiruya ikh!

title: Dyschronia: Chronos Alternate Definitive edition [NSZ][ENG]
description:
《虛時異境：迷離時空 終極版》完整收錄1～3章內容，並新增Nintendo Switch限定劇情。

你是擁有「改寫過去能力」的特別監察官「赫爾」，
任務是解決「不可能發生的犯罪」。
解開隱藏在各地與人們心中的謎題，臨機應變地化解突如其來的危機吧！
預言顯示城市將在7天後毀滅。你能夠查明真相，改變未來嗎？

■遊戲系統
【記憶潛行】追溯及改寫過去的能力將是解決案件的關鍵。
【橫跨現實與夢境的場景】上千隻魚群及鯨魚在意識之海中遨遊，體驗「擴展夢境」的視覺震撼。
【嚮導機器人】「莉莉」是你的嚮導機器人，將陪著你一同調查疑點重重的案件。當調查時遇到瓶頸時，不妨跟莉莉討論看看吧。
【潛行動作】在調查過程中不時會遭遇生命危險，在潛行動作中逃出生天吧。
【解謎】隨著調查深入，案件之中的謎題也將一一浮現。想辦法找出隱藏在城市之中的各項線索吧。
【審訊】利用收集到的證據來重現兇手的犯行。在樂園都市守護者的面前揭露案件的真相吧！
【節奏遊戲】透過節奏遊戲對市民進行「意識引導」，安撫他們心中的焦慮與不安吧。

■遊戲特色
為Nintendo Switch量身打造的操作方式與運鏡，以及親切的操作介面，帶來Nintendo Switch特有的遊玩體驗。
完整重現震動、畫面演出及自由的遊戲視角，帶來令人身歷其境的精彩演出！

■故事大綱
海上都市「阿斯特拉 · 克羅茲」，
一個利用「夢境」將所有犯罪防範於未然，犯罪率只有0.001%的城市。
城市的創建人「阿爾伯特」在這座被稱為「樂園」的城市遭到殺害，「不可能發生」的案件發生了。
成為特別監察官的「赫爾」受到城市的請託，負責揭露這起詭異案件的真相。

title: Dyadic [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Reshayte sovmestnye golovolomki i razvyazyvayte zhestokie predatelstva v etom kooperativnom platformere-golovolomke! Poteryavshis gluboko pod zemley, zastryav v drevnikh ruinakh, vy dolzhny rabotat vmeste, chtoby preodolet ispytaniya zabytykh glubin — i uspeshno sbezhat. No sotrudnichestvo i komandnaya rabota eshchyo ne konets — kazhdyy iz vas dolzhen popytatsya sbezhat s Nefritovoy statuey, tainstvennoy i drevney relikviey neischislimeyshey tsennosti.
Tolko odin iz vas mozhet poluchit relikviyu, i kto zhe eto budet?..
Ispolzuyte Joy-Con'y, chtoby issledovat skrytye glubiny Dyadic s drugom ili podrugoy, otkryvaya novye vozmozhnosti dlya nedobrosovestnykh taktik. No esli vy druzya, ne volnuytes — vmesto etogo vy smozhete ispolzovat dva kontrollera po otdelnosti, chtoby vybratsya iz podzemelya sovmestno.*
*My ne nesem otvetstvennosti za lyubye slomannye kontrollery libo razorvannye druzheskie otnosheniya, voznikshie v rezultate prokhozhdeniya etoy igry!

title: Swords & Soldiers + Swords and Soldiers 2 Shawarmageddon [NSP][ENG,RUS]
description:
Gromite bazu sopernika v dinamichnykh i veselykh srazheniyakh, igrayte po seti, na odnom ekrane ili protiv kovarnogo II. 

Gde by vy ni byli — broste vyzov druzyam i srazhaytes na odnom ekrane svoego ustroystva Nintendo Switch™ ili po seti! Naslazhdaytes epicheskoy odinochnoy kampaniey, v kotoroy vy komanduete Ryzheborodom i ego vikingami. Otpravlyaytes v pokhod po lesam vikingov, palyashchim pustynyam Persii i opasnym vladeniyam demonov, chtoby spasti... ovets, ukradennykh iz larka s shaurmoy, a zaodno raskryt zlodeyskiy zagovor i ostanovit neminuemyy Shaurmageddon. Da zdravstvuet pravosudie po-vikingski!

Dobyvayte zoloto i otkryvayte boytsov, postroyki i zaklinaniya. Sotrite oplot vraga v poroshok, obrushiv na nego vsyu moshch svoey armii, podkreplennuyu magiey!

Opisanie:
Tri moshchnye fraktsii. Komanduyte boevoy druzhinoy vikingov, armiey persov na kovrakh-samoletakh ili zhestokimi demonami! V boyu vam pomogut unikalnye boytsy, zaklinaniya i sbor resursov!

Bolshaya odinochnaya kampaniya. Vmeste s Ryzheborodom vam predstoit proyti cherez dremuchie lesa vikingov, peresech zharkie pustyni persov i spustitsya v glubiny ada, chtoby v itoge dobyt vkusneyshuyu shaurmu!

Setevye srazheniya. Broste vyzov drugim voitelyam v setevoy igre v formate 1 na 1, popadite v spisok liderov ili igrayte s druzyami na odnom ekrane! Adaptiruytes k deystviyam sopernikov i proyavite svoy strategicheskiy geniy! Vo vremya ozhidaniya matcha igrayte v rezhime vylazki ili v odnu iz dinamichnykh mini-igr!

Voyna po vashim pravilam. Soberite sobstvennuyu armiyu iz lyubimykh boytsov i zaklinaniy i oderzhite verkh v srazheniyakh s druzyami i sopernikami!

Nanimayte moguchikh chempionov! Kak glasit narodnaya mudrost, umnyy v goru ne poydet, umnyy kupit boytsov posilnee! U kazhdogo iz supervoinov ne tolko moguchie udary, no i unikalnye sposobnosti!

title: Itadaki Smash [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Katsu is the owner of the best restaurant in the city, however the Tengogo is determined to end his business and for this he throws a curse on all the food transforming it into terrible demons. Only Katsu and his friends can stop them.

- A colorful, cartoon-style graphics inspired by classic Beat 'em Up.
- Fight alone or with a friend to clean up San Daigo city. 
- 4 unique characters inspired by Japanese folklore (yokai).
- 16 detailed and challenging stages, with unique classic gameplay enhanced with new and modern mechanics.
- 4 game modes! Finish the game with only one coin (Arcade), play without limits (Normal), or challenge your abilities against waves of enemies (Arena) or against friends (VS). 
- Travel back to the 80’s and the 90’s arcades with a vibrant and oriental soundtrack.

title: ScourgeBringer (Scourge Bringer) [NSP][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Pogruzites v postapokalipticheskiy mir, gde misticheskoe sushchestvo udarilo po vsemu chelovechestvu. V ScourgeBringer vy — Kyhra, samaya besposhchadnaya voitelnitsa klana. Pomogite ey izuchit neizvestnoe i prolozhit put cherez antichnye mashiny, okhranyayushchie pechat ee proshlogo, a vozmozhno, i spasti chelovechestvo.

- Vas zhdet dinamichnyy platformer-rogalik, «smes Dead Cells i Celeste», po slovam izdaniya Eurogamer.
- Prokladyvayte sebe put s pomoshchyu superplavnogo upravleniya.
- Ottachivayte svoi navyki s fantasticheskoy boevoy sistemoy, napravlennoy tolko na ataki.
- Brosaytes vpered na paranormalnye adaptivnye zvuki Joonas Turner (Nuclear Throne, Downwell, Broforce...).
- Brosayte vyzovy ordam bezmolvnykh vragov i gigantam-bossam, khranyashchim sekrety Scourge.
- Izuchayte beskonechnye glubiny postoyanno menyayushchikhsya temnits.
- Raskryvayte tayny i nakhodite napominaniya o predydushchikh issledovatelyakh, chtoby razblokirovat sekrety, opredelyayushchie realnost.

title: Riot Civil Unrest [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
RIOT – Civil Unrest — eto dolgozhdannaya strategiya: simulyator vosstaniy v realnom vremeni, blagodarya kotoromu igrok smozhet popast v samuyu gushchu vsemirno izvestnykh stolknoveniy. Vas zhdut sleduyushchie kampanii: Vozmushchennye (Ispaniya), Arabskaya vesna (Egipet), Kerateya (Gretsiya) i NoTAV (Italiya). Semnadtsat odnourovnevykh stsenariev privedut vas v Rim, Oklend, Parizh, London i Ukrainu. 

Leonard Menchiari, sozdatel igry RIOT – Civil Unrest, ne ponaslyshke znakom s vosstaniyami, poskolku uchastvoval v protestakh NoTAV v Italii. On sozdal etu igru, chtoby podelitsya s drugimi temi istoriyami i chuvstvami, kotorye znakomy uchastnikam protestov. Chto zastavlyaet tolpu vesti sebya tak gnevno i agressivno? Chto chuvstvuyut ofitsery politsii, stalkivayas vo vremya konfliktov s tolpoy, prevoskhodyashchey ikh chislom? RIOT — Civil Unrest daet igrokam vozmozhnost prinyat lyubuyu storonu v bitvakh, gde ne mozhet byt pobeditelya. Kto prav, a kto oshibaetsya? Igrayte v RIOT — Civil Unrest i delayte svoi sobstvennye vyvody.

Igrayte na storone politsii

•	Primenyayte razlichnye metody sderzhivaniya tolpy: kak passivnye, tak i agressivnye.
•	Upravlyayte shturmovymi i takticheskimi otryadami, a takzhe otryadami strelkov.
•	Vyzovite podmogu: politseyskie gruzoviki, vodyanuyu pushku ili dazhe tank!
•	Reshayte, budete li vy ispolzovat dymovye shashki, rezinovye i plastikovye puli ili dazhe nastoyashchie boepripasy.

Igrayte na storone protestuyushchikh

•	Davayte instruktsii protestuyushchim (vooruzhennym ili passivnym) i zhurnalistam
•	Podstrekayte narod k yarostnym napadeniyam ili popytaytes uregulirovat situatsiyu s pomoshchyu takticheskikh peregruppirovok i otstupleniy.
•	Napadayte na predstaviteley vlasti, ispolzuya kokteyli Molotova, feyerverki, bumazhnye bomby, kamni, ulichnuyu mebel i silu SMI.

Mnozhestvo rezhimov

•	Shestnadtsat urovney kampanii razdelyayutsya na chetyre stsenariya: Kerateya (Gretsiya), NoTAV (Italiya), Vozmushchennye (Ispaniya) i Arabskaya vesna (Egipet).
•	Nablyudayte za syuzhetom s obeikh storon: sygrayte na vsekh 32 urovnyakh za protestuyushchikh ili politsiyu.
•	Rezhim odinochnoy igry: igrayte protiv iskusstvennogo intellekta.
•	Rezhim protivostoyaniya: igrayte s druzyami ili protiv nikh i iskusstvennogo intellekta na odnom i tom zhe kompyutere.

title: The Colonists [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description: Vypolnyayte seriyu otdelnykh missiy ili postroyte svoyu koloniyu, svobodnuyu ot kakikh-libo ogranicheniy v rezhime Pesochnitsy. Razvedyvayte, issleduyte, upravlyayte, nastraivayte i sovershenstvuyte, kak dushe ugodno.

title: Mutropolis [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
MUTROPOLIS — milyy nauchno-fantasticheskiy kvest na pokinutoy vsemi planete Zemlya. Vy igraete za Anri Dizhona, kotoryy ishchet legendarnyy zateryannyy gorod. Otpravtes v prekrasnoe, narisovannoe vruchnuyu priklyuchenie. Nakhodite strannye drevnie artefakty, i, POZhALUYSTA, ne popadites vechnomu zlu, a ne to ono vas ispepelit. My vas predupredili.

Na dvore 5000-y god, i vse velikie dostizheniya chelovechestva zabyty. Piramidy, Mona Liza — zabyto vse.

Zabyto vsemi, krome Anri Dizhona i ego raznosherstnoy komandy arkheologov. Oni uletayut s Marsa na dikuyu i negostepriimnuyu planetu Zemlya. I vse u nikh tam idet khorosho, poka professora Anri ne pokhishchayut, a vokrug nachinayut proiskhodit... strannye veshchi.

Prisoedinites k Anri v etom bezbashennom priklyuchenii na ruinakh nashey tsivilizatsii. Otvechayte na voprosy tipa: "Kto takoy byl etot Soni Volkman i vystupal li on v tsirke?". Raskopayte neobychaynye relikvii, spasite professora Totelya i pervymi popadite v legendarnyy gorod Mutropolis.
A, i vot eshche chto: bogi Drevnego Egipta na samom dele sushchestvuyut i pytayutsya unichtozhit chelovechestvo. Udachki!

Osobennosti
50+ narisovannykh ot ruki fonov s milymi i nemnogo strannymi personazhami.
Polnaya angliyskaya ozvuchka s subtitrami na russkom, ispanskom, nemetskom, frantsuzskom, italyanskom, portugalskom, kitayskom, koreyskom i yaponskom yazykakh.
MORE LYuBVI!


Official Selection: AdventureX 2019
Winner: Indie Prize Casual Connect (London 2019)
Winner: Indie[MAD] Award (Madrid 2019)

title: The Princess Guide [NSZ][ENG]
description: Vyberite sredi chetyrekh printsess na ikh stremlenii k formirovaniyu mir svoey mechty. Budete li vy vybrat, chtoby polozhit konets goloda v mire s Liliartie, golodnyy, no schastlivyy Voin printsessa? Ili vy mozhete pomoch Veronika, derzkiy, no talantlivaya vedma printsessy, dostich mirovogo gospodstva? Mozhet byt, raskopat Semeynye sekrety i polozhit konets bednosti s Rouz printsessa, odnomariya? Ili rasprostranit slova mira i very po vsemu miru s Alpana, printsessoy drakona?

title: Plunder Panic [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Plunder Panic™ 是一款海盜行動的街機遊戲，最多可有 12 名玩家，兩組敵對船員在公海展開霸權爭奪戰！可以在本機或線上遊玩，和你的船員一起爭奪戰利品、打敗敵對船長，或擊沉他們的船。第一個佔領目標的隊伍就能獲勝，所以務必小心其他鬼鬼祟祟的海盜！

揚起海盜旗幟，並好好探索這款融合經典與現代元素的遊戲，其中具備復古的圖案、簡單的操控，和節奏明快的瘋狂街機動作遊戲相得益彰。還有多種遊戲模式、特殊的能量提升，以及顛覆遊戲的修改道具，數百種的遊戲組合保證能讓你感到刺激好玩！ Plunder Panic™ 提供彈性的團隊配置，包括本機、線上和 AI 控制玩家。是時候召集你的船員，大家齊心協力，把壞蛋競爭者關到反派的儲物櫃！

title: Big Bobby Car the Big Race [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Dlya samykh malenkikh igrokov!..
..Puteshestvuyte po otkrytomu miru, polnomu priklyucheniy na svoyom bolshom Bobbi-mobile, poznakomtes s drugimi, polnostyu ozvuchennymi mashinkami, vypolnyayte neslozhnye missii i nakhodite vse-vse spryatannye sokrovishcha, poka ne nastanet schastlivyy den vyigrysha ezhegodnoy Bolshoy Gonki, podnimayushchiy vas na podium pobediteley v kachestve novogo Chempiona!

title: Defend the Rook [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 移植版 rusifikatsii 来自 djonmarvel 用于 v0
description:
排兵佈陣，智取敵方！

享受比一般的塔防遊戲更多變的戰術樂趣，並擊退一波接一波的敵人。
克服挑戰，智取敵方。以強勁的法術對抗入侵者，力挽狂瀾並掌握戰局！

建造並升級塔樓，在敵方攻勢下努力生存。

想活到最後並取得勝利，不僅要運用手下精兵的智與勇，還要謹慎規劃塔樓的部署和升級。

設置陷阱和路障，守護你的城堡！

巧妙利用陷阱與路障，將入侵者集中，進而打亂其陣腳，破壞敵軍精心布置的陣形！

成為拯救王國的英雄吧！

你有本事捍衛住領地嗎？趕快踏入戰場，享受隨機生成的類Rogue回合制戰役吧！每一場仗都是獨一無二的體驗。

title: Master Spy [NSZ][ENG]
description:
你是間諜大師。
在這個腐敗墮落的世界裡，你不僅是優秀的間諜，還是最出色的間諜。借助你的原型隱形服和敏捷的智慧，你將偷偷摸摸地躲過無數敵人和障礙，同時揭開一個陰謀詭計的陰謀，讓你扮演一個遠比你的合同所承諾的更重要的角色。

機密細節：

在 50 多個具有挑戰性的關卡中跳躍、潛行和隱身，這些關卡所處的地點既有洶湧的電子工廠，也有神秘的忍者指揮中心！

電影般的像素藝術場景將您帶入遊戲體驗中，編織出一個關於間諜、陰謀和背叛的故事！

探索隱藏在遊戲中的秘密關卡，改變故事情節！

在可解鎖的有限可見度盲人大師模式中，對你的技能進行終極測試！

在新的「新手」模式中進行訓練，檢查點可幫助您完成任務！

在敘事模式中以自己的節奏進行遊戲——欣賞剪輯畫面和 OST，而不會被抓到！

卡住了？直接在暫停選單中切換敘事模式、新手模式和特工模式！

輸入作弊代碼，就能在閒暇時玩任何關卡並觀看剪輯！

由葛萊美獎得主 André Allen Anjos / RAC 製作原聲音樂。

title: Stealth [NSZ][RUS/Multi3]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 3]
description: 隱身一款你需要此時此地思考的遊戲。 每次延遲都會使您遭受一定程度的失敗。 只有有意義的動作，快速而敏銳的動作才能幫助您到達關卡的盡頭。 使用聲音炸彈隱藏或消滅敵人，營救人質，在極簡主義的隱形世界中，還有更多有趣的事情等待著您。

title: Never Stop Sneaking [NSP][ENG]
description:
Can you believe it? That madman, Amadeus Guildenstern, just traveled through time and kidnapped all the U.S. Presidents!

Yes, all of them! Even the bad ones!

If you're going to fix history, you'll need the help of the world's most elite stealth operatives: The Department of Sneakin'.

Infiltrate the enemy base, avoid their patrols, and hack their systems to gain valuable intel. Build your Sneakin' HQ, and figure out how to stop Guildenstern's time-traveling scheme!

- Classic tactical sneakin' action, rendered with only the finest polygons.
- Unlock new characters, weapons, and perks to aid you in your mission.
- Fight incredible bosses, including the evil Dr. Acula (probably a vampire) and Vice President Helicopter (who is a helicopter).
- Dynamic infiltration system generates new layouts every mission. Never sneak through the same base twice!
- Multiple control options to customize your sneakin' experience!

title: Blud [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Voskhititelno bezumnaya igra o podzemelyakh, stirayushchaya gran mezhdu rolevymi boevikami i giperkineticheskimi multfilmami devyanostykh ot Nikelodeona. Zdes vam nuzhno spasti druzey, ne dopustit vampirskogo apokalipsisa i perezhit uzhasy novichka v khokkee s myachom.
Bekki Bryuster — starsheklassnitsa, nedavno pereekhavshaya v gorod, i ubivat nezhit dlya neyo — norma zhizni, ved ona — poslednyaya v drevnem rodu koldunov, ubiyts vampirov. Chtoby nayti gnyozda nezhiti, nuzhno izuchat burlyashchie gorodskie sotsseti, a chtoby nayti slabye mesta demonov, nuzhno delat s nimi selfi. S pomoshchyu grimuarov i shkolnykh pripasov mozhno usovershenstvovat vernuyu khokkeynuyu klyushku dlya ubiystva nezhiti, a takzhe razvit spyashchie volshebnye navyki. V borbe pomozhet raznoshyorstnaya kompaniya koloritnykh personazhey: pust vampiry znayut, chto takoe starshaya shkola Karpentersvillya!

title: Tesla Force [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Tesla Force — napryazhennyy rogue-lite shuter s vidom sverkhu i protsedurnym generirovaniem urovney. Vas zhdet bezumnaya, trebuyushchaya polnoy otdachi sil progulka.

* Veseloe bezumie i napryazhennye srazheniya
* Igra v zhanre rogue-lite, kotoruyu mozhno prokhodit snova i snova
* Sluchayno generiruemye urovni
* Ogromnyy vybor razrushitelnogo oruzhiya
* Smertonosnye nauchnye gadzhety dlya borby s porozhdeniyami mraka
* Raznoobraznye, bezumnye navyki, pozvolyayushchie nastroit personazha pod sebya
* Desyatki unikalnykh tvarey i bossov, pridumannykh Lavkraftom
* Igrayte za Nikolu Tesla, Mariyu Kyuri, G. F. Lavkrafta ili Meri Shelli.

title: Desert Child [NSP][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Vy slomleny, vy golodny, a vse vashi druzya — staryy khoverbayk i miska lapshi.

V igre Desert Child vy sygraete za molodogo i talantlivogo gonshchika na khoverbaykakh. Emu nuzhno pridumat, kak naskresti dostatochno deneg na gonkakh i podrabotkakh, chtoby kupit bilet v odin konets na Krasnuyu Planetu i prinyat uchastie v samoy krupnoy gonke vselennoy, Gran-Pri.

Znakomyy nam mir medlenno stanovitsya prigodnym dlya zhizni, i mnogie lyudi s Zemli pereselilis na Mars iz-za luchshego kachestva zhizni. Ko vsemu prochemu, pravitelstvo soobshchilo, chto cherez dve nedeli tsena na bilety do Marsa vyrastet, chto sdelaet pereselenie na krasnuyu planetu nevozmozhnym dlya obychnykh lyudey.

Na svoem puti vam pridetsya rabotat dostavshchikom pitstsy, sobirat chasti oruzhiya, okhotitsya za nagradami i priobretat fanatov. Mezhdu gonkami vy budete issledovat krasochnye goroda, v kotorykh mozhno otremontirovat i uluchshit bayk, est mestnuyu edu i srazhatsya s gangsterami, okhotnikami za golovami i raznymi drugimi interesnymi lichnostyami prosto dlya togo, chtoby zarabotat na edu i detali dlya bayka.

Ved nichego ne besplatno v Desert Child!

Osobennosti
• Srazhaytes s okhotnikami za golovami, dostavlyayte pitstsu, uchastvuyte v gonkakh — delayte vse, chtoby zarabotat
• Moderniziruyte svoy lyubimyy bayk, ustanavlivaya na nego oruzhie, usiliteli i raskrashivaya ego reklamoy
• Eshte samye raznye mezhplanetnye blyuda, kotorye dayut vam poleznye usileniya
• Ovladeyte slozhnoy mekhanikoy srazheniy i gonok i vyrabotayte svoy firmennyy stil
• Uchastvuyte v gonkakh, strelyayte i sovershenstvuytes! Vy mozhete povtorno uchastvovat v gonkakh, otkryvaya vse novye sekrety
• Naslazhdaytes originalnym saundtrekom v stile khip-khop v vintazhnom nizkom kachestve
• Sorevnuytes s druzyami v lokalnom mnogopolzovatelskom rezhime

title: Slaycation Paradise [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
SLAYCATION PARADISE: ZABRONIRUYTE OTPUSK V BESPLODNOY PUSTOShI

V samom serdtse Galaktiki raspolozhen nash velikolepnyy Slaycation Paradise, gde v vashem rasporyazhenii budet vsyo dlya otdykha mechty! Lyuboy puteshestvennik po varpu, ustavshiy ot ezhednevnoy rutiny, budet rad otdokhnut za ubiystvami v nashem prelestnom pansione. Issleduyte chudesnye khaoticheskie ugolki nashego zavedeniya, perepolnennye monstrami, chya edinstvennaya tsel — ubit vas. Otrinte vse problemy i provedite nezabyvaemyy otpusk, lyubuyas uvyadayushchim, gibnushchim mirom!

POSETITE UNIKALNYE EKZOTIChESKIE UGOLKI I POLYuBUYTES KONTsOM SVETA
Cherez unikalnye mezhprostranstvennye portaly Slaycation Paradise vy vsey semey perenesetes k samym raznym variantam apokalipsisa i svoimi glazami uvidite, kak gibnet Zemlya. Lyubuytes potryasayushchimi peyzazhami, poka mir umiraet v ogne. Omoyte nogi v rekakh krovi, popivaya «Margaritu»*.
Tolko v Slaycation Paradise vy smozhete oshchutit eto unikalnoe chuvstvo, budto Vselennaya vot-vot pogibnet! Prikhodite skoree, boynya segodnya vydalas zamechatelnaya!
*Ne rekomenduem ispolzovat tyazheloe oruzhie v sostoyanii opyaneniya.

DAYTE VOLYu FANTAZII, SOZDAV SOBSTVENNYE USLOVIYa DLYa ZAShchITY ZAMKA
Vsem nashim gostyam besplatno predostavlyayutsya bazovye konstruktivnye oboronnye tureli (nabor K.O.T.), s pomoshchyu kotorykh lyuboy smozhet vystroit zashchitnye ukrepleniya gde ugodno!  Nabor idealno podoydet dlya oborony ot nadoedlivykh zombi! **
Nabor K.O.T. obespechit vam i vashim lyubimym naivysshiy uroven bezopasnosti, chtoby vy mogli nasladitsya kazhdym mgnoveniem svoego otpuska v apokalipsise.
**Ispolzuyte na svoy strakh i risk. Slaycation Paradise Ltd. ne neset otvetstvennosti za posledstviya raneniy ili zarazheniy zombi-chumoy.

PROSMOTRITE KATALOG S TURELYaMI V ARENDU I VOSPOLZUYTES NAShIM LUChShIM ORUZhIEM
Vospolzuytes nashim proverennym oruzhiem dlya apokalipticheskikh vremen: ot klassicheskogo pompovogo drobovika do ognemeta, kotomyota, volshebnykh palochek i mnogogo, mnogogo drugogo. V nashem prevoskhodnom arsenale naydetsya oruzhie dlya lyuboy tseli, bud to ubiystva melkoty ili srazheniya s chudovishchami razmerom s dom. Kto skazal, chto boynya ne byvaet veseloy?!

title: Kraken Academy [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
Dobro pozhalovat v shkolu «Kraken». 

Shkola «Kraken» daleko ne samaya obychnaya. Na fakultete iskusstv zdes uchatsya prizraki, na sportploshchadke vynashivayut plany sektanty, a krokodily nedavno nachali est detey.

Vmeste s volshebnym Krakenom vam predstoit vyyasnit, kem zhe yavlyaetsya zloy geniy po prozvishchu Predatel... S kazhdoy novoy petlyoy vremeni vashi shansy spasti shkolu «Kraken» budut uvelichivatsya.

Issleduyte i rassleduyte
Spasenie mira — delo vazhnoe, no lyubomu geroyu inogda nuzhno otdokhnut i zanyatsya chem-to drugim. Vse tri dnya vremennoy petli v vashem rasporyazhenii: issleduyte shkolu i uznavayte, chem zanimayutsya ucheniki i prepodavateli. Posetite maskarad, vzhivites v rol detektiva i pomogite shkolnomu uborshchiku razobratsya s prestupnym sindikatom.

Vstupite v klub po interesam
Uchashchimsya dostupny chetyre kluba po interesam: klub lyubiteley iskusstva, a takzhe muzykalnyy, sportivnyy i dramaticheskiy kluby.

• V klube lyubiteley alternativnoy muzyki vy smozhete vstupit v modnuyu molodyozhnuyu rok-gruppu.
• Klub lyubiteley iskusstva pozvolit vam proyavit tvorcheskuyu zhilku i pokhvastatsya svoimi rabotami pered drugimi uchashchimisya.
• Sportivnyy klub — nastoyashchiy ray dlya lyubiteley borotsya i ne sdavatsya.
• Dramaticheskiy klub — pristanishche snobov, i vyzhit tam smozhet ne kazhdyy. No kto znaet, vdrug glavnaya rol v ikh sleduyushchey pese dostanetsya imenno vam?

K schastyu, vy mozhete vstupit vo vse chetyre kluba! Magicheskiy amulet pozvolit vam perekhodit v drugoy klub v kazhdoy novoy vremennoy petle.

Znakomtes i obshchaytes
V shkole «Kraken» polno yarkikh lichnostey. V odnom tolko muzykalnom klube vy poznakomites s krasavchikom Vladimirom — vedushchim vokalistom, stradayushchim ot vnimaniya neugomonnykh poklonnits, razdrazhitelnoy basistkoy-mizantropom Simonoy v tolstovke s zhirafom, a takzhe s barabanshchitsey Brokkoli, bespreryvno toskuyushchey po svoemu partnyoru posle rasstavaniya.

Skoree khvatayte svoyu shkolnuyu formu, nadevayte volshebnyy amulet dlya puteshestviy vo vremeni i ne slushayte vash vnutrenniy golos, pytayushchiysya otgovorit vas ot etoy bezumnoy zatei!

title: Verne: The Shape of Fantasy [NSZ][ENG]
description:
驚悚離奇

時值1888年，對抗殘暴“國家”的戰爭已到生死關頭，濱海之地赫墨拉危於累卵。為了拯救國家，儒勒·凡爾納與尼摩船長決定孤注一擲，駕駛聲名狼藉的“鸚鵡螺號”潛艇深潛搜尋傳說中的亞特蘭蒂斯。
根據傳說，那裡埋藏著一件有著足以改變歷史進程的古代秘寶：赫菲斯托斯之焰！正是它的力量讓亞特蘭蒂斯崛起與衰落。
在他們的冒險中，儒勒·凡爾納不僅將發現超乎想像的奇觀與秘密，更將遭遇一位強大的黑暗使徒，其唯一目的便是將赫墨拉中所有人的想像力抹殺 – 凡爾納本人也不例外！

遊戲特色
• 發揮想像力: 利用亞特蘭蒂斯秘寶IMAG的力量來重寫歷史，並在重要關頭改寫儒勒的命運。
• 獨特故事: 一千個讀者眼中就會有一千個哈姆雷特。本作的非線性對話會讓每個玩家的遊戲體驗各有不同。
• 深海尋寶: 遊戲受經典冒險遊戲啟發，解開謎題，探索環境將是成功的關鍵。
• 掘地三尺: 從鸚鵡螺號的幽暗過道，到亞特蘭蒂斯的古代遺跡 - 充滿細節和氛圍感的蒸汽朋克圖元美術等待您的挖掘。
• 深入細節: 親身參與，成為儒勒·凡爾納作品與人生故事的一部分吧。

title: Freud's Bones The Game [NSP][ENG]
description:
«Bez realnosti chelovek eshchyo smozhet prozhit, no bez fantaziy — nikogda.» 
Proniknite, upravlyayte i odnovremenno spasayte razum ottsa psikhoanaliza, avstriyskogo psikhologa, psikhoanalitika, psikhiatra i nevrologa Zigmunda Freyda v etom syurrealisticheskom i zagadochnom priklyuchenii!.. Upravlyayte ego «vnutrennim golosom», vybirayte ego sudbu, rassleduyte klinicheskie sluchai svoikh samykh slozhnykh patsientov, spasayte (ili osuzhdayte) ikh, poputno pytayas spasti Freyda ot samogo sebya.

title: The Dark Prophecy [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
description:
Igrayte za Dzheykoba, obychnogo srednevekovogo malchika, stremyashchegosya spasti korolevstvo ot razrushitelnogo koldovstva.

Vskore Dzheykob okazyvaetsya v vodovorote volshebnykh sobytiy. Teper sudba ego derevni (i vsego korolevstva) zavisit ot nego.

Issleduyte yarkiy mir i reshayte golovolomki, chtoby prodvigatsya po syuzhetu igry, nakhodite unikalnye predmety i misticheskie lokatsii i naslazhdaytes prekrasnoy estetikoy pikselnoy grafiki. 


Kharakteristiki:
	* Fenteziynyy kvest tipa «ukazhi i shchelkni»
	* Issleduyte detalno prorabotannoe srednevekovoe korolevstvo
	* Vzaimodeystviya «Osmotret/Ispolzovat/Pogovorit»

title: Cleo a Pirate's Tale [NSZ][ENG]
description:
* With full voice acting in English and German!

THE STORY
„What is the most important part of a story?“

Cleo is a 14 year old cynical girl, living a repetitive life with her father in a bar. She knows everything about the epic adventures of pirate legend Captain Cabeca, but in her everyday life, she is just surrounded by boring fishermen and unsuccessful pirates, hanging around at the counter.
But when Cleo finds a strange pirate-logbook and sees a ghost, who gives her a mysterious hint, her boring life is about to get turned upside down. She is thrown into a dangerous adventure and finds herself in a world of lies, deceit, greed and bad breath - the world of pirates - and most of them are looking for the same thing:
THE TREASURE OF ETERNAL MEMORY.

KRAKEN FODDER:
"Kraken Fodder" is a mini game inside the game.
It is a card and dice game, which is taken pretty seriously among fishermen and pirates. One round takes about 5 minutes and the game is about destroying your opponents card deck with canon balls. HAHAHAR!
Throughout the game, Cleo has to play this card game against a few NPCs.

The game was successfully funded on Kickstarter in 2020.
ARRRGH!

title: Sumatra Fate of Yandi [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 俄语, lyubitelskiy Prometheus Project / AlchemistLab
description:
Yandi, odinokiy i poteryannyy v dzhunglyakh posle uzhasnogo opolznya, dolzhen nayti put domoy k svoey vozlyublennoy Adiratne.

Emu predstoit izbezhat massy opasnostey i raskryt mnozhestvo tayn, probirayas cherez beskraynie prostory neizvedannogo lesa i pustynnykh pustoshey.

Prisoedinites k Yandi v ego epicheskom priklyuchenii i pomogite emu vyzhit.

OSOBENNOSTI:
* Issleduyte nasyshchennye i yarkie dzhungli, polnye tayn
* Intriguyushchaya syuzhetnaya liniya s neozhidannymi povorotami
* Nostalgicheskiy priklyuchencheskiy stil «ukazhi i shchelkni» s mnozhestvom golovolomok
* Vstrechaytes s lyudmi i zhivotnymi, druzyami i vragami
* Originalnyy saundtrek iz 30 kompozitsiy

title: Jewel Fever 3 [NSZ][ENG]
description:
它增加了新的遊戲模式、更好的圖形，以及本地和線上多人遊戲！

本遊戲的特色
- 經典遊戲模式「一般」、「快速」與「無限」！
- 任務模式有 30 個任務需要解決！
- AI 模式，在 2 種遊戲模式中有 4 種不同的 AI 對手！
- 本地和線上多人遊戲！
- 15 項成就

title: Milkmaid of the Milky Way [NSP][ENG]
description:
Experience a story-based puzzle game unlike anything you've ever played before! Raved by critics and players around the world, you play as milkmaid Ruth who lives alone on a remote farm in a faraway fjord. Then one day a spaceship arrives and turns Ruth's life upside down, sending her on a quest that will change her life forever.

Milkmaid is a modern take on a much loved genre from the 90's, the point'n'click adventure game. Solve puzzles, explore intriguing settings and experience a gripping story that twists and turns.

Features
- A lovingly crafted universe with hand-painted backgrounds combined with old school pixel art 
- An exciting, intriguing story filled with wonder
- 2-4 hour playtime
- All dialogue and game text written in rhyme! 
- English, French and Norwegian languages
- Autosave and custom save games
- Four earth-based cows
- Absolutely no microtransitions, loot boxes or pay to win
- Lovely, original soundtracks
- Made with passion by one guy from Norway

title: Lapis x Labyrinth [NSP][ENG]
description:
Nabirat i nastroit svoyu komandu avantyuristov ot vybora 8 igrovykh klassov v etom vysokovoltnykh deystviyakh platformera.
 Za kazhdym monstrom umysle vnutri labirinta mozhet byt nepostizhimye sokrovishcha, beskonechnoe zoloto, ili, vozmozhno, dazhe bolee strashnye koshmary. Prinesite vashi luchshie detali, maksimalno ispolzovat potentsial vashey partii, i aktivirovat Fever Mode, chtoby preodolet lyubye prepyatstviya na vashem puti k nizhney chasti labirinta.

title: Fuze 4 [NSZ][ENG]
description:
FUZE4 Nintendo Switch™ is an all-in-one coding application. Developed by a team of gamers, programmers, artists and educators, the end result is a powerful yet accessible application and unique programming language suitable for absolute beginners, professionals and everything between!

Features
• Real, text-based coding language
• Program sharing – download games made by other FUZE users and share your programs!
• Showcase Gallery – see the best creations made by the FUZE community! Get your games features for the whole world to play!
• Vast library of game assets to create with – over 10,000 assets across 2D, 3D and Audio. Features contributions from over 30 artists and musicians
• 2D sprite engine with extensive functionality for creating fast and powerful 2D games
• 3D engine with lighting, camera, shadows, 3D terrain and animated 3D models
• Audio engine to allow music and sound effects creation using the synthesizer functions
• Use Joy-Con™ Controllers, Touchscreen, USB Keyboards, Mouse and IR Motion Camera in your games
• Advanced maths functions & Quaternion support
• Image and Map editors to create your own custom assets, tilesheets and 2D game levels
• Group and attach 3D objects to customise 3D models

Documentation
• Comprehensive reference guide featuring detailed descriptions for each function complete with code examples
• Over 30 extensive tutorials to take total beginners from simple programs such as ‘Hello World’ to creating your own games!
• Learn and understand crucial coding concepts such as iteration, variables, conditions, input/output, functions, algorithms and use them in your creations!
• Join the growing community of coders and game enthusiasts to learn and improve your coding skills, no matter where you are in your journey!

FUZE4 Nintendo Switch™ uses a unique programming language created by Team FUZE specifically to lower the barrier to entry to real coding. It is dynamically typed, case insensitive, uses simple English words in place of cryptic symbols to facilitate easy understanding and does not enforce a particular style of formatting.

title: Star Trek: Voyager Elite Force Holomatch (移植版 VoyagerNX) [NSP][ENG]
description:
Star Trek Voyager: Elite Force Holomatch — shuter ot pervogo litsa ot Raven Software, vypushchennyy v prodazhu Activision; deystvie proiskhodit vo vselennoy «Zvyozdnogo puti». Igra byla khorosho vosprinyata publikoy.
Syuzhet osnovan na fantasticheskom teleseriale «Zvyozdnyy put: Voyadzher». Igrok prinimaet rol ensina «Aleks» Munro kak chlen elitnogo otryada bezopasnosti — Komandy opasnosti (angl. Hazard Team). Kogda zvezdolyot «Voyadzher» zastrevaet v zagadochnom kladbishche korabley, zadacha spaseniya korablya padaet na plechi Munro. On/ona vstretit predstaviteley mnogikh ras vselennoy «Zvyozdnogo puti», vklyuchaya borgov, lyudey iz Zemnoy imperii (Terran Empire), klingonov, khirodzhinov i vid 8472, a takzhe mnogikh ras, eksklyuzivnykh dlya igry. Krome bitv s inoplanetyanami, Munro takzhe dolzhen(-na) zavershat zadaniya po vsemu korablyu, naprimer ostanavlivat peregruzku reaktora i pomogat s remontom korablya.
Bitvy proiskhodyat na golopalube, v igre razlichnye tipy igr, vklyuchaya deathmatch, team deathmatch i zakhvat flaga; est i boty.
Primer geympleya.Drugie Star Trek-igry.

title: While True learn [NSZ][RUS/Multi3]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 3]
description:
While True: learn() — eto golovolomka/simulyator, posvyashchennaya eshche bolee golovolomnym veshcham: mashinnomu obucheniyu, neyrosetyam, iskusstvennomu intellektu i bolshim dannym. No glavnym obrazom, eto igra o tom, kak ponyat kota.

Vy okazhetes v roli programmista, kotoryy neozhidanno uznal, chto ego kot gorazdo luchshe razbiraetsya v kompyuterakh, chem on sam (no pri etom ne ochen-to razbiraetsya v chelovecheskom yazyke). Teper etot programmist dolzhen vsestoronne osvoit mashinnoe obuchenie, chtoby sozdat sistemu-perevodchik s koshachego yazyka na chelovecheskiy.

Uznayte, chto zhe takoe mashinnoe obuchenie
Igra osnovana na realno primenyaemykh printsipakh mashinnogo obucheniya: ot nelovkikh ekspertnykh sistem do moguchikh sverkhtochnykh neyrosetey, sposobnykh predskazyvat budushchee. Ne pugaytes: eto vse eshche vyglyadit i igraetsya kak zabavnaya golovolomka.

Stante titanom v mire bolshikh dannykh!
Peretaskivayte obekty po ekranu myshkoy! Soedinyayte ikh liniyami (o da!). Pytaytes. Terpite krakh. Pytaytes snova. Zatem nazhimayte knopku «Opublikovat» i nablyudayte za tem, kak dannye stroynymi ryadami proplyvayut po vashemu ekranu.

Okunites v polnuyu adrenalina zhizn spetsialista po mashinnomu obucheniyu!
Chtoby sozdat proryvnuyu tekhnologiyu, pridetsya porabotat frilanserom i pochuvstvovat na sebe vse tyagoty i lisheniya etoy zhizni. Poluchayte imeyly! Prinimayte zadaniya! Sidite tselymi dnyami v komnate v polnom molchanii! Nastoyashchie spetsialisty po obrabotke dannykh tak i zhivut!

Progaem po-tsarski
Nashi zadaniya osnovany na realnykh problemakh, reshaemykh s pomoshchyu mashinnogo obucheniya. Naprimer, u nas mozhno postroit mashinu s avtopilotom (i usadit za rul kota). A esli zakhotite proverit sebya po-vzroslomu, stante tekhnicheskim direktorom startapa: tolko vy i vashi navyki protiv dikikh zakonov rynka! 

Prokachivayte zhelezki, prokachivayte zhizn!
Kak tolko nachnete zarabatyvat stabilnye dengi, nastanet vremya zakupitsya moshchneyshim oborudovaniem. No ne odnimi zhelezkami syt programmist! Kupite kotiku klassnyy kostyum! Chert, vy dazhe mozhete kupit sebe nastoyashchiy kustik aloe!

Zabavnyy fakt: chem-to takim spetsialisty po mashinnomu obucheniyu i zanimayutsya. Teper vy mozhete stat odnim iz nikh (pravda, bez ikh zarplat)!

title: The Long Reach [NSZ][ENG]
description: Deystvie igry The Long Reach proiskhodit v shtate Nyu-Gempshir, v vymyshlennom gorode Bervoks. Sozdateli cherpali vdokhnovenie v takikh igrakh, kak Lone Survivor, The Cave, a takzhe v klassicheskikh priklyuchencheskikh igrakh (vot tolko deystvie v The Long Reach proiskhodit v sovremennosti). Vy ne budete igrat v postapokalipticheskom mire ili issledovat mir fentezi, polnyy fey. Vy popadete v gushchu sobytiy, kotorye proiskhodyat pryamo za uglom, nedaleko ot blizhayshego produktovogo magazina.

title: Blackwind [NSZ][ENG]
description:
星艦 Pandora 號被擊落，直接衝向 Medusa-42，詹姆士哈金斯發現自己被困在一套軍用原型 Battle Frame 裝甲當中。隨著拉諾斯人在這顆星球上大肆破壞，搗毀一個又一個人類的採礦殖民地，詹姆士必須盡快學會如何使用這套 Battle Frame 裝甲，這樣才能在危險重重的處境中倖存，並且找到他失聯的父親。

然而，詹姆士並非孤軍奮戰——他的 Battle Frame 裝甲裡面隱藏了一個意想不到的夥伴……

- 選擇你專屬的遊戲風格：近身肉搏、遠距射擊、飛彈轟炸，或運用特殊的戰鬥服能力，在面對入侵者的殊死戰中求生。
- 以兇猛的招式殘暴地終結你的對手。
以新的能力強化你的 Battle Frame 裝甲，拓展你的技能樹。
- 在單人戰役中使用 Battle Frame 無人機擴展你的戰鬥格局，並探索各種技能。
- 本機合作模式：Battle Frame 裝甲和其無人機可由兩名玩家分別操控。

title: Citizens Unite Earth x Space (Citizens of Space) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Citizens Unite!: Earth x Space包括「Citizens of Earth」，其中的菜鳥副總統和國內公民，調查在地球各地冒出來的奇異神秘事件，還有「Citizens of Space」，其中的地球新大使展開旅程，要在銀河全境公民幫助下，尋找失蹤的地球。

此次這兩場探險結合了全新要素。召募 88 名具有獨特能力的公民，要在兩個時間段中拯救地球！在「Citizens of Earth」和「Citizens of Space」之間從事往返時間旅行，解鎖新內容並揭露真正結局！

團結公民以阻止秘密敵入幕後運作來拯救時間線！

title: Dungeon Munchies [NSZ][ENG]
description:
被死靈法師西米施法復活的你，必須逃離這個已經化為奇妙地城的巨大地下複合式設施。在西米的協助下，你得確保自身安全，取得糧食，找出逃離地城的手段。由台灣團隊獻上的這款橫向捲軸動作RPG，等著你來挑戰！

《餐癮地城》是一款橫向捲軸動作RPG遊戲。在化為迷宮的巨大建築物當中，你將狩獵盤踞在此的怪物，把它們做成美味佳餚。吃下這些料理，還能夠得到怪物所擁有的特殊能力。各種料理與效果的搭配，都會帶來獨特的遊戲風格與體驗喔！

豐富菜單，供你大快朵頤
《餐癮地城》存在著非常多種類的料理，然而你的胃只能裝下七種菜色。慎選吃下肚的食物，才有助於發揮你原本應有的能力。例如像芭樂汁、串燒蝦或炒螃蟹等料理，分別就具有恢復生命力、提昇對敵人造成的傷害，以及附加防水護盾等特殊效果。

物盡其用，打造強力裝備
吃不進肚裡的動植物部位也別浪費，把它們做成各式各樣的武器或防具吧。和你最愛吃的料理搭配，打造出最殺的戰鬥組合吧！

挑戰兇惡怪物，取得新鮮珍味
這個時代想要取得新鮮食材並不容易。身上帶電的蝸牛、爪子銳利的蝦，還有會發射雷射光的胡蜂等等，這些怪物個個都不好惹。想採集到美味的食材或強力的裝備材料，得先做好心理準備。

這世界似乎哪裡不對勁……？
自稱擁有特級證照的死靈法師大廚、暴虐無道的森林之王，加上推動水果革命的激進派革命家……這地城裡存在著各式各樣的人物（搞不好不是人類？）。你復活後所見到的這世界，和過去有什麼不同？這個地城正在發生什麼樣的大事？在探索地城的過程中，一切都將逐漸明朗。

title: Boris the Rocket [NSZ][RUS/Multi3]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 3]
description:
BORIS THE ROCKET - simulyator usatogo sovetskogo raketchika vremen Kholodnoy voyny. U vas budet vozmozhnost v odinochku zashchitit svoyu neobyatnuyu Rodinu. Vam predstoit borotsya s morozom i koznyami medvedya, khlebat sgushchenku, chtoby vyzhit i svoevremenno adaptirovatsya k bystro menyayushcheysya obstanovke.

Polnoe pogruzhenie v dramaticheskuyu obstanovku vremyon Kholodnoy voyny, to vremya, kogda dolg pered Rodinoy vazhnee lichnogo mneniya, a tvoyo brennoe telo polnostyu prinadlezhit gosudarstvu. Ved imenno v takikh usloviyakh stanovyatsya nastoyashchimi geroyami i patriotami svoey strany. 
Ne day pogubit svoyu Rodinu i dostoyno otvet vragu! Umri, no sdelay! Ved u sovetskogo cheloveka dazhe smert ne yavlyaetsya opravdaniem!

• Mozhno prokachat organizm Borisa, chto neosporimo uluchshit kachestvo vypolnyaemoy im sluzhby. Nesmotrya na to, chto Boris i tak v ochen khoroshey forme, kak izvestno, net predela sovershenstvu!
• Progress ne stoit na meste, a izobretatelnosti vraga mozhno tolko pozavidovat. Ozhidayte prodolzhitelnyy grad iz raznoobraznogo  vysokotekhnologichnogo metalla vdobavok so smertonosnym yadernym zaryadom.
• Izgotavlivayte zhiznenno neobkhodimoe zele. Ved edinstvennoe, chto mozhet ostanovit medvedya, - eto butylka VODY. Pripasite paru butylok: odnu dlya sebya i odnu dlya vashego novogo tayozhnogo druga!
• Eto kak minimum to, chto zastavit vraga vas uvazhat, a kak maksimum zastavit ego zamolchat navsegda. Chudo inzhenernoy mysli, kombinatsiya adskoy sily i velikolepiya - mezhkontinentalnaya ballisticheskaya raketa "STEPAN".

title: Orwell: Keeping an Eye On You, Ignorance is Strength [NSZ][ENG,RUS]
interface_lang: 俄语 (u 1-oy igry), 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
«Svoboda — eto v pervuyu ochered pravo vsekh govorit vsem lyudyam to, chego oni ne khotyat slyshat.» ~©
Orwell — novaya pravitelstvennaya programma bezopasnosti, sposobnaya otslezhivat deystviya kazhdogo cheloveka v Natsii v seti. Ona mozhet fiksirovat vse zvonki i perepisku i poluchat dostup k lyubomu kompyuteru. V tselyakh zashchity personalnykh dannykh grazhdan issledovateli-lyudi izuchayut poluchennye II Orwell fragmenty i reshayut, kakuyu informatsiyu sleduet predostavit silam bezopasnosti, a kakaya ne predstavlyaet vazhnosti.

title: Ghostanoid [NSZ][RUS]
interface_lang: 俄语 [RUS], 德语 [DEU], 英语 [ENG], 西班牙语 [ESP], 法语 [FRA], 意大利语 [ITA]

title: Firework [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Follow Yan the Defective One through his fight against the Fire Troops and let him unveil the Facility's mystery.

Dive into a modern tale written by David de La Rosa and developed by Ivan Zanotti.

Make your way through the Facility and face platform challenges.
Repel the fire, extinguishing its flames and soldiers.
Obtain hidden power-ups and special equipment.

The game finally arrives on Nintendo Switch™ in a revisited version and enriched by the brilliant Co-Op mode, perfect to be played with Joy-Con™ together with a friend.

title: Cats on Duty [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description: 本作是一款結合了即時戰略、塔防、三消等要素的超搞笑動作遊戲。遊戲中，身經百戰的重武裝貓咪老兵們將會在和老鼠們的小規模衝突及混亂的毛線團中發揮牠們的重要作用。不只保衛自己的家園（還有貓砂盆），更要抵禦巨大的邪惡勢力！利用多種不同的貓科動物與高達50種的邪惡生物作戰吧！

title: Elli [NSP][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 机器翻译 来自 most2820
description:
Prichudlivoe priklyuchenie dlya odnogo igroka, napolnennoe mnozhestvom golovolomok i zakhvatyvayushchikh platformerov.
Sledi za svoim shagom, est mnogo opasnostey, kotorye nuzhno preodolet!
Otkroyte dlya sebya voskhititelnyy mir, naselennyy igrivoy i obychno poleznoy Mandragoroy.
Puteshestvie ot roskoshnykh plyazhey, drevnikh khramov, gornykh vershin i peshcher, zapolnennykh zabytoy tekhnologiey Mandragory, i mnogoe drugoe.
Ogromnyy i postoyanno menyayushchiysya saundtrek, prekrasno sochetayushchiy temy mira i podcherkivayushchiy priklyucheniya Elli.
Sobirayte dragotsennye kamni i skrytye monety i obmenivayte ikh na razlichnye odeyaniya, posokhi i shlyapy.
Prostoe upravlenie, pozvolyayushchee igrat detyam i vzroslym!

title: Undergrave [NSP][ENG]
description:
歡迎來到 Void Realm，一個危險潛伏在每個角落的地方。 來自 Red Ronin 的創造者的新挑戰將考驗您的戰略技能和戰術實力。 Undergrave 是一款激動人心的 roguelike 冒險遊戲，每次嘗試都會帶來全新的體驗。

當您踏入 Void Realm 時，您必須依靠角色的 3 種不同能力才能生存。 然而，你使用的每一種能力都會消耗你寶貴的耐力，耐力會隨著時間的推移而恢復。 你必須明智地使用你的能力來克服面前的挑戰。

要在 Undergrave 取得成功，您必須完善您的策略並結合您的能力以智取敵人。 每一次新的嘗試，你都會遇到新的挑戰，但只要採取正確的行動和敏捷的思維，你就能取得勝利。

您準備好挑戰 Void Realm 並證明您作為戰術策劃者的價值了嗎？ Undergrave 等待著挑戰！

遊戲特色：

- 獨特的戰鬥系統：遊戲的戰鬥系統基於戰略移動和戰術能力使用的結合，創造了動態和引人入勝的遊戲體驗。
- 體力管理：玩家必須仔細管理角色的體力，體力會因使用能力而消耗，迫使他們做出關於何時使用能力以及何時保存體力的戰略決策。

title: Savage Age [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
往古之時，大地上密林廣布，沼澤遍地。懷着對自然的敬畏，抗爭求存的先民聚眾而居，立圖騰以為象，將文明的火種一代代傳承下來。

我們的故事就從其中一個小小的部落開始：為了奪回蠻王劫掠的三翼圖騰，英雄肩負着全族的熱望踏上征程，步入神秘未知的大荒深處，開啟了一場浪漫而狂野的旅行……

遊戲特色

-扮演蠻荒時代的勇者掙扎求存，玩法融合了生存、戰鬥、建造甚至塔防等多種要素。
-設定與細節腦洞大開：頗具特色的俯視角卡通畫風，融入腦洞大開的詼諧設定，力圖帶給玩家前所未見，別具一格的蠻荒時代。
-精心設計、充滿驚喜的場景與謎題：場景交互與謎題設置回歸直覺、注重探索，鼓勵玩家進行不拘一格的多樣嘗試。
-豐富的關卡內容與收集要素：二十一個主線關卡及隱藏內容，通關後還將解鎖無限模式。各種各樣有趣的成就設置。在冒險途中，還能收集翡翠骷髏來揭開遊戲的隱藏奧秘。

title: Puzzle Adventure Blockle [NSP][ENG]
description:
Rotate the world to find a path to the goal in this rotating puzzle game!
Go on an adventure to the mysterious Wonder Labyrinth with Kulu, just a regular Kat trying to find his way and the beautiful Arika who has lost her memory!

Rotate the world, avoid obstacles, climb steps, and make use of various features to clear each stage.
The journey to Wonder Labyrinth will take you through many various worlds with changing environments such as the Icicle Palace and Flame Mountain.
Visit each of the worlds with their own features and obstacles and overcome the challenges of each one as you strive to obtain each of the 7 world stones.

Take your time and figure out each puzzle and don't worry if you make a mistake. You can quickly undo a move or retry anytime!

title: Progress Orders [NSP][ENG]
description:
孤身一人的主角因祖父的一封信，踏上旅程來到了公會。雖未能找到祖父的身影，但主角以收集情報為條件，開啟了在公會裡的工作。且在成為公會職員的儀式中，主角獲得了透過對方眼睛便能觀察事物的「千里眼」能力。

主角可選擇男性或女性。在3D繪製的公會中，你可以利用鍛冶屋、道具店、菜園等各種設施支援個性豐富的冒險者們。錯綜複雜的地下城將由各個隊伍自動進行，遭遇怪物時，可以選擇介入戰鬥，並展開策略型「閱讀指令」的刺激戰鬥。你也可以將戰鬥託付給冒險者，來專心處理其他工作！

包含3名男性和3名女性，共6名角色。與夥伴建立親近關係後，各自的故事也會隨之展開。與喜愛的夥伴一同打造公會吧！

title: Valley [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
description:
Issleduy ogromnyy i prekrasnyy mir Valley, ispolzuya vsyu silu L.E.A.F kostyuma: neveroyatno moshchnogo ekzoskeleta, nadelyayushchego svoego vladeltsa ne tolko sverkhchelovecheskoy skorostyu i lovkostyu, no i absolyutnoy vlastyu nad zhiznyu i smertyu vsekh zhivykh sushchestv. Valley eto priklyuchenie ot pervogo litsa, ravnogo kotoromu  eshche ne bylo. Ty by udivilsya, obnaruzhiv sebya v taynoy doline, spryatannoy v glubine otdalennykh oblastey Skalistykh gor? Blagodarya moshchi nedavno obnaruzhennogo L.E.A.F. kostyuma ( Leap Effortlessly though Air Functionality), prokladyvay sebe put s pomoshchyu bega i pryzhkov cherez prekrasnye lesa, opasnye ruiny i raznoobraznye sredy obitaniya; ne zabyvay primenyat svoi vozmozhnosti upravleniya zhiznyu i smertyu dlya raskrytiya udivitelnykh tayn zagadochnoy doliny.

-  Dvigaysya bystree, prygay vyshe: ispolzuy vsyu moshch L.E.A.F kostyuma i peremeshchaysya po miru Valley so sverkhchelovecheskoy skorostyu i lovkostyu.
-  Kontrol zhizni i smerti: L.E.A.F. kostyum pozvolyaet tebe reshat, komu zhit, a komu umeret.
-  Kazhdaya smert – novyy stezhok. S kazhdoy tvoey smertyu pogibaet i nebolshaya chast doliny.
-  Razvivaysya: uluchshay svoy kostyum i poluchay novye vozmozhnosti i umeniya.
-  Issleduy: Valley - eto neobyatnyy mir s dremuchimi lesami, dikimi prostorami, drevnimi ruinami, ocharovatelnymi sozdaniyami i opasnymi vragami. Eto mir, polnyy tayn...

title: Passing By a Tailwind Journey [NSZ][ENG]
description:
V udivitelnom i prekrasnom mire letayushchikh ostrovov, nikogda ne stikhaet zapadnyy veter. V roli Kerli, novichka-vozdukhoplavatelya, vam predstoit otpravitsya v nezabyvaemoe puteshestvie, chtoby dostavit tainstvennoe poslanie. V etoy novatorskoy kombinatsii dvukhmernogo platformera s golovolomkami, igry na vyzhivanie i priklyucheniya vy mozhete issledovat mir v sobstvennom tempe, puteshestvuya s ostrova na ostrov na korable/vozdushnom share i reshaya golovolomki. No ne zabyvayte pro neobkhodimye dlya vyzhivaniya resursy. Vas zhdyot uvlekatelnoe priklyuchenie, polnoe interesnykh vstrech i nezabyvaemykh vpechatleniy!
Gotovy nachat odisseyu k neizvestnomu mestu naznacheniya skvoz oblaka? «Puteshestvie ne menee vazhno, chem tsel. Da ne pogasnet vasha gorelka i ne utikhnet zapadnyy veter!»

title: Tyrant's Blessing [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Take charge of the last living warriors in tactical, turn-based battles and drive the Dead Army into the sea!

The Tyrant landed in Tyberia bearing promises of a paradise, without war, without suffering… and without death. All Tyberians had to do in order to enter his paradise was to simply die at the hands of his Dead Army. The war was over before it even began, with thousands perishing in the Tyrant's wake, only to be brought into his fold as undying thralls, bound by magic. The few living warriors left are scattered across the remnants of their homeland, tirelessly looking for a way to turn the tables on the tyrannical Tyrant. Lead a great Uprising, defeat the Dead Army, and drive the monstrous overlord back into the depths of the sea from whence he came.

Tyrant's Blessing is a tactical turn-based game where your ability to plan, adapt, and strategize is more important than min-maxing your units or finding the sharpest sword in the hoard. Select battles every day, make challenging choices, and cleverly use the strengths of these rag-tag insurgents to defeat the undead hordes and maybe - just maybe - bring real life back to Tyberia.

Every Day is a Battle for Survival
Before you bring the battle to the Tyrant's doorstep, you'll have to make sure you live long enough to reclaim the Island.

Decide whether to fight, rescue the living from the Undying, or gather your strength. Every choice matters throughout every day of the Uprising.
As you fight your way across the face of Tyberia, face off against random encounters that force difficult decisions. Do you intervene and fight highwaymen, putting your warriors at risk? Do you try to save a child, risking valuable time and resources? Only your morals and ideals hold the answer.
Pick your heroic roster carefully. Screeg, the elder wizard advising the Uprising, can only teleport three heroes and a pet at once: Do you send your elite warriors in? Or rookies to train and hold the line? Are they up to the task? Can you handle the consequences?


Every Battle is a Risk
The Tyrant can’t be defeated without destroying an army's worth of the Undying. However, winning is more than simply whacking the enemy as hard as you can.

Analyze the fray and plan accordingly. Place warriors around the battlefield to gain strategic advantages.
Stay ever mindful of surroundings: kick up dust to make the enemies lose sight or hop over stones and dodge into bushes to avoid enemy attacks.
Mind the enemy: every attack is telegraphed, but take care, simply moving away leaves behind a shadow. This remnant of a character can still be attacked if there is no way to avoid it... 
Knock the enemies out of the way and into obstacles, shield weaker heroes with ones that can tank damage, as well as chain powerful elemental attacks using the environment. Brute force works, but fight smarter, not harder.


Every Risk is Another Day
Each of your heroes has their own personality, properties, and abilities. Who will you choose to put in harm’s way?

Enlist twenty hallowed heroes, each with a distinct set of abilities that can dramatically alter the course of any battle.
But stay mindful: Not all heroes appear in a playthrough - and not everyone is guaranteed to make it to the finish line of this quest.
Pick the right team for the task. An assassin may thrive in confined spaces, while an archer will suffer in close quarters. Some heroes may even bring their pets along, who might provide just enough leverage to win a battle for the group.
Even if heroes fall, they can still be freed from the Tyrant's grasp. Track them down, defeat them in combat, and restore them back to their stolen life!

title: Neurodeck Psychological Deckbuilder [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Sozdayte svoyu kolodu i sposobnosti, otvechaya na lichnostnye testy, poseshchaya komnaty ili meditiruya. 

Osobennosti

- Sborka kolod po mere prokhozhdeniya igry 
- Meditiruyte i vybirayte cherty kharaktera, kotorye kardinalno menyayut igrovoy protsess
- Issleduyte labirint podsoznaniya, polnyy kart i uluchsheniy, kotorye pomogut pobedit monstrov v vashem razume
- Lyogkaya RPG-mekhanika pozvolyaet nastraivat kharakteristiki i navyki vashego personazha
- Personazhi i mesta iz vashego proshlogo rasskazhut fakty i istorii o psikhicheskom zdorove
- Glubokaya igrovaya mekhanika, v kotoroy osnovnoe vnimanie udelyaetsya vozmozhnosti povtornogo prokhozhdeniya i raznoobraziyu igrovogo protsessa
- Uzhasayushchie monstry, osnovannye na realnykh fobiyakh

title: Buildings Have Feelings Too [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Lyudi snesli Old Pete — sudoverf. On pervyy iz kompanii, kogo postigla takaya uchast. Ego bezvremennyy ukhod byl tak vnezapen... Vse zabespokoilis.

Esli vy sdelany iz kirpichey i betona, to eto ne znachit, chto vam ne o chem volnovatsya.

Eta raznosherstnaya gruppa druzey byla zdes s samogo nachala: mozhno skazat, vokrug nikh gorod stroilsya. Oni priveli s soboy titanov industrii i sotni drugikh domov; sozdali mnozhestvo rabochikh mest. No u Lnokombinata v etom godu pochti net zakazov na tkani, Sklad poteryal ocherednoy kontrakt s sosednim gorodom, a u Starogo Banka problemy s dengami.

Chto-to idet ne tak. Nastaet perelomnyy moment. A esli oni stanut sleduyushchimi?

K schastyu, za delo beretes vy — Otel. Vy tverdo namereny navesti poryadok! Snachala vy dumali, chto eto prosto podrabotka, no problemy narastayut, kak snezhnyy kom: istoriya razvivaetsya slishkom bystro, ugonites li vy za ney?

Buildings Have Feelings Too! — eto uvlekatelnaya novaya igra v zhanre «Upravlenie gorodom». Syuzhet stroitsya vokrug zdaniy i goroda, v kotorom oni obitayut.

Predstavte sebe gorod, gde zdaniya mogut peredvigatsya i razgovarivat drug s drugom. U kazhdogo svoi stremleniya, nadezhdy i strakhi. V osnovnom oni starayutsya ne razrugatsya drug s drugom i perezhit ocherednoy den. Razvivayte gorod, chtoby prevratit ego v ozhivlennyy megapolis s raznoobraznymi magazinami, biznes- i razvlekatelnymi tsentrami. Zabottes o protsvetanii vashikh zdaniy, inache ikh mogut snesti navsegda!

- Otkryvayte i razvivayte samye raznye predpriyatiya — ot viktorianskikh vremen do nashikh dney.

- Znakomtes s samymi raznymi zdaniyami: u kazhdogo — svoi stremleniya, strakhi i nadezhdy, i vse pytayutsya kak-to ustroitsya v izmenchivom mire.

- Menyayte i perestraivayte gorod, peredvigayte zdaniya i ishchite vygodnoe raspolozhenie, kotoroe pomozhet vashemu gorodu razvivatsya.

- Rasshiryaytes, zanimaya novye rayony goroda, otkryvaya novye dostoprimechatelnosti i znakomyas s novymi personazhami.

title: Hundred Days Winemaking simulator [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
在百日之內，您將完全控制新酒廠。首先，選擇您想要種植的葡萄藤，了解如何種植它們以及何時收穫它們。然後跟蹤整個葡萄酒生產過程，確定您想要生產的葡萄酒類型或市場需求。您還需要出售您生產的葡萄酒以促進業務增長。

實際上，從葡萄園到銷售的任何選擇都將影響葡萄酒的數量和質量。高品質的葡萄酒會增加您公司在世界範圍內的聲譽，可能會以更高的價格出現，讓您成長得更好更快。

- 適合初學者和更有經驗的玩家的模擬和現實方法
- 可以種植不同類型的葡萄樹
- 分析土壤並選擇最適合這些特性的葡萄品種
- 安排葡萄園的工作，如修剪或切碎
- 根據病害類型採用特殊處理方法保護您的葡萄藤
- 檢查葡萄的成熟度並決定何時收穫
- 遵循您的葡萄酒釀造過程並改善您的葡萄酒的特性
- 選擇發酵過程中使用的酵母和細菌
- 決定您的葡萄酒如何以及哪些葡萄酒隨著年齡的增長而陳釀
- 通過選擇瓶子的形狀、顏色和其他美學特徵來定制您的瓶子
- 創建自己的銷售網絡，並根據客戶類型調整產品功能
- 管理您的營銷和社交活動，以提高您公司的聲譽

包括納帕谷
在百日 - 納帕谷，您可以探索一個新的美國葡萄酒產區。 使用新舊技術培育新的葡萄品種並生產您的葡萄酒。

新遊戲場景：納帕谷
新葡萄品種包括：赤霞珠、仙粉黛、黑比諾和雷司令
新的挑戰
新工具和結構
新的陳釀選擇和口味
新的裝瓶定制

title: Weaving Tides [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Otpravlyaytes v puteshestvie vmeste so svoim Tkachom: issleduyte drevnie podzemelya, reshayte golovolomki, broste vyzov prichudlivym sushchestvam i raskroyte velikie tayny davno zabytogo proshlogo! Weaving Tides – eto ocharovatelnoe priklyuchenie dlya odnogo igroka v mire magii i tkachestva. Prokatites verkhom na kovrovykh drakonakh i issleduyte potryasayushchiy peyzazh, vzletaya nad tkushchimsya polotnom i opuskayas pod nego.

Spletayte velikolepnyy igrovoy mir
Razrezayte i sshivayte polotno, issleduya mir igry. Ispolzuyte sposobnosti Tkacha, chtoby oputat vragov i stat nastoyashchim pokoritelem kovarnykh podzemeliy i golovolomok. Vyberite Tkacha, sootvetstvuyushchego vashemu stilyu igry, i ukraste ego misticheskoy vyshivkoy, chtoby eshche bolshe usilit ego sposobnosti.

Issleduyte yarkiy tkanyy mir
Pogruzites v nezabyvaemyy peyzazh, sozdannyy iz tkani, pochuvstvuyte ocharovanie krasochnykh personazhey, narisovannykh ot ruki portretov i zakhvatyvayushchey muzyki.

Raskroyte vse tayny etoy ocharovatelnoy istorii
Naydite neobychnykh soyuznikov, pomogite Tassu nayti roditeley, soberite fragmenty proshlogo i raskroyte davno zabytye tayny etogo mira.

Podruzhites s tremya Tkachami i prokatites na nikh verkhom
Prichudlivye druzya-drakony pomogut vam orientirovatsya v mire i reshat neobychnye golovolomki. Vyberite, s kem vy razdelite priklyuchenie.

Potryasayushchiy tvorcheskiy rezhim
Razblokiruyte novye krasochnye lenty dlya svoikh Tkachey v kampanii i ispolzuyte ikh, chtoby sozdat svoyu sobstvennuyu tsifrovuyu vyshivku.

title: Kiki [NSZ][ENG]
description:
以第一人稱視角探索動態的 3D 障礙關卡，挑戰你遊玩平臺遊戲的實力！《Kiki》是一款快節奏的動作遊戲，在這裡唯一需要的就是精準的平臺遊戲能力。奔跑、跳躍來躲避狡詐的陷阱，還要蒐集星星與獎盃，並找出鑰匙來解鎖大門等，更伴隨著富有節奏感的電子樂原聲帶！

遊戲中共有 60 個散佈在多個不同的世界的障礙關卡，每一關都有獨特的挑戰需要克服，且難度會隨著進度推進而漸增。完成任務目標並在時間內破關即可解鎖新的關卡，也可以持續遊玩已通過的關卡來挑戰更好的成績！你能夠成為真正的跳躍大師嗎？

特色：

• 以 3D 的第一人稱視角挑戰 60 關的障礙關卡！
• 在每一關都蒐集到全部的星星。
• 奔跑、飛躍並躲開陷阱，找出通往勝利的最速通道！
• 找出鑰匙來解鎖出口，向下一個挑戰前進。
• 可立即重生，挑戰關卡幾次都行！

title: My Singing Monsters Playground [NSP][RUS/Multi7]
genre: 音乐节奏, 街机, 派对聚会
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Posetite mir monstrov i primite uchastie v uvlekatelnom turnire! Lyubimye monstry ozhivut na vashikh glazakh: begite, prygayte i katites k pobede v raznoobraznykh igrakh dlya 4 igrokov. Vstrechaytes s druzyami v Playground, chtoby poborotsya za zvanie absolyutnogo chempiona sredi monstrov!
 Lokalnye igry dlya neskolkikh igrokov
 Ustraivayte poedinki s druzyami v tselom raznoobrazii igr v mire monstrov.
 
 Poyushchie monstry snova zdes
 Upravlyayte svoimi lyubimymi personazhami iz mira My Singing Monsters.
 
 Bogatyy assortiment igrovykh rezhimov
 Obedinyaytes v komandy i stalkivaytes v igrakh 2 na 2 ili dobivaytes edinolichnoy pobedy v skhvatkakh, gde kazhdyy sam za sebya.
 Vidy igr
 Igrayte v svoem tempe — s druzyami ili v odinochku — v rezhimakh «Turnir-vecherinka», «Solo-zabeg» ili «Svobodnaya igra»!

title: AirJet Fighter: Sky Assault, Air Jet Combat Europe Fly Plane Attack, Dominators Aerial [NSZ][ENG]
description:
當天空變得險惡時，只有速度最快的飛行員才能生存。

在《噴射戰鬥機：空中突擊》中，你將駕駛一架先進的噴射機，執行分秒必爭的危險任務。參與驚險刺激的空戰，鎖定敵機，躲避來襲飛彈，並在動態地形中釋放毀滅性的火力。從廣闊的海洋到城市天際線，每個戰場都考驗著你的反應和精準度。

升級你的飛機，自訂你的武器庫，並掌握多種遊戲模式——從劇情驅動的戰役到生存對決和限時突擊任務。流暢的操控、身臨其境的視覺效果和令人腎上腺素飆升的動作體驗，這不僅僅是一次飛行——而是一場全力以赴的空中突擊。

主要特色：

- 高速噴射機戰鬥，流暢靈敏的飛行機制

- 戰役模式，挑戰和獎勵循序漸進

- 生存模式與限時挑戰模式，考驗你的技能

- 逼真的 3D 噴射機模型和大氣戰區

翱翔天際，稱霸天空，書寫你身為菁英空戰飛行員的傳奇。

title: Runner2 (Runner 2) Future Legend of Rhythm Alien [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Yarkiy ranner-platformer predlagaet vam issledovat pyat zavorazhivayushchikh mirov, proyti 120 zakhvatyvayushchikh urovney i srazitsya s pyatyu epicheskimi bitvami s bossami. Vybirayte odnogo iz vosmi personazhey, kazhdyy iz kotorykh obladaet sobstvennymi talantami, peremeshchayas po oshelomlyayushchim miram.
Legendarnyy Charlz Martine, izvestnyy svoey kultovoy rolyu golosa Mario, vystupaet v roli kharizmatichnogo rasskazchika, dobavlyaya notku prichudy v vashe priklyuchenie. Nastoyashchaya zvezda? Plyus zakhvatyvayushchiy saundtrek, kotoryy pulsiruet pri kazhdom dvizhenii, obespechivaya ni s chem ne sravnimoe pogruzhenie v igru!Runner3 sm. zdes.

title: Radio Commander [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
Pered vami ne ocherednaya RTS, gde vy — lish nevidimoe sushchestvo, paryashchee nad polem boya. V Radio Commander edinstvennyy sposob otsenit obstanovku — vnimatelno slushat svoikh soldat, vedushchikh srazhenie. V vashem rasporyazhenii lish strategicheskaya karta, na kotoroy vy razmeshchaete otryady i delaete pometki.

Radio Commander predlozhit vam unikalnyy igrovoy opyt, sovsem nepokhozhiy na to, k chemu vy privykli v strategiyakh v realnom vremeni. Eto smelaya popytka pereosmyslit zhanr — protsess prinyatiya resheniy zdes gorazdo realistichnee, chem v bolee kazualnykh RTS. Zaprashivayte otchety o situatsii. Slushayte svoikh boytsov.

Sudba soldat v vashikh rukakh. Resheniya, kotorye vy prinimaete, vliyayut na khod igry i opredelyayut vzglyady vashego geroya. Ili, vozmozhno, vashi sobstvennye? V Radio Commander pered vami vstanut neprostye voprosy. Spravedlivy li vashi postupki? Kakova tsena chelovecheskoy zhizni? Naskolko silna otrava propagandy i stereotipov?

title: Sowon the Toy Wonderland Dream Adventure [NSP][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
「玩具都跑哪去了？」

小女孩的父母離奇失蹤，有個看起來略微面熟的神秘人留下了邀請函。女孩打開原本一直所著的閣樓房門，勇敢展開冒險尋找自己的父母……她在門的另一端找到了奇特卻又美麗的世界，那裡充滿玩具！

《SOWON : The Toy Wonderland》這款冒險遊戲的故事主人翁是 Sowon，這位小女孩突然之間來到了充滿玩具的世界，玩家必須操控她在地圖的每個角落尋找線索，並勇敢踏入充滿神祕謎團的遊戲世界。

Sowon 有沒有辦法解開神秘人的謎團並重返自己原本的世界呢？

<遊戲介紹>

▶前往充滿神祕玩具的世界
這個世界看起來怪怪的，跟現實長不一樣……這裡比較漂亮、奇特且古怪。感受獨特的畫風，既有童話故事的可愛感，看起來卻又像是黏土捏成的作品。

▶心臟是齒輪發條，肚子則是棉花
這個玩具世界裡面生活著各式各樣的娃娃與人偶，每個角色都有獨特的樣貌和動作，帶給你不同的印象和感受。只要滿足他們每個人的願望，原本被堵住的道路就有機會成為新的通道！

▶多元謎題滿足你的好奇心
靠解謎和玩小遊戲的方式不斷前進，每一道關卡都豐富多元但卻又設計得人性化，有樂趣也有色彩繽紛的視覺效果。過程中處處都有耐人尋味的線索。
仔細觀察周遭環境，任何一點小細節都不放過。如果你發揮想像力努力思考答案，說不定三兩下就能找到解答……

▶邀請函與神秘故事
這張邀請函是誰給的？那張熟悉的面容會是誰？我們什麼也不知道，但我們會隨著 Sowon 的腳步展開冒險之旅，勇闖那個雖然陌生但卻令人嚮往的世界。

title: Attack of the Toy Tanks [NSP][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
Voyna gryadet, soldat, gotov ty k ney ili net! Na protyazhenii 60 urovney osnovnoy kampanii igry Attack of the Toy Tanks vam predstoit, upravlyaya boevym transportnym sredstvom, srazhatsya na raznykh arenakh i stat poslednim utselevshim tankistom.

A esli ugroza, iskhodyashchaya ot upravlyaemoy AI, nedostatochno poshchekochet vashi nervy, vy vsegda mozhete ispytat sebya v mnogopolzovatelskom rezhime i srazitsya s priyatelem.

Imeyte vvidu, chto vam nuzhno izbegat ne tolko tyazheloy artillerii, no i tselogo ryadya razrushitelnykh prepyatstviy, kotorye mogut zavalit vas vo vremya ataki. 

Kharakteristiki: 
* 60 urovney povyshennoy trudnosti,
* geympley na boevykh arenakh,
* rezhim na dvukh igrokov.

title: L.O.L Surprise! Remix We Rule The World [NSZ][RUS]
interface_lang: 俄语 [RUS], 英语 [ENG], 德语 [DEU], 法语 [FRA], 西班牙语 [ESP], 荷兰语 [DUT], 意大利语 [ITA], 葡萄牙语 [POR], 日语 [JAP], 中文 [CHI]
description:
Pervaya v istorii pristavochnaya igra, osnovannaya na vsemirno izvestnoy franshize, vykhodit isklyuchitelno na Nintendo Switch™! Nastraivay oblik svoego personazha L.O.L. Surprise! v etom ochen veselom 3D-priklyuchenii! Issleduy tematicheskiy mir igry L.O.L Surprise!, pereezzhay  v novyy dom, zavodi novykh druzey, vypolnyay kvesty, igray v mini-igry, zarabatyvay bilet VIBB i vystupay na stsene s lyubimymi kuklami L.O.L. Surprise!

Nachni s nulya
Pereezzhay v novyy dom i postepenno adaptiruy i mebliruy ego v svoem stile, a takzhe poluchay novye predmety, poseshchaya razlichnye meropriyatiya. Po mere peremeshcheniya po miru ty budesh nakhodit razlichnye mini-igry i kvesty. Za prokhozhdenie kvestov predostavlyayutsya blestyashchie zhetony dlya pokupki predmetov.

Issleduy
Gulyay po territorii festivalya L.O.L. Surprise! Remix i vzaimodeystvuy s personazhami L.O.L. Surprise!

Ukras svoy dom i napolni ego razlichnymi aksessuarami
Zarabatyvay vnutriigrovye tovary, vklyuchaya mebel, chtoby ukrasit svoy dom, modnye veshchi dlya smeny naryadov personazha svoego igroka i sozdavay zapisi s razlichnymi pesnyami L.O.L. Surprise!

Fotografii

Sfotografiruy sebya i druzey v igre. Fotografii mozhno ispolzovat dlya ukrasheniya svoego doma, a v nekotorykh sluchayakh oni budut svyazany s kvestami.

title: Repentant [NSP][RUS/Multi4]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 4]
description:
Repentant is a dramatic point & click adventure game with hand-painted art.

Experienced criminal Oliver begins to suffer from strong remorse after the terrible deeds of which his family has suffered. Unsuccessful attempts to restore relations with his ex-wife further worsen his condition and alcohol dependence.
One day in a small shop, he becomes a witness of a robbery committed by a young girl. At this moment, he gets the opportunity to atone for his sins by helping another person. But who really needs help and who is the victim? It remains to be seen.

Repentant is partially a sequel to the game Little Kite, but it can be played by a person who is not familiar with Little Kite.

Features

Explore atmospheric hand-painted locations with challenging puzzles
Enjoy an intriguing story with an unexpected ending
Listen to an amazing soundtrack by Abstracode and full English voice acting

title: Streets of Red Devils Dare Deluxe [NSZ][ENG]
description:
V Streets of Red: Devil's Dare Deluxe samoe strashnoe, chto mozhet sluchitsya, eto okazatsya na ulitse! Eto khorror-mochilovo s edinstvennoy zhiznyu, gde lyubiteli retroigr srazyatsya s tolpami zombi.
Shest igrovykh personazhey i rasshiryayushchiysya vybor urovney ne dadut vam zaskuchat, a originalnaya boevaya sistema pridaet igre glubiny.
Dengi v igre mozhno potratit na uluchsheniya ili dlya voskresheniya v sluchae smerti. Poetomu v Streets of Red ikh stoit tratit s umom. Vy gotovy k samomu koshmarnomu ispytaniyu v zhizni?

title: Decarnation [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 俄语 来自 AlchemistLab
description:
Confront your demons.

Decarnation plunges you into a haunting, dreamlike adventure where reality and fantasy become one. Inspired by some of the most influential surrealist works (Silent Hill, the original tale of Alice in Wonderland, films by David Lynch and Satoshi Kon...), allow yourself to be swept away by an intense and mesmerising story, oscillating between dreams and nightmares.


Paris, 1990...

Gloria is a cabaret dancer at the end of her rope. As her career, relationships and self-esteem begin to deteriorate, a mysterious patron makes her an offer she couldn’t possibly refuse. Will this event mark the end of her recent struggles , or the beginning of her descent into hell? Decarnation is a story of survival, where monsters and nightmares weave themselves into the fabric of everyday life. Get ready for a poignant and captivating adventure!


A horrifying adventure.

With a wide variety of mini-games, Decarnation expertly brings together the classic elements of horror and adventure games, where each challenge requires consideration, responsiveness and coordination. Solve cryptic riddles, confront ominous enemies and explore a bewildering world...


Soundtrack & Art.

Decarnation's Rêve and Cauchemar soundtracks feature contributions from numerous artists, including the renowned composer Akira Yamaoka (Silent Hill) whose works blend horror and the paranormal, breathing life into this nightmarish tale.

"I'm delighted to have been able to take part in the development of Decarnation [...] I've developed a special bond with this game.

Numerous references and inspirations from cult horror works have shaped the world of Decarnation - can you spot them all?

title: Cats the Commander [NSZ][ENG]
description:
◆ 激烈戰鬥，全新喵喵遊戲誕生！ ◆
新手大歡迎！硬核玩家和孩子們也可以參加！！
讓我們一起出擊，為了喵喵征服世界喵！！

▼ 超簡單戰鬥系統
召喚喜愛的角色！偶爾釋放必殺技！
連續擊敗敵人，朝目標前進！！

▼新模式的塔防遊戲
停不下來的新遊戲模式!
攻擊才是最強的防禦!喵喵勇往直前喵!!

▼ 總計超過650種角色登場！
用無需額外付費的轉蛋強化你的隊伍！
打造屬於自己的編隊挑戰關卡吧！

▼ Nintendo Switch™版限定原創劇情
解救被囚禁的七英雄！
個性豐富的喵喵們拯救世界的限定劇情！

title: Tonari ni Kanojo no Iru Shiawase ~Two Farce, Winter Guest, Curious Queen~ (となりに彼女のいる幸せ Tonakai, patchennye 18+) [NSP][JAP]
description:
Vesna — vremya tyoplykh vstrech.
..Klub istoricheskoy literatury okazalsya raspushchen, i v nyom ostayotsya tolko glavnyy geroy, i ego kokhay, Chisa. Vmeste oni prodolzhayut svoi ezhednevnye, trivialnye razgovory v klubnoy komnate — takim obrazom, stanovyas vsyo blizhe den oto dnya.
Tak obychnaya shkolnaya zhizn v tsikle «Cchaste imet devushku ryadom s soboy» snova kruto menyaetsya!..
Vklyucheny 3 chasti istorii:

title: Home Sheep Home Farmageddon Party edition [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Join Shaun the Sheep and his friends Timmy and Shirley on this epic adventure journeying through underground caverns, negotiating the busy streets of London and teleporting through outer space all in search of the green, green grass of home.

Let's Ewe This!
Overcome the fiendishly challenging puzzles by working as a flock with new multiplayer features, using each sheep’s unique abilities to solve challenges and shove, leap, squeeze and swim through underground tunnels, abandoned mineshafts - and even evade the guards at Buckingham Palace.

All new multiplayer Baaa-tle
A brand new suite of action-packed, Shaun the Sheep movie themed party games bring some extra-terrestrial chaos to the farm with a visit to the Farmageddon theme park where you can compete with family and friends in a series of madcap fairground games hosted by Shaun’s new alien pal Lu-La, who has crash-landed near Mossy Bottom Farm.

Lovingly Lamb-made animation
Brought to you by award winning animation studio Aardman the game features a beautiful hand-painted and traditionally animated art style, spectacular environments and endearing character animation.

Reviews for Home Sheep Home 2
“It's like some sort of adorable vortex you never want to leave...there's something to be said for a game that goes out of its way to excel at style and quality, and Home Sheep Home 2 definitely has both by the bushel.”
4.7/5 – Jay Is Games

“What’s more impressive about this game is how little is reused. Basic puzzle mechanics stay throughout (only by stepping on the button can you open the door) but the flow of the puzzles doesn’t repeat. Like Braid and Portal before it, there’s a desire to always present the player with new challenges, and it works. One moment you might be evading a giant boulder, only to be grabbing parachutes mid-air the next.”
9/10 – Thunderbolt Games

“It looks like many of you really looked forward to this title on the forums, and I can say that it's taken all the concepts from the first game and made them bigger and better, and it doesn't disappoint in its execution.”
4/5 – Touch Arcade

title: Solstice Chronicles MIA [NSZ][ENG]
description:
In a dead colony on Mars a corporate marine is left far behind enemy lines. With the unlikely help of an insurgent drone, he faces a battle for survival against an army of murderous, mindless mutants... and worse things.

This isometric action shooter includes key strategic decisions. Your drone has vital abilities and you need to strategize as you fight; should you scavenge for supplies or push forward to face the enemy?

Decimate the mutant onslaught with upgradeable weaponry, including shotguns, rocket launchers and more, as well as special Heavy weapons like the autocannon and flamethrower, which will obliterate everything in their path. Develop your own skill tree from across four classes - Assault, Demolition, Hellfire, and Terminator - to become the ultimate instrument of destruction.

Tackle the Story, with 20 levels of intense action and entertaining cutscenes. Or head into Survival, where you battle wave after wave of enemies.

Whatever the mode you can also team up with a friend in local co-op, a Nintendo Switch™ exclusive feature; it’s perfect for playing with a buddy anytime, anywhere!

Features:

•	Fluid and exciting twin-stick combat against fiendish foes on Mars.
•	Key tactical decisions to be made with your accompanying drone.
•	A variety of weapons, each with fantastic effects for killing enemies.
•	Develop your skills with Assault, Demolition, Hellfire or Terminator classes – find the style that suits you best!
•	Play the Story or have a quick fight in Survival mode.
•	Re-designed for Nintendo Switch, including exclusive local co-op to share the battle!

title: Story of a Gladiator [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Story of a Gladiator — eto novaya igra v zhanre Beat 'em up, v kotoroy tebe predstoit brosit vyzov sudbe i nayti svoe prednaznachenie na arene Kolizeya.

Voyna s Rimskoy imperiey zabrala u tebya absolyutno vse. Tvoi rodnye i blizkie ubity, tvoy dom sozhzhen dotla, a tvoya rodina teper pod gnetom rimlyan. Nesmotrya na vse eto, tebe udalos izbezhat rabstva i bolee khudshey uchasti. Teper ty brodish po ulitsam Rima, ne ponimaya, zachem zhit dalshe i pochemu bogi tebya poshchadili. I vot odnazhdy, sudba reshaet raskryt svoi karty. Primesh li ty ee vyzov?

• Izuchay boevye navyki i priemy i sokrushay svoikh vragov
• Bolee 80 gladiatorov i 20 zhivotnykh, kotorye obladayut svoey unikalnoy boevoy strategiey
• 3 areny s 36 srazheniyami i 3 bossami
• Zavoyuy blagosklonnost tolpy i poluchi neozhidannuyu pomoshch
• Molis bogam i prosi ikh pomoch tebe vyigrat srazheniya
• Treniruy svoego lichnogo ruchnogo tigra
• Srazhaysya s pomoshchyu mecha i shchita ili trezubtsa i seti
• Vyberi svoe proiskhozhdenie: Gretsiya, Karfagen ili Egipet
• Dlya prirozhdennykh gladiatorov dostupen takzhe rezhim roguelike

Arena zhdet tebya, gladiator!
UMRI S ChESTYu!

title: Drago Noka [NSZ][ENG]
description:
The surface is overrun with huge giants and dangerous pests, leaving an uninhabitable world in their quake. Humans have nowhere to live on the surface, and so... they live on the backs on dragons! Develop your very own village, gather various materials, and create new items with your very own hands. Relax and enjoy a safe and peaceful village life away from the surface below atop a giant dragon!

▼Invite new villagers with various skill sets
Recruit and settle in new villagers with unique skills and personalities. Befriend them, work together, and build together. Enrich one another's lives and who knows...you may even start a family of your own!

▼Live a busy but carefree life
Take on many different jobs like farming, blacksmithing, fishing, sewing, cooking, synthesizing, and raising farm animals! Create the village you desire while taking care of your villagers' needs.

▼Prepare for battle with other dragons!
As peaceful as village life is, one must be prepared for the fight ahead as your dragon is not the only dragon in this world...The Fire Dragon, Wind Dragon, Ice Dragon, and many more also roam the land. Their very existance affects your village in various ways. One day, you might need to fight them head-on, so be prepared!

This title is brought to you by GeSEI unkan, the indie game developers behind Wandering. They used the game construction tool WOLF RPG Editor to bring this masterpiece to life.

title: Dig Deep + 2 DLC [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Shovel your way to success: go underground and dig for treasure like a mole on a mission. But don't worry, you won't get stuck in a hole - unless you forget to hire workers to boost your digging empire.

This game is the perfect blend of laziness and ambition. Your job is to sit back, relax, and let your hired diggers do the dirty work while you search for those sweet gems and diamonds. If you become the best miner around, you can even hire more gold diggers to expand your mining tycoon empire.

Game Features:
- dig, shovel, excavate, burrow and dredge a hole
- mine gems and earn money to unearth more holes
- hire workers to enable idle play
- use powerups to speedup mining or buy pets for permanent buffs
- build monuments for your glory
- play with your friend to dig even deeper!

title: Demonic Supremacy [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
《Demonic Supremacy》是一款老派 3D FPS，帶有一定的末日氣息。 它為任何類型的玩家提供了在爆炸性重金屬下的幾個小時的颶風遊戲和 3 個難度級別。

來看看史詩般的故事吧！ 地獄之主被擊敗，但星界卻不承認新國王——澤克薩斯。 世界上強大的主宰們向惡魔發起挑戰，並在成群的爪牙的幫助下消滅它。 澤克薩斯必須向他們所有人表明，他們是嚴重錯誤的，因此必須要麼死，要麼跪在他的力量面前！

主要特徵：

——史詩般且令人難忘的主角澤克薩斯
— 90 年代風格的圖形
— 強大的老闆
— 老式第一人稱射擊遊戲
— 重金屬，寶貝！

title: Dance of Death Du Lac & Fey [NSZ][RUS/Multi5]
developer: Salix Games, Tea Clipper Games Ltd.
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
1888年，開膛手在倫敦街頭潛行。

以亞瑟王傳說中的不朽角色蘭斯洛特．杜拉克和摩根娜．勒菲的視角，挑戰刺激的任務，嘗試制止歷史上最惡名昭著的謀殺案，拯救這個城市的人們。
與白教堂居民瑪麗‧簡‧凱利聯手，探索英國首都的陰暗面，結識在當地生活的有趣人物，與他們合作解決罪案。但要緊記，你的每個決定都會影響他們的命運。

遊戲特色
- 維多利亞時代驚心動魄的謎團，「恐怖之秋」事件
- 忠於史實的犯罪場景和真實的地點，經過精心研究並由專家進行事實查核

獎項
- TIGA Games Industry Awards「最佳音響設計」—獲獎
- TIGA Games Industry Awards「英格蘭文化資產」—入圍
- G.A.N.G. Awards「獨立遊戲最佳對話」—提名
- Aggie Awards「最佳角色—杜拉克及菲」—提名

title: CyberTD [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Virus-mutant vtorgsya v ego yadro i ugrozhaet unichtozhit ego. Vam reshat, srazitsya s etimi volnami virusov i zashchitit yadro kiberprostranstva takim obrazom, chtoby ni odin iz nikh ne dostig ego. No ne nuzhno bespokoitsya — u vas budet beschislennoe kolichestvo uluchsheniy i dron-ubiytsa s razdvoeniem lichnosti, kotoryy (bolee ili menee) pomozhet vam! Dumaete, u vas est vse neobkhodimoe dlya spaseniya kiberprostranstva?
Nash proekt beret klassicheskiy opyt zashchity bashni i sochetaet ego s elementami roguelite, sozdavaya zakhvatyvayushchuyu smes. S kazhdym povysheniem urovnya vy budete otkryvat novye uluchsheniya i poluchat dostup k dopolnitelnym vozmozhnostyam dlya nastroyki zashchity v sootvetstvii s vashim sobstvennym unikalnym stilem. Khotya izuchit prostuyu mekhaniku igry neslozhno, vam nuzhno budet pridumat slozhnuyu strategiyu, esli vy khotite dostich rekordnoy territorii. Vy budete razvlekatsya v techenie bolshogo kolichestva vremeni v poiskakh luchshikh uluchsheniy i taktiki, i vy poluchite somnitelnuyu podderzhku ot vyshedshego na pensiyu bespilotnika-ubiytsy s dvumya derzkimi lichnostyami.

title: Cramped Room of Death [NSZ][ENG]
description:
■劇情介紹
喜歡宴會的冒險家蘭斯，今天也與夥伴們一同舉杯狂歡。不小心喝多的蘭斯，就這樣在宴會上醉倒了。

而在一旁觀望的卑鄙盜賊團「比薩迪」，看見蘭斯醉得不省人事，便乘隙偷走他發現的寶藏及武器。

蘭斯清醒之後發現遭竊，只好拿起唯一留在現場的「長槍」，前往比薩迪的巢穴「死之地下墓穴」，要奪回被偷走的東西……

…
……
………沒想到，


「長槍」的長度太長，讓蘭斯無法在狹窄的通道中自由行動……
蘭斯究竟能否順利攻破地下墓穴，奪回被偷走的寶藏呢……？

■遊戲介紹
《Cramped Room of Death》是由馬來西亞遊戲公司 Hafiz Mohd Rozlan 開發的像素風格解謎冒險遊戲。

遊戲名稱即代表「狹窄難受的房間」。蘭斯手持著唯一的武器「長槍」，步步為營勇闖狹隘的地下墓穴，每往前踏出一步都如此令人煎熬……

在迷宮中除了要對抗盜賊團「比薩迪」的黨羽，還要小心迴避裂開的地板及尖刺陷阱等重重難關。玩家要動腦筋思考最佳路徑，巧妙變更前進方向，避免被長槍卡住無法前進。


・總共 5 種類型、變化多端的 170 間「狹窄房間」等玩家來闖蕩。
・共 12 種陷阱及障礙物，想辦法迴避危險前進吧！
・埋伏在地下墓穴的盜賊團「比薩迪」，會用「劍」或「長槍」等不同攻擊範圍的武器，阻止玩家前進！
・通道中隱藏著秘密房間！房間裡也許有寶藏！？
・共 12 款角色服裝可自由變裝，打開寶箱收集新服裝吧！
・收集硬幣可以交換「鑰匙」，也許會成為遇上難關時的救命符！
・多達 10 種「死亡結局」！

title: Rain City [NSZ][ENG]
description:
The game begins with the main character, a cat, who embarks to Rain City to find his sister. The story is both bizarre and exciting making players get lost in a mushroom field, search for a secret passage, and run experiments in a laboratory. The reason rain continues in Rain City is uncovered when players find his missing sister...

Players control the main character to look for his sister in the city. The story moves along while meeting various characters, gathering information, solving puzzles, and clearing minigames. There are elements that test skills including memory and observation, and the many items that appear add to its appeal to the game.

The picture book-like graphics and story about animals who live like humans will draw you in to the world of Rain City.

title: Organ Trail Director's Cut Complete edition [NSZ][ENG]
developer: The Men Who Wear Many Hats
description:
Organ Trail Complete Edition includes the Endless Expansion and the new Final Cut Expansion!

Organ Trail is a retro zombie survival game. Travel westward in a station wagon with 4 other survivors, scavenging for supplies and fending off the undead. Packed full of zombie mechanics, themes and references this is a must have for any zombie survival fans.

The Final Cut & Endless Expansions more than double the content and adds co-op play, loads of new boss fights, zombies, unlockable characters and cars, new ways to die with a radiation mechanic and the ability to choose-your-own-route.

Key Features:
-Name your party after your friends and watch them die slowly
-Drop in co-op play during any combat scenario
-Hours of gameplay & replayability!
-Get dysentery and 9 other diseases
-Scavenge for supplies while you fight back the undead
-Put down infected party members who might turn on you
-Endless Mode! Play until you die
-Car and combat upgrades
-Huge soundtrack and delicious Apple 2 pixel art

title: Alone With You [NSP][ENG]
description:
Vy — posledniy vyzhivshiy v razrushennoy kosmicheskoy kolonii. Pokinte planetu, poka ona ne vzorvalas. S pomoshchyu skanera ishchite prichiny tragedii, postigshey koloniyu, reshayte golovolomki.
