Uznayte sudbu i sekrety bolee chem 24 kolonistov, zhizni kotorykh byli perepleteny ochen tesno. Dnem issleduyte gluboko prorabotannyy mir v kompanii bespokoynogo Iskusstvennogo Intellekta. A nochi korotayte s golograficheskimi kompanonami, vstupaya s nimi v dlitelnye otnosheniya i vse bolshe uznavaya o tragicheskom padenii kolonii.

– Proydite bolee dyuzhiny missiy na gidroponnykh fermakh, v ogromnykh nauchnykh laboratoriyakh i otsekakh byvshikh kolleg, gde tsarit zloveshchaya tishina.
– Uznayte poblizhe Pera, Vinni, Zhana i Lesli i pomogite im ispolnit svoe prednaznachenie, ispolzuya unikalnuyu i estestvennuyu sotsialnuyu sistemu.
– Razlichnye kontsovki i varianty dialogov pozvolyayut otkryvat vsyo novye grani syuzheta pri kazhdom prokhozhdenii igry.
– Voskhititelnyy originalnyy saundtrek sostoit iz energichnykh i atmosfernykh kompozitsiy.

title: Thomas Was Alone [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Thomas Was Alone is the award winning, critically acclaimed platformer about friendship and jumping and floating and anti-gravity. Guide a group of sentient rectangles through a series of obstacles, combining their skills to reach the end of each level.

Discover the story of the world’s first sentient AIs, and how they worked together to, well not escape… “escape” is a strong word. Perhaps “emerge” might be better. “Emerge” has an air of importance about it, while keeping the various plot twists and origin stories you’ll discover under wraps. We didn’t even mention the bouncing. That would be overkill.

Listen to reactive and atmospheric music originally composed by David Housden. Negotiate puzzles meticulously designed by Mike Bithell, and immerse yourself in the characters journey with a BAFTA award winning voiceover read wistfully and amusingly by Danny Wallace.

Also includes Thomas Was Alone: Benjamin’s Flight, the additional level pack that follows the tale of Benjamin and his father’s incredible invention. Meet a new companion and a familiar face in the events leading up to Thomas’ emergence.

* Beat 100 levels carefully designed to test your puzzle-solving skills and uncover the story of the AIs.
* Utilize the unique skills of 12 different characters, each as unique as the AIs themselves.
* Immerse yourself in David Housden’s critically acclaimed procedural score.
* Join Danny Wallace for a BAFTA award winning performance of the story’s narration.
* Includes Director’s Commentary by creator Mike Bithell.
* Includes the “Benjamin’s Flight” additional level pack – join new characters and utilize new abilities in 20 additional levels in a story about hope and the wild impetuosity of youth.

title: Arcaea + 8 DLC [NSP][ENG]
interface_lang: 英语, 日语, 韩语, 中文 [ENG / JAP / Multi 4]
description:
Kasaytes, uderzhivayte, skolzite - i vpervye v istorii ispolzuyte kontrollery Joy-Con, chtoby skolzit po miru Arcaea. Pochuvstvuyte ritm ogromnoy kollektsii pesen, kotorye teper polnostyu dostupny na Nintendo Switch, i prosledite za sudbonosnoy istoriey devushek, zateryannykh v etom mire.
Kazhdaya iz nikh probuzhdaetsya bez kakikh-libo vospominaniy v besplodnom, blednom mire razrushennykh zdaniy i vysokhshikh okeanov. Tolko dreyfuyushchie, pokhozhie na steklyannye oskolki vospominaniya dayut khot kakoy-to smysl zhizni v etom mire... no kuda privedut ikh vospominaniya?

title: Theme Hospital / Chastnaya klinika / Psikhushka (Homebrew) [NSP][ENG]
description:
«Theme Hospital» («Chastnaya klinika» ili «Psikhushka») — ekonomicheskiy simulyator, sozdannyy kompaniey Bullfrog Productions i vypushchennyy v prodazhu Electronic Arts v 1997 godu. Zadacha igroka — sozdat bolnitsu i upravlyat eyu. Kak i bolshinstvo drugikh igr ot Bullfrog, Theme Hospital soderzhit v sebe izryadnuyu dozu ekstsentrichnogo yumora. Igra yavlyaetsya tematicheskoy naslednitsey drugoy igry ot Bullfrog, Theme Park.
Deystvie igry razvorachivaetsya v bolnitse. Ot igroka trebuetsya sozdat usloviya dlya privlecheniya patsientov (u kotorykh dovolno zabavnye nedugi, bolezni i zarazy). V igre prisutstvuet dolya chyornogo yumora. Nesmotrya na to, chto igra zavisit ot togo, kak budet sebya vesti personal bolnitsy, igrok ne mozhet upravlyat imi napryamuyu. U igroka, vprochem, est vozmozhnost podbora lyubogo sotrudnika v shtat bolnitsy i svoboda ikh peremeshcheniya po zdaniyu. Silno nadoedlivykh patsientov mozhno prognat iz bolnitsy (skandalistov — chtoby ne meshali normalnoy rabote, i patsientov pri smerti — chtoby ne portili statistiku).
Patsientov privlekaet otchasti reputatsiya bolnitsy i tsena lecheniya. Diagnoz i lechenie bolnykh dayot ne tolko pritok finansov bolnitse, no i yavlyayutsya neobkhodimymi deystviyami dlya vypolneniya usloviy urovnya. Vse bolezni v igre vymyshlennye i nesut na sebe otpechatok «chyornogo yumora»; zdes est razdutaya golova, nevidimost, dlinnyy yazyk, neobychnaya prostuda, i drugie. Tak kak ne vse bolezni yavlyayutsya izvestnymi, bolnitse neobkhodimy kabinety i oborudovanie dlya ikh izucheniya. Bolee prodvinutye urovni igry vklyuchayut v sebya epidemii, gde igroku neobkhodimo eyo ostanovit, putyom izlecheniya zarazhyonnykh patsientov i vaktsinatsii drugikh. Est takzhe momenty, gde nekotorym patsientam neobkhodimo ekstrenno okazat pomoshch za opredelyonnyy period vremeni. I sushchestvuyut zemletryaseniya, povrezhdayushchie oborudovanie. Po okonchanii kazhdogo goda igroku predostavlyayutsya nagrady za upravlenie bolnitsey.
Ne rabotaet na FW vyshe 8.1.0.

title: Tin & Kuna [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Vrashchaytes i pobezhdayte v krasochnom mire Tina i Kuny. Issleduyte urovni, polnye golovolomok i opasnostey. Kuna sobiraet kristally sily i poluchaet osobye sposobnosti: umenie vysoko prygat, vosplamenyatsya i prikreplyatsya k magnitnym predmetam - i vsyo eto, chtoby spasti Tina. Ispolzuyte svoi umeniya, chtoby privesti mir k ravnovesiyu i pobedit khaos!

V odin prekrasnyy den luchshie druzya Tim i Kuna obnaruzhivayut tainstvennyy shar. Kuna sluchayno vskryvaet ego - i, vot beda! - vysvobozhdaet zlykh dukhov, kotorye ovladevayut bednym Tinom. Kune ponadobitsya vsya ego skorost i umeniya, chtoby spasti Tina, i oni dolzhny vmeste vosstanovit shar i sderzhat khaos, terroriziruyushchiy ikh kroshechnuyu planetu.

• Srazhaytes so zlobnymi silami khaosa! Pomogite svoemu priyatelyu katitsya, prygat i manevrirovat, izbegaya nepriyatnykh lovushek, na 40 urovnyakh igry v chetyrekh razlichnykh biomakh.

• Issleduyte mir! Volshebnye miry Tina i Kuny soderzhat sekrety i skrytye sokrovishcha, kotorye otvazhnye igroki mogut otyskat na kazhdom urovne.

• Siyayushchaya moshch! Vospolzuytes energiey kristallov, chtoby nabratsya sil, preodolet lovushki i reshit golovolomki.

• Vmeste - luchshe! Vosstanovite balans v mire s pomoshchyu magicheskoy sily druzhby.

title: The Letter a Horror Visual Novel [NSP][ENG]
description:
當七個人淪為惡性詛咒的獵物時，他們發現真正的威脅不存在陰暗中，而是在他們自己的內心和心靈中。《鬼來信 : 恐怖視覺小說》(The Letter: A Horror Visual Novel) 是一部互動恐怖主題的劇，靈感來自經典的亞洲恐怖電影。通過身歷其境去敘述故事分支，遊戲讓玩家扮演七個不斷變化的角色，因為他們發現自己陷入了困擾著艾門加德大廈數百年的謎團。

你所選擇的將塑造並推動故事的發展。你會在崩潰的邊緣修補一段關係，還是讓它破裂呢？你會冒險拯救某人， 儘管你可能會面臨後果， 還是讓他們遇到可怕的結局？除了《鬼來信 : 恐怖視覺小說》(The Letter: A Horror Visual Novel) 的恐怖主題外，還高度重視角色的發展和互動。這些人的命運掌握在你手中。

特色：

• 發現超過70萬字的視覺小說！
• 做出直接影響故事進程的關鍵決策。
• 扮演7個不同的角色，每個角色都有獨特的動機和個性。
• 探索80多種背景，100種CG和50種結尾的變化！
• 通過可選的快速事件和英語配音來自定你的體驗。
• 享受動畫精靈和場景，將生命帶入你的周圍環境。
• 利用日記功能記錄線索並按時間順序跟蹤事件。

title: Ludo XXL [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Eta potryasayushchaya klassicheskaya igra davnym-davno razvlekaet starykh i malykh. Lyubimaya mnogimi originalnaya versiya s nepredskazuemymi broskami kostey i pravilami, kotorye poymut i deti, nakonets-to dostupna na Nintendo Switch™. Ona otlichno podoydet dlya vsey semi: s ney mozhno i posmeyatsya, i povolnovatsya!

• 4 raznye igrovye doski
• 3 rezhima igry: klassicheskiy ili s kletkami sobytiya («vecherinka» i «ekstrim»)
• Nastraivaemye pravila igry: igrayte tak, kak igrali ranshe!
• S uchastiem do 6 igrokov (realnykh ili pod upravleniem II)

title: The Dragoness: Command of the Flame [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
Priklyuchenie v dukhe starykh dobrykh takticheskikh RPG s elementami roguelite. Otpravlyaytes na poiski priklyucheniy na poluostrove Draytir, razorennom voynoy mezhdu raznymi fraktsiyami drakonov. Vam predstoit primerit na sebya rol elfiyskogo voitelya, kotorogo nanyala Drakonitsa: vozglavte ee armii i navedite poryadok v mire. 

Staraya stolitsa Voven-Sal byla poteryana v svirepoy bitve s alchnym Shai-Va, i teper vam nuzhno zanovo sobrat armiyu v novom sredotochii vlasti Drakonitsy — Nivenbore.  

Puteshestvuyte po poluostrovu, sobirayte v svoyu armiyu moguchikh chudovishch, kopite dragotsennye resursy i gotovtes k gryadushchim ispytaniyam. Klyuch k pobede — strategicheskoe myshlenie i takticheski vernye resheniya! 

Issleduyte razrushennyy voynoy mir
Puteshestvuyte po poluostrovu Draytir, razorennomu voynoy mezhdu tsarstvuyushchimi drakonami i kovarnym Shai-Va. Otpravte svoyu armiyu v pokhod cherez chashchoby Graskholta, zasnezhennye vershiny Frostkhilla, zasushlivye pustyni Vatana i porochnuyu Zildariyu. 

Masshtabnaya kampaniya bolshe chem na 30 chasov
Nachnite epicheskuyu kampaniyu s 16 zadaniyami: u kazhdogo — svoya tsel i sredstva. Dobyvayte tsenneyshie resursy, zashchishchayte strategicheski vazhnye tochki i srazhaytes s protivnikami, kotorye stanovyatsya vsyo opasnee.     

40 unikalnykh boevykh edinits, kotorykh mozhno nanyat
Nanimayte boevye edinitsy: vy naydete ikh v lageryakh stolitsy ili vstretite vo vremya zadaniy. Ispolzuyte sposobnosti boevykh edinits, chtoby razrabotat slozhnye sinergii i strategii. Obedinyayte boevye edinitsy odnogo tipa, chtoby sozdat eshche bolee moguchikh sushchestv!     

Takticheskie poshagovye boi
srazhaytes s armiyami protivnika, vstupaya v takticheskie poshagovye skhvatki. Vystraivayte strategiyu, peremeshchayte boevye edinitsy, razrushayte shchity protivnika i aktiviruyte sposobnosti, chtoby perelomit khod bitvy.   

6 tipov magii, kotoruyu mozhno osvoit
Ispolzuyte magicheskie zaklinaniya shesti shkol: nekromantiya, nevidimost, vosstanovlenie, ulovki, kontrol i sila. Vypolnyayte zadaniya i poluchayte opyt, chtoby popolnit knigu zaklinaniy! 

Vernite byluyu slavu stolitse
Perestroyte Nivenbor — novoe mesto obitaniya Drakonitsy. Raskhoduyte resursy, chtoby stroit i uluchshat zdaniya, a takzhe uluchshat boevye edinitsy, talanty i umeniya.

title: Crazy Oce [NSZ][RUS]
interface_lang: 俄语 [RUS], 德语 [DEU], 英语 [ENG], 西班牙语 [SPA], 法语 [FRA], 意大利语 [ITA], 日语 [JAP], 葡萄牙语 [POR], 中文 [CHI]
description:
奧茜是壹滴露水，名字出自印地語露水的發音。

奧茜同往常壹樣外出，只是這壹次很奇怪，空間漩渦突然出現，將奧茜帶到壹個新的空間。

這裏很奇怪，不僅重力規則改變了，還充滿了機關和陷阱！
但，奧茜不會坐以待斃，將要逃離這裏！

挑戰重力：
重力已改變，站在壹些特殊的地面上重力將改變，但這也為我們闖關提供了有利的條件。
盡快適應重力的規則吧，這將是奧茜逃離的關鍵。

探索機關：
機關可能在妳以為觸碰不到的地方，機關能讓奧茜前進的道路更為通暢。

穿越陷阱：
重力可以幫到我們，但也可能因此傷害到我們。
小心周圍的陷阱與利刃，這是奧茜最大的威脅。

還有通關記錄？
或許是奧茜記憶混亂，或許是空間在作怪。
奧茜將充滿危險的空間當作了挑戰場，壹次又壹次的挑戰，只為用最快的速度通關！

不管怎麽說，還是得盡快離開這個奇怪且危險的地方！

title: Catching Spirits [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 机器翻译 来自 most2820
description: 在 悠信・穆倫 的薩滿世界中探索充滿陷阱的競技場，釋放元素之力。

title: The Pizza Delivery Boy who Saved the World [NSP][ENG]
description:
«Posmotri na nebo! Eto ptitsa! Eto samolet! Net, eto kurer s dvoynoy pepperoni i kolbasoy! My spaseny!»
 
 Raznosit pitstsu nelegko. Moy boss – pridurok, vse moi kollegi dumayut, chto ya super-staryy, potomu chto mne za 20, a klienty... nu, skazhem tak, oni mogut byt dovolno, mmm, pikantnymi. Kak chelovek, kotoryy ne znaet svoego adresa. Ili paren s 12-y avenyu, kotoryy otkryvaet dver sovershen golym. Menya ne volnuet, kakoy u tebya press, chuvak; eto ne normalno!
 
 I chto delat, kogda poyavlyaetsya neryashlivyy paren, utverzhdayushchiy, chto on – eto «ya» iz budushchego? Da, legko otmakhnutsya ot nego... No poka ne stoit etogo delat, ved menya presleduet organizatsiya, zanimayushchayasya strannymi koshachimi eksperimentami. No my eshche vernemsya k etomu. A poka budte uvereny: vasha pitstsa DEYSTVITELNO v puti – i ona pod sousom pravednosti!
 
 - Dug Rivers
 
 Raznoschik pitstsy spas mir! Sovershenno novyy vizualnyy roman byvshego kurera, kotoryy, veroyatno, nikogda bolshe ne budet raznosit pitstsu, esli ego boss uznaet, chto on sozdal etu igru.

title: Starlight Shores [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Starlight Shores – eto «ostrovnoy» vizualnyy roman, v kotorom ispolzuetsya unikalnyy romanticheskiy stil «korotkikh rasskazov».
 
V nem est neskolko kontsovok, zavisyashchikh ot vashego vybora po khodu razvitiya syuzheta.
 
Istoriya:
 
Posle togo, kak vasha podruga detstva Teo priglashaet vas na uik-end v kottedzh v gorodke Sisayd, vy gotovites provesti svoy den rozhdeniya v rayu. Proshlo neskolko mesyatsev s tekh por, kak vy v posledniy raz videli Teo, i ona neveroyatno rada provesti vykhodnye vmeste.
 
Ona takzhe priglashaet svoyu sosedku po komnate Lenu i vashego druga Aleka. Posle togo, kak vy rasstalis, razekhavshis na uchebu po raznym kolledzham, teper samoe vremya soedinitsya vmeste snova.
 
Kazhetsya, vse skladyvaetsya idealno... poka Alek ne nastaivaet na tom, chto doberetsya odin na svoey mashine. Vy pribyvaete v kottedzh ranshe nego v uverennosti, chto on brosil vashu kompaniyu. Cherez nekotoroe vremya on zvonit i soobshchaet, chto vezet s soboy eshche odnogo gostya.
 
Khotya Erika mozhet byt iz togo zhe gorodka, chto i bolshinstvo gruppy, eto edinstvennoe, chto u vas obshchego...
 
Vy poluchite udovolstvie ot nochi s Teo i zagadaete zhelanie, glyadya na zvezdu?

title: Path of Ra [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
在《Path of Ra》中，您將陪伴幻化成墓室壁畫上象形文字的法老靈魂。您需要移動石板來為法老開路，讓他得以收集自己心臟的碎片。透過手工繪製的精美動畫，重溫法老的故事並發掘他的死亡之謎。

獨特的美術設計
《Path of Ra》以金字塔宏偉的象形文字壁畫為靈感，將帶領您踏上前所未見的古埃及之旅。

簡單好上手
只要滑動手指就能移動及旋轉壁畫磚，進而重新排列壁畫。所有人都能輕鬆體驗本遊戲的樂趣。
遊戲包含超過 60 個精心打造的關卡，當中的每個新壁畫都將帶來十足的挑戰性。

音效
遊戲中採用的音樂和各種聲景可讓您沉浸在古埃及的溫暖氛圍中。
建議使用耳機以獲得最佳體驗。

title: Terror of Hemasaurus [NSZ][ENG]
description:
地球正處於氣候災難的邊緣！ 聖蜥蜴教會制定了一個可疑的計劃，以拯救人類免受其對地球的魯莽漠視——釋放一個怪物來殺戮、摧毀並造成恐怖！

作為四隻最近解凍的怪物之一，踏上跨越多個階段的全面毀滅的狂暴之路。 在令人敬畏的怪物、令人滿意的破壞和滑稽的死亡的世界末日復古街機爆炸中，踩踏驚恐的公民並粉碎建築物時，高興地咆哮！

Hemasurus 的恐怖是 Super Blood Hockey 創作者 Loren Lemcke 的最新遊戲。

主要特徵：
怪物！ 血馬龍！ 時鍾樹懶！ 火蜥蜴！ 自主血馬龍！ 四隻可怕（但也有點可愛）的野獸，每隻都有自己的殺手鐧！

毀滅！ 大規模的爆炸性像素破壞和混亂！ 將建築物化為塵土。 推倒摩天大樓。 摧毀一切！

死亡！ 將人類扔進直升機葉片！ 屁股撞向驚恐的市民人群！ 吃人是為了滋養！ 消滅他們，拯救地球！

階段！ 在不同的關卡中按照遊戲告訴你的去做！ 將汽車踢進建築物！ 拯救貓和狗！ 在創紀錄的時間內共建一座塔！

朋友們！ 有小伙伴嗎？ 對你有好處！ 通過讓他們加入您的行列來使用它們來進行一些本地合作大屠殺！ 最多四個朋友可以一起製造恐怖！

title: Distant Bloom [NSZ][ENG]
description:
歡迎來到 界外花境；這是一款溫馨的模擬經營遊戲，同時也會帶你遠離家園並探索未知。

歷經漫長的外太空冒險，你和你的太空船員降落在外太空星球，肩負起一個重大任務：為你的植物物種打造出新家園。但是這個地方和透過望遠鏡看到的景象截然不同。這個世界中青翠的生命發生什麼事了？你會遇到什麼驚奇的事？

遊戲特色：

- 探索這個荒涼的世界，運用植物之力恢復昔日的繁盛榮光！
- 學習照顧多種外來植物來培育新生命。玩轉植物結構，打造出一個欣欣向榮的的生態系統！
- 將你收穫的東西變成配方、工具和物品，以用來建立並改善你的基地。
- 將分散的太空船員集結到一個社區，每個成員都有自己的故事可分享。
- 探索這片荒土，揭開這個陌生星球的歷史。了解到底是什麼人或什麼原因，讓這片土地變成零零落落的神祕廢墟？
- 改變世界！你的所作所為不僅會影響大自然，還會影響到太空船員的未來。

界外花境 是一款能輕鬆上手的有益遊戲，能讓你體驗到溫暖、安全和親切的感受。來盡情探索和創造吧，讓大自然和家園更融為一體！

title: Inbento [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
特色：

超過100個謎題及獨特的拼圖遊戲機制！

關於貓咪和為人父母的無文本溫馨故事

靈感源自日本的便當文化與美學

title: Ponpu [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
V Ponpu vas zhdut klassicheskiy geympley i innovatsionnye mekhaniki — da eshche i v kryshesnosnom vizualnom stile! Stante messiey Utinogo Boga i spasite mir ot vernoy gibeli, srazivshis so svoimi bratyami. I sestrami. 
A potom soberites s druzyami — maksimum s tremya — i vyyasnite, u kogo yaytsa bolshe!
Prigotovitsya k bombometaniyu!
Osobennosti: 

Svezhiy vzglyad na klassicheskuyu kontseptsiyu

Epichnaya kampaniya s ogromnymi bossami

Dinamichnyy mnogopolzovatelskiy rezhim dlya chetyrekh igrokov s raznymi rezhimami:
Dezmatch — dolzhen ostatsya tolko odin!
Alchnost — soberite bolshe vsego monetok, poka ne vyshlo vremya. I lyagte na nikh.
Den krasok — perekraste mir v proletarski-krasnyy! Ili v kakoy tam vam nravitsya.

Arsenal, podrazumevayushchiy ochen vnushitelnye yaytsa.

title: Warlock's Tower [NSP][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
Warlock's Tower 是一款復古的益智遊戲，精心設計的關卡都圍繞著一個簡單的規則-一步足以致命。扮演郵差蒂姆，你必須勇敢地進入這座塔及複雜的房間，以到達塔頂及為Warlock帶來和平。

不過，清除每個房間都不容易！ 你踏出的每一步都要付出生命的代價，到處都是怪物和陷阱，有些房間需要兩個角色才能成功！

派遞變得如此困難。 小心你的每一步！

特色：

• 解決100多個越來越複雜的房間
• 智者殭屍，飛翔之眼和黏液。 不斷減少的步數，並非唯一的危險。
• 感受80年代！ 復古的8bit 美學，讓你感覺就像在重玩自己喜歡的掌上電腦般。

title: Demon's Tier Plus / Xenon Valkyrie Plus / Riddled Corpses EX [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Riddled Corpses EX — tvin-stik shuter v stile 8/16-bitrykh arkadnykh igr.

Otpravlyaytes v raznoobraznye mesta, naselennye opasnymi tvaryami i ikh ogromnymi povelitelyami. S umom vybirayte personazha, ispolzuyte ego umeniya i spetsialnye predmety na polnuyu katushku (chasy, dinamit i tureli) i unichtozhte koren vsego Zla!

- Bezbashennyy ekshn v bogopodobnom 60 FPS
- Lokalnyy kooperativ dlya 2-kh igrokov
- 6 personazhey s razlichnymi kharakteristikami
- Arkadnyy i syuzhetnyy rezhimy, a takzhe rezhim vyzhivaniya
- Sistema kombo
- Chiptyun-saundtrek vysochayshego kachestva
- I onlayn turnirnaya tablitsa dlya vashikh igrovykh dostizheniy!

title: Dodo Peak [NSP][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
Poigrayte za ptitsu dodo: otyshchite i spasite rasteryavshikhsya ptentsov na opasnykh vershinakh. Privedite ikh domoy, izbegaya prepyatstviy i vragov! Dodo Peak — eto staryy dobryy arkadnyy platformer s sovremennymi osobennostyami.

Sobirayte monety, uvilivayte ot khitrykh zmey, izbegayte zlobnykh obezyan, khvatayte usileniya dlya dopolnitelnoy skorosti ili supersily. Popytaytes proyti vse sozdannye vruchnuyu ostrova kak mozhno bystree. Chem mnogochislenney vasha staya, tem slozhnee privesti ee domoy!

Osobennosti:
  - Potryasayushchie, sozdannye vruchnuyu urovni s unikalnym dizaynom, tselyami i vragami.
  - Prostoe, dostupnoe vsem upravlenie i mnozhestvo slozhnykh urovney — dlya trenirovki navykov.
  - Raznoobraznoe okruzhenie: tropicheskie ostrova, opasnye vulkany i mnogoe drugoe.
  - Otkryvayte unikalnykh zabavnykh dodo za prokhozhdenie urovney i sobrannye monety.
  - Idealno podkhodit dlya korotkikh igrovykh sessiy v transporte ili dolgikh vecherov doma.
  - Sorevnuytes v skorostnom prokhozhdenii urovney i poprobuyte svoi sily v ezhenedelnom ispytanii, gde vas zhdut osobo slozhnye urovni.

title: PicoMix by NuSan (Pico Mix, 20 款游戏) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Sbornik iz dvadtsati sovremennykh retro-igr ot indi-razrabotchika NuSan, sozdannykh na protyazhenii 8 let podarit vam chasy priyatnykh ispytaniy!
Osnovnye — 9 igr:

title: Street Cleaner [NSP][ENG]
description:
Street Cleaner is a modern synthwave artist based in San Diego. Inspired by action films of the '80s to write the soundtrack to a vigilante movie that never existed, he has broadened his sound from retro synth inspiration to chiptunes, darksynth, and more. Street Cleaner: The Video Game is the licensed game that would have been made based on that movie, brought to reality.

* ALL NEW soundtrack of authentic pulse-pounding 8-bit chiptunes by the Street Cleaner himself.
* SEVEN Stages featuring TWELVE exciting boss fights.
* Stylish 8-bit retro aesthetics combined with modern visual flair like large scale pixel animations, parallax scrolling backgrounds and particle effects.
* In game controller remapping for convenience and accessibility.
* "Assist Mode" accessibility options allows EVERYONE to play the game how they want to by adjusting settings like: infinite health, infinite ammo, double jump, reduced game speed, and more.
* "Hardcore Mode" for players in search of extreme difficulty.

title: Evolution Board Game + 4 DLC [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
ADAPTIRUYSYa ILI VYMRI
V evolyutsii vy prisposablivaete svoy vid, chtoby vyzhit i byt na shag vperedi sopernikov. 

* Vodoem peresokh? Evolyutsioniruyte dlinnuyu sheyu, chtoby dostat pishchu na derevyakh. 
* Srazhaetes s khishchnikom? Razvivayte tverdyy pantsir, chtoby zashchitit sebya. 
* U protivnika slishkom mnogo vidov? Pochemu by vam ne stat khishchnikom?

ADAPTATsIYa, OTMEChENNAYa NAGRADAMI
«Nastolnaya tsifrovaya igra goda», — Ars Technica
«Luchshaya tsifrovaya nastolnaya igra goda», — Vulture

POLNYY NABOR VOZMOZhNOSTEY
* Odnopolzovatelskaya kampaniya iz 21 igry s iskusstvennym intellektom protivnikov.
* Mnogopolzovatelskaya onlayn-igra s podborom igrokov na osnove navykov.
* Asinkhronnaya igra, sistema druzey i chat.
* Lestnitsa progressa i onlayn-reyting pozvolyat vam uvidet svoi dostizheniya. 
* Prokhodi i igray!
 *Ezhenedelnye zadaniya proveryayut vashe masterstvo.
* Interaktivnyy uchebnik.
* Velikolepnye vidy, narisovannye ot ruki.

title: Poison Control [NSZ][ENG]
description: Spirits are being trapped in poisonous manifestations of their despair, and only Poisonette and her Soul Mate can purify them! Venture through the different Belles' Hells to defeat enemies, learn the stories of fallen souls and other Poisonettes, and fight your way to Heaven in this stylishly twisted action shooter!

title: Inversus Deluxe [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
50 unikalnykh kart, sotni razblokiruemykh predmetov, protivniki s II i reytingovye mnogopolzovatelskie igry po seti — vse eto zhdet vas v itogovoy versii igry INVERSUS!

Na pervyy vzglyad pole boya vyglyadit prosto, no kak tolko nachinaetsya igra, slozhnost uvelichivaetsya po narastayushchey. Khody igroka ogranicheny protivopolozhnymi tsvetami cherno-beloy reshetki. Ya khozhu po stenam protivnika, a protivnik — po moim. Kazhdyy vystrel izmenyaet tsveta plitok, chtoby blokirovat, perekryt protivnika, libo zagnat ego v lovushku.

V rezhime PROTIVOSTOYaNIE mozhet igrat do chetyrekh igrokov, a v rezhime ARKADY mozhno sovmestno igrat vdvoem. Igrayte s druzyami na divane, po seti ili srazu i to, i drugoe! Ottachivayte svoe masterstvo protiv kompyutera, a potom otpravlyaytes na pokorenie spiskov liderov v setevom rezhime!

title: Catastronauts [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Soberite svoikh druzey ili v odinochku prisoedinyaytes k proslavlennomu kosmicheskomu flotu v etoy vesyoloy astroigre!
Cmozhete li vy spravitsya s katastrofoy i uderzhivat svoy korabl dostatochno dolgo, chtoby spastis ot vrazheskikh zakhvatchikov? Remontiruyte sistemy, tushite pozhary, vooruzhayte torpedami oruzhie, izbegayte smertelnykh solnechnykh vspyshek, kloniruyte druzey — eto obychnaya zhizn Katastronavta!

title: Hololive Holo's Hanafuda Japanese Playing Cards + 4 DLC [NSP][ENG]
description:
和超人氣虛擬實況主hololive成員一同踏入「原創花牌」的遊戲冒險世界！

■何謂花牌
源自日本的花牌歷史悠遠，是一款深受各年齡層喜愛的卡牌遊戲。本作提供新手教學及輔助功能，可協助不熟悉遊戲規則的玩家輕鬆上手。

■與hololive 成員一起使用「新規則」體驗懷舊花牌的樂趣
本作除了花牌的基本玩法「來來」「追丁株」「花合」以外，還新增了顛覆傳統的原創規則「holo花合」。湊齊畫有名人成員們的花牌即可發動「holo牌型」，再搭配各名人專屬的「名人技能」，靈活運用策略獲得高分超越對手吧！

■使用收集到的點數製作自己的「原創便當」
可親手製作作為「禮物」的便當，亦可發揮創意製作充滿hololive愛的便當……

■線上對戰
除了挑戰CPU之外，還能與全世界玩家線上激戰！
可任選遊戲模式，邀請遠方朋友或隨機配對與各方人士來場花牌對決，輕鬆享受花牌的魅力！
此外，還可以與對手交換親手製作的便當，大顯自己的手藝！

■登場名人
●百鬼綾目
「人類大人們大家好～！呀齁～～！」
隸屬魔界學校的和服鬼神女孩。惡作劇是他的興趣，常放鬼火戲弄他人，但實際身分是學生會長。

●白上吹雪
「KonKon狐狸大家好～！我是白上吹雪！」
留著一頭白髮和獸耳的「宅」狐。喜歡跟人類交談，也很開心受到大家的注視。每天快樂生活的他，目標是成為頂級宅系偶像。

●大神澪
「大家好Mion～！我是大神澪～！」
突然降臨的來路不明黑髮獸耳少女。經常出沒在神社，最愛打遊戲。

●櫻巫女
「喵哈囉～！我是菁櫻巫女也是大家的偶像樱巫女！」
電腦櫻神社的巫女。他夢想成為偶像，並以獨一無二的頂級菁櫻巫女偶像為終極目標，每天都在為實現夢想而努力！雖自稱「菁櫻」，但據說在粉絲間都會戲稱他「廢柴」……

■劇情
在某個平凡的日子，hololive成員們竟突然被捲入一個繪滿花牌的神秘異世界！

在找尋失散夥伴的同時以牌會敵向終點邁進。請與hololive成員一路過關斬將，享受這段原創劇情的奇幻冒險旅程！

title: The Journey Down: Chapter 1-3 [NSP][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 俄语, lyubitelskiy 来自 Prometheus Project
description:
V dzhunglyakh Underland, v peshcherakh Kwayerumoshi, tayatsya ostanki velikogo zla, kotorye vot-vot raskroyut tri neveroyatnykh geroya. 

V zaklyuchitelnoy glave Bwana, Kito i Lina uznayut pravdu o dereve Asili i energokompanii Armando.

The Journey Down – saga s afro-karibskimi motivami. Otpravsya v puteshestvie navstrechu priklyucheniyam!

Vozmozhnosti
* Epokhalnoe priklyuchenie 
* Risovannye ot ruki okruzheniya 
* Igray pod dzhaz i reggi 
* Ozvuchka personazhey (angl.)
* Grafika i animatsiya v HD
* Subtitry (angl. i nem.)

title: The Master's Pupil [NSZ][Multi]
description:
探索這位印象派大師的眼睛，體驗一段獨一無二的傳記式旅程！遊戲中，你的技能和毅力將受到考驗。你將幫助莫内克服眼疾並解決難題，幫助這位畫家完成他的一幅幅傑作。

關於遊戲：
《大師之眼》是一款解謎冒險遊戲。遊戲中，你將穿越克勞德·莫内的眼睛，幫助他完成藝術傑作。

莫内曾經歷喪親之痛，例如他的妻子卡米爾因病去世，並需要與對他的藝術創作構成威脅的白內障進行抗爭。你將遇到並克服這些挑戰。當你穿越他的眼睛時，你需要考慮色彩、空間和物理學。一個錯誤的顏色組合或動作就可能會結束你的旅程。

主要特點：
手工繪製，精心製作：這款遊戲的幾乎每個部分都是用真實的畫筆在現實中精心製作的，然後導入到遊戲世界中。因此，遊戲的視覺效果獨特而出眾，令人想起莫内的印象派藝術，並隨著畫家的一生而改變和調整。
傳記式旅程：以前所未有方式的體驗莫内的傳奇人生。遊戲沒有使用語言或文字來描述這位元藝術家或其行為，而是以他的真實畫作為基礎，引領玩家漫遊於引人入勝的風景和豐富多樣的聲景中。獨立作曲家 Steven W Schouten 飽含情感的配樂與遊戲場景相得益彰。
平靜思緒，放鬆身心：藝術家在創作時不會急於求成，而是不限辰光。《大師之眼》給予你充分的時間來考慮每道謎題，其中的考驗將挑戰你的大腦而非你的反應能力。

title: Relicta [NSP][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Relicta — osnovannaya na zakonakh fiziki golovolomka s vidom ot pervogo litsa. Raskroyte tayny bazy «Chandra», menyaya magnetizm i gravitatsiyu. Vy odni na Lune. Chtoby spasti doch, vam pridetsya polagatsya na svoy um...
Vy — fizik, ostavlennyy na lunnoy baze. Proydite cherez kratery, reshaya golovolomki. Ustremites li vy k bezopasnosti ili popytaetes sobrat uliki, raskryvaya tayny orbitalnoy politiki 22 veka? Kratery khranyat nechto, sposobnoe zabrat zhizn vashey docheri, libo izmenit sudbu chelovechestva. Primete li vy posledstviya vashego issledovaniya?

title: Forklift Extreme + 10 DLC [NSZ][RUS/Multi16]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 16]
description:
Kataytes po skladam i sobirayte poddony, chtoby razmestit ikh v nuzhnykh mestakh na raznykh polkakh i na raznykh vysotakh. 

Forklift Extreme daet vam vozmozhnost zavershit fizicheskie ispytaniya i okunutsya v takoe priklyuchenie s oshchushcheniem polnoy upravlyaemosti, o kotorom vy mechtali.  Inogda v etom neveroyatnom 3D-simulyatore s vilochnym pogruzchikom vam pridetsya vypolnyat neskolko operatsiy po vygruzke i pogruzke. Est mnogo ispytaniy, kotorye vam nuzhno vypolnit!

Voditel pogruzchika sdelan s ispolzovaniem Ragdoll-fiziki, chto daet vam nailuchshee oshchushchenie fiziki vozhdeniya vilochnogo pogruzchika. Mnogie obekty v igre yavlyayutsya fizicheskimi, poetomu sledite za tem, chtoby vash pogruzchik nichego ne unichtozhil, esli v etom net neobkhodimosti. V Forklift Extreme Simulator vy mozhete ne tolko upravlyat svoim pogruzchikom, no i nastraivat ego, svoego voditelya, vybiraya iz mnozhestva dostupnykh skinov, tsvetov i tipov. Razblokiruyte novye tipy pogruzchikov, vypolnyaya zadaniya i dostizheniya, i ishchite spryatannye sokrovishcha na urovnyakh, chtoby razblokirovat novye skiny. Sdelayte svoy pogruzchik unikalnym!

Mnozhestvo polozheniy kamery: izometricheskoe, ot pervogo litsa i vid sverkhu vniz luchshe vsego otobrazhayut atmosferu ekstremalnogo vozhdeniya pogruzchika, pozvolyayut pravilno upravlyat vashim transportnym sredstvom i tochno manevrirovat vilami. Ispolzuyte kameru s umom, menyayte rakursy, chtoby idealno raspolozhit pogruzchik, i poluchayte preimushchestvo, vypolnyaya razlichnye ispytaniya ili prosto dostavlyaya poddony.

Osobennosti Forklift Extreme:
- Udivitelnaya fizika upravleniya pogruzchikom
- Ragdoll-fizika, chtoby poluchit luchshie oshchushcheniya
- Shirokie vozmozhnosti nastroyki dlya vilochnogo pogruzchika i dlya voditelya
- Mnogo raznykh urovney, kazhdyy s legkimi i slozhnymi ispytaniyami
- Plavnoe upravlenie i otlichnyy obzor kamery dlya maksimalnoy tochnosti i bystroy dostavki
- Otlichnye trekhmernye sklady (takzhe fizicheskaya simulyatsiya )

title: Teeny Tiny Trains the Enchanted Attic [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
還記得把客廳變成鐵路王國的童年時光嗎？

在《Teeny Tiny Trains》中重新體驗那份美好——搭建軌道、切換道岔、避開趣味障礙，引導你的小火車安全返家。

遊戲特色：
- 靈感源自童年空間的溫馨微縮立體場景
- 精心設計的謎題搭配悠閒放鬆的氛圍——沒有時間限制，只有無限的樂趣
- 收集可解鎖的玩具火車
- 遊戲內還有一台復古街機，讓你暢玩火車主題小遊戲

title: Warparty [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
《戰爭派對 (Warparty)》是一款傳統經典的即時戰略 (RTS) 遊戲，玩家必須收集資源來解鎖新的建築、軍隊和升級，目的在於摧毀所有對手的基地。玩家也可以控制一位強大的酋長，在擴張其定居點的時候通過選擇天賦來進行塑造。這些天賦也會提供新的軍隊或獎勵，可以改變玩家的遊戲方式。
然而資源是有限的，玩家需要走出自己的基地來收集所需的珍貴資源，以進一步增強自己的軍隊；或者奪取聖地，這些聖地會慢慢賦予玩家能量點，用於召喚強大的能力，從而扭轉戰局。
另外，玩家也需要非常小心，因為地圖上散佈著野生恐龍和其他部落。

title: Super Putty Squad [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Putti vozvrashchaetsya! Nestareyushchaya klassika vykhodit na Nintendo Switch!

Prygayte, rastyagivaytes, menyayte formu i derzhite udar na puti k pobede, pomogaya Putti spasti pokhishchennykh druzey ot vernoy smerti v etom klassicheskom platformere, sostoyashchem iz bolee 100 urovney!

Super Putty Squad — eto novaya inkarnatsiya beskompromissnogo retro-platformera, vypolnennaya po sovremennym standartam i dopolnennaya sovershenno novym rezhimom obucheniya dlya bolee sovershennoy igry. Rezhim obucheniya provedet vas po otkryvayushchimsya urovnyam, podskazyvaya, kak i kogda luchshe ispolzovat dvizheniya i snaryazhenie Putti.

Nash geroy po imeni Putti umeet razduvatsya, rastyagivatsya, menyat formu, razdavat i derzhat udary, raspravlyayas so svirepymi vragami i spasaya druzey iz zatocheniya. Super Putty Squad sostoit iz ocharovatelnykh urovney. Proverte svoe chuvstvo vremeni, voobrazhenie i umenie spravlyatsya s malenkimi ispytaniyami v etom neveroyatno prityagatelnom platformennom priklyuchenii!

Otkryvayte novye prizy, usilivayte svoego geroya, nakhodite tshchatelno spryatannye novye urovni i issleduyte ikh, a takzhe sledite za uspekhami s pomoshchyu unikalnoy knigi s nakleykami!

Putti — ochen neobychnyy geroy. Ego unikalnye vozmozhnosti ne dayut otorvatsya ot igry, pri etom delaya ee dostupnoy dlya samykh neopytnykh polzovateley. Dobavte k etomu usileniya i spetsialnye predmety, razbrosannye po igrovomu miru, i vy poluchite mnogo-mnogo chasov nastoyashchego veselya!

title: Tales from Toyotoki: Arrival of the Witch [NSZ][ENG]
publisher: Aksys Games, Seikei Production, Mayflower Entertainment
description:
Khikaru — bezdomnyy neudachnik na neznakomom ostrove. Izbegaya gadyuk, on stalkivaetsya s vedmoy — v ochen pokhozhey situatsii.
Eti dvoe otpravlyayutsya vyzhivat i, kak oni nadeyutsya, protsvetat na Toyotoki, beskompromissnom ostrove, izolirovannom ot sovremennogo mira, kotoryy propitan drevnimi traditsiyami i okutan magicheskimi taynami.
Po puti oni vstretyat derzkuyu ostrovnuyu krasavitsu, nadmennuyu bogatuyu devushku, neuklyuzhuyu prodavshchitsu i khuligana, lyubyashchego mangu, vse oni — mestnye zhiteli ostrova, kotorye presleduyut skhozhuyu s nimi tsel — nayti sebya i svoe mesto v mire.
Smozhet li eta raznoshyorstnaya gruppa neobychnykh «druzey» s pomoshchyu truda (i kapelki magii) razgadat taynu ostrova Toyotoki, a takzhe dobitsya uspekha v svoem puteshestvii — i samopoznanii?Eshchyo vizualnykh novell na Switch (renpy).

title: Amairo Chocolate [NSZ][ENG]
description:
在“Setaria咖啡館“工作的是一群隱藏真實身份的獸人少女們。
而知道她們秘密的主人公也在“Setaria咖啡館“一起工作。 是一個甜美戀愛的冒險遊戲。

■故事
季節為秋。在那樹葉開始發黃的時節，少年來到了夕渚鎮。
少年最初遇到的，是一位獨自發傳單的可愛貓耳女僕。
“Setaria”咖、咖啡館。請多指教
走進女僕帶我走進的咖啡館後，那裡有著同樣帶著獸耳的女孩子
面對一臉不解的少年，女孩們疑惑地向他如此問道。
莫非，您看得見我們的耳朵嗎……？
她們說明到她們其實屬於名為獸人的種族，耳朵和尾巴一般的人類是無法看到的。
然後得知了秘密的少年，與同伴們開始在咖啡店一起打工了。

少年在對人類與獸人的區別感到吃驚的同時，今天也要和獸耳娘們一同努力工作。

■新加入內容
・可對應多國語言（日語・英語・中文繁體字・中文簡體字）
・追加原畫師「しらたま」和「梱枝りこ」新發表的獎勵靜止畫！
・您可以透過保存聲音功能等便利的操作系統，隨時保存自己喜歡聲音。

title: Zorya the Celestial Sisters [NSP][ENG]
description:
Priglasite druga proyti pervye 5 urovney v etoy versii ili sygrayte v polnuyu igru s drugom, u kotorogo est polnaya versiya (trebuetsya onlayn-sessiya).
Otmechennaya nagradami sovmestnaya igra-golovolomka, deystvie kotoroy proiskhodit v pustynnom mire, gde nikogda ne zakhodit solntse. Vyberite rol odnoy iz dvukh sester: Aysu, bogini nochi, kotoraya dolzhna ostavatsya v teni i mozhet vyzyvat Silu vetra, ili Solveyg, vsemogushchey bogini solntsa, kotoraya kontroliruet vremya i mozhet ispolzovat solnechnuyu energiyu. Chtoby dobitsya uspekha v igre, igroki dolzhny vossoedinit sester, bezopasno peremeshchayas po tenyam, chtoby reshat vse bolee slozhnye golovolomki i vosstanavlivat ravnovesie v mire.

title: Abyss of The Sacrifice [NSZ][ENG]
description:
在封閉的地下城市邂逅的五名少女。
歷經背叛、殘殺之後，迎接她們的會是希望？還是絕望？
聲優陣容豪華，全程配音＆多線結局設定讓您盡情沉浸在臨場感滿溢的遊戲世界中。
※僅提供日文語音

■結合懸疑ADV與扎實故事線的逃脫遊戲

以可愛的少女們展開的故事內容，層層謎團交疊而出的正統推理作。
遊戲中的高難度探索體驗，絕對讓逃脫遊戲的深度玩家也為之驚艷！

■劇情走向變幻莫測，反覆在絕望中尋找希望

劇情章節將依角色各別展開。
根據章節的選擇順序不同，結局和內容也會有所變化。
而結果，將攸關少女們的生死……


■故事簡介
建造在地底深處的巨大生活設施「基地」。

是何時、是為何而建造――
又是誰，引領人們前往於此――

真相，在漫長歲月中風化；歷史，在久遠過往裡消逝。
在此，無人知曉地面上的世界。
如今，唯有存在於地底的這個基地才是人們所知的「世界」。

突然襲來的「異變」，改變了五名少女的命運。

人類消失的「世界」。
時而來襲的巨大震動。
崩塌的牆垣及天頂。
逐漸耗盡的水與糧食――
殘存的五名少女在這嚴酷的狀況下必須奮力求生。

如今，基地正面臨崩毀的危機。

而少女們最後的漫長試煉，正要到來――


■角色聲優
・美希　（CV：真堂圭）
・亞斯娜　（CV：喜多村英梨）
・奧爾嘉　（CV：伊藤靜）
・克蘿伊　（CV：Yukana）
・依特卡　（CV：大龜明日香）

title: Trilogiya Ghost in the Pool / Weirdo / Concealed [NSZ][ENG/RUS (Mod.)]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 机器翻译 来自 most2820
description:
Eta prichudlivaya chyorno-belaya vizualnaya novella pereneset vas v traditsionnuyu istoriyu uzhasov. Stante svidetelem koshmarnykh stsen i sozertsayte uzhasayushchie momenty, ot kotorykh vas prosto vyvernet naiznanku!..
Syuzhet i khudozhestvennyy stil osnovany na originalnoy serii khorror-komiksov «诡闻斋» (Guiwenzhai, Dzhuyvenchzhay), igra byla vossozdana s nulya i razrabotana CASCHA sovmestno s originalnym avtorami komiksa, JOEY.
Vsyo nachalos so slukha o tom, chto v shkolnom basseyne zavyolsya prizrak, osobenno esli priyti tuda nochyu. Vsya shkola znaet ob etom, no administratsiya predpochitaet khranit molchanie, i prosto zakryvaet basseyn srazu posle obychnykh dnevnykh zanyatiy..

title: Super Life of Pixel [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Prisoedinyaytes k Pikselyu v ego puteshestvii cherez istoriyu videoigr, teleportiruyas iz odnoy znamenitoy konsoli ushedshego pokoleniya v druguyu. Emu pridetsya prygat, uvorachivatsya i khitrit, chtoby ne popastsya v lovushki, reshat golovolomki i raspravlyatsya s mnogochislennymi vragami, kotorye pritailis na kazhdom shagu.

No eto eshchyo ne vsyo! Super Life of Pixel vpervye predstavlyaet sistemu «osobykh kollektsiy»: vas zhdut eshchyo shest tshchatelno otrestavrirovannykh starykh konsoley, kotorye Pikselyu pridyotsya pokorit na puti k slave.

Nazhmite na knopku — vperedi nostalgiya i more veselya!

title: Jeopardy! [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Jeopardy! («Riskuy!») — amerikanskaya televizionnaya igra-viktorina, avtorom kotoroy yavlyaetsya Merv Griffin. Sut igry zaklyuchaetsya v tom, chto uchastniki otvechayut na voprosy iz oblasti obshchikh znaniy: kazhdyy vopros predstavlen v vide utverzhdeniya o nekoem predmete, a igrok dolzhen dat svoy otvet v forme voprosa, nazvav iskomyy predmet.
Russkoyazychnyy analog televiktoriny — «Svoya igra».

title: The Falconeer Warrior edition [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8
description:
在這個由個人開發者托馬斯·薩拉開發、獲得BAFTA提名的空戰遊戲中，登上雄壯的戰鷹，翱翔於天空之中，探索令人驚歎的廣闊海洋世界，進行史詩般的空中纏鬥。

您將扮演一名「獵鷹者」，作為強大的空中鬥士穿越被數世代的惡意決定和不同想法撕裂的浩瀚世界。經歷數個戰役，你將從多個不同視角和效忠對象來體驗生活，解決潛藏在塢爾西、塢爾西人民和歷史之間的秘密。

在危險的主線使命和支線任務中逐步潛行，手持閃電投擲器保護船隻免遭海盜、海妖和其他威脅的侵襲。深入海洋深處，與巨大海蟹的城市戰鬥；翱翔白雲之巔，和掌控與規制技術的神秘曼瑟教派進行激烈的纏鬥。

《The Falconeer: 勇力無雙版》包含完全更新版遊戲，外加《The Hunter》DLC – 加入全新玩家職業和可飛行的奧彌爾龍、專屬燃燒彈制導火箭套裝；《Edge of the World》DLC，包含 3 個額外支線任務和新的遭遇頭目。

飛上天空
乘上巨大戰鷹自由飛行，體驗穿越精彩開放世界的超離感受。

探索不可思議的世界
在充滿了遺失神話和美妙地貌的廣闊海洋世界中進行探索。

激烈的空戰
穿越雲巔，展開令人歎而觀止的空戰纏鬥。

眾多對立派系
加入並支持自己的派系，接受使命，改變同志和自己的命運。

多個戰役
作為一名獵鷹者，從各個視角體驗生活。

升級自己的座駕
活下來，贏得史林特，提升自己的裝備和座駕。

全面配音
強大的配音陣容為玩家在《The Falconeer》中打造了一個栩栩如生的遊戲世界。

塢爾西之聲
在斬獲大獎的樂曲陪伴下，將自己沉浸於《The Falconeer》的世界。

托馬斯·薩拉
《The Falconeer》展現了特立獨行的獨立遊戲開發者托馬斯·薩拉的獨特視角。

title: Pool Together 1-2 [NSZ][ENG]
description:
歡迎來到 Pool Together 2！在這款令人愉快的遊戲中與您的朋友一起或與電腦 AI 較量

8 球和 9 球模式：
選擇您的遊戲 - 經典 8 球或充滿活力的 9 球挑戰。 在《Pool Together 2》中，令人興奮的口袋對戰即將上演。

一台主機最多可容納 4 名玩家：
聚集你的工作人員，把你的客廳變成一個虛擬的撞球廳。 Pool Together 2 在一台主機上最多支援 4 名玩家，確保每個人都有機會展現自己的技能。

單人遊戲的人工智慧對手：
沒有完整的船員嗎？ 不用擔心！ 對抗適應你遊戲風格的人工智慧對手。

是時候在 Pool Together 2 中突破、瞄準並沉入勝利！

title: Hermitage Strange Case Files [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Etot zakhvatyvayushchiy paranormalnyy khorror-priklyuchenie vrashchaetsya vokrug Ermitazha, zloveshchego knizhnogo magazina, kotoryy privlekaet samykh neobychnykh pokupateley - vse oni, pokhozhe, vovlecheny v tainstvennye dela, granichashchie s paranormalnymi. Rassleduyte zagadochnye dela, vzyav na sebya rol ne slishkom motivirovannogo vladeltsa knizhnogo magazina, byvshego professora antropologii, kotorogo po neizvestnym prichinam nikogda ne videli za predelami ego knizhnogo magazina.

S pomoshchyu geniya-khakera, nakhodyashchegosya v begakh, samoprovozglashennogo detektiva i vspylchivogo yuridicheskogo konsultanta vy dolzhny razobratsya v ryade uzhasnykh proisshestviy, pomnya o sverkhestestvennykh uzhasakh, kotorye tayatsya na stranitsakh lavkraftianskoy kollektsii knig Hermitage.

Klyuchevye osobennosti:
-Uvidet unikalnoe priklyuchenie..... v populyarnom stile vizualnoy novelly.
-Sobirayte uliki...... cherez dialogi, televizionnye novosti, veb-forumy, telefonnye soobshcheniya i elektronnye pisma
-Poluchayte podskazki......, razgovarivaya s drugimi personazhami i vybiraya podkhod, kotoryy sootvetstvuet lichnosti tseli.
-Razblokiruyte navyki personazhey...... i prokhodite ispytaniya v opredelennye momenty igry
-Ispolzuyte pinbord...... dlya svyazi i analiza personazhey i sobytiy.
-Prosmotrite predystoriyu personazhey i ikh navyki......, chtoby pomoch vam, esli vy zaydete v tupik vo vremya vashego rassledovaniya
-Podtverdite svoi podozreniya...... putem sopostavleniya vashikh svedeniy i predpolozheniy dlya polucheniya dokazatelstv
-Reshite, po kakomu puti poydet vasha istoriya......, otkryvaya razlichnye syuzhetnye linii blagodarya sdelannomu vami vyboru.

title: Home Postmortem edition [NSP][ENG]
description:
Igrayte v etu klassicheskuyu «indi-khorror» igru, v kotoruyu vkhodit teper i «posmertnaya» chast, t.e. ekskursiya «za kulisy», kotoruyu dlya vas provodit razrabotchik vo vremya igry!

Prosnuvshis ot zvukov nadvigayushcheysya buri, vy otkryvaete glaza i obnaruzhivaete sebya v strannoy temnoy komnate v chuzhom dome. Vasha tsel- nayti dorogu domoy. Odnako, budte ostorozhny, poskolku, kakoy by vy ne sdelali vybor- vash vybor mozhet izmenit khod istorii takim obrazom, kakim vy togo ne ozhidaete.

OSOBENNOSTI IGRY:
- Polnyy, originalnyy «indi-khorror» uzhas, adaptirovannyy pod Nintendo Switch™

- Mnogochislennye varianty razvyazki i izmeneniy v syuzhete, v zavisimosti ot vashego vybora i vashikh deystviy

- Novoe! Pryamo ot razrabotchika! Novatorskiy «posmertnyy rezhim»- ekskursiya v protsess sozdaniya samoy igry po khodu igry

- Novoe! Galereya «za kulisami», vklyuchaya dokumentatsiyu po dizaynu, izobrazheniya protsessov, a takzhe drugie artefakty realnogo mira

title: Retrace Memories of Death [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Kogda chto-to uzhasno ne zaladilos na ekskursii po mestam s prizrakami, Freyya s druzyami okazalas v strannom neumolimom alternativnom mire, zhelayushchem ikh smerti. Voydite v rol Freyi, ishchushchey vykhod i otkryvshey vozmozhnost perematyvat vremya, chto daet ey shans probovat novye sposoby i prinimat razlichnye resheniya na puti k spaseniyu.

Issleduyte atmosfernoe tsarstvo tayn, v kotorom igrovoy protsess s pikselnoy grafikoy sochetaetsya s narisovannymi vruchnuyu portretami personazhey. Reshayte golovolomki i prodelyvayte golovokruzhitelnye posledovatelnosti deystviy, raskryvayte sekrety zloveshchego parallelnogo izmereniya i issleduyte glubokie otnosheniya so sputnikami Freyi. Sblizit li ikh uzhas etogo opyta ili razluchit navsegda?

Kharakteristiki

• Puteshestvuyte po temnomu, no krasivomu miru, v kotorom pikselnaya grafika sochetaetsya s narisovannymi vruchnuyu portretami.
• Ispolzuyte to, chto vy uznali iz smerti, chtoby otkryt alternativnye puti vyzhivaniya.
• Naydite obkhodnye puti i soedinite zatsepki, chtoby vyrvatsya.
• Izuchite strannye otnosheniya i sdelayte vybor, kotoryy povliyaet na istoriyu.

title: Escape Trick: 35 Fateful Enigmas [NSZ][ENG]
description:
「留下謎之鑰匙便失蹤的父親」
主角為了尋找父親的蹤跡而前往各個地方。
他是否能從封閉的空間成功逃出，
順利找到行蹤不明的父親呢？

「睜開眼，卻發現自己身處密室……」
手邊只有手機跟一張紙條。
在失憶的主角眼前出現了一名謎樣女性「凱伊」。
靠著唯一的線索進行層層追查，兩人卻發現了驚人的事實……！？

由兩個故事交織而出的謎題，那背後的真實又是？

title: Chenso Club [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
拿起鏈鋸、大錘，甚至借用外星人自己的生命力來對付它們吧。這幫英勇無畏的戰士將一路殺敵，以摧枯拉朽之勢沖向勝利。可以單槍匹馬！也可強強聯合！打開這款精彩刺激的橫版平台格鬥遊戲，砍翻那些外星人吧！

外星的入侵者猖獗肆虐，不論去了什麼地方，不論遇到什麼人，都會破壞、殘殺！他們一旦死去，就會留下生力——這是一種超級神奇的能源！還有沒有希望？

走進《Chenso Club》，化身這裡的戰士，奮力拯救這個世界。他們利用外星敵人的生力強化自己，以其人之道還治其人之身。他們看着十分可愛，但是他們會歡快、殘忍地消滅所有礙事的威脅。

我們的主角會把握所有機會，運用她們新近學會的能力。你要熟悉她們的招式，提升她們的能力，讓全世界看到Chenso Club的實力。

※ 遊戲特色
• 兩種遊戲模式（更多陸續有來）：你可以進入劇情模式，在豐富多彩的世界中與各路頭目對戰，欣賞以漫畫分格講述的故事；也可以進入合作模式，和朋友一起打遊戲！
• 揮拳、跳躍、劈砍、猛砸：靈活運用姑娘們的招式，將反應能力提升到極致，在隨機生成的關卡中一路打拼、消滅外星人。
• 可以單人，亦可多人：既可單槍匹馬戰鬥，又可在本地多人聯機模式下盡情體會 Chenso Club 姑娘們的拼搏本色。

title: Contraptions 1-2-3 ('The Incredible Machine', TIM) [NSP][ENG,RUS]
interface_lang: 俄语 (2/3-aya chasti), 英语 [ENG, RUS]
description:
Skolko shagov nuzhno, chtoby zamenit lampochku? Esli vash otvet 10 ili bolee, to vy gotovy k «Contraptions» - igre, tsel kotoroy sostoit v tom, chtoby ispravit prichudlivye khitrosti, kotorye vypolnyayut prostye zadachi nepryamymi i zaputannymi sposobami, v stile Rube Goldberg.

Ispolzuyte verblyudov v kachestve batutov, butylok shampanskogo v kachestve pushek, vozdushnykh sharov dlya podema predmetov, koles feyerverkov dlya privoda konveyernykh lent, magnitov dlya privlecheniya metallicheskikh predmetov i mnogikh drugikh gadzhetov dlya resheniya golovolomok i prokhozhdeniya urovney.

Kharakteristiki
+ Reshite bolee 100 duratskikh golovolomok v 5 raznykh mirakh.
+ Sozdayte neogranichennoe kolichestvo vashikh sobstvennykh urovney i broste vyzov drugu, chtoby popytatsya pobedit ego.
+ Ispolzuyte mnozhestvo tupykh gadzhetov ot nozhnits do kolyshkov linii stirki.
+ Proydite urovni neskolkimi sposobami ... stante pomeshannymi i kreativnymi, kak vam nravitsya.

Igrovoy protsess
Na kazhdom urovne est mnozhestvo obektov i monstrov ... Tsel sostoit v tom, chtoby izbavitsya ot urovnya monstrov.

Eto mozhet byt dostignuto razlichnymi sposobami ... Na obekty vliyayut zakony fiziki, i oni igrayut klyuchevuyu rol v reshenii golovolomki. Obekty obrazuyut «Contraptions», raspolozhennuyu takim obrazom, chto sozdaet tsepnuyu reaktsiyu, kotoraya unichtozhit vsekh monstrov. Zagvozdka v tom, chto khitroe ustroystvo slomano - nekotorye predmety nakhodyatsya ne v nuzhnom meste. Vasha tsel sostoit v tom, chtoby ispravit ustroystvo. Vy delaete eto, peremeshchaya, perevorachivaya ili soedinyaya razlichnye obekty.

Kogda uroven nachinaetsya «vremya zamorozheno», gravitatsiya ne vliyaet na obekty, i vse mashiny ili gadzhety ne rabotayut. V techenie etogo vremeni vy mozhete peremeshchat veshchi, soedinyat veshchi, perevorachivat veshchi, chtoby zastavit tsepnuyu reaktsiyu rabotat. Kogda vy zakonchite, vy privodite veshchi v dvizhenie (vremya razmorazhivaniya), nazhimaya knopku «Vosproizvedenie», i smotrite, kak vse proiskhodit.

Esli vy vse sdelali pravilno, tsepnaya reaktsiya unichtozhit vsekh monstrov, i vy pereydete na sleduyushchiy uroven. Esli vashe reshenie ne pravilnoe, vy mozhete priostanovit khitrost i snova vozitsya s obektami.

title: New Terra / Terra Trilogy: Bomber, Lander 1-2 Rockslide Rescue [NSZ][ENG]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
«Soobshchestvo portativnykh igr» daet New Terra 8.5/10!

«Novaya Terra zanimala menya, legko sochetaya potrebnost v tochnosti s besposhchadnoy slozhnostyu. Igra chestnaya i brosaet vyzov... Fantasticheskiy saundtrek i tochno nastroennye elementy upravleniya namnogo pereveshivayut lyubye graficheskie problemy.... Saundtrek i tochno nastroennye elementy upravleniya podnyali igru v tselom, i eto, bezuslovno, dostoynoe nazvanie dlya nuzhnaya auditoriya... New Terra — ochen obnadezhivayushchee nachalo dlya WINTERYEAR Studios».

Metacritic 10/10 — «Davno ozhidaemoe i stoyashchee ozhidanie! Plavnyy geympley, deystvitelno krasivaya grafika, gotovaya k posteru, otlichnaya muzyka. Udivitelnoe vnimanie k detalyam i neskolko dovolno krutykh melochey 10/10»

O Novoy Terre:

Kogda est opasnye kosmicheskie kontrakty, bolshe nikto ne khochet bratsya... Vam zvonyat.

Vy pilotiruete staryy voenizirovannyy kosmicheskiy istrebitel Edgecrusher i okazyvaetes na dalekikh planetakh, gluboko pod chuzhimi okeanami i v dalekikh galaktikakh.

NEW TERRA® — eto ekshn-strategiya, v kotoroy na kazhdom urovne vy okazyvaetes v novom mire, vypolnyaya opasnye missii, takie kak smelye spasatelnye operatsii, izvlechenie drevnikh inoplanetnykh artefaktov, uklonenie ot vulkanov na dalekikh lunakh, remont antenn v glubokom kosmose, vyvoz voennykh prestupnikov, vyvoz lda vo vremya asteroidnykh bur, borby s peschanymi chervyami, vrazheskimi korablyami, turelyami, gigantskimi lazerami i skrytnymi planetarnymi esmintsami.

Topliva na etom korable khvataet nenadolgo, i ego trudno dostat.

Beregite svoi resursy i deystvuyte bystro, inache vy ne vyzhivete.

Itak... Skazhi mne... Ty gotov stat kapitanom?

Osobennosti igry:
- Mnogonapravlennyy kosmicheskiy shuter, osnovannyy na gravitatsii i fizike.
- 18 unikalnykh i ochen slozhnykh missiy
- Rezhim kromeshnoy tmy (pereigrayte igru v absolyutnoy temnote, ispolzuya tolko fary, sozdav v obshchey slozhnosti 36 unikalnykh urovney!)
- Vpechatlyayushchiy i originalnyy saundtrek k igre Rona Vassermana (Moguchie reyndzhery, Zhemchug drakona Z, Lyudi Iks i dr.)
- Vstroennyy avtonomnyy muzykalnyy proigryvatel s vizualnymi effektami
- Podrobnaya uchebnaya missiya
- Nastroyki peremennoy slozhnosti
- Mnogoyazychnaya podderzhka

title: Colossal Cave [NSZ][RUS/Multi13]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 13]
description:
Znamenityy dizayner igr Roberta Uilyams vozrozhdaet Kolossalnuyu Peshcheru kak retro-golovolomku v stile "nazhmi i klikni". Osnovyvayas na originalnom dizayne 1970-kh godov Uilla Kroutera i Dona Vudsa, nachale igr v zhanre priklyucheniy, eto 3D-obnovlenie sokhranyaet svoy vintazhnyy sharm, adaptiruya ego dlya sovremennykh geymerov.

Otpravlyaytes v vechnoe puteshestvie po obshirnoy sisteme peshcher, polnykh sokrovishch, sushchestv, labirintov i golovolomok, oshelomlyayushchikh um. Velikiy prapredok priklyuchencheskikh igr proverit vas i razvlechet vashi navyki resheniya problem, poka vy ne raskroete ego syuzhet i sekrety. Cherez khitroe metodom prob i oshibok vy budete probiratsya cherez uzkie prokhody, vstrechat vpechatlyayushchie peshchery, sobirat inventar, nakhodit sokrovishcha, protivostoyat atakam gnomov, sledya za schetom, poka vash fonar ne pogasnet.

Eta perelomnaya igra schitaetsya odnoy iz samykh vliyatelnykh v istorii, ustanovivshey standarty, kotorye stali normoy v zhanre priklyuchencheskikh igr. Eyo portirovali prakticheski na kazhdyy kompyuter i konsol, v neyo igrali milliony, ona vdokhnovila mnozhestvo drugikh igr, knig, filmov i teleshou.

S eyo slozhnymi i zakhvatyvayushchimi golovolomkami eta issledovatelskaya igra ne otpustit vas. Issleduyte 14 razlichnykh regionov, polnykh magii, skrytykh sekretov, zakhvatyvayushchikh vidov i sushchestv, obitayushchikh v peshcherakh. Kazhdaya zona predlagaet unikalnyy i volshebnyy opyt; vy budete v vostorge chasami.

• Prostoe, intuitivnoe upravlenie "nazhmi i klikni"
• Zakhvatyvayushchie, krasochnye i pogruzhayushchie regiony
• Slozhnye logicheskie golovolomki
• Idealnoe sochetanie slozhnosti i nagrady
• Zhivopisnye podzemnye peyzazhi s skrytymi sekretami
• Igra, kotoraya neveroyatno veselaya i uvlekatelnaya

I, naskolko eta igra propitana istoriey i mifami igr, est i prichina, po kotoroy ona vyderzhala ispytanie vremenem i stala tak silno perepletena s igrovoy kulturoy. Eto veselo! Eto tvorcheskoe. Eto stimuliruet myshlenie i slozhnoe. Eto i prosto, i slozhno. Eto fantasticheskiy dizayn.

Otpravlyaytes v Kolossalnuyu Peshcheru i issleduyte eyo glubiny. Ne zabudte vash fonar!

title: Chronicles of Albian: The Magic Convention [NSZ][ENG]
description:
仙女教母 Gwendolyn 呼籲您幫助準備幾週後在她家 Albian Castle 舉行的官方魔法大師大會。
世界各地的巫師和巫師都來到阿爾比安，享受終生難忘的魔法盛會，並期待令人難以置信的住宿。
在《阿爾比安傳奇：魔法大會》中使用你的隱藏物品天賦來尋找隱藏的寶藏，並幫助資助所需的維修和升級城堡場地！

- 搞笑角色
- 隱藏物體場景的縮放功能
- 具有挑戰性的謎題
- 探索阿爾比安城堡！

title: Chronicles of 2 (Two) Heroes: Amaterasu's Wrath [NSP][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Amaterasu i eyo uchenitsa, imperatritsa Khimiko, vmeste s groznoy armiey dukhov tiranyat feodalnuyu Yaponiyu.

Stili igry personazhey silno otlichayutsya. Kensey khorosh v rukopashnom boyu, no ne mozhet prygat. Ayame prygaet i gorazdo provornee iz-za umeniya atakovat izdali. Pereklyuchaysya mezhdu personazhami, chereduya ikh navyki, chtoby odolevat slozhnye uchastki arkady i bossov.

title: Chaos Galaxy 1-2 [NSZ][ENG]
description:
故事背景
統治銀河千年的龐大帝國在異形攻擊下崩潰，帝國的提督、海賊、商團、教會、傭兵、殖民者們為爭奪霸權而陷入了混戰。

然而，叛亂的智械軍團，再次襲來的異形巢群，即將開始毫無憐憫地毀滅人類物種。悲壯酷烈的諸神黃昏決戰已揭開序幕。
請使用你的謀略和勇氣，終結這個銀河的混亂！

治理你的國家
你可以在自己擁有的行星上建造各種建築區域。地面的農場、礦山、巢都、實驗室……軌道上的船塢、兵工廠、衛星要塞……

指揮戰爭
生產各式各樣的艦船和機甲，任命強大的指揮官指揮艦隊擊潰敵人的艦隊，攻佔敵人的行星。

多姿多彩的事件
人們之間有各式各樣的故事聯繫，隨著時間的推移將會發生數以百計的事件。

豐富的外交手段
銀河中存在十幾個大型勢力和更多的地方小勢力。你可以使用外交手段增加你的盟友和從屬國，挑撥瓦解敵人之間的盟友關係。

決策和科技
每個勢力都有一套完整的決策樹，可以獲得本勢力特有的五種高級兵種和幾十種內政和軍事方面的增幅效果。還能通過與異形交戰，研究異形開發出強殖裝甲，或是從流浪方舟獲得失落的科技圖紙，甚至還能在消滅敵對勢力時獲得敵人的兵種圖紙。

不同風格的陣營
遊戲中的勢力分屬8種不同的陣營類型，每種陣營都有自己的獨特玩法和特殊的行星建築。

title: Cave of Past Sorrows [NSZ][ENG]
description:
先開槍

確保聰明地射擊，而不是用力。 每當您扣動扳機時，您的子彈將永遠停留在周圍……您的所有敵人也將如此。

時間是相對的

利用時間膨脹對你有利。 將你的敵人引向你過去的自己，以“回收”你的舊照片。 睜大眼睛留意任何即將發生的事情，並在這場猛攻中倖存下來。

讓我感興趣

在循環中取得進展，為您的遊戲解鎖新的顏色變化。 選擇您最喜歡的或旨在獲得所有！

主要特徵：

- 時間循環機制
- 對經典子彈地獄的獨特詮釋
- 單色美學
- 基於反射的挑戰

title: Super Mombo Quest [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Kvest Super-Mombo - eto ekshn-platformer! Metroidvaniya s klassicheskoy arkadnoy mekhanikoy, sumasshedshimi boyami, slozhnymi kombo i mnozhestvom kollektsionnykh predmetov - i vsyo eto v ogromnom vzaimosvyazannom mire!

Poluchayte idealnye kombo na sotnyakh urovney!

Puteshestvuyte po gigantskomu vzaimosvyazannomu miru, sostoyashchemu iz soten oblastey, v kazhdoy iz kotorykh prisutstvuet mnozhestvo slozhnykh vragov. Kto-to budet presledovat vas, kto-to poprobuet zastrelit, a kto-to stanet letat vokrug… A nekotorye iz vragov ochen opasny! Smozhete li vy byt dostatochno bystrymi, chtoby pobedit ikh vsekh v idealnom kombo? 

Nastroyte svoy igrovoy protsess pod svoi nuzhdy s pomoshchyu osobykh sposobnostey!

Razblokiruyte razlichnye formy Mombo, chtoby dostich neveroyatnoy skorosti! I ispolzuyte ikh v svoikh interesakh, chtoby raskryt sekrety i sdelat moshchnye kombo!

Obshchaytes s NPC, pokupayte predmety i poluchayte obnovleniya!

Esli vy perenapryazheny i ustali, rasslabtes i poboltayte so strazhami Subrozy. Oni obyazatelno predlozhat predmety i uluchsheniya, chtoby vy mogli eshche luchshe ispytat sebya.

Spasite zemli Subrozy!

Ne dayte groznomu Korolyu Koshmarov unichtozhit Subrozu. Proyavite sebya davno predskazannym geroem. Vse rasschityvayut na vas i vash gigantskiy yazyk! Gotovy li vy vyyti na ulitsu?

title: Castle of the Underdogs Ep.1 [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Komediynaya rolevaya igra v narochito yaponskom stile, vdokhnovlennaya vsem izvestnymi igrami so strategicheskimi poshagovymi boyami, geroyami i shtab-kvartiroy — v sobstvennom zamke!..
Prisoedinyaytes k Khikari, ozornoy i bezzabotnoy devushke, izuchayushchey magiyu v etom absurdnom priklyuchenii, podruzhites s desyatkom druzey, chtoby v itoge vosstanovit mir Bestannii!

title: Bumballon [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Prisoedinyaytes k Bumbalonu v etom milom i otchayannom priklyuchenii v neveroyatnom mire, polnom opasnostey!

Issleduyte 7 unikalnykh mirov, perepolnennykh krasivoy animirovannoy grafikoy v nostalgicheskom retro-stile. Preodolevayte raznoobraznye trudnosti, chtoby spasti volshebnoe korolevstvo Bumbalona i prekrasnuyu printsessu Lunu.

Kazhdaya oshibka prevratitsya v urok, kotoryy pomozhet preodolet budushchie prepyatstviya v neprostom, no interesnom puteshestvii Bumbalona.


Osobennosti:
* Krasivaya animirovannaya grafika.
* Issleduyte 7 mirov.
* 35 raznoobraznykh urovney.
* 5 razblokiruemykh skinov.
* Raznoobraznye mekhaniki deystviy.

title: Brightstone Mysteries Dilogy: Paranormal Hotel, The Others [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi10]
description:
Meet the ancient Egyptian cult in a search of almighty artifact, Marcus Antonius, King Arthur and many others who tried to kept this omni-powerful object hidden away from those who wanted to use its terrible powers for conquering the world and stop the evil from raising from its grave!

- Lead a young detective and confront the ancient Egyptian cult
- Meet King Arthur, Cleopatra, Marcus Antonius and other historical characters
- Explore the mystical old castle and over 50 other locations
- Search the "underworld" and discover the supernatural
- Help save the world from the ultimate evil

title: Boo Party [NSP][ENG]
description:
你受僱於一名怪怪科學家，任務就是闖入一個充滿超自然現象的地點，並帶回照片用以證明鬼魂和怪物的存在。《Boo Party》是一款俯瞰視角的像素風冒險遊戲，你要與 NPC 互動、完成特殊工作及支線任務、找出關鍵道具和遊玩各式各樣的小遊戲，才能從十幾位誘人的超自然美女那取得完整的獨家資訊。

按自己的步調探索豪宅、幫各種有趣的角色完成任務、並替你發掘的辛辣秘密一個個拍照存證……為了研究用途！準備享受這輕鬆又愉快的冒險，肯定會讓你這凡人會心一笑，再配上由作曲家 OSC 所創作的超讚原聲帶！

特色：

• 以像素風俯瞰視角自由探索這棟鬧鬼豪宅！
• 認識 12 位超自然女士，幫他們拍些美照。
• 解鎖色色照片，蒐集在你的相簿裡！
• 遊玩各式小遊戲來完成 NPC 委託的支線任務和工作。
• 享受由《Crawlco Block Knockers》作曲家 OSC 帶來的超讚原聲帶！

title: Bone's Cafe [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Follow the journey of Bones the necromancer as you grow and expand your cafe. Serve your customers quickly, design your own cafe, discover recipes, customize your menu, strategically attract, kill, and harvest customers for fresh ingredients and use their souls to raise an undead army!

FEATURES
Customizable cafe layout.
Customizable cafe menu.
Experiment with ingredients in the kitchen to discover 97 recipes.
Use stealth to harvest exotic ingredients from your cafe customers.
Automate your cafe with minions.
Play with your friends in local co-op 1-4 players.

title: Bit Orchard Animal Valley + 6 DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
升級你的果園
賣掉你的蘋果來賺錢，改善你的果園。擴展你的土地，找到新的秘密。誰知道呢，也許你會一路上結交新朋友...

復古圖形
享受記憶之旅，風格化的2D圖形，類似於舊的Game Boy遊戲。如果你喜歡圖元藝術遊戲，你應該毫不猶豫地嘗試這個迷人的遊戲。

奇普圖恩音樂
你會聽到一些朗朗上口的曲調，以改善你的冒險。每當你回到房間時，你都可以在軌道之間切換，以進行一些急需的休息。

主要特點
- 簡單的控制
- 沒有看不見的牆（只有可見的牆）
- 偉大的重播價值
- 寵物兔
- 風格化的2D圖形
- 令人難以置信的音樂曲目

title: Tied Together [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Odnazhdy gruppa uchenykh sozdala chetyrekh kroshechnykh monstrov. Zachem oni eto sdelali? Chtoby ispytat ikh umenie deystvovat soobshcha! Dlya etogo monstrov svyazali vmeste kroshechnoy tsepochkoy i poruchili preodolet polosu yarkikh, kovarnykh i strannykh prepyatstviy – takoe mogli pridumat tolko uchenye!

Kto skazal, chto syuzhet igry ploskiy, kak dvukhmernaya grafika? Vse verno! Tak ono i est. Sut v tom, chto chudovishcha – eto vy, a uchenye – eto my. Privyazhite sebya k druzyam, a my proverim, kak khorosho vy rabotaete drug s drugom i umeete reshat slozhnye zadachi! A eshche my ispytaem vashu druzhbu na prochnost...

Odinokie igroki nikogda ne spravyatsya s ispytaniyami monstrov. Krome togo, s druzyami igrat veselee, chem odnomu, tak ved? Rabotaya drug s drugom, vam pridetsya slazhenno peremeshchatsya, sovershat pryzhki i tseplyatsya za steny i pol, chtoby preodolevat polosy prepyatstviy i prokhodit urovni. Eto gorazdo trudnee, chem mozhet pokazatsya na pervyy vzglyad – i vo mnogo raz veselee! Kogda chto-to idet ne tak, nachinaetsya sushchiy khaos – a v komnate razdaetsya gromkiy khokhot.

Nu chto, podopytnye? Gotovy ispytat svoyu druzhbu i umenie rabotat odnoy komandoy?

Zabavnye osobennosti:
- Sygrayte v nashu otmechennuyu nagradami dvukhmernuyu igru dlya neskolkikh uchastnikov v odnoy komnate – ona otlichno podkhodit dlya vecherinok!
- V igre net nasiliya, tolko vesele dlya vsekh chlenov semi – ot babushek do samykh malenkikh!
- Bolee 40 neprostykh urovney v parnom rezhime (dlya 2 igrokov)
- Bolee 20 slozhnykh urovney v gruppovom rezhime (dlya 3 ili 4 igrokov)
- Zavershayte urovni kak mozhno bystree, chtoby zarabatyvat zolotye, serebryanye ili bronzovye medali v zavisimosti ot vremeni prokhozhdeniya!
- Privyazhite sebya k druzyam i veselites vmeste!

title: Belle Boomerang [NSZ][ENG]
description:
The monarchs have been placed under a monstrous curse! Play as Belle with the aid of her legendary boomerang, and raise the curtain on this evil scheme. Leap through a world full of charming creatures and lively environments, inspired by the shining stars of the golden age!

No boomerang alone can save this kingdom... Toss cherries, inspirit statues, and soar through flame-filled skies!

• An Array of Powerful Abilities:
There is no shortage of unique power-ups to keep the energy high!
• Bursting with Charm:
The lovely backgrounds and music celebrate the 8-bit era!
• Grand Boss Battles:
Test your mastery of Belle Boomerang's many mechanics in rich, multi-segment bosses.
• Retro Difficulty:
Challenging action is met with modern design and precise controls. Do you have the reflexes?

title: Before the Night [NSZ][ENG]
description:
「我一定會報答你的恩情。」

造訪人類和動物地位互換的奇異世界。
寵物人麗薩無比想念自己已故的主人——
名為愛麗絲的兔子。

為了尋找能將亡者帶回人世的「生命之花」，
麗薩冒險進入陌生的動物世界。

然而，復活愛麗絲的願望越是強烈，
出現在動物世界中的異象就越是可怕……

《 尋找生命之花 》
生命之花是復活愛麗絲的關鍵。
探索可愛的動物世界，找尋生命之花綻放的地方。
然而，摘花者必將付出可怕的代價。

《 謹慎選擇物品 》
在冒險中找到各種物品並使用，解決謎題，平定威脅。
麗薩可以通過多種方式獲得物品，但和平的方式往往並不適用。

《 暗黑童話世界 》
白天，是和諧相處的動物們。夜裡，是遊蕩街頭、來歷不明的突變體。
動物居民們的晝夜變化，這背後會不會有什麼原因呢？

《 直到度過黑夜，太陽再次升起 》
飢餓的突變體會對你窮追不捨。
逃跑、屏息躲在灌木叢中或是使用武器反擊。
在這個怪誕扭曲的村落裡，你必須想盡一切辦法活下去。

title: Battle Kid: Fortress of Peril / Battle Kid 2: Mountain of Torment (na p NES / Nestopia) [NSP][ENG]
description:
Doktor Tina Bayers, uchenyy, rabotayushchaya v korporatsii «Disch», poluchaet soobshchenie o tom, chto gruppa sushchestv neizvestnogo proiskhozhdeniya zakhvatyvaet bazu i stroit Supermekha, svoego roda robota s mnogochislennymi sistemami vooruzheniya v kreposti Il-Akab, gde kogda-to zhila rasa volshebnikov. Opasayas, chto etot Supermekh mozhet stat ugrozoy, doktor Bayers soobshchaet vam, glavnomu geroyu, Timmi ob etom i dayot prototip boevogo kostyuma. V etom kostyume, Timmi otpravlyaetsya tuda na svoem kosmicheskom korable, chtoby ostanovit proizvodstvo Supermekhanizma..
«Battle Kid: Fortress of Peril / Battle Kid 2: Mountain of Torment» — eto homebrew-igry 2010-go i 2012-go godov, kartridzhi, sozdannye spetsialno dlya NES (Nintendo Entertainment System aka «Dendi»), vdokhnovlyonnye kultovymi, slozhneyshimi besplatnymi PK-platformerami «I Wanna Be the Guy» / «I Wanna Be the Boshy»: oni skhozhi s tochki zreniya dizayna glavnogo geroya, oruzhiya, kotorym on vladeet i podkhoda k geympleyu metodom «prob i oshibok» s mekhanikoy mgnovennoy smerti personazha, vragami i opasnostyami; takzhe vzyaty proobrazy bitv s bossami kak v serii Mega Man.
V igre naschityvaetsya bolee 500 otdelnykh komnat, 30+ razlichnykh vidov vragov i mnozhestvo (shest: Very Easy, Easy, Normal, Hard, Very Hard, Unfair; v pervyy raz luchshe vsego nachinat na slozhnosti Hard) nastraivaemykh urovney slozhnosti; vo vtoroy igre (pryamom prodolzhenii istorii pervoy igry) — bolee 650 komnat, 25 tipov razlichnykh vragov, 13 bitv s bossami, 42 muzykalnykh treka i novye mekhaniki.

title: Anthology of Fear [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
After months of investigations, no one has been able to locate your brother. When all hope for help is lost, you take matters into your own hands.
Discover the story chapter by chapter, with each one unveiling their common tragedy.
Explore embodied horrors of human consciousness and fight your way through them to find your brother.
Your personal investigation leads you into an abandoned medical facility. Gradually, you discover its disturbing past, as well as what happened to people associated with it.
Delve into the memories of people associated with your brother’s disappearance. Experience the unexplainable, survive the unimaginable, and put the pieces together.
Avoid the dangers waiting for you on your way to the truth. Interact with your surroundings and take part in surreal experiences which may help you understand what happened.

title: Another Crusade [NSP][ENG]
description:
Play as Rai Reysend and his companions through a series of comical events and epic battles to reveal the mystery of the cosmic barriers that were created after a meteor shower. Will you be able to save the land and uncover the truth?

-Traditional turn-based combat RPG!
-Execute commands with timing to increase your attacks and defences!
-Cast powerful magic attacks and amplify them with fun button sequences!
-Run and jump your way through various stages while finding treasures!
-Solve puzzles and complete quests!
-Meet a wonderful cast of funny characters in comical situations!
-Tons of secrets to discover!

title: Annalynn [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Get ready for an adrenaline-pumping blast from the past with Annalynn! This brand new arcade classic warps you back to the distant year of 1980 with its 2D platformer style. But don't be fooled by the retro aesthetic – Annalynn is packed with all the excitement and challenge you could ever want!

Join Annalynn, the fearless miner, as she runs, jumps, and climbs her way through 16 intense rounds spread across 5 unique worlds! But beware: the four sneaky snakes, Randy, Handy, Candy, and Mike are hot on her heels, ready to strike at any moment! It's up to you to outwit them and collect as many coins and bonus foods as possible. And if you're in need of a leg up, grab the Blinding Rubies to turn the tables and kick those dirty snakes off the stage!

If you’re looking for the most exciting, most fun-filled, most talked about modern arcade title on the market, dig no further: Annalynn is the gem you’ve been waiting for!

- Get your heart pumping with addictive arcade action! 
- Enjoy hours of gameplay with 16 challenging rounds over 5 unique areas!
- Blast your retinas with authentic early 80s arcade graphics!
- Melt your eardrums with a groovy chiptune soundtrack!
- Unlock 30 different character palettes to customize your Annalynn just the way you want her!
- Compete with your friends and family on local high score tables!
- Polish up your skills in the included Practice Mode!
- Main campaign not enough of a challenge? Put a whole new spin on your Annalynn experience in Random Mode!
- Exclusive to the Nintendo Switch™ version, play as Dynamite Anton from ANTONBLAST in New Anton Mode!
- Also exclusive to the Nintendo Switch version, play Annalynn in TATE Mode for authentic arcade aspect ratio!

title: Alpha Particle [NSZ][ENG]
description:
化身手無寸鐵的能量粒子，在太空站之間穿梭，一邊尋求答案。在這個 2.5D 橫向卷軸動作冒險遊戲中，玩家唯一的目標就是發揮創意克服難關並勇往直前，希望在冒險的過程中能找出存在的意義。

玩家扮演的粒子沒有實體，你的生命力除了能讓你衝刺前進外，還是遊戲中通用的貨幣，所以你必須一邊進行新挑戰，一邊謹慎運用生命力。取得新能力、使用地圖機關來解謎或是擊退敵人，探索宛如迷宮一般的星際基地，用盡一切方法生存下去。你能夠超越形體的極限，成為最強的粒子嗎？

特色：

• 挑戰多達 60 個難度逐漸攀升的關卡！
• 尋找並搭配不同的粒子以及 10 種以上的特殊能力。
• 用戰鬥以外的方法移除帶來威脅的敵人！
• 有不同難度可供選擇。
• 解開謎題，證明你是智慧生命體！

title: Alien Death Mob [NSP][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Ocherednoy klon Vampire Survivors!
Arkadnyy pikselnyy idle-shuter, v kotorom vy vystupaete v kachestve posledney nadezhdy chelovechestva s pobedoy nad ordami inoplanetyan.
Vzyav pod kontrol supersoldata, srazhaytes s beschislennymi ordami pikselnykh vragov — v vashem rasporyazhenii budet raznoobrazneyshee vooruzhenie, moshchnye bonusy i dazhe vozmozhnost zamedlyat samo vremya!Army of Ruin / Bio Prototype / Legion of Doom / Monster Destroyer / Void Scrappers / Necrosmith / Spirit Hunters: Infinite Horde / Forest Fire / Whispike Survivors / Last Mage Survivors / Wild Legion / Remedium Sentinels / Catlord / Encore Rally / Hero Survival / Brotato sm. zdes.

title: Alekon [NSP][ENG]
description:
Lyubite New Pokémon Snap?..
Fotografiruyte i zdes desyatki prichudlivykh sushchestv, reshaya golovolomki, prinimaya kollektsionnye pozy, podruzhivshis so vsemi, vypolnyaya zadachki i mini-igry — ot sozdaniya snezhinok i igry na khrustalnykh arfakh do organizatsii monstro-vecherinok!..

title: Derpy Conga [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Soberi vsekh druzey i otpravsya v puteshestvie radi spaseniya planety, kotoroy grozit opasnost!
Nakhodya druga, khvatay ego za ruku, chtoby obrazovat liniyu kongi i nikogo ne poteryat. No bud ostorozhnee: chem dlinnee liniya, tem slozhnee eyu upravlyat.
Odnako nekotorye prepyatstviya proshche preodolevat ruka ob ruku (kha-kha!) s druzyami.

Unikalnaya mekhanika platformera!
Odin, dva... A mozhet, tselaya tolpa zabavnykh druzey? Upravlyay srazu vsemi!

Druzya s raznymi sposobnostyami!
Tebya zhdut vstrechi s raznymi druzyami. Ikh unikalnye sposobnosti prigodyatsya v tvoem puteshestvii.

Veselye golovolomki!
Ispolzuy razlichnye sposobnosti druzey, chtoby preodolevat trudnosti i prepyatstviya.

Krutoy kooperativ!
Igray s druzyami (nastoyashchimi!) v lyuboe vremya!

Priyatnaya muzyka!
Detalno prorabotannyy mnogogrannyy saundtrek postepenno menyaetsya s kazhdym novym dopolneniem k tvoey linii kongi.

Pereizbytok miloty!
Ocharovatelnye multyashki spasut mir i podnimut nastroenie!

Zavorazhivayushchie vidy!
Naslazhdaysya krasochnymi i zhivymi mirami, puteshestvuya po kosmosu v poiskakh druzey.

Bez druzhby nikuda!

title: Paddles [NSZ][ENG]
description:
本地多人遊戲大亂鬥
在本地4人派對混亂中與朋友或機器人競爭! 在緊張的關卡中保衛自己，對抗神奇的球，贏得珍貴的杯冠。

簡單控制
簡單而又難以掌握，Paddles是一款完美的拿起就走的派對遊戲，可以隨時隨地與你的朋友們一起玩耍。

神奇的球
從快速的火球到幽靈般的球體，總有另一個挑戰需要掌握。不同的關卡和神奇的球融合在一起,每次遊戲都會有獨特的體驗。

Party模式 - 24個獨特的關卡
從小型的快節奏關卡到巨型的忙碌關卡，有很多玩法。
24個獨特的關卡具有棘手的移動障礙、怪異的物理學和多彩的古怪設計。

Versus模式
在2人Versus模式中進行頭對頭遊戲! 競爭性和機械性的重點,Versus模式是為了磨練你的技能和挑戰你的朋友進行一對一的戰鬥。

免費更新即將到來!
在Party和Versus模式中,期待更多的關卡，更多的魔法球，複雜的難度定製和更多的內容即將免費到來。

title: Witchcrafty [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
description:
Witchcrafty 是一款類銀河戰士的平台遊戲，你可以在魔法世界中暢遊。王國發生了奇怪的事件：森林裡充斥掠食性植物，原本愛好和平的人民開始武裝鬥爭，深黑礦坑裡出現了哥布林。小女巫必須啟程找出真相和答案。誰是所有這些事件的幕後黑手？你能相信路上的陌生人嗎？是誰偷走了女巫的信？

- 動態的動作遊戲，可使用連擊、閃避、衝刺和魔法。還能火燒敵人、用閃電刺穿，或用冰魔法冷卻對方的狂熱。連你的魔杖也不只是魔法飾品，而是能在關鍵時刻拯救自己的混戰武器。
- 探索這個世界，包括魔法森林、黑暗洞穴、冰雪山脈和廢棄的城堡，裡面都充滿了秘密和寶藏，還危機四伏。
- 你掌控的每個新元素，都能讓你開拓新機會和道路。冰雪魔法能讓深水域不再危險，閃電還能劈開路上的岩石。
- 可愛的像素藝術和圖案：前所未有的可愛圖案！

title: Tiny Barbarian DX [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Steel yourself for a relentless display of might and muscle... of brawn and bravery... of magic and mayhem! Can you cleave your enemies’ skulls, plunder all the booty and flex to impress the barbarienne of your dreams?

Inspired by heroic fantasy fiction, Tiny Barbarian DX combines engaging 2D platform action and combo-based hack-and-slash combat with retro-style pixel art and a loincloth-stirring chiptune soundtrack.

title: Hindsight [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
如果我們生活中的一件尋常物品、一件隨身之物是通往過去的時光之窗，結果會怎樣？在 Hindsight 中，窺視遠久的記憶，探尋不可預見的未來。

Hindsight 同由《Prune》的創作團隊操刀，是一款敘事性探索遊戲，你將跟隨女主角的腳步，翻閱她從出生到現在走過的一生。重回她童年時的家園，整理她的私人物品，穿過時光之窗喚醒她塵封的記憶。
Hindsight 邀請你放慢腳步，注意遺落在時光裡的各種小物件。將這些小物件拼湊起來，不斷改變你的視覺，直至找到正確的角度，進入更久遠的過去。

塵封的記憶和夢境交錯重疊，你儘可以在過去駐足流連，但是早晚要回到現在。

你會帶走什麼？又會留下什麼？

title: 8 and 9 Ball Pocket [NSZ][ENG]
description: 8 & 9 Ball Pocket brings you eight-ball pool and nine-ball pool, also known as American billiards. You can compete with up to 4 friends or against the AI in Versus mode, or challenge the best in the world in Arcade mode, where you can make combo shots and rack up points to become Number 1 in the online ranking. All of this comes in a setting with great graphics and Jazz music.

title: Hyperspaced [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + optsionalnyy mashinnyy 来自 most2820 用于 v0
description:
Tushite pozhary, zachishchayte, remontiruyte, pererabatyvayte otkhody, srazhaytes s vragami i issleduyte kosmos! Obedinyaytes v komandu i srazhaytes, prokladyvaya sebe put cherez protsedurno sgenerirovannuyu galaktiku. Spasite Multivselennuyu v Hyperspaced, khaotichnom kooperativnom kosmicheskom ekshene dlya 4 igrokov!
Rabotaya v komande, vy i vashi tovarishchi-kosmokadety dolzhny spasti Multivselennuyu ot kollapsa. Zabiraytes v kreslo pilota, upravlyayte turelyami, stante mekhanikom i uborshchikom. Multivselennaya v opasnosti!
Kakoy-to chudak ukral neskolko Velikikh Svyazey — predmetov ogromnoy vazhnosti, kotorye svyazyvayut voedino mnozhestvo razroznennykh vselennykh. Esli truby ostanutsya otkrytymi, galaktiki bez elektrichestva medlenno pogibnut. ShELDON, vash derzkiy bortovoy II napravlyaet vas v vashikh poiskakh i vosstanovlenii balansa. Po puti vy mozhete vstretit mnozhestvo drugikh mezhgalakticheskikh puteshestvennikov, ostro nuzhdayushchikhsya v pomoshchi: tainstvennyy robot, strannyy otshelnik, kosmicheskiy osminog-torgovets... i koshki?
Pomozhete im? Togda, kto znaet, oni mogut prisoedinitsya k vashemu opasnomu priklyucheniyu..Ot sozdateley Rogue Glitch Ultra.

title: Lugaru HD (原生移植版 ) [NSP][ENG]
description: Lugaru («lugarý», foneticheskoe proiznoshenie frantsuzskogo slovosochetaniya «loup-garou», «vervolf») The Rabbit’s Foot — tyomno-fenteziynyy zhestokiy i mrachnyy boevoy 3D-ekshn s elementami stelsa: igrok upravlyaet Tyornerom, antropomorfnym krolikom, iskusno vladeyushchim boevymi navykami. Ispolzuya shirokiy spektr spetstekhnik, Tyorner srazhaetsya s volkami i vrazhdebnymi krolikami na stepnykh, zasnezhennykh i pustynnykh territoriyakh.

title: Afterthought [NSZ][ENG]
description: 準備在夢幻般的世界中導航，克服無數激烈的對戰吧。按照自己的節奏完成關卡，同時享受那狂野而不撓的藝術和配樂。在嘗試不同的遊戲風格和能力時，你甚至能學會輕鬆快速地跨越各種關卡。

title: A Tiny Sticker Tale [NSZ][ENG]
description:
在 一個簡短的貼紙故事 中，從周圍的世界中獲取任何東西，將其變成貼紙，然後利用你的創造力將其貼回不同的地方，解決謎題並幫助你的新朋友！

在這個健康的小冒險中，穿上驢子弗林的小靴子，穿越菲戈里島，發現充滿活力的任務，這需要一本非常特殊的魔法貼紙書的力量。

遊戲特色

- 獨特的遊戲玩法，發揮你的創造力，透過在不同的地方放置貼紙來解決謎題
- 透過放置貼紙來改變你的周圍環境
-隨心所欲地客製化和裝飾你的島嶼！
- 華麗、迷人的藝術風格，菲戈里島是一整天冒險後休息的完美場所
- 探索一個充滿神秘和冒險的詳細而迷人的島嶼
- 收集島上的所有貼紙

*一個簡短的貼紙故事 被設計為一個短篇冒險，充滿了許多細節、主要故事的精彩附加內容以及大量的可重玩性！

Ogre Pixel - 2023

title: Zorro the Chronicles [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
在這款受《Zorro The Chronicles》動畫啟發的動作及潛行遊戲中，遊玩蘇洛或他妹妹伊內斯的角色。釋放平民、撥亂反正，並用寶劍的尖端簽上自己的大名，以嘲諷加西亞中士！ 

一趟歷險正等著你！
《Zorro The Chronicles》是款既刺激又幽默的動作遊戲，包含受電視劇啟發的戰鬥及探索場景。 
這趟史詩歷險能讓你沉浸在《Zorro The Chronicles》這部成功動畫劇的世界中。保護脆弱又無辜的人民，免於邪惡將軍及其軍團的侵擾。在 19 世紀的西屬加利福尼亞撥亂反正。

以真正英雄的身分遊玩，並為正義而戰。
你可以遊玩蘇洛或他妹妹伊內斯的角色。透過解鎖新招式以升級英雄。

成為一名寶劍鬥士大師！
利用劍術技巧讓敵人失去平衡、使用鞭索或劍擊讓他們解除武裝，並使出超凡的招式！使用高超的雜技本領及反應能力以躲避他們的攻擊。然後使用寶劍的尖端在他們的身上留下「Z」的標記！

做出正確的選擇！
探索 18 個關卡，並根據各種情況及敵人調整你的應對方式。使用狡猾的手段讓敵人出奇不意、鬼祟躲避他們並探索周圍環境，或與他們來場腥風血雨的寶劍戰。

色彩繽紛的角色
遇見《Zorro The Chronicles》這部動畫劇中各式各樣的卓越角色。有些角色會百般阻撓你且為令人可畏的敵人，而有些則會在你為正義而戰時向你伸出援手。

title: Smoke and Sacrifice [NSZ][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
Smoke and Sacrifice — syuzhetnaya RPG v otkrytom mire. Sozdavayte predmety, srazhaytes i issleduyte otrisovannyy vruchnuyu mir, napolnennyy interesnymi personazhami.

Dom Sati nakhoditsya na kroshechnom uchastke plodorodnoy zemli posredi ledyanoy pustoshi. Ee obshchina protsvetaet blagodarya pylayushchemu Solnechnomu Drevu, zamenivshemu soboy svet ugasshego solntsa. Otdav svoego pervorozhdennogo v zhertvu Solnechnomu Drevu, Sati otkryla uzhasnyy sekret, tayashchiysya za milostyu zhretsov. Raskroet li ona pravdu v taynom mire ili pogibnet v smertonosnom dymu?

Uznaet li Sati pravdu o tom, chto sluchilos s ee synom?

title: Tokoyo Tower of Perpetuity [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Fight your way through a constantly changing tower to solidify your eternal legacy!

You find yourself trapped in a mysterious tower – one that transforms its very structure every 24 hours.
The legacy of your epic struggle shall be carved into the hearts of those who challenge you like an epitaph. 
Surpass countless poor fallen souls and make your way to the heretofore unseen top.

Journey to the top and unravel the mystery hidden within the tower!

▼An auto-generated dungeon that changes daily
This 2D action game is set in Tokoyo – the Tower of Perpetuity – a constantly changing and devilishly deceptive auto-generated dungeon crawling with fiendish monsters and brutal traps. The Tower of Perpetuity is automatically regenerated by the game server every 24 hours (in real-world time), allowing for players around the world to take on the same dungeon each day, and for one day only. Different traps and gimmicks await you each day, and you must compete against other players while battling your way through. The dungeon contains various differing branches, offering a certain degree of free choice and randomization.

▼Light social elements
Social features utilizing the network have been implemented in the game, in which a gravestone will be placed where a player meets their end, appearing in other players’ games along with their “relics” and “last words”. Take advantage of the different special skills afforded to each character and compete with other players as you struggle to surpass the countless bodies of your less fortunate rivals and fight your way through the impregnable dungeon.

title: Time on Frog Island [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
擱淺在一座陌生島嶼

可怕的暴風雨掀起驚濤駭浪，把你那艘巨大的船隻拋向島嶼附近的岩石上。
你醒來後發現船身肢離破碎，一場海難讓你置身陌生的島嶼，島上滿是... 青蛙？

隨著你尋找材料修復船隻，義大利麵貿易網將帶你走遍這座陌生的島嶼。探索《Time on Frog Island》的世界，你將認識一眾友善的角色，破解益智謎題，尋找隱藏寶藏。

依自己的步調盡情探索
•	在這個島嶼沙盒中開闢自己的道路，下一個轉角會遇到什麼，你永遠不知道！
•	結識當地的青蛙朋友，隨時出手幫忙。
•	利用釣魚和農耕挖掘新物品，調製簡單的啤酒，它會改變你橫跨島嶼的方式。
•	跟青蛙學習，在島嶼上測試你的新技能。

透過交易來修理你的船隻
•	到處詢問你需要的物品，但是請記住，你可能需要幫青蛙一些忙，好換取你想要的物品。
•	破解有趣的謎題，拿走需要的物品。
•	盡量別讓島嶼生活影響過多！

發揮實驗精神！
•	跑得更快，跳得更高，跌得比別人慢，只要握有正確的物品，沒有不可能。
•	挖掘不同的方式來完成重要的交易。
•	你拾起的每一件物品，都可能是扭轉一切的關鍵。

title: Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon (DanMachi) Familia Myth Infinite Combate / Fullland of Water and Light [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Posetite gorod-labirint, gde bogi daruyut lyudyam neveroyatnye sily. Syuzhet vertitsya vokrug Bella Kranelya — yunoshi, kotoryy mechtaet stat velikim iskatelem priklyucheniy, — i umeloy mechnitsy Ays Vallenshtayn, chi sudby perepletayutsya i vliyayut na ves Orario!

Sledite za khitrospleteniyami syuzheta, kotorykh ne bylo v anime!

Issleduyte podzemelya: pobezhdayte monstrov v opasnom labirinte pod gorodom!

Prokhodite dopolnitelnye ispytaniya: posle zaversheniya syuzheta vy smozhete popast v novye podzemelya, kotorye generiruyutsya sluchaynym obrazom!

Khodite na svidaniya i razvivayte otnosheniya s neskolkimi personazhami. Eti vstrechi est tolko v igre!

title: Crossroads Inn a Fantasy Tavern Sim [NSZ][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
V Crossroads Inn: A Fantasy Tavern Sim mikromenedzhment idet ruka ob ruku s bogatym syuzhetom. Poskolku korolevstvo nakhoditsya v smyatenii i ozhidaetsya smena vlasti, vash traktir vskore privlechet vnimanie vazhnykh politicheskikh i voennykh deyateley, kotorye otchayanno pytayutsya uderzhat brazdy pravleniya. 

Ostanetes li vy neytralnymi ili stanete chastyu masshtabnoy dramy, polnoy politicheskikh intrig? Poznakomtes s yarkimi personazhami, stolknites s kovarnymi NPC i vypolnite opasnye zadaniya, vdokhnovlennye rolevymi igrami — zdes dazhe est devushka, kotoruyu nuzhno spasti!

V rezhime pesochnitsy vy sosredotochites isklyuchitelno na upravlenii biznesom i ekonomikoy — postroyte sobstvennuyu tavernu, naymite personal i kontroliruyte ego rabotu, upravlyayte tsepochkami postavok i sozdavayte novye retsepty blyud. Esli vam zakhochetsya dopolnitelnykh ispytaniy, my podgotovili 6 stsenariev — kazhdyy iz nikh predstavlyaet soboy otdelnuyu, samostoyatelnuyu istoriyu, s unikalnymi tselyami i pravilami. 

Klyuchevye osobennosti

- Postroyte sobstvennuyu tavernu v originalnom fenteziynom mire Delcrys i nasladites simulyatorom upravleniya v realnom vremeni i rolevoy igroy v odnoy igre!

- Vyberite odin iz trekh rezhimov igry: epicheskiy rezhim kampanii s nelineynym syuzhetom (12 razlichnykh kontsovok!), pochti beskonechnyy rezhim pesochnitsy, prednaznachennyy dlya lyubiteley khardkornykh simov, i stsenarnyy rezhim s 6 unikalnymi istoriyami.

- Pogruzites v bogatuyu i podrobnuyu istoriyu s vrazhduyushchimi fraktsiyami i vliyatelnymi organizatsiyami — vybirayte, zaklyuchat soyuzy ili rabotat protiv drugikh v originalnom mire s nizkim urovnem fentezi.

- Nasladites kulinarnym priklyucheniem, razrabotannym v sotrudnichestve s ekspertami iz Nerds' Kitchen — otkryvayte retsepty, sozdavayte novye blyuda i podavayte raznoobraznye menyu, chtoby privlech razlichnye tipy gostey i udovletvorit ikh potrebnosti v pitanii.

- Issleduyte slozhnuyu ekonomicheskuyu simulyatsiyu taverny, vklyuchaya osobykh gostey, unikalnykh i obychnykh rabotnikov, desyatki resursov i obekty dlya stroitelstva i razvitiya.

- Otkroyte dlya sebya vnutriigrovye DLC, soderzhashchie dopolnitelnykh rabotnikov i predmety, vdokhnovlennye igrami Klabater!

title: Unreal Life [NSZ][ENG]
description:
失去記憶的少女與會說話的紅綠燈相遇。
少女擁有「從觸摸到的事物中讀取記憶的力量」。

少女為了尋找殘留在腦海的記憶中的「老師」，
跟紅綠燈一起展開了奇妙的夜晚之旅。

- 結合像素圖和3D技術的夢幻世界觀
將影像視覺效果技術用像素圖來呈現，
玩家可以真實地體驗《UNREAL LIFE》特有的夢幻氛圍和
魅力的世界觀。

- 觸摸事物的讀取「記憶」系統
《UNREAL LIFE》是邊讀取記憶邊進行的冒險遊戲。
比較觸摸事物時所看到的過去和現在，
解開其中的祕密吧。

- 透過嘗試錯誤解開問題來進行遊戲
在《UNREAL LIFE》中，
設計成透過嘗試錯誤來發現提示。
跟隨記憶展開的旅程，等在最後的究竟是……?

title: Luxar [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
In LUXAR, you control an alien luminescent organic entity that has just been born and must pass its first survival trials to show its adult peers that it deserves to grow among them. It will have to cross 16 dark and hostile sectors with labyrinth-shaped alien architectures populated by toxic substances, obstacles, patrol drones and mechanisms of all kinds.

You are its only chance to make it happen...

title: Across the Grooves [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Across the Grooves is an interactive graphic novel, set in a magical realism universe, where your decisions affect the destiny of Alice, the main character, drastically changing her reality and allowing her to explore alternative destinies by modifying her past.

• Story:
Alice lives an uneventful life. She's in a long term relationship, has a stable office job and a nice apartment in the center of Bordeaux. One day, Ulysse, her ex-lover, comes back into her life through an old vinyl record she receives in the mail. When she puts it for a spin on turntable, she is thrown back into her own past, forced to relive old events. When she comes back to the present, her reality has changed and her fiancé no longer knows her, as if they never met.

Determined to bring her life back on track, Alice packs up and embarks on a hunt across Europe, following the tracks of Ulysse while trying to uncover the origins of the record. However, her journey gradually turns into a quest of self-discovery as she explores new parallel realities each time she puts the needle in the groove.

• Features:
— A hand-crafted adventure — With each playthrough, discover a novel-sized adventure and a slice of the hundreds of hand-drawn images created for the game.
— Every choice matters — Each decision you make slightly alters the personality of the main character, Alice.
— Discover and explore — Travel across European cities, meet colorful characters and solve the mystery, all depicted in gorgeous European comic book art style.
— Immersive and finely crafted soundtrack — The music adapts and shifts according to your choices and the mood of each scene.
— Dynamic dialogue system — Read the story like a comic book.
— High replayability — Choose Alice’s fate and discover the outcome of your decisions through multiple story paths and endings.

title: AntVentor [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Vy zadumyvalis kogda-nibud, kak vyglyadit mir glazami muravya?

AntVentor — eto pervaya korotkaya glava iz serii igr AntTrilogy o murave i ego neobychnykh priklyucheniyakh v fotorealistichnom makromire.

Glavnyy geroy — muravey-izobretatel, kotoryy, nesmotrya na svoy kroshechnyy razmer, stremitsya k bolshoy mechte.

On zhil prostoy i razmerennoy zhiznyu, poka ne poyavilis vy, i ne slomali ego mekhanizm, tem samym narushiv ego plany. Teper vam pridetsya sdelat vse vozmozhnoe, chtoby Florantin ne tolko vernulsya k svoey privychnoy zhizni, no i poluchil vozmozhnost osushchestvit svoyu zavetnuyu mechtu.

Vmeste s nim vam predstoit preodolet nemalo trudnostey i pouchastvovat vo mnogikh priklyucheniyakh, kotorye tolko nachinayutsya v etoy pervoy glave.

A vy khotite:
- Pochuvstvovat, kakovo eto — byt razmerom s muravya?
- Okunutsya v unikalnyy i udivitelno fotorealistichnyy makromir?
- Sovershenno bespardonno vorvatsya v zhizn glavnogo geroya?
- Poznakomitsya s Florantinom, zabavnym, no nemnogo nadmennym muravem-izobretatelem?
- Posmeyatsya nad vsemi komichnymi momentami igry?
- Povstrechat strashnykh i milykh, ogromnykh i malyusenkikh, zhiteley makromira?
- Nasladitsya skrupulezno sozdannoy animatsiey, sostoyashchey iz bolee chem 15 000 kadrov?
- Poradovatsya otsutstviyu nudnykh pazlov, obychno sozdannykh dlya togo, chtoby potyanut vashe vremya?
