- Ne propuskat dlinnykh dialogov prosto potomu, chto ikh tut net?
- Naslazhdatsya spetsialno sozdannoy atmosfernoy muzykoy kontrabasa?
- Uvlechsya lakonichnym, no ochen zakhvatyvayushchim syuzhetom s sovershenno neozhidannym finalom?

Esli khot na odin vopros vash otvet «da», to eta igra dlya vas!

title: Duel Princess [NSZ][ENG]
description:
This is a side-scrolling tower defense game where you lead your units from your own castle towards the Princess' castle and capture it. 
There are roguelite elements that lets you enjoy building new decks each time you play the story mode.
There are also many sexy rewards that men all over the world can enjoy!

title: Smashing The Battle Ghost Soul [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Geympley. Smashing the Battle — eto igra v zhanre khaker-slesh.
Vy srazhaetes s robotami, ispolzuya standartnye ataki, a takzhe kombo-ataki. Sokrushiv vraga, vy mozhete otkryt put vpered. Atakuya vraga, vy mozhete poluchit ochki navykov, chto pozvolit vam nanesti sokrushitelnye udary po bolshim gruppam vragov odnovremenno. Posle prokhozhdeniya kazhdogo etapa ispolzuyte sobrannye monety, chtoby usilit svoego personazha, chto pozvolit vam srazitsya s eshche bolshim kolichestvom vragov. Vy takzhe mozhete ispolzovat monety dlya pokupki razlichnykh kostyumov s razlichnymi sposobnostyami.

2086 g. n. e. — Vvedenie. Prizrachnaya dusha
Oplombirovannaya podzemnaya zona — cherez god posle intsidenta s Keyt.
Amano El, agent otdela spetsialnykh operatsiy stolichnogo departamenta politsii, vyslezhivaet respublikanskogo shpiona, kotoryy pronik v stranu pod prikrytiem. Legendarnyy khaker poyavlyaetsya na meste proisshestviya, kogda El vryvaetsya na obekt, gde byvshaya armiya provodila sekretnye yadernye issledovaniya.
Ell i Alina — agenty protivoborstvuyushchikh natsiy, kazhdaya iz kotorykh stremitsya uznat pravdu! Yadernoe razvitie, voennye marionetochnye operatsii, neobiotsentrizm... Chto oni naydut v kontse svoikh peresekayushchikhsya istoriy?

2085 g. n. e. — Vvedenie
Glubokoy nochyu na stroyke multipleksa Highrise...
Sara O'Konnell i ee kollega Ivan vnezapno okazyvayutsya v okruzhenii robotov-izgoev.
Posle togo kak Lorien spasaet Sara, ona sbegaet i beret zashchitnyy kostyum, chtoby probitsya k vykhodu!
Kogda istorii Sary i Meri stalkivayutsya, smogut li oni dokopatsya do suti intsidenta i uznat pravdu?

title: Saturnalia [NSP][ENG]
description:
Priklyuchencheskiy roguelite-khorror ot tretego litsa s mnozhestvom personazhey.
Rabotaya nad igroy, my vdokhnovlyalis folklorom italyanskoy Sardinii — regiona, bogatogo unikalnymi traditsiyami i kulturoy. Vas zhdut chetyre personazha i glubokiy syuzhet, svyazyvayushchiy ikh proshloe s traditsiyami starinnoy derevni.
Derevnya predstavlyaet soboy zaputannyy labirint, kotoryy menyaetsya s kazhdym prokhozhdeniem — issledovat derevnyu i iskat otvety vam pridyotsya samostoyatelno.
Vashe oruzhie? Korobok spichek....
Posle smerti vashego personazha vy uvidite, kak derevnya polnostyu perestraivaetsya. Reshayte golovolomki, otkryvayte dorogi v novye rayony s pomoshchyu instrumentov i predmetov, kotorye popadayutsya vam na puti, razblokiruyte vse fragmenty syuzheta s raznymi personazhami, kazhdyy iz kotorykh obladaet sobstvennymi sposobnostyami i otvechaet za svoyu chast issledovaniya i rassledovaniya.
Vokrug sgushchaetsya tma, i vsyo chto u vas est — nemnogo spichek. Sumeete li vy proyti cherez tuman i uznat pravdu? Ili vas poglotyat mrachnye tayny, kotorye derevnya ne khochet vam raskryvat?
Osobennosti igry

● Struktura derevni menyaetsya kazhdyy raz, kogda personazh umiraet.
● Razblokiruyte osobye sposobnosti personazhey, primenyayte instrumenty i raskhodnye materialy, chtoby otkryvat dorogi v novye mesta.
● Sledite za povestvovaniem i progressom v reshenii golovolomok pri kazhdom zavershenii igry (roguelite).
● Sledite za svoim zapasom spichek, kotorye pomogut vam osmatrivat tyomnye mesta i razgadyvat zagadki.
● Nelineynyy syuzhet, dinamicheskaya i adaptivnaya istoriya.
● Rassleduyte ritual, vokrug kotorogo stroitsya vsya igra, i ispolzuyte vsyo, chto smozhete nayti, chtoby ostanovit ego.
● Golovolomki gluboko integrirovany v igrovoy mir i syuzhet (ne abstraktnye).
● Risovka i animatsiya osnovana na pokadrovoy semke i tekhnologii rotoskopirovaniya.

title: The Quest for Excalibur Puy du Fou [NSZ][ENG]
description:
"Kazhdyy slyshal o legendarnom korole Arture i ego davnem sopernike Lanselote.

Snedaemyy zavistyu, Lanselot vyzval korolya na poedinok. Ekskalibur, vernyy mech Artura, raskololsya na chasti. Ot nego ostalas lish rukoyat i krestovina. 

Artur zaklyuchil dogovor s feey Morganoy i brosil oblomki mecha v vodu. No Artura predali, i on okazalsya zatochyon v zagrobnom korolevstve Avalon. 

Po prikazu korolya volshebnik Merlin dolzhen nayti naslednika Artura, sobrat vse 15 oblomkov Ekskalibura i vernut Artura v mir zhivykh."

V igre vossozdan vsemirno izvestnyy frantsuzskiy tematicheskiy park.

Pochuvstvuyte sebya geroem arturiany i otpravlyaytes v neveroyatnoe puteshestvie, chtoby nayti vse 15 oblomkov Ekskalibura i osvobodit korolya.

Sovershite puteshestvie vo vremeni i srazites s groznymi vragami: dayte otpor svirepym vikingam, vstupite v boy na arene antichnogo amfiteatra, stante rytsarem i oderzhivayte pobedy na zhestokikh turnirakh.

Issleduyte park Pyui-dyu-Fu, vossozdannyy do melchayshikh detaley: nakhodite podskazki, chtoby proyti osnovnuyu kampaniyu, ili vypolnyayte dopolnitelnye zadaniya na istoricheskuyu tematiku.

Sozdayte svoy avatar i vyberite, kakim budet vashe sobstvennoe priklyuchenie v Pyui-dyu-Fu.

Bolee 15 ispytaniy i mnozhestvo tsennykh nakhodok zhdut vas v unikalnom puteshestvii po antichnosti i Srednim vekam."

title: The Company Man [NSZ][ENG]
description:
在《打工人》這款傳統動作平台遊戲裡你將扮演個普普通通的打工仔，吉姆。喝點咖啡就得在古德水公司拼命！用鍵盤打倒瘋狂同事，給霸總們發射導彈電郵，克服打工人的苦，升級成公司總裁。

・打敗同事搶先升值
挑戰你的平台技巧並且衝過七個充滿陷阱、怪胎同事、野蠻經理的工作部門。

・沈浸在一個精心製作的世界中
從空調寒風入骨的會計部到文件堆積如山的人力資源部，探索各種美麗的手繪環境

・幽默地呈現共鳴話題
記得你的懶惰又霸道的上司嗎？或那整天想推銷自己傳銷計劃的煩人同事？你會不知不覺地被工作和生活中的許多雙關語和笑話逗笑。

・咬緊牙關提升自己（的武器)
在擊敗一個新的部門後，用鍵盤升級來提高自己的技能。從諷刺的評論到垃圾郵件海嘯，有很多方法可以完成這項工作。

・在輕鬆的休息時光來杯咖啡來恢復精力
感覺有點動力不足？喝杯咖啡可以促進你的健康和精力！我是說，沒有一點咖啡因你怎麼可能推翻一個公司呢？

・品嘗咖啡豆帶給你的衝勁
用你打敗同事的血汗工資來換取咖啡店裡一系列的咖啡補品。

・尋找秘密地牢
在遊戲里的秘密地牢挑戰自己。協助吉姆打敗一輪接一輪的同事。加倍注意，這些地牢隱藏的特別不好找

・每個人都有一個合適難度等級
無論你是菜鳥還是高手，我們都會為你提供從「正常」到「不可能」的各種難度級別(遊戲備注:「不可能」會在打敗遊戲後解鎖)。

title: Tasomachi Behind the Twilight [NSP][ENG]
description:
少女悠雲乘坐她引以為傲的飛艇踏上旅程。
在去辦差事前往東洋小鎮的途中，飛艇受到不明的力量影響而發生故障。

她駕駛著即將要墜毀的飛艇並設法著陸，
而降落到一處被濃霧覆蓋，安靜得所有東西像是沉睡似的地方...

《黄昏沉眠街》 是一款由畫師nocras個人制作，主要以自由探索，欣賞由nocras描繪的美麗世界為題材的冒險遊戲。
玩家操縱少女悠雲，為了收集零件修理壞掉了的飛艇，在濃罩“黃昏之霧”的小鎮中尋找隱藏著的“大地之源”，同時協助回復小鎮昔日的輝煌。
配上電子音樂制作人Ujico*創作的夢幻音樂，能令大家盡情享受悠閑獨特的東方幻想世界。

title: Oxide Room 104 [NSP][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
《Oxide Room 104》的背景設定在一間汽車旅館裡面，是一款結合密室逃脫的遊戲方式和動作、令人感到冰寒刺骨的單人肉體恐怖遊戲。被人綁架、任由一名殘酷的科學家擺佈，還有一個可怕的怪物尾隨，你必須試著運用常識來逃脫，正如在現實生活中一樣。你能夠活著逃離 Oxide 嗎？

你在一間汽車旅館房間的浴缸裡醒來，一絲不掛，身上帶傷，也不確定發生了什麼事。故事就此開始。你想起那件出了差錯的交易，但是現在惟一重要的事就是不計代價逃離那個恐怖的地方。從這一刻開始，你的每一個行動都會帶領你走向多個結局之一。而且我們要警告你，在各式各樣可能的結局中，只有一個是好的……

要解決一個困境，有許多選擇和方法，也有不同的途徑。有些行為會改變你對環境的認知，甚至使你突然走到結局。記住，一個惡劣的決定就可能決定你是生，還是死。

• 決定權在你手中！馬修做了很多錯誤的決定，才淪落到這個地步。用心做決定，因為你的行為將影響遊戲的走向和結局。只有靠著你的努力，才能活著離開這裡... 或是走不出去。

• 用和現實生活中相同的方式與每一樣物品互動。尋找資源、地圖、線索，或是可以用來保護自己的手段。Night Soul Motel 裡，到處都是你可以運用的東西。

• 令人震驚的故事。離開那裡不會是一件容易的事；揭發 Oxide 的真相更是一大挑戰。現在是有人在玩弄你，但這一切事情背後的力量是什麼？

• 遊戲結束？每次主角死亡，無論是因為意外還是因為汽車旅館的危險而喪命，你都會再度出現在 104 號房的浴缸裡，然而一切事物都有代價...

• 絕佳的重玩性。你的行動和決定將影響冒險的結局，因此每次遊戲都會是一場挑戰，有許多不同的選擇可以探索。

title: Onsen Master [NSZ][ENG]
description: Onsen Master is a hot spring customer management game where players have been charged with the task of revitalizing hot springs across the fantasy island Izajima. Create ingredients to match the various customer ailments, reconnect the communities that surround each onsen, and discover the supernatural world they’ve long since been disconnected from.

title: No Place for Bravery [NSZ][ENG]
description:
No Place for Bravery eto dvukhmernaya rolevaya igra s vidom sverkhu vniz, kotoraya predlagaet potryasayushchuyu grafiku, zapominayushchiysya saundtrek i napryazhennye boi, vpletennye v ochen lichnoe povestvovanie o moralnykh dilemmakh.

Igra postroena na bystrom tempe boya s bolshim kolichestvom parirovaniya. Oshibki budut stoit vam dorogo, i vy vsegda budete stalkivatsya s novymi opasnymi vyzovami v mire Dewr.

Torn, otstavnoy voin, chi koshmary ne otpuskayut ego, neozhidanno natykaetsya na vozmozhnost otomstit, kogda nakhodit klyuchi k svoey davno poteryannoy docheri. Kak igrok, vy reshaete, kak daleko zaydet Torn v soprovozhdenii svoego priemnogo syna Fida, bud to v poiskakh docheri ili v presledovanii sobstvennykh ambitsiy.

Istoriya "No Place for Bravery" neset v sebe silnoe poslanie o roli geroev-roditeley i posledstviyakh ikh vybora v nespokoynom mire. Soobshchenie osnovano na lichnom opyte razrabotchikov i predstavleno gramotno i gluboko, chtoby peredat ikh realnye i ponyatnye chuvstva.

Torn - talantlivyy boets v mire, gde takie, kak on, kazhdyy den teryayut svoi zhizni. Pod vashim rukovodstvom Torn obretet sposobnost ubivat i vyzhivat, no vy takzhe dolzhny ozhidat, chto vashi rokovye porazheniya povliyayut na ego uyazvimost.

Vas ozhidaet vpechatlyayushchee sochetanie fantastiki, vysokodetalizirovannogo pikselnogo iskusstva i krasivykh tekstur, narisovannykh vruchnuyu, kotorye ozhivlyayut etot potryasayushchiy mir. Kazhdaya sekunda, provedennaya v No Place for Bravery, budet perepolnyat vas zakhvatyvayushchey atmosferoy, kotoraya budet budorazhit vashu dushu vo mnogikh otnosheniyakh.

title: NHRA Championship Drag Racing Speed for All - Ultimate edition [NSP][ENG]
description:
NHRA™ vernulsya – teper bolshe i luchshe, chem kogda-libo! Okunites s golovoy v komandy, trassy, tyuning i strategii, pristegnites k voditelskomu kreslu v svoyom nesgibaemom stremlenii stat chempionom sredi istinnykh Beasts of the Strip™.

Glavnye osobennosti igry:
• 5 NHRA klassov: Top Fuel, Funny Car, Pro Stock, Pro Mod i Super Modified
• 38 luchshikh NHRA gonshchikov: Brittany Force, Antron Brown, John Force, Steve Torrence i drugie!
• Realnye treki, ofitsialno odobrennye NHRA: Bristol, Las Vegas, Charlotte, Indianapolis, Pomona i drugie.
• Osnovannyy na realnoy fizike dreg-reysing s imitatsiey glubiny, skorosti i nastoyashchikh oshchushcheniy realnogo mira.
• Rezhim karery dlya odnogo igroka, okhvatyvayushchiy neskolko igrovykh sezonov.
• Rezhim karery: upravlenie komandoy, issledovaniya i razrabotki, tyuning i nastroyki.
• Asinkhronnye mnogopolzovatelskie setevye reytingi dlya podderzhki vashego sorevnovatelnogo dukha.

title: Mozart Requiem (The Last Secret, The Conspirators of Prague) [NSZ][ENG]
publisher: GS2 Games, Funbox Media, Micro Application, HR Games
description:
«Lacrimosa dies illa
Qua resurget ex favilla
Judicandus homo reus
Dona eis requiem
Amen»
«Rekviem Re minor» K.626, s lat. «zaupokoynaya messa» — poslednee i nezavershyonnoe prizhiznennoe muzykalnoe proizvedenie Volfganga Amadeya Motsarta, nad kotorym on rabotal vplot do samoy konchiny — s 22 noyabrya do smertelnoy nochi s 4 na 5 dekabrya 1791 goda — traurnaya liturgicheskaya sluzhba, napisannaya na kanonicheskiy latinskiy tekst, chast «Dies Irae», dnya gneva, t. e. Strashnogo suda — sekventsiyu v katolicheskoy messe, odin iz samykh populyarnykh grigorianskikh raspevov. Eyo tekst na latyni proiskhodit ot 18-y i 19-y stans. Posle smerti sochinenie zavershili Yozef Eybler i Frants Ksaver Zyusmayer, no tem ne menee «Rekviem» yavlyaetsya odnim iz naibolee izvestnykh proizvedeniy Motsarta, i rassmatrivaetsya kak odno iz vazhneyshikh tvoreniy velikogo kompozitora.
V iyule 1791 goda Motsart poluchil neobychnyy zakaz: k nemu v dom prishyol neizvestnyy poslannik v chyornom i na usloviyakh sekretnosti sdelal zakaz. Motsart soglasilsya na rabotu i poluchil avans 50 ili 100 dukatov. Stolko zhe kompozitor dolzhen byl poluchit po okonchanii raboty. Kak vyyasnilos pozzhe, Rekviem byl zakazan grafom Frantsem fon Valzeggom dlya ispolneniya v pamyat o svoey supruge, Anne fon Flamberg, umershey v fevrale 1791 goda. Vyyasnilos i imya posrednika, neposredstvenno sdelavshego zakaz maestro: im byl upravlyayushchiy grafa Loytgeb. Graf fon Valzegg byl lyubitelem muzyki, i sam igral na fleyte i na violoncheli, chasto ispolnyal u sebya doma razlichnye sochineniya i teatralnye predstavleniya raznykh avtorov, odnako emu khotelos, chtoby ego tozhe schitali kompozitorom, i poetomu on neodnokratno vydaval zakazannye u raznykh masterov sochineniya za sobstvennye: perepisyval sobstvennoy rukoy partitury, poluchennye ot avtora, i uzhe potom otdaval ikh raspisyvat na partii. Pri pervom ispolnenii «Rekviema» Valzeggom 14 dekabrya 1793 goda na partiture bylo ukazano: «Rekviem sochineniya grafa fon Valzegga», Requiem composito del conte Walsegg. Pochti na vsekh polotnakh, otrazhayushchikh poslednie chasy zhizni Motsarta izobrazhaetsya imenno ispolnenie Rekviema.
V etom pereizdanii proslavlennoy igry 2008-go goda budet: polnaya prorabotka dialogov s realnymi istoricheskimi personazhami, intrigi i istoricheskie zapisi, litsenzirovannaya muzyka Volfganga Amadeya v nastoyashchey Prage, tochno smodelirovannoy po kartam togo vremeni i desyatki khitroumnykh golovolomok dlya prokhozhdeniya — v polnom 3D!..

title: Connectank (Connec Tank) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Dostavka nikogda ne byla rabotoy dlya nezhenok. A esli dobavit k ney neobkhodimost srazhatsya s ogromnymi i unikalnymi uboynymi tankami? V etom i sostoit sut raboty kurerom u Finneasa Zhirnogo Kota XV, odnogo iz glavnykh magnatov Novoy Pangei! 
 
K schastyu, vam dlya raboty v dostavke budet dostupen ogromnyy tank. Soedinyayte konveyery i vzryvayte vrazheskie tanki, obstrelivaya ikh snaryadami, proizvodimymi pryamo v pylu srazheniya. Poluchayte novye boepripasy i ustroystva, chtoby unichtozhit dazhe samye uzhasnye tanki! Sobirayte detali ot pobezhdennykh tankov — i smozhete ispolzovat ikh sami!
 
Smozhete stat luchshim naemnikom Finneasa Zhirnogo Kota? Smozhete eshche silnee uvelichit ego slavu i bogatstvo? Finneas rasschityvaet na vas, starina!

title: Tesla vs. Lovecraft [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Igrayte zagadochnym izobretatelem Nikoloy Tesloy! Unichtozhayte ordy koshmarnykh chudovishch razrushitelnym oruzhiem, sobirayte moshchnye usileniya i odoleyte vragov nevoobrazimoy ognevoy moshchyu boevogo robota Tesly!

Tesla byl na grani velikogo otkrytiya, kogda laboratoriyu sozhgli slugi Lavkrafta. I nachalas bitva nevidannykh masshtabov! Unichtozhte chudovishch i pobedite bezumie drevnikh bogov s pomoshchyu nauki!

Osobennosti:
– Teleportiruytes podalshe ot vragov ili skvoz prepyatstviya!
– Krushite chudovishch verkhom na boevom robote!
– Srazhaytes realnym oruzhiem i takimi chudesami nauki, kak Rentgenovskiy klinok!
– Popadite v tablitsu liderov v syuzhetnom rezhime i rezhime vyzhivaniya!
– Sovmestnaya igra na odnom kompyutere dlya 2-4 igrokov!

title: Monster Outbreak [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Nachalos vtorzhenie monstrov! Prostranstvennaya sfera vyshla iz stroya, i v korolevstvo khlynuli ordy chudovishch. V roli Yulii, poslednego utselevshego boytsa Korolevskoy gvardii, vam predstoit otstoyat svoi pozitsii, uluchshit svoy arsenal i vyzhit — chtoby nayti i unichtozhit sferu!
Sfera izmereniy obeshchala bogatstvo i znaniya, prevoskhodyashchie samye smelye mechty chelovechestva, i byla skryta ot vsekh, poka ee ne obnaruzhili i ne prinesli korolyu. Buduchi chelovekom, korol legko poddalsya iskusheniyu, i na nekotoroe vremya obeshchanie ispolnilos. Blagodarya Sfere v korolevstvo potekli bogatstva, znaniya i neveroyatnye istorii. no potom poyavilis chudovishcha.

title: Letters a Written Adventure [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Letters is a cozy, often funny, and sometimes sad game about friendship, courage, and the power of words.
Journey back to the 90s and 2000s to follow the story of Sarah and move through her beautiful hand-drawn letters and nostalgic pixel worlds.
Help her navigate all the ups and downs of growing up and decide what kind of person she'll become.
Use words to solve riddles and explore Sarah's colorful world full of wacky characters, relatable stories, and bad puns.

Features
- Comfy, playful, and casual game that focuses on narration and having fun with words.
- Relatable coming-of-age story inspired by real-life.
- Clever riddles that you can solve with the power of words.
- Beautifully hand-drawn visuals and pixel art that evolves with Sarah's age.
- Branching storyline where you can discover new possibilities with every playthrough.
- Good for practicing English skills in a fun way.

title: Bai Qu Hundreds of Melodies [NSP][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
Naveshchaya svoego bolnogo ottsa, student kolledzha Vey Tsyuvu sluchayno vstretil devushku, igrayushchuyu na kontsertine.

Khotya ponachalu eto kazalos maloveroyatnym, no Vey Tsyuvu stanovitsya khoroshim drugom muzykantshi Li Tszyayun. Oba oni stali igrat vazhnuyu rol v zhizni drug druga.

Poka odnazhdy koe-kto ne otkryl Vey Tsyuvu zhestokuyu pravdu, skrytuyu pod skazochnym pokrovom ...

Kharakteristiki
* Syuzhetnaya liniya dlitelnostyu ot 8 do 12 chasov.
* Mnozhestvo putey i kontsovok.
* Absolyutno net «pravilnogo/nepravilnogo vybora, raznye kontsovki nesut raznyy smysl.
* Izyskannye i realistichnye fonovye izobrazheniya, zvukovoe soprovozhdenie, zapisannoe na meste.
* Bolee 20 zamechatelnykh fonovykh muzykalnykh kompozitsiy v samykh raznykh muzykalnykh zhanrakh.
* Neobyknovennaya istoriya na temu lyubvi i zaboty v povsednevnoy zhizni.

title: Vivid Knight [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
Vivid Knight – priklyuchencheskaya igra v zhanre Roguelike, v kotoroy nuzhno spasti druzey, prevrashchennykh v dragotsennye kamni, i sobrat ikh sposobnosti voedino, chtoby sozdat neprevzoydennuyu komandu!
Issleduyte postoyanno menyayushcheesya podzemele, nakhodite dragotsennosti i ispolzuyte ikh, chtoby pobedit Chernuyu vedmu!


◆Vasha tsel – samoe serdtse podzemelya!
Issleduyte podzemele, kotoroe menyaet oblik pri kazhdom prokhozhdenii, sokrushite Chernuyu vedmu, podzhidayushchuyu vas v samoy glubine podzemelya, i osvobodite svoikh druzey iz kamennogo plena!


◆Sobirayte kamni!
Sobirayte kamni (yunity), razbrosannye po vsemu podzemelyu, i dobavlyayte ikh v svoyu komandu. Poluchayte dublikaty kamney, chtoby povysit ikh parametry!

◆Sozdayte svoy sobstvennyy unikalnyy rytsarskiy orden!
Kogda vy dobavlyaete kamni v svoyu komandu, aktiviruyutsya moshchnye sposobnosti simvolov. Peremeshivayte i obedinyayte tsveta i simvoly sobrannykh kamney, chtoby aktivirovat razlichnye effekty i sozdat svoyu unikalnuyu komandu!
Razlichnye kombinatsii simvolov dayut raznye effekty, poetomu eksperimentiruyte s raznymi skhemami, chtoby sobrat komandu, podkhodyashchuyu imenno dlya vashego stilya igry!


◆Ispolzuyte dragotsennye kamni dlya usileniya svoey komandy!
Igroki mogut ispolzovat magicheskie sily i instrumenty, spryatannye v dragotsennykh kamnyakh, chtoby podderzhat svoyu komandu v boyu.
Strategicheski ispolzuyte dragotsennye kamni, chtoby pobedit vragov, napadayushchikh na vas v podzemele!

◆Mnozhestvo aksessuarov
V podzemele mozhno nayti razlichnye aksessuary.
Aksessuary dayut razlichnye effekty, usilivayushchie moshch vashey komandy.
Vyberite podkhodyashchie aksessuary dlya svoey komandy, i u vas poyavitsya shans spravitsya s Chernoy vedmoy!

title: Umihara Kawase Fresh / BaZooKa [NSZ][ENG]
description: Kogda molodaya shef-povar po imeni Kavase Umikhara, puteshestvuyushchaya po Yaponii devushka pribyvaet v pogranichnyy Kingnes, ona nakhodit idealno tochnuyu kopiya goroda, o kotorom mechtala v detstve. Zaintrigovannaya, ustraivaetsya ona na rabotu posylnym i povarom v mestnyy restoran. Blagodarya issledovaniyam i besedam s mestnymi zhitelyami, Kavase postepenno uznaet istoriyu etogo goroda — tainstvennyy zamok, kotoryy plavaet nad nim, opasnuyu peshcheru, kotoraya skryvaetsya pod nim, i nevyrazimykh demonov!

title: Tobari Dream Ocean + Nightmare [NSZ][ENG]
description:
2D ekshen-platformer s magiey plyus dop. kontentom «Nightmare» — teper na Nintendo Switch!
Tobari vozvrashchaetsya! Ispolzuyte svoy vernyy posokh i atakuyte svoikh vragov, puteshestvuya po Okeanu Snov.
Naydite tainstvennyy golos, kotoryy zovet vas iz-za morey, puteshestvuya s Tobari v etot neizvestnyy, novyy mir.

title: RemiLore: Lost Girl in the Lands of Lore [NSZ][ENG]
description:
RemiLore - eto «prichudlivoe» priklyuchenie v stile anime, sozdannoe v krasochnom mire fantaziy, gde igroki vzlomayut i prorezayut svoy put cherez armiyu mekhanicheskikh monstrov, ispolzuya ogromnoe kolichestvo unikalnogo oruzhiya blizhnego boya i razrushitelnykh magicheskikh atak!

Remi, obychnyy uchenik sredney shkoly, probudil Loru, govoryashchuyu knigu, kotoraya yavlyaetsya samoprovozglashennoy «magistrom» magii. Vmeste oni vtyanuty v volshebnyy mir Ragnoa, kotorogo nastigli gnusnye mecha-monstry. Remi i Lore dolzhny vmeste otpravitsya vmeste i nayti dorogu domoy, no mozhet li Remi deystvitelno doveryat ozornoy magicheskoy knige «Lore»? Kto tainstvennaya devochka-android «Choux» i pochemu ona khochet zakhvatit Lore? Budet li Remi kogda-libo nayti vykhod iz volshebnogo mira i vernutsya domoy?

Osobennosti odnopolzovatelskogo syuzhetnogo rezhima s polnoy yaponskoy ozvuchkoy, dvukhpolzovatelskim rezhimom kooperativa, obnovlyaemymi zaklinaniyami i bonusnymi chertami, a takzhe protsedurno-generiruemymi urovnyami v chetyrekh krasivo oformlennykh mirakh, kazhdyy iz kotorykh osnovan na odnom iz chetyrekh sezonov. U pobeditelya mecha-monstrov takzhe est svoi nagrady - igroki mogut raskryt mnozhestvo razblokiruemykh, vklyuchaya alternativnye kostyumy, 200+ kollektsionnoe oruzhie, rezhimy «Novaya igra +» i mnogoe

title: Penny Punching Princess [NSZ][ENG]
description: Penny-Punching Princess is an isometric brawler that takes place in a world ruled by capitalism, where cash is king. Fight or bribe your way to reclaiming your kingdom from the greedy Dragoloans.

title: Bug and Seek + 2 DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Milyy simulyator entomologa!.. V etom uyutnom mire v stile 8-bitnoy klassiki vy priobreli mestnyy muzey nasekomykh, zabroshennyy posle tainstvennogo ogrableniya. Vypolnyayte zakazy, sozdavayte svoyu kollektsiyu i uluchshayte navyki i oborudovanie, issleduya Zhukburg i raskryvaya vse ego sekretiki.
Bolee 175 samykh nastoyashchikh, realnykh nasekomykh! Razrabatyvaemyy nebolshoy komandoy razrabotchikov iz dvukh chelovek, Bug & Seek - eto rasslablyayushchiy, beskonechnyy simulyator po lovle nasekomykh i kollektsionirovaniyu sushchestv s elementami tayny. V Bug & Seek vy tolko chto vlozhili svoi sberezheniya v pokupku zabroshennogo Insektariya (muzey nasekomykh)! Kogda-to eto bylo zhiznennoy siloy goroda i ego ekonomiki, no kto-to ukral vse nasekomye v glubokoy nochi. Teper na vas lezhit zadacha lovit i prodavat nasekomykh, vypolnyat zakazy iz mestnykh magazinov i vosstanovit Insektariy kak simvol goroda. Stante masterom po lovle nasekomykh povyshayte svoi navyki lovli nasekomykh, uluchshayte oborudovanie i rasshiryayte svoy Insektariy. Znakomtes s mestnymi zhitelyami, vypolnyayte zadaniya dlya polucheniya spetsialnykh predmetov i raskroyte taynu Velikogo ogrableniya nasekomykh. I rasslabtes! Zdes net nevernykh vyborov, ne nuzhno bespokoitsya ob urovnyakh energii, i u vas mnogo vremeni dlya vypolneniya zadaniy i raboty.

title: DragonFangZ The Rose and Dungeon of Time [NSP][ENG]
description:
Rose is half human and half dragon. One day, she wanders into a world called "Tree of time" with her nanny, Fairy.

It is said that there’s a powerful treasure deep under the dungeon. In order to return back to their village through the power of the treasure, they decided to face the challenges of the dungeon!

If Rose is defeated during the adventure, she will lose all items and her level will be reset. And because the dungeon transforms every time you challenge it, the quests will never be the same. Your courage and growth will be the key to clear the dungeon!

Features:

One choice, one victory: This game is turn-based. Both Rose and the enemies take turns moving. Players can think about what to do on their next turn. Wisdom and courage will bring you “small victories”, and these will eventually bring you “huge victories”. 

The "Fang" system: Rose can wear Fangs of monsters and gain their abilities. There are more than 200 kinds of monsters. You can seek the strongest combination and arrange your Fangs however you like.

The "Brave" system: Rose powers up when there are no obstacles around you within 8 squares. This overturns the “battling within the passage” theory of the Roguelike game.

This game also has the Ranking function, Item Warehouse, Monster's Database, Achievement, Mini Puzzle, and Dungeon for Advanced Players.

title: Brave Dungeon + Dark Witch Story Combat / The Meaning of Justice [NSZ][ENG]
description:
繼承了之前《魔神少女》系列的《Brave Dungeon》的基本系統的續集。妳可以在不同的故事和不同的系統中扮演三個主人公的情景。

-亞爾：走過廣闊的奇跡森林，尋找森林的齣口。我們將通過使用數量有限的 "GrassKeys"，在無數的 "IvyDoors "阻擋下前進。妳可以通過拾取散落在森林中的Shega碎片和創造Seama物品來進一步探索。

-克琳希： 目標是獲得藏在三個圖書館書堆中的 "解封書"。圖書館裡有一個 "封印陷阱"，考驗入侵者的智慧。

-帕佩爾涅： 帕珮爾內被帶到了一個空曠的平原。她開始從頭開始建設她的城市。她可以按照自己的意願自由建造城市。讓她建立一個更有吸引力的城市，吸引更多的遊客。

title: Boot Hill Bounties / Heroes [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Boot Hill Heroes - pervaya igra v serii, v kotoroy sochetayutsya elementy spagetti-vesterna - strelba iz prestupnikov, khrabrye zakonniki i neobuzdannaya pustynya - s klassicheskim syuzhetom i igrovym protsessom v rolevoy igre. Eto epicheskoe priklyuchenie na Dikom Zapade, napolnennoe azartom, intrigoy i doley yumora.

-Retro Refresh: eksperimentalnoe sochetanie starykh i novykh idey, kotoroe prinosit unikalnyy opyt kak sovremennym geymeram, tak i fanatam staroy shkoly. Boot Hill Bounties sochetaet v sebe elementy spagetti-vesternov - strelbu iz prestupnikov, khrabrykh zakonnikov i neobuzdannuyu dikuyu mestnost - s klassicheskoy syuzhetnoy liniey i igrovym protsessom.

-4 igroka Kooperativnaya igra: igrayte v odinochnuyu ili lokalnuyu kooperativnuyu igru do chetyrekh igrokov. Druzya mogut legko voyti i vzyat pod kontrol odnogo ili neskolkikh iz chetyrekh personazhey!

-Net sluchaynykh srazheniy: vragov mozhno uvidet i izbezhat, a ranee pobezhdennye vragi ukhodyat s vashego puti. Srazhaytes s prestupnikami i zhivotnymi! Smozhete li vy ostanovit draku v bare? Smozhete li vy pobedit bandu enotov, kopyashchikh dragotsennyy musor?

-Aktivnyy boy: tipichnyy poshagovyy boy zamenen bystroy i uvlekatelnoy sistemoy v realnom vremeni, gde vse igroki dolzhny postoyanno sledit za bitvoy i adaptirovatsya k novym strategiyam!

title: Vostok Inc [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Lyubite dengi? Vy — novyy generalnyy direktor Vostok Inc. Buduchi zhadnym kosmokapitalistom, vy stavite pered soboy tsel: zarabatyvat kak mozhno bolshe.

Zarabotayte startovyy kapital unichtozhaya s pomoshchyu dvukh stikov vragov, asteroidy i vse ostalnoe, chto popadetsya vam na puti, a zatem otpravlyaytes v novyy kvest po zarabatyvaniyu babla, koloniziruya, issleduya i ekspluatiruya bolee 40 planet v 6 unikalnykh solnechnykh sistemakh. Dobyvayte planetarnye resursy i spasayte rukovoditeley, chtoby priumnozhit svoyu pribyl, vse eto vremya prebyvaya v rayskoy atmosfere razvlecheniy blagodarya tselomu sonmu uvlekatelneyshikh mini-igr v stile retro, kotorye zastavyat vas vozvrashchatsya za novymi portsiyami snova i snova.

S boem prokhodite kazhduyu novuyu solnechnuyu sistemu, unichtozhayte zlykh bossov, naslazhdaytes ritmichnym elektronnym saundtrekom i prosto rasslablyaytes, bukvalno kupayas v kuchakh babla i stanovyas bezmerno i do neprilichiya bogatymi!

title: Razed [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
RAZED — bystryy kak molniya odinochnyy ranner-platformer dlya tekh, kto lyubit skorostnye prokhozhdeniya. Stavte rekordy skorostnykh zabegov po dinamichnym neonovym urovnyam, primenyaya takie sposobnosti, kak maksimalnoe uskorenie, zatyazhnye pryzhki, ukhody v zanos, moshchnye udary i stremitelnye uvoroty, chtoby preodolevat prepyatstviya i nakhodit srezki v borbe za pervye mesta v onlayn-reytinge igrokov. No pomnite: sposobnosti raskhoduyut energiyu, a esli ona upadet do nulya, vashi bashmaki vzorvutsya (vmeste s vami)... 

KAZhDYY UROVEN SLOZhNEE PREDYDUShchEGO 
Sovershayte zabegi na 60 dinamichnykh urovnyakh v 6 unikalnykh mirakh, u kazhdogo iz kotorykh svoy sobstvennyy vizualnyy stil, razblokiruemaya sposobnost i napryazhennaya bitva s bossom. 

PROKLADYVAYTE SVOY MARShRUT 
Otklonyaytes ot protorennoy dorozhki i prokladyvayte svoy marshrut, ustanavlivaya rekordy skorosti prokhozhdeniya i poluchaya otsenku S. 

ONLAYN-REYTING I GONKI S PRIZRAKAMI 
Sorevnuytes s igrokami vsego mira i beyte ikh rekordy iz onlayn-reytinga ili broste vyzov prizrakam svoikh druzey v ramkakh asinkhronnogo pervenstva.

SKOROSTNYE PROKhOZhDENIYa BEZ LIShNEY SUETY
Kogda rech idet o pogone za sovershenstvom, ozhidanie neumestno. Uzhe yasno, chto tselevogo vremeni ne dostich? Zhmite knopku perezapuska, chtoby vernutsya v nachalo urovnya, ne tratya vremeni na ego zagruzku. 

SEKRETNYE UROVNI DLYa SAMYKh LOVKIKh
Zadeystvuyte polnyy nabor sposobnostey, chtoby otyskat i proyti samye slozhnye urovni RAZED.

title: Harmonia [NSP][ENG]
description:
Set in a distant future where the world has been ravaged by war, Harmonia is a sci-fi visual novel about a robot boy and a human girl who come to form a special bond. A touching story that has been well-received the world over now comes to the Nintendo Switch™ system!

Now fully voiced!
Protagonist Rei, as well as twenty-six background characters, are all given voices for the first time. Be swept up anew by passionate performances from star voice actors!

Text in three languages!
The text can be set to Japanese, English, or Simplified Chinese (audio only available in Japanese). This includes in-game text, options, and the digital manual. Language settings can be changed at any time.

Summary
In the distant future, the Earth has been ravaged by an immense war, leaving the human population dwindling. In this ruined world, a humanoid robot boy, designated Phiroid, awakens in a disused facility. 
Prior to the war, Phiroids were the purest form of human scientific achievement, imbued with all five senses and emotive functionality. Designed as partners for humans, they promised to make life better for all humanity. 
When this boy-type Phiroid awakens, however, he quickly realizes that he is missing his emotive functions. Harboring an innate need for human contact, and to regain his missing emotions, he sets out into the devastated earth.
Having walked for countless days, he eventually loses consciousness, only to be saved by a lone girl. Thinking that he is human, the girl takes good care of him. As this Phiroid boy lives alongside this girl, little by little, he comes to learn about emotions.

*There are no choice-based story branches in this game.

Staff
Character Design & Original Art: Itaru Hinoue
Scenario: Tsuzuru Nakamura / Kai
Music: Shinji Orito / Ryo Mizutsuki / Tomohiro Takeshita

Cast
Rei         VA: Ryo Nishitani
Shiona    VA: Kaori Mizuhashi
Tipi        VA: Misaki Kuno
Madd      VA: Kenta Miyake
*Fully voiced

title: Beasties [NSP][ENG]
description:
The Beasties live in complete harmony and symbiosis with humans. But this harmony gets cracked after the disappearance of a Beastiemaster. The guild of Beastiemasters sends you to an isolated village to find out what happened to the master.

Will you find the master and restore the old balance?

This game offers you: 
-	Strategical match-3 brawling
-	Many monsters with a unique design
-	A fulsome solo campaign
-	Large area for free-form exploration
-	Colorful and hand painted world
-	Monster taming and training
-	A relaxing atmosphere

Key features:

• Beastie Brawls: Our turn-based puzzle combat system is easily accessible for beginners, but offers enough depth and the ability to plan moves far in advance for hardened veterans. They like to brawl our Beasties ;)
• Improve your Beasties : Our friends, the Beasties, receive primordial dust plates as loot after winning battles. With them you'll improve their abilities. In this way, you can upgrade each Beastie individually by investing in health, defense, strength and special abilities. You decide how to set up your team based on your strategy!
• Exploring : To reward Exploring, within the world there will be hidden objects and random events with special loot. Use your time to collect important resources and prepare for the next adventure phase, challenge beastie trainers or search for new beasties in the tall grass.
• Sophisticated genre mix of Monster Trainer & Puzzle
• Many Beasties have adapted to the environment, creating a variety of Beastie types
• Mining is important to get resources that are needed for your journey!
• Team up with Beasties, upgrade and customize them for your gameplay

title: Land of Screens [NSZ][ENG]
description:
V «Strane ekranov» napravte Gollandiyu v ee novuyu missiyu - izbavitsya ot perepolneniya sotssetey i otkryt dlya sebya otnosheniya iz realnogo mira, zaruchivshis pomoshchyu neskolkikh novykh druzey, parochki sinteticheskikh chiptyunov i nepovtorimoy khimii malenkikh detey i ocharovatelnykh zhivotnykh.

Internet-begstvo ot deystvitelnosti v zhanre "ukazhi i shchelkni"

Nadente svoyu samuyu prichudlivuyu shapku dlya obshcheniya, chtoby preodolet do boli znakomye problemy, takie kak:
• Provedenie improvizirovannoy vecherinki, gde vash edinstvennyy vybor kompanii - eto neznakomtsy ili, chto eshche khuzhe: druzya, kotorykh vy ne videli so shkoly.
• Brodit po vestibyulyu otelya, chtoby neuklyuzhe poznakomitsya s drugimi uchastnikami professionalnoy konferentsii.
• Sostavte nailuchshie plany kontsertov v poslednyuyu minutu, kogda vy nikogda ne slyshali o gruppe, ne byli na meste provedeniya ili ne vstrechalis s kem-libo iz lyudey, s kotorymi vy tam nakhodites.
• Semya. Vossoedineniya.
• Volnenie vashikh druzey zanyatiyami prirodoy, chtoby oni mogli ubedit drugikh nachat zanimatsya prirodoy, chtoby vy vse mogli provesti den, zanimayas prirodoy.

Prosto zastavte vsekh perestat smotret v svoi telefony… Net problem.

Kuda by Kholland ni otpravilsya, chtoby popytatsya uyti, vse prikovany k svoim ekranam. Ey ponadobitsya pomoshch starykh druzey i novykh znakomykh - i im ponadobitsya ee pomoshch, - chtoby izbezhat bezumiya v seti i, nakonets, na vremya otklyuchitsya ot seti. Okunuvshis (ili spotknuvshis) v novyy opyt, novye otnosheniya i sluchaynye priklyucheniya, Gollandiya mozhet poluchit shans izbezhat vezdesushchey dramy v sotsialnykh setyakh.

Pomnite, kak priyatno govorit pri nastoyashchikh litsakh?

V mire, zastryavshem na tsifrovykh soedineniyakh, edinstvennyy sposob, kotorym Gollandiya sobiraetsya perezhit etot razryv s sokhraneniem svoego rassudka, - eto pereyti na analogovuyu svyaz. K schastyu, ona skoro uznaet, skolko zamanchivykh priklyucheniy sushchestvuet, vdali ot postoyannykh kommentariev v sotsialnykh setyakh. Konechno, ona mogla by zatsiklitsya na seti mneniy o ee razryve, kak obychno, no, mozhet byt, est drugoy sposob ...

title: Kurokami-sama's Feast [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Kurokami-sama's Feast is a horror-adventure visual novel following an unlucky trio who find themselves hunting monsters to be turned into gourmet dishes for the powerful (and woefully famished) being known as Kurokami-sama. Using Kurokami-sama's ear to listen in on people's innermost thoughts, and wielding Kurokami-sama's arm to strike back at the supernatural, you will come face to face with the darkness that lurks beneath the veil of mundane society. Will our heroes find a way to escape Kurokami-sama's clutches before it's too late?

During your encounters with monsters and otherworldly entities, you'll have access to a parameter called spiritual energy, which can be used to read minds and launch devastating attacks. Clever use of this resource is the key to overcoming the many trials and tribulations that await you in the world of Kurokami-sama's Feast.

Cruel and stunningly beautiful in equal measure, Kurokami-sama is the supernatural being who forces the protagonist into her service. Hoping to regain enough of her strength to break free from the magical barrier that binds her, Kurokami-sama commands you to procure cooking ingredients from the countless monsters that infest the city. Will you obey her, find a means to defeat her yourself... or perhaps make an attempt to seduce her? The choice is yours.

Featuring a wide and varied roster of supernatural entities, Kurokami-sama's Feast will pit you against monsters from comparatively recent urban legends, such as the Aka Manto and the Kunekune, as well as more ancient beasts of folklore like the Keukegen or the Sazae-oni. Beings of western and Chinese origin, such as the Boogeyman and the Onromaki, also make an appearance.

title: Kraino Origins [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Pomogite Kreyno odolet monstrov, prizrakov i zombi s pomoshchyu moguchey kosy! Izbegayte pil, ognennykh sharov, luzh s kislotoy i shipov, pytayas nayti vse sekrety i dobyt moshchnoe oruzhie. Kraino Origins obedinyaet v sebe vse luchshee ot retro-igr!

Eto zhutkoe priklyuchenie razvorachivaetsya v mire, kotoryy naselyayut monstry, guli, prizraki i skelety. No, kak i v nashem mire, zdes postoyanno idet borba dobra so zlom. Kreyno byl sozdan silami zla, no nikakaya temnaya magiya, okazalas ne v silakh izmenit ego istinnuyu — dobruyu — sushchnost.

Teper Kreyno dolzhen brosit vyzov silam zla, srazhayas s nimi ikh zhe oruzhiem. On otpravitsya v zakhvatyvayushchee puteshestvie, chtoby raspravitsya so zlymi povelitelyami, nayti spryatannoe oruzhie i otomstit svoemu sozdatelyu po imeni Doktor Betkula.

- Dinamichnyy i surovyy ekshen-platformer!
- Issleduyte 8 ogromnykh urovney i srazhaytes s bossami v stile retro
- Nakhodite predmety dlya usileniya magii i uvelicheniya zdorovya
- Sobirayte moshchnoe oruzhie, chtoby seyat khaos i razrushenie!

title: King of the Hat [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
《King of the Hat》是一款二至四人的 2D 派對平台帽子大戰遊戲！可以透過丟帽子來攻擊、防禦和引誘敵人。請小心！如果有人跳到你的帽子上……你就完了！
在《King of the Hat》的世界裡，您的靈魂就藏在帽子裡。粉碎對手的帽子（和靈魂）來宣誓主權。
帽子丟出去之後就會著火並呈現無敵狀態。你可以用它來橫掃其他玩家，或阻擋敵人的火焰帽攻擊。
雖然《King of the Hat》的基本遊戲機制很容易上手，但它同時也是一款深度與競爭性兼具的帽子大戰雙人遊戲。
改變規則、加入增強技能並挑戰關卡障礙，打造一場夢想中的帽子大亂鬥。

title: Kamikaze Veggies [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Esli Vy ishchete absurdnuyu, sumasshedshuyu i smeshnuyu igru, to Vy prishli po adresu. Dobro pozhalovat v mir voyny i okkupatsii krasnymi ovoshchami.
Vasha komanda — eto komanda sumasshedshikh voinov kamikadze, gotovykh umeret. Oni professionalnye soldaty. Oni obladayut razlichnymi navykami i predraspolozhennostyu.
Imenno ot Vas zavisit, smozhete li Vy ispolzovat ikh potentsial i uspeshno vypolnit missiyu!

Kamikaze Veggies — eto igra, v kotoroy odin nevernyy shag oznachaet smert.
Ne spuskayte glaz! Chtoby bystro otreagirovat na ugrozu, nuzhno byt sosredotochennym. Esli Vy umny, u Vas est shans proyti missiyu uspeshno. Kogda situatsiya na peredovoy stanovitsya tragicheskoy, ispolzuyte samoubiystvennyy vzryv. Eto spetsialnost komandy povstantsev.

Vash vrag — krasnye kommunisticheskie ovoshchi. Eto zhestokie i bezzhalostnye ublyudki, glavnaya tsel kotorykh — vzyat pod kontrol ves mir. U krasnykh chislennoe prevoskhodstvo, oni luchshe vooruzheny, a v ikh otryadakh est GMO-mutanty — chrezvychayno agressivnye zveri.
Prigotovtes k smertelnoy vstreche. Voyna — eto ne mesto dlya trusov!

Klyuchevye osobennosti

●Odinochnyy rezhim s interesnoy istoriey
●Perspektiva tretego litsa
●Optsiya rezhima razdeleniya ekrana 
●Unikalnyy geympley, osnovannyy na prinesenii v zhertvu voinov-kamikadze
●Mnogo interesnykh missiy
●Mnozhestvo uvlekatelnykh personazhey s raznymi sposobnostyami
●Krasivyy i kontrastnyy khudozhestvennyy stil, a takzhe otlichnaya muzyka

title: Roombo First Blood / Justice Sucks Tactical Vacuum Action [NSZ][RUS/Multi]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
竊賊闖入麥克潔一家時，小塵必須離經叛道，以保護他的家人。很不幸地，他英勇的行徑引起了大家庭企業的注意，而且一場與保證小隊間的戰鬥，還讓小塵飛進了客廳的電視中。

小塵在電視的異世界中醒來，他必須駭入、躲藏並大力吸起物品，才能重獲自由。與你的戰鬥專家性感麥克潔同心協力，並發展出致命的技能，以協助他擊敗大家庭企業並拯救他的家人！

製造混亂
吸起物品以用來對抗你的敵人，便能暢快無比地摧毀他們。

暢飲鮮血
克盡你身為吸塵器的本分，並清除一切混亂。啃食敵人的身體、吸起血液，並吃光所有的殘骸。

釋放強大的破壞力｜消耗敵人的血液以為小塵的致命戰力注入能量，朝著一波又一波的大家庭企業探員猛擊、衝撞，以突破重圍、向前邁進。

躲藏起來
低調地躲藏在家具底下、躲避偵查，並向毫無戒心的敵人發動強勁的偷襲。

駭入世界
透過駭入智慧型裝置並將其轉變成致命陷阱，以運用周遭環境來對抗你的敵人。

見見力量強大的盟友
與動物盟友交好，並組織成一個無人能擋的團隊，來摧毀小塵的敵人。

title: Fruitbus (Fruit Bus) [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Avtostop-puteshestvie vkusov i druzhby zhdet vas v uyutnom, personaliziruemom furgone s edoy!
Sobirayte svezhie ingredienty, chtoby sozdat sobstvennoe menyu, a zatem nakormite zheludki i dushi domashney edoy. Menyayte mir po odnomu yabloku za raz. Uluchshayte svoy vernyy gruzovik i vmeste posetite tselyy mir novykh mest!

title: Meteorfall Krumit's Tale [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description: 九宮格網加卡牌構築的奇妙組合，一段“星隕傳說宇宙”的傳奇冒險。 街角神秘魔法店，老人慾把往事談。布魯諾，灰鬍子，英雄暮年已歸鄉，蓋世巫妖早不見，《流浪者的故事》永流傳。

title: Azur Lane Crosswave [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Izmenite khod srazheniya v etom 3D-ekshen-shutere, naberite bolee 50+ korabelnykh devushek iz populyarnoy mobilnoy igry Azur Lane!

Pogruzites v 4 igrovykh rezhima, v tom chisle Extreme Battle Mode. Nastroyte svoy flot s razlichnymi sudami i oborudovaniem!

Dannyy produkt podderzhivaet sleduyushchie yazyki; Angliyskiy

title: Damascus Gear Operation: Tokyo, Osaka [NSP][ENG]
description:
Damascus Gear Operation Osaka的目標是
在到期日之前償還主角欠下的高額[債務]。
[Cosmopolis]中，賭上高額的[Eyn(這世界的貨幣)]
每天展開被稱為[鬥技]的GEAR戰鬥。

主角作為選手參加[鬥技]，打算以獎金還[債]。
主角一天能進行一次[委託]或是[鬥技]。

[委託]中探索副本獲得新零件，
[鬥技]中以排名戰獲得獎金或是進行排名。
在到期日之前運用[委託]強化GEAR，用[鬥技]攢取獎金吧。
萬一在到期日之前無法做到的話…？

-劇情-
[GEAR System] 21世紀中期，Atsuga公司革新了公開的系統
全部技術，完成了載人機器人[GEAR]。

但是，因為在2050年開始的第4次世界大戰中發生的[GEAR System]暴走，
世界情勢發生變化。暴走的[GEAR]變成[RAGE]，
大半戰力[GEAR]開始單方面虐殺依存於它們的人類。

經歷滅頂之災，倖存下來的人類躲到了地下，
利用[GEAR System]進行反擊。

人類和[RAGE]的鬥爭是再激烈不過的， 
根據RAGE對策本部[Freya]和GEAR傭兵的聯繫，逐漸成功奪回重地。
2112年，終於在日本結束50多年的戰鬥。人類贏了[RAGE]。

終戰30多年後，舞台是建造於日本大阪復興據點城市[cosmopolis]。
繼承父母遺產—[GEAR]和[債]的年輕飛行員和操作員一起
開始作為鬥技選手活躍起來。

歷史未存的，朝向自由的兩人戰鬥即將展開…

title: Inua a Story in Ice and Time [NSP][ENG]
developer: The Pixel Hunt, IKO, ARTE France
description:
A Mystical Game in the Canadian Far north:
Set off on a mystical journey to the Canadian Far North with Inua - a Story in Ice and Time, a point & click narrative adventure spanning multiple eras.
Meet Taïna, a present-day reporter determined to discover the truth behind the disappearance of the Terror, one of the ship of the Franklin expedition whose goal was to explore the Arctic in the 19th century. Her destiny is mysteriously linked to that of Peter, a young filmmaker covering a military expedition in the 1950s and Simon, a sailor of the Franklin expedition struggling to keep his crew alive.

Navigate through time to discover what links them together. Search for ideas, instill them in the characters' minds and guide them toward Nanurluk, the mythical polar bear who lived 10 000 years ago.

A Mystical Time Travel Experience:
Go on an adventure in the far North of Canada, navigate through the ages, and interact with the past to change the present. In Inua, you’ll need to unravel space-time to solve mysteries and guide the characters on their journey. Move from scene to scene, era to era, and uncover events of the past, unearthing new ideas that influence the characters' minds. Help Simon, Peter, and Taïna overcome the obstacles standing in their way, and change the course of history.

A Historical Saga:
The original and supernatural scenario of Inua is based on a very real story: that of the Franklin expedition, a British mission in the 19th century to explore the Arctic that resulted in shipwreck, disease, and mutiny. The fate of this expedition is still largely unknown. Gather clues and discover its history!

Inua - a Story in Ice and Time:
- A fantasy tale based on incredible historical facts.
- An extraordinary story inspired by Inuit tales and legends, with support from Inuit writer Thomassie Mangiok and advisors Billy Gauthier and Monica Ittusardjuat.
- A game designed by the creators of Bury Me, My Love, and Vignettes, adapted from the original story by Nathalie Frassoni and Frédéric Bouvier, with the breathtaking artistic direction of Delphine Fourneau from the Klondike collective.

title: Ikai [NSP][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 机器翻译 来自 most2820
description:
Ikai — eto psikhologicheskiy khorror ot pervogo litsa po motivam yaponskogo folklora. Ispytayte uzhas ot vstrechi s yokayami i pogruzites v sueveriya proshlogo, issleduya igrovoy mir i prokhodya unikalnyy syuzhet.

Ikai voploshchaet v sebe dukh klassicheskogo zhanra psikhologicheskogo khorrora s bezzashchitnym glavnym geroem, nesposobnym atakovat zlykh sushchestv. Odnako igra takzhe eksperimentiruet s novym chuvstvom uzhasa, zastavlyaya igroka stolknutsya s ugrozami litsom k litsu, ne ubegaya i ne napadaya.

STRAKh: ispytayte uzhas ot pervogo litsa, stolknuvshis s yaponskimi dukhami, chudovishchami i yokayami.

ISSLEDOVANIE: progulyaytes po srednevekovomu sintoistskomu khramu i issleduyte ego, chtoby uznat istoriyu, kotoraya tam proizoshla.

RISOVANIE: sosredotochtes na nanesenii zashchitnykh pechatey, poka vokrug razdayutsya strannye zvuki i proiskhodyat neveroyatnye sobytiya.

GOLOVOLOMKI: reshite neskolko golovolomok, kotorye popytayutsya vas ostanovit.

SKRYTNOST I BEG: kradites tikho, chtoby ne potrevozhit zlo... Ili prosto begite, begite izo vsekh sil, esli smozhete…

title: Crush Crush / Hush Hush [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Privet lyubitelyam goryachenkogo! Vy iskali zabavnuyu i soblaznitelnuyu igru, chtoby rasslabitsya i ot dushi posmeyatsya? Sovpadenie — no i ona iskala vas! Dobro pozhalovat v Sokrushitelnoe Vlechenie – simulyator vesyolykh svidaniy!
Nachnite poiski, chtoby zavoevat serdtsa milykh dam... Posle neskolkikh provalnykh vstupleniy! Proizvedite vpechatlenie na milashek, otkryvaya rabochie mesta i poluchaya prodvizheniya po sluzhbe.
Udivlyayte romanticheskimi svidaniyami, produmannymi podarkami i paroy-troykoy shchekotlivykh shuteek, po puti razblokiruya massu potryasayushche pikantnogo kontenta!

title: Hirilun [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description: Mir Hirilun — tyomnyy i strannyy gorod, polnyy neboskryobov i ukromnykh mest. Popast tuda mozhet lyuboy, no lish samye bystrye zavoyuyut tam slavu... 3D-platformer ot pervogo litsa, v kotorom vazhnuyu rol igraet kontrol vremeni i prokhozhdenie ispytaniy. Poznakomsya so strannym i mrachnym gorodom. Prygay, begay i pari v vozdukhe, chtoby pokazat nailuchshee vremya prokhozhdeniya.

title: Chipmonk [NSZ][ENG]
description:
花栗鼠！ 是一款復古風格的清版動作遊戲，由花栗鼠戰士主演。

貪吃的灰松鼠偷走了這片土地上所有的食物儲備，森林居民面臨著飢餓威脅。 扮演花栗鼠武術大師（灰、臉頰或紅），踏上危險的旅程，與眾多敵人作戰，英勇地嘗試找回被盜的食物。

你有足夠的勇氣去冒險嗎？

主要特徵：

- 兩名玩家本地合作：單獨行動或與朋友組隊
- 三個可玩角色：扮演 Grey、Cheeks 或 Red - 每個角色都有自己的優點和缺點
- 多種遊戲模式：踏上經典冒險之旅，與無休無止的暴徒戰斗等等！
- 復古像素美學！
- 易於上手：看看你能在多大程度上按下按鈕或掌握各種更高級的動作

title: Harmony's Odyssey [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
《小魔女星拼樂》是一款融合了解密玩法、神奇生物和魔法元素的3D幻想風格拼圖冒險遊戲。 遊戲故事講述了小魔女踏上神秘之地的冒險之旅，期間她調皮的寵物小猫引發了各種意想不到的麻煩，小魔女需要利用手中的法杖去嘗試解决這些問題。 旅途中，小魔女還會遇見形形色色的夥伴：沉溺於玩手機的獨眼巨人庫克羅普斯、立志要做大偵探的木乃伊、以及傳說中的神龍和巫師，他們都將對你伸出援手，共同努力恢復這個世界的和諧秩序。

遊戲特色
奇妙的3D立體拼圖-生動細緻的立體模型、引人入勝的遊戲玩法和機制，使得每一個拼圖關卡都是獨特的存在。
邂逅各種神奇生物-冒險旅途中，你會偶遇各種神話故事中才會出現的角色，並撞見他們所在經歷的小事件。
有趣的迷你遊戲-除了立體拼圖謎題，你還會發現各種各樣不同的有趣謎題和遊戲。 遊戲也將支持合作與對戰模式，與家人和朋友一起在沙發上度過閒暇時光。

遊戲亮點
●超過100個充滿魔法和神奇動物的3D立體模型謎題
●8個風格迥異的大關卡
●7種不同的休閒小遊戲玩法
●輕鬆但不失挑戰與樂趣的友好遊戲機制
●解鎖諸多魔法寶藏體驗更多樂趣
●愜意、溫馨、舒適的風格讓你如沐春風

title: Gravitar Recharged [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
你必須完成每個太陽系中的任務，為此你要適應各種極具挑戰的環境，每個環境中的重力都不相同，這對你的飛行技能是一個巨大考驗。完成一個太陽系中的所有任務後，你將被巨大的黑洞被傳送到下一個太陽系。你，能回家嗎？

《邪惡進攻：重製版》（Gravitar: Recharged）的視覺美學在《重製版》系列遊戲中獨樹一幟，採用繪畫風格和柔和色調渲染出了波瀾壯闊的場景。資深作曲家 Megan McDuffee 創作的遊戲原聲曲目更是舒緩大氣，與遊戲風格相得益彰，讓人連連稱歎。

遊戲特色：

街機模式：從一個星球飛到另一個星球，在越來越有挑戰性的太陽系中奮勇前進，探求回家之路。

任務：24 個艱巨挑戰，你能登上全球排行榜嗎？

強化道具：用你的牽引激光拾取強化道具，比如自動尋蹤導彈和 EMP 干擾器。

合作：每個遊戲模式中都支援雙人作戰，但對默契程度的要求相當之高。

戰歌助陣：Megan McDuffee 帶來最新佳作，伴你征戰未知的宇宙深處。

title: Flashout 3 [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Gde bolshaya skorost i krupnye stavki. Gde zhestkiy boy, gromkaya elektronnaya muzyka i vyzyvayushchiy privykanie vybros adrenalina smeshivayutsya, chtoby otdelit pobediteley ot proigravshikh. Gde gravitatsiya - ne bolee chem pustoe slovo. Primite uchastie v zakhvatyvayushchey borbe do pobednogo kontsa! Imenno zdes mir FLASHOUT 3 dovedet vas i vashu mashinu do absolyutnogo predela!

FLASHOUT 3 predlagaet vam sverkhskorostnoy transport, petli, pryzhki i vnezapnye, rezkie povoroty! Proverte svoi navyki na samykh vpechatlyayushchikh fantasticheskikh gonochnykh trassakh i postaraytes ne otstat! No esli eto proizoydet, ne perezhivayte! Zadeystvuyte potentsial raket, oruzhiya, bomb i min, chtoby pomoch vam srovnyat s zemley vashikh sopernikov!

Primite uchastie v zakhvatyvayushchey borbe do pobednogo kontsa! Stante svidetelem zakhvatyvayushchikh krusheniy, agonii porazheniya i sladkogo vkusa pobedy! No ne promorgayte! Vse mozhet zakonchitsya v odno mgnovenie!

> REZhIM RAZDELNOGO EKRANA
Optsiya, kotoraya nikogda ne ustarevaet, no otsutstvuet vo mnogikh igrakh. Igrayte v igru s drugom na odnom displee! FLASHOUT 3 podderzhivaet kak gorizontalnyy, tak i vertikalnyy rezhim razdelennogo ekrana. Vyberite tot, kotoryy podkhodit vam bolshe vsego!

> UDIVITELNAYa ELEKTRONNAYa MUZYKA
V FLASHOUT 3 zvuchit elektronnaya muzyka v vysokom ritme, napisannaya spetsialno dlya igry izvestnymi khudozhnikami demostseny!

> I?
- Slozhnaya kampaniya, sostoyashchaya iz 10 turnirov;
- Razlichnye rezhimy gonki, vklyuchaya standartnuyu gonku, rezhim vybyvaniya, rezhim razrusheniya i mnogoe drugoe!
- Vosem detalizirovannykh i sverkhbystrykh korabley AG!
- Moshchnyy arsenal oruzhiya, usileniy i uluchsheniy v vashem rasporyazhenii!
- 10 tematicheskikh unikalnykh trass v dvukh versiyakh - standartnoy i reversivnoy!
- Potryasayushchaya 3D-grafika!
- Dva personazha na vybor!
- Vozdushnye tormoza!
- I mnogoe drugoe!

title: Falling Out [NSZ][ENG]
description:
陷洪大冒險是一款迷人、輕鬆又易上手的2D roguelite冒險。
 
控制兩位偶然相遇的冒險家，探索古老的王國，發現寶藏（小心陷阱！）並碰上同樣迷路的店主：阿薩爾。收集物品來製作奇怪的武器和有用的物品，這些物品將協助你在這場毫無計畫的逃亡中穿越世界。
 
本應是輕鬆的假期，但拋棄行程表吧！因為你現在必須選擇自己的路。穿梭在程式生成，提供風險和回報完美平衡的關卡。幫助喬治和菲利絲克服他們的分歧，在單人遊戲或合作模式中通力合作。無論怎麼玩，都必須聯手才能攻克分散在每個世界裡的獨特障礙和挑戰。

遊戲特色

獨自上陣或找個真實隊友。
在單人、合作或對戰模式中扮演喬治或菲利絲。於不同的角色之間輕鬆切換，使用他們各自的獨特特點。
 
不附船
探索是很有趣，但不要停留太久，因為這些聖殿會淹沒！抓住能抓住的東西，免得太晚才趕到出口。噢，請別丟下自己的夥伴唷……

這裡絕無既視感！
在探索隨機生成的聖殿、威脅和出口位置時，穿越成群的可怕古代生物。每個關卡皆不相同，每場挑戰都是獨一無二的，只有加以攻克所獲得的成就感不變。
 
每日金字塔
一座隨機產生的金字塔會停留24小時，供大家一起暢玩。

製作物品
解讀藍圖、購買物品和收集廢料來建造武器和物品，協助你克服前方未知的危險。
 
爆笑對戰模式
用香蕉、煎鍋、地雷、迴旋鏢和任何隨手可得的東西製造徹底的大混亂，以便偷取你對手的戰利品。只要記住隨時保護自己的夥伴就可以了！
 
再看一次
透過慢鏡頭重播，隨時重溫每一段爆笑時刻。

title: She Remembered Caterpillars [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Eto igra-zagadka v trevozhnoy estetike fungipanka. Deystvie proiskhodit v fantasmagorichnom mire izvivayushchikhsya gusenits, yarkikh tsvetastykh Gammi i zhivoy arkhitektury, a igroki budut nablyudat so storony za popytkami uchenoy spasti svoego ottsa.

Vo vremya prokhozhdeniya, mir budet raskryvat svoyu istoriyu: chto za katastrofa tut proizoshla? I chto voobshche Gammi zabyli v etom fantasmagorichnom meste?

Pobeditel Intel Level Up Game Demo’s Best Puzzle Game Award, She Remembered Caterpillars pokazhet na chto vy sposobny v ekstrennykh situatsiyakh, davaya vam vzaimosvyazannye zagadki s postepenno uvelichivayushcheysya slozhnostyu.

Osobennosti

• Velikolepnye illyustratsii ot sozdatelya Symmetrain (IGF 2014 Student Showcase Award) Danielya Lindera Goffina.
• 40 urovney, polnykh umodrobitelnykh zagadok, pri etom kazhdyy akt predlagaet svoyu mekhaniku i tsvetovuyu skhemu. 
• Muzyka avtorstva Tomasa Khekhla.
• Blagodarya unikalnoy sisteme simvolov i form v She Remembered Caterpillars legko mogut igrat lyudi s tsvetovoy slepotoy.

title: Soul Axiom Rebooted [NSZ][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
Pogruzites v atmosfernyy fantasticheskiy mir i rasputyvayte tayny tsifrovogo nebytiya v Soul Axiom, igre-golovolomke dlya Nintendo Switch.

Otkroyte mrachnuyu pravdu ob Elizii, zagadochnom kiberneticheskom mire, gde vospominaniya i sny khranyatsya, obrabatyvayutsya i povtorno ispolzuyutsya. Pogruzites v khitrospleteniya intriguyushchego syuzheta, chtoby razobratsya, chto proiskhodit v etom mire, kto vy takoy i chto ot vas skryvayut. No pomnite: nekotorye tayny luchshe ostavit netronutymi...

•	Issleduyte zagadochnyy mir Elizii, gde ozhivayut tsifrovye vospominaniya i mechty.
•	Puteshestvuyte po stilnoy vselennoy v dukhe kiber-panka.
•	Ispolzuyte osobye sposobnosti, chtoby manipulirovat okruzhayushchim mirom i reshat khitroumnye golovolomki.
•	Poznakomtes s zakhvatyvayushchey istoriey ot studii Wales Interactive.

title: Deathrun TV [NSZ][ENG]
description:
You'll experience real-time blistering speed and bullet-dodging action as you compete for glory...assuming you’re able to survive in this 2D bullet hell where only “likes” really count.
Coming to you from the largest studio ever constructed...The show where contestants risk it all to gather likes from audiences watching all over the world; 24 hours a day. The entertainment never ends! 

With breakneck speed, bullet dodging action and lots of guns, you'll have to survive swarms of rabid mutants to progress and level up your contestant. Twin-stick bullet hell  action will test your reflexes through each arena. 

FIGHT EPIC BOSSES 
Meet Eyeball, Zangbeef the Bear Wrestler, Elite Gaurd and many more. A variety of unique and crazy bosses await you, leading to intense and challenging battles! 

GET LIKES, GET MUTATIONS, GET STRONGER 
Getting those precious likes and leveling up your likability will be rewarded with an ever-changing roster of mutations to choose from including exploding bodies and big heads. 

UNLOCK COOL WEAPONS 
State of the art studio and proprietary technology will reanimate your body ensuring that you can try again and again, and again and again...Each run offers new challenges and new opportunities to gain fame, you'll also unlock crazy new cool weapons each time you die! 

BURN…EVERYTHING. 

Have you always dreamed of barbecuing monsters? If so, you've come to the right game show. 

ESCAPE BEFORE IT’S TOO LATE 
At the end of each room, deadly traps and explosives will start to fall, so hurry out before the studio self-destructs and you with it!

title: Dark Minute Kira's Adventure [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
跟著琪拉展開一場昏暗的冒險吧！你得在平台遊戲「黑暗時刻」中試著走出陰暗，  並透過跳躍、衝刺、閃躲障礙物才能度過重重關卡，並收集 3 個能量電池後，打開通往出口的大門。不過你動作可要快點，因為60 秒後燈將熄滅。你將探索超過 100 個關卡、遊走在陰暗地牢和水下迷宮中，並在這個黑暗、美麗又複古的像素世界中，拼湊出人類的另類歷史。

準備好探索隱藏在黑暗世界中被遺忘的秘密，但無論如何，都不要讓光熄滅。

▪ 探索 100 多個大型、昏暗的關卡，場景包含地牢和水下迷宮。
▪ 任務必須於 60 秒內完成，並在燈光熄滅之前，找到 3 個能量電池並打開通往出口的大門。
▪ 享受美麗又復古的像素畫風。
▪ 深入探索並找出人類失落的秘密，這將比冒險中的其他部分都更加黑暗。
▪ 別畏懼黑暗。

title: Crypto Miner Tycoon Simulator [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Crypto Miner Tycoon Simulator is a complete simulation of the cryptocurrency mining business. There are multiple scenarios available. In the first one, you start as a teenager whose wealthy father is hyped about digital currency. He isn’t really tech savvy, so he gives you some cash and challenges you to build a crypto mining business:

Relive mining history
* Start in your bedroom in 2010
* Historically accurate coin exchange rates
* Various events including new hardware unlocks
* Speed up the game clock up to 28800x

The game uses real prices for coins, but your actions can change the course of history. For example, you can set up a PR department that will influence the media and hype some coins up or down.

Build mining rigs
* Assemble rigs from PC parts
* Install software
* Use racks to organize space and direct heat
* Replace broken parts and outdated components


A custom C++ game engine was written specially for this game in order to support 1000’s of mining hardware units per facility.

Mine coins
* Play through the CPU, GPU, FPGA and ASIC mining era
* Mine Bitcoin, Ethereum and more...
* Realistic network hash rates
* Manage power, heat, noise, dust


Build datacenters with cooling systems and low dust levels. Keep noise down in research labs.

Manage your company
* Buy or rent new offices
* Hire people
* Set work shifts and task priorities
* Pay monthly bills and wages

You can unlock overtime work by upgrading your management skill or hiring professional managers.

Research
* Develop employee skills
* Create research labs
* Discover new technology before competition
* Create your own coin and launch the ICO

Each game scenario has a special research goal related to the story.

Customization
* Customize your character
* Set dress code for employees
* Use whichever currency you like ($, GBP, EUR...)
* Imperial and metric system supported

What are you waiting for? The best time to start mining was 10 years ago, and you can relive the history in this game.

title: Crowns and Pawns Kingdom of Deceit [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
V etom ocharovatelnom priklyuchenii legendy proshlogo stanovyatsya yavyu.

Crowns and Pawns — eto sovremennoe priklyuchenie v stile point and click. Otkroyte dlya sebya maloizvestnye stranitsy istorii Evropy. Uznayte legendy Velikogo knyazhestva Litovskogo, vyvedite na chistuyu vodu zloveshchuyu yacheyku KGB, reshayte golovolomki i sobirayte uliki, chtoby raskryt tayny nekoronovannogo korolya.

Sygrayte za Mildu, devushku iz Chikago, vnezapno poluchivshuyu v nasledstvo ot dedushki dom v Litve. Pribyv v Evropu, ona stalkivaetsya s neznakomtsem, kotoryy pytaetsya ugrozami zastavit eyo otkazatsya ot nasledstva. Zaintrigovannaya devushka reshaet osmotret zabroshennyy dom i obnaruzhivaet dokumenty i podskazki, napisannye eshche v XV veke. Sobytiya zakruchivayutsya, i vot uzhe Milda otpravlyaetsya na opasnye poiski davno uteryannoy tainstvennoy relikvii...

Osobennosti:
- Issleduyte realnuyu Evropu i izuchite eyo istoriyu i legendy.
-Mnogochislennye golovolomki: predmety, manipulyatsii s ryukzakom, dialogi, mini-igry i mnogoe drugoe!
- Narisovannaya vruchnuyu kartinka, kotoraya ozhivaet u vas na glazakh s pomoshchyu sovremennykh graficheskikh vozmozhnostey.
- Mir, kotoryy reagiruet na vashi resheniya.
- Menyayte vneshniy vid glavnoy geroini, chtoby reshit zagadki (ili prosto radi zabavy).
- Polnostyu ozvuchennye dialogi.
- Muzyka ot kompozitora Danielya Farosa, zasluzhivshego mnozhestvo nagrad.

title: Brewmaster Beer Brewing Simulator [NSP][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
在精釀啤酒的極致慶典中發現、學習及掌握自釀藝術。
從精進真實的化學釀造工藝到命名、入瓶及加上標籤——在首個逼真的啤酒釀造體驗中精煉你的工藝，成為終極釀造大師。掌握行業的所有技巧且有最好的設備任你使用，你可以按照食譜進行操作，或嘗試現實世界種類繁多的原料來磨練你的技能。參加友誼賽、賺取啤酒代幣及升級你的設備，以成為更出色的釀造者。

title: Active DBG Brave's Rage [NSZ][ENG]
genre: Strategy, Adventure, Board Game, Roguelite, TCG
description:
7大特色關卡，9位獨特勇者，17種角色外觀，超過300張強力卡牌！
在手忙腳亂型即時策略卡牌《勇者趕時間》中，身懷絶技的勇者們將聽候你的指揮！
智勇雙全的你，快善用賢者時間、靈活走位和完美防禦，快速解決來犯的敵人吧。

勇者成雙，八仙過海！

新的隊友，新的徵程。每一次冒險，都可以選擇兩位勇者組隊出徵。從最初的“冒險家·艾夫華”、“遊俠·翠爾”、“盾衛·胖桑丘”開始，隨着每一次冒險，更多更強的全新勇者，也將會陸續加入戰鬥！而在八大勇者中，每一位的職業都有各自獨特的角色卡牌，和完整的天賦技能升級系統。如何組建最適合自己戰法和策略的最強勇者戰隊，就由你來決定！

就算戰鬥真的很急，我也要我的賢者時間！

在瞬息萬變的即時戰鬥中，敵我雙方動如脫兔！但是不要慌，記住善用你的“賢者時間”停緩節奏，從而做出最完美的決策！另外，勇者各種獨特的徽記技能，也能助你一擊橫掃多名敵人！！想不到吧，還可以通過技能走位巧妙回避，或是完美防禦來一轉攻勢！！！

每一次，都將是全新的大冒險！

在勇者的世界中，擊敗巨龍救回公主是永恆的使命。然而，這一次……巨龍已逝，公主卻……但殘存的勇者們卻必須快馬加鞭，探索故事的真相。只不過，每一次的冒險，都會因爲你的選擇而遭遇不同的敵人和事件，謹慎選擇你的勇者和卡牌吧，能依靠的就隻有他們了！

title: Best Month Ever [NSZ][RUS/Multi4]
developer: Warsaw Film School Video Game and Film Production Studio
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 4]
description:
Sovershite polnoe yarkikh emotsiy dorozhnoe puteshestvie vmeste s Luizoy, kotoraya pytaetsya nauchit syna Mitcha vyzhivat v zhestokom mire SShA kontsa 60-kh godov.
 
 Kakovo byt materyu?
 
 Chto takoe khorosho i chto takoe plokho? Otvetit na etot vopros vsegda nelegko, no eshchyo slozhnee, esli vy — ne dostigshaya 30 let mat-odinochka s soobrazitelnym vosmiletnim synom. Kazhdoe prinyatoe nami reshenie za dolyu sekundy mozhet izmenit nashi zhizni navsegda — i povliyat na to, kakimi tsennostyami budet rukovodstvovatsya Mitch i kakim on v itoge vyrastet.
 
 Pochemu my stali takimi?
 
 Vyyasnite, chto povliyalo na zhizn Luizy, i prinimayte vazhnye resheniya, kotorye ne pod silu prinyat nikomu drugomu. Pokazhite Mitchu vsyo neobkhodimoe, chtoby on vyros nezavisimym, vospitannym i dostatochno khrabrym, chtoby preodolet v zhizni vse trudnosti.
 
 U vsego est svoi posledstviya
 
 Resheniya DEYSTVITELNO imeyut znachenie! Razvitie kharaktera vzrosleyushchego Mitcha otslezhivaetsya pri pomoshchi [b]tryokh pokazateley, menyayushchikhsya pri kazhdom vashem vybore: Nravstvennost, Uverennost i Otkrytost[/b]. Eti znacheniya opredelyat final, k kotoromu pridyot Mitch — [b]vsego v igre 9 razlichnykh kontsovok![/b]
 
 U vsekh est svoya istoriya
 
 60-e gody vydalis vesma likhimi. «Leto lyubvi», voyna vo Vetname, mnozhestvo tekh, kto vyzhil i kto proigral v velikoy istoricheskoy gonke.
 Canned Heat «Proekhalis po strane», poka Bob Dilan sprashival, «Kakovo eto?» — ne imet doma i zhit na ulitse.
 Puteshestvuyte po strane i vstrechayte personazhey, kotorye mogut pomoch ili pomeshat Luize dostich eyo tseley. Sredi nikh — nekotorye iz naibolee protivorechivykh organizatsiy, o kotorykh vse pozabyli.

title: 漸隱的星之旋律 [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
角色使用了E-mote動畫系統。
呼吸、眨眼、說話，栩栩如生。
並且，收錄了日語配音。

絕望的春天，沒有希望的未來。  
即使在這樣的世界裡，你依然在微笑……  

在公園裡低頭垂淚的我，被一位來自英國的留學生搭話。  
總是充滿活力、陽光明媚的她，彷彿引領著我一步步找回了失去的色彩。  
然而，內心深處的傷痛，卻依舊難以彌補……  

當星光黯淡至盡，未完成的旋律，是否還能在時間的盡頭再次奏響？

title: Pixel Gladiator [NSP][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
Dalyokoe budushchee...
 Zhestokie gladiatorskie boi pokoryayut televizionnye charty po vsey vselennoy. 

Vy – uchastnik odnogo iz takikh shou, zabroshennyy na vrazhdebnuyu planetu pod pristalnym vzglyadom telekamer. Vasha tsel – proderzhatsya kak mozhno dolshe, otrazhaya ataki agressivnykh mutantov.

Ubivaya, vy zarabatyvaete dengi na oruzhie i stroitelstvo oboronnogo perimetra. Vash uspekh finansiruetsya vashimi poklonnikami, poetomu soxranyayte ix interes, ubivaya vragov bystro i zrelishchno. Vyzhivite li vy v neravnoy skhvatke za blagosklonnost publiki?

Primite vyzov i vyydite pobeditelem iz srazheniy s bezzhalostnymi tvaryami! Pobeditelem v beskompromissno krovavom shou, polnom boli i bessmyslennoy zhestokosti. Pixel Gladiator — idushchie na smert, privetstvuyut tebya, telezritel! 

-Stroyte i ukreplyayte oboronitelnye bashni i lovushki -Unichtozhayte vragov i srazhaytes s bossami
-Uluchshayte oruzhie i bronyu geroya
-Ubivayte vragov pod vzglyadom kamer chtoby zarabotat deneg

title: The World of Kungfu: Dragon and Eagle [NSZ][ENG]
description:
江湖紛亂，群雄四起，而冠絕武林的，是被稱為「東書、西博、北孤、南婆」的四位絕世高手……
這是一款懷舊像素風武俠RPG，遊戲以南宋初年為背景打造原汁原味的武俠世界，玩家將扮演初入江湖的小蝦，結識各派江湖俠客，修習武學秘笈，在多分支、高自由度的江湖中闖出自己的故事。

【懷舊像素風中式武俠RPG】
SFC、MD時代的Q版像素風，結合宋代水墨畫進行的場景設計，一段純正的中國傳統武俠故事，帶大家重溫90年代經典RPG的歲月。

【高自由度探索大地圖】
參考真實古代江河地形，設計了荊州、瀟湘、巴蜀、江東、中原等武俠大地圖，眾多江湖門派、古代城鎮、迷宮古道散佈其中，不必按固定路線，天高海闊任你闖蕩，去探索未知的江湖世界。

【多分支劇情及多路線隊友選擇】
60+萬字劇情故事，多分支主線結識不同的江湖隊友，他們或是江湖浪子、書院才女，或是朝廷鷹犬、江洋大盜，可任意選擇是與武林同道浪跡江湖，還是背靠大樹登上權利巔峰，自由書寫屬於你的江湖故事。

【多武功路線數值養成】
江湖中有眾多武林門派，超百本絕世神功，劍法、刀法、棍仗、拳掌、指法、暗器、音律等等，各家各派皆有所長，可選擇身法靈動的劍法，或是以悟性見長之劍招，不同屬性可培養成完全不同的武學套路，十幾種武學路線等待你去發現。

title: Splatterbot (Splatter Bot) [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description: 清潔機器人失控了！最多可 4 名玩家在本地多人模式中競爭，看誰能製造最多的混亂！利用場地環境與強化道具，將對手徹底淹沒在一片雜亂之中。準備好變髒吧……

title: Neon City Riders [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Looking for a 2D action-adventure mixed with super-powered urban gangs in a post-cyberpunk neon scenario? Well, if you do, Neon City Riders is right for you!

Assume the role of Rick, a rad masked vigilante in search of superpowers and companions to defeat hordes of vicious enemies, solve defiant puzzles, unlock new paths, complete engaging side-quests, and finally, free the decaying futurist Neon City that has been seized by a group of superpowered gangs!

Features

• Fight in a deep and fast-paced combat based on unlockable super-abilities.

• Explore the open-ended progression and the lots of optional side-quests to complete the game through one of the four different endings.

• Immerse in the retro-futuristic graphics and sounds inspired in the 80's pop-culture and video game consoles.

Vmeste s yunoy Achtli ty srazishsya s Zabytymi bogami i raskroesh zagadki mezoamerikanskogo megapolisa dalekogo budushchego. Pomogi ey obratit silu bogov protiv nikh samikh i vosparit nad gorodom, kak nastoyashchemu geroyu.

title: Ashina the Red Witch [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Prisoedinyaytes k Esh v puteshestvii v mir posle smerti! Puteshestvuyte v zagadochnom mire dukhov, polnom strannykh sushchestv, interesnykh personazhey i zapominayushchikhsya momentov! Esh dolzhna nayti dorogu domoy i spasti svoyu sestru.

Ashina: The Red Witch — priklyuchencheskaya igra na issledovanie mira s interesnym syuzhetom. Ispolzuyte predmety, chtoby reshat golovolomki, i beseduyte s raznoobraznymi personazhami, chtoby glubzhe proniknut v syuzhet!

Osobennosti

* Interesnye personazhi

title: Apico [NSP][ENG]
description:
APICO is a laid-back beekeeping sim game about breeding, collecting, & conserving bees! 
Leave your boring city job behind to return to your family home in Port APICO and get back to your beekeeping roots.

Set in a series of lush environments, APICO uniquely combines resource gathering, biology, and beekeeping minigames, taking ideas from a mix of real-life and fantasy apiculture & floriculture. 

On your journey you'll rediscover lost species, cross-breed new bees, and help repopulate the islands.

title: Anuchard [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Generations after the collapse, its surviving descendants have chosen you to become The Bellwielder of the magical Audros Bell. Go forth, battle monsters, solve puzzles, and restore Anuchard to its former skyward glory! 

Anuchard was known as a place of wonder and peace, a land of limitless bounty suspended in the heavens above. Five ancient Guardians gave the island their blessings... Until one day they left without a word. The Anuchardian paradise fell from the skies, crashing onto the world below. Only a tiny speck of an island survived the fall. The rest has been coalesced underground into a twisted mass of winding passages full of wild magic and vicious monsters, known simply as The Dungeon.

Generations passed as few survivors eked out an existence in the Orchard, the sole village on the surviving island, which maintains  the few remains of Anuchardian magic. Farmers tend to the fields while scavengers pick through the bones of the kingdom. 

All await the Chosen One, the Bellwielder, who will take up the Audros Bell and enter the Dungeon, wake the Guardians from their slumber, and bring back paradise.

Be judged worthy and take up the mantle of the Bellwielder. The Dungeon awaits!

The Bell Tolls

For everyone and everything. You are the Bellwielder and the Audros Bell is your best friend.

Master the Bell! Not just as a weapon, but as a most vital tool for overcoming puzzles and obstacles.

A bell can be more than just a blunt instrument of mayhem. Use its knock-back ability to smash enemies into obstacles, reposition them, and clear the way forward.

Solve challenges throughout the Dungeon with the Bell. Launch projectiles, move puzzle pieces, and utilize them creatively!

Enter the Dungeon

The warped, magical Dungeon houses the Guardians needed to restore the lost kingdom of Anuchard.

Explore handcrafted, unique dungeons. Each was changed by magic to match the personality and aspect of its owner.

Each is a unique challenge as a result. Master their unique mechanics to reach the slumbering Guardians - and unlock the deepest reaches of the greater Dungeon.

Remember your duty: Confront and defeat the Guardians in set piece boss battles, to make them return to serve the people of Anuchard.

Restoring Paradise

Assist the Orchard along the path of a Bellwielder’s legendary quest.

Rescue the souls of lost villagers trapped in the Dungeon, returning them to Orchard through the ritual of revival.

Each revived villager contributes to your quest. Farmers, chefs, herbalists, all will help you and the rest of the village to restore Anuchard.

Prepare for ever deeper ventures into the Dungeon. Cook up meals using ingredients provided by village residents, then head back into the fray!

title: Air Twister [NSP][RUS/Multi11]
publisher: ININ Games, United Games Entertainment GmbH

Oprobuyte raznoobraznoe oruzhie, spetsialnye priemy i osobye rezhimy igry.

V bitve vas budet soprovozhdat zavorazhivayushchiy saundtrek v stile rok-opery, napisannyy izvestnoy gollandskoy ispolnitelnitsey Valensia."

title: Abyss Memory: Fallen Angel and the Path of Magic [NSP][ENG]
description:
什麼是深淵記憶？

某個天堂的故事。
好奇的天使少女“瑪麗”幾乎每天都去圖書館閱讀各種書籍，重複一些假小子的事情。

一天，當我像往常一樣去圖書館看書時，我發現了一本神秘的書。
封面上只寫了一個“深淵”二字，內容完全空白。

事實上，瑪麗曾經聽過成年天使談論這本書。
在我們生活的世界之下，還有另一個世界“深淵”。

想知道一本空白的書，瑪麗想了解深淵，並參觀了天堂之橋。
而當您低頭...


用陀螺儀或觸摸操作的繪圖動作挑戰！

通過陀螺操作“保護”“幫助”“連接”“播放”
瑪麗一直朝同一個方向走。畫一條線來幫助瑪麗的冒險。

“連接”

這個世界上有些地方是瑪麗走不了的，有些地方是她夠不到的。
讓我們將腳手架連接到腳手架以到達那裡。

“幫助”

您可以遠離這個世界上攻擊瑪麗的特殊生物，並解決噱頭來提供幫助。

“保護”

您可以防禦攻擊瑪麗的敵人和噱頭。

“玩”

您可以玩噱頭的攻擊和敵人的攻擊。
通過玩它，您可以打開道路並做各種事情，所以請玩並檢查一下。

他們的
