title: Model Debut Nicola 1-2-3-4 (モデルデビュー ニコラ) [NSZ][JAP]
description:
«Nikol» — odin iz samykh populyarnykh zhurnalov dlya podrostkov. Naslazhdaytes vysokoy modoy i molodymi devushkami, rabotaya v modelnom mire, stremyas zabratsya na vershinu!.. Smeshivayte i sochetayte raznye naryady, ispolzuya modnye brendovye veshchi, menyaya svoy luk ot milykh do derzkikh, popsovykh ili zrelykh. Vyberite svoy tsvet volos iz shirokoy tsvetovoy palitry, sochetayte ego s razlichnymi stilyami chyolki i osnovnoy pricheski. Siyayte s pomoshchyu makiyazha, zapolnyayushchego detali vashikh glaz, gub, shchyok — i mnogogo drugogo!..
Poziruyte dlya modnykh zhurnalov, vybiraya naryad i pozu, sootvetstvuyushchie teme, sdelayte maket glavnoy stati privlekatelnym s pomoshchyu osobykh uluchsheniy, chtoby vzrashchivat svoikh poklonnikov!..Vo vtoroy chasti igry, prodolzhayte rabotat zhenskoy modelyu, debyutirovav v kachestve novoy rabotnitsy v nebolshom proizvodstve, naslazhdayas modoy, modelnoy rabotoy, a inogda — i lyubovyu!V tretey chasti vy takzhe smozhete nasladitsya poslednimi tendentsiyami mody! Stante novoy modelyu i stremites stat top, naslazhdayas rabotoy i lyubovyu! Ispytayte rabotu modeli mechty! Poprobuyte razlichnye stezi: zhurnaly, teleprogrammy, pokazy mod, i mnogoe drugoe!V chetvyortoy chasti, sozdayte polnotsennyy stilnyy obraz s pomoshchyu modnykh veshchey, podobrannykh populyarnym modnym zhurnalom Nicola! Poprobuyte sebya v raznykh professiyakh i voplotite svoi mechty i lyubov v realnost, stremyas stat topoveyshey top-modelyu.
Amerikanskaya versiya tretey chasti na angliyskom tut: https://rutracker.org/forum/viewtopic.php?t=6590397

title: Wing of Darkness [NSP][ENG]
description:
■故事
不明的未知敵人「虛無者」的出現，改變了戰爭的本質。戰爭轉變為一場賭上人類全體生死存亡的鬥爭。
面對展現壓倒性力量的「虛無者」，有效的對抗手段只有「海德系統」與能夠著裝該系統的「鐵翼少女」。
人類的希望「鐵翼少女」。在她們作為「鐵翼少女」飛翔之際，必須承擔犧牲的覺悟與恐懼，以及殘酷的「罪業」。
若不戰鬥人類將會滅亡，然而在戰鬥的過程中，她們將漸漸失去重要的事物。
這是一部，透過２名少女所描繪的「人」的故事……


■遊戲介紹
《射擊遊戲部分》和《過場劇情部分》交織而成的「少女」們的戰爭。
遊戲進行分為兩個部分，首先玩家們將親自操縱與不明飛行物體「虛無者」交戰的少女們，在美得令人屏息的天空中自由自在地翱翔，並以取之不盡的彈藥殲滅敵人，體驗充滿爽快感的射擊遊戲。另一部分則是透過美麗的3D作畫，由身為主角的２名少女以各自角度述說這場戰爭的過場劇情。


《射擊遊戲部分》
本作追求透過簡單操作就能在空中360度隨心所欲高速翱翔的爽快感。彈藥數量沒有限制，耗盡彈藥後經過一段時間即可恢復。可享受在戰鬥開始前選擇喜愛的武器，利用無限彈藥盡情射擊強敵的爽快感，以及穿梭在雷射武器與飛彈的混戰中，帥氣的空中戰鬥。

《過場劇情部分》
在射擊遊戲部分的前後會穿插過場劇情，由克菈菈和艾莉卡２位主角的角度，以回想的方式交互敘述故事。個性迥異的兩人從一開始相互排斥，進而化解誤會並一同成長，最終將揭開世界、虛無者和鐵翼少女之謎。

title: Awesome Pea 1/2/3 [NSZ][ENG,RUS]
interface_lang: 俄语 (2 i 3 chasti), 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Pomogite zhadnomu Goroshku probratsya cherez verenitsu urovney, zapolnennykh smertelnymi lovushkami i milymi (no opasnymi) protivnikami. Soberite vse monetki, do kotorykh tolko smozhete dotyanutsya!

Awesome Pea - klassicheskiy platformer, v kotorom vam predstoit proyti mnozhestvo izobretatelnykh urovney i pomoch zhadnomu Goroshku, kotoryy gotov proyti lyubye ispytaniya radi zvona monet. Vas zhdut opasnye podzemelya, obmanchivo krasivaya priroda, skryvayushchaya smertelnye lovushki, a takzhe mnogo... MNOGO monet!

Vot chto vy tochno naydete v igre:
- Stilnaya pikselnaya grafika, vdokhnovlennaya retro-igrami
- 30 raznoobraznykh urovney
- Potryasayushchiy retro-saundtrek

title: Meta Meet Cute Plus [NSZ][ENG]
description:
湊未來是木陽高校的一名學生，他很享受與他的靦腆青梅竹馬笹塚 愛裏一起度過的平淡日子。她盡職盡責地履行著青梅竹馬的約定，每天早上從他的窗戶爬進來叫他起床。

"嗲...*嗲嗲的*是什麽意思？你不要把這個寫進遊戲描述裏呀！"

愛...愛裏？你怎麽知道我在寫什麽？不過現在這不重要。我現在在做的是設置場景，用遊戲的背景來吸引讀者。

"嘖，好吧。我還是關掉界面吧。反正我也得走了......"

總之，正如剛開始所說的那樣......未來的平凡日子戛然而止，因為他遇到了一個又一個的邂逅對象，他突然發現眼前出現了各種浪漫路線！

"沒錯沒錯 不愧是我的主人公，他很厲害吧？嘿嘿，在我的幫助下，他馬上就會被小可愛們包圍了！" 

欸，鳴，現在別這樣，看到這篇文章的人可能會買你所在的這款遊戲。我正在盡力寫一段誘人的描述！

"哦，玩家正在看這個？好呀，我的人生目標就是和可愛的動漫女孩們一起玩！我就指望你能讓未來把其他所有的女主都介紹給我了，夥伴~"

咳咳* 正如鳴所說，有很多角色和路線值得一探究竟，因此，如何確保未來做出正確（或錯誤）的選擇，在難以預料的浪漫路線中航行，就取決於你了！

"......嘿，未來，他太酷了，不是嗎？不過，那個叫鳴的女孩說的*其他*女主是什麽意思，嗯？"

咦，流美？你有點奇怪，沒事吧？我正準備用一句 "在第四面牆之外尋找愛情 "之類的殺手鐧來結束這段描述呢，你又走神了嗎？抱歉抱歉，我得趕緊處理一下...

嘿！流美！我在下面找到的。

"哦，太謝謝你了，抱歉，我打斷了你的遊戲介紹嗎？不好意思 再次感謝你幫我找到了它"

不會再有人出現了吧？我們快完成了，對嗎？[我終於可以完成這個了

老鷹怎麼會在這裏？有3條主線要完成，還有20條支線要找

*嘎嘎

 總之請買下這款遊戲吧！

title: Tsugunohi / Evil God Korone / Tsugu No Hi Supernatural Supermarket / Zombie Scream (The Hexed Day) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
在YouTube和Niconico上非常受歡迎的恐怖遊戲《翌日》終於登陸Nintendo Switch™️！
《翌日》是一款經典的恐怖遊戲，已經被衆多著名的玩傢和Vtuber發行視頻。 讓妳體驗陷入一個循環，妳的日常生活逐漸被侵蝕成一個可怕的世界。

■唯一的操作是 "嚮左走"。
這款遊戲最鮮明的特點是 "嚮左走 "的操作。 但許多人都被正常的日常生活逐漸變異為恐怖的經曆所吸引 妳可以品嘗到 "蠕動的恐懼"，這是J-恐怖的真正快感。
妳能把搖桿嚮左壓嗎...?

■10個繫列的恐怖遊戲，具有恐怖遊戲的所有魅力!
該遊戲是一繫列的短小遊戲。 遊戲時間很短，每侷15至30分鐘不等，但緊張而濃縮的恐怖體驗會接二連三地衝擊妳。
Nintendo Switch版本包含10個短篇故事，包括與非常受歡迎的Vtuber合作。

藉此機會，妳可以親手玩一下流行的恐怖遊戲《翌日》。

title: Mighty Mike (Power Pete, khoumbryu) [NSP][ENG]
description:
Mighty Mike (takzhe izvestnaya kak Power Pete) — dvukhmernaya 2D-ekshn-videoigra s vidom sverkhu, razrabotannaya kompaniey Pangea Software i izdannaya Interplay pod brendom MacPlay v 1995-om godu; postavlyalas v komplekte vmeste s Mac OS System 7 Big Bang dlya kompyuterov Macintosh Performa. Glavnyy geroy dolzhen byl spasat pushistykh krolikov iz otdela kukol ot plokhikh igrushek, prokhodya pyatnadtsat nasyshchennykh ekshn-urovney.
Igra poluchila nagradu «Luchshaya arkadnaya igra goda» ot Macworld i zanyala vtoroe mesto v nominatsii «Luchshaya ekshn-igra» ot MacUser.
Posle zakrytiya magazina vse igrushki ozhivayut, i nachinaetsya khaos. Gruppa plyushevykh krolikov sbegaet iz svoego konteynera i razbredaetsya po vsemu magazinu, bespomoshchnye pered ordami bolee opasnykh tovarok. Spasti ikh mozhet tolko samaya populyarnaya igrushka v magazine — figurka Moguchego Pita/Mayka. Moguchiy Pit (Mayk) nachinaet svoy pokhod, chtoby spasti vsekh krolikov.
V izdanii «Biblii Macintosh» ot 1996 goda Power Pete nazvana «po-nastoyashchemu uvlekatelnoy» i «ochen vesyoloy». V svoey state dlya Computer Games Strategy Plus Piter Smit zametil: «U vladeltsev kompyuterov Mac ne tak uzh i mnogo kachestvennykh, polnoekrannykh i dinamichnykh arkadnykh ekshn-igr, iz kotorykh mozhno vybirat, no dazhe esli by oni byli, ya by vsyo ravno dal Power Pete svoe samoe goryachee odobrenie».

title: Yet Another Zombie Defense HD [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
publisher: Awesome Games Studio Sp. z o.o.
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
V Yet Another Zombie Defense HD vam predstoit kazhduyu noch zashchishchatsya ot polchishch porozhdeniy tmy. Vy — edinstvennyy vyzhivshiy, a tolpy vragov s kazhdoy volnoy stanovyatsya vse silnee, poetomu vasha gibel neizbezhna. Ostaetsya lish odin vopros: kak dolgo vy proderzhites?

Eta igra — arkada s vidom sverkhu s takticheskimi elementami, gde vam predstoit istreblyat zombi. Vy smozhete ustanavlivat tureli s raznoobraznymi vidami vooruzheniya i stroit oboronitelnye barrikady, starayas proderzhatsya kak mozhno dolshe. Igra pridetsya po vkusu tem, kto lyubit ispytyvat svoe masterstvo, iskat optimalnye strategii i borotsya za mesto v tablitse rezultatov! Takzhe zdes mozhno igrat s druzyami — kak po seti, tak i na odnoy konsoli. Srazhaytes s zombi plechom k plechu ili voyuyte drug s drugom v rezhime «Protiv vsekh»!

title: Iris Fall [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description: Fusing gameplay with light & shadow. The concept of light and shadow runs throughout the design of the game’s story, art and puzzles. Switch between light and shadow and pass through the two realities as you experience unique interlacing of black and white, as well as both 2D and 3D.

title: Littlewood [NSZ][ENG]
description:
You defeated the Dark Wizard. The world of Solemn is finally at peace, but at what cost? You can't quite remember...

THE HERO WHO SAVED THE WORLD.
+Explore the vast world of Solemn. Enchanted Forests, Bustling Fishing Towns, & Dark Mining Caves are some of the few places to visit.
+Meet Townsfolk and convince them to stay in your town. Perhaps meeting people will unlock your memories of the past…
+Collect rare items and materials found across the world and bring them back to your town for selling and crafting!

CUSTOMIZE YOUR TOWN
+Harvest materials by chopping wood, mining ores, catching bugs, and fishing in rivers and ponds!
+Unlock new structures to build by meeting new Townsfolk. Want a Tavern or a Lumber Mill? How about a Fishing Hut or a Magical Library? Your town's design is all up to you!
+Fulfill your Townsfolk's requests. Some may want to live on a higher elevation, others may want to be surrounded by trees and water. Fulfilling the requests of your Townsfolk will earn you their hearts and unlock new relationship paths.

MASTER NEW HOBBIES & CRAFTS
+Gathering: Whether you’re picking fruit or picking weeds, your gathering skill will level up! The Gatherer’s Glove is needed to unlock this ability.
+Mining: Looking for shiny ores to collect? Interested in rare materials for crafting? Then mining is for you!
+Woodcutting: Those pesky trees and debris that keep popping up all over town needs to be chopped! Wood is an essential material for building new structures and furniture.

title: The Eternal Castle [NSZ][ENG]
developer: Leonard Menchiari, Daniele Vicinanzo, Giulio Perrone
description:
The Eternal Castle [REMASTERED] is an ambitious attempt to modernize an old classic in order to keep its memory alive. Through detailed research and hard work, the production team tried to expand the experience while keeping the same 'feel' and emotional flow of the original masterpiece from 1987.

FEATURES:
• Enjoy the atmosphere or speedrun through a post-AI fallout packed with challenges
• Meditate, Predict, and Wake up, in the eternal dream with Adam or Eve (or BOTH with 2 player co-op)
• Fight your way through the Ancient Ruins
• Shoot your way through the Forgotten City
• Sneak by monsters in the Unholy Lab
• Enter the Eternal Castle
• Collect all 4 GLIDERS to power up your ship
• Use over 10 different weapons
• Unlock up to 10 different items
• Find all missing FRAGMENTS to get back home                                
• Repeat the dream for as many times as you can
• LOST TALES episode of a brave SACRIFICE, and PvP death arena mode included

title: Real Drift Racing [NSP][ENG]
description:
Prishlo vremya vypustit demona skorosti! Drift, skorost i vysokaya konkurentsiya - vse v odnoy igre!

Prigotovtes k vozhdeniyu na potryasayushchikh avto  i driftuyte na nikh s molnienosnoy skorostyu na realistichnykh trassakh.

Sovershenstvuyte svoi navyki v gonkakh i driftinge, zarabatyvaete dengi, chtoby kupit novye avtomobili! Tyuninguyte i nastraivayte svoi avto i stanovites luchshim voditelem v mire!

Pristegivaytes i nazhimayte na gaz!

V REAL DRIFT RACING vy naydete:

* Beskonechnoe kolichestvo nastroek
* Beschislennye varianty tyuninga: dvigatel, nastroyki upravlyaemosti, korobki peredach, podveska i mnogoe drugoe.
* Udivitelnaya 3D-grafika, neverotyanaya muzyka i zvukovye effekty.
* 12 trass s izmenyayushchimisya pogodnymi usloviyami.

title: The Unexpected Quest [NSZ][RUS/Multi4]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 4]
description:
在不斷建造、戰鬥、施展魔法和釀造藥劑的過程中，完成不同的任務、尋找寶藏並管理資源，為世界建立新秩序。

探索
在不同地點活動的奇怪生物正等待著您。他們有一些會幫助您，有一些需要您的協助，還有一些會喜您的頭腦… 或者更確切地說，您的新鮮大腦。您將會到訪安靜的村莊、白雪皚皚的山頂、難以穿越的森林和惡臭的沼澤。但不變的是 - 冒險無處不在等著您！

收集資源
收集所有沒有用螺栓固定在地板上的東西！矮人不介意工作，但飢餓時絕對不會動一根手指頭。泥土和木棍無法建造一個能夠運作的磨坊，所以您必須尋找適合的材料。保持食物儲備與資源充足，您的世界就會日益擴大！

建造
在湍急的河流上架起橋樑，在沼澤中建造碼頭，修復建築物，並建造新的建築物！工廠可以提供食物，鋸木廠可以提供建築材料，鍛造廠可以改進設備 - 您可以隨時在市場上出售剩餘的產品。遊戲中有多種建築風格和顏色等著您去發掘。

去探索
遊戲中有許多問題需要等著您來克服，許多任務需要完成。盡力協助每個人，並收穫您的勞動成果。在探索過程中，您還可以找到最重要的東西：真誠的感激之情。

戰鬥
一句善言加上一把劍，能讓您走得更遠，而僅靠一句善言是做不到的。僱用經驗豐富的士兵，升級他們的盔甲和武器，進行戰鬥並征服一切。那些說「筆比劍更強大」的人，肯定從未體驗過被大砍刀指著的滋味！

施展法術
沒有足夠的食物或材料？您的士兵正在因嚴重傷勢而死亡嗎？工人們決定成立工會嗎？魔法物品和藥水可以解決這些問題！儲存你的黃金，完成任務，掠奪寶箱。而獲得魔法物品的方法有很多！

title: Pine a Story of Loss [NSZ][Multi]
description:
《Pine》是一款情感豐沛的短劇情互動遊戲，透過手繪動畫和悠揚音樂講述故事，無言勝有言，正適合一口氣玩到結局，品味悠長餘韻。

主角是一名木匠，因妻子逝世，終日沉浸於悲傷之中。在這片承載著二人共同生活印記的林間空地上，形單影隻的他試著用自己的方式生活下去。

打理花園，準備過冬木材……雜務串連起日常，又被二人共同組成的溫馨回憶切得支離破碎。木匠試圖用收集到的木材復刻那一幕幕場景，捕捉片刻美好，將她留在記憶裡。

《Pine》是一款劇情驅動遊戲，透過簡單易懂的無障礙沉浸式互動，玩家彷彿化身木匠，經歷他所經歷的一切。往日溫馨回憶中滿是引人入勝的謎題和小遊戲，而艱難當下則充斥著刻意安排的種種雜務，足見「放下」並非如此簡單。

主要特色
記憶留痕，情意難平
幫助木匠完成日常工作的過程中，雜務總是會被與亡妻有關的回憶打斷。在這溫馨的一幕幕中，玩家將重溫最為幸福的二人時光，體驗各類小遊戲，共同經營人生。 

細微之處，紀念之物
木匠以精湛雕功定格記憶片段，紀念逝去的摯愛。《Pine》有著相當獨特的雕刻機制，玩家可操縱木匠之手，打造出各式紀念品，每一件都訴說著濃得化不開的思念。

默默無言，紙短情長
《Pine》並無文字表達，而是透過視覺和聽覺將玩家帶入木匠的世界。這段淒美的愛情故事，正適合一口氣玩到結局，品味悠長餘韻。

匠心創作，精雕細琢
手繪動畫風格雋永，環境呈現美不勝收，配樂和環境音效更是讓人沉浸其中、回味不已。多方面加持下，《Pine》才能如此生動鮮活。

title: Tardy [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
description:
Remto – ne samyy umnyy v mire chelovek. On lyubit nakhodit sebe problemy, a eshche bolshe emu nravitsya ikh reshat. No dazhe etot paren ofigel, kogda prosnulsya na kosmicheskom korable. Odin. Ne umeya im upravlyat. I posredi kuchi strannykh ustroystv, sozdannykh inzhenerom-shizofrenikom.

Tardy – kvest, posvyashchennyy vozne s samymi raznymi kompyuterami, terminalami, gadzhetami i prochim vysokotekhnologichnym khlamom. Vniknite v rabotu dolbanutykh mekhanizmov, raskroyte taynu ischeznoveniya ekipazha i pomogite geroyu vernutsya domoy!

- Nravitsya stroit absurdnye teorii? Zdes dlya etogo samoe mesto: ves ekipazh ischez, korabl ochen-ochen strannyy, a mir obyat voynoy i kishit predatelyami.
- Ukachivaet v VR-ochkakh? My pogruzim v igru i bez nikh: vse knopochki, pereklyuchateli, terminaly i prochee mozhno potrogat pochti chto vruchnuyu.
- Lyubite kvesty, no ustali ot vsey etoy rutiny, vrode poiska predmetov i begotni tuda-syuda? Ne nravitsya reshat zadachi, soedinyaya kozhuru banana s molotkom v inventare? U nas etogo net!
- Piksel-art eshche ne zastavlyaet vas rydat krovavymi slezami? Otlichno! Tem bolee, chto u nas on ochen dazhe simpatichnyy. Da i muzyka tozhe nichego…

title: Riverbond [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Otpravlyaytes v geroicheskoe puteshestvie: vypolnyayte zadaniya, srazhaytes s prikolnymi protivnikami i razbivayte vse krugom v melkie kubiki! Smozhete li vy i vashi druzya stat legendarnymi geroyami etogo chudesnogo mira u reki?
 
Rytsar zakhvatil predvoditeley vosmi mirov i obrushil na Rechnodole khaos, bedy i smyatenie. Preodoleyte vse pregrady, chtoby pobedit zlo i pomoch ocharovatelnym zhitelyam rechnoy doliny v etom zakhvatyvayushchem puteshestvii po prekrasnym, vruchnuyu sozdannym miram. Otkryvayte oruzhie, ispolzuyte novye obliki, aktiviruyte usileniya, chtoby s boem probit dorogu k slave!
 
Klassicheskiy rezhim dlya odnogo igroka ili khaotichnyy rezhim sovmestnoy igry!
Igraya v odinochku ili vmeste s tovarishchami, vy vsegda mozhete prokhodit igru po-svoemu. Prisoedinyaytes k sovmestnoy igre i vykhodite iz nee skolko ugodno: v kontse vas zhdet obshchaya pobeda!
 
Kubicheskie boi i upoitelnoe vokselnoe razrushenie!
V vashem rasporyazhenii ogromnyy arsenal bystrogo i moshchnogo oruzhiya: seyat khaos i razrusheniya budet ochen veselo. Snosite ogromnye bashni vzmakhom mecha, palite vo vsekh vragov bez razbora i vzryvayte bomby, prevrashchaya vse vokrug v fontany vokseley!
 
Ocharovatelnye personazhi i smertelno opasnye bossy
Vstrechayte ocharovatelnykh geroev, zavodite neozhidannye znakomstva i srazhaytes s simpatichnymi (no smertelno opasnymi) bossami. V vashem rasporyazhenii bolee 50 vidov vooruzheniya: pobezhdayte vragov v vashem sobstvennom stile. A eshche - otlichnaya priklyuchencheskaya muzyka!

title: Connection Haunted / reHaunted [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
你好，

希望你近況還好。我收到了你寄來的CD。在大致看了一下文檔後，我覺得還是有希望恢復軟體的。儘管數據有所損毀，但軟體應該還能運行。

我還沒深入研究，但這看上去像一款簡單的遊戲。不少文檔標了「地圖」，還有一些槍支，看上去像一款復古射擊遊戲。

我要去睡一覺。昨晚沒睡好，做了很多噩夢，但內容記不清了。會盡快會向你匯報最新進展。

祝好，
戴維

title: Toolboy [NSP][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
A story of a repair robot who during the weekend, instead of enjoying his free time watching a speedball game on a planet nearby, has to go to work and fix a malfunction in one of the corporate buildings, as he’s usually the one to be called in such cases.
By accident, he discovers a corporate management plot regarding a new project related to the department of power. Unfortunately, the conspirators notice they are being overheard. Toolboy attempts to escape by solving more puzzles, and the more he solves, the more skills as superpowers he gains. Our bot also has an ally in the form of an old computer disconnected from the main system. Toolboy uses special information points to communicate with him and to get more clues.

Toolboy is an old-style platform game inspired by the classics, you will find here game mechanisms from such all-time classics games.
Toolboy has 4 superpowers that launch on successive levels
- Remote control as a Controller
Power that allows to control some devices by changing their direction of rotation.
- Cube
Toolboy can turn himself into a cube that looks like an element of scenery, this disguise allows him to
to hide from drones scanning the area.
- SpeedRun
A super run that our Hero uses while speedrunning between levels to escape in from the enemies.
- Magnetic Walk
Skill that allows to move large objects, mainly containers, which can be used as climbing and jumping surfaces.

title: Symmetry [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
performance: 是 (在 6.2 Atmosphere) s ignorirovaniem versiy
description:
Issledovatelskiy korabl podletaet k zabroshennoy planete. No vse idet ne tak, i vskore situatsiya vykhodit iz-pod kontrolya. Smozhet li ekipazh vyzhit i vernutsya domoy? 

SYMMETRY — eto igra v zhanre taym-menedzhera na vyzhivanie, deystvie kotoroy razvorachivaetsya v postapokalipticheskom mire. Vasha osnovnaya tsel – upravlyaya utselevshimi, pomoch im vyzhit na pustynnoy ledyanoy planete, pochinit svoy korabl i sbezhat. Glubokiy i uvlekatelnyy syuzhet v sochetanii s atmosfernoy muzykoy i graficheskim dizaynom pogruzhayut igroka v surovyy i tainstvennyy mir. 

V khode igry vy budete znakomitsya s zagadochnym mirom simmetrii i raskryvat peripetii syuzheta. Vse personazhi — eto uchastniki issledovatelskoy ekspeditsii, chey korabl razbilsya na neizvestnoy planete. Teper im nuzhno ne tolko vyzhit, no i pochinit korabl, chtoby vernutsya domoy. Ekstremalno nizkaya temperatura i smertelno opasnye paranormalnye yavleniya sdelayut ikh zadachu nastoyashchey borboy za vyzhivanie. 

Vy dolzhny budete upravlyat kriticheski vazhnymi dlya utselevshikh deystviyami — ot vas zavisit ikh pitanie, otdykh, dushevnoe zdorove i lichnye navyki. Vam nuzhno kak mozhno bystree pochinit korabl, sobiraya neobkhodimye detali. Vam predstoit prinimat neprostye moralnye resheniya, vliyayushchie na sudbu vsey ekspeditsii. 

Vektornaya grafika peredaet atmosferu surovogo pustynnogo mira. Priglushennye i pastelnye tsveta sozdayut oshchushchenie otstranennosti i nerealnosti landshafta.

title: Lichtspeer Double Speer edition [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 俄语, lyubitelskiy 来自 djonmarvel
description:
Kogda vokrug kishat pingvikingi, ofisnye zombi i khipster-yotuny, vyzhivanie stanovitsya iskusstvom. K schastyu, na svete est vy: drevniy geroy, prizvannyy bogami, chtoby vosstanovit vo vselennoy ravnovesie i ordnung.

Khvatayte kope i prevrashchaytes v germanavta. Vyzhivayte stilno i rastite nad soboy: poraduyte vsemogushchikh bogov krovavymi poboishchami.

TsELTES. STRELYaYTE. UBIVAYTE. UMIRAYTE. TAKOVA VOLYa BOGOV! Das ist LICHTSPEER!
 
VSE-V-ODNOM
Neveroyatnoe sochetanie arkadnogo ekshna s fizicheskim simulyatorom metaniya kopya.

MIR GERMANSKIKh MIFOV - V NAShE VREMYa
Eto mir germanskikh mifov, perenesennyy v sovremennost. Vam protivostoit mnozhestvo monstrov-byurgerov zlobnye kosmotsvergi, kity-skeytery i...

VY MASTER? NATYuRLIKh!
Odin brosok kopya - i vragu kaput! Osvoyte spetsataki i massirovannye kombo-bombardirovki.

Takzhe:
- LOKALNAYa KOOPERATIVNAYa IGRA DLYa 2 IGROKOV
- BOI S VUNDERBOSSAMI
- AYNE KLYaYNE BOMBASTIShE MYuZIK
- VYKhOD SGORYaChA I NOVYE SUPERREZhIMY

title: Zengeon [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Zengeon — eto rolevaya ekshn-igra v zhanre Roguelite s unikalnymi personazhami, u kazhdogo iz kotorykh est svoy igrovoy stil. Prorubayte put skvoz polchishcha demonov i ustrashayushchikh bossov, ispolzuya sotni kombinatsiy i umeniy!
Sotni let Nebesnaya akademiya zashchishchala pechat v Blagoslovennoy zemle, ne davaya Tyomnoy pustote vtorgnutsya v mir. No... vsyo kogda-nibud zakanchivaetsya. Vo vremya lunnogo zatmeniya chary pechati razorvala velikaya sila, i mir zapolonila Tyomnaya pustota.

Teper zdes snova votsaritsya bog-demon... Vybirayte odnogo iz shesti personazhey, u kazhdogo iz kotorykh est unikalnye ataki, umeniya i predmety.

Imenno vy, student Nebesnoy akademii, dolzhny razognat Tyomnuyu pustotu i vosstanovit pechat v Blagoslovennoy zemle!

- Vybirayte odnogo iz shesti personazhey, kazhdyy iz kotorykh obladaet unikalnymi umeniyami, sposobnostyami i igrovym stilem. 

- Ni odno prokhozhdenie ne pokhozhe na drugoe. Igru mozhno prokhodit beskonechnoe kolichestvo raz, ved karty i razmeshchenie protivnikov postoyanno menyayutsya. Adaptiruyte strategiyu k raznym situatsiyam, sochetayte sotni umeniy i srazhaytes, chtoby poluchit ochki varpa. 

- Vystraivayte personazhey pryamo na khodu. Prinimayte slozhnye resheniya, vybiraya unikalnye usileniya, i pryamo v igre sozdavayte bildy, kotorye idealno podkhodyat vashemu igrovomu stilyu. 

- Soberite do trekh druzey, chtoby igrat vmeste. Obedinites s tovarishchami i vmeste vykhodite na boy s legionami tmy. Chem bolshe igrokov vy soberete, tem slozhnee budet igrat v Zengeon, ved igra dinamicheski nastraivaet uroven slozhnosti.

title: Werewolf the Apocalypse - Heart of the Forest, Purgatory [NSZ][ENG]
description:
跳入黑暗之中！

 沉浸於全球著名的「黑暗世界」宇宙中的故事驅動RPG驚悚遊戲《狼人：末日之戰 — 煉獄》的引人入勝的世界。扮演年輕的狼人薩米拉，探索波蘭及其他地方的陰影。

釋放內心的野獸 

探索被雪覆蓋的比亞沃維耶扎森林的寒冷景觀、歷史悠久的華沙街道和阿富汗的記憶。作為薩米拉，你將與怪物戰鬥，揭開黑暗的陰謀，並面對內心的動盪。你做出的每個決定都將塑造你的命運，揭示新的秘密，並導致多種結局。

塑造你的命運 

選擇你的道路：調查超自然謀殺案，還是深入了解強大狼族的秘密。你的選擇將影響薩米拉的旅程，平衡她的健康、意志、憤怒和技能。你會引導她走向光明還是黑暗？

經典RPG機制 

體驗受傳奇「黑暗世界」第五版啟發的視覺小說敘事和桌面RPG元素的結合。管理你的物品庫，掌握獨特的技能，並通過反映薩米拉內心絕望的哈拉諾系統進行遊戲。

適合所有人 

無論你是「黑暗世界」的老手還是新手，《煉獄》都提供了進入這個豐富宇宙的引人入勝的入口。遊戲內的彈出詞彙解釋、可調節字體和自定義文本速度確保了所有人都能輕鬆體驗。
在《狼人：末日之戰 — 煉獄》中，加入薩米拉尋求真相和生存的恐怖旅程。你會幫助她克服內心的惡魔和周圍的黑暗，還是讓她被其吞噬？選擇權在你手中！

Product Features:
- 調查黑暗陰謀： 揭示超自然謀殺案和狼人政治背後的真相。
- 動態敘事： 你的選擇揭示新的路徑和結局，並影響你對憤怒、健康和意志的管理。
- RPG機制： 使用技能，管理物品庫，並利用哈拉諾系統塑造薩米拉的命運。
- 豐富的知識： 從新發布的第五版核心書中適應的知識中沉浸於「黑暗世界」。

title: The Sisters Party of the Year + DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Vse nachinaetsya, kogda Vendi reshaet ustroit doma novogodnyuyu vecherinku dlya druzey. No prezhde chem ona uspevaet sprosit razresheniya u roditeley, ee nevynosimaya mladshaya sestra Morin kradet ee ideyu i sprashivaet pervoy! K sozhaleniyu, roditeli razreshayut tolko odnu vecherinku...

Morin i Vendi nachinayut bezumnye sostyazaniya, chtoby reshit, komu iz nikh ustraivat prazdnik. Sestra protiv sestry — eto garantiya nepriyatnostey! 

Otpravtes v mir sestrenok Sisters, u kotorykh nikogda ne zakanchivayutsya idei dlya shalostey! 

Issleduyte gorod Sisters, vypolnyayte zadaniya i prokhodite ispytaniya v rezhime priklyucheniy.

Veselites vmeste s semey i druzyami v odnom iz chetyrekh rezhimov dlya neskolkikh igrokov:
– Sostyazanie: sygrayte s druzyami v lyubuyu mini-igru po vyboru!
– Turnir: poprobuyte vyigrat turnir, oderzhav pobedu v kazhdom raunde!
– Vse ili nichego: sygrayte vo vse mini-igry podryad!
–Vokrug sveta: po ocheredi vybirayte lyubimuyu mini-igru!

U nas est 24 bezumnye mini-igry, poyavivshiesya na svet pryamo iz voobrazheniya sestrenok Sisters, — naprimer, «Brosok edinoroga», «Fabrika keksov» i «Ekstremalnyy ping-pong».

title: Sunblaze [NSZ][ENG]
description:
No budte ostorozhny, on mozhet zabarakhlit i zaperet vas vnutri… Sunblaze — eto mozgolomnyy platformer s sotnyami trudnykh, no interesnykh sozdannykh.

«A chya eto krov na stenakh?» – Dzhozi

Dzhozi ne boitsya probovat novoe. Ee otets, supergeroy na pensii, pochinil svoy geroyskiy trenazher i razreshil Dzhozi s nim poigrat. Kakoy otets ne khochet sdelat iz docheri supergeroya?

Vot tolko trenazher vdrug sletaet s katushek, i dlya Dzhozi stavkoy stanovitsya ee zhizn. V nashem neprostom tonko nastroennom platformere vy igraete za Dzhozi po prozvishchu Sunblaze, pytayas proyti kurs obuchenie supergeroev. V trenazhere chego tolko net: golovolomki, prepyatstviya, vzryvchatka, shipy, drony... Zato u vas est zamurchatelnyy drug — kot. A kogda est kot, chto eshche nuzhno?

Nu, naprimer, lovkost ruk. Ona vam tochno ponadobitsya. Trenazher postoyanno menyaetsya, i s nim menyayutsya i zadachi – nekotorye iz nikh mozhno prokhodit chasami.

Byt roditelem voobshche neprosto, no u nas tut eshche slozhnee.

Tak, roditeli, kotorye nikogda ne teryali svoikh detey, podnimite ruki! To-to zhe. No vy khotya by ne teryali ikh v bezzhalostnom trenazhere dlya supergeroev s lazerami, zlymi robotami, shipami i... Sami uvidite, chto eshche u nego vnutri!

VNIMANIE: igra v Sunblaze mozhet vyzvat rezkoe razvitie intellekta.

Chtoby vyzhit na vsekh nashikh urovnyakh, pridetsya poshevelit mozgami. No ne pugaytes, ved kak skazal Aristotel: «Sosredotochsya — i v temneyshiy iz momentov uvidish svet». Ili vot Kventin Tarantino: «Malo na chto tak interesno smotret, kak na nasilie». 

Vy chto, eshche chitaete? Idite uzhe igrat! V odnom my uvereny tochno: ni v odnoy drugoy igre nelzya 5000 raz podryad umeret s takim udovolstviem.

title: Stonefly [NSZ][ENG]
description:
在加拿大最大遊戲展MEGAMIGS 2021
榮獲藝術類最佳獎
(BEST ART DIRECTION AND ARTISTIC ACHIEVEMENT)

這款冒險遊戲的主角Annika Stonefly是一個聰明伶俐卻不諳世事的發明家，她將在大自然之中駕駛強力的機甲──Rig，為了奪回遺失的傳家寶而踏上旅程。
滑翔在美麗的植物和危險的動物之間，與饑餓的昆蟲對戰，邂逅獨具特色的角色們吧。
以探尋自我、遺產以及羈絆為主題，一場故事溫暖人心的冒險就此展開。

▷獨特的對戰方式
在環境嚴苛的自然界裡擊退野蠻的昆蟲，透過這種對戰方式獲得戰利品。 戰利品將使用來製作Rig的專用零件。 

▷自訂元素
可以依照玩家的遊戲風格調整Rig，為自己的機甲開發並改造專屬的能力。

▷採用Unreal Engine開發的3D繪圖
繪圖美術風格以手繪風為基底，靈感來自於60年代的現代風設計與自然界，建構出遊戲裡的動人世界。

▷▷超乎預期的世界觀
在Stonefly中，玩家將駕駛小型機甲Rig，穿梭在魔法森林之中。 升級用空氣與風力當作武器的裝備和零件，並沿著岩石和綠意盎然的天幕向前移動。 Annika Stonefly為了奪回遭人偷走的傳家寶而踏上旅途，並運用策略擊退具有攻擊性的昆蟲們。

▷▷嶄新的移動方式
Stonefly之中的機甲──Rig不同於以往的機械，是一台鍛造精良、前所未有的昆蟲型機器人。 顛覆與遊戲相關的常識，有些情況下會在滑翔中度過大部分時間。 因此玩家能橫越各種地形，躲避在附近爬行的危險昆蟲。

▷▷運用風與空氣
遊戲中採取運用風將昆蟲推出擂台的獨特戰鬥方式，請將您擁有的能力發揮到極限。 昆蟲有各自獨特的行動模式，為了戰勝它們需要對症下藥，使出策略。 
有效率地運用昆蟲，就能更快速地收集升級Rig所需的珍貴礦物資源！

▷▷藝術性的氣氛與視覺效果
Stonefly除了擁有優美的色調，還選用了德國音樂創作者「Natureboy Flako」原創的自然鐵克諾音樂和音效。 
敬請期待與充滿特色的外來駕駛員集團──Acorn Corp的角色們相遇。 
並且體驗遊戲世界裡的優美自然，紅葉茂盛的樹群、荊棘灌木叢，還有籠罩著迷霧的溼地地帶。

title: Staxel [NSP][ENG]
description:
Welcome to Staxel, a quaint island full of charming characters, with bugs and fish to catch, fossils to excavate and quests to complete! Settle into your new home on the farm, fix it up, fill it with crops and animals, then change it up across the seasons of the year. When you’re not farming, take up a range of hobbies to earn some extra cash, or spend some time befriending the locals!

Nurture Your Farm
Put down roots in Staxel as you settle into your new life. It’s your job to fix up, improve and maintain your homestead. Work the fields, tend to your crops, and adopt a variety of adorable animals such as cows, sheep, cats, and dogs! Make sure to adapt with the changing seasons so you can enjoy the fruits (and vegetables!) of your labour all year round!

Make The World Your Own
With an extensive supply of resources available and a tool catered to every job, you’re tasked with handling all construction in the Staxel world, from your own farm to your neighbours’ houses, the general store and even the town hall!. Will you grow the village while keeping it’s rustic charm, or take it in an entirely new direction? Perhaps you’d rather focus on your own projects? It’s all up to you, and your creativity is just the tool for the job!

Two Ways To Play
In Staxel, there are two options to tailor your gameplay! You can start from scratch and work your way up, earning money and growing your town as your farm expands or you can start out in Creative Mode, in which money and resources are no object! Build, destroy and expand all you like, without worry.

Experience Village Life
The local village is inhabited by all sorts of characters and there are plenty of fun activities to get involved in! You could be making new friends, taking up new hobbies, hitting the shops, finishing one of many collections or just catching up on the latest news with your neighbours. Village life is rich and rewarding, there's nothing quite like it!

Festivals
Changing weather isn’t the only thing that the seasons bring. Take part in yearly festivals that transform the town. Collect new items, help out the locals, and have some fun!

Make Friends, Become Roomies
Advance your friendship with the villagers through hand-crafted quests that unlock new items, crafting, and town amenities! Learn about each villager’s likes and dislikes and help them with day-to-day problems, and eventually one of them could become your roomie!

Explore Far-Off Lands
By befriending villagers, you’ll visit far-off islands across the ocean, with new resources to collect, crops to grow, animals to raise and friends to make! Or check out the portals that frequent the festival grounds. These allow you to visit special resource islands that reset every season, allowing you to gather resources without needing to dig up your village!

title: Space Otter Charlie [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Kogda lyudi sobrali pozhitki i uleteli s Zemli, tyazhelaya missiya po spaseniyu ostavshikhsya na umirayushchey planete zhivotnykh vypala na dolyu... vydr. Vmeste s Charli i ego raznosherstnoy komandoy otpravlyaytes v opasnuyu missiyu cherez otkrytyy kosmos i naydite zhivotnym novyy dom. Vas zhdut zabroshennye kosmicheskie stantsii, sletevshie s mikroskhem roboty i drugie neVYDROyatnye priklyucheniya. Bolee desyati uvlekatelnykh urovney, gde vy mozhete esli uzh ne plavat, to prygat, parit i dazhe letat!

Klassicheskiy platformer i nulevaya gravitatsiya - v takoe vy eshche ne igrali! Esli chto-to ne privincheno k poverkhnosti, ono parit v nevesomosti! A eto sulit mnozhestvo novykh neobychnykh i neprostykh zadach dlya vashego geroya. V protsesse igry vy naydete samye raznoobraznye skhemy sozdaniya lyubogo tipa snaryazheniya: ot dzhetpakov do blasterov i dazhe... kostyuma akuly iz porolona?! Na chto ne poydesh radi svetlogo budushchego dlya svoego plemeni!


Osnovnye kharakteristiki:
• Platformer s nulevoy gravitatsiey. Vashi mozgi tochno vskipyat, poka vy budete rasschityvat traektoriyu pryzhka ili poleta, prokhodya ocherednoy zakovyristyy uroven s zakonami, podchinennymi realnoy fizike.
• Krutoe snaryazhenie i sistema prokachki. Otkryvayte novye sposobnosti i sozdavayte novoe snaryazhenie iz detaley, kotorye popadutsya vam na puti. Pustite v khod luch otrazhatelya, chtoby vashi vystrely rikoshetili za ugly, ili ostavte posle sebya vyzhzhennyy put, skolzya cherez polchishcha vragov s pomoshchyu elektroslayda. U Charli pripaseny samye klassnye igrushki - ot dzhetpakov do raketnykh ustanovok.
• Prikolnye skafandry. Razumeetsya, lyuboy vydre dlya vyzhivaniya v kholodnom bezvozdushnom prostranstve nuzhen skafandr, no i v nem mozhno vyglyadet stilno (i MILO)! Chertezhi dlya novykh skafandrov razbrosany po vsey igre. K kazhdomu zabavnomu kostyumu prilagaetsya sobstvennoe moshchnoe oruzhie! Khotite uznat, kak vyglyadit vydra v kostyume akuly? Charli vas prikroet!
• Dinamichnyy multipleer. Khotite eshche bolshe dinamiki? Srazites v yarostnom poedinke s druzyami na arenakh na 4 igroka. Srazhaytes za edu v rezhime ""Ezhovaya bitva"" ili porvite vsekh na shuby v myasorubke ""Iz shersti von"".

title: Ravensword Shadowlands [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Posle padeniya Ravengarda mir pogruzilsya v khaos. Korolevstvo Tirey v odinochku protivostoyalo masse temnykh elfiyskikh zakhvatchikov. Mech Vorona byl poteryan, i nachalis temnye vremena. Buduchi potomkom drevney korolevskoy dinastii, tolko vy imeete pravo zavladet snova Mechom Vorona i vosstanovat to, chto bylo utracheno.

Issleduyte obshirnyy i bogato detalizirovannyy mir, sobirayte moshchnoe oruzhie i predmety, uluchshayte svoi navyki i sleduyte gluboko prorabotannoy syuzhetnoy linii, chtoby raskryt tayny korolevstva Tirey.

Legko pereklyuchaytes mezhdu vidom ot pervogo i tretego litsa, osvaivaya razlichnye navyki, prinimaya resheniya, vliyayushchie na zadaniya i reputatsiyu!

Osobennosti:
* Mnozhestvo variantov nastroyki personazha i vypolneniya zadaniy
* Srazhaytes s razlichnymi tipami vragov, vklyuchaya ogromnykh doistoricheskikh sushchestv
* Poluchaemye vami zadaniya, sostoyashchie iz neskolkikh chastey, zavisyat ot ranee prinyatykh resheniy
* Ispolzuyte razlichnoe oruzhie, takoe kak luki, topory i mechi
* Reflektornyy i tochnyy boy s blokirovkoy i ukloneniem

title: Persephone [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
Uzhe dostupno polnoe izdanie «Persefony»! Bolee 100 urovney v 10 glavakh. 3 polnye istorii Persefony, Demetry i Aida i mnogoe drugoe dlya issledovaniya!

«Persefona» — eto igra-golovolomka, v kotoroy issleduyutsya sleduyushchie vozmozhnosti: chto esli smert ne konets, v klyuch k resheniyu golovolomok? Gde, kogda i kak vy khotite umeret, chtoby prodolzhit razvitie? 

Otkroyte dlya sebya bolee 100 golovolomok v 10 razlichnykh vidakh obstanovki, kazhdaya s unikalnymi mekhanizmami. 

Perenesites v etot volshebnyy mir s krasivoy grafikoy i charuyushchey muzykoy.

title: Onirike [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Mechty leleyutsya nadezhdami, oni est u nas s detstva i nazyvayutsya mechtami poka ne budut ispolneny. Odnako... Ty kogda-nibud zadumyvalsya, chto proiskhodit s mechtami, kotorye nikogda ne sbyvayutsya?

Onirike - eto originalnaya priklyuchencheskaya videoigra i golovolomka na platforme 3D, deystvie kotoroy razvorachivaetsya v zamyslovatom otkrytom mire, sozdannom pri pomoshchi nelineynogo povestvovaniya i predstavlennom v svoeobraznoy graficheskoy i zvukovoy estetike.

Vo vremya igry polzovatel beret na sebya rol Prieto, strannogo sushchestva, kotoroe ne znaet svoey sobstvennoy prirody, no obladaet unikalnoy sposobnostyu stanovitsya nevidimym. Issledovanie, tayny i vyrashchivanie gipsofily stanut klyuchom k razgadke istorii Prieto i togo mira, v kotorom on obitaet.

Osnovnye kharakteristiki:

Issleduy zamyslovatyy otkrytyy mir Onirike.
Otkroy dlya sebya ego plenitelnuyu nelineynuyu istoriyu.
Pozvol sebya udivit ego svoeobraznym graficheskim i zvukovym stilem.
Razvey novye navyki Prieto.
Vyrashchivay gipsofilu strategicheski.
Izbegay pozhirateley dush s pomoshchyu nevidimosti.

title: Nuts [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
準備好你的露營車、打開你的GPS、攤開你的地圖並深入梅爾摩斯森林。身為菜鳥實地研究員，你在白天放置相機，晚上觀看錄影片段，追蹤跑動迅速的松鼠。

牠們把堅果藏在哪裡？牠們在哪些謎之路徑行動？牠們為什麼表現得如此怪異？

包括
以監視與追蹤為主的遊戲內容
有完整配音，引人入勝的故事情節
大膽的視覺效果和音效，讓你被栩栩如生的森林包圍


放置你的相機
你的任務簡報會給你一個起點，但是你必須透過嘗試與犯錯，決定最佳的設備布局。在日間輕鬆探索謎樣梅爾摩斯森林的美景與謎團，直到夜幕降臨……


分析影像片段
……在DIY的控制中心檢視所有錄下的內容。仔細梳理影片中的資訊來完成你的任務，並把證據傳回給你在研究機構的老闆妮娜·紹茲博士。有你們兩個聯手，也許你能找出真相？


開始行動
你是維亞戈大學毫無起色的研究中的一個小角色。你被送到梅爾摩斯森林的狹小露營車獨自居住。你的工作呢？找出原生松鼠的巢穴以及牠們的神祕行動。

title: Nongunz Doppelganger edition [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Nongunz 是一個虛無主義的動作平台遊戲 roguelike。

遊戲玩法和主題都晦澀難懂，這是一個需要犧牲的謎語。

從頭開始重建，Doppelganger Edition 是原版的重製版，以前從未在控制台上發布，並具有兩種全新模式：競技場和本地合作。

主要特點：
無情的遊戲玩法，將挑戰您的技能和智慧

整個遊戲就是一個謎。 揭開Nongunz虛無主義宇宙背後的神秘面紗

title: Nerf Legends + 6 DLC [NSP][ENG]
description:
V igre NERF Legends vy popadete v nauchno-fantasticheskiy mir budushchego, gde stolknetes s legionami nedruzhelyubnykh robotov i ustrashayushchimi bossami. Vooruzhites blasterami NERF, sozdannymi po obrazu i podobiyu realnykh igrushek etoy serii, i srazhaytes s uzhasayushchimi vragami sredi unikalnykh neobychnykh peyzazhey, delaya vpechatlyayushchie slozhnye vystrely. Dostatochno li khorosho vy vladeete oruzhiem NERF, chtoby stat legendoy NERF?

• Extreme Games vmeste s oruzhiem NERF! Delo proiskhodit v neobychnykh mestakh: vy budete igrat na takikh kartakh, kak «Osada kreposti», «Nepriyatnosti v dzhunglyakh», «Ragnaryok» i «Perestrelka v kosmoportu»!

• V kampanii dlya odnogo igroka vy srazites s upravlyaemymi II robotami raznykh tipov, a takzhe vstupite v bitvu s pyatyu bossami i proydete napryazhennye ispytaniya
• Ispolzuyte uskoriteli i trampliny, chtoby pruzhinit i letat po miru igry!
• Reshayte golovolomki i prokhodite ispytaniya, ispolzuya blastery!
• Prokhodite polosy prepyatstviy NERF i poluchayte luchshie nagrady!
