title: Sonic CD (Decompilation) [NSP][ENG]
developer: Sonic Team, Blit Software, RubberDuckyCooly, heyjoeway
description:
Sonic the Hedgehog CD (yap. ソニック・ザ・ヘッジホッグ CD, Sonikku dza Khedzikhoggu Si: Di:), na territoriyakh Evropy i SShA izvestna pod nazvaniem Sonic CD — videoigra v zhanre platformer, razrabotannaya kompaniey Sonic Team i izdannaya Sega osenyu 1993 goda, pervaya i edinstvennaya igra serii Sonic the Hedgehog, vyshedshey na pristavku Sega Mega-CD.
Sonic the Hedgehog CD vypolnena v dvukhmernoy grafike, a igrovoy protsess pokhozh na predydushchie igry serii. Po syuzhetu doktor Robotnik, posetiv Malenkuyu planetu, khochet ispolzovat Kamni Vremeni, sposobnye kontrolirovat khod vremeni. Yozh Sonik, uznav ob etom, otpravlyaetsya na issledovanie planety. Po puti on vstrechaet Emi Rouz, odnako vskore eyo pokhishchaet Metal Sonik, metallicheskaya kopiya sinego ezha..

title: Monster Harvest [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
趣味橫生的耕作歷險！
發展自己的農場，建造和定制自己的房屋，製作自己的專屬傢俱，調製美味果醬，變異作物 – 產生可以帶去戰鬥的忠誠勇猛夥伴！

在植獸寶地的旅程中，你將發現奇特的粘質 – 借助它們，可以讓自己的作物以絕難想像的方式進行變異！根據季節、粘質或變異的作物，你可以創造出多達 72 種不同的變異！

植獸是忠誠的變異作物，無論何種情況都會陪伴在你身旁。它們會是你在植獸寶地探險、參加激動人心的回合制戰鬥、探索地下城、擊敗邪惡的 SlimeCo. 的關鍵夥伴。

植獸寶地有三個獨特的季節，它們會影響你遊玩的方式 – 以奇特的天氣和季節變更影響可種植的作物 – 注意奇特變異，它們會隨著季節有所變化！
在《Monster Harvest》中，有多種方式建造和定制最好的農場！製作和放置數十種物品，通過製作裝飾物品，將自己的農場提升到下一等級！解鎖灌溉管道、醃制機和更多將新鮮收穫的作物變成可以上市銷售的產品的工具。

- 以突變進行耕耘！利用神奇粘質，將生長於你農場中的作物突變。
- 探索植獸寶地。一些粘質可將你的作物突變為植獸！ 
- 帶上忠實的夥伴前去戰鬥，將植獸寶地從邪惡的 SlimeCo. 手中拯救出來。  
- 三個獨特季節：旱季、雨季和無光季 – 奇特天氣外加季節變換影響玩家可種植的作物。
- 深入植獸寶地的城鎮 – 發現生活在此的人與生物，建立關係以獲得折扣。
- 為自己的農場和房屋製作數十種物品。

title: Marchen Forest Mylne and the Forest Gift [NSZ][ENG]
description:
在一座遙遠的森林深處，
住著一群不可思議的居民。
這是關於不可思議的森林中的一位女孩的小小冒險故事。

《故事背景》
森中藥鋪的女孩梅露在不可思議的森林中尋找材料，並調合各式各樣的材料製作藥品。
在被捲進某起事件後，原本讓人暖心的童話奇幻風格故事發展急轉直下，使得梅露必須挑戰森林深處的地下遺跡。

《關於本作》
在這款風格獨具的RPG作品中，玩家將能享受到冒險遊戲與迷宮探索RPG等各種不同元素。
故事從可愛而帶有童話風格的「奇幻森林」開始。
隨著玩家推進章節，故事雖然仍保留著可愛色彩，但會漸漸顯露出世界觀中含有的黑暗童話元素。

title: Love Choice (LoveChoice) [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Eto nachalo novykh otnosheniy. Privedut li oni k radosti ili pechali? 

V LoveChoice vy vybiraete deystviya, kotorye opredelyayut razvitie otnosheniy. Vybirayte otvety v kazhdoy situatsii v etikh trekh istoriyakh.

Trogatelnye istorii v etoy igre na udivlenie realistichny i ponyatny. Nezavisimo ot togo, odinoki li vy, sostoite v otnosheniyakh ili prosto ishchete zapominayushchiysya novyy igrovoy protsess, LoveChoice budet pravilnym vyborom! 

Kharakteristiki
* 3 korotkie istorii o lyubvi s raznymi kontsovkami
* Trogatelnyy i realistichnyy opyt otnosheniy
* Raznoobrazie mekhaniki igry
* Krasivaya grafika i priyatnaya muzyka
* Kombinatsiya vizualnoy novelly i igry-klikera
* Pobeditel konkursa Indie Prize Asia 2019 v kategorii «luchshaya istoriya»

title: Little Kite [NSZ][RUS/Multi3]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 3]
description:
V igre osveshcheny problemy neblagopoluchnoy semi, v kotoroy kto-to opuskaet ruki, a kto-to pytaetsya iz poslednikh sil chto to ispravit.
Glavnymi personazhami yavlyayutsya Mariya i ee syn Andrey. Posle gibeli muzha, Mariya vykhodit zamuzh vtoroy raz, za Olega, pytayas sozdat polnotsennuyu semyu dlya svoego syna. No bytovye problemy pogloshchayut novogo muzha i on nakhodit uteshenie v alkogole. A vskore i domashnee nasilie stanovitsya obychnym delom.

Terpenie i bezdeystvie Marii, takoe privychnoe i udobnoe dlya vsekh krome malenkogo Andryushi, privodit zhizn semi k predelnoy tochke, kogda ey nuzhno prinimat smeloe reshenie.

title: Gods Will Fall [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Vy — poslednyaya nadezhda chelovechestva

Muchitelnoe pravlenie bogov nad lyudmi prodolzhaetsya tysyacheletiyami. Upivayas zhestkostyu i chuzhimi stradaniyami, oni trebuyut slepogo podchineniya i pokloneniya, skreplyonnogo klyatvoy sluzhby ot kazhdogo muzhchiny, kazhdoy zhenshchiny, kazhdogo rebyonka. Tekh zhe, kto otkazhetsya podchinyatsya bozhestvennoy vole, budet zhdat medlennaya i bezzhalostnaya smert.
 
Proydite zhestokie ispytaniya vmeste s otvazhnym otryadom voiteley, stremyashchikhsya vyrvatsya iz bezzhalostnoy khvatki bogov, vtsepivshikhsya v chelovechestvo. Kazhdyy i kazhdaya, kto mozhet podnyat klinok, slishkom dolgo terpevshie zverstva bozhestvennogo gospodstva, sostavyat vash klan iz 8 keltskikh vyzhivshikh — i vstanut protiv polchishch uzhasayushchikh chudishch i prispeshnikov, obitayushchikh v infernalnykh tsarstvakh bogov. 
 
Kazhdoe prinyatoe reshenie budet zapolnyat stranitsy unikalnoy istorii. Oderzhivayte pobedy, i na vashikh glazakh rodyatsya legendy. Ostupaytes — i smotrite, kak zhizni obrashchayutsya v prakh.

title: Ginka [NSZ][ENG]
description:
視覺小說『GINKA』將在Nintendo Switch™登場！

■概要

在某個夏日祭的夜晚，主人公的兒時玩伴——銀花遭遇神隱，消失得無影無蹤。
自事件發生之後，已經過去了五年。
成為了高中生的青羽流星乘坐渡輪，重返姬之島。
他迫切地想要知道銀花的下落。
說不定，她已經平安無事地回到家中，正就讀於島上的高校，過起了平凡的生活……
然而，淡淡的期待終究還是落空。
自那一夜，銀花便不知所蹤。
流星大失所望，決定離開姬之島。就在這時，他經歷了一場不可思議的重逢。
出現在他面前的，是仍保持舊時模樣的少女——Ginka。
“歡迎回來”
Ginka連自己的名字都不已不記得。
只記得“流星”這一名字，以及對他的愛慕之情。
迄今為止，她到底身處何方？
為何保持年幼時的模樣？
流星將在這座生活節奏緩慢的小小島嶼上，與從神隱歸來的青梅竹馬之友一起。
度過宛如童話一般的暑假。

title: Forward To The Sky [NSZ][ENG]
description:
公主為了擊倒傳說中的魔女成為勇者，乘坐熱氣球踏入了高聳的天空塔。謠傳只要收集水晶就能解開天空塔的歷史，發現魔女的行蹤。被嘲笑為搗蛋鬼的野丫頭公主，期望證明自己扭轉印象，拿起了巨劍，掃蕩一路上的魔物，向著塔頂出發。

・收錄日文及英文語音
・難易度分為普通、簡單、困難，3個階段
・除了主要關卡以外，還收錄了以戰鬥為重的小遊戲「怪物襲來」與朝著塔頂收集水晶的跑酷遊戲「天空迴廊」。

配音演員：公主騎士 宮崎珠子／魔女 桜木つぐみ

title: Evertried [NSP][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Evertried是一款以45度俯視做為視角的戰術輕度Rogue遊戲。你為了遁入來生，需要攀爬一座神秘的高塔，與塔中的怪物們進行回合制戰鬥。高塔的每一層都是一次獨特的挑戰，需要你動動腦筋、運用策略、巧妙站位擊敗各種敵人。合理規劃你的移動與攻擊，巧妙利用各類技能與環境消滅敵人，為了你的宿命向塔頂出發吧！

在Evertried中，你的舉動決定敵人何時移動。也就是說，你永遠第一個行動。快速擊殺的爽快？還是按部就班的邏輯？得益於本遊戲自由的回合制行動機制，你想怎麼玩就怎麼玩。根據具體情況，合理組合使用移動、攻擊、衝刺、技能甚至是環境殺來消滅敵人、保全自己。這可是破關取勝的秘訣！ 

你的Evertried你做主！走一步，看三步！學會如何使用精妙的策略吊打笨笨的敵人，一路殺到塔頂吧！

來一場策略頭腦風暴
連續命中或擊殺敵人能夠累積“專注等級”，“專注等級”可以為你的碎片收益帶來加成，並且解鎖各種特殊能力（我們叫它們“特質”）。在地圖上掛機發呆或四處悠晃，只會導致你的“專注等級”持續下降，所以一定要動起來！巧妙的引誘敵人，利用環境殺擊中或者消滅他們同樣可以提高“專注等級”，記得在你的策略中好好運用環境殺。

你比敵人聰明？好好運用衝刺和技能吧
如何移動與攻擊也是要講究策略的。“衝刺”能夠讓你一次移動兩倍的距離，而且無視碰撞體積，用來越過障礙物或是轉移位置再好不過了。別忘了使用“技能”和“特質”。前者主動觸發，後者被動生效。合理組合運用它們，創造出屬於你自己的搭配！“技能”的精通能夠永久保留，而“特質”則隨著“專注等級”的提升而變得更強。

攀登高塔，直面命運
高塔共有50層，分為5個區域。每個區域都各具特色，並且都會出現新的敵人。爬得越高，你就會遇到更複雜的樓層。每個區域內都會出現一個商店層，你可以花費打怪掉落的碎片來購買技能和特質或者治療自己。合理的規劃能夠讓你的登頂之路更加輕鬆。 

戰勝Boss，超越自我
在每個區域的最後一層，你都會遇見一名守衛著高塔的“守護者”。他們將作為每個區域的關底Boss，對你的戰鬥技巧和策略進行最終考驗。生命點降為0後，作為遊戲主角的“戰士”就會魂飛魄散，並失去之前獲得的所有能力，在第1層重新復活並再次開始爬塔。但是別擔心，“技能”的精通是能夠永久保留的。涅盤吧戰士，直面你的命運！

title: Cyberhive [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
description:
Survive, gather resources, expand your crew, improve your starship, and pave the way through outer space – full of hostile races. Your path will consist of difficult choices and everyone will have an influence on the outcome.
…and perhaps you might be able to solve the mystery of this universe.

FLYING AMONG THE STARS

You are the commander of the “Melistar” (“The Star Bee”), and you have a swarm of intelligent anthropomorphic bees. Your ship is your home, and your mission is to keep an eye on its fighting ability to repel enemy attacks; to stay on course, and to effectively collect resources to ensure that both the Queen and soldier bees have enough food; and, of course, to keep an eye on the status of your crew, whose members strive to get into trouble or arrange it.

OTHER SPECIES

The ship travels through an amazing universe full of strange insectoid races. Who you’ll be forming an alliance with, and who you’ll be fighting with, is largely up to you! The Merchant Guild fights the League of Smugglers; the intelligent Ants compete with Locusts for space colonies; the sinister cult of Blood Suckers spreads across the galaxy...
We’ll have to fight and trade – and every one of these decisions can be a turning point in the story.

SURVIVAL AND STORYTELLING

* You can try your hand at surviving. Space cycles alternate, resources run out – and the crew increases; but luck and accurate calculation are on your side! Competently upgrade your ship and set the right course – and you can stay alive for a certain amount of time, or maybe even break a record!
* If you like branching plots and world exploration – boldly immerse yourself in the storyline. The CyberHive universe is a mysterious and deep setting. Collect ancient artifacts and pieces of knowledge on distant planets about the past – and discover how the world turned out to be and what misfortune it faces. Maybe you can avert it... or not.

MANY EVENTS

As you try to find resources and survive, you will experience many events on the ship: from intrigues within the crew and problems with passengers, to a large contraband “set-up” or a collision with the ghost of a legendary pirate starship. Some events form a story, and some occur randomly. But the choices within each event will also have to be considered...

...Subjects with the waist of a wasp and a deadly sting; predatory rivals and faction battles; exploring the farthest corners of the galaxy; dangerous challenges and responsible decisions.
Welcome to the world of CyberHive!
Commander, we are counting on you.

title: Curved Space [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
"Igra sdelana po motivam klassicheskikh arkad. Zdes nuzhno iskat usiliteli oruzhiya i prochie uluchsheniya, pri etom uvorachivayas ot vrazheskogo ognya, strelyaya po mezhprostranstvennym zhukam i srazhayas s ogromnymi bossami. V kampanii s vetvyashchimsya syuzhetom mozhno budet legko obuchitsya igre, no vot polnostyu osvoit eyo i podnyatsya v reytinge budet neprosto!

Ob igre:

• Novyy vzglyad na klassicheskie strelyalki: dinamichnye srazheniya, kak v starykh dvumernykh shuterakh, no v izognutom tryokhmernom prostranstve! Vzbiraytes na steny, prygayte na obratnuyu storonu mestnosti i lyubuytes zakhvatyvayushchimi vidami.

• Igrayte po-svoemu i podnimaytes v reytinge: proydite kampaniyu o puteshestvii pilota, prinimayte vsyo novye vyzovy, ispytayte svoi navyki i zaymite mesto v reytinge, uchastvuya v ezhednevnykh zabegakh, srazhayas na arene, v rezhime na vyzhivanie i v beskonechnom rezhime.

• Slushayte sintveyv: v igre energichnaya elektronnaya muzyka, napisannaya v sotrudnichestve s FiXT Neon pri uchastii takikh muzykantov kak Scandroid, 3Force i Fury Weekend.

• Stanovites luchshe i pobezhdayte: ishchite uluchsheniya dlya sposobnostey i oruzhiya! Orudiya tut samye raznye, ot lazerov do ognemyotov, i u kazhdogo svoy rezhim overdrayva!


Igrovye rezhimy:

Kampaniya: sygrayte za sborshchika energii, kotoryy ugodil vo vtorzhenie galakticheskikh paukov. Vashi resheniya privedut k odnoy iz tryokh igrovykh roley, v kotoroy pridyotsya otbivatsya ot zakhvatchikov na asteroidakh, kosmicheskikh stantsiyakh i prochikh mezhgalakticheskikh urovnyakh. Kazhdaya rol vliyaet na khod igry.

Arena: proydite bolee 60 sluchaynykh ispytaniy iz igrovoy kampanii, i, vozmozhno, popadyote v mestnyy reyting!

Vyzhivanie: otbivaytes ot voln zakhvatchikov, kazhdaya iz kotorykh vsyo slozhnee.  

Beskonechnyy: prokhodite sluchaynye ispytaniya iz kampanii i vypolnyayte dopolnitelnye zadaniya, prisposablivayas k tomu, chto predlagaet igra.

Ezhednevnyy zabeg: kazhdyy den u vas budet odin shans proyti zabeg i nabrat tam kak mozhno bolshe ochkov. Ne popali v segodnyashniy reyting? Nichego, povtorite zavtra."

title: Cris Tales [NSP][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Cris Tales — prekrasnaya indi-igra, sdelannaya s bolshoy lyubovyu k klassicheskim yaponskim rolevym igram, no na novyy maner. Oglyanites na proshloe, deystvuyte v nastoyashchem i smotrite, kak vash vybor menyaet budushchee, i vsyo na odnom ekrane! Prisoedinyaytes k tolko chto probuzhdyonnomu magu vremeni po imeni Crisbell (Krisbell) i eyo fantasticheskim sputnikam v mire, kotoryy zhdyot nezavidnoe budushchee. Moguchaya Imperatritsa Vremeni i eyo sily grozyatsya ustroit kataklizm, chto razorvyot Crystallis (Kristallis) i ostalnye chetyre korolevstva v etom regione.

Daby ostanovit Imperatritsu Vremeni i izmenit budushchee etikh zemel, vy otpravites v zhutkoe puteshestvie po korolevstvam, povstrechaete i povedyote za soboy silnykh soyuznikov, kotorye pomogut v boyu. Izuchite ikh sposobnosti i unikalnuyu vremennuyu magiyu glavnoy geroini, chtoby odolet groznykh vragov: otpravte ikh v proshloe i srazites s ikh bolee slabymi, eshchyo ne razvitymi versiyami, ili v budushchee, gde vrag umryot ot yada, primenyonnogo v nastoyashchem, ili razrabotayte sobstvennuyu strategiyu v zdeshney unikalnoy boevoy sisteme.

Po mere togo kak rastyot sila Crisbell, vam nuzhno budet delat vybor s daleko idushchimi posledstviyami dlya vstrechennykh vami lyudey, i posledstviya budut vliyat na igrovoy mir v realnom vremeni. U kazhdogo personazha, vraga i dazhe korolevstva est proshloe, nastoyashchee i neskolko variantov budushchego, zavisyashchego ot vashikh deystviy. Krasivaya, vruchnuyu narisovannaya dvukhmernaya grafika animirovana pokadrovo i napolnyaet zhiznyu polnyy vozmozhnostey igrovoy mir na protyazhenii bolee chem 20 chasov igry.

V igre Cris Tales vas zhdyot unikalnoe sochetanie razvetvlyonnykh syuzhetov, innovatsionnykh boyov i klassicheskikh rolevykh elementov. Eto volnuyushchee i nezabyvaemoe perezhivanie togo, kak nashi deystviya otzyvayutsya vo vremeni.

title: Centipede: Recharged [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
鼻祖級爆炸街機遊戲經典歸來！《Centipede: Recharged》迎合現代電玩進行了重構，加入了適用現代螢幕的勁爆視效，擁有 16:9 的遊戲畫面，以及由屢獲殊榮的電子遊戲音樂製作人 Megan McDuffee 原創的遊戲配樂。

在經典街機模式下勇奪高分，傲然躋身排行榜高位。或是在多達 30 種極富創造性的挑戰關卡中測試你的水準，獲得排位，為你帶來全新、刺激的遊戲體驗。

清屏爆炸、軌道槍，甚至放慢時間等十幾種強力道具全新上線，為你提供闖關助力。每個模式和關卡都可以在單機合作模式下和朋友一起玩。

遊戲特色：

新舊交融：經典電玩《Centipede》發佈更新，操作更為流暢，更增添了適配現代電腦和遊戲機的視覺效果

強力道具：十幾種強力道具供你選擇——嚇跑敵人，側面出擊打他們一個措手不及，扔出一串炸彈，無限可能任你想像

挑戰重重：多達 30 項的挑戰，即便遊戲老手也無法輕鬆通關

勝者為王：在街機模式和單機挑戰模式下站上全球排行榜之巔

並肩作戰：任何模式都可以和好友進行單機合作……打爆巨蟲，一起上分

戰歌助陣：在 Megan McDuffee 原創的音樂節奏中大展身手吧

title: Blitz Breaker [NSZ][ENG]
description:
化身為一名具為 Blitz 的新建機器人，並嘗試逃脫創造你的工廠中的各種恐怖機器！《Blitz Breaker》是一款快節奏動作平台遊戲，且包含一大特點，Blitz 並不會跑。因此你必須使跳躍與空中衝刺來穿梭在危險且狹窄的工廠中，另外，你還得使用蹬壁、迴避陷阱與敵人武器、砸爛屏障並使用戰略思考。

時機就是關鍵！熟練你的跳躍與 4 方衝刺技能來獲得星星，這能夠用來為 Blitz 解鎖新頭型。探索秘密並開啟傳送門來解鎖更困難的挑戰。在你的電腦小幫手 Chip 的幫助下，你將能夠幫助 Blitz 完成超過一百個精心打造的關卡……並走向自由！

特色

• 透過一個按鈕與方向鍵來完成謎題關卡。
• 完成 101 個獨特關卡中，困難而公平的挑戰。
• 擊敗 4 個恐怖的魔王！
• 收集高達 20 種頭型來自定你的角色外觀。
• 探索秘密傳送區！
• 聆聽 Fat Bard 打造的電子音樂。

title: Avaris 3 (Avaris3) [NSP][ENG]
description:
<故事>
敵人是摧毀了他的家族和帝國的人類軍隊。

成為惡魔混血兒阿爾維亞公主，引導他們的靈魂。

<遊戲系統>
* 收集惡魔，訓練軍隊，大軍對大軍作戰！

* 與你訓練有素的軍隊與你的朋友和來自世界各地的人們競爭！

* 在Nintendo Switch™版本中，您還可以與家人和朋友合作玩！

<進化的原創遊戲引擎>
自從上一款遊戲《Vaster Claws 3》以來的三年裡，我們改進了專用遊戲引擎，並編寫了專門針對部落對部落的程式。
大量單位發生碰撞，這在 Nintendo Switch™ 上被認為是不可能的。

title: The Days Without Gods (Zengyu Shenjia Yu Huangyan) [NSZ][ENG]
developer: Jisen Zaozhi Gong Fang 季森造纸工坊
description:
玩家將扮演魔法協會長西索的下屬兼學徒「莫里·格蘭森」，在法師之都「塔林」中，與多年前救下的少女「柯希尼亞」及其他女性角色們相遇。
在與她們一同展開冒險的同時，主角還需要幫助她們建立彼此的良好關係，嘗試組建一個沒有血緣關係的家庭「格蘭森一家」——他最終能成功嗎？

title: Big Trouble in Little Chimney [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Ocherednoy klon Vampire Survivors!
Khvatayte drobovik, dobivayte elfov ne zabyvayte o svoey missii: spasti Rozhdestvo!.. Vyzhivite, srazhayas s beskonechnymi polchishchami sushchestv, skryvayushchikhsya v temnoy dymokhodnoy trube.
Mnozhestvo oruzhiya dlya razvlecheniya: dvustvolka, pistolet-pulemyot i potryasayushchiy ognemet dlya vsekh lyubiteley barbekyu!
Plyus prekrasnaya muzyka ot Kevina Makleoda.

title: Angry Alligator [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Spustites na boloto i otpravlyaytes v nezabyvaemoe priklyuchenie! Nachnite s malenkogo detenysha alligatora i vyrastite v samuyu bolshuyu i uzhasnuyu reptiliyu. Eshte vse, chto dvizhetsya, i dazhe bolshe, chtoby vy mogli stat bolshim i silnym, chtoby protivostoyat vsem predstoyashchim ispytaniyam.

Sudba bolota i vsego, chto v nem obitaet, lezhit na vashikh cheshuychatykh plechakh! Uzhasnye khumany zakhvatili vlast, i tolko vy mozhete ikh otpugnut! No ne boytes! Vy ne budete odinoki. Poslushayte slova Wisecroc - samogo mudrogo krokodila v gorode - poka on vedet vas po myagkomu i bolotistomu puti k velichiyu alligatora.

Ispolzuyte svoyu smekalku, svoi chelyusti i vse glupoe oborudovanie, kotoroe vy mozhete nayti, chtoby prevratit boloto obratno v veseloe ubezhishche, kakim ono bylo kogda-to! Spasite svoikh sobratev-alligatorov iz lap uzhasnykh khumanov i ikh zlobnykh eksperimentov. Otpugnite nadoedlivykh turistov, zasoryayushchikh vashe krasivoe boloto, spasaytes ot dronov, pytayushchikhsya skhvatit vas, i srazites s bolshimi zlobnymi bossami!

Vy zhazhdete priklyucheniy? Na tebya rasschityvaet vse boloto!

• Prisoedinyaytes k malenkomu alligatoru v bolshom priklyuchenii, chtoby osvobodit ego dom ot etikh uzhasnykh khumanov! Nikto ne trogaet tvoe boloto!
• Stante edinym tselym s mudrostyu Wisecroc i uznayte puti bolota.
• Issleduyte krasochnyy i ogromnyy otkrytyy mir, napolnennyy sushchestvami, kotorykh nuzhno vstrechat i est, khumanami, kotorykh nuzhno otpugnut, bossami, s kotorymi nuzhno srazhatsya, i mnozhestvom sekretov, kotorye nuzhno otkryt!
• Prevratites v samogo bolshogo alligatora v bolote i eshte vse, chto vstrechaetsya na vashem puti: ot lyagushek, ptits i dazhe medvedey do istochnika vsego zla - khumanov!
• Vybirayte iz razlichnykh alligatorov i igrayte za nikh - ili dazhe naryazhayte ikh! Kto skazal, chto alligatoram nelzya nosit shlyapy? Ili pariki?
• Delayte vse vozmozhnoe, chtoby vozitsya s etimi vonyuchimi khuliganami! Sovershayte nabegi na ikh lagerya, vytaskivayte ikh cherez tualety ili dazhe vzryvayte ikh s pomoshchyu VZRYVOV! Vremya mesti!

title: Always Sometimes Monsters [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Bez deneg i neudachi vy obnaruzhivaete, chto serdtse razbito i nakhoditsya na grani krakha. Vash domovladelets zabral klyuch, vy ne mozhete zakonchit rukopis, a vash vozlyublennyy vykhodit zamuzh za drugogo. Ne imeya vybora, krome kak spravitsya so vsem, chto brosaet vam zhizn, vy otpravlyaetes v otkrytuyu dorogu s missiey vernut lyubov vsey svoey zhizni. Rasskaz ottuda zavisit ot vas. Mozhno li spasti vashu zhizn, ili my vsegda inogda yavlyaemsya monstrami?

Vybor
Syuzhetnyy opyt, v kotorom osnovnoe vnimanie udelyaetsya otnosheniyam i emotsionalnym svyazyam, a ne traditsionnym rolevym srazheniyam i priklyucheniyam. Nereshitelnost - vash vrag, a sochuvstvie - vashe oruzhie v poiskakh poslednego shansa vernut lyubov vsey svoey zhizni.

Obstoyatelstvo
Vybirayte iz personazhey raznogo pola, rasy i seksualnykh predpochteniy i perezhivayte obshchie perezhivaniya i unikalnye trudnosti kazhdogo v zavisimosti ot vashego vybora. NPC mogut otnositsya k vam po-raznomu v zavisimosti ot vashego pola, rasy ili seksualnykh predpochteniy, otkryvaya i zakryvaya raznye puti na svoem puti.

Posledstvie
Kazhdoe prokhozhdenie napolneno oshelomlyayushchim kolichestvom raskhodyashchikhsya putey, kotorye mozhno obnaruzhit kak s pomoshchyu yavnykh deystviy, tak i s pomoshchyu tonkogo vybora v razgovore. Puteshestvie, kotoroe vy proydete, budet adaptirovano k vashemu lichnomu eticheskomu kompasu, poskolku vashi resheniya, kak soznatelnye, tak i podsoznatelnye, izmenyat vashu sudbu.

title: Alterity Experience [NSZ][ENG]
description:
安東康威爾 (Anton Cornwell) 是北加州的農民，對於最近在農作物上附著的某種神秘紫色物質感到困擾。
起初、他還以為只是其他同業誇大其詞，但直到當他自己農場的玉米與其他農作物上，也開始附著謎樣的紫色物質時，他決定進行調查。
有一天，妻子和孩子外出看電影後，事情突然急轉直下。某個神秘的不明物體開始試圖闖入房屋。
安東能否避開試圖入侵的不明物體，並從無法與外界聯繫且失去電力的家中逃出呢？

這是一款利用影像和音樂營造出如同 70～80 年代科幻恐怖電影的世界觀，採用第一人稱視角的 3D 冒險遊戲，。
請享受與不明物體間的攻防戰鬥及解謎，尋找充滿緊張感的逃生方法的樂趣。

title: Zero Zero Zero Zero / 0000 [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Zero Zero Zero Zero — eto unikalnyy 1-bitnyy platformer nizkogo razresheniya, brosayushchiy vyzov igrokam na mnozhestve urovney, kotorye potrebuyut navykov i tshchatelnogo manevrirovaniya. Uvilivay, strelyay i prygay cherez sluchayno vybrannye urovni po mere prodvizheniya k pobede ili gibeli.

Plavnyy, effektnyy saundtrek, pod kotoryy mozhno igrat, preodolevaya opasnosti i vragov.

Khvatit li u tebya snorovki, chtoby zavershit vse 100 urovney?

Kharakteristiki
* Bystryy, slozhnyy, no chestnyy igrovoy protsess.
* 100 neprostykh urovney.
* Sprinterskiy rezhim, v kotorom igroki mogut srazhatsya drug s drugom, chtoby vyyasnit, kto yavlyaetsya nastoyashchim profi zhanra 1-bitnykh platformerov.
* Sluchayno vybrannye urovni, kotorye poyavlyayutsya posle kazhdoy smerti i zaversheniya urovnya.
* Grafika s nizkim razresheniem v sochetanii s potryasayushchim elektronnym saundtrekom Levi Bonda.

title: Warborn [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
VOSSTANTE
Vosstante i prigotovtes k boyu, oblachivshis v mekhanicheskuyu bronyu — vysokotekhnologichnyy boevoy kostyum. Politicheskaya obstanovka nestabilna, fraktsii vrazhduyut drug s drugom, i vsya Solnechnaya sistema okhvachena konfliktami. Vedite v poshagovyy takticheskiy boy udarnuyu silu: smertonosnykh mekhanoidov.

KOMANDUYTE
Vybirayte odnogo iz chetyrekh voenachalnikov, kazhdyy iz kotorykh predstavlyaet otdelnuyu fraktsiyu i obladaet unikalnymi silami, chertami i stilem igry. Prizovite na pomoshch takticheskoe myshlenie i razmeshchayte boevye edinitsy na pole boya, srazhaytes s mekhanoidami protivnika i nablyudayte za rezultatom: dramatichnymi stsenami srazheniy, vdokhnovlennymi yaponskoy animatsiey devyanostykh.

RAZMEShchAYTE VOYSKA
Zovite na pomoshch podkrepleniya s orbity, vybiraya boevye edinitsy massovogo proizvodstva s unikalnymi boevymi umeniyami. Sobirayte otryady, chtoby vesti ikh v boy i vselyat strakh v serdtsa vragov. Protivniki zadrozhat ot strakha, kogda uvidyat vnushitelnuyu mekhanicheskuyu bronyu vtorogo pokoleniya, nosit kotoruyu mozhet tolko voenachalnik.

SRAZhAYTES
Nakladyvayte otritsatelnye effekty, razmeshchayte lovushki, podderzhivayte soyuznikov. Vse vidy mekhanicheskoy broni snabzheny osobym snaryazheniem i obladayut unikalnymi umeniyami, kotorye pozvolyat vam napast na protivnika, primenyaya razlichnye sposoby borby. 

KAMPANIYa
WARBORN prokhodit v sisteme Auros, kotoraya zakhlebyvaetsya v voyne i politicheskikh intrigakh. Poka fraktsii voyuyut drug s drugom, nablyudayte za proiskhodyashchim s tochki zreniya chetyrekh raznykh voenachalnikov. Pered vami razvernetsya syuzhetnaya kampaniya s bolee chem 40 zadaniyami.

REZhIM SKhVATOK I M/P REZhIM
Nastroyte parametry matcha i razrabotayte novuyu taktiku, sorevnuyas v rezhime skhvatok s II. Takzhe vy mozhete vyyti v set i popytatsya perekhitrit voenachalnikov protivnikov so vsego mira v napryazhennykh matchakh odin na odin.

REDAKTOR KART
Khotite dat volyu fantazii? Sozdavayte sobstvennye polzovatelskie karty s pomoshchyu vstroennogo redaktora kart. Igrayte na svoikh kartakh v rezhime skhvatok, chtoby ispytat svoi sily v boyu s kompyuterom, ili priglasite druzey i sygrayte na sobstvennoy karte po seti.

title: Vigour (ne Vigor) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Igra-golovolomka-platformer: milaya ptichka (eto vy) dolzhna reshat golovolomki s raznoobrazneyshey mekhanikoy na 30 urovnyakh.
Smozhete proyti vse-vse-vse zdeshnie golovomoyki v kazhdom iz sezonov?

title: The Turing Test [NSP][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 俄语 来自 djonmarvel
description:
The Turing Test is a challenging first-person puzzle game set on Jupiter’s moon, Europa. You are Ava Turing, an engineer for the International Space Agency (ISA) sent to discover the cause behind the disappearance of the ground crew stationed there. Guided only by the station’s AI, Tom, find your way through the facility and discover what it truly means to be human.

• Harness the ability to transfer power between machines using your ‘Energy Manipulation Tool’ providing a unique twist on gameplay mechanics and puzzle logic.
• Learn the significance of player control as you switch between multiple perspectives to solve The Turing Test’s most challenging puzzles.
• Discover a story with multiple layers of depth and conspiracy; challenging concepts of human morality and giving freedom to players to form theories about the fate of ISA's crew members.

title: The Dark Crystal Age of Resistance Tactics [NSZ][ENG]
description:
V The Dark Crystal: Age of Resistance - Tactics Vy smozhete pogruzitsya v fenteziynyy mir Tra i stat svidetelem sobytiy, kotorye ne pokazany v seriale na Netflix. Vy povstrechaetes s novymi personazhami i budete issledovat novye oblasti!
Primite uchastie v 80 unikalnykh poshagovykh bitvakh, kotorye budut proiskhodit v raznykh ugolkakh mira Tra. Zaruchites podderzhkoy novykh soyuznikov i uluchshayte sobstvennye voyska, osnashchaya ikh novym snaryazheniem!

title: The Bluecoats North and South [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Vstrechayte starykh znakomykh — serzhanta Korneliusa M. Chesterfilda (Cornelius M. Chesterfield) i kaprala Blatcha (Blutch): vas zhdet remaster igry, v kotoroy pokhodovaya strategiya sochetaetsya s dinamichnymi srazheniyami v realnom vremeni. Eta versiya poraduet poklonnikov originalnoy igry, vyshedshey na Amiga v 1980-kh godakh!

Stante masterom pokhodovoy strategii, chtoby oderzhat pobedu. Zakhvatyvayte novye shtaty, uderzhivayte forty i zheleznye dorogi, chtoby nakaplivat resursy, i vedite v boy podkrepleniya, kotorye pribyvayut iz Evropy. Otkroyte dlya sebya v pervyy raz ili perezhivite zanovo vse vpechatleniya ot originalnoy igry The bluecoats North and South v odinochku ili v rezhime dlya dvukh igrokov. V etoy obnovlennoy versii vas zhdet pererabotannyy igrovoy protsess.

Vy mozhete byt novichkom ili opytnym igrokom v strategii — etu igru vy mozhete nastroit pod sebya, aktiviruya razlichnye optsii.
Prokhodite razlichnye epizody grazhdanskoy voyny v SShA, vybrav god, v kotorom nachnetsya igry. Vy mozhete sokhranit status-kvo — ili perepisat khod istorii!

Osobennosti:

3 razlichnykh rezhima igry:

  – Pokhodovaya strategiya na karte: komanduyte operatsiyami i vedite svoi batalony, chtoby zakhvatyvat novye shtaty, atakovat vragov i ukreplyat svoi pozitsii.

  – Bitvy v realnom vremeni: otpravlyaytes na pole boya i srazites s vragom litsom k litsu. Ispolzuyte pekhotu, kavaleriyu i artilleriyu, chtoby oderzhat pobedu. Polzuytes silnymi storonami kazhdogo roda voysk, chtoby sokrushit protivnika.

  – Atakuyte i zashchishchayte forty v rezhime shutera ot pervogo litsa. Etot polnostyu peredelannyy rezhim pozvolit vam sygrat rol odnogo iz soldat. Zashchishchayte svoi pozitsii ot zakhvatchikov ili perekhvatite initsiativu, atakovav vraga.

Polnotsennyy rezhim dlya dvukh igrokov.

title: Synaptic Drive [NSZ][ENG]
description: Set hundreds of years in the future, diverse fighters from space have assembled on one planet to battle in competitions. Some want to show off their abilities, some live to fight, while others are after prize money... Whatever the reason may be, they're all aiming to come out on top. To attain superhuman reflexes, these fighters have mechanized their bodies to activate synapses in the brain. Such are the origins of Synaptic Drive™.

title: Slide Stars [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Vy gotovy k ekstremalnym priklyucheniyam na vodnykh gorkakh? Vas zhdut bolee 20 zvezd sotssetey! Upravlyayte imi i nesites navstrechu velikomu priklyucheniyu! Vybirayte lyubimuyu zvezdu, prygayte na podkhodyashchiy transport i katites vniz s bezumnykh vodnykh gorok!

Skolzite, prygayte i balansiruyte na bezumnykh dorozhkakh, gde vas podzhidayut tipichnye dlya platformera opasnosti i neobychnye vragi. Preodolevayte sumasshedshie opasnosti: katyashchiesya bulyzhniki i neustoychivye konstruktsii; spasaytes ot martyshek s bananovymi bombami i dazhe ot gigantskogo krakena! Etim zvezdam nikakie opasnosti ne strashny!

Doberetes li vy do finishnoy pryamoy?

OSOBENNOSTI
★ Skolzite, prygayte i balansiruyte, chtoby preodolet bezumnye opasnosti na vode! 
★ Sdelayte skolzhenie eshche bolee uvlekatelnym, vypolnyaya ego vmeste v lokalnom kooperativnom rezhime dlya 2 igrokov!
★ Razblokiruyte 20 strannykh transportov: akulu, edinoroga, lamu, mekhanoida, drakona i mnogie drugie. U kazhdogo — svoi preimushchestva i nedostatki!
★ Vypolnyayte sumasshedshie tryuki i zavisayte v vozdukhe, chtoby poluchit bolshe ochkov!
★ Igrat legko, osvoit v sovershenstve — trudno. Smozhete li vy ustanovit novyy rekord?
★ Broste sebe vyzov: proydite uroven neskolkimi sposobami, razblokiruyte skrytye dorozhki i poluchite osobye medali!

title: Skully [NSP][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description: Na dalyokom tainstvennom ostrove na bereg vybrosilo cherep, i mestnoe bozhestvo probudilo ego. Cherep poluchil imya Skully, i teper on dolzhen ostanovit voynu mezhdu tremya rodstvennikami bozhestva, potomu chto ona ugrozhaet ikh rodnomu ostrovu.

title: Rivals of Aether [NSZ][ENG]
description:
RIVALS OF AETHER - eto indi-fayting, baziruyushchiysya v mire, gde voyuyushchie tsivilizatsii vyzyvayut silu ognya, vody, vozdukha i zemli. Igra poluchila vysokuyu otsenku kritikov i priznanie fanatov zhanra za glubokiy geympley, otzyvchivoe upravlenie i druzhelyubie k novym igrokam. 

Osobennosti:
- Srazhaytes v sorevnovatelnykh poedinkakh 1-na-1, 2-na-2 ili formate vse-protiv-vsekh.
- Sygrayte v KAMPANIYu, chtoby uznat predystoriyu kazhdogo personazha i raskryt sekrety mira Aether.
- Sokrushayte volny prizrachnykh vragov v REZhIME BEZDNY v odinochku ili s drugom za mesto v globalnoy tablitse liderov. Soberite optimalnyy nabor uluchsheniy dlya svoego personazha i broste vyzov svoim druzyam na ARENE BEZDNY.
- Pokazhite svoy skill v MULTIPLLERNYKh MATChAKh! Igrayte protiv druzey ili protiv sluchaynykh protivnikov v REYTINGOVOM REZhIME, chtoby pokorit tablitsu liderov.
- TUTORIAL pomozhet vam razobratsya vo vsekh mekhanikakh igry, nachinaya s bazovykh navykov i zakanchivaya prodvinutymi khitrostyami. A TRENIROVOChNYY REZhIM pozvolit vam ottochit ikh v formate stop-kadra s vizualizatsiey khitboksov.

title: Reflection of Mine [NSP][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
Pomogi Lilli Vitchgan – molodoy devushke s dissotsiativnym rasstroystvom identichnosti. Vyyasni, kakaya iz ee lichnostey nastoyashchaya i raskroy vse temnye tayny ee razuma.

Upravlyay dvumya raznymi personazhami odnovremenno v poiskakh vykhoda, put k kotoromu lezhit cherez mnozhestvo lovushek. Kazhdaya storona razdelennogo nadvoe urovnya otlichaetsya dlya kazhdoy lichnosti, poetomu smotri v oba!

Osobennosti:
* Bolee 10 chasov geympleya
* 55 unikalnykh golovolomok s raznoobraznymi mekhanikami
* 10 etapov v arkadnom rezhime
* Bolee 10 razlichnykh lichnostey dlya upravleniya

title: Override: Mech City Brawl Super Charged Mega edition / Override 2: Super Mech League + 5 DLC [NSP][ENG]
description:
Vot uzhe 7 let kak vtorgshiesya na Zemlyu zenotaypy pobezhdeny. Gigantskie roboty, nekogda byvshie zashchitnikami chelovechestva, teper razvlekayut zriteley v bitvakh po vsemu miru. Vy — novyy pilot byvshego voennogo orudiya, i vam predstoit podnyatsya v reytinge i dostoyno predstavit svoy klub s pomoshchyu izvestnykh i novykh robotov, u kazhdogo iz kotorykh svoi osobennosti, priyomy i moshchnye ataki. V igru Override 2: Super Mech League mozhno igrat i odnomu, i s tovarishchami: est kampanii dlya 4 igrokov po lokalnoy seti, a urovni razbrosany po vsemu miru!

Nachnite igrat za novogo pilota i podnimites v reytinge v zakhvatyvayushchem rezhime karery. Vstupite v mekha-ligu i proslavte svoyo imya, srazhayas na arenakh po vsemu miru. V vashem rasporyazhenii kak uzhe izvestnye, tak i sovershenno novye roboty, a srazhatsya mozhno kak v poedinkakh, tak i v komandnykh bitvakh dlya 4 igrokov po lokalnoy seti. Odoleyte sopernikov s pomoshchyu unikalnykh priyomov: sverkhzaryazhennykh dalnikh atak, probivayushchikh metall kombinatsiy ili silneyshey ataki, ot kotoroy sodrognyotsya vsya arena!

V igre:

• Rezhim karery: srazhaytes v mekha-ligakh, berite novye vysoty i postaraytes stat luchshim pilotom. Dostoyno predstavte svoy klub i vmeste s tovarishchami zarabotayte vliyanie i nagrady! 
• Reytingovyy boi: vkhodit dva robota, vykhodit odin. Odoleyte sopernikov, podnimites v reytinge i stante legendoy.
• Mekhamaniya: 20 pilotiruemykh robotov, v tom chisle i sovershenno novye, s unikalnymi sposobnostyami, naborami navykov i silneyshimi priyomami.
• Opasnye areny s dinamicheskimi elementami: geyzerami, ozyorami lavy i platformami, zastavlyayushchimi produmyvat strategiyu i privodyashchimi k neozhidannym razvyazkam.
• Uluchshennye rezhimy igry: matchi 1 na 1, 2 na 2, svobodnyy match, «Zenoroy» (Xenoswarm) «Tsar gory» (King of the Hill) i prochie. 
• Obshirnye nastroyki: v garazhe mozhno razblokirovat raznuyu kosmetiku i aksessuary dlya nuzhnogo robota.

Thank you very much for your support. As of August 2025, online co-operative play has ended, but Override 2 still supports local co-op.

title: Outbreak The Nightmare Chronicles / Epidemic / The New Nightmare / Lost Hope / Endless Nightmares / Contagious Memories / Dinobreak [NSZ][ENG]
description: Pochuvstvuyte, kak mat otchayanno ishchet svoyu doch posredi obshchenatsionalnoy epidemii. Eta istoriya, deystvie kotoroy proiskhodit vo vselennoy Outbreak ot Dead Drop Studios, sleduet za Gven srazu posle ee muchitelnogo pobega iz gorodskogo tsentra vo vremya epidemii. Uzhasnaya avariya zastavlyaet ee razluchatsya so svoey docheryu Khoup, i ey prikhoditsya borotsya s nezhityu, chtoby vyzhit ... i spasti svoyu doch.

title: Mad Tower Tycoon [NSZ][ENG]
description:
V Mad Tower Tycoon stroyte neboskreby v 100 etazhey i otkryvayte v nikh zavedeniya, kotorye budut prinosit dokhod: restorany, kinoteatry, podzemnye parkovki i dazhe zooparki! Chtoby dostich uspekha, udovletvoryayte zaprosy potentsialnykh posetiteley i vybirayte te zavedeniya, kotorye privlekut bolshe vsego gostey. V klassicheskom rezhime stroitelstva vy budete sorevnovatsya za zavetnuyu nagradu: «shest zvezd». Vasha tsel — zavershit stroitelstvo i sdat v arendu ofisy, kvartiry i magaziny na territorii 100 etazhey.

SLUChAYNYE SOBYTIYa
Pomimo zhalob ot arendatorov, vam pridetsya razbiratsya s pozharami v novykh ofisakh, zemletryaseniyami i pokhishchayushchimi arendatorov NLO. Postoyanno menyayushchayasya chereda sobytiy ne dast zaskuchat! Eti sobytiya zastavyat vas prodolzhat sledit za poryadkom v neboskrebe, skolko by problem on ne sozdaval.   

SISTEMA UROVNEY
S ezhednevnymi zadaniyami vy smozhete povysit uroven uspeshnosti i zarabotat ochki opyta. Uchites i nabirayte ochki opyta, chtoby otkryt bolee 50 navykov.

ZNANIYa — SILA
Ne upuskayte ni odnoy detali: znayte, na kakom etazhe nuzhen remont, a na kakom nuzhno chto-to sdelat s razdrazhayushchim gostey shumom. Skolko posetiteley bylo u vas za poslednie sutki? Poluchili li vy pribyl v etom mesyatse? Vsyu nuzhnuyu informatsiyu o sostoyanii vashego neboskreba vy naydete v statistike Mad Tower Tycoon.

DYaVOL KROETSYa V DETALYaKh
Vashi posetiteli ne budut dovolny, esli im pridetsya khodit po stupenkam ili slishkom dolgo zhdat lift. Eto legko ispravit: sistema liftov v Mad Tower Tycoon pozvolyaet sledit za samymi raznymi pokazatelyami, v tom chisle — za vremenem ozhidaniya na vsekh etazhakh. Radovat gostey i klientov i sovershenstvovat i vash neboskreb, i vashi umeniya — blagodarnyy trud!

title: Levelhead [NSP][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
員工你好！航運局是銀河中首屈一指的快遞公司。數百年來，我們的客戶一直相信我們會以良好的服務運送他們的貨物。現在，你成為了這場魔法般的快遞服務的一部分。
 
 作為崩潰製造部的新員工，你負責針對每種可能的快遞情況，對你自己的 GR-18 快遞機器人進行訓練。在工廠中使用直觀的關卡編輯器創建關卡，又稱「員工限制評估有限練習」，然後發佈關卡供全世界體驗。
 
 建造不可思議的裝置和機器、製作充滿冒險、既要動腦也要動手的探險，或僅僅創建一個輕鬆的音樂場景，讓崩潰製造部的其他人放鬆一下。一旦完成你的關卡，請將它分享給全世界，並贏得粉絲！崩潰製造部配備了強大的展示和關注系統，因此你可以隨時找到由你的同事創建的最佳新關卡。
 
 別忘了訓練課程！90 個以上的手工製作的關卡，提供了豐富的挑戰和驚喜，以激發你的創造力。
 
 你還在等什麼，員工？走出去，推廣我們的商品吧！
 
 遊戲特色
 
 + 建立自己的關卡！發揮創意，用數以百計的物品製作自己的關卡，這些物品包括敵人、危險障礙、路徑、可程式化開關、秘密、天氣，音樂和道具。建造龐大的冒險、解謎遊戲、彈珠台、充滿頭目的關卡、快節奏的挑戰、輕鬆的音樂裝置、節奏良好的橫板過關遊戲，或者你能想像到的任何東西！「Levelhead」直觀的關卡編輯器可以讓你將設計理念轉換為面向全球玩家的平台冒險遊戲。
 + 完成極具挑戰的有趣活動！控制GR-18，這是一個還在訓練中的快遞機器人，在過關模式中一路奔跑、跳躍、轟炸來通過 90 多個富於挑戰性的手工設計關卡。一路上，你將解鎖新的頭像、飛奔完成準時遞送，並成為崩潰製造部的明星員工！
 + 獲得粉絲！將你的關卡發佈到全世界，並看著你的遊戲時間、嘗試與粉絲積少成多。憑藉強大的搜尋和展示功能，「Levelhead」使收集粉絲及遊玩全球使用者不斷生成的內容變得輕而易舉。。此外，市場部可以透過玩遊戲，將你的關卡推到統計表的頂端，這意味著你不必出名就能讓人們玩你的關卡！
 + 為了速度而競爭，獲得獎勵！每個關卡都有一個排行榜——登上榜首，你將勝利捧杯！但請注意，競爭非常激烈，你永遠不知道誰會來爭奪你的獎勵。
 + 跨平台、跨存檔、跨遊戲！你創建的關卡會向全世界發佈，無論在什麼裝置上！你甚至可以將未完成的關卡備份到雲端，並在裝置之間輕鬆傳輸，以便隨時隨地構建和遊玩。
 + 在本地合作中與朋友一起開懷大笑！和多達三個朋友在同一張沙發上遊戲，享受徹頭徹尾的爆笑樂趣。如果你想建立更深厚的友情，請與朋友一起進入關卡編輯器，共同構建關卡。你甚至可以構建只為 2、3 或 4 名玩家設計的關卡！

title: Lair of the Clockwork God [NSZ][ENG]
description:
BEN — fanat kvestov. Odnoy nogoy zastryal v 90-kh, obozhaet sobirat vsyakiy khlam.

Ego priyatel DEN — mechtaet stat novoy zvezdoy platformerov.

V LAIR OF THE CLOCKWORK GOD vy igraete za Bena i Dena, kombiniruya ikh sposobnosti, chtoby ostanovit vse apokalipsisy!

Reshayte golovolomki za Bena, chtoby sozdavat uluchsheniya dlya Dena, — i on smozhet prygat, begat i rasstrelivat vo vse vokrug. Begayte i prygayte za Dena, chtoby otkryt novye zony i golovolomki dlya Bena!

title: Kuukiyomi Consider It / Kuukiyomi 2 Consider It More New Era / Kuukiyomi 3 Consider It More and More! Father to Son / Read The Atmosphere Together Corocoro Comic Ver / 4 + DLC Dire Situations [NSZ][ENG,JAP]
description:
人類為何要“閱讀空氣”？ 
問題的答案就潛藏在這款“閱讀空氣度”測試遊戲《大家一起閱讀空氣。4》之中。

這部作品也聚焦了主角「你」的童年。
當回顧每個人小時候都會經歷的各種事件時，
天真一點，我們來解讀氣氛。

基本規則非常簡單：移動螢幕上的紅色物體。
請根據會被問到的各種場景來判斷狀況、解讀氣氛。

Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition 新增可以檢測你的「滑鼠操作技巧」的選單，
使用Joy-Con™ 2 的滑鼠進行操作，來挑戰全新的閱讀空氣。請好好享受遊戲的樂趣吧。

大家一起閱讀空氣。4 有以下遊戲模式。

・讀空氣
總共會問100種情況。
完成所有問題後，您將得到診斷。

・兩人一起讀空氣
與您的朋友和家人一起玩。
總共 30 個問題中將提出 10 個問題。
玩完之後，就會診斷出兩個人之間的相容性。

・小遊戲專區
內含 3 個小遊戲。
力爭在分數競賽中獲得最高分。

title: Eufloria HD [NSP][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + optsionalnyy LFS-翻译 来自 AlchemistLab
description:
Explore a beautifully realized universe rendered in a style that is unique and compelling.

Engage in space exploration, conquest, plant growth and bio mechanical evolution. Conquer asteroids in deep space and use their resources to grow and nurture semi-organic plants and creatures to do your bidding. Plan your strategy against AI opponents that all vie for the same resources and offer fierce opposition.

Eufloria is easy to learn, and enjoyable to master. It’s a game for everyone. Try it now!

Features:

- A 25 level “Story Mode” with many hours of gameplay.
- “Relaxed Mode”, for a more ambient experience which anyone can enjoy.
- “Skirmish Levels” that can be played over and over.
- “Dark Matter Mode” for a stylish, more challenging way to play.
- Original ambient soundtrack by “Milieu”.
- Many procedurally generated levels which are different every time!

title: Tricky Doors [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Tricky doors — eto zatyagivayushchaya igra, kotoraya predlagaet mnozhestvo zagadok. Proyavite smekalku, chtoby vybratsya iz kazhdoy komnaty.

Tricky doors — point-and-click igra v zhanre escape the room, s bolshim kolichestvom uvlekatelnykh mini-igr i slozhnykh kvestov. 

Vam otkroetsya mnozhestvo samykh raznykh dverey. Za kazhdoy vas zhdut vrazhdebnye i druzhelyubnye miry, privychnye i ekzoticheskie peyzazhi. Zadacha lish odna — pokinut cherez portal ocherednoe mesto, kuda zabrosit vas igra. 
Reshayte golovolomki i nakhodite spryatannye predmety. Mnogie iz nikh budut vam znakomy. Nekotorye vy uvidite vpervye. Poluchitsya li u vas s ikh pomoshchyu nayti vykhod — zavisit tolko ot vashey soobrazitelnosti. Broste vyzov svoey nakhodchivosti!

Mnozhestvo velikolepnykh lokatsiy i prekrasnaya grafika
Unikalnye istorii pobega
Uvlekatelnyy poisk predmetov
Brosayushchie vyzov mini-igry
Budet interesno kak novichkam, tak i opytnym igrokam

title: Platago Super Platform Game Maker [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
PlataGO! — neveroyatno prostoy konstruktor igr v zhanre «platformer», kotoryy ponravitsya vsem tvorcheskim naturam nezavisimo ot vozrasta!

Vam ne pridetsya programmirovat ili pisat slozhnye skripty: 100% deystviy v PlataGO! vypolnyaetsya s pomoshchyu peretaskivaniya myshyu, a znachit, vy s khodu mozhete pristupit k sozdaniyu igr v zhanre «platformer». Nikakikh slozhnostey, nikakogo obucheniya — prosto zapustite konstruktor i tvorite!

Bolee togo, vy mozhete tut zhe poigrat v sozdannyy vami uroven po nazhatiyu odnoy knopki, chto krayne uproshchaet testirovanie vashego platformera! Dazhe esli u vas net nikakogo opyta, vsego za neskolko minut vy smozhete sozdat prostoy uroven.

Razmestit platformu mozhno prostym peretaskivaniem gotovogo obekta iz menyu. Poluchilos ne to, chto khoteli? Ispravte oshibku s pomoshchyu instrumenta «lastik»! Khotite dobavit na uroven vragov? Prosto perenesite myshyu ponravivshegosya monstra iz menyu!

Konstruktor predlagaet shirokiy vybor gotovykh stroitelnykh blokov, vragov i obektov, tak chto vashemu voobrazheniyu budet gde razgulyatsya! Ispolzuyte trampliny, teleporty i pushki, padayushchie i podvizhnye platformy, lazernye lovushki i reaktivnye rantsy.

Krome togo, v PlataGO! est tselyy nabor retro-stiley, imitiruyushchikh populyarnye igrovye sistemy: vash platformer budet vyglyadet, kak igra iz epokhi NES, SNES, Amiga, Commodore 64 ili Game Boy. Odin shchelchok myshyu — i u vashey igry uzhe drugoy vizualnyy stil!

title: Iris and the Giant [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Iris and the Giant — eto kollektsionnaya kartochnaya igra s elementami RPG i «roglayka». Vy igraete za devochku Ayris, kotoraya reshila dat boy svoim strakham v voobrazhaemom mire. Silami minimalistichnogo khudozhestvennogo stilya igrokam otkroetsya trogatelnaya istoriya devochki-podrostka, vynuzhdennoy vstretitsya litsom k litsu so svoimi vnutrennimi demonami i uspokoit bushuyushchego v ee dushe velikana.
 
Sobirayte svoyu kolodu
Postepenno nakhodite novye karty i zarabatyvayte ochki, kotorye otkroyut vam novye preimushchestva. S kazhdoy novoy popytkoy vy stanete silnee i smozhete proyti dalshe!
 
Poeticheskaya, melankholichnaya istoriya
V protsesse igry vam budut otkryvatsya chastichki vospominaniy Ayris, prolivaya svet na prichiny vashikh stranstviy po ee soznaniyu.
 
 Osobennosti
- Takticheskie boi: srazites s monstrami v srazheniyakh, sochetayushchikh mekhaniki kollektsionnykh kart, rolevuyu sistemu i elementy zhanra «roglayk»
- Koloda: soberite kolodu po khodu igry. Iz mnozhestva dostupnykh kart vybirayte te, chto naibolee sootvetstvuyut vashey strategii
- Glubina vybora: v igre vas zhdet 51 karta, a takzhe raznoobraznye sposoby nastroit personazha i kolodu pod predpochitaemyy stil igry
- Trogatelnoe priklyuchenie: traditsionno skupoy na syuzhet zhanr obogashchen tshchatelno vypisannoy zakhvatyvayushchey i emotsionalnoy istoriey
- Progressivnaya krivaya slozhnosti: igra dostupna maksimalno shirokoy auditorii, no i lyubiteli slozhnostey naydut zdes dlya sebya dostoynye ispytaniya

title: Gorsd [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
生於眼子宮，你發現一個充滿挑戰性的世界，與未知力量造成。你的出生的目的到底是什麼？揭露GORSD的真相。
• 你只有一顆子彈。發射，控制並收回它。
• 本地1-4人對抗模式。
• 8種不同的多人遊戲模式與可修改的規則，21張不同的地圖可玩。
• 可玩7個小時的單人遊戲，包含60多個戰鬥關卡的大型世界中。
• 制定你的個人戰略 - 當你從敵人逃跑時，考慮你發射子彈的方向。

我們是GORSD。
GORSD永遠不會離開你。

• 美妙的遊戲音樂。
• 專為阻止終極無聊和永久地豐富你生活而設計的遊戲。
• 超好玩的本地多人模式。

title: Gleamlight [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
「微光閃爍」是一款2D動作冒險遊戲，帶領玩家穿梭於過眼雲煙的唯美世界。

玩家在欣賞如同花窗玻璃般幽美的畫面時，還能體驗獨特的無UI遊戲介面，以及旁白甚少的神秘故事，享受全新的遊戲方式。
獨行在這個既美妙又令人畏懼的玻璃世界裡，你又會作何感想、踏上怎麼樣的一個旅程呢？

◆ 玻璃的世界
無論是大自然裡的花草樹木，或是各種人造物，皆以各式各樣的玻璃製成，放眼望去都是一幕幕宜人風景。玻璃折射著光芒便顯得溫暖，而受黑暗漸染時則冰冷無情；奇妙的玻璃世界正等著你去探索。

◆ 無UI的遊戲介面設計
無UI的遊戲介面設計能讓玩家更沉浸於故事內容裡。每當擊退敵人時，遊戲會多加一點精彩，動作內容也會愈發有趣，因此鼓勵玩家以直覺操作遊戲。

◆ 一語不發的故事
這個世界曾經歷了些什麼，未來又將面臨些什麼，一切都取決於你的感官。把旅程中的零碎經歷拼湊成故事，拯救這個轉眼即逝的美麗玻璃世界吧。

title: Falcon Age [NSP][ENG]
description:
Podruzhites s yunym sokolom i otpravtes v priklyuchenie. Falcon Age — eto odinochnyy priklyuchencheskiy ekshen s vidom ot pervogo litsa. Vy vozmete na sebya rol Ary, kotoraya srazhaetsya s armiey robotov-zakhvatchikov, chtoby vosstanovit kulturnoe nasledie svoego naroda — zabytoe iskusstvo sokolinoy okhoty.

Osobennosti:
Priruchite pernatogo kompanona: vy mozhete dat svoemu sokolu imya, gladit ego, kormit, uchit i odevat.
Okhottes vmeste so svoim sokolom: vy mozhete okhotitsya na samykh razlichnykh zverey, chtoby dobyt dragotsennye materialy.
Gotovte ugoshcheniya dlya vashego sokola: vy mozhete gotovit razlichnye lakomstva, kotorye pomogut uluchshit, istselit ili sdelat  vashego sokola silnee.
Naryazhayte vashego sokola: sozdayte svoemu sokolu nepovtorimyy obraz s pomoshchyu razlichnykh shapochek i sharfov. Takzhe mozhno davat emu funktsionalnoe snaryazhenie, naprimer ekholokator i bronyu.
Srazhaytes s robotami-zakhvatchikami: dayte otpor dronam i robotam s pomoshchyu vernoy oglushayushchey dubinki i svoego sokola.
Osvobodite svoyu planetu: otvoyuyte mnozhestvo poseleniy u kolonizatorov i vosstanovite obshchestvo.
Mirolyubivyy rezhim: prokhodite syuzhetnuyu kampaniyu bez srazheniy.
Otdelnaya knopka dlya vzaimodeystviya s sokolom: davayte i zabirayte predmety, delayte privetstvie ladonyu ili kulakom i uspokaivayte svoego sokola.

title: Even The Ocean [NSP][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
Alif, skromnyy inzhener elektrostantsii v gorode Uaytfordzh, obnaruzhivaet, chto ee mir perevernulsya s nog na golovu posle togo, kak planovoe tekhnicheskoe obsluzhivanie poshlo ne tak. Teper, rabotaya neposredstvenno s merom Biggsom, chtoby protivostoyat neizvestnoy ugroze, Alif dolzhna upravlyat svoey vnov obretennoy siloy i vliyaniem, chtoby spasti gorod.

Individualnost Alif, ekologicheskie voprosy i sudba mira - vse eto nakhoditsya v balanse Svetloy i Temnoy energii.

Osobennosti: 
* Ispolzuy kak Svetluyu, tak i Temnuyu energiyu, chtoby preodolevat razlichnye prepyatstviya i stabilizirovat gorod.
* Vstrechay novykh druzey, soyuznikov i zagadochnykh puteshestvennikov. 
* Issleduyte krasivuyu i strannuyu geografiyu v raznoobraznykh usloviyakh, okruzhayushchikh gorod Uaytfordzh.
* Nastraivaemye urovni slozhnosti i stili igry: kazhdyy raz vybirayte mezhdu variantami «Zaversheno», «Tolko syuzhet» ili «Geympley», chtoby poluchit unikalnyy opyt.

title: Evan's Remains [NSP][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description: Evan's Remains is a mystery-thriller puzzle adventure about finding a missing boy: Evan. The game combines logic-based platform puzzles with visual-novel style narrative inspired by Japanese graphic adventure games.

title: Eldrador Creatures / Shadowfall [NSZ][ENG]
description:
「埃爾多拉多」是德國玩具公司史萊奇（Schleich）的原創模型，廣受全球玩家喜愛。
不論大人或小孩，都為這些鮮明活潑的生物創造的浩大世界觀深深著迷！
在這部戰略角色扮演遊戲中，您可以享受到風趣幽默的故事、兼具策略深度的戰鬥，率領重現模型3D模組、特色鮮明的生物群施展「必殺技 × 連擊」，體驗將敵人一掃而空的爆棚爽快感！

★	由您親自指揮的刺激戰鬥！
鮮明有趣的生物群將帶您體驗幽默風趣的故事與兼具策略深度的戰鬥。暗影大軍來襲，席捲熔岩、冰雪、岩石、叢林四大國度！
 
★	率領專屬隊伍贏得勝利！
昨天的敵人，今天的盟友！培養因戰鬥而化敵為友的生物，與牠們並肩作戰！善加搭配屬性與技能，編組喜愛的隊伍吧。
 
★	施展華麗攻擊，將暗影大軍一掃而空！
組合夥伴的屬性攻擊，施展連擊！把敵人凍僵、揍飛，再吐出烈焰燒成焦炭！
 
★	戰略與戰術就是您的武器！
運用您的聰明才智來培育、戰鬥、編組隊伍，化身運籌帷幄的司令官，指揮生物群使出獨樹一格的攻擊！
 
★	遊戲共有四種難度，您可以依照自己的實力調整，獲得最棒的遊戲體驗。

title: Duck Souls [NSP][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Duck Souls+ - eto dinamichnaya igra-platformer o malenkoy utke s neveroyatnoy izvorotlivostyu i umeniem vypolnyat zadaniya, nakhodit vse yaytsa, chtoby spasti svoy utinyy vid.

Duck Souls+ razvorachivaetsya v milom i smertelno opasnom mire fentezi, gde mnozhestvo lovushek mogut otorvat krylya, poka ty izo vsekh sil pytaeshsya skhvatit khrupkoe yaytso.

Begay, prygay i proryvaysya cherez krasochnyy i kovarnyy geympley, chtoby spasti vsekh i stat geroem, esli smozhesh, konechno.

Kharakteristiki:
 * 100 brutalnykh urovney ruchnoy raboty, napolnennykh smertelnymi lovushkami
 * Pereprygivay shipy, vzbiraysya na steny i izbegay smerti
 * Ispytay svoi navyki v etom platformere s zhestkoy slozhnostyu
 * Vyydi iz bolee 20 razlichnykh tipov smertelnykh lovushek
 * Soberi 20 raznykh shlyap i ukras svoyu utku!

title: Dokapon Up Mugen no Roulette (ドカポンUP! 夢幻のルーレット, Dream Roulette) + 8 DLC [NSZ][ENG (Mod.)/JAP]
genre: Role-Playing, Board Game, Strategy, Visual Novel
interface_lang: 日语 [JAP] + lyubitelskiy MOD angloyazychnogo perevoda 用于 versii 1.0.3 v196608
description:
Utawarerumono (yap. うたわれるもの Utavarerumono, «Tot, o kom poyut pesni») — manga i 26-seriynyy anime-serial, snyatyy v 2006 godu. Yavlyayutsya adaptatsiey videoigry dlya vzroslykh v zhanre priklyucheniya i takticheskoy RPG, vyshedshey 26 aprelya 2002 goda. Manga nachala vykhodit v 2005 godu v zhurnale Dengeki G's Magazine. V 2015 godu vyshlo prodolzhenie pod nazvaniem Utawarerumono: Itsuwari no Kamen ot studii White Fox.
Syuzhet osnovyvaetsya na istorii glavnogo personazha — Khakuoro, kotorogo v lesu nedaleko ot derevni nakhodit semya, sostoyashchaya iz dvukh devushek i babushki. On tyazhelo ranen i poteryal pamyat. Semya reshila priyutit neznakomtsa do tekh por, poka on ne popravitsya. Vskore Khakuoro osvaivaetsya v derevne, gde on ostayotsya zhit dalshe, no zadolgo do etogo Khakuoro ponimaet, chto zhizn v etoy derevne podavlyaetsya zhadnym imperatorom, upravlyayushchim stranoy, v kotoroy nakhoditsya ikh derevnya. Pozdnee ego nedobrozhelatelnye deystviya k derevne privodyat k tomu, chto Khakuoro beryotsya vozglavit soprotivlenie, kotoromu udayotsya smestit neugodnogo pravitelya..
Videoigra «Dokapon UP! Mugen no Roulette» sochetaet v sebe nastolnuyu igru tipa sugoroku, elementy RPG, vizualnuyu novellu i seriyu takticheskoy strategii po franshize! Znakomye personazhi, takie kak Khaku, Kuon, Khakuoro i Eruruu budut uchastvovat v vesyolykh dialogakh — i zharkikh bitvakh!..
S dobavleniem rezhima «Istoriya», v kotorom vy mozhete naslazhdatsya osnovnym syuzhetom v polnom obeme, «Offlayn-match», gde vy cmozhete, kak i ranshe, sobirat druzey doma so svoimi druzyami.

title: Depth of Extinction [NSZ][ENG]
description:
In a flooded future world, killer machines are plotting mankind's demise. As the sole defender of humanity's last government, only you can create the ultimate squad and save humanity in this turn based, tactical RPG with roguelike elements.

GAME FEATURES
- Explore a sunken world and build your own story 
- Familiar tactical options with a few new twists including action refunds, stealth positioning and ambushes
- Create the ultimate squad from 10 different character classes including the brand new SABOTEUR
- Outfit your team with 115 different weapons, armor, and items
- Fight 30+ unique enemies from 5 factions
- Position your team and then get the kill with stealth
- Control the leader and the other characters will follow (and pick up loot) using an advanced AI

title: Children of Zodiarcs [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Children of Zodiarcs — syuzhetno-takticheskaya rolevaya igra, deystvie kotoroy razvorachivaetsya v skazochnom korolevstve Lyumus — mire, razobshchyonnom bogatstvom i bednostyu. Nami i eyo shayka otverzhennykh avantyuristov zhdut vashikh komand. Ispolzuyte dlya etogo noveyshuyu boevuyu sistemu na osnove kartochek i kubikov. Nanesite udar po nenasytnym appetitam alchnoy znati!

Syuzhet
V pogone za drevney relikviey banda professionalnykh vorov pronikaet v roskoshnye pokoi prodazhnogo dvoryanina, edva izbezhav gibeli ot ruk razyaryonnoy gorodskoy strazhi, podsteregayushchey ikh na kazhdom uglu. Otchayavshis nayti vykhod, oni ishchut pristanishcha v gorodskikh trushchobakh i otvazhno spuskayutsya v neproglyadnuyu tmu podzemnogo mira. Za nashimi geroyami otkryvayut okhotu vooruzhyonnye do zubov voiny gorodskoy strazhi, vrazhdebnye bandy golovorezov i klany bezumnykh podzemnykh kannibalov. Vypav iz sistemy i vynuzhdennye pomogat zhadnym do nazhivy prestupnikam, yunye geroi dolzhny primiritsya s novoy dlya sebya realnostyu. No pomnite! V mire Children of Zodiarcs nikomu ne udastsya uyti nevredimym.

Osobennosti
Boevye kartochki
Ataki i umeniya vsekh vashikh tovarishchey privyazany k boevym kartochkam. Ispolzovanie razlichnykh kartochek vo vremya kazhdogo poedinka daet vam beschislennye varianty ataki.

Stepen vozdeystviya karty opredelyaet brosok kubika
Kak tolko vyberete tip ataki, broste virtualnye kubiki dlya polucheniya bonusov. Vmesto tsifr na nikh vypadayut simvoly, kotorye otvechayut za modifikatory ataki, zashchity, lecheniya i osobykh umeniy.

Ispytayte Gospozhu Udachu
Esli khotite vnesti dopolnitelnye urovni strategii v Children of Zodiarcs, kombiniruyte kubiki v sootvetstvii so svoim stilem igry. Vy mozhete perebrosit do dvukh kubikov za kazhdyy khod. Ne boytes polozhitsya na blagosklonnost Gospozhi Udachi!

Mir, polnyy yarkikh personazhey
V khode igry vy poznakomites s Nami, kotoruyu v detstve pokhitili iz rodnogo doma; Brays, vynuzhdennoy vyzhivat na polnykh opasnostey ulitsakh Tora; kharizmatichnym prestupnym liderom Zirkkhoffom, nanimayushchim v usluzhenie detey-sirot, — a takzhe mnogimi drugimi opasnymi negodyayami.

title: Redden 100 Denarii [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
時間接近"一百元便士"二手店的關門時間。
疲憊不堪的店老闆在最後一位客戶離開時關上店門，
而看似空蕩店內響起了閒聊聲音。
Jo 是一塊砧板，過去曾經是一支箭，
Bi 是用回收苦無做成的煎鍋，
而 Cal 是一把帶著如子彈般鐵礦的刀子。
這些日常使用的工具個個都有個神奇故事，等待有緣人前來聆聽。

"你知道嗎？我曾經當過..."

這些就是廢棄工具之間停不來的閒聊。
由工具觀點出發所設計的動作通道遊戲，REDDEN！

獲獎歷史
Award history
・Exhibition piece in the 1st 'Google Play Playtown'
・Exhibition piece in the 4th Kyoto Indie Game Festival‘BitSummit’
・Exhibition piece in the 1st 'Google Indie Game Festival'
・Exhibition piece in the ‘G-STAR BIC Showcase’
・'IGF China' honorably mentioned
・Top List of the 9th 'Gamein Award,'
・Finalist of the 1st 'Open Play Day,
・Selected as 'Unity Shocking Project,
・Reached over 137% of 'Tumblbug' crowd funding goal amount 

・美麗又獨特的世界，描繪每個物件的歷史特色。
由工具帶領我們進入、中世紀、當代的歷史場景！
探索只有工具能領略片刻的世界。
體驗單純卻獨特的工具世界！

・操控簡單。發揮快速直覺，就能上手。
你將在工具的歷史記憶片段中，親自感受乘風、避開並破壞障礙物，以及攻擊目標。
別輕易放棄！發揮你的直覺，輕鬆上手。

・破壞並向前移動！
乘風飛行，並加快運用技能的速度。
用你的個人方式，運用技能來破壞物件。
絕對不要停止，並持續向前，直到你消滅遊戲場景中的最後一個目標！

・聰明使用三個角色中的任何一個角色專屬技能！
Jo、Bi 和 Cal 都有專屬的技能，可以讓直覺遊戲更有趣。
旋轉和直線加速可以打碎物件，建立克隆複本，炸碎周遭環境。
運用技能和策略，有助於你完成每個遊戲場景！

・絢麗與魔幻的遊戲場景。
隨著每個階段的推進，工具的動作和內觀對話
會帶領你進入美麗的動畫世界。

你還在等什麼？快點展開這場史詩般的遊戲吧！

title: Reky [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
簡單是關鍵

儘管規則可能很容易理解，但大多數挑戰絕非簡單。 記住這個世界的規則，你應該沒有問題。

感受一下

平靜的環境配樂進一步提升了 reky 的遊戲玩法。 讓它幫助您沉浸在這種獨特的審美體驗中。

- 96 個關卡
- 受建築極簡主義啟發的美學
- 優雅的設計
- 美麗的配樂
- 自定義地圖顏色

title: Still There [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
STILL THERE – psikhologicheskoe priklyuchenie s tekhnicheskimi golovolomkami, stremnym II, mrachnym yumorom i neotstupayushchey bolyu ot poteri. Ubegayte ot svoego proshlogo k neizvestnosti i zabveniyu, popivaya prevoskhodnyy italyanskiy kofe.

OTKROYTE ISTINU
Signal bedstviya navsegda menyaet razmerennyy poryadok zhizni smotritelya kosmicheskogo mayaka i sostavlyayushchego emu kompaniyu II. Sporte, sochuvstvuyte i izlivayte dushu personazham v nasyshchennykh i uvlekatelnykh dialogakh. Vas zhdet klassicheskaya nauchno-fantasticheskaya misteriya s chelovecheskim litsom.

REShAYTE SLOZhNYE ZAGADKI
Vam otvedena rol Karla Khamby, edinstvennogo operatora stantsii «Bento», chya zadacha – zanimatsya remontom i obsluzhivaniem klyuchevykh sistem stantsii na paru s Gorkim, iskusstvennym intellektom stantsii. Izuchayte oborudovanie, chtoby ponyat, kak ustroena stantsiya. Pishite otchety svoim maloadekvatnym nachalnikam. Raskroyte svoe istinnoe prednaznachenie.

UBIVAYTE VREMYa
Ishchite, chem zanyat sebya v pereryve mezhdu rabochimi zadachami. Pytaytes obygrat Gorkogo v shakhmaty, zabottes o mestnoy tuatare i pererabatyvayte otkhody zhiznedeyatelnosti v «izyskannye blyuda». Na «Bento» vy naydete mnozhestvo interesnykh sposobov vzaimodeystviya prakticheski s lyubymi obektami.

title: Orbit Industries [NSP][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
V kosmose nikto ne uslyshit vash krik — ni likuyushchiy, ni polnyy gorechi ili razocharovaniya. Chto zhe vy budete delat, pokoritel kosmosa, kogda na vas lyazhet gruz otvetstvennosti?
 
 SOZDAVAYTE PREKRASNOE ZRELIShchE
 Stroyte, peredelyvayte i dovodite svoyu stantsiyu do sovershenstva v [b]polnostyu tryokhmernom okruzhenii, sozdannom pri pomoshchi vpechatlyayushchikh vozmozhnostey Unreal Engine 4[/b]. Vrashchayte svoyo tvorenie na [b]360 gradusov[/b], priblizhayte i otdalyayte.
 Lyubuytes zavorazhivayushchimi sozvezdiyami, tumannostyami i planetami — razrabotchiki mnogo nedel provodili issledovaniya, pozvolyayushchie sozdat realistichnuyu vizualizatsiyu beskonechnogo neba.
 
 POLZUYTES ABSTRAKTNOY MODELYu
 Nastraivayte i kontroliruyte proizvodstvennye tsikly, dobychu resursov i ikh raspredelenie. [b]Sosredotochtes na effektivnosti ili obyome vyrabotki[/b], polzuyas vsemi dostupnymi pokazatelyami. [b]K vashim uslugam abstraktnaya proektsiya, vneshne napominayushchaya ustroystvo elektronnykh skhem[/b], kotoraya pomozhet vam nalazhivat svyazi mezhdu modulyami i postepenno prevrashchat stantsiyu v inzhenernoe chudo!
 
 EKONOMIKA, OShIBKI I NE TOLKO!
 [b]Unikalnaya ekonomicheskaya model[/b] brosaet vam glavnyy vyzov — sdelat stantsiyu effektivnoy i prinosyashchey dokhod ili poterpet neudachu!
 Privychnyy khod sobytiy mozhet prervatsya iz-za mnozhestva sobytiy: [b]ot khakerskikh atak do oshibok i sboev[/b], kotorye mogut proizoyti v lyubom iz moduley stantsii.
 K tomu zhe, izbytochnoe proizvodstvo mozhet privesti k peregruzke — poetomu tshchatelno planiruyte, razrabatyvayte i vypolnyayte zadumannoe!
 
 ISSLEDUYTE NEVIDANNYE MIRY
 Vy mozhete igrat v rezhime kampanii — ona sostoit iz [b]tryokh razlichnykh missiy[/b], v khode kotorykh vam nuzhno terraformirovat odnu iz planet, sdelav eyo prigodnoy dlya zhizni i dobychi resursov. 
 Kazhdaya iz etikh missiy obladaet sobstvennym syuzhetom i zastavit vas udelyat vnimanie dvum rezhimam obzora, chtoby [b]dobitsya postavlennykh zadach[/b] pri pomoshchi postroennoy stantsii.
 Sdelaete li vy stavku na maksimalnuyu effektivnost ili obyom vyrabotki? Ili zakhotite postroit stantsiyu iz samykh elegantnykh moduley? Lyuboy sposob khorosh, esli missiya vypolnena!

title: Cold Silence [NSZ][RUS/Multi3]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 3]
description:
特徵：
- 沒有黑暗的恐怖，因為情況本身而令人毛骨悚然
- 只有 3 種顏色傳達絕望的感覺

title: Ary and the Secret of Seasons [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + optsionalnyy 俄语 翻译 来自 Flenper
description:
Ary and the Secret of Seasons — udostoennaya nagrad priklyuchencheskaya igra, gde devochka po imeni Aryelle (Ariel) ili Ary (Ari) puteshestvuet po ogromnomu miru Valdi. Stav Strazhem Zimy, Ary poluchaet sposobnost menyat sezony, i ey predstoit nauchitsya upravlyat imi, pobezhdat vragov, preodolevat prepyatstviya i reshat slozhnye golovolomki po vsemu miru.

Davnym-davno miru Valdi ugrozhal zloy mag. Posle dolgoy borby Legendarnyy Voin pobedil ego i zaper v sklepe na veka. Chtoby mag ne vybralsya, chetyre velikikh mudretsa poklyalis okhranyat sklep. Oni stali pervymi Strazhami Sezonov — taynoy organizatsiey, o kotoroy nyne ostalis lish legendy.

Posle togo kak zagadochnaya sila povredila sklep, Ary reshila pomoch Strazham Sezonov i otpravilas iskat istochnik nepriyatnostey. Ey pridyotsya proyavit otvagu i smekalku, odolet moguchikh vragov, taynye zagovory i ustarevshie traditsii, chtoby spasti mir i privesti ego v ravnovesie.

V igre:
— Priyatnye issledovaniya. Polzuyas siloy sezonov, geroinya mozhet peremeshchatsya po samym raznym landshaftam i reshat interesnye prirodnye golovolomki, chtoby prodvinutsya po syuzhetu.
— Uvlekatelnaya istoriya. Devochka dolzhna pomoch Strazham Sezonov: starinnoy organizatsii s ukorenivshimisya traditsiyami. Puteshestvuya po neizvedannym zemlyam, Ary raskroet tayny Strazhey Sezonov i poymyot vsyo znachenie dannoy organizatsii.
— Menyayushchiesya lokatsii. Peremeshchaytes mezhdu ekosistemami i menyayte okruzhayushchuyu sredu i sezony s pomoshchyu sily Ary, chtoby poluchit nuzhnoe.
— Plavnye srazheniya. Ary pridyotsya primenit vse svoi sposobnosti, potomu chto ey postoyanno budut meshat vragi: ot mestnykh zhiteley do ogromnykh ispolinov. Ey pridyotsya primenyat ves svoy arsenal dlya preodoleniya tyazhkikh prepyatstviy.
— Privlekatelnyy tryokhmernyy mir. Krasivaya grafika i ocharovatelnoe muzykalnoe soprovozhdenie sozdayut priyatnuyu atmosferu, blagodarya kotoroy igra zapomnitsya nadolgo.

title: 140 (One Hundred Forty, Sto sorok) [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
140 is an IGF award-winning rhythm platformer with a minimalistic style and abstract, colorful graphics. Use the rhythm to overcome challenging obstacles controlled by an energetic electronic soundtrack.

The game is independently designed by Jeppe Carlsen, former lead gameplay designer at Playdead.

title: Klaus [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description: Klaus ochnulsya v podvale, ne imeya ponyatiya ot tom, kto on i gde nakhoditsya. Edinstvennaya zatsepka — eto tatuirovka KLAUS na ego ruke. On vynuzhden bezhat iz mekhanicheskogo i konstruktivistskogo mira, v kotorom schitaet sebya uznikom. Vmeste s igrovym personazhem po imeni K1, druzhelyubnym grubiyanom, Klaus puskaetsya v ekzistentsialnoe puteshestvie, issleduya ponyatie chetvertoy steny i mir, v kotorom on okazalsya.

title: Shipped [NSP][RUS/MULTI7]
genre: 动作, 街机, 派对聚会
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语, 德语, 西班牙语, 法语, 意大利语, 葡萄牙语.
description:
Shipped is an adorable party game where up to 8 players compete in sea skirmishes. Choose your favorite girl and navigate the sea. Your ship can’t break, so first learn how to maneuver. With simple controls, it’s easy to start but hard to master.

To win, you must push your opponents to crash on land or out of the screen. Or just shoot them. To do that, grab ammo crates. If you’re out of cannonballs, use your cannon and blow air to push enemies or deflect incoming fire. Remember to keep up with the movement of the camera - if your ship goes off-screen, it will instantly explode!

With five different modes, you’ll never get bored playing Shipped. If you’re short on friends to play, you can always add AI-controlled players or try the challenging single-player arcade mode. 

Features: 

Local multiplayer for 2-8 players.
Arcade single-player mode or AI-controlled players for solo play.
Five different game modes: Cruise, Chase, Race, Yincana, Sumo.
Fun and straightforward mechanics. 
Lovely characters, colorful graphics, and a pleasant soundtrack. 
Over 95% positive reviews from PC players!

title: Zombieland Double Tap Road Trip (Dobro pozhalovat v Zombilend 2: Kontrolnyy vystrel - Dorozhnoe puteshestvie) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
S syuzhetom, razvorachivayushchimsya mezhdu sobytiyami pervogo filma, Zombieland: Double Tap Road Trip — eto do neleposti veselyy shuter s vozmozhnostyu lokalnoy sovmestnoy igry do chetyrekh uchastnikov. Igrayte za lyubimykh personazhey originalnogo filma: Tallakhassi, Kolambusa, Vichitu i Litl-Rok — a takzhe za novykh razblokiruemykh personazhey iz sikvela.
Igra vklyuchaet v sebya igrovye elementy filma: ot «Pravil» do «Zombiubiystva nedeli». Ispolzuyte spetsialnye vozmozhnosti, arsenal oruzhiya i samoe vazhnoe: pravila vyzhivaniya v Zombilende, chtoby vystoyat protiv gromadnogo chisla isklyuchitelno grotesknykh i opasnykh chudovishchnykh zhivykh mertvetsov!.. Dostupen rezhim syuzhetnoy kampanii, otdelnykh polchishch, atakuyushchikh volnami, i srazheniya s bossami.

title: Wuppo Definitive edition [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Odinokiy brodyaga Vum poteryal dom. On dolzhen opravitsya v put i oboyti ves mir, chtoby nayti novoe mesto dlya doma. Na puti ot glavnogo pristanishcha Plopositi do peshcheristogo Blikopolisa nashego Vuma budut zhdat volshebnye mesta i vstrechi so strannymi sushchestvami. No brodyaga Vum — ne obychnyy geroy. Tolko s pomoshchyu ostroumiya i obayaniya emu udastsya dobitsya uspekha v etom bolshom puteshestvii.

Wuppo — eto proekt dvukh uvlechennykh lyudey, risovannaya vruchnuyu grafika, moshchnyy saundtrek i ogromnyy neizvedannyy mir.

Osobennosti
- Novyy kooperativnyy rezhim
- Issleduyte chudesnyy mir, napolnennyy vumami, fnakkerami i drugimi strannymi sushchestvami.
- Razreshite drevnee protivostoyanie po puti k novomu domu.
- Ispolzuyte predmety i sotsialnye navyki dlya preodoleniya razlichnykh prepyatstviy.
- Srazhaytes s mnozhestvom vragov ot samykh malenkikh do krupnykh i dazhe OGROMNYKh!
- Sobirayte kinoplenki, chtoby uznat podrobnuyu istoriyu mira.
- Naslazhdaytes zavorazhivayushchim i nezabyvaemym saundtrekom v orkestrovom ispolnenii.

title: War Theatre [NSP][ENG]
description:
Voyna prishla k Kasalli. Po mere togo, kak bushuet beskonechnyy konflikt, sem voinov obnaruzhivayut drevnyuyu silu, kotoraya obeshchaet gospodstvo na lyubom pole bitvy.

War Theatre ot razrabotchikov Plague Road rasshiryaet klassicheskuyu poshagovuyu strategiyu s elementami RPG. Vyberite svoego geroya i vstupayte v boy v odnopolzovatelskikh kampaniyakh na kontinente, razrushennom nepreryvnoy voynoy. Vypolnyayte kvesty, chtoby zarabatyvat bonusy i otkryvat bolee glubokie varianty nastroyki, chtoby usovershenstvovat svoyu strategiyu i dominirovat nad protivnikami v multipleere.

title: Unknown Fate [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
Vy prosypaetes, odin, v mire, sovershenno neizvestnom vam.

U vas net vospominaniy o vashem proshlom, vy ne znaete, kak vam udalos dostich etogo mira, i edinstvennoe, chto vy mozhete sdelat, eto prodolzhat i pytatsya nayti pravdu.

Neizvestnaya sudba - odnopolzovatelskaya golovolomka-priklyuchencheskaya igra s zagadochnoy istoriey, golovolomki dlya resheniya i vragi, chtoby pobedit.
Puteshestvuyte v neveroyatnykh mirakh, reshaya golovolomki vokrug vas i sobiraya poteryannye vospominaniya Richarda, chtoby raskryt pravdu o puteshestvii Richarda.

title: Ultrawings [NSZ][ENG]
description: Ultrawings Flat — aviatsionnaya igra s otkrytym mirom, v kotorom vy budete upravlyat sverkhlegkim vozdushnym transportom, «dzhi reyserami», raketnymi planerami i sportivnymi samoletami. Vam predstoit vypolnyat razlichnye zadaniya v velikolepno stilizovannom pod ostrovnuyu tematiku mire. Vy budete vzryvat vozdushnye shariki, prizemlyatsya v zadannykh tochkakh, uchastvovat v zakhvatyvayushchikh vozdushnykh gonkakh, delat snimki i mnogoe drugoe! Zarabatyvayte igrovye dengi, chtoby otkryvat novye aeroporty i vozdushnye sudna.

title: Truberbrook [NSZ][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
Trüberbrook – eto zakhvatyvayushchaya, polnaya tayn i zagadok priklyuchencheskaya igra v nauchno-fantasticheskom-anturazhe.
Vas zhdet neobychnyy otpusk v 60-kh godakh v parallelnoy vselennoy – nauchno-fantasticheskoe priklyuchenie, vse dekoratsii k kotoromu sozdany vruchnuyu. 

Predstavte, chto na dvore konets 60-kh godov i vy poekhali v otpusk v Zapadnuyu Evropu. Teper predstavte, chto vy sami – molodoy amerikanskiy uchenyy, a zovut vas Gans Tangeyzer. Da-da, imenno tak, kak geroya opery Vagnera.

title: The Church in the Darkness [NSZ][RUS/Multi4]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 4]
description:
V kontse 70-kh Missiyu Kollektivnoy Spravedlivosti vozglavlyayut kharizmatichnye Ayzek i Rebekka Uokery. Ikh nazyvayut radikalami. Chtoby skrytsya ot presledovaniya pravitelstva SShA, Uokery pereselyayut chlenov kulta v dzhungli Yuzhnoy Ameriki – edinstvennoe mesto, gde oni smogut sozdat sotsialisticheskuyu utopiyu. Tam oni stroyat Gorod Svobody. No rodstvenniki, ostavshiesya v SShA, volnuyutsya: chto voobshche proiskhodit v etikh dzhunglyakh?
Vy – Vik, byvshiy strazh poryadka, i vasha zadacha – probratsya v Gorod Svobody, chtoby uznat, kak dela u vashego plemyannika Aleksa. Vy mozhete proniknut v kommunu skrytno ili siloy. Uznayte, chto tam proiskhodit, i naydite plemyannika, poka ne pozdno.
Naskolko opasny Uokery? Kak daleko vy gotovy zayti, chtoby raskryt pravdu i spasti Aleksa? Moglo li vse zakonchitsya po-drugomu?

title: Super Cane Magic Zero [NSZ][ENG]
description: Tort-Charodey myortv, a ego Volshebnyy Pyos stal neupravlyaem! Mozhesh li ty spasti mir? A pomoch Psu? Pokoryay opasnye kholmy Minestronii v roli Chuvaka — pekarya s siloy bekona! Srazis so zlobnymi ognevikami v roli Chuvikhi — neukrotimoy vodoprovodchitsy! Razmoroz lazernyy vulkan v roli Chuvadeya — konfetnogo maga-lekarya — ili prosto stan krutym, kak Chuvara-Avtoritet! Super Cane Magic ZERO — lokalnaya rolevaya igra dlya 1–4 igrokov.  — Bolee 20 chasov bezumnogo syuzheta i personazhi khudozhnika Simone Albrigi (Sio) — Srazhaysya s druzyami na 8 lokalnykh mnogopolzovatelskikh arenakh — Razblokiruy bolee 15 personazhey s sumasshedshimi sposobnostyami — Issleduy ogromnyy mir i sobiray sotni unikalnykh predmetov! — Podberi sbalansirovannuyu dietu s uchetom svoikh vkusov. Esh ne menee chetyrekh tipov kamney! — Opredelis s ubezhdeniyami i voploti ikh v realnost! Razblokiruy 7 Derevev Ubezhdeniy dlya uluchsheniya svoikh sposobnostey Bolshoy Divan ne predostavlyaetsya.

title: Octahedron Transfixed edition [NSP][RUS/Mult5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 0]
description:
Broste vyzov gravitatsii v mertsayushchem psikhodelicheskom podzemele pod zavorazhivayushchiy ritm. Vyzyvayte svoyu platformu iz vozdukha v lyubom meste i v lyuboy moment. Otkryvayte moshchnye sposobnosti na protyazhenii 50 sozdannykh vruchnuyu urovney. 

Podzharivayte vragov lazerami, krushite steny i reshayte golovolomki. Smotrite, kak prepyatstviya i vragi takzhe dvizhutsya v ritme muzyki. Vzbiraytes na vershiny podzemnogo mira Vitragul i pogruzhaytes v glubiny velikolepnykh trekov ot Chipzel, Andre Sobota, Derek Howell i Monomirror. 

Naslazhdaytes materialami, eksklyuzivnymi dlya Transfixed Edition: novye medali na vremya, desyatki osobykh ispytaniy i novye osobennosti, dostupnye posle prokhozhdeniya igry.

title: Little Town Hero [NSZ][ENG]
description:
The story is set in an isolated village on the edge of the world.
The only gate leading outside is heavily guarded by a castle, and the villagers are not allowed to leave.
Most of the villagers don't give it a thought, and happily go on with their everyday lives.
However, the protagonist is a little different from the others - he wants to see the world outside.
One day, a "Monster" appears in the village, shocking everyone because until then, no one knew such creatures existed.
The protagonist is able to fight it using a mysterious Red stone he found in the coalmines.
In the course of his defense of the village, he gradually unravels secrets of how the stones and the monsters came to be…
　
Unlike most RPGs, there is no need to fight weak monsters repeatedly to level grind in "Little Town Hero".
Instead, you will need to have a good strategy to fight each boss monster one on one.
...Will the protagonist live the adventure he craves and escape the humdrum village life?
- A challenging battle system which relies heavily on coming up with new Ideas and strategies.
- Compact story progression designed with the busy gamer in mind.
- Soundtrack by Toby Fox, composer of the background music for UNDERTALE.

title: Lanternium [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description: Lanternium, samoe dobroe priklyuchenie pro Enota v mire zaputannykh golovolomok i tsvetnykh kubikov, prikhodit na konsoli. Etot indi-pazl ot studii Blazing Planet yavlyaetsya druzhelyubnoy igroy dlya vsey semi — geympley posvyashchen interaktivnym golovolomkam, v khode kotorykh igroki eksperimentiruyut s razlichnymi tsvetami, predmetami i ikh svoystvami, poputno pytayas provesti Enota cherez labirinty iz kubikov. A vse potomu, chto u Enota ukrali ego lyubimye shokoladnye pechenki, za kotorymi on otpravlyaetsya, poputno vyyasnyaya taynu ischeznuvshikh ulitok i kovarnye plany zlodeya Anglera. Po khodu priklyucheniy glavnyy geroy vstrechaet mnozhestvo neobychnykh zverey — Lisu, Ulitku i drugikh. Obmanchivo prostaya ponachalu, Lanternium vskore otkryvaet svoi potaennye grani, brosaya igrokam vyzov, kotoryy pozvolit im pochuvstvovat sebya nastoyashchimi geymerami!

title: Raiders of the North Sea [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + optsionalnyy 俄语 lyubitelskiy
description:
It's Raiding Season!
Assemble a crew and outfit a longboat to raid settlements for gold and fame! Impress your Chieftain in glorious battle and win your place among the legends of the North Sea in this digital adaptation of the award-winning board game!

The Official Digital Adaptation of the Award-Winning Board Game!
Plunder your way to adventure as Raiders of the North Sea brings the strategy and fun of the hit tabletop game to digital life!

Cross-Platform Play!
Sail dangerous waters with cross-platform online play!

Deep Worker Placement Strategy!
* Each turn you'll harvest resources twice: first by placing one worker, and then by recovering a different one!
* Use your resources to hire a Viking crew and outfit your longboat!
* Send your crew on daring raids to win gold and glory!
* Survive battles with the legendary Valkyrie...or honor your Chieftain in a glorious death!
* Amass Plunder and make sacrificial Offerings to win!

Many Ways to Raid!
* Turn-Based Strategy lets you play at your own pace!
Learn the Oars in a full tutorial that teaches you the strategy of the game!
* Explore the North Sea in a 10-game campaign!
* Lead Your People in single-player games against AI opponents!
* Rise to Greatness in multiplayer battles!

title: Fimbul [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Fimbul — priklyuchenie v settinge skandinavskikh mifov.
Glavnogo geroya vyrezali vmeste so vsey derevney bandity, no ego vozrodili Norny, chtoby on unichtozhil Yotunov i tem samym ne dal by sluchitsya Ragnaryoku
Vas vstretit stilizatsii pod komiksy, syuzhetnye vstavki, ochen interesnaya interpretatsiya fekhtovaniya v Hack’n’Slash mekhanike i vozmozhnost reshat sudby nekotorykh sopernikov, tem samym menyaya okonchanie igry!

title: Ghoulboy [NSZ][ENG]
interface_lang: 德语, 英语, 西班牙语, 日语, 韩语, 中文 [Multi 6]
description:
《GhoulBoy》是一款融合了動作角色扮演元素和砍殺遊戲玩法的復古風動作平台遊戲。擊殺怪獸、收集戰利品、迴避危險的陷阱並擊敗兇惡的魔王。《GhoulBoy》將重現 90 年代經典復古平台遊戲的外觀與手感並推出全新且引人入勝的遊戲玩法功能。如果你懷念 16 位元時代的平台遊戲，《GhoulBoy》將非常適合你遊玩。

特色：

• 探索魔法世界中的地牢、村落和狡猾的怪獸。
• 尋找強大的武器、道具和法術來擊敗你的敵人。
• 斬殺怪獸並擊敗具挑戰性的魔王。
• 享受 16 位元風格圖像與復古的晶片音樂。

title: Mimpi Dreams [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Mimpi userdno metit territoriyu svoey mechty, kak, sobstvenno, delayu vse sobaki. Pomogite emu spasti svoikh druzey, upravlyaya okruzhayushchey sredoy v 7 illyustrirovannykh mirakh. Eta igra predstavlyaet soboy smes priklyucheniya i platformera s nekotorymi elementami golovolomki.

Mimpi lenivyy pesik, kotoryy lyubit pospat. V svoikh snakh on stanovitsya geroem, kotoryy spasaet i zashchishchaet tekh, kto nuzhdaetsya v spasenii i zashchite! Bud to piratskiy korabl, laboratornaya krysa, kotoraya mechtaet vyrvatsya na svobodu, ili plenennaya drakonom printsessa — geroy Mimpi tut kak tut i gotov spasti polozhenie. Konechno, Mimpi ne mozhet sdelat eto bez pomoshchi svoego druga — vas!

Vmeste s Mimpi vy sozdaete ego sny. Upravlyaya snami, vy pomozhete emu stat nastoyashchim geroem! Peremeshchayte prepyatstviya, chtoby Mimpi proshel cherez urovni, reshayte golovolomki i pomogite pesiku obshchatsya s sushchestvami vo sne.

title: Hogtie [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description: Milaya golovolomka v stile «sokoban», v kotoroy vy upravlyaete svoimi svinkami s pomoshchyu lasso. Issleduyte raznoobraznye biomy, khodite po plitkam s osobymi effektami i naslazhdaytes kastomizatsiey svoego personazha bolee chem na 100 urovnyakh!

title: Draw Rider Remake (Gravity Defied) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
這是備受期待的傳奇 Draw Rider 的翻拍，從頭開始重寫，在各個方面都變得更大、更好和更漂亮。

在遊戲中，您會發現大量不同的關卡，其中的通道將為角色定制開闢各種機會。 一開始不會有什麼困難，但是一旦訓練結束，就會有真正的硬核！ 如果您厭倦了標準曲目，您可以隨時在特殊編輯器中創建自己的關卡，也可以播放其他玩家創建的曲目。

特徵：

• 350 個手工關卡
• 自定義關卡、關卡編輯器和全局關卡共享
• 超過 200,000 個關卡的排行榜和在線模式
• 超過 100 種隱藏的秘密定制物品等您發現
• 9 種不同的瘋狂車輛
• 和更多！

歡樂的海洋，不可思議的關卡，酷炫的電子音樂，這一切都是Draw Rider Remake！

title: Little Big Workshop [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Predstavte, chto v vashey komnate otkuda ni vozmis poyavilsya volshebnyy zavod. Tshchatelno produmannyy shedevr, gde trudolyubivye rabotniki mogut sozdat vse, chto ugodno klientam. Izgotavlivayte rezinovye utochki i komody, drony i elektrogitary, skutery i drugie chudesnye tovary iz razlichnykh materialov i prodavayte za dengi — valyutu, kotoruyu mozhno investirovat v zavod dlya polucheniya novykh stankov i rabotnikov ili rasshireniya vashego biznesa. Stante krutym vladeltsem zavoda v Little Big Workshop!

Upravlyat zavodom interesno
Syadte v kreslo Bolshogo nachalnika i vozmite na sebya upravlenie sobstvennym nastolnym zavodom. Organizuyte rabotu v tsekhe, upravlyayte rabotnikami, zakupayte stanki i proektiruyte effektivnye linii proizvodstva — vse, chtoby uspet k oboznachennomu sroku i udovletvorit klientov! 

Beskonechnaya pesochnitsa
Ne napryagaytes: v etoy pesochnitse mozhno dumat, prikidyvat i tykat vse do tekh por, poka ono ne zarabotaet tak, kak vam nuzhno. Postavlyayte tovary klientam i na postoyanno menyayushchiysya rynok. Sozdayte bolee 50 unikalnykh produktov, sostoyashchikh iz neskolkikh elementov, kotorye proizvodyatsya raznymi sposobami i iz raznykh materialov. Postroyte po-nastoyashchemu unikalnyy zavod!

Malenkie ruchki, bolshie ambitsii
Nachnite s nebolshoy masterskoy i rasshirtes do ogromnogo zavoda. Otkryvayte krutye stanki, dobavlyayte novye metody proizvodstva i rastite, rastite! Ne uspeete obernutsya, kak u vas uzhe budet neskolko liniy proizvodstva, na kotorykh vashi trogatelnye rabotniki budut kazhdyy den izgotavlivat sotni slozhnykh produktov.

Osobennosti igry
• Razlichnye otrasli i shirokiy assortiment produktsii
• Sosredotochtes na prakticheskikh zadachakh, a ne na stoimosti, ekonomike ili logistike.
• Organizuyte vse etapy proizvodstva s pomoshchyu chertezha.
• Otkryvayte novoe mesto na stole i uvelichivayte svoy zavod.
• Polnostyu smodelirovannyy smena dnya i nochi
• Zabottes o svoikh rabotnikakh! Ne vyzhimayte iz nikh vse soki, chtoby oni ne vzbuntovalis.
• Milyy miniatyurnyy stil.

title: Hyperforma + 2 DLC [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]

title: Holy Potatoes! What The Hell?! / We're In Space?! / A Weapon Shop?! [NSZ][ENG,RUS]
description:
Kosmos... Glavnaya frityurnitsa mira! Otpravlyaytes v mezhgalakticheskoe puteshestvie s issledovaniyami, priklyucheniyami i kartofelnymi shutochkami v igre Holy Potatoes! We're In Space?! V ney khorosho prozharennye bitvy, pyureshnoe upravlenie i zapechennaya simulyatsiya obedinyayutsya v odno blyudo na million!

Vedite kapitana Kessi i ee sestru Fey cherez galaktiku v poiskakh ikh dedushki! Issleduyte planety i uchastvuyte v poshagovykh kosmicheskikh boyakh i mezhplanetnykh sobytiyakh. Nanimayte komandu, sozdavayte oruzhie i postroyte po-nastoyashchemu ofrititelnyy korabl! Puteshestvuyte po prostoram ovoshchnoy vselennoy, no beregites yarosti Eklipsa — v kosmose nikto ne pridet na pomoshch i ne spaset vas ot skorovarki!

• Upravlyayte v detalyakh svoey komandoy, sozdavayte oruzhie i postroyte velichayshiy kosmolet vsekh vremen.

• Srazhaytes s vrazheskimi korablyami v poshagovykh boyakh — tolko vam reshat, pomilovat vragov ili podzharit ikh do khrustyashchey korochki!

• Issleduyte vselennuyu, vypolnyayte zadaniya i otkryvayte postoyanno menyayushchuyusya syuzhetnuyu liniyu.

• Khotite pif-paf-ekshna bez lishnikh usiliy? Poprobuyte Rezhim ovoshcha i snimite stress!

title: Gigantic Army [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Mekh-strelba s bokovogo skrollinga VERNULAS!

GIGANTIC ARMY - eto iskrenniy poklon mekh-shuteram epokhi 16-bit.

XXI vek, i Zemlya v voyne s Ramulonami - prisheltsami, reshivshimi prepyatstvovat prodvizheniyu chelovechestva v kosmos.

Voyna chelovechestva protiv Ramulonov doshla do planety Ramulon, i teper na TEBE lezhit zadacha upravlyat 'GMR-34 SALADIN' - Obitaemym Boevym Robotom - i vzyatsya za armiyu Ramulonov. Nastroy svoy arsenal vzryvchatki, snaryadov i plazmennogo oruzhiya, i obedini ego s rukopashnymi atakami, tyagovymi ustanovkami i shchitom, chtoby vzyat boy v svoi ruki i polozhit konets konfliktu!

GIGANTIC ARMY gorditsya potryasayushchimi retro-stilyami arkady, plavnoy animatsiey, podrobnym dizaynom personazhey i urovney, a takzhe zakhvatyvayushchim i sverkhzavisimym igrovym protsessom.

title: Pulling no Punches [NSZ][ENG]
description:
