Satiricheskiy bitemap dlya 4-kh s elementami klassicheskoy arkady, i sovremennymi vizualnymi effektami.
Igra sleduet istorii globalnoy pandemii, okhvativshey mir i ignoriruemoy fanatikami, ne veryashchimi v realnost etoy bolezni. Glavnye geroi, zashchishchennykh perchatkami i maskami, dolzhny razobratsya s etimi neveruyushchimi i reshit situatsiyu — dlya ikh zhe bezopasnosti!

title: Model Debut Nicola 3 [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Stante samoy stilnoy devushkoy na rayone i nasladites poslednimi modnymi tendentsiyami vsego mira! Voplotite top-model, naslazhdayas modoy, rabotoy i svobodnoy lyubovyu!
Poprobuyte sebya v razlichnykh professiyakh na modnykh pokazakh! Rabotaya v glyantsevom zhurnale, vy ispytaete vsyo: ot sootvetstviya predmetov v sootvetstvii s temoy do fotosemki i oformleniya.
Osobaya istoriya lichnostnogo rosta zhdyot vas, chtoby vstretitsya s beschislennym kolichestvom podruzhek i boyfrendov! Rabotayte vmeste, vykhodite v svet i poznavayte yarkuyu modelnuyu zhizn vo vsyom eyo velikolepii!Vse tri chasti igry na yaponskom yazyke sm. zdes.

title: Double Cross [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Uvlekatelnuyu priklyuchencheskuyu igru Double Cross, gde vam predstoit primerit na sebya rol agenta RAZLOMa Zakhry, razrabotala studiya 13AM Games. Sredi drugikh ee izvestnykh igr chislitsya zasluzhivshaya mnozhestvo nagrad Runbow. «RAZLOM» rasshifrovyvaetsya kak «Regulirovshchiki Antisotsialnykh Zatey i Letalnykh Opasnostey Mezh mirami». Zadacha etoy kompanii — sledit za poryadkom mezhdu vsemi izmereniyami. Nedavno na shtab RAZLOMa napali, i teper igrokam predstoit rassledovat novoe delo. Vooruzhivshis razrabotannym v RAZLOMe oborudovaniem, oni budut strelyat, uvorachivatsya, srazhatsya i rassledovat prestupleniya v dalekikh izmereniyakh. Vo vremya puteshestviy oni soberut vse neobkhodimye uliki, chtoby priblizitsya k razgadke, uznat, kto zhe napal na RAZLOM, a takzhe spasti kazhduyu versiyu vselennoy.

OSOBENNOSTI IGRY
• Igroki mogut nastraivat stil sobstvennoy igry, sobiraya uluchshator i ispolzuya ego, chtoby povysit svoy uroven i razblokirovat snaryazhenie agentov RAZLOMa.
• Polnyy priklyucheniy igrovoy protsess i sistema uluchsheniy, blagodarya kotorym igroki smogut vybirat, kak i v kakom poryadke prokhodit urovni
• Unikalnaya mekhanika «protonnoy rogatki», kotoraya pozvolyaet primenyat samye raznye dvizheniya na razlichnykh urovnyakh. U igroka budet vozmozhnost khvatat i shvyryat predmety i vragov
• Razlichnye ataki i kombo, kotorye mozhno uluchshat
• Zaputannaya istoriya, kotoraya vovlechet uchastnikov v reshenie zagadki i puteshestviya mezh izmereniyami, gde im predstoit poznakomitsya so mnozhestvom razlichnykh personazhey
• Elegantnaya vysokokachestvennaya 2D-grafika, kotoraya napominaet o kultovykh igrakh i stile anime

title: Decay of Logos [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Pogruzites v mir Decay of Logos i raskroyte ego tayny. Issleduyte starinnye podzemelya, srazhaytes s bezzhalostnymi vragami i proydite cherez krasochnyy mir fentezi vmeste s tainstvennym losem-naparnikom.

Otpravlyaytes v priklyuchenie, polnoe predatelstv i mesti, posle togo, kak Bagrovye rytsari razrushili derevnyu molodoy geroini. Vmeste s vernym losem-naparnikom srazhaytes c bezzhalostnymi vragami, kotorye brodyat po miru, gde kogda-to tsaril mir. Issleduyte drevnie ruiny i podzemelya v poiskakh nagrad, chtoby uznat, kto stoit za napadeniem na rodinu Ady. Ne zabyvayte: v etom mire tsarit tainstvennaya temnaya sila, kotoraya pogloshchaet dazhe ego zhiteley.

• Action/adventure RPG ot tretego litsa s uporom na issledovanie i samoobuchenie.
• Neprostye bitvy i boevaya sistema, pooshchryayushchaya risk; oruzhie s raznoy dalnostyu, nabory priemov, kombo i drevnyaya magiya.
• Los-naparnik: ukreplyayte druzhbu s zagadochnym losem, reshaya zagadki i raskryvaya zloveshchie tayny.
• Prorabotannaya vselennaya i zamyslovatyy syuzhet s polnoy ozvuchkoy: vy ne smozhete ugadat kontsovku vplot do zaversheniya vashego puteshestviya cherez masshtabnyy, drevniy i fantasticheskiy mir Decay of Logos.

title: Blood Waves [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
description:
pri pomoshchi smertonosnykh lovushek, oboronitelnykh barrikad, a takzhe oruzhiya blizhnego i dalnego boya.

Istreblyayte zombi, poluchayte kesh i gotovtes k sleduyushchey volne. V pereryve vy mozhete dokupat neobkhodimoe vooruzhenie, rasstavlyat lovushki i zashchitnye barrikady, chinit perezhivshie predydushchuyu volnu lovushki. I da, ne zabyvayte proveryat zapasy patronov i popravlyat zdorove.

Mnogo vnimaniya udeleno effektam krovi i raschleneniya vragov, blagodarya chemu dostigaetsya glubokoe pogruzhenie v atmosferu krovavogo ekshena. Raznye vidy zombi obladayut otlichitelnymi osobennostyami. Est vragi s dalney atakoy, est bolee umnye – izbegayushchie opredelennykh lovushek.

Obshirnaya sistema navykov personazha i sistema prokachki predusmatrivaet uluchsheniya oruzhiya, lovushek i kharakteristik personazha. Parametry prokachki individualny dlya kazhdogo iz predstavlennykh vidov oruzhiya. Kazhdaya lovushka obladaet unikalnymi kharakteristikami i osobennostyami. Est lovushki ustoychivye k atakam opredelennykh vidov zombi.

Vybirayte optimalnuyu strategiyu vyzhivaniya. Dlya naibolee uspeshnoy igry vam neobkhodimo sledit za pravilnym raskhodom zarabotannykh resursov. Ot etogo zavisit naskolko dolgo vy smozhete vyzhivat.

title: Blade Arcus Rebellion From Shining / ブレードアークス・フロム・シャイニング [NSP][JAP]
description: 總計21名角色進行熱血共鬥對戰。利用新系統「角色技能」來打造出專屬的戰鬥型態，並透過連線對戰來與全世界的對手相互競爭等，有許多可歡樂遊玩的要素！

title: Train Traffic Manager + 4 DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
鐵路運輸經理人不是你想像中的骨董遊戲。快捷思考、迅速計劃，防止這些火車變成燃燒中的金屬五彩火焰。在這款策略益智遊戲中，由你來負責從開關、號誌到橋梁的一切事務。哦！對了，還要防止災難性的火車衝撞。

在各類環境中挑戰80多個關卡，從陽光明媚的沙漠景觀到神秘莫測的午夜場景。這可比你車廂裡的仙人掌有趣多了！

每種環境都有其獨到之處。沙漠中有流星雨（想當然耳），森林裡有倒下的樹木（沒有點木頭還配叫做森林嗎？），冬季會凍結你的開關，而在午夜，嗯！你只需要四處張望。

如果感到普通模式過於混亂的話，可以來到無盡模式下稍作喘息。沒有特定目標，只有你、鐵軌和無數的火車。這裡是鐵路運輸經理人的禪修花園！

準備好進入瘋狂世界了嗎？搞定混亂、控制鐵軌，證明你才是正格的鐵路運輸經理人。

記住囉！千萬別在工作時打瞌睡！

title: Techno Banter [NSZ][ENG]
description:
«..Ne nado ovatsiy! Grafa Monte-Kristo iz menya ne vyshlo. Pridyotsya perekvalifitsirovatsya v upravdomy.» ©
Vy vysoko leteli po zhizni, poka udacha ulybalas vam; no kak tolko ona otvernulas, padat prishlos ochen, OChEN dolgo... V odno mgnovene vash byt na shirokuyu nogu v shikarnykh neboskrebakh ostalas pozadi. Pridetsya vernutsya k tomu, s chego vy nachinali: rabote prostym vyshibaloy v klube «Zelyonaya Dver».
U vas s klubom est koe-chto obshchee: so dna byvaet tolko odin put — put naverkh. Prishlo vremya vernut sebe byluyu slavu. Sredi neonovykh ogney, gryaznykh ulits i zubodrobitelnykh tekhno-bitov vam vypala nelegkaya rabotenka vyshibaly u vkhoda na reyv-vecherinku. Soberite v kulak vse svoe ostroumie, ved protiv tekh, kogo vy ne pustili v klub, vam pridetsya vyvozit — na slovakh! Uchtite, chto vzorvat gorod v plany khozyaev ne vkhodit.

title: Battle Supremacy [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description: Raskroyte vsyu silu vashego ustroystva v tankovoy igre pro Vtoruyu mirovuyu voynu «Bitva za prevoskhodstvo», s shchekochushchim nervy geympleem i dostoynoy vizualizatsiey. Issleduyte polnostyu otkrytyy mir, nevidannyy ranee na mobilnykh ustroystvakh, i sdelayte eto na sushe, vozdukhe ili vode. Polyubuytes na udivitelnye peyzazhi i dostoprimechatelnosti: tselye lesa, izobiluyushchie dikoy prirodoy; prostirayushchiesya na bolshie rasstoyaniya goroda s tonnelyami i mostami, izezzhennymi tankami, poezdami i voennymi korablyami. Tam dazhe ryba voditsya!

title: Skelattack [NSZ][ENG]
description:
V Zagrobnom mire byt mertvetsom ne tak uzh i plokho. Na ego volshebnykh prostorakh obitayut ocharovatelno-strannye (khotya poroy smertelno opasnye) sushchestva. A zhiteli chasto sobirayutsya na Posleferme — ostrovke schastya, gde mertvye korotayut otvedennuyu im vechnost blagodarya ritualu pominoveniya. 

Dlya vashego geroya Skalli den pominoveniya omrachaetsya vtorzheniem lyudey iz raspolozhennogo naverkhu tsarstva zhivykh. Ne pokusivshis na sokrovishcha zagrobnogo mira, oni pokhishchayut stareyshinu Poslefermy — skeleta Elzedona — i otpravlyayutsya na poiski Golubykh fakelov, magicheskoy sily, chto pitaet mertvykh. Bez Golubykh fakelov ischeznet ne tolko Posleferma, no i ves Zagrobnyy mir.

Vmeste s luchshim drugom — letuchey myshyu Imber — vy otpravites v polnye pryzhkov, srazheniy i poletov stranstviya, chtoby spasti Zagrobnyy mir ot lyudey! Vasha zadacha — ostanovit lyudey, spasti Elzedona, zashchitit Golubye fakely i razobratsya s prezhney zhiznyu Skalli.

Osobennosti:
Plavnyy i raznoobraznyy platformennyy geympley.
Ocharovatelnaya zagrobnaya grafika.
Vozmozhnost stat NASTOYaShchIM voinom-skeletom.
Skhvatka s lyudmi za zhizn posle smerti!
Vstrecha s unikalnymi veselymi monstrami, so mnogimi iz kotorykh vy mozhete podruzhitsya.
Igra za ocharovatelnuyu letuchuyu mysh Imber, luchshego druga vashego personazha.
Udobnyy stil igry: mozhno ne spesha obyskivat vse ugolki v poiskakh sekretov ili zhe poprobovat skorostnoe prokhozhdenie.
Priyatnoe vremyaprovozhdenie, ne zavisyashchee ot urovnya vashikh navykov i nastroya.
Funktsionalnye kontrolnye tochki s Golubymi fakelami, kotorye pomogut vam ottachivat pryzhki!

title: Away: Journey To The Unexpected [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Predstavlyaem vashemu vnimaniyu veselyy shuter ot pervogo litsa. Uvlekatelnoe priklyuchenie, kotoroe sochetaet v sebe ekshen, dialogi i elementy rogue-lite. Vy igraete kak rebenok, kotoryy ne yavlyaetsya geroem ili voinom. No blagodarya druzhbe vy preodoleete vse prepyatstviya na svoem puti!

Proydite vse urovni, uznayte podrobnosti zabavnoy istorii i, prezhde vsego, obretite soyuznikov. 
Vas zhdut strannye rabochie, zagadki iz kosmosa, chudakovatye druzya i bystryy boy! 

Puteshestvie po krasochnomu miru s unikalnymi vizualnymi effektami, s 2D-personazhami, zhivushchimi v 3D-mire.

Razgadayte zabavnuyu i komichnuyu istoriyu, kotoraya napolnena elementami rogue-lite. 

Stante druzyami i igrayte ot litsa bolshogo chisla veselykh personazhey! Saundtrek po tematike "anime" sozdan Kadzukhiro Naruse.

title: Automachef [NSP][ENG]
description:
Automachef — eto golovolomka i menedzher resursov. V etoy igre vam predstoit meblirovat kukhni, programmirovat ustroystva i nablyudat, kak ozhivaet vash genialnyy povar. Stroyte kukhni budushchego uzhe seychas!

Planiruyte. Razmeshchayte. Programmiruyte. Stroyte avtomatizirovannye restorany, zatem programmiruyte ikh, chtoby oni rabotali, kak otlazhennye mekhanizmy! Vy schitaete, chto spravites s lyuboy zadachey, i znaete, kak zavoevat mir avtomatizirovannykh restoranov? Togda za delo!

Slozhnye golovolomki. Reshayte zaputannye prostranstvennye golovolomki, stsenarnye zadachi i problemy s upravleniem resursami. Nedostatochno khot-dogov? Vy razberetes! Na kukhne pozhar? Dlya cheloveka s intellektom eto ne problema! 

Neskolko slozhnykh intellektualnykh rezhimov. Prokhodite urovni kampanii, prokladyvayte put v mire biznesa v rezhime kontraktov ili okunites v testovyy rezhim i igrayte, poka ne nasytites.

More ocharovaniya i strannovatyy yumor. I vsyo eto blagodarya bespomoshchnomu rasteryavshemusya glavnomu geroyu: Robertu Individu. On tochno chelovek. Ne zadavayte voprosov.

title: Valthirian Arc Hero School Story [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
STANTE LUChShIM DIREKTOROM
Nablyudayte za razvitiem vashey shkoly geroev, vozvodite novye zdaniya, uluchshayte razlichnye postroyki i upravlyayte ezhednevnymi zanyatiyami uchashchikhsya

OBUChAYTE SVOIKh PODOPEChNYKh
Treniruyte voinov, magov i luchnikov, pomogayte im v polnoy mere ovladet svoimi sposobnostyami, a takzhe razblokiruyte mogushchestvennye podklassy: paladin, uchenyy, arlekin i mnogie drugie!

POMOGAYTE ZhITELYaM VALTIRII
Otpravlyayte studentov na ogranichennye po vremeni zadaniya po vsemu miru ili otpravlyaytes navstrechu priklyucheniyam s sobstvennym otryadom, chtoby lichno stolknutsya s opasnostyu

OVLADEYTE SILOY I MAGIEY
Ispolzuyte mogushchestvennye umeniya i vzryvnye zaklyatya v bitvakh v rezhime realnogo vremeni, sobrav gruppu iz chetyrekh uchashchikhsya

SOZDAVAYTE SAMOE RAZNOE ORUZhIE I BRONYu
Razdelyvaytes s vragami, chtoby poluchit materialy, a zatem uznavayte retsepty i sozdavayte po nim mogushchestvennoe snaryazhenie, kotoroe usilit sposobnosti vashikh uchashchikhsya

UChASTVUYTE V VELIChESTVENNOY RPG-ISTORII
Zaklyuchite soyuz s odnoy iz pyati korolev-sopernits, chtoby povliyat na sudbu vsey Valtirii, a takzhe uznat odnu iz neskolkikh kontsovok

title: The Spectrum Retreat [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
The Spectrum Retreat — uvlekatelnaya igra-golovolomka ot pervogo litsa v nedalekom budushchem. Vy prosypaetes v otele The Penrose — uyutnom, no kakom-to strannom meste, skryvayushchem vas ot vneshnego mira. I pochemu vam kazhetsya, chto mezhdu vami i etim mestom est kakaya-to osobaya svyaz.

Issleduya potryasayushchiy otel v stile art-deko, vy raskroete i ego sekrety, i tayny, okruzhayushchie vashe prebyvanie tam. Na puti k pravde vas zhdut «tsvetnye» i neveroyatnye «fizicheskie» zagadki, a takzhe popytki skryt ot drugikh svoi istinnye namereniya.

title: Suicide Guy Collection (Sleepin Deeply) [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语, 德语, 西班牙语, 法语, 意大利语, 日语, 韩语, 中文 [MULTI 9]
description:
Suicide Guy i Suicide Guy: Sleepin 'Deeply vpervye vmeste v megapakete!

Deystvie proiskhodit v neveroyatnykh i neobychnykh snakh glavnogo geroya, na etot raz vam pridetsya sekonomit ne 1, a 2 butylki piva.

Funktsii
• 25 + 7 urovney dlya chasov veselya!
• Urovni po fizike
• Sovershennye dvizheniya: umet podnimat predmety, brosat ikh, aktivirovat mekhanizmy i dazhe rygat.
• Zabavnye sushchestva, kotorykh mozhno razdrazhat.
• Transportnye sredstva dlya vozhdeniya.

Na etot raz, chtoby razbudit ego, vam ponadobyatsya vse vashi navyki.
Nesmotrya na nazvanie, igra vovse NE o samoubiystve ili depressii.

title: Damsel [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Nadelayte shuma i okunites v zakhvatyvayushchiy mir etogo ekshn-platformera! Spetsialnogo agenta Damzel zhdut desyatki napryazhennykh zadaniy, ved ona — nash pervyy i posledniy rubezh oborony v borbe s zhutkimi obitatelyami mira vampirov. Spasayte zalozhnikov, obezvrezhivayte bomby, vzlamyvayte servery i izbavlyaytes ot nezhiti akkuratno, bystro i elegantno. Soblyudayte ravnovesie mezhdu beshenoy gonkoy i molnienosnymi i tochnymi resheniyami, no budte ostorozhny! Nikto ne znaet, otkuda vyskochit ocherednoy vampir.
Atakuyte vragov s pomoshchyu moshchnogo ultrafioletovogo drobovika, bystrykh refleksov, oglushitelnykh priemov rukopashnogo boya i stremitelnykh ryvkov. Tochnoe i chuvstvitelnoe upravlenie pozvolyaet peremeshchatsya po urovnyam, obkhodya smertelno opasnye prepyatstviya, stoyashchie na vashem puti. Eksperimentiruyte na kazhdom zadanii, chtoby nayti idealnuyu posledovatelnost dvizheniy i udarov. Ottachivayte skorost i tochnost udarov Damzel i otyshchite bezuprechnyy put cherez uroven, kotoryy pozvolit nabrat maksimalnoe kolichestvo ochkov i zanyat verkhnyuyu strochku v spiske liderov. Damzel — eto balet, a vy — ee khoreograf. 


Klassicheskaya arkadnaya atmosfera
- Igra razbita na nebolshie zadaniya, kotorye zastavyat vas povtoryat «Nu, eshche odin razok!» (i nichego, chto tak vy govorili i neskolko popytok nazad...)

Kampaniya v mire komiksov
- Raskroyte sekrety «Krasnogo Tumana» i rasstroyte ikh zhutkie plany.

Tablitsa luchshikh igrokov
- Ottachivayte masterstvo, uluchshayte vremya prokhozhdeniya zadaniy i stante luchshim agentom.

Vremya rasslabitsya
- Rezhim igry «na rasslabone» pozvolyaet nemnogo peredokhnut i nasladitsya igroy, ne bespokoyas o takikh melkikh nepriyatnostyakh, kak smert.

Rezhimy povyshennoy slozhnosti
- Zadaniya povyshennoy slozhnosti — dlya samykh trebovatelnykh i neugomonnykh ubiyts!

Saundtrek zhanra Synth
- Uboynye goticheskie melodii stanut idealnym fonom dlya rezni!

title: Star Story The Horizon Escape [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
description:
The archaeological research mission faced some unexpected difficulties. Your spaceship crashed. Can you escape from this planet? But how? No one can help you. You are here all alone. Or not? Do you have a plan? Will you find what it takes to be a hero?

Star Story: The Horizon Escape is a turn-based, adventure game with text-rpg elements. Tune into the story of the aspiring space-archaeologist Van Klik on his mission to the mysterious planet of Horizon!

Non-linear plot development, 24 alternative endings
Your choices define the story. Totaly. Some will turn out better than others, some will be worse, and some will be straight up hilarious. You are here to find the real true ending among all of your possible destinies and become a hero. Or maybe something more...

Text-based gameplay
The core classic. Dive into the storie and find a way to exploit EVERY possible situation. Did you know that if you throw a lockpick at an attack droid, it will decide that you are stupid and will deactivate? Build your character, choose your alignments, learn the lore of the world. You will need it all to succeed.

Game mechanics
The story will throw a mix of dialogues, choices, turn-based battles, puzzles, weapon and resource crafting, technology research and more at you. You will use all you can to survive the challenging world of Horizon.

Turn-based philosophy
The player decides on the pace he wants to play the game at. Everything is turn-based. There is no time-limit for making decisions, no quick-time events, no rush: you can take any amount of time to make your move.

Beautiful world
Enjoy the wild and crazy sceneries of the Horizon world. Deserts, jungles, cities, underground caverns… the list goes on.

Colorful characters
Meet the locals! Who is more to your liking? Side with “Bullet King” and uncover an ancient cryptic artifact. Or choose to undermine his brutal regime and make the local revolutionary your friend. Or leave them and go try to play romance with the alien girl? Or blow up the planet? Or… You get it!

title: Snow Battle Princess Sayuki [NSP][ENG]
description:
Pomogite Sayyuki, snezhnoy printsesse, razrushit proklyatie i osvobodit svoego lyubimogo. Naydite 8 volshebnykh predmetov, zateryannykh na 8 zemlyakh. Proydite slozhnyy put skvoz Metelnye Gory, Zamok Monstrov i Adskuyu Dolinu, pobezhdaya na khodu raznoobraznykh demonov.

Sayyuki mozhet upravlyat vodoy, sozdavaya oruzhie dlya srazheniy s raznoobraznymi monstrami. Sobirayte kristally raznykh tsvetov, chtoby menyat i usilivat tipy atak: skorostnaya, troynaya ili samonavodyashchayasya.

Srazhaytes s mnozhestvom vragov: mumiyami, vedmami, fonaryami-privideniyami i udivitelnymi demonami!
Poprobuyte pobedit gigantskikh demonov - glavnykh bossov, podsteregayushchikh vas v kontse kazhdogo urovnya.

Ispolzuyte osobuyu Metelnuyu ataku, chtoby zamorazhivat demonov odnim makhom, a takzhe soedinyayte ataki dlya luchshikh rezultatov!

Igrayte v odinochku ili s drugom, predostaviv emu
rol sestry Sayyuki - Koyuki.

Sobirayte snezhnykh fey, spryatannykh na vsekh 8 zemlyakh, chtoby razblokirovat rezhim Boss Ataki kak dlya odinochnoy igry, tak i dlya multipleera.

title: Saturday Morning RPG [NSZ][ENG]
description: Molodoy parenyok po imeni Marti zasypaet pered ryadovym shkolnym dnyom i vidit neveroyatnyy son: budto by on ochutilsya v magicheskoy strane vmeste s magicheskim bloknotom.

title: Swords and Souls Neverseen [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Kompaniya SoulGame Studio, podarivshaya miru neveroyatno populyarnuyu igru Swords & Souls,
sozdala novoe masshtabnoe priklyuchenie, deystvie kotorogo proiskhodit na dalekom
zamorskom ostrove. V igre Swords & Souls: Neverseen vy poterpite korablekrushenie i
okazhetes v samom tsentre protivostoyaniya uzhasnoy vedmy i chudakovatykh obitateley
ostrova. Treniruytes, srazhaytes, a potom snova treniruytes i snova srazhaytes, chtoby
ostanovit vedmu. Vas zhdet uvlekatelnaya odinochnaya igra, sosredotochennaya na srazheniyakh,
i nagrady za umeniya i bystryy progress.

Osobennosti igry:

- Uvlekatelnye i zakhvatyvayushchie mini-igry dlya razvitiya kharakteristik vashego personazha
- Dinamichnye srazheniya, sochetayushchie poshagovyy rezhim s rezhimom realnogo vremeni
- Srazheniya s ordami vragov na ostrove Neversin i v ego okrestnostyakh
- Dressirovka pitomtsev i znakomstva s zabavnymi naemnikami, kotorye budut srazhatsya na vashey storone
- Izmenenie stilya igry blagodarya shesti vidam oruzhiya, passivnym umeniyam i unikalnym koltsam
- Uluchsheniya doma i trenirovochnoy ploshchadki dlya razvitiya kharakteristik i polucheniya opyta
- Pokupka snaryazheniya, vklady v mestnyy muzey, pokhody po magazinam i na rybalku. I eto tolko chast vozmozhnykh razvlecheniy!
- Vozmozhnost prodolzhit igru posle zaversheniya: vas zhdet beskonechnyy rezhim i sluchaynye vstrechi
- Setevye spiski liderov, gde budut otobrazhatsya vashi rekordy
- Veselaya istoriya, polnaya syurprizov i yumora

title: Pixel Heroes Mega Byte & Magic [NSP][ENG]
description:
«O, Khak Khammerson! Vy uzhe zdes! Slava bogu! V obshchem, novosti skvernye. Dukhi stikhiy stanovyatsya vse bolee bespokoynymi. Vnov nazrevaet khaos. Vidimo, moi utomlennye glaza eshche ne vse povidali!»

Voydi v mir pikselnykh geroev i podgotov sebya k zakhvatyvayushchemu priklyucheniyu v stile RPG/Roguelike, podobnogo kotoromu ty nikogda ne videl prezhde! 

Issleduyte nepredskazuemyy mir, polnyy zakhvatyvayushchikh sobytiy, smertelnykh tverdyn i samykh strannykh NPC, kotorykh vy kogda-libo vstrechali v igre! 

Vyberi trekh geroev dlya vashey missii i vozmi ikh s soboy v puteshestvie - unikalnoe pri kazhdom novom zapuske igry. Upivaysya morem poluchennykh trofeev i pobezhday zlye sily, kotorye ugrozhayut gorodu Pixton! 

Osobennosti:
– 33 razblokiruemykh klassa so svoimi unikalnymi navykami i kharakteristikami.
– Bolshe protsedurno generiruemykh toporov, kopiy, bulav, mechey, shchitov, lukov, arbaletov, zaklinaniy i molitv, chem volos na tele lamy.
– 17 tainstvennykh, prekrasnykh i neveroyatno opasnykh podzemeliy. I epicheskie bitvy s bossami vdobavok!
– Chetyre kampanii, kazhdaya s finalnym podzemelem i bossom.
– Rezhim odnoy zhizni! Vy ved etogo khotite.
– Detalizirovannoe kladbishche, gde vy mozhete oplakivat pavshikh geroev, sravnivat ikh rezultaty i smotret, kakie resheniya priveli k skoropostizhnym smertyam.
– Krayne bezumnye neigrovye personazhi s vazhnymi syuzhetnymi liniyami. Proydite ikh, chtoby poluchit krutye veshchichki v nagradu!
– Mnozhestvo sluchaynykh sobytiy, kotorye proizoydut vo vremya vashikh priklyucheniy i potrebuyut sdelat vazhnyy vybor. A vy budete neistovo krichat na koshku?
– Beskonechnyy rezhim areny s bonusnymi effektami i vozrastayushchim urovnem slozhnosti.

title: Pinku Kult Hex Mortis [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Psikhodelicheskaya rolevaya advenchura c koloritneyshimi personazhami, zagadkami i klassicheskimi poshagovymi boyami!
Vas (glavnogo geroya) nanimaet odna korporatsiya dlya provedeniya sekretnogo rassledovaniya. Izuchite vse proisshestviya, svyazannye s ischeznoveniem lyudey i ikh strannymi smertyami.. Predpolagaetsya, chto vinovnik vsego nekaya devushka v maske, no dokazatelstv — net!
Ogromnye podzemelya i osobnyaki s privideniyami zhdut vas!

title: Pick My Heart Chapter 2 [NSZ][ENG]
description:
這部以動畫為靈感的視覺小說發生在一個充滿活力的現代世界，神話與現實交織在一起，帶來幽默、感人的時刻，有時也充滿挑戰。


魔法的瞬間 在第2章中，索塔與各個角色之間的關係更加深厚，每個角色都有著獨特的秘密和個性。無論是與愛芙羅狄蒂、赫拉、雅典娜還是厄里斯相遇，索塔都發現自己在驚喜、情感揭示和激烈的遭遇中，這些遭遇考驗著他的忠誠與愛意。


愛情的痕跡 每位女神都為索塔的生活帶來了新的視角。無論是在溫馨的卡拉OK俱樂部相遇，還是在寧靜浪漫的場所探索，索塔的選擇塑造了他的旅程，每次相遇都讓他更接近理解愛情的複雜性。


主要特色:
- 現代愛情故事與神話的結合
- 改變並塑造故事的關鍵選擇
- 四位美麗的希臘女神，每位都有自己的故事和秘密
- 諸神與凡人共存的現代生活與古代神話的鮮明融合
- 諸如卡拉OK約會等獨特的地點與事件
- 關於愛情的複雜神界與凡間的考驗

title: Cat's Request [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
有一天，他們平靜的生活被突然出現的電腦病毒所打亂，這病毒威脅到所有有感知的程序。Ash扮演偵探的角色，解開這個病毒之謎。

你可以在Ash和他的虛擬助理之間切換。只有一個角色可以進入某些地點。

- 完成任務並獲得報酬
- 在生成器中創造物品
- 監控你的心理健康
- 奇幻冒險和一個未探索的世界在等著你
- 與你的助理協同工作
- 找出真相
- 揭露罪犯

title: Terrifier the Artcade Game [NSP][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 机器翻译 来自 most2820 用于 v65536
description:
Terrifier («Uzhasayushchiy») — amerikanskiy malobyudzhetnyy slesher 2016 goda; rezhissyorom filma vystupil Demien Leone, voplotivshiy v filme obraz Arta, takzhe izobrazhyonnogo v ego korotkometrazhnykh rabotakh «Devyatyy krug» (2008) i «Nesushchiy uzhas» (2011) i filme «Kanun Dnya Vsekh Svyatykh» (2013). V kartine snimalis Dzhenna Kenell, Samanta Skaffidi, Ketrin Korkoran i Devid Khovard Tornton. Osnovnym mestom deystviya filma stanovitsya vetkhiy mnogokvartirnyy dom, predstavlyayushchiy soboy labirint, skvoz kotoryy dolzhny proyti geroi, Tara Kheyz i eyo sestra Viktoriya, srazhayas s klounom Artom.
«Terrifier: The ARTcade Game» — eto super-krovavyy retro-bitemap s beshenym ekshenom i mnozhestvom zabavnykh otsylok k franshize «Terrifier». Primerte na sebya rol klouna Arta — strashnogo i nepredskazuemogo zlodeya iz serii filmov «Uzhasayushchiy» — i dayte khaosu zavladet mirom. Deystvie kazhdogo urovnya razvorachivaetsya na syomochnoy ploshchadke filma ob Arte, i vasha zadacha — narushit vse plany!

title: Omensight Definitive edition [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description: Ot nagrazhdyonnykh sozdateley Stories: The Path of Destinies, Omensight - eto ekshn igra-golovolmka. Vy - Predvestnik, mogushchestvennyy misticheskiy voin. Vy stali svidetelyam razrusheniya mira. Chtoby predotvratit unichtozhenie, vam suzhdeno povtoryat etot rokovoy den i raskryt ubiystvo Bezbozhnoy-Zhritsy, smert kotoroy uskorila apokalipsis.

title: Nightmare Boy [NSZ][ENG]
description: Eta istoriya proiskhodit v Donoroke, v gosudarstve Noktum. Posle ischeznoveniya korolya Noktuma Astera v mire votsarilsya khaos. Otnosheniya mezhdu monstrami, mongami i snovidtsami absolyutno nestabilny, i Donorok, zemlya, na kotoruyu stol silno povliyala eta smuta, malo-pomalu zakhvatyvaet zemli v sosednikh regionakh.

title: Neo Atlas 1469 [NSP][ENG]
description:
在15世紀，大航海時代的歐洲。這是世界的姿態還不明確，人們堅信它是平的的時代。
追尋世界的盡頭有著什麼的答案，收集有關世界的資訊，並做出只屬於自己的世界地圖——但是進行冒險的是優秀的提督們。玩家將會成為里斯本（葡萄牙）的貿易商人，雇用船隊，挑戰製作世界地圖的偉大事業。
要不要來試著揭開真實的世界的面紗呢？

身為貿易商人的玩家要聽取探險回來的提督們的報告，並以此為依據製作地圖。這些提督們的報告從值得信賴的內容，到說有怪物出現，有些不可靠的內容都有，相當千變萬化。但是只有玩家相信的事情，才會被記錄在玩家製作的地圖上。因此，玩家相信了什麼，或者不相信什麼，世界的形狀也會跟著變化為各式各樣的風貌。

說不定美洲大陸不存在，而亞特蘭提斯或姆大陸卻存在呢。在只有玩家相信的事才會成為真實的世界中，玩家完成的獨一無二的地圖，正是反映了玩家的價值觀的「主觀世界」。

title: Path to Mnemosyne [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]

title: Nairi: Tower of Shirin, Rising Tide [NSP][ENG]
description:
NAIRI: Tower of Shirin — ocharovatelnoe graficheskoe priklyuchenie s milymi personazhami, kotoroe ponravitsya igrokam vsekh vozrastov, kotorye lyubyat interesnye syuzhety i golovolomki.
Raskroyte temnuyu taynu zagadochnoy Bashni Sirin! V mire, gde polno udivitelnykh i smertelno opasnykh sushchestv, Nairi predstoit obvodit vokrug paltsa kotov-razboynikov, naladit druzheskie otnosheniya s kriminalnymi seleznyami i vybratsya iz sereznoy peredryagi.

title: Masters of Anima [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description: Masters of Anima — eto originalnaya priklyuchencheskaya igra, v kotoroy tebe otkroetsya magicheskiy mir Iskry. Srazhaysya s silami zla v strategicheskikh i dinamichnykh bitvakh, iskhod kotorykh zavisit ot bystrykh takticheskikh resheniy. Sobiray i komanduy ogromnymi armiyami, v ryadakh kotorykh mozhet byt do 100 moguchikh strazhey razlichnykh vidov, dlya kazhdogo iz kotorykh kharakterny unikalnye sposobnosti, blagodarya intuitivnomu i innovatsionnomu igrovomu protsessu.

title: Heroland [NSZ][ENG]
description: Vy — ekskursovod noveyshego magicheskogo parka razvlecheniy, i vasha zadacha — pomoch 20 unikalnym gostyam vyzhit sredi mnozhestva monstrov-maskotov i v razlichnykh smertelno opasnykh podzemelyakh. Pomogayte svoey komande iz 4 geroev — vybirayte dlya nikh strategi, remontiruyte oruzhie i ne dayte im pogibnut! Eta ekstsentrichnaya istoriya o printsesse, rabotnikakh po sovmestitelstvu i pikselnykh chelovechkakh podarit vam nezabyvaemye vpechatleniya... za svoyu tsenu.

title: The Forbidden Arts [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Kogda Feniks, glavnyy personazh igry, ishchet soveta u druida, chtoby razobratsya so svoimi predstavleniyami, ona probuzhdaet v nem skrytuyu piromaniyu. S etogo nachinaetsya epicheskoe puteshestvie – ot skromnogo nachala do osvoeniya stikhii ognya.

Vazhnye kharakteristiki:
• 5 mirov so mnozhestvom urovney
• 6 srazheniy s bossami
• 30+ unikalnykh vragov
• 12+ chasov igry

• Napravte plamya piromana na vybrasyvanie na vragov i bosoov opustoshitelnykh zaklinaniy, zashchitu ego ot povrezhdeniy i manipulirovanie okruzhayushchey obstanovkoy.

• Issleduyte ogromnye miry s vozmozhnostyu sokhranyat progress prakticheski v lyubom meste i v lyuboe vremya. Mozhno pereklyuchatsya mezhdu 2-mernoy igroy v podvalakh i 3-mernoy pri issledovanii karty mira.

• Proverte svoe provorstvo, vzbirayas na steny, prygaya cherez provaly, karabkayas po vinogradnym lozam i manevriruya v usloviyakh raznoy obstanovki s sootvetstvuyushchimi prepyatstviyami i trudnostyami.

• Prodvigaytes po uvlekatelnomu syuzhetu, sleduya za parnem, kotoryy ishchet pravdu o sebe i nakhodit grandioznye priklyucheniya drevney magii.

• Vypolnyayte zadaniya neigrovykh personazhey i reshayte golovolomki, kotorye vstretite na puti. 

• Naydite davno zabytye taynye predmety i mesta, chtoby razblokirovat sposobnosti i zarabotat dostizheniya.

Prishlo vremya mobilizovat svoy vnutrenniy ogon i dokazat miru, chto vy mozhete nazyvatsya piromanom. Sygrayte v Forbidden Arts segodnya.

title: Paradise Marsh [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Vy prosypaetes na mirnom bolote i obnaruzhivaete, chto zvezdy, napolnyavshie nebo, upali na zemlyu. 
Vas zhdut zhivopisnye, tainstvennye mesta; zhivnost, kotoruyu nuzhno lovit sachkom; besedy s nezabyvaemymi personazhami... 
Po puti mozhno rvat tsvety, est griby, nakhodit poslaniya v pustykh butylkakh i mnogoe drugoe! 
Vernutsya li na nebo propavshie sozvezdiya?

- Lovite lyagushek, svetlyachkov i drugikh sushchestv s unikalnymi chertami i osobennostyami!
- Znakomtes s chudesnymi zvezdnymi dikaryami v istorii, polnoy priklyucheniy.
- Issleduyte unikalnyy protsedurno-generiruemyy mir s kazhdym zapuskom igry!
- Sobirayte zagadochnye zapiski v raznykh ugolkakh Topi i raskroyte ee tayny...
- Slushayte krasochnye stikhi mileyshikh ptits!
- Naslazhdaytes prirodoy: zdes net metok zadaniy, net minikart i net nikakikh ogranicheniy po vremeni.
- Sryvayte tsvety, eshte strannye griby, lepite snegovikov, brosayte v vodu «blinchiki»... i zanimaytes drugimi interesnymi delami!
- Vas zhdet upoitelnyy zvukovoy dizayn ot Disasterpeace! (FEZ)

title: Charming Hearts [NSP][ENG]
developer: Kunyu Technology, Juhuo Culture, Yiran Films
description:
是乍見之歡下的一見鍾情，還是久處不厭中的漸生情愫？
是對那個嬌憨的“她”心生憐愛，抑或對那個霸道的“她”俯首貼耳？
是在牽手耳語的下午沉浸於“她”的溫柔聰慧，還是在臉紅心跳的午夜迷失與“她”的野性冒險……
玩家將與形色各異的美女們相識、相知、相戀，體驗愛情的無數可能和多重面貌。
每一次選擇，都會導向與“她”截然不同的化學反應；每一次的糾結，蜜糖般的愛情都在纏繞拉扯；與她們的怦然心動，旋複如不休止的舞曲，可極致的柔情，為何帶著一絲微苦？

——平凡如我，也有枯木開花的一天嗎？
——那一樹的風華，你會擷取哪一朵？
是看似霸道傲嬌，實則溫柔體貼的人間富貴花？
是表面禁欲肅穆，實則火辣性感的未亡人？
是集萬千寵愛於一身，卻唯獨青睞你一人的頂流大明星？
是純情體貼、偶爾脫線的雙面甜妹？
是紅袖添香、與你心照神交的知性女神？
還是春風般柔情、春雨般含愁的校園白月光？
各色美女輪番登場，螢幕前的你，快來奔赴這一場酣暢淋漓的愛情！

產品特色
■ 有呼吸感的戀愛體驗
《怦然心動的瞬間》，採取第一人稱真人實拍，在玩家遊覽遊戲的過程中，營造真實可感的戀愛氛圍，讓玩家充分體驗有呼吸感的戀愛。

■ 扎實有趣的劇情，多元不落俗的故事走向
職業編劇把關，確保每條故事線起承轉合絲滑流暢不割裂，劇情乾貨滿滿絕不注水，情節分支複雜多變，多種結局和隱藏暗線等待玩家解鎖。

■ 真人實拍，場景升級
全程由職業演員出演，一顰一笑直戳玩家內心；場景豐富度較同類產品大幅度提升，精挑細選、不落俗套。力求讓玩家在精緻浪漫的氛圍裡，全身心融入溫柔鄉之中。

■ 多變的玩法，更高的自由度，更充分的遊玩時長
在常規的遊玩過程中，本作加入了更多的玩法，創新的遊玩體驗與複雜的劇情帶來更高的自由度，豐富的探索混合細膩的人物線鋪陳，讓給玩家的遊玩感受更加酣暢淋漓。

■ 性格迥異卻不標籤化
六位女生無論是那種性格，都有挖掘反轉的空間，每一步的深入瞭解，都有意向不到的發展等著玩家，層次豐富的人物，帶來跟真實的戀愛觸覺，不知不覺中，體會真正的怦然心動。

title: Western 1849 Reloaded [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Back in 1849, when the West was Wild and gunslingers faced off on the street, gold was discovered in the sleepy town of Sunset Bluff. Like a coyote drawn to the scent of blood, the Quicksilver Bandits rode into town to seize the mines and establish the law of the gun. The helpless citizens have suffered, and now they're looking to you, their savior. Draw your weapons! It is time to clear Sunset Bluff of the bloodthirsty vermin!


Features:
• GUNSLINGER ROLE - aim with your Joy-Con™ controllers like with a real Gun or use the Left Stick and Right Stick (in Handheld Mode)
• Upgradeable weapons (Revolvers, Shotguns, Rifles...)
• Immersive, ultra-slick, toon-shaded graphics
• Five unique, action-packed levels
• Unlockable Perk Cards and Charms - to refine each playthrough
• Rage Mode - to make you invincible and boost the pace even more!


Western 1849 Reloaded is a captivating Arcade Shooter, that will take you through the ultimate gunfights across various locations of the Wild West.

title: Voyage [NSP][Multi]
description:
Voyage — eto kinematograficheskaya igra-priklyuchenie s sovmestnym issledovaniem. 

Nezavisimo ot togo, budete li vy igrat samostoyatelno ili sovmestno, v tsentre puteshestviya vsegda budet dvoe vyzhivshikh, kotorye ishchut otvety na voprosy davno zabytogo proshlogo. 

Otpravlyaytes v puteshestvie, raskroyte taynu i naydite dorogu domoy vmeste.

* Sovmestnaya igra — samostoyatelno ili s drugom napravlyayte dvoikh vyzhivshikh i issleduyte mir igry Voyage v unikalnom sovmestnom rezhime.
* Narisovannaya vruchnuyu grafika — pogruzites v yarkuyu, sozdannuyu vruchnuyu grafiku mira Voyage.
* Besslovesnaya istoriya — ishchite otvety v tainstvennom i bezmolvnom puteshestvii.
* Bez zhestokosti — aktsent Voyage postavlen na issledovaniyakh, a ne na zhestokosti, poetomu igrat v nee mogut igroki lyubogo vozrasta.
* Zvukovoe pogruzhenie — muzyka i zvuki ot Kaluma Bouena.

title: Uchi Home Training うちトレ ～最短4分 筋トレ＆有酸素運動～ [NSZ][JAP]
description:
Effektivno szhigayte lishnie obyomy s pomoshchyu trenirovki myshts i aerobnykh uprazhneniy!.. Sochetaya vysokointensivnuyu trenirovku, prisedaniya i skruchivaniya myshts zhivota s aerobnymi uprazhneniyami, takimi kak boks, dzhazovyy tanets, samba i aerobika, eta fitnes-igra predlagaet vam polnotsennuyu programmu uprazhneniy s dzhoykonami, doma!
45 tipov dvizheniy, napravlennykh na trenirovku myshts i anaerobnye uprazhneniya, takie kak vypady, pryzhki i skruchivaniya, pozvolyaya realizovat metody HIIT spetsialno na Nintendo Switch.
Aerobnye uprazhneniya, takie kak tantsy i boks! Nabor vklyuchaet v sebya 20 tipov aerobnykh uprazhneniy «Ritm-Fit» v techenie dlitelnogo perioda vremeni, privodyashchiy telo v ritm. Poprobuyte neobychnye tantsy, takie kak «Parapara» i «Otagey», chtoby razvlechsya!
A velikolepnye yaponskie aktery ozvuchki (seyyu) budut podderzhivat vash dukh! Pyat instruktorov s raznymi kharakterami ne tolko dayut poleznye sportivnye sovety: kak pravilno dvigatsya, stavit ruki i nogi, no takzhe zamotiviruyut vas i v nuzhnyy moment podderzhat v vashey povsednevnoy deyatelnosti.Videotreyler.

title: Tears of Avia [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
Podberite gruppu pod svoy stil igry: Tears of Avia — eto strategicheskaya RPG i poshagovaya takticheskaya igra, gde mnogoe zavisit ot vybora i razvitiya navykov. Podberite gruppu, podkhodyashchuyu k vashey taktike, kombiniruya sushchestvuyushchie v igre klassy: sledopyt, voin, zhrets, mag i boets. 

Gibkaya sistema navykov: issleduyte bezgranichnye vozmozhnosti sochetaniya navykov i ikh vzaimodeystvie, okazyvayushchee ogromnoe vliyanie na iskhod boya!

Dinamichnyy syuzhet: resheniya, kotorye vy prinimaete dlya svoey gruppy, opredelyayut razvitie syuzheta. Razgovarivaya s raznymi personazhami, vy budete aktivirovat pobochnye zadaniya. Sudba Estery zavisit ot togo, kogo vy vyberete sebe v sputniki, a takzhe ot vashikh sobstvennykh deystviy. 

Navyki, zavisyashchie ot oruzhiya: sotni razlichnykh navykov zavisyat ne tolko ot vybrannogo klassa, no i ot oruzhiya, chto otkryvaet novye strategicheskie vozmozhnosti. 

Issleduyte ogromnyy zatyagivayushchiy mir: puteshestvuyte po nepokhozhim drug na druga regionam Estery i drevnim korolevstvam v poiskakh zabytogo goroda Avalona i lyubvi, poteryannoy mnogo let nazad. 

Zdes net nichego cherno-belogo: net pravilnykh i nepravilnykh deystviy, no kazhdoe iz nikh imeet posledstviya, opredelyayushchie vash put...

title: Dead Secret Circle [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Proshlo pyat let s tekh por, kak Patritsiya Geybl samostoyatelno raskryla taynu smerti Kharrisa Bullarda. V protsesse rassledovaniya ona byla podvergnuta vozdeystviyu apparata Lunar Dream, ustroystva, kotoroe mozhet raskryvat sekrety podsoznaniya..
No teper, v tishine kholodnoy zimy v Chikago, smertelnyy ubiytsa presleduet Patritsiyu v ee snakh. Svyazana li eta novaya ugroza s korpusom Woodcutter?
Uglubites v svoyo podsoznanie, chtoby nayti otvet i poymat ego, prezhde chem on snova popytaetsya napast!

title: Panic in Sweets Land [NSZ][ENG]
description:
雖然想遊玩暢快的動作遊戲，操作可愛的魔法少女讓敵人被連段攻擊粉碎，
但討厭複雜的操作……

就是想隨心所欲地遊玩。如果沒有的話，就徹底地，做一個吧。

擊碎明亮華麗世界觀的爆裂動作，現在在此登場！

◆本作品的特色

①用簡單的操作施展超華麗動作！如果連續連段的話，攻擊力會爆發性上升！
②透過商店道具等RPG式成長來擴增追加動作與狀態！
③關卡內到處都藏有道具！探索地圖也充滿樂趣！
④戰鬥風格可自由地交換兩個角色攻略關卡！
⑤結局內容也很豐富！無論何時都可以繼續遊玩！

◆故事

和人界存在於不同世界，居住著奇妙生物的國度──席魯菲王國。
這裡是受妖精女王米露露所統治的奇幻世界。

據說席魯菲王國大部分的土地都被妖精們改造成障礙賽道，
充斥著滿滿的玩心。

居住在這個國度的妖精們是一群純真無邪、開朗快樂的生物。

可是有一天，他們被邪惡之心埃比珥控制，變身成了凶暴的魔物。
至於為什麼會受到埃比珥的控制，目前仍是個謎團。

究竟蕾夢、茗特、帕比三人能否將埃比珥趕出妖精們的心，
讓席魯菲王國恢復和平呢？

title: Restless Soul [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Prigotovtes k do smerti uvlekatelnym priklyucheniyam! Pomogite bespokoynomu dukhu vernutsya v mir zhivykh v etoy zhutko zabavnoy priklyuchencheskoy igre, polnoy shutok o zhizni, smerti, videoigrakh, pop-kulture i mnogom drugom.
Otvazhno srazhaytes pod gradom pul, puteshestvuya po cherno-belomu miru v poiskakh vosmi klyuchey, otkryvayushchikh portal v mir zhivykh. Odnako eti klyuchi nuzhny ne tolko vam… Zlobnyy doktor Krull i ego armiya popytayutsya zapoluchit ikh ranshe vas, a Smert s kosoy poydet na vse, chtoby ne dat vam sbezhat.
Pobezhdayte vragov, razgadyvayte golovolomki i smeytes do upadu, vypolnyaya pobochnye ispytaniya i brosaya vyzov arkadnym mini-igram. A «pomozhet» vam v etom flegmatichnyy prizrachnyy pes po klichke Gav (i da, ego mozhno pogladit).
Sdelayte vse, chto v vashikh silakh, ved eto vopros zhizni i smerti!

OSOBENNOSTI
• Naslazhdaytes do smerti smeshnymi dialogami, vdrebezgi razbivayushchimi «chetvertuyu stenu».
• Srazhaytes pod gradom pul v opasnykh bashnyakh s golovolomkami, dvizhushchimisya platformami i vragami, ispolzuyushchimi raznye vidy pul i ataki.
• Uvorachivaytes ot pul na kovarnykh urovnyakh, gde nelzya strelyat i vypolnyat ryvok.
• Vypolnyayte pobochnye ispytaniya, sredi kotorykh — poisk vsekh tainstvennykh zdaniy i spasenie plennikov.
• Brosayte vyzov arkadnym mini-igram, vdokhnovlennym igroy Tapper, tirom i ne tolko.
• Poprobuyte zarabotat vse dostizheniya, vklyuchaya poluchenie 9 bukv iz nazvaniya igry v kazhdom gorode.
• Izuchite 8 gorodov i povstrechayte bolee 100 «yarkikh» personazhey v monokhromnom pikselnom mire.
• Ispolzuyte svoy grobofon, chtoby snyat selfi s lyubimymi personazhami i sokhranit teplye vospominaniya o Zagrobnom mire.
• Vklyuchite «Rezhim boga» ili mnozhitel sily igroka, chtoby dobitsya nuzhnogo urovnya slozhnosti.

title: Macrotis a Mother's Journey [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Macrotis 講述了一位母親不懈地尋找失踪孩子的故事，這是一個情感故事通過植被茂盛的 2.5D 平台講述,充滿了發人深省的難題。 在美麗而危險的環境中攀爬，跳躍並咬，用自己的方式，避免陷阱，並利用水的物理學來發揮自己的優勢。 隨著你的前進，你將獲得各種自然的和超自然的能力，以克服前進道路上的障礙。 你會幫助母親比爾比拯救她的家人嗎？

特色：

• 瀏覽看似美麗的風景。
• 通過咬和挖掘來克服障礙！
• 控制水的物理學以免遇溺。
• 獲得穿過牆壁或升起障礙物的魔法能力。
• 收集收藏品以了解環繞世界的知識！

title: Illuminaria [NSZ][RUS/Multi12]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 12]
description:
指揮一隊智慧型機器人，拯救整個世界。你要一邊採集資源，一邊管理和防守多個基地。踏上遠征的旅途，參與自動戰鬥，同時研發新的科技，並打造你的魔像大軍，以驅散黑暗、找回光明為目標。

■ 雖然需要操控成群的智慧型機器人，但遊戲互動操作簡單直觀。

只要決定好建築的位置和需要採集的資源，後續的苦力活就可以交給機器人了。它們會採集資源、建造建築、裝填武器、戰鬥，也會對周邊環境產生反應。

■ 防守基地，抵禦襲擊

黑暗的敵人邪惡狠毒，他們會襲擊你的基地，企圖摧毀反應爐以搶奪資源。建造防禦設施並裝填彈藥，擊退入侵的敵人吧。

■ 建設多個基地並加以管理

遊戲中沒有沙盒世界，你需要在有限的空間建設多個小型基地。所有基地都會持續運作，但同時也有可能遭到敵方襲擊，所以務必多加小心。

■ 深入地城，遠征作戰，尋找珍貴文物

踏上探索的冒險旅程，在自動戰鬥中迎戰敵人，並尋找隱藏的寶藏。你將有機會獲得助益良多的稀有資源。

■ 在不同區域研發新科技

遊戲共有五個區域，每一區的資源和科技各有差異

■ 點亮光塔，打造軍隊，進而解放整個世界

光界星球已被黑暗佔領。點亮各地的光塔，率領魔像大軍驅散黑暗，逐一解放五個區域，慢慢瞭解這顆星球的境遇。

title: Can Androids Pray Blue / Can Androids Survive [NSZ][ENG]
developer: Xalavier Nelson Jr, Natalie Clayton, Priscilla Snow
description:
Stante khodyachey dvukhtonnoy liniey snabzheniya v novom korotkometrazhnom shutere ot pervogo litsa s pesochnitsey ot avtora Can Androids Pray.

V Can Androids Survive vy vystupaete v roli kurera na pole boya, otpravlennogo v aktivnuyu zonu boevykh deystviy na Lune, chtoby dostavlyat pripasy na bazy Starbound Alliance, dazhe esli eto budet stoit vam zhizni. Srazites s istoshchayushchimsya toplivnym datchikom, polchishchami mekhanicheskikh opasnostey i kovarnoy lunnoy poverkhnostyu, chtoby razgadat prirodu svoego sushchestvovaniya.

Sbrasyvayte toplivo cherez vykhlopnye otverstiya, chtoby izbezhat zvezdnykh poplavkovykh min i zapustit svoe shassi cherez kratery. Prekratite samu voynu - unichtozhiv pole.

V 2143 godu II-izgoy zakhvatyvaet oboronitelnye sputniki, okruzhayushchie mertvuyu Zemlyu, i vzryvaet Lunu.

Vot kak vy eto delaete.

title: 12 is Better Than 6 [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
1873 god - vremena bezzakoniya i zhestokosti na Dikom Zapade. Ty sbezhal s katorgi i napravlyaeshsya v Tekhas. No derzhi pushku nagotove, ved za tvoyu golovu obyavlena krupnaya nagrada i naemniki poydut na vse, chtoby ostanovit tebya.


Vysokaya slozhnost:
Puli razletayutsya v storony, a beschislennye vragi ne razdumyvayut pered vystrelom.

Autentichnoe oruzhie:
Ispolzuy realnoe oruzhie, chtoby dostich svoikh tseley. Vintovka, dvustvolnoe oruzhie, revolver, luk i dazhe pulemyot sistemy Gatlinga.

Lokatsii:
Realnye goroda - San-Antonio, Albukerke i Khyuston, indeyskie poseleniya, dukh pustyni i samye otchayannye banditos peredayut atmosferu nastoyashchego Dikogo Zapada.

Vybor stilya:
Stels-elementy dayut tebe pravo vybora, ved ne vsegda est zhelanie riskovat svoey zhiznyu. Bolshuyu chast igry mozhno proyti, ostavayas nezamechennym. Put vybiraesh tolko ty.

Zakhvatyvayushchaya istoriya:
Bolee shesti chasov syuzhetnoy kampanii o puteshestvii sbezhavshego meksikanskogo katorzhnika, kotoryy boretsya za vyzhivanie i svobodu v seredine XIX veka v Soedinennykh Shtatakh.

title: Orangeblood [NSZ][ENG]
description:
[199X, New Koza]
It's the end of the 20th century, on a historic timeline different from that which we know. A manmade island off the coast of Okinawa is humming with a dirty, exotic vibe - and it's awesome!
Rust and faded concrete glisten in the morning sun and the late-night neon, showing off the various faces of the island.

[Amazing Soundtrack]
Let yourself go to the subtropical sun, the sound of the waves, and the scent of dank weed, and let some real deep cuts and unknown classics of 1990s hiphop take you away. It doesn't matter whether you're chilling on a couch on a rooftop, having a drink at the bar, or capping fools in a firefight in some sketchy alleyway - these dope-ass tracks are gonna get you moving!

[Four "Kawaii" Soldiers]
Hey you! Do you like hardcore adventures where you take on the role of an even harder-core badass tasked with beating the crap out of a bunch of demons? Well, so do I, but sometimes it's fun to try out something a little different, you know?
These four cute Asian girls couldn't care less about little photo stickers... They'd rather play with some 7.62x39mm rifles and filthy, filthy cash!

[Simple-yet-deep Turn-based Gunfighting]
Use simple controls to take down evil gang members and killer robots! In New Koza, you can purchase randomly-generated and extremely powerful guns, 24/7.
Load up a shotgun so powerful you'd burn yourself to toast if the gas leaked and some brand-new fireproof sneakers, find a group of psychotic yakuza thugs, and personally deliver a handwritten invitation to BEATDOWN TOWN!

[There's a Dog, Too!]
Ruff!

title: Infinite Seek and Find + 2 DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
歡迎來到終極隱藏物品挑戰。《尋物大師：這裏什麼都沒有》邀請你參與一場獨特的尋物體驗，每一輪都為你帶來不同的視覺挑戰。

深入觀察，應對挑戰
除了基礎的對象大小，色彩、旋轉和反射等細節都可能成為你尋找的障礙。你是否有信心找出所有隱藏的物件？

豐富的圖像集任你挑選
我們為你準備了超過10種風格迥異的圖像集，每一種都有其獨特的探索樂趣和考驗。

多重難度，多重挑戰
無論你是新手還是尋物專家，三個不同的難度級別都能為你提供適當的挑戰，為你帶來絕不枯燥的遊戲體驗。

title: One Way Heroics Plus [NSZ][ENG]
description:
A world controlled by darkness.
In game, the darkness constantly advances from the left side of the screen, swallowing up the map. If you are swallowed by the darkness, it's game over. You cannot turn back.

The screen will continue to scroll right even while shopping or fighting enemies. You must keep advancing and save the world. In One Way Heroics, if the player moves or attacks enemies will do the same.

In essence, it is a rogue-like game.
To clear the game, you must defeat the Demon Lord, who will appear after a set time. One round is around 30 minutes play time, and some parts of your legend carry over into the next round. See if you can overcome the challenges of this one way adventure.

Features:
・A definitive edition, including features from both One Way Heroics and One Way Heroics Plus, brought to Nintendo Switch™.
・Controls optimized for Nintendo Switch.
・Eleven classes to choose from for your player character.
・Allies and NPC's which aid your character.
・Over 260 items.
・9 different endings.
・Replay function to play back your adventures.

title: Demetrios The Big Cynical Adventure [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
Byorn Tonen - tot eshchyo neryakha i vladelets antikvarnogo magazina, zhivushchiy v Parizhe. Odnazhdy nochyu on vozvrashchaetsya domoy pyanym i stanovitsya zhertvoy ogrableniya. Vynuzhdennyy nachat sobstvennoe rassledovanie, zaruchivshis pomoshchyu sosedki Sandry, on postepenno osoznayot, chto stal uchastnikom vesma zaputannoy istorii.

Udastsya li nashim geroyam uznat vsyu pravdu?

- Point'n'Click vizualnaya novella, vmestivshaya v sebya smeshenie raznykh zhanrov.
- Prodolzhitelnoe i raznoobraznoe priklyuchenie (ot 8 do 12 chasov igry).
- Bolee 15.000 strok dialogov.
- Vsya igra narisovana ot ruki, vysokoe kachestvo izobrazheniya.
- Vysokiy uroven interaktivnosti.
- Neskolko interesnykh mini-igr, vstrechayushchikhsya po khodu syuzheta.
- Vnutriigrovye podskazki: poisk i sbor spryatannykh pechenek v kazhdoy lokatsii!
- Teksty polnostyu perevedeny na russkom

title: Billion Road [NSZ][ENG]
description:
«Billion Road» otpravit vas v puteshestvie po realnym prefekturam i gorodam vsey Strany voskhodyashchego solntsa, gde vasha tsel — stat samym bogatym! Do 4-kh igrokov mogut sorevnovatsya lokalno.
Zakhvati rynok Yaponii i dominiruy v mire biznesa — kak nastoyashchiy magnat!..

title: One (To the Radiant Season, Kagayaku Kisetsu e) [NSP][ENG]
developer: Tactics, Novamicus ノヴァミクス
description:
讓我能留存在這個世界的事物

1998年的冬天。
在我這個平凡學生的心中，忽然出現了另一個世界。
它如同悄悄積起的白雪，緩緩淹沒我的日常生活。
直到這時，我才幡然醒悟——
存在於周而復始的生活中的不變之物。
未曾改變過的熟悉風景。
深愛卻不自知的人帶來的溫暖。

是它們，將我繼續生活在這個世界。

那一刻，我第一次主動追尋起了重要的人，以及那條牢固的紐帶。
時光流轉，陽光灑滿大地的季節將會再次來臨。
那時，我會站在什麼樣的世界裡，又會是誰緊握著我的手呢？

讓一代人泣繫文字冒險...
傳奇視覺小說回歸，並以更新的藝術，動畫和功能更勝以往！

▼配音演員
長森 瑞佳　cv.石見 舞菜香
七瀨 留美　cv.前田 佳織里
川名 岬　cv.愛美
里村 茜　cv.立花 日菜
上月 澪　cv.高森 奈津美
椎名 繭　cv.高橋 花林

▼主題歌
名為永恆的光輝
歌手：fhána
詞：林 英樹
作編曲：佐藤 純一

title: Of Mice and Sand Revised [NSP][ENG]
description:
宇宙的那邊，在沙漠星上生活的老鼠們。
踏上沙船 前進吧 移動要塞！ 目標夢幻黃金鄉！

在【沙漠老鼠團！改！】中，率領居住在沙漠星球的【老鼠團】，
操控他們的住處──移動要塞【沙船】。這是一個朝著傳說之黃金
鄉旅行的養成冒險遊戲。

●匯集道具並享受沙漠之旅吧！
●攻略的關鍵就在於生產道具！
●在船上搭建各種設施提升能力！
●事件、敵人、荒漠…跨越各種遭遇向黃金鄉前進吧！

--渡過灼熱的沙漠
穿越暴風侵襲的廣野
向著殘破的廢墟
乘著鋼鐵之艦 朝向流沙之海！ 致敬！老鼠團！

title: Thinking of You Beyond Time [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
角色使用了E-mote動畫系統。
呼吸、眨眼、說話，栩栩如生。
並且，收錄了日語配音。

時光如流水，悄然帶走那些曾經的溫暖，
卻無法抹去深藏心底的低語。
  
回憶如晨曦中的薄霧，輕柔而朦朧，飄散在遙遠的歲月裡。  
那未曾言明的思念，如星光般在時空的彼岸閃爍，
不曾熄滅，靜靜等待被拾起的時刻。  

一段穿越時空的靜謐旅程，
帶你領略時間盡頭的情感迴響，
在無垠的歲月中感受那份永恆的牽絆。

title: Nowhere Girl [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Napivshis do zyuzikov s baykerom-volshebnikom, ty, glavnyy geroy nashey istorii, prosnulsya s privideniem v svoey posteli! Ee prizrachnyy khvost prikovan tsepyu k tvoey noge, i ona tak zhe napugana, kak i ty! Vy mozhete tryastis, bitsya, krichat, pinat i orat skolko ugodno, no est tolko odin sposob osvoboditsya ot etikh strannykh uz. Ty dolzhen v nee vlyubitsya. Chuvstvo ne obyazatelno dolzhno byt vzaimnym.
 
Stoit li vlyublyatsya v togo, kto tebya brosit? U tebya kogda-nibud byl vybor? Mozhesh li ty khotya by popytatsya poveselitsya, poka vse eto dlitsya? Ili prosto slishkom slozhno pustit vse na samotek?

title: Pan-Pan a Tiny Big Adventure [NSZ][ENG]
description:
PAN-PAN is an open plain adventure that expands on the concept of environmental narrative storytelling with puzzle solving and exploration elements at its core. 

Set against a backdrop of soothing ambient sounds crafted by renowned sound composer Simon Viklund, your task is to fix your downed spaceship and begin the pilgrimage home. 

In a world littered with world shifting riddles and sprinkled with the memorable characters - how you solve these riddles is firmly in your hands. 

Main features:

Set in an open world: Unlock new areas by collecting items and solving puzzles.
Stellar soundtrack created by acclaimed sound producer – Simon Viklund.
A balanced blend of exploration and puzzle solving game mechanics.
Story beats told through environmental interactions.
Use a mix of tools, gadgets and devices to solve puzzles and uncover the path home.

title: Skelittle A Giant Party [NSP][ENG]
description:
Skelittle — eto nezamyslovataya krasochnaya komandnaya igra, sozdannaya, chtoby razvlechsya s druzyami i v krugu semi. 
Brosayte drug drugu vyzov v seriyakh po 15 mini-igr i otkryvayte predmety, chtoby sozdavat sobstvennye igrovye seansy v rezhime «pesochnitsy».

Prevratite svoy dom v gigantskuyu igrovuyu ploshchadku!
Skelittles — eto kroshechnye igrushki, sbezhavshie iz svoikh korobok iz-pod gotovykh zavtrakov. Igrayte s nimi, prevrashchaya povsednevnuyu obstanovku v ogromnuyu igrovuyu ploshchadku!
Ubegayte ot strashnogo robota-pylesosa, voruyte lyubimyy korm svoego psa i sbrasyvayte druzey na samoe dno vanny. Kazhdaya iz mini-igr osobennaya i imeet svoi zabavnye zadaniya. 

Sozdavayte sobstvennye neveroyatnye igry!
Chem dolshe vy igraete, tem bolshe otkroete predmetov, kotorye mozhno primenyat v rezhime «pesochnitsy».
Ispolzuyte ikh, chtoby sozdavat sobstvennye neveroyatnye igry! Kak naschet igry v futbol, gde u kazhdogo igroka est reaktivnyy ranets? Igry v basketbol na ldu? Ili bezumnogo sostyazaniya v peyntbol v inversionnykh botinkakh? V mire Skelittle vozmozhno vse!

Osobennosti igry
• 15 krasochnykh i nezamyslovatykh mini-igr s razlichnym geympleem i graficheskoy sredoy.
• Rezhim «pesochnitsy» s bolee chem 50 predmetami. Otkryvayte ikh i sozdavayte sobstvennye igry!
• Rezhimy odinochnoy i komandnoy igry (1–4 igroka). Igrayte v odinochku protiv kompyutera ili priglasite druzey i rodnykh prisoedinitsya k vam v bezumnom igrovom seanse na divane.
• Prostota v ispolzovanii. Igry ochen legkie i podkhodyat dazhe detyam!
• Velikolepnaya multiplikatsionnaya grafika, blagodarya kotoroy serye budni zaigrayut yarkimi kraskami.

title: Red Ronin [NSZ][ENG]
description:
什麼是紅浪人？

一個一個，一個一個，一個一個的殺光！

Red Ronin 是一款戰術回合制但節奏快的衝刺遊戲，嗜血浪人和她的同伴機器人尋求復仇。

故事

在被前任團隊背叛後，瑞德與她的同伴機器人伊薩克開始了不間斷的復仇之旅，以消滅所有離開她的人。

title: The Uncertain Last Quiet Day [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Vy upravlyaete RT-217NP — inzhenernym robotom, kotoryy ispytyvaet neozhidannoe lyubopytstvo po otnosheniyu k davno ischeznuvshey chelovecheskoy rase. Issleduyte ruiny nekogda protsvetayushchey tsivilizatsii i popytaytes uznat pravdu ob ischeznovenii chelovechestva.

Iskusstvennyy intellekt
Est li mesto morali v mire, kotorym upravlyaet chistaya mekhanicheskaya logika? Gde kazhdoe reshenie svoditsya k prostomu naboru edinits i nuley? Vam predstoyat slozhnye vybory, kotorye otkroyut smysl chelovecheskikh postupkov s sovershenno drugoy storony.

Ostanki biologicheskogo geniya
Chelovechestvo ostavilo mnozhestvo podskazok ob istinnoy prichine ego ischeznoveniya, no eti sekrety vsegda tshchatelno okhranyalis. Na puti k pravde vas zhdyot mnozhestvo neprostykh golovolomok, poetomu budte gotovy k tomu, chtoby razgadat ikh.

Vzglyanite na Zemlyu glazami robota
Ruiny tsivilizatsii polny zagadok. V Uncertain: Last Quiet Day vy otkroete dlya sebya novyy opustevshiy mir: byvshiy shumnyy megapolis teper lish pustaya obolochka svoego bylogo velichiya, useyannaya ostankami togo, chem kogda-to bylo chelovechestvo.

Osobennosti:
- Priklyuchenie s dinamichnym syuzhetom, kotoryy budet razvivatsya v zavisimosti ot vashikh resheniy.
- Krasivaya grafika, pogloshchayushchaya atmosfera i velikolepnyy saundtrek
- Slozhnye golovolomki, kotorye brosyat vyzov dazhe samym opytnym igrokam
- Mnozhestvo skrytykh istoriy i paskhalok, kotorye skryvaet v sebe zabytyy mir

title: Space Routine [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Space Routine 是一款以物理為基礎、愚蠢的模擬遊戲，模擬太空中典型的日常生活。

玩家控制著一個太空家庭的成員，他們會像噴射包裝到工作地點，上學，從事休閒活動，購買食品雜貨，修理或更換汽車，並花一些優質的家庭時間一樣進行日常例行活動。

這款遊戲提供了一種原創的生活模擬遊戲，將愚蠢的物理學機制融入遊戲中，並以有趣的復古風格為特色，其中充滿了豐富的流行文化參考，這將會深深觸動玩家內心的童心。

Space Routine 呈現了一個科幻的視角，鼓勵玩家反思自己的日常例行活動和家庭生活。

主要特色：

• 以物理為基礎的太空生活模擬器。
• 滿足你家人的需求：健康、食物、工作、娛樂和愛。
• 為您的家庭隨機選擇起點位置。
• 迷你遊戲，讓您的日常辦公工作更輕鬆。
• 三種不同的太空汽車，讓您在太空中飛馳。
• 豐富的太空站、住宅、辦公室、商店和太空美食推車！

title: NightmareScape (Nightmare Scape, In Nightmare Director cut) [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
developer: Beijing Magic Fish Technology Co., Ltd.
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
進入驚悚駭人的異想夢境
我們的主角對現實世界關上了心扉，陷入深度睡眠，並在夢魘般的夢境中醒來。闇夜永夢 是一款旁白敘事型驚悚冒險遊戲，融入了潛入行動和各種謎題。故事圍繞著一個正在尋找最後愛的希望的小男孩而展開，主角計劃通過探索自己內心的恐懼世界實行自我救贖。

在經歷了家庭破裂及其帶來的悲痛後，一個小男孩逃離現實世界，遁入一個由他自己的記憶創造的黑暗異想世界。這使他踏上了探尋其中真相的旅程。過往在現實世界中經歷的苦痛變成了令人恐懼的怪物，它們想把我們的主角困在無盡的夢魘之中。在夢境精靈的幫助下，小男孩將設法躲過敵人，解開錯綜複雜的謎題，欣然接受自己的恐懼和揭開真相，從而淨化由他的過往記憶所創造的怪物，並最終醒來。
你會克服自己的恐懼還是深陷夢魘？

1. 希望寄託於夢境：掙脫束縛，逃離黑暗且怪異的夢境世界，四處尋找線索，逐漸揭開自己所在世界的真相。
2. 苦中解謎：你在冒險途中會遇到試圖阻礙你繼續前進的各種謎題。發揮你的聰明才智，借助夢境精靈的引導，克服重重障礙。
3. 黑暗中的亮光：控制你的夢境精靈，作為替身幫助你偵測看不見的通道或物品，以及感知前方的威脅。
4. 夢魘成真：令你真正恐懼的怪物源自你的潛意識。不要讓自己被這些怪物或潛伏的陰影抓住，那樣就會被困在無盡的夢魘之中。

title: Shanghai Summer [NSZ][RUS/Multi13]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 13]
description:
《薄暮夏夢》是一個以千禧年的上海為背景的文字冒險遊戲，講述了主角屠百川在十二個夏日內所經歷的種種「異常」……在探尋真相的過程中，時隔多年的心願與遺憾重新交匯，而他又是否能夠抓住這僅有的機會，「修復」這一切？

2003年，上海，
“屠百川”的生活突然變得怪異, 恍惚間總能看到陌生的記憶。
十二個夏日，如十二場清醒夢。 而這一切的開端，則是分別多年的前女友“季秋雨”突然地邀約。

「時間在你身上出現了異常。」

追夢的無業青年“若奉一”；
迷茫的不良高中生“吳小波”；
受家庭所累的女大學生“蘇靜嫻”……

儘管生活一片狼藉，堅強的他們依然在遺憾中負重前行，閃閃發光。

通過與友人對話中的選擇決定故事走向，與周邊互動收集話題或線索。
入睡前你將有機會整理如夢如真的線索尋找故事的關鍵，
最後在十二夜的終點——「修復」這個支離破碎的夢境。

你將決定屠百川脫離夢境見證真相，抑或是沉溺夢境尋求解脫。

老舊教室、萬一書屋、街角咖啡店……
不能再平凡的市井光景，是每個少年少女的日常，
而恰恰就在這平凡之中，潛藏孕育著多重的可能。
改變命運的那一把鑰匙，或許就藏在擦肩而過的街頭人潮中……

title: Varenje Don't Touch the Berries [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description: 讓樹莓果醬冒險給你帶來一點兒夏日樂趣！

title: Baila Latino + 5 DLC [NSP][ENG]
description:
Latin American music is suitable for all ages, and makes children and adults dance, creating an atmosphere of great amusement in front of the TV.

There are 20 hit songs (5 tracks with free DLC) to choose from, and the game's choreography has been created by professional dancers, Carlo Romano and Vera Sokolova from the “Carolyn Smith Dance Academy”.

You can play alone or with friends, up to four players at the same time.

The lyrics of the song will appear on the screen so while you are dancing, others can sing!

Baila Latino will bring lots of family fun!

title: World End Economica Ep. 01, 02, 03: Complete [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 俄语, lyubitelskiy Unkenbro
description:
從移民者們成功在月球上落腳至今，已經過了十六年的歲月。
這是一個人類文明的前線被摩天樓所埋沒，
許多人競相追逐著沒有終點夢想的時代。

在月球出生、月球長大的少年阿晴 (Haru)，也是其中一個抱有這種遠大夢想的人。
他的夢想便是要站上那前人未至之地。
為了這個夢想，他需要資金；他需要壓倒性多的資金。
少年阿晴 (Haru) 動身前往的地方，是從百年前就吞食著人類的欲望，時而讓其實現，時而無情地將其粉碎殆盡的場所。
而支配著那裡的規則只有兩條。
規則一：不要虧損。
規則二：絕對不能忘記第一條規則──。
唯有遵守這規則的人，才能獲得莫大的財富。

終於，這三部劇集的完整包裝，即將登陸Nintendo Switch!

title: Fat City [NSZ][ENG]
description: In this action-puzzler with 60 targets spread throughout the five boroughs of New York City, players will use their cunning and brain power to plan raids and execute getaways to pull in the big bucks in the city that never sleeps.

title: Pato Box [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Test your reflexes as you fight your way through an evil corporation in search for retribution. 
Uncover their deepest secrets by exploring thrilling 3d environments with a graphic novel/comic book art style.
Find the henchmen who took your dream away in an action-packed and fast-paced fights that will test you to the limit as a true boxing champion!

Will you chicken out or learn how to DUCK?

Features

-    Find the truth on Story Mode, a single player adventure filled with surprises and 3D environments as well as 2D boss fights!

-    Fight your way through Arcade Mode, defeat all the bosses as fast as possible one at a time or all in row with a special boss at the end!

-    Challenging and surreal 2D fights with a comic book art style.

-    Motion control support that will make you the real boxing champion!

-    Amazing Soundtrack by Controvol that will fill you with adrenaline.

-    Ducks!

title: Spinch [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Popadite v mir, zarazhennyy puzyrkovoy psikhodeliey. Pogruzites v glubiny novoy ekologii, izobiluyushchey mnozhestvom prokhodov, svetyashchimisya urovnyami i slozhnymi prepyatstviyami. Vyydite za predely materialnoy vselennoy, primite svoyu estestvennuyu formu giperpodvizhnogo organizma Spincha i spasti svoe poteryannoe potomstvo ot beskonechnogo nashestviya besformennykh i urodlivykh strannostey i neordinarnostey.

V Spinch ispolzuetsya oldskulnaya sistema slozhnosti, pri kotoroy vam pridetsya pereigryvat mnogie uchastki, poka vy ne ottochite vremya reaktsii i refleksy. Brosaytes, uklonyaytes, karabkaytes, plavayte, prygayte i dazhe zapuskayte svoikh sobstvennykh detey kak snaryady, chtoby pobedit shesterykh ekstsentrichnykh bossov v shesti yarkikh mirakh. Sobirayte predmety, chtoby poluchit preimushchestvo v poiske svoikh poteryannykh detey. Osteregaytes svoego kuzena — on prismatrivaet za detmi nekotorykh vashikh rodstvennikov, no on nemnogo strannyy. Tolko taymer i bystrye perezapuske — bez kontsa igry ili zhizney. Igra budet interesna dlya lyubykh igrokov, no ona stanet nastoyashchim vyzovom dazhe dlya samykh opytnykh spidrannerov.

Osobennosti
• Vizualnyy stil v stile retro s psikhodelicheskimi tsvetami, sozdannyy zasluzhennym khudozhnikom-multiplikatorom iz Kanady Dzhessi Dzheykobsom.
• Tochno vyverennaya igra, gde nuzhno delat ryvki, uklonyatsya i otprygivat ot poverkhnostey, chtoby spastis ot neonovykh paukov, gigantskikh raduzhnykh chervey i bombyashchikh lunopsov.
• Pogruzites v neobyknovennye psikhodelicheskie miry: neonovye ravniny, eksperimentalnye basseyny, zamorozhennye ostrova i dazhe otkrytyy kosmos.
• Srazites s zagadochnymi bossami i rasstrelyayte ikh svoimi detishkami — ikh mozhno ispolzovat kak boepripasy.
• Podkhodit igrokam lyubogo urovnya; idealno dlya spidranov.
• Saundtrek kanadskogo ispolnitelya Dzheymsa Kirkpatrika, sostoyashchiy iz trekov, napisannykh ili izmenennykh na Gameboys, a takzhe s ispolzovaniem izognutykh ili sozdannykh s nulya instrumentov.

title: Maggie the Magnet [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Maggie 最愛的事情絕對是科學實驗了！她是顆活潑的小磁鐵，能夠隨心所欲地發動和關閉她的磁鐵能力。她看出了科學發現的潛力後，開設了屬於自己的實驗室，現在只剩下一個關鍵的齒輪，她就能開始享受並探索自己的能力。她需要有人在旁看著她做實驗！你能夠勝任這份工作嗎？

《Maggie the Magnet》是一款基於物理設計的解謎遊戲，遊戲過程圍繞著僅僅一顆按鍵。按住按鍵，即可以發動 Maggie 的磁鐵能力，讓她飛往磁鐵指向的地方，一塊有四個磁鐵附著的鐵板。放開按鍵，可以讓 Maggie 運用重力和累積的動能，飛過缺口及施展出各種的空中特技。帶領 Maggie 翱翔實驗室和富有獨特設計的實驗，有超過 150 種具挑戰性的關卡！

特色：

• 運用重力和磁吸力來飛過棘手的單畫面關卡！
• 解開涉及物理與科學法則的環境謎題。
• 無障礙地使用單一按鍵，帶自己飛翔於實驗室中！
• 破解超過 150 種具挑戰性的關卡。
• 享受隨配樂變化的可愛自適應視覺效果！

title: Mind over Magnet [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 可选机翻 来自 most2820
description:
Platformernaya golovolomka, v kotoroy vy ispolzuete magnity, chtoby sbezhat s fabriki.
Vam predstoit obedinitsya s tremya druzyami-magnitami i ispolzovat ikh spets. sposobnosti, chtoby reshit bolee 50 kaverznykh zadachek. Eto — igra ot Marka Brauna, sozdatelya odnoimyonnogo YouTube-kanala.
A esli zakhochetsya, proydite igru vtoroy raz vmeste s kommentariyami razrabotchika, chtoby uznat, kak ona byla sozdana!..

title: Soviet Project [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
你是一名因病錯過疏散的普通市民，現在需要了解情況才能離開城市。 遊戲充滿了蘇聯晚期的氛圍，結合了恐怖類型特有的神秘和神秘元素。
探索充滿危險變異玩偶的獨特開放世界，揭開這個地方的所有謎團。 你可以摧毀他們，也可以試著避免遇見他們，選擇權在你。

特點：
• 廣闊的區域可供探索。
• 遊戲時間超過10 小時。
• 多個結局。
• 獨特的地點。
• 恐怖氣氛。

title: Karma Knight [NSZ][ENG]
description:
輪迴俠客是華彩的戰鬥和靈敏的動作構成的橫滾動遊戲。 
尋找階段里處處隱藏的項目又得到魔法而一邊成長一邊打敗眼前的敵人，能感覺到平台遊戲動作的快樂。

title: The Warlock of Firetop Mountain: Goblin Scourge Edition [NSZ][ENG]
description:
CHOOSE YOUR OWN ADVENTURE 
Battle, sneak, and charm your way through thousands of story options as you play through over a dozen major quests, each unique to a different Hero. 

SIMULTANEOUS TURN-BASED COMBAT
Experiment with a slew of interesting battle strategies! Each Hero comes with their own set of attacks and manoeuvres. Poison, crossbows, holy magic, or a good old sword and shield – however you want to take down your enemies, there’s sure to be a Hero to suit! Venture forth, kill monsters and earn Souls to prove your might and unlock all eighteen Heroes. 

WHICH HERO WILL YOU TAKE INTO THE MOUNTAIN?
Will you play as the noble and experienced adventurer Alexandra of Blacksand? Or perhaps take the pious and righteous path of battle-priest Landov Lowan? Forego the risks of combat with evasive sleep-bomb manouveurs as Krea Datura! Or get straight to the punch with hard-hitting rhino-man Twenty-Three. 

BEAUTIFULLY CRAFTED MINIATURES
Encounter the nostalgic aesthetic of classic tabletop RPGs by playing with over 100 handsomely painted character and monster miniatures as you explore the depths of Firetop Mountain. 

GOBLINS, GOBLINS, GOBLINS! 
The Hill Goblins of Firetop Mountain have been unleashed on to the realm of Allansia! This special Goblin Scourge Edition features three additional adventurers whose stories are intricately woven into the Goblin Scourge. Explore the dangerous caverns and uncover the mysteries of Scarclaw’s evil minions! 

PLAY AS A MONSTER IN THE GAUNTLET
Sick of fighting on the side of good? No problem! Play as one of Zagor’s evil minions – Slime Beast, Giant Rat, Skeleton Warrior and more – in a combat-heavy, story-light quest. Battle your way deep into the mountain, striving to earn as many Souls as possible in a single dungeon run!

title: Candylands Journey [NSP][ENG]
description:
魔法大學出事了！魔法之心被糕點女巫偷走了。前往她們的巢穴，歸還魔法水晶並懲罰這些女巫。

探索15個多彩的地點，尋找遺失的拼圖碎片，打開通往最終Boss的道路。穿越綠色草原、黑暗洞穴、深河與海洋、神秘城堡、遺跡、島嶼以及其他繽紛地點。收集寶石碎片來購買獨特的魔法類型。收集所有元素與召喚。找出所有秘密，摧毀所有蛋糕塔，解開所有謎題。這一切都將幫助你戰勝敵人，拯救魔法大學！

title: Monoquous 2 [NSP][ENG]
developer: Chequered Ink (Allison J. James, Daniel Johnston Menezes)
description:
Zdes vse zakony fiziki yavlyayutsya lish prostoy rekomendatsiey.
«Monoquous» — eto slozhnaya chyorno-belaya golovolomka-platformer, v kotoroy vy smozhete prokhodit skvoz steny, chtoby perevernut mir, izmenyaya napravlenie gravitatsii — verkh stanovitsya nizom, chyornoe stanovitsya belym, a smertelnye prepyatstviya teryayutsya, ili vnov priobretayut svoyu ugrozu.
Vklyuchayte i vyklyuchayte novye stenki i nakhodite puti, vzbiraytes po dlinnym konveyeram, ne kasayas nichego ostrogo... Zdes budut 130 urovney, 30 iz kotorykh vernulis iz originalnoy igry na itch.io, a eshchyo 100 — polnostyu novye dlya Monoquous 2.
Ot sozdateley Revolver and Co / Ink Cipher / Cryptrio / Gyro Boss DX.

title: Reflex Unit 2 [NSZ][ENG]
description:
The year is 2039 and the planet has recovered after a robotic drone invasion 3 years earlier. Life seems safe, until a new larger army of robot drones attacks strategic cities around the globe. 

It is up to you again to pilot a new batch of experimental mech hardware and fight back the invading forces. Save the planet, and beyond!

- 1 or 2 Player (online) Campaign Mode
- 2 to 4 Player (online) Versus Mode
- 1 to 4 Player (online) Survival modes
- Cross Platform Online Multiplayer (see www.robosaru.com for details)
- Nintendo Labo™ Toy-Con VR Goggle support (optional)

title: Clan O'Conall and the Crown of the Stag [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Master bow, blade and fist, and unite as one to save your father from the Mother of Demons! Clan O’Conall is a hand-crafted platformer experience like no other. 

Set in the ancient land of Hibernia, drawn from real Celtic myth, three heroes of the Clan O’Conall must stop Caoránach from claiming the Crown of the Stag for her demonic legions. 

SWAP on the Fly!
Switch between characters instantly, combining the powers of a Swordmaster, a Huntress, and a Brute, weaving between them to chain up legendary combos and travel the vast, untamed land of Hibernia.

• Control three unique characters with their own weapons, styles, and special abilities.

• Traverse across a painted world of Celtic myth, braving deadly swamps and airy mountaintops.

• Swap characters and create your own combos, traverse dangerous worlds, and solve the puzzles left behind by your ancestors!

• A unique, hand-crafted art style inspired by manuscript illustration and bronze-age Celtic designs.

• A compelling tale of family, honor, and sacrifice, told through hand-drawn animated cutscenes.

• An all-original soundtrack of Celtic-inspired music by Moonwalk Audio!

Now with improvements for handheld play! Focus your camera instantly with a button press and never be lost in the wilderness again!

title: Feather [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Pora raspravit krylya!
Feather — eto spokoynaya igra, v kotoryy vy pogruzhaetes v peyzazh prekrasnogo ostrova. Prevratites v ptitsu, oshchutite polet i rastvorites v dzen-potoke, slushaya umirotvoryayushchuyu muzyku.
Udobnoe i otzyvchivoe upravlenie pozvolyaet vypolnyat pikirovanie, planirovanie, mertvuyu petlyu i drugie tryuki vo vremya issledovaniya ostrova.

Spokoynyy igrovoy protsess
Nikakikh vragov, nikakoy borby i ugroz — prosto mirnyy polet v odinochku ili vmeste s drugimi ptitsami. Passivnyy multipleer pozvolyaet vam prisoedinitsya k stae i issledovat mir s druzyami.
Izuchayte ogromnyy otkrytyy ostrov i naydite novye pesni, kotorye nakhodyatsya v okrestnostyakh. 
Kazhdyy element ostrova reagiruet na vashe prisutstvie zhuzhzhaniem, tonom i ritmom, chtoby soedinit vas s okruzhayushchey sredoy.

title: Megabyte Punch [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Megabyte Punch is an electro beat ‘em up game with platforming elements in which you build your own fighter while playing!

Megabyte Punch takes place in a computer universe where you have to protect the Heartcore of your village. You defend your people from the Valk Empire and the dreaded Khoteps in 6 different levels with each 3 stages and a boss fight!

As you travel through the worlds, you battle other creatures to get their parts. Parts have their own powers and bonuses, like gun arms for a shoot ability or powerful hips for a devastating pelvic thrust attack. The whole adventure is playable with up to 4 players at once. Using the abilities of your customized fighter, you can also battle your friends in a destructible arena or you can compete in the tournament to test your own skills.

Key Features
- A hard-edge graphic style to represent the digital world that the 'Megacs' live in
- 6 unique electro-worlds each with their own boss fight
- 150 parts to collect and almost endless combinations to customize your character
- A pumpin' electro soundtrack
- Up to 4 player local co-op and versus mode
- Use any amiibo in-game to get exclusive colors for your fighter
- For Nintendo Switch™ only: 2 exclusive bonus stages

title: Subway Midnight [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
年幼的女孩“Liz”獨自一人，身處一輛午夜中的幽暗寂靜的地鐵之中。
不知道究竟要走多遠，才能走到這個不知是夢還是幻覺的世界的終點。

由藝術設計師兼遊戲開發者的Bubby Darkstar所創作的本作品，是以一款以可怕的午夜地鐵為舞臺，可愛的角色們在多姿多彩的世界中不斷輪迴的冒險遊戲。

眾多異想天開、色彩斑斕、令人毛骨悚然的奇妙空間，為你帶來一場激動人心的體驗。
恐怖而又有趣、陰森而又可愛、黑暗卻又多彩。
在這樣一個多種感官同時共存的矛盾且又獨特的世界中，來一場大冒險吧！

title: MouseCraft (Mouse Craft) [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 移植版 russkogo perevoda 来自 AlchemistLab
description:
V MouseCraft igroki pomogayut mysham v poiskakh syra i napravlyayut ikh k tseli, skladyvaya na svoem puti razlichnye tipy tetramino.

Razlichnye tipy blokov.
80 razlichnykh urovney v 5 razlichnykh lokatsiyakh.
Intellektualnaya sistema podscheta ochkov.

title: Mothmen 1966 / Varney Lake / Bahnsen Knights (LCB's Pixel Pulps) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
在Varney Lake到底發生了什麼？
 1954年，漫長而炎熱的夏季，Jimmy、Doug和Christine在Varney Lake度過了他們第四個假期。他們當時正處於青春期，生活中充滿了各種少年暗戀、惡作劇和卡牌魔術，一天到晚冒險，還有拯救當地汽車電影院的美好夢想。他們那時還只是孩子，正在成長。
 
 直到他們遇到了那個吸血鬼。
 
 1981年，靈異調查員Lou Hill發現了一個驚人的線索。他能說服現年40多歲的Christine和Jimmy告訴他那個夏天的真相嗎？他們自己是否真正知道發生了什麼？
 
 還有，道格到底怎麼了？
 
 《Mothmen 1966》的續作
 《Varney Lake》是Pixel Pulps系列的第二部作品，是由小說家Nico Saraintaris和藝術家Fernando Martinez Ruppel創作的全新系列交互式冒險遊戲，通過80年代家用電腦風格的圖形呈現，講述了受20世紀中期低俗小說所啟發的引人入勝的故事。 Pixel Pulps系列包括三款遊戲：《Mothmen 1966》、《Varney Lake》和《Bahnsen Knights》。
 
 《Varney Lake》適合所有喜歡優秀敘事和引人入勝解謎的人：
 
 - 在懷舊的分支敘述中尋找真相
 - 通過其豐富而生動的插圖，沉浸在引人入勝故事中。
 -透過 “選擇自己的冒險”式的玩法，見證Varney Lake中各個角色的命運
 - 解開易於上手、腦筋急轉彎式的謎題。
 - 進一步了解Pixel Pulps系列的常駐調查員Lou Hill。

title: Neon Noodles (Zachtronics) [NSZ][RUS/Multi12]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 12]
description:
在黑暗的反烏托邦電子龐克未來中，食物是財富與身分的終極象徵。貴族們使用具革命性的發明霓虹麵來享用各種佳餚。朱門酒肉臭，路有凍死骨。你沒有任何記憶也沒有名字，你不過是這個機器的一個小螺絲。但是一個神秘的訊息解鎖了你被遺忘的過去，將你送入一個大膽的盜竊密謀，以奪取霓虹麵並取回你的未來。

《Neon Noodles》是一款開放式結局美食主題的機器建造解謎遊戲，你將編寫一個機器主廚來烹飪世界各地的 250 種配方，並使用 400 種獨特的材料。接受來自各種有趣客戶的挑戰任務，並設計複雜而美麗的自動化系統來揭開霓虹麵背後的真相。你準備好要從貪婪的企業手中解放人類的未來了嗎？

特色：

• 使用簡單好用的紀錄重播系統來設計烹飪機器！
• 使用 400 種獨特的材料編寫機器主廚。
• 烹飪 250 種取材自世界佳餚的配方！
• 挑戰來自各種令人印象深刻的客戶所給予的任務。
• 享受反烏托邦故事，在這裡食物是寶貴資源和身分的象徵！

title: Virtuous Western [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Dobro pozhalovat na dikiy zapad, gde problemy reshayutsya svintsom iz dula pistoleta! Banda kovarnykh razboynikov vorvalas v gorod i ukrala lyubimogo zherebtsa nashego geroya. 

Strelyay vo vragov iz svoego lyubimogo revolvera ili nakhodi drugie sposoby, kak ispolzovat okruzhenie v svoyo preimushchestvo.

Kiday veshchi na golovy, vzryvay vsyo krugom i dazhe manipuliruy vragami, chtoby oni povalili drug druga ognyom po svoim! Prygay, uvorachivaysya i sobiray puli.
		
Dokazhi, chtoby ty samyy vynoslivyy strelok dikogo zapada!

Kharakteristiki
* Interesnye i vesyolye golovolomki
* Krasivaya pikselnaya grafika
* Razlichnye puti ustraneniya vragov 
* 30 etapov v osnovnoy kampanii
* Rezhim skorostnogo prokhozhdeniya igry

title: Subway Simulator [NSZ][ENG]
description:
地鐵模擬器非常迷人！這款遊戲是控制地下列車的絕佳機會。
鐵路遊戲讓你有機會感受真正的客運列車司機，並在地鐵地圖上探索各種車站路線。
     通過地鐵模擬器，獲得學習操作真實客運列車的絕佳機會。
毫無疑問，這是其中一款最棒的鐵路遊戲之一，你可以選擇一列地下列車，感受成為真正的列車司機的感覺。
     成為不斷發展的地鐵世界的一部分！我們相信每個人都能在這裡找到適合自己的東西。

       成為一名地鐵司機，開啟你的職業生涯。
- 在4個不同的城市駕駛列車。選擇最適合你的5種可用列車之一。
-通過通過遊戲關卡來提高技能。
-探索新的地鐵路線和車站。
-有100個不同難度的關卡可供遊玩。
     享受地鐵模擬器，這是一款創新和互動性強的遊戲，擁有多種地鐵列車、多條路線和多種可能性 - 是最好的地鐵列車遊戲之一！

title: As Far As The Eye [NSP][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
玩家將化身為「風」，引導部落的學徒抵達世界中心。你必須協助族人管理資源、建築物和生活。在世界覆沒之前，透過農業、手工業、以及科學與神話研究來增進他們的智慧。要注意的是，經營的規劃必須嚴謹有序，確保族人不會挨餓或受到水災肆虐。

- 規劃：為部落安排合適的路途，以順利抵達世界之眼為目標。
- 探索：分析並搜索各地景點，在隨機生成的世界尋找失落的寶藏。
- 資源：農耕、建造、儲糧，並在巨浪吞噬部落之前離開駐紮地。
- 升級：以職業系統增進學徒的力量，以建築系統加強建設，並善用部落知識提升部落的實力。
- 生存：在嚴苛的環境下求生，並保護學徒不受隨機事件所影響。
- 結盟：協商取得資源並招募新的學徒，培養可用的人脈。
- 因果：向聖地獻上貢品，或選擇將聖物占為己有，但別忘了你必須承受所作所為的後果。
- 放鬆：享受和平的旅程，遊戲當中沒有敵人。
- 變化性：類Rogue部落系統的設計，為你呈現新鮮感不間斷的冒險。

title: Bossgard [NSZ][ENG]
description:
WHO’S THE BOSS? It’s finally you! One big, bad, player-controlled Boss goes against a team of Vikings, each with special abilities. Enter BOSSGARD, a hectic 1v2, 1v3, up to 1v5 bossfight multiplayer game in which you get to crush your friends as THE BOSS.
You can also fight in viking vs viking FFA or TDM formats.

title: Extra Coin [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 机器翻译 来自 most2820
description: Syuzhetnyy sim, deystvie kotorogo razvorachivaetsya v realnom mire i virtualnoy utopii. Issleduyte gorod, igrayte, srazhaytes. Budete sledovat Tsiklu — ili razorvete ego v poiskakh svoikh roditeley? Delo za vami. V to vremya kak voyny razdirali mir na chasti, a perenaselenie dostiglo svoego pika, na pomoshch prishla novaya realnost — virtualnyy mir Arkady, obeshchayushchiy spasenie. V etoy tsifrovoy utopii vse takoe yarkoe i prekrasnoe, i net nikakikh problem... po krayne mere, tak nam govoryat.

title: Save The World [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
V nashem mire, stradayushchem ot konfliktov, zhadnosti i razdeleniya, nadezhda prikhodit izdaleka, iz zvezd. Prishli inoplanetyane na Zemlyu, i oni slushayut vse, chto vy govorite, i delayut eto realnostyu. Chto vy sdelaete s etoy vnezapnoy vlastyu? Smozhete li vy spasti mir?
Posle rasstavaniya i nedavnego izmeneniya raboty zhizn Ekii prinimaet eshche bolee rezkiy oborot, kogda ee pokhishchayut prisheltsy. Ikh lider predstavlyaetsya Ksenom i obyasnyaet, chto oni kosmicheskie puteshestvenniki s zadachey spaseniya mirov, s kotorymi oni vstrechayutsya. Ksen sprashivaet Ekiyu o problemakh na Zemle, i vse, chto Ekiya delaet, eto otvechaet na vidimo nevinnye voprosy o mire, vklyuchaya nespravedlivoe raspredelenie bogatstva. Malo kto znaet, chto ee otvety skoro povliyayut na sudbu vsego mira.
Na sleduyushchiy den Ksen delaet zayavlenie: kazhdyy den budet ubivatsya vse bolshee chislo samykh bogatykh lyudey na Zemle. Snachala est popytki protivostoyat. Odnako prevoskhodstvo tekhnologii prisheltsev bystro stanovitsya yasnym. Mir polnostyu na ikh milost - i, vozmozhno, Ekiya. Ksen, pokhozhe, doveryaet ee suzhdeniyu i prodolzhaet slushat sovety Ekii. Mozhet li Ekiya izmenit mnenie Ksena? Ubedit ikh pokinut? Ili, esli na to poydet, mozhet li Ekiya nayti sposob unichtozhit Ksena i ostalnykh prisheltsev?
Imenno eto prosit sdelat agent Kastilo (s vashey pomoshchyu) iz MI6! Tut budet chetyre raznye kontsovki, kak minimum dva lyubovnykh interesa i istoriey, polnaya nepredskazuemykh peripetiy!..Eshchyo vizualnykh novell na Switch (renpy).

title: Kingsgrave [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
Dobro pozhalovat v Kingsgrave, priklyuchencheskuyu rolevuyu ekshn-advenchuru v stile temnogo fentezi. Obretite byluyu moshch, otkryvaya novye boevye navyki, issleduya rukotvornyy mir, unichtozhaya porozhdeniya chumy, reshaya golovolomki i otstraivaya doma. Vernite svoe korolevstvo!
Vosstan iz zatyanuvshegosya zabveniya, moguchiy monarkh! Strashnaya bolezn porazila korolevstvo i unesla zhizni mnozhestva lyudey. Vashi zemli uvyali, vyzhivshie poddannye pokinuli doma, a na ikh mesto prishli pozhirayushchie vse zhivoe chudovishcha, sozdannye iz oskolkov bolnykh dush. Korol, prishla pora probuditsya i obedinit raskolotye zemli, pobedit tmu i privesti svoy narod k protsvetaniyu, kak v bylye vremena. Sudba korolevstva zavisit ot vas!

title: Stone [NSZ][ENG]
description: «Stoun» — korotkaya interaktivnaya istoriya ot tretego litsa dlya odnogo igroka, v kotoroy vy igraete za pokhmelnogo detektiva-koalu.

title: Death's Hangover [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Death has a hangover and worse is that he was robbed from souls by nightmarish Dracula. Old Grim needs the help of his two best warriors -  or the first ones he could find. 
Only these two dead morons can get the souls back and defeat this once and for all. If they fail, Death will kill them again... So no pressure… 

Your errand seems easy, you need to beat all the enemies in a tremendous castle and keep alive with souls for your master. Your only weapon will be the ball -  the last thing you have left, so watch it and protect!

The challenge that awaits them is the most difficult they have encountered. The mysterious Castle with multiple routes and secret areas awaits for our warriors. Secret passages and Bosses who guard next floors are not the only obstacles on their road. Don’t worry - our adventure will be accompanied by such abilities as sticky, spike and ghost power-ups. You can also control the speed of your ball – dash it or slowdown. At the end of each room, it will be a unique encounter with a huge boss awaits you. 


Additional features: 
- We have at your disposal an extensive editor where you can create your own levels
- You are able to play in coop mode with your friend and you won't have to face it with Dracula alone

title: Hyperspace Delivery Service [NSZ][ENG]
description:
You’ve been hired by the Hyperspace Delivery Service to make a delivery to planet Miridian V.

Located on the other side of explored space, the trip to Miridian V will be a dangerous yet lucrative journey full of mad robots and unpredictable stellar phenomenon.
Can you and your crew survive the trip? Will you die from the dreaded Telunian flu? Hyperspace Delivery Service offers an exciting and strategically challenging journey where you must manage your fuel, oxygen, food, and various other supplies to make your delivery within the target time.

Choose what kind of captain you will be. Work the trade routes, learn to use your crews’ unique attributes, mine for fuel, search for abandoned supplies, fight robot space pirates on the ground in retro FPS, experience thrilling space battles from the bridge of your space ship in retro 3D space shooting action.

Can you make it to Miridian V? See you on the next delivery!

Features:
-Retro pixel art graphics
-Name your very own space ship
-Trade with aliens
-Shop at orbiting space stations
-Manage your food, fuel, oxygen, ship repairs, credits, and much more to keep your ship running and crew alive
-Name your crew members and watch them live or die by your decisions
-Original soundtrack using Adlib sound card inspired sounds
-Choose your play style. Work the trade routes, mine for fuel, work missions, and so much more.
-Fight robot pirates in retro FPS game-play
-Directly control your space ship to fend off pirate attacks
-Dodge asteroids!
-Perma-death hard mode
-Help space citizens or leave them to suffer
-Simple to understand with a quick core game loop which offers pick up and play style gaming

title: Sleep Attack TD [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Enjoy an amazing new TWIST in Tower Defense! You control the layout of the battlefield, and you decide the paths your enemies follow!

Build and place powerful turrets to attack invading enemies. Then rotate the battlefield to force foes down your preferred path of destruction. Be careful though, there are always multiple routes to control!
Combine tactical planning with strategic tower upgrades to slow, divert and damage your enemies. Carefully choose the placement and upgrade levels of your towers, as each turret possesses unique strengths and weaknesses.

Features include:
- Twist and turn your enemies so your towers can destroy them!
- Nine tower types to construct and upgrade, each with their own strengths and weaknesses.
- 17 gruesome enemies with different abilities, ranging from the speedy Boardog to the gargantuan Ghost.
- Six unique and beautifully designed dream worlds containing many epic levels to conquer.
- Discover massive boss enemies, each with their own fearsome powers and special abilities.
- Beautiful dreamlike graphics take you on a vividly imagined journey.

title: Youkai Poetry [NSZ][ENG]
description:
窗外的梅雨不曾有停歇的跡象，落魄的大學生小說家步疏對著一張皺巴巴的信紙苦思冥想，也正是這個令人心情低落的雨季，他與抱著白色狐狸的女子再次相遇……

『寫作陷入瓶頸、荒廢學業、沉迷網游……我所看見的你的未來，並不樂觀。你有好好上課嗎？』
一直以步疏姐姐自居的神秘女子，就這樣住進了步疏家中。

截稿日逼近卻毫無靈感的步疏，一方面要應付自己編輯的女兒兼好友兼讀者『牧棉』的花式催稿，一方面還要試著與曾經無疾而終的初戀對象『步蘅』好好相處，而這個時候，他發現步蘅帶回來的白色狐狸『櫻寧』，大搖大擺地幻化成了人形……

——與『妖怪』們相遇的這個夏天，注定是不能平靜地度過了。

本作為現代幻想題材的單綫視覺小説，擁有全程語音，多首原創音樂與CG，為您帶來一個宛如夏夜的涼爽微風般，兼具小小歡樂與治愈成長的故事。

title: Scar of the Doll a Psycho Horror Story About the Mystery of an Older Sister (Ningyou no Kizuato) [NSP][ENG]
description:
Scar of the Doll is an original psycho-suspense Visual Novel produced by Child-Dream in 1998, when became an exceptional hit.
