Ishchi resursy v razlichnykh zdaniyakh, v tom chisle v dostoprimechatelnostyakh Pripyati: gostinitse "Polese", dvortse kultury, kinoteatre "Prometey", basseyne i zabroshennykh mnogoetazhkakh. Sozdavay i vybiray podkhodyashchee snaryazhenie. Nakhodi zashchishchennye stoyanki, chtoby perezhit noch. Pomni, vse vokrug — vragi, i tolko snaryazhenie, oruzhie i transport — tvoi druzya.
 
Udachi!

title: Love Live Nijigasaki High School Idol Club Tokimeki Roadmap to Future [NSP][ENG]
description:
Budushchee izmenitsya v zavisimosti ot vashego vybora! Ispytayte raznye kontsovki dlya kazhdogo uchastnika.
Dni, napolnennye lyubovyu, kotorye vy proveli s 12 uchastnitsami kluba aydolov starshey shkoly Nidzigasaki. Vy leleyali vse eti sverkayushchie momenty v pamyati, kazhdyy iz kotorykh siyal, kak raduga.
No zatem vse vashi vospominaniya yunosti vnezapno uskolzayut iz vashego razuma. Chto zhe vas zhdyot posle prokhozhdeniya vsekh kontsovok?..Eshchyo vizualnykh novell na Switch (renpy).

title: Thea: The Awakening Return of the Giants / Thea 2: The Shattering [NSZ][ENG,RUS]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Thea 2: The Shattering is a follow-up to the successful Thea: The Awakening, which brings the idea of innovative genre hybrid, with elements of turn-based, 4X strategy, survival, RPG and a card game, to entirely new and thoroughly polished level.

The player takes on the role of a deity from the Slavic mythology-inspired pantheon and as such, controls the fate of a small flock of believers struggling for survival. This goal can be achieved in many ways, from diplomacy to war, from exploring to conquering, but any playstyle will surely lead to completely unique adventures thanks to the procedurally generated environments. Rich options, from crafting to town-building system, as well as the co-op multiplayer gameplay, make Thea 2 an ideal choice for tactically minded players, who are up for a challenge.

title: Make a Killing [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description: Make a Killing is an emotionally confronting, anxiety provoking single-player survival horror game. Played in a first-person perspective, the player takes on the role of protagonist Cole, a man that travels to unhallowed grounds in hopes of saving his brother Jace. Crippled by debt, Jace has been blinded by the pursuit of payout collecting untouched gold deposits, only to fall into the hands of accursed mass murderer Ira King. Despite his noble intentions, Cole has become ensnared in a game of cat and mouse with Ira in an arrangement that will bring about the end.

title: What the Duck [NSZ][ENG]
description: Otpravtes v priklyuchenie mesti i samoprinyatiya vmeste s vashim strannym utenkom-dukhom. Stante izvestnym v mire, gde te, u kogo samye silnye dukhovnye zhivotnye, derzhat v rukakh vsyu vlast.

title: Racine [NSP][ENG]
description:
你手中的祈禱卡牌能夠影響戰鬥的結果，但你必須迅速行動：因為所有的行動都是實時發生的，所以無論你是否出牌，敵人都會盡可能地對你發動攻擊。不過，無需倉促進入混戰，因為你在戰鬥中能夠繼續為你的角色提供助力，因此請花點時間明智地選擇你將在旅途中隨身攜帶的卡牌。

- 動態實時戰鬥，強度不斷增加: 快速使用你的卡牌，讓你的角色有機會在當前及未來的戰鬥中生存下來。
- 明智規劃你的角色。
- 構建你的牌組。
- 收集新的祈禱卡牌。
- 揭開這個世界的秘密。

title: Aria Chronicle + 2 DLC [NSP][ENG]
description:
為了丹瑪加列亞王國的王位繼承儀式，艾莉亞等人踏上了巡禮之旅。
然而他們造訪的村莊卻發生了領主失蹤事件，以及突然出現的未知組織「教團」。
在與教團熾熱的戰鬥當中，艾莉亞得知了王國的真相，並被迫做出了一項重大的決定———

《ARIA CHRONICLE》是一款有著，每次挑戰都會隨機變化的迷宮・戰略性的戰鬥・深奧的養成系統，以及與個性豐富的夥伴們一同冒險的角色扮演遊戲。

遊戲的故事描述著為了「巡禮之旅」而離開丹瑪加列亞王國的公主「艾莉亞」，在與神秘組織「教團」的戰鬥中不斷成長，並一步一步發現了隱藏在歷史背後的「王國與世界的真相」。

在遊戲中可以享受每回合都有諸多變化的戰略性戰鬥，並有著其他RPG中少見的「心智值」系統。心智值的高低都影響著角色的能力值並且能左右戰況。在隨機變化的迷宮中必須適當的管理角色們的心智值，並藉此發揮角色最大限度的能力才能戰勝各種難關。

任務最多可以與5名角色一同冒險。主角的艾莉亞公主也有著多達14種的職業可供玩家選擇。同行的其他角色也可以自訂裝備和特質等等，可以依照玩家構思的戰術任意組隊進行冒險。

每次進入都會改變的迷宮以及心智值管理等「隨機性」，加上可以自由選擇職業的5位同行角色，調整好角色們的裝備，善用你的「戰術」來克服困難吧！

title: Pnevmo Capsula Domiki [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Eto igra rodom s Urala, vpitavshaya v sebya ukhodyashchiy v proshloe tekhnologicheskiy dukh rossiyskoy glubinki v zhanre stimpank kvest.

«Pnevmo-Capsula» priotkroet dver v istoriyu parallelnoy rossiyskoy realnosti, gde obshchestvo i tekhnologii razvivalis po puti kultivatsii surovoy mekhaniki. Anturazh sovetskoy epokhi, boylerpanka, vremya slovno zamerlo na razlome 1930-1960 godov. Utopicheskoe reshenie vlastey: v gorodakh ne postroili dorogi, a imeyushchiesya demontirovali i ne vypuskali avtomobiley. Gorod soedinen edinoy sistemoy rels, putey, i trub. Samoy malenkoy chastyu etoy prichudlivoy sistemy yavlyaetsya mekhanicheskaya pochta, za kotoruyu i predstoit Vam igrat.

Osnovnaya ideya igry - kroshechnye relsy, ispeshchryayushchie zavody, platformy i zhilye doma, soedinyaya ikh v edinuyu set. Imenno po nim Vam predstoit puteshestvovat, preodolevaya razlichnye golovolomki.

Po mere prokhozhdeniya igroku vstretyatsya dikovinnye zhilye prostranstva-golovolomki: «Budka smotritelya» na stolbe elektroperedach, slozhennaya iz shpal; "Aeroplatforma" c domikami na vysote; "Izba khudozhnika", zakreplennaya pryamo na LEP! Pri vsey dikosti idey, igroku na intuitivnom urovne stanet ponyatno prednaznachenie obektov i ikh funktsional.

title: Space Gladiators [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Vy kogda-nibud mechtali stat kosmicheskim kartofelem? Teper u vas est vse shansy! Space Gladiators - eto risovannyy 2D Rogue-lite platformer, istoriya kotorogo rasskazyvaet o kuchke plennikov, probivayushchikh sebe put k vykhodu s planety-tyurmy. Odoleyte ordy prisheltsev na gladiatorskikh arenakh i zasluzhite svoyu svobodu!

Vas skhvatili i otpravili razvlekat inoplanetyan v kachestve gladiatora na dalekuyu planetu pod nazvaniem Tartar. Vam pridetsya prodvigatsya cherez sluchayno sgenerirovannye biomy so smertelnymi lovushkami i monstrami, pregrazhdayushchimi vam put. Vybirayte protivnikov na arenakh, pobezhdayte ikh za predmety i monety, i, vozmozhno, vy smozhete zasluzhit svoyu svobodu!

Tochnoe i plavnoe upravlenie, kotoroe pozvolit vam uklonyatsya i srazhatsya s vragami bez polucheniya urona. Edinstvennoe chto vas ogranichivaet - eto vami vybrannyy nabor navykov
Sotni sozdannykh vruchnuyu komnat, kotorye vybirayutsya sluchaynym obrazom, chtoby sdelat kazhdyy novyy zabeg unikalnym.
Bolee 50 vragov i 10 bossov, kotorykh mozhno pobedit s pomoshchyu razlichnykh naborov priemov i sposobov ataki.
Bolee 300 predmetov, vklyuchaya pitomtsev, oruzhie i bezdelushki, kotorye otkryvayut novye sposobnosti dlya vashikh personazhey. Vzryvay serdtsa, chtoby istselitsya, brosay frikadelki ili strelyay iz lazernogo pistoleta.
8 unikalnykh personazhey, podkhodyashchikh pod raznye stili igry, v tom chisle kartofel i inoplanetnyy chervyak v trusakh.
Nastroyte svoi zabegi, vybiraya bolee slozhnye puti, esli vy chuvstvuete sebya uverenno, ili bolee legkie, esli vy nakhodites na grani smerti. Bolshoy risk, bolshaya nagrada.

title: To The Rescue a Dog Shelter Simulator [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
To The Rescue! — simulyator priyuta dlya sobak, v kotorom ot vas zavisyat zhizni desyatkov zamechatelnykh bezdomnykh sobak. Odnako vam predstoit ne tolko gladit ikh i umilyatsya. Derzhat priyut — neprostaya zadacha. Vam pridyotsya udovletvoryat nuzhdy sobak, chtoby uvelichit ikh shansy byt prinyatymi v semyu.

Kazhdyy den budet prinosit novye ispytaniya i nagrady. U sobak est predpochteniya, oni mogut zarazitsya razlichnymi boleznyami, a takzhe priobresti negativnye cherty. No s drugoy storony, vy smozhete ustraivat blagotvoritelnye vstrechi i poluchat sluchaynye pozhertvovaniya. A esli postaraetes — nayti komu-to novogo luchshego druga. K neschastyu, mesta vsegda ne khvataet, a sobak stanovitsya vsyo bolshe i bolshe.

Nekotorykh sobak zabirayut bystree drugikh, no esli u vas poluchitsya prozhdat dostatochno dolgo, vdrug poluchitsya nayti dom dlya kazhdoy.



Priobshchites k realnoy blagotvoritelnosti. 20% pribyli razrabotchikov ot prodazh To The Rescue! napravlyaetsya v nastoyashchie priyuty dlya sobak pri posrednichestve nashego partnyora PetFinder Foundation.
Kazhdaya sobaka unikalna. Kazhdaya sobaka sozdayotsya so svoimi predpochteniyami i osobennostyami, chto delayut kazhdogo pyosika neobychnym i zapominayushchimsya.
Podbirayte sobak pod nuzhdy usynoviteley. Lyudi, zhelayushchie zavesti sobaku, chasto budut iskat chto-to konkretnoe. Podberite zhivotnoe, sootvetstvuyushchee ikh predpochteniyam, chtoby maksimalno uvelichit ego shansy na usynovlenie.
Uluchshayte i ukrashayte svoy priyut. Esli u vas budut lishnie sredstva, vy smozhete uluchshit priyut, postaviv v nyom roskoshnye volery, nanyav pomoshchnikov i mnogoe drugoe!
Dveri priyuta dolzhny byt otkryty. Poroy budet slozhno ukhazhivat za vsemi sobakami v priyute. Vam pridyotsya proyavlyat berezhlivost i inogda prinimat trudnye resheniya, chtoby prodolzhat pomogat sobakam nakhodit semi.


... i da, konechno zhe, sobachek mozhno pogladit!

title: League of Enthusiastic Losers [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
description:
有障礙的友誼
Vitya和Volodya是我們故事中兩個最好的朋友和英雄 - 在日常生活中掙扎著游泳，並試圖漂浮。面對被驅逐，他們決定找到一個有助於償還債務的寶藏。

在冒險過程中，他們將結識許多新朋友，見證典型住宅區的未平凡（或在一些非常普通的人眼中）的事件。

給90年代的懷舊信
在前蘇聯莫斯科的街道上的紅色和白色手推車上漫步。面對年輕一代被解放的俄羅斯的問題，儘管他們並不完全自由。瞭解附近的日常生活。

體驗成年後發現自己的苦樂參半的味道。

一個迷人的現實生活故事
決定你的英雄的命運，並引導他們從此走向幸福。由於迷人的圖形，你將直接回到互聯網是西方發明的時代。

溫暖而環繞的配樂將讓你沉浸在情感之旅的心情中。
 
主要特點：

- 關於友誼的力量和克服生活中的障礙的冒險
- 90年代的氛圍與故事的位置在前蘇聯莫斯科
- 住在混凝土砌塊住宅區的居民的故事
- 許多對90年代東歐文化的懷舊引用
- 風格化的圖形和大氣的配樂

title: Snug Finder + DLC [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
Snug Finder ——是一款精美的尋物遊戲。成為一名尋找專家，並嘗試找到所有目標物，但要小心，有時候沒那麼容易。

將自己沈浸在擁有可愛插圖、美好配樂和舒適氛圍的一個精美遊戲中，在36個精彩關卡、300多個隱藏目標物上度過數小時的時光。讓我們開始冒險吧！

特點：
360個隱藏目標物
36個精彩關卡
可愛的插圖
舒適的氛圍
支援觸控螢幕

title: Youropa [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Youropa 大陸變得四分五裂。你將施展飛簷走壁的能力，讓支離破碎的城市恢復往日的榮景，同時找尋真正的自我。這是款需要打破常規、上下顛倒，並且跳脫思考的平台解謎冒險遊戲。

倒吊行走、飛簷走壁，走上任何你能抵達的地方。腳上的吸力杯能讓你附著在任何表面之上。你將在這個抽象卻符合邏輯的宇宙中解鎖新技能、解開謎題、探索秘密、遇上兇惡的敵人，並可彩繪自己的角色，挑戰自己對立體空間的感知能力。

在創造模式中，你可以打造自己的關卡並遊玩，還可以將關卡和角色設計分享給其他玩家。

Youropa 是由一群志同道合的朋友花上 15 年所製作完成的。

title: Shattered Tale of the Forgotten King [NSP][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
Vmeste s Korolem ischez prezhniy mir. Vosstanavlivayte Vselennuyu v etoy mrachnoy rolevoy igre, napolnennoy bitvami na vyzhivanie, zavorazhivayushchimi lokatsiyami i vospominaniyami vyzhivshikh — vam reshat, doveryat im ili net. Vpered, k priklyucheniyam, Strannik!
Vmeste s Korolem ischez prezhniy mir. Stranniku predstoit sobrat voedino vse fragmenty realnosti i uznat, chto na samom dele privelo k padeniyu tsivilizatsii. Bitvy na vyzhivanie, zavorazhivayushchie lokatsii i vospominaniya vyzhivshikh — vam reshat, doveryat im ili net. Vam predstoit progulka po razrushennomu kontinentu sredi zabytykh istoriy i moguchikh protivnikov. Tolko khrabrye sposobny nayti v mire Gipnosa sekrety. Nekotorye iz kotorykh stanut podskazkami, a drugie — raskroyut tayny sobytiy v proshlom. Srazhaytes v boyakh na platformere 2.5D i pogruzhaytes v istoriyu zakhvatyvayushchey realnosti v priklyuchencheskom ekshene!

title: Never Again [NSP][RUS/Multi3]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 3]
description:
扮演著 13歲的莎莎·安德斯，她從一場噩夢中醒來，發現自己家裡發生著非常可怕的事情。在父母和兄弟失踪，房屋大廳漆黑的情況下，莎莎被迫走進了奇異且陌生的地方去尋找答案。

在這個第一身的冒險遊戲中，解開環境的難題時，恐怖就潛伏在其中。當你意識到哮喘發作，可能會在沒有吸入劑的情況下，結束令人窒息的旅程。這是一個神秘而有趣的故事，但總是帶點恐懼，即使只是為了一個年輕女孩，也必須把故事結束。

特色：

• 在探索每個困擾地點的同時解決難題。
• 利用實時 3D物理去拾取，放下和操縱物品。
• 躲開並躲避噩夢般的威脅！
• 使用吸入劑緩解沙沙因恐懼而引起的哮喘病。
• 收集並閱讀日記記錄，以解開故事的黑暗事實。

title: Zero to Dance Hero (Hop! Step! Dance!) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
強調「初學者也能學會跳舞」的舞蹈教學遊戲軟體登場！

▼能從基礎學起的正式舞蹈教學！快在家盡情「偷練」吧！！
本作是一款真正的舞蹈教學遊戲軟體，只要雙手拿著Joy-Con™，再配合教練的指示跳舞，就能學會舞蹈基礎，甚至掌握帥翻天的舞蹈訣竅。
主要的教學項目是由30個步驟所組成的菜單，玩家能學會「向下律動」，「向上律動」和「波浪舞」等舞蹈動作。一開始會教只用上半身隨節奏起伏的動作，再逐步提升難度，慢慢加入下半身的動作及其他舞步，即便是初學者也能放心學習。
此外，這款遊戲可讓人在家輕鬆學跳舞，「對舞蹈有興趣卻一直沒有機會學習的人」和「不好意思在人前跳舞的人」都能偷偷地練習。

▼運用在教學中學會的技巧挑戰自由模式！
自由模式收錄了6種不同曲風的原創舞蹈，讓玩家更能學以致用。玩家可輕鬆掌握背景音樂的節奏，享受各式各樣的舞風，教練也會化身「舞者」，專心陪玩家一起跳舞。
透過每天的教學，穩紮穩打地學會舞蹈技巧吧。

▼一對一細心指導！
玩家身邊會有4名教練從旁指導。教學項目由安娜，諾爾負責。此外，琳，希洛更特別從Fitness Boxing系列前來客串，擔任自由模式的教練。
即便不熟悉教學，遇到挫折時，教練也會貼心地給予讚美，提升玩家的動力，千萬別錯過他們的一舉一動喔。

▼幫助玩家進步與持之以恆的功能一應俱全
遊戲內有各式各樣的功能，讓玩家可輕鬆持之以恆，教學中還能變換鏡頭的角度，協助玩家查看「側面動作」等細節。教學結束後，教練會與玩家「擊掌」並蓋章，讓人充滿成就感。
另外，個人資料中也能查看玩家透過跳舞所消耗的卡路里。

title: Pogo Stadium [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Uchastvuyte v energichnykh bitvakh, gde ritm sochetaetsya so strategiey na bolee chem 100 dinamichnykh urovnyakh! Otbivaytes, stavte lovushki i ottachivayte svoi tryuki v skorostnykh duelyakh na futuristicheskikh boevykh arenakh, paryashchikh vysoko nad gorodom pod nochnym nebom..
Proydite 45 ritmichnykh ispytaniy v 9 razlichnykh zonakh. Stolknites so slozhnymi skhemami, strategicheskimi dilemmami i tainstvennymi vragami. Odinochnaya igra — eto glubokaya, slozhnaya i razrabotannaya spetsialno dlya togo, chtoby ottochit vashi instinkty.
To, chto vas zhdyot dalshe… mozhet vas udivit.
Kazhdyy match — eto novye ispytaniya dlya uma — kak vy prevzoydyote svoikh sopernikov?

title: Elea Paradigm Shift [NSP][ENG]
description:
Elea: Paradigm Shift is a game that takes the player on the deeply personal journey of a woman, whose life is marked by loss, grief, and self-accusation in the aftermath of a global pandemic. 
Luckily, an Earth-like exoplanet within an achievable distance from the Solar system had been discovered. Pooling volunteers from around the globe, a first-of-a-kind interstellar spaceship was built and sent to colonize the yet unexplored planet. The gargantuan vessel was named Pilgrimage, embodying the hopes of all of humanity. To everyone’s dismay, shortly after a successful arrival, the Pilgrimage went on total radio silence. What caused it remains a mystery.
13 years later, research starship Recovery has arrived on-site to investigate the fate of the expedition. The player takes the role of the space scientist River Elea Catherine Jones. She is driven above all by a personal goal – to find her husband Ethan, who occupied a prominent position on the Pilgrimage’s scientific crew.

title: Infectra [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Infectra is a strategy game set in 2124 on the distant planet Emevera III, ruled by the Maxploit Corporation, where an epidemic of a yet unknown virus broke out.
The corporation was during advanced level of colonizing a new planet, the perfect source of strategic materials. The group of engineers, miners, technicians and their families meant to be the seed of a new civilization. And then one day a not yet classified organic gas spread out to the atmosphere, changing irrevocably genotype of people with direct contact with... let's call it virus. It sounds like something manageable.

Your goal as the corporation security commander is to evacuate as many healthy people as possible and to eliminate infected individuals.

- plan evacuation and build fortification
- try out variety of tactics
- find the best solutions
- succeed or be lost

When the world is on the edge of catastrophy and the future lays in your hands, the man must hold his ground and find a way of survival.
You were not chosen specifically for this kind of job. No one would ever apply ...
Stop the infection from spreading. Guide civilians to the rescue zones and fight hordes of mutants. The corporation is counting on you!

Game main features:

- challenge yourself on the strategic field in 12 missions
- find your own method of building fortification, experiment and get better results
- enjoy 3D low poly graphics

title: The World According to Girl [NSZ][ENG]
description:
「無名少女成爲救世主的遊戲」

『傾注世界所有的少女』是一款將卡牌構築型rouglike與養成遊戲所結合的文字冒險遊戲。爲了將少女培養成救世主，您將成爲一名管理官，選擇每個回合來訪的各具特色的「人才（卡牌）」來達成目標。

「人才（卡牌）效果」例
·本季度的成本+1
·使所有藝人1以上的能力+2
·隨機引發緊急事態或者特殊現象

1年有6個季度（回合），總計花費7年42個回合來將少女培養成真正的救世主。在每年在最後，將會與審問官進行對話（戰鬥）以評估少女的能力。利用少女的能力與至今爲止的所有回憶爭取勝利，并讓計劃得以繼續。物語的結局將根據少女的能力而變化，請見證少女和世界的命運直到最後吧。

故事梗概
故事發生在一百年以後的未來
世界已抵達了名爲“崩壞”的道路的邊緣
人類計劃利用僅存的太空船向外太空發出求救
爲此，乘船的人必須是世界上最爲優秀的人才
世界將傾盡所有， 培養僅僅1人的少女.

title: Like No Other the Legend of the Twin Books [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + optsionalnyy mashinnyy 来自 most2820
description:
The adventure begins!

Dan is a bumbling first-time adventurer who risks everything to solve the legend of the twin books by exploring the abandoned town of Red Pines.

Legend has it that a talented artist replicated the Spirits' Book, and the replica was so perfect that the museum staff mistakenly left the original behind during the evacuation of Red Pines. After learning of the legend, Dan decides to check if it's true, and recover the book if it is.

Join Dan on this light, family-friendly quest and help his love for adventure thrive.

Length
~ 1:30h

Features
- 23 unique rooms to explore
- Easy-to-learn controls
- Low skill ceiling
- No death / violence
- No hyper-realism / last-gen graphics
- No procedural worlds

title: High Noon Revolver [NSP][ENG]
description:
High Noon Revolver is a 2D Action Shooter; blast your way across 3 layers of platforming, collecting gold and obtaining upgrades helping you go from puny to powerhouse! Play as a cast of colorful characters, each with unique weapons and abilities (like Chickens with Shotguns and Robots with Swords!). Chase down and collect bounties on Wanted outlaws everywhere from Sunken Ships to Haunted Mansions!

Features
- Play as a slew of colorful characters with unique weapons and abilities
- Collect hefty bounties on Wanted outlaws
- Spend gold on character and weapon upgrades
- Chase down criminals across diverse landscapes
- Race against your best time to achieve high scores
- Play with friends in Local Co-op

title: MistWorld the After 1-2 (Mist World) [NSZ][JAP,ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG], vo vtoroy igre 日语 [JAP]
description:
Razrabotannaya Askoy Vatanabe i opublikovannaya Regista, traditsionnaya RPG, narisovannaya v 3D! Buduchi okhotnikom, glavnyy geroy upravlyal drevnim lesom, gde on zhil so svoim pokoynym dedom, no v poslednee vremya vy pochuvstvovali, chto chislo strannykh demonov stalo uvelichivatsya. Otpravlyaytes v stolitsu, chtoby vyyasnit prichinu vsekh proisshestviy, i raskryt zagovor s tselyu voskresheniya zlogo boga! Smozhete li vy eto predotvratit?
Vo vtoroy igre, Minkha, yunaya devushka, zhivyot v bolshom osobnyake v udalyonnoy derevne. Tuda navedyvayutsya eyo byvshiy tovarishch po priklyucheniyam, bolshoy uchenyy Lester i boginya Nisfor, puteshestvovavshaya vmeste s Lesterom. Pogovarivayut, chto oni ishchut relikviyu «Korolya Demonov» dlya svoey taynoy missii!

title: Sublevel Zero Redux [NSP][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Sublevel Zero Redux – eto shuter ot pervogo litsa s shestyu stepenyami svobody, v kotorom realnost razvalivaetsya na chasti. Stante pilotom boevogo korablya i srazhaytes v nevesomosti posredi ogromnykh podzemnykh protsedurno generiruemykh lokatsiy, chtoby vernut utrachennuyu tekhnologiyu i izbezhat mnogikh opasnostey, podzhidayushchikh vas na kazhdom uglu.

VERSIYa REDUX UZhE VKLYuChENA

Sublevel Zero Redux teper vklyuchaet dopolnenie Redux, gde vas zhdet mnogo chasov uvlekatelnoy igry, bolee intensivnye srazheniya, a takzhe podderzhka pritselivaniya i upravleniya kameroy s pomoshchyu giroskopa, kotorye dostupny tolko v versii dlya Nintendo Switch™.

PROTsEDURNAYa GENERATsIYa I NEOBRATIMAYa SMERT

Bez zhizney. Bez sokhraneniy. Probiraytes s boem cherez protsedurno generiruemoe okruzhenie. Proschityvayte kazhdyy shag, kazhdyy vystrel. Obstanovka budet postoyanno menyatsya: ot promyshlennykh zon, do glubokikh shakht. Mgnovenno reagiruyte i bystro prisposablivaytes, inache budet slishkom pozdno.

SOZDANIE PREDMETOV

Soberite ogromnuyu kollektsiyu sluchayno sgenerirovannogo oruzhiya, uluchsheniy i izmenyayushchikh igru predmetov. Obedinyayte ikh, sozdavaya nepovtorimoe osnashchenie dlya svoego korablya. Razblokiruyte novye predmety i chertezhi, kotorye budut dostupny i pri posleduyushchikh prokhozhdeniyakh.

title: Emergency Call - The Attack Squad [NSP][ENG]
interface_lang: 英语, 西班牙语, 德语, 波兰语, 葡萄牙语, 法语
description: Vozmite na sebya rol shturmovogo otryada, issleduyte mesto proisshestviya i razumno reshayte voznikayushchie problemy. Neyasnaya situatsiya s povrezhdeniyami v nachale kazhdoy stseny, bud to pozhary, spasenie lyudey ili tekhnicheskaya pomoshch, trebuet vashego vnimaniya. Imeyte v vidu, chto vybor pravilnykh instrumentov tak zhe vazhen, kak i razumnyy takticheskiy poryadok, kotoryy vy dolzhny prinyat pri izuchenii i otrabotke operatsiy.Osobennosti:

title: Dual Souls the Last Bearer [NSZ][ENG]
description:
The spirit of old-school fighting games is back with Dual Souls. Inspired by classic fighting game series, Dual Souls delivers it all - it’s fast; it’s full-on; it’s tactical; it’s online and it’s FUN!

With fluid animations and colorful graphics, Dual Souls is a highly tactical game with multiple unique fighters, each with their own fighting styles and moves. The game also comes stacked with an array of awesome features:

* Rollback Net-Code.
* Create and customize your fighter with "Journey" mode.
* Challenge players from around the world with "Net-play" mode.
* Learn game mechanics with "Tutorial Lessons".
* Access each character's ending and story with "Arcade" mode.
* 11 Fighters (+Free DLC) each with unique abilities. Characters include a dagger-wielding Ottoman warrior who excels in slap attacks; a giant kunai riding ninja; a Kazakh shaman who uses spirits to attack and curse opponents; a * half-beast with his pet which helps to create combination attack patterns; a Templar knight who resists and counters opponent’s attacks.
* Easy to use controls with a set-up to suit everyone.
* Multiple gameplay Modes - Arcade Mode, Story Mode, Net-play, Versus Play, Tutorials, Combo Challenges and Journey Mode (survival/customization mode).
* Tactical Features - Enhance your gameplay style and create your own combos with features like "Block" and "Counter Block" (similar to "Parry" in SF3 games), "Recovery" and "Power Recovery" (similar to Roman Cancels in GG games), "Power Escape" (similar to Burst in GG games) and "Limit Break" attacks.
* Finish off your opponent with a character-specific method when they are in low health and you are on the winning round.

title: The Eye of Typhoon (Tsunami Edition / Saiki, TEoT, khoumbryu) [NSP][ENG]
description:
..Sredi mnogikh chelovecheskikh iskusstv sushchestvuet (kak minimum) odno, v kotorom vsegda mozhno vyyavit luchshego bezoshibochno. Iskusstvo, gde net mesta razlichiyu vkusov, otsenochnym suzhdeniyam i predrassudkam. Boevoe iskusstvo. Ni velikie bogatstva, ni vsemirnoe priznanie ne delayut mastera boevogo iskusstva stol zhe schastlivym, kak yavstvennoe osoznanie dokazannogo prevoskhodstva nad sebe podobnymi. I lish bezostanovochnoe samosovershenstvovanie i ottachivanie umeniy mozhet priblizit ego k etoy tseli!
V fokuse syuzheta «Glaza Tayfuna» nakhoditsya mezhdunarodnoe sostyazanie masterov razlichnykh vidov edinoborstv, v kachestve glavnogo priza v kotorom vystupaet taynoe znanie o drevnem boevom iskusstve khonkvondo. Soglasno legende, osvoivshiy ego boets vykhodit na sovershenno novyy uroven vladeniya svoim telom, razumom i dukhom i stanovitsya prakticheski nepobedimym. Rezonans, vyzvannyy izvestiem o vozmozhnoy nagrade, sobiraet sotni zhelayushchikh dokazat miru svoyo pravo na ovladenie tekhnikoy, no v finalnuyu chast turnira prokhodit lish dyuzhina silneyshikh. Oni gotovy soytis drug s drugom v otchayannykh skhvatkakh, dazhe ne podozrevaya o tom, kakovy istinnye motivy organizatorov dannogo meropriyatiya…

title: Tensei [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
「點睛」是一款非常休閒的無盡動作遊戲。
在跳躍與下降交替之間，彷彿用筆在紙上書寫，
慢慢地向著蒼穹飄升， 在這段旅程中，
遠離繁忙的日常，感受無憂無慮的時刻。

遊戲特色
【具備浮游感的低重力遊戲環境】
將意識投影在遊戲當中，便能在放鬆心神之餘同時沉浸於遊戲體驗。

【淨化雜念】
俯衝（高速下降）命中傷害區域後，即可將之淨化。
提高集中力瞄準目標，在迴避傷害的同時往高空前進吧。

【化身為莊嚴龍姿】
活用三段跳躍，在平台間移動的同時收集場地中的墨滴，即可變身進入龍化模式，充滿力量地向上飛升。

title: Bad Dream: Coma, Fever [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + aktivator ofits. perevoda 来自 AlchemistLab
description: Pogruzites v vospalennyy son i otkroyte dlya sebya ego abstraktnyy mir. Uznayte o razrushenii vashego mira i prisposobtes k nemu. Deystvuyte ostorozhno. Na kazhdom shagu vas podsteregaet zlobnyy virus. Izbegayte chernil, i vse budet khorosho. Budte otkryty i gotovy ko vsemu. Vidte vraga v kazhdom cheloveke, dazhe v samom naimenee podozritelnom. Esli vy chuvstvuete predatelstvo, pomnite, chto likhoradka mozhet prevratit v polnogo neadekvata dazhe silnogo i sovershenno zdorovogo cheloveka. Vospalennyy razum teryaet zdravyy smysl... Postaraytes spasti khotya by odnogo cheloveka. Pomnite, chto inogda vylozhitsya dazhe na 100 % byvaet nedostatochno. Ne pozvolyayte likhoradke zakhvatit vash razum. Ne dayte chernilam izmenit sebya... OSOBENNOSTI - Atmosfera mira, pokhozhego na bredovyy son bolnogo. - Neprostye zagadki, trebuyushchie osobogo podkhoda. - Neobychnoe, intriguyushchee i gipnotiziruyushchee okruzhenie. - Mrachnyy i slozhnyy syuzhet, povestvuemyy avtorom ot vsego serdtsa.

title: The Magister [NSP][ENG]
description:
The Magister – RPG o zagadochnom ubiystve s kartochnymi bitvami.

Sobirayte i nastraivayte kolodu dlya bitv ili ispolzuyte «takticheskuyu diplomatiyu», chtoby reshat delo mirom.

Sobirayte uliki i ishchite motivy, chtoby raskryt taynu gibeli proshlogo magistra i nayti prestupnika.
Osobennosti igry
Zagadochnoe ubiystvo kazhdyy raz proiskhodit po novomu – prokhozhdenie ne pomozhet! Sobytiya, uliki, motivy i ubiytsa menyayutsya s kazhdym prokhozhdeniem. Tolko vy smozhete nayti prestupnika.

Takticheskie kartochnye boi: vashi boevye i razgovornye navyki zavisyat ot kart v kolode. Vybirayte iz takikh kart, kak «Serdtsestop», «Yadovityy udar», «Plokhaya shutka» i «Dolgiy razgovor» – i mnogikh drugikh.

Ugovarivayte vragov reshat delo mirom: «takticheskaya diplomatiya» pomozhet izbezhat boya i snizit uroven yarosti vragov do 0 s pomoshchyu razgovornykh kart.
Vybirayte magistra: u kazhdogo iz nikh svoi osobennosti i nedostatki. Ot nervnogo alkogolika do intelligenta s bessonnitsey – u vsekh budet svoe priklyuchenie.

Ishchite soyuznikov-lyudey ili pushistykh sputnikov: naemnik, shpion ili mudrets mogut pomoch v rassledovanii. A esli podruzhitsya s mestnoy koshkoy ili sobakoy, oni budut dratsya za vas.

Charuyushchiy mir v stile fentezi: u vas est 14 dney, chtoby uznat derevnyu Silverkhyorst, podruzhitsya s ee zhitelyami (ili zapugat ikh), naperegonki so vremenem pytayas raskryt ubiytsu.

title: Exploding Kittens [NSP][ENG]
description:
Exploding Kittens is a multiplayer card game where players draw cards until someone draws an Exploding Kitten and explodes!

Play your cards to try to avoid, move, or defuse the Exploding Kitten. If you don't explode, you win! Congratulations, you are full of greatness.

Play with friends in the same room or online, or play with strangers in online play. Not into other people? Play single player against kitty-bot opponents! 

This version of the game includes the Streaking Kittens, Party Pack, Betrayal Pack, and Barking Kittens expansions, exclusive cards, and hilarious illustrations by The Oatmeal.  

With millions of games sold and downloaded, Exploding Kittens is the perfect card game for players of all ages who are into kittens and explosions and laser beams and sometimes goats. 

"It's like UNO, except there are goats, magical enchiladas and kittens that can kill you." -CNN

title: Lyrica / Lyrica 2 Stars Align [NSZ][ENG]
description:
故事描述懷抱著音樂夢的少年─春，無意間在夢中穿越中國古代歷史，與神秘的詩人相遇。劇情結合知名詩人的歷史典故與許多經典的古詩詞。

玩法核心概念是將古典詩詞融合於遊戲中，依音樂節奏點擊詩詞，或如書法般畫出文字，或詩詞如字幕般演出，可從遊玩中感受到詩詞文字之美。

樂曲收錄部分，強調以古典詩詞為歌詞，結合現代搖滾、抒情、爵士等曲風音樂。且首創有收錄阿卡貝拉音樂、台灣族語音樂。

title: Cattails / Cattails Wildwood Story [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Igrayte ulichnoy koshkoy i issleduyte ogromnye otkrytye prostranstva. Dobyvayte sebe propitanie, srazhaytes s koshkami iz drugikh koloniy i podruzhites s sosedyami.
Zavedite semyu, ukhazhivayte za milymi kotyatami i berite ikh s soboy v priklyucheniya!
Ili issleduyte temnye peshchery v poiskakh sokrovishch! Tolko ne zabudte vzyat s soboy chto-nibud sestnoe na sluchay, esli vy progolodaetes..
Spi, kotenok, bayu-bayu,
Za oknom sobaki layut,
Zlo rychat, a ne kusayut,
Nam ne strashno ikh nichut. ©
Eshchyo kotoigry.

title: One Way The Elevator [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
One Way: The Elevator — eto tvorcheskaya igra v zhanre «point & click», gde Vam nuzhno nayti sinyuyu sferu v kazhdoy stsene, chtoby privesti lift v dvizhenie vverkh! Vnimatelno smotrite i dumayte, kak reshit vse golovolomki...
Kazhdyy raz, kogda lift podnimaetsya, vy popadaete v sovershenno novyy mir. Igra otlichaetsya osobym khudozhestvennym stilem, dayushchim zhizn strannym personazham, takimi kak osminog, slon, robot ili tsvetok-lyudoed. Konechno zhe, vas zhdet eshchyo mnozhestvo interesnykh i intriguyushchikh zadach!Igry Mr. Pumpkin 2: Walls of Kowloon (Walled City), sbornik Isoland ot etogo razrabotchika.

title: Charge Kid [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Zaryazhayte golovu pervoy v... shipy! Zatem ispolzuyte vashu udobnuyu energeticheskuyu pulyu, chtoby probitsya skvoz prepyatstviya i zhit, chtoby reshit bolshe golovolomok v etoy 2D golovolomke-platforme prednamerennoy zaryadki!

Charge Kid - igra, gde kazhdyy pryzhok - eto golovolomka. Vy dolzhny nayti umnoe ispolzovanie mekhaniki i fiziki, chtoby "reshit" kazhduyu lokatsiyu, dostignuv nuzhnoy lokatsii. U vas est ogranichennye resursy, chtoby sdelat kazhdyy pryzhok. Igra fokusiruetsya na aspekte golovolomki, a ne tochnost-platformennost. Samoe slozhnoe - eto ponyat, kak ispolzovat resursy, chtoby sdelat kazhdyy pryzhok vmesto vypolneniya. No ne obmanyvaytes! Vypolnenie tozhe tyazhelo, a eto znachit, chto nayti kazhdoe reshenie eshche slozhnee!

Osobennosti:
- Zhestkiy kontrol i dvizhenie zhidkosti,
- Slozhnyy igrovoy protsess,
- Golovolomki s neskolkimi resheniyami,
- Simpatichnoe i minimalistichnoe pikselnoe iskusstvo,
- Nezhnye zvukovye effekty i muzyka!

title: Saint Maker [NSZ][ENG]
description:
What makes a saint? Fire to one’s face, wounds on one’s body, dying slowly from disease — history paints a grim picture. When Holly Beltran attends a religious recollection, she discovers the dark secrets that haunt the convent’s past. At night, broken faced statues and whispered prayers haunt Holly’s dreams — before the recollection is over, Holly may have to face more than her own demons to come out alive.

What happens when the faithful go too far?

FEATURES

✟ Religious Horror: Experience a horror story rich with eerie religious iconography and psychological scares.

✟ A Short and Haunting Story: At around 60,000 words and with 4-6 hours of estimated gameplay, Saint Maker is perfect to play on a dark and stormy night.

✟ Fully Voiced: A cast of professional English voice actors has breathe life into the characters and their struggles.

✟ Interactive Dialogue Choices: As the horror unfolds, your choices will help Holly discover more about herself during this ordeal. A normal ending and a (secret) bonus scene await you depending on your choices.

✟ Bone-chilling Visuals: Witness the haunting setting of Saint Idelora's Convent, with detailed backgrounds, CGs, and animated illustrations adding to an immersive and terrifying experience.

✟ Original Soundtrack: Originally composed soundtracks which add both horror and heart to the story.

title: Teamfight Manager [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
有效成長你的戰隊，找到最好戰略，獲得全球總決賽冠軍的榮譽！

· Ban&Pick 體系 
數十個英雄當中發現最優秀的組合。為了得到最好的結果，要同時考慮你的選手們熟練的英雄，對方選手們熟練的英雄，以及組合之間的相性關係。

· 賽事進行
各英雄在一分鐘內以對決方式進行戰鬥，擊殺更多英雄的戰隊獲得勝利。

· 英雄
英雄具有獨特的特徵，週期使用的基本技能與每小局只能使用一次的大招。要把握英雄的基本能力值和技能的特性，適當選擇英雄才能獲得勝利。

· 管理選手
通過轉會選拔更優秀的選手，或者培養現有的選手，提高團隊戰力。每選手的攻擊能力、防禦能力、英雄熟練度不同，有些選手具有與眾不同的天賦。斟酌團隊資金與選手能力，有效管理你的選手們。

· 成長戰隊
通過製造裝備或改善設施，可以給選手們提供更好的環境。提供高性能裝備和良好的環境，讓最優秀的選手們得到最好的結果。
 
看來你已經準備好成為教練了。希望你順風揚帆，駛向全球總決賽冠軍！

title: Harlow [NSZ][ENG]
description:
玩家扮演的機器人偏離航道好幾光年，處於低電量狀態，有一個重要目標：舉辦一個史詩級的驚喜派對，從而使解除冰凍狀態的太空殖民開拓者不會陷入崩潰。《Harlow》是一款氛圍獨特的2D平台遊戲，玩家需要利用物理學躲避古老行星的危險，收集採集，計劃一個太空派對。

Harlow是R1-Humanity飛船上的緊湊型機器人。在飛船後勤A.I. Manifesto的幫助下，玩家將儲備物資，將飛船從一艘冰冷的太空船變成一場星際盛典，為飛船上處於超低溫冷凍狀態的船員加油打氣。

跳躍、翻滾和躲避！玩家利用物理學控制Harlow探索酸液海洋，躲避古老的機械裝置和穿越熔岩瀑布！

計劃一個驚喜派對：用3D列印的派對物資裝飾R1-Humanity。玩家對飛船的改造將解鎖不同的結局！

title: 2048 Battles [NSP][ENG]
description:
Teper v 2048 mozhno igrat sovmestno s 8 igrokami! 

Istoriya i uvlekatelnye melochi v odnoy igre. 

Igrayte s druzyami ili sopernikami v trekh raznykh rezhimakh i do 8 igrokov! 

Naslazhdaytes klassicheskim rezhimom, s ogranicheniem shagov ili na vremya i drugimi!

Reshayte raznye golovolomki, igrayte v odinochku ili v mnogopolzovatelskom rezhime i puteshestvuyte po razlichnym istoricheskim periodam. 

V igru mogut igrat do 8 igrokov! Igrayte s 2, 4 ili 8 igrokami odnovremenno!

title: The Bear and The Admiral [NSZ][RUS/Multi14]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 14]
description:
太陽系的居民已被凍結在馬格尼修斯的停滯狀態，由你來拯救他們！
當你穿越陌生的世界和奇異的關卡時，扮演熊和海軍上將（作為單人遊戲或本地多人遊戲），用沿途發現的各種武器和物品與陌生的敵人作戰。

title: GALAK-Z: The Void: Deluxe Edition [NSP][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Blagodarya otzyvam kritikov nam udalos sozdat neprevzoydennuyu versiyu dlya Nintendo Switch™.
Smes kosmicheskikh anime i arkad vosmidesyatykh s sovremennoy fizikoy i II - vot chto ozhidaet vas v etom priklyuchenii s protsedurno-generiruemymi missiyami, trebuyushchimi nemalogo masterstva. Stante geroem v mire, kotoryy napominaet klassicheskoe anime, no igraetsya kak zhestkiy sovremennyy takticheskiy shuter. Postaraytes vyzhit vo vrazhdebnom glubokom kosmose, srazhayas protiv vrazhduyushchikh gruppirovok i unikalnykh khitrykh vragov. Otkryvayte moshchnye uluchsheniya, postepenno uznavaya taynu GALAK-Z, i umirayte snova i snova, doblestno pytayas stat luchshim pilotom, kotoryy smozhet spravitsya so vsemi trudnostyami v GALAK-Z!
•	Novyy rezhim: v "Bezdne" vas zhdut beskonechnye igry, setevoy reyting igrokov i ezhednevnye sostyazaniya.
•	Lyubiteley nasyshchennykh srazheniy poraduet uluchshennyy II.
•	Rezhim "Arkada" otlichno podoydet dlya tekh, kto ne lyubit chrezmernoy zhestokosti.
V GALAK-Z mozhno igrat v portativnom i nastolnom rezhimakh, a takzhe v rezhime TV. Igra podderzhivaet  kontroller Nintendo Switch™ Pro i kontrollery Joy-Con™.

title: Space Warlord Organ Trading Simulator [NSP][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
ORGANY.
U vsekh oni est, i vsem oni nuzhny. V etoy strannoy i peremenchivoy vselennoy vy torgovets organami, a klientov u vas khot otbavlyay. Otchayanno zhelaya priobresti myasistye kusochki chuzhoy ploti, oni obrashchayutsya imenno k vam — ved vy mozhete dostat vsyo chto ugodno!

Sorevnuytes s konkurentami na besposhchadnom rynke organov. Prodavayte vnutrennosti skolzkim tipam. Potrokha vampirov i lichey budut pytatsya poglotit ostalnye tovary v gruzovom otseke — sledite za etim! Postavlyayte kishki, pochki i serdtsa vo vse ugolki kosmosa. Delayte dengi. Space Warlord Organ Trading Simulator — eto nauchno-fantasticheskiy khorror dlya prirozhdennykh predprinimateley na rynke telesnykh zapchastey. Otkroyte v sebe talanty, o kotorykh vy i ne podozrevali!

title: Crumble [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Crumble - eto fizicheskiy platformer s mekhanikoy zakhvata yazyka.
Prisoedinyaytes k khaosu nestabilnykh platform i neozhidannykh razrusheniy s etim milym sinim sharom.
Postaraytes progressirovat v uvlekatelnykh urovnyakh, padayushchikh vokrug vas.
Dvigaysya kak sliz, prygay kak myach i kachay yazykom!
Funktsii:
-Rezhim kampanii so vse bolee razrushayushchimsya mirom
-Mnogopolzovatelskiy rezhim vecherinki do 2-kh igrokov
-Razblokirovat novye skiny
-Onlayn-doski liderov
-Vysokaya dinamicheskaya i interaktivnaya fizika

title: Maze Blaze [NSZ][ENG]
description:
在 Maze Blaze 中通過外星人出沒的迷宮射擊和爆炸，這是一款色彩和遊戲玩法都非常激烈的 Roguelike 動作射擊遊戲。目標很簡單——進入迷宮並擊落任何介於你和出口之間的東西。你的目標可能始終相同，但其他一切都在不斷變化。

每個迷宮都是一個程序生成的關卡，其中的敵人、物品和迷宮的佈局本身都是隨機的。你轉過的任何一個角落都不會與你上次進入時相同。一旦你進入他們的附近，越來越強硬的外星敵人會試圖把你帶走，所以你最好準備好先開槍，然後再提問。散佈在每個迷宮周圍的修飾符將增強你的能力和射擊。每款皮卡都提供了一個獨特的選擇，將定義你的遊戲風格。

簡單是 Maze Blaze 的核心。它很容易跳入，但有足夠的深度讓你繼續玩。你可以在長時間的遊戲會話中休息，或者在你有一點停機時間時清除幾個迷宮。無論你選擇如何玩，你總是會取得進步。你穿過的迷宮越多，你解鎖的東西就越多。混合搭配你新獲得的力量和武器，進一步深入不同的遊戲模式。

特徵：

無限可能的迷宮 - 遊戲玩法很簡單，但深度可以隨心所欲。隨機生成的迷宮、敵人和物品讓每一次遊戲都有自己意想不到的體驗。

玩你自己的方式 - 通過關卡和清除BOSS，或通過無盡的迷宮進行戰鬥。獨自一人或與朋友一起。你怎麼玩是你自己的選擇。

A Spectacle of Colour - 享受超風格化、霓虹色裝飾的 Roguelike 體驗，迷人的視覺效果令人驚嘆，但又不會讓人覺得過於壓倒性。

title: OpenTTD (Transport Tycoon Deluxe) [NSP][RUS/ENG]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 57]
description:
OpenTTD — kompyuternaya igra, portirovannaya versiya izvestnoy igry Transport Tycoon Deluxe, yavlyaetsya besplatnoy i svobodnoy programmoy, Transport Tycoon (sokr. TT, inogda TTO) (rus. Transportnyy magnat) — kompyuternaya igra, ekonomicheskaya strategiya v realnom vremeni, v kotoroy igrok vystupaet v kachestve upravlyayushchego transportnoy kompanii i pytaetsya poluchit maksimalnuyu pribyl za schyot perevozki passazhirov i raznoobraznykh gruzov po avtodorogam, zheleznym dorogam, monorelsovym dorogam, a takzhe vodnym i vozdushnym transportom. Razrabotchik igry — Kris Soyer (angl. Chris Sawyer).
Sut igry v sozdanii i uspeshnom razvitii transportnogo predpriyatiya, kotorym rukovodit igrok. Razvitie proiskhodit blagodarya izvlecheniyu pribyli, kotoraya poluchaetsya ot perevozok gruzov i passazhirov raznoobraznym transportom (zheleznodorozhnym, avto, avia i vodnym).
Igrok nachinaet igru v nachale XX veka s parovozami i samolyotami tipa «Kukuruznik» ili Yunkers, prodolzhaet igrat s dizelyami i «Boingami» i zakanchivaet igrat v kontse XXI veka s maglevami, monorelsami i «Konkordami», mozhno prokladyvat mosty i tonneli, stroit dorogi, zheleznye dorogi, stantsii, aeroporty, kanaly i akveduki. V obshchem igrovoy protsess polnostyu povtoryaet original — est proizvodstvennye tsepochki, a takzhe goroda, kotorye neobkhodimo svyazat transportom, ne zabyvaya ego obsluzhivat, i pri etom osushchestvlyat konkurentnuyu borbu. V igre vozmozhna pokupka aktsiy firm-konkurentov.

title: Resolutiion (Resolution) [NSP][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Resolutiion — eto dinamichnaya igra v zhanre action-adventure, sozdannaya dvumya zlobnymi bratyami iz Germanii. Prisoedinyaytes k gruppe brodyag v igre s prekrasnoy pikselnoy grafikoy, gryaznymi shutochkami, glubokimi ideyami i krutym saundtrekom na 20 chasov igrovogo vremeni. Vas zhdut zhestokie bitvy, issledovaniya, nagrady i neprostaya istoriya. Kem vy stanete? Igrokom ili igrushkoy? V Imperii Beskonechnosti vse ne to, chem kazhetsya.

Issleduyte raskolotyy mir budushchego, sobirayte neobychnye orudiya, istorii i proshloe po kusochkam: predannyy drug, razrushennaya semya i voyna mirov.

Chtoby razreshit taynu Kolybeley, vy pogruzites v puchinu, gde vas zhdut tsinichnye bogi, mashiny s chuvstvami, fanatiki, protivniki evolyutsii i mokhnatye sozdaniya. Etomu miru vse ravno, sbivaet li on vas s tolku ili ubivaet... oy, smotrite! Kotik!

*20 ch. igrovogo vremeni.
*Issleduyte zloveshchiy mir v stile kiberpank, gde vse ne to, chem kazhetsya.
*Pogruzites v mrachnuyu istoriyu, stante geroem ili zlodeem.
*Otkryvayte novye sposobnosti i pobezhdayte vragov.
*Vyzhivayte v surovykh bitvakh i krushite zhutkikh bossov.
*Naslazhdaytes krutym saundtrekom v stile kiberpank.

title: Chained [NSP][ENG]
description:
Pomogite Koulu otomstit zlomu «Skautu» i nagloy kiberneticheskoy kompanii, kotoraya uvolila ego s raboty. Reshayte golovolomki, vzlamyvayte akkaunty i ne pozvolyayte otdelu kiberbezopasnosti zakhvatit razvivayushchuyusya sistemu iskusstvennogo intellekta. No vskore to, chto nachinaetsya kak prostoy akt mesti, pererastaet v nechto, ot chego Koul bolshe nikogda ne mozhet uyti..
Golovolomki vklyuchayut v sebya bystroe obedinenie tsepochek chisel, chtoby oboyti mery bezopasnosti i pozaimstvovat dengi korporatsiy. Po mere togo, kak II «Razvedchik» uznayot vsyo bolshe tryukov, Chained brosit vyzov vashey lovkosti i predpolozheniyam o tom, chego mozhet stoit kholodnaya mest.

title: Protodroid Delta [NSP][ENG]
description:
Predstavte: MegaMan — no v 3D!.. Protodroid DeLTA — eto bystryy, dinamichnyy tryokhmernyy ekshn-platformer, gde deystvie proiskhodit v polnom nadezhd mire v stile solar-pank, a vas zhdut krasochnyy landshaft, personazhi i bossy, kotorykh nuzhno pobedit!
Vsemirno izvestnyy robototekhnik, doktor Shelton sozdal odnogo iz pervykh proto-droidov — giper-prodvinutogo androida po imeni Delta (DeLTA) s urovnem intellekta, priblizhayushchemusya k chelovecheskomu.

title: Mystery Mine [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
description:
Dinamichnoe priklyuchenie v nedrakh tainstvennoy Shakhty: opasnye monstry i bossy, drevnyaya magiya i resheniya, ot kotorykh zavisyat mnozhestvo sudeb! Smozhet li prostoy tuzemets spasti mir?

Istoriya
Geroy igry Mbonga - prostoy rabotnik v otdalennoy ot tsivilizatsii derevne. Odnazhdy on vstrechaet drevnego Dukha, kotoromu nuzhna ego pomoshch. Doverivshis Dukhu, kotoryy obeshchaet spasti derevnyu ot zla, nadvigayushchegosya na zhiteley, Mbonga otpravlyaetsya v dolgiy put k Preispodney. 

Geympley
Nasha tsel v igre - dostich Preispodney, chtoby pomoch Dukhu i spasti derevnyu. Po puti igrok budet srazhatsya s monstrami, preodolevat opasnye prepyatstviya, reshat golovolomki i uznaet istoriyu etogo mira i ego obitateley.

title: Semblance [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Semblance — eto unikalnyy platformer v settinge volshebnogo minimalistichnogo mira, v kotorom vy mozhete izmenyat landshaft. Igra govorit vam: chto esli by vy mogli izmenyat landshaft okruzhayushchego vas mira? Semblance beret ideyu «platformy» i perevorachivaet ee s nog na golovu! Teper platformy ne prosto put, oni — klyuch k preodoleniyu prepyatstviy.
Issleduyte «myagkiy» mir, v kotorom otsutstvuet kontseptsiya tverdogo sostoyaniya. V igre predstavleny tri mira — tri planety, na landshaft kotorykh vy mozhete vozdeystvovat. Razbivayte strannuyu kristallicheskuyu infektsiyu iz zhestkogo materiala, osvobozhdaya zhiznennuyu essentsiyu i raskryvaya prichinu vozniknoveniya etoy skverny.

Unikalnyy geympley iskazheniya platformy:
Ne udaetsya dobratsya do nagrady? Soberite zemlyu v kuchu, chtoby doprygnut. Na puti voznikli ostrye shipy? Promnite zemlyu i idite dalshe. Szhimayte, udaryayte, rasplyushchivayte mir — i nikakie prepyatstviya vas ne ostanovyat.

Estetika minimalistichnogo dizayna:
Puteshestvuyte po trem miram, kotorye napolneny yarkim ocharovaniem krasok, prichudlivymi sozdaniyami i umirotvoryayushchimi gorizontami. Pozvolte sebe vpast v igrovoy trans ot dinamichno smenyayushchikhsya urovney, slovno vas gipnotiziruet afrikanskiy shaman.

Nelineynoe dvizhenie:
Igra pozvolyaet vam peremeshchatsya mezhdu zagadkami tak, kak vam udobno. Vam ne nuzhno v obyazatelnom poryadke iskat reshenie, chtoby prodvinutsya dalshe — vy vsegda smozhete vernutsya. Povestvovanie v igre nelineyno, tak chto vy mozhete sobirat istoriyu slovno chasti pazla.

title: Royal Hole Poco Academy (王立 穴ポコ学園, Ouritsu Anapoco Gakuen) [NSZ][JAP]
description:
«Korolevskaya akademiya Anapoko» ispolzuet poshagovuyu boevuyu sistemu i bystrye stsenarii, bolee 100 studentov-personazhey budut poseshchat Akademiyu Anapoko, i vmeste brosyat vyzov vsem taynam podzemnogo mira.
Tainstvennyy mir, prostirayushchiysya na samoe dno.. Studenty magicheskoy shkoly budut issledovat podzemnyy mir v techenie tryokh let svoey zhizni, a priobretennyy opyt obretyot novuyu silu i budet peredan novym pokoleniyam. Tut vse bitvy razvorachivayutsya plavno, a vragi mogut podkradyvatsya kazhdyy khod. Izvlekayte vygodu iz kazhdogo srazheniya, v polnoy mere ispolzuya navyki, meshayushchie deystviyam protivnika, uznavayte poryadok deystviy vraga do nachala bitvy, ili poprobuyte perekhitrit ego!
Sozdannaya vmeste s izvestnoy mangakoy Ayami Morinagoy, ona rasshiryaet ranee narisovannuyu istoriyu!

title: Hakokoro V / ハココロ5 [NSZ][JAP]
publisher: AMZY アムジー株式会社
description:
Predstavlyaem novuyu igru v izvestnoy seriyu Hakokoro na Nintendo DSi Ware s prostym ustroystvom, no glubokim geympleem: postaraytes bystro proyti vse etapy, v polnoy mere ispolzuya intuitivnoe upravlenie i reaktsiyu v prinyatii resheniy!
Aktiviruyte magiyu, kataya kubik-«korobku», zakhvatyvaya volshebnye shary, i pobedite vsekh vragov.
Eta istoriya ob Emi, molodoy uchenitse volshebnika, priekhavshey v gorod, chtoby stat Velikoy volshebnitsey Kuku. Vam nuzhno budet sdat Ekzamen Volshebnikov v glavnoy bashne, chtoby stat ey! Broste vyzov sluchayno sgenerirovannym urovnyam, i stremites k naivysshemu ballu!..

title: Jack n Hat [NSP][ENG]
description:
Igra Jack’n' Hat mozhet pokhvastatsya potryasayushchey 16-bitnoy pikselnoy grafikoy, prekrasnoy muzykoy i chyotkim upravleniem, kotorye navernyaka napomnyat tebe o luchshikh oldskulnykh platformerakh. 
 
 Otpravsya v zakhvatyvayushchee priklyuchenie po miru platformera Ririlenda! Zlobnyy doktor Vu Dum ukral printsessu Riri, chto privelo k grazhdanskoy voyne i pogruzilo korolevstvo v khaos!
 
 Smozhet li khot kto-nibud spasti eto otchayannoe korolevskoe polozhenie? Dzhek, znamenityy master na vse ruki, gotov vosstanovit v strane mir.
 
 Vooruzhivshis poslednim izobreteniem neveroyatnogo doktora Ekspo Zisiona - kepkoy, kotoruyu mozhno brosat kak bumerang, - Dzhek otpravlyaetsya v puteshestvie po planete v poiskakh Energeticheskikh kristallov, moshch kotorykh pozvolit emu dobratsya do luny i polozhit konets planam doktora Vu Duma po zavoevaniyu mira!
 
 Pomogi Dzheku prygat i skolzit po pustynyam, dzhunglyam i vulkanam, srazhayas s kovarnymi vragami i opasnymi bossami!
 
 Smozhesh li ty spasti Ririlend?

Ob igre Jack’n' Hat's:
 - 20 obshirnykh urovney s sekretnymi podurovnyami!
 - Sobiray kristally, samotsvety i zvyozdy. Smozhesh li ty nayti vse?
 - Napryazhyonnye srazheniya s bossami
 - Dopolnitelnye umeniya, kotorye nuzhno otkryt
 - Priyatnyy chiptyun-saundtrek
 - Sovremennyy i retro-rezhimy
 - 7-8 chasov geympleya

title: Ruggnar [NSP][ENG]
description:
It's a dwarf's story!

As the veins of his city are depleted and the valley is deserted of its inhabitants, rumors of taverns come to Ruggnar's ears. Abandoned places contain incredible treasures that are just waiting to be pickep up.
Equipped with his bag and a few candles, he goes on an adventure to make his fortune!

Really useful candles!

Ruggnar has a limited amount of candles to help him in these dark places. Help him to manage his supply.
Seeing the path ahead of you, activating certain mechanisms or simply lighting up: it's up to you to find the perfect use for each candle!
And if you throw one, remember to pick it up. It might come in useful soon!

Sneaky traps!

There are no enemies to kill here, but many traps are in your way. 
Hidden by the darkness, you may find yourself face to face with an axe, a fireball or other nasty things. 
Don't worry, move carefully, use your candles and everything will be fine. After all, Ruggnar is very agile for a dwarf and he gets up quite easily after an accident.
Observe your surroundings, listen to the noises around you, throw your candles. The traps are there. It's up to you to avoid them!

Customize Ruggnar!

Throughout your journey, unlock new abilities.
Visit the merchant to learn the secrets contained in ancient grimoires to improve your candles and equipment, or to buy the latest items in stock.
Need a change? Many beard dyes, armors and helmets are hidden. Find them and create your own style!

And much more!

- Explore every corner with smooth controls
- Hand-forged story mode
- Procedural generation to extend the experience
- Discover the story behind this humorous adventure
- Pierre-Alain de Garrigues (PADG, french voice over) and Jordan Harrelson (english voice over) lend their talents to Ruggnar so he can swear louder and louder!

title: Klang 2 [NSP][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Zaklyuchennyy v tyurmu v neizvestnom meste, Klang dolzhen ottachivat svoi navyki ritmichnoy borby v audiovizualnykh simulyatsiyakh.

Bystro atakuyte vraga yarkimi ognennymi sharami. Uklonyaytes i protivostoite vrazheskim atakam i nanosite znachitelnyy ushcherb molniey, po sravneniyu s chem pobleknut dazhe velichayshie bogi mifologii. Dostignite eyforicheskogo sostoyaniya transa v etoy ekshen-igre s gipnoticheskim ritmom i dinamichnym boem.


Kharakteristiki:

* 30 urovney intensivnogo EDM-ekshena, vosproizvodimogo na normalnoy i vysokoy skorosti
* Poluprotsedurnaya boevaya sistema garantiruet, chto treki nikogda ne budut zvuchat odinakovo
* Bossy postepenno vvodyat novye pravila igry
* Tekhno-grecheskaya estetika, vdokhnovlennaya sintveyvom, muzykalnoy simvolikoy i skulpturoy
* Muzyka legendarnogo kompozitora bLiNd i drugikh talantlivykh ispolniteley, takikh kak Dzheyms Landino, Arcien i Nhato

title: Brain Show [NSP][ENG]
description:
Brain Show: Who is the smartest one in your crew?

Brain Show is a quiz game spiced with some mean, but harmless humour. Immerse in the world of classic game shows: choose your categories, answer questions, eliminate rivals in various challenges, and prove yourself to be the smartest one in the pack!

Up to 8 players
Over 5 000 questions in 41 categories
13 competitions with entirely different rules
Charismatic, funny (and a little cringy) host commenting your actions.

Controls in Brain Show were designed on a test group consisting of my chihuahua and a blind, 22 years old cat. So don’t worry if some of your friends have never played any game in their lives, someone drank one too many, or you have this one peculiar fellow in the group… You just hand out pads, launch the game and have fun from the get-go. No manual or explanation needed!

Welcome to a TV game show for people who are ashamed to admit that they have always dreamt about participating in one! Stand on a stage, take part in various challenges, such as the Stealing Points Round or Eliminations, play for a stake, and get annoyed by the weird host (because there is no game show without someone like me!).
And since we’re talking about me. I admit, I will throw some shade at you, but also tell you a good word (if you deserve it!). Always remember – my only purpose is to bring you loads of laughs (and a little bit of cringe).

Game available in English and Polish.

Get Brain Show and join the fun!

title: Before We Leave [NSP][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Vashi lyudi mnogo pokoleniy prozhili pod zemley. Im tak ne khvatalo laskayushchikh kozhu solnechnykh luchey, rykhloy zemli pod bosymi nogami i dazhe nazoylivykh mukh. Oni podnyalis na poverkhnost polnymi predvkusheniya, no ne umeyushchimi vyrashchivat nichego, krome kartofelya. Vozrodite zabytuyu tsivilizatsiyu: obespechte lyudey zhilyom, issleduyte drevnie tekhnologii, zaselyayte drugie kontinenty i dazhe planety. No pomnite, chto vselennaya polna opasnostey. Drevnie kosmicheskie strazhi ugrozhayut vashim poseleniyam, i esli vy khotite, chtoby lyudi i dalshe zhili v mire i protsvetali, vam pridyotsya perekhitrit etikh sushchestv..
Gradostroitelnyy simulyator, deystvie kotorogo razvorachivaetsya v odnom uyutnom ugolke vselennoy. Zabottes o svoikh zhitelyakh, vozrodite zabytuyu tsivilizatsiyu i raskroyte eyo tayny. Zaselyayte novye zemli i planety i spasaytes ot golodnykh kosmicheskikh kitov!
Otyshchite to, chto bylo uteryano, i vozrodite tsivilizatsiyu! Stroyte poseleniya i zaselyayte planety v odnom uyutnom ugolke vselennoy. Vyrashchivayte, sobirayte i raspredelyayte resursy, chtoby vashi poseleniya protsvetali. Snabzhayte sosednie zemli i planety. Igrayte v svoyom ritme. Rasprostranyayte svoe vliyanie i zaselite tseluyu solnechnuyu sistemu schastlivymi lyudmi. Ne vsyo i ne vsegda budet po-vashemu, no ostryy um i nauchnye znaniya pomogut vam preodolet ispytaniya, s kotorymi nekogda stolknulis vashi predki.

title: Stella of The End [NSP][ENG]
description:
Syuzhet razvorachivaetsya na Zemle, kotoraya uzhe davno nakhoditsya pod kontrolem mashin, a zhalkie ostatki chelovechestva, zataiv dykhanie, vynuzhdeny shchemitsya po uglam. Glavnyy zhe geroy igry, khladnokrovnyy kurer Dzhud Grey odnazhdy poluchaet zakaz na transportirovku androida zhenskogo tipa po imeni Filiya, kotoraya pochemu-to ne nakhoditsya vo vlasti mashin.
Ispytyvaya otvrashchenie k naivnomu povedeniyu Filii, Dzhud otpravlyaetsya v put. Inogda oni vynuzhdeny ubegat ot maroderov, inogda preodolevat opasnye zony, gde brodyat mashiny. No nevziraya na opasnosti, Dzhud stremitsya vypolnit poruchenie. Filiya chasto govorit, chto khochet stat chelovekom, kotorym po slukham android mozhet stat, dostignuv vershiny kosmicheskogo lifta, vozvyshayushchegosya vdaleke i pronzayushchego nebo.
No pravda li eto?..
Roli ozvuchivayut:

title: Trogdor Reburninated (自制程序) [NSP][ENG]
developer: Videlectrix, Jonathan Hows, Aeon Softworks, Mike and Matt
description:
TROGDOR! — eto vesyolaya arkadnaya igra, osnovannaya na pokhozhdeniyakh personazha-drakona Trogdora iz Strong Bad Email. Trogdor davit krestyan i szhigaet doma, izbegaya pri etom rytsarey i luchnikov.
V rolyakh (v poryadke poyavleniya): Trogdor, Peres, Khakvort, Stiv, Krasnyy i siniy rytsari, Siamskie luchniki, Strong Plokhoy, Kerrek. A nochyu est vremya dlya... Trogdora!
Khotya v originalnuyu igru po-prezhnemu mozhno igrat v onlayne na sovremennykh ustroystvakh blagodarya HTML5, imenno etot proekt napravlen na rasshirenie originalnoy versii novymi funktsiyami i mnogoplatformennymi bibliotekami, kotorye pozvolyayut nativno portirovat ee na shirokiy spektr sistem: PSP, Wii U, Wii, Gamecube, 3DS, PS Vita, PK i Nintendo Switch.

title: Espacio Cosmic Light-Seeker [NSP][ENG]
description:
This space is full of magical characters too!
Enjoy the monochrome worldview with cute space animals.
What is the true nature of this space?
What awaits you in search of the light!

The appearance of your buddy Celluar is customizable!
There are also various item books, so try to complete them!

title: Revolver and Co [NSP][ENG]
developer: Chequered Ink (Allison J. James, Daniel Johnston Menezes)
description:
It's 2038, and a late maniacal inventor has left behind a legacy of madness - coordinates to an island full of wealthy robots, a gun that asks questions, and a widow that's hired you to answer them.

As Izzy Buspec, the newest recruit to Randco, take charge of their patented revolver as you explore the densely packed biomes of Corvynnia, bringing down hordes of docile robots in a money-making adventure. Every time you fire, you'll have to answer one of over 2,000 trivia questions with answers based on numbers, percentages, geography, dates, and more - the further you are from the actual answer, the more of its own ammunition the revolver will discharge. If you run out, it's back to Randco HQ to reload!

Revolver and Co features 105 story levels across 7 unique worlds and 12 question themes which will test you on a wide range of subjects, tied together with humorous debriefings between Izzy and her maniacal boss before the start of each mission.

Or if you're looking for more of a challenge, have a go at one of the Endless challenges, which pits you against a barrage of questions until you finally succumb to an empty revolver chamber. You can even unlock more Endless challenges by completing the story levels, including a grueling hour-long session where the only thing you have to lose is time.

title: Pinkshake (移植版 ) [NSP][RUS/ENG]
description:
Sobakevicha Pinksheyk snova ukral Zloy Skeleto-Demon. Da kak on vashche posmel?!..
Teper Pinksheyk dolzhna ispolzovat vse svoi super-navyki, chtoby ozhivit chetveronogo lyubimtsa i pomeshat kovarnym planam Zlodeya. V stile starogo dobrogo klassicheskogo 3D-platformera, prygaya s odnogo paryashchego ostrova na drugoy, ispolzuya moshchnyy ryvok i svoy vernyy kryuk, dostigayte vsyo bolee dalnikh mest mestnogo mira. I ne zabudte svoyo glavnoe oruzhie — zontik!..
Ot russkogo razrabotchika.
Videotreyler.Eshchyo lou-poli 3D igr, pokhozhikh na epokhu PS1-PSX.

title: Intrepid Izzy [NSP][ENG]
description:
Intrepid Izzy — eto brosayushchaya vyzov zhanru 2D-igra s unikalnym khudozhestvennym stilem grafiki vysokogo razresheniya.

Garmonichno sochetaya platformer s elementami zhanra «pobey ikh vsekh» i priklyucheniy, igra otlichaetsya porazitelnym khudozhestvennym stilem, vdokhnovlennym grafikoy retro-igr, s chetkimi, detalizirovannymi spraytami i plavnoy animatsiey.

Vy budete issledovat ogromnye urovni, kazhdyy so svoey tematikoy i mekhanikoy. Poluchite raznye kostyumy dlya Izzi i vospolzuytes osobymi sposobnostyami, kotorye oni dayut!

Kharakteristiki
* Platformennyy ekshen i geympley «pobey ikh vsekh»
* Sovremennaya grafika, vdokhnovlennaya retro-igrami
* Raznoobraznye urovni
* Veselaya i zakhvatyvayushchaya istoriya
* Saundtrek Bena Kurotoshiro

title: Moon Raider [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Eyva – molodaya doch doktora Keyvora, pozhilogo genialnogo uchenogo, i Seleny, byvshey korolevy Luny. Zhizn Seleny zavisit ot osoboy energii, kotoruyu ey dayut tolko lunnye kristally. No kristally zakonchilis, i vremya na iskhode. Doktor Keyvor poruchaet Eyve otpravitsya na lunu i prinesti kak mozhno bolshe kristallov!

Eyve nuzhno vyzhit v opasnykh katakombakh gluboko pod poverkhnostyu i dat otpor legionu prisheltsev, zakhvativshikh kontrol nad Lunoy i okazavshikhsya ne takimi uzh primitivnymi. Ikh mir polon uzhasayushchikh tekhnologiy, smertonosnykh lovushek i vooruzhennykh boytsov. Vskore Eyva osoznaet, chto edinstvennyy sposob spasti mat – eto spasti Lunu ot samoy sebya.

 Osobennosti:

 - Issleduyte raznoobraznyy mir ruchnoy raboty, kotoryy ne naskuchit ot nachala do kontsa
 - Nakhodite spryatannye uluchsheniya i potaynye oblasti
 - 10 krasochnykh urovney
 - 11 epichnykh srazheniy s bossami
 - Lokalnyy kooperativnyy rezhim dlya dvukh igrokov

title: My Heart Grows Fonder [NSP][ENG]
description:
Poznakomtes s neschastnym Kassiem, kotoryy pytaetsya zabyt svoyu byvshuyu, Mayyu, kotoraya brosila ego i razbila emu serdtse. Ego uteshaet ego luchshaya podruga Ava, kotoraya ostalas s nim i pytaetsya pomoch emu dvigatsya dalshe.

Kak izmenyatsya otnosheniya v etom treugolnike, esli oni budut vynuzhdeny zhit vmeste?

Smozhet li Kassiy naladit otnosheniya s byvshey i vernut ee? Ili on ostavit proshloe v proshlom i naydet sebe novoe schaste?


Kharakteristiki:
* Vizualnaya novella - simulyator svidaniy
* Krasivaya grafika v stile anime
* Sladkie romanticheskie stseny
* Pyat raznykh kontsovok

title: The Sorrowvirus a Faceless Short Story [NSZ][RUS/Multi4]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 4]
description:
Wyatt Heyll 是一位從小飽受各種疾病所苦的少年。在死亡前夕，Wyatt 的父母讓他服用了一種名為 Sorrowvirus 的超自然物質，這會使人類的靈魂受到汙染且無法超渡。如此一來 Wyatt 的靈魂便會墜入煉獄，而他的父母就能在煉獄中治療他，並讓他起死回生。然而，每次 Wyatt 的靈魂回歸時，癌症與疾病發作的速度卻更勝以往。

Wyatt 的父母在煉獄中發現了一種或許能永遠治好他的有機粒子，但在進行研究的這段期間，他們不斷讓 Wyatt 在生死間徘徊。歷經多次死亡的 Wyatt 只想一了百了。您的目標就是讓 Wyatt 從永無止盡的折磨中獲得解脫。以第一人稱視角探索充滿悲傷氛圍的場景，解謎取得線索並揭開 Wyatt 的悲慘故事。四種結局之中，只有一種是真正的解脫。

特色：

• 探究少年陷入無限死亡輪迴的原因。
• 發現對話中的差異和不同的難題，遊戲將繼承前一輪的記憶。
• 以第一人稱視角在精緻華麗的場景中探索！
• 解決挑戰謎題，找出追尋的答案。
• 沉浸於令人回味無窮的唯美音樂中。
• 找尋唯一正確的道路，從折磨中解放 Wyatt！

title: Cardaclysm Shards of the Four [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Vy — tyomnyy mag, kotoromu ne sledovalo svyazyvatsya so slishkom mogushchestvennymi zaklinaniyami. No vy, konechno, vsyo ravno risknuli. Na etot raz dela poshli sovsem skverno: iz-za vas v mir yavilis Chetyre vsadnika Apokalipsisa i ikh prispeshniki! Blestyashchiy rezultat, chto i govorit… Itak, potoropites: ispolzuyte volshebnye karty, chtoby otpravit etu velikolepnuyu chetvyorku obratno v eyo adskoe izmerenie, poka Apokalipsis ne unichtozhil vsekh i vsya — i, chto eshchyo vazhnee, poka sovet magov ne obnaruzhil, chto vy natvorili…

Cardaclysm: Oskolki Chetyryokh — eto generiruemaya sluchaynym obrazom kollektsionnaya kartochnaya igra s elementami RPG!
Sobirayte karty sushchestv i zaklinaniy i ispolzuyte ikh silu v boyu!
Mir igry beskonechen: zdes vsegda naydyotsya chto-to novoe!

Bitva 
Sobirayte, kombiniruyte i ispolzuyte silu chudovishch, misticheskikh sushchestv i magicheskikh zaklinaniy v poshagovykh srazheniyakh! V igre «Cardaclysm: Oskolki Chetyryokh» bolee 200 kart, i u kazhdoy svoi unikalnye svoystva, grafika i 3D-animatsiya.

Biomy
Brosayte vyzov protivnikam i srazhaytes s nimi na arenakh, raspolozhennykh v razlichnykh biomakh. Preodolevayte raskalyonnye pustyni, vechnye ldy i neprolaznye dzhungli. Budte ostorozhny: za kazhdym povorotom vas ozhidayut bezzhalostnye chudovishcha!

Pab
V promezhutkakh mezhdu srazheniyami posetite Mezhmirovoy pab. Zdes mozhno prokhodit ispytaniya, obmenivatsya mogushchestvennymi kartami, a takzhe pryatat lishnie zaklinaniya v svoy lichnyy sunduk do toy pory, poka oni vnov ne ponadobyatsya vam v epicheskom srazhenii s silami tmy.

• Vas zhdut 5 fraktsiy i bolee 200 kart, u kazhdoy iz kotorykh svoi unikalnye svoystva, grafika i 3D-animatsiya
• Ispolzuyte bolee 40 artefaktov dlya usileniya vashego geroya
• Srazites s pyatyu mificheskimi bossami: pobeda nad kazhdym trebuet svoego podkhoda k igrovoy mekhanike
• Issleduyte beskonechnye miry v raznoobraznykh biomakh
• Prokhodite ispytaniya i obmenivaytes kartami v Mezhmirovom pabe, v kotoryy vy smozhete popast v promezhutkakh mezhdu zadaniyami

title: Blobby Volley 2 (GPLv2, voleybol) [NSP][ENG]
developer: Daniel Knobe, Jonathan Sieber, Daniel Skoraszewsky, Silvio Mummert
description:
Blobby Volley — eto populyarnaya besplatnaya sportivnaya arkadnaya videoigra s otkrytym iskhodnym kodom, v kotoroy dva sushchestva v forme kapli igrayut v voleybol drug protiv druga.
Pravila, ispolzuemye v Blobby Volley, vzyaty iz standartnykh pravil voleybola. V otlichie ot nastoyashchego sporta, dvizheniya igrokov ogranicheny dvukhmernym prostranstvom ekrana, granitsy ekrana deystvuyut kak nevidimaya stena, ot kotoroy myach otskakivaet, a poskolku na kazhdoy storone polya nakhoditsya tolko odin igrok, razresheno, v otlichie ot standartnogo voleybolnogo myacha kasatsya myacha neskolko raz podryad.
Igra zakanchivaetsya, kogda odin iz dvukh igrokov nabiraet 15 (ili bolee) ochkov, a takzhe imeet preimushchestvo v dva ochka nad drugim. Ochki mozhet nabrat tolko igrok, podayushchiy myach. Poetomu kazhdyy iz igrokov pytaetsya zastavit drugogo sovershit oshibku, chtoby oni mogli podavat i nabirat ochki.

title: Open Syobon Action DC / Cat Mario, NekoMario, Mario from Hell (na reicast) [NSP][ENG]
description:
Syobon Action (yap. しょぼんのアクション), takzhe izvestnaya kak Cat Mario (NekoMario) i Mario from Hell, — yaponskaya videoigra v zhanre ironichnogo platformera, vypushchennaya v fevrale 2007 goda. Ona stala izvestna i populyarna blagodarya svoim, kazhushchimisya na pervyy vzglyad, prostymi urovnyam; priznayotsya parodiey na igru ot kompanii Nintendo Super Mario Bros. 1985 goda. Nesmotrya na neozhidannost lovushek v igre, urovni ne menyayutsya posle proigrysha, chto pozvolyaet igroku zapominat ikh mestopolozhenie i v konechnom itoge propuskat ikh. V otlichie ot Super Mario Bros., gde posle tryokh popytok ves progress sbrasyvaetsya, — tut beskonechnoe kolichestvo zhizney. Takzhe mozhno sobirat monety, pravda, ikh schyotchik ne pokazyvaetsya.
Igrok upravlyaet podobnym kotu personazhem, kotoryy dolzhen proyti cherez platformennye urovni, podobnye Super Mario Bros. Igra sostoit iz urovney, pronizannykh lovushkami, prednaznachennymi dlya obmana igroka, v tom chisle obychnyy na vid kirpich, kotoryy padaet ili provalivaetsya pod igroka; bloki, iz kotorykh pri prikosnovenii vyrastayut shipy; vragi, sprygivayushchie s vysoty ili vyletayushchie iz trub; bloki s monetami, ustanovlennye na krayu yamy, zastavlyayushchie personazha udaritsya ob nikh i upast; oblaka-ubiytsy; zvyozdy, kotorye v originalnoy igre pridayut sposobnosti, tut — unichtozhayut igroka; i flagshtok v kontse urovnya, gde geroy takzhe mozhet umeret dvumya sposobami.
Po priznaniyu sozdatelya igry, nezavisimogo yaponskogo razrabotchika «Chiku» — bolshinstvo idey on cherpal u Flash-igry «Bolshoe priklyuchenie Ovaty», osnovnaya ideya kotoroy — mnozhestvo vnezapnykh prepyatstviy, vstrechayushchikhsya po khodu urovnya. Khotya sam vneshniy vid igrovogo protsessa sozdan pod vidnym vliyaniem igroy Super Mario Bros. kompanii Nintendo 1985 goda vypuska. Saundtrek Syobon Action — sbornik muzyki iz razlichnykh igr, vykhodivshikh v 1980-e i 1990-e gody. Muzykalnaya tema pervogo urovnya byla vzyata iz igry, popavshey v nelitsenzirovannyy sbornik videoigr Action 52 — The Cheetahmen. Glavnyy geroy, podobie kota, pokhozh na talisman Sony v Yaponii — Toro Inoue. Samyy pervyy variant Syobon Action byl sozdan za tri dnya i predstavlen na kulturnom festivale, provodivshemsya v kampuse ego kolledzha, stav samoy populyarnoy iz predstavlennykh rabot. K fevralyu 2007 goda Syobon Action nachal rasprostranyatsya po Seti.
Syobon Action byla vosprinyata polozhitelno, a v obzorakh otmechaetsya intensivnaya i chasto razocharovyvayushchaya vysokaya slozhnost igry. Ona byla priznana igroy, kotoraya «sistematicheski narushaet vse pravila igrovogo protsessa 2D-platformera», i chto uspekh v igre chasto zavisit kak ot «metoda prob i oshibok», tak i ot sposobnosti igroka ispolzovat nelogichnye strategii, chtoby izbegat prepyatstviy. Po mneniyu datskogo igrovogo zhurnalista Povla Rasmussena, Syobon Action «nastolko plokha i v to zhe vremya nevozmozhna, chto v segodnyashnie dni dostigla kultovogo statusa».

title: Them Bombs [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Ty nakhodishsya v pomeshchenii s tikayushchey bomboy. Tik! Tak! Tik-Tak! Chasy neumolimo otschityvayut vremya do detonatsii. Kakoy provodok pererezat - siniy ili krasnyy? Tik-Tak! Tik-Tak! Kak ustanovit ruchki? Tik-Tak! Tik-Tak! Ostalos eshchyo tolko dve minuty… Medlenno sadyatsya batareyki fonarika. Skachet adrenalin. Ty smozhesh ostavatsya khladnokrovnym i obezvredit vzryvnoe ustroystvo?
 
OB IGRE
 – Soberi Gruppu Ekspertov i prover, skolko chelovek vam udastsya spasti.
 – Opisyvay Ekspertam to, chto ty vidish, tolko s pomoshchyu slov (postaraysya delat eto kak mozhno bolee ponyatnee!).
 – Obezvrezhivay bombu, tochno sleduya ukazaniyam Ekspertov.
 – Testiruy svoi kommunikatsionnye sposobnosti.
 
PREDUPREZhDENIE: Kogda vremya podzhimaet i rastyot uroven adrenalina, legko skatitsya do krika, rugatelstv i nedorazumeniy. V takoy situatsii mozhet doyti do ssory mezhdu znakomymi ili do "molchalivykh dney" u suprugov...

PRAVILA IGRY
 Odin iz igrokov yavlyaetsya Nezhdannym Geroem, kotoryy nashyol bombu. Ostalnye igroki sostavlyayut Gruppu Ekspertov i raspolagayut rukovodstvom, v kotorom soderzhitsya instruktsiya po obezvrezhivaniyu vzryvnogo ustroystva. Oni ne mogut smotret na to, chto vidit Nezhdannyy Geroy, a Geroy ne mozhet videt soderzhaniya rukovodstva. Igrokam razreshaetsya obshchatsya tolko s pomoshchyu golosa (kak budto by oni razgovarivali mezhdu soboy po ratsii).

DISCORD
Nash server nakhoditsya na Discord! Igray s lyudmi so vsego mira cherez golosovoy chat! 
Zaydi na veb-sayt www.thembombs.com/discord

title: Diluvian Winds [NSZ][ENG]
publisher: Goblinz Publishing, IndieArk, Red Art Games
description:
Kogda snaruzhi bushuet burya, na mayake, upravlyaemom mudrym tyulenem, puteshestvennikov vsegda zhdet krov i radushnyy priem. Stante smotritelem mayaka, vstrechayte i razmeshchayte gostey, vyderzhivayte natisk stikhii i razvivayte svoe poselenie odnovremenno na sushe, pod vodoy i v vozdukhe.
Mayak pomogaet karavanam i odinokim strannikam nayti put skvoz tmu i buri. Zadacha smotritelya – sledit, chtoby fonar ne potukh, a obitateli derevni pri mayake ne okazalis otrezannymi ot mira. V derevne regulyarno osedayut novye antropomorfnye puteshestvenniki. U kazhdogo iz nikh – svoya istoriya, svoi talanty i svoi zaprosy, kotorye voley-nevoley pridetsya vypolnyat. Inache kak postroit krepkoe, ustoychivoe grazhdanskoe obshchestvo v otdelno vzyatom poselenii?

title: Quadroids [NSP][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
**獨特玩法：**同時在四個畫面上控制你的Quadroids，通過100多個充滿危險的關卡。跳躍以避免酸浴、雷射、致命的尖刺和其他危險陷阱，或者策略性地犧牲你的手下以創造新的平台機會。

Quadroids的操作簡單，只需4個按鈕（每個畫面一個），但你能否掌握技巧呢？

**單人還是多人遊戲？**如果你的大腦力有不逮，可以請朋友來控制一個或多個畫面...

Quadroids會撕裂你的新皮質。展示你是老大，奮鬥到排行榜的頂端吧！

title: Cards of the Dead [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Infektsiya prodvigaetsya na minutu i poluchenie vaktsiny - edinstvennaya nadezhda na chelovechestvo.
Delayte vse v svoey vlasti, chtoby borotsya s polchishchami zombi, nakaplivayushchikhsya na ulitsakh, chtoby proyti put k biologicheskomu kompleksu i poluchit obrazets.

Zhit istoriyu Rika, Selena i Dena, tri vzaimosvyazannykh istoriya, na kotorykh eto zavisit ot togo, chtoby poluchit vaktsinu, chtoby ostanovit infektsiyu.

Funktsii
- Neskolko oruzhiy: poluchit vse oruzhie v vashem rasporyazhenii, chtoby vynut nezhit
- Strategiya vyzhivaniya: upravlyat svoey vaktsinoy, chtoby izbezhat podachi v infektsiyu, poka vy nalichiem pishchi, chtoby vosstanovit svoe zdorove i oruzhie, chtoby zashchitit sebya
- Istoriya koshmara: razgadat rol vyzhivshikh i kak ikh zhizn perepletaetsya v toy zhe sudbe
- Ochagi zombi: Zombie Apocalypse pokazhet vam bespokoystvo.

title: Dungeontop (Dungeon Top Spell Sword Cards) [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 移植版 ofitsialnogo russkogo perevoda 来自 AlchemistLab
description:
DungeonTop is a fresh new take on the roguelike deckbuilding genre, bringing a flavour of tight table top battles into the mix. Employ clever board tactics to gain advantage such as range, flanking, tanking and rushing.

A balance of risk to reward greets you both in an out of battle. Progression in DungeonTop could mean two things, grabbing more gold, or defeating more monsters! Play it your way. Will you build for cunning, speed, or power? Your choices in the dungeon directly influence your chance of survival!

There are shops to upgrade your cards along with ways to remove them and plenty of loot to add. Adventuring in the dungeon allows you to level your hero, find powerful weapons to equip, artifacts to use and talents to master. Build your unique fantasy hero by making careful choices on what to learn, what to discard and who to fight.

The choice of hero class will affect your play style and spells, whilst the allegiance you choose affects what minions you'll have to fight with. There are scores of achievements, treasures to find, gold to gather and more than 800 powerful cards to unlock.

DungeonTop will have you exploring a plethora of deck-building options for hours on end, continually finding new inventive ways to succeed on and off the board!

title: Black Legend [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Vvedite otryad naemnikov v proklyatyy gorod Grant i pomogite myatezhnikam v srazheniyakh s koshmarnymi kultistami. V etoy uvlekatelnoy poshagovoy RPG-strategii s alternativnoy istoriey vam predstoit razveyat tuman, okutyvayushchiy ulitsy goroda i svodyashchiy zhiteley s uma!

Brodite po razrushennym ulitsam Granta — goroda XVII veka, chya arkhitektura napominaet shotlandskuyu. Pomogite myatezhnikam borotsya s kultistami Mefisto.
Raskroyte tayny Mefisto — uzhasayushchego alkhimika, kotoryy sotvoril svodyashchiy s uma tuman i okutal im tselyy gorod.
Srazhaytes s pomoshchyu telesnoy alkhimii, sut kotoroy obyasnyaet uchenie gumorizma. Osvoyte chetyre nestabilnosti i soedinite ikh s atakami-katalizatorami, chtoby nanosit vragam moshchnyy uron!
Razblokiruyte 15 igrovykh klassov: personazhi kazhdogo klassa mogut obuchatsya unikalnym sposobnostyam i primenyat unikalnoe snaryazhenie. Osvoyte ikh, podberite optimalnye boevye sochetaniya i osvobodite Grant!
Vyberite svoy stil igry: lyubitelyam syuzheta podoydet bolee prostoy rezhim, a opytnym igrokam — slozhnoe ispytanie bez prava na oshibku.

Neznakomets, my nadeemsya, chto vy nas osvobodite.

Ispolnite nashe zhelanie!

title: Black Bird [NSZ][ENG]
description:
This is the tale of a young girl who dies one day on a street corner and is reborn as the ominous Black Bird. The bird is one of the great calamities, spoken of in the kingdom since ancient times.

Become the calamity, ‘Black Bird’, and destroy the kingdom

- What fate awaits this girl-turned bird?
- Will you, the Black Bird, destroy the world?
- Will this lively, fun-filled kingdom tread the path to destruction?


[Game Features]
**A darkly humourous world, built with loving care, pixel by pixel.
Visuals which recall a classic era of gaming portray a rich, picture book world.
Completing each stage will reveal more of the mysteries which shroud the dark, fairytale-like exterior.

**A unique audio/visual mix combined in an action-packed shooting game
Your enemies’ movement synchronises with the operatic soundtrack, sung in a bizarre, fictional language, creating a truly unique experience.

**8 different endings!
A high score is the key to the real ending and unlocking the story’s secrets.
Your skill will guide how the story concludes; practice really does make perfect!

**Extra Features Galore!
Unlock True Mode after completing the game to see new enemies, hidden bonus characters and more!
Learn the combo system, bomb system and hidden characters, then mix and match to find your own play style.
When you’re confident, aim for the top of the leaderboards in Score Attack.

[Award History]
BLACK BIRD received 2 awards at BitSummit Vol.6, a Japanese indie game festival held in 2018.
The first is the "Vermilion Gate Award" which is the grand prix prize, and the second one is a music award: the "Excellence in Audio Award"!
This is the best indie game from Japan in 2018!

title: Camped Out [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Work together as a team to complete campsites and unlock further areas in the game world.

Each level is a race against the clock where players are required to build tents, construct a campfire, cook enough food and get into bed before darkness falls.

THE WORLD IS YOUR OYSTER
It's a wide, bountiful world out there, teeming with all the natural resources you'll need to complete your campsite. There's wood to be chopped, stone to be mined and fish to be caught - but don't leave them lying around or they might disappear...

TEAMWORK MAKES THE DREAM WORK
To set up your camp as efficiently as possible, you'll need to work together. Throw tools to a teammate in need, ferry resources to a blueprint someone else placed, duck out of the way to let a camper through; every little bit of synergy helps. And most importantly, communicate!

ROME WASN'T BUILT IN A DAY
...but your campsite must be built by nightfall! Each camper's backpack holds a tent pack, lantern, and some shared tools. There's also a cooking pot to stew a succulent meal. You choose where to place your blueprints, so choose carefully!

MEET THE CAMPERS
Quintana is the Camp Leader at Roaring Pines Summer Camp. She is the eleven year old daughter of high achieving parents. Her mother, a respected surgeon and father, a psychiatrist. As the first born of two girls, Quintana feels a sense of responsibility to protect her little sister. She’s clever and curious and having achieved leadership status in Mensa for Kids, prefers the company of books to frivolous child’s play.

Covington is ten years old and lost his father when he was only five. Coming from a creative family, Covington's father left him with music in his veins. Covington continues to teach himself to play guitar by watching online videos of his favorite bands. He loves excursions and field trips with his fellow Campers, as he feels a close bond with them and will often serenade them with melodic renditions of his favorite songs.

Saffron is ten years old and the middle child of seven children. But with her ginger locks and eyes of blue and spirit to match her dazzling appearance she has no trouble standing out amongst the crowd. Living on the expanse of the farm with her six siblings, she is constantly seeking her next adventure and with a freckle to match each of her escapades, she’s unstoppable.

Rascal is eleven years old and an only child who’s been misunderstood until he was diagnosed with ADHD. His parents had him join Roaring Pines Summer Camp when he was seven, and as his name suggests he has a tendency to create mischief between his peers. Rascal loves to build and will use any material available to bring his imagination and creations to life. Whether it be sailing through stormy seas on a raft made of driftwood or flying through space with meteorite precision, Rascal leaves those around him in the wake of his creative destruction.

title: Turbo Shell [NSZ][ENG]
description: Turbo Shell — eto stremitelnyy 2D-platformer s neobychnoy mekhanikoy peredvizheniya: vmesto bega i pryzhkov vy tolkaete (i tyanete) samogo sebya po urovnyam s pomoshchyu spets. gadzheta: prokhodite vse bolee slozhnye urovni v roli Kreyga-Yaytsa, sobirayte nagrady — i pobeyte luchshee vremya svoikh druzey!..

title: She and the Light Bearer [NSP][ENG]
description:
Follow the Journey of the Little Firefly to seek The Mother deep inside the heart of the unknown forest! Though, this journey won't be easy for such a bug. The Little Firefly has to earn the forest trust and prove their worth by solving riddles, challenges, and puzzles.
Deeper into the forest, Our Little Firefly will learn the sacrifice of the forest, the horror of the Devourers, and the secret to awaken Mother. 

She and the Light Bearer is a blend of a music album and point and click adventure that borrows its aesthetics from storybook and fairytale. The game emphasized on art, poem, dialogue, and music to deliver the experience. 

She and the Light Bearer is brought to you by Mojiken Studio, Toge Productions, and Pathetic Experience.

- Fairy tale with interesting characters to interact with
- Fully hand drawn and animated visuals
- Instrumental acoustic soundtrack that brings you to the heart of the forest

title: Super Tux (移植版 ST/Supertux) [NSP][ENG]
developer: Bill Kendrick, Ingo Ruhnke, Marek 'wansti' Moeckel, SuperTux Development Team
description:
SuperTux — igra s otkrytym iskhodnym kodom, vo mnogom vdokhnovlyonnaya klassicheskim platformerom Super Mario, rasprostranyayushchayasya pod litsenziey GNU GPL. Iznachalno, avtory igry — Bill Kendrik i Ingo Runke; periodicheski vykhodyat novye versii SuperTux blagodarya aktivnoy komande odnoimyonnykh razrabotchikov.
Vam dlya spaseniya svoey vozlyublennoy, Penni, neobkhodimo proyti mnozhestvo urovney, preodolevaya prepyatstviya i uvorachivayas ot vragov. Personazhem vystupaet talisman OS Linux pingvin Taks, nakhodyashchiysya v odnom iz tryokh sostoyaniy s sootvetstvuyushchimi stepenyami zhivuchesti, ot kotorykh zavisit kolichestvo soprikosnoveniy s vragami ili opasnymi prepyatstviyami do proigrysha urovnya: malenkiy Taks — 1 soprikosnovenie, bolshoy — 2, bolshoy v golovnom ubore (strelyayushchiy ili obladayushchiy drugim svoystvom) — 3. Nekotorye vragi likvidiruyutsya naprygivaniem na nikh sverkhu ili udarom snizu cherez oporu, po kotoroy oni peredvigayutsya. Sobrannye monetki pozvolyayut Taksu, v sluchae proigrysha urovnya, nachat ego ne s nachala, a s bolee dalnego proydennogo mesta, otmechennogo kolokolchikom (kontrolnaya tochka). Pri nedostatke monet na schyote ves uroven pridyotsya prokhodit zanovo.
Italyanskaya gazeta Punto Informatico v iyule 2007 goda nazvala SuperTux kachestvenno sdelannym produktom s priyatnoy atmosferoy i fonovoy muzykoy. Portal Softonic otmetil prostotu igrovogo protsessa SuperTux, svoystvennuyu otlichnym klassicheskim igram. Marius Nestor, avtor obzorov sayta Softpedia, otsenil SuperTux kak zabavnuyu i uvlekatelnuyu igru s krasivoy grafikoy dlya igrokov lyubogo vozrasta.Super Tux Kart (port STK) sm. zdes.

title: Bring it to MOM [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Otpravlyaytes v priklyuchenie ILLa. Pomogite mame vosstanovit zdorove i istselite svoyu planetu. Uznayte 2 finala istorii. Vyberites iz 50 razlichnykh komnat. Ispolzuyte verevki, kataytes, prygayte, letayte, nyryayte, otbivaytes, sobirayte galaktiki i energiyu. Mame nuzhno bolshe energii. Prinesite ee. 

Chto vas zhdet
- Uvlekatelnyy syuzhet priklyuchencheskoy igry s elementami boevika.
- 2 razlichnykh finala.
- 50 etapov.
- Neozhidannye dopolnitelnye komnaty, iz kotorykh neobkhodimo sbezhat.
