- Otlichnoe razvlechenie na mnogo chasov.
- Final, s kotorym vy soglasites?

title: Freddy Spaghetti 1/2 [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Sledite za istoriey Freddi, i vy pogruzites s golovoy v istoriyu ispytaniy i prepyatstviy. Sozdannyy v laboratorii blistatelnogo doktora P. Starra, Freddi popadaet v neobychnoe priklyuchenie.

Freddi ispolzuet dvizheniya veryovki dlya imitatsii gibkogo, elastichnogo, verevochnogo personazha. Khodba, beg, pryzhok, skolzhenie, shlepok, sokrushenie, udar, uklonenie i polnyy proval – vot vash put k tseli. Preodolevayte slozhnye usloviya, stante masterom svoikh spagetti!

Osnovnye momenty
* Vesele i prostota upravleniya
* Dvizheniya povsyudu
* Unikalnye urovni
* Veselaya i zakhvatyvayushchaya istoriya
* Professionalnoe povestvovanie
* Mnogo individualnosti

title: Saomi / Hatup [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
Saomi 是一個喜歡挑戰和探索新地方的小冒險家。 在這次冒險中，Saomi 開始尋找一顆非常稀有的鑽石，該鑽石丟失在一個古老的家族寶藏中。

在冒險過程中，Saomi 會奔跑、跳過障礙物、使用二段跳來跳過更大的障礙物、使用她的空中推力技能來躲避陷阱、沿著牆壁跳躍和滑行等等，以尋找丟失的寶藏。

特徵：
- 玩 50 多個關卡；
- 不同的環境；
- 直觀的遊戲玩法；
- 具有挑戰性的精準平台遊戲；

title: Rabisco Plus [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Luna opechalilas, potomu chto zvezdy ischezli, i teper nebo temnoe i pustoe.

Pomogite miss Rabisko nayti poteryannye zvezdy i vernut svet v etot milyy, no opasnyy mir. Pogruzites v ocharovatelnyy khudozhestvennyy stil s siyayushchimi tsvetami i narisovannymi ot ruki karandashnymi liniyami. Saundtrek v stile bossa-nova dopolnyaet esteticheskuyu kartinu, sozdavaya rasslablyayushchuyu atmosferu.

Igra Rabisco vesma zamyslovata s bolee chem 20 tipami vragov i mnozhestvom interaktivnykh obektov, vklyuchaya rezhim uskorennogo bega.

Kharakteristiki
* Dvizhenie v dvukh izmereniyakh
* Simpatichnaya rasslablyayushchaya grafika i muzyka
* 100 urovney
* Rezhim uskorennogo bega

title: Mindball Play [NSP][ENG]
description:
Challenge your family and friends to a fun action packed racing game for all ages. Gather around the TV for split screen, create an online party and race your friends, or play by yourself and take on the time trial leaderboards.
Practice vs the computer before taking on the competition. Test the different power-ups and get to know the colorful sci-fi tracks— collect skins and customize your ball by beating bosses in the campaign mode. Rest assured, this game will test your focus to the limit. One mistake can cost you the game.
A physics based racing game where you need to become one with the ball— roll, bounce and push your way to victory.
Easy to learn, hard to master. Play with your kid on the easier tracks or challenge your friends to become the champion of this difficult racing game!

title: Flux8 [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Flux8 - the magnetic puzzle platformer.

Take control of Newt and Tess, or play split-screen with a friend! Navigate the factory floor attracting and repelling at will to avoid your untimely demise across 80 challenging levels.

Test yourself with fiendish puzzles and avoid deadly traps as you head for freedom.

Collect loot throughout your escape to customize Newt and Tess with a range of fashionable accessories.

Create your own adventures with the in-built level editor.

title: Super Intern Story [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Have you ever wondered how video games are made? Is it your life long dream to work in the gaming industry? Today is your lucky day! We may have the perfect position for you. Come work for us in this "challenging" environment where everything that can go wrong will absolutely go wrong.

We offer you valuable experience such as learning how to fix other people’s mistakes or getting blamed for everything because you’re just an intern.

Each day is different here and you will have to face new problems that makes you wonder about your own sanity. I hope you will apply for the job and discover the secrets of the video games industry!

Your future boss

Key Features:

- Every chapter is a new day with unique gameplay and challenges. You won't get bored!
- Beautiful environments that remind you that you're stuck at work and - wait did that fake pyramid just fall on the floor?
- Drama, joy, tragedy, nonsense... Just like your regular 9 to 5 job
- Lots of side quests & secrets scattered all over the madhouse that is your office building
- 4 monster costumes each with different abilities and unique cuteness
- A handful of coworkers to share a coffee with while listening to their complains
- Great corporate meta humor that feels like a crying emoji in a powerpoint about why you are fired

title: A Walk with Yiayia [NSZ][ENG]
publisher: Rochester Institute of Technology MAGIC Spell Studios
description:
無失敗、低壓力和情感的故事將第一代移民及其家庭成員的經歷聯繫起來，反思他們可以從彼此的經歷中學到什麼。

在這場深思熟慮的冒險中，透過引人入勝的對話進行聯繫，探索輕鬆的環境，並完成微型任務。

這款遊戲講述了一位祖母走出自己的舒適區，無所畏懼地過著自己的生活的感人故事。

title: Race Track Driver [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Join your personal Driving Tutor at the Race Track today! Follow his advice to earn your license and get promoted to the Race Team as a Test Driver! Take control of 16 High Performance Cars and complete various Tests of Driving Skills and Advanced Car Control to earn your Racing License.

FEATURES:
Sit alongside your Virtual Driving Instructor
Learn how to handle High Performance Cars
Complete 64 Driving Tests to earn your new Racing License
Racing Lines, Apexes, Braking Points and Drift Control Lessons
Get behind the wheel of 16 Awesome Track Tuned Cars
Featuring Realistic Racing Circuit with Multiple Layouts

FOLLOW YOUR INSTRUCTOR
Enter various Driving Test events such as Slaloms, Braking Tests, Racing Lines & Apex Tuition, Drifting and Donuts! Learn the “Art of Race Driving’ through advice from the Virtual Tutor and put it all together on the Race Track to earn Medals and unlock faster cars! Can you beat the Tutor on the road?!

REALISTIC RACE TRACK
Ultra HD Graphics and High-Resolution Track Modeling, including realistic corner curbs, pit garages and surfaces with varying grip levels. Learn and Master various different layouts of the main Race Circuit in increasingly powerful cars!

CAR COLLECTOR
Featuring 16 Awesome Cars including Rear Wheel Drive, Front Wheel Drive and All Wheel Drive. Jump into Off-Road and Rally cars for a different driving experience including some mixed surface rally-cross stages with epic rally cars!

title: Loot Hero DX [NSP][ENG]
description:
Odoleyte monstrov i stante geroem v etom epicheskom fenteziynom kveste! Legendarnyy drakon brodit po etim zemlyam. Goroda podzhigayutsya, i temnaya magicheskaya sila voskreshaet zlykh sozdaniy.

Geroy dolzhen otpravitsya v dalnie ugolki Zemli i ubit zverya, chtoby vosstanovit mir. Smelo brosaytes v boy so vse bolee trudnymi vragami, sobirayte opyt i dobychu, pokupayte luchshee snaryazhenie, povyshayte uroven i delayte vse eto snova!

Eta igra mozhet pokhvastatsya ogromnym kolichestvom vragov, kotorykh vy mozhete unichtozhit, odnovremenno sozdavaya taynik s zolotom, dostizheniyami i bestiariem, polnym monstrov dlya okhoty.


Osobennosti
* Ogromnyy akterskiy sostav razlichnykh vragov i bossov
* Tonny razlichnykh modernizatsiy oborudovaniya
* Lyubovno sozdannaya retro-grafika
* Geroicheskie podvigi
* Smeshnoe kolichestvo dobychi i opyta!

title: Community Inc [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Kak novyy menedzher, sozdayte schastlivoe soobshchestvo i torguyte s drugimi rasami... radi deneg. Da, vse verno, nam nuzhno ikh schaste, chtoby my mogli aktivirovat portaly. Lingi, vashi rabochie, budut podchinyatsya i pomogat v derevne. No budte ostorozhny, oni mogut vyzvat nemalo problem. Esli vam etogo eshche nedostatochno, est i drugie sushchestva, kotorye popytayutsya sdelat to zhe samoe - torgovat, srazhatsya ili pomogat. O, i ne zabyvayte pro pogodu i neozhidannye sobytiya.

POSTROYTE DEREVNYu

Postroyte svoyu sobstvennuyu derevnyu s mnozhestvom tipov zdaniy, i reshayte, kakie obekty vy khotite pomestit vnutri. Zdes mozhno izgotovit bolee 150 predmetov, i u kazhdogo est svoe naznachenie. Naprimer, sozdayte derevyannyy shkaf i razmestite ego v dome, chtoby uvelichit mesto dlya khraneniya. Dorogi mogut zastavit rabochikh idti bystree... i dazhe bolshe.

VAShI RABOTNIKI

Lingi rabotayut na vas. Vzamen vy dolzhny platit im zarplatu, davat edu, odezhdu i sozdavat «zdorovuyu» obstanovku. Vam reshat, kak oni rabotayut i gde. Ostorozhno, oni mogut vstupat v konflikty drug s drugom i dazhe podzhech vashu derevnyu. Sledite, o chem oni govoryat, i ne spuskayte glaz s ikh statistiki. Kazhdyy iz nikh imeet unikalnye cherty i kharakteristiki, kotorye vy mozhete kontrolirovat.

ISSLEDUYTE

Karta – eto pesochnitsa so sluchayno sgenerirovannoy prirodoy na osnove vashego iskhodnogo profilya. Est i polzovatelskie karty, kotorye vy mozhete postroit samostoyatelno. Obshchaytes, torguyte ili srazhaytes s drugimi rasami. Sobirayte sokrovishcha i prodavayte ikh ili ispolzuyte v svoem soobshchestve. Sluchaynye sobytiya, kotorye mogut prevratit vsyu vashu derevnyu v koshmar. Uznayte, kak pogoda vliyaet na vashu edu i rabotnikov.

I DAZhE BOLShE!

Dozhd i sneg izmenit ne tolko vneshniy vid, no i to, kak vy upravites so svoey derevney. Sdelayte luchshuyu odezhdu, inache rabotniki mogut zabolet. Sozdavayte luchshee oruzhie i dospekhi, chtoby protivostoyat zlym sushchestvam ili sluchaynym voram. Zaklyuchayte sdelki i poluchayte dostatochno deneg, chtoby uvelichit vashe soobshchestvo. I, esli vse poydet ne tak (ili plokho dlya vas), vy mozhete prosto prodat derevnyu!

DOBRO POZhALOVAT V COMMUNITY INC!

title: Pyramid Quest / Spencer / Monster Blast [NSP][ENG]
description:
Pyramid Quest is an exploration and treasure-hunting game inspired by classic platform games.
The goal is to find the three parts of an artefact and open the gate to the next level while collecting diamonds and coins.
 
Traps, obstacles, and enemies from old days make the quest very dangerous and challenging.
 
3D graphics packed in a nice graphics style, great 2.5D levels and proven gameplay gives you hours of fun.

title: Kyle is Famous [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Take Control of Kyle in this Text-Based Adventure. . .
-----------------
Make decisions for Kyle that will affect every part of his day. Take Kyle's hand through 117 unique endings, each determined by what Kyle has done and who he has interacted with. He needs you. Be kind.


Kyle just woke up. . .
-----------------
. . .and Kyle needs to prepare to conduct an interview with a very, very important guest on his show. Collect items, make choices, and solve mysteries.


Kyle can swallow the fridge. . .
-----------------
. . .and Kyle can travel time and steal from the locals and dump lard on his neighbor and many, many other things that KYLE SHOULD NOT DO. Take Kyle's hand. Direct him. Tell him what he ABSOLUTELY SHOULD NOT DO. Confidently help Kyle. He needs you.


Kyle has 117 endings. . .
-----------------
. . .but only one of them is the good, well-prepared ending that you are going to guide Kyle to. Who knows what would happen if you weren't there for him? Would he destroy the city? Gossip about his neighbor? Fight crime? Revive a dead loved one?

title: Flying Hero X [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Zlye edinorogi zavoevali Myau-York!
Prishlo vremya raskryt svoy istinnyy geroyskiy talant i otomstit!
Spasite vsekh milykh kotyat v etom protsvetayushchem gorode na prekrasnom ostrove i uluchshite svoe snaryazhenie, chtoby letat bystree lyubogo drugogo geroya!

I nakonets ... pokazhite etim edinorogam, iz chego vy sdelany!

FLYING HERO X predlagaet issleduemyy otkrytyy mir s mnozhestvom missiy i
desyatki paskhalnykh yaits i skrytykh oblastey, kotorye nuzhno nayti (vklyuchaya uroven korovy).

title: Iota [NSZ][ENG]
description:
iota is a hardcore, precision platformer with one important difference: there is no jump button. instead, you will bounce up and down, left and right as you struggle over and over again to reach the next trial. do you have what it takes? can you beat iota?

There are no powerups. no special abilities. no boss fights. Just you. Your will. Your determination.

Features:
36 levels
soundtrack that bops
unique gameplay
no such thing as game over
challenge unlike any other

title: They Bleed Pixels [NSZ][ENG]
description:
在遊戲中，你將化身爲問題女子專門學校拉夫卡迪奥學院的一名匿名學生。你需要戰鬥到底，擊敗噩夢深處潛藏的詛咒——這個可怕的詛咒正在將你慢慢變成一隻利爪惡魔。
 
They Bleed Pixels 將快節奏、高技巧的平台遊戲玩法和激烈的一鍵砍殺戰鬥完美结合了起來。剋制自己瘋狂按鍵的衝動吧，專注於以巧妙的技巧完成富有風格的殺戮，你將會獲得檢查點作爲獎勵：你既可以選擇及時使用它們來確保順利通關，也可以將它們一直保留到關底，以換取額外的獎勵點數。
 
遊戲特色：
 
• 擇遊戲難度！既可以選擇原汁原味的高難度硬核模式，也可以體驗簡單的新手模式，關卡進行了一系列調整，以適應水平不一的各類玩家。
 
• 善假於物，利用環境對抗敵人！踢打，戳刺，將敵人推入利鋸與尖刺，來滿足追求高分的殺戮者。
 
• 以低清像素呈現出有機紙墨質感的紋理，美術風格令人矚目。
 
• 化身砍怪大師或是競速之王，刷新個人等級排名和線上排行，獲取150種技能徽章。
 
• 解鎖獎勵客邀關卡，以及來自全世界藝術家創作的漫畫和同人插圖。
 
• 傾聽由 DJ Finish Him（即 Shaun Hatton）創作的原聲電子音樂，使用合成器，非傳統樂器和一些通常不用於音樂的小道具演奏。

• 華麗的哥特式可愛風格動態漫畫，講述了一個年輕女孩被邪魔噩夢糾纏困擾的故事。

title: My Big Sister + Remastered [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Poznakomtes s Lutsiey, sarkastichnoy dvenadtsatiletney devochkoy s igrivym chuvstvom yumora. Esli verit tomu, chto ona govorit, My Big Sister — eto priklyuchencheskaya igra v zhanre RPG, syuzhet kotoroy ne o ney, a o ee sestre Sombrii.
My Big Sister — eto igra pro Lutsiyu i Sombriyu, dvukh sester, kotorye pytayutsya vernutsya domoy posle pokhishcheniya neznakomtsami, i Lutsiya vzvalivaet na svoi malenkie plechi etu neposilnuyu zadachu.
V mnogochislennykh glavakh etoy igry s vidom sverkhu igrokam predstoit razgadyvat golovolomki i nakhodit spetsialnye predmety, no speshit sovsem neobyazatelno. Pomogut li vam mnozhestvo sekretov i variantov finala vernut Lutsiyu i Sombriyu domoy tselymi i nevredimymi?Igru Ashina: The Red Witch sm. tam.

title: Abomi Nation [NSZ][ENG]
description:
超過175種怪怪魔可供挑選，組建屬於你自己的小隊，幫助他們不斷進化，並成為戰鬥大師！在這個遊戲中，每個人的隊伍都是獨一無二的。受Nuzlocke挑戰啓發，怪怪魔境被設計為一個極具重複可玩性，并可高度客制化的遊戲。

為怪怪魔境而戰！
體驗並掌握獨特的1對1回合制戰鬥系統，同時你還可以巧妙運用策略，讓後備的隊員還未加入戰鬥就能受到增益。你可以釋放如“煉獄火雨”或“山崩地裂”之類的強大技能來利用敵人的弱點，或是使用“演說！”技能來增益自己的隊友。

至死…方休？
每隻怪怪魔都可學習到海量技能。同時，怪怪魔還有著不同的屬性類型（普通、火、水、木、電、飛行以及陸地），好好運用策略，運用屬性間的相互剋制，贏得各種戰鬥。怪怪魔們愈漸文明開化，他們中的大多數已經忘記了野蠻的過去。但正當這和平之時，一股危機悄然升起，你的隊伍必須要重新找回自己的力量，並為守護怪怪魔境而戰。

如果怪怪魔在永久死亡的戰鬥中倒下，它將永遠離開！你需要不斷剋服，適應眼前的挑戰，保護小隊中盡可能多的怪怪魔成員。不過別擔心！如果你失去了所有怪怪魔，仍可付出一定獎勵為代價，在關閉永久死亡選項后繼續遊玩。盡力做到最好即可！

每一輪都有新的島嶼！
每一次全新的遊玩流程都會生成一個形狀獨特的島嶼供你的小隊深入探險，且其中包含許多不同的區域、Boss組合、甚至是完全不同的隊伍成員！重複可玩性是怪怪魔境的一大核心要素，你可以在任何時候，挑戰任意組合的怪怪魔。

每一次遊玩中的各種隨機因素，為怪怪魔境帶來了千奇百怪的隊伍配置。怪怪魔間有著不同的個性，並且會影響他們對同一事件的不同反應。隨著你冒險的不斷深入，兩個怪怪魔間的情誼會不斷加深，在其中一方陷入險境時，他們也會做出截然不同的反應。

隨著不斷的遊玩，你還會解鎖新的怪怪魔形態，新區域，以及全新道具。整個怪怪魔境都處在不斷的變化之中！

自訂你的遊戲！
通過微調遊戲設置，你的每一輪遊戲都是嶄新的體驗。按照自己的步調來體驗遊戲吧！想要挑戰等級完全隨機的怪怪魔嗎？想要自己決定誰來加入你的隊伍嗎？想要決定隊伍中的成員是否會在戰鬥中永久死亡嗎？你可以隨意改變遊戲的長度和遊玩方式，找到最適合你的體驗。

當然，怪怪魔境不僅僅只有戰鬥。與隊伍中的同伴一起品嚐美食、玩遊戲，在好客的小鎮中參與各種事件，能夠提升怪怪魔的能力數值，也能讓你徹底萌上他們。畢竟在生死抉擇的戰鬥之間，偶爾坐下來休息一下，也不是什麼壞事嘛。

招募外作的角色！
超過175種隨機出現的怪怪魔，其中還包含了來自獨立遊戲佳作Bug Fables: The Everlasting Sapling與Disc Creatures中的聯動角色！

你可以選擇最喜愛的怪怪魔抵禦來自Bug Fables的敵人與Boss，或是養一隻來自Disc Creatures的小番，拍拍它可愛的小腦袋！怪怪魔境永遠接納來自其他世界的一切事物。

title: 100animalease (100 Animal Ease) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
主角是一名虛弱的少女。
舞台是被混凝土牆包圍的神祕設施。

設施已經開始崩壞，為了生存只能選擇逃脫。
然而，設施中設有阻止逃脫的機關。
突破的關鍵在於設施內居住的100隻多樣化的動物們。

每隻動物都擁有特殊能力。
嗅覺敏銳的、視力出眾的、身形嬌小的、體型巨大的……
在牠們的幫助下，攻略機關會更加容易。

動物們充滿個性，也各自懷有煩惱與心願。
若想與牠們成為朋友，就必須傾聽並滿足牠們的要求。

有時候，動物會失控並展開攻擊。
只要用一桶水潑下，就能讓失控的動物恢復原狀。
在取得水之前，必須想辦法逃脫避免被抓住。

透過完成動物們的請求任務並與牠們建立友誼，
你將能借用牠們的能力。
逃離這座神祕設施，奪回屬於你的自由。

各種試煉正等待著你。

title: Dobby x Escape Spooky Adventure / Pirate Adventure [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
嗨，朋友們！

湯米長大想要當海盜！

在藍月亮的幫助下，再加上他的魔杖和他曾曾曾祖父的海盜帽，他的夢想成真了！

跟著湯米一起踏上精采萬分的冒險之旅，他會遇到傳奇說中的海盜，黑鬍子！

全員出發！

特徵：
• 充滿密室逃脫、解謎和冒險的遊戲！
• 完成六章！
• 精美的手繪圖案讓這款遊戲的畫面栩栩如生！
• 許多物品需要收集和解謎！
• 原創音效！

title: Beat Souls [NSZ][ENG]
description:
《Beat Souls》是一款音樂和激烈動作玩法互相碰撞所產生的高速節奏遊戲，您必須避開障礙物並收集靈魂，在挑戰最高分的途中累積酷炫的連擊！跳出驚艷眾人的舞步，來段炸翻全場的表演，擊敗節奏妖怪吧！繽紛可愛的動畫美學搭配霓虹賽博龐克風格，融合出《Beat Souls》獨特的視覺效果，而律動感十足的音樂則能讓您百玩不厭！

掌握躲避與跳躍的優雅舞步以避開障礙物，同時移動您的「僕從」夥伴來收集靈魂。但小心了！碰撞到「噪音」將打斷您的律動、重置連擊並消耗體力。如果體力耗盡遊戲就結束了。化身為傳說中能透過舞蹈與妖怪溝通的神社少女 Mikoto，在超過 30 道可調整難度的關卡中戰鬥吧！您具備戰勝「噪音」的力量嗎？

特色：

• 隨著音樂節奏左右移動並收集靈魂！
• 避開噪音障礙物，持續累積連擊和「火熱槽」。
• 解鎖具備獨特技能的可用新角色！
• 每道關卡都能選擇符合自身風格的難度。
• 在「無限地獄模式」中將技巧磨練到極致！

title: Grimshade [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
description:
Grimshade tells the story of the company of heroes, by a twist of fate involved in the cycle of events unfolding in the world of Ree'fah. Numerous dreadful monsters infested the forest around the city of Brann and high walls could no longer protect residents from the attacks. The menacing army of the neighbouring kingdom suddenly landed on the outskirts of the city, wreaking havoc. There is no hope for salvation — the strength of the defenders is running low, but the King and his loyal Champions had vanished.

Lead the group of the adventurers on a journey and explore a varied and intricate world, meet new characters and reveal plot-related secrets. Remember, beauty is deceptive — danger lurks everywhere. Test your skills in challenging turn-based battles, adjusting your combat tactics and optimal team combinations for each foe you met on the way.

Key Features:
- Seven memorable characters, including Kiba, the dark child, Charlie, the talking sniper badger, Alister, the brave guy with an Ether gauntlet, and Ruby, the princess of the thieves. Each of them has their role (sometimes more than one) on the battlefield and their own mission on a big journey.

- The character development system is based on equipment: each piece of armour, weapon or accessory gives a unique skill to a particular hero, expanding their range of attack types and defensive boosts. Find, trade for, or craft new equipment to improve your characters and make them versatile and adaptable.

- Complex tactical turn-based battles: a variety of elaborate enemies won't let you complete the whole game using a single tactic or invincible team build. Choose wisely the squad you take in a fight — proper positioning and awareness are essential to your success struggling against powerful foes.

- The vivid and diverse world of Ree'fah: immerse yourself in the hand-painted fantasy universe of Grimshade and discover an impressive history in more than 20 hours of an exciting journey.

title: Quintuplets, The Slipperyslabs, Pigs in Clover, The Queen Mary i dr. (The Original Mobile Games, Perplexus / Superplexus / perpleksus) [NSP][ENG]
description:
Igrali li vy kogda-nibud v ruchnuyu sovetskuyu igru-labirint s malenkim metallicheskim sharikom vnutri (perpleksus), kotoryy bylo neobkhodimo provesti iz odnoy tochki v druguyu?..
Eta kollektsiya peredayot vsyu ~149-letnyuyu istoriyu podobnykh igr, nachinaya s 1870-kh — v ruki entuziastov!
V sbornike predstavleny polnostyu simulirovannye tsifrovye reproduktsii istoricheskikh realnykh igr i golovolomok na lovkost, dopolnennye originalnymi risunkami, fotografiyami i spravochnoy informatsiey dlya kazhdoy igrushki iz arkhivov «The Strong National Museum of Play», nakhodyashchimsya v gorode Rochestere, shtat Nyu-York, SShA.

title: Perils of Baking / Super Perils of Baking [NSZ][ENG]
description:
在 Super Perils of Baking 中，玩家控制了一位才華橫溢的學生麵包師，他的目標只有一個：阻止他的兄弟——被他們學校地下室裡的一頂被詛咒的烘焙帽迷住了——在這片土地上肆虐。

Super Perils of Baking 完全以詩歌形式寫成，帶有故事書般的演示文稿，跨越 50 個核心關卡，也包含大量秘密。簡潔的 2D 平台、平衡的難度、精美的像素藝術、有趣的配樂和大量可供解鎖的內容（包括新的可玩角色）。 Lillymo 的最新產品是為年輕和年長的觀眾製作的（對於成年人和他們的孩子一起玩特別可愛）。

無論是步行、在礦車中飛馳、在水下游泳、抓住氣球，還是改變重力並完全顛倒過來，Super Perils of Baking 對每個人來說都是一場食物大戰……真正的麵包師會找到大量的收藏品讓他們也忙於冒險。

title: Makis Adventure [NSZ][ENG]
description:
扮演 Maki ，探索充滿獨特島嶼的世界，結識新朋友，運用三種不同的鯊魚形態在水中自由穿梭。《Maki's Adventure》是一款 橫向捲軸動作平台遊戲 ，讓你自由決定如何應對各種挑戰。無論你喜愛戰鬥還是專注探索，都能找到豐富的內容來塑造你的遊戲風格。

奔跑、 跳躍 、 游泳和撕咬 ，闖過危機四伏的地牢，利用鯊魚的速度衝刺關卡，在絢麗的 2D 像素藝術風格下戰勝迷你首領和大魔王。然後，在 3D 中心世界乘風飛越未開拓的島嶼，挑戰環形迷你遊戲 ，發掘更多驚喜！

• 探索未知且充滿危機的島嶼，化身人類或鯊魚！
• 奔跑、跳躍、游泳、撕咬，挑戰橫向捲軸關卡！
• 暢遊未知島嶼的中心世界，體驗 3D 遊戲體驗！
• 專注戰鬥或探索，由你決定！
• 挑戰迷你遊戲，尋找隱藏寶藏，甚至享受悠閒的釣魚時光！

title: Shuyan Saga [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
走進動作冒險遊戲《書雁傳奇》，在中式古文化結合武術力量的世界，體驗引人入勝的敘事和精美的畫面。你將化身為決心當功夫高手的書雁公主，親手阻止邪惡古爾軍摧毀神州五國，譜寫出榮譽、勇氣、自我探索的精彩故事。

主要特色:

流暢的武打動作
在以技能為核心的對戰中解放你的武打魂。遊戲中多種戰鬥風格各有專屬的招式和機制，等著你逐一探索及駕馭。攻擊剛柔並濟，施展出勢不可當的組合技，並搭配運用強大的特殊能力。超過300種武打動畫採動作捕捉技術製成，以楊龍飛大師的身法為原型，呈現出道地又暢快的戰鬥場面。

精美視覺與美術
走進手繪風格的迷人世界。知名漫畫家大雄手繪超過1,400種精美場景，構築出栩栩如生的世界。他曾參與黑馬出版社的《星球大戰》系列漫畫及DC的《正義聯盟》系列漫畫，從其作品可以看出他既講究細節，又擅於呈現色彩鮮明的美學，以獨特魅力風靡無數人。

互動性的漫畫敘事
創新的漫畫風敘事帶你體驗劇情。置身精美手繪場景的你要在對話中做出抉擇，進而決定故事的發展。在這個以古代為設計靈感的奇幻世界中，你將一邊解開謎團，一邊掌握敘事走向。

動聽的配樂
遊戲中美妙的原聲帶由獲獎作曲家Aaron Tsang製作，讓你一秒置身充滿驚奇和冒險的世界。配樂和遊戲相輔相成，為劇情的起承轉合注入更多情感渲染力。

Kristin Kreuk配音
知名配音員Kristin Kreuk（知名作品有《超人前傳》、《美女與野獸》等影集）首度參與電玩遊戲配音，便成為一段讓人難忘的經歷，使主角書雁變得栩栩如生。你將在生動配音的相伴下，展開身歷其境的旅程。

獨特的功夫玩法
在「單打模式」和「群打模式」中，探索剛與柔兩種功夫風格，感受武打的層次與變化。團隊運用了超過300種武打動畫呈現動態戰鬥場面，一展山西螳螂拳的道地身手。

title: Fall of Light Darkest Edition [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Fall of Light — eto rolevoy boevik v mire, pogloshchennom tmoy. Vy — Nikt, pozhiloy voin, kotoryy otpravilsya v opasnoe puteshestvie vmeste so svoey docheryu Efiroy. Ona — Siyayushchiy rebenok, izluchayushchiy svet, i tolko vmeste geroi smogut dobratsya do poslednego mesta na zemle, gde eshche est solnechnyy svet. 

Osobennosti
•	20 boevykh stoek
•	10 klassov oruzhiya
•	Novoe podzemele v Darkest Edition
•	Svet Efiry delaet vas silnee! 
•	Ishchite sekrety i uznavayte istoriyu mira

title: Mushroom Wars 2 [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Mushroom Wars 2 – eto otmechennoe nagradami prodolzhenie izvestnoy strategii v realnom vremeni. Za osnovu vzyat originalnyy geympley Mushroom Wars, kotoryy tak polyubilsya igrokam. 

SYuZhETNAYa KAMPANIYa
Bolee 100 missiy i bitvy s bossami.

ONLAYN MULTIPLEER
Reytingovye matchi i igry s druzyami v raznykh sorevnovatelnykh rezhimakh do 4 igrokov, vklyuchaya 2 na 2.

- 12 geroev, 4 plemeni, kazhdoe s unikalnymi sposobnostyami.
- Korotkie i masshtabnye boi, do 4000 voinov na pole bitvy.
- Prostoy, no glubokiy geympley, massa taktik i masterskikh tryukov.
- Mnozhestvo variantov kart, interaktivnye obekty, kotorye kardinalno vliyayut na khod srazheniya.

Ovladet azami iskusstva gribnoy voyny prosto, blagodarya udobnomu i intuitivnomu upravleniyu i podderzhke geympada. Odnako put stanovleniya besstrashnogo voenachalnika trebuet mnogikh umeniy: bystroty reaktsii, strategicheskogo myshleniya i sposobnosti upravlyat tysyachami voinov odnovremenno!

Kogda osvoites, mozhno smelo otpravlyat svoyu armiyu protiv drugikh igrokov v multipleere. V Mushroom Wars 2 provodyatsya turniry, est sistema lig i reytingovye boi dlya neshutochnykh srazheniy. V «Svoey igre» mozhno oprobovat novye strategii s druzyami: 4 uchastnika mogut srazhatsya v rezhime «kazhdyy sam za sebya» ili v komandnykh matchakh. 

Srazhaetes li vy s ordami vragov v odnopolzovatelskoy kampanii ili sorevnuetes s druzyami za zvanie luchshego stratega v raznykh rezhimakh multipleera, Mushroom Wars 2 – eto vsegda nasyshchennye vysokoskorostnye i zakhvatyvayushchie bitvy!

title: Sword and Sandals Spartacus [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
You are Spartacus, the gladiator who defied the corrupt tyrants of Rome!

One man who broke free from a brutal gladiator arena. One man who took on the most powerful legions in Ancient Rome. This is the story of the legendary ... SPARTACUS!

Now for the first time, take up the sword of the greatest gladiator ever and do battle with Rome yourself in this thrilling action combat platformer. From the dark dungeons under the Arena of Capua to the heights of Mt Vesuvius and beyond, you will battle brutal slave drivers, grizzled legionnaires and mighty centurions as you free the slaves of Rome.

- Huge action packed levels filled with challenging retro combat platforming. Fighting, fencing, zip lining, traps beyond belief. Spartacus will test you!
- A rich and detailed adventure across Ancient Rome and beyond. Climb mountains, explore brooding castles and dark mines on your great quest!
- Collect fabulous treasures and spend them on upgrading your weapons, shield and powers!
- Simple and intuitive combat. Block with your shield, throw javelins, unleash the power of your sword arm on your hapless foes.
- Beautiful retro pixel art straight out of a 1980s arcade cabinet. Moonlit nights come alive, trackless forests sway in the wind, demons saunter between worlds.
- Fight dozens of different enemy types from roman soldiers and rabid dogs to the demons of the underworld and even the gods themselves!
- No metroidvania gimmickry, no backtracking, no grinding. Just one man, his sword and a legion of Romans standing in his way.
- Test your mettle on permadeath mode for even more challenge!

title: Mechs v Kaijus Tower Defense [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
In Mechs V Kaijus you take on the role of the commander of a powerful Mechs squadron. Jump your mechs out of the Defense wall and control them on the battlefield. Strategically place towers and traps on the battlefield in tactical mode to create an impenetrable defense. Use powerful skills and deploy support units and create huge armies with Factories.

Features
- The best hardcore tower defense experience.
- A unique combination of MOBA, tower defense and shooter mechanics.
- Upgrade your mech with many different power-ups.
- A big battlefield created with amazing pixel-art.

title: Fallen Angel [NSP][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Vy — padshiy angel, i vam predstoit pobedit nebesnye armii, srazhayas s nimi vo mnozhestve strannykh mirov. Vy budete bluzhdat po ruinam, zelenym lugam, kiberpankovym nochnym klubam i drugim strannym mestam.
U odnikh budut krylya, u drugikh — shchupaltsa, u tretikh — mnozhestvo glaz. Chego u nikh ne budet, tak eto rozovykh shchyochek i sladkozvuchnykh arf. Rolevoy 2D-boevik s vidom sverkhu, dinamichnymi strategicheskimi bitvami, predmetami i oruzhiem, kotorye sootvetstvuyut miru, i interesnoy sistemoy razvitiya personazha, podoydet imenno vashemu stilyu boya.
Deystvie razvorachivaetsya v rayu — raznoobraznykh i strannykh mirakh, vdokhnovlennom apokrifami i modernistskim stilem. Lyutsifer budet prorubatsya ne tolko cherez zhemchuzhnye vrata i sonmy angelov, no i puteshestvovat cherez strannye tekhnologichnye konstruktsii, idillicheskie zemnye doliny, paryashchie ostrova i mnogoe drugoe. Kazhdyy arkhangel vliyaet na mir, v kotorom zhivet, i vsekh sushchestv v etom mire.

title: Kaiju Wars [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Razygrayte film o kaydzyu v roli mera goroda Floatio, kotoromu porucheno sderzhivat podavlyayushchuyu silu ataki kaydzyu s pomoshchyu (beznadezhno) prevoskhodyashchikh vooruzhennykh sil. Zashchitite svoy gorod, poka pyat unikalnykh i razrushitelnykh kaydzyu nabirayut silu s kazhdoy atakoy. K sozhaleniyu, oni nelzya ubit, no mozhno zamedlit i zastavit otstupit... poka.

Monstry dvizhutsya k blizhayshemu zdaniyu, i uchenye rasschitali tochnye shansy togo, kuda oni mogut poyti dalshe. Stroyte zhertvennye armeyskie bazy i aerodromy, chtoby otvlekat kaydzyu. Esli standartnykh metodov nedostatochno, razvernite eksperimentalnoe oruzhie, takoe kak zamorazhivayushchie luchi i transformiruyushchie mekhanizmy, chtoby derzhat ikh v strakhe. Ili vy vsegda mozhete postavit tanki i reaktivnye samolety na puti monstrov, chtoby zamedlit ikh (ne volnuytes, u nas est khoroshiy strakhovoy polis). Esli vse vashi usiliya poterpyat neudachu, ne stydites i begite! Budte gotovy evakuirovat laboratoriyu, ispolzuya transportnye sredstva, lodki ili samolety, kogda kaydzyu podberutsya slishkom blizko.

Vypolnyayte zadaniya so vsego mira, srazhayas s Kaydzyu v bolee chem 15-chasovoy syuzhetnoy kampanii. Na protyazhenii vsey kampanii u vas budet vozmozhnost poluchit preimushchestvo s pomoshchyu uluchshaemykh boevykh edinits ACE i personalizirovannoy kolody proekta. Proverte svoyu smekalku v takticheskikh golovolomkakh, komanduyte desyatkami yunitov v krupnomasshtabnykh stsenariyakh i otrazhayte neodnokratnye ataki v oboronitelnykh missiyakh, odnovremenno razvivaya svoy gorod ekonomicheski. A esli vam khochetsya bolshego, proverte svoi komandnye navyki v ezhenedelnykh ispytaniyakh!

Zashchitite svoy gorod v takticheskom srazhenii s pomoshchyu pushechnykh tankov, reaktivnykh samoletov i mnogogo drugogo... neobychaynoy ognevoy moshchi.
Srazites s pyatyu raznymi kaydzyu, kazhdyy iz kotorykh obladaet unikalnymi navykami i potentsialom mutatsii.
naslazhdaytes igrovym protsessom, osnovannym na povestvovanii, s mnozhestvom dialogov mezhdu istoricheskimi personazhami na protyazhenii kazhdoy operatsii.
Delayte vse, chtoby ostanovit monstrov, v tom chisle zhertvuyte svoimi yunitami i zdaniyami.

title: Redo [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
REDO!  – eto mrachnaya, navevayushchaya odinochestvo metroidvaniya. 
REDO! rasskazyvaet istoriyu devushki, kotoraya pytaetsya ponyat, chto ostalos v distopicheskom mire, upravlyaemom biorobotami. 
Zagadochnaya istoriya igry proiskhodit v temnom umirayushchem gorode, gde vse vzaimosvyazano, a povestvovanie predstavleno v nelineynom i otkrytom formate. 
Srazheniya trebuyut metodichnosti: chtoby odolet silneyshikh protivnikov, igroku prikhoditsya iskat sposoby sdelat ikh menee opasnymi i bolee uyazvimymi, ne zabyvaya pri etom yarostno bitsya, chtoby kak mozhno skoree ischerpat ikh zdorove. 
Chtoby vyzhit posle padeniya chelovecheskoy tsivilizatsii, igroku dostupny razlichnye predmety i oruzhie: ot energeticheskikh klinkov i politseyskikh shchitov do raketnykh puskovykh ustanovok. 
Izoshchrennye bioroboty, naselyayushchie odinokiy mir igry REDO!, mogut vydykhat ogon, elektrizovat vozdukh i plevatsya plazmoy. Chtoby vyzhit, vam prigoditsya kazhdyy dostupnyy predmet i instrument.

Osnovnye kharakteristiki:
    Glubokiy i tainstvennyy mir, kotoryy ostavili posle sebya poslednie predstaviteli chelovechestva
    Raznoobrazie oruzhiya i predmetov, dlya kazhdogo iz kotorykh naydetsya svoe primenenie
    Ogromnyy megapolis bez granits i umirayushchiy mir, kotoryy mozhno issledovat
    Bolshe dyuzhiny vidov uzhasayushchikh i izoshchrennykh protivnikov
    Brutalnyy geympley v stile metroidvanii v Dark Souls, kotoryy podcherkivaet balans smertnosti i vynoslivosti
    7-12 igrovykh chasov

title: Words of Wisdom [NSP][RUS/ENG]
description:
詩意、哲學和具有挑戰性的平台遊戲？ 這一切都與《Words of Wisdow》有關，它是硬核平台遊戲與文本謎語和謎題的創新融合。 為了掌握這款遊戲，玩家必須同時運用智慧和手指，在致命的小丑、消失的平台和隱藏的致命尖刺中生存下來。

我們機智的英雄的 2D 像素冒險將需要你所擁有的一切來度過各種謎題和挑戰。 這個遊戲隨著每個完成的房間和任務而成長 - 而且它們也有很多！ 如果您正在尋找對舊貨的懷舊之情，那就別再猶豫了。 智慧之言將幫助您體驗任何好難題的兩面：物理方面和哲學方面。 你準備好挑戰我們的遊戲了嗎？

title: Runout [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
RUNOUT – dinamichnyy ranner-platformer s logicheskimi zagadkami v settinge budushchego. 

Igrok vsegda bezhit, no pri stolknovenii s kakoy-libo pregradoy on razvorachivaetsya v protivopolozhnuyu storonu. Emu predstoit vovremya prygat, strelyat, uskoryatsya i zamedlyat vremya, chtoby proyti uroven.

Na servera korporatsii 'MFS', vypuskayushchey ekzoskelety, sovershena khakerskaya ataka. Bolshinstvo nositeley ekzoskeletov pogibli. Sleduya syuzhetu zakhvatyvayushchey istorii, naydite vinovnika zloveshchego zagovora i, v konechnom schete, spasite mir.


Kharakteristiki:
* Lokalnyy kooperativnyy rezhim dlya odnogo i dvukh igrokov
* Razlichnye razblokiruemye personazhi
* Dve trudnosti: vyberite napravlenie dlya bega ili povorachivayte tolko togda, kogda natknetes na stenu
* Reshayte platformennye golovolomki vo vremya bega
* Nakhodite i ispolzuyte razlichnye sposobnosti (strelba, uskorenie, zamedlenie vremeni)
* Zakhvatyvayushchie animatsionnye zastavki
* Vizualnaya estetika kiberpanka
* Saundtrek v stile sintveyv

title: Tetragon [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
歡迎來到四方世界，這個遼闊的神秘宇宙蘊含了各種特別的遊戲機制、謎題、魔法迷宮與挑戰！如果你喜歡類似《The Room》、《The Witness》和《塔羅斯的法則》的遊戲，就一定不要錯過這一款作品。

你的目標是利用世界旋轉的重力，移動平面。動用四方靈石的魔力，移動地面和建築，讓勇敢的伐木工盧修斯走過一個又一個破碎的世界，找到自己迷路的兒子！

《四方世界》簡介
平行宇宙的某個地方有一個世界，完全由平面構成。這些平面漂浮在四方靈石周圍。自誕生以來，這個世界就是一片繁榮，原本沒有一絲一毫的邪惡……只是後來憑空長出了一股神秘的黑暗能量。過了一陣子，這股能量變成了非常奇怪的造物，企圖摧毀四方靈石，令四方世界陷入混亂！這個造物最終得逞了，四方靈石支離破碎。四方之念動用了所有力量，才將這個黑暗造物囚禁了起來，可惜為時已晚。如今，必須要有勇者找到四方靈石的碎片，才能拯救這個破碎的世界……

你要破解一道又一道謎題，才能逐漸實現你的目標。
 
 你擁有了四方靈石的力量之後，可以改換平面和建築的位置，可以搭造平台和樓梯，甚至可以旋轉世界！

遊戲特色
• 數百個謎題、迷宮和挑戰，需要旋轉世界、移動建築才能破解或完成。開闢你的道路，走進這個迷宮世界的深處！
 
• 獨特的遊戲機制，即便是解謎遊戲老手，也有可能一籌莫展！
 
• 40多個關卡，組成了三個魔法世界。越是深入其中，就越能碰到更難、更有意思的謎題！
 
• 戰鬥場面宏大，父親尋子的故事暖人心扉。盧修斯需要克服所有挑戰，勇面危險而又強大的敵人，最終才能找到他的兒子傑里，才能拯救四方世界的宇宙！

title: SolSeraph [NSP][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 俄语 lyubitelskiy 来自 djonmarvel
description:
Zashchiti chelovechestvo i reshi sudbu tsivilizatsii.  Stroy goroda i oboronitelnye sooruzheniya, chtoby zashchititsya ot neustanno atakuyushchikh monstrov, a zatem spustis v ikh logova s mechom i parochkoy zaklinaniy za pazukhoy, chtoby pokonchit s nimi raz i navsegda. Issleduy paryashchie ostrova, drevnie peshchery i zabroshennye goroda. Mir u tvoikh nog!

SolSeraph ot ACE Team, avtorov Rock of Ages i Zeno Clash, sochetaet ekshn i strategiyu v nasyshchennom unikalnom geymplee, napominayushchem o 16-bitnoy ere.

title: Wartile Complete edition [NSP][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 俄语, 移植版 djonmarvel
description:
Predstavlyaem vam zhivuyu i dyshashchuyu nastolnuyu videoigru. V ney igrok popadaet v miniatyurnuyu vselennuyu, napolnennuyu malenkimi priklyucheniyami, prokhodyashchimi na detalizirovannykh dioramnykh polyakh boya, sozdannykh na osnove skandinavskoy mifologii vo slavu vikingov!

Igra Wartile osnovana na vosstanovlenii khodov, v ney ne prekrashchayutsya deystviya i u vas est mnozhestvo vozmozhnostey planirovat svoi khody. Khotya v igre imeyutsya strategicheskie elementy poshagovykh igr, ee smes zamedlennykh deystviy i vosstanovleniya khodov postoyanno podderzhivayut napryazhenie bitvy i dayut vam vozmozhnost podumat i prinyat takticheskie resheniya. A v tsentre igry Wartile — pravilnoe razmeshchenie i takticheskie resheniya.

title: Draw Chilly [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
DRAW CHILLY  - chertovski arkadnaya igra, gde ty v roli Vladimira vytyagivaesh gorod so dna Chistilishcha, vypolnyaya poruchenie svoikh rabotodateley - Vsadnikov Apokalipsisa.

Otryad glupykh, no smelykh i chistykh serdtsem mekhanikov, vo glave s Vladimirom srazhaetsya s obezyanami, proryvayas vverkh po etazham, chtoby vernut iz Chistilishcha oshibochno popavshikh syuda klientov - bossov - obratno k Zhnetsam dlya ikh vernogo raspredeleniya v Ad.

Uluchshaya gorod, usilivaya otryad i Vladimira, ty uznaesh chasti istorii kazhdogo iz glavnykh protivnikov, uvidish stseny iz proshlogo Vladimira i poznakomishsya s Vsadnikami, kotorye v nashey Vselennoy dobry i obladayut chuvstvom yumora.

Eta pikselnaya arkadnaya 2d igra predostavit tebe vozmozhnost ochen mnogo begat vlevo i vpravo, no u igry est i drugie, bolee znachimye, osobennosti.

- Sobiraya tsyplyat i vyrabatyvaya energiyu osobym nezhestokim sposobom, ty uluchshaesh gorod i otkryvaesh umeniya. Gorod predostavlyaet tebe pomoshchnikov v vide NPC i chlenov otryada, a umeniya pozvolyayut Vladimiru effektno raspravlyatsya s protivnikami. Naprimer, mozhno vyzvat rozovogo chervya, zamedlit protivnikov, a zatem udarit po nim ogromnym gaechnym klyuchom.
- Poluchaya za kazhdyy proydennyy etazh VladKoiny, ty dopolnitelno prokachivaesh umeniya i navyki samogo Vladimira, usilivaya ego.
- Gruznye tsyplyata s yashchikami dostavyat tebe tem bolshe novykh umeniy, tem bystree ty podnimaesh gorod i nagonyaesh ikh v beskonechnom kolodtse, v kotorom proiskhodit deystvie.
- Vsadniki Apokalipsisa ne tolko pomogayut v bitve, kogda ty prizyvaesh ikh posle polnoy zaryadki Magnita, no i prepodnosyat Dary Vsadnikov - osobye usileniya, svyazannye s bossami.

title: Gav-Gav Odyssey [NSP][RUS/ENG]
description:
Gav-Gav Odyssey 是從過去的遊戲中獲得爆炸的另一種方式！ 該遊戲融合了黃金時代遊戲的最佳元素：平台、滾動射擊和謎題。 可愛的小狗作為關鍵英雄與具有挑戰性的益智技巧相結合，可以在很長一段時間內吸引您的興趣。 這個設定看起來很真實，甚至有人會認為這個遊戲是在 20 或 30 年前在 8 位或 16 位平台上發布的！ 漂亮的像素藝術圖形、友好的遊戲玩法和有趣的過場動畫能夠吸引孩子和成年人，尤其是那些仍然記得 80 和 90 年代最好的平台遊戲的人！

主要特點：

- 詳細而多彩的像素藝術方法
- 漂亮的犬類情節，需要你拯救你的小狗朋友
- 兩種類型的遊戲：滾動射擊和益智平台
- 豐富的秘密、彩蛋和文化參考

title: Henosis [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
凝聚之水是一款2D橫版懸疑解謎遊戲, 玩家將在一個奇特的世界中控制一個小小的黏性水滴, 克服各個關卡中的障礙物和敵人.

玩家必須在每個世界中展開冒險, 收集珍貴的水之徽章並打開傳送門, 讓飽受乾旱困擾的家園再度恢復活力.

特徵:
+ 體驗27個精心製作的關卡
+ 獨特的玩家機制
+ 在3個不同的世界中與險惡的首領對戰
+ 原創藝術集&動畫
+ 全面的控制器支持
+ 本地化支持

title: Super Magbot [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
description:
Magnetia 星系正面臨重大危機，因為有個邪惡的壞蛋正在星系中大肆破壞。拯救世界的重責大任落在一名機器探險者的身上，那就是 Magbot！

超磁機甲擁有操控正 (紅) 負 (藍) 磁極的能力，他必須通過無數困難重重的平台關卡，才能讓他的母星 MagTek 脫離險境。

異性相吸：運用磁吸引力把自己拉向平台，並跨越危險的陷阱。

同性相斥：Magbot 的身軀很沉重，所以無法跳躍！但是您可以運用相斥的磁力讓自己飛越空中！	

收集恆星碎片：藉由收集難以取得的恆星碎片征服每一個關卡，並解鎖額外挑戰。
享受經典遊戲氛圍：色彩鮮明的 16 位元像素藝術，搭配 Moonsailor 充滿活力的晶片音樂配樂。

title: Ravva and the Cyclops Curse / the Phantom Library [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
扮演年輕的召喚師學徒 Ravva，召喚最多 4 名獨特的夥伴來陪伴你逃離噩夢般的 Phantom Library！在這款復古的橫向卷軸平台遊戲裡，你可以隨著自己的喜好選擇冒險的順序，進入鬧鬼的書中世界，擊敗每本書的書主，才能見到控制著圖書館的幕後黑手。你也可以重新進入已破關的書本中，不只是單純打敗魔王，而是找出新的秘密後再破關，便有機會解鎖只為最用心的召喚師而準備的特殊結局！

《Ravva and the Phantom Library》受 8 位元經典遊戲啟發，結合了巧妙的關卡設計、生動的像素風格和精準的操作系統，在帶來全新體驗的同時，也向那些經典作品致敬。在 7 個充滿挑戰性的關卡中，你可以體驗到討喜的角色、流暢的動畫和考驗腦力的難題！從 3 個難度中選擇最適合你的遊戲體驗。

特色：

• 扮演小小召喚師－－貓頭鷹 Ravva，享受復古的橫向卷軸動作遊戲！
• 運用 4 位夥伴獨特的天賦來克服阻礙、擊敗敵人。
• 進入鬧鬼的書本，在不同的主題中探索具挑戰性的關卡！
• 在流暢的像素世界中擊敗巨型的魔王。
• 重新遊玩已破關的書中世界來發掘秘密，也許還能解鎖特殊結局！

title: Eyra the Crow Maiden [NSZ][RUS/Multi13]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 13]
description: 在《艾拉：烏鴉少女》中，以艾拉為主人公，她是科魯哈魯斯部落的年輕祭司！這是一款迷人的8位元獨立遊戲，結合了探索和動作平台元素。加入艾拉和她忠實的烏鴉伙伴努卡馬，一同踏上危險的任務，拯救他們部落被邪惡的地獄劫掠者擄走的勇士。

title: Mixx Island Remix Plus + 5 DLC [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
與強大的老闆進行一系列史詩般的戰鬥。 解鎖新的能力和能量提升，成為終極戰士。 躲避一連串的激光束和爆炸，確保你是最後一個站著的人。

混音島：混編音樂加分 擁有充滿活力的畫面、震撼人心的配樂和直觀的控制，是一款容易上手但難以放下的遊戲。

無論您是經驗豐富的遊戲玩家還是橫向捲軸遊戲世界的新手，您都會在這場驚心動魄的冒險中找到許多值得喜愛的地方。

主要特徵：

- 二維世界
- 高動作遊戲
- 獎勵遊戲循環
- 可愛的角色
- 驚人的配樂
- 動漫風格的審美

title: Battle of Kings [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
SYuZhET

Mnogo let nazad zemli chetyrekh ostrovov byli razdeleny na dva korolevstva. Odno iz nikh bylo peredano vam, a drugoe vashemu kuzenu Markusu. S tekh por lyudi vashego korolevstva zhili mirnoy i protsvetayushchey zhiznyu pod vashim pravleniem. No eti dni kanuli v letu, kogda vash zhadnyy kuzen obedinilsya s temnym koldunom Arfaelem i sobralsya zakhvatit zemli, kotorye prinadlezhat vam po pravu. Vam nuzhno otrazit ataki, napravlennye protiv vsekh vashikh strategicheskikh forpostov, i sokrushit Markusa v finalnoy bitve.

OSOBENNOSTI IGRY

•7 tipov bashen razlichnogo strategicheskogo naznacheniya, kazhdaya iz kotorykh imeet 3 urovnya uluchsheniy.

•8 tipov yunitov (soldaty, boevye mashiny) s 4 urovnyami uluchsheniy u kazhdogo

•4 raznykh – ot lesa i pustyni do snezhnykh kholmov i lavovykh gor – tem okruzheniya i lokatsiy, kotorye sozdadut mnozhestvo vyigryshnykh strategiy

•Rezhim odinochnoy kampanii (PvE), v kotorom vy igraete v klassicheskuyu igru v zhanre bashennoy zashchity i uchastvuete v nekotorykh klyuchevykh srazheniyakh 1 na 1 s korolem vrazhdebnogo korolevstva (II)

•Rezhim srazheniy (PvE ili PvP), gde vy dolzhny:
→zashchishchat svoe korolevstvo
→atakovat protivnika
→razvivat ekonomiku
→improvizirovat, prisposablivatsya, preodolevat trudnosti i povtoryat vse vnov i vnov! (vse srazu!)

•Mnogopolzovatelskiy rezhim PvP-srazheniy, v kotorom vy smozhete proverit i uluchshit svoi strategicheskie navyki, srazhayas s druzyami ili drugimi igrokami.

•Igrayte tak, kak nravitsya! 3 udobnykh igrovykh rezhima: nastolnyy rezhim, portativnyy rezhim i rezhim TV

Vozvodite steny, uluchshayte bashni, treniruyte armiyu i budte khoroshim pravitelem korolevstva v Battle of Kings v eto klassicheskoy igre v zhanre bashennoy zashchity s primesyu srazheniy 1 na 1!

title: Lanota [NSP][ENG]
description:
Lanota offers a unique blend of dynamic music rhythm gameplay and storytelling, delivering a colorful narrative and enticing soundtrack in one package!

You perform over 70 tracks on a 360 degree circular field – your goal is to hit notes all around the ‘plate’, enabling you to both feel the beat and follow the musical flow. Tap, hold and slide to perform and achieve perfect combos and harmony!

There are multiple ways to tackle each track -  along with four difficulty settings you can choose to ‘Tune’ or ‘Purify’ songs. Purify ends your attempt if you miss too many notes, whereas Tune allows you to continue without that added pressure!

In addition to dynamic circular play areas and varied beats to hit, Lanota offers a distinctive narrative. The world has lost sound and color, and the task falls to our two heroes – Fisica and Ritmo – to revive ‘Notalium’ and bring music back to the world. Complete songs to unlock new story segments and undertake this vital task!

Features:
•	70+ tracks, including two new songs that are exclusive to the Nintendo Switch™
•	Utilise the touch screen for precise and dynamic controls
•	Varied songs and stage designs, including ‘boss’ tracks
•	Four difficulty settings and the choice of ‘Tune’ and ‘Purify’ modes
•	Complete the plot for a unique storybook experience
•	Plug in some headphones and enjoy a special musical experience

title: Firebird [NSZ][RUS/Multi3]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 3]
description:
To save a lost village in the Far North of Siberia, Mariska and Vassilissa embark on a road trip. They will come across myths and legends rooted in this area. Will you reach your destination without succumbing to the dangers inhabiting these hostile lands?

Choose your destinations

Your journey will lead you through different situations depending on the choices you make. You will meet twenty colorful characters such as Koschei and Baba Yaga. You can visit unexplored places from the map or discover the outcomes of other choices anytime by replaying the game!

Manage your resources during your journey

To progress smoothly in your adventure, you will need to oversee your gas level and amount of money. You can collect these resources at different steps during your trip. Your truck’s condition matters too: without your Firebird, it’s the end of the line!

Discover Slavic legends

Encounter legendary figures all over the map and admire them as you progress. This universe, hand-drawn by Quentin Vijoux and written by FibreTigre (Out There, Game of Rôles), unleashes the enchantment of Slavic culture.

title: Axis Football 2023 [NSZ][ENG]
description:

-Realizovano nyryanie, pryzhki i lovlya na bokovoy linii
