title: Sandream [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 机器翻译 来自 most2820
description: 這是一款RPG動作冒險遊戲，沙畫背景風格，逐步展示了艾拉的成長蛻變之旅。 在沙的世界裏她的記憶模糊不清。 她獨自一人面臨著重重困難，在眾多朋友的幫助下勇敢前行，不斷收集記憶碎片找回自我。 遊戲設計了諸多技能、裝備、加成陞級等操作，擁有複雜多樣的地形，需要不斷去探索收集，越過重重機關關卡，在收集完所有記憶後，挑戰强大的Boss。

title: Super Dodgeball Beats [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Primite uchastie v bezumno krutykh matchakh po vyshibalam v ritme 18 originalnykh muzykalnykh trekov. Pokorite sopernikov svoim idealnym ritmom i klevymi dvizheniyami. Veselee nekuda!
 
 MNOGOPOLZOVATELSKAYa IGRA: igrayte s druzyami i demonstriruyte svoi udivitelnye navyki na dele. Vam na vybor predlagaetsya 4 komandy, 8 velikolepnykh urovney i mnozhestvo muzykalnykh trekov na lyuboy vkus! Tochno rasschityvayte khody i gromite protivnikov!
 
 REZhIM ChEMPIONATA: stante luchshey komandoy galaktiki po vyshibalam v intensivnom odinochnom rezhime! Vasha komanda iz 4 yuniorov dolzhna proyti vse urovni i srazitsya s samymi raznoobraznymi protivnikami, ot groznykh vampirov-veteranov do zagadochnykh, pronizannykh gromom startsov. Chem dalshe vam udastsya proyti, tem strannee i moshchnee budut bossy na vashem puti!
 
 BEZUMYE PODPITKI: perelomite khod bitvy, ispolzuya mnozhestvo bonusov, vklyuchaya granaty, ponchiki, kamennye golemy i mnogoe drugoe.

title: The Spy Who Shot Me [NSZ][ENG]
description:
扮演超級間諜 Agent7！他將與邪惡的 S.C.U.M. 展開殊死搏鬥。

遊戲特色
-> 復古 FPS 風格的快速遊戲
-> 間諜/戲謔幽默
-> 與成群的敵人作戰
-> 獨特的跑酷與槍戰遊戲
-> 車輛行動
-> 武器改裝
-> 可愛的尖角多邊形

title: Story of Seasons: A Wonderful Life + 7 DLC [NSZ][ENG (Mod.)/JAP]
interface_lang: 日语 [JAP] + orig. MOD-anglofikator 来自 Marya
description:
Nezabyvaemaya istoriya o druzhbe, seme i selskom khozyaystve ozhivaet!.. Vasha novaya zhizn nachinaetsya v Zabytoy doline — tikhom gorodke, gde vash otets i ego drug Takakura kogda-to reshili zavesti fermu. Kogda vy podruzhites s zhitelyami doliny i poluchite nasledstvo, ostavsheesya ot ottsa, vy budete zhit bezzabotnoy zhiznyu na ferme, vyrashchivat urozhay i razvodit zhivotnykh. So vremenem vy naydete svoego lyubimogo cheloveka i budete vmeste vospityvat detey.
Kogda zhe vy peredelaete vsyu rabotu na ferme, to smozhete poyti na rybalku, otpravitsya na poiski drevnikh sokrovishch na mestakh raskopok ili poobshchatsya s mestnymi druzyami, chtoby sozdat priyatnye vospominaniya. A kogda proydut gody i vash rebenok stanet dostatochno vzroslym, chtoby vybrat sebe zanyatie po dushe... Unasleduet li on fermu ili naydet svoe prizvanie v chem-to drugom? Vremya pokazhet.
Etot rimeyk lyubimoy klassicheskoy igry vklyuchaet v sebya mnozhestvo novykh sobytiy, bolee yarkie prazdniki, dopolnitelnye retsepty i tseluyu goru nevidannykh zlakov i klubney. Razmyshlyaete, chem by eshche zanyatsya na ferme? Ustroyte fotosessiyu svoey seme s pomoshchyu fotorezhima, pereodentes v lyubimye naryady ili pomogite sosedyam reshit ikh problemy. I tekh, kto otpravilsya v pervoe puteshestvie v serii Story of Seasons, i tekh, kto v ocherednoy raz posetil Zabytuyu dolinu, zhdet chudesnaya zhizn..

title: Ultimate ADOM Caverns of Chaos [NSZ][ENG]
description:
體驗這款經過現代化改造的傳統roguelike地牢攻略經典作品。無盡的程序生成地牢，蜂擁而至的敵人，嫁接系統，製造系統，龐大的技能樹和物品讓遊戲有著無限的可重玩性。


深厚的背景故事 

邪惡已被擊敗，安卡蒂亞重獲和平，人們再次燃起了發展的熱情。七個各具特色的派系爭奪著這片被安多·德拉克的遺災蹂躪過的土地。而在某個邪惡的黑暗洞窟深處，混沌正蠢蠢欲動... 

拿起你的寶劍，準備你的法術，磨礪你的匕首，拉緊你的長弓，因為你即將踏入不祥的混沌洞窟。小心選擇你的派系，因為你不過是他們諸多手下中的一員。

不論是為榮耀和財富而戰，為愈發凋零的正義而戰，還是為光明，純潔，甚至是混沌而戰，你的每個選擇都將在混沌洞窟改變歷史。


經典ROGUELIKE加上現代功能 

無盡的程序生成地牢，蜂擁而至的敵人，龐大的技能樹和物品讓遊戲有著無限的可重玩性。


可互動環境！推翻火盆，打開棺材，砸爛大門或者把它變成傀儡來為你服務。


現代畫面模式和經典ASCII畫面模式供您選擇。

本能式操作系統讓你不再需要記憶上百個繁瑣的按鍵操作。當然，我們也為想要這麼做的玩家保留了這個功能。

首屈一指的複雜度和內容深度 

職業，性別，種族和派係都將改變遊戲方式和挑戰。 NPC將對你產生不同的態度，根據你的選擇將解鎖不同的任務。

深邃的魔法系統，有著獨一無二的魔法派系和超過一百種可選魔法 – 從召喚惡魔到活化地牢牆壁應有盡有，發揮你的想像力吧！

 超過八十個技能樹和許多隱藏技能樹等待著你的解鎖。
 

潛行系統為遊戲開啟了全新可能：不再踢門殺戮，而是遁影避戰，攻敵不備！

將敵人的肢體嫁接到自己身上，變成超級生化怪物。比拿兩把劍更厲害的是什麼？拿六把劍！

※本遊戲不支持繁體中文

title: Big Crown Showdown [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Big Crown: Showdown — eto igra, v kotoroy druzya stanovyatsya vragami, boryas mezhdu soboy za koronu v lokalnom (do 4-kh igrokov) i setevom mnogopolzovatelskom boyu. Deystvie razvorachivaetsya v trekh strannykh mirakh, polnykh srednevekovykh priklyucheniy. Izbegayte popadaniya v opasnye situatsii ili vvyazyvaytes v ozhestochennye boi, pytayas sbit protivnikov s kursa na 15 bezumnykh marshrutakh etoy neveroyatnoy korolevskoy bitvy!

OSNOVNYE OSOBENNOSTI:

• Legko osvaivaemaya tekhnika vedeniya boya: Big Crown Showdown — eto priyatnyy i legkiy geympley, dostupnyy dlya igrokov vsekh vozrastov i urovney navykov. Boi, dlya uchastiya v kotorykh dostatochno nazhatiya vsego odnoy knopki, daryat nezabyvaemuyu glubinu vpechatleniy — vy zakhotite vernutsya v igru snova!

• Bespreryvno rabotayushchaya kamera: V igre Big Crown Showdown ispolzuetsya unikalnaya sistema, v ramkakh kotoroy kamera dvizhetsya vdol marshruta, ne ostanavlivayas ni na sekundu, chto zastavit vas vse vremya nakhoditsya v dvizhenii na vstrechu novym priklyucheniyam. Net vremeni na otdykh, kogda kamera podstegivaet sobytiya!

• Klassicheskaya platformennaya igra: V Big Crown Showdown boi — ne glavnoe. Igra sochetaet v sebe khaoticheskie boevye epizody i momenty zateylivogo platforminga, zastavlyaya vas dvigatsya i reagirovat ochen bystro. Na kazhdom marshrute vas podsteregaet mnozhestvo smertelno opasnykh prepyatstviy!

title: BFF or Die [NSZ][ENG]
description:
扮演一個時空旅行的外星人，個人或多達 4名玩家一起執行充滿難題的任務！在 BFF or Die 中，你和你的朋友從著名的星際時空學院畢業，並準備你們的第一個工作。在30個故事關卡完成任務，可解鎖的無限模式充滿了程序生成的挑戰，也充斥著不斷發展的滑稽事情！

所有的奧比斯都失踪了！欠缺它們，將無法啟動你們族人極需要的時空技術！你有責任營救這些能量小物並為你的時空機器配備新功能，以克服未來不斷升級的挑戰。確定由誰負責每個的小工具，並結合各種能力來尋找最佳的策略。這是團隊合作，只有是死黨才有希望生存！

特色：

• 獨自或與朋友合作共闖30個獨特的關卡！
• 通過有趣和瘋狂的實時操作解決難題。
• 體驗個別角色的不同故事文本。
• 解鎖無限嘗試模式，可獲得無限重玩的樂趣！

title: Matchmaker Agency [NSP][ENG]
description:
你有經歷過失敗的約會嗎？您是否厭倦了與剛通過朋友或在線應用程序認識的陌生人相親的尷尬場面？現在是你改變這現狀的機會了。是時候你化身為丘比特並在這款沉浸式、引人注目的故事遊戲中配對情侶。

戀愛與浪漫方面的初學者，您將很快掌握如何實現人們的希望和夢想。成功配對情侶即可獲得聲譽點數積分和金錢，解鎖升級以提昇活動，享受可愛的貓咪伴侶查爾斯一同陪伴。但切記——這是一場與時間的賽跑，而且你還欠着房東錢！

成為媒人 - 分析並與客戶交流，尋找出最佳的約會地點，選擇最精緻的禮物併策劃出一場完美的約會。單身的您可能不是個完美的戀人，但至少你可以成為遊戲中最棒的媒人！

客戶 - 程序編制出的客戶具有（幾乎）無限的組合、獨特的個性類型、額外獎勵積分和不同的個人品味。每個人對愛情有着不同的需求！

特殊的客戶 - 結識獨特的客戶，每個客戶都有着有趣的背景故事和目標（以及有潛在的戀人）。你會協助他們獲得這份唯一的真愛嗎？還是你會爲了自己的樂趣而故意從中搞破壞？

升級 - 升級吧玩家們，升級！每組成功配對的情侶都會讓您賺取獎勵，這些獎勵可以用來升級你的技能和改善你的辦公室。解鎖與提升更多您的配對能力和技巧！

放鬆一下 - 隨着自己的步伐與節奏，玩一玩並享受這配對成雙的遊戲。畢竟，愛情開花結果需要時間，不宜操之過急。

您周圍有着許多單身男女，他們已做好約會戀愛的準備！不，不是與你。您的任務就是為他們找出完美的約會對象，並成為鎮上響噹噹的媒人。

title: Tactics V: Obsidian Brigade [NSZ][ENG]
description: 戰術 V：“黑曜石旅”是一款復古風格的回合制戰術視頻遊戲，向 1990 年代的控制台戰術角色扮演遊戲致敬。它設置在內部幻想環境中，擁有自己的知識和魔法

title: Ned Iron Outlaw (试玩版) [NSZ][DEMO][ENG]
description:
Edvard «Ned» Kelli (3 iyunya 1854 — 11 noyabrya 1880, Melburn) — avstraliyskiy bushreyndzher XIX veka, razboynik, izvestnyy svoimi derzkimi ogrableniyami bankov, kaznyon cherez poveshenie za mnogochislennye narusheniya zakona. Predaniya i ballady o podvigakh Neda Kelli, gde on predstayot kak «blagorodnyy razboynik», poyavilis eshchyo pri ego zhizni i stali neotemlemoy chastyu avstraliyskogo narodnogo folklora. Otnoshenie k Nedu Kelli na udalyonnom materike daleko ot odnoznachnogo: chast avstraliytsev schitaet ego bezzhalostnym ubiytsey, a chast — simvolom soprotivleniya kolonialnym vlastyam i voploshcheniem osobennostey natsionalnogo kharaktera.
Prorvites skvoz polchishcha vragov v obraze Zheleznogo Neda v zakhvatyvayushchem priklyuchencheskom platformere, deystvie kotorogo razvorachivaetsya v bogatoy na istoricheskiy bekgraund avstraliyskoy derevenskoy glubinke.
2D-platformer pod DOOM, osnovannyy na dokumentalnoy biografii odnogo iz samykh pechalno izvestnykh prestupnikov Avstralii: probiraytes skvoz beskonechnye polchishcha vragov, ispolzuya originalnoe, umasshedshee oruzhie; issleduyte zakruchennyy vzglyad na realnye sobytiya s uchastiem legend Strany Kenguru!

title: Roah [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Velikaya neizvestnaya opasnost priblizhaetsya k rodnoy planete Roa. Sleduyte za Roa, kogda ona issleduet mir i stalkivaetsya so vsemi ego razlichnymi fraktsiyami, raskryvaya taynu togo, chto istoshchaet zhiznennuyu silu planet.

U Roa bolshoy otkrytyy mir s novymi sposobnostyami, navykami i dvizheniyami, kotorye nuzhno poluchit i osvoit. V nem predstavleny unikalnye boevye deystviya, vdokhnovlennye boevymi igrami, s mnozhestvom razlichnykh dvizheniy.

Vozmozhnosti vklyuchayut:
- Vyrazitelnaya i gibkaya boevaya sistema.
- Nelineynyy priklyuchencheskiy put.
- Unikalnye i slozhnye bitvy s bossami.
- Raznoobraznaya sreda.
- Poluchayte novye formy, chtoby reshat golovolomki i preodolevat okruzhenie.
- Kazualnyy rezhim dlya bolee legkogo prokhozhdeniya.

title: Pan'orama (Panorama) [NSZ][ENG]
description: Dobro pozhalovat v rasslablyayushchuyu golovolomku-simulyator, kotoraya pozvolyaet sozdavat zakhvatyvayushchie peyzazhi, ispolzuya razlichnye tipy plitok. V Pan'orama vy perenesetes v mir krasoty i spokoystviya, gde smozhete otdokhnut ot stressa povsednevnoy zhizni i nasladitsya rasslablyayushchey muzykoy, umirotvoryayushchey atmosferoy i, prezhde vsego, uspokaivayushchimi vidami, sozdannymi vami samimi.

title: Dragon Caffi [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Dragon Caffi — eto priklyuchencheskaya golovolomka s otkrytym mirom, napolnennaya chistym i bezzabotnym schastem i podkhodyashchaya dlya vsekh vozrastov! Eta igra s lyubovyu narisovana vruchnuyu i traditsionno animirovana (v nekotorykh sluchayakh na bumage!).
Edinstvennaya tsel etogo malenkogo priklyucheniya — dostavit vsem radost i udovolstvie.

title: Detective Agency: Gray Tie Collector's Edition [NSZ][ENG]
description:
充滿了美麗的地點、各種隱藏物體場景和各種迷你遊戲，
這款尋物遊戲讓您深入調查一名涉嫌盜竊無價小雕像的神秘惡棍！
跟隨專業偵探阿曼達和她得力的助手前往阿姆斯特丹，
古怪的收藏家吉諾·格拉索 (Gino Grasso) 最珍貴的作品不見了。
這條小徑將帶您前往各種引人入勝的地點，您將在這些地點尋找線索並解開謎團，從而揭開謎團並將嫌疑人繩之以法！
充滿戲劇性的曲折，這可能是偵探迄今為止最具挑戰性的案件！

珍藏版包括：
- 8 個額外的地點，有更多的東西等著你去尋找！
- 還有 8 個小遊戲等你完成！
- 聽配樂！

title: Faircroft's Antiques Set Collector's Edition's: Treasures of Treffenburg, Home for Christmas, The Heir of Glen Kinnoch, The Forbidden Crypt, The Mountaineer's Legacy [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Join Antiquities expert Mia Faircroft as she visits the beautiful Austrian town of Treffenburg in search of a fabled antique collection that once belonged to a famous matriarch named Lady Ophelia Harcourt. But Mia knows there’s a story behind every antique, and when she finds that some details aren’t adding up, she’ll dig through every nook and cranny to uncover the Harcourt family’s secrets. Join Mia in this lavishly illustrated Hidden-Object Puzzle Adventure game bursting with mystery, a diverse cast of lovable characters, and mind-bending minigames in every chapter!

- 20 mystery-packed chapters!
- Play over 30 fun minigames as you recover and repair antiques!
- A new adventure inspired by European art!
- 20 gorgeous locations!
- Two minigames in every story chapter

title: Say No More [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Sovershenno novyy plod voobrazheniya Studio Fizbin. Eto mir, gde lyudi privykli k statusu-kvo i postoyanno na vse soglashayutsya. Sozdayte stazhera i otpravlyaytes spasat mir pri pomoshchi pozitivnoy sily slova «NET!» Eta sila pomozhet preodolet lyubye pregrady: prosto kriknite «NET» v otvet na absurdnye trebovaniya okruzhayushchikh.

Upravlyat personazhem proshche prostogo. Proydite rabochiy den po gotovomu marshrutu v razveselom ofise. Vy ne tolko smozhete krichat «NET!» na svoem yazyke, no eshche i s razlichnymi emotsionalnymi okraskami, chtoby dat kollegam otpor. Sbivayte ikh s tolku razlichnymi deystviyami, a zatem kriknite «NET!» s udvoennoy siloy, poka oni pytayutsya ponyat, chto proiskhodit.

Eto umoritelnoe priklyuchenie s glubokim smyslom, zatragivayushchee vechnye i aktualnye temy: sotsialnyy etiket, druzhba i rabochaya atmosfera. Vse eto v veselom stile videoigr kontsa 90-kh: prostovataya, no yarkaya grafika, zabavnaya animatsiya i bodryy saundtrek. Dumaete, takoy stil ustarel? NET!

OSOBENNOSTI 
Reshayte, kak skazat «Net!»:
Goryacho
Ravnodushno
Lenivo
Po-duratski
«Zaryadite» otkaz dlya maksimalnogo effekta!
Razdrazhayte kolleg!
Smeytes nad nimi!
Aplodiruyte im!
Ukhmylyaytes im!
Pritvoryaytes, chto slushaete ikh, khotya na samom dele eto sarkazm!
Govorite «Net!» na raznykh yazykakh!
Nastroyte oblik personazha!
Dayte otpor vrednym kollegam, nachalnikam i direktoram!
Zavodite druzey za obedom!
Smeytes vslukh, igra krayne smeshnaya!
I usvoyte, chto «Net!» – pobeditelya otvet!

title: Flatland Vol 1-2 / Flatland Prologue [NSP][ENG]
Doronko Wanko [NSZ][ENG]
description:
《泥狗了！（DORONKO WANKO）》是一款讓你化身無邪小狗、盡情把家裡弄髒的泥巴動作遊戲！
從博美、柴犬、鬥牛犬、貴賓犬、傑克羅素、柯基等六種狗狗中選擇你最喜歡的，在漂亮乾淨的家裡探險、撒野、弄得一團亂吧！

◆ 蹭蹭！抖抖！超可愛的泥巴動作！
在地板上的「髒污」上蹭一蹭，小狗就會變得髒兮兮。
再來一個「抖抖」，把泥巴灑滿整個房間吧！

◆ 全屋亂搞的話，會發現「隱藏博美」！？
找到所有「隱藏博美」後，就能打開通往「香香的房間」的大門！
（趁家人不注意，偷偷潛進去看看吧！）

◆ 越髒，損失越多！
弄髒的越多，清潔費與維修費也會越高。
遊戲結束時可以查看「收據」，確認你的戰績！

◆ 越弄髒，獎勵越多！
每當損失達到一定程度，就會收到「神秘禮物」！？
幫助你更有效地噴泥，還能獲得關鍵道具和可愛造型喔！

title: Recall Empty Wishes [NSZ][ENG]
description:
《Recall : Empty Wishes 空願 》是一款基於2010年代臺灣背景的心理驚悚作品。自從弟弟子維神秘地失蹤後，姊姊子晴決定尋找其失踪真相。子晴越是深入調查，越是陷入現實與幻境的邊界之中，令人不安的秘密也將被一層層揭開。

聰明又善解人意的男孩林子維，為何會突然失蹤？某天，林子晴找到了她和弟弟林子維童年的玩具話筒，這個神秘的話筒引導子晴與她的朋友一起進入虛幻的世界，在那裡他們可以探索與子維相關人物的回憶。通過話筒穿梭在人物們最深層的願望裡，並藉此揭開子維失蹤背後的真相。

玩家將扮演姊姊子晴與她的朋友睿萱，一起重溫子維與生命中重要角色的回憶。每一章節都將深入探討一個角色的過去，並揭示他們心中各自埋藏的願望與秘密。在這個值得探索的2D橫向捲軸遊戲裡，玩家可與角色互動、調查場景、蒐集物品並做出抉擇，子維失蹤的謎團就埋藏在其中。

特色：
- 基於2010年代臺灣學生文化的沉浸式冒險
- 非線性敘事結合幻想、懸疑與恐怖元素
- 多重角色敘事，從不同視角探索整個故事
- 選擇與行動將影響其他角色與結局分歧
- 2D橫向捲軸遊戲玩法，富含互動元素和解謎
- 像素視覺風格與角色立繪互相結合
- 支援多種語言，包括中文、英文及日文

title: Bloo Kid 2 / Super Bloo Kid Adventure [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Vyzvoliv svoyu devushku iz lap kovarnogo zlogo volshebnika, Blyu Kid (Siniy Paren) s Pink Gyorl (Rozovoy Devchushkoy) naslazhdayutsya zhiznyu i rastyat novorozhdennogo Pink Kida (Rozovogo Parnya). I tut vnezapno nachinaetsya novoe i zakhvatyvayushchee priklyuchenie.
Begayte, prygayte i plyvite k svoey tseli po PYaTI miram, kazhdyy iz kotorykh sostoit iz 12 urovney.
Stante pobeditelem v brutalnykh skhvatkakh s bossami i nakhodite mnozhestvo sekretov v mire Bloo Kid 2.

Kharakternye cherty igry Bloo Kid 2:
- 5 mirov, v kazhdom iz kotorykh 12 urovney,
- Pikselnaya grafika, sozdannaya vruchnuyu,
- Nastoyashchiy vosmibitnyy saundtrek,
- Epichnye bitvy s bossami,
- Tonny sekretov povsyudu,
- Ultratochnoe upravlenie

title: Chickenoidz Super Party [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Chickenoidz Super Party 是一款多人競技射擊遊戲，最多可容納 4 名玩家。 使用一系列令人難以置信的武器、特別的裝備以至變異來搶盡風頭。 將你的對手粉碎，也把周圍的一切撕成碎片。 在激怒下，成為小雞大戰的最終勝利者！

►小鳥大混亂◀ 

在節奏明快的戰鬥中與其他玩家對戰。 這非常適合在家庭聚會上與朋友一起玩。 以防萬一，也有先進的人工智能待命。

►變異一點◀ 

吃下秘密 DNA 配方，變異成一個瘋狂的魁梧雞雞。 將其他小雞驅散，釋放終極大規模攻擊能力，摧毀一切觸手可及的東西 - 感受成為巨大怪物的力量。

►忘記扳機的約束◀ 

讓自己筋疲力盡，試用所有的武器——從水槍到發射雞蛋的彈弓。 只要拿起武器，消滅所有其他小雞！

用錘子擊暈他們，用拳擊手套擊拳 - 這只是遊戲中所有可用特殊動作的一小部分。 欺騙你的對手並小心你的背後，定要智取。

►暫時放下你的槍◀ 

參加標準戰鬥和有特殊規則的回合。 在射擊準確性並不那麼重要的附加比賽中獲得額外積分。

►讓你的個性閃耀◀ 

從超過 15 種頂級服裝中選擇你個人的小雞造型：成為朋克、武士、女巫等等。

title: Ink & Paper Doodlecut [NSZ][ENG]
description:
You take control of a doodle bug crawling across the notebook. As you move, you draw a line behind you. When you surround an area, you can capture and doodle it. You must sketch more than three-quarters of a page to win.

Each level offers plenty of challenges - from special areas to multiple types of enemies. Don't let them catch you or cut your line!

Play alone or with your friend in co-op mode to get the most space in the shortest time! You can also unlock expert speed and endless mode.

Doodle, divide and conquer!

title: Swoon Earth Escape [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
這顆星球被一種神秘的綠色酸所淹沒。 幫助 Swoon 和其他船員逃離地球。 收集你的宇宙飛船的所有機械部件，在這個史詩般的複古風格旅程中面對最大膽的老闆！
• 玩 5 個不同的 2.5D 和 3D 世界，從冒險的侏羅紀島旅行到發光的科幻世界！
• 從您的車庫中解鎖新的可穿戴套裝，學習滾動、漩渦和路徑生成器等技能。 穿上冒險、雪地、蒸汽朋克和科幻套裝，並在它們之間切換以殺死敵人、解決謎題或建造替代路徑。
• 探索、收集機械零件、寶石和鑰匙以解鎖新的遊戲功能。
• 拯救你所有的朋友，準備離開地球！

title: Miyamoto S [NSZ][ENG]
description:
《MIYAMOTO》是一款精美的日式紙牌遊戲。用每次戰鬥中獲得的卡牌建構一副牌組，
有效放置獨特的棋子是策略的關鍵。

餘一、半藏、黑道等獨特的大師可以透過收集戰鬥幣來兌換。
選擇隨機發的牌並為每場戰鬥建立一副牌組。
可以攻擊2格的歌舞伎、強化週邊的柴犬、依照盟友數量強化的公主等。
了解各個棋子的獨特能力並有效地放置它們。

組建強大的套牌並擊敗在最後等待你的宮本。

title: Barricadez Revisited [NSZ][ENG]
description:
本軟件是一款製造型塔防遊戲，以文明崩壞後的世界為舞台，面對不明身份的敵人來襲，建造基地來保護搖籃中的嬰兒
〇在地下採集素材
可以在地下世界採掘製造陷阱和牆壁的素材。深入挖掘來獲得寶貴的資源吧
〇在地面建設基地
在地面上，您可以製造陷阱和牆壁來擊退來襲的敵人
結合多個陷阱來建造屬於自己的最強基地吧

title: Bakugan Champions of Vestroia [NSZ][ENG]
description:
全新的動作角色扮演遊戲，其原創劇情在熱門電視動畫中獲得擴展。這場冒險帶玩家進入終極的決鬥旅程，並與名為爆丸的強大生物成為好友。準備好裝備、自訂並掌握你的爆丸團隊來進行策略戰鬥，進而成為維斯托亞之冠。
透過高度競爭的動作戰鬥系統，玩家可組建其最頂尖的爆丸團隊，以成為爆丸戰鬥英雄。玩家可在探索及完成任務時，與爆丸成為好友並加以收集。
完整可探索的3D世界，其分為各個區域，每個區域都有專門的戰鬥環境。玩家可與其他角色互動、執行任務，並與自身爆丸團隊一起探索。玩家還可以進行多人線上對抗。

title: Napoleon Maiden in the Third World, Ep. 1 [NSZ][ENG]
description:
角色立繪使用了E-mote動畫系統。
呼吸、眨眼、說話，栩栩如生。
并且，收錄了由霜月はるか、逢瀬アキラ演唱的主題曲！
所有角色，全日語配音。

「——改變命運，我的字典裡沒有不可能三個字。」

咲川將一是一個平凡的高中二年級的學生，直到那一天他遭遇了交通事故。
當他再次睜開雙眼時，展現在他眼前的光景是正處於資產階級革命白熱化時期的19世紀的法國。
在千鈞一發之際從砲彈轟炸下把將一救出來的是一位帶劍的少女。
「——我是拿破崙·波拿巴。是未來的法國皇帝。」
此後，受少女「拿破崙」救命之恩的將一決定與她同行。
出乎意料的是這個世界並非「過去」，而是一個異世界。
在這裡，被神託付了偉人命運的“神諭”的少女們使用一種名為「天啟」的異能展開激烈的交戰。

究竟將一是否能夠平安無事地回到原本的世界呢？
他和拿破崙之間逐漸萌發的感情的未來又將如何呢——

OP主題歌「Divine Akashic」
作編曲/作詞/歌：逢瀬アキラ

ED主題歌「命の唄」
歌：霜月はるか
作詞：大愛アヲイ

title: Invisigun Reloaded [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Risk versus reward guides your journey through the full-length single player campaign and local/online multiplayer. Vigilance is key as environmental tells such as footprints and other disturbances will point out careless cadets. A massive amount of lovingly-made environments, maps, modes, and abilities – all obsessively balanced – combine for high replayability and a deep path to mastery.

★ Single Player Campaigns
Challenge yourself in the Hero’s Journey: individually tailored hero campaigns filled with puzzle rooms, skill challenges, and boss fights. The unique abilities have entire journeys built specifically to teach you to properly use that hero’s playstyle – all while the art of stealth and mastery of movement becomes second-nature.

★ Multiplayer Battles - Local and Online
Once you’ve honed your skills in the Hero’s Journey and defeated all of your friends, you’ll want to challenge the world! Online matchmaking, crossplay with the PC community, and public or private matches with join keys allow you to find a foe anytime, anywhere.

★ Choose your Main
With 12 different heroes – each with their own unique ability – there is a perfect strategy for every playstyle. From meticulously sneaky to ruthlessly aggressive, find your favorite ability and shock your friends when you appear out of thin air and surprise them!

★ Competitive, Deep Hide and Seek
Count your steps to find the perfect hiding spot, wait for your foes to reveal themselves, then pounce! While counterintuitive at first, invisibility becomes your most versatile tool, leading to intense moments of complete silence. Invisigun’s core mechanics reward patience, forethought, trickery, and awareness.

★ Easy to Learn, Tough to Master
The depth is nearly unlimited with intentional baits, undetectable direction changes, powerup drops, and accidental bumps (that may not be so accidental). The chess dance is infinite and evolving, and all of the deceit is only heightened by the fact that your opponents could be lurking ANYWHERE!

title: Dead Dungeon [NSP][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
Dead Dungeon eto khardkornyy 2D platformer v luchshikh traditsiyakh klassicheskikh igr, s otlichnym chiptyun saundtrekom. Igra proverit vashi nervy na prochnost i prineset massu emotsiy.

O syuzhete:
U Vas byla bezzabotnaya zhizn poka ne yavilsya zlodey i ne lishil Vas sladostey zabrav dushi u vsego zhivogo. Teper Vam trebuetsya otpravitsya v trudnoe puteshestvie, chtoby vernut vse dushi i sladosti iz tainstvennogo podzemelya.

Osobennosti:
-Khardkornyy geympley 
Postepenno narastayushchaya slozhnost i obuchenie igre bez nadoedlivykh tutorialov, tolko blagodarya stroeniyu urovney - kak v starye dobrye vremena.

-Prostaya i krasivaya grafika
Prostoy graficheskiy stil budet priyaten glazu, a kvadratnye sprayty pridut po dushe lyubitelyam kvadratnykh spraytov.

-Otlichnyy saundtrek
Originalnyy chiptyun saundtrek, napisannyy spetsialno dlya igry avtorom HateBit izvestnym po igre Dungeon Escape i drugim.

-Obilie zagadok i paskhalok
Nalichie zagadok i paskhalok sdelayut igru eshchyo interesnee i zagadochnee.

-Nostalgicheskie chuvstva

title: Monmusu Gladiator [NSZ][ENG]
description:
「獸娘競技場」是一款獸娘養成的Rogue-lite式RPG遊戲。身為培育師的你，必須克服重重困難，和夥伴一起培育出最強的獸娘，在競技場的各大賽中獲勝！善用擊敗對手後獲得的培育卡來建構牌組，依照你的喜好養出最厲害的獸娘！

利用桌遊風格的走格子玩法，培育可愛的獸娘。培育過程中，還有操作簡單又刺激的戰鬥等著你體驗。

選擇卡牌來提升能力！
建構出你專屬的牌組，培養出最強的獸娘吧！
事件與能力的重要抉擇，將會是獸娘存活的關鍵。

刺激又緊繃的戰鬥
戰鬥操作非常簡單，只要等AP集滿，按下技能鈕就能出招！
不斷過關斬將，直到獸娘重獲自由吧！

title: Rainbow Skies [NSP][ENG]
description:
《Rainbow Skies》是一款有著活潑的等距視角風格的策略型 RPG！沉浸於多彩的世界中，充滿陰森的地城與傳統回合制戰鬥。可馴服的怪物與多種類的武器、裝備和技能，讓你有大量自訂選項和角色發展的可能性。無數的支線任務、活潑的城鎮與刺激的秘密等著你去發掘，讓你能夠不斷遊玩！

故事：

Damion 的大日子到了。今天是他作為怪物訓獸師的最後測驗，在他經常遭受怪物攻擊的家鄉，這可是個十分重要的工作。然而在嚴重宿醉下，Damion 全都搞砸了，不僅測驗沒過，還破壞了怪物化合物。當他和考官 Layne 想掩蓋這齣悲劇時，情況從糟糕變成難以理解，還有一堆沒料到的慘事隨即而來，他們更發現自已身在兩股敵對超級力量中間。

特色：

• 跟著 3 名年輕英雄踏上旅程，認識友情的無價！
• 在活潑的世界裡盡情探索，充滿有趣的朋友與夥伴。
• 在著重策略的回合制戰鬥中，施展威力強大的技能！
• 飼養無數種的怪物，幫助牠們升級，成為小隊的一員。
• 升級角色、武器、裝備和戰鬥技能！
• 挖掘隱藏的寶藏、找出其他的寶貴收藏品。
• 遊玩各式各樣的小遊戲，像是回合制釣魚遊戲！

title: Game of Dragons [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
[故事]
世界大體上分為兩種宗教，經絡教和流星教，每個宗教的信徒都相互對立。伊露尼斯教會創造了一個眾神的樂園，傳言說那裡有各種知識和寶物。包括主角 Faia 在內的六個角色為了自己的原因去往眾神的天堂進行冒險。

【遊戲特色與系統】
您在大廳開始遊戲，在那裡您可以製作和增強卡片、設備和雕刻。
通過接受任務，回合製冒險模式繼續進行。
一共有6個角色，最多可以有4個角色參與戰鬥。
冒險模式是在一個由3D六邊形瓷磚地圖組成的棋盤上進行的，棋盤上每個建築物（15種）可用的功能是不同的。
戰鬥基本上是在3D瓷磚地圖上進行實時自動戰鬥，用戶通過使用每個角色獨特的卡牌技能進行干預。用戶可以在大廳提前編輯要使用的卡。還有許多其他額外的戰鬥系統，例如戰術級別。
有RPG元素，例如昇級和角色統計。
您可以在冒險和戰鬥中使用卡片、獲取新卡片、編輯和增強卡片組。
有一種農業元素，它使用從征服敵人中獲得的材料來製造和加強設備。此外，可以通過條件和效果的組合，根據用戶想要的組合來創建可以安裝在設備上的雕刻。

title: Guild of Dungeoneering Ultimate edition [NSZ][ENG]
description:
玩家將使用從公會卡組中抽取的卡牌設置房間、怪物、陷阱以及戰利品。與此同時，您的英雄將自己決定去往何方或者與誰交戰。但問題是，英雄是否足夠強大，能夠挑戰最深處的地下城呢？在地下城探索的間隙，您需要管理自己的公會，建造新的房間以吸引全新職業的冒險者，並利用更加強大的物品擴張您的卡組。

• 前所未有的深度。終極版將免費提供從「海盜灣」到「冰淇淋讓人頭痛」在內的所有內容！除此之外，更有全新職業、全新怪物、全新任務以及裝滿戰利品的全新寶箱供您體驗。
• 隨心打造您的冒險家。利用數十種全新髮型與飾品外加全新的勝利特性塑造冒險家，幫助他們在您打造的凶險地下城之中堅持更久。
• 經過完善的遊戲機制以及全面的平衡性調整。精心的最佳化將讓您在公會與地下城中體會到無與倫比的快樂與享受。在派遣傻瓜去送死的過程中，體驗前所未有的愉悅吧！
• 全新文字、動畫、配樂以及音效。細緻的全面設計將讓您的地下城與公會愈發逼真。但一定要小心，牙尖嘴利的吟遊詩人已經回來囉。

title: Mystic Vale [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Get ready for an all-new deck-building experience in Mystic Vale, as you use the the innovate Card Crafting System to improve your cards to create a diverse and effective deck.

In Mystic Vale, cards combine in a variety of different ways to create powerful combos. Each turn you can purchase upgrades to your existing cards, making them stronger as the game goes on. Push extra cards onto your field to gain more resources, at the risk of ending your turn early. The player who scores the most victory points wins!

Mystic Vale is easy to pick up for those new to deck-building games, yet is challenging even for those skilled in the genre. Practice against AI opponents before you take the battle online, where you can find and create public or private rooms to play against friends or random players!

If your clan are all together in one place, Mystic Vale also supports Hot Seat for up to 4 people!

title: Donut Dodo [NSZ][ENG]
description:
準備好登頂高分榜了嗎？
堅韌如釘，永無止境，你有能力嗎？

Donut Dodo 是一款輕鬆的街機遊戲，讓人想起我們至今仍珍視的 80 年代初深受喜愛的經典遊戲。你扮演貝克比利伯恩斯，他必須奔跑、跳躍和攀爬，以智取甜甜圈渡渡鳥和他那群毫無頭緒的爪牙。您的目標是在最佳時間收集每個關卡中的所有甜甜圈！

你今天會在高分榜上名列前茅嗎？
快來湊熱鬧吧！

現在是 1983 年，只有更好！遊戲特色...

- 5 個單屏關卡和一個獎勵關卡，每個關卡都有其獨特的遊戲機制
- 瘋狂的單人街機遊戲的控制非常嚴格（沒有便宜的死亡）
- 具有 16 色調色板的老式屏幕比例和像素完美圖形
- 由才華橫溢的 CosmicGem 創作的原創芯片音樂
- 全球排行榜，僅限 3 個字符的首字母，街機風格！

title: Shephy [NSZ][ENG]
description:
◆ 培育羊遊戲是什麼？
把一隻羊培養到 1000 隻羊，就是本遊戲的目標。
靈活運用手裡的特殊卡牌，在 3 回合之內把羊增加到 1000 隻吧。

◆ 設有初學者也能遊玩的「Practice Mode」！
在「Tutorial」或 Practice Mode 中可以學習 Shephy 的規則。

◆ 挑戰極限！「Challenge Mode」
收集 1000 隻以上的羊的模式！
在 3 回合之內挑戰看看能收集到多少隻的羊！

◆ 能體驗Shephy故事的「Post Love Mode」
可以觀賞羊群的故事的「Post Love Mode」。
不同的故事設有不同的規則，可以體驗 Shephy 的新感覺。

title: Rise of the Slime [NSZ][ENG]
description:
«Vosstanie Slizuna» sovershenno ne pokhozhe na drugie igry zhanra roguelike. Eto odnovremenno takticheskaya kartochnaya igra i zakhvatyvayushchiy priklyuchencheskiy sayd-skroller.

⯀ Tvoya igra — tvoi pravila: soberi neveroyatno moshchnuyu kolodu iz 100 s lishnim kart!

⯀ Marshrut izmenchiv i polon neozhidannostey: izbegay padayushchikh kamney i yam s shipami, zakupay v magazinakh usileniya dlya kolody i ishchi potaynye sokrovishchnitsy!

⯀ Srazhaysya s zagadochnymi i groznymi protivnikami: ot khitrykh besyat do koshmarnykh gigantov. Chtoby ikh pobedit, pridyotsya vyzhat iz svoey kolody maksimum!

⯀ Issleduy krasivyy volshebnyy mir topkikh tryasin, burlyashchikh ognennykh ozyor i tainstvennykh sadov!

⯀ Razlichnye modifikatory, izmenchivyy marshrut i beskonechnye varianty kolod — prokhodi igru kazhdyy raz po-novomu!

title: Miracle Snack Shop [NSZ][ENG]
description:
主人公——Seolhwa Cha由於突發原因而需要獨自承擔起Snack shop的經營活動。
但是，店裡的客人卻寥寥無幾......

苦悶只是暫時的，Snack shop的閣樓上突然出現了一個奇怪的入口！
通過這個入口來到此地的不是別人，正是這個世界的女王！？

她說自己是食鹽女王——Philia，Seolhwa Cha便用冰沙招待了她,
兩人的關係也由此漸漸變得親密......

「你在做什麼?冰沙工，快給我拿冰沙來。」

在平凡的Snack shop裡，和女王之間的心動冰沙愛情開始了！

◆ 充滿魅力的兩位女主角！
可愛又個性十足的兩位女主角之間甜蜜的愛情喜劇！
藉由凸顯女主角魅力的漂亮插圖和全語音來欣賞故事情節。

Philia: CV Marie Miyake / Hyewon Jeong
Mira: CV Mai Ishihara / Mi Jang

◆ 休閒享受Snack shop經營！
藉由簡單的操作即可培養料理實力、蒐集食譜。
請透過多樣化的行銷戰略來提升店鋪的人氣、挑戰最佳Snack shop經營吧！
 
◆ 不同選擇帶來不同結局！
結局隨玩家的選擇和行為而改變，
兩位女主角的關係掌握在您的手中！

◆ 包括後續花絮《Philia續篇》！
收錄了描寫特定結局之後的故事花絮，讓您欣賞更加豐富的故事！

title: The Hundred Year Kingdom [NSZ][ENG]
description:
這是個尚未有文明存在的新世界。

在這個尚不存在文明的世界上，
有位造物主──也就是「你」，
和一位有著神話中女神之名，被稱為「神託少女」的少女。

你和少女兩人將同心協力，共享歡笑、淚水以及喜悅，
並一步步培育出新文明。

百年後的世界究竟會是什麼模樣？
歡迎身為玩家的你親自體驗。

遊戲特色
・本遊戲是簡單好上手的回合制模擬遊戲。玩家將透過建築與開拓等方式，在一百年的期間中培育出文明。

・你將和與神話中的大地女神同名，被稱為「神託巫女」的少女一起培育文明。

・遊戲中沒有外交、戰爭或災害等負面又複雜的要素。

・你的文明不會遭到蠻族入侵，也不會被甘地丟核彈。

・你可以照自己的步調，隨心所欲地培育屬於自己的文明。

在《百年王國》裡，你將會在創造出的各式各樣世界當中培育新文明。無論是有著群山峻嶺、遼闊大海，或是草原一望無際的綠意盎然世界，都由你隨心所欲創造與培育。

title: Battle Planet Judgement Day [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Battle Planet - Judgement Day is a planetary rogue-lite top-down shooter. You are one of the universe's 3 most wanted criminals on the run, fighting your way through hordes of aliens, military and police units. There is only one way to reclaim your freedom - destroy them all...

Escape a crashed prisoner transport ship and fight the authorities in a non-stop mayhem of blazing gunfire and planet destroying bombs sent to perforate you and the ground beneath your feet.

Doomed to be killed in a never ending loop, your trial of survival relies solely on your hardcore skills


-	permanently upgrade your convict and the weapon arsenal after each run

-	battle your way through hordes of enemies designed to torment you

-	power up your ass with a load-out of perks

-	face bosses that have your controller buttons on their death list

-	couch co-op mode: die together in excessive sessions with friends


Make them pay to make sure today is NOT your judgement day.

title: Battle Hunters [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Korolevstvo v opasnosti, i lish stareyshiy i mudreyshiy volshebnik mira yavlyaetsya siloy, sposobnoy sderzhat zlodeya, che imya neizvestno. Tri geroya, opirayas na mnozhestvo silnykh soyuznikov, kotorye prisoedinyatsya k missii dlya zashchity korolevstva, otpravlyayutsya na poiski Drevnego, chtoby pomoch emu v borbe s tainstvennym uzhasom.

Srazhaysya s merzkimi tvaryami i monstrami vsekh sortov na svoem puti po raznym ugolkam korolevstva. Ot Velikogo Lesa, naselennogo kovarnymi goblinami i neuklyuzhimi trollyami, do vysokikh Utesov Otchayaniya, gde ty povstrechaesh zlobnykh garguliy i neuderzhimykh kamennykh golemov. Poznakomsya s otvazhnymi i silnymi geroyami etogo mira i dalekikh prostranstv i vremen. Kazhdyy iz nikh privneset v srazheniya sobstvennye unikalnye sposobnosti, moshchnye zaklinaniya i razrushitelnoe oruzhie. Volshebniki, voiny, drakony i demony, samurai i kolduny gotovy otpravitsya v puteshestvie i vstupit v boy.

Battle Hunters predlagaet tvoemu vnimaniyu unikalnuyu boevuyu sistemu, kotoraya sochetaet elementy strategicheskogo upravleniya geroyami i ekshen v realnom vremeni. Ispolzuy osobye sposobnosti i predmety dlya vyzhivaniya, vybiray podkhodyashchie momenty dlya ataki, oborony ili otstupleniya. Kazhdyy sdelannyy vybor imeet reshayushchee znachenie, kogda rech idet o porazhenii ili pobede. Priklyuchenie, sozdannoe s oglyadkoy na klassiku, no s novym podkhodom k vedeniyu boya, klassam personazhey i ikh sposobnostyam.

Chego zhe ty zhdesh? Vybiray geroev, pobezhday v boyu, spasi korolevstvo.

title: Barbarous Tavern of Emyr / Welcome to Primrose Lake [NSZ][ENG]
developer: Sqrt3 S.A. Square Root of Tree
description:
In this game, you will be tasked with preparing various treats and delivering them to the customers. Grab items and combine ingredients in compounds. But be warned. Customers have limited patience, and they won’t wait forever for you to respond. Manage your time well, or you’ll lose clients. Each action is rewarded. Get the points for checking out guests, and earn diamonds as a reward.

You play as Emyr realm’s - probably - most famous hero. That is, until his career was destroyed by a dreadful wound. And that right before he had a chance to kill his Archenemy; whom, as 100% credible prophecy has said: “No hero can defeat”. 
If that’s not enough, one day he wakes up only to find out that he spent all his money on a shabby tavern. Life as an innkeeper? That’s no role for a leading hero, right? That’s a commoner’s job! And to make things even worse, suddenly some teenager claims to be his daughter. Will Emyr be able to get his adventuring career back on track? Will he defeat his dreadful foe? And finally, can he answer the challenges of responsible parenthood? As they say, old habits die hard.

Features: 

- Play in a single and cooperative mode.

- 5 unique taverns, each in a different place, visited during Emyr’s travels; 

- 60 engaging levels with unique gameplay experience; 

- 120 in-game cutscenes (intro and outro for every level) with some depth mixed with tons of humorous references.

title: Nowhere Prophet [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Build a loyal band of followers and survive the journey across a broken world. Barely.

Take on the role of a powerful leader and mystic. Empowered with the gifts of technopathy, the ability to sense and affect electrical currents. 

You are the last hope to a band of outcastes and refugees. Lead them across the randomly generated wastelands. Pick fights with greedy slavers and crazy machines using the turn-based card combat. Can you survive long enough to reach the mysterious Crypt?

- Card-based tactical combat system
- New procedurally generated maps each game
- Find loot and recruit followers to build your deck 
- Unlock new content across multiple playthroughs
- More than 300 cards for you to discover
- Indian infused electronica soundtrack

Nowhere Prophet is a single-player card game with procedurally generated maps, high difficulty and permadeath. At its heart are two distinct parts of gameplay: Travel and combat.

During travel you navigate across a procedurally generated map. Make sure your convoy has enough resources to travel as you pick your route. On your journey you will encounter strange places and even stranger people. You will be thrust into situations that put the fate of your followers in your hands. 

If you're lucky enough to gain some rewards, maybe for helping someone - or robbing them, then you can invest those to improve your decks. Recruit more followers to have more and different units to put into battle. Equip your prophet or level up and learn new skills to have access to stronger action cards in combat.

You will have to overcome some enemies to keep your convoy and resources together. And sometimes you may even want to pick a fight for righteousness or just for loot. Once in battle the game changes to the turn-based card game mode. 

Play convoy cards to put your followers onto the field and position them so you can overcome your enemy. Or play action cards to dramatically change the battlefield. But be careful: If you're wounded you will have to find a safe place to heal. And if one of your followers takes too many wounds, they are lost forever.

Nowhere Prophet is set on a far off planet called Soma. Your story begins many years after the Crash, a complete technological collapse. Civilization has broken down and the lack of resources made everyone turn either bandit or madman.

In this world inspired by Indian culture, you lead a convoy of outcastes. These desperate men and woman following your vision of a better future. Under your guidance, they travel with you through the wastelands. Your goal is the Crypt, a mystical place that promises untainted technology and safety. 

If you can survive long enough to find it.

title: No Sun to Worship [NSP][ENG]
description:
沒有可崇拜的太陽是一款極簡風格的潛行動作遊戲，捕捉了潛行類型最初開創者的精髓，並在一個即將死亡的世界中重現他們的復古美學魅力。

懲罰執行
每一章的挑戰將考驗你的潛入與暗殺技巧，並讓你自由選擇如何接近關卡。悄悄潛行、匍匐前進、禁用監控系統並打破光源，保持不被發現。安靜地孤立並消除目標，或按自己的條件開始火拼。明智地管理你的資源，或被迫發揮創意 — 敵人不需要知道指向他們頭部的槍是空的。

垂死世界的回音
透過環境與非語言敘事，發掘自己的角色與更大的故事，在核戰爭後的痛苦中，旅行於一個即將滅亡的世界，當地居民試圖將破碎的碎片拼湊在一起，而來自另一個世界的觀察者靜靜地觀看。

title: Runner3 (Runner 3) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Ritmichno-muzykalnyy geympley BIT.TRIP RUNNER i Runner2 vozvrashchaetsya v luchshem vide!

The Timbletot nameren lishit multivselennuyu vsey lyubvi i schastya. CommanderVideo ne mozhet dopustit, chtoby eto proizoshlo. On gotov prygat, podprygivat, pereprygivat, podnyrivat, skolzit, parit, nyryat, letat i tantsevat, chtoby prokladyvat svoy put k pobede v chrede zakhvatyvayushchikh, interesnykh i veselykh urovney!

Kharakteristiki igry:
⦁ Geroyskie zadaniya! - Igra Runner3 napolnena chudnymi personazhami, kotorym trebuetsya vasha pomoshch. Protyanite im ruku pomoshchi, i oni shchedro vas nagradyat!
⦁ Transportnye sredstva! – Vy stolknetes s samymi nevoobrazimymi transportnymi sredstvami, u kotorykh net shansa poyavitsya na ulitsakh na zakonnom osnovanii. Baklazhannye samolety! Seldereynye avtomobili! Banki, privodimye v dvizhenie uglekislym gazom! I eto eshche ne vsyo!
⦁ Vetvyashchiesya puti! – Na kazhdom urovne Runner3 puti vetvyatsya po urovnyu slozhnosti. Vstante na trudnyy put i zarabotayte samotsvety; na obychnom puti mozhno nabit svoi karmany dragotsennymi zolotymi slitkami. Vybor za vami!
⦁ Retro-ispytaniya! – Soglasno traditsiyam serii, kazhdyy uroven Runner3 imeet soprovoditelnyy retro-uroven – eto kak imet dve igry po tsene odnoy! Na etikh urovnyakh vas ozhidaet koe-chto novoe za vsyu seriyu igr: svobodnoe dvizhenie! Upravlyayte CommanderVideo nevidannymi ranee sposobami i zarabatyvayte dragotsennye monety “Gildan” po khodu dela! 
⦁ Magazin predmetov! – Igroki budut imet vozmozhnost tratit svoi krovno zarabotannye Gildans i samotsvety na kostyumy, plashchi, aksessuary i prochee. V Runner3 net vnutriigrovykh pokupok za realnye dengi -- rasslabtes!
⦁ Novye igrovye personazhi! – K Kommanderam prisoedinilis novye i starye druzya, vklyuchaya Dave iz populyarnoy igry Woah Dave!, Unkle Dill, Frank 'N Stein, Awnty Rewty i ne tolko!
⦁ Charles Martinet! - Charles Martinet, vozvrashchaetsya za svoyu rol "The Narrator"

title: Lynn The Girl Drawn on Puzzles [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
很久很久以前......
妖魔鬼怪還在人間橫行。

有一天，傳播天花的瘟神經過村莊，
把疫病傳給了少女唯一的弟弟。

少女的弟弟受到了瘟神的詛咒，人們對它束手無策。
少女聽說，只要被具有神秘力量的九尾狐珠散發出來的光芒照射，
就能解除詛咒。
為了自己的弟弟，她爬上高山，找到九尾狐曾經住過的房子。


房裡除了一本書，什麼也沒有......
少女翻開那本書，書中冒出耀眼的光，
把少女吸進了水墨畫的世界裡，那裡到處都是迷宮！

少女被吸進去的那本書是九尾狐的日記！？
少女偷看九尾狐日記後，意外得知九尾狐鮮為人知的過去......

■ 進入水墨畫世界的少女
被吸進九尾狐所繪水墨畫中的少女「琳」，
和琳一起在美麗的水墨畫中展開冒險之旅吧！

■ 挑戰100關以上的謎題
移動用黑色毛筆勾勒的房間，讓琳逃跑！
用簡單的操作搞定機關重重的關卡吧！

■ 東洋風的美麗畫面和BGM
用水墨畫勾勒出氛圍獨特的自然風景，極富個性的角色和插圖
增強沈浸感的傳統又時尚的音效！

畫中的少女琳能否走出迷宮，找到九尾狐之珠呢？
這幅水墨畫中九尾狐故事的真相是......？

title: Apsulov End of Gods [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
人類在地下深處挖掘以尋求眾神的憐憫。 他們發現的東西絕不會浮出水面。 不在米德加德，也不在任何伊格德拉希爾的領域。

你在一個為研究 Yggdrasil 世界而建造的設施中醒來。 當你穿越一個充滿技術和神話文物的世界時，在潛伏的危險中倖存下來，混亂統治著人類領域。 正是在這種混亂中，你找到了你的目的和命運。

主要特點
探索充滿未來科技和北歐神話的噩夢般的避難所

在獨特的大氣環境中體驗第一人稱恐怖

掌握超凡脫俗的神器和 Yggdrasil 的秘密

title: Emily Archer and the Curse of Tutankhamun [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Lady Archer is invited to Egypt to see the priceless treasure of King Tutankhamun by her friend Lord Carnarvon. 
She arrives to find her dear friend murdered and the mask of Tutankhamun stolen. 
She's on a mission to solve the murder and find the missing mask! Collect evidence, examine clues, and solve intricate riddles as you move closer to the truth. 
Can you help Lady Archer to solve this case?

Search scenes through 1920s Egypt, including excavations, tombs and hotel room. 
Search for clues and missing objects to discover who's murdered Emily's friend Lord Carnarvon and find the missing treasure of Tutankhamun. 
With puzzles round every corner players are also challenged to take on thrilling mini-games. The great gameplay is complemented by beautiful backgrounds and an engrossing soundtrack.

Features:
- Seek and find through locations of ancient Egypt, recreated in stunning detail
- Solve a myriad of unique puzzles as you examine the evidence
- Enjoy musical score to accompany you on your investigation
- Interact with an engaging cast of characters in each scene
- Trace the footsteps of the killer and piece together a case

title: Cloudy Valley [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Dlya samykh malenkikh igrokov!
Otpravlyaytes na letnie kanikuly na arkhipelag Klaudi-Velli. Plavayte, lazayte po skalam i issleduyte ostrova, otkryvayte sokrovishcha ili naslazhdaytes uyutnoy i rasslablyayushchey atmosferoy u voln..

title: Noah's Dilemma [NSZ][ENG]
description:
《諾亞的困境》是一款結合了數獨與自走棋特點，以佈局與培養爲核心玩法的策略型Roguelike遊戲。本作在注重玩法的同時也致力於提供一個獨特的基於“諾亞方舟”故事的航海冒險體驗。

■ 遊戲時長
一次成功的挑戰通常需要2到5小時，而初次通關則通常需要5到10次左右這樣的嘗試。

■ 組建動物船隊
踏上你的旅程，召集沿途的動物，因爲它們就是你的船員。掌握並充分利用它們的航海能力，將你的方舟變成追風的快船。

■ 探索野生島嶼
在隨機生成的地圖上航行，悉數探索途經的島嶼，溫泉、祭壇、村莊、寶藏…… 島上仍有更多的未知等待着被你發現。

■ 對抗珊瑚惡種
珊瑚惡種是對大洪水後湧現而出的敵對生物的總稱。如遇襲擊，你需要指揮你的動物船員來抵禦它們對方舟執着的入侵。

■ 征服四海之巔
大洪水重塑後的世界被劃分爲四片海域，各由一位強大的首領鎮守。你能否最終擊敗所有敵人，將方舟上的動物帶往應許之地，成爲縱橫四海的征服者？

■ 結束亦是開始
在踏破四海之後，將會解鎖新的可玩角色、更爲艱鉅的試煉、以及專爲深度玩家設計的挑戰模式。本作旨在提供給所有玩家新鮮有趣的10小時遊玩體驗，而對於那些想要踏破、探索、收集和掌握所有內容的玩家，本作的樂趣將會更加持久。

■ 遊戲特色
- 四片待征服的海域，每片海域都有各自的特色以及首領。
- 三位可選角色，每個角色將適配不同的遊玩風格及水平。
- 超過50種生物，從熟悉的哺乳動物到可怖的深海生物。
- 超過50種隨機事件將會隨機交織在你的冒險之中。
- 超過50種動物天性和異常狀態，收穫與風險常伴。
- 超過50種動物特效，提供充分的組合協同可能性。
- 超過150種旨在激發不同策略與流派的物品和遺物。
- 專爲深度玩家設計的6種試煉與10個等級的挑戰模式。

title: Bunny Battle Nemesis [NSZ][ENG]
description:
科幻、嗜血的兔子，以及女神的力量盡在你掌握之中。這就是 Bunny Battle Nemesis。對抗復仇的半神與其傭兵大軍，保護兔子王國。

包含兔子領主：與兔子領主並肩作戰。為了更好的明天，今天殺戮吧。

Bunny Battle Nemesis 提供充滿挑戰性的街機風格體驗，包含激烈戰鬥、本地合作與混亂的遊戲玩法。精通戰鬥系統，成為真正的連擊野獸，與擁有獨特技能的英雄們共同對抗敵人浪潮。自訂並升級角色，帶來更大破壞力。

擁有鮮豔誇張的美術風格與可永遠戰鬥的無限模式。探索兔子王國的多樣環境，揭開 DCF Universe（DCF 宇宙）的神秘面紗。

title: Dragon Eclipse [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Okunites v volshebnyy mir mificheskikh sushchestv i drevnikh drakonov v Dragon Eclipse — novoy zakhvatyvayushchey kollektsionnoy kartochnoy igre! Raskroyte tayny zatmeniya, izmenivshego vsyo, i otkroyte dlya sebya opasnyy i kovarnyy mir, kotoryy vas zhdyot.
Issleduyte yarkiy i zakhvatyvayushchiy mir, napolnennyy velichestvennymi sushchestvami, s kotorymi vy mozhete srazhatsya, priruchat, lovit i obuchat. U kazhdogo sushchestva est koloda kart, kotoruyu vy mozhete ispolzovat v boyu, i spetsialnye sposobnosti, predlagayushchie beskonechnye takticheskie vozmozhnosti dlya osvoeniya. Igra delitsya na dve chereduyushchiesya fazy:
Vyberite svoego Ukrotitelya, obedinites s mogushchestvennymi Mistlingami i srazhaytes s yarostnymi vragami. Razvivayte i razvivayte svoikh sushchestv, sozdavayte pobednuyu kolodu i ispolzuyte epicheskie kombo, chtoby dominirovat na pole boya.
No budte ostorozhny — Zatmenie blizko!..

title: EmyLiveShow Dangers and Mysteries Tale, King of Desires [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
description:
Vy kogda-nibud mechtali nayti khoroshuyu kompaniyu dlya nastolnykh rolevykh igr? Sozdat kompaniyu smelykh i bezrassudnykh devushek, kotorye pobezhdayut svoikh sopernits siloy lyubvi i vozhdeleniya? Soblaznit drakona vmesto togo, chtoby srazhatsya? EmyLiveShow: Dragon & Mistresses Tale mozhet voplotit eti mechty v realnost! Pogruzites v mir fentezi i provedite po nemu trekh iskateley priklyucheniy. Srazhaytes s monstrami, zavodite romany s ocharovatelnymi neznakomtsami, nakhodite mogushchestvennye artefakty. Spasite mir i ne zabudte poblagodarit svoego geymmeystera v kontse zanyatiya!
Nastolnaya rolevaya igra v zhanre vizualnogo romana, v kotoroy ispolzuetsya mekhanika brosaniya kubikov.
Syuzhet razvivaetsya po dvum parallelnym liniyam. Devushki za stolom obsuzhdayut sobytiya, prepirayutsya i pytayutsya vyudit spoylery u vedushchego igry vo vremya rolevoy igry. Pomogite im vypolnit zadanie mirno ili zhestoko! Ispytayte svoyu udachu. Brosok kostey opredelit iskhod vashikh deystviy, no istoriya v lyubom sluchae prodolzhitsya. Inogda interesnee poterpet neudachu, chem dobitsya uspekha! Vooruzhite svoikh iskateley priklyucheniy. Pravilnoe snaryazhenie mozhet pomoch, kogda zhrebiy ne na vashey storone. No smotrite vnimatelno, nekotorye iz etikh artefaktov proklyaty... Naslazhdaytes raznoobraziem goryachikh stsen na lyuboy vkus. Ne zabyvayte o malenkikh udovolstviyakh, dazhe kogda mir v opasnosti. Poznakomtes poblizhe s Emi, Nia, Umoy i Siks!
Ot russkikh razrabotchikov.Eshchyo vizualnykh novell na Switch (renpy).

title: Mowing and Throwing [NSP][ENG]
description: Ispolzuyte gazonnykh gnomov, chtoby kosit travu na svoyom zadnem dvore i kidat veshchi! Udivitelno veselo!

title: Hell is Other Demons [NSZ][ENG]
description:
A Fast-Paced Bullet Hell Platformer with Big Pixels
---
This arcade shooter is driven by quick, creative gameplay that rewards fast decision making and faster reflexes.

A Hell of a Campaign
---
Jump into the hooves of a demon out to kill a bunch of other demons as you progress through an extensive campaign and dominate wonderfully over-the-top bosses. Accumulate an arsenal of powerful weapons and upgrades as you take on varied and brutal challenges.

Endless Challenges
---
Fans of classic, high-score based arcade games will find a cozy home in Arcade Mode, which offers unlimited, procedurally generated action and infinite replayability. Nothing is stopping you from topping your high score except thousands of bloodthirsty demons.

The Best Bleeps and Boops
---
Hell is Other Demons’ bold colors and chunky pixels are backed up by a heavy synthwave soundtrack composed by Rémi Gallego, of The Algorithm, and retro sound effects by Magnus Pålsson.

title: The Wanderer Frankenstein's Creature [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
A fresh look at the myth of Frankenstein
Play as the Creature, a wanderer without memory or past, a virgin spirit in a completely fabricated body. To forge the destiny of this artificial being who is ignorant of both Good and Evil, you will have to explore the vast world and experience joy and sorrow.
Dr. Frankenstein's founding myth is once again revealed in all its glory through the innocent eyes of his creature. A thousand miles from the horror stories, here is a sensitive wander in the shoes of a pop icon.
 
A breathtaking artistic direction
Imbued with a dark romanticism, the game's universe draws its astonishing beauty from 19th century paintings. Through evolving landscapes, the boundary between reality and fiction fades and the novel comes to life. Powerful and original, the soundtrack highlights the Creature's feelings of wanderlust.
 
Explore your emotions and write your story
One choice after another, feel your way towards your destiny. Confronted with humans, you will no longer be able to escape the question of your origins. Who gave you life? This introspective quest will take you on an adventure across Europe. Bitter or pleasant, your experiences will bring you closer to the truth. Will you be ready to face it?
 
The Wanderer: Frankenstein's Creature is the new video game from La Belle Games, co-produced and published by ARTE, the cultural European TV and digital channel.

Features
Rediscover a pop culture icon through 18 paintings, in a narrative game 
Your actions will shape the end of your story, choose carefully
Landscapes evolve according to the creature's emotions
A unique atmosphere thanks to a staggering soundtrack

title: Idol Manager [NSP][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
Vy berete na sebya rol menedzhera v nebolshom (no rastushchem!) agentstve talantov. Po mere togo, kak vy vospityvaete i obuchaete novoe pokolenie molodykh pop-zvezd, vam pridetsya reshat, kogo nanyat, a kogo uvolit, kogo povysit, a kogo nakazat vygovorom. Lichnaya zhizn etikh yunykh znamenitostey — chast vashego biznesa, a zhizn pop-zvezdy ne vsegda svetla i raduzhna. Ikh lichnye dostizheniya mogut stat vashim velichayshim kommercheskim uspekhom, no ikh emotsionalnye sryvy i piar-koshmary mogut obernutsya finansovoy katastrofoy dlya vashey kompanii.
Vy dolzhny bespokoitsya ne tolko ob idolakh. Mir polon zhurnalnykh spleten, otchayannykh fanatov i sopernichayushchikh grupp, zhazhdushchikh uznat o poslednem skandale. Est mnogo lyudey, kotorye khotyat navredit vam i gotovy igrat gryazno, no ne dayte etomu sebya odolet. Nichego lichnogo, eto prosto biznes.

Preodoleyte razlichnye prepyatstviya i sozdayte s nulya luchshee agentstvo aydolov v Yaponii!

title: Under the Warehouse [NSZ][ENG]
description:
在一座無名的城市中，一棟水泥與磚造的陰暗倉庫深藏在這座都市叢林。倉庫裡充滿了箱子、文件、電器與各式各樣充滿謎團的員工，而卻沒有人在意這裡神祕詭異的氣氛。在《Under the Warehouse》這款第一人稱冒險遊戲中，你將化身為一名接到求助電話的員工。

打電話給你的人需要藏在倉庫某處的一顆蛋。為了找出蛋的下落，你必須與其他員工交談、尋找線索、收集道具、並用經典的點擊冒險模式來解謎，探索最黑暗的角落。各種不同的結局在等著你，這場超現實的冒險將考驗你的智慧，你的好奇心也會獲得回報……前提是你有勇氣踏進此地。

特色：

• 在神祕的公司裡體驗現代風格的黑暗冒險！
• 在客戶的要求下尋找一顆特殊的蛋。
• 從第一人稱角度與同事交流和解謎！
• 透過經典的點擊冒險模式來探索周遭環境。
• 你的抉擇將決定你的結局！

title: Mezmeratu [NSZ][ENG]
description: MEZMERATU！一款完全地獄風格的2D盜賊式平台遊戲！每次遊玩時世界都會改變！所以忘記記憶關卡吧！每次都是全新的！Mezmeratu是Jacob Jazz獨立創作的Baobabs Mausoleum傳奇系列的平台遊戲衍生作。充滿超現實恐怖村莊、發臭的說話角色、不可能的盜賊平台，還有...一條巨魚被綁架在貓頭鷹的喙中。歡迎來到PROSCIUTTO MISA！

title: PixelJunk Scrappers Deluxe [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
在《PixelJunk Scrappers Deluxe》中清理「垃圾城」的街道，把擋路的人都丟進垃圾車！

化身為機器清道夫小隊「Scrappers」，努力清理近未來的骯髒城市。獨自打掃街道，或是組成最多四名玩家的終極小隊。在垃圾城，時間就是金錢，所以你以可以把垃圾在手中堆高高再扔給隊友，以此提高效率，進而贏得更優渥的報酬。

清運垃圾只是工作的其中一部分！
你會遭遇敵對機器人的攻擊和干擾，因此請在不影響工作效率的前提下，把它們一起報廢吧。團隊合作是將效率催到極致、贏得最多分數的關鍵，並可藉此解鎖新角色和自訂選項。

主要特色：
- 在混亂的街頭鬥毆中與敵對清道夫作戰
- 探索五個各具獨特主題而生氣蓬勃的區域，總共包含超過 25 個關卡
- 掌握迅捷狂暴的垃圾清運技術，可以單打獨鬥或組成最多四名玩家的隊伍
- 支援線上和本機合作遊戲
- 多種戰鬥風格等你駕馭，還有各式各樣的近戰和遠程武器供你解鎖
- 用超過 100 種獨一無二的自訂零件自定義你的垃圾車
- 解鎖並招募各式各樣的 Scrapper
- 在有趣又競爭刺激的迷你遊戲中挑戰你的朋友
- 令人沈浸其中的賽博龐克世界，以真實世界的日本為靈感，並採用普普藝術風格繪製

《PixelJunk Scrappers Deluxe》是由 Q-Games 開發的新遊戲，該公司也是傳奇《PixelJunk》系列、《Star Fox Command》、《X-Returns》等眾多經典遊戲的開發商！

title: Delirium [NSP][ENG]
description: Pikantnoe graficheskoe priklyuchenie v stile point-and-click ot pervogo litsa, v kotorom my upravlyaem podrostkom-buntarem Loloy. Kak i Lola, nashey glavnoy zadachey budet pobeg iz Delirium vmeste s ee yo bratom-chudakom Denni, kotoryy budet soprovozhdat nas vo vremya priklyucheniya.

title: Hungry Meem + 3 DLC [NSZ][ENG]
developer: Drecom Co., Ltd. 株式会社ドリコム
description:
Mimy — ocharovatelnye sozdaniya, kotorye lyubyat est, spat i igrat. V khode igry razvivayutsya, menyayut vneshniy vid, izuchayut novye navyki i nakhodyat paru. Raznoobrazie kombinatsiy beskonechno, a vy mozhete sozdavat osobennykh personazhey, i obustraivat dlya nikh komfortnuyu zhizn.
Milaya istoriya o sushchestvakh, kotorye zhivut pod Mirovym Derevom. Magicheskiy gorshok, sposobnyy gotovit lyubuyu pishchu, razrushen, i teper Mimam ugrozhaet ischeznovenie. Pomogayte sushchestvam vosstanovit poselenie, uluchshit usloviya zhizni i vyrastit Mirovoe Derevo, pozvolyayushchee issledovat novye territorii.
Vizualno igra vyglyadit krasochno i obeshchaet geympley s elementami issledovaniya. Stroyte zdaniya, sobirayte resursy i razvivayte poseleniya, pomogaya Mimam obresti schaste i radost!..

title: Outrun (原生移植版 cannonball-nx) [NSP][ENG]
description:
Out Run (yap. アウトラン, Auto Ran), takzhe izvestnaya kak OutRun i Outrun — avtosimulyator 1986 goda, razrabotannyy Yu Sudzuki i Sega AM2 iznachalno dlya rynka videoarkad. Vposledstvii igra byla portirovana na mnogie drugie populyarnye platformy. V retrospektivnykh intervyu Yu Sudzuki nazyval Out Run «ne gonochnoy, a voditelskoy igroy».
Igrok upravlyaet voditelem, sidyashchim za Ferrari Testarossa (prototip Testarossa Ferrari Mythos), kotoryy edet so svoey lyubimoy svetlovolosoy podrugoy. Nachinaya poezdku po Kokosovomu plyazhu, on dolzhen proekhat cherez chetyre kontrolnykh tochki za zadannoe vremya.
V moment svoego vypuska igra byla unikalna vozmozhnostyu vybora puti dvizheniya. Pered kazhdoy kontrolnoy tochkoy est razvilka, kotoraya dayot vozmozhnost igroku vybrat odin iz dvukh putey (podobnaya vetvyashchayasya sistema takzhe ispolzovalas v igre TX-1 Atari/Tatsumi 1983 goda, no v toy igre vybor chetvyortogo puti opredelyal i pyatyy put).

title: Lumini [NSZ][ENG]
description:
消失了數千年的痕跡，單純的生物種族被稱為Lumini回到了他們的家園。可悲的是，這不是好的時間，星球的平衡發生了變化，曾經溫和的環境變成了敵對狀態。只有Lumini自己才能恢復平衡並幫助恢復長期休眠的種族，保護子孫後代的未來。

在這種輕鬆的流動式冒險中探索Lumini的家園世界，克服障礙並確保團隊的安全，同時收集地球的能量以帶回你倒下的戰友。拆分並改革你的團隊，發展並發現新能力，帶領Lumini重拾過去的輝煌……

特色：

•順其自然–旨在成為有史以來最輕鬆的遊戲之一，具有悠閒的遊戲玩法和舒緩的配樂。
•更好的在一起–收集能量並利用它來令Lumini團隊成長，然後分成兩個團隊以解決難題及克服障礙。
•自然選擇–群體越大，Lumini進化得越多，獲得更多的能力；聲納，助推，防禦移動及更多。

title: Light Fairytale (Ep. 1-2) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Light Fairytale is a turn-based Japanese-style RPG series set in a dying underground world ruled by an evil empire.

The goal of this project is to bring back the immersion and emotion of 90's era JRPGs on current platforms with the expected evolution in both design and technique.

Episode 1 is the start of the adventure. Play as Haru and his childhood friend Kuroko as they fight a dark empire in the underground 'Lower City'.

Characters

Haru
A bit lazy and a lot naive, Haru nonetheless is a kind soul and knows how to handle himself if push comes to shove.

Kuroko
She might be short and cute (sometimes), but don't let that fool you: Kuroko is exceedingly capable in battle and always willing to step up. She's also fond of technology - maaaybe a bit too much so.

Notes about the Light Fairytale series
Each episode is a standalone game, approximately 2 to 3 hours long for a first play-through, double it for a full completion of all the achievements and secrets.

About neko.works
neko.works (neko dot works) is a one person indie game studio from France making modern renditions of classic concepts.

title: LiEat [NSZ][ENG]
description:
LiEat是一款日系RPG遊戲，內容敘述一位情報屋兼詐欺師的主角──Leo（里歐）(通稱)，與被他保護的龍少女──Efina，在各式各樣的小鎮裡一邊買賣情報，一邊尋找關於他們自身的真相。
在旅行的過程中，他們會遇到充滿謎團的案件，還有各種不好應付的登場人物（包括龍）。玩家將會了解到主角們過往、以及他們是如何走到今日的歷程。

・重視劇情的日系RPG風格。
・有多首如實表現了世界觀的BGM，讓玩家能沉浸在LiEat的世界裡。
・有隱藏道具和限定事件等等的全破要素。
・三合一的超值合集。

title: Lair Land Story [NSZ][ENG]
developer: Arc System Works, Initory Studio, CIRCLE Ent.
description:
Kogda Gerol nakhodit Chiliyu, tainstvennuyu volshebnuyu devushku, spasshuyu ego razrushennyy voynoy gorod ot razrusheniya, ona, kazhetsya, poteryala vsyakuyu pamyat o svoem geroicheskom podvige. Ne pomnya o ee prezhney zhizni i silakh, on reshaet vzyat ee k sebe. Teper vy, kak Gerol, dolzhny vospityvat Chiliyu v techenie chetyrekh let, planirovat ee povsednevnuyu zhizn i pomogat ey razvivat kharakter i navyki! 

Klyuchevye osobennosti.

- Planiruyte den Chilii. Sostavte ee raspisanie v sootvetstvii s ee sezonnymi tselyami ili predpochitaemymi kharakteristikami. Kakie by zadachi ili zanyatiya ona ni brala na sebya, eto povliyaet na to, kakim chelovekom ona stanet. Sledite za tem, chtoby ne utomit i ne naskuchit ey, ot etogo mozhet postradat ee uspevaemost vo vremya zanyatiy ili raboty. 
- Raskroyte tayny proshlogo ee Chilii. Ne imeya vospominaniy o svoem proshlom, teper vy dolzhny pomoch Chilii vspomnit, kto ona i otkuda. Dolzhna zhe byt prichina, po kotoroy Boginya odarila ee svoimi blagosloveniyami. 
- Naydite nastoyashchuyu lyubov. Vospitanie rebenka mozhet byt nelegkim delom, poetomu ne zabyvayte iskat i svoe sobstvennoe schaste. Vy mozhete nayti lyubov v samykh neozhidannykh mestakh ili s temi lyudmi, kotorykh menshe vsego ozhidaete, ved nekotorye druzya ili "vragi" mogut prevratitsya v lyubovnikov. 
- Otpravlyaytes v gorod. Nuzhno otdokhnut ot napryazhennoy raboty strazhnika? Pochemu by ne issledovat korolevstvo i ne poznakomitsya s ego zhitelyami? Provedite vremya na ploshchadi, u dvortsovykh vorot ili otdokhnite v bare, a esli vam zakhochetsya izmenit vneshnost, otpravlyaytes v salon krasoty i shveynuyu masterskuyu! Kto znaet, kogo vy vstretite, i kakie priklyucheniya zhdut vas za predelami vashego doma? 
- Pomogite Lair Land.  Voyna zakonchilas, no korolevstvo eshche ne vosstanovilos. Pomogite obshchestvennosti Lair Land vosstanovit gorod i ego dostoprimechatelnosti, poka zhiteli medlenno opravlyayutsya ot poter, s kotorymi im prishlos stolknutsya. Osteregaytes, voyna, vozmozhno, i zakonchilas, no zlo vse eshche taitsya, i monarkhiya, pokhozhe, v opasnosti.

title: More Dark [NSZ][RUS/Multi3]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 3]
description:
Posle togo, kak Povelitel Potustoronnego mira ushel v otpusk, ego rukovodstvo bylo vremenno perenyato miloy docheryu Evilinoy, i posledoval khaos. Vse proklyatye uzniki sbezhali iz svoikh tyurem i zateryalis po vsemu korolevstvu, razrushaya khrupkiy mir vladychestva dyavola.

Tvoya zadacha - navesti poryadok v Adu, zagnat sbezhavshikh prestupnikov v kamery i ochistit kazhduyu oblast karty ot khaosa i anarkhii. Smozhesh li ty spasti Ad i, vozmozhno, poluchit neslabuyu nagradu?

Kharakteristiki:
* 60 urovney
* Raznoobraznaya mekhanika
* Spryatannye klyuchi dlya razblokirovki shlyap
* Mrachnaya, stilnaya pikselnaya grafika
* Muzyka v stile retro

title: Sir Happenlance and the Spear of Density [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
developer: Miles Fogle, Phillip Trudeau-Tavara, Cyborg Primate
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description: 攀登高山，刺穿數百名敵人，並解決棘手的物理難題……所有這些都只使用長矛。在這場史詩般的格鬥遊戲冒險中，撐竿跳高自己取得勝利！

title: Hop Squash (HopSquash, Jump 'n Bump) [NSZ][ENG]
description: Up to 8 kids and adults can SQUASH each other the most times to win! Controllers can be shared between two people, doubling the amount of simultaneous players! Enjoy a variety of levels, with different music and themes, and add computer-controlled opponents to enhance the chaos or use them to play alone and build up your skills!

title: Blacksmith Hit [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Become the ultimate blacksmith in BlackSmith HIT, an exclusive and captivating arcade game for Nintendo Switch™. Immerse yourself in an ultra-realistic hammering experience, featuring stunning graphics, incredible animations, and intuitive controls. Hammer the red iron, discard the cold ones, and unlock amazing rewards as you progress through new levels.
Prepare to unleash your inner strength and experience tremendous satisfaction in BlackSmith HIT. Only if you have what it takes to be a real blacksmith, your hammer awaits. Seize it and embark on a smashing adventure! This game is tailored for passionate and competitive players, offering a wealth of excitement and challenges.

Establish your name among the world's finest blacksmiths, with each swing of your hammer taking you closer to greatness.

While the concept may sound simple, BlackSmith HIT offers an addictive and engaging gameplay experience. Your task is to hit and catch, but there's a twist. Maintain the anvil at the optimal temperature by skilfully tossing the grey iron bars over your shoulder with the pliers in hand.
Collect as many real gold horseshoes as possible and strive for the highest number of successful strikes. Your progress unlocks a vast array of possibilities in the blacksmithing world. Conquer exciting challenges to unlock 20 unique and expertly crafted blacksmith characters, each with their own captivating storylines and specialized scenes.

Features:
- Prove yourself as the best blacksmith in the world
Immerse in astonishing graphics, stunning animations, and a splendid soundtrack
- Choose from 20 awesome characters and their tailored scenes
- Earn gold horseshoes and decide how to spend them
- Experience addictive and intuitive gameplay mechanics
- Share your best scores and showcase your blacksmithing skills to the world

Don't wait any longer. Gear up, unleash your inner Thor, grab your hammer, and prove that you're worthy of the title of a true blacksmith. It's time to HIT LIKE A BLACKSMITH!

title: Sausage Bundle Till the last drop of ketchup: Run Sausage Run / Sausage Wars [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Enjoy your short life as a hot dog playing SOLO or with FRIENDS! (up to 8 players)

- Play as the tasty sausage of your choice. Weisswurst or blutwurst, bacon or chocolate… even president or ninja!

- Run for your life and avoid getting sliced, chopped, burned, or smashed in this adventure run game!

- Tons of juicy sausages to choose from and tons of hot dog skins to enjoy in this adventure run.

- Compare the speed of your wursts in a classic Sausage Race or outrun a giant land mower in Panic Race! 

This adventure run is a hot dog’s dream - or nightmare - depending on how well you do.

title: Knight Out (Knightout) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
描述：
KnightOut是一款適合1-4名玩家的聚會爭鬥遊戲！
在一場瘋狂的戰鬥中與你的朋友一起玩或對戰。
一半的戰鬥是通過建立一個史詩般的城堡與致命的武器和陷阱來贏得。
沖進刀劍決鬥或用遠距離武器保持距離。

戰鬥：
每場比賽開始時，兩隊都要建造一個裝有大炮的城堡。然後，所有的地獄都開始了! 炮彈飛舞，石牆崩塌，你的騎士在草地上揮舞著他的劍。當你摧毀了對手的基地，並將裡面的國王或皇后K.O.，你就贏得了這一輪。你需要三個K.O.來贏得比賽。每一輪結束後，你可以重建你的城堡。

故事：
通過幾個關卡進行遊戲，在擴大你的武器庫時擊敗敵人。這個遊戲模式是單人遊戲或合作遊戲。你將在布拉爾王國開始你的冒險，並穿越其他王國，因為你在每個關卡後獲得蛋糕以解鎖新的世界。它的特點是有一個可愛的故事，有身臨其境的電影剪輯。
	
拱廊：
保衛你的城堡，對抗一波又一波的敵人，單人遊戲或與你最好的朋友合作。在我們光榮的排行榜上比較你和世界其他地方的表現。當你擊敗敵人時，敵人會掉落黃金。每一波攻擊過後，黃金可以用來升級你的城堡。

特色：
2至4人的戰鬥 - 在本地多人遊戲中與你的朋友對戰或合作。
建立一個巨大的城堡 - 發揮你的創造力，建立你自己的城堡。
近戰戰鬥 - 簡單易學卻難以掌握。
提高你的武器庫 - 用16種物品建立不同的武器和防禦系統，供你選擇。
由Mike Raznick (Rachet & Clank, Oddworld: Abe's Oddyess - New "N" Tasty) 原創配樂。
風格化的充滿活力的藝術風格
大量華麗的解鎖功能

title: Nippon Marathon [NSZ][ENG]
description:
一！二！三！出發！！！
拉伸肌肉，開始這場終極日本馬拉松大賽。
在這款十分瘋狂，基於物理演算，四人聚會型競賽遊戲中，一切皆有可能！
障礙桶，跑得比誰都快的柴犬，衝出小徑的自行車，而與此同時奔跑在賽道上的你需要朝著對手砸水果，衝過架在瀑布上方並不穩定的木板，
在這虛幻的設定中你會感到真實的樂趣！

title: Button Button Up [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Button Button Up! is a platforming adventure game that combines single player, co-op and competitive battle modes. You’ll also realise that buttons have some unique and clever abilities to help you through each challenge! 

There are lots of useful skills to solve puzzles and clear hazards, like sewing buttons in the air to lock into a platform, kicking other buttons for vital momentum, and blocking dangerous lasers of the same color as yourself. Button Button Up! will test your reflexes and puzzles solving skills!

In the solo campaign you tackle four chapters, each introducing a new character and a unique challenge. Checkpoints make any failures easy to handle, and when you gather materials you’re able to purchase collectables and cool customisations for your characters.

The co-op campaign includes unique levels specially designed for two players, but you can tackle them solo for an extra challenge. Play with one Joy-Con™ each so that you can play with a friend at any time, working together to get through tricky stages.

Finally, you can head into the VS mode for some fun battles with up to 4 local players. Stand your ground in Base battles or try to be the last standing in Survival as Buttons go head to head!

Features:

●	Three fun modes for solo, co-op or competitive play.

title: Summertime Madness [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Igrok v roli khudozhnika zaklyuchil sdelku s dyavolom i byl obmanut, teper on dolzhen popytatsya vernutsya v realnyy mir iz kartiny, v kotoroyu byl pomeshchen. Skazochnoe puteshestvie v syurrealisticheskiy mir sobstvennykh tvoreniy khudozhnika, gde atmosfernyy igrovoy protsess sostoit iz resheniya zagadok i golovolomok, i issledovaniya khudozhestvennykh peyzazhey.

GEYMPLEY
Vy popadaete na evolyutsioniruyushchiy ostrov.Ostrov menyaetsya po mere ego issledovaniya. Poyavlenie korablya, podem mayaka, kazhdaya raskrytaya vami zagadka otkryvaet novye chudesa i mesta dlya issledovaniya. No preduprezhdaem srazu, eto zakhvatyvayushchee dukh krasochnoe mesto, v kotorom vy okazalis, ne vsegda yavlyaetsya tem, chem mozhet pokazatsya. Etot intriguyushchiy kartinnyy mir soderzhit dazhe bolshe zagadok, chem zadumyval sam khudozhnik.

ISTORIYa
Praga
20 iyulya 1945 g.

Razrushennyy voynoy gorod.
Razrushennye zdaniya, sgorevshie tserkvi, i vse dolzhno bylo byt smyto s litsa zemli navsegda. Zdes zhivet izolirovannyy ot vneshnego mira khudozhnik. Chem uzhasnee stanovilis posledstviya voyny, tem bolshey oderzhimostyu on risoval prekrasnye peyzazhi, kontrastiruyushchie s uzhasami za oknom. Odnazhdy nochyu v dome poyavilas zagadochnaya figura, kazalos by, iz niotkuda. Neznakomets medlenno oboshel komnatu, osmatrivaya kartiny. Zatem on sel pered khudozhnikom i predlozhit emu sdelku: vozmozhnost voyti v odno iz ego sobstvennykh tvoreniy, podalshe ot voyny. No neobkhodimo budet nayti vykhod obratno do polunochi, inache ego dusha okazhetsya v lovushke navsegda. Chuvstvuya sebya odinokim, na grani bezumiya, terroriziruemyy zapakhom smerti, pronikayushchim s ulits, khudozhnik pozhal ruku tainstvennomu muzhchine, prinimaya sdelku.
Cherez neskolko mgnoveniy dom opustel.

KLYuChEVYE OSOBENNOSTI
- Unikalnyy khudozhestvennyy stil i syurrealistichnaya atmosfera
- Podborka khitrykh golovolomok, kotorye ispytayut vashu nakhodchivost
- Postoyanno menyayushchiysya mir, kotoryy razvivaetsya po mere prodvizheniya
- Skrytye tayny

description:
Unsheathe your sword and journey through a realm filled with monsters, traps and treasures! Defeat monster mobs, slay bosses, hoard treasure and upgrade your sword, shield and armor. Follow your trousers to the world's end and claim what is rightfully yours! Trouserheart is all about fun, instantly accessible, pick up and play hack'n'slash gameplay with playful art style and humorous tone. The game offers two difficulty levels and even an optional perma-death mode for the bravest of adventurers!

- Meet peculiar enemies
- Hoard treasures
- Upgrade your sword, shield and armor

- Explore exciting environments

title: Symphonic Rain [NSZ][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
當標題是由工畫堂工作室開發的代表性作品，於2004年以PC套裝軟體的形式在日本發行，不僅在日本國內，甚至在全世界範圍內都擁有一部分熱情的粉絲。
在2017年，這款遊戲以擴大畫面尺寸並全方位重製畫面效果的《交響樂之雨 HD重製版》重新登場。而現在，它首次登陸Nintendo Switch™平台。
遊戲類型基於玩家熟悉的文字冒險遊戲，但融入了一個特色亮點：在某些場景中玩家需要按下控制器的按鍵來演奏樂器，增加了動作性的趣味元素。

故事的舞台設置在一座「永不停歇降雨」的小鎮「琵歐伯」。這是一個音樂之城，吸引著懷抱音樂家夢想的年輕人們匯聚於此。
主角庫裡斯-霍爾頓是一名魔法樂器「符德魯琴」的演奏者，立志成為一名出色的「符德魯琴演奏家」。他就讀於這座城市的象徵——琵歐伯音樂學院。
時光流逝，季節已進入冬天……再過幾個月，庫裡斯就要畢業了。然而，作為畢業課題，他必須與一名夥伴合作，演奏一首「原創曲目」。
究竟庫裡斯能否順利找到自己的夥伴，共同完成「原創曲目」的演奏呢？這是一個與同樣就讀於音樂學院的女主角們互動、並共同奏響美麗音符的故事。

本作的劇本由以細膩的心理描寫與精心構築的故事聞名的「西川真音」撰寫。故事的世界觀以及圍繞「雨」這一主題創作的歌曲，皆由創作型歌手「岡崎律子」負責，她的音樂儘顯纖細、哀婉且動人的美感。  
角色圖像則由以柔和色調與溫暖筆觸打動眾多粉絲的插畫家「SIRO」繪製。  
這款經典的PC遊戲作品，無論時光如何流轉，其魅力依然不減，邀請您細細品味其中的感動與美好。

Help Barb win the main prize and whole family to celebrate their great trip to California!

- 25+ Levels over 8 chapters

- Bright, colorful graphics
- Fun for the whole family

title: Weeping Willow [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
description:
Weeping Willow 是一部偵探故事類的動感視覺小說，故事發生在中世紀小鎮 Weidendorf。由於這個貧窮的地方爆發瘟疫，小鎮被隔離了。

故事的開始，主角的丈夫 Von Wolf 男爵神秘地失踪了。幾天後，他在緋紅玫瑰教團的當地教區被發現，但是男爵夫人堅稱不認得她的丈夫。不過其他人相信了冒名頂替者的身份，沒有人相信男爵夫人。由於瘟疫隔離，年輕的男爵夫人變成了自己家中的俘虜，她開始常擔心自己的生命安全。而之後發生一系列戲劇性的事件，讓她的生活展開了無法轉圜的改變。

這個短篇故事精采無比，充滿心機、背叛和陰謀的情節會讓玩家非常驚艷。

遊戲特色：
- 引人入勝而且難以預測的情節
- 出其不意的結局
- 女主角
- 精彩動人的動畫角色和鉅細靡遺的背景

title: The Bonfire Forsaken Lands [NSZ][RUS/Multi16]

description: 在積雪的營地建造聚落，並通過管理工人和資源以在怪物來襲的夜晚生存下來。你會慢慢接觸到高級建築和先進工藝，發現新的文明，與他們往來交易，並發現古老的秘密。

title: The Adventures of Panzer 1-2 Legacy collection [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Voydite v epicheskiy i v to zhe vremya slegka nelepyy mir General Panzer!.. Spustya pochti desyatiletie; Legendarnyy lider reyda, general Pantser vozvrashchaetsya iz svoego zagadochnogo otpuska vmeste so svoim vernym leytenantom, tovarishchem Blargom vy vdvoyom otpravites v neveroyatnoe priklyuchenie, chtoby snova navestit svoikh starykh druzey!
Puteshestvuyte po takim lokatsiyam, kak banditskaya peshchera Mekha-Grokka, dzhungli dinozavrov i zamok chernoknizhnikov Pugny. Ispolzuyte kak fizicheskie ataki blizhnego boya, tak i magicheskie snaryady, chtoby sokrushit svoikh vragov! Srazhaytes s monstrami i mini-bossami, izbegayte letuchikh myshey i paukov, uklonyaytes ot strel i magicheskikh zaklinaniy, chtoby spasti… ili, vozmozhno, prosto pokhitit… byvshikh uchastnikov Panzer!
Pantser vozvrashchaetsya k svoey roli lidera reyda zergadinov. Postroen novyy shtab, staraya komanda sobrana i gotova k deystviyu. Prishlo novoe zlo, i chtoby pobedit ego, i potrebuetsya slazhennaya rabota vsey komandy. Na etot raz Panzer ne pridetsya srazhatsya v odinochku! K vam prisoedinyayutsya Okhotnik Kankaro s ego lukom i strelami, Ledyanoy Mag Azriaz s ee magiey lda i Bezumnyy Troll Vespeto s vzryvchatkoy!

title: Research and Destroy [NSP][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
《RESEARCH AND DESTROY》是一款回合制動作遊戲，並支援單機多人同樂。玩家需操作三名能力出色的科學家，研究並開發出奇特的新武器和裝備，以消滅迫害人類的超自然生物！

研究（RESEARCH）
透過戰鬥蒐集更多超自然生物的第一手資料，進一步研發出更多新奇有趣的強大武器與裝備！

戰鬥（DESTROY）
華麗的射擊動作要素搭配回合制的戰略思考，徹底活用每一秒！

多人遊玩模式（CO-OP）
科學家也能很時尚！替自己的科學家設計髮型與服裝，透過單機多人模式與朋友一起同樂吧！

戰役模式（CAMPAIGN）
用科學之力過關斬將，讓世界從超自然生物的支配中解放！千變萬化的通關策略讓每次遊玩都是不同體驗！

title: Starlight Drifter [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Spustya sotni let posle nachala mezhzvezdnoy epokhi, chelovechestvo teper zhivyot sredi dalyokikh zvezd. No oni byli daleko ne pervymi, mnogie zhivye sushchestva sushchestvovali i do nikh. S tekh por chelovechestvo proshlo cherez gornilo.
Stante kapitanom sobstvennogo zvezdoleta, sformiruyte svoyu komandu i naydite sobstvennyy put vo Vselennoy!
No vash novyy korabl — ne obychnoe yunkerskoe sudno, a odin iz poslednikh ostatkov I.E.R., stoletnego pravitelstva, kotoroe ischezlo, zabrav s soboy peredovye tekhnologii. Sudya po vsemu, etot korabl yavlyaetsya odnim iz poslednikh prototipov toy epokhi i osnashchen pochti mifologicheskoy sistemoy giperprivoda, kotoraya pozvolyaetm gnovenno peremeshchatsya mezhdu sistemami pryamo skvoz kvantovoe prostranstvo.
Sdelayte sebe zvyozdnoe imya i zaymite tsentralnoe mesto vo vselennoy etoy kosmicheskoy vizualnoy novelly!..Eshchyo vizualnykh novell na Switch (renpy).

Originalnaya muzyka, dopolnyayushchaya deystvie igry.

title: Table of Tales the Crooked Crown [NSP][ENG]
description:
Table of Tales: The Crooked Crown is a role playing adventure that brings tabletop gaming to life. Take a seat at the magical table, captain the helm, and lead your party of scoundrels as they venture through a world of swashbuckling and sorcery.

- Embark on a narrative-driven campaign featuring a fully-voiced Dungeon Master companion, who appears as a mechanical talking bird called Arbitrix.
- Guide a party of four scoundrels through a captivating story that is shaped by important world-changing choices!
- Battle, charm or sneak your way through more than 24 enthralling encounters.
- Tactical turn-based combat and encounters feature dice, cards, skill checks and over 40 different types of enemy.
- Each scoundrel has their own skill and stat upgrade path. Choose different abilities each time you play.
- The magical table transforms before your eyes, building new game boards and playing environments.
- Inspired by the nostalgia of classic tabletop games!

title: Train Plus + 5 DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:

若想體驗極速奔馳，就進入時速 1000 公里以上的「超爆速駕駛模式」，感受驚人的速度感！
你可以在任何地方開啟或關閉車門，用自由視角欣賞列車內外，甚至與自動行駛的列車並肩奔馳。

title: Monobot [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]

《默途》是一款基於 2D 物理的平台冒險解謎遊戲，您可以在其中控制 默途，這是一個陷入黑暗、遙遠未來的敵對世界中的小實體。你必須引導 默途完成他的單人旅程，解開謎題，揭開這個反烏托邦世界的秘密。

title: The Tenth Line SE / Eden's Last Sunrise [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Eden's Last Sunrise is a retro tactical RPG like no other. Choose between the magic-wielding surface dwellers or the high-tech spacefarers, train and befriend your troops, and choose your path as the final days of the world wind down. 

-Enjoy classic turn-based isometric tactical RPG combat with adjustable difficulty and a unique action point system that let you make the most of every turn.
-A rich story full of colourful characters and multiple story paths and endings.
-Engage with your allies personally through visual novel-like story skits. Gain their trust and unlock their personal stories as you grow closer.
-Create custom units, choose their colours/costume/voices, and lead them to victory alongside the main cast.

title: Dreamless Girl [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Dobro pozhalovat v igru, kotoraya sochetaet v sebe elementy vizualnoy novelly i adskoy strelby s shutemapom! Dnem vy budete nablyudat za shkolnoy zhiznyu glavnoy geroini s ee tochki zreniya. Nochyu vy prevrashchaetes v sekretnogo operativnika, pilotiruya "Razrushitelya snov" po razlichnym skazochnym mestam. Chtoby nayti svoyu propavshuyu sestru, glavnaya geroinya Mu Den kazhduyu noch pogruzhaetsya v raznye sny v poiskakh podskazok, kotorye ostavila ee sestra. Po puti ona vstrechaet raznykh poputchikov i postepenno raskryvaet sekrety ischeznoveniya svoey sestry.
Istoriya voploshchena v zhizn s pomoshchyu mnozhestva krasivykh kompyuternykh i 2D-animatsionnykh illyustratsiy, naglyadno pokazyvayushchikh otnosheniya mezhdu devushkami. Eti dinamichnye illyustratsii ozhivlyayut kazhdogo personazha, ot ikh povsednevnykh vzaimodeystviy do klyuchevykh syuzhetnykh momentov, obespechivaya igrokam zakhvatyvayushchiy vizualnyy opyt. Vyrazheniya lits i dvizheniya personazhey tshchatelno prorabotany, chtoby zapechatlet kazhdyy emotsionalnyy moment.
Osnovnaya mekhanika igry zaklyuchaetsya v uklonenii ot pul i zadevanii ikh. Kogda vy stalkivaetes s plotnymi pulevymi atakami, tochnoe uklonenie pozvolyaet vam bezopasno prokhodit skvoz puli. Kazhdoe uspeshnoe uklonenie i zadevanie ne tolko pozvolyaet vam izbezhat atak, no i nakaplivaet energiyu. Eta energiya mozhet byt ispolzovana dlya vysvobozhdeniya moshchnykh atakuyushchikh navykov, pereloma khoda bitvy i naneseniya sokrushitelnykh udarov po vashim vragam.
Pomimo traditsionnykh atak adskimi pulyami, v igre est razlichnye spetsialnye etapy ispytaniy. Eti etapy ne tolko proveryayut vashi operativnye navyki, no i trebuyut strategicheskogo myshleniya. Kazhdyy etap ispytaniya imeet svoy igrovoy protsess i mekhaniku; nekotorye iz nikh mogut potrebovat ot vas unichtozhit vsekh vragov za opredelennoe vremya, v to vremya kak drugie mogut poprosit vas ubit opredelennykh vragov v opredelennoe vremya i v opredelennykh mestakh. Prokhozhdenie etikh etapov pozvolyaet vam razblokirovat razlichnye moshchnye navyki, kotorye eshche bolshe rasshiryayut vozmozhnosti vashey mashiny i dayut vam znachitelnoe preimushchestvo v srazheniyakh.
Naprimer, nekotorye navyki mogut uvelichit silu vashey ataki, delaya kazhduyu ataku bolee smertonosnoy; drugie mogut povysit vashu zhivuchest, delaya vas bolee ustoychivym k silnym protivnikam. Nekotorye navyki obladayut osobymi sposobnostyami, takimi kak mgnovennoe obezvrezhivanie vsekh pul ili nanesenie udarov na bolshom rasstoyanii. Blagodarya postoyannym ispytaniyam i modernizatsiyam vasha mashina budet stanovitsya vse silnee, chto pozvolit vam protivostoyat vse bolee groznym vragam i bolee slozhnym ispytaniyam..Eshchyo vizualnye novelly / shmapy.

title: What Lies in the Multiverse [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
What Lies in the Multiverse — syuzhetnoe 2D-priklyuchenie v zhanre dramaticheskoy komedii. Nesmotrya na mnozhestvo veselykh multyashnykh shutok, syuzhet zatragivaet glubokie i slozhnye temy, v tom chisle smert, zavist i oderzhimost. 

Stoit vam otkryt vozmozhnost puteshestvovat mezhdu parallelnymi mirami, kak v multivselennoy bystro i neizbezhno nachnetsya kavardak. Vy uvidite alternativnye versii kazhdogo urovnya, kotorye razlichayutsya vneshne, tematicheski i dazhe na urovne zakonov fiziki. Pereklyuchaytes mezhdu nimi, chtoby reshat logicheskie i prostranstvennye golovolomki dlya prodvizheniya po syuzhetu. 

Mgnovennaya transformatsiya
Vsegda khoteli smenyat miry manoveniem ruki? Menyayte! Nikak ne dotyanutsya do ustupa? Bam! Vot i drugoy mir. Boites poskolznutsya? Pereydite v druguyu vselennuyu, gde zemlya potverzhe! Tolko ne zabyvayte o gravitatsii...

Raznoobrazie mirov
Otpravlyaytes v puteshestvie po mnozhestvu pikselnykh mirov, kazhdyy iz kotorykh khorosh po-svoemu. V multivselennoy vas zhdut khramy, goroda, porty i dikaya priroda.

Yarkie personazhi
Poznakomtes s neskolkimi strannymi, no neotrazimymi personazhami. Naprimer, s Everettom, vashim budushchim genialnym sputnikom. Predstavte sebe sarkastichnogo i ekstsentrichnogo Alberta Eynshteyna. Est eshche zagadochnoe sushchestvo EZ, kotoroe vse teplo vspominayut, no nikto ne mozhet opisat. I ZENIT, gruppa tainstvennykh i mrachnykh sozdaniy, vsegda dyshashchikh vam v zatylok.

Razvitie syuzheta
Khotya istoriya ostaetsya legkoy i bezzabotnoy, po mere prokhozhdeniya ona stanovitsya glubzhe. Vas zhdut nastoyashchie amerikanskie gonki smekha, radosti i pechali.

title: Empire of Angels IV [NSZ][ENG]
description:
自從該系列於1993年開始以來，《天使帝國》首次出現在遊戲機上！作為傳奇戰術RPG系列的最新作品，《天使帝國Ⅳ》畫面以3D卡通風格，策略性的回合制戰鬥，由眾多各具特色女性所組成的人物角色，全程中文語音，並附有繁體和簡體中文字幕。

《天使帝國Ⅳ》為愛斯嘉的歷史提供了全新的視角，重新建構其故事、角色和系統，無需事先瞭解就能享受這全新的冒險。以幻想為主題的深層政治陰謀和迫在眉睫的恐怖戰爭，透過輕鬆的角色互動、幽默的生活片段、誘人的角色設計以及擊破所有女性對手盔甲的能力！

一場瘟疫襲擊愛斯嘉大陸，此瘟疫會驅使普通百姓變成嗜血狂徒，為維持大陸秩序，瓦爾克麗王國的主將妮雅組成了那姆塔調查隊。有天，妮雅目睹一個閃亮的神秘光球從天而降，有鑑於愛斯嘉過往歷史，此異狀令她感到不安。在盟友與新夥伴協助下，妮雅帶領團踏上旅程，為阻止愛斯嘉大陸遭瘟疫所吞噬。

特色：

• 與眾多女戰士相遇並一同冒險。
• 以3D卡通風格呈現，進行回合制的策略戰鬥！
• 使用詳細的世界地圖遊歷愛斯嘉大陸。
• 多類型的兵種來自訂你的團隊。
• 根據你的行動發現不同的故事發展與結局！

title: Quantum Replica [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Nastupil 2084 god, i mir sklonilsya pered gruppoy korporatsiy — Sindikatom. V siyayushchem neonom gorode zhiteli paralizovany strakhom pered armiyami naemnikov i ikh gospodami. Tayny zdes prinyato tshchatelno pryatat. Tayny, kotorye nuzhno raskryt. Vy upravlyaete «Alfoy» — geroem, kotoryy ne pomnit proshlogo. 

- Neveroyatno dinamichnoe priklyuchenie v zhanre «stels», v kotorom klassicheskie shpionskie koshki-myshki a-lya Metal Gear proiskhodyat v neonovom kiberpankovom mire s puteshestviyami vo vremeni! Pryachtes v teni i manipuliruyte vremenem, chtoby odolevat protivnikov i obkhodit sistemy bezopasnosti.

- Primerte na sebya rol «Alfy» — bezhentsa, kotoryy skryvaetsya i nichego ne pomnit o sebe. Vy dolzhny proniknut v tenevuyu pravitelstvennuyu organizatsiyu, chtoby vernut svoi vospominaniya i organizovat vosstanie v gorode, chto stradaet pod pyatoy diktatora.

- Issleduyte kiberpankovyy mir i ishchite otvety na voprosy o svoem proshlom. Razblokiruyte oruzhie, ustroystva i sposobnosti, s pomoshchyu kotorykh vy budete skryvatsya, obkhodit sistemy bezopasnosti i odolevat protivnikov, kotorye stanovyatsya vsyo silnee.

- Pyat razlichnykh rayonov, v kazhdom iz kotorykh zhdut unikalnye ispytaniya i vidy. Ot gryaznykh ulits i krysh, kotorye okhranyaet politsiya, do vysokotekhnologichnykh laboratoriy so slozhnymi sistemami bezopasnosti, — preodolevayte vse prepyatstviya i budte na shag vperedi protivnika blagodarya otlichnym refleksam i ostromu umu.

- V kazhdom rayone vas zhdut surovye bossy i protivniki. Sobirayte ustroystva i menyayushchie vremya sposobnosti, chtoby nayti unikalnye strategii dlya pobedy nad vragami.

- Quantum Replica — igra-antiutopiya, v kotoroy na tyomnykh ulitsakh totalitarnogo gosudarstva vspykhivaet siyayushchiy neon, a sobytiya igrovogo protsessa smenyayut drug druga s golovokruzhitelnoy skorostyu.

title: Struggling [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Odna zhutkaya golova khorosho, a dve luchshe 
Originalnyy sovmestnyy rezhim stanet ispytaniem dlya samoy krepkoy druzhby. Igrayte s druzyami, upravlyaya odnoy iz ruk personazha. Tolko obediniv usiliya, vy smozhete sokhranit spokoystvie i chto-to sdelat, naprimer, prosto proytis.

Polzite, kachaytes, karabkaytes i skolzite k pobede
Upravlyaya kazhdoy rukoy otdelno, khvataytes za vse, chto vy vidite, – ot podozritelnykh rychagov do svisayushchikh glaznykh yablok. Prokhodite ispytaniya, osnovannye na zakonakh fiziki, vo vremya kotorykh vy mozhete lishitsya ruk (ne volnuytes, oni snova otrastut).

Strannye urovni, eshche bolee strannye prepyatstviya
Vashi stranstviya okhvatyvayut zagromozhdennye laboratorii, opasnye kanony i dazhe psikhodelicheskiy goryachechnyy son. Zatykayte svoimi konechnostyami izvergayushchie otkhody truby, pereprygivayte cherez ziyayushchie propasti i izuchayte slozhnye mekhanizmy, upravlyat kotorymi vy ne umeete.

Do smeshnogo zhutkiy videoryad
Grotesknaya grafika, budto narisovannaya levoy pyatkoy. Bogatyy vnutrenniy mir igry – ot vlazhnykh slizistykh do blestyashchikh kishok. Oshibki privodyat k telesnym povrezhdeniyam, i dosadnye oploshnosti ostavlyayut nepriglyadnye otmetiny u vas na litse.

Postoyanno mutiruyushchiy personazh
Otkryvayte razlichnye sposobnosti, v korne menyayushchie igru. Oni vklyuchayut zamedlenie vremeni, pozvolyayushchee bystro uklonitsya ot opasnostey, otdelyaemye ruki, kotorye mozhno otpravit polzat vokrug, i peresadku ploti na okruzhayushchie predmety. Reshayte golovolomki s pomoshchyu svoey razrushitelnoy DNK.

title: Fantasy General II (2) Invasion + DLC Onslaught / Empire Aflame / Evolution [NSZ][ENG]
description:
The Legacy
Fantasy General II: Invasion is the reimagination of the strategy game classic from the 90s! Armies once again draw battle-lines on the war-torn land of Keldonia, and a new generation of commanders will test their bravery and tactics against each other. Fantasy wargaming is back!
The Battles
True to the tradition of the original game, Fantasy General II is all about turn-based battles. Lead over 75 different unique unit types, including powerful heroes. Take into consideration terrain, weapons and armour, magical effects, morale, and the balance of forces, make a plan, execute it, and vanquish your enemy, forging your reputation as a savage war-leader.
The Campaign
Battle after battle, you will need to make decisions and develop your army. The young clan members will need to be trained, and as they gain enough experience, even the greenest recruits can be turned into champions. But beware: costly victories can be worse than a defeat… when battle-hardened units perish, so does their progression and experience. Each unit comes with their specific abilities, arms and armour, and they can be equipped with magic artefacts you find during battle and upgraded with gold and resources that you need to plunder from your enemy.
The Clans
A confederation of autonomous hill-land tribes, who value their independence and will fight fiercely for it. Field axemen, berserkers, spearmaidens, trolls and shamans, summon ancestor spirits and mighty elementals or train nimble stag riders and deadly werebears or recruit mercenaries from longbowmen to centaurs.
The Empire
The most powerful realm on the face of Aer. Face the mighty Legions of the Empire and their magical creations from dragon cannons to golems as well as the Undead hordes they bring to battle, or fight harpies, lizard people and great dragons on your way.
The World
The world of Aer is filled with beauty and wonders. From the cold, magic-rich highlands of Fareach, home to the player’s Barbarian Clans, to the Borderlands with their fertile river valleys and deep woods where witches and monsters still roam free; from the Sunken Land, submerged through a great Cataclysm and filled with treacherous swamp and Lizardfolk, to the refined and temperate Empire to the South, home to wondrous cities and built upon undead labour. Your campaign will see you fight across very different battlefields, requiring variable tactics and army composition.

title: Simona's Requiem [NSZ][ENG]
description: 西蒙娜的安魂曲是一款復古畫素風平臺遊戲，靈感來自於老派動作冒險遊戲，但融合了現代的新玩法。你就是西蒙娜，拿起你的鐮刀，揮刀斬棘，尋找藏在月亮之後的費舍爾國王。

title: Savage Halloween [NSZ][ENG]
description:
每年，怪物都會被邀請參加 24 小時的萬聖節狂歡，但這一次沒有人回家，因為一個邪惡的吸血鬼使用咒語阻止了回到來世的通道，因為據他說，派對無法停止。
賓客中，被打斷了永眠的農夫詹姆斯拿起了獵槍，決定平息騷亂。
加入抵抗運動，把每個人都送回家。再也沒有人能夠處理這麼多的噪音、粘液和衣服上的狼人毛髮了。

人物
詹姆斯：生活中，脾氣暴躁的農民；在來世，他仍然心情不好，現在也武裝了；
露露：狼人，不知道自己是男人夢到自己是狗，還是狗夢到自己是人；
多米尼卡：參加聚會的黑魔王的女兒，多米尼卡是一個來自深處的極客，她迫切想回家看她最喜歡的系列。

遊戲玩法
拍攝具有不同遊戲玩法和機制的 7 個場景，從乘坐女巫的掃帚飛行到搭便車在企鵝背上。

特徵
