具有經典力學的2D平台；
向8個方向射擊；
本地多人遊戲；
3個具有個性的可玩角色；
史詩般多樣的 Boss 戰；
各種奇怪的鏡頭。

選擇你的怪物並向敵人發射子彈！

title: Golden Warden [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Golden Warden以被生成為雙陸棋風格的魔域為舞台，是一款Roguelike冒險遊戲。

選擇與骰子融合在一起的行動卡，驅使劍、魔法、弓、炸彈、雷筒等等攻擊手段向每次進入都會發生變化的魔域發起挑戰。
在冒險中進行各種升級，消費金幣強化武器，戰勝或躲避敵人，在魔域的最深處獲得被黃金監視者把守的寶藏吧。

行動卡:
移動與攻擊被融合在同一張行動卡當中，每回合允許選擇1枚。請深思熟慮，選擇突破困境的最佳卡牌。

方格構成的魔域:
魔域內部由擁有各種效果的方格構成。靈活運用方格帶來的各種輔助效果，將敵人統統幹掉！

千變萬化的遊戲套路:
隨著冒險的繼續，升級與新武器也會漸漸地給通關方式帶來變化。發掘最適合自己的戰術，向魔域最深處邁進吧。

title: Fragrant Story and Papaya's Path [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Byvshiy eksklyuziv dlya Nintendo 3DS vozvrashchaetsya na Switch!..
Eta takticheskaya yaponskaya rolevaya igra privnosit novyy vzglyad na klassicheskiy zhanr s personazhami, kotorymi rukovodyat Reven i Papayya. Pokorite vse syuzhetnye biomy za 10 chasov, a zatem otslezhivayte svoy progress i proydite igru na 100% primerno za 30 chasov!
Povyshayte uroven svoey komandy, pobezhdaya vragov, otkryvaya postoyannye uluchsheniya s novym snaryazheniem i uluchsheniyami sposobnostey. Nastroyte svoyu komandu i kombiniruyte razlichnye sposobnosti v udivitelno universalnoy boevoy sisteme. Nanesite kriticheskiy udar, ili ostavte eto na volyu sluchaya. Ispolzuyte khitrye khody, chtoby podstrakhovatsya i obespechit sebe pobedu.
Ispolzuyte kartu missiy, chtoby otyskat vse korolevskie sunduki s ikh legendarnymi sokrovishchami!..
Videotreyler.

title: 8 Colors Star Guardians Plus [NSZ][ENG]
description:
在這款僅用 8 種顏色製作的回合製、選擇你的 Boss 路徑遊戲中，以像素風格對抗邪惡！

對特攝流派的衷心而諷刺的致敬
不好了！邪惡的外星怪物（再次）襲擊了地球！但不用擔心，因為由熱血瑞亞領導的精英戰士團體星之守護者將把他們踢回外太空！

規劃你的路徑
面對八個巨大的銀河怪物，仔細選擇先對付哪一個！透過擊敗最弱的人來解鎖技能，並利用它們來擊敗重量級選手！如果您第一次嘗試失敗也不必擔心，您的隊友會在每次失敗後提供寶貴的建議！

來認識一下你的（功能失調的）女主角吧！
星之守護者是一群形形色色的女孩和女人，她們處於人生的不同階段，她們有怪癖、抱負、迷戀和小特質。詳細了解他們被老闆擊敗（或被擊敗）後的關係。

準備好迎接另一項挑戰嗎？
您可以選擇更輕鬆的故事模式（包含對話、提示和迷人的互動）和更殘酷的街機模式（您必須在一定的回合數內擊敗所有敵人）。你能在計時器耗盡之前擊敗他們嗎？

等等，還有更多！
與原始版本相比，此版本添加了更多內容並提高了生活品質：
故事模式第二章：第一章結束一年後，與致命的怪物群進行戰鬥，找到神秘白色守護者背後的真相，再次為地球帶來和平！
所有角色均可解鎖服裝，透過通關故事和街機模式獲得
改進的設定和使用者介面

title: The Ramsey [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 可选机翻 来自 erll_2nd
description: 拉姆齊是一個二維平臺，與可愛的松鼠角色一起生活在由六個巨大的島嶼組成的齊普馬斯行星上。 玩家可以利用松鼠拉姆齊揮舞的特殊武器棉槍解決迷宮和拼圖,探索多種領域。 從遙遠的奇普馬斯乘坐宇宙車來到地球的拉姆齊,現在與倉鼠朋友芝士聊起了故鄉的冒險故事。 由邪惡的發明者貪婪引起的氣候變化使所有的齊普馬斯人幾乎不適合本地齧齒動物。 瞭解一下拉姆齊是如何戰勝這場災難的，以及他來到地球的原因。

title: Xiaomei and the Flame Dragon's Fist [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Xiaomei and the Flame Dragon's Fist is a 16-bit kung fu action game that pays homage to retro kung fu games from the 80s and 90s. You play as kung fu heroine Xiaomei, who embarks on a journey to save her elder sister, Xiaoyin, from the evil influence of the Dark Dragon. Punch, kick, and unleash the Flame Dragon's Fist at enemies stopping you from saving your sister.

The game has been enhanced with new features and upgrades on Nintendo Switch™. Experience a new story from Xiaoyin's perspective in Xiaoyin Mode, meet new characters, and unlock special content such as wallpapers and character illustrations. Enjoy new music from legendary former Namco composer Norio Nakagata (Zombie Nation, Genpei Tōma Den), sound effects by Hirofumi Murasaki (Shinobi III: Return of the Ninja Master, Clockwork Knight), and character voices by Suika.

Features

・Time and execute kung fu moves against a horde of enemies and challenging bosses. Learn your opponent's moves and act accordingly!
・Three difficulty levels and other gameplay options for players of all skill levels
・Uncover the full story by playing as Xiaomei and Xiaoyin in their respective story modes
・Enjoy authentic 16-bit kung fu gameplay with finely tuned pixel art, resolution, and colors
・Unlock various content by playing and beating the game
・Admire illustrations designed by Studio Vigor in Gallery Mode

title: Martian Panic [NSZ][ENG]
description:
充滿不間斷的動作，玩家將使用一系列強大的武器來對抗一群色彩繽紛、滑稽可笑的敵人入侵者。 收集通電並拯救無助的平民以獲得高分並獲得成就。

8 個關卡充滿了豐富多彩的過場動畫和激烈的街機動作。 10 種獨特的敵人類型、6 種不同的武器和 5 種不同的強化道具為遊戲增添趣味。

幽默的過場動畫傳達了故事情節，讓玩家有機會在不間斷的動作之間休息。 多個難度級別、成就和有趣且引人入勝的故事情節增加了重玩價值。

title: Innocence Island [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Vy zabyli vse svoi navyki i umeniya, no smozhete vspomnit ikh, nablyudaya za okruzhayushchim mirom. Naprimer, vy nauchites prygat, uvidev pryzhki obezyany, ili orudovat mechom, esli kto-to primenit ego v boyu.

- Vyberite mirnyy i nenasilstvennyy stil igry, ili zhe vstante na put zhestokosti i razrusheniy. Mir igry Innocence Island budet menyatsya v sootvetstvii s vashimi postupkami.

- Nablyudayte za lyudmi i zhivotnymi vokrug, chtoby nauchitsya novym sposobnostyam — naprimer, rybalke, kovke ili dazhe boevym priemam, podsmotrennym u vragov.

- Reshayte golovolomki, pomogayte mestnym zhitelyam i vozvrashchayte zabytye vospominaniya.

- Puteshestvuyte po zhivopisnomu ostrovu, zaklyuchennomu v sfere, peshkom — ili ispolzuyte silu volshebnykh statuy, chtoby osedlat dukhov zhivotnykh!

- Igra Innocence Island podderzhivaet raznye stili grafiki: pomimo standartnogo nizkopoligonalnogo stilya, mozhno vybrat «Maslyanye kraski» ili «Krupnye pikseli»!

title: Super Cable Boy [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Super Cable Boy is a retro inspired platformer, where you are playing a sentient handheld gaming system with a power cord. Collect game cartridges to become more powerful and take on your quest to defeat "the Glitch", an entity that 1▧01☠011‱☣[ERROR]⌀▧ ..

This game has it all:
⦁ Fast paced platforming with quick respawns.
⦁ A steady difficulty curve and lots of levels.
⦁ Mind-bending retroesque glichart.
⦁ A weird story with cute characters and dialogs.
⦁ Collectable onigiris (rice balls)!
⦁ Two player local co-op mode.
⦁ Accessibility options.

title: Dog Duty [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
你將控制一支由幾位怪才組成的小隊，和邪惡的大頭目章魚司令以及他手下的軍隊激戰，挽救世界和平。在這款快節奏的即時戰術遊戲中，你將使用遊擊戰術將敵人各個擊破。你的小隊將駕駛載具在各個島嶼間移動，並站在載具頂上迎擊敵人。你將逐個解放敵方哨所，擊敗多個駕駛著瘋狂章魚機械的BOSS。快來把敵人全部消滅吧，不過要小心，他們已經全副武裝。

組建一支3人戰鬥小隊，進行激烈的即時戰術大戰
解放各個哨站，切斷敵人的武器、裝甲等物資供應
擊敗各種巨型BOSS，一路殺向邪惡的章魚司令
駕駛裝甲載具，站在載具頂上把攔路的敵人打得滿地找牙

title: Back Again [NSZ][ENG]
description:
您要挑戰的《Back Again》是由黑白紅三色構成、令人心寒的超現實虛空世界，屬於沉浸式第一人稱視角的硬核 3D 平台遊戲。在虛空中，您唯一的脫逃方式是穿越機關越來越複雜的飄浮平台。障礙物會在平台周圍以固定模式移動，您必須掌握它們的動作，以免被掃落平台或困在空中。附近的假人有時會引導您穿越平台，有時則只是靜靜觀察您。或許它們手中握有解謎的提示，又或許他們只是單純喜歡您。無論如何，它們都能提供一些慰藉。

《Back Again》的詭異故事是由簡約敘事風格和令人不安的氣氛所組成，為了測驗您的技巧、考驗您的心靈並獎勵您的決心，全程都配有隨著心境不斷變換的獨特音樂。查看故事的結局，盡可能重複嘗試每種機關，並在您建立起足夠的信心後，選擇「生存模式」看看您是否能一次通過整個遊戲！

特色：

• 在嚴峻的 3D 解謎脫逃遊戲中，以步行、奔跑和跳躍的方式跨越平台！
• 掌握障礙物的移動模式，通過障礙物。
• 見證怪異的事件，享受簡單的敘事風格！
• 沉浸在不斷變換的獨特音樂中。
• 在「生存模式」中將技巧磨練到極致！

title: Kardboard Kings Card Shop Simulator [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
developer: Henry's House, Oscar Brittain, Rob Gross
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
Vy - Garri Khsu, molodoy chelovek, nedavno unasledovavshiy kartochnyy magazin ot svoego ottsa, byvshego chempiona znamenitoy kartochnoy igry """"Chernoknizhnik"""". .Vy Garri Khsu, molodoy chelovek, nedavno unasledovavshiy kartochnuyu magazin ot ottsa, byvshego chempiona po znamenitoy kartochnoy igre ""Chernoknizhnik"". .
Vash provodnik, Dzhuzeppe, bystro govoryashchiy kakadu, pomozhet vam v vashem puteshestvii po pokupkam i prodazham — dobudet karty razlichnoy redkosti dlya luchshikh kollektsionerov ili pomozhet vostorzhennomu pokupatelyu po sosedstvu».

Osobennosti

- Pokupayte, obmenivayte, prodavayte ili sobirayte - Pokupayte v nuzhnoe vremya i pereprodavayte bolshe ili polozhite svoi karty v papku dlya demonstratsii.

- Karty, karty, karty - Otkryvayte konverty ili otpravlyaytes v magaziny, chtoby nayti bolee sotni kart raznoy stepeni redkosti (i blestyashchikh variatsiy!), illyustrirovannykh talantlivymi khudozhnikami.

- Nepredskazuemyy rynok - Perevypuski, zapreshchennye karty, podarki v detskom menyu, krazhi, tserkovnye osuzhdeniya... vse eti sobytiya mogut povliyat na tsenu vashego inventarya.

- Zarabotayte lyubov svoego soobshchestva - Podruzhites s zhitelyami rayona, prislushivaytes k ikh prosbam i pomogite im udovletvorit ikh oderzhimost, popolnyaya svoyu kollektsiyu ili stanovyas luchshimi igrokami. Oni mogli by pomoch vam stat luchshim magazinom v gorode.

- Sozdayte idealnyy magazin - Smena menedzhera - eto tozhe smena imidzha. Sozdayte magazin svoey mechty s vyborom sten, polov i drugikh ukrasheniy. Vse lyubyat terrakotovye figurki, verno?

- Intriguyushchaya istoriya - U morya vneshnost obmanchiva! Vnezapnoe poyavlenie zagadochnogo klienta zastavlyaet zadumatsya, pochemu on gotov doveryat vam bolshe, chem prosto informatsiyu.

title: Armored Lab Force Vulvehicles [NSZ][ENG]
description:
在切換巴爾戰車的同時，與敵人戰鬥，打倒關卡Boss吧！

高火力型、誘導兵器型、範圍攻擊型、高機動型……適合駕駛員各自出身星球，專門訂製的12輛充滿個性的戰車。
使用電送切換，決定好「用哪台戰車戰鬥，保留哪些資源」是勝利的關鍵。


【故事】
西曆2010年。

超電氣科學研究所阿貝克星支部。有出身許多不同行星的研究員聚集在這裡，過著有趣的生活。

突然，地球防衛軍（TDF）宣稱要掌握研究所控制權、排除外星人，開始了武力鎮壓。
此時站出來反抗的，是6名美少女和12輛萬能戰車，「巴爾戰車」。

阿貝克星支部那群悠悠哉哉的人們，到底能否奪回自己和平的日常呢？


【特徵】
・共6區域，合計24關
・12種超有個性的自機
・5等級的難度

title: Johnny Trigger / Sniper [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Johnny Trigger returns in a sequel that shakes up the sniper game genre. All the action, no lurking, tedious waiting or stress: pick a target, take aim, shoot and pick another target.

You play as a professional assassin with style, guts and an awesome rifle. Your opponents aren't beaten in the dark either and they can bite back, but you've got enough bullets in your magazine: pick a target, aim, headshot! Way to go!

Earn money for missions to unlock new guns, rocket launchers and even assault rifles. Collect keys to open mysterious suitcases. Shoot exploding barrels, defeat mafia bosses and make sure innocent civilians don't get hurt. 

Become the best sniper and show everyone that you deserve your name!

title: Lunara Planet IX (9) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Stroyte i issleduyte v Planet IX — yarkoy simulyatsionnoy igre v 2D pikselnom iskusstve, gde vam predstoit sozdat koloniyu na tainstvennoy planete, srazhatsya s monstrami i raskryvat sekrety, upravlyaya resursami i kislorodom.
Poka uchenye issledovali etot novyy mir, obuchaya Lunarian nashemu yazyku, na Zemlyu obrushilas katastrofa: Luna byla tainstvennym obrazom unichtozhena. S oblomkami, ugrozhayushchimi zhizni na Zemle, nauchnaya komanda pospeshila vernutsya, chtoby spasti vyzhivshikh, ostaviv pozadi Emiliyu, predannogo grazhdanskogo inzhenera. S pomoshchyu II GP.To Emiliya beret na sebya otvetstvennost za stroitelstvo bezopasnoy kolonii dlya poslednikh vyzhivshikh na Zemle.

title: Death Tales [NSP][ENG]
description:
Otpravlyaytes v priklyuchenie v roli novogo zhnetsa, kotoryy soshel s uma! Sobirayte snaryazhenie i zaklinaniya, izuchayte moshchnye ataki protiv polchishch vragov, vypolnyayte kvesty dlya gruppy prichudlivykh personazhey i delayte trudnyy vybor v etom mrachnom, no bogato illyustrirovannom 2D-mire. Igrayte v odinochku ili s drugom v lokalnom kooperative i vmeste sluzhite Smerti!

Vy mozhete priobresti bolee 40 edinits snaryazheniya, chtoby nastroit svoego Zhnetsa i pomoch vam v boyu! Naydite oborudovanie v razlichnykh khorosho spryatannykh sundukakh ili ispolzuyte sobrannye vami dushi v kachestve valyuty dlya pokupki predmetov u mestnogo prodavtsa, Fiony. Obyazatelno zakhodite syuda kazhdyy den, tak kak ee inventar menyaetsya! Kombiniruyte dospekhi i ispolzuyte silu unikalnykh navykov, takikh kak ognennye shary, sposobnost zamorazhivat vragov, angelskie krylya, pozvolyayushchie vam parit v bezopasnoe mesto, vyzyvat meteory s neba i dazhe toptat edinorogov!

Obedinite usiliya s drugom po mestu zhitelstva. V lokalnoy igre Igrok 2 igraet Spauru, Khranitelya Dush Zhnetsa.

Srazhaytes na 30 krasivo oformlennykh urovnyakh, pomogayte yarkim personazham v razlichnykh pobochnykh kvestakh i vypolnyayte svoi obyazannosti zhnetsa, sobiraya dushi dlya Smerti. Ezhednevnye nagrady dostupny ot razlichnykh NPC.

Sobirayte snaryazhenie, izuchayte zaklinaniya i prodvigaytes kak Zhnets, chtoby srazitsya s uzhasnymi vragami i pobezhdat epicheskikh bossov.

title: Poi Explorer Edition [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
- Priklyuchenie: Issleduyte mir v poiskakh bolee 100 medalonov Issledovatelya. 
- Vyzov: Ustanavlivayte rekordy v globalnykh spiskakh liderov. 
- Masterstvo: Nauchites prygat po stenam, delat troynye pryzhki, dlinnye pryzhki s perekatom i mnogoe drugoe. 
- Originalnyy saundtrek: Slushayte originalnye kompozitsii, sozdannye kompozitorom.

title: Four (4) the Elements [NSZ][ENG]
developer: Rafael Rubim de Medeiros Teixeira Lontra
description: 在這場銀河惡魔城冒險中，在四個自然元素之間即時切換，克服挑戰，獲得新能力，並在精心設計的主題階段擊敗強大的頭目。

title: Jet Set Knights [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Korol uekhal v otpusk na Bagamy, chtoby sobratsya s silami i podgotovit korolevstvo k atake sil iz temnogo podzemnogo mira. Ostavshayasya na khozyaystve printsessa Kitti i ee poddannye teper v opasnosti!

Ot tebya zavisit ikh sudba! Upravlyay odnim iz chetyrekh khrabrykh rytsarey, srazhaysya s sotnyami zlykh sushchestv i zashchishchay printsessu lyuboy tsenoy!

Jet Set Knights - arkadnyy old-skulnyy ekshen-platformer, vdokhnovlennyy klassikoy zolotogo veka! Sygray v igru - novyy vzglyad na klassiku s unikalnoy zashchitoy bashni i elementami RPG!

Kharakteristiki:
* Upravlenie «podbiray i igray»
* Chetyre rytsarya na vybor, kazhdyy s unikalnymi sposobnostyami
* Okhranyay printsessu v odinochku ili s druzyami v lokalnoy igre
* Razblokiruy sekretnykh personazhey, oruzhie i zaklinaniya

title: Mechblaze [NSZ][ENG]
description:
秘密基地已然陷入火海，土崩瓦解。
機槍子彈如雨點般，橫掃著向我方襲擊而來的大群鋼鐵之軀。
必殺兵器打樁機（Pile Banker），轟出大鐵錐，貫穿巨大敵人。
然後，無敵的超級機器人，從瓦礫中甦醒！

現實中的近代兵器，以及由超科學誕生的超級機械，薈萃一堂的超重量級玩具遊戲，Battle Action！！

【故事】
西曆1989年。
人類擊退外星侵略者「革戈軍團」，正欲迎來繁榮年代的時候。
強大的秘密結社，「新羅蘭黨」，在全世界掀起暴動，開始全面攻擊。

過去曾和革戈軍團大戰的超電氣科學研究所，也被新羅蘭黨襲擊而毀滅。
集結殘餘兵力，勇敢地向新羅蘭黨抵抗——

【特徵】
- 全6面
- 多達13種的多樣武器
- 5級別的難度

title: I'll Kill Her [NSP][RUS/ENG]
description:
Stefani gotova pozhertvovat vsem, radi svoey mechty. Ona progulivaet zanyatiya, ignoriruet mat i vsyo bolshe otdalyaetsya ot svoego parnya Brendona. Vsyo radi togo, chtoby dokazat, eyo fotografii – iskusstvo. Odnako, v VUZe tak ne schitayut, ved snyat «prodayushchiy kadr» gorazdo vazhnee realizatsii tvorcheskogo ya. Stefani uzhe dokhodit do tochki kipeniya, kogda Brendon reshaet uyti... Gluboko lichnaya istoriya o lyubvi, zhizni s psikhicheskim rasstroystvom i borbe za pravo byt uslyshannym.

Osobennosti:
- 10 glav
- galereya oblozhek
- mini igra Odevalka

title: Ratyrinth [NSZ][ENG]
description:
扮演這隻和家人走失的靈活小老鼠，穿越這片充滿恐怖壞蛋的森林！《Ratyrinth》是一款講求精準的橫向卷軸平台遊戲，有著燒腦的關卡和復古風格的畫面。遊戲有著黑白極簡風的流暢畫面，結合奔跑、跳躍、貼牆、游泳和攀爬，穿梭在迷宮般的關卡之中。

失敗了也別灰心，你馬上就會重生在起始點，想嘗試幾次都沒問題。每次完成新的關卡，難度便會逐步提升，並加入新的機關和敵人。

特色：

• 挑戰迷宮般的平台關卡。
• 精準地控制靈活的小老鼠，去奔跑、跳躍和攀爬。
• 享受遊戲內極簡的黑白像素與流暢的畫面！
• 立即重生，想重試幾次都可以。
• 解鎖色彩濾鏡，來客製化遊戲體驗！

title: Xicatrice (シカトリス, demonstratsionnaya versiya) [NSZ][DEMO][JAP]
description:
Proshlo okolo veka s tekh por, kak chelovechestvo nachalo razvivat svoi sverkhestestvennye sily, nazyvaemym «sverkhsposobnostyami». Bolshinstvo ispolzovali svoi sily, chtoby nesti poleznyy vklad v obshchestvo, no byli i te, kto zloupotreblyal imi — kak i te, kto ne mog ikh kontrolirovat.
Chtoby aktivno reagirovat na takie intsidenty, pravitelstvo uchredilo «Gruppu po borbe s opasnymi talantami (GUBOT)», pravookhranitelnoe agentstvo, sostoyashchee iz trenirovannykh sverkhsensorikov. Odnako, kolichestvo intsidentov prodolzhalo rezko uvelichivatsya do stepeni nekontroliruemosti. Nasha istoriya nachinaetsya v 2023-m godu s byvshego chlena GUBOT, kotoryy poteryal eti sposobnosti v rezultate neschastnogo sluchaya.
Vam budet naznachen ezhenedelnyy grafik obucheniya dlya razvitiya sil 7 izbrannykh uchenikov, a «osnovnye» kharakteristiki, takie kak vynoslivost i rassuditelnost, budut uluchshatsya v zavisimosti ot vybrannoy imenno vami uchebnoy programmy dlya nikh.
Smozhete li vy ostanovit katastrofu?Videotreyler.

title: Triangle Strategy - Debut, Prologue [NSP][DEMO][ENG,RUS (Mod.)]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 俄语, lyubitelskiy 来自 faceoff2, beta-版本 k ranney demo
description:
TRIANGLE STRATEGY — novaya takticheskaya rolevaya igra ot Square Enix, kotoraya vyydet na Nintendo Switch v 2022 godu.
V roli Serenoa, naslednogo printsa korolevstva Glenbruk, komanduyte otryadom voinov. Vy okazhetes vtyanuty v pautinu intrig i zagovorov, a ot vashikh resheniy budet zaviset sudba korolevstva. Klyuchevye resheniya vliyayut na tri ubezhdeniya: moral, svobodu i polzu. Imenno oni formiruyut zhiznennye vzglyady Serenoa i povliyayut na razvitie syuzheta. Pri prinyatii poistine sudbonosnykh resheniy mnozhestvo personazhey golosuyut na Vesakh ubezhdeniy. V takie momenty privlechennye vami soyuzniki i prinyatye vami resheniya mogut opredelit sudbu tselykh natsiy i vsego kontinenta.
Vybor luchshey pozitsii mozhet sklonit khod boya v vashu polzu. Razmeshchayte otryady na vozvyshennosti, chtoby poluchit takticheskoe preimushchestvo i uvelichit dalnost atak. Vy takzhe mozhete okruzhat vragov s dvukh storon i nanosit im s tyla sereznyy uron. Krome togo, kombinatsii atak mogut vnesti sushchestvennyy vklad v pobedu. Naprimer, rasplavte led ognem, a zatem udarte v eto mesto molniey. Teper ostaetsya lish podtolknut tuda vraga, chtoby u nego iskry iz glaz posypalis.
Vedite strategicheskie boi na mnogourovnevykh lokatsiyakh — i vyigryvayte!..Octopath Traveler sm. zdes.

title: Bar Stella Abyss (ステラアビス, demonstratsionnaya versiya) [NSZ][DEMO][JAP]
publisher: NIS 株式会社日本一ソフトウェア
description:
Pokhozhe, ty ochen ustal, paren. Pozvol mne nalit tebe vypit.
Glavnyy geroy, to est vy natykaetes na «Stella Abyss», malenkiy sokrytyy oto vsekh glaz bar v ugolke goroda, napravlyaemyy paryashchimi vetrami, i otkryvaete tuda dver.
Napivshis i zasnuv pod prigotovlennyy napitok, rekomendovannyy strannym barmenom, GG prosypaetsya ot ekha v svoey golove v neznakomom volshebnom poselenii. I pered vami stoit zagadochnoe sushchestvo, paryashchee v vozdukhe, s tsvetushchimi tsvetami vokrug.
Eta igra — prosto son netrezvogo cheloveka, «Pyanyy mir»?.. Vy, bez ruki i litsa, okazalis v lovushke zdeshnego mira gryoz, chtoby eto vyyasnit!..

title: Family Man [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Family Man is a dark, story-led RPG that asks the question: When pushed to the limits of your own morality, how far would you go for the sake of your family?

You owe money to the mob, and you've got three weeks to pay it back. Will you flip burgers and earn an honest living while scraping the money together... or will you take on some dirty jobs for more cash, but potentially push your family away?

Every decision you make affects everyone around you. The neighbourhood will blossom or perish under the weight of your decisions, while the path you choose may lead to your household becoming stronger than ever... or the breakdown of your marriage and relationship with your child.

- Explore Riverport, and decide how you want to deal with each situation that arises
- Earn cash the hard (legal) way, or break a few rules here or there
- Every choice you make affects the neighbourhood and your family
- Dozens of missions to complete and stories to resolve
- Unlock unique perks that suit your gameplay style
- Multiple different endings based on the decisions you made

title: EvoMonsters [NSZ][ENG]
description:
這裡是EvoMons——非凡的生物。準備好讓它們成為真正的EvoMon冠軍吧！滿足它們的需求，餵食並訓練它們，看著一個小而脆弱的嬰兒如何進化成為無所畏懼的戰士。

做你的小EvoMon的最佳訓練師
用各種點心餵養你的朋友，保持它的清潔，並從商店提供必要的護理工具。確保所有需求都得到滿足，否則，你珍貴的生物將停止成長，你將永遠照顧一個嬰兒。

在九種有趣的迷你遊戲中訓練你的EvoMon，獲取經驗值，並觀察它的進化。畢竟，你有多達49種不同階段的EvoMon可以發現！

準備好戰鬥了嗎？
帶著你強大的成年EvoMon參加最終戰鬥，你將面對其他訓練師的EvoMon。別擔心，如果你一次不能擊敗它們，獲得的經驗下次會派上用場。誰知道呢，也許你會以新EvoMon冠軍的頭銜離開競技場？

或者，現在是冒險的時候了？
在神秘的探險區展開非凡的冒險吧！發現獨特的EvoMon並獲得僅在那裡可用的獨家物品，這些物品可以在你的EvoMon實驗室中使用。

說到實驗室。每次你在戰鬥中失去EvoMon時，你可以復活舊的或將其“冷凍”。結合兩個EvoMon創造一個蛋，準備好一個全新的EvoMon來訓練。

可能性如同EvoMon本身一樣多
如果你需要錢，前往釣魚區捕獲獨特的釣魚物品和魚類，可以用來餵養或出售。

你甚至可以從扭蛋機中獲得新家具，根據你的品味裝飾EvoMon房間！

主要特點：
- 以90年代經典電子寵物的風格照顧小EvoMon，並進行要求嚴格的訓練，
- 收集49種不同的EvoMon，每種都有3個進化階段——總共有149個進化階段！
- 在9個迷你遊戲中訓練你的寵物並賺取Evocoins的訓練區，
- 與其他訓練師的EvoMon進行激烈的戰鬥，有機會贏得EvoMon冠軍的頭銜！
- 一個可以儲存你冷凍EvoMon、復活它們或結合完全不同新類型的實驗室，
- 探險區有3個不同的任務，每個任務包含1個獨家迷你遊戲和一個特殊物品，可以在實驗室中釋放一個新的EvoMon，
- 探索各種魚類和特殊物品的釣魚區，
- 用各種家具裝飾你的EvoMon房間，
- 像素風格，
- 8位元音樂。

title: Azuran Tales Trials [NSZ][ENG]
Azurebreak Heroes [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Escape the Prison-World!
Through the bizarre, colorful, yet dark areas of Heldia, Heroes look for a way to escape a demonic grasp.

Azurebreak Heroes is a 2D RPG with roguelite elements. Battle otherworldly creatures, enhance your skills, unlock new heroes and choose the upgrades you want while looking for a way to escape a prison-world of Heldia.

Features:
- A responsive, real-time combat system.
- 6 playable heroes, each with its own skill tree and perks!
- Create builds by choosing artifacts you want! All of the artifacts synergize with each other.
- Random level layouts.
- 3 possible endings to uncover.
- Secrets!

title: Ring of Pain [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
探索隨機生成的環形地牢，與各式各樣的事物相遇！
 觀察並規劃路線。你會選擇搜刮財寶，還是去偷襲駭人的怪物？在你搜刮、戰鬥、潛行、邂逅新事物之際，環形地牢也會根據你的行動而變化。
 
 這款回合制Roguelike遊戲挑戰重重，節奏由你掌控，記得小心選擇道路，你可能會遭遇埋伏，或者陷入更加棘手的危機中……

查看所做選擇的預測結果，專注在重要關鍵：決策！
 這個世界強敵環伺，生物不會隱瞞自身行動，隨時都可能朝你直撲而來。你會選擇逃跑，還是利用地牢環境反制其身？
 選定位置是存活的關鍵，否則有可能迅速命喪成群敵人手中……

寶箱怪提供有償選擇。在欄位有限的情況下合理取捨，搭配出一套擁有合適被動能力的裝備組合。
 你可以變成使用淬毒利刃的刺客，以敏捷速度與閃避技巧取勝；也可以化身銅牆鐵壁，靠粗暴蠻力所向披靡；甚至還能鑄就火焰之軀，用爆炸轟出一條生路。
 要消耗靈魂購得想要的能力，還是在無情的深淵中一路搜刮、隨機應變，都取決於你。

在《苦痛之環》深處，你將發現通向未知領域的新道路。路的盡頭可能是新的朋友、強力的戰利品，也可能是暗藏深意的詩句。
 尋得安寧祥和的片刻停留，或者躲避鬼哭狼嚎的驚悚怪物。
 勇敢的人可能在冒險後迎來豐厚回報，也可能因為貪婪野心而葬送小命。

行過暗影，步步為營。
 未知的領域現已遍佈恐懼的爪牙。

正式版遊戲的主要特色：
- 16個核心主線地牢，外加2個分支結局，考驗你的最終實力。
- 解鎖困難模式，適合那些在苦痛中越戰越勇的人。
- 解鎖每日地牢，超過25種特殊限制條件，給你截然不同的體驗。
- 勇闖超過25種特殊地牢，掠奪戰利品並邂逅奇異事物。
- 4種環境區域，各具獨特的恐怖風格。
- 解鎖超過180個物品，可在15個物品欄欄位組合搭配。
- 認識超過40種生物，了解該如何對付。其中既有友善的朋友，也有兇狠的惡棍……
- 回合制遊戲機制，你可以快速作戰，也可以運籌帷幄。
- 富含深意、耐人尋味的簡短詩句。
- 粗獷的圖像美術風格，靈感來自於心盲症患者。
- 可愛的青蛙朋友。
- 一段苦痛之旅。

title: Aqua Lungers [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Race your way through challenging stages while contending with deadly creatures and dastardly opponents to collect the most treasure.

While everyone's goal is the same, each player is afforded several options to get an edge over their competitors. Players can use their speed and agility to outpace and evade their opponents, while others might use devastating attacks to slow them down and steal their hard earned goods.

If you're the type that prefers the solo experience or wants to get some experience in before challenging your friends, fear not! Aqua Lungers can be played with as few as 1 player! In single player, Aqua Lungers retains the gold collecting mechanic while increasing the penalty for deaths in each level. This shifts the challenge from PvP racing to PvE survival!

title: Hide and Dance / Mom Hid My Game 1 + 2 / My Brother Ate My Pudding! [NSZ][ENG]
genre: Puzzle, Simulation, Adventure, Board Game, Hidden objects
developer: hap inc., Kotobuki Solution Co., Ltd.
description:
Otyshchem igrovuyu konsol kotoruyu spryatala Mama!

Vnutri sunduka ili na knizhnoy polke? A mozhet, ona pod krovatyu?

Gde zhe ona!?

Naydi "igru" na kazhdom urovne ispolzuya razlichnye predmety!

Tebya ozhidaet rasslablyayushchaya i smeshnaya eskeyp-rum igra!

title: Life of Slime [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
description:
Slami沒有上大學，他去Intown試圖找到他生命中的特殊道路。但是，這條路將會長而且困難，你無法預測在這條路上會發生什麼，Slami太希望有光明的生活。

在Intown，你會遇到像Slami這樣的角色，他們彼此都不同，每個人都有自己的願望和長長的道路。你會陪伴他們走這條路嗎？這由你決定。

在這次冒險中，你將與史萊姆的世界互動。這遊戲不需要你付出太多努力，但它有一些驚喜等著你。好奇的玩家可以完全探索這個充滿各種秘密的世界。

特色:
- 充滿事件和角色的豐富故事
- 8位和Lo-fi類型的40多種不同音樂曲目
- 你可以擔任收銀員，保安，甚至是警察！
- 50多種不同的史萊姆，幾乎每一個你都可以稍微交談一下
- 獨特、美麗的地點

title: Infini [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Ispytay sebya v psikhodelicheskom puteshestvii sredi pazlov i znachimykh vstrech so Vremenem, Poeziey, Pamyatyu, Tekhnologiey, Voynoy i Neizbezhnostyu.
Nadezhda vse glubzhe pogruzhaetsya v Beskonechnost, i realnyy mir nachinaet stradat ot ego otsutstviya. Kazhetsya, chto vykhoda net, no Nadezhda po svoey prirode obrechena prodolzhat.

Uluchshay svoi navyki upravleniya innovatsionnoy kameroy, chtoby otkryt novye oblasti. Kazhdyy mir skryvaet v sebe novye sposobnosti, temy, vozmozhnosti dlya izucheniya multivselennoy i vstrechi s prichudlivymi lichnostyami, kotorye mogut byt poleznymi soyuznikami ili lzhivymi protivnikami.

Osnovnye kharakteristiki Infini

∞ Otkroyte dlya sebya unikalnyy, umopomrachitelnyy i raznoobraznyy igrovoy protsess.
∞ Pogruzis v nasyshchennuyu emotsionalnuyu istoriyu.
∞ 8 chasov igrovogo protsessa na 100+ urovnyakh i v 10 raznoobraznykh mirakh.
∞ Idealno podkhodit dlya bystroy igry.
∞ Originalnye obrazy i saundtreki iz bolee chem 20 pesen.
∞ Pochuvstvuy pustotu Beskonechnosti!

Razrabotano Barnaque
«My vsegda stremimsya razdvinut predely i preodolet granitsy s pomoshchyu nashikh istoriy, igrovogo protsessa i muzyki. Nasha tsel s Infini —pogruzit vas v neizvedannyy mir syurprizov », — Devid Martin i Emerik Moren iz nezavisimoy studii v Monreale.

Opublikovano Nakana.io
«My sobiraem igry, kotorye napolneny bolshim opytom i legko zapominayutsya. Vmeste s Infini my rady predstavit igru, kotoraya odnovremenno unikalna i zakhvatyvayushcha vo vsekh ee aspektakh: igrovom protsesse, grafike i istorii », — Mikael Burzhet, osnovatel izdatelskogo leybla.

title: My Name is Mayo 1-2-3 [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Filosofskiy kliker, rasskazyvayushchiy istoriyu pro.. Banku mayoneza s achivkami! Eto li ne to, o chyom vy tak mechtali?..
«My Name is Mayo» — seriya igr, gde vam predstoit klikat po banke mayoneza. I vsyo. Bukvalno, eto vsyo! Eto vsya igra — nazhimat po banke. Pri nazhatii na banku vy poluchite sootvetstvuyushchie dostizheniya i vizualnye affekty, takie kak: parik na banku, zhenskiy kupalnik na tu zhe banku, nu, i mnogo chego eshchyo.
A saund u igry dzhazovyy.

title: Chasing Light [NSZ][ENG]
description:
2021 IGF Nuovo Award入圍者
2021 Korea Game Awards獨立遊戲獎、優秀遊戲獎入圍者
2020 BIC 卓越實驗性獎
2020 GIGDC 銅獎
2020 首爾政府 G-RANK Challenge 首爾獎
2020 SOTAESAN FILM FESTIVAL 官方評選
2020 IGN日本獨立遊戲周官方評選
2020 BIGS官方評選

“《Chasing Light》是一款試圖打破傳統遊戲概念的遊戲，它證明了遊戲也是一種偉大藝術。”

什麼是遊戲？ 遊戲應該包括什麼？ 遊戲應該要怎麼樣？  《Chasing Light》是探究一款遊戲物理上的構成、並揭開人類和社會內在的七日問答過程和故事。

你將扮演一個遊戲開發組並製作一款名為《Chase Light》的遊戲。 通過操控導演和製作人，你將在遊戲製作過程中做出很多決定：音樂及音效的選擇，敵人的數量，敵人出現以及攻擊的速度……有很多懸而未決的問題需要你決定。 所以，想一想你要如何製作一款人們會喜歡的遊戲。 你將在《Chasing Light》中找到專屬於你的旅程。

《Chasing Light》的世界，以及我們的生活，就像一片佈滿礁石的茫茫大海，找不到方向。 如果是你，你想去哪裡？

title: Pill Baby [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Play as Anna, finding a job and moving to a new country. Explore her new life, struggles, loneliness, relationships, language barrier.
Pill Baby features deep action mechanics, including a wide movement set where you can learn lots of different attacks, and use them strategically. Helpful drone units with special moves that help you on offense or defense. Custom gloves for special effects such as freezing or poisoning parasites. Use all your powers strategically to fight with epic parasites 10 times your size.
Play as Anna, finding a job and moving to a new country. Stress, loneliness and alienation. Can she survive here? See the small town she moved to and interact with her new friends and neighbors. Form all kinds of relationships. Sinister and mysterious things are going on in this town.

title: To Leave [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Proydites po bolee chem 80 velikolepno oformlennym kartam, ispolzuya «letayushchuyu dver» Kharma. Eto vash put i edinstvennoe sredstvo peredvizheniya. Pomnit! Oni ochen khrupkie i k nim nuzhno otnositsya s maksimalnoy ostorozhnostyu.

Puteshestvuyte po Temnoy Pustote. Otkroyte dlya sebya skrytye smysly i simvolizm, vpletennye v igrovoy protsess. Broste sebe vyzov i poymite dusherazdirayushchuyu pravdu o Kharme.

Klyuchevye osobennosti:

-Narisovannye ot ruki fony
-Uvlekatelnaya istoriya
- Unikalnaya mekhanika puteshestviy
-80 urovney
-Neveroyatnyy muzykalnyy trek

title: No Thing [NSZ][ENG]
description:
The year is 1994 and it is the future.

NO THING is a minimalistic surreal action game set in a totalitarian regime of future.
Tells the story of an office clerk who is sent with an important message to the Queen of Ice.

NO THING Features:
- radical gameplay
- migraine inducing
- weird storyline
- retro surrealistic full 3D graphic
- full voiceover and speech synthesis
- chiptune sounds
- original cold wave music
- simple controls
- easy to play, very hard to master

title: Membrane [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Membrane is a creative-action puzzle game in which you build, bend and break the world around you while experimenting to create your own solutions. Bendy bridges, wobbly ladders and shaky structures are just the beginning of what you'll make to test the limits of this weird, day-glo world! 

Membrane was designed to allow creative space for the player to interact and build their own unique solutions. The puzzles are NOT designed to rely on deception or a single solution, lock & key approach to test players. Instead the game was built to reward creativity and experimentation from the player. Get your thinking cap on friends! 

• 10/10 from Bonus Stage UK
• 9/10 from Nintendo Life & Pure Nintendo
• Debut console release from Perfect Hat
• IGF Honorable Mention for Best Student Game 2018
• 45 awesome levels to explore and get your creative mind going!
• 3 unlockable Bonus modes including Catapult, Trickshot & Boulderball

title: They Breathe [NSZ][ENG]
description:
A lone frog descends into the depths of a flooded forest, not yet knowing the full extent of its tragedy. To survive in a brutal, oxygen-obsessed ecosystem, you must help it see the patterns and hidden truths that make up the rules of the forest - horrible as they may be. Now as a new remastered version, rebuilt from the ground up and enhanced with local co-op mode.

They Breathe is a critically acclaimed indie gem. In thirty short minutes, the game leaves it up to you to figure out every part of its increasingly bizarre universe, in order to survive the onslaught of unexpected creatures and ultimately comprehend their true nature. No matter how your descent to the bottom of the forest takes shape, it is guaranteed to give you the chills without a single word of dialog.

Keep your eyes open, for there is darkness beneath the surface. And you're not at the bottom yet.

title: Superola and the Lost Burgers Champion edition [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Superola Champion Edition is a challenging runner-style platforming adventure, in which you’ll have to guide a burger loving llama in its quest to defeat the Hotdog Aliens and recover the stolen hamburgers... before they get cold!

Explore 10 worlds with over 70 super challenging stages, unlock all the costumes and map’s secrets, fight boss battles, clear bonus rounds and compete with up to 4 friends!

- Over 70 stages with tons of secrets and costumes to unlock
- Choose between 4K cartoon graphics or retro pixel art
- Super challenging platforming, leaderboards & achievements
- 4 Player split-screen VS 
- Bonus Alpaca's Redemption game included
- Remastered and chiptune original soundtracks

title: Medulla [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description: Medulla - eto uvlekatelnaya igra - golovolomka o priklyucheniyakh v mire, pokhozhem na son. Yunosha Takito puteshestvuet po raznym mestam, gde ego zhdut raznye strannye prepyatstviya i ne logichnye na pervyy vzglyad golovolomki. Raznoobraznye krasivye peyzazhi, narisovannye vruchnuyu, sozdayut neponyatnoe i tainstvennoe okruzhenie, iz kotorogo Takito dolzhen nayti vykhod. Vizualnyy obraz igry vrashchaetsya vokrug stiley zhivopisi sovremennykh khudozhnikov. Nekotorye vizualnye effekty otrazhayut priemy syurrealizma, drugie naveyany traditsionnymi priemami i unikalnymi obraznymi stilyami, i vse vmeste oni sozdayut obshchee oshchushchenie misticheskogo realizma.

title: Explosionade DX [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Vse vashi druzya shturmuyut krepost Khorronim, no polkovnik Bush ostavil vas okhranyat sklad pripasov. Ne obrashchaya vnimaniya na prikazy, vy otkryvaete sklad, chtoby nayti gigantskiy prototip mekha.
Vremya odevatsya!

FUNKTsII:
• Proniknite v podzemnye tsitadeli, naselennye khitrymi dvunogimi prisheltsami, na 60 urovnyakh!
• Zaryadka MegaNades i potryasayushchiy pulemet razorvut razrushaemuyu sredu na narisovannye vruchnuyu kusochki!
• Srazhaytes s khitrymi inoplanetyanami, kotorye mogut begat, uvorachivatsya, strelyat v gorshok i brosat granaty, chtoby raznesti vas na kuski!
    Lokalnyy kooperativ na 2 igrokov, chtoby vy mogli razdelit radost ot broska granat i topaniya prisheltsev!
• Vzryvayte bossov, zapolnyayushchikh ekrany, gluboko v neizvedannykh glubinakh!
• Neskolko rezhimov slozhnosti i kontrol skorosti igrovogo protsessa, chtoby nayti podkhodyashchuyu zadachu!
• Novoe izdanie Deluxe vklyuchaet v sebya bolshe vragov, izobrazheniya v bolee vysokom razreshenii i onlayn-tablitsy liderov!
• Narisovannye ot ruki, shelkovisto-gladkie effekty animatsii, kak ranshe delala mama!

title: Tux and Fanny [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Tux and Fanny just want to play soccer but their soccer ball is deflated. Go on an epic adventure to help them inflate their ball. Play as both Tux and Fanny as well as a cat and a flea. All four characters will have to work together if you’re going to inflate the ball. 

Play a multitude of diverse mini-games which you'll collect as you progress through your journey, each with their own unique rewards. There are secrets hidden at every turn in the world of Tux and Fanny. Can you find them all?

title: Cosmic Top Secret [NSZ][ENG]
description:
EXPERIENCE SOMETHING UNIQUE
“Cosmic Top Secret” is the weird, but official, term NATO uses for top confidentiality. A fitting name for this game since it needed military clearance to be released!
Cosmic Top Secret won multiple awards for the innovative ways it engages players in deeply documented plots. The game even inspired the creation of a life-size event at the Cold War Museum of Denmark.

- “a fascinating means of storytelling” - Indie Game Reviewer
- “beautiful, abstract papercraft art designs” - GameSpot
- “will linger with you long after the credits roll.” - The Indie Game Website

SPIES, SOLDIERS & POLITICIANS
Meet people who made history - spies, army leaders, math geniuses, fighter pilots and more - from both sides of the Iron Curtain and with incredible, absurd or thrilling stories.

FIRST COMPUTERS & NUCLEAR THREAT
Discover fascinating programs and devices designed to outsmart the enemy in a tense context of international espionage and fear of atomic war. This is the dawn of new technologies.

DEEPLY PERSONAL, YET RELATABLE STORY
“Like a million others, I’m an ordinary 'kid of the Cold War'. Just a very curious one with parents working in Intelligence services. By getting to know me and my family better, you might see yourself and even feel the itch to investigate your loved ones!” - Trine Laier (T)

PUBLISHED BY Nakana.io
“We gather games that share a strong experience to remember. We’d never seen anything like Cosmic Top Secret before!” - Mikaël Bourget, founder of the publishing label.

title: Everything [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Everything — eto interaktiv, napolnennyy vsevozmozhnymi obektami i shtukovinami, v kotorye mozhno prevrashchatsya: zhivotnye, planety, galaktiki i vsyo chto ugodno eshchyo. Naprimer, mozhno puteshestvovat mezhdu mezhzvyozdnym i mezhplanetnym prostranstvami i issledovat ogromnuyu svyaznuyu veshchestvennuyu vselennuyu, v kotoroy net navyazannykh tseley, ochkov, ili zadach, trebuyushchikh ispolneniya. Everything — eto protsedurnaya simulyatsiya prirodnykh sistem, osnovannaya na iskusstvennom intellekte, s perspektivy vsekh obektov vo vselennoy.

Everything uchit prevrashchatsya i sozdavat miry vnutri mirov vnutri mirov, razdvigat grani vremeni, i rezhissirovat neskonchaemyy dokumentalnyy film o mire, v kotorom zhivyosh.

Rasskaz, osnovannyy na vdokhnovlyayushchey filosofii Alana Uottsa, i moshchnoe zvukovoe soprovozhdenie ot Bena Lukasa Boysena usilivayut effekt Everything i raskryvayut pered zritelem novye rakursy zhizni.

title: Oneiros [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Liam wakes up late just like any other day, but something just feels different. Doors to his room are locked, laptop's hacked, phone's broken and something just doesn't feel right.
The place definitely looks like his room, but at the same time it just doesn't feel like it is, anymore.
He just had a weirdest dream ever, feels like his head is about to explode and he doesn't remember what he did yesterday.
Find out what's going on and help Liam escape.

Features:
- immersive, story-based gameplay
- beautiful surreal world filled with details
- hundreds of interactive items waiting for you to discover
- fully voiced characters
- interactive laptop with 2 mini-games embedded
- amazing graphics with advanced lighting and effects
- psychedelic, dreamy visions
- many puzzles to solve
- escape room mechanics
- many interactive, fully physics-based items
- crafting/building mechanics

title: Straimium Immortaly [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Igra na styke zhanrov roguelite, strelyalki i pokhoda po podzemelyam zastavit vas srazhatsya s udivitelnymi vragami. V Straimium Immortaly vam predstoit pobedit groznuyu imperatritsu. K vashim uslugam raketnyy ranets i ogromnyy arsenal oruzhiya i usileniy. Podvizhnost, tochnoe upravlenie, massa nagrad — vse eto pomozhet vam vyzhit v Kubikuse.

Osobennosti
Etot mir unikalen: udivitelnoe napolnennoe chudovishchami okruzhenie Kubikusa sozdaetsya kazhdyy raz zanovo.
Potustoronniy mir v pikselyakh: staraya tekhnika beret na vooruzhenie novye kraski!
Letite bystro i khvatayte pushku pobolshe — ot ionnogo lazera do metatelya molniy, bolshe 25 vidov uluchshaemogo oruzhiya i bolshe 50 predmetov.
Dazhe nindzya pozaviduet: vy smozhete ispolzovat raznoobraznye sposobnosti shinobi.
Nokautiruyte gigantskikh negodyaev: spasite galaktiku ot zakhvatchikov, pobezhdaya ogromnykh chudovishch!
Srazhaytes, kak vam nravitsya, pri pomoshchi otkryvaemykh klassov, mutatorov, chitov i shapok. Chtoby privnesti pobolshe raznoobraziya, mozhno nastroit protsess generatsii urovney i ikh razmer. Est rezhimy boya s bossami, nashestviya i drugie.
Mnozhestvo pokazateley: sledite za svoim rostom v tablitsakh liderov, za dostizheniyami, chitayte entsiklopediyu vragov, bossov, oruzhiya, predmetov i mnogogo drugogo.

title: Jack N Jill DX [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Odnazhdy Dzhek i Dzhill reshili podnyatsya na goru, chtoby nabrat vody, no eta zateya ne privela ikh ni k chemu khoroshemu. I, otkrovenno govorya, eshche odnikh Dzheka i Dzhill tozhe zhdalo mnozhestvo priklyucheniy.

Oldskulnyy odnoknopochnyy platformer Jack N’ Jill DX pozvolyaet vybrat syuzhetnuyu liniyu Dzheka i preodolet samye neveroyatnye prepyatstviya, chtoby snova vstretitsya s Dzhill v kontse kazhdogo iz 140 urovney. A tem, komu khochetsya nemnogo izmenit privychnyy khod sobytiy, mogut poprobovat sebya v roli Dzhill i otpravitsya na spasenie Dzheka!

Osobennosti:
* 7 mirov po 20 urovney v kazhdom
* 7 mini-igr, v kotorykh mozhno poluchit bilety dlya pokupok vo vnutriigrovom magazine
* Magazin, v kotorom za vnutriigrovye bilety mozhno razblokirovat raznoobraznye golovnye ubory i pomenyat tsvet ekrana
* Zerkalnyy rezhim
* 2 igrovykh personazha

title: Him & Her Collection (Him and Her / Her Challenges DLC / Him & Her 3) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Him & Her Collection 帶來了三款具有挑戰性的益智平台系列遊戲，Him & Her、Her Challenges 和 Him & Her 3。

你可以從橫向滾動的角度移動你的角色，並且在任何時候，你也可以跳躍。 但是，當不跳躍時，你只需走向平台，整個關卡將根據你移動壁架的方向旋轉。

從灰色的世界到引人入勝的配樂，它的黑暗主題但家庭友好的基調將讓每一刻都成為一種愉快的體驗，因為玩家找出正確的路線將他或她活到他的靈魂伴侶身邊。

遊戲特色
- 此版本合集中的三款遊戲；
- 超過100個不同難度級別的挑戰；
- 普通和困難難度設置；
- 喜怒無常的藝術圖形；
- 被激怒的經歷；


由 Willams 開發並由 QUByte Interactive 與 Game Nacional 發布

title: Ovivo [NSP][ENG]
description:
Vas zhdet puteshestvie po metaforicheskomu miru, napolnennomu illyuziyami i skrytymi poslaniyami.

V mire OVIVO Chernoe i Beloe zhivut v garmonii. Perepletayas i zamenyaya drug druga, oni soblyudayut ravnovesie. Glavnyy geroy — OVO, porozhdenie etikh dvukh polovinok, kotoroe obladaet svoystvom peremeshchatsya iz odnogo prostranstva v drugoe. Sozdanie puteshestvuet po abstraktnomu miru, i, preodolevaya opasnosti, sobiraet simvoly, kotorye pomogut uznat, kakie tayny khranit etot mir, no interpretatsiyu ego istorii my ostavlyaem na vas.

Osobennosti:
- Mekhanika potoka. V belom tsvete sila gravitatsii napravlena vniz, v chernom — vverkh. Blagodarya impulsu pri perekhode iz chernogo v beloe igrok slovno v potoke plyvet vdol ikh granitsy.
- Dizayn bez slov. V igre net teksta, a istoriya povestvuetsya cherez geympley i vizualnyy ryad.
- Meditativnaya muzyka gruppy Brokenkites.
- Zavorazhivayushchiy art. V metaforicheskom mire OVIVO vy vstretite mnozhestvo skrytykh obrazov i opticheskikh illyuziy.

title: Cryptrio [NSZ][ENG]
developer: Chequered Ink (Allison J. James, Daniel Johnston Menezes)
description:
Monstro-arkadnaya pikselnaya igra «tri v ryad» — s izyuminkoy! Soedinyayte figury v pravilnykh mestakh, chtoby ochistit podzemele ot monstrov i pobedit bossov, vse radi pogoni za naivysshim vozmozhnym schetom. Voydite v sklep i pobedite kak mozhno bolshe vragov — prezhde chem oni sokrushat vas!
Soberite 3 odinakovykh monstrika, chtoby ikh pobedit. A strannye, shatkie formy oznachayut, chto vam pridetsya khoroshenko popotet i podumat o tom, kuda i kak soedinit kazhduyu chast, chtoby ne okazatsya zagnannym v ugol.
Prigotovtes pogruzitsya v razrushayushchiysya sklep i dokazat svoyu tsennost kak geroya golovolomok!
Ot sozdateley Gyro Boss DX / Monoquous 2 / Revolver and Co / Ink Cipher.

title: Gyro Boss DX [NSZ][ENG]
developer: Chequered Ink. (Allison J. James, Daniel Johnston Menezes)
description:
Your home planet is under siege from a band of intergalactic pirates led by the fiendish Gyro Boss!

Unfortunately your technology is no match for this deadly beast and his crazy weapons. Every game is doomed from the start, but you'll fight with honour to complete your mission objectives and achieve the best possible score.

Dodge an endless assault of weapons as you orbit around the boss on a fixed circle, it's not as easy as it looks. Can you secure bragging rights as the best space pilot to bite the dust against the alien menace?

Crazy Weapons

Dodge Gyro Boss' crazy attacks including shoals of squid, extendable boxing gloves, cluster bombs, homing silverfish and many more. You can even find out which weapons cause you the most trouble by looking up your deaths in the statistics menu.

Multiplayer Madness

New to Gyro Boss DX - enter party mode with 2-4 players and battle the boss together. Party mode cycles through a variety of weird mini games including faulty brakes mode and civil war. Who will come out on top?

Fifty Objectives

When your friends aren't around, you can always enjoy classic mode. We've added 50 objectives to the game so you can feel good about yourself even when you're failing miserably in your fight against the Gyro Boss.

Dare to take on the Gyro Boss today. Your planet needs you.

title: Hotel Sowls [NSZ][ENG]
description:
夢想成為名利雙收的藥學家的你
在索爾斯地區找到了「神秘之石」。

“有了它，研究就一定能取得成功！”

經過長途旅行，你已經疲憊不堪，於是入住索爾斯酒店休息，
不料卻在第二天早上發現行李箱中的石頭不見了。

“肯定是被人偷走了！”

就這樣，你開始在酒店中尋找神秘之石……

◆奪回神秘之石
住宿在酒店的時間僅有五天。
在有限的時間內找出偷走神秘之石的犯人吧！

◆線索就在酒店內
這座彌漫著古怪氣息的酒店隱藏著秘密！
要通過探索與探聽追查石頭的下落！

◆無法預料的結局
你的選擇將會使命運發生改變！
由玩家的選擇決定走向的多結局系統。

title: Cruel Bands Career [NSZ][ENG]
description:
《殘酷樂隊生涯》是一款風格獨特，玩法迥異的另類遊戲。

三人樂隊肩負著秘密使命進行演出，唯一棘手的就是不斷湧來的“觀眾”。需要時刻留意樂手的心情，通過調整他們在舞臺上的站位、使用其各自的技能來控制局面。

隨著路線的推進，樂隊可以選擇不同的能力升級，或在誤入的隱藏房間小憩，探索愈加兇險的世界，直至抵達故事的終點。

多位可選角色 - 每個樂手的技能各有特點，用它們來對付那些討厭的觀眾或向巨大的boss開炮。

觀看演出的朋友們 - 朋友們會隨著旅程的進行逐漸解鎖，當他們在場下扭動身體時，也會盡職盡責地發揮作用。

title: Ord [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
Ord. - eto unikalnyy vzglyad na tekstovye priklyuchencheskie igry s minimalistichnym ispolzovaniem slov, vizualnykh effektov i zvuka. Igrayte v unikalnye istorii vsego iz 3 slov! Svoim originalnym podkhodom k povestvovaniyu i igrovomu dizaynu Ord. zastavit vas smeyatsya i plakat. Sygrayte v Ord., chtoby ubeditsya v etom sami! 

Igra Ord. poluchila mnozhestvo nagrad kritikov i otraslevykh premiy za novatorskiy podkhod k povestvovaniyu. Igra voshla v ofitsialnyy otbor AdventureX Narrative Games Convention v 2019 godu, stala finalistom konkursa TIGA Games Industry Awards, a takzhe pobeditelem premii FutureZone Award v 2019 godu.
Sygrayte v Ord. i uznayte, pochemu vokrug nee stolko shumikhi!

Kharakteristiki
* Pyat unikalnykh istoriy dlya igry
* Minimalistichnye grafika, teksty i zvuk

title: Breakneck City [NSZ][ENG]
description:
當狠毒的黑幫試圖燒毀他們最愛的錄影帶出租店，Sidney Flintlock 和 Justine Jacobs 便走上街頭，準備大展拳腳。
《Breakneck City》是一款注重與環境互動的老派 3D 清版動作遊戲。特色包括低面數圖像、像素風格質地，以及能夠單機雙人組隊合作闖關，《Breakneck City》將 1990 年代後期的鬥毆動作帶入一個新世代。

在 6 道極為困難的關卡中揮拳、出腳並躲避，關卡包括城市巷弄、舞廳、摩天大樓以及更多！擊敗類型各異的黑幫成員和難纏的首領。在戰鬥中拾起武器提升效率，並使用環境創造優勢。利用燈桿使出迴旋踢，將敵人踹進垃圾桶或踢出窗外，並從天而降一腳造成巨大傷亡。你得利用周圍環境創造優勢，對抗那些來勢洶洶的敵人！

特色：

• 6 道手工 3D 關卡等你來闖！
• 2 名角色供你選擇，也可以單機組隊合作闖關。
• 拾起武器，擴大優勢！
• 利用環境進行特殊攻擊和快速掃蕩。
• 享受老派街機美學和經典的低面數設計。

title: Superation [NSZ][ENG]
description: Srazites s Torom i zasluzhite svoe mesto sredi bogov. Razblokiruyte novye blagosloveniya i proydite vse ispytaniya, chtoby otkryt mudrost skandinaskikh run v nashem boksyorskom rogalike v stile PlayStation 1 s bossami! Ona sochetaet v sebe tochnyy bystryy boksyorskiy boy s reigrabelnostyu i razblokiruemymi predmetami, kotorye predlagayut obychnye roguelite-igry s 9 bossami, i vsyo eto s izucheniem filosofii samosovershenstvovaniya.

title: God Damn the Garden [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
God Damn The Garden brosaet tebe vyzov: proyti ispytanie Ublyudochnogo skeleta, proveryayushchego, dostoin li ty stat sleduyushchim korolem Ofigennykh nebes.

V ogromnom podzemnom mire naydi sposob vybratsya iz tainstvennykh glubin Proklyatogo bogom mira, probivayas skvoz agressivnykh sushchestv.

Dobyvay boepripasy iz rasteniy, chtoby stanovitsya silnee, i naydi sovershennoe oruzhie, kotoroe pomozhet tebe vybratsya iz glubin.


Kharakteristiki:
* Stremitelnaya strelba po proklyatym zhivotnym
* Atmosfernoe issledovanie v tainstvennykh glubinakh Proklyatogo bogom mira
* Nezabyvaemye bitvy s bossami
* Realno debilnye dialogi
* Klassnyy originalnyy saundtrek
* Kapibary

title: Blood Breed [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Blood Breed - eto brutalnyy khorror v stile retro so slozhnym igrovym protsessom i ""vzroslymi"" vizualnymi effektami (nagotu mozhno otklyuchit v menyu igry). 

V etoy stilnoy igre vy budete borotsya za svoyu zhizn i issledovat igrovoy mir, sozdannyy vruchnuyu.

Vasha mashina lomaetsya i vy ostaetes odin na odin s tainstvennym mestom, polnym krovi, s uzhasnym manyakom, okhotyashchimsya za vami. Po mere togo, kak vy pogruzhaetes v istoriyu, vy nachinaete obnaruzhivat izvrashchennyy i okkultnyy smysl... 

Vyzhivete li vy, chtoby snova uvidet dnevnoy svet?

title: Boreal Tenebrae Deluxe edition [NSZ][ENG]
description:
解開謎團
你扮演多個角色，每個角色都有自己的故事，並前往城鎮的實際地點和他們的黑暗版本。
在這場噩夢中，你要破除兇殺案，尋找失踪的妹妹莎拉，完成神秘的儀式，拯救垂死的小鎮。 你能解開 博雷亞爾 特內佈雷 豪華 的所有黑暗秘密嗎？

尋找莎拉
探索一個一切都不正常的病態城鎮。 鎮上出現了發出催眠靜電的奇怪盒子。 一些市民，包括莎拉，已經被這個神秘物體吸收，再也沒有回來。

博雷亞爾 特內佈雷 豪華 在 2021 年加拿大遊戲大獎中獲得最佳藝術指導和最佳敘事提名。

主要特徵：
• 經典復古風格冒險
• 恐怖元素和血腥
• 多個角色的故事驅動任務
• 固定相機

title: Vaccine / Vaccine Rebirth [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Your friend has been infected again, find a cure before time runs out. But it won't be easy, sooner or later your friend will relapse and you'll have to find a new cure in a new randomly generated mansion. Will you be able to discover the secret of the mansion and save your friend once and for all?

Vaccine Rebirth has been built from scratch, expanding the original idea, including new gameplay mechanics, enemies, locations, weapons and much more!

Share the fear playing in the new local cooperative mode or beat the best online records of other survivors.

title: Nova 111 [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
駕駛堅固可靠的飛船，在這款獲獎肯定的回合制科幻冒險遊戲中闖蕩神祕的異星球，同時親身體驗即時對戰的絕妙遊戲設計。你的任務：恢復原有的時空秩序，並尋找在「宇宙大實驗」後下落不明的幾位科學家。你只有一名助手引導你前進 (儘管他對三明治的愛好近乎瘋狂)，而你必須在他的輔助下，全力讓時間漩渦恢復正常運作！

絞盡腦汁，破解各個棘手關卡！在這個時空中，回合制的遊戲世界和即時運作的世界相互碰撞，你必須在這個扭曲的遊戲環境中，與奇特的外太空生物全力奮戰。

遊走三個繽紛美麗的奇異世界！過程中，你必須設法獲取新技能來保護自己，並記得收集飛船所需的升級模組。不過無論你怎麼做，都別忘了科學始終是你最強大的武器！

遊戲特色：
▪ 輪到你了！但同時也是我的回合 – 結合回合制和即時對戰設計，創新模式令人驚豔
▪ 事前準備不算作弊 – 機智作戰，智慧終究勝過蠻力
▪ 太空冒險引發不適症狀？– 燒腦的重重難關才是讓人頭痛的元兇
▪ 視覺饗宴 – 每個精心打造的星球各具風采，分別具有獨一無二的敵人和環境，需以不同戰略對症下藥
▪ 威力無上限！- 善用特殊雷射武器或「時間暫停」之類的特殊能力，任意扭曲時間以創造優勢
▪ 突破時空邊界 – 為飛船收集大量升級組件和模組，航向更遠的疆域
▪ 遊戲越激烈，配樂也會越熱血 – 動態配樂會隨著玩法而變化，增添情境感
▪ 科學就是信仰！- 畢竟誰不愛科學進展呢？

title: Wand Wars [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Wand Wars — dinamichnaya, volshebnaya indi igra v zhanre «Lokalnyy multipleer». Igroki letayut na metlakh po drevnim arenam, brosayutsya zaklinaniyami i prevrashchayut sopernikov v ocharovatelnykh tsyplyat. V osnove sostyazaniya lezhit upravlenie moshchnym magicheskim sharom, kotoryy otskakivaet ot granits areny, uvelichivayas so vremenem po skorosti i razmeru. Volshebnye areny igry, krasochnye personazhi i neobychnye zakoldovannye samotsvety sozdayut uvlekatelnyy igrovoy protsess, v kotorom neveroyatno veselo uchastvovat i za kotorym interestno nablyudat. Ottachivayte svoi navyki i raskroyte skazochnuyu vselennuyu Wand Wars v odinochnoy igre Story Mode ili ispytayte sebya v beskonechnom khaose The Trials (1-2 igroka). I nakonets, igrayte protiv druzey ili kompyutera v 7-mi zakhvatyvayushchikh multipleer rezhimakh (do 4-kh igrokov).

Klyuchevye osobennosti:
• Rezhimy odinochnoy igry: Story Mode i The Trials (1-2 igroka).
• Lokalnyy multipleer (do 4-kh igrokov) s semyu rezhimami igry: Arcane Arena, Team Arena, Merlinball, Hexout, Team Hexout, Spellstorm i Medley.
• Izmenyayushchie igru areny, usileniya i zaklinaniya.
• Otkrytie kontenta po mere polucheniya XP (po zhelaniyu).
• Krasivaya grafika v pikselnom stile na sovremennyy lad.
• Originalnyy, polnyy magii saundtrek.

title: Unichrome a 1 Bit Unicorn Adventure [NSZ][ENG]
description: 以經典 Atari 的精神重溫復古遊戲機時代的輝煌，同時體驗令人心跳加速的平台和射擊動作。 通過嚴格的控制、令人耳目一新的遊戲機制、破解復古藝術和令人上癮的配樂，為街機樂趣做好準備。

title: Space Roguelike Adventure [NSZ][ENG]
description:
現在，在平行宇宙之外還有另一個遙遠的星系——彩虹星球突然出現在那裡，沒有什麼特別的原因。它擁有如此強大的磁場，幾乎擊碎了監獄星球阿巴卡茲的保護屏障。許多危險的銀河罪犯已經設法逃脫並定居在一些無人居住的土地上。所有這些不幸的事件將我們帶到了一個來自地球的年輕獵人的冒險開始的地步。當然是你！

那麼，我們的數字口袋裡有什麼：

- 五個獨特的行星
- 獨角獸的腦袋專橫跋扈（要把你逼死）
- 能量劍
- 看起來如此熟悉的有趣太空裝甲
- 程序生成的關卡
- 還有更多（我們只有六個關鍵功能）

好了，您可以盡情享受我們最新的遊戲：Space Roguelike Adventure！是的，我們選擇了這個標題，因為它是對這篇文學豐富的營銷帖子的完美總結。

title: Petite Adventure [NSZ][ENG]
description:
V Petite Adventure vy vodite kroshechnye mashinki po vsemu domu i vypolnyaete neprostye zadachi.

Sovershayte drift na 360°, lopayte vozdushnye shary, igrayte v golf, sobirayte monety i issleduyte kazhdyy uroven. V Petite Adventure est 32 zadaniya raznoy slozhnosti.

Upravlyayte mnozhestvom miniatyurnykh avtomobiley, vklyuchaya legkovushki i gruzoviki; ovladeyte iskusstvom vozhdeniya v stesnennykh bytovykh usloviyakh i ne svalites s kraya stola!


Kharakteristiki:
* Simpatichnye kroshechnye mashinki
* 32 urovnya
* Razlichnye mekhaniki (drift, lopanie vozdushnykh sharov, igra v golf i mnogoe drugoe)
* Simpatichnaya 3D-grafika

title: Lone McLonegan: A Western Adventure [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Odinokiy MakLonegan kogda-to byl «samym razyskivaemym prestupnikom na Starom Zapade», no teper on nemnogo zarzhavel i poteryal formu. Bregg Plokhish, ego zaklyatyy vrag, teper nomer odin v spiske samykh razyskivaemykh prestupnikov i novyy idol Zapada.

Kogda Odinochka uznaet o poslednem podvige Plokhisha, on dopivaet svoy mokhito, vskakivaet s divana i reshaet vernut sebe tron, ograbiv bank Oldevella, gde khranitsya samyy nadezhnyy seyf v okruge. Eto, nesomnenno, snova naznachit samuyu vysokuyu tsenu za ego golovu, i on, nakonets, prevzoydet Plokhisha!

Na polputi dilizhans, v kotorom ekhal Odinochka, podvergaetsya napadeniyu killerov Plokhisha, i Odinochke prikhoditsya idti peshkom v Oldvell, chtoby snova voyti v istoriyu.

 - Poznakomtes s mnozhestvom prichudlivykh personazhey.
 - Reshayte slozhnye i veselye golovolomki.
 - Vzlomayte samyy bezopasnyy seyf v okruge.
 - Organizuyte pobeg iz tyurmy.
 - Smeshayte opasnye ingredienty.
 - Vzryvayte vse vokrug.
 - Vrite.
 - Shutite.
 - Vyzhmite vse soki iz kaktusa...
 - O, i... pobeyte Plokhisha!

Priklyuchenie staroy shkoly
Lone McLonegan — eto priklyuchencheskaya igra v zhanre point-n-click. Ishchite, podbirayte i ispolzuyte predmety, razgovarivayte i vzaimodeystvuyte s personazhami, pinayte predmety, nosite s soboy beschislennye strannye predmety inventarya i ispolzuyte ikh samym komichnym obrazom.

Odinochka, krutoy paren
Odinochka — klassicheskiy krutoy paren... no tolko vneshne. Vnutri on myagkiy i truslivyy. On izbegaet drak, kogda mozhet, i obychno vykhodit iz samykh zaputannykh situatsiy, ispolzuya svoyu smekalku i, konechno, vashu pomoshch. V igre Lone McLonegan vy ne prosto reshaete golovolomki! Odinochka budet razgovarivat s vami, obsuzhdat vashi resheniya i pokoryat vas svoey individualnostyu.

Sozdannaya s lyubovyu igra
Vse personazhi narisovany vruchnuyu, a stseny sokhranyayut osobyy sharm starykh vesternov. My vklyuchili ssylki na pop-kulturu, kotorye zastavyat vas gromko smeyatsya, i zabavnye anakhronizmy, kotorye delayut Lone McLonegan unikalnoy igroy s ogromnoy individualnostyu, kotoraya ne ostavit vas ravnodushnymi.

Pomogite Odinochke stat «samym razyskivaemym prestupnikom Starogo Zapada»!

title: Flewfie's Adventure [NSZ][ENG]
description: Planeta Kyumellou v opasnosti, ved Uzzu i ego roy monstrov gotovy vzyat verkh!

title: Dungeons and Doomknights Adventure Quest 8-Bit [NSZ][ENG]
description:
深入《AdventureQuest 8-Bit: Dungeons & DoomKnights》迷人的敘事中，探索年輕英雄艾提克斯不為人知的傳奇故事。艾提克斯在聖騎士試煉中獲得成功後，回到了一個震驚的場景：他的村莊變成廢墟，被亡靈軍團摧毀，村民們也消失了。他發誓要救出他們並擊敗造成這一創傷的末日騎士。你會與艾提克斯聯手克服亡靈威脅，還是會奪取權力並親自領導？

關鍵特點：

沉浸在一個8位冒險世界中，探索和動作的經典元素在此匯聚。
體驗全新混沌模式，帶來獨特的轉折和更高的興奮。
發現加深故事並延長你的遊戲體驗的額外遊戲。
開始《AdventureQuest 8-Bit: Dungeons & DoomKnights》的旅程，決定艾提克斯和他的世界的命運，在這個迷人的冒險中！

title: Adventure Bar Story [NSZ][ENG]
description: Rolevoy simulyator iz portativnoy sistemy Nintendo 3DS po upravleniyu barom s milymi devushkami, v kotoroy vy stremites stat luchshim restoranom korolevstva!.. Rang vashego bara budet povyshatsya v zavisimosti ot rezultatov na korolevskikh kulinarnykh konkursakh i rostu prodazh. Otkryvayte vsyo novye goroda i podzemelya, gde mozhno nayti vsyo bolshe i materialov, i retseptov!

title: Subpar Pool [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Pogruzites v protsedurno sgenerirovannye urovni, sostoyashchie iz seriy stolov s sharami, kotorye nuzhno zagnat v lunki za opredelennoe kolichestvo udarov. Naslazhdaytes neveroyatno yarkim mirom, pridumyvaya plan po zabivaniyu sharov. Nablyudayte za tem, kak etot plan rushitsya, ibo dlya pobedy kazhdyy khod nuzhno podstraivatsya pod situatsiyu.

Prodvigaytes po igre i sozdavayte sobstvennyy kurs, vybiraya karty iz kolody, — nastraivayte slozhnost i stil igry pod sebya. Khotite ispytat svoi vozmozhnosti? Uchastvuyte v Bystroy igre, gde vremya na podgotovku udara ogranicheno. Khotite urovni s portalami? Ili, mozhet, s konveyernymi lentami? Subpar Pool vas ne razocharuet. V Subpar Pool mozhno igrat dazhe so steklyannymi sharami. Chto budet, kogda oni stolknutsya? Kombinirovat karty mozhno tysyachami raznykh sposobov, kazhdyy raz sozdavaya unikalnyy opyt.

Pogruzites v ocharovatelnyy zhivoy mir Subpar Pool i uznayte, smozhete li spravitsya s nepredskazuemostyu postoyanno menyayushchikhsya sharov, stalkivayushchikhsya v uvlekatelnom i zavorazhivayushchem opyte.

Osobennosti:
•  Chetyre raznykh mira — kazhdyy so svoimi ispytaniyami i ogranicheniyami
•  Protsedurno generiruemye stoly i 18 raznykh kart s bolee chem 14 000 sposobov ikh kombinirovat, kazhdyy raz sozdavaya svezhiy igrovoy opyt
•  Kompaktnaya semeynaya igra dlya nebolshikh igrovykh sessiy (ili bolshikh, esli zakhotite!), dostupnaya kogda i gde ugodno
•  Potryasayushche yarkiy frantsuzskiy khudozhestvennyy stil, chto pogruzit vas v ocharovatelnyy mir 
•  Atmosfernyy uspokaivayushchiy fank-saundtrek, navevayushchiy nuzhnoe nastroenie
•  Ot grapefrukt games — razrabotchikov, sozdavshikh polyubivshiesya igrokam i otmechennye nagradami holedown, twofold inc i rymdkapsel

title: Ryan's Rescue Squad [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Druzey Rayana ukrali zlodei — Titan Tmy, Robo-Kombo i Krysolyud, i spasti ikh mozhete tolko vy! Otpravlyaytes v priklyuchenie, polnoe slizi, bossov na kosmicheskikh korablyakh i yaits s syurprizami. Sobirayte solnechnye monetki i yaytsa s syurprizami, chtoby otkryt novye predmety v magazine i ukrasit svoego geroya smeshnymi inoplanetnymi shapkami, geymerskimi aksessuarami i drugimi veshchichkami. Chtoby spasti mir, vam prigodyatsya superudary i navyki platformennoy akrobatiki.

V odinochku so zlodeyami ne spravitsya, i v etom puteshestvii vas prikroyut zabavnye personazhi Ryan’s World. Bochki Dzhilla, korabl Mo, sliz Klyuvika — vragam nesdobrovat! Zdes dazhe mozhno budet osedlat gigantskogo Sheldona! Vse eti sposobnosti stanut dostupny po mere izucheniya udivitelnykh mirov igrushek, piratov, prisheltsev i dinozavrov, v kazhdom iz kotorykh nuzhno spasti kogo-to iz druzey Rayana.

Vybirayte svoego geroya — Rayana, Kombo-Pandu, Alfa-Leksu ili Krokodilchika Gusa — i otpravlyaytes v mir Ryan’s World. Druzya i vzroslye tozhe mogut igrat vmeste s vami v rezhime dlya dvukh igrokov — dlya etogo my pridumali rezhimy «Polet na kosmicheskom korable» i «Pol — eto lava». Smozhete li vy odolet Titana Tmy i ego uzhasnykh soyuznikov?

•	VYBERITE PERSONAZhA: stante Rayanom, Kombo-Pandoy, Alfa-Leksoy ili Krokodilchikom Gusom

•	RABOTAYTE V KOMANDE: dostupna igra vdvoem po lokalnoy seti

•	IGRAYTE V MINI-IGRY: vy smozhete sygrat v «Metkogo strelka», «Polet na kosmicheskom korable», «Pol — eto lava» i «Beglyy ogon»!

•	SOBIRAYTES S SILAMI: eshte pitstsu Mo, chtoby stat neuyazvimym!

•	KOLLEKTsIONIRUYTE I UKRAShAYTE SEBYa: razblokiruyte neveroyatnye novye kostyumy dlya geroya i sozdayte svoy stil

title: Surmount [NSZ][ENG]
description:
《Surmount》是一款自由流暢且採用物理運算的平台冒險遊戲。玩家能在此體驗爬山的樂趣。挑戰Om山上各種手工或程式自動生成的危險攀爬路徑，而沿途還能與古怪的人們一起講述一個白癡好笑的故事。可以單人或與朋友一起掌握各自獨特的攀爬風格，並能透過升級和定制您的登山家來有更好的表現。說不定您就是第一個登上世界巔峰的人哦！

遊戲特色：
- 使用物理運算且操作簡單的攀爬系統，可以無限重玩，不用擔心失敗後的懲罰機制。
- 關卡混合了開發小組自製的區域，以及由程式自動生成出的頗有挑戰性區域。
- 在前往Om山頂的途中會遭遇各種古怪的角色，他們每個人都有自己的登頂理由。
- 解鎖各種永久和可裝備的物品，這些物品能用來提高你的能力值。
- 透過自訂角色外觀功能，成為最時髦的登山家吧。
- 可以單人遊玩，或是利用區域連線跟朋友們同樂。

title: Ruvato Original Complex [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 机器翻译 来自 most2820
description:
'Ria', a veteran mercenary of HA Company, receives a command to "enter the Neuroscience Research Institute and capture a scientist alive", but fails her mission as the scientist kills himself.
On her way back, Ria rescues a child 'Ai,' a girl in a state of suspended animation, and secretly lives a secluded life with the girl, aiding her recovery.

Their peaceful life is soon interrupted, when HA Company finds out about the girl and sends another mercenary to attack Ria.
Ria becomes critically injured and the girl gets kidnapped and taken elsewhere...
Standing at the crossroads of life and death, Ria transforms her body into a cyborg and heads to HA Company to find the mysterious girl.

"Ruvato : Original Complex" is a "high-speed, hack and slash, action game" taking place in the near future. 
A player controls the protagonist, Ria, and moves around within the stage to quickly attack enemies and clear missions.
As the player continuously knocks down enemies, their attack power increases and it becomes easier to strike down more enemies.
An effective strategy is to knock down weaker enemies first to quickly increase attack power.
A player gains items after knocking down enemies, and using these items, the player can strengthen various skills to execute more effective attacks. 
At the end of each area awaits a battle with the extremely powerful boss who performs incredible attacks.
Even if a player dies, the player could try again and again to improve the player's own techniques and enjoy clearing the stages.
By tackling various missions throughout the game, the user could also enjoy feelings of accomplishment.

Stolen Girl, Hidden Truth 
Ruvato : Original Complex

title: Clea / Clea 2 [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
S tragedii v osobnyake Uitlokov proshlo chetyre goda. Byvshaya sluzhanka Florin namerena voskresit cheloveka, kotoryy byl dlya nee vsem. Chtoby dobitsya svoego, ey predstoit proyti cherez trete izmerenie i popast v miry za ego predelami. Nevoobrazimye uzhasy podsteregayut ee na puti, no Florin ne sobiraetsya pokoryatsya sudbe.

V kontse kontsov... eto ee posledniy shans na iskuplenie.

* * *

Khorror, kotoryy proveryaet umeniya:

«Klea 2» proveryaet umeniya igroka. Vragi brodyat po koridoram v realnom vremeni i reagiruyut na maleyshiy shum. «Klea» – neprostaya igra, kotoraya voznagrazhdaet tekh, kto khorosho osvoil ee mekhaniki.

Nikakikh skrimerov:

V Clea 1 ne bylo nikakikh skrimerov, i prodolzhenie soblyudaet etu traditsiyu.

Reigrabelnost:

Kostyumy/galerei/urovni slozhnosti, kotorye otkryvayutsya postepenno, neskolko kontsovok i dazhe arkadnyy rezhim. U Florin predostatochno povodov povtorit svoe puteshestvie.

Polnoe ozvuchenie:

Vse kat-stseny polnostyu ozvucheny. Naslazhdaytes igroy akterov, vse bolshe pogruzhayas v mir Clea.

title: Eternal Hope [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
«Vy gotovy poyti na kray sveta za svoimi lyubimymi. No poydete li vy dalshe?».

V igre Eternal Hope vy budete upravlyat Ti Bi — odinokim malchikom, kotoryy poteryal lyubov vsey svoey zhizni. Soprovodite ego v neobychnom puteshestvii: spustites v pokhozhiy na chistilishche Mir teney i popytaytes vernut obratno dushu ego lyubimoy devochki. No puteshestvie po etomu miru budet neprostym. Na puti vam vstretitsya mnozhestvo opasnostey i zagadok, kotorye nuzhno reshit, prezhde chem dvigatsya dalshe.

Khranitel dush daroval Ti Bi vozmozhnost peremeshchatsya mezhdu mirami. Blagodarya novoy sile malchik smozhet puteshestvovat, reshat golovolomki i znakomitsya s potustoronnimi sozdaniyami, chto zhivut sredi teney. Otpravtes vmeste s Ti Bi v mir posle i otkroyte drevnie sekrety, kotorye nevedomy smertnym.

Osobennosti igry Eternal Hope
• Puteshestvuyte po zhutkovatomu volshebnomu miru, polnomu tayn!
• Peresekayte tainstvennye lesa, zagadochnye peshchery i drevnie goroda, chtoby podnyatsya v gory i voyti v Khram dush.
• Ispolzuyte osobye sily, chtoby peremeshchatsya mezhdu mirami i menyat okruzhayushchuyu sredu.
• Reshayte golovolomki i polzuytes pomoshchyu! Vsyo i vse kto vas okruzhaet v Mire teney mozhet pomoch vam preodolet prepyatstviya.
• Drug ili vrag? Znakomtes s unikalnymi sushchestvami i uznavayte bolshe o sozdaniyakh, naselyayushchikh Mir teney.
• Chudesnyy originalnyy saundtrek pomozhet vam s golovoy pogruzitsya v trogatelnuyu istoriyu Ti Bi.
• Puteshestvuyte po chudesnym mestam, kotorye pomogayut istorii raskrytsya v polnoy mere.
• Smotrite na mir glazami Ti Bi i uznayte pravdu o sebe i o davno zabytoy tsivilizatsii.

title: Mike Dies [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Everything is out to get poor Mike. Portals that slice him to bits. Demons with giant swords. Scary eyeballs. Killer statues. And other, horrible things, that we can't mention in this family-friendly description.

Only your platforming skills can keep Mike alive!

- Explore a massive non-linear spaceship, with like, a million secret areas.

- Dying is actually fun! You will only feel bad for Mike a little bit.

- Multiple endings! Unravel Mike’s enigmatic past and discover his true fate!

- Epic boss encounters!

- Fully voice acted!

*No actual Mikes were harmed in the making of this title.

title: Elden Path of the Forgotten [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description: 遊戲通過顛覆傳統的方式，利用間接敘述的方式來講述和探索故事，就好比在閱讀一本你不懂的語言的圖集。遊戲中的戰鬥是基於玩家的反應，而不是動作，你需要有效判定你的耐力消耗和所在位置，同時等待攻擊的最佳時機。遊戲的主視覺靈感來自經典的16-bit和8-bit遊戲，在Elden: Path of the Forgotten中，將會有一個神秘莫測，黑暗且迷霧重重的世界等待著你的探索。

title: Chex Quest HD [NSZ][ENG]
developer: Flight School Studio, Team Chex Quest HD
description:
Otpravlyaytes na dalekuyu planetu Bazoyk, chtoby osvobodit zhiteley galaktiki ot flamoidov, poedayushchikh zlaki! Chex Quest HD — eto sovremennyy remeyk klassicheskoy odnoimennoy igry 1996 goda.
Forpost Mezhgalakticheskoy federatsii zakusok na otdalennoy planete Bazoyk byl zakhvachen zlobnymi sushchestvami iz drugogo izmereniya, pitayushchimisya zlakami! Eti skolzkie sushchestva vzyali v plen vsekh zhiteley. K schastyu, u vas est udobnyy nabor «zortsiruyushchikh» ustroystv, kotorye mogut otpravit etikh zakhvatchikov obratno v ikh rodnoe izmerenie!

title: Forrader Hero [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description: Poshagovaya igra s elementami rogalika, v kotoroy geroi ne mogut otstupit i dolzhny srazhatsya do kontsa, chtoby spasti svoyu dushu v Zabytom Proto.Mire, srazhayas s polchishchami monstrov, nezhiti i ikh povelitelyami.

title: Speedgunner Ultra [NSZ][RUS/Multi3]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 3]
description: Speedgunner Ultra 以令人印象深刻的方式混合了兩種不同的類型——平台遊戲和射擊遊戲。 只需按下一個按鈕，您就可以在兩種變體之間切換：能夠發射火箭的武裝半機械人和能夠衝刺和加速的反應式噴氣式飛機。 明智地使用你的形式和能力來克服挑戰並粉碎你的敵人。 當您玩 Speedgunner Ultra 時，只有您可以決定如何超越遊戲中的記錄。 所以，朋友，告訴我們你有什麼！

title: Dead Station [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
description:
Dead Station 是由 Oliver's Adventures in the Fairyland 的開發商 Hoodoo Bear 推出的新作品。 這是在空間站«Soyuz-1»上設置的老式平台體驗，被一些敵對怪物佔領。 你的任務是用近戰武器和槍支武裝自己，找到關於那裡到底發生了什麼的任何答案，無論如何都要生存！

這是生存動作類型的新轉折——你必須運用你的智慧和周圍的環境才能通過這個車站。 其實不是“死”，更像是“死”！ 你認為你有能力冒險穿過這些危險的大廳和走廊嗎？

title: Mist Hunter [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
description:
Unusual magic weapons, 100 of trophies that change the play style, 7 arenas that will put your skills to test.

Features 
*Combat - frantic combat that incentives to use and change all the weapons constantly. Almost every enemy has weakness to the Mist it has been corrupted by. Use the same type of Mist as the enemy to obliterate them in seconds.

*Fluid movement system - gives a high degree of traversal freedom from the get go. Double jumps and dashes that can be later upgraded and infused with special traits.

*100 of upgrades - that can drastically change the play style

*Powerful power-ups - that may help you win the hardest of the battles

*Weird Enemies - creatures from different worlds corrupted by the Mists.

*Combos system - show off your  style and mastery

*12 unique magic weapons - each with two distinct fire modes that have strength and weakness of their own

title: Phrase Fight (PHRASEFIGHT) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
3428 god nashey ery, Yaponskoe Korolevstvo, ostrov Tokio. Prishla mirnaya epokha, nastupivshaya posle IV Mirovoy voyny. Tem ne menee, razryv mezhdu lyudmi ne byl preodolen. Voznikaet sovershenno novyy vid sporta, v kotorom v storony kachestve oruzhiya ispolzuetsya tolko svoyo chuvstvo ritma!.. Mir, v kotorom kazhdyy mozhet stremitsya k silneyshey pozitsii.
PHRASEFIGHT — eto igra, v kotoroy vy stanete pobezhdaete drug druga — v ritme!.. Atakuyte vovremya pod muzyku, i tochnost raschyota vashego nazhatiya reshit iskhod!..
Sygrayte v dva osnovnykh rezhima igry, «League Fight», gde vy vyigryvaete seriyu bitv protiv II, i «svobodnyy boy», v kotorom vy mozhete svobodno ustanavlivat razlichnye usloviya, i srazhatsya vdvoyom.

title: Live by the Sword Tactics [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Live By The Sword: Tactics is an unashamedly old school tactical RPG with modern gameplay ideas. Set after the fall of the land, you control two brothers who must traverse the kingdom to stop it from falling back into the darkness of conflict. It’s a journey that will test their brotherly bond and the player’s tactical skills as they form a team and go on this heroic quest.

The game is a new take on Tactical / Strategy gameplay. Characters do not gain experience points and you cannot collect overpowered equipment to easily bypass difficult fights. You, the player, must become more skilled to achieve victory. Are you up for the challenge of becoming a true Tactician?

■Multiple Game Modes
Live by the Sword: Tactics features many ways to play:
- Story Mode that features a group of adventurers who discover an evil plot.
- Adventure Mode that has you building the world as you explore it. Beware, defeat means death in this mode.
- Tactician Mode that places you in odd battle scenarios to solve. Many with unique win conditions. 
- Online battles between two players. 
- Local battles between two players.

Coming Post-Release
- Tools to create custom battlefields.
- Ranked Online multiplayer.
- Additional Classes

■Classes
The battle system in Live by the Sword revolves around 5 vs 5 battles. The player has the choice of building their team with 7 unique classes. 
- The Alchemist, Archer, Assassin, Brawler, Medic, Warrior and Wizard

Each class possess an innate ability as well as a pool of 8 unique abilities to choose from. Choose wisely as you can only take 4 into battle.

title: Sea Horizon [NSZ][ENG]
description:
在《海平線》的世界中，每一步都是攸關生死的頂尖冒險！《海平線》是 Roguelike 類型的回合制 RPG 遊戲，本作以 3D 鳥瞰方式展現蜂巢狀網格地圖，破碎的邁里希恩群島會隨每次探索呈現出不同面貌。

從擁有各自故事背景和個人動機的眾多主角中進行選擇。在穿越豐富地貌和危險海域時繪製路線圖，一邊裝備武器，悉心管理飢餓和健康狀態，衡量每個支線任務的潛在獎勵是否值得冒險，藉由祝福過關斬將並做出戰鬥中的生死抉擇！

你會在危機四伏的領域揚名立萬，或像之前的冒險者一樣成為無名屍呢？

特色：

• 以傳統的角色扮演風格在蜂巢狀地圖中穿梭！
• 在回合制戰鬥中，使用卡牌和骰子謹慎行動！
• 探索隱藏地點並挖掘寶藏，讓旅程更加愜意！
• 解鎖並遊玩多位角色，每位角色均有各自的故事和動機。
• 管理飢餓和健康狀態，衡量每個場景的獎勵是否值得冒險。
• 面對隨機的地點和事件，探索多種結局！

title: N Verlore Verstand [NSZ][ENG]
description:
在迷失的心靈中，你將被帶入夢想和夢魘的現實。在潛意識的這段旅程中，你會發現自己會發現什麼？

在這些未知的領域中，你必須經歷迷宮般的記憶，最終找到適合自己真理的道路。

特徵：

 - 抽象冒險。
 - 參與夢幻般的環境。
 - 神秘的謎題。
 - 平台化
 - 探索

title: Here Be Dragons [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 俄语, lyubitelskiy ZoG
description:
Here Be Dragons is a satirical turn-based strategy game featuring a unique "living map" graphics, where you lead a group of crazed captains.

Christopher Columbus discovered the Americas in 1492. In 10 weeks. With 100 men. With 3 ships. This is a LIE!

Firstly, someone had to defeat Kraken and tritons. Someone had to vanquish the Leviathan. Someone had to banish all the ghost ships. The information about these deeds is missing from the archives, and you can’t find it in any great statesmen’s memoir. The knowledge of the “Avant Armada” was completely erased by some bloody officials.

Features:
- Use the original Dice Activation System to attack enemies, heal your crew, and upgrade the fleet.
- Collect Ink and use Errata to turn the tide of the encounter.
- Cross the seas with an ancient, living map, full of terrible creatures that want to devour you!
- Confront the most fierce beasts that ever lived: leviathans and krakens, predatory whales, and lustful mermaids. Decimate tritons, awake Dagon, and then erase them from human memory.

title: MeteoHeroes (Meteo Heroes) Saving Planet Earth [NSZ][ENG]
description:
MEET THE SIX COOL SUPERHERO KIDS WHO ARE HERE TO SAVE PLANET EARTH

Wherever and whenever they are needed, you’ll find the MeteoHeroes! Our super-powered friends are ready to solve any problem that may affect the environment – anywhere on Earth! Travel with them from Rome to the South Pole, as they take on incredible missions, visiting nine amazing places on our planet until they reach their final destination – and a showdown with their fearsome arch-enemies Doctor Makina and the Maculans!

Help our heroes to use their unique weather-controlling powers to defeat the Maculans. Come with them to nine famous locations threatened by chaos and pollution and help them to fight for a clean, safe planet. You’ll travel through Rome, Cape Town, Sydney, Seattle, Harbin, Buenos Aires, the South Pole and the Amazon until you reach the Gran Sasso and the MEC, the MeteoHeroes’ base. But the MEC has been taken over by Dr. Makina's evil Maculans! Can you help the team to get it back?

Get ready for a fun-filled action platform game in which you must find the hidden items that will help you clean up every city and get the MeteoHeroes’ back to their home – while keeping out of reach of the many enemies that want to stop you. It’s fabulous fun for children of all ages – and, of course, features all the characters from the popular TV series MeteoHeroes!

Features:

•	All six members of the fabulous MeteoHeroes team: Fulmen, Nix, Nubess, Pluvia, Thermo and Ventum
•	 Use the powers of each of the MeteoHeroes to overcome the different dangers and defeat the Maculans in lots of exciting scenarios!
•	Play as two different MeteoHeroes in each mission!
•	Nine exciting adventures, nine locations, all continents!

title: Joojee's Journey [NSZ][ENG]
developer: Quantum Peaks, Digital Innovative Design and Technology Center
description:
In this whimsical narrative adventure, you’ll play as Joojee, a lovable bunny who suddenly wakes up without her memory. Armed with nothing but her charm and a mysterious magic brush that allows her to enter anyone’s mind, Joojee goes on a journey to recover her lost memories while helping others overcome their own troubles.
Game features:
•	Touching and funny character backstories and memories.
•	Challenging platformer sequences.
•	Mind-bending riddles and puzzles.
•	Assist mode that lets players skip challenging obstacles if they wish.
Prepare to smile, laugh, and cry in Joojee’s journey! Available in Thai, English, Japanese, and French. More languages will be released in the future.

title: Dotori [NSZ][ENG]
description:
主角“利可”是一隻以收集橡果為生的松鼠。
有一天，它和弟弟“洛蒂”一起收集橡果時，突然冒出一隻貓頭鷹擄走了弟弟！

為了救出“洛蒂”，“利可”踏上了艱難的旅途……

· 和松鼠“利可”一起在充滿謎團的世界探險吧！
· 奔跑、跳躍、投擲！操作簡單的炫酷動作！
· 去尋找隱藏在關卡各處的橡果吧！
· 攻擊模式多變的BOSS，緊張刺激的BOSS戰
· 過關後解鎖的終極難度隱藏關卡！

松鼠“利可”能救出弟弟“洛蒂”嗎？

“洛蒂”等我……，
我一定會去救你！

title: Putty Pals [NSP][ENG]
description:
Two adorable bouncing blobs are lost far from home, and only teamwork, communication and a whole lot of hilarious mistakes will guide them back. Sitting side-by-side on the couch, you and a friend will glide, bounce, squish and swing your way through a vibrant cartoon landscape, solving puzzles, avoiding danger and uncovering hidden secrets.

PURE CO-OP GOODNESS
Putty Pals isn’t just a single-player game that two people can play together. It’s been designed from the ground up to be a cooperative two-player experience.
- Color-based puzzles mean both players have important jobs to do
- Flatten yourself into a trampoline to bounce your friend to new heights
- Communication is key: you won’t get anywhere if you don’t talk to each other

A WHIMSICAL WORLD!
You know what Putty Pals isn’t? BROWN! Play as colorful characters in a colorful world and enjoy a fun, feel-good experience that will leave you smiling.
- Featuring cute characters with adorable animations
- Hilarious character voices that will make you giggle
- Explore locations from explosive Mt Puttuvius to frozen Puttarctica

SO MUCH TO EXPLORE
Share hours of fun with your co-op buddy as you bounce your way through a bonanza of challenges and collectibles.
- 28 full-sized levels, plus 25 unlockable bonus mini-levels for extra challenge
- Cunningly hidden secrets and taxing time trials will keep you coming back for more

title: Super Sami Roll [NSZ][ENG]
description:
The wicked Albert VII has captured Sami’s friend Vera and only you can help him save her! But it won’t be easy – you’ll need to roll, grapple, and jump to make it through in the colorful 3D world of Super Sami Roll.

Embark on a journey rolling through beautiful green fields, deserts dotted with magnificent pyramids, dangerous oozing volcanoes, frigid ice lands and many other memorable places with rolling physics and tons of hidden secrets!

Features:
- Beautiful World: Explore colorful, eye-catching environments, characters and enemies.
- Level Variety: Play through dozens upon dozens of unique levels
- 2D & 3D Art: Features a combination of painstakingly hand-crafted pixel art and modern 3D graphics
- Secret Hunting: Find tons of secrets – including awesome unlockable modes (even a multiplayer one!)
- Challenges: Progressive difficulty that’s been fine-tuned to keep you engaged until you become a true master!
- Sami in Style: Customize your character.
- Great Tunes: Upbeat soundtrack, check!

title: Sentinels of Freedom [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Prepare for a story-driven campaign within the Sentinel Comics universe as you join forces with an ever-growing team of heroes to face a wide variety of villains. What seems like a typical bank heist reveals itself to be just the beginning of a much more sinister plan! Create your hero, gather your team, and save the world in this exciting new turn-based strategy!

	Highlights
Build Your Team - select from the many available heroes and unlock more throughout
Full Story Campaign - writers and creators from Sentinel Comics
Freeform Movement - Turn-based game that allows you to move anywhere
Squad Dynamics - heroes or villains can work together for more powerful actions
Massive Mission Variety - multiple objectives, interactions and dangers
Create Your Hero - choose backstory, archetype, powers, and appearance
What kind of hero will you be? 
Sentinels of Freedom will feature Chapter 1 - as a self contained story - on release with many levels, new heroes and villains, along with hero upgrades.  Chapter 2 will release shortly after in 2020 with other chapters planned to follow.

Custom Heroes
Choose the character's backstory, personality, power source, abilities and costume. Heroes have "stances" that provide boosts to certain stats like extra movement along with powerful sets of abilities and can be fully customized to fit your play style.

Build your hero from 12 exciting themes - fill your stances with powerful abilities from any three:
Power Melee - When you really want to hit someone really hard.
Combos - Concentrate your attacks, spread 'em out, or bring a friend!
Supportive - Whether protecting or attacking, the right move requires no planning.
Blaster - Attack as many as you can in several different areas!
Interceptor - Never let an enemy out of your sights and punish wrong moves.
Minions - Disposable and endless, have your own minions fight for you!
Gadgets - Deploy an arsenal of gadgets that eliminate all who oppose you.
And more!

Creating a superhero identity is more than a costume selection! Choose how your hero uses their abilities, different weapons, attack styles, and special effects; some themes even have different types of units that you can summon. Refine your heroic identity throughout the game - changing everything about how your hero looks, all the way down to your hero's body type, between any mission.

Sync and Vigilance Actions
Sync and Vigilance actions add life to the battlefield when characters perform additional actions out of sequence, triggered by special conditions. When a character performs an action, sync actions allow other characters to take part or enhance that action, like a character creating a distraction to remove the target's Evade defense before an attack lands. Positioning your team to take advantage of these extra actions can be critical to the success of a mission.

Vigilance allows an inactive character to react to the active character based on various triggers, such as moving through their line of sight. Each character has a "vigilance zone" around them which sets the chance of the vigilance action happening. These actions can go much further than the standard overwatch with actions like "keep cover" which allows a character to try and find new cover when flanked.

Large Scale Missions
Players will embark on several missions throughout the campaign. These missions are broken up into groups of engagements - each offering unique objectives, enemy types and player choice on where to go next - keeping each feeling fresh and unique. Another benefit to these smaller engagements is that the player will not be overwhelmed by both the quantity of enemies and time for each turn. However, stringing all these engagements together still allows the player to feel like their heroes are very powerful as they dispatch lots of enemies throughout the mission.

Initiative
Will you be able to rescue the hostages in time? Can you survive the chaos until more defensive actions are taken? Initiative can have

title: Blockamok Remix (移植版 ) [NSP][ENG]
description:
Vy (sluchayno) zapustili svoy kosmicheskiy korabl pryamo v ogromnuyu chervotochinu.
Udivitelno, no on okazalsya v alternativnom izmerenii, zapolnennom odnimi tolko pravilnymi geksaedrami.
Vazhnyy drossel na vashem pepelatse polnostyu sloman, i postepenno prodolzhaet nabirat skorost.
Kak dolgo vy smozhete vyzhit?..

title: Inkventure [NSZ][ENG]
