description:
Prisoedinyaytes k Glupiku, milomu ottsu-odinochke, v krasochnom pazl-platformere! Reshayte tsvetnye golovolomki i spasayte svoikh chudakovatykh detishek v etoy ocharovatelnoy igre!
Tainstvennoe vedro zasasyvaet chetyrekh ozornykh detey Glupika v yarkoe, napolnennoe tsvetami izmerenie. Teper emu — slaymu-ottsu — predstoit prygnut vnutr, osvoit iskusstvo smeny tsvetov i spasti svoikh chudakovatykh detey! Sopostavlyayte tsvet Glupa s polom, ostorozhno prokhodya kazhdyy uroven. Smotrite pod nogi! Pereklyuchaytes mezhdu zelenym, krasnym, sinim i zhyoltym tsvetami, kasayas vedyor, napolnennykh raznotsvetnymi chernilami, chtoby bezopasno dobratsya do doma.
Tolkayte yashchiki, sootvetstvuyushchie tekushchemu tsvetu, chtoby podnyatsya na bolee vysokie platformy, otkryvayte zapertye dveri, nakhodya i aktiviruya rychagi pravilnogo tsveta, chtoby prodvinutsya v svoem puteshestvii.

title: Disc Jam [NSP][ENG]
description:
Setevye servery Disc Jam budut otklyucheny 30 sentyabrya 2022 goda. Vse setevye funktsii etoy igry (vklyuchaya mnogopolzovatelskie setevye rezhimy) budut otklyucheny v etot den. Vy po-prezhnemu smozhete igrat i naslazhdatsya etoy igroy v odinochnom i lokalnom oflayn rezhimakh. Odnako s 30 sentyabrya 2022 goda v etoy igre bolshe ne budut dostupny vse setevye funktsii.

Disc Jam – dinamichnaya sportivnaya igra dlya 2–4 igrokov, zakhvatyvayushchaya smes aerokhokkeya s tennisom. Igroki pytayutsya zavladet osobym svetyashchimsya diskom i primenyayut uboynye navyki, chtoby zabit gol sopernikam, odnovremenno prikryvaya zonu zashchity na svoey polovine polya. Eta arkadnaya igra, uvlekatelnoe sochetanie strategii i ekshna, predostavlyaet na vybor mnozhestvo bezumnykh personazhey i pozvolyaet igrat s druzyami!

title: Dungeon Encounters [NSZ][ENG]
description:
■《DungeonEncounters》簡介
《DungeonEncounters》是一款追求極簡遊戲設計的迷宮探索RPG。本作基於原始設計理念，盡可能簡化視覺表現和效果，因此玩家可以體驗遊戲系統本身的樂趣。

當運用技能探索迷宮時，將會遭遇各種以十六進位表示的事件。戰鬥也包含在事件之中，玩家將與非同一般的敵人展開驚心動魄的戰鬥，並且需要反覆探索才能到達更深的階層。本作最大的魅力就在於玩家可以透過此過程享受到自主思考的樂趣。

此外，走遍地圖本身也是遊戲的主要目的之一。迷宮內還存在著稀有道具、尚未加入的夥伴和稀有敵人等豐富多彩的收集要素。克服了無數困難之後，在最深層等待玩家的究竟是什麼……

■事件
在本作中，「獲得道具」、「HP回復」、「更換技能」、「武器店」和「防具店」這些一般RPG中的獨立要素在地圖上也以「事件」的形式存在，並顯示為白色號碼。同樣，與敵人的戰鬥也存在於地圖上，如果裝備了「Fiend Scouting（顯示戰鬥號碼）」的技能，則將以黑色號碼顯示。事件滿足條件時，則可以隨時從選單的「Log（日誌）」中查閱，這將有助於玩家攻略迷宮。

■戰鬥
戰鬥方面則採用了「FINALFANTASY」系列中熟悉的「Active・Time・Battle（ATB）」系統。此系統將基於每個角色的速度，對敵方盟友即時進行攻擊和防禦（※）。由於此系統的設計者同時擔任本作總監，因此可以享受經過仔細打磨的ATB系統也是本作的特徵之一。（※玩家在選擇指令時還可以設定「Wait（等待）」使時間停止。）

■地圖
地圖由橫竪網格分隔而成的正方形格子組成，畫面左上角顯示目前位置的坐標。每走遍一整層的所有格子就可以獲得「技能分數」，因此推薦積極去走遍地圖。然而，較深樓層的格子本身會被隱藏或設置陷阱，因此前進時需要小心謹慎。

title: MegaZeux Game Creation System + 122 igry (khoumbryu Mega Zeux / MZX GCS) [NSP][ENG]
description:
MegaZeux — eto GPL-2.0 sistema sozdaniya igr (GCS), napisannaya Endryu Poyntonom v 1994 godu; virtualnaya platforma dlya sozdaniya 2D-igr, analogichnaya takim, naprimer, kak RPG Maker.
On dayot vozmozhnsot polzovatelyam sozdavat svoi sobstvennye igry, ispolzuya prostoy yazyk programmirovaniya i vizualnyy redaktor.
Iznachalno v MegaZeux po umolchaniyu vklyuchena igra Caverns of Zeux, kotoraya sluzhit primerom togo, chto mozhno sozdavat s pomoshchyu etoy sistemy.

title: Frowntown [NSZ][ENG]
description:
深入「皺眉鎮」，一個輕鬆愉快的生活模擬風格喜劇角色扮演遊戲。

你已經辭去日常工作，追求一個既令人畏懼又充滿興奮的夢想：成為一個在笑聲既是挑戰也是獎賞的城市裡的脫口秀喜劇演員。「皺眉鎮」不是關於拯救世界；它是關於用一套好節目來拯救你的夜晚。

• 舞台上的成功取決於你將智慧與不同俱樂部觀眾的偏好相匹配的能力，導航各種因素可能成就或破壞你的表演。

• 「皺眉鎮」的生活不全是關於表演。你在台下做出的決策——從與誘惑調情到做出個人承諾——可以影響你的狀態和遊戲中的路徑。這些選擇，連同升級你的裝備，都在你向著喜劇競技場事件，即「皺眉鎮」喜劇場景的巔峰，的旅程中扮演角色。

• 簡約的2D-3D像素藝術風格和吸引人的配樂，「皺眉鎮」提供了一個輕鬆深入的脫口秀喜劇世界。在這裡，每一個決策都輕微地影響你的軌跡，從未知到可能被記住。

你從工作到舞台的信念跳躍會讓你成為焦點，還是成為城市背景的一部分？同時：所以，你決定成為一個脫口秀喜劇演員了嗎？

title: We Should Talk [NSZ][ENG]
description:
We should talk is a short-form narrative game that will make you think carefully about the words you choose. Can your relationship survive the night?

Using a unique narrative choice mechanic, players craft sentences in response to the in-game characters in We should talk. Through this careful choice of words, players express themselves as they discuss ongoing problems about life and romance with their in-game partner over text messages, while also chatting with friends and strangers at their favorite local bar about what’s on their mind. The combination of words they choose impacts the conversations they have, how genuinely they can connect with their partner, and whether their relationship can survive the night.

title: Wide Ocean Big Jacket [NSZ][ENG]
description:
** INDEPENDENT GAMES FESTIVAL 2020 - FINALIST - EXCELLENCE IN NARRATIVE **

Take part in a classic camping trip: Roast hot dogs on the fire, go birdwatching, tell ghost stories, grab a beverage from the cooler and do cartwheels on the beach.

WOBJ is a short story game including 20 chapters, 4 playable characters, 10,000 words of dialog and 8 explorable areas, all rendered in a beautiful 2D/3D art style.


Playtime: 60-90 minutes

(like watching a good movie with friends or curling up to read a book)

title: Date Z + 4 DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Dobro pozhalovat v strastnoe zakhvatyvayushchee priklyuchenie, neozhidannye povoroty shkolnoy dramy, tayn i romantiki. Vasha debyutnaya nedelya v novoy shkole dlya starsheklassnika prevrashchaetsya v neobyknovennuyu gonku so vremenem. Rech idet ne tolko o tom, chtoby zavesti druzey ili poluchit vysshee obrazovanie. Vashe vyzhivanie zavisit ot odnoy zadachi: nayti svidanie k pyatnitse!
Eta prichudlivaya srednyaya shkola v malenkom gorodke raspolozhena na vershine staroy zabroshennoy voennoy aviabazy s zapertymi dveryami i potaynymi prokhodami. Pod rutinoy shkolnoy zhizni shevelitsya chto-to trevozhnoe, brosaya zloveshchuyu ten na shkolu. No reshenie etoy tayny mozhet podozhdat. Vo-pervykh, vam nuzhno nayti svoyu paru i obespechit sebe vyzhivanie.

title: Vertical Kingdom [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Interesnaya krasochnaya strategicheski-kartochnaya «pixel-perfect» igra pro stroitelstvo gorodov! Est eshchyo odna osobennost – vy mozhete stroit tolko vverkh!..
Sobytiya Vertical Kingdom prokhodyat v mire, opustoshyonnom voynoy, kotoraya dlilas tseloe pokolenie. Nekogda velikaya Imperiya v upadke, i Velikomu Arkhitektoru predstoit po kirpichiku vernut ey byloe velichie. Puteshestvuyte po miru, otpravlyaytes v sluchaynye ekspeditsii v stile rouglayt i vozvodite novye goroda s pomoshchyu novoy kartochnoy sistemy stroitelstva v sochetanii so slozhnoy ekonomikoy resursov. Vosstanovite Imperiyu ne siloy oruzhiya ili politicheskimi igrami, a kirpichom i tsementom!

title: Eight-Minute Empire [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Ofitsialnaya versiya nastolnoy igry - "Vosmiminutnaya Imperiya" (Eight-Minute Empire), avtor Rayan Lokat (Ryan Laukat).

Vosmiminutnaya imperiya: Polnoe Izdanie soderzhit vse dopolnitelnye materialy, vypushchennye na segodnyashniy den:  
• Vosmiminutnaya imperiya: bazovaya igra
• Rasshirenie Gory
• Karty:
- Staraya Evropa
- Arkhipelag Azra
- Yuzhnye ravniny
- Meteoritnyy krater
- Peresheek Gom

Postroyte imperiyu priblizitelno za vosem minut!

Soberite voysko, chtoby usilit svoyu armiyu
Komanduyte vooruzhennymi silami, chtoby priobresti novye provintsii
Broste vyzov svoim druzyam po vsemu miru
Pereplyvite i morya i okeany i postroyte zamki, chtoby rasshirit svoyu imperiyu
Unichtozhte vrazheskie voyska, chtoby oslabit svoikh protivnikov
Sobirayte tovary, chtoby usilit svoi preimushchestva

"Vosmiminutnaya imperiya", avtora Rayana Lokata - eto bystraya igra, v kotoroy ispolzuetsya tema Tsivilizatsii/Issledovaniya pri pomoshchi zonalnogo kontrolya pod upravleniem kartochek.

V igre "Vosmiminutnaya Imperiya" 2-5 igrokov po ocheredi vybirayut kartochku iz shesti pokazannykh na ekrane. Kartochka daet igroku resurs, a takzhe imeet deystvie, kotoroe igrok vypolnyaet nemedlenno. Deystviya pomogayut igrokam brat v svoe rasporyazhenie kartu, no sobranie resursov stoit ballov v kontse igry, poetomu igrokam neobkhodimo uravnoveshivat dva etikh aspekta. Igroki raspredelyayutsya po karte s tselyu sobrat bally v kontse igry putyom polucheniya podavlyayushchego bolshinstva v regionakh i na kontinentakh.

"Vosmiminutnaya imperiya" - eto sverkhbystraya igra za zonalnyy kontrol, trebuyushchaya zhestkikh resheniy. V neyo legko nauchitsya igrat i sovershenstvovat navyki, kogda u vas est vsego lish neskolko minut.

Funktsii:
- ofitsialnaya igra "Vosmiminutnaya Imperiya"
- yazyki: angliyskiy, nemetskiy, gollandskiy, polskiy, frantsuzskiy, ispanskiy, italyanskiy, koreyskiy, yaponskiy, kitayskiy traditsionnyy i uproshchennyy, russkiy
- rezhim propuska v igre
- setevaya igra cherez internet s sinkhronnym i asinkhronnym rezhimami
- povtor poslednikh khodov opponenta
- 3 urovnya slozhnosti s individualnymi strategiyami Ala
- oshchushchenie unikalnoy, originalnoy nastolnoy igry na vashem elektronnom ustroystve
- rezhim dlya daltonikov
- bolee 70 dostizheniy

title: Airport [NSP][ENG]
description:
身為一個孩子，您是否曾夢想成為空中交通管制員，管理數百架玩具飛機和乘客的航班？ 好吧，現在您可以使用 Nintendo Switch™ 的全新交通管理遊戲 Airport！

機場是一款完美的派對遊戲，或是一個人玩的挑戰遊戲。 每個關卡都是一個美麗而複雜的發條機器，等著玩家。 最多四名玩家可以組隊一起控制機場，或者你也可以單獨玩，看看你有多厲害。

如果您喜歡易於上手但難以掌握的遊戲，那麼您一定會喜歡《Airport》。 這是一款讓您感覺又回到童年的遊戲，玩您最喜歡的玩具並享受樂趣。

Airport 有 50 多個難度和複雜性不斷增加的關卡，每個關卡都有自己的目標和挑戰。 如果您正在尋找更多挑戰，您可以嘗試可解鎖的困難模式，這將更加考驗您的技能和協調能力。

《機場》現已在 Nintendo Switch™ 上推出，所以拿起你的控制器，準備起飛吧！

title: Indygo [RUS (Mod.)/NSZ][ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 俄语, 移植版 来自 kugarus
description:
Indygo tells the story of a painter who suffers from depression. One of the symptoms is proceeding isolation. The main character hasn’t left his room for more than 3 months. The person who helps him live through this hard time is his girlfriend Anna. It became obvious for both of them, that this situation can’t last forever. The time has come to look for a solution. It’s up to the player to decide how the story will progress.

Features:
- Deep, melancholy atmosphere thanks to high quality handmade art and originally composed soundtrack.
- Intriguing story evolving at every subtle, seemingly trivial decision.
- Engaging narrative with multiple endings depending on the decisions made by the player.
- Unique, ever-changing room which reacts to the mental state of the main character.

title: Strife Veteran Edition [NSZ][ENG]
description:
The Original Strife is back!

Hailed as the original FPS-RPG game that spawned countless imitators, Strife: Veteran Edition is a love letter to the classic from 1996.

Immerse yourself in this all-consuming epic quest - now available for the first time on the Nintendo Switch™!
An evil presence has implanted itself in the fabric of our world. Play the role of spy, assassin, warrior and thief as you are lured into the darkest and most perilous adventure of your life. You´ll have Blackbird on your side - a seductive underground agent that will provide you with clues as you encounter progressively more sinister foes. Be strong, and trust no one. 

FULLY INTERACTIVE WORLD
The elaborate virtual environment offers 28 interconnected levels covering over 200 square miles. Explore medieval towns and industrial complexes filled with pitfalls and perils, ending in a final confrontation that will reveal the planet's darkest secrets.

AN AWESOME ARSENAL
From the silent but lethal crossbow to the breathtaking flame thrower, you'll toast, mince and vaporize your opponents in your search to control the ultimate weapon of mass destruction- the Sigil.

NAIL-BITING NARRATIVE
In your role as resistance fighter, you'll conspire with allies to demolish the fanatical ranks of the order from the inside out. Provides an engaging complex storyline and a multitude of dramatic voice-overs.

title: Gigapocalypse [NSZ][ENG]
description:
V detstve mnogie iz nas lyubili igrat s drakonami, plevatsya voobrazhaemym ognyom i unichtozhat vsyo podryad.
Teper u vas poyavilas realnaya vozmozhnost stat takim chudovishchem v pikselnoy 2D-igre pro razrusheniya Gigapocalypse, vdokhnovlyonnoy klassicheskimi filmami pro kaydzyu.
Gigapocalypse pozvolyaet vybrat iz mnozhestva «gigantov» iz doistoricheskoy epokhi, neizvedannogo kosmosa ili zabytoy drevnosti. Kazhdyy monstr obladaet unikalnymi navykami, mutatsiyami i oblikami, kotorye otkryvayutsya po mere polucheniya novykh urovney.
Nachnite svoyu volnu razrusheniya i srovnyayte s zemlyoy mnogochislennye detalno prorabotannye pikselnye lokatsii. Vy kogda-nibud zadavalis voprosom, kakovo eto, kogda ogromnoe chudovishche unichtozhaet kovboyskiy gorodok? Ili raskidyvaet khrabrykh rytsarey? Gigapocalypse otvetit na eti i mnozhestvo drugikh voprosov. No budte ostorozhny: zlobnye soldaty, magi, drony i roboty sdelayut vsyo, chtoby vas ostanovit! S kazhdoy popytkoy vash gigant budet stanovitsya vsyo silnee i silnee, gotovyas k bitvam s epicheskimi bossami, kotorye zhdut vas v kontse kazhdogo urovnya.
Vypolnyayte zadaniya, ukhazhivayte za svoim gigantom, kormite i baluyte ego, nakhodite sekretnye vozmozhnosti dlya uluchsheniya giganta i ego «doma», a takzhe otkryvayte milykh, no smertelno opasnykh pitomtsev, kotorye budut vsyudu za vami sledovat.
Gigapocalypse — gromkaya, buntarskaya, brutalnaya, bezumnaya, no takaya milaya dan uvazheniya klassicheskim igram i filmam. Eto igra dlya rebyonka, chto do sikh por zhivyot v kazhdom iz nas.

Osobennosti:
• Devyat gigantov s unikalnymi sposobnostyami i drevami navykov.
• Shest produmannykh do melochey urovney v proshlom, nastoyashchem i budushchem Zemli.
• Tematicheskie vragi i zdaniya.
• Epicheskie i umoritelnye bitvy s bossami.
• Otkryvaemye sputniki, navyki i mutatsii.
• Dopolnitelnye zadaniya i sekrety, otkryvayushchie novye sposobnosti vashikh monstrov.
• Stremitelnyy arkadnyy igrovoy protsess i prostoe upravlenie.
• Nezabyvaemye oshchushcheniya ot pikselnykh razrusheniy.
• Saundtrek v stile khevi-metal, otlichno dopolnyayushchiy tvoryashchiysya v igre khaos.

title: The Card Battle Eternal Destiny (Infinita Strada Hana) [NSP][ENG]
description:
THE Card Battle: Eternal Destiny―― 是一款每張卡牌都附帶動畫、卡牌總量超過600張的卡牌遊戲。
利用這些脫胎於神話和傳說並獨具個性的角色卡牌來構建你的卡組，巧妙地活用進化機制、卡牌技能及屬性，在戰鬥中高奏凱歌吧

概要：
在人類的“千禧年”走向終焉、“歷史時間”靜滯停擺的近未來地球上————人類集結起了Cybers（新人類）以對抗Demons（邪神）和Kells（聖靈）。厭倦了曠日持久、安寧無望的戰事，人們開始將希望寄託在“創世祕蹟”之上，並創建了獨立組織“協調官事務局”。你作爲一名新任協調官，肩負起和領域嚮導們一起探索全世界遺蹟的重任。

最後，誰將獲得“創世祕蹟”並主宰下一個“千禧年”呢・・・？

遊戲特色：
・超過600張附帶動畫的卡牌
・將兩張相同卡牌重合即可進化！
・靈活組合技能、特技與屬性等要素，贏取酣暢淋漓的大勝吧
・新晉協調官直面陰謀的故事模式
・能獲取經驗值、金幣以及稀有卡牌的地下城模式
・以神話與傳說人物爲主題，一衆個性鮮明的卡牌
・選擇你所喜愛的“司令官”，開始遊戲吧！
・推進劇情並獲得寶貴的事件繪圖

title: Cinders [NSP][ENG]
description:
大人版《仙履奇緣》，一切都與玩家的選擇有關，以你喜歡的方式重新塑造著名童話。 

Cinders 是個聰明伶俐的年輕女子，與霸道的繼母和兩個姐姐一起生活，彷彿在重現知名童話。但 Cinders 不像童話主角，她不怕掌握自己的命運。即便這代表要打破規則…… 

這個遊戲聚焦於四名女子及她們的故事。故事講述了自由、夢想、姊妹情誼，以及找尋屬於自己的幸福快樂日子，可能與經典童話的過時寓意不盡相同。

《Cinders》有多種結局、120 個決策點和超過 300 個選擇，讓你完整掌控主角的個性，以及她的故事走向。

title: Double Shot Gals [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Shag vpered! Posle tyazheloy i napryazhennoy nedeli segodnyashniy vecher dolzhen byl stat veselym na yarmarochnoy ploshchadi Paradiz-parka.

Odnako vse ne vsegda idet po planu, i zdes nachinaetsya eta prichudlivaya i seksualnaya istoriya! Snabzhennaya nebolshimi povestvovatelnymi stsenami, igra Double Shot Gals fokusiruetsya na karnavalnykh priklyucheniyakh v zhanre etti s arkadnym geympleem, sozdavaya veseluyu seksualnuyu atmosferu.

Razblokiruy prizy, vklyuchaya novye skiny i illyustratsii.


Kharakteristiki:
* Poznakomsya s 5 potryasayushchimi devushkami!
* 2 vystrela, 2 tipa samotsvetov, 2 obzora!
* Razblokiruemaya galereya s HD-izobrazheniyami khudozhnika-multiplikatora Oskara Selestini!
* Vysokaya reigrabelnost v arkadnom rezhime!
* Etti, etti, etti!

title: Pong Quest [NSP][ENG]
description:
Davayte vmeste veselo otmetim 48-letie velikoy videoigry s Atari!..
Otpravlyaytes v grandioznoe priklyuchenie v PONG Quest na poiski korolya po mnogochislennym tematicheskim podzemelyam, zapolnennym vsevozmozhnymi golovolomkami. Nastroyte svoego geroya i primite vyzov v novom geymplee PONG, vklyuchayushchem bolee 50 razlichnykh arkadnykh mekhanik. Reshayte zadachi i sobirayte trofei, raskryvaya tayny sfer i Spooky Door v puteshestvii.
Vmeste — interesnee! Igrayte s 4 druzyami v bolshikh bitvakh po klassicheskim pravilam i pokazhite vsem, kto yavlyaetsya luchshim igrokom v PONG!

title: Moonleap [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Moonleap is a game about a moon boy on his journey to recover shooting stars. Change day to night with your jump and catch all the stars in this challenging puzzle-platformer!

An innovative mechanic with simple and accessible controls, walk and jump!

title: Halcyon 6: Starbase Commander [NSZ][ENG]
description:
On the edge of Terran space lies Halcyon 6, a derelict starbase left behind by a mysterious precursor race. Your mission is to reclaim the derelict station and rebuild it.
A mysterious alien force is making a beeline towards Earth and this starbase is the best chance for the New Terran Federation to establish new alliances, research new technologies and otherwise figure out a way to stop the impending invasion.

Using only the resources you can salvage from the derelict station and gathered from nearby star systems, it’s up to you to rebuild the starbase to lead the Terran Republic’s scientific research, exploration and diplomatic efforts on the edge of known space.

Features:
- Base Building: spend resources to build station facilities (rooms) to enhance your production and technological capabilities, or build ships to help you control more territory
- Exploration: assign your fleets to nearby star clusters, where they can handle emerging enemy threats, do missions for alien factions or secure bonus resources
- Crew Management: assign crew to station facilities to greatly improve their output efficiency, or to ships where they can contribute in unique ways to combat, missions and events
- Deep Tactical Combat: fight tactical ship or ground battles to resolve hostile events, create a foothold in the sector and ultimately defeat the enemy mothership!
- Story Events: based on game criteria like rooms-built, alien diplomacy scores or officer traits/skills, the game will produce story events (often with multiple choice outcomes) that can lead to combat, time-related applied bonuses/negatives, officer attribute changes or any number of crazy in-game stories.

title: Hot Sento Girls and Love [NSZ][ENG]
description:
為了守護奶奶回憶中的澡堂而決定穿女裝。
這是一款講述女裝男子各種鬧劇的冒險遊戲。

他能在女裝不被發現的情況下守護澡堂嗎？

★Story

-為什麼我一定要穿女裝啊！？-

正在悠閒度過暑假的“Asahi Kirisaki”
接到了奶奶住院的消息。

而又因為住院，
奶奶經營的澡堂迎來了關門的危機。

想做點什麼的Asahi與姐姐Jun Kirisaki
商量的時候，卻被問到是否是認真的。

“當然是認真的！”聽到Asahi的回答之後，
Jun把一個紙袋子交給了他。
裏面裝的是假髮和一套看起來像女裝的衣服。

Jun為Asahi說明了早已被他拋諸腦後的規則——
“公主之湯的收費台基本上都是女性坐著的。”

Asahi正煩惱該吐槽哪里。

而且，因為打工的Chika Kirie正好是被他看到洗澡的女孩子，
為了隱藏自己，他也不得不穿女裝。

就這樣，Asahi穿著女裝重新開始了澡堂的營業。

澡堂的未來到底會變成什麼樣呢。
Asahi能在不被發現女裝的情況下安然度過嗎？

title: Memoranda [NSP][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 俄语, 移植版 djonmarvel
description:
Memoranda is a game about forgetting and being forgotten!

A point and click adventure game with magic realism elements that tells the story of a young woman who gradually realizes that she is forgetting her own name. But is she really losing her memory, or is there something else that could explain the strange situation?

The beautiful hand-drawn adventure takes place in a quiet little town where a few ordinary people live together with some more unusual characters. From a World War II veteran to an elephant taking shelter in a man’s cottage hoping to become a human, everyone in Memoranda has one thing in common: they are all on the verge of losing something. It could be a name, a loved one or even their own sanity!

Features:

- A classic 2D point-and-click adventure game set in a magical realism setting
- Unique and beautiful hand-drawn full-HD 2D graphics
- Original soundtrack with more than 15 tracks
- Thousands of dialogue lines with English voice over
- Meet more than 35 characters in 40 different locations
- Play with buttons or touch screen

title: Raptor: Call of the Shadows, Mercenary 2029 (1994, port raptor-nx) [NSP][ENG]
description:
Deystvie igry proiskhodit v budushchem. Vy — nayomnik, pilotiruyushchego sverkhtekhnologichnyy istrebitel Raptor, vypolnyaya mezhplanetnye missii po unichtozheniyu konkurentov korporatsii MegaCorps: vash istrebitel Raptor predstavlyaet soboy kombinatsiyu reaktivnykh istrebiteley Eurofighter Typhoon (deltovidnoe krylo i aerodinamicheskaya skhema «Utka») i F-15 Eagle (fyuzelyazh i dvoynoy khvost).
I vot, nad sedoy ravninoy zemnoy inoplanetnoy poverkhnosti gordo reet nash kosmokorablik, postrelivayushchiy v supostatov iz bortovykh pushek, zhgushchiy supostatovy doma napalmom i bombami, nu, a do kuchi eshchyo i obchishchayushchiy supostatovu kaznu posredstvom uvorovyvaniya vsyakikh bonusov. Letayushchikh zlodeev ugoshchaem iz razlichnykh pushek i lazerov, zdaniya i vsyakikh rozhdyonnykh polzat — tanki tam, zenitnye ustanovki, korabliki — bombim i zakidyvaem raketami. Sovershenstvovat svoi orudiya spravedlivoy borby s zakhvatchikami i okkupantami rodnoy zemli mozhno v pereryve mezhdu missiyami — v sootvetstvii s zarabotannymi chestnym dengami. Lyubiteley otpuskat gashetku tolko posle smerti bossa zhdyot nebolshoe razocharovanie — raskhod energii korablya na podobnye shalosti meshaet vosstanovleniyu energeticheskogo shchita, kotoryy, mezhdu prochim, zashchishchaet nezhnuyu i chuvstvitelnuyu obshivku zvezdolyota ot zhestokostey vneshnego mira, snaryadov i pul.
«Raptor» — otlichnaya igra: bystraya, vesyolaya i ne osobo zagruzhayushchaya osnovnoy mozg vysokimi myslyami o tom, kuda my letim i zachem my strelyaem — letim kuda prikazhut i strelyaem kuda skazhut. Otklyuchites na paru chasov, pomeditiruyte vmeste s «Zovom Teney»!

title: Aerial Knight's Never Yield [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Poprobuyte vyzhit v futuristicheskom Detroyte. 3D-ranner rasskazyvaet istoriyu Uolli, raskryvshego informatsiyu, kotoraya mozhet navsegda izmenit gorod. Issleduyte igrovoy mir pod fantasticheskiy saundtrek!

SYuZhET
Vam predstoit igrat ot litsa zagadochnogo personazha Uolli. On nashel to, chto bylo u nego ukradeno. Teper ostaetsya nadeyatsya, chto vam khvatit pryti ubezhat ot vragov. Vyyasnite pravdu i postaraytes raskryt taynu proizoshedshego.

IGROVOY PROTsESS
Aerial_Knight's Never Yield — eto trekhmernyy sayd-skroller v zhanre klassicheskogo «beskonechnogo rannera». Zakhvatyvayushchaya syuzhetnaya intriga vse vremya derzhit igrokov v napryazhenii. Begite, prygayte, skolzite i nakhodite potryasayushchie kombinatsii akrobaticheskikh elementov, chtoby preodolevat prepyatstviya. Igroy Aerial_Knight's Never Yield smogut nasladitsya kak lyubiteli parkura, tak i samyy shirokiy krug igrokov.

SAUNDTREK
Saundtrek dlya Aerial_Knight's Never Yield pishet muzykant Danime-Sama iz Detroyta. V nem budut ispolzovany vokalnye partii ispolniteley so vsego mira.

OT RAZRABOTChIKA
Etot proekt nachinalsya kak khobbi: ya delal ego dlya sebya. Mne khotelos sozdat chto-to odnovremenno novoe i znakomoe dlya segodnyashnego pokoleniya geymerov, a takzhe obratit vnimanie na plasty kultury, kotorye obshchestvo chasto obkhodit vnimaniem. Ya nadeyus, chto vam ponravitsya moe detishche i vy budete sledit za moimi dalneyshimi popytkami sozdavat novye interesnye igry.

Aerial_Knight

title: Myths of Orion: Light from the North [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
Long time ago, in a Realm of Orion, a powerful, but greedy wizard collected knowledge from all around the world. And thus came to write the three Books: books of Knowledge, Law and Magic.The books gave him ultimate powers. But, he used them not to prosper, but for chaos!

One day the mighty enchantress Salina gathered all of her strength and courage and stole the Books from the Wizard.
Under the cover of a night, she took the Books and her child, baby Meredith, and ran far, far away to the North, to her sister Ariel's house - at the very edge of the world. She could only hope the Wizard wouldn't find them there. And so, the years and decades passed by... until one day...

- Help Meredith stop the Wizard and his wrath
- Explore the 3 unique Kingdoms of Orion
- Solve hundreds of quests and dozens of Minigames
- Win achievements and find special items
- In-detail customization of your gameplay experience
- Full motion cinematics

title: Zombie Attack Zombies Survival Shooter [NSP][RUS/ENG]
description:
Vy okazyvaetes na zabroshennoy kosmicheskoy stantsii, kotoraya posle neudachnogo nauchnogo eksperimenta prevratilas v nastoyashchiy ad. Zarazhennye zombi, poyavivshiesya v rezultate eksperimenta, zapolonili koridory i otseki... Vasha edinstvennaya zadacha — vyzhit i spastis!
Vy edinstvennyy vyzhivshiy, kto ostalsya chelovekom sredi beschislennykh polchishch razlichnykh zombi. Kazhdyy tip zombi imeet svoi unikalnye kharakteristiki, chto trebuet ot vas adaptatsii i ispolzovaniya sobstvennoy taktiki v kazhdom boyu. V vashem arsenale shirokiy vybor oruzhiya, vklyuchaya kak kholodnoe oruzhie blizhnego boya, tak i dalnoboynoe ognestrelnoe oruzhie.
Issleduyte opasnye koridory, ishchite ukrytiya i probiraytes k vykhodu sredi tolp zombi. Prigotovtes k ispytaniyu, polnomu ostrykh oshchushcheniy, i pokazhite, na chto vy sposobny, stolknuvshis s zombi v pustote kosmosa!
OSOBENNOSTI IGRY:
▪ Mnozhestvo razlichnykh urovney s opasnymi zombi;
▪ Bolshoy arsenal oruzhiya na lyuboy vkus;
▪ Razlichnye vidy zombi.

title: Nexoria Dungeon Rogue Heroes [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
description:
Srazheniya
Igra yavlyaet soboy unikalnuyu smes rogue-like s issledovaniem podzemeliy, RPG, poshagovoy taktiki i kollektsionnoy kartochnoy igry. V osnove poshagovoy sistemy lezhat ne khody, a vremya. Nakhodite i prokachivayte novykh geroev i dobyvayte monety dlya pokupki novykh zaklinaniy. Odnako pomnite, chto smert geroya budet fatalna.

Geroi
Kazhdyy geroy, pomimo trekh kharakteristik (sila, lovkost, vynoslivost) mozhet vladet osobym perkom, a takzhe zaklinaniem. Soberi svoyu komandu geroev, pridumay unikalnuyu taktiku dlya bitv. Traditsionnye Tank, Khiler i Voiny? Ili oboytis lish gruboy siloy?

Vo vremya bitv, v kolodu podmeshivayutsya vybrannye zaranee 20 kart s zaklinaniyami. Kazhdye 6 sekund boya vy berete novuyu kartu v ruku. Vo vremya obychnogo khoda, u vas budet takoy vybor deystviy:
- Obychnaya ataka;
- Oborona;
- Smena pozitsii;
- Primenenie zaklinaniya geroya (odno na kazhdogo);
- Primenenie zaklinaniya iz ruki.

Kazhdoe zaklinanie, bud ono geroyskoe, libo iz kolody, imeet svoyu stoimost many. Mana obshchaya dlya vsekh geroev, i nakaplivaetsya v techenii boya. Takim obrazom igroku predstoit vybirat kakoe zaklinanie nuzhno ispolzovat seychas, ved na sleduyushchee mozhet ne khvatit many.

Podzemelya
Otpravlyayte svoikh geroev v samoe opasnoe priklyuchenie — Podzemelya Neksorii. Sluchayno generiruemye podzemnye etazhi s bossom v kontse kazhdogo. Daleko ne vse smogut vernutsya, a te, kto vernutsya obretut velikuyu slavu!

Sobytiya
Issledovanie podzemeliy tait v sebe ne tolko tolpy vragov, kotorye nuzhno unichtozhit, a mnozhestvo sluchaynykh sobytiy i lovushek, iskhod kotorykh mozhet byt fatalnym.

title: Glyph [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Glyph is a cute, physics-based adventure starring a mech-scarab and his trusted guide, Anobi, challenged with rebuilding an ancient civilization buried under the desert sand. Jump, double-jump, smash and glide through the air in this vertical platformer with amazing controls.

The list:
Time trials
Pure platforming
Refine your skill
Original soundtrack
Customizable cosmetics
Explore and solve puzzles
Value for money at 80+ levels
Route planning in open worlds
One-of-a-kind abilities and controls

title: Disease Hidden Object [NSZ][ENG]
description:
What is “Disease -Hidden Object-”? :
This is a horror adventure game where the player go back and forth in between the real world and the hallucination world.
The purpose of this game is to search items and collect scattered documents while solving mysteries and finding out the truth of the abolished hospital.

Story Line :
The main character is an ex-doctor who’s license was deprived due to hallucination and auditory hallucination from some kind of a mental disease.
To get back his doctor license, the main character decides to take the job which his ex-boss offered.
The job was to collect medical supplies and materials from a certain abolished hospital.
Nothing complicated, just an easy job.
But once the main character began to search inside the hospital, he suddenly becomes very sick.
Mysterious cat.
Unusual hallucination.
Memo which he doesn’t even remember writing.
The fearful mysteries of the hospital, the mysterious materials, and the story of the people who existed in the hospital. 
The main character approaches in the horrifying truth while doubting everything that goes in his mind.

title: Pocket Rumble [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Pocket Rumble retains all the gameplay elements that make traditional fighting games great, but reduces the level of execution and memorization necessary to the bare minimum. That way experienced players can learn the game fast and be able to focus on deeper elements of strategy and mindgames, new players can learn the ins and outs of fighting games without being overwhelmed, and everyone can get their skills to a competitive level without too much grinding alone in training mode.

Features:
* Simple, 2-button controls and universal, easy special move inputs with no complex joystick motions.
* Short combos with easy timing and a straightforward cancel system.
* On-screen frame data bar and visual indicators for properties like invulnerability help players understand fighting game mechanics and how individual moves work.
* Simple, unambiguous health and damage system: All characters have 12 HP and all hits do 1 damage.
* Diverse cast of characters each with their own unique meter and mechanics.
* Quickly swap characters after a lost round to counterpick, just like between matches in a tournament, without slowing down the pace of the match.
* Near-flawless online multiplayer with GGPO netcode.
* Play with any combination of Joy-Con™ and Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller for multiplayer wherever you go.

Offline Modes:
* Arcade: Face off against the rest of the game's cast back to back! Can you survive all 8 matches?
* Versus: Play local matches with friends or the CPU, and get competitive with hidden cursors for double-blind character select at the touch of a button.
* Career: Take part in fictional fighting game tournaments around the globe, playing against AIs based on some of Pocket Rumble's top players and eventually facing off against AIs from some familiar faces in the FGC.
* Lessons: Robust tutorials that teach you the very basics of how fighting games work
* Training: A fully-featured training mode with a variety of hotkeys and options including viewable hitboxes, save states, dummy recording and more.

Online Modes:
* Ranked: Get matched up with players of your skill level online, earn points and rank up with Elo ratings, leaderboards including character-specific rankings, and a rematch button to challenge someone to an unranked set when you need that runback.
* Unranked: Invite your friends to play unranked matches just for fun!

title: To Be or Not To Be [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Ni slova bole: pala svyaz vremen!
     Zachem zhe ya svyazat eyo rozhdyon?
Provedite Gamleta, Ofeliyu i drugikh k ikh vesyoloy smerti v interaktivnom romane «Byt ili ne byt» po motivam «Tragicheskoy istorii Gamleta, printsa datskogo» 1600-go goda, odnoy iz samykh znamenitykh pes mirovoy dramaturgii!
Teper tolko vam reshat, chto budet dalshe. Igrayte za Gamleta i otomstite za smert svoego ottsa. Igrayte za Ofeliyu, i sovershayte proryvnye nauchnye otkrytiya. Igrayte za korolya Gamleta-starshego i umrite na pervoy zhe stranitse (navernoe).
Stsenariy sozdan Rayanom Nortom (komiksy po Adventure Time, Dinosaur Comics, The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl), raboty kotorogo neodnokratno poluchali nagrady Eisner Awards i Harvey Awards, a takzhe vkhodili v spiski bestsellerov New York Times; khudozhniki — Metyu Inmann (The Oatmeal), Keyt Biton (Hark! A Vagrant), Entoni Klark (Nedroid), Mayk Krakhulik (Penny Arcade), Itan Nikol (Axe Cop), Endryu Khassi (MS Paint Adventures), Zak Vayner (Saturday Morning Breakfast Cereal) i mnogikh drugikh!

title: Mushroom Heroes [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
從16位元時代汲取靈感的 Mushroom Heroes，集益智的休閒遊戲與像素美術於一身。 根據面前的障礙，主動地在 3個角色之間轉換。 珍比可以飛躍而起，優比可以用弓箭殺死敵人或引爆牆壁和炸彈，而多比可以用盾牌阻止攻擊或拉動方塊！ 聚在一起，這個快樂的真菌樂隊可以勇敢的面對任何挑戰。

特色：

• 享受由16位元經典啟發的有趣遊戲設計！
• 解決許多具有挑戰性的難題。
• 穿越38個具有挑戰性的關卡。
• 在具有獨特能力的3位英雄之間轉換！
• 克服各種障礙和敵人的類型。

title: Caffeine Victoria's Legacy [NSP][ENG]
description:
Caffeine: Victoria's Legacy — eto priklyuchencheskaya fantasticheskaya vizualnaya novella s bogatym vyborom, deystvie kotoroy proiskhodit v viktorianskoy realnosti v stile stim-pank.

Vo vremya puteshestviya na rodinu svoey davno poteryannoy mamy Taka tainstvennym obrazom okazyvaetsya v gorode Viktoriya. Vskore on smotrit na kofeynyu pod nazvaniem «Kofeynya Taka», tu samuyu kofeynyu, s kotoroy u nego svyazany nezhnye detskie vospominaniya.

Prisoedinyaytes k Take, chtoby uznat ego korni i raskryt sekrety ego semi v gorode, gde barista — rytsari, a kofe — korol.


Kharakteristiki
* Vizualnyy roman epicheskogo masshtaba s 450 000 slov
* Mnozhestvo variantov i kontsovok
* Chetyre varianta razvitiya romanticheskikh otnosheniy
* Animirovannye sprayty i roliki
* Originalnyy saundtrek, vklyuchaya vstupitelnye i finalnye pesni
* Chastichnaya ozvuchka

title: Jubilee [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Preodolevayte prepyatstviya, sobirayte samotsvety i spasayte zveryushek. Jubilee — platformer ne dlya slabykh dukhom: peresech mnogochislennye tropy raznoobraznogo igrovogo mira i vyyti na svobodu smogut tolko samye lovkie. Jubilee ne daet igrokam prava na oshibku: ot vas potrebuetsya polnaya sosredotochennost, inache vmesto uspekha sluchitsya fiasko.
Vy okazalis za reshetkoy za neuplatu dolgov. Po kakomu voobshche pravu?! No, vprochem, vy i ne sobiralis platit…

title: Super Dungeon Tactics [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Super Dungeon Tactics is a classic turn-based game featuring exciting, new gameplay mechanics. Along with traditional RPG characters making you feel right at home, the dynamic gameplay will keep you on your toes.

Call upon 15 heroes, each with unique abilities, to combat the Dark Consul’s forces throughout the magical land of Crystalia. Explore ever-changing dungeons and battle diverse hordes of monsters during your adventures. React to the tides of battle with randomly rolled ability dice; boost core stats or unlock potent abilities, it’s up to you — and a little luck — to use them to their fullest potential. Choose wisely and craft the ultimate band of heroes to complete each adventure.

Key Features :
● Balance of strategy and chance - In Super Dungeon Tactics, chance may influence short term decisions but never gets in the way of your overall strategy.
● Round Boosts - Every round, unique dice enhance character stats and provide access to special abilities making every round a new challenge.
● Loot-based Leveling - With progression tied to loot, no heroes are left behind. Swap equipment around and bring heroes anywhere without worry of underleveling.
● Player-controlled initiative order - Choose which hero activates on an initiative turn to maximize each hero's potential.
● Aggro management system - Influence who the enemy attacks. Passive abilities, consumables, healing, and killing all affect Aggro.
● Persistent Multi-part quests - Quests take heroes on journeys across multiple locations. Divide and conquer by splitting the party to accomplish objectives in different areas.

title: Shishi Timeless Prelude + DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Shishi：永恒的序曲是一款色彩豐富的地宮探索類角色扮演。身為伊莉亞，一個年輕的魔法師，你將深度探索一座聖所，完成各種挑戰並成為一名祭司。

被女神選擇的伊莉亞將展開一場冒險並努力保護王國。不過，她必須先完成訓練。伴隨著她在永恒聖所的探索，伊莉亞變得更加強大，同時也學習了完成考驗所必需的咒語。


色彩豐富的探索之路！
在色彩豐富的地宮探索中與各種生物戰鬥，並保護好你自己！

在另一個時間線上的約會！
每一次探索都在發生在一個新的時間線，也就是說，你將發掘各種各樣的房間，遇見新的敵人以及更多內容！

無人能敵的祭司！
探索、攻擊敵人並收集咒語與道具，讓大家知道你已準備好去保護這個世界！

title: A Good Snowman is Hard to Build [NSP][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
就算是怪獸也需要朋友！繼續探索《怪獸遠征》的世界，在一系列輕鬆好理解的謎題中結交新朋友。在這座冬季花園裡，雪和空間都是有限的，必須有清明的頭腦、遠大的胸襟才能擁抱它們。

• 《Sokobond》風格的推方塊謎題，加上一點冷颼颼的變化。
• 圖形可愛、謎題有趣，來自《怪獸遠征》和《Cosmic Express》團隊的傑作
• Priscilla Snow（《Voyageur》、《JETT: The Far Shore》、《Patrick's Parabox》）的迷人原聲帶

title: Bob the Elementalist / A Frog's Job [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Vsemogushchiy Lyagushachiy bog poobeshchal vam dar reinkarnatsii. Spasite zabludshie dushi 40 lyagushek! Vam darovana sposobnost priostanavlivat i vozobnovlyat vremya po vashemu zhelaniyu.
Pereprygivayte cherez dvizhushchiesya platformy, izbegayte yam, shipov i vragov i dazhe sozdayte svoy sobstvennyy khoverbord!

title: The Dresden Files Cooperative Card Game [NSZ][RUS/Multi4]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 4]
description: Primerte na sebya rol Garri Drezdena i ego druzey: rassleduyte dela iz knig-bestsellerov «Dose Drezdena», izmenennykh po printsipu «chto esli». Chto esli Garri pridetsya deystvovat vmeste s soyuznikami, kotorykh ne bylo v iznachalnoy istorii? V osnovnoy igre vy vstretites s Garri, Merfi, Syuzen, Mayklom i alfami. Syuzhet okhvatyvaet osnovnye sobytiya vsekh pyati knig o Garri Drezdene, a takzhe vklyuchaet v sebya podrabotki: sluchaynye dela, sozdannye na osnove odnoimennogo sbornika rasskazov.

title: Little Bug [NSZ][ENG]
description:
進入一個冒險故事，講述一個名叫 Nyah 的年輕城市女孩被困在一個危險的幻想世界中，邪惡的粉紅色靈魂潛伏在峽谷、冰洞和月光下的沙漠中。

具有挑戰性的遊戲玩法
同時扮演 Nyah 和她的光之夥伴。他們有著不可思議的聯繫，讓一個小女孩能夠擺動和跳得更高，摧毀障礙物，擊敗危險的惡魔並照亮通往秘密區域的道路。

幫助 NYAH 找到回家的路
幫助 Nyah 逃離噩夢。她是一個八歲的好奇小女孩，想像力豐富，在放學回家的路上突然掉進了一個黑暗的敵對世界。

夢幻的世界
探索大氣夢幻般的幻想世界，並在你聰明的朋友的幫助下嘗試到達難以到達的地方。在午餐盒中收集包含 Nyah 生活片段的物品，並將她的故事拼湊起來。
決定你要在旅途中保留哪些寶藏，以及向名為 Roadkill 的貓精靈提供哪些寶藏，它可以解鎖帶有特殊物品和新挑戰的秘密區域。

主要特點
一個充滿奇異惡靈的獨特而危險的幻想世界
出色的圖形風格 - 色彩繽紛的場景，柔和的燈光
兩個可玩角色與獨特的基於物理的擺動機制有關
發現和揭開 Nyah 過去秘密的隱藏寶藏
秘密獎勵關卡，有許多新挑戰等你解鎖

title: Journey to the Blue Mountain [NSZ][ENG]
description: Set off on an adventure to find the way back to the birds' home. Face different animals during the journey through different labyrinths, dodge traps and collect all the feathers. Transit between the map and levels in this platform game.

title: Wet Steps [NSP][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
這個小說的主角不僅僅是普通的高中生！大自然賦予了他體力和魅力，以及漂亮的外表，正是由於這個原因，他經常成為少女夢的對象。有一天，他注意到一個迷人的年輕女孩叫艾里斯穿著怪異，跟著他小聲嘟噥著一些神奇的單詞。但是，如果這些詞不是“愛情咒語”，而是應該擔心完全不同的事情呢？

主要特徵：
一個具有選擇和四個不同結局的互動故事
超過20種多彩CG
兩個動畫結局

title: Azure Saga Pathfinder Deluxe edition [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Far into the future, the human race survives through colonies scattered across the universe. One tale gives humanity’s remnants hope – one of the legendary planet, Azure, a world full of life and abundant resources that could bring humanity back from the brink of extinction. Join a young scientist, Synch, as he travels across the galaxy to meet new companions and find his father.

Features:
- Immerse yourself in a world with a classic storyline that will delight both veterans and new RPG fans, infused with highly detailed 2D illustrations

- Traditional Turn-Based RPG Gameplay inspired by the classic JRPG of the 90s

- Strategize and configure your characters’ gear and jewels in to enhance their maximum potential. 

- Unite, mix, and match your characters’ skills to discover powerful abilities, each with their special effects

- Classic old school adventure with tons of puzzles and secrets to discover

title: Blade Jumper [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Blade Jumper是一款2D動作跑跳遊戲，玩家使用簡單的跳躍動作來攀登障礙重重的塔。

2045年，位於首爾中心的汝矣島，建起了一座巨大的建築，庫庫魯塔。它的建成給這座城市蒙上了一層陰影。 在這座高不可測的塔中，被選中的1%的首爾居民過著與外界隔絕的幸福生活。

以庫庫魯塔為據點，獨裁主義集團Unreality使用高度致癮的庫庫魯糖果，愉快地統治著首爾。 義警組織Ground Z，正在準備推翻Unreality集團的決戰。他們找到了你，該組織以前惡名遠揚的特務。

你準備好攀登神秘的庫庫魯塔了嗎？

▶ 瀟灑的跳躍動作，激發你的挑戰欲望！◀

玩家必須用「跳攻砍殺」這唯一的操作完成所有的移動和攻擊。 他們必須在保持自己不斷爬升的同時，避開那些決心讓主角墜落的敵方單位。通過熟練的控制和反應來與敵人周旋，否則就會被送回起點，感受挫敗感。

▶ 多樣的暴徒設計和關卡格局◀

在完全與外界隔絕的庫庫魯塔內，等待著的冒險比玩家想像的還要多。玩家要以各種機智武裝的敵方單位為目標，利用突顯各區域非凡魅力的地形，攻克並戰勝隱藏的陷阱，以征服每張地圖。 

▶隱藏在這個誘人的世界中的故事◀

玩家爬上塔後將遇到各種角色，並發現令人驚嘆的紀錄。 他們爬得越高，這個隱藏的真相就越會逐漸顯露出來——隨之而來的就是不安的感覺。
玩家為什麼要跟這些角色一起爬這座塔？塔頂有什麼在等待著他們？登上塔尖就會真相大白。

title: The Skylia Prophecy [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Mirenia是一位18歲女孩，正在尋求救贖。在她十幾歲的時候釋放了邪惡的力量之後，她現在正前往提爾金要塞（Tirkin Fortress）表演古老的咒語，這應該有助於她征服三年前釋放的邪惡。
現在，在任務即將結束時，她到達了要塞外的村莊，那裡的怪物肆虐。年輕婦女被捕，男人被屠殺。帶著她值得信賴的盾牌劍刃，Mirenia幾乎可以消除她過去的錯誤。她會成功還是最終只會使事情變得更糟？

《The Skylia Prophecy》是一部設定在中世紀幻想世界中的橫搖動作角色扮演遊戲。作為Mirenia，您將在這種由“靈魂”遊戲的“殺死玩家”哲學啟發的艱苦的冒險中，穿越土地和城鎮，探索古代地牢和不死族群。一路上，您會遇到這些土地上的人，他們會要求您幫助他們，向您出售有力的物品並透露秘密，以幫助您的旅途。通過與城鎮居民互動，您最終將獲得獎勵，從長遠來看，這使遊戲變得更加輕鬆-因此，您可以自己設定最終的難度！
您會發現救贖還是最終死亡？

The Skylia Prophecy將通過困難而公平的挑戰，強大的boss和基於探索的謎語在每一個轉彎處挑戰您。

title: Lost Lands Collection: Dark Overlord, The Four Horsemen, The Golden Curse, The Wanderer, Ice Spell, Mistakes of the Past, Redemption, Sand Captivity [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Molodaya mat s synom sobiralis uezzhat iz letnego domika v lesu. Syuzan vsego na sekundu otvleklas na telefonnyy zvonok. Tem vremenem ee syn, igravshiy nepodaleku, uslyshal strannye golosa i otpravilsya iskat istochnik zvuka. Kogda Syuzan zametila chto proiskhodit, Dzhimmi uzhe zatyagival portal. Teper Syuzan neobkhodimo nayti prokhod v etot udivitelnyy mir i otyskat syna. Vse okazhetsya namnogo slozhnee i opasnee, chem ona mogla predpolozhit. Na svoem puti Syuzan stolknetsya s mnozhestvom zagadok i golovolomok, vstretit neobychnykh obitateley Zateryannykh Zemel, takzhe ey budut protivostoyat sily zla. Chtoby vernut Dzhimmi, ey pridetsya pobedit Temnogo Vladyku, kotoryy derzhit v strakhe ves mir!
Smozhet li otchayannaya mat spasti syna i osvobodit tselyy mir ot zla?

Osobennosti igry
• Issleduyte bolee 50 potryasayushchikh lokatsiy.
• Proydite svyshe 40 raznoobraznykh mini-igr.
• Okunites v udivitelnyy podvodnyy mir v bonusnoy glave!
• Proyavite smekalku v interaktivnykh stsenakh s poiskom predmetov.
• Sobirayte kollektsii, morfing-obekty, poluchayte dostizheniya.

title: Hidden Paws / Summer Paws / Hidden Paws Mystery [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
打開車子和箱子，在木材堆中翻找，搜索森林。貓咪很會躲，但牠們在你靠近時會喵喵叫，所以要仔細聽，你或許能把牠們全都找出來。

有 12 種以上的迷人冬季地貌，還有超過 120 隻小貓咪可以找噢。

title: In Between [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
In Between — otmechennyy nagradami platformer s nezabyvaemoy atmosferoy i zakhvatyvayushchim igrovym protsessom. Mekhanika golovolomok osnovana na vzaimodeystvii s gravitatsiey i okruzhayushchim mirom.

Vas zhdet puteshestvie po chelovecheskomu soznaniyu — miru, nepodvlastnomu zakonam fiziki, i bolee 60 unikalnykh zagadok.

Po mere prokhozhdeniya igrovoy protsess menyaetsya v sootvetstvii s emotsiyami personazha.

Uznayte, kakie ispytaniya vypali na dolyu geroya, i pomogite emu v borbe za schaste.

title: Dreaming Sarah [NSP][ENG]
description:
Dreaming Sarah — syurrealistichnyy platformer s elementami golovolomok, zakhvatyvayushchim okruzheniem, originalnymi personazhami i, samo soboy, devochkoy po imeni Sara. 

S Saroy proizoshel neschastnyy sluchay, i teper ona lezhit v kome. Pomogite ey prosnutsya issleduya mir snov.

Osobennosti:
* Issleduyte zagadochnye oblasti podsoznaniya geroini 
* Sobirayte i ispolzuyte predmety
* Vzaimodeystvuyte s massoy prichudlivykh personazhey
* Reshayte khitrye golovolomki

title: Himno [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Himno — nenasilstvennyy platformer bez ubiystv. Ispolzuyte otskoki ot sten i drugie dvizheniya, chtoby dostich novykh vysot na sluchayno sgenerirovannykh kartakh!

Ispolzuya intuitivno ponyatnye i legkie v osvoenii elementy upravleniya, prokhodite kazhduyu kartu, preodolevaya trudnosti i otkryvaya novye rayony. Povyshayte uroven po mere dostizheniya novykh vysot, poluchaya yarkiy svet, kogda fakely zazhigayutsya i muzyka nachinaet menyatsya.

Spasayte ogonki, chtoby osvetit tmu vokrug, vremenno uluchshaya sposobnosti, kotorye pozvolyayut vam dvigatsya dalshe v drugie rayony.

Kharakteristiki:
 * Vashi deystviya v igrovom mire vyzyvayut emotsionalnye saundtreki i yarkie vizualnye effekty
 * Igrayte v svoem tempe bez stressa
 * Smotrite, kak ogonki tantsuyut vokrug vas
 * Naslazhdaytes shirokim raznoobraziem igrovykh navykov

title: Jack Quest The Tale of the Sword [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Odnazhdy nochyu yunyy Dzhek i prekrasnaya Nara otpravlyayutsya na progulku po lesu, no vozlyublennuyu geroya pokhishchaet zlobnyy ork Korg. Dzhek brosaetsya spasat devushku i okazyvaetsya v podzemnom logove Korga. Tam on nakhodit neobychnyy klinok, kotoryy neozhidanno stanovitsya ego soyuznikom.

V JackQuest igrokam predstoit issledovat obitel Korga, lezhashchuyu v glubinnykh peshcherakh, reshat prostranstvennye golovolomki, a takzhe srazhatsya s vragami, vklyuchaya silnykh bossov.

U razmeshchennykh v vazhnykh tochkakh torgovtsev vy naydete mnogo poleznykh uluchsheniy i usileniy. Tratte monety s umom: luchshe nakopit deneg i kupit predmety podorozhe, kotorye pozzhe mogut spasti vam zhizn. Nakhodite moshchnoe oruzhie i snaryazhenie vrode mechey, luka so strelami i pryzhkovykh botinok. Izuchayte osobye navyki: otprygivayte ot sten, dvigaytes so skorostyu molnii i ispolzuyte silu magicheskikh kristallov dlya razrushitelnogo udara-melnitsy!

title: Hatchwell [NSZ][ENG]
description:
一款以 Hatchwell 小鎮為背景的自上而下的動作角色扮演遊戲。 在市民們忙著為節日做準備的同時，一系列的活動將停止準備工作。 在鎮上跑來跑去，幫助市長調查 Hatchwell 的不同部分，找出導致這些事件的原因。

特徵：
• 自定義你的角色。
• 從 12 種不同的寵物伴侶中進行選擇。
• 體驗Hatchwell 在（遊戲中）一天的變化。
• 探索和解決來自城鎮 7 個地區的謎題
• 尋找可以幫助您冒險的物品。
• 收集具有獨特能力的可選配件。
• 發現更多主故事情節中沒有的可選項目。

title: Henchman Story [NSP][ENG]
description:
Henchman Story is an interactive story where you play as a beleaguered henchman working for a bumbling supervillain.

It’s thankless work. Week in and week out, you put on your purple spandex and get the crap beaten out of you by much stronger, much cooler people wearing much fancier spandex. But the checks clear, and Lord Bedlam offers healthcare, so a job’s a job, right?

Even henchmen have bills to pay, and sometimes, even henchmen can make choices that change everything.

Features:
- Superhero Satire: A comedic take on the world of superheroes that revels in the ridiculous nature of its setting, and showcases a colourful, comic book aesthetic.

- Colourful Characters: Find friends, enemies and even romance amongst a lively cast of villains, heroes and fellow henchmen.

- Meaningful Choices: Your decisions directly influence the story - leading to eleven endings, determining the fate of its characters, and if you play your cards right, you might even earn a promotion!

- Full Voice Acting: Starring a talented cast of professional actors that have been featured in anime, video games and more!

title: Stone Age Digital edition [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 俄语 来自 AlchemistLab
description:
Prolozhite svoy put cherez predystoriyu i postroyte fundament chelovecheskoy tsivilizatsii. Naskolko svetloe budushchee chelovechestva? Eto zavisit ot vas! Provedite svoyo plemya skvoz pechalnyy kamennyy vek!
V Stone Age vy beryote na sebya rol doistoricheskogo cheloveka. Nachinaya s arkhaichnykh instrumentov, vy sobiraete derevo, kamen i zoloto, chtoby dostich bolee vysokogo urovnya znaniy i postroit bolee prochnye konstruktsii. Poskolku resursov ne khvataet, vy dolzhny sorevnovatsya za ogranichennoe kolichestvo mest na doske, gde oni proizvodyatsya, a takzhe sobirat edu, chtoby nakormit svoe rastushchee plemya.
V kamennom veke kolichestvo mest ogranicheno, poetomu vy dolzhny opredelit, kakie deystviya luchshe vsego predprinyat v kazhdom raunde. Vam predstoit razvivat svoe plemya, sobiraya resursy, stroya novye zdaniya i razvivaya ego kulturu, sokhranyaya pri etom dostatochno edy, chtoby prokormit svoy narod. Naydite pravilnyy balans, chtoby sozdat samuyu razvituyu tsivilizatsiyu i privesti svoy narod k luchshey zhizni!

title: Element [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
Element - eto kosmicheskaya strategiya v rezhime realnogo vremeni dlya lyudey, kotorye slishkom zanyaty, chtoby igrat v kosmicheskie strategii v rezhime realnogo vremeni. 

Doma ne ostalos resursov dlya vyzhivaniya.
Nachalsya boy za resursy, neobkhodimye, chtoby spastis iz nashey sistemy.
Budushchee bezgranichno...

Element - eto kosmicheskaya strategiya v rezhime realnogo vremeni s velikolepnoy grafikoy i produmannym i ponyatnym igrovym protsessom.

Element - eto igra dlya lyubiteley originalnykh, masterski vypolnennykh igr. Ona dlya lyudey, kotorye lyubyat kosmos i strategii, no ne mogut udelyat im mnogo vremeni. A eshchyo eto igra dlya tekh, komu nravitsya zapuskat rakety i vzryvat vsyo podryad :)

Vy uletaete iz razrushayushcheysya Solnechnoy sistemy. Vam potrebuetsya posetit mnozhestvo planet na svoem puti, dobyt dostatochno elementa i pobedit vraga, chtoby otpravitsya dalshe, k drugim planetam. Generiruyte energiyu, dobyvayte elementy, stroyte zashchitnye i atakuyushchie ustanovki i pobedite vraga, ne zabyvaya podderzhivat balans mezhdu zemley, vozdukhom i vodoy.

title: Crashbots (Crash Bots) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Po doroge k finishu vas zhdut opasnye prepyatstviya, miny-lovushki i kovarnye vragi.

SYuZhETNYY REZhIM:
V etom rezhime igry vy dolzhny dostich finishnoy cherty kazhdogo urovnya, prezhde chem batareya robota polnostyu razryaditsya. V igre predstavleny 5 raznykh mirov, kazhdyy iz kotorykh imeet svoi unikalnye khitrosti i vragov, kotorye budut vsyacheski meshat vam po puti. Finalnyy uroven kazhdogo mira - eto epicheskaya bitva s bolshim bossom.

BESKONEChNYY REZhIM:
V etom rezhime vy dolzhny probezhat kak mozhno dalshe, prezhde chem energiya vashego robota polnostyu zakonchitsya.

V Crashbots predstavleny 5 modeley robotov. U kazhdogo robota svoi kharakteristiki i unikalnaya tyazhelaya ataka. Robotov mozhno modernizirovat, chtoby povysit ikh prochnost i boevuyu moshch. Vy mozhete razblokirovat novykh robotov, sobiraya ikh po chastyam v kazhdom iz igrovykh mirov.

title: Mini Island Challenge Bundle: Red, Snow, Night, Mini Island [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Vybirayte personazha, sobirayte usileniya i pobezhdayte bossov! Probegite po chetyryom miram i dayte otpor vragam — begite, strelyayte i uklonyaytes!
Issleduyte chetyre unikalnykh tematicheskikh ostrova i proydite vse ikh ispytaniya. Neslozhnaya mekhanika, ponyatnyy igrovoy protsess i unikalnyy khudozhestvennyy stil pomogut vam bystro osvoitsya v igre.

Ne teryayte vremeni — vyberite arsenal, nastroyte personazha s pomoshchyu usileniy i proydite ispytanie Mini Island Challenge Bundle!

OSOBENNOSTI
— Razvitie personazha s pomoshchyu usileniy
— 4 unikalnykh ostrova
— Bitvy s bossami
— Napryazhyonnyy i slozhnyy igrovoy protsess

title: Overmorrow [NSZ][Multi]
description:
Igra s kharakternym vizualnym stilem i svoeobraznym zagadochnym metanarrativom! Chem bolshe run vy obnaruzhite, tem bolshe deystviy vy smozhete vypolnit za den, i tem glubzhe smozhete issledovat zagadochnyy ostrov.
Ogranicheniy net — nasladites spokoynym prostranstvom, gde na kazhdom urovne predstavleny proizvedeniya iskusstva i lyubopytnye sekretiki.
No uchtite, chto rovno cherez 30 igrovykh dney vash progress budet obnulyon. Odnako, v Overmorrow vsyo ne sovsem tak, chem kazhetsya na pervyy vzglyad, eto vsego lish eshchyo odin shag k raskrytiyu mnogikh tayn etogo mira...

title: Lit Bend the Light [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
遊戲的背景是在一個沒有電的時代，除了偉大發明家的想像力外，什麼也沒有，LIT 測試藏在您自己內心的工程師，讓您發現第一手的光實驗樂趣。
- LIT 中的光行為是完全符合物理規律。也就是說，您要在 LIT 中所建立的璀璨光束是可能的，但在現實生活中極難再現。我們的遊戲讓您有機會根據需要設置鏡子和玻璃片來反射和折射光束。
- 我們的謎題都是屬於開放式的。我們為您提供規則和工具，您向我們展示說明如何解決問題。我們為每個關卡分配了一些可能的解決方案，但不要被這些東西所迷惑，我們只是在等待玩家找到我們沒有從未有想過的解決方案。
- 視覺效果會在卡通和現實之間穿插。節奏不錯。輕鬆的音樂，讓您能夠沉浸享受其中。所有這些元素都營造出一種獨特、神秘但又溫馨的氛圍。
- 當光束照射到鏡子上並反射時，它會照射到玻璃上並發生彎曲。就是這樣。不過，它提供了幾千種可能性，這代表著我們每個關卡都是獨一無二的。
- LIT 是非常直接簡單的。已在多個遊戲活動中經過測試，證明它適合所有年齡層和所有類型的玩家遊玩。您想找到所有解決方法及其他解決方法嗎？正在為 5 歲的小朋友尋找遊戲？或者，也許您想要向您的媽媽介紹遊戲？

title: Hero-U Rogue to Redemption [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Feature list:
- Story and Character-Driven Adventure Game
- Role-Playing Game Featuring Skills, Equipment, and Tactical Combat
- Replayable with thousands of player choices and story variations
- Turn-Based, Non-Twitch, Avoidable Combat
- Seamless Blend of Dramatic Story and Comedy
- Immersive Mini-Games and Challenging Stealth Gameplay
- First of a Series of Games Set at the Hero University

About this game:
Hero-U: Rogue to Redemption is an epic - and humorous - fantasy adventure and role-playing game in which you take on the role of Shawn O'Conner, a young man striving to become a hero as well as a rogue.

During the day, Shawn attends classes at the University, practices his skills, and tries to make friends with other students. At night, it's time to pull out weapons, armor, and traps to explore the abandoned wine cellars, stunning sea caves, creepy catacombs, and deadly dungeon beneath Hero-U. Most combat is optional for those who prefer a pure adventure game, but there are ample rewards for those who choose to valorously fight the creatures that threaten the school and all of Sardonia.

Shawn can become the Rogue of the Year while exploring a mysterious castle, making friends and enemies, fighting deadly foes, and uncovering the secrets of his own hidden past. Meanwhile players will enjoy the rich and humorous dialogue and descriptions as they guide Shawn through his adventures.

title: Commander Keen in Keen Dreams / Definitive Edition [NSZ][ENG]
developer: id Software, Lone Wolf Technology LLC,
description:
THE STORY SO FAR

Billy Blaze, eight year-old genius, working diligently in his backyard clubhouse has created an interstellar starship from old soup cans, rubber cement, and plastic tubing.  While his folks are out on the town and the babysitter has fallen asleep, Billy travels into his backyard workshop, dons his brother's football helmet, and transforms into...

COMMANDER KEEN --- defender of Earth!

In his ship, the Bean-with-Bacon Megarocket, Keen dispenses galactic justice with an iron hand!


THIS EPISODE: "Keen Dreams"

We find young Billy discussing matters of paramount importance with his mother.

"I just saved the Earth, Mom," said Billy. "I don't have to eat vegetables."

"Sure, dear," said Billy's mom. "I bet Neil Armstrong never complained about HIS mashed potatoes."

"I bet Neil Armstrong never travelled to Vorticon VI and defeated the Grand Intellect, either," Billy mumbled at his plate.  He sat there, legs dangling, staring at his offensive, starch-laden foe.

After a pointed remark about the quality of the mashed potatoes, Billy was sent to his room.

"Stupid vegetables," he grumbled, his eyelids growing heavy.

Soon Billy was fast asleep.


Suddenly he woke up, and his bed was atop a hill. On either side of his bed were giant potatoes wearing metal helmets and carrying bayonets.

"Come with us now, Captain Keen," said the first.

"You've been brought here by the Dream Machine," said the second.

"Boobus Tuber, our king and boss--"

"--is now your master, come with us!"

Billy frowned, grabbed his football helmet off his bedpost, and started to put it on.

"First of all, spuds," Billy said, pushing down on the helmet.  "That's COMMANDER Keen. Second of all, who do you think you are?"

"We're Tater Troopers, it's plain to see," said the first.

"So, get--"

Keen reached under his pillow and retrieved his Vorticon Hyperpistol.  He moved it from "Stun," past "Disrupt," all the way up to "Fry to Delicate Brown."

"How about a walk on the fried side boys?" Keen said.


Two BZZAPs later, Keen pouted.

"Aw, nuts. My Hyperpistol's empty," he said.


Just then, a child in chains ran up to him.

"Keen, oh, Keen, oh, Captain Keen!  Save us from the Dream Machine!" he said.

"That's COMMANDER Keen!" the young genius corrected.

"Whatever.  Save us!" said the child.

So Billy hopped out of bed and started on his quest to defeat King Boobus Tuber and destroy the Dream Machine!

title: Dead Z Meat [NSP][ENG]
description:
Khvatayte pistolet i nachinayte strelyat — eti zombi zlobny i glupy.

Eto snova apokalipsis!
Vy vpolne mozhete okazatsya poslednim chelovekom na Zemle! Khvatayte pistolet i strelyayte — eti zombi nastolko zhe zlobny, kak i glupy. Vyzhivayte kazhdyy den, uluchshayte svoy arsenal i zaryazhayte svoi podpitki, chtoby razrushit polchishcha mertvogo myasa v vashem rayone.

OSNOVNYE FUNKTsII
- Aktivnoe strelbishche
- Vpechatlyayushchiy moderniziruemyy arsenal, v tom chisle nauchno-fantasticheskoe oruzhie, sovremennoe oruzhie i vzryvchatka
- Podpitki vklyucheny dlya vashego razvlecheniya
- Stilizovannye multiplikatsionnye izobrazheniya
- I beskonechnyy zapas zombi

title: Pi Exe (PI.EXE) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
PI.EXE 是一款具有挑戰性的動作/平台遊戲，發生在操作系統的服務器內部！ 在服務器的每個扇區中殺出一條血路，消滅敵人，消滅感染它的整個系統！

單一的進攻手段：一劍斬敵，奪取數據再次充能！ 你只有一次機會！

一次挑戰，一次接觸，一次終結：敵人的一次掠過會讓你消失，並迫使你重新開始每個區域！

主要目標不是結束：可重玩性，無論是鍵盤還是遊戲手柄！ 通過到達每個區域並在盡可能短的時間內完成遊戲，充分利用您的時間和能力！ 或者，盡可能多地進行連鎖組合攻擊！

title: Beyond Memories Tales From the Heart [NSZ][ENG]
description: Pogruzites v zloveshchuyu atmosferu mrachnogo ocharovaniya Smerti s kosoy v etom zhutkom simulyatore polyota s elementami povestvovaniya. Igra unesyot vas v tyomnye, zagadochnye miry, okutannye tenyami i taynami. Vasha zadacha skolzit po etim zloveshchim miram, sbivaya kletki, chtoby osvobozhdat izmuchennye dushi. Kazhdaya spasyonnaya dusha rasskazyvaet pugayushchuyu istoriyu - po kusochku, otkryvaya 11 korotkikh, ledenyashchikh dushu rasskazov o mrachnom i sverkhestestvennom. Nenasilstvennyy geympley sozdan dlya pogruzheniya v atmosferu trevogi i intrigi. Sobirayte energiyu, chtoby strelyat, issleduyte mrachnuyu krasotu mira i perezhivite misticheskoe priklyuchenie, v kotorom kazhdaya dusha dobavlyaet novuyu glavu k tyomnomu povestvovaniyu.

title: Drowning [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 机器翻译 来自 most2820
description: Progulyaytes vmeste s nim po krasivym nizkopoligonalnym lokatsiyam i on rasskazhet vam, kak nauchilsya zhit so svoim vnutrennim demonom. Istoriya beret nachalo v sedmom klasse sredney shkoly i prodolzhaetsya na protyazhenii neskolkikh let. So vremenem bolezn stanovitsya pokhozha na cheloveka, kotoryy postoyanno nakhoditsya ryadom i pytaetsya unizit ego. V igre est neskolko raznykh putey, chtoby poluchit odnu iz kontsovok, poetomu tolko ot vas zavisit razvitie etoy istorii.

title: Orten Was The Case [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Ziggi prosypaetsya odnazhdy s strannoy metkoy na ruke, ne imeya ponyatiya, chto proizoshlo nochyu. Posle neskolkikh minut, poteryannykh sredi znakomykh ulits svoego prigoroda, Orten, vzryv vozvrashchaet ego tochno tuda, gde on prosnulsya mgnoveniya nazad... On zastryal vo vremennoy petle. Bez obuvi ili vospominaniy o proshlom, on otpravlyaetsya v missiyu, chtoby vyyasnit, chto, chert vozmi, proiskhodit i kak izbezhat unichtozheniya ego goroda. Eto ne budet legko, potomu chto chem bolshe on vyiskivaet ne tam, gde nado, tem bolshe on uznaet, chto ego rodnoy gorod skryvaet mnogo sekretov. Ego strannye sosedi stanovyatsya eshche strannee, i on mozhet polagatsya tolko na svoikh druzey i na svoy vysokonadezhnyy mozg.
Esli den povtoryaetsya snova i snova, to kak mozhno prodvigatsya vpered? Vot v chem podvokh: znanie — vash klyuch k progressu v Ortene. Kazhdyy tsikl, kotoryy vy prokhodite, vy uznaete chto-to novoe, chto pozvolit vam prodvinut syuzhet dalshe. Blagodarya mekhanike vremennoy petli vy sokhranyaete podskazki, zametki i sobytiya na vremennoy osi, v konechnom itoge uznav, kak vy mozhete izmenit budushchee vsego za 12 minut v obychnoe voskresene.
Kto oni? Polunochnyy Sovet, ya imeyu v vidu. Kazhetsya, oni edinstvennye, kto v odnom shage vperedi vas. Chto na samom dele proizoshlo v etom gorode 40 let nazad i kak vybratsya iz vremennoy petli i izbezhat smerti? Sleduyte za ulikami, reshayte golovolomki i issleduyte zagadochnyy prigorod Ortena v etoy priklyuchencheskoy igre v stile 2.5D, vypolnennoy vruchnuyu!

title: Scotland Yard Hunting Mister X [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Adaptatsiya znamenitoy nastolnoy igry, i odno iz samykh zaputannykh del Skotland-Yarda! Mister Kh pryachetsya gde-to v Londone, a edinstvennaya zatsepka, chto mozhet k nemu privesti — vybroshennye im bilety. No chto eto za bilety? Smotrite! Tam! Neuzhto eto on? Sokhranyayte spokoystvie, otsepite territoriyu, proschitayte puti otkhoda i poymayte ego!
Vozmite na sebya rol odnogo iz pyati detektivov, vysledite legendarnogo mistera Kh i zaryadites nastroeniem pogoni po ulochkam Londona. Esli vam po dushe put neulovimogo prestupnika, to sdelayte vse, chtoby izbezhat tsepkikh lap politsii!

title: Roniu's Tale [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Pomogi Roniu nayti put skvoz smertonosnye podzemelya i pobedit ordy vragov oderzhimykh zhelaniem uderzhat ego zdes. 

Ronius Teil - eto golovolomka s elementami ekshena i kameroy verkhnego vida. Khotya urovni sozdany tak, chtob imet odin ili bolshe putey, kazhdyy shag sdelannyy Roniu privodit k nevozvratnym posledstviyam po mere prokhozhdeniya. 

Ispolzuya magiyu i nemnogo smekalki, tebe predstoit pomoch Roniu nayti sfery i klyuchi, kotorye emu nuzhny, chtoby vybratsya.

- 47 urovnya opasnykh putey
- golovokruzhitelnye zagadki
- Uragan vragov i epichnykh Bossov
- Intuitivnoe i tochnoe upravlenie
- Limbo, Lavovyy, Dikiy, Mezhprostranstvinnyy, Pikselno-pogruzhayushchiy geympley

title: Ogre [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Ogre — eto poshagovaya strategiya o vysokotekhnologichnoy voyne, v kotoroy vam nuzhno budet proyavit navyki taktiki i strategicheskoe myshlenie. Eto ofitsialnaya adaptatsiya legendarnogo nastolnogo vargeyma ot kompanii Steve Jackson Games, razrabotannaya otmechennoy nagradami studiey Auroch Digital.
Na polyakh srazheniy blizhayshego budushchego nemalo opasnoy tekhniki, no est boevaya edinitsa, ot kotoroy predpochitayut derzhatsya na bezopasnoy distantsii dazhe soyuzniki. I nazyvaetsya ona «Ogr». Eti tanki pod upravleniem II nastolko opasny, chto kazhdyy sposoben zamenit tselyy batalon obychnykh tankov i pekhoty.
V beskonechnoy mirovoy voyne srazhaetsya samaya raznaya tekhnika: mashiny na vozdushnoy podushke, tanki, morpekhi, obychnaya pekhota i chudovishchnye «Ogry». Vam predstoit vzyat komandovanie na sebya i zavoevat gospodstvo na izedennykh radiatsiey polyakh voyny budushchego.

title: Edge of Reality [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
看似世界上再也沒有比當典當行估價師更無聊的職業了。但與一名神秘的年輕女子的相遇使這名估價師經歷了一系列奇怪的事件，改變了Dan對他的手藝的初步看法。在這款遊戲中，您將沉浸在一個錯綜複雜的故事中，夢想和現實被編織成一個完整的整體。在某個時候，現實本身可能會失去其穩定性。

遊戲特色：
- 非線性進程和出乎意料的情節轉折
- 獨特的視覺風格
- 專為此遊戲編寫的音樂，使您可以充分傳達氛圍

“Edge of Reality”是一款互動視覺小說。結局將取決於您的選擇。

title: Earthshine [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
description:
『Earthshine』講述了兩位旅行者Talia和Inar的故事，當他們穿越沙漠尋找遺忘之地。傳說這些地方有著美麗的花朵：這些花朵可以治癒任何傷口、復活死者，並給予尋求它的人永生。但是以前從未有人證明這些傳言是真的...

Talia和Inar是誰？他們只是兩個陌生人，還是更多的東西？他們能否到達遺忘之地，並找到他們一直在尋找的答案？

特點：
- 大約1-2小時的閱讀時間
- 非線性情節
- 獨特的視覺風格，不是典型的視覺小說風格
- 女主人公
- 具有來自多國傳說的魔法設定
- 關於愛、命運和困難選擇的主題
- 這本小說將吸引所有性別的童話故事粉絲

無論您選擇什麼，都要從心底選擇！

title: If Found [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
«If Found…» – interaktivnaya videoigra studii DREAMFEEL o poiskakh dushevnykh svyazey.

Ostrov Akill, 31 dekabrya 1993 goda… Ukryvshis v vetkhom osobnyake, Kasio unichtozhaet svoy dnevnik.

V nem rasskazyvaetsya o ee vozvrashchenii domoy, na zapad Irlandii, o konflikte s semey, o tom, s kem ona zavodit druzhbu i kakie trudnosti preodolevaet.

Vsyo vedet k etoy nochi, kogda chernaya dyra unichtozhit ves mir. Otkuda ona vzyalas? Mozhno li etomu pomeshat?

Sovershenno unikalnaya igrovaya mekhanika, chudesnye risunki ot ruki i udivitelnyy saundtrek pozvolyat igrokam perezhit vsyo, chto chuvstvuet Kasio, i svoimi glazami uvidet kak radostnye, tak i muchitelnye mgnoveniya, iz kotorykh skladyvalsya tot dekabr 1993.

Yarkie momenty: strannaya vlyublennost, planeta Yupiter, mnogo potseluev, pank-kontsert, schaste, milyy pesik i dazhe ograblenie.

title: Big Dipper [NSZ][RUS/Multi3]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 3]
description:
Nayti svoe mesto – ne tak-to prosto 
No chto esli eto mesto – ne tolko tvoe? I kak byt, esli ni odin iz vas ne khochet ustupat? 
Bolshaya Medveditsa - eto romanticheskaya istoriya o tom, kak dva cheloveka vstretilis v kanun Novogo Goda pri ne samykh obychnykh obstoyatelstvakh. 

Glavnye personazhi

Andrey 
Iz-za semeynykh problem Andreyu prishlos rano povzroslet i pokinut otchiy dom. Sudba zakinula ego daleko na sever, gde ot kholodnoy i golodnoy smerti ego spas staryy mebelshchik. Obuchivshis u nego remeslu, Andrey bystro voshel v rabochuyu koleyu i spustya gody upornogo truda priobrel dom v lesnoy glushi. Glavnyy urok on usvoil krepko-nakrepko: zhizn bez kryshi nad golovoy – ne zhizn vovse. 

Yulya
Vse detstvo Yulya provela s dedushkoy. Roditeli godami propadali v komandirovkakh, a devochka rosla, zasypaya u kamina pod zavyvaniya vetra i postukivanie dedovskikh instrumentov. Kogda Yule ispolnilos dvenadtsat, roditeli uvezli ee za tysyachi kilometrov, no ona znala, chto obyazatelno vernetsya domoy, kogda pridet vremya.

Osobennosti
-Prodolzhitelnost 2-4 chasa
-Novella dostupna na russkom i angliyskom
-10+ CG
-Zhivopisnaya, neobychnaya khudozhestvennaya chast v vysokom razreshenii
-Chudesnaya istoriya o lyubvi, sudbe i resheniyakh, vedushchikh nas po zhizni.

title: Nirvana Pilot Yume / Nirvana [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
80年代科幻懷舊
涅盤充滿了復古的科幻動漫氛圍 - 霓虹燈，美麗的女人和超快的宇宙飛船。這也是對DOS時代經典賽車遊戲的頌歌，並結合了引人入勝的視覺小說！

除了在10條復古主題的低多邊形賽道上比賽外，遊戲中還有很多決定要做出，有5個不同的故事結局！ 

歡迎來到3080
偉大的超思想宇宙競賽（簡稱G.U.R.U）是每個軌道城市通過沿著危險的星際軌道賽車來解決衝突的地方。

你扮演一個退休的眼睛 - 涅盤飛行員的嚮導。在過去，一場悲劇奪走了你行動的意志——你因一個錯誤而失去了你心愛的人。

年輕的飛行員Yume請求你的説明，然而，記憶又回來了......你能克服痛苦並救贖你的罪孽嗎？

迷幻金屬波浪曲調
Retröxx創作的激動人心的音樂將説明你克服速度障礙。通過復古氛圍的朗朗上口的曲目，重溫80年代的懷舊情懷！

主要特點：
- 參加受經典街機遊戲啟發的超快速比賽
- 在街機模式中測試你的技能，你只專注於賽車
- 體驗一個充滿浪漫的故事，靈感來自80年代的科幻和動漫
- 10+ 1太空競賽，背景設定在復古主題的低多邊形環境中
- 12個故事事件，多條路徑和5個不同的故事結局
- 朗朗上口的復古金屬波浪配樂由偉大的Retröxx創作。

title: Turn Tack [NSP][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
降落在阿茲特克帝國的命運之女。
她是毀滅者，還是救世主？

每4千年就會滅亡1次的阿茲特克，在經歷了4次滅亡後，第5次滅亡即將來臨。根據“將白髮少女作為祭品獻出去就可以阻止世界滅亡”的傳說，人們想要將白髮少女作為祭品獻出去。

逃亡後的少女帶著”世界的滅亡“取決於”自己的生存“的矛盾心理，邊躲避前來抓捕自己的人和猛獸的襲擊以及各種危險，邊展開一系列的冒險。

在阿茲特克神話為背景的異國氛圍中，邊操作少女，邊躲避隱藏在關卡中的危險。透過分析各個關卡的特點解開各種謎團，還可以利用各種”淨水“的力量獲得幫助。

透過平臺解謎類遊戲“在失敗與摸索中分析事物規律”的特點獲得突破各種難關的“闖關樂趣”，如同欣賞藝術動漫般的畫質和音效也會讓玩家更沉浸其中。

title: Hot Shot Burn [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Khvatayte popkorn, priglashayte druzey i uchastvuyte v bezumnykh boyakh, v kotorykh pobeda dostigaetsya i schastlivoy sluchaynostyu, i ottochennym navykom strelby.  Druzya ne mogut priyti? Ne vopros! Mozhno igrat s neznakomtsami po seti.
Vyberite geroya: ot surovogo kosmicheskogo bortsa do smertonosnogo motylka-ubiytsy i pukhlenkogo inoplanetyanina, kotoryy voobshche ne ponimaet, chto on tut zabyl. U kazhdogo personazha svoy nabor navykov i stil igry. Opredelite, kto vam bolshe nravitsya, i nachnite rvat druzey i blizkikh na chasti na potekhu galakticheskoy publike.

Shou nachinaetsya! Srazhaytes i umirayte v pryamom efire na vidu u tysyach zriteley. Gladiatorskie boi ne shchadyat nikogo. Publika likuet! Kommentator otpuskaet shutochki nad vashim triko! I vsem veselo! (Po krayney mere tem, kto eshche stoit na nogakh.)
I ezhu ponyatno, chto vy prishli pobezhdat, poetomu zabudte o kakom-to tam dobrosovestnom povedenii ili zakonakh fiziki. Teleportiruytes, stanovites nevidimym, zapuskayte puli rikoshetom ot sten ili prostrelivayte eti steny. Delayte vse, chto mozhete, lish by vystoyat. V lyubvi, kak na voyne i kosmicheskikh gladiatorskikh boyakh, vse sredstva khoroshi.

OSOBENNOSTI:

- Stremitelnye i nepredskazuemye setevye boi dlya 2–4 igrokov
- Igrayte sidya na divane, po seti ili vse srazu!
- Kucha aren s unikalnymi opasnymi zonami i pravilami
- Mnozhestvo moshchnykh mutatorov, menyayushchikh realnost i perevorachivayushchikh igru s nog na golovu.
- Yarkiy vizualnyy stil, osnovannyy na klassicheskikh amerikanskikh multfilmakh 60-kh – 90-kh godov
- Kachayushchie ritmy SINTVEYVA!

title: Gridd Retroenhanced [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
GRIDD: Retroenhanced — yarkiy arkadnyy kiberpankovyy shuter s fantasticheskim saundtrekom, generiruemymi v protsesse igry elementami i naelektrizovannoy grafikoy.

Vedite svoy samolet skvoz postoyanno menyayushchiesya skopishcha karayushchikh vragov, opasnykh lazerov i drugikh vrazhdebnykh prepyatstviy! Popytaytes otklyuchit neumolimyy zashchitnyy protsessor i unichtozhit iskusstvennyy intellekt, upravlyayushchiy etoy sistemoy, chtoby zabratsya na vershinu tablitsy liderov!

Mir igry Gridd vdokhnovlen antiutopicheskimi kiberpankovymi filmami, pervymi popytkami domashnego kodirovaniya i energichnym saundtrekom v zhanre "sintveyv" ot Dream Fiend. On napolnen dukhom ushedshey epokhi i elementami sovremennykh arkadnykh priklyucheniy.

title: One Deck Dungeon + DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Adventure calls... but you don't always have time to spend hours optimizing your character sheet or managing your inventory! One Deck Dungeon lets you jump right in to bashing down doors, rolling dice, and squashing baddies with style. Get a full roguelike game experience, boiled down to its essence, and captured in a single deck of cards and a handful of dice!

One Deck Dungeon is a dungeon crawling adventure game. Each time you play, choose one or two of these 9 brave heroes:

• Mage - There's rarely a problem in the dungeon she can't solve with a spell.
• Warrior - Her favorite dungeon activity is squashing her opponents immediately.
• Rogue - Watch in awe as she dispatches monsters with style.
• Archer - Accurate, brilliant, catastrophically deadly.
• Paladin - She seeks out danger and shields her allies from deadly enemies.
• Caliana - This faerie has decided that dungeoneering looks fun! Don't let her get bored...
• Fanatic - A righteous Sentinel is here to smite evil wherever it may lurk!
• Witch - Her chaotic magic hammer is ready to smash glooping oozes into glooping puddles!
• Mist - This breach mage has crossed over from the world of Aeon's End to help defend Mynerva.

There are 7 dangerous challenges to face:

• Dragon’s Cave - The thick-skinned wyvern who occupies this dungeon prefers her heroes on the crispy side.
• Yeti’s Cavern - If you can survive the freezing winds and biting cold, an abominable snowman awaits.
• Hydra’s Reef - Chop off one head, and another appears! This regenerating venomous monstrosity is a slippery foe.
• Lich’s Tomb - Hordes of undead foes, evil curses, and magical wards. What could possibly go wrong?
• Minotaur’s Maze - Abandon all hope, ye who enter here!
• Cinder Plains - The Hellhound awaits those reckless enough to venture here...
• Phoenix's Den - Only the bravest heroes can handle the heat!

All cards in One Deck Dungeon have many colorful boxes. Roll your dice, and attempt to fill in as many boxes as possible. For every one you don't fill, you’ll suffer consequences in hearts and time! Once you complete an encounter you'll be able to learn a new skill, acquire a new item, or gain experience to level up your hero. Descend the dungeon and face the boss for the final challenge!

After every game, your heroes make progress toward unlocking up to 15 new talents, building up their power for future games.

Once you know your way around the dungeon, a game takes about 15 minutes. It might take a little longer if you're learning, or a lot shorter if you jump into a pit of spikes.

Warning: do not jump into a pit of spikes.

Welcome to the world of One Deck Dungeon. Adventure awaits!

title: Pureya [NSZ][Multi]
description:
簡單的街機遊戲固然很棒，但很快就會變得無聊。如果它們每 10 秒就變一次呢？

Pureya 是一系列街機小遊戲，只需按兩顆按鈕即可玩。每 10 秒，遊戲會從一個隨機迷你遊戲跳到另一個。

避開障礙並收集盡可能多的彈珠，然後在彈珠機中使用這些彈珠來解鎖新的迷你遊戲、音樂和面板。

每次 10 秒鐘即可享受 30 多種迷你遊戲，或是單獨挑戰它們，爭取高分。

遊戲特色
- 30+ 種迷你遊戲
- 每 10 秒切換到不同的迷你遊戲
- 收集大理石，在彈珠機中使用它們來解鎖新的迷你遊戲、音樂和面板。
- 快速簡單：只需 2 個按鈕即可進行遊戲
- 動態難度適合所有技術等級
- 動態原創音樂與 10 秒連續曲目

title: Grammarian Ltd [NSZ][ENG]
description:
歡迎來到2099，在這裡所有的交流都必須使用正確的語法。使用錯誤的語法最終導致學分過低，最終被解僱，拒絕公共服務，甚至入獄。

扮演一個剛畢業的理論數學專業的畢業生，因為一些誤會，現在不得不在最大的語法驗證機構擔任語法驗證員。

運用你的語法和管理技能，從“初級實習生”晉升為“高階編輯”。找出並糾正文件中的語法錯誤，學習一些新的語法規則，並在語法戰鬥中擊敗你的同事。如果一切順利，你可以升級你破舊的公寓，收養一隻寵物，或者坐直升機去辦公室。在Grammarian Ltd，一切皆有可能。

title: Encounters Music Stories [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Shake the Joy-Con™ to the beat of the music! Let yourself be carried away by the melody and tune your ear in this musical rhythm game. 

Encounters: Music Stories tells us about the desires of its characters to meet and be happy with their loved ones. Do you want to know how these stories end? You will have to be precise and let yourself be carried away by its wonderful music. 

Each character plays a part of the musical piece. To advance you will only have to go down the blue tiles at the right time and live the experience of synchronizing with the instruments of precious melodies.

Features:

- Follow the visual clues to make the experience easier. 
- Shake the Joy-Con to the beat of the music! You can also play using the touch screen or ZL/ZR Buttons.
- Achievements
- 4 game modes: Training, Easy, Normal and Night

Enjoy these emotional stories and feel the music in a different way!

Encounters: Music Stories has been created with great care by Raquel (idea, music, development, and design) and Pilar (stories)

title: Frederic Resurrection of Music / Frederic 2 Evil Strikes Back / Fred3ric [NSZ][ENG,RUS]
description:
Friderik vozvrashchaetsya... Nesmotrya na to, chto ego borba okonchilas pobedoy, zlo tak i ne unichtozheno do kontsa. Tsaytgayst, zlobnoe kiberneticheskoe voploshchenie absolyutnogo zla, zamyshlyaet novyy kovarnyy plan. On khochet brosit Friderika v vodovorot vremeni i zabrat u nego vsyo samoe dorogoe. I Tsaytgayst v etom ne odinok. Frideriku pridyotsya stolknutsya s velikimi kompozitorami proshlogo, zarazhyonnymi i prevrashchyonnymi v kiborgov. U geroya ne ostalos nichego, krome pianino i umeniya igrat na nyom. Khvatit li emu etogo?

Tretya igra v serii Frederic predostavit igrokam eshchyo bolshe zamechatelnoy muzyki i vsyo to, chto im polyubilos v predydushchikh igrakh. 

OSOBENNOSTI:
 — Pereosmyslennye proizvedeniya klassicheskoy muzyki.
 — Krasivaya i bogataya na detali dvukhmernaya grafika.
 — Originalnyy i zabavnyy syuzhet.
 — Urovni slozhnosti, prisposoblennye pod samykh raznykh igrokov.
 — Vosem urovney i masshtabnoe zavershenie istorii.

title: Galaxy Squad [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
description:
Galaxy squad 是一款回合制戰術的 roguelike 遊戲，你將帶領一隊僱傭兵穿越隨機生成的銀河系並充滿不同的事件。

該遊戲基於節點探索隨機的事件和硬核的戰鬥相結合。 所有的角色都是隨機生成的，你可以隨心所欲地進化他們，創造你的終極團隊。

特色：

• 探索不同的行星和系統，與成群結隊的敵人作戰。
• 升級你的飛船並在事件或戰鬥中使用其系統。
• 探索太空間站，尋找任務。
• 一個完善的故事系統，涉及你的角色和故事分支的情節。
• 通過不同的改造以升級你的設備，並尋找稀有的戰利品。

title: ReMix (Re Mix) [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
在這款遊戲中，你將遇到多位具有獨特演奏和戰鬥風格的英雄，每位英雄都擁有他們特色的音樂和戰鬥風格。你還將與十多位不同能力的音樂家一同作戰，他們使用的不僅僅是音樂，還有他們獨特的戰鬥技巧。此外，遊戲中還有數百種效果各異的道具供你選擇和使用，你可以透過巧妙的搭配，創造出千變萬化的戰鬥組合。

不一樣的英雄 不一樣的節奏
不同的英雄會帶來不同的音樂和不同的節奏
針對不同的節奏操作，釋放出的技巧也會完全不同

豐富的戰鬥效果和組合。
不同的音樂家有不同的戰鬥風格：
召喚音樂武器進行近戰劈砍攻擊。
召喚音樂能量發動彈幕攻擊。
持續召喚音樂能量以集中能量攻擊。
用廣域演奏手法持續影響附近的單位。
等等…

音樂家的攻擊有不同的特殊效果，例如持續傷害、減速、擊退、彈射、凍結、電擊、暴擊、斬殺等。數十種信物與數百種道具配對，與英雄和音樂家相結合，創造出千變萬化的戰鬥流派。這些特效可以與道具和信物的特效及觸發條件結合，創造出各種不同的Build。

探索世界的真相
隨著你持續擊退虛空怪物並揭開人物和世界的真相，更深入地探索整個故事。

title: The Low Road [NSZ][ENG]
description:
The Low Road is a point-and-click graphic adventure game in which rookie agent Noomi Kovacs must navigate her way through the world of corporate espionage in this dark spy comedy set in the 1970s.

 Sporting a unique visual style inspired by gouache paintings and a pulsating rock and roll score, "The Low Road" will captivate players through intricate puzzles, branching moral dilemmas, and a quirky cast of memorable characters.


Features:
•	A unique digitally hand painted 2D illustration style with 1970s television influences.
•	Over 32000 words of dark comedic dialogue fully-voiced from a cast of characters
•	Play from the perspective of two corporate espionage agents
•	A mergence of traditional storytelling and engaging game play
•	An original score of swirling psychedelia and dusty Americana 
•	Nostalgic point-and-click style gameplay influenced by LucasArts and Sierra classics
•	Branching conversation puzzles that will challenge your deductive and intuitive abilities
•	Over 15+ first person puzzle sequence

title: Nelly Cootalot: The Fowl Fleet [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Pirate heroine Nelly Cootalot takes on the villainous Baron Widebeard in this point and click adventure game. Meet a cast of outlandish characters and face perplexing challenges in your quest for the Treasure of the Seventh Sea.
What is Baron Widebeard planning? Can he be stopped? In what way is a frozen volcano involved?
To answer these questions comes Nelly Cootalot: pirate heroine and defender of endangered and adorable creatures. Nelly’s journey will take her from Port Rubicund in the South Seas to the lonely isle of Gloomholm in the icy north. She’ll meet outlandish characters and face perplexing challenges in her quest for the Treasure of the Seventh Sea.
Explore a beautiful hand-drawn world, created by award-winning comedian & filmmaker Alasdair Beckett-King.
Meet outlandish characters voiced by talented & hilarious actors and comedians, with credits including Doctor Who, Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy & Broken Sword 5.
Help Nelly foil Baron Widebeard by tackling a variety of original & challenging puzzles. Race aristocrats, charter an airship & lie to strangers with no consequences.

FEATURES
     • Full Voice-Acting in English & German.
     • A script that will amuse and delight whether you are 9, 19 or 90. (But ONLY those ages.)
     • German, Spanish, Italian & French Localisations 
     • Puzzles that will tax the world's greatest minds, if they're having an off-day.
     • Over 45 Unique Characters & 35 Locations.
     • Quaint British spellings = extra letters for free.


PRESS CUTTINGS
• "It’s funny, daft, and the look is incessantly fantastic ... And it’s got Tom Baker in it. I had a thoroughly lovely time." - Rock, Paper, Shotgun
• "Incredibly funny and charming" (8.5/10) - Gamewatcher
• "Nelly Cootalot: The Fowl Fleet is one of the funniest games I have played in recent years." (5/5) - Kickstartventures
• "The puzzles are as perfect as possible." - Just Adventure
• "I had a lot of fun with Nelly Cootalot, and I recommend it for anyone who loves point-and-click adventures, birds, and/or pirates." (Score A) - Nerdy but Flirty
• "...with some beautiful art, an engaging story, some fun gameplay and snappy dialogue, Nelly Cootalot: The Fowl Fleet is a nice little gem." (9.1/10) - Geeknifty
• "It has obviously been influenced by the Monkey Island series, but without being a carbon copy. If you are a fan of the genre, then The Fowl Fleet should definitely be on your wishlist." (8.3) - Gameramble
• "A joy to play through from start to finish... easily one of the most enjoyable adventures of 2016." (8/10) - cubed3
• "Outstanding puzzle design" (87% ) - adventurecorner.de
• "Nelly Cootalot: The Fowl Fleet is a brilliant adventure that wonderfully demonstrates quirky British humor and is totally unique." (4.5/5 - Amazing) - The Nerd Stash
• "An amazing adventure game. Its story has surprising depth, the characters are lovable, the puzzles are great fun and it wraps it all up in a layer of fantastic humour!" (4.5/5 - AMAZING! ) - The Mental Attic

title: A Clockwork Ley-Line Trilogy: The Borderline of Dusk / Daybreak of Remnants Shadow / Flowers Falling in the Morning Mist (Tokeijikake no Leyline Kagerou ni Samayou Majo 時計仕掛けのレイライン) [NSP][ENG (Mod.)/JAP]
interface_lang: 日语 [JAP] + kastomnyy anglofikator 来自 masagrator 用于 1-oy chasti
description:
Trilogiya zagadochnogo priklyucheniya «A Clockwork Leyline», deystvie kotorogo razvorachivaetsya v neobychnoy shkole, gde sushchestvuet nastoyashchaya magiya teper dostupno v Full HD-kachestve na Nintendo Switch!
