Glavnogo geroya napravlyayut v «Otdel rassledovaniya osobykh situatsiy» v pervyy zhe den ego postupleniya v «Akademiyu Tenbin Ruri». Rol etogo filiala — reshat magicheskie proisshestviya, proiskhodyashchie v starshey shkole. Raskryvaya razlichnye dela, glavnyy geroy (to est, vy) s druzyami stolknutsya litsom k litsu s tainstvennoy charodeyskoy siloy, sokrytoy v obyknovennoy yaponskoy shkole...
Sbornik vklyuchaet v sebya vse 3 vyshedshie chasti igry:

title: Moonless Moon [NSZ][ENG]
description:
荒涼的月漠、隧道裡的茶餐廳、漂浮的天空島……每到夜晚，她都會造訪這些與現實相迥的世界。

《劇情》
夜蕗是一位平平無奇的學生，但每當夜幕降臨，她總是會不自覺地來到另一個世界。
荒涼的月漠、隧道裡的茶餐廳、漂浮的天空島——每個世界都顯得稀奇古怪，但她依然在那裡交到了朋友，享受著自在又愉快的時光。
與此同時她也在不斷思索——自己非要生活在白天的世界不可嗎？在學校裡度過的時光真的是現實嗎？
漸漸地，她將學會如何面對自己的世界。

《特徵》
·令人印象深刻的畫面與音樂，彷彿一部可供遊玩的音樂短片。
·在「RIDDLE PART」當中，玩家需要親手完成令劇情得以發展的文章。將採取尋找關鍵字並填補空白的簡單操作方式。
·許多原創樂曲會隨著MV一同出現在遊戲裡。幾位為人熟知的作者將獻上符合遊戲世界觀的精彩曲目。
·遊戲擁有多個結局。玩家的行動會影響劇情的走向。

title: Ato [NSZ][Multi]
description:
《Ato》是一款善於營造氛圍的銀河城類刀劍對決遊戲，背景設定在日本封建時代。遊戲以畫面敘事為主，講述了一位父親為了與妻小過上平靜生活而拋卻自己舊日的行徑，然而不久後孩子卻被奪走，平靜生活就此被打破......
  
在《Ato》中，每一場戰鬥都是至死方休的艱苦對決。你可以施展高風險的招架技巧、借助敵方進行跳躍、閃避他們的攻擊、並解鎖新能力來獲得更多在迎敵時的選擇。每一場戰鬥都有獨特的風格和特色。挑戰、觀察並擊敗你面對的每一個敵人，努力從你曾經效力的勢力中奪回你的孩子。
  
探索多彩和氛圍不同的各種環境，獲得新能力來解開環境中的謎題，發現這個世界中的秘密，體驗一段全程沒有任何文字的故事。
  
• 難度選項：
  -協助 - 適用於休閒通關
  -無障礙 - 略帶挑戰，需中等技術
  -資深 - 提供熟悉高難度遊戲的資深玩家。
  
在Ato的世界中探索、體驗、並擊敗強敵吧。

title: Brunswick Pro Billiards [NSP][ENG]
description: Brunswick Pro Billiards — samyy realistichnyy i zakhvatyvayushchiy simulyator bilyarda, dostupnyy na vsekh platformakh. Igra litsenzirovana kompaniey Brunswick, poetomu v ney ispolzuyutsya kopii nastoyashchikh bilyardnykh stolov, kiev i sharov. Srazhaytes s drugimi igrokami po seti i zarabatyvayte dollary Brunswick! Tratte vyigrysh na novoe snaryazhenie! A eshche vy mozhete potrenirovatsya, igraya protiv II, provesti vecher s druzyami za igroy v lokalnom mnogopolzovatelskom rezhime ili poprobovat raznye varianty rezhima ispytaniya.

title: Hijouguchi no Pikuto-san Dilogy (Find it! / Where are you? Mr. Picto of the Emergency Exit / ドコにいる？/ 探せ！非常口のピクトさん) [NSZ][JAP]
description: Hijouguchi no Pikuto-san — eto igry, v kotorykh vy ishchete razlichnykh «Pikto-san» na abstraktnykh illyustratsiyakh. Oni napominayut seriyu izvestnykh knig «Detektiv Per rasputyvaet delo» ot Khiro Kamigaki (Hirofumi Kamigaki), no v inoy stilistike.

title: The Sundew [NSZ][ENG]
description:
ABOUT THIS GAME
Shibukawa, capital of Japan, 2054. Water drips from the cracked ceiling onto the edge of your bed as the incessant rain masks the whine of a refrigerator and the neon hum of the city outside. You don’t recognise the heavy breath in your ear nor the warmth of the body lying next to you...

The world’s gone to hell, and it’s taking you down with it.

Welcome to Shibukawa

You are Anna Isobe, a cybernetically enhanced cop in a world that’s left you behind. Once a shining hope for the future, cyborgs have become taboo, replaced by drones and automata that make even your heightened abilities obsolete. Stuck in a thankless job surrounded by indifferent eyes you still have a duty to protect and serve, and that’s just what you’re going to do.

The Sundew is a dark adventure game set in the aftermath of a devastating future war, where the world as we know it was twisted by flames into a terrifying new dystopia. What begins as a normal day quickly becomes something else, and soon a lonely beat cop will hold the fate of the world in her hands.

The dark future, realised

The Sundew pays homage to classic adventure games of old while reflecting contemporary issues and gameplay. Beautifully drawn pixel-art and stunning sound design brings this dark future to life and grounds you in a vision of humanity’s progress that is both alien and strangely familiar...

Brave New World

Japan lies in ruins, save for the bustling haven of Shibukawa. Guide Anna through this new megalopolis and beyond in her search for the mystery behind a growing conspiracy. Travel from the backstreets of the city to far-flung isles, and the most notorious prison this side of the Steppe.

Choose your fate and that of the world

Alongside classic point-and-click gameplay The Sundew will ask you to make decisions that will change the future of humanity. Playing off contemporary issues, the choices offered are never black and white. Where do you believe mankind’s interests lie, and what means are acceptable to achieve them?

Features

- Guide Anna Isobe, a cyborg cop with a dark past, through the unravelling of a global conspiracy.
- Experience a diverse cast of characters, each with their own secrets and history.
- Explore Shibukawa and the remnants of the old world.
- Make decisions that will change the fate of humanity, for better or worse.

title: Watch [NSZ][ENG]
description:
這是一款關於視覺謎題的益智遊戲。
跟隨主角找到一切的答案，看似摸不著頭腦的開始，如果您不是那麽的匆忙，請不要輕易放棄遊戲中的謎題，也不要忽略了遊戲中的對話，有時候，它可能是謎題的關鍵。

遊戲的靈感來自於經典視覺謎題的遊戲。
通過旋轉鏡頭讓遊戲環境千變萬化，某些不可抵達的位置，可能換個角度便可以輕而易舉的抵達。某些看起來很遙遠的地方，轉動鏡頭就讓其近在咫尺。這一切都來自透視原理。

想不想讓一滴水裝滿一整個桶？或者把太陽當點火器？
這趟旅程，將帶你見證「透視」的魅力。體驗透視帶來的樂趣，用透視的原理解決旅途的困難，不論遇到看似無法越過的深坑，還是看似高不可攀的樓頂，又或是控製光的傳導。只需要轉變您看待事物的角度，你便能從中找到答案。

道具讓我們走得更遠
在遊戲中，你也會遇到各種道具：普通的箱子，奇怪的箱子，能飛風扇，又大又小的熱氣球。這些熟悉的東西，不是簡單的存在，如何使用它們，就發揮您的聰明才智吧！

title: Gnomes Garden 1-2-3 The Thief of Castles / New Home / Lost King [NSZ][RUS/Multi4]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 4]
description:
Printsessa skazochnogo korolevstva davno povzroslela i vyshla zamuzh. No odnazhdy ee lyubimyy muzh uekhal na ocherednuyu okhotu i ne vernulsya. Propal so vsey svoey svitoy.
Kuda zhe on delsya?

Reshis na puteshestvie po miru polnomu tayn i misticheskikh sushchestv v zakhvatyvayushchey kazualnoy fentezi-strategii Sad Gnomov.

title: Doll Explorer [NSZ][ENG]
description:
某處存在一個埋藏著無數金銀財寶的地下迷宮，自古以來未有人跡，遍布有毒氣體與妖魔鬼怪，通常的生物要在這裡存活超過一分鐘都極為困難。

魔女蒂雅因財政危機失去了自己的家，為了將其贖回而展開了探索迷宮的計劃，卻在途中與自稱「魔族公主」的地獄犬不期而遇。於是蒂雅借用她的身體，與魔法生物「多爾」一起對危機四伏的迷宮發起了挑戰。

本應與彼此無緣的魔女、魔法生物、魔族公主即將一同踏上冒險之旅。

【概述】
『Doll Explorer』是一款通過組合卡牌進行操作的回合制策略遊戲。玩家可以自由地將「向前1步」、「攻擊正前方」等行動進行組合，並交給多爾來執行，以此應付充斥地下迷宮的強敵與陷阱，以及步步緊逼的毒霧。

為了獲得埋藏在迷宮深處的寶藏，每踏出一步都必須小心謹慎。請務必細心觀察敵人與陷阱的位置，制定最為周全的行動計劃。同時也不要忘記讓蒂雅施展各種魔法。

玩家可以靠打倒敵人獲得強化素材，也可以通過「探索」拾取素材，在遭遇強敵之前用新的魔法和道具對蒂雅和多爾進行強化。

【特色】
·超過20種可選行動
·通過特定行動組合而成的連鎖技能
·有利於攻略的各種魔法
·收集素材強化角色的養成要素
·與各具特色的敵人以及巨型BOSS進行戰鬥
·可愛的角色與誘人的料理！
·收錄遊戲內各種美術資料的畫廊模式

一同踏向迷宮深處，尋找寶藏吧！

title: Whitestone [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Dobro pozhalovat na bort «Okhotnika za solntsem» na zare 20-go veka vmeste s Dzhekom i komandoy!

Pri podderzhke svoego khoroshego druga Dzhek delaet svoy pervyy sereznyy shag v karere v kachestve uchenika kafedry arkheologii na bortu kolossalnogo dirizhablya. Zavershayushchee puteshestvie v Arktiku idet gladko, poka v kayutu Dzheka ne vlomilis i ego drug ne propal.

Po korablyu rasprostranilos bezumie. Ekipazh smotrit na Dzheka s paranoyey, i Dzhek smotrit v otvet s toy zhe paranoyey. Ne znaya, komu doveryat, Dzhek vynuzhden borotsya s koshmarami, kak psikhicheskimi, tak i fizicheskimi, poskolku on stanovitsya glavnym podozrevaemym v uzhasnom postupke i v konechnom itoge uznaet pravdu s pomoshchyu svoikh tovarishchey po komande.

Uaytstoun nachinaetsya kak rassledovanie, a zatem vykhodit daleko za ramki. Uaytstoun sochetaet v sebe rolevuyu igru, uzhasy, boevik, komediyu i romantiku. Khotite schastlivyy konets JRPG? Uchites, pomogayte svoim tovarishcham po komande i dovedite puteshestvie do kontsa! Khotite kontsovku Survival Horror? Sdelayte... eee, ne ochen pravilnyy vybor.

Vyzhivanie ne garantirovano ni Dzheku, ni ego druzyam. Vash vybor imeet znachenie. Poyti na banket s druzyami? Ostatsya nochyu v zhutkom lazarete odin? Ili ne delayte ni togo, ni drugogo! Pytka? Ili zvanyy uzhin? Mnozhestvo marshrutov vedut ne tolko k raznym kontsovkam, no i k raznym syuzhetnym liniyam, glavnym geroyam i vragam.

Vdokhnovlen takimi igrami, kak Corpse Party, Higurashi: When They Cry, Dead Space, Dark Souls i franshizoy Persona.

Funktsii:
Bolee 10 chasov istorii za 30 igrovykh dney.
6 razlichnykh marshrutov s raznymi personazhami, boevymi urovnyami i syuzhetnoy napravlennostyu.
Novaya igra+ s povyshennoy slozhnostyu, sokhranyaya pri etom vashi predmety, statistiku i dengi.
20 chlenov ekipazha so svoimi pobochnymi kvestami.
Desyatki vidov oruzhiya i stikhiynykh sil dlya borby s vragami.
8 boevykh urovney na temy srednevekovogo fentezi, nauchnoy fantastiki i stimpanka.

title: World Conqueror X / European Conqueror X / Great Conqueror Rome [NSZ][ENG]
description:
A strategy experience with incredible detail and depth, you control great Commanders including Caesar, Pompey, Antony, Octavian, and Spartacus. Make major decisions on deployments, city improvements and more to emerge victorious!

Take on the Campaign mode to relive history and lead an empire across Africa, Europe and Asia. Lead legions across historic wars, build cities, recruit soldiers, develop gear and naval fleets, and research new technologies – you have control.

In Conquest mode you create history during Rome’s era; choose from many countries and forge a path to glory. Form alliances, declare war, and build your empire to be the most powerful in the world!

For an extra challenge there is Expedition mode; take on 5 different scenarios in which you undertake a variety of battles that’ll truly test your leadership; can you make good use of limited resources and units?

Great Conqueror: Rome brings unparalleled strategy gameplay, historical detail and content to Nintendo Switch™; prepare to bring glory to Rome!

title: Growbot [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Growbot — eto dvukhmernoe priklyuchenie o devochke-robote, spasayushchey svoy dom ot zloy sily kristallov. Deystvie proiskhodit na kosmicheskoy biopank-stantsii, izobiluyushchey fantasticheskimi rasteniyami i prisheltsami. Vy igraete za Naru, devochku-rostobota, prokhodyashchuyu obuchenie na kapitana. Kogda vashu rodnuyu stantsiyu atakuyut bystrorastushchie kristally, imenno vy dolzhny spasti ee.
Na sozdanie igry nas vdokhnovili klassicheskie priklyuchencheskie igry, takie kak Loom, i sovremennye advechury tipa Machinarium. Igra dolzhna ponravitsya kak opytnym igrokam, tak i novichkam. 

Osobennosti
• Issleduyte chudesnuyu kosmicheskuyu stantsiyu i otremontiruyte ee udivitelnoe oborudovanie.
• Povstrechayte mnozhestvo fantasticheskikh rasteniy i sushchestv.
• Sobirayte zvuki tsvetov i kombiniruyte ikh, chtoby sozdavat moshchnye shchity.
• Poznakomtes s pushistoy beloy gologrammoy po imeni Zvezdopuzya, u kotoroy v zhivotike galaktika.
• Otkroyte dlya sebya skazku o sile tsvetov — skazku, chi korni ochen khitro perepleteny.

title: Karma Incarnation One [NSZ][RUS/Multi25]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 25]
description:
This original adventure game explores a love story between two beautiful souls through ingenious humour and a bizarre, hand-drawn, frame-by-frame animation style. Our hero’s beloved has been abducted by evil spirits, and the only way to reunite them is to reincarnate himself as a dragon to defeat Evil. But something has gone wrong, and his soul is reborn as a worm named Pip. Now Pip must overcome the challenges of a surreal world, solve mind bending puzzles, and save his love. Choosing between good and evil, Pip learns the laws of Karma, and his choices define the outcome of the game.

Features:

— Play as Pip and explore a rich, bizarre world.
— Use Astral sight, a power that allows you to peek into the world of spirits at any point of the game.
— Learn Karma laws through choice and action. Each evil deed spoils Pip’s karma and changes his appearance. Good deeds purify karma. Key characters respond differently to Pip’s karma, opening additional storyline.
— Hand-drawn animations of the varied interactions of Pip with his strange environment. The environment and other characters of the quests are drawn individually for each situation.
— Live magical award winning music and sound by ZMEIRADUGA.

title: Witch College / Witch College 2 Revenge of the Societies / Study Partner / My Favourite Teacher Bundle [NSZ][ENG]
description:
V universitete Khimavari vse kazalos normalnym, odnako v odin strannyy vecher vse izmenilos.

Tainstvennye illyuzii, falshivye vospominaniya i magicheskie zaklinaniya... eto mozhet byt tolko delom ruk zloy podsolnechnoy vedmy, no... kto ona?

Komu zhe mozhno doveryat? Mozhet byt, eto tvoya luchshaya podruga Aki? Sem, novenkaya? Khana, strannaya tikhaya devushka? Eto mozhet byt kto ugodno! Poznakomtes s nimi poblizhe i dokopaytes do suti etoy tayny.

V etom nabore vy poluchite dva priklyucheniya serii Witch College (i dva dopolneniya), napolnennykh magiey, lyubovyu, komediey i romantikoy!

Gotovy li vy k feericheskomu priklyucheniyu?

Kharakteristiki:
* 2 polnye igry s dopolnitelnymi glavami.
* 25+ polnostyu illyustrirovannykh stsen.
* Simpatichnye milye personazhi.
* Varianty romanticheskikh otnosheniy s neskolkimi personazhami.
* Mnozhestvo variantov s alternativnymi vetvleniyami.
* Neskolko kontsovok v zavisimosti ot vashikh deystviy.

title: Epic Dumpster Bear 1.5 DX Dumpster Fire Rebirth / 2 He Who Bears Wins [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Tainstvennaya zlaya megakorporatsiya unichtozhila ves vash les, zastaviv est musor, chtoby vyzhit. Teper nastala ochered mesti!
Epic Dumpster Bear — shutlivyy dinamichnyy ekshn-platformer, vdokhnovlennyy klassikoy 16-bitnoy epokhi, v kotorom vy igraete golodnym musornym medvedyom. Igra soderzhit 7 mirov i 70 urovney, bossov, a takzhe sekretnye i bonusnye golovolomochnye platformy.
Vo vtoroy chasti igry, vam budet eshchyo dostupno 8 novykh mirov i 53+ zaputannykh urovnya dlya prokhozhdeniya!

title: Stilstand [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Experience a young woman’s insecurities during a long summer of parties, dates, dreams and time-wasting.

Amid the feeling of being stuck and the desire for isolation, there's still hope that one day, things will change. Maybe the shadow monster in her apartment can help her stay afloat?

“an incredibly well written and truly unique experience” - Nintendo World Report
“every element of Stilstand is incredibly detailed” - Pure Nintendo
“a profound, unique and worthy experience” - Finger Guns

● Flip through the pages of an emotionally-engaging hand-drawn story
● Interact directly with items and characters during your adventures
● Explore themes like anxiety and loss of sense in a whimsical way 

Made in Copenhagen by Niila Games & Ida Hartmann
“With Stilstand I wanted to explore how a game could dig into the core of unpleasant feelings, while balancing comic panels, game design and a dark sense of humour.” - Ida Hartmann, writer, co-designer and illustrator

Published by Nakana.io
“Our focus is on impactful games. Stilstand is a short and striking experience.” - Mikaël Bourget, founder of the publishing label

title: Gohome (Go Home) [NSP][ENG]
description:
Syurrealistichnyy yaponskiy khorror v dekoratsiyakh nostalgicheskogo zhilogo rayona Yaponii 2000-kh godov!
Mosaiko Sudzuki 7 let. Vorony karkayut v svyatilishchakh, osminogi gulyayut v parkakh. Zakatnoe solntse svetit v okna domov.
Eto vsyo — znakomyy devochke gorod, no chto-to tut vsyo zhe idyot ne tak..

title: Laraan [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Created with a minimalist low poly style. Accompanied by a splendid movie soundtrack.
You’re about to enter an old world of computer entertainment. Laraan bridges the gap between Cinema and Action/Adventure games with a completely old style of fluid, cinematic storytelling. 

Using a completely old graphic system of cinematic zooms, pans, close-ups, and cuts, Laraan gets you involved in a breathtaking story of inter-dimensional travel.

You’ll have to run, fight, investigate, solve puzzles and ride futuristic bikes. The complete musical score and realistic, digitized sound effects will make you feel like you’re on a movie sound stage.

title: The Kids We Were [NSZ][ENG]
description:
《變成大人也不要忘記。》是一款背景設定在日本昭和時代的電影冒險遊戲。
將既美好又懷舊，令人屏息的｢那個年代｣街景搬入遊戲中，
少年心湊將在那裡展開一段不可思議的夏日冒險。


這部作品是一款冒險遊戲，手機版於2020年2月正式上架發行全球後，除了榮獲Google Play Indie Games Festival「TOP3」及特別獎的「avex獎」之外，也入選了Google Play Best of 2020的「2020：獨立遊戲部門」。
 在Nintendo Switch「完整版」中增加了講述手機版本篇結局後的「後日談」新劇情，還追加了新的「收藏品」。

--------
劇情
--------
少年「心湊」和媽媽還有妹妹一起
造訪了這座平凡的小鎮「加賀美町」

這個旅程中他有個秘密計畫要實行。
那就是，瞞著媽媽找尋住在鎮上的爸爸。

為了某個目的。
心湊終於找到有關爸爸下落的線索。
然而……

那卻是一本，爸爸遺留下來的謎之線索「七大不可思議筆記本」

在筆記本的指引下，心湊踏上了遙遠又艱難的旅程。
目的地是爸爸和媽媽相識的，「那個年代」的加賀美町。
也就是……33年前的世界！

title: Winning Post 9 2020 [NSP][JAP]
description: Igra-simulyator skachek uvidit, kak igroki ukreplyayut svoikh loshadey, chtoby pobedit svoikh sopernikov. Silnye sopernichayushchie lagerya budut ispolzovat unikalnye strategii, takie kak rotatsiya i naznachenie zhokeya, chtoby pobedit igrokov. Vy budete poluchat «Komandy po svyazyam» po rezultatam gonok, rasshiryat svoi svyazi s zhokeyami, trenerami i prodyuserami i uglublyat svoi svyazi. Obuchenie i proizvodstvo budut imet razlichnye effekty. Sozdayte svoi svyazi, uglubite svyazi mezhdu vsadnikom i loshadyu, i srazhaytes s vashimi mogushchestvennymi sopernikami. Igra-simulyator skachek, v kotoroy vy smozhete nasladitsya realnym mirom skachek i ispytat zakhvatyvayushchuyu bitvu sopernikov. Predstavte novyy opyt lordov, elementy zhokeya i svyazi s loshadmi byli izmeneny na sistemu, osnovannuyu na komandakh. Poroda loshad mirovogo klassa s priznakom prigodnosti mira.

title: Flood of Light [NSZ][ENG]
description:
You control a mysterious girl who arrives at a city that is completely flooded with water. Only she possesses the ability to control light.
By using the girl's supernatural power, you can solve various puzzles to gradually make the water recede and ultimately save the city.

However, by doing so, the true purpose of this mysterious girl will also be slowly revealed to you.

title: Pako Caravan [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Sdelay svoy karavan kak mozhno dlinnee! Prokhodi missii v krasochnykh i veselykh urovnyakh, kazhdyy iz kotorykh interesen po-svoemu. Zdes i gazon, kotoryy nuzhno podstrich, i teleporty, kotorye nuzhno ispolzovat, a takzhe riskovannye pryzhki, NLO, laboratornye eksperimenty i mnogoe drugoe!

OSOBENNOSTI:
+ Prokhodi urovni so vse bolee dlinnym karavanom!
+ 15 urovney v ne vpolne realistichnykh lokatsiyakh.
+ Na kazhdom urovne krutye avtomobili, sotni treylerov i osobye tryuki.
+ 150 zadaniy dlya vypolneniya.
+ Legkoe upravlenie, trudnoe osvoenie!

title: Robotry [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Fizicheskiy platformer — bez knopki pryzhka! Khodite, prygayte, karabkaytes i parkurte, upravlyaya kazhdoy nogoy zaputavshegosya robota-malysha. Prevratites iz malysha v kuvyrkayushchegosya akrobata v rezhime istorii, ili podelites mnogonogim robotom s druzyami, chtoby dobavit v svoyu zhizn khaosa!..
Pomogi veselym oranzhevym astronavtam provesti krutye nauchnye eksperimenty na raznykh planetakh, puteshestvuya po kosmosu. Pytaytes v odinochku — ili obedinite usiliya vmeste s dvumya druzyami!

title: Coffee Plis [NSZ][ENG]
description: 年輕人的第一份工作是在一家大型自助餐廳為同事工作，但當他發現混亂（也稱為高峰時間）時，事情就失控了。

title: Kill The Bad Guy [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Vse li zasluzhivayut vtoroy shans? Vozmozhno li prostit cheloveku ego prestupleniya? Mnozhestvo voennykh prestupnikov, byvshikh mafiozi i drugikh narushiteley zakona skryvayutsya ot nakazaniya, lovko pryachas sredi obychnykh lyudey. No tut v dele poyavlyaetes Vy. Vasha zadacha, kak chlena zagadochnogo taynogo obshchestva, poklyavshegosya izbavit mir ot Plokhikh Parney – pomoch spravedlivosti vostorzhestvovat v samom krovavom vide, ispolzuya v svoikh interesakh element neozhidannosti.

Vysledite Plokhikh Parney, budte bezzhalostny, no umny, planiruya svoyo delo i ustranyaya ikh odin za odnim. No pomnite: kazhdaya smert dolzhna vyglyadet, kak neschastnyy sluchay.  Na kazhdom urovne Vam predstavitsya shans izbavitsya ot Plokhogo Parnya s pomoshchyu razlichnogo oruzhiya i lovushek. Tolko Vam dano sdelat tak, chtoby on okazalsya ne v tom meste, ne v to vremya.

 V etoy originalnoy golovolomke bolshuyu rol igraet fizika, a takzhe trezvyy raschet i soobrazitelnost. Plokhie Parni ne zasluzhivayut miloserdiya! “Dlya vsekh ostalnykh my ne sushchestvuem. Esli ty provalish zadanie, ty edinstvennyy, kto ponesyot otvetstvennost, a my budem otritsat vse svyazi s toboy.”

Osobennosti
VYSLEDI SVOYu TsEL na 60 urovnyakh, kazhdyy iz kotorykh eshchyo interesnee, chem predydushchiy, i otkroy 6 novykh potryasayushchikh bonusnykh urovney.
ISPOLZUY VOOBRAZhENIE, kogda budesh ubivat prestupnikov odin za drugim. Dozhdis podkhodyashchego momenta, i proley stolko krovi, skolko smozhesh! 
STAN POSLANNIKOM SMERTI i pokazhi, kak nuzhno rasporyazhatsya nashim arsenalom lovushek. Vzlamyvay avtomobili, prevrashchay obychnye predmety v smertelnoe oruzhie ili kombiniruy raznye elementy, chtoby sozdat chto-to unikalnoe.
OSTAVAYSYa V TENI. Ne stoit privlekat k sebe vnimanie. Kamery, prokhozhie, politseyskie i telokhraniteli Plokhikh Parney ne dolzhny tebya zapodozrit. Nikto ne dolzhen dazhe zasomnevatsya v sluchaynosti etikh intsidentov.
TERPENIE I TRUD VSYo PERETRUT. Ispolzuy funktsiyu povtora, chtoby poluchit rekordnoe kolichestvo ochkov, vypolnit dopolnitelnye zadaniya, nayti novye sposoby ubit Plokhogo Parnya ili ottochit svoyo smertelnoe remeslo.

title: Akuto Showdown [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Akuto: Showdown is an isometric, fast-paced action game where players fight with different weapons in intense battles. The game is set on various stages where players have to not only watch out for opponents, but also for the environment from killing them. Cars on the streets, trains and gunslingers -  all waiting for your one careless step. The arenas are set in many different themes like Wild West or medieval Japan. 

There are 10 unlockable melee weapons - from standard swords to shovels and...legs. The same applies to guns, 15 kinds of firearms are at your disposal: pistol, shotgun or even a magic wand.  To make your character unique you can customize your fighter with one of many funny hats. 

So what are you waiting for? Gather up, draw your sword - showdown is on! 

Features:

- Enjoy the intensity and fun of classic couch party games, but with more violence

- A wide range of dynamic levels with environmental hazards

- Unlockable weapons and HATS!

- Fight against your friends in local multiplayer, or play against the bots in one of the many versus modes

title: Grab the Bottle [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Grab the Bottle – eto neobychnaya igra-golovolomka, v kotoroy vy reshaete zadachi, rastyagivaya sobstvennuyu ruku po vsemu urovnyu.

Vam nuzhno manevrirovat postoyanno rastyagivayushcheysya rukoy i izbegat lyubykh opasnostey na puti k prizovoy butylke. A chtoby zhizn medom ne kazalas, v Grab the Bottle takzhe est fizika i golovolomki. Vam pridetsya khvatat, tyanut i dazhe brosat raznoobraznye obekty, chtoby dobratsya do zavetnoy butylochki.

Istoriya igry nachinaetsya v 50-kh godakh, gde-to v selskoy Amerike, gde odin neordinarnyy rebenok delaet pervye shagi i obnaruzhivaet, chto net nichego nevozmozhnogo… Osobenno esli u tebya est beskonechno rastyagivayushchayasya ruka!

Grab the Bottle sleduet za zhiznyu etogo malchika ot kolybeli do mogily, reshaya mnozhestvo golovolomok, vdokhnovlennykh «povsednevnymi problemami» na puti. Tsentralnym elementom istorii yavlyaetsya nezdorovaya tyaga k butylkam, kotoruyu imeet glavnyy geroy.

Osobennosti:
- Innovatsionnyy sposob resheniya golovolomok pri pomoshchi rastyagivaniya i vtyagivaniya svoey ruki.
- Rezhim istorii s desyatkami urovney, nachinaya ot pylnykh cherdakov i zakanchivaya ogromnymi parkami razvlecheniy. Vsego ot 7 do 10 chasov geympleya.
- Raznoobraznyy saundtrek s razlichnymi stilyami muzyki, otrazhayushchiy zhiznennye fazy glavnogo geroya.

title: Oh...Sir! The Insult Simulator / Oh Sir! The Hollywood Roast [NSZ][ENG]
description:
***** Game in English only *****
The boys are back , and they look better than ever! Oh…Sir! The Hollywood Roast is a brand new spin-off to the surprise indie hi, Oh…Sir! The Insult Simulator. This time around we’re taking tinsel town down a few notches, whilst classing up the joint. Play as one of many famous, but for legal purposes, slightly different pop culture icons and verbally spar with other Hollywood elitists using a deep battle system.

Verbally joust by yourself or take your verbal skills on a global PR tour and battle friends and family from anywhere in the world.

====== Game Features ======

- Unleash the sickest burns on your opponents in a Hollywood-style roast
- Play alone, online or couch multiplayer
- Deeper-than-you-think mechanics featuring combos, continuations and exploiting your rival’s weak spots
- A star-studded new cast of crazy Hollywood characters
- Set the scene with a slew of iconic film backdrops
- Bigger, ruder, insultier
- Comeback mechanic - charge your anger and finish the sentence with a unique closure
- Expanded career mode - master each scene to win Golden Parrots and use them to develop your character

title: Worse Than Death [NSP][ENG]
description: Begite, spasayte svoi zhizni, pryachtes v teni, ispolzuyte vashu soobrazitelnost, chtoby izbezhat prizrachnykh sushchestv i obnaruzhit uzhasnye istiny o vashem neschastnom rodnom gorode. Reshayte kovarnye golovolomki, chtoby priotkryt emotsionalnuyu istoriyu Kholli i eyo druzey, istoriyu, ot kotoroy vy budete v zakhvate do samogo kontsa!

title: Elliot Quest [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Posle togo kak zhena Elliot-a ischezaet, on zabolevaet i pytaetsya sovershit samoubiystvo, no obnaruzhivaet, chto ne mozhet umeret. Stradaya ot koshmarov i slabeya den oto dnya, Elliot nakhodit mestnogo mudretsa, kotoryy rasskazyvaet emu, chto on stal zhertvoy redkogo proklyatiya. Demon po imeni Satar medlenno vytyagivaet zhiznennuyu silu Elliot-a. Esli Elliot ne smozhet nayti lekarstvo ot proklyatiya, prezhde chem stanet slishkom pozdno, on prevratitsya v Satar-a. Ego edinstvennaya nadezhda — obratitsya za pomoshchyu k odnomu iz khraniteley ostrova, kotorye ne pozvolili Satar-u zakhvatit Urele.

Izuchayte zhivoy otkrytyy mir, polnyy tayn i zagadochnykh khraniteley, kotorye mogut pomoch vylechit proklyatie bessmertiya Elliot-a. Na protyazhenii vsego etogo priklyucheniya vy soberete beschislennoe mnozhestvo sposobnostey i zaklinaniy, proberetes v svoikh poiskakh cherez 5 podzemeliy i pobedite na svoem puti 16 unikalnykh bossov, chtoby otkryt razlichnye kontsovki.

title: A Winter's Daydream [NSP][ENG]
description:
v simpatichnuyu moloduyu devushku! *Mesto dlya shutok*

Devyatnadtsatiletniy Yuu terpet ne mozhet svoyu mladshuyu sestru Otoko, i eto chuvstvo u nikh vzaimno. Proshel pochti god s tekh por, kak Yuu videl ee v posledniy raz, sbezhav iz rodnogo provintsialnogo gorodka, chtoby uchitsya v stolitse. Tolko na Novyy God on vozvrashchaetsya obratno, chtoby otprazdnovat 31-e dekabrya v uyutnom krugu semi.

K sozhaleniyu, za vremya otsutstviya ego mladshaya sestra nikak ne izmenilas i napryazhenie mezhdu nimi stalo tolko silnee. Ustav ot postoyannykh ssor, Yuu reshaet sbezhat eshche raz, no tolko na etot raz ne v gorod, a v zasnezhennuyu glukhuyu derevnyu ego babushki.

Vstrecha s babushkoy nachinalas dovolno spokoyno, no tolko do pervoy lunnoy nochi, kogda oni uvideli zvezdu, pronosyashchuyusya po nebu.

Na sleduyushchee utro Yuu vkhodit v kukhnyu, vse eshche v polusne, chtoby obnaruzhit...

«Kto ty? Chto ty delaesh v dome moey babushki?»

...chto ego babushka prevratilas v simpatichnuyu moloduyu devushku!

Chto zhe tut na samom dele proizoshlo? Smozhet li Yuu vernut svoyu ba v pervonachalnoe sostoyanie? I pochemu ona takaya ocharovatelnaya?!

Osobennosti:
- Novaya istoriya ot ebi-hime, avtora vizualnykh novell Sweetest Monster, Blackberry Honey i The Way We All Go
- Okolo 50,000 slov (primerno 3-4 chasa chteniya)
- Detalizirovannye fony i personazhi
- Eksklyuzivnyy saundtrek
- Kineticheskaya istoriya bez vyborov i razvetvleniy
- Nu ochen milaya babushka!!!

title: Rascal's Escape [NSZ][ENG]
description: «Priklyucheniya Ozornogo Barsuka» — vesyolaya priklyuchencheskaya igra dlya dvoikh puteshestvennikov po Evrope: prisoedinyaytes k lovkoy belke i silnomu medvedyu, prygay, topay i zhuy, pokoryay znamenitye dostoprimechatelnosti, sobiray frukty i orekhi, peredvigay derevya, shlyopay po gryazi ili tashchi gigantskie torty!

title: Skyhook [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Braulernyy ekshn, v kotorom 4 igroka (ili vy odin) s pomoshchyu kryukov-koshek peremeshchayutsya po urovnyu i srazhayutsya drug s drugom!
Ispolzuyte svoy kryuk, chtoby pobezhdat sovernikov vragov, i svobodno peremeshchaytes po urovnyu v lyubykh ploskostyakh.

title: Shmubedi Boo / Robots Under Attack [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
description:
在Shmubedi Boo的土地上發生了麻煩！
一隻邪惡的兔子偷走了城市居民的蘋果儲備。
幫助阻止這個惡棍，並將被盜的蘋果帶回家吧！

• 一起遊玩更有趣！
與你的朋友在同一屏幕上遊玩。
誰能擊敗所有頭目並拯救Shmubedi Boo的居民呢？

• 真正的硬核挑戰。
超過100個逐漸增加難度的關卡，5個獨特的頭目，
以及大量的獎勵、陷阱和怪物等待著你！

• 偉大的英雄們。
7名英雄可供選擇。
試試操控每一位英雄進行遊戲吧！

• 蘋果商店。
想買一頂帽子，或者一顆冰凍炸彈來凍結你的朋友嗎？
沒問題！在我們的蘋果商店裡，
只要你有足夠的蘋果，你的英雄甚至可以為自己買一條命！

• 英雄的煉獄。
在煉獄中試試你的運氣，
看看你是否能欺騙死神本身！

title: The Flower Collectors [NSZ][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
Barselona, 1977. Prikovannyy k invalidnoy kolyaske byvshiy politseyskiy stanovitsya svidetelem ubiystva i obedinyaetsya s molodoy ambitsioznoy zhurnalistkoy, chtoby dokopatsya do istiny. Vooruzhivshis fotokameroy, binoklem i ratsiey, uznayte tayny goroda pryamo so svoego balkona v etom neodnoznachnom detektive.

Poka odnazhdy v dozhdlivuyu noch ne stanovites svidetelem ubiystva. V stremlenii raskryt pravdu vy neozhidanno dlya sebya obedinyaetes s molodoy ambitsioznoy zhurnalistkoy Melindoy i vmeste nachinaete rassledovanie. 

Sovmestnymi usiliyami vam udastsya raskryt taynu i i uznat sekrety mestnykh zhiteley.

Sozdateli igry, vdokhnovlennye klassicheskimi nuarnymi detektivami i igrami, vrode Firewatch ot Capo Santo, vlozhili v nee mnogo lyubvi.

* Raskroyte ubiystvo s neobychnym syuzhetom
* Poznakomtes s tseloy gruppoy yarkikh antropomorfnykh personazhey v krasivom atmosfernom mire
* Rassleduyte delo s pomoshchyu binoklya, fotokamery i ratsii i uznayte tayny mestnykh zhiteley pryamo so svoego balkona
* Vossozdayte khronologiyu sobytiy, chtoby uznat, kto ubiytsa
* Rassprosite vsekh, kogo vstretite, bud to svyashchennik, artistka ili vorchlivaya starukha
* Pogruzites v unikalnuyu atmosferu Barselony 70-kh
* V etoy igre personazhi, mir i istoriya vazhnee lovkosti i masterstva

title: Real Heroes: Firefighter [NSP][ENG]
description:
For the first time on Nintendo Switch™, Real Heroes: Firefighter gives you a realistic point-of-view experience of the challenges firefighters face. Experience raging infernos and explosive environments in this truly unique action game. Use the firefighter tools of the trade, like axe, hose and saw to rescue survivors and control fires. You take on the role of a new graduate starting out at a big city fire station, gradually learn the tools of the trade and proceed to battle fires and other hazards. Operate the tools of the trade during many hours of gameplay and enjoy beautiful dramatic cinematic scenes. Aim jets of water and pry open doors. Save people and animals from fiery or electrical danger and become a true hero – a real firefighter!

- Realistic AI based fire behavior delivers a dangerous, even cunning challenge
- Career mode with over 9 levels and many locations
- Many realistic tools such as axes and hydraulic spreaders help you to hack down doors and pry apart crushed metal
- Phenomenal voice cast, including James Marsters (Buffy), Jack McGee (Rescue Me), Michael Jace (The Shield), Jamie Kennedy (Ghost Whisperer) and Jenette Goldstein (Aliens)
- Updated graphics for Nintendo Switch™

title: Gelly Break [NSP][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 机器翻译 来自 most2820
description: Vy spasaete rodnuyu planetu Gelli ot zloy Zloy Kapli v roli Gelya i Li!..

title: Lost King's Lullaby [NSZ][ENG]
description:
We will venture forth with Kiara in a Celtic adventure, exploring different maze-like procedurally generated worlds. We will face enemies in frenetic battles where we will have to make use of our reflexes and choose between different abilities to beat the menacing creatures. Lift the curse upon the kingdom of Bamba and find out why you are the only one not frozen in time.

Celtic Ambientation
Lost King's Lullaby brings us a new point of view of the celtic culture, taking a lot of traditional elements of this culture and rediscovering it.

Tale esthetic
Be amazed by a beautiful art style. You will feel like you are falling into a tale...

Alternative Battle System
Fight in frenetic battles  where your reflexes and tactical thinking will play a big part. Customize the way you want to battle by choosing your abilities and buffs.

Procedural World
You will be always surprised by our procedural woods. Each time you run your adventure you will encounter new routes and paths, enemies and treasures.

title: Beyond Enemy Lines Remastered Edition (Covert Operations / Essentials) [NSP][ENG]
description:
Mir blizok k yadernomu apokalipsisu, sovetskaya separatistskaya gruppirovka zakhvatila chip upravleniya voennogo sputnika. Eto vasha rabota - vosstanovit chip! Osnashchennyy sovremennym oruzhiem i oborudovaniem, vy deystvuete v absolyutnoy sekretnosti kak odinokiy volk daleko za predelami linii vraga.

Produmayte svoy put, nablyudayte za svoimi vragami, probiraytes na ikh bazu i vypolnyayte svoyu zadachu. U vas est polnaya svoboda vybora - sverkayushchee oruzhie ili besshumnyy ubiytsa - eto vash vybor! Beyond Enemy Lines - eto neumolimyy i napryazhennyy opyt, v kotorom vazhny navyki i takticheskie resheniya!

Beyond Enemy Lines: Remastered Edition soderzhit raznoobraznyy obnovlennyy kontent.

Iskhodnaya kampaniya
Kampaniya na 8 missiy so srednim vremenem igry ~ 10 chasov.

Operatsiya: Arctic Hawk - AddOn
Dopolnitelnaya kampaniya s 4 missiyami, deystvie kotoroy proiskhodit zimoy, so srednim vremenem igry ~ 3 chasa.

- Obnovlennaya igra i perestrelka
- Uluchshennyy AI
- Polnostyu obnovlennaya listva s bolee gustoy rastitelnostyu i bolee realistichnymi lesami.
- Uluchsheny effekty i postobrabotka.

title: Two Sided Runner [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Pereklyuchaytes mezhdu angelskoy i demonicheskoy formami, prizyvayte familyarov i nanosite otvetnye udary mogushchestvennym bossam! Eto — vesyolyy ranner, kotoraya proverit vashu reaktsiyu! Uklonyaytes ot prepyatstviy s pomoshchyu pryzhkov i smeny tsvetov, peremeshchayas po zapolnennym vragami urovnyam s zakhvatyvayushchey mekhanikoy. Stremites nabrat naibolshee kolichestvo ochkov, parya po dinamichnym urovnyam!
S drevnikh vremen nebesnye sushchestva ispolzovali beluyu i chyornuyu magiyu, chtoby podderzhivat ravnovesie v nizhnem mire. Odnazhdy poyavilas fraktsiya zlykh nebesnykh sushchestv, zamyshlyayushchaya unichtozhenie nizhnego mira. Oni vypustili armii familyarov, povergnuv ravnovesie v khaos! Geroi doblestno protivostoyali etim zlodeyam, postaviv ikh na gran porazheniya.
..No zlodei nachali vykachivat ogromnoe kolichestvo magicheskoy sily iz nizhnego mira cherez svoikh familyarov. Porazhennye etoy novoobretennoy siloy, geroi byli pobezhdeny i nizvergnuty v nizhniy mir. Tak nachinaetsya puteshestvie geroev po vosstanovleniyu mira, srazhayas s neistovymi monstrami i mogushchestvennymi bossami v bitve za vosstanovlenie ravnovesiya v mire!

title: Destiny Connect: Tick-Tock Travelers [NSP][ENG]
description: When strange events befall the town of Clocknee on the eve of a new year, the fabric of history will change forever!

title: Legendary Heroes [NSZ][ENG]
description:
有史以來最偉大的戰鬥已經開始。 來自各個宇宙的英雄被召喚來展示他們的力量並證明哪個團隊是最好的！

傳奇英雄是一款帶有MOBA元素的實時RPG/策略遊戲。 保護你的塔並粉碎你的對手！

與 10 個不同的英雄一起玩，每個英雄都有 4 種特殊能力。 獲得 XP，升級你的力量，變得更強大、更快、更有抵抗力。 在 30 種不同的地圖中進行快速而激烈的比賽，為所有玩家（老手或新手）帶來獨特的挑戰。

遊戲特色：
- 實時激烈的行動/策略
- 具有獨特特殊能力的英雄
- 在多場比賽中保持你的進步
- 使用道具讓你的團隊更強大

title: Placid Plastic Duck Simulator [NSP][RUS/Multi12]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 12]
description: 療癒橡皮鴨模擬器是一款放鬆的3D遊戲，讓您體驗成為一隻橡皮鴨的生活，帶來平靜和幸福的實驗。您可以在喜愛的海邊泳池中度過恢復活力的假期，或者在山間湖泊享受雪景。您並不孤單，眾多橡皮鴨會陪伴您，每隻都有獨特風格和神韻。漂浮、日光浴、點水、滑梯，音樂襯托著懷舊氛圍。夜幕降臨，星星閃耀，讓海浪聲伴您入眠。新的一天開始，享受藍天，滑進下一個泳池。飛機匆忙經過，但與您無關。活在當下，享受生活。一切都會好起來的。

title: Mickey Storm and the Cursed Mask [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Dobro pozhalovat v luchshiy akvapark v mire! Na etom kurorte, polnom priklyucheniy i zakhvatyvayushchikh vodnykh gorok, tolko vy i vasha sestra smozhete ostanovit zlogo doktora Fishera! Ispolzuya silu tainstvennoy maski, etot zlobnyy zlodey ocharoval ves park, chtoby nakonets zamanit v lovushku vashikh roditeley. Pochemu? Potomu chto oni ne kto inoy, kak vsemirno izvestnye shpiony Shtorma!

Prygayte, skolzite i mchites po serii slozhnykh vodnykh gorok 2.5D, chtoby srazit doktora Fishera i spasti svoikh roditeley! No ne zhdite progulki po parku. Iz-za proklyatiya vse slaydy polnostyu VNE KONTROLYa! Kazhdaya oblast napolnena opasnostyami, prepyatstviyami i vragami, podzhidayushchimi vas v kazhdom uglu, tak chto prigotovtes, prezhde chem vas unichtozhat. K schastyu, vy ne odinoki v etom, tak kak vas budet soprovozhdat vash spetsialnyy shpionskiy dron dlya videoblogov B.U.D.D.Y.

FUNKTsII:
• Igrayte za Mikki ili Dzhenni Storm i stante geroem (inoy), spasayushchim vashikh roditeley!
• Platforma, skolzite i vybirayte svoy sobstvennyy marshrut cherez 74 priklyuchencheskikh urovnya.
• Stolknutsya s problemami, svyazannymi s gryzt nogti vo vsekh zonakh akvaparka. Ot tropicheskikh sokrovishch i vulkanicheskikh prostorov do strany budushchego i zabytykh dzhungley
• Razblokiruyte 16 dikikh attraktsionov: v tom chisle samokat-shpion, vodnyy mototsikl, pingvina, Roborku (potryasayushchiy robot-kosatku) ... i mnogie drugie!
• Bud gotov! Vam predstoit srazitsya s doktorom Fisherom v razlichnykh skhvatkakh s bossami!
• Obedinyaytes v komandu oboikh Shtormov v lokalnom kooperativnom mnogopolzovatelskom rezhime!
• Rabotayte vmeste s vashim spetsialnym shpionskim dronom dlya videoblogov B.U.D.D.Y.

Priobretaya Mickey Storm i Cursed Mask, vy mozhete podderzhat detey v rayonakh, zatronutykh konfliktom, tak kak 5% ot kazhdoy pokupki poydet War Child.

title: Hexagroove Tactical DJ [NSZ][ENG]
description:
DJ策略律動將策略、節奏和動作遊戲元素以一種獨特的自我表現方式結合在一起。作為一名DJ，你的目標是即時組合音樂循環樂段來調節虛擬觀眾的能量，用你的藝術技巧讓他們進入一種興奮狀態。當你在十五種舞曲類型的歌曲章節之間漫遊時，動作會從沉思轉變為瘋狂。隨著時間的流逝，您將解鎖新的音樂循環，DJ技巧和俱樂部場所，並在其中玩耍。這是Elite Beat Agents和Blocksworld開發商的真正創意作品，通過本遊戲可與您的房間或舞池裡的朋友一起表演。

優勝者: BEST GAME AUDIO BALTIC SEA GAMES AWARD
提名獲獎: MOST CREATIVE GAME, PLAY21, INDIECADE GRAND JURY NOMINEE, BITSUMMIT OFFICIAL SELECTION

* 選擇並結合15種舞蹈類型的音樂作品
* 通過700多個樂器循環構建你的音樂工具包
* 觀察人群並做出反應，在8個俱樂部場所中完成關卡
* 時間節奏元素和音訊濾鏡
* 利用音效和組合即興表演
* 表演DJ技巧，力爭獲得最高分

在一台Nintendo Switch上展開1-4人的本地多人遊戲吧

來自日本、瑞典和荷蘭的音樂內容: Mr. YT (Yuji Takenouchi), missingsoul, Legowelt, CYLON, Runners Club 95, no. 9, SEXY-SYNTHESIZER, DÉ DÉ MOUSE, Big Skapinksy, TWIDDL, Kristoffer Wallman, lallow, DISPOSABLE, Junya Nakano, Yasuo Sato

title: Dull Grey [NSZ][RUS/Multi3]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 3]
description:
你將一次又一次地做出同樣的選擇，決定兒子應該成為誰——點燈工還是理貨員。一開始，情況似乎讓你別無選擇。但不要急於下結論，花點時間仔細考慮一下，然後，也許，你會看到你的故事的全貌。

主要特點：
在進度計畫控制的復古未來世界的背景下展示日常生活中的戲劇
單一選擇的異常機制導致不同的遊戲結局
視覺風格可以追溯到20年代的蘇聯圖形
靈感來自斯特拉加茨基兄弟的世界，陀思妥耶夫斯基的作品和塔爾科夫斯基的電影

獎項：
2019年世界盃最佳創新遊戲
XYZZY Awards 2019最佳多媒體使用獎

title: The Nightmare Journey [NSZ][RUS/Multi25]
developer: Luiz Felipe Da Silva Marian, Nil Rocha
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 25]
description:
在一個奇特而詭異的宇宙中，小亞瑟面對他最大的恐懼，夜幕降臨是他最害怕的時刻。在這段短暫的黑暗中，他的綜合症超越了心理的界限，怪物總是在伺機而動。這次他能逃脫嗎？
數千年前，長者們在石頭上刻寫了一個古老的傳說：「每個夜晚，黑暗中的遊魂都會擾亂充滿活力的生物的夢境，夜幕降臨時，一個純血生物會被選中，並打破兩個世界之間的現實邊界。」
看來這次亞瑟被選中了，他的夢魘之旅將不會輕鬆，平行宇宙中的黑暗生物想要吞噬他的靈魂。
《The Nightmare Journey》是一款風格化的2D遊戲，具有獨特的圖形，亞瑟是主要角色，他必須克服各種挑戰和謎題，遊戲中不乏謎團。

title: Jars [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
那本書裡記載的一切，絕對超乎維多你那個小腦袋裡的所有胡思亂想。

和維多一起勇闖家族地下室，展開一場古怪的冒險。發現躲藏在地窖重重幽影中的頭號勁敵與危險的討厭鬼。房子下方埋藏著什麼黑暗的祕密？為什麼這本神祕書籍裡缺了好幾頁？為什麼地下室裡還有一隻德古拉？！世界的命運，就扛在維多瘦弱的肩膀上！你會拯救世界，還是慘遭媽媽禁足？

目標很簡單：摧毀所有玻璃瓶！

JARS 是具備解謎與塔防元素的策略遊戲。砸碎所有玻璃瓶，保護石棺的安全。這就是你的主要目標!
靈活動腦，制定策略，每個關卡都需要你隨機應變。

獨特的美術風格，靈感來自驚悚駭人卻又趣味十足的經典之作

精心手繪的美術，完美呈現古老陰沉的地窖，又帶了一絲黑色幽默。

JARS 著重隨機應變的樂趣與技巧

玩家永遠無法確定瓶子裡裝著什麼，每次揭曉都令人既期待又怕受傷害。每個關卡都有新機制與情境，讓你的旅程刻刻有驚喜、處處有驚嚇！

title: Sonar Beat [NSZ][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description: Sonar Beat - eto muzykalnaya ritm-arkadnaya igra s izyuminkoy: noty sleduyut spiralnoy strukture, poetomu te, kotorye vy propustili, ostanutsya i budut dvigatsya vpered k vashemu tsentru. Esli oni doberutsya do nego, ty mertv. Vy igraete cherez interfeys radara, ispolzuya konus datchika, chtoby obnaruzhivat vragov, priblizhayushchikhsya k tsentru. Sorevnuytes v onlayn-tablitsakh liderov za naivysshiy reyting i broste vyzov svoim druzyam, chtoby uznat, kto naberet naivysshiy ball.

title: Nevaeh [NSP][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
某個光明又寧靜的城鎮。
有一天，城鎮裡的路燈突然一個個熄滅，整個城鎮陷入黑暗之中。
為幫助城鎮找回光明，少女決定前往掌管城鎮光明的塔。

少女在那裡發現了神祕的蝴蝶，它能發出耀眼的光芒。
少女覺得這個光可以幫助城鎮找回光明，於是和蝴蝶一起離開了塔。
但少女萬萬沒想到，失去光明的城鎮瞬間被黑暗吞沒，消失得無影無蹤……
為找到自己的城鎮，少女再一次向塔頂出發！

失去光明的塔已經變成了一座魔塔，塔內佈滿了各種陷阱和
躲在黑暗之中伺機攻擊少女的惡魔，它們擋住了少女的去路。

與照亮少女前路的“發光蝴蝶”一起
救出消失在黑暗之中的城鎮和人們，重新找回光明吧！

title: Barbearian [NSP][ENG]
description:
Hijacked to a to strange world. Forced to fight for your life. Discover the secrets of the Arbitrators and find your way back home!

Barbearian is a fast-paced hack'n'slash with massive battles in a colorful, hand-drawn world.

- 100+ levels full of action and adventure
- Collect loot, purchase upgrades and experiment with numerous weapons
- Rescue prisoners and build your own army
- Encounter colossal boss monsters and take them down
- Plenty of challenge, not for the easily discouraged!

title: Blackguards 2 [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
《Blackguards 2》是款回合制策略RPG，特色是充滿挑戰的六角格戰場戰鬥，以及暴力與犯罪內容的堅韌故事。

選擇你的遊戲風格：無論是前線戰鬥怪物、法師或是遠程戰士、要如何發展角色都取決於你自己。每個行動都有相應的後果，明智地做出決定。死亡可能就在眼前。

烏里亞伯爵的陰謀已過了三年。九人部落的征服者早就分道揚鑣，但阿文圖里亞的生活仍在繼續。卡西亞是擁有貴族血統的年輕女子，她只有一個目標：她想不計代價奪取鯊魚王座；而且要在一天完成。

不過有兩個問題會讓她的計劃受阻。她整天被關押在地牢中，其次，她的寶座上已經有人：那是瑪律萬。她不喜歡也不擅長外交和政治，因此她選擇了更……實際的方法。她打算越獄，推翻瑪律萬，靠自己奪回王位。為此她需要強大的盟友。她需要招募舞劍大軍，並召集九人部落的徵服者，帶在身邊。

聽起來這計劃很行，不是嗎？話說回來，要多麼狡猾，才能擺脫地牢的高牆；要多麼魯莽，才能召集與指揮王國最糟的敗類？

遊戲特色

- 招募傭兵、尋求升級並打造一支不屈的軍隊
- 找出九人部落的征服者、看看塔卡特、瑙里姆和祖爾巴蘭變成了什麼樣
- 有許多轉折、重要決定、和超過20小時挑戰性遊戲時間的故事等著你
- 在隊伍中指揮多達20位角色，帶領他們走向死亡或榮耀
- 在許多非線性路徑專精並完成遊戲
- 做出會影響你小隊和遊戲結束的決定
- 明智地選擇你的法術、天賦和技能，它們會左右你戰場上的策略。在具備挑戰性的戰鬥優先考慮進攻或戰術
- 與環境互動、讓高牆倒塌、甚至在穿越阿文圖里亞的旅程中發現新的路線
- 用強大的法術和能力消滅你的敵人。但保持警惕：你的敵人可能也有相同能力

title: Skybolt Zack [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Arkada novogo pokoleniya
Skybolt Zack — eto unikalnoe sochetanie platformera s mekhanikoy sovmeshcheniya tsvetov. 

Napravlyayte Zaka i ispolzuyte ego raketnye udary, ryvok, vozmozhnost pritselivatsya, menyat napravlenie i unichtozhayte vragov. Igra mozhet predlozhit gorazdo bolshe, chem mozhno uvidet na pervyy vzglyad, sleduya pri etom formule: «legko nauchitsya, no slozhno osvoit».

Eto platformer, gde nelzya prygat, i muzykalnaya igra, gde vy sami zadaete ritm. Takogo eshche ne bylo!

Osobennosti
●	48 bezumno slozhnykh urovney, kotorye mozhno proyti, ni razu ne stupiv na zemlyu.
●	Marshruty raznoy slozhnosti.
●	Bolee 15 okruzheniy v 5 mirakh.
●	Vizualnyy stil, sochetayushchiy 3D-grafiku i risovannye tekstury so mnozhestvom spetseffektov i vzryvov!
●	Progressiruyushchiy saundtrek, sozdannyy pod vdokhnoveniem izvestnykh platformerov 90-kh.
●	Desyatki vrazheskikh robotov, sozdayushchie nepovtorimye ispytaniya.
●	Igrovye rezhimy na luchshee vremya i luchshiy schet.
●	2 raznykh reytinga na kazhdom urovne: na luchshiy schet i luchshee vremya.
●	Nastraivaemoe upravlenie i osobye vozmozhnosti dlya daltonikov.
●	Nikakikh skuchnykh dialogov! (Vy by ikh i tak propustili...).

Raznye marshruty
Nakhodite raznye sposoby proyti uroven — igrayte v Skybolt Zack snova i snova!

Zdes net urovney slozhnosti: bolee legkie marshruty podoydut novichkam, no tolko samye luchshie igroki smogut proyti zamyslovatymi marshrutami i otkryt samye trudnye urovni!

Rezhim superigry
Pomimo osnovnogo syuzheta v Skybolt Zack est dva dopolnitelnykh igrovykh rezhima — ispytanie dlya osobo azartnykh igrokov!
 ‎
Rezhim «Ataka na vremya»— dlya tekh, kto khochet proyti uroven kak mozhno bystree. Na pomoshch pridut osobye instrumenty, pozvolyayushchie uskoritsya.
Rezhim «Ataka na ochki» podkhodit tem, kto khochet nabrat kak mozhno bolshe ochkov.

Reytingi
Chtoby poluchat ochki ili proyti uroven kak mozhno skoree, nuzhny raznye strategii. V Skybolt Zack 2 mirovykh reytinga: na luchshiy schet i na luchshee vremya. Ispytayte sebya!

title: Zeroptian Invasion [NSP][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
從過去的舊式街機射擊遊戲中汲取靈感，並添加了一些現代風格和令人驚嘆的像素美術，Zeroptian Invasion可說是往昔街機射擊遊戲的現代版。

從逐步提昇的遊戲難度，到採用晶片音樂的遊戲配樂，這款懷舊之作絕對不容射擊遊戲迷錯過，畢竟危險的Zeroptian可不會在短期內自我毀滅。

特色：

• 具有挑戰性的經典遊戲。
• 彩色1位元的像素藝術。
• 困難又經典的遊玩方式。
• 敵人種類超多，老大令人難忘。

title: Hookbots [NSZ][ENG]
description: Battle & challenge your human friends on this multiplayer robot party game: 52 ways to customize your bots & 14 game modes. From knights and dinosaurs, to bounty hunters and space warriors. Choose, customize and crush tons of different bots.

title: Xenogunner [NSP][ENG]
description:
Sila Ksenoprirody.

V budushchem 2011 godu Zeta Rik, dobryy i krotkiy korol ksenoliytsev, budet svergnut mogushchestvennym tiranom po imeni Ksenoganner.

Ksenoganner — eto tainstvennoe sushchestvo, sposobnoe na mnogochislennye ustrashayushchie podvigi, ispolzuya dlya etogo silu, izvestnuyu kak «Ksenopriroda». Eto moshchnaya energiya, kotoraya daet cheloveku, umeyushchemu ee ispolzovat, mnozhestvo elementalnykh i neelementalnykh sil.

Zeta tozhe odaren silami Ksenoprirody. Zeta dolzhen svergnut Ksenogannera i vernut sebe tron...

...no deystvitelno li vsem etim zapravlyaet Ksenoganner...?

Napryazhennye bitvy s bossami!

«Ksenoganner» — eto napryazhennyy, napolnennyy pryzhkami i perestrelkami platformer s aktsentom na bossov, osnovannyy na igrakh vremen 16-bitnykh konsoley. My schitaem, chto s pomoshchyu dobavleniya takikh udobstv, kak navedenie myshi i nastraivaemye parametry slozhnosti, nam deystvitelno udalos modernizirovali klassicheskiy igrovoy zhanr, zarodivshiysya mnogo desyatiletiy nazad.

Korotkie etapy, effektnye, raznoobraznye i opasnye bossy, a eshche my dadim vam stolko zhizney, skolko potrebuetsya... potomu chto vam potrebuetsya stolko zhizney, skolko mozhno poluchit! Smozhet li Zeta pobedit Ksenogannera...? Tolko vy mozhete privesti ego k pobede!

title: How to Say Goodbye [NSZ][ENG]
developer: Arte France, Florian Veltman, Baptiste Portefaix
description:
THE JOURNEY OF A LITTLE GHOST
How to say Goodbye tells the story of a person who has recently been turned into a ghost, lost in an unfamiliar world populated by disoriented spirits. In this narrative puzzle game, move the decor to allow the characters to escape from the parallel reality in which they are lost.
Help them find their friends who are trapped by a mysterious wizard and accompany them on their journey to the other side.

A PUZZLE GAME BASED ON WORLD MANIPULATION
Move the decor elements on a grid to lead the ghosts to the exit
Travel through more than 15 chapters, from the kitchen of your home to the moon. 
Solve numerous puzzles in a universe inspired by illustration and great classics of children's literature (Tomi Ungerer, Tove Jansson, Antoine de Saint-Exupéry, Maurice Sendak...)

A STRONG AND UNIQUE THEME
- A poignant puzzle game that deals with grief with kindness and subtlety
- Save your friend before he disappears forever
- Guide the ghosts out of the liminal space they are trapped in 
- Help the characters you meet to find peace and mourn their own lives
- Unlock the secret of the Wizard and the spleens, the misguided spirits that haunt the other side

title: Glowpop [NSP][ENG]
description:
您是 黃色Punnu，一位光彩奪目的探險家，正在尋找失蹤的 綠色Punnu。 穿越四個引人入勝的星球，每個星球都有五張神秘的地圖，僅憑一顆發光的心，面對令人難忘的挑戰。

準備好在這款可愛但極具挑戰性的平臺遊戲中真正測試您的技能了嗎？

快速節奏且充滿挑戰的平臺冒險： 美麗的環境、令人難以置信的原聲音樂和令人震撼的故事情節。

易於學習且易於上手的機制： 您的彈跳和光芒就是您所需要的一切。

四個星球，每個都有五張不同的地圖可供探索： 即使是最偉大的冒險家也將面臨不斷增加的挑戰。

殘酷的「恐怖模式」： 測試您的技能、神經和耐心。

面對危險，將您的技能推向極限： 從這些外星球的眾多危險中彈跳逃離。 黃色Punnu 可能很小，但它的翻轉跳躍是史詩級的！

發現獨特的世界和藝術風格： 您可以在一些漂亮的地方找到尖刺上的圓屁股！

享受多汁的「彩虹閃光飛濺」： 在一次小小的跳躍失誤中，快樂的小Punnu像氣球一樣以彩虹的所有顏色爆裂開來！

在一個視覺上令人驚嘆的宇宙中，當心尖刺、酸液等危險。 與 黃色Punnu 和同伴 藍色Punnu、紅色Punnu 一起拼湊 綠色Punnu 失蹤的謎團，揭示威脅整個宇宙的史詩級危險。

title: Soulblight [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Soulblight is a dark, unforgiving, top-down action roguelike luring you to cross the thin line between good and evil. Instead of XP grinding, it introduces a Tainting Mechanics. While traveling through the shattered reality of the Sanctuary, you will receive personality traits based on your choices. These will be the main source of your strength. To harness them, you will have to act accordingly. Becoming an alcoholic means that you will be rewarded for getting drunk, but from that point being sober might prove to be unbearable.

FEATURES
- A unique Tainting Mechanic designed to encourage role playing
- Tons of weapons, armor, and utility items
- Dynamic and tactical combat build around stamina management and distance control
- Optional stealth approach that complements fighting
- Randomly generated, visually breathtaking levels
- High difficulty level emphasized by permadeath mechanics
- Gameplay­-driven narrative

GAMEPLAY
Before entering each level of the Sanctuary you get to choose a Taint that represents a certain personality trait. That choice will shape your future experiences as each Taint unlocks a new way of gaining power - a custom mechanic designed to encourage role-playing. Tainting Mechanics channels your will to survive into actions that are aligned with your hero’s personality. Let’s have a look at some examples:

Greed
- Receive "Scrooge" penalty for overpaying
- The bigger fortune you Acquire the stronger you are

Fierce
- Receive "Rage" boost after being wounded
- Receive permanent passive bonus for killing enemies during "Rage"

As you go deeper into the Sanctuary you’ll be able to add more Taints to your character’s personality making the shifting levels of the dungeon itself a skill tree of a kind. However with each new Taint you’re a step closer to the point of no return. Are you sure you know where it is?

title: Mekorama [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Ocharovatelnyy robot poterpel krushenie na kvadratnoy planete. Dostav ego v bezopasnoe mesto.

Issleduy urovni, vrashchaya ikh v 3D vo vsekh napravleniyakh, chtoby nayti vykhod. Ispolzuy lifty i dvigayushchiesya platformy dlya obzora i produmyvaniya strategii.

Tebya zhdet sto neveroyatnykh urovney. Prigotovsya k syurprizam i priklyucheniyam!

Popytay svoi sily v sozdanii novykh urovney pri pomoshchi redaktora urovney.

title: Itta [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
ITTA — eto priklyuchencheskaya igra so strelboy, deystvie kotoroy razvorachivaetsya v mire, polnom monstrov-bossov. Odnazhdy Itta prosnulas i obnaruzhila, chto vsya ee semya mertva. Ee edinstvennym pomoshchnikom stal strannyy dukh, kotoryy prinyal oblik kota i podaril ey siyayushchiy revolver.

Primeriv na sebya rol Itty, igrok budet iskat mogushchestvennykh sushchestv, zapertykh pod etim s vidu spokoynym mirom, i vstupat s nimi v strashnye bitvy. Put, na kotorom vstretyatsya monstry ot drevnikh golemov do zubastykh chudovishch, proverit na prochnost kak Ittu, tak i vas. K schastyu, vy mozhete menyat stil boya: kazhdyy novyy vid oruzhiya podarit vam unikalnyy stil ataki, a esli srazhenie stanet slishkom opasnym, vy vsegda mozhete pereklyuchitsya na rezhim neuyazvimosti ili podklyuchit mnozhiteli urona.

ITTA — igra, vdokhnovlennaya temoy borby s samimi soboy. Esli est svet, to dolzhna byt i tma. Samoe glavnoe — prodolzhat put... i nevazhno, skolko trudnostey vam pridetsya preodolet.

Otlichitelnye osobennosti
Pobedite 18 smertonosnykh bossov v bitvakh s gradom pul v etoy igre dlya dvukh stikov
Sobirayte arsenal moshchnogo prizrachnogo oruzhiya, chtoby nauchitsya novym priemam boya
Otkroyte taynu strannogo razrushayushchegosya mira i ego zagadochnykh obitateley
Issleduyte chudesnyy pikselnyy mir pod trevozhnuyu eklektichnuyu muzyku.
Ne otchaivaytes: v lyuboy moment mozhno vklyuchit mnozhiteli urona ili rezhim neuyazvimosti

title: Smilemo [NSP][ENG]
description:
>>> 收到了新資訊……
>>> 正在下載表情符號……
>>> 正在下載病毒……？

一碰到病毒就會飛起來？！
控制我們的笑臉表情符號主角斯邁爾莫，
幫助他拯救這個被病毒蹂躪的電腦世界。

≪ 穿越電腦世界的表情包冒險故事 ≫
這個電腦世界被入侵的病毒摧毀。
唯一有能力面對這個強敵的就是我們的笑臉表情斯邁爾莫。
在系統管理員的幫助下，
我們的英雄冒險前去消滅病毒。

≪ 讓你時刻保持警惕的橫版動作遊戲 ≫
在你引導斯邁爾莫收集殺毒代碼片段時，
突破這種一觸即飛的病毒的防禦。
奔跑、跳躍、反彈，闖出自己的路！
這場需要全神貫注才能破關的冒險在等待著你。

≪ 收集殺毒代碼，復原電腦世界 ≫
你越深入各種數據保險庫收集殺毒代碼，
就越能重建這個電腦世界。
使用斯邁爾莫一路解鎖的特殊能力，
直面路上等待著的各種挑戰和考驗！

title: Tyr Chains of Valhalla [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Igra Tyr: Chains of Valhalla vdokhnovlena skandinavskoy mifologiey, tochnee, Ragnarök! V tekhnologicheskom mire, v kotorom chelovechestvo zavisit ot takikh megakorporatsiy, kak Yggdrasil, krupnye kompanii ne znayut granits i konkuriruyut za globalnuyu monopoliyu, a vragi podzhidayut na kazhdom uglu, kto-to dolzhen navesti poryadok v gorode.

Tir, sozdannyy professorom Osvaldom Dina, a.k.a. O.Din, poluchil zadanie pomeshat Lemuz Oki, a.k.a. L.Oki, unichtozhit mirovoy poryadok i sozdat khaos s tselyu zakhvatit krupneyshuyu tekhnologicheskuyu kompaniyu i vzyat pod kontrol ves mir. Tir s pomoshchyu Huginn & Muninn («mysl» i «pamyat») i svoego vernogo Sleypnira doberetsya do verkhushki Valkhally, chtoby rasstroit zlye plany L.Oki i ego shayki vikingov i mekha.

title: Tonight We Riot [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
V mire, gde bogataya elita kontroliruet SMI, vybory i zhizn trudyashchikhsya, u nas tolko dva vykhoda: prinyat eto ili borotsya za chto-to luchshee.

V igre Tonight We Riot net geroya. Vy vlivaetes v narodnoe dvizhenie, i blagopoluchie lyudey opredelyaet iskhod revolyutsii.

Po slovam USGamer, eta dolgozhdannaya igra «dlya vsekh tekh, komu neobkhodimo izbavitsya ot svoego politicheskogo gneva». 

Osnovnye osobennosti
   * Kooperativnaya igra
   * 20 dostizhimykh vidov oruzhiya, snaryazheniya i lgot
   * Sobaka (govorit tolko po-grecheski)
   * Ssylki na veshchi, kotorye my vse lyubim (i nenavidim)
   * Beskonechnyy rezhim
   * Kaydzu
   * Drobitel drevesiny
   * Sint
   * Unikalnyy katarsis, kotoryy proiskhodit tolko ot udara kulakom v gorlo milliarderu

title: The True [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
description:
Dlya togo chtoby razobratsya chto zhe sluchilos v laboratorii Robotec vam predstoit popast v podzemnuyu laboratoriyu Ascendo kuda i vedet sled, kotoryy obnaruzhila Sara v pamyati robota DR12.

Vam pridetsya razgadyvat golovolomki, borotsya s neponyatnymi sushchestvami i nakonets uznat PRAVDU ne tolko o tom chto zhe sluchilos v laboratoriyakh, no i o tom kto takaya na samom dele Sara.

V igre u geroya est portativnaya teleport pushka, kotoraya mozhet zamorazhivat, podzhigat, polivat vodoy i peremeshchat obekty.

Ispytayte sebya i uznayte pravdu

title: Astro Duel Deluxe [NSP][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
«Astro Duel» — neistovo veselaya gruppovaya igra na odnom ekrane dlya ot 1 do 6 igrokov!

Raundy v ney bystrye, a porazhenie vnezapno — vy ispepelyaete vrazheskie korabli ili razmazyvaete v lepeshku chuzhikh pilotov. Chto ochen zabavno!

OSOBENNOSTI IGRY

• Igrat mozhno gde ugodno — na teleekrane, na khodu ili dazhe lezha na stole ili na polu!

• Rezhim «Komandnoe unichtozhenie», v kotorom vy sotrete v poroshok eskadry svoikh druzey

• Rezhim «Khaos», rasschitannyy na 6 igrokov (i eshche bolshe otkrytykh aren s igroy «Vse protiv vsekh» i «3 na 3»)

• Bezumnyy rezhim «Kasanie» — kogda korabli mogut povorachivat tolko v odnu storonu!

• Srazhaytes s druzyami ili vmeste s nimi pobezhdayte kompyuternogo protivnika

• Ubivayte pilotov v rezhime «Okhota za pilotami», unichtozhayte korabli v «Okhote za korablyami» ili obedinyayte usiliya v «Komandnom matche»

• Osnashchayte svoy korabl raketami, lazerami, taranami i shchitami

• Na dinamicheskikh arenakh polno ukrytiy i opasnostey — tureli, asteroidy, luchi smerti i chernye dyry

• Nastroyka igry s pomoshchyu modifikatorov (vklyuchenie asteroidov, startovykh bonusov, super-pryzhkov i tak dalee)

• Mnozhestvo sposobov upravleniya igroy (v tom chisle sensornyy ekran)

title: Thief of Thieves [NSZ][ENG]
description:
V igre Thief of Thieves: Season One («Vor iz vorov – pervyy sezon») ty — vor-fortochnik,  organizuyushchiy gromkie ogrableniya po vsemu miru s pomoshchyu khitrostey, razvodilova i komandy podelnikov.

Igra razrabotana po motivam serii komiksov Roberta Kirkmana, udostoennoy mnogikh nagrad. Eto uvlekatelnaya istoriya o grabezhakh i lyudyakh, stoyashchikh za nimi. Seliya — nachinayushchaya grabitelnitsa i protezhe pochyotnogo vora Redmonda.  Ona reshaet, chto prishlo vremya prodelat put ot uchenitsy do znatnogo vora. Posle provala na rodine Seliya otpravlyaetsya v Evropu i primykaet k novoy shayke, chtoby provesti s ney seriyu grabezhey. 

Tvoya zadacha: uznat svoikh podelnikov poblizhe i razrabotat konkretnyy plan deystviy na meste dlya vypolneniya dela. No ne teryay bditelnosti! Tvoi deystviya mogut byt chrevaty tyazhkimi posledstviyami.

Udastsya li tebe proyti ispytanie delom na novom kontinente i s novymi lyudmi, i opravdat ozhidaniya svoego pokrovitelya?

- Syuzhet razvivaetsya v kadrakh komiksa, gde glavnaya geroinya Seliya perekhodit ot igrovoy stseny k sleduyushchey — bud to vecherinka ili stroyploshchadka — prodvigayas k tseli s pomoshchyu svoego umeniya razvesti drugikh lyudey i konspiratsii, no nikogda ne pribegaya k nasiliyu.
- Snogsshibatelnaya grafika, gde komiksy, narisovannye ot ruki, plavno peretekayut v tryokhmernye igrovye urovni, sozdavaya nepovtorimyy igrovoy syuzhet.
- Zhivye, realistichnye igrovye personazhi ozvucheny takimi izvestnymi aktyorami ozvuchki, kak Frida Vulf (igra Mass Effect: Andromeda), Stefen Stenton (film «Izgoy-odin»), Emili O’Brayen (igra Death Stranding), Sissi Dzhons (igry Firewatch, The Walking Dead: Season 1), Fred Tataskor («Kung-fu panda 2») i Ilays Tufeksis (igra Deus Ex: Human Revolution).
- Individualnyy geympley — deystviya, sovershaemye v igre, vliyayut na razvitie igrovogo syuzheta i otnosheniya s podelnikami.

title: The Unholy Society [NSZ][ENG]
description:
The Unholy Society, an award-winning adventure game mixed with action elements, is the first part of BonBon's crazy adventures. Inspired by '80s and '90s movies, comic books, as well as everything else that fits into the categories of "iconic" and "pop culture", it takes a humorous look at usually not-so-humorous themes.

STORY:
The world as we know is about to change - the united forces of demons, gods, and monsters prepare for another deadly attempt to eradicate "the big guys" and change the religious status quo.

And, just perhaps, to drink lots of tea and discuss art in the meantime.

The only one who can stop them is Bonaventura Horowitz - a snarky exorcist, who isn't exactly an angel himself.

At the request of the Pope himself, Bon, accompanied by a group of his peculiar friends, sets off on a thrilling mission, leaving behind a trail of cigarette butts, empty whiskey bottles, and broken demonic hearts.

FEATURES:
• Quirky, fleshed out characters
• Unique story, inspired by all the good stuff from pop culture
• Comic-like aesthetics
• Engaging exorcism system
• Loads of sarcasm and humour
• Pope on speed dial

title: AX Chip8 interpretator (RCA Studio II i dr.) dlya Nintendo Switch + 66 款游戏 [NSP][ENG]
description:
CHIP-8 — eto interpretiruemyy yazyk programmirovaniya, razrabotannyy Dzhozefom Veysbekerom, pervonachalno ispolzovalsya na 8-bitnykh mikrokompyuterakh COSMAC VIP i Telmac 1800 v seredine 1970-kh godov. Programmy CHIP-8 vypolnyayutsya na virtualnoy mashine CHIP-8. Eto bylo sdelano dlya togo, chtoby videoigry mogli byt bolee legko zaprogrammirovany dlya takikh kompyuterov.
RCA (CDP) 1802 (takzhe izvesten kak RCA COSMAC, COSMAC 1802) — 8-razryadnyy mikroprotsessor, predstavlennyy kompaniey Radio Corporation of America (RCA) vesnoy 1976 goda, v nastoyashchee vremya prodolzhaet vypuskatsya kompaniey Intersil Corporation; proizvodilas versiya, vypolnennaya po tekhnologii kremniy na sapfire (KNS), kotoryy byl ispolzovan v kosmicheskom apparate Galileo, a takzhe shiroko primenyalsya v iskusstvennykh sputnikakh Zemli.

title: War Torn Dreams [NSZ][ENG]
description:
WAR-TORN DREAMS - eto 2D syuzhetnaya igra s bogatoy syuzhetnoy liniey, prokhodyashchaya v pustyne SShA, izmuchennaya postoyannoy voynoy. Posle krakha ekonomiki, pravitelstva i obshchestva vy dolzhny otvazhno vooruzhitsya do zubov vooruzhennymi formirovaniyami, bezzakonnymi bandami, opasnymi ulitsami, opustoshennymi zdaniyami i podzemnymi bunkerami v svoem stremlenii vyrvatsya iz etoy postapokalipticheskoy pustyni zhivymi. Doroga k novoy zhizni vymoshchena opasnostyu, nadezhdoy i postoyannymi napominaniyami obo vsem, chto bylo poteryano.
Vy budete uchastvovat v borbe s bandami i opolchentsami, chtoby vyzhit, i mozhete vybrat pomoshch drugim vyzhivshim, kotorye polny sobstvennykh lichnykh stradaniy, nadezhd i mechtaniy, gde kazhdyy pytaetsya uvidet sleduyushchiy rassvet v etoy khaoticheskoy pustoshi.

* Bystrye pobochnye deystviya i zhestokie boi.
* Izbegayte prepyatstviy, dvizhushchikhsya lazerov i elektricheskikh luchey i drugikh, razlichnykh form lovushek.
* Vstrechaytes i obshchaytes s drugimi vyzhivshimi po puti i ne stesnyaytes vybirat, pomogat im ili ignorirovat ikh. Eto zavisit tolko ot vas, kak vy khotite, chtoby vas zapomnili v etoy khaoticheskoy pustoshi.
* Bolee 100 tysyach slov tekstov dlya chteniya o fonovykh personazhakh i ikh otnosheniyakh, o bandakh, fraktsiyakh i lokatsiyakh.
* 9 glav postapokalipticheskogo settinga.

title: Lucah Born of a Dream [NSZ][ENG]
description:
HACK, SLASH, ASCEND.  Lucah: Born of a Dream is a harrowing struggle through our worst nightmares. 

You have been MARKED, cursed to have your inner demons come to life as vicious Nightmares. After awakening a false god, you must atone. Traverse the hellish realm of dreams, endure the nightmare onslaught, and uncover the strength to accept yourself.

☐ KEY FEATURES ☐
Master a deep combat system that blends ranged- and melee-action with rich customization. Explore an atmospheric world of repressed memories and unspeakable feelings. Lay waste to the Nightmares in a kinetic flurry of beautiful violence. 

• Striking colors and evocative linework elicit a surreal sense of ambiguity and tension. 
• Mix and match different Attack Mantras to create an endless variety of flashy combos. 
• Befriend Familiars and use their ranged magic to turn the course of battle. 
• Personalize your character with Virtues like slow-motion dodges, stunning parries, or vampiric attacks.
• Use Rewinds to instantly retry a battle you were failing to achieve better results.

title: Balthazar's Dream [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Malchik po imeni Dastin vpal v komu posle togo, kak ego sbil furgon s morozhenym. On serezno ranen, i nadezhdy na ego probuzhdenie prakticheski net.
Ryadom s nim spit ego pes, kotoromu snyatsya udivitelnye i strannye kraya, polnye sobachikh chudes. Eto Baltazar — luchshiy drug Dastina, i ni chto v tselom mire ne zastavit ego otoyti dazhe na shag ot khozyaina.
Vo sne Baltazar chuvstvuet, chto ryadom s nim nakhodyatsya nekto dvoe. V odnom iz nikh on uznaet Dastina i sleduet za nim, polagayas na svoe obonyanie. Vtoraya ten ugrozhayushche mayachit v temnote. Baltazar uveren, chto ona khochet zabrat u nego malchika.

S gromkim laem Baltazar otpravlyaetsya navstrechu priklyucheniyam, chtoby spasti svoego khozyaina, prodvigayas po strane snov s lyubovyu i reshimostyu, na kotorye sposobny tolko sobaki.

FEATURES
• 10 urovney
• 3 sobachikh svary s vozhakami;
• 5 razlichnykh porod sobak na vybor 
• zapusk vashey sobaki v kosmos.
• slozhnye platformennye segmenty;

title: Sokoball Dreams [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Sokoball Dreams is a stunningly immersive puzzle game that challenges players to think strategically and creatively in order to solve increasingly difficult challenges. With its simple yet elegant design and intuitive controls, this game is sure to delight players of all skill levels and provide hours of challenging and engaging gameplay.

The game's minimalist approach to design is truly impressive, with each level featuring only the essential elements needed to create an intriguing and challenging puzzle. Players must navigate a variety of obstacles and challenges, using their wit and problem-solving skills to move boxes to their designated locations with the least possible moves. As they progress through the game, the puzzles become increasingly complex, testing the limits of players' abilities and forcing them to think outside the box in order to succeed.

One of the most impressive aspects of Sokoball Dreams is its commitment to creating a truly immersive experience for players. From the serene and enchanting soundtrack to the stunning graphics and minimalist design, every element of the game is carefully crafted to draw players into the world of Sokoball Dreams and keep them fully engaged throughout each level. The game's intuitive controls also make it easy for players to jump right in and start playing, while the increasing challenge level ensures that they will stay engaged and interested in the game for hours on end.

Overall, Sokoball Dreams is a must-play for anyone who loves challenging puzzle games with immersive and engaging gameplay. With its elegant design, intuitive controls, and stunning visuals, this game is sure to become a favorite of puzzle enthusiasts everywhere. So why wait? Start playing Sokoball Dreams today and see just how far your problem-solving skills can take you!

title: Feral Fury [NSP][ENG]
description:
Pust pochva, kotoruyu my zavoyuem, vzrashchivaet svyatye semena velikogo bambuka.

Spustya dolgoe vremya posle togo, kak chelovechestvo pogiblo v plameni neftyanykh voyn, Velikaya pandovaya imperiya rasprostranyaetsya po vsey galaktike kak novaya dominiruyushchaya sila. Staryy mir prevratilsya v pepel, a iz-za beskonechnoy potrebnosti v bambuke tselye planety prevrashchayutsya v plantatsii, vnov razzhigaya plamya voyny.»


OSOBENNOSTI:

* 15 protsedurno-generiruemykh urovney v 5 glavakh

* Mnozhestvo predmetov: shlemy, oruzhie, drony, usileniya, svitki i mnogoe drugoe

* Uluchsheniya, kotorye mozhno razblokirovat za 

* sobrannye sfery

* Sekretnye urovni i spryatannye klyuchi, kotorye otkryvayut spetsialnye magaziny i prodavtsov
Otkryvaemye personazhi

title: Your Computer Might be at Risk [NSP][ENG]
description:
Your Computer Might Be At Risk 是一款第一人稱敘事益智遊戲。 在一場神秘的車禍後被鎖在一個房間裡，你必須想辦法逃脫，同時在危險的考驗中倖存下來並解決幾十個謎題。 平行敘述，二十年後你的兒子揭開了你神秘消失的故事。

遊戲包括特殊章節“La Rata Escarlata”。 最後一章探索了故事的起源，並在一個獨特的新位置添加了新的相互關聯的謎題。

截至 2023 年 12 月，遊戲還包含"Xmas Special"章節。 這個簡短的聖誕節主題劇集與主遊戲的基調形成鮮明對比，並具有新的謎題、音樂和場景。

特徵：

- 獨特的 3D 視覺風格與程式化模型、受 Giallo 流派啟發的鮮豔色彩美學以及從真實視頻片段創建的動畫視頻過場動畫。

- 解決數十個具有獨特而有趣的機制的謎題。

- 多樣化的遊戲玩法，從固定相機點和點擊場景到自由移動的第一人稱相機。

- 多樣化的場景和情況，從現實世界到夢幻般的舞台。

title: Colorful Boi [NSZ][ENG]
description:
與 Colorful Boi 一起準備一場與眾不同的腎上腺素飆升之旅！ 這款引人入勝的平台遊戲擁有 63 個激烈的遊戲關卡，充滿了危險的陷阱。
Colorful Boi 將把你的技能發揮到極限，並提供令人難忘的遊戲體驗。
您準備好征服所有挑戰並成為終極平台冠軍了嗎？ 現在就跳入 Colorful Boi 充滿活力的世界吧！

title: Alt Frequencies [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Alt-Frequencies is an audio mystery game where you use the airwaves to open the world’s eyes to the truth. Record, rewind time and broadcast snippets of radio shows to expose radio hosts, conspiracy theorists, politicians, underground activists - and a dog.

By redistributing information, you change what happens in the next 3 minute time loop and impact both news cycles and the lives of the people behind them.

Listen as their personal stories evolve, in a world that seems to stand still.


Features:
- A new kind of narrative game that blurs the lines between the fantastical and the everyday while examining our relationship with mainstream media through the prism of radio stations.
- Built-in accessibility features that make the game available to a wide range of people - including blind and visually impaired players.
- Brought to life by a diverse cast of 20+ amazing voice performers, including TV, podcasts and YouTube personalities such as Jasika Nicole (Fringe, Welcome to Night Vale) & Mike Rugnetta (Reasonably Sound, CrashCourse).
- By the studio behind the critically acclaimed A Normal Lost Phone and Another Lost Phone: Laura’s Story.

title: Legend of Arcadieu 1-2 [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Deystvie The Legend of Arcadieu proiskhodit v misticheskom korolevstve vnutri kompyuternoy igry. Vsyo nachinaetsya s togo, chto vy sluchayno zakhodite v igru i stanovites velikim legendarnym geroem. Teper vam nuzhno nayti dorogu domoy.

S pomoshchyu simpatichnoy magini i krasivoy voitelnitsy vy dolzhny srazitsya s ordoy privlekatelnykh monstrov, chtoby vstretit svoyu sudbu. Issleduyte volshebnyy mir, napolnennyy mnozhestvom krasivykh devushek, satiroy na glupye RPG i mnozhestvom romanticheskikh variantov na vybor.

V komplekt vkhodyat obe igry: The Legend of Arcadieu i The Legend of Arcadieu 2. Kazhdaya igra predlagaet neskolko kontsovok v zavisimosti ot vybora, kotoryy vy delaete po khodu priklyucheniya.

Kharakteristiki
* Dve igry.
* Vizualnyy roman + komediynaya parodiya na RPG.
* Bolee 25 polnostyu illyustrirovannykh stsen.
* Romanticheskie varianty s 5 personazhami.
* Reshayushchiy vybor i mnozhestvo kontsovok.

title: SpyHack [NSZ][ENG]
developer: Pyramid Games, Art Games Studio S.A.
description:
2111 god. Mirom pravyat tekhnologicheskie korporatsii. Ikh eksperimenty davno pereshagnuli granitsy moralno-eticheskikh norm.
Vy agent OPT — otdela peredovykh tekhnologiy. V mire, gde vse reshayut tekhnokorporatsii, deystvuet tolko odno pravilo: libo vzlomaesh ty, libo vzlomayut tebya. Vasha zadacha — polozhit konets sekretnomu proektu «Kupol», kotoryy mozhet postavit chelovechestvo na gran samounichtozheniya. V etoy nauchno-fantasticheskoy igre s elementami stelsa i taktiki vam pridetsya vzhitsya v rol shpiona. 


OSOBENNOSTI:

- Vzlamyvayte i upravlyayte: lyubymi ustroystvami i obektami mozhno zavladet. Voyuyte na tsifrovom fronte. Otkryvayte dveri, polzuytes kamerami i snaryazheniem, stante khozyainom okruzhayushchego mira.
- Zadaniya po vsemu miru: raskryvayte zagovory v zakhvatyvayushchikh zadaniyakh v Evrope i stranakh Severnoy i Yuzhnoy Ameriki. Pobyvayte v kazhdom ugolke Zemli, vypolnyaya razlichnye pobochnye zadaniya.
- Polzuytes ognestrelnym oruzhiem ili EMI-bombami. Tolko vam reshat, kakimi sredstvami dobitsya postavlennoy tseli. Esli vy lyubite bolshie pushki — oni v vashem rasporyazhenii.
- Peredovye tekhnologii: vypolnyayte zadaniya, polzuyas noveyshimi izobreteniyami. Lyubye elektronnye ustroystva, podklyuchennye k seti, zdorovo pomogut operativnikam — naprimer, otvlekut okhranu ili prevratyatsya v groznoe oruzhie.

title: Overwhelm [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Zloveshchiy otkrytyy mir Redkie obryvki kart stanut vashim edinstvennym orientirom v zaputannykh tonnelyakh ulya. Vrag mozhet podzhidat za kazhdym povorotom.

Bossy usilivayut vragov Kogda vy pobezhdaete odnogo iz pyati unikalnykh bossov, vragi po vsemu miru poluchayut ikh sposobnosti, chto delaet igru slozhnee.

Bystrye i zhestkie boi Srazheniya zdes polny napryazheniya. Odin udar — i vy mertvy. Tri smerti — i igra okonchena. Poprobuyte srazhatsya s bossami v raznom poryadke, chtoby nayti variant prokhozhdeniya poproshche.

Yarkaya muzyka i zvukovoy fon Zvukov zdes nemnogo, no vse oni zastavyat vas ispuganno vsmatrivatsya v temnotu vperedi. V osobo napryazhennykh momentakh vrode bitv s bossami atmosferu podderzhit negromkaya zloveshchaya muzyka.

Sovmestnyy rezhim Teper v OVERWHELM mozhno igrat vmeste s drugom. Otvlekayte vragov, obedinyaytes protiv nikh i voskreshayte drug druga, chtoby vybratsya iz ulya zhivymi.

title: Monster Slayers [NSP][ENG]
description:
Monster Slayers — unikalnoe roguelike-priklyuchenie s kartochnymi boyami. Soberite kolodu, podkhodyashchuyu imenno vam, i vpered! 
 Vstupayte v gildiyu okhotnikov na chudovishch i otpravlyaytes v put po Severnoy doline na poiski legendarnogo Vestnika! 
 
• Srazhaytes s uzhasnymi tvaryami v kartochnykh boyakh
• Sobirayte kolodu i vystraivayte strategiyu
• Otkryvayte novye sposobnosti i snaryazhenie s kazhdym urovnem
• Soberite komandu vernykh sputnikov
• Sluchaynaya generatsiya urovney i mira igry
• 12 klassov personazha

title: Shipwreck Escape [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Shipwreck Escape是一款帶有解謎元素的2.5D沉浸式遊戲。 災難發生在遊輪從雅典駛往迪拜時。 主角是一艘船上賭場的荷官，他被困在這個下沉的地獄裡。

解開謎題，拯救其他乘客，控制兩個角色穿越各個關卡走向自由，找出災難的原因。

- 超過 20 個難度不斷增加的手工關卡（客艙、引擎區、賭場、公園、餐廳等）；
- 沉船的氣氛和周圍的恐慌；
- 控制兩個必須互相幫助的角色逃脫；
- 陷入陷阱的乘客很多，但逃生的時間有限，留下來幫助還是自救只有你自己決定；
- 找到穿越所有障礙的方法：火災、蒸汽、電氣危險等等；

title: Professor Lupo and his Horrible Pets / Ocean [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Vy prosypaetes posredi razrushennogo kosmicheskogo korablya, gde vse zatopleno vodoy...! Korabl na dne okeana! Bortovoy kompyuter nastaivaet na tom, chtoby naznachit vam tonnu zadach po remontu i govorit, chto vy... klon? Priklyuchenie tolko nachalos!

Dobro pozhalovat v «Professor Lupo: Okean», epilog sagi «Professor Lupo i ego Uzhasnye Pitomtsy». V kontse originalnoy igry nashi geroi ostalis v samom nachale ochen dolgogo kosmicheskogo puteshestviya. Pyat tysyach let spustya Stantsiya «Avrora» dostigla koordinat naznacheniya. No kak tak vyshlo, chto ona zatonula i, kuda podevalsya ves ekipazh — eto imenno to, chto predstoit vyyasnit Klonu, nashey novoy geroine.

«Professor Lupo: Okean» — eto priklyuchencheskaya igra-golovolomka 2D, orientirovannaya na razvitie syuzheta. My pozaimstvovali mekhaniku iz pervoy chasti igry i dobavili novyy element — vodu. Voda okazyvaet fundamentalnoe vliyanie na ves igrovoy protsess i vzaimodeystvuet so vsemi personazhami.

Osobennosti:
- 40 novykh urovney.
- Furaks po imeni Ro: druzhestvennyy personazh, kotoryy pomogaet vam v techenie vsego priklyucheniya.
- Izuchite povedenie inoplanetyan i ispolzuyte ikh kachestva v svoyu polzu.
- Syuzhetnye povoroty, svyazyvayushchie proiskhodyashchie sobytiya s originalnoy igroy.

Smozhete li vy sovershit pobeg?

title: D-Corp (DCorp) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
沒時間想太多——這是一種入侵

習慣 D下士 的動態遊戲。 在達到配額之前，你的每一秒都將充滿挑戰。 與最多 4 名玩家和各種具有挑戰性的場景一起體驗塔防和解謎的獨特組合。

還活著

每張地圖都有其獨特的轉折點。 找出它是什麼，同時你面對成群的敵人。 使用您可以使用的一切來節省您的設備。 使用砲塔建立防禦……或者直接敲打憤怒的外星人的腦袋。

多任務處理是關鍵

重新裝填你的砲塔，摧毀偷偷摸摸的史萊姆，並收穫必要的資源。 分擔責任或嘗試自己做所有事情。 你的敵人會以同樣的方式回應。 有些會爆炸，有些會追你，但每個人都會流血。

你喜歡帽子嗎？

完成特定場景的任務以解鎖新的自定義選項。 讓你的角色在這片混亂的海洋中脫穎而出。 將他們變成斯巴達戰士、紳士，還有更多等待探索的東西。

主要特徵：

• 最多可容納 4 名玩家的沙發多人遊戲
• 卡通美學
• 要完成的多項挑戰
• 有趣和意想不到的遊戲
• 塔防與益智遊戲相結合
• 多種定制選項

title: Broken Mind [NSZ][ENG]
description:
BROKEN MIND vy igraete agenta Frenka Morgana, detektiva s temnym proshlym. Vam predstoit rassledovat ischeznovenie devochki-podrostka, kotoruyu pokhitili vo vremya pryamoy internet-translyatsii. Rassledovanie uskoryaetsya, kogda telefon Laury izluchaet signal v neskolkikh kilometrakh posredi lesa!

BROKEN MIND — eto khorror na vyzhivanie v zhanre ekshn.
Srazhaytes, rassleduyte, reshayte golovolomki i uznayte, chto sluchilos s Loroy Kempbell.
Esli ona eshche zhiva, deystvovat nuzhno bystro!

- Povestvovatelnaya igra s geympleem, sochetayushchim v sebe rassledovaniya, golovolomki i boi!
- Sledite za istoriey s raznykh storon, igraya neskolkimi personazhami s unikalnymi navykami.
- 7 akterov i 1 kompozitor dlya bolee moshchnoy atmosfery.
- Gnetushchaya atmosfera s graficheskim stilem, sochetayushchim 3D i risunki ruchnoy raboty.
- Igra, sozdannaya odnim chelovekom!

Igra dostupna tolko na angliyskom yazyke.

title: Plague Road [NSP][ENG]
description:
Plague Road結合了回合製的戰略和角色扮演遊戲的元素。

這是一個被充滿了瘟疫的城市，Plague Road講述一個孤獨醫生的故事，他曾經放棄家園，而他現在終於回來去面對他命運。從農場的安全避難所出發，經過一些的地方，逐漸去到受瘟疫肆虐的地區。

在路上，救援倖存者並選擇是否將他們用作旅行伴侶或去改善醫生的農場並獲得新的能力。農場的發展取決於你如何分配倖存者的工作。

一些倖存者類型在某些工作中有更高的價值，但如果用於探險，則可能更有用。倖存的道路將依賴於你對抗瘟疫能力，在對戰的模式中會應用網格定位和回合戰略的機制。

title: A Tale of Synapse The Chaos Theories [NSZ][ENG]
description:
A Tale Of Synapse: The Chaos Theories is a mix of platformer and puzzle game melting abstract art and sciences. Use the universe rules and all the elements that compose it to help Synapsians to be open-minded.  Discover an incredible and colorful story with Sci and Néro, two heroes, who cooperate to evolve in this dreamlike world based on Math logic rules. The original soundtrack will immerse you in the universe of Héméide.
Are you able to enter this magical land? Play alone or co-op with your friend and develop your synapses to get more competencies, solve puzzles and fight enemies.

- 4 magical worlds
- Local Multiplayer Mode
- 45 levels with incredible puzzles
- Colorful and unique 2D
- More than 10h of gameplay
- French Innovative Indie Game
- Solve equations with your sense of logic

title: Tales of Aravorn Seasons of the Wolf [NSP][ENG]
description:
V etoy vizualnom romanie-RPG vy mozhete igrat za Shi ili Alteyu, bliznetsov iz okruzhennoy ldami derevni Ninim.

V odin iz samykh obychnykh dney odin iz bliznetsov nakhodit molodogo volka i reshaet vzyat ego s soboy – vot togda i nachinaet raskruchivatsya tselaya istoriya.

Epicheskoe puteshestvie privedet brata i sestru v stoyashchiy posredi pustyni gorod Dingirr i produvaemyy vsemi vetrami port Sheklsplit.

Issleduyte pronizannye porchey zaly Dingirra i srazites s kriminalnymi avtoritetami, schitayushchimi ikh svoim vladeniem. Otpravlyaytes v otkrytoe more i blagopoluchno vernites domoy!

S kazhdym povysheniem urovnya vybirayte novye atributy s umom, tak kak kazhdyy iz nikh budet imet reshayushchee vliyanie na iskhod budushchikh srazheniy. V igre imeetsya 9 raznykh klassov, kazhdyy so svoim naborom navykov.

Srazhaytes s mnozhestvom vragov v poshagovykh takticheskikh srazheniyakh i sobirayte sluchayno vypadaemye predmety dlya novoy igry!


Kharakteristiki:
* Dostupen rezhim igry v vide tolko vizualnogo romana
* Avtonomnaya fenteziynaya rolevaya igra, deystvie kotoroy razvorachivaetsya v mire Aravorn
* Mozhno vybrat svoy klass
* Vyberite, kem igrat: muzhchinoy (Shi) ili zhenshchinoy (Alteya)
* Dostupno 4 partnera dlya romanticheskikh otnosheniy
* 8 unikalnykh chlenov gruppy s raznymi navykami
* Karty gorodov v izometricheskoy proektsii
* Udostoennaya nagrad muzykalnaya tema

title: Galaxy Tales Story of Rapunzel [NSZ][ENG]
description:
用長發公主，事件捆綁包Android擊敗太空海盜！曾在Planet Jimo地下室睡了很長時間的Android Rapunzel被Rose的錯誤喚醒了。庇護所的整個內部都被太空海盜佔據。但是，如果智能Rose和Android Rapunzel聯手，一切皆有可能！

長發公主的武器是跳躍和頭髮。長發公主沒有手腳，劍和魔術，而是揮動長髮扔海盜，並使用避難所中的裝置跳起來。可愛又蓬鬆的外星生物長發公主和羅斯能否安全逃離庇護所？

[主要特徵]

-快節奏的2D動作平台遊戲！
-可愛的卡通風格的圖形！
-您可以用頭髮捉住並扔掉敵人！
-您可以通過獲取地圖上所有收集的物品來解鎖隱藏的場景！
-每章中都有獨特的BOSS！

title: Summer Daze Tilly's Tale (At Hero-U) [NSP][ENG]
description:
你是 Tilly Appleberry，一個淘氣的遊俠學生，將遊樂置於尊重規則和權威之上。

你的選擇很重要。反復遊戲，結識不同的人，運用你的智慧、魅力和技能讓即將到來的豐收節取得成功。

來結交牛頭怪聖騎士、狗狗大廚以及其他潛在的好友和心上人吧！

Tilly的故事由著名的冒險遊戲作家Lori Ann Cole撰寫，充滿了幽默和愛心，適合所有年齡段的玩家。

title: Orebody Binder's Tale [NSZ][RUS/Multi13]
interface_lang: 俄语 (chastichno), 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 13]
description:
Orebody: Binder's Tale是一款發生在外星世界Orebody上的跑酷射擊遊戲。

使用經典8位遊戲的限制構建，Binder's Tale為年輕和老年玩家提供了一種真正的老派體驗。

作為一個名為Binder的孤兒戰鬥機器人，玩家需要在Orebody上奔跑，跳躍和射擊，以到達Galvanstad懸浮的AI堡壘，面對他們的製造者，為他們的導師報仇。

title: Romeow to the Cracked Mars [NSZ][ENG]
description:
蒐集太空船零件，並在這顆橘色的星球插上貓旗。快來與小貓一起享受這款輕鬆的益智遊戲。

羅密喵是一款輕鬆迷人的益智遊戲，講述一隻小貓夢想前往太空。他必須走過不斷變換的小路，才可以組裝自己的太空船並達成目標。

遊戲特色：
- 穿越迷宮，蒐集太空船零件！
- 親手打造 40 道關卡，不斷增加難度。
- 好好放鬆！不計分數、不計時、沒有壓力。
- 享受悅耳動聽的配樂。

title: Rising Dusk [NSP][ENG]
description:
Stupite v mir Rising Dusk! Eto — zemlya, gde vsegda tsaryat sumerki i obitayut raznye upyri.
Upravlyayte Tamako – molodoy devushkoy, zapertoy v mire Yokay. Udastsya li vam proyti etu opasnuyu zemlyu i dobratsya do strannoy novoy gory na gorizonte? Prodvinutsya vpered mozhno lish uklonyayas ot monet v etom uvlekatelnom 2D-platformere!

title: The Awakening of Mummies [NSZ][ENG]
description:
木乃伊被邪惡的法老王 Cléo 囚禁在金字塔裡，用你的砌圖解謎能力，引導木乃伊穿過密室，記得要當心陷阱！

操控一群木乃伊，引導他們跨過洞穴、搖搖欲墜的地板、從地上穿出來的長矛等陷阱！收集每個木乃伊的特定符文，並連同這些符文同時找到他們各自的圖騰，然後開啟大門，前往金字塔的下一個密室。

title: LOVE 3 (LOVE 1-2-3 Classic / Remastered / Kuso) [NSP][RUS/Multi11]
description:
