LOVE 3 是一個要求精準的平台跳躍遊戲，你會控制一個孤獨的生環者 fiveEight，在一個末日機械世界尋找其他人。面對充滿挑戰性的障礙物，發現隱藏秘密，每次跨越新的危機時嘗試在絕望中尋找希望。

在探索中你找到的東西會影響結局，所以確保你找到重要的東西。

特點

通過 25 個手工製作的關卡，體驗能夠快速上手的精密遊戲

享受 James Bennett 製作的全新原聲帶，每個關卡都會有原創音樂

調節度高和多元化的挑戰：設置屬於你的檢查點和生命數目，切換慢動作，或是嘗試不同遊玩模式

內含 LOVE、LOVE 2: kuso 和 LOVE Remastered 的所有關卡，另外加入 42 首原創原聲帶曲目

挑戰遊戲專門的競速模式，以最快的速度進行競爭

title: Mechanic Battle [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Let the race for the title of the best car mechanic begin!

Pick up your tools and work your magic in order to bring old, rusty wrecks back to their former glory.

Hours of blood, sweat, customising, and repairs will allow you to create the ultimate beast of a vehicle, capable of facing the rest of the best in a series of gruelling races!

Features:

• Repair
Buy and repair your favourite vehicles - from the petite Tiny to the luxurious Vette! Change the engine, add some nitro, reduce weight, and much more.

• Customization
Add some personality to your ride! Woo the judges with a splash of colour, some cool decals or brand new rims and spoilers.

• Tuning
Play around with various settings that will influence your car’s performance. Adjust gear ratios, change the size of the turbocharger, balance the brake strength and find the perfect balance for your driving style.

• Race
After everything’s ready and you're ready to go, take your car for the final drive at the Mechanic Battle Tournament. Race against other drivers, take part in an elimination challenge or push your speed limits during hot laps - all for that sweet, sweet money and even better cars!

title: Rover Wars [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Chto zhe eto za igra?
Esli vy kak raz nakhodites v poiske klassicheskoy, no v to zhe vremya krutoy i zakhvatyvayushchey smesi deystviy i strategiy, no ne sobiraetes tratit chasy na obuchenie igre, togda Rover Wars to, chto vam nuzhno.

Vorvites pryamo v gushchu sobytiy na svoem malenkom Planetokhode i nachnite stroit zavody i nanosit uron edinitsam protivnika. Taktika igry zaklyuchaetsya v upravlenii resursami i razmeshcheniya i tipa zavodov. Zavody proizvodyat boytsov, kotorye proberutsya v zdaniya naprotiv i unichtozhat ikh. Kak tolko vy unichtozhite bazu protivnika, vy pobedite. Vse prosto.

Khvatit nablyudat, prisoedinyaytes!
Rover Wars imeet nalazhennuyu lokalnuyu mnogopolzovatelskuyu sistemu. V nee mozhet igrat do 8-mi igrokov. Chtoby izbezhat divannykh konfliktov, my vnedrili otlichneyshiy iskusstvennyy intellekt dlya sovmestnoy bitvy. Vsegda est 2 komandy, i u kazhdoy storony est maksimum 4 Planetokhoda, vo vremya boya igroki mogut dazhe pomenyat komandy ili nanyat nekiy II.
Pomimo kampanii est takzhe rezhim boya. Eto pozvolyaet vam srazhatsya na odnoy iz 17 mgnovenno dostupnykh kart. Nastroit mnogie parametry, takie kak, bazovaya sila i iskusstvennyy intellekt.

title: Editor's Hell Newspaper Story [NSZ][ENG]
description:
你剛剛成為一個麻煩國家的報紙的編輯。 首先，你必須做出選擇。 你會支持政府還是反對政府？ 支持政府可能會導致破產，因為已經有很多報紙這樣做了。 或者你也可以採取反對立場，與一位誠信有問題、正在走向獨裁的總統對峙，而不會引起太多關注。
成為報紙的編輯
         決定要播放哪些新聞標題，將其分配給您的一位記者。 管理您的員工； 或買新的。
用您選擇發布的新聞設計您的報紙頁面，選擇要列印的廣告。
整理送紙路線； 決定報紙的分發地點和方式
回家照顧家人，管理經濟。
根據你的管理，達到不同的結局。

title: Crossniq Plus [NSP][ENG]
description:
CROSSNIQ+ (CROSS-neek plus) - eto arkadnaya golovolomka v stile «y2k», vypolnennaya v futuristicheskom vizualnom stile kontsa 90-kh godov i predlagayushchaya zakhvatyvayushchiy, molnienosnyy geympley pryamo iz zolotogo veka arkadnykh igr-golovolomok!
Perestavlyayte plitki v setke tak, chtoby poluchilis «krestiki» - ryad i stolbets odnogo tsveta, - zarabatyvayte ochki i prodolzhayte igru. Bystrye raschistki i mnogokratnye perekreshchivaniya prinesut vam bonusnye ochki, no budte ostorozhny... po mere togo kak slozhnost igry budet vozrastat, zablokirovannye i zamorozhennye plitki zastavyat vas napryach refleksy do predela. Chtoby stat chempionom CROSSNIQ+, vam pridetsya nauchitsya dumat vo vsekh napravleniyakh - dazhe esli dlya etogo pridetsya obognut setku!
- Igrayte na predele svoikh vozmozhnostey v rezhime Endless ili raskroyte svoi samye bystrye i yarostnye navyki golovolomki v rezhime Time Attack... Stremites k vershine i delites svoimi luchshimi rezultatami s igrokami po vsemu miru cherez onlayn-tablo liderov!
- Srazites s drugom v rezhime Versus - khaotichnoy lokalnoy mnogopolzovatelskoy bitve s personazhami, predmetami, spetsialnymi priemami i mnogim drugim!
- Chuvstvuete sebya ozadachennym? Otdokhnite v rezhime Chillout. Nikakikh opasnostey, nikakikh taymerov, nikakoy igry zanovo - prosto rasslabtes i delayte krestiki-noliki v svoe udovolstvie, naslazhdayas shirokim spektrom yarkikh dostoprimechatelnostey i atmosfernykh zvukov.
- Naslazhdaytes mnozhestvom razblokiruemykh v igre predmetov, kostyumov, muzyki i mnogogo drugogo!
Vpered! Tselsya v TOP!!!

title: Black Rainbow [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
對於冒險家海倫·斯通來說，最大的冒險還在後頭！
幫助海倫逃離燃燒的村莊，引導她穿越黑暗危險的森林，幫助亞馬遜地區的人民。

幕後的邪惡比任何人想像的都要大和危險。 海倫要在這個隱藏和未探索的世界中恢復平衡。 你會在不可能的事情中倖存下來嗎！？

- 在亞馬遜的黑暗森林中尋找出路
- 搜索數十個隱藏和神聖的地方
- 幫助亞馬遜地區的人們阻止黑暗
- 解決數十個令人興奮的小遊戲
- 眾多動畫、多彩的地點等你探索

title: Paper Cut Mansion [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Paper Cut Mansion – igra v zhanre «rouglayt-khorror», deystvie kotoroy proiskhodit v bumazhnom mire. Igrayte za sledovatelya Tobi, kotoryy priezzhaet v zagadochnyy staryy osobnyak. Issleduyte osobnyak etazh za etazhom, chtoby uznat istoriyu etogo strannogo mesta. Kazhdyy probeg daet shans nayti ocherednuyu podskazku dlya doski ulik. Tainstvennye obitateli osobnyaka mogut kak pomogat, tak i prepyatstvovat vashemu rassledovaniyu...
Osobennosti
•	Mrachnyy shchekochushchiy nervy syuzhet razvorachivaetsya vmeste s bumazhnymi dekoratsiyami po mere prodvizheniya v igre. Kontsovka budet zaviset ot vashikh uspekhov
•	Igrovye mekhaniki obespechivayut vysokuyu reigrabelnost
•	Odna zhizn
•	Chem bolshe vy proigryvaete i nachinaete zanovo, tem bolshe uznaete o mekhanikakh igry
•	Unikalnyy II dlya kazhdogo tipa vragov – nepredskazuemoe povedenie delaet vragov strashnee i opasnee
•	Logicheskie golovolomki zastavyat igroka dumat
•	Raznoobraznye uluchsheniya
•	Nastraivayte snaryazhenie pered kazhdym probegom, chtoby vyrabotat svoy igrovoy stil

Probeg za probegom vy budete otkryvat novye sposobnosti i snaryazhenie, chtoby nayti sobstvennyy stil igry i uspeshno spravlyatsya s prepyatstviyami, kotorye generiruyutsya sluchaynym obrazom. Uluchshayte svoego personazha s pomoshchyu predmetov i sozdavayte unikalnye modifikatsii, ot besstrashnogo boytsa blizhnego boya do metkogo snaypera.

Bumazhnyy osobnyak stoit v neskolkikh izmereniya. Na kazhdom etazhe est portaly, vedushchie v drugie versii tekh zhe lokatsiy. Vid komnat i geympley v raznykh izmereniyakh otlichaetsya. Vy vsegda budete nachinat v neokortekse – izmerenii, gde nuzhno iskat vykhod iz komnaty, polnoy ispytaniy, zagadok i syurprizov.

Mnozhestvo vragov, zadaniy, sekretov, dobychi i uvlekatelnykh logicheskikh golovolomok, razbrosannykh po osobnyaku, sdelaet kazhdyy probeg polnym otkrytiy i ne dast rasslabitsya. Urovni razdeleny muzykalnymi vstavkami, kotorye raskryvayut chast zaputannoy istorii. Vsego u etoy strashnoy skazki 27 kontsovok, i kakuyu uvidite vy, zavisit isklyuchitelno ot vashikh resheniy vo vremya probegov.

Dobavte k etomu neveroyatnuyu bumazhnuyu grafiku, i poluchite Paper Cut Mansion – rouglayt, kotoryy vy tochno ne zakhotite propustit!

title: Oniria Crimes [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Razgadyvayte tayny strany grez vmeste s okruglitelyami.

«Prestupleniya Dremotii» — priklyuchencheskaya igra, v kotoroy deystvie proiskhodit v Dremotii, tsarstve grez. Pomogite detektivu Santos i inspektoru Torresu izuchat stseny prestupleniy. Igrayte na storone okrugliteley, taynogo obshchestva po borbe s prestupnostyu vo sne.

Syuzhet «Prestupleniy Dremotii» pokhozh na vizualnyy roman, gde nuzhno nakhodit predmety i shchelkat ikh kak v priklyuchencheskikh graficheskikh kvestakh. Veshchi pomogut ponyat, chto proizoshlo na meste prestupleniya.

6 epizodov «Prestupleniy Dremotii» polny zagadochnykh sobytiy. Predmety tam sposobny davat pokazaniya. A klyuchevye uliki dobyvayutsya putem razgadyvaniya golovolomok pod priyatnuyu progressivnuyu muzyku v mrachnoy obstanovke, sozdannoy iz trekhmernykh pikseley.

Syuzhet:

Pryamo pered pervymi vyborami pokoy Dvortsa zhelaniy, stolitsy Dremotii, narushaet seriynyy ubiytsa. Okruglitelyam nuzhno potoraplivatsya, potomu chto uliki v tsarstve grez nedolgovechny. Veshchi s mesta prestupleniya, kotorye byli svidetelyami ubiystv, pomogut im.

Situatsiya oslozhnyaetsya iz-za togo, chto vtayne realizuetsya sekretnyy plan. Gildii Dremotii boryutsya za kontrol nad budushchim vsekh spyashchikh. Poka kazhdyy tyanet odeyalo na sebya, k spyashchim vse blizhe podbirayutsya iskonnye obitateli Dremotii (kabu ili «koshmary»)...

Osobennosti:

— Issledovanie 6 mest prestupleniya
— Atmosfera filmov «nuar» i smeshnye dialogi
— Trekhmernye golovolomki
— Zagadki
— Grafika na osnove obemnykh pikseley
— Sovremennyy originalnyy saundtrek

title: King Oddball [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 俄语, 移植版 s PK
description:
Vzryvay tanki! Sbivay vertolety! Davi zhalkikh lyudishek! Rush zdaniya! Shvyryay bulyzhniki! Krushi vse! UNIChTOZh MIR!

Zavali mir kamnyami! Nazhmi na knopku vovremya i sokrushi vse tseli!

Poluchi bulyzhniki za unichtozhenie trekh tseley razom! Ottochi svoe masterstvo, predugadyvaya, kak pokatyatsya kamni, gde oni podskochat i kuda ikh otkinet vzryvom. Ispolzuy rushashchiesya zdaniya v svoyu polzu! 

Zakhvati mir, proydya bolee 120 veselykh urovney, kotorye stanovyatsya vse slozhnee i slozhnee!

OSOBENNOSTI
- Odna knopka dlya igry: chto mozhet byt proshche?
- Bolee 120 urovney + sekrety
- Originalnoe oformlenie
- Saundtrek Dzhonatana Gira

title: Son of a Witch [NSP][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description: Rogalik na 1-4 igrokov s simpatichnoy grafikoy, s lyogkim upravleniem i glubokimi igrovymi mekhanikam. Kombiniruy mnozhestvo oruzhiya, magii, predmetov, zeliy i svitkov s unikalnymi effektami chtoby pobedit 7 vrazheskikh fraktsiy i 24 bossa. Smozhesh li ty nayti drevniy goblinskiy artefakt v kontse podzemelya?

title: Empires Shall Fall [NSZ][RUS/Multi4]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 4]
description:
在《帝國陣線》中玩家將分別扮演兩個完全敵對陣線，黑淵帝國、青空同盟。兩者都在爭奪一塊應許之地：自由領。
為此這兩個超級大國以近乎傾國之力向自由領進發，你將體驗兩種不同的戰爭視角。排兵佈陣，擊潰敵軍。

《帝國陣線》的開發受到了經典遊戲“高級戰爭”的啟發。在地圖中除了已有的部隊，還有不斷攻佔建築物、奪取資源，建造新的部隊。通過地空配合、步坦協同等多種經典戰爭思路來完成戰略要求。此外，戰鬥前還可以為部隊進行選擇性升級，以便適應不同的戰局需求。

遊戲特色：
非隨機戰鬥。
多兵種類型，包括多種步兵、騎兵、機械化部隊，以及空中單位。
非常具有深度的關卡設計和適當的戰鬥難度。
自訂地圖和本地多人遊戲！
序章、帝國、同盟，三條故事線共同編織戰爭史詩。
每個兵種都有其獨特的升級內容。

title: Madness Beverage [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Madness Beverage - shuter ot pervogo litsa, deystvie kotorogo proiskhodit v kosmose. Puteshestvuyte po inoplanetnym planetam, zabytym peshcheram, starym zamkam i temnym koridoram i sobirayte moshchnye toksichnye napitki, kotorye nadelyayut vas nekotorymi osobymi sposobnostyami i, takim obrazom, pomogayut v vashikh poiskakh.
Eto odinochnaya kampaniya, no vy nikogda ne budete odinoki - osteregaytes demonov, oni povsyudu i khotyat videt vas mertvymi.
U vas budet vozmozhnost posetit mnozhestvo unikalnykh lokatsiy, srazitsya s mogushchestvennymi monstrami, izbezhat lovushek i srazitsya s bossami!
Issleduyte istochnik radiosignala v starom zamke na Neo Valkirii, otkroyte sekrety podozritelnoy laboratorii, issleduyte mir Chuzhikh s ego intriguyushchey dikoy prirodoy i postaraytes ne umeret v ogne vo vremya missii v Lavovoy peshchere.
Vy mozhete priobresti vsevozmozhnye napitki, i kazhdyy iz nikh obladaet svoey unikalnoy siloy. Zashchitite sebya, zamedlite svoikh vragov, stante neveroyatno mogushchestvennym i dazhe posetite drugie izmereniya, no budte ostorozhny ... napitki mogut byt toksichnymi! Nekotorye iz nikh mogut zastavit vas chuvstvovat sebya nemnogo nechetko.
Vy chasto ispytyvaete nostalgiyu? Poprobuyte "oldskulnyy" rezhim, kotoryy otpravit vas v puteshestvie po pikselnoy versii igry! Pochuvstvuyte vkus starykh dobrykh vremen!
Provedite chasy, unichtozhaya lyubogo demona, kotoryy vstanet u vas na puti! Nablyudayte, kak krov bryzzhet povsyudu, i ostavte grudu trupov na svoem puti!

title: Light Fingers [NSZ][ENG]
description:
What do skulking thieves do after a night of procuring shady spoils? They gather at a favourite tavern and wager it away on a friendly game of Light Fingers!

Played on a magical clockworks game board, this turn-based multiplayer game has real-time action and devious opportunities for misdirection, all in the pursuit of securing more loot than your opponents.

title: McDroid [NSZ][ENG]
description:
«Eta igra sdelana iz lyubvi. Khoroshee sochetanie arkady i igry v zhanre Tower Defense, kotoruyu ya nikogda ranshe ne videl». -bele

Originalnaya smes Farming, Arcade i Tower Defense, kotoraya brosit vyzov vashim refleksam i vashemu intellektu, zastavit vas khotet pit klubnichnyy sok!

Moderniziruyte svoego malenkogo robota-sobaku do BOEVOY STANTsII, soberite stado sobak-robotov, slushayte boltovnyu gigantskikh lazerov, sazhayte mnogo derevev, chtoby pokryt zemlyu schastem, i sobirayte naryady dlya svoego robota!

"eto deystvitelno ochen veselo!" -Dzhessi Koks
«Vkusnaya i sochnaya klubnika» -etalyx
«Ya ne mogu perestat igrat :)» -Bar.pys
«Blestyashchaya zhemchuzhina» - Kodidzhak
«Prosto vkusno» -Al
«A est klubnika-DRM!» -RadioNosorog

title: BugVasion TD (Tower Defense) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Bugvasion TD 旨在將 Micro Machines 外觀與塔防類型相結合，為您的屏幕帶來豐富多彩的關卡和古怪的敵人。 然而，這不僅僅是一種建造你的塔然後坐下來的體驗，你必須積極維護你的塔，使用特殊的能力和攻擊，並結合你的工具一個房間一個房間地保衛你的家免受外星人的侵害- 擁有錯誤。

特徵：
- 一個房間一個房間地保衛你的房子，並利用周圍的環境對你有利
- 從閣樓到地下室，整個房子都有 20 個色彩繽紛且古怪的關卡
- 結合特殊攻擊和塔防 - 明智地使用你的武器庫並嘗試將攻擊與你在地圖上找到的任何東西結合起來，這可能值得一試
- 技能樹 - 使用你的技術點來解鎖和升級塔，特殊攻擊
- 幽默的故事情節與古怪的角色
- 事件系統 - 帶來具有不同特徵的隨機波，你永遠不知道接下來會發生什麼，它可能對你有幫助，也可能使你處於劣勢，而這一切都取決於運氣。

維護你的塔 - 密切關注你的塔並更換罐和電池以保持它們運行。
使用環境 - 地圖周圍有幾個交互式對象，您可以利用它們來發揮自己的優勢，例如膠水管、ZEP 分配器和辣醬瓶。
結合你的工具 - 嘗試著火或觸電，你永遠不知道什麼會引發連鎖反應。
解鎖新技術 - 通過完成關卡並花費它們來解鎖新塔和特殊攻擊來收集技術點。

收集徽章、成就和積分來統治排行榜

title: Golem Gates [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Golem Gates — eto sochetanie boevika, strategii i kartochnoy igry v postapokalipticheskom settinge, gde vashi armii srazhayutsya s silami iz inykh mirov. Soberite kolodu iz assortimenta v 100 kart-glifov i primenyayte boytsov, zdaniya, bonusy i drugie poleznye elementy v takticheskikh boyakh v odinochnom, a takzhe kooperativnom i mnogopolzovatelskom setevykh rezhimakh.
 
Drevnyaya ugroza proryvaetsya skvoz Vrata Golema, i tolko Predvestnik gotov vstat u nee na puti. Upravlyaya siloy Pepla — nanitami — vy dolzhny zashchitit mir, razrushennyy v drevnikh voynakh. 
 
Klyuchevye osobennosti:

Vybirayte glify: pokroyte pole dyuzhinami otryadov, zdaniy, lovushek, polozhitelnykh i otritsatelnykh effektov, a takzhe tekhnologiy.

Elegantnaya taktika: ispolzuyte karty-glify neposredstvenno vo vremya boya i podstraivaytes pod situatsiyu, vybiraya zashchitu, napadenie ili ukreplenie.

Unikalnyy kontent: odinochnaya kampaniya, rezhim stsenariev, odinochnyy i sovmestnyy setevoy rezhim vyzhivaniya, sorevnovatelnye setevye matchi i mnogoe drugoe.

title: Rhythm of the Gods [NSP][ENG]
description:
在這個希臘風格的自動跑酷韻律遊戲中，解決凡人面臨的問題。擊敗各式各樣嘔啞嘲哳的神話怪物，以打動每一個神明，並贏得你一對一挑戰他們的權利——當然，是以韻律之戰的形式。跟上節奏並揭示每個神明的真實音調，說服他們相信你是合適的人選。


獨特的節拍圖
基礎階段清關即可解鎖神明模式的特殊節拍圖，並一對一挑戰韻律之神。伴著作曲家Nathan FitzPatric令人上癮原創音樂，暢玩這些快節奏戰鬥。


馬拉松模式
在馬拉松模式下測試你的韻律耐力！看看你能持續多久並提升自己的技能。

高分和獎杯
保持追蹤你的最佳成績，執行各種任務來贏得全部獎盃！

時間扭曲模式
凡間似乎有所不同——好像有一個全新的的遊戲模式等待著解鎖！在新鮮的twist模式下演繹熟悉的曲目。

簡單模式
找不到旋律？Titans將調低音量。以更輕鬆節奏挑戰每個級別。

title: Crowalt: Traces of the Lost Colony [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
PREODOLENIE TAYNY, NE OBYaSNENNOY 150 LET

Gruppa lyudey, kotorye namerevalis osnovat pervuyu osedluyu koloniyu v Amerike v 1587 godu, tainstvennym obrazom ischezaet vskore posle pribytiya. Oni ostavlyayut tolko nazvanie ostrova, vysechennoe na dereve: «Krouolt».

Seychas 1737 god.

Molodoy i ambitsioznyy iskatel priklyucheniy Khyu Redkliff presleduet Zateryannuyu koloniyu, chtoby sdelat svoe pervoe velikoe otkrytie. Teper raznye lyudi zhivut v Krouolte, kuda on priekhal razgadyvat etu zagadku. On budet parit vokrug ostrova i obyazatelno popadet v cheredu nepriyatnostey, chtoby uznat, chto sluchilos s Zateryannoy koloniey.

KLASSIChESKAYa TOChKA I MEKhANIKA NAZhATIYa
Sobirayte, kombiniruyte i ispolzuyte predmety dlya resheniya golovolomok.

PIRATY TOZhE ZDES!
Poprobuyte razobratsya s obychnymi piratami, posetivshimi Krouolt, i, konechno zhe, nasladites zabavnymi dialogami.

SLEDITE ZA SVOIM ZhURNALOM
Khyu risuet vazhnye veshchi i delaet o nikh zametki v svoem dnevnike. On budet obnovlyatsya posle vazhnykh sobytiy i otkrytiy vo vremya igry.

DELAYTE VYBOR
Lgite ili govorite tolko pravdu.

CSOBIRAYTE ISKUSSTVA
Na ostrove mnogo istoricheskikh predmetov, sbor kotorykh pereneset vam na novyy uroven… dostizheniy!

ZARABATYVAYTE DOVERIE UROZhENTsEV
Urozhentsy - sderzhannye zhiteli ostrova. Poluchenie informatsii ot nikh potrebuet doveriya.

title: The Escapee (onEscapee) [NSZ][ENG]
publisher: IntuitiveComputers, JoshProd, RushOnGame, PixelHeart, Sadeness Software
description:
Velikolepnaya klassika pryamikom s Dreamcast!.. Vozmozhno, oni podumali, chto ya umer, i vyshvyrnuli menya, kak tryapichnuyu kuklu, posredi gryazi, otkhodov i musora. Ya byl begletsom — no byl ya edinstvennym? Deniel Uayt — zakhvachen s Zemli.
Skroytes ot mogushchestvennykh inoplanetnykh sushchestv na chuzhoy planete, buduchi pereneseny tuda po prichine, kotoruyu nikto ne znaet. Naydite dorogu domoy, na Zemlyu, i razgadayte vse tayny!

title: Venice 2089 [NSZ][ENG]
description:
In Venice 2089, you'll explore the city through the eyes of Nova, a bored teenager who has no clue about what to do in life and just wants to relax from the stress of their usual routine.

Use your hoverboard to navigate the streets of Venice in a unique 2.5D art style, perform tricks and create a dynamic soundtrack that'll match your mood. Interact with the world using your drone, collect objects out of your reach, and solve some puzzles.

Meet a diverse cast of characters scattered throughout the city. Know their personalities, learn their points of view, and help them in different quests. Fill your houseboat with important objects, and remember the experiences you made.

title: A Duel Hand Disaster Trackher [NSZ][ENG]
description:
A Duel Hand Disaster: Trackher was created in El Paso, Texas.

FEATURES:

No cutscenes, just action. 

CAPITAL LIST LEADHERBOARDS - The primary goal is to get a high score, however the only way to keep your score is to extract with it. You cannot play till death. If you die, not only do you wipe your current score, you risk the chance of wiping your leaderboard position as well. How you ask? The lower your health the higher the bonus the greater the risk. Every time you extract your score is marked. Why you ask? Why not?

SPLIT SCREEN SINGLE PLAYER TWIN STICK RISK ‘EM UP - You will be controlling two ships simultaneously. The devil is in the details. The left side is invincible, however shooting and moving consumes your LINK. In order to restore it you must recover MATERIAL on the right side. MATERIAL multiplies your overall score so use it with absolute discretion. On the right side you are recovering resources and will need 12 PARTS to extract and mark your leaderboard position. Don’t doubt yourself. Push yourself. You will be rewarded and you will be tested.

TEARS - Each Tear consists of new challenges with hella bonuses attached to them. Focus, overcome, and survive.

If you want a challenge you came to the right place. Don’t doubt what you are capable of. Get out of your comfort zone. Question everything.

Arcade Is Not Dead.

title: 50 Pinch Barrage [NSZ][ENG]
developer: GameStudio 株式会社ゲームスタジオ
description:
◆你是一位緊急降落在未知島嶼的尋寶獵人！
面對接二連三，不斷襲來的危機與陷阱，是否能從這個島中安全逃出？！

◆在遊戲中只能使用移動（方向鍵/L操控遙桿）和A鍵/B鍵。
在遊戲中會出現各種各樣的地形、敵人和陷阱，但如何突破的方法和操作手段，全都需要你自己來决定！

◆會記錄遊戲中的所有內容，並且添加了可以之後閱覽的重放功能。
支持與全球玩家競爭通關時間的線上排行榜。

◆還是一樣的好玩，《危機50連發！！》他回來了！
以原作的關卡為基礎，部分調整了遊戲體驗。
在美術方面也有所提升，變得更加容易上手了！

title: Ciel Fledge A Daughter Raising Simulator [NSZ][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
3716 god. Nad chelovechestvom navisla inoplanetnaya ugroza, kotoraya nosit nazvanie «GIGANTA». Spasayas ot nee, v velikolepnyy nebesnyy gorod «KOVChEG-3» pribyvaet zagadochnaya devochka...

Ciel Fledge — eto igra o mire budushchego, gde vsyo eshche teplitsya nadezhda. V etom mire vam predstoit vospitat priemnuyu doch. V etoy igre so slozhnymi zadachami na upravlenie i ocharovatelnymi personazhami vy budete zabotitsya o Sil, poka ona ne povzrosleet i ne pokinet rodnoe gnezdo. 

Grafik
Kak vy budete vospityvat Sil? Vospolzuytes grafikom, kotoryy mozhno redaktirovat s pomoshchyu sensornykh klavish upravleniya na Nintendo Switch. Planiruyte kazhdyy den nedeli i nablyudayte za tem, chto proiskhodit posle etogo. Vybirayte khobbi i predmety dlya izucheniya, pooshchryayte Sil obshchatsya s druzyami. Ili ustroyte ee na rabotu, chtoby zarabotat chut bolshe deneg i kupit vkusnuyu edu na uzhin.

Nablyudayte
Nablyudayte za sobytiyami dnya i povedeniem Sil. Sledite za ee nastroeniem: Sil mozhet brosit vazhnye dela, esli ustanet. Povyshayte vynoslivost s pomoshchyu predmetov, baluyte Sil, predlagaya ey rasshirennyy paek, ili rugayte, esli ona progulivaet shkolu. Vybirayte, kak sebya s ney vesti.

Ispytaniya
Ezhednevnye problemy prinimayut formu golovolomok-ispytaniy: sovershite deystvie ili propustite kontrolnuyu, sopostaviv tri karty i vyigrav strategicheskuyu igru. Izuchayte novye tekhniki i ishchite druzey, chtoby poluchit podderzhku v ispytaniyakh.

Nastraivayte
U kazhdogo igroka budet svoya Sil. Vybirayte naryady i snaryazhenie dlya svoey priemnoy docheri i reshayte, kakim chelovekom ona stanet: ot etogo zavisit, kakuyu iz neskolkikh kontsovok vy uvidite. S techeniem vremeni izmenitsya ee vozrast, rost i dazhe ves.

Issledovaniya
Otpravlyayte Sil v ekspeditsii na poverkhnost Zemli, chtoby issledovat staryy mir i otkryvat novye oblasti. Ishchite poleznye predmety i kooperiruytes s druzyami, chtoby srazhatsya s protivnikami i poluchat bolshie bonusy k kharakteristikam.

Razvitie mira
Lyubuytes gorodom i izuchayte povsednevnuyu zhizn v KOVChEGE-3. Vam obyazatelno ponravitsya chudesnaya grafika i velikolepnyy saundtrek, vdokhnovlennyy yaponskoy muzykoy v zhanre City Pop.

title: Super Dragonfly Chronicles [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Super Dragonfly Chronicles» — eto stilnyy ekshn-platformer, polnyy ispytaniy i veselya, vdokhnovlennyy oldskulnymi 2D-shuterami s sovremennoy grafikoy i SFX, chtoby dat igroku vyzov i dat pochuvstvovat znakomyy ekspiriens klassicheskoy epokhi.
Igrayte za Marka Uesta, uznayte, chto sluchilos s vashim ottsom, proydite kazhdyy uroven, ispolzuya svoi moshchnye navyki dlya unichtozheniya smertonosnykh vragov, nakhodite razlichnye predmety, chtoby raskryvat bolshe potayonnymkh dannykh, igrayte v shutemap-urovni, ubegaya ot vzryvayushchikhsya sooruzheniy i naslazhdaytes potryasayushchimi kinematograficheskimi rolikami v stile klassicheskikh komiksov!

title: Ashland Dossier [NSZ][RUS/Multi4]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 4]
description:
Ashland Dossier — shpionskiy triller, napolnennyy elementami poshagovoy taktiki skrytnosti i priklyuchencheskoy rolevoy igry. Ispolzuyte svoyu khitrost, lovkost i smekalku, chtoby na etot raz navsegda pokonchit s natsistskoy chumoy. Vperedi vas zhdet smertelnoe protivostoyanie, poskolku vrag snova ugrozhaet vvergnut mir v puchinu uzhasnoy i bessmyslennoy voyny.
Posle Vtoroy mirovoy voyny mnogim natsistam udalos proskolznut skvoz shcheli i bezhat za granitsu. Kak krysy, oni razbezhalis po miru, chtoby spryatatsya v teni, verya, chto dlinnaya ruka pravosudiya nikogda ne dostignet ikh. Odnako eto odno fatalnoe zabluzhdenie.
V kontse 1950-kh godov byla obrazovana chastnaya sledstvennaya organizatsiya. INCU (Mezhdunarodnaya gruppa po borbe s natsistskoy prestupnostyu) imeet v vidu tolko odnu konkretnuyu tsel: nayti takikh prestupnikov i vernut ikh dlya spravedlivogo suda.
Vy vozmete na sebya rol ofitsera, kotoryy ishchet gruppu samykh otyavlennykh negodyaev. V proshlom vse oni sovershili osobo tyazhkie prestupleniya, kotorye do sikh por ostayutsya beznakazannymi. Vasha tsel — nayti ikh sled, sobrat vse vozmozhnye uliki i, nakonets, privlech ikh k otvetstvennosti.
Khotya legche skazat, chem sdelat. Est eshche odna novaya sila, kotoraya tolko chto poyavilas iz niotkuda — Eshlend. K sozhaleniyu, eti lyudi ne ostanovyatsya ni pered chem v svoem reshitelnom stremlenii pomoch beglym natsistam...
Dose Eshlenda vklyuchaet v sebya:
- napryazhennye operatsii, vklyuchayushchie vyyavlenie, presledovanie i evakuatsiyu podozrevaemogo,
- bogatyy lor i predystoriya razvorachivayushchikhsya sobytiy,
- skrupuleznyy analiz informatsii, dokazatelstv i pokazaniy svideteley,
- dve igrovye vremennye shkaly: 1960-1964 i 1941-1945,
- unikalnye personazhi, neozhidannye povoroty syuzheta, neskolko kontsovok,
- glubokiy i realistichnyy vzglyad na pravdivye uzhasy Vtoroy mirovoy voyny.

title: Kaichu the Kaiju Dating Sim [NSZ][ENG]
description: Kaychu, gigantskiy romantik, milyy ogromnyy monstr pytaetsya soblaznit drugikh chudovishch!.. Eti sobytiya kommentiruyut para zhurnalistov iz studii, vedya reportazh o ego lyubovnykh priklyucheniyakh!

title: Anshi [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Khvatayte svoy khoverbord i issleduyte drevniy tainstvennyy mir Anshi, puteshestvuya po peshcheram, bolshim pustynyam i ruinam starykh khramov, chtoby raskryt ego sekrety.
V kompanii energeticheskogo sushchestva vy vmeste issleduete etot ogromnyy mir. Uznayte, chto sluchilos s planetoy i ee sushchestvom. Blagodarya potryasayushchim vizualnym effektam i
originalnyy saundtrek, AnShi darit rasslablyayushchee, unikalnoe, zakhvatyvayushchee vpechatlenie.

title: Accident [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
The course of each accident consists of several stages and possibilities:
Providing assistance to accident victims. It is necessary to check the condition of accident victims and help those who need it most. Every accident is different so it is necessary to assess the situation quickly. This can include stopping the bleeding, performing CPR, and putting the victims in a safe position. 
After the rescue operation and secure accident area,  discover the reasons of the tragedy.

title: Gordian Rooms a Curious Heritage [NSZ][RUS/Multi4]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 4]
description:
Experience the legacy!
Your mysterious uncle left nothing but a letter in his wake, telling you to solve his final puzzle to obtain his heritage… but is there more to this than meets the eye?

Use your wits!
You will need to use your skills of deduction, combination, recollection and observation to overcome the various challenges in the game.

Discover the secrets!
While you wreck your brain on the puzzles don't forget to look around you, not everything is as simple as it seems!

title: Cannibal Cuisine [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Khuchubu khochet sest... vas. No kak znaet lyuboy lyudoed, luchshe byt povarom, a ne blyudom.

Tur po ostrovu
Na start, vnimanie… marsh gotovit na bolee chem 20 urovnyakh kampanii na ostrove! Otpravlyaytes v dzhungli, khramy, na plyazhi i v izvergayushchiysya vulkan!

Zagadochnaya kulinariya
Chtoby ukrotit appetit Khuchubu, nuzhno ne tolko gotovit. Obgonite Shipastoe brevno sudby™, odoleyte vse volny turistov i bossov na arene v dzhunglyakh i proydite drugie ispytaniya.

Vudu-kukhnya
Tainstvennye sily vudu — idealnyy ingredient uspekha. Eta magiya pozvolyaet delat ryvok, razmeshchat tselitelnye totemy i dazhe dyshat ognem. V mnogopolzovatelskom rezhime kazhdyy shef mozhet vybrat raznye sposobnosti, podkhodyashchie ego stilyu.

Festival edy ili gastronomicheskoe srazhenie
Proydite adskuyu kukhnyu samostoyatelno ili priglasite do 4 shefov. Broste drug drugu vyzov v PvP-rezhime! Kogda na kukhne stolko povarov, khaosa ne izbezhat.

title: Twin Blades of the Three Kingdoms [NSP][ENG]
description:
Welcome to Twin Blades of the Three Kingdoms, a retro-style RPG based on the Romance of the Three Kingdoms. Guided by a legendary sword, watch as the story of our hero Xu Shu unfolds from the “Yellow Turban Rebellion” through to the “Battle of the Red Cliffs”.

◆ Over 120 beautifully illustrated generals
Watch this exciting story unfold through the exploits and encounters of these heroes.

◆ A Flexible party system just like your favourite TRPGs
Command your troops via a retro-style menu system.
An array of characteristic generals bring their skills to the table to add spice to each battle.
Grow your entourage as the story progresses and form your own unique party to best compliment your individual playing style.

◆ An 8-bit retro soundtrack to capture the exquisite world of Romance of the Three Kingdoms
From the smallest skirmishes to the largest boss-battles, let the meticulously arranged retro-tunes of BUNBUN guide you through this journey!

title: The Snow Fable: Mystery of the Flame [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
踏上令人驚嘆的魔法和無限想像力的三消冒險！ 玩結合了三消棋盤和滑動瓷磚拼圖的關卡。 擊敗威脅要佔領屏幕的危險頭目。 巧妙地利用角色技能和獎勵標記，以爆炸性的華麗動作將棋盤擦得乾乾淨淨。

一個女孩踏上了拯救她脾氣暴躁的朋友的旅程。 但每向前邁出一步，她就更接近與她無法想像的黑暗力量的遭遇。 在這裡，你將決定火焰之謎的命運——它會被密封還是最終被解決？

特徵：

- 72 個令人愉快的戰役關卡
- 4 次挑戰試驗中的 32 個獎勵關卡
- 具有不同曲折的精彩故事
- 具有挑戰性的無限模式
- 獲得創造性成就

title: Heart and Slash [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
"Serdtse i Sekach" — istoriya lyubvi voyuyushchikh plutovatykh tryokhmernykh robotov, kotorye deystvuyut v mire, gde ot chelovecheskoy tsivilizatsii ostalis lish mashiny.

Ty budesh igrat za Serdtse, chuvstvitelnogo robota, probivayushchegosya na svobodu, chtoby izbezhat iga zloy vsevidyashchey mashiny KVASI (kvalifikatsionnoy sistemy). No ne dumay, chto pobedit v igre "Serdtse i Sekach" nichego ne stoit. Ni odnu smert nevozmozhno otmenit. Posle smerti sluchaynym obrazzom generiruetsya novyy uroven, gde tebe nado budet nachinat snachala s drugim naborom oruzhiya i predmetov, s novymi vragami i sekretami. "Serdtse i Sekach" predlagaet igrokam nechto novoe, brosaya im vyzov. Ved rech ne idyot o tom, chtoby osvoit odnu-edinstvennuyu sistemu. Vmesto etogo nuzhno adaptirovatsya k obstoyatelstvam i izvlekat iz nikh maksimalnuyu polzu.

title: Inspector Waffles [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Inspector Waffles was hoping his worst days were behind him, but the murder of a high-profile industrialist CEO beloved by the citizens of Cat Town raises new questions and fears.

Being the best inspector on the CTPD, Waffles has no choice: he's gotta push past the painful memories, don his well-worn overcoat, and prepare to get his paws dirty.

A detective story reminiscent of the old school classics, Inspector Waffles provides plenty of peculiar mystery, a story full of intrigue, and a slew of characters to interrogate, all wrapped into beautifully simple pixel-art. Will you be able to sniff out every clue and nab the murderer?

A REAL TREAT, SEE?
* A brilliant feline detective in a world full of anthropomorphic cats, dogs, and maybe other species. It’s pixel-animal madness, I tell ya.
* A beautiful jazzy soundtrack, full of notes and music and harmony pleasing to your ears and brain.
* Chock full of dry humor and puns about cats and dogs. Seriously, I couldn’t think of any more puns to include. The pun supply is exhausted.

title: Intruders Hide and Seek [NSP][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 机器翻译 来自 most2820
description:
Ispytayte ledenyashchie dushu emotsii vmeste s Benom, starshim rebyonkom v seme Rikhterov. Otdykhaya v zagorodnom dome, vy stanovites svidetelem togo, kak troe opasnykh zloumyshlennikov vtorgayutsya v semeynuyu obitel i berut v zalozhniki vashikh blizkikh.

Roditeli nichem ne mogut vam pomoch, sestra gde-to spryatalas, i vy ostayotes odin na odin s nezvanymi gostyami. Vam predstoit pridumat, kak pomoch svoey seme, a takzhe postaratsya vyyasnit, kto eti troe i chego oni khotyat.

Vy ne mozhete ubezhat i ne v silakh borotsya. Ostayotsya lish... pryatatsya.

Osobennosti:

- Realistichnaya i krayne napryazhyonnaya drama o zalozhnikakh.
- Zloveshchaya atmosfera: pogruzites v neveroyatnoe priklyuchenie.
- Sochetanie elementov trillera, detektiva i khorrora.
- Geympley s mekhanikami issledovaniya i stelsa, ot kotorogo serdtse ukhodit v pyatki.

title: Cyber Hook [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Khardkornyy parkur!
 
Cyber Hook — dinamichnyy 3D-platformer, v kotorom tebe ponadobyatsya navyki parkura i kryuk, chtoby pokoryat samye nepristupnye steny, i lazernyy palets-pistolet, chtoby ustranyat vragov i prepyatstviya. Promchis po yarkomu miru v stile retroveyv, chtoby ispytat na prochnost navyki parkura, no bud nacheku: odin nevernyy pryzhok — i tebe konets.

OSOBENNOSTI
 
Intensivnyy parkur
Dinamichnyy igrovoy protsess, osnovannyy na parkure, kotoryy pogruzhaet v napryazhennuyu atmosferu ispytaniy v 3D-vselennoy. Pokoryay samye nepristupnye steny i ne zevay: gravitatsiya besserdechna.
 
Podruchnye sredstva
Ispolzuy kryuk, chtoby peremeshchatsya mezhdu urovnyami, tseplyayas za bloki, i otstrelivay vragov lazernym paltsem-pistoletom.
 
Gibkost igry
Upravlyay vremenem, chtoby spastis ot neminuemoy gibeli i otkryvay novye dvizheniya, chtoby prokhodit ispytaniya. V Cyber Hook ty mozhesh prolozhit svoy sobstvennyy put k pobede, narushaya zakony fiziki i podchinyaya sebe dizayn urovney.
 
Izobilie urovney
Bolee 70 urovney, chtoby ispytat tvoi navyki parkura.
 
Globalnyy reyting
Ishchi svoy sobstvennyy put na vershinu reytinga i nablyuday za igroy drugikh, chtoby vybrat luchshuyu strategiyu prokhozhdeniya urovney.

title: Where Angels Cry, Where Angels Cry: Tears of the Fallen Collector's Edition [NSZ][ENG,RUS]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Strange events are taking place in an isolated medieval monastery, set high in the Alps.  Monks are vanishing without a trace, mysterious persons are being sighted running through the dark passages of the monastery in the still of the night, Templars have now been assigned to stand watch and there are even reports that a statue in the center of the village is crying the tears of blood!

A Vatican Cardinal has chosen you to travel to the monastery, undercover, to investigate these bizarre occurrences. Your duty is to reveal the secrets of the monastery, and monks who inhabit it, freeing this once sacred place from the evil forces currently in power. Take this amazing adventure and prove that your keen investigative instincts are up to this formidable task in Where Angels Cry - a challenging and exciting mystery, adventure game!

- Use your skills and your secret identity to reveal the terrifying truth
- Explore the monastery and its surroundings while interrogating its inhabitants
- Solve perplexing puzzle and dozens of mini games
- Enjoy the unique atmosphere and detailed environment
- Earn many different achievements

title: Red Crow Mysteries: Legion [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Your extraordinary gift is also your biggest curse. It is a burden you must bare. The ability to see things others cannot is an unbelievable challenge and responsibility. And evil never sleeps. Evil is never far away. He who has many names, has awakened again - hungry for victory and power. Can you pass the test and prove you are the one who will defend mankind when judgment day comes?
But remember, fear is your worst enemy! Never let him see your fear! He will use it against you and everything will be lost!
Dive into an alternative dimension alive with ghosts and demons in Red Crow Mysteries: Legion - a dark and thrilling puzzle, adventure game!

- Confront ancient evil and prove yourself worthy to the afterlife spirits
- Investigate eye-catching locations and solve dozens of  puzzles
- Search for clues and follow the path
- Beautiful graphics and mysterious atmosphere
- Fantastic music and voice-acting
- 3 fully customizable game-play modes: Easy, Casual and Adventure
- Native wide-screen support

title: Winkeltje the Little Shop [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi11]
description:
Stante vladeltsem sobstvennogo magazina v fentezi-mire proshlogo v igre Winkeltje: The Little Shop! Stroyte, ukrashayte, sozdavayte, prodavayte i stante khozyainom sobstvennogo magazina v beskonechnoy upravlencheskoy igre.

Upravlenie magazinom

Vy vladeete sobstvennym magazinom, i poetomu otvechaete za pokupku, prodazhu, podderzhanie zapasov i poluchenie pribyli. Tovary mozhno kupit u torgovtsev ili dostavit za platu.

- Pokupayte deshevo, prodavayte dorogo i obyazatelno vypolnyayte zaprosy klientov.
- Shirokoe raznoobrazie predmetov: ot optovykh tovarov i resursov do ovoshchey, drugoy edy, odezhdy, instrumentov i dazhe alkhimicheskikh eliksirov!
- Igrayte v svoem tempe i otkroyte svoy magazin, kogda budete gotovy k rabochemu dnyu.

Ukrashenie

Pokazhite svoi navyki dizayna intererov, rasstavlyaya mebel i vitriny v lyubom poryadke. Khorosho ukrashayte magazin, chtoby privlekat pokupateley.

- Mnozhestvo raznoobraznoy mebeli, ot stolov i vitrin do prilavkov, skladskikh palletov i masterskikh.
- Masterski razmeshchayte ukrasheniya, chtoby vpechatlit pokupateley i prodat bolshe tovarov!

Rasshirenie

Rasshiryayte magazin, kogda nakopite dostatochno sredstv. Stante sobstvennym arkhitektorom pri stroitelstve magazina mechty.

- Pridumayte planirovku magazina i razmeshchenie dverey, okon i proemov.
- Uvelichte magazin i sdelayte ego privlekatelnee.

Sozdanie tovarov

Sobirayte resursy i reshite, kakie predmety sozdavat, chtoby poluchat bolshe vsego pribyli.

- Sozdavayte predmety v otdelnykh masterskikh, ot tkatskikh stolov i kuznechnykh gornov do alkhimicheskikh stolov.
- Zarabatyvayte opyt, chtoby sozdavat bolee kachestvennye tovary (i prodavat ikh dorozhe!).

Fermerstvo

Uvelichte zapasy edy v magazine i vyrashchivayte vkusnye artishoki, tsvetnuyu kapustu, kartoshku i drugie kultury v sobstvennom ogorode.

Sotrudniki

Nanimayte sotrudnikov, chtoby oni pomogali vam, kogda del slishkom mnogo dlya odnogo cheloveka.

- Prosmatrivayte zayavki potentsialnykh sotrudnikov i vybirayte, kogo nanyat ili uvolit.
- Razvivayte navyki sotrudnikov i svoi sobstvennye navyki rabotodatelya, chtoby privlekat kadry.
- Reguliruyte zarplaty, chtoby vashi sotrudniki byli schastlivy i khorosho rabotali.

title: War Titans [NSZ][ENG]
description:
In a hundred-year long battle with the alien hordes the humans finally have a game changing weapon system at their disposal: the War Titans. These are some extraordinary battle machines that transform in order to be more effective against the enemy. Each War Titan comes as a combination of a mechanized war robot and an armored vehicle, and they each serve different roles on the battlefield. It's up to your skills and your strategic mind to decide when is the best time to play as a Mech and when the situation demands an armored vehicle on the field.

The Mech - a powerful robot that packs an explosive punch with it's twin machine guns and shoulder-mounted rocket launcher. The Mech is most effective against heavy enemies such as tanks, turrets and enemy mechs. However, the light attacks from the droids will damage the mech more, since thy often hit between the armored plating. The Mech has 3 upgrades: Machineguns, Rockets and Armor.

The Vehicle - your armored vehicle is perfect for running down hordes of droids, It is unarmored so it's not effective against heavy enemies. You can upgrade the vehicle's armor and Nitro which gives you a short but powerful boost in speed and acceleration.

As you progress in the level you will reach certain areas where the enemies will overwhelm you - fear not! Each attempt earns you coins from the distance you cover and the enemies you eliminate. You will also win different types of prize chests which give you more gold and Parts. Collect enough parts and unlock stronger Mechs and Vehicles.

Get ready soldier and who everyone what you're made of. Transform into the Mech and the Vehicle as the situation demands it and make your way through desert bases, alien jungles and remote lunar facilities and become the ultimate War Titan!

title: Lambs on the road: The Beginning [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Ot sozdateley Eternum EX, v sotrudnichestve so studiey Gone Mad.

Yagnyata v doroge - eto istoriya uzhasov vyzhivaniya ottsa, ishchushchego svoyu doch.

Pomogite Dzhonu nayti ee doch, Meri, podvergshuyusya razlichnym opasnostyam, zateryavshuyusya v post-apokalipticheskom mire, gde tsarit khaos.
Poprobuy ubezhat ot golodayushchikh i otchayavshikhsya lyudey, spryachsya, begi, srazhaysya i v tselom nikogda ne oglyadyvaysya nazad.

Osobennosti:
- Korotkaya dusherazdirayushchaya istoriya, kotoraya uderzhit vashe serdtse v kulake...
- Lichnoe puteshestvie, chtoby nauchitsya vyzhivat
- Skazka, napolnennaya uzhasom i otchayaniem...
- Krasochnoe iskusstvo soprovozhdaet vashe puteshestvie
- Priyatnoe sochetanie mezhdu platformerom i priklyuchencheskoy igroy.

title: Guards [NSZ][RUS/Multi3]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 3]
description:
Igrayte za komandu iz 4 geroev. Dayte otpor ordam monstrov, planiruyte khody i uluchshayte sposobnosti. Odoleyte protivnikov na vsekh urovnyakh i vstupite v smertelnuyu skhvatku s bossom!

Osobennosti
- Originalnaya poshagovaya sistema boya
- Vosem geroev, u kazhdogo iz nikh est unikalnye sposobnosti i sobstvennaya tekhnika boya
- Mnozhestvo dopolnitelnykh navykov i volshebnykh predmetov
- Svobodnyy vybor igrovoy taktiki
- Dopolnitelnye urovni slozhnosti, kotorye stanut sereznym ispytaniem dazhe dlya opytnykh strategov

Igrovoy protsess
Klyuchevaya osobennost igry – unikalnaya poshagovaya sistema boya. V vashem rasporyazhenii otryad iz chetyrekh geroev, troe iz kotorykh srazhayutsya na peredney linii, a posledniy vosstanavlivaet sily za spinami soyuznikov. Chtoby sdelat khod, nuzhno pomenyat dvukh lyubykh geroev mestami. Esli geroy vykhodit s zadney linii vpered, on primenyaet supersposobnost. K primeru, rytsar sotryasaet zemlyu, oglushaya vsekh protivnikov na linii, a okhotnitsa zaryazhaet luk energiey, vypuskaya strely odnovremenno vo vsekh protivnikov.

title: Hynpytol [NSZ][ENG]
description:
《白塞爾大冒險（HYNPYTOL）》是一款充滿90年代復古風格的動作解謎冒險遊戲，名稱「HYNPYTOL（흰피톨）」在韓文中意為「白血球」。
玩家將扮演被選中的「殺手T」，在「樹突狀」那稍顯冷漠(？)的引導下，展開一場拯救瀕臨崩潰的免疫系統的冒險之旅。

◆ 簡單卻多樣的擊掌互動！
面對重重困難的世界，「殺手T」唯一的武器就是「擊掌」！
從簡單的移動和對話，到清除感染細胞或搬運障礙物，
所有的互動都可以靠著一隻「手」輕鬆完成！

◆ 90年代美術風格與音效的全新詮釋
《白塞爾大冒險（HYNPYTOL）》取材自90年代的像素畫風與經典音效，重現那個時代的美好情懷。
不僅如此，遊戲也結合了現代元素，展現復古與現代交織的獨特魅力。
快來探索隱藏的彩蛋與復古元素，喚起你屬於那個年代的溫馨回憶吧！

◆「免疫系統」 —— 分辨「我們」和「你們」
深入身體內部，親身體驗免疫系統獨特的運作機制！
透過「圖鑑」，你可以了解免疫系統中每個角色的背景故事，讓你的冒險更加豐富多彩。
對了，別忘了挑戰《白塞爾大冒險（HYNPYTOL）》的「遊戲成就」！
或許，還有更多祕密等著你去發掘……

title: Wander Hero [NSP][ENG]
description:
特色傭兵：
團長可穿梭於異世界的各個城鎮：皮魔鎮，群山環繞景色宜人，打鐵聲絡繹不絕；亂霧村，盛行樹屋建築，樹木林立，小橋流水，宜居的不二選擇… …城鎮的「奇遇」「事件」還能助團長邂逅不同的傭兵，邀請他們組成最強傭兵團！訓練傭兵提陞技能，為他們購買裝備提昇實力，一起冒險奇妙異世界。
全部主要角色已搭載動態立繪！

精美立繪：
在異世界不斷邂逅美女夥伴！不同裝扮、不同個性甚至是不同種族，總有一款對你胃口。能變裝以蠱惑人心的新生魅魔、擁有強大戰力但喜愛黏人的騎士長、逃離少爺之手又酷愛冒險的戰鬥女僕......或許多逛逛酒館還可能打聽到有關於她們的傳聞哦~

角色彈珠：
每位角色都將化身一顆彈珠，輕輕拉出基準線，彈射後即可戰鬥！強大的團長也將通過基準線，預判力道和路徑，彈射更多的怪物。角色之間還能互相影響彈射效果，利用連動機制打出爽快的連擊！

夥伴聯動：
每一次異世界的冒險，團長都可以帶著自己組成的強大傭兵團夥伴，體驗每個週目不同的戰鬥體驗。每次協同戰鬥都有不同的戰鬥體驗，哪個組合才是消滅魔王的最佳組合，等你來探索！

技能卡牌：
異世界也散落了許多技能卡片，攻擊、防禦、buff牌各式各樣，收集並建構出屬於自己的流派。配合彈射打出深度策略！當然，偶爾也會拿到不合適的卡片，有所取捨才能讓卡組更強大。

關於開發者：
作者是Solo開發的死宅。
希望透過建構這個遊戲，與廣大穿越者一起完成心中的奇幻異世界夢想。
遊戲若有不足，希望大家理解，作者會盡力完善。如果您喜歡，也希望可以推薦給您的朋友。

title: Crush Your Enemies [NSZ][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
Vsem nam nadoeli eti standartnye miry, nabitye fenteziynymi klishe: otvazhnymi rytsaryami, zhenopodobnymi elfami i karlikami, oderzhimymi strastyu k zolotu i brilliantam. Tipichiya — sovershenno inoy mir. K schastyu, tut est zlobnye varvary, chtoby bylo komu grabit, nasazhivat golovy na kopya, pit pivo i nepristoyno vyrazhatsya — v obshchem, chtoby zhizn ne davala skuchat. I znaete chto? Ikh vozglavite vy!

Vernites v te dalekie dni, kogda vykhodili potryasayushchie strategii v realnom vremeni. No na sey raz vam ne pridetsya tratit tselyy chas na odnu stychku. Srazu v boy — stryakhnite pyl so svoikh strategicheskikh i takticheskikh navykov, chtoby sokrushit sotni vragov za paru minut! Crush Your Enemies — eto vse, chto vy lyubite v strategiyakh: planirovanie, shirokiy vybor yunitov razlichnykh tipov, upravlenie resursami, zakhvat vrazheskoy territorii i vozmozhnost perekhitrit protivnika neobychnym postroeniem otryadov. No vse eto strategicheskoe bogatstvo tak zdorovo upakovano, chto vam obespecheny zakhvatyvayushchie vpechatleniya nezavisimo ot togo, skolko vremeni u vas naydetsya na igru.

Osobennosti igry

- Polnotsennaya strategiya v kompaktnom formate: na vsekh urovnyakh vam budut predlozheny neochevidnye strategicheskie resheniya, no proyti urovni mozhno ochen bystro.
- Ochen prostoe upravleniya: ne smotrya na slozhnuyu strukturu igry, dlya upravleniya budet dostatochno odnogo kontrollera Joy-Con™.
- Grandioznaya odinochnaya kampaniya: igra predlagaet mnogo chasov naslazhdeniya strategiey v odinochnom rezhime.
- Setevoy i lokalnyy multipleer: igrayte s druzyami i blizkimi. Bitva ne dolzhna zakanchivatsya!
- Raznye tipy yunitov: u kazhdogo iz nikh svoya rol na pole boya.
- Trofei: iskusno primenyayte osobye predmety, kotorye pri umelom ispolzovanii mogut perelomit khod bitvy.
- Bitvy s neobychnymi bossami: srazhalis li vy kogda-nibud s Gigantskim Sliznem, kotoryy obozhaet bodatsya? Net? Tak chego zhe vy zhdete?
- Syuzhet, polnyy sochnogo yumora: vasha mamochka ne pereputaet etu igru s ee lyubimym poiskom skrytykh predmetov v srednevekovoy derevne!
- Nasilie, pivo, rugan: khvatit slov...

title: Alteric [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Eshche vchera vy byli chelovekom. 
Segodnya vsyo izmenilos.
Vy umerli.
No vasha dusha vsyo eshche sushchestvuet. Ona - chastichka svetloy energii v chuzherodnom prostranstve mezhdu dvukh mirov.

Alteric - eto:
Odinochnyy 2D-platformer
Yarkaya minimalistichnaya grafika
'Podzharivayushchiy zadnitsu' geympley s fizikoy, gravitatsiey i logikoy
2 vzaimodeystvuyushchikh drug s drugom parallelnykh izmereniya
Raznoobrazie prepyatstviy i opasneyshie bossy
Atmosfernyy saundtrek

title: Avia Corporation [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Avia corporation 邀請大家感受擁有航空公司的樂趣。這是一款經濟策略遊戲，您需要理性思考並仔細考慮每一步，來建設您夢寐以求的航空公司。在這個遊戲中，理性的方法和戰略計劃能力非常重要。

遊戲特點：

    利用初始資本來購買或租用飛機。隨著公司的發展，您的收入也會增長。
    隨機生成的超過一百種飛機模型。
    選擇超過一百四十個世界各地的目的地。
    根據城市的人口和受歡迎程度進行乘客流量統計系統。
    構建具有轉機功能的複雜航線。
    考慮天氣情況。

title: Mech Wars [NSP][ENG]
description:
很久以前，Stenian 族人在他們的機甲協助下，和諧的生活在 Xelarvis 星上。然而，當 Kaxeder 種族來到時，一切都改變了。他們入侵這個世界，意圖摧毀和征服它。Stenian 軍隊被擊敗，被迫逃到冰凍地區的一個古老居住地避難。當敵人開始佔領冰封區域時，希望似乎破滅了--也就是說，除了一位史坦尼亞人駕駛員，他即使孤軍奮戰，也要反擊。

儘管只剩他一個人，但這位史坦尼亞機師擊退了 Kaxeder 軍隊，並摧毀了負責消耗星球生命的科技發電機。在發現駕駛員的位置後，Kaxeder 總部現正迅速採取行動，制止他的肆虐。

幾個月後，史坦尼亞飛行員抵達冰霜區域的 Kaxeder 聚居地。該聚落戒備森嚴，試圖阻擋史坦尼亞族最後一隻泰坦機甲的到來。

現在，所有史坦尼亞人的希望都寄託在這位機師身上。
這個駕駛員就是你

您必須摧毀敵人的機甲，以及燃料箱、發電機、原子反應堆和敵人核心等目標，在激烈的 3D 戰鬥中，感受深沉的科幻氛圍和身歷其境的音效。為了幫助您，您可以選擇不同的機甲並調整它們的裝備。

拯救您的種族，船長！

title: Kofi Quest [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Vy budete upravlyat Kofi, slabym, lenivym i neudachlivym personazhem videoigry, za kotorym budet sledovat gruppa interesnykh (i zhalkikh) personazhey, pomogayushchikh emu perezhit bolshoe priklyuchenie.

Osobennosti igry:

Personazhi videoigr, kotorye znayut, chto oni personazhi videoigr.

Mekhanika iz RTS, RPG i graficheskogo priklyucheniya.

Issleduyte Neyborvud i raskroyte mnozhestvo sekretov.

Boy v realnom vremeni, pokhozhiy na Action RPG s upravleniem voyskami.

Gotovte svoi voyska k pobede.

Kapitany voysk so spetsialnymi navykami.

Istoriya pogruzit vas v komicheskoe priklyuchenie s massoy situatsiy i personazhey.

Ozvuchka!

Krutoy saundtrek, vdokhnovlennyy JRPG.

Tvoy mech sloman, a tvoy luchshiy drug kozyol, no ty mozhesh ezdit na lyutovolke.

title: 3 out of 10: Season One (Ep. 1-5) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Prisoedinyaytes k neskonchaemym priklyucheniyam razrabotchikov iz khudshey v mire studii videoigr i smotrite, kak geroi vykhodyat iz nelepykh i v to zhe vremya zlobodnevnykh situatsiy. Poluchitsya li u nikh sozdat igru, kotoraya poluchit otsenku vyshe chem 3 iz 10? Ostavaytes s nami, chtoby uznat.

Pomimo vsekh 5 epizodov pervogo sezona «3 iz 10», osobyy nabor takzhe vklyuchaet:

• Bezgranichnye issledovaniya v svobodnom rezhime: izuchayte vse, chto vidite, bez ogranicheniy, chtoby uznat bolshe o mire igry «3 iz 10». Udastsya li vam nayti vse retro-igry?
• Ofitsialnyy saundtrek: polnyy saundtrek k pervomu sezonu sitkoma-igry «3 iz 10» soderzhit 40 minut eklektichnoy, legko zapominayushcheysya i effektnoy muzyki. Vklyuchaet treki ot Mayka Mirabello (kompozitor Tower of Guns i Mothergunship) pri uchastii Krisa Zukovski.
• Bolshie golovy: vy kogda-nibud mechtali o tom, chtoby posmotret sitkom, gde u geroev ogromnye golovy? Vasha mechta sbylas!
• Kommentarii glavnykh razrabotchikov: v «3 iz 10» mnogo unikalnykh veshchey, i razrabotchiki Dzho Mirabello i Kris Zukovski gotovy podelitsya sekretami o sozdanii pervogo v mire sitkoma-igry.
• Galereya kontsept-artov: polyubuytes na rannie kontsept-arty, chto legli v osnovu «3 iz 10»!
• Profili akterov: uznayte bolshe ob akterakh, kotorye igrayut choknutykh personazhey igry «3 iz 10».

Eto angloyazychnaya versiya igry bez subtitrov na russkom yazyke

title: Chinese Parents [NSZ][ENG]
description:
This is probably the most heart-warming simulation game you have ever played.
As a child born in an ordinary family, there is a journey ahead of you, a journey of growth from birth to adult——
Faced with the choices in life, how would you respond?
Faced with the talented kids, can you stand out?
Faced with your true love, how would you deal with your heart...
The most important thing is that in this era of rapid development, how many generations will you need?

title: Choices That Matter 1-3: And The Sun Went Out / And Their Souls Were Eaten / And Their Heroes Were Lost [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Chto by sluchilos, esli by Solntse vdrug neobyasnimo ischezlo, chtoby vernutsya snova — cherez neskolko chasov? Provedite rassledovanie vmeste so svoim tovarishchem, II Moti, raskryvayte zagovory, otkroyte drevnie religii, puteshestvuyte po miru.
«Vybory, kotorye imeyut znachenie, i pogasshee Solntse» — eto epicheskaya tekstovaya priklyuchencheskaya igra v serii «Choices That Matter», soderzhashchaya okolo 600000 slov i 2400 raznykh igrovykh vyborov! Kazhdyy raz, kogda vy zavershaete odnu iz 10 syuzhetnykh arok, vy mozhete uznat, skolko drugikh igrokov zakanchivayut syuzhet v tom zhe meste, chto i vy. Vy pobyvaete v raznykh stranakh i mestakh, ustanovite blizkie otnosheniya s raznymi personazhami i, v konechnom itoge, dostignete finala, v kotorom vasha sudba i sudba vashego II-kompanona, Moti budet ochen, ochen razlichna.
Eto — vashe puteshestvie, i tolko vash vybor pomozhet raskryt pravdu. Ved Solntse uzhe zashlo..
Vklyucheny 3 chasti Choices That Matter:

title: Royal Adviser [NSP][ENG]
performance: 是 (在 6.2.0 Atmosphere) s ignorirovaniem versiy
description: In Royal Adviser the players take on the roles of court advisers of an old King and attempt to seize power for themselves. Each player has a secret goal that they must achieve by manipulating the kingdom and advising the King on daily issues. They can also form secret alliances, spy, and accuse each other of their ambitions.  One match takes about 20-30 minutes.

title: Bury me my Love [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Igra "Bury me, my Love" povedaet vam istoriyu siriyskoy bezhenki po imeni Nur i ee muzha Mazhda. Nur otpravlyaetsya v riskovannoe puteshestvie v poiskakh bezopasnoy zhizni v Evrope.

"Bury me, my Love" – eto syuzhetnaya igra v vide obmena tekstovymi soobshcheniyami. Ee glavnoy geroiney yavlyaetsya Nur, siriyskaya migrantka, kotoraya pytaetsya popast v Evropu. Ee suprug Mazhd, kotoryy ostalsya v Sirii, obshchaetsya s Nur v messendzhere i staraetsya nayti dlya nee naibolee bezopasnyy put k tseli. 

"Bury me, my love" – eto siriyskaya fraza proshchaniya. Ona priblizitelno oznachaet: "Beregi sebya, dazhe ne dumay umeret ranshe menya". Eti slova priobretayut bolee glubokiy smysl, poskolku Mazhd govorit ikh svoey zhene, Nur, kogda ona otpravlyaetsya v svoe polnoe opasnostey puteshestvie v Evropu. 

Sovmestnoe proizvodstvo ARTE, The European cultural network, The Pixel Hunt i Figs.

 
***Igra v vide obmena mgnovennymi soobshcheniyami v messendzhere
V roli Mazhda vy budete obshchatsya s Nur na protyazhenii vsego ee puti do Evropy, kak esli by obmenivalis s ney tekstovymi soobshcheniyami cherez SMS. Vy budete pisat drug drugu soobshcheniya i obmenivatsya smaylikami, izobrazheniyami, selfi i nuzhnymi ssylkami… 

*** Mnozhestvo putey razvitiya syuzheta
Chitaya soobshcheniya i vybiraya varianty otveta, igroki pomogayut Nur preodolevat trudnosti, s kotorymi ona stalkivaetsya. 
V "Bury me, my Love" vash vybor deystvitelno vliyaet na sobytiya: Nur smozhet posetit 50 razlichnykh mest, predusmotreny 19 raznykh kontsovok ee istorii s sovershenno raznymi iskhodami. 

*** Osnovana na realnykh sobytiyakh 
"Bury me, my Love" – eto "igra, vdokhnovlennaya deystvitelnostyu", dokumentalnaya proza, osnovannaya na sobytiyakh realnogo mira. Originalnaya ideya igry voznikla iz stati zhurnalistki Le Monde Lyusi Sule, rasskazyvayushchey istoriyu Dany, molodoy siriyskoy zhenshchiny, kotoraya bezhala iz svoey strany i teper zhivet v Germanii.

Etot opyt pomozhet probudit chutkost v molodezhi.

title: Art Sqool [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Vozmite na sebya rol molodogo studenta, brodite po kampusu i vypolnyayte zadaniya, dannye vam professorom. Zvuchit skuchno? Professor predstavlyaet soboy neyronnuyu set, a kampus raspolozhen na neskolkikh plavuchikh ostrovakh i zapolnen obektami i rasteniyami prichudlivoy formy iz etogo mira. Krome togo, vy mozhete letat.

No podozhdite, a kak naschet zadaniy? Chto nuzhno risovat?
Zhivopis, vmeste s issledovaniem mira, yavlyaetsya samym vazhnym v etoy igre. Inogda vam budet predlozheno perenesti opredelennyy obekt iz igrovoy oblasti na virtualnyy kholst, inogda vam nuzhno budet narisovat loshad… No obychno vy mozhete prosto dat volyu svoemu voobrazheniyu - eto igra, kotoraya probudit vashe tvorchestvo. Ne volnuytes, esli dumaete, chto ne vy ne khudozhnik. Art Sqool dokazhet obratnoe.

No ved bez kistey ne byvaet zhivopisi? Vy mozhete sobirat novye, no snachala ikh nuzhno budet nayti! Na territorii kampusa spryatano bolee desyatka kistey. Poluchite ikh vsekh!

Klyuchevye osobennosti:
BUD KREATIVNYM. Professor deystvitelno klassnyy chuvak. A zhivopis - eto razvlechenie, tak chto skhodite s uma! Bolee 200 vdokhnovlyayushchikh podskazok pomogut preodolet lyuboy tvorcheskiy blok.
ISSLEDUY UDIVITELNYY MIR. Vy nikogda ne videli nichego podobnogo.
RASSLABLYaYSYa. Konechno, v igre est zadaniya, no ona takzhe pozvolyaet igrokam rasslabitsya: oni mogut otdokhnut pod priyatnuyu muzyku i rasslablennyy temp igry.
BUD KOLLEKTsIONEROM. Naydite i soberite neobychnye kisti, kotorye pomogut vam v tvorcheskom protsesse. Po vsey karte est skrytye instrumenty, takie kak figurnaya kist, raduzhnyy karandash i… vodnaya kist.

title: Body of Evidence [NSZ][ENG]
description:
FEATURES:
• Full of black humor.
• Many ways to complete each level.
• 30 different flats with unique crime scenes.
• Advanced hiding body mechanic.
• Advanced ragdoll effects - lift, bend, move, drop, squeeze naturally.
• Music by Draco Nared

BECOME THE "CLEANER"
Become a dead body disposal specialist!
As a “cleaner” you need to get rid of the body and make sure there is no evidence left behind.
Remember, you’re on a clock. Think fast, use proper tools, and don’t mess up…
Leave one smear of blood and you’re in trouble. All of this in a low-poly noir style.

HIDE BODIES BEFORE IT IS TOO LATE!
Hide the body in a locker, dump it off the coast or put it in a barrel full of acid, the choice is yours!
Start with some simple cleanups, work your way up by completing new orders.
No jobs are the same, but each one requires you to be quick and professional!

GET INTO THE WORLD OF CRIME
Develop your own style, accept jobs from the cops to the mafia, and find a unique way to complete each one of them.
Meet new characters on your way up. Follow the storyline full of plot twists, low-poly bloody scenes, wicked sense of humour and tons of references.
Always stay sharp, expect the unexpected, and of course... leave no evidence.

VARIOUS MECHANICS
Can’t open the door? Get that lockpick out and work that lock.
Use a mop, a brush soaked in some soap, or a nearby hose to make the mess disappear.
You should probably use some luminol to expose some hidden blood stains as well…
Cuz the police won’t miss those!
Then just leave carrying the corpse in a body bag like nothing ever happened.

THERE IS NO TIME FOR FEAR
Every order is not just a body to ditch, but also a race against time.
Any blood stains left behind will only lead you to one place…
Fuck up one order for the mafia, and you better start digging your own grave.
Body Of Evidence is full of dangers, and if you want to exist in this business, don’t let the fear beat you.

title: Before I Forget [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Issleduyte nastoyashchee, chtoby uznat proshloe v etoy korotkoy istorii o lyubvi, potere i schastlivo-prozhitoy zhizni.
Povestvovatelnyy kvest v mire, gde vospominaniya tuskneyut i smeshivayutsya. Igra o pomutnenii rassudka i o tom, chto byvaet, kogda ot vas uskolzaet vsyo, chto vy delali, i vse, kogo vy lyubili.

title: Terrorhythm Trrt [NSZ][ENG]
description:
V seredine XXV veka mir prishel k totalnoy zvukovoy diktature, pogruzivshey ego v tishinu. Ona prochno zavladela mirom, i tolko vam pod silu vernut chelovechestvu zvuki i muzyku. Poka est te, kto pomnyat melodii proshlogo, nadezhda zhivet. My eshche mozhem pobedit terror. Sleduyte za ritmom i pobezhdayte zashchitnye sistemy, skryvayushchie zvuk ot lyudey. Beytes pod muzyku, beytes za muzyku!

OSOBENNOSTI
- Khardkornaya ritmichnaya beat 'em up igra v stile kiberpank s yarkoy animatsiey personazhey i zrelishchnye effekty
- Dinamichnye skhvatki s polchishchami khraniteley polnoy tishiny
- Slushayte ritm i sobirayte kombo, chtoby nanosit moshchnye dalnoboynye ataki
- Novyy igrovoy opyt: mezhdu bitom i dvizheniem vashego personazha est pryamaya svyaz
- V igre neskolko urovney slozhnosti, vklyuchaya slozhnyy rezhim dlya tekh, kto khochet stavit rekordy

title: Dark Witch Music Episode Rudymical [NSZ][ENG]
description:
．以高畫質重現原作的世界觀
．知名樂曲製作人【來兔】所製作的遊戲樂曲
．多位知名的插圖畫家製作的美術

這就是魔神少女風格的音樂遊戲!

【露蒂節奏】 遊戲介紹◆
規則非常簡單!依照樂曲的節奏，點觸畫面上半部，或是畫面下半部!
．點選下半部 就會使出「斬擊」
．點選上半部 就會使出「跳躍」

title: Eat Beat Deadspike-san [NSP][ENG]
description:
"EAT BEAT DEADSPIKE-san" is a rhythm action game spin-off of the 2D-fighting game series, "BLAZBLUE", that features Dead Spike-san in an eating frenzy.

■How to Play
The controls are simple, tap the buttons to the beat and eat the incoming food! 
Enjoy the music of "BLAZBLUE" while having Dead Spike-san eat as much food as possible!

■Featuring a total of 20 playable songs!
There are 3 difficulties: "Easy", "Normal", or "Hard" for each of the songs.
Anyone can enjoy playing by choosing the appropriate difficulty.

■AWARD system for replayability!
A total of 14 objectives to challenge yourself!

Simple and interesting!
Groove to the rhythm and aim to achieve high calories(score)!

title: Hocus 2 [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
hocus。 是繼續。 這一次一切都是動態的。 它具有新的機制和幻覺組合，具有許多創造性的解決可能性。


• 迄今為止 85 個手工製作的創意關卡
• 9 種不同的機制
• 由 Yunus Ayyıldız 設計和開發
• 本傑明·蒂索 (Benjamin Tissot) 的音樂

title: Urban Cards [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Urban Cards - svezhiy vzglyad na zhanr sozdaniya kolod, gde vasha tsel - zarabatyvat dengi bystree chem vash opponent, ne zabyvaya o svoyom dolge i vragakh.
V dannom rogalike kartochnykh srazheniy vy srazites s akulolyudom, razrabotchikami, kreditorami, gangsterami kazino... I, nakonets, protivostoite ugnetayushchey vlasti Pravitelstva.

Sama igra yavlyaetsya satiroy s 3 fraktsiyami i igrovymi stilyami na vybor.

Oper: tsarstvo generalnogo direktora-millionera, kostyuma trudogolika i opasnoy akuley ulybki rostovshchika. Khot on i osleplyon shchedrymi bonusami, budte ostorozhny s ego svirepym appetitom k dolgam.

Akibara: dolina tekhnologiy kontroliruemaya geymerami, khakerami i neonovymi ognyami. Zdes na dannykh drugikh lyudey delayutsya sostoyaniya bitkoinov, za etim vsem prismatrivaet starshiy brat.

Gaztaun: odnovremenno s upravleniem ulitsami, bednye i zabytye zhiteli umeyut sabotirovat svoego protivnika, vorovat u ego biznesa. Eta fraktsiya "sdelay ili umri" ne uklonyaetsya ot zdorovoy dozy fizicheskogo nasiliya dlya dostizheniya svoikh tseley.

Osobennosti:
Soberite i otredaktiruyte svoyu kolodu iz razlichnykh 138 kart.
Vyberite iz tryokh raznykh fraktsiy so svoimi nachalnymi kolodami: Oper, Akibara, Gaztaun.
Tshchatelno upravlyayte razlichnymi tipami imeyushchikhsya kart: Biznesy, Rabochie, Prispeshniki, Deystviya i Predmety.
Primite vyzov i prolozhite put po protsedurno-sgenerirovannoy kampanii s 20+ Sobytiyami i mnozhestvom chasov reigrabelnosti.
Bolee desyatka vragov budet stoyat na vashem puti k uspekhu, ot bossov band do otaku i kreditorov. Prigotovtes svergnut samogo bolshogo moshennika sredi nikh - Pravitelstvo!
Soberite 30+ spetsialnykh predmetov, kotorye pomgut vam zarabotat eshchyo bolshe deneg!
Igrayte protiv drugikh lyudey 1 na 1!

title: Witch of the Meta Loop [NSZ][ENG]
description:
+ 和你可靠的伙伴一起探索整個小島，踏過麥浪和雪原，遊覽圖書館並攀登魔法高塔。
+ 上百種能力供你選擇，建構出你獨有的風格！
+ 與島上各具魅力的原住民們一起，找出孤島中的秘密，揭開魔王背後的真相！

title: Challenge Letter from Greco Calculation Castle and Ghosts [NSP][ENG (Mod.)/JAP]
description:
«Greko i prizraki» nauchat vas matematike na Nintendo Switch! Predstavlyaem vam PO dlya obucheniya, kotoroe pozvolit vam poluchat udovolstvie, igraya na konsoli.
Delayte matematicheskie uprazhneniya, izuchennye v nachalnoy shkole. Zdes budet 10 etapov obucheniya, nachinaya s 1-go klassa nachalnoy shkoly i vklyuchaya vychisleniya s dvumya i chetyrmya tsiframi vplot do 3-go klassa.

title: Recolit [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Vash kosmicheskiy korabl terpit krushenie, i vy okazyvaetes v mrachnom gorode, kotoryy vyglyadit tak zhe, kak i vse ostalnye, no v nem est chto-to neobychnoe. Ego zhiteli zhivut svoey povsednevnoy zhiznyu, kak ni v chem ne byvalo, khotya nebo nad ikh golovami vsegda chernoe.
Odin chelovek khochet chto-nibud vypit. Drugoy khochet poigrat s golubem. Pomogaya im v etikh melochakh, vy prodvigaetes k tomu, chto deystvitelno vazhno.
Tainstvennaya devushka, kotoruyu vy vstretili po puti, govorit vam: «Vsyo v poryadke. Ya budu zhdat tebya.» Rekolit — priklyuchencheskaya golovolomka v stile piksel-arta, v kotoroy vy ishchete svet v gorode, gde noch nikogda ne konchaetsya..

title: Megalan 11 [NSZ][RUS/Multi4]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 4]
description:
這是一款探索解謎遊戲。 不幸的救援人員只有 11 天的時間來擺脫這個長期被所有人遺棄的星球上的陷阱。

一次科考船捕捉到求救信號，但由於著陸不成功，救援行動徹底失敗。 您將不得不尋找庇護所並適應紅色星球的惡劣條件，即使船員中有五個人，您也只能依靠自己。

你必須探索廢棄的基地並保衛它，在沙漠中進行突襲並收集金屬進行設備維修。

title: Headland [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Headland是一個充滿鮮明色彩和呆萌生物的奇幻想像世界。但邪惡的外來力量打算竊取這個世界的美好事物以及色彩。與諾爾一起展開飛天遁地的冒險，幫助他修復想像力核心，拯救心像世界吧！
・探索心像世界裡各個色彩繽紛的島嶼
・與想像力投射出的怪物群戰鬥，讓你的力量升級
・收集藍圖並擴建你的特殊武器庫
・在活熔爐消耗資源並升級你的武器
・結識心像世界的居民並幫助他們解決問題
・探索邪惡的蒼白守衛背後目的
・還有一個專用的跳舞按鍵！

title: Tauronos [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Geroy brosaetsya v drevniy labirint, v kotorom on dolzhen stolknutsya s psikhicheskim i psikhologicheskim vyzovom na svoyom puti k ego tsentru - mestu, gde bylo obeshchano nayti znanie - v to vremya, kak mificheskiy Minotavr presleduet ego.

Unikalnyy geympley
Odin vrag: prakticheski neuyazvimyy minotavr - igrok dolzhen nayti sposob pobedit ego k kontsu svoego puteshestviya.
Uluchsheniya, sekrety i nagrady razbrosany po vsemu labirintu i igrok mozhet ikh sobrat, no khitrost v tom, chto eto trebuet nekotorogo vremeni, za kotoroe Minotavr stanovitsya vsyo blizhe i blizhe.

Tyomnaya atmosfera
Igra vdokhnovlena grecheskim mifom o labirinte i borboy mezhdu Teseem i Minotavrom. Tyomnaya tema vizualno vyrazhena piksel-artom v stile retro, obogashchena golosovym ozvuchivaniem i metaforicheskim povestvovaniem, sozdayushchim (my nadeemsya) zakhvatyvayushchuyu atmosferu.

Labirint
Puteshestvie sostoit iz 6 glav, kazhdaya iz kotorykh s sobstvennymi zadachami, strukturoy, dizaynom i nagradami. V obshchey slozhnosti 42 urovnya, 5 urovney uluchsheniya navykov (s kazhdymi tremya urovnyami), 3 skrytykh uluchsheniya, 2 unikalnykh uluchsheniya, sekretnye prokhody i paskhalnye yaytsa. 

Dobrosovestnoe preduprezhdenie
Eta igra ne yavlyaetsya roguelike dungeon crawler'om. Skoree, eto opyt, kotoryy v konechnom itoge dast vam otvet na vopros: osmelivaetes li vy poznat sebya? Konechno, vy mozhete smotret na neyo kak na prostuyu arkadu, no vozmite na zametku: permanentnaya smert besposhchadna.

title: Metroplex Zero [NSZ][ENG]
description:
組建你的小隊，定制你的套牌，獲得強大的控制論增強，並對抗邪惡的巨型企業！
您的小隊中可以包含各種獨特的英雄，每個英雄都有自己獨特的遊戲玩法。每個英雄都可以獲得不同的技能。想丟手榴彈和射擊步槍嗎？用動力護盾保護你的隊伍？讓你的敵人遭受強烈的心理痛苦？躲在陰影中等待出擊的最佳時機？這一切你都可以做到！將您想要的英雄放入您的隊伍中，並協同他們的技能，創造雙重無限的遊戲風格！
2280 年，歐亞大陸被殘酷的超級資本主義大企業統治。為了抵抗資本主義的暴政，你需要強大起來。面對有著自己動機的狡猾敵人。努力應對錯綜複雜的道德細微差別。遇見邪惡而富有詩意的天才、快樂而邪惡的人工智慧、自我毀滅的機器人。
透過贏得戰鬥為你的英雄獲得強大的卡牌。客製化你的牌組來制定你自己的小隊策略。你永遠不會被迫將任何你不喜歡的卡牌帶入戰鬥。在您的策略指導下，您的每位英雄都會將完美的 12 張卡牌帶入戰鬥。在每場戰鬥之前，偵察你的敵人並選擇理想的卡牌來對付他們。
有不同的英雄可供選擇，每個英雄都有其獨特且令人驚訝的遊戲玩法。在跑步過程中，您將能夠獲得新卡。當你升級你的英雄時，你可以獲得特殊的外科植入物，並獲得強大的控制論增強。
遊戲特色：
- 完全客製化您的套牌。為每個英雄選擇您想要的 12 張卡片。
- 超過 250 張不同的卡牌，可融合各種遊戲風格和構建
- 超過 70 個獨特的改變遊戲規則的增強功能
- 9位英雄，每個英雄都有不同的玩法
- 每次運行中多次升級你的英雄
- 每次獲得足夠的經驗值時，選擇自己的升級獎勵
- 超過 30 種不同的敵人
- 在扣人心弦的賽博龐克迷你故事中做出改變生活的道德決定

title: Radio Hammer Station [NSZ][ENG]
description:
在城市裡大受歡迎的地下電台「RADIOHAMMER STATION」
人氣DJ們平常在節目中為觀眾們帶來動人的音樂，
當城市有危險的時候，則會化身為正義的英雄，
揮舞巨大的槌子打擊邪惡！

title: Neon Beats [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Neon Beats 是一款 2D 側視平台遊戲，玩家將在不同的關卡中進化，這些關卡都以動聽的音樂為節奏。

儘快完成關卡！
收集多種隱藏的收藏品！
勇敢面對不同的挑戰障礙！

在 Neon Beats 中，您會發現 ：
- 8 個不同的關卡，每個關卡都有自己的音樂
- 以節奏為基礎的遊戲
- 流暢且反應迅速的控制角色
- 簡單優雅的霓虹燈氛圍
- 多種具有挑戰性的關卡元素
- 隱藏的收藏品可為音樂添加樂器
- 根據您的時間、收藏品和死亡次數計算得分的系統

title: Rhythm Fighter [NSZ][ENG]
description:
亂奏大將軍，宇宙中最臭名昭著的拍拍星人，終於把他邪惡的目光投向了地球，轉瞬間毀掉了動物與蔬菜們平靜的生活。亂奏大將軍使用黑暗拍拍原力，將蔬菜們統統變成邪惡的爪牙。它們在世界各地持續暴走，無數的動物英雄犧牲了。亂奏大將軍毀滅地球的邪惡目的眼看就要得逞了。
就在這危急存亡的關頭，同樣來自拍拍星球的神秘男人——狄哥降臨了！他使用光明拍拍原力，復活了倒下的英雄們。在這神秘力量的加持之下，英雄們掌握了跟隨節奏擊敗黑暗的戰斗方法，於是踏上了他們拯救星球的征程。然而，狄哥真正的目的，卻始終沒人知道……
《節奏快打》是一款結合了橫版動作闖關與節奏元素的狠遊戲。在遊戲中，你需要踩准節拍，拳拳到肉，在跟隨音樂戰鬥的同時，還要注意走位、翻滾、擊飛、連擊……與強大的對手剛正面，打出你的招牌連招。
隨機生成的戰斗場景，充滿驚喜的特殊房間，上百種炫酷技能與手感各異的強力武器，隨機掉落，每次戰鬥，都能給你船新的體驗。
DJ、特工、小學生……持續更新中的奇葩英雄，從人設到風格，從技能到操作，各自獨有的特色玩法，讓人無法拒絕。
超多武器和技能道具N種組合，每次出擊都能騷操作。

title: Curious Cases [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Im raskryto bolshe del, chem mozhno sebe predstavit. On pristupil k rabote srazu zhe, kak tolko drugie zashli v tupik.

3 glavy
Igra sostoit iz 3 glav, kazhdaya iz kotorykh otkryvaetsya v kontse predydushchey.

Story
Uchenyy propal bez vesti, zayaviv, chto im sdelano potryasayushchee otkrytie! Neobychaynyy sluchay ego ischeznoveniya iz zapertogo kabineta lish s odnim vykhodom srazu zhe privlek vnimanie detektiva Mura. Sovremennoy legendoy - detektivom Tomasom Murom raskryto bolshe del, chem mozhno sebe predstavit. On pristupil k rabote srazu zhe, kak tolko drugie zashli v tupik. Nekotorye iz raskrytykh im situatsiy byli znachitelno slozhnee, no on vsegda nakhodil vykhod. Na etot raz vse obstoit inache ... Chto-to idet ne tak, kak budto v igre uchastvuyut vysshie sily ...

title: We. The Revolution [NSZ][ENG]
description:
We. The Revolution — unikalnaya igra s neobychnym khudozhestvennym stilem, sobytiya kotoroy proiskhodyat v krovavom i paranoidalnom mire Frantsuzskoy Revolyutsii, gde druzey ochen slozhno otlichit ot vragov. Buduchi sudey Revolyutsionnogo tribunala, Vy budete vynosit prigovory i vesti opasnuyu politicheskuyu igru. Takzhe Vam pridetsya obosnovyvat svoi resheniya pered rodnymi, u kotorykh mozhet byt sovsem inaya tochka zreniya.

Vlast nad chelovecheskoy zhiznyu i smertyu — tyazheloe bremya, kotoroe mozhet povliyat na sudbu revolyutsii. Imeyte eto v vidu kazhdyy raz pri vynesenii prigovora v zale suda, davaya zadaniya svoim agentam i pletya politicheskie intrigi. We. The Revolution rasschitana preimushchestvenno na igrokov, kotorym nravitsya reshat moralnye dilemmy, delat slozhnyy lichnostnyy vybor i pogruzhatsya v mir politicheskikh khitrospleteniy.

title: Heads Up Phones Down edition [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Vremya viktorin!.. Prodemonstriruyte smekalku v etoy veseloy igre dlya vecherinok ot 2 do 4 igrokov, dlya bolshogo ekrana!
Heads Up — eto igra dlya vecherinok Povernites spinoy k televizoru i s pomoshchyu druzey ili rodnykh poprobuyte ugadat slovo ili frazu na ekrane.

title: Exorder [NSZ][ENG]
description:
你可以暢遊我們數小時的單人戰役，也可連線多人模式與朋友進行決鬥。
同時，更可以跨平臺通過挑戰模式提升你的指揮本領。

遊戲特性：
單人模式設有十二個奇幻任務。
8張跌宕起伏的挑戰地圖。
跨平臺全球多人遊戲模式。
十餘種超酷技能的兵種。


關於遊戲：
蔚藍王國需要一位新的君主！國王過世以後，碧拉公主以及其哥哥崔斯坦王子，要為繼承權一較高下。在敵友不明朗的狀況下，誰會是蔚藍王國的勝者和最終的君王？

在遊戲五彩斑斕的外表下，蘊含著精心為玩家設計的戰術系統。瞭解你的兵種力量，以此來抗擊超越你的對手，並率領你的軍隊取得勝利！該遊戲是一扇打開轉向戰略（TBT）遊戲的打門，有趣易玩。同時，也為尋求更多挑戰的玩家提供了複雜的戰略玩法。

追隨碧拉公主，勇闖奇幻般的蔚藍王國一集其三個鄰國的12個人物的單人戰役。完美指揮《EXORDER》世界中光怪陸離的兵種其所需的各項本領。

多人遊戲模式中，你可以任意選擇線上配對或隨機小衝突戰鬥。與隨機抽選出的、實力相當的玩家進行對戰。擊敗你的敵人，登上全球英雄榜！也可以線上或離線自訂最多四人的多人小隊。


本遊戲開發僅由三人組成的Solid9 Studio完成，祝你在《EXORDER》的世界中玩得愉快！

title: Lazriel the Demon's Fall [NSZ][ENG]
description:
『墮入魔界的拉茲瑞爾』是集合了卡牌、Rogue-like與黑化要素的遊戲。你將扮演誤入魔界的天使，在屈服於惡魔的力量之前登上塔頂，重返天界。

為了在魔界獨自求生，即便是天使有時也不得不借助惡魔的力量。
但若是對此過於仰賴，沉澱在體內的罪孽會對身心都造成極大影響。
究竟拉茲瑞爾能否登上塔頂，平安無事地返回天界？

title: Nine Nights Martial Ci Lang Story [NSZ][ENG]
description:
你不甘失敗，在危機重重的九夜世界中奔跑，不斷學習新的戰鬥技能，激烈戰鬥，靈活機智地跨越重重障礙，與日益兇惡詭異的敵人頑強對抗。艱難地復仇。


面對不同類型的敵人，你需要策略性地戰鬥。
腿部攻擊可以更有效地摧毀敵人的防禦。
鎬攻擊可以更有效地對抗地下敵人。
擁有適合自己的強大武力系統，是殺手生存的保證。 使用您獲得的獎勵來升級您的戰鬥動作，增強您的技能，或購買武器和道具以在需要時使用。
跳躍攻擊對更高的敵人更有效。
將敵人吸引得更近，以便使用終極技能更有效地進行攻擊。
更多可能的攻擊組合等待你的創意發揮。

title: Shikon-X Astro Defense Fortress [NSZ][ENG]
description: 向著星辰大海踏上史詩般的旅途，揭開威脅全人類的戰爭背後的謎團。就算是面對著宇宙尺度的重大威脅，也別忘了抽空玩彈珠台！

title: Funtasia [NSZ][ENG]
description:
It's time to take a drive on the Furry Road! Funtasia is a side-scrolling, 2D racing game where the goal is simple: Drive as fast as possible to reach the finish line. Help save the beautiful, ecologically sustainable world of Funtasia and its furry inhabitants from certain death beneath tons of garbage dumped on it from space.

Simple to pick up and play, yet challenging to truly master, Funtasia is all about timing and balance. The race track ripples, with hills, pits, bridges, quicksand, cliffs, and caves separating you from the finish line. Reaching the finish line requires balancing gas, brakes, and the car itself, just right (drivers do not enjoy meeting hard surfaces face-first at a hundred KPH, nor do doctors recommend it).

Oh, and keep in mind that there's no stopping, there's only going really, really fast. Breaks are for cowards. The car's battery isn't known for its lifespan!


Save Funtasia, a paradise full of furry animals, from an apocalyptic wave of garbage by driving really, really fast over 10 fantastical tracks.
Master 40 different cars, with their own performance, challenges, and idiosyncrasies!
Survive boss fights with foes equal parts twisted and dastardly.
Brave the Furry Road all alone or as a duo with Cooperative or Challenge modes.
Challenge players across the world in online leaderboards to claim the top spot in going fast
Experience a fanciful art style by Italian artist Emanuele Olives drawing inspirations from Heinz Edelmenn’s work on Adventure Time, and Troma.

title: Rogue Robots [NSZ][ENG]
description:
A dlya etogo pridetsya istrebit ogromnoe chislo lyudey. Ostorozhnee! Ikh zadacha — unichtozhit chelovechestvo. Sudba vsego lyudskogo roda v tvoikh rukakh. Khvatit li u tebya khrabrosti vypolnit etu missiyu?

Novyy shuter-rogalik, polnyy ekshena i sochashchiysya adrenalinom, vzorvet tebe mozgi i sneset tebya s nashey planety! On uzhe zdes!

Ot sozdateley legendarnykh Drunk-Fu i Spareware! My predstavlyaem sikvel Spareware.

Stop, minutochku. No ved Spareware — eto…

«Krayne primitivnaya igra s ogranichennoy mekhanikoy i odnoobraznym geympleem».

«Snosnyy shuter — ne menshe, no i ne bolshe».

«Nudyatina — mne bystro nadoelo… Igra prakticheski nichem ne vydelyaetsya».

I IMENNO POETOMU eto bolshe ne Spareware! Dorogie lyudi i prisheltsy, vstrechayte: Rogue Robots! Postroy svoego robota-istrebitelya i probey sebe dorogu skvoz tolpy chelovekov, unichtozhayushchikh svoyu prekrasnuyu planetu Zemlya.

Tebe pridetsya stolknutsya s politseyskimi otryadami budushchego, kotorye zhazhdut tvoego masla i khotyat smesti tebya s poverkhnosti planety. Esli tvoy robot pogibnet, to uzhe navsegda, a sluchaynye karty s ulitsami, nabitymi vragami, budut razvlekat tebya dolgie chasy. 

V Rogue Robot est kooperativnyy rezhim, kotoryy podderzhivaet do 4 chelovek i pozvolyaet razvlekatsya s druzyami.

A chto zhe togda ostalos ot Spareware? Kak obychno, samoe luchshee:

«Pulevoy ad s izmenyaemymi robotam».

«Krepkiy shuter s elementami rogalika, vsego odnoy zhiznyu i takticheskimi resheniyami».

Postroy svoyu mashinu unichtozheniya iz raznykh detaley, kazhdaya iz kotorykh vliyaet na tvoi sposobnosti. Vybiray oruzhie. Osteregaysya lovushek. Probivaysya cherez ordy vragov. Spasi chelovechestvo ot samogo sebya.

title: PopSlinger / Pop Slinger Vol. 2 Loveless [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Prisoedinyaytes k volshebnoy devushke s gazirovannymi pistoletami v mechtatelnom priklyuchenii, zashchitaya svoy dom ot zloveshchikh vragov v muzykalnom ekshene, napolnennom strelboy! PopSlinger — yarkiy muzykalnyy shuter s povestvovatelnoy napravlennostyu, vdokhnovlennyy kulturoy New Wave'a 80-kh i 90-kh godov.
Okunites v prichudlivuyu istoriyu Rii i Dzhin, srazhayushchikhsya s «Korazonami», lyudmi, chi serdtsa byli isporcheny temnymi silami iz drugogo izmereniya, i vse eto pod dinamichnyy saundtrek, kotoryy reagiruet na vashi deystviya v igre v realnom vremeni!

title: The Magnificent Trufflepigs [NSP][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
The Magnificent Trufflepigs — eto romantichnaya igra ot pervogo litsa, v kotoroy vam predstoit vooruzhitsya metalloiskatelem i otpravitsya na poiski. Vy igraete za Adama — ostrogo na yazyk, no ponimayushchego cheloveka, kotoryy spustya dolgie gody vozvrashchaetsya v rodnuyu derevnyu Stenning, chtoby pomoch devushke po imeni Bet nayti sokrovishche. Bet rasplanirovala svoyu zhizn ot i do, no kogda idealnaya kartinka nachinaet rassypatsya, ee zhizn otkryvaetsya s novoy storony. Vybiraya otvety Adama, pomogite Bet odolet demonov ee razuma.

Meditativnye progulki s metalloiskatelem po bezmyatezhnoy angliyskoy glubinke dopolnyayutsya moshchnoy istoriey o chelovecheskikh vzaimootnosheniyakh. The Magnificent Trufflepigs — eto igra o poiskakh, atmosfera kotoroy napominaet tipichnoe angliyskoe leto: po bolshey chasti priyatnye denki peremezhayutsya buryami, kotorye grozyat snesti vsyo na svoem puti.

title: Dieselpunk Wars [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Dieselpunk Wars — eto igra o stroitelstve transportnykh sredstv, deystvie kotoroy proiskhodit v otkrytom, ogromnom mire. Vy ne tolko postroite voennuyu mashinu svoey mechty, no i prokatites na ney po pustynyam, goram ili bolotam. V igre bolee 300 unikalnykh elementov, mnozhestvo razlichnykh materialov i dospekhov, kotorye mozhno pokrasit, chto pozvolit vam postroit zamechatelnuyu mashinu. Razlichnye tipy broni, pushek, motorov, koles i privodov pozvolyat vam konstruirovat dvizhushchiesya, plavayushchie i letatelnye apparaty. Stroyte istrebiteli, transportery, tanki, esmintsy, dirizhabli i mnogoe drugoe. Naslazhdaytes svobodoy tvorchestva!
Uchastvuyte v masshtabnykh srazheniyakh, raskroyte ves potentsial svoego avtomobilya i nachnite vtorzhenie, chtoby zavoevat tselye ostrova v odinochnoy kampanii. Uznayte slabye mesta korabley vashikh vragov i razgadayte ikh boevye plany. U vas budet mnogo razlichnogo oruzhiya na vybor, vklyuchaya raketnye ustanovki, pulemety, ognemety, torpednye ustanovki, bomby, glubinnye bomby i bezumnoe oruzhie blizhnego boya.

title: Robbie Swifthand and the Orb of Mysteries [NSZ][ENG]
description:
"Robbie Swifthand and the Orb of Mysteries" - eto 2D-platformer, kotoryy sostoit iz urovney s intriguyushchim, osnovannym na psikhologii dizaynom, epicheskikh i unikalnykh bitv s bossami pod zavodnuyu i zagadochnuyu (actually, "mystifying" translates like "mistifitsiruyushchiy" or "intriguyushchiy" but "zagadochnuyu" is more suitable) muzyku~

Planiruy kazhdoe svoyo dvizhenie i perekhitri vse lovushki, chto skryvayutsya v khrame libo budesh raschlenyon vesyolymi sposobami! 

PREDYSTORIYa.
Robbi prosypaetsya v neznakomoy komnate, gde malenkiy dukh govorit emu, chto on dolzhen spasti chelovechestvo.
...
DA KOGO ETO VOLNUET?!

Esli v kontse ego ozhidaet NAGRADA, to on sdelaet eto.

Ispytayte YaROST i udovletvorenie v etom khardkornom platformere!
Kupite dopolnitelnuyu kontroller, ili dazhe dve... Vam oni prigodyatsya...

UROVNI SLOZhNOSTI
Vyberite uroven slozhnosti, v kotorom vy by khoteli sebya ispytat, no imeyte v vidu, chto Robbi Shustrorukiy (it's literal translation his last name. If you don't need it, you can use "Sviftkhend". Hope you understand that I mean ^^') - eto TA (Russian haven't article, so I changed "the" to "that") igra, kotoraya sdelaet vas masterom platformerov!

NE OChEN SLOZhNO
My rekomenduem igrat na etom urovne slozhnosti tolko esli eto vash pervyy platformer za dolgoe vremya ili esli vy ranshe voobshche ne igrali v platformery!

SLOZhNO
Igra, kakoy ona dolzhna byt dlya khardkornykh igrokov.

SUMASShESTVIE
Esli vy ne zavershili igru na 100%... dlya tvoego zhe blaga, prosto ne nachinay...

SUMASShEDShAYa slozhnost sozdana isklyuchitelno dlya opytnykh igrokov - my NASTOYaTELNO rekomenduem proyti igru na Slozhnoy slozhnosti PERED tem kak nachat prokhodit na SUMASShEDShEY.

title: Paradox Error [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Paradox Error是滾動平台遊戲格式的超現實形式，結合了簡約的黑白顯示與自我意識，是打破第四牆的設計。故障是有意整合的，允許玩家欺騙死亡，通過觸發漏洞或跳出用戶界面元素打開新區域，就好像是舞臺的一部分一樣。標題螢幕的主選單充當重生中心，游標可能顯示為敵人或有用的指南，圖形錯誤掩蓋了屏幕的某些部分，玩家的角色在死亡時會被爆炸成像素。

為了生存，你必須快速確定可以到達屏幕的哪個部分，哪些像素是可以觸摸的，哪些只是背景圖案。適應遊戲突然轉向不同的視角，或者需要與故障物件進行交互。在其核心，Paradox Error 是一個不斷變化的環境難題，你預計將反覆死亡，並利用這些失敗為進一步的嘗試提供信息，直到最終實現目標。堅決地在困難中處於頑強的狀態，但公平地鼓勵重複比賽，這是一種反複試驗的練習，在這種試驗中成功並為自己帶來自豪感。

特色：

• 探索一個動盪不定的數字世界！
• 適應遊戲機制和視角的變化。
• 嘗試，死亡並重複，學習如何生存。
• 享受簡約的黑白像素藝術的風格。
• 使用用戶界面元素和打破常規的漏洞來發揮自己的優勢！

title: Waking Violet [NSZ][ENG]
interface_lang: 英语, 德语, 西班牙语, 法语, 意大利语
description:
Waking Violet — klassicheskaya dvukhmernaya golovolomka s vidom sverkhu, kotoraya otlichaetsya neveroyatnymi zaklinaniyami i mekhanikoy peremotki vremeni.

Vy igraete za Violettu — skromnuyu devochku, kotoraya tak khochet vyrasti, no ne mozhet vybratsya iz sna, v kotorom ona zabludilas. 
S kazhdoy reshennoy golovolomkoy vy na shag blizhe k tomu, chtoby prosnutsya i vernutsya k zhizni, no u vashego bluzhdaniya vo sne est prichina, i vybratsya budet ne tak-to legko…

– 42 urovnya, kotorye zastavyat vas popotet.
– Izuchayte interesnye zaklinaniya.
– Issleduyte volshebnyy mir i uznayte kto (ili chto) vas v nem uderzhivaet.
– Sobirayte manu, kolduyte, no ne otchaivaytes, esli vam chto-to ne udalos — nachinayte snachala!
– Krasochnaya i nepovtorimaya grafika, narisovannaya vruchnuyu.
– Neveroyatnaya umirotvoryayushchaya muzyka pomozhet vam sosredotochitsya.

title: Infernal Radiation [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi8]
description:
On Halloween Island, engineers test the innovative way of generating heat. The roots of the power plant reach deep into the earth, all the way to the heart of Hell, where the reactors obtain energy from burning souls.
