When an accident happens, the infernal radiation contaminates the earth. Inhabitants living in defiled areas struggle with numerous possessions. An exorcist is needed.

Game features:
- Very simple gameplay, very difficult opponents.
- Dynamic clashes.
 -20 demons with unique abilities and battle patterns.
- A dark history of the island hidden in the reports of the possessed.
- Help of the rescued residents.
- Free exploration of the rich world.
- A lot of dark humour. 
- The choice of the order of exorcisms.

title: Wizards Wand of Epicosity [NSZ][ENG]
description:
When the Wizard of Darkness awakened, it was up to one man to defeat him. When that man was accidentally killed by one idiot, Tobuscus (or "person of extremely low intelligence" - gently put), the responsibility of becoming an AWESOME WIZARD fell onto him... by default!

Wizards: Wand of Epicosity is a thrilling, fast paced Tower Defense game with magic, zombies, and a teleporting castle.
The Wizard of Darkness sends forth his undead hordes and it is up to you and your allies to defeat them. 
-        Conjure Blizzards, weave Lightning and summon Tornadoes to destroy your enemies!
-        Unlock rare new Wands, Robes, and Items to multiply your killing power!
-        Upgrade your Castle to survive the massive onslaught of zombies and demons!
-        Strap Mines to your faithful dog and shoot him out of a cannon!
-        Collect all of the Magic Runes and summon your courage to defeat the Evil Wizard of Darkness!"

title: 103 (One Hundred and Three [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
Lili nikogda ne byla takoy, kak drugie lyudi. S samogo detstva, ee dikoe voobrazhenie i silnaya pamyat dali ey talant sozdat svoy sobstvennyy dom. Mesto v ee soznanii vdali ot opasnostey mira, chtoby sokhranit ee mechty i vospominaniya v bezopasnosti.

No vo vremya nochnogo svidaniya s druzyami, chto-to sluchilos. Chto-to uzhasnoe, i teper ee zhizn izmenilas navsegda. Pomogite Lili ispolzovat svoe voobrazhenie, chtoby razblokirovat svoi vospominaniya i perezhit sobytiya toy nochi.

Igrayte v 103 prosto glyadya na obekty, chtoby razobrat istoriyu vmeste. Chem bolshe vy nablyudaete za okruzhayushchey sredoy, tem bolshe vy ponimaete. Pervonachalnye instruktsii i prostye zagadki dayutsya cherez dva kadra, kotorye napravlyayut vas k progressu.

103 fokusiruetsya na sozdanii bolee kompaktnogo i podrobnogo okruzheniya, kotoroe vy smozhete issledovat. Chitayte soobshcheniya, reshayte golovolomki, prosmatrivayte kartinki i obekty, a takzhe perezhivayte sobytiya i vstrechaytes s personazhami, kotorye pomogut vam ponyat, chto proizoshlo.

title: Regina and Mac / Regina & Mac World [NSZ][ENG]
description: Join the macaw Regina and the tyrannosaurus Mac on their adventure as they try to escape a lifeless research lab. The only way out? To find the golden Floppy discs on which the memory of the lab’s computer system U64 is stored so that it can help the duo to find an exit. Regina & Mac is a 3D platformer that stands in the tradition of the classics from the late 90s and offers a fair challenge even for genre aficionados.

title: Blaze Union: Story to Reach the Future Remaster / ブレイズ・ユニオン [NSP][JAP]
description: Blaze Union: Story to Reach the Future — takticheskaya rolevaya igra. Ona byl vypushchena 27 maya 2010 goda isklyuchitelno v Yaponii dlya PSP. I vot, spustya trinadtsat let, Sting Entertainment vypustili remaster versiyu dlya Nintendo Switch!

title: Rimelands Hammer of Thor [NSZ][ENG]
description:
You’re Rose Cristo - a young treasure hunter on a quest to unveil a mystery behind a new enemy that arrives up into your world. On your way, you uncover a truth about your heritage and stop the threat that could destroy the world.  

As fantasy and technology coexist you can use spells, melee weapons like swords and also newer inventions such as pistols. There are three skills trees corresponding to these type of combat : barbarian, assassin and shaman. 

The fighting system is based on the roll of dice - each turn you and your enemy roll and power of attack depend on what you draw. Every dice got attack side, double attack, defend and an empty slot. It’s a simple mechanic but also deep with the addition of bonuses from equipment and skills. 

Features:
- adventure in a fantasy world where magic exists next to technology powered by steam
- intriguing and unpredictable plot 
- a turn-based fighting system with simple, but deep mechanics 
- three skill trees: barbarian, assassin, and shaman
- a crafting system that lets you create powerful equipment

title: Jumanji the Curse Returns + 2 DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Get ready - the jungle’s coming to challenge you! With every roll of the dice, dangerous wildlife escapes into the town and can only be stopped by you reaching the center of the board. Be careful, if the jungle overpowers you and your team - everyone loses!
 
FEATURES:

GATHER YOUR TEAM
You’ll need a full team of 4 players to defeat the jungle. If you’re missing a player or two, AI companions will join and fill empty spots. Become Alan, Sarah, Peter and Judy, or the brand-new characters, Coach Holly and Lucas Garcia. 
 
CHOOSE YOUR TOKEN
Choose your magical Jumanji Token: Elephant, Rhino, Crocodile or Monkey. 
 
FACE THE DANGERS
Survive encounters with creatures and plants from the deepest depths of the Jumanji jungle. You’ll face giant Mosquitos, Lions, Rhinos, Crocodiles, and even Carnivorous Plants. You’ll also need to dodge attacks from the legendary hunter, Van Pelt!
 
PLAY IN DIFFERENT MODES
Play in Online Multiplayer or join one friend and two AI characters in Local-Play Mode, or join a complete AI team in Single Player Mode.
 
EXPERIENCE THE BOARD GAME + CARD-BASED STRATEGY
Dive headfirst into a mash-up of the classic board game and fast paced card-based strategy. Face jungle wildlife with an ever-shuffling deck and send every danger back into the game. Improve your deck between rounds for a different experience every time.
 
EXPLORE BRANTFORD & WINTER RESORT
Play your way around a map of iconic locations in Brantford, from the Parrish Mansion to the Sir Sav-a-Lot supermarket.
 
Travel beyond Brantford! Jungle drums are sending shockwaves through the icy valley of a Winter Resort Map. Gather a team, face a new danger, and explore a festive Winter wonderland! 
 • Play as AJ the snowboarder and novice skier Yuki Sato!
 • Add the Mountain Bear and Snow Leopard tokens to your collection.

 It’s high-altitude fun. As long as the jungle drums don’t cause an avalanche.

title: SD Shin Kamen Rider Rumble + 11 DLC [NSZ][ENG (Mod.)/JAP]
interface_lang: 日语 [JAP] + MOD ofitsialnogo angliyskogo perevoda
description:
Sumasshedshaya skhvatka mezhdu Kamen Rider i SHOCKER teper pokazana v vizualnom stile SD, s razlichnymi sistemami usileniya. Igroki smogut nasladitsya boevymi stsenami, v kotorykh oni smogut v mgnovenie oka unichtozhit vragov, ispolzuya svoy sobstvennyy finalnyy priyom.
Budte pobezhdeny i vosstante vnov! Smozhete li vy srazitsya s Kamen Rayderom i sdelat tak, chtoby lyudi ostavalis lyudmi?

title: Pineview Drive [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 俄语 lyubitelskiy, 移植版 djonmarvel
description:
Na ulitse Paynvyu vas zhdet zabroshennyy osobnyak, u vorot kotorogo stoit neznakomets. On byl zdes so svoey zhenoy Lindoy 20 let nazad. Togda-to ego lyubimaya i propala... Zagadka ee ischeznoveniya do sikh por ne raskryta. Naydite v sebe sily shagnut za vorota i srazitsya so zlom vnutri. Uznayte taynu propazhi Lindy i proleyte svet na etu uzhasnuyu istoriyu.

V polnoy versii:
• 30 igrovykh dney
• kto-to budet sledit za kazhdym vashim shagom
• potryasayushchie zvukovye effekty
• zakhvatyvayushchaya atmosfera trillera.

title: Ignatius [NSZ][ENG]
publisher: Ultimate Games, Golden Eggs, Glob Games Studio
description:
The game with its visual form and plot refers to the old silent movies. It takes us to the surreal, black-and-white world where we play as a character named Ignatius.

Main character is a boy a bit bored with his current monotonous life. One moonlit night something unexpected happened, something that turn his orderly life upside down. He encountered a mysterious theater director named Vigo, who moves him to oneiric film reality.

The player’s task is to find his way in this strange world and escape from it.
We traverse interesting locations, discovering this mysterious universe and trying to unravel its mystery. On our way stands various obstacles, logical puzzles and specific oponents.

title: Rez Plz [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
REZ PLZ predstavlyaet iz sebya platformennuyu golovolomku s novym podkhodom k rezhimu odinochnoy i sovmestnoy igry. Ubivayte svoego brata, chtoby razgadyvat golovolomki i prokhodit podzemelya. Srazites s silami Temnogo Arkanuma vmeste s volshebnikami-uchenikami Arkanom i Zefom, vooruzhennymi lish Svitkom voskresheniya, s pomoshchyu kotorogo oni mogut vernut drug druga k zhizni. Po mere prokhozhdeniya vy poluchite dostup k novym zaklinaniyam, dayushchim raznye sposobnosti, s pomoshchyu kotorykh vy i proydete vse bolee slozhnye ispytaniya.

OSOBENNOSTI
 
Sovmestnaya igra
REZ PLZ ispolzuet unikalnyy podkhod k traditsionnoy kontseptsii sovmestnoy igry pod drugim sousom. Vmesto togo chtoby ne dat drug drugu umeret, igroki dolzhny strategicheski ubivat drug druga pri prokhozhdenii kazhdogo urovnya, chtoby reshat golovolomki i unichtozhat protivnikov. Dlya ozhivleniya Arkana ili Zefa ispolzuetsya Svitok voskresheniya.
 
Smert za kazhdym povorotom
V REZ PLZ smert — obychno ot odnogo-edinstvennogo udara — podkaraulivaet povsyudu! Geroy mozhet byt razrublen popolam, seden chudovishchami, sozhzhen zazhivo i t. d.
 
Otkroyte magicheskie zaklinaniya
Otkryvayte novye zaklinaniya, chtoby preodolevat vse bolee slozhnye ispytaniya, no budte ostorozhny: eti bratya plokho vladeyut magiey, a kazhdoe neudachnoe zaklinanie mozhet privesti k smerti!
 
Otkryvaemye predmety
Issleduyte igrovoy mir i nakhodite mnozhestvo otkryvaemykh kosmeticheskikh predmetov, a takzhe otkryvaemye urovni, pozvolyayushchie nastroit igrovoy protsess po svoemu vkusu. Uglubites v igru eshche bolshe s pomoshchyu bonusnykh rezhimov, takikh kak PvP-sostyazaniya po begu. 
 
Syuzhet
REZ PLZ rasskazyvaet istoriyu dvukh volshebnikov-uchenikov — Arkana i Zefa. Posle togo kak ikh shkolu zakhvatyvayut sily zla, im prikhoditsya obedinit sily, chtoby pobedit zlykh koldunov Temnogo Arkanuma, no delo v tom, chto volshebniki iz Arkana i Zefa — kak sito iz sobachego khvosta. Khotya geroi postepenno uchat novye zaklinaniya, ovladevayut oni magiey medlenno. Kogda oni umirayut, ikh ozhivlyaet Svitok vozrozhdeniya.
 
Spravka
REZ PLZ byla razrabotana bratyami Dzhoshem i Neytom Pirs, osnovatelyami Long Neck Games. Na sozdanie REZ PLZ ikh vdokhnovili beschislennye chasy, provedennye v detstve za igrami v sovmestnom rezhime.

title: Kosmokrats [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description: Reshayte dinamicheskie golovolomki s pomoshchyu pilotiruemogo bespilotnika. Soberite moguchiy kosmicheskiy flot i koloniziruyte zvezdy. Kakuyu formu pravleniya vy predpochtete? Sotsialisticheskuyu utopiyu?

title: Green Video Game (G.R.E.E.N. The Life ALG0R1THM) [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
description:
Vyzhivite v mire, zakhvachennom geneticheski modifitsirovannymi rasteniyami.

Chelovechestvo — vymirayushchiy vid, i spasti ego pod silu tolko vam!
Dobro pozhalovat v igru G.R.E.E.N. THE LIFE ALG0R1THM — zrelishchnoe priklyuchenie, v kotorom vam predstoit stolknutsya so smertelno opasnymi rasteniyami i vernut sebe status glavnogo sushchestva na planete. No pomnite — unichtozhit rasteniya nevozmozhno, poetomu vam ostaetsya tolko paralizovat ikh i ispolzovat sebe na polzu. Vash razumnyy vybor — klyuch k vyzhivaniyu.

Ispolzuyte svoi navyki
● Vam predstoit stolknutsya s razumnymi rasteniyami i ikh nepredskazuemym povedeniem.
● Paralizuyte vragov i ispolzuyte ikh dlya razgadki golovolomok.
● Pogruzites v syuzhet, kotoryy pokazhet vam samye zhestkie storony prirody-materi.

Nepovtorimye vpechatleniya
G.R.E.E.N. THE LIFE ALG0R1THM — eto igra sovershenno novogo stilya i vpechatleniy blagodarya unikalnomu dizaynu i povedeniyu vragov. V itoge vas zhdet uvlekatelnoe priklyuchenie so mnozhestvom neobychnykh zadach, no bez smerti i zhestokosti. Puteshestvuyte po neveroyatno zrelishchnym miram i srazhaytes s opasnymi rasteniyami v soprovozhdenii prekrasnoy i ekstraordinarnoy grafiki, muzyki i animatsii.

title: Dark Water: Slime Invader [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
黑水是少女與婆婆對抗被詛咒的史萊姆解救村莊的冒險遊戲。
請以弓箭使用多種動作與技能對抗敵人且解除陷阱並解救村莊吧。

黑水是幻想橫向捲軸動作類遊戲，榮幸獲得了以下獎項。
・Unity 2020 最佳獨立遊戲第一名
・遊戲選秀第二名
・全球獨立遊戲開發者大賽大獎

水彩蠟筆風的幻想畫面！
・少女與婆婆可以使用弓箭或降落傘等多種能力進行通關。
・少女無法單獨移動的沈重石頭或陷阱可以與婆婆配合一起解決。
・需要少女與婆婆協助通關的地點要看好地形動動腦筋解決。
・豐富多彩的平臺圍繞著幻想氛圍，多種多樣的怪物可以使玩家長時間享受冒險。
・可以欣賞洛克人系列的著名遊戲音樂作曲家松前真奈美 (Manami Matsumae) 的充滿神秘氣氛的主題曲、背景音樂以及Boss戰音樂。

少女和婆婆在一個和平的村莊過著幸福的生活。
突然有一天，村裏出現了史萊姆怪物威脅村莊與村民們。
請使用少女與婆婆的各種技能擊退史萊姆的侵略，並討伐Boss怪物。
找回村莊的和平在你手上！

title: Cursed Island [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
description:
被詛咒的島嶼是一個人試圖離開充滿神秘恐怖和難以想像的怪物的島嶼的故事。 為了完成這項任務，他必須用他可靠的鎬子穿過島嶼。

詛咒島將一些流行遊戲的元素與懷舊的像素藝術圖形融合在一起。 我們敢說，這款遊戲是一種獨特的遊戲體驗，將幫助您享受以探索、挖掘和戰鬥神獸為重點的慢節奏遊戲。

title: Tribal Pass [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Tribal Pass – eto slozhnyy takticheskiy ranner s upravleniem resursami i vzaimodeystviem s okruzheniem – i vse eto na begu. 

Plemya nepreryvno dvizhetsya po vrazhdebnoy zemle, vstrechaya pregrady i rasteniya, raznoy stepeni opasnosti zhivotnykh i lyudey. Igrok reagiruet na eti vstrechi, razbivaya plemya na gruppy, vooruzhaya ego kopyami i fakelami, – delaya vse, chtoby lyudi byli zhivy, a edy bylo vdovol.

Prosim uchest, chto eto deystvitelno RANNER (pravda, takogo rannera vy eshche ne vstrechali) – nikakikh ostanovok, poka solntse ne syadet i zabeg ne konchitsya.

Zabegi stroyatsya protsedurno i ne zhaleyut novykh igrokov, no v itoge vse zavisit ot vashego sobstvennogo masterstva i znaniy o tom, chto vstretitsya vam na puti, a vovse ne ot raboty generatora.

title: Freaky Awesome [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description: Freaky Awesome - eto rogue-lite so sluchaynoy generatsiey okruzheniya, neobratimoy smertyu i bolshim kolichestvom postepenno otkryvayushchegosya kontenta. Freaky Awesome vzvinchivaet gradus bezumiya! Ty pryamo vo vremya boya mozhesh mutirovat v novuyu formu s unikalnoy mekhanikoy, k kotoroy pridetsya bystro prisposobitsya. Pomimo mutatsiy vy mozhete razblokirovat umeniya i predmety, kotorye vliyayut na mekhaniku i prokhozhdenie. Igrayte v odinochku ili sovmestno s druzyami po seti!

title: Time Walker Dark World [NSZ][ENG]
description:
帶領4名精銳的“時行者”在黑暗世界的無盡戰鬥中拾取50種以上的各式技能，無視職業隨心所欲搭配，打造出治療弓手、血牛刺客、火毒法師等等奇妙組合

戰鬥前選擇4個時行者轉職方向，搭配不同的技能都能給陣容帶來不同的化學反應，每次開局都可以打造獨一無二的時行者小隊！

每一關戰鬥結束後會有豐富的資源掉落，通過合成或者重鑄來分配好資源

別忽視局外成長，通過天賦係統可解鎖更多的英雄職業和技能，還能提高時行者職業的基礎屬性

進階職業和EX技能已加入戰場！三個一階的轉職道具可合成一個進階的轉職道具，兩個三階的技能可合成一個特有加強版的EX技能！

究竟黑暗世界的深處隱藏著什麽神秘的力量能讓時行者變強呢，裏面又隱藏著牛王者什麽樣的陰謀呢？前來探索揭開吧...

title: Rukavichka / Rukavychka (移植版 ) [NSP][Multi]
description:
«Rukavichka» — milaya nebolshaya golovolomka, cherpayushchaya vdokhnovenie iz narodnoy ukrainskoy legendy o Rukavichke (perchatke, varezhke), kotoraya stanovitsya domom dlya mnozhestva volshebnykh lesnykh zhivotnykh vsekh razmerov, ot malenkoy myshki do ogromnogo medvedya. Khotya v pervonachalnoy istorii starik nakhodit i zabiraet perchatku, igra predstavlyaet soboy mir, v kotorom zhivotnye mogut prodolzhat bezopasno zhit v svoyom dome.
Tsel igry — nayti mysh (pravym stikom s drakonom) i dver v Rukavichku (levym stikom s lisoy), a zatem provesti lesnuyu mysh k dveri. Myshka mozhet khodit tolko po rasteniyam vnutri lisy ili drakona i ostanavlivaetsya pered proemami. Privedite vsekh poteryavshikhsya zhivotnykh s pomoshchyu ukrainskoy lisitsy i vavelskogo drakona iz polskikh predaniy, chtoby obedinitsya i vmeste sozdat bezopasnoe budushchee dlya vsekh lesnykh sushchestv.
Dizayn proekta byl vdokhnovlen traditsionnymi tsvetochnymi uzorami, ornamentom, sozdannym s ispolzovaniem akvareli i chernil; takzhe vklyuchaet v sebya natsionalnye zhyoltye i sinie ottenki s nebolshim kolichestvom zeleni listev, polevye tsvety, podsolnukhi i barvinok.

title: Exception [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
Exception — eto boevoy platformer, deystvie kotorogo razvorachivaetsya vnutri kompyuternoy sistemy, zarazhennoy vredonosnym virusom. Odin khrabryy protsess dolzhen vyyti iz teni, chtoby povesti za soboy soprotivlenie i svergnut brutalnyy rezhim. Kombiniruyte molnienosnye refleksy s prorabotannymi atakami, chtoby pobedit virus i vosstanovit svobodu.

Novyy podkhod k platformeram: dvukhmernoe deystvie v trekhmernom mire. Urovni transformiruyutsya, otkryvaya novye prepyatstviya i vozmozhnosti.

Saundtrek Synthwave: saundtrek, sostoyashchiy iz trekov luchshikh muzykantov v zhanre Synthwave.

Popadite v tablitsu liderov: sorevnuytes za luchshee vremya na svoikh lyubimykh urovnyakh v 100 s lishnim tablitsakh liderov.

title: Juiced [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Spasite galaktiku ot neminuemoy gibeli v etom zakhvatyvayushchem 2D platformere! Nachnite epicheskoe priklyuchenie po ekzoticheskim miram, chtoby raskryt taynu magicheskikh kristallov...

Zloy volshebnik nakhoditsya v poiskakh Kristallov Vechnosti, chtoby zapitat svoyu mashinu. Pomogite okhotniku za sokrovishchami Tiko s ego epicheskoy missiey nayti kristally i spasti galaktiku ot gibeli!

Osobennosti:
- Russkaya lokalizatsiya
- Uvlekatelnyy 2D platforming
- Intriguyushchiy syuzhet
- Neprostye i veselye golovolomki
- Vstrette 80 razlichnykh vragov
- Otkroyte 30 unikalnykh oruzhiy i sposobnostey
- 15 unikalnykh mirov i bitv s bossami
- Bolee 10 chasov geympleya
- Mnozhestvo sekretnykh kollektsionnykh predmetov i bonusnykh urovney
- Izmenyaemaya slozhnost
- Otkryvaemye ispytaniya (gonka na vremya i YOLO)
- Otkryvaemye kostyumy
- Bolee 40 trekov unikalnoy elektronnoy muzyki
- Polnaya podderzhka geympada

title: Seven (7) Days of Rose [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Maykl schitaet sebya skuchnym, zauryadnym 17-letnim podrostkom.
V to vremya kak bolshinstvo ego odnoklassnikov nashli svoi uvlecheniya i otkryli v sebe talanty, kazhetsya, nichto ne privlekaet ego interesa.

Nakonets-to nastupilo leto, i on gadaet, chem zhe zanyatsya posle shkoly, kogda ego roditeli obyavlyayut ob osobennoy semeynoy poezdke; nedelya na tropicheskom ostrove!

Ekzoticheskoe mesto, gde ego nikto ne znaet... Vozmozhno, eto shans dlya nego stat kem-to drugim; kem-to interesnym! Etot genialnyy plan prokhodit proverku, kogda on vstrechaet Rouz, intriguyushchuyu i prichudlivuyu devushku. Ocharovannyy eyu, Maykl provodit v ee okruzhenii sem dney...

No ne vse tak, kak kazhetsya.
Chto skryvaetsya za ee krasivoy ulybkoy?

Kharakteristiki

* Vysokokachestvennaya grafika
* Saundtrek s ekzoticheskimi melodiyami
* 3 kontsovki
* Galereya kompyuternoy grafiki
* Muzykalnaya galereya
* Optsiya shrifta OpenDyslexic

title: Dragon Hills 1/2 [NSZ][ENG,RUS]
interface_lang: 俄语 (tolko 2-aya chast), 英语 [RUS / ENG]
description:
我們又來了！幾年過去了，快來見識見識我們的霹靂少女!
殭屍！...在哪裡？？？...龍！什麼？？？牛仔，裝甲機和宇宙飛船！為什麼？！

問題太多了...現在可沒時間尋找答案，伙計們。殭屍世界末日已經在降臨了！趕快！坐上你的機器龍，奮力拯救人類!
在這個情節起伏跌宕的活力冒險中，滑下山丘、跳進地下、跳離地面，猛撞並摧毀沿途的障礙物。探索這片充滿了殭屍、巨人、龍和各種驚喜的刺激又神奇的領地。

精彩特點：

• 超級有趣，快速又激烈的遊戲玩法
• 完全可破壞的地形 (大樓，橋樑，車輛等等)
• 史詩級的BOSS之戰，28個塔等你來征服，4 個完全不同又令人興奮的世界等你探索
•可升級的武器，更有龍和爆炸式增強法寶可供解鎖 
•易於學習，直觀的單觸控制，結合了創新的遊戲操作

title: Tails of Trainspot [NSZ][ENG]
description:
《島嶼鐵道局》中你可以暫離現實的煩擾，沈浸在帕岡群島的世界裡，與島上的動物居民交流，深入探索帕岡群島的神祕歷史。除了常規的故事模式外，遊戲還提供了無盡模式和排名挑戰模式，讓您盡情挑戰自己的謎題解決能力。

遊戲規則簡單易懂，但挑戰性十足。地圖上有數字在1到8之間的車站，代表到車站的實際軌道數。要解決難題，玩家需要考慮如何在各個車站鋪設軌道，調整所需軌道的數量並確保所有車站都相連。

title: Byte the Bullet [NSP][ENG]
description: Proniknite v zarazhennyy kompyuter i vosstanovite kazhduyu zarazhennuyu virusom sistemu, vosstanoviv igrovye atributy, takie kak tsvet ili funktsii sokhraneniya. Naslazhdaytes etoy parodiey na neskolko klassicheskikh igr 80-kh i 90-kh godov! Issleduyte vzaimosvyazannye miry v nelineynoy kampanii:

title: Bard's Gold [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Pomogite Bardu preodolet kovarnye lovushki podzemeliy, ispolzuya volshebnye sokrovishcha, kotorye vstretyatsya na vashem puti i pomogut uluchshit vashego geroya i priobresti novoe oruzhie i snaryazhenie! 

Klyuchevye osobennosti :

- Atmosfera oldskulnogo platformera - nikakikh video-instruktsiy ili rasskazov o tom, kak imenno nuzhno igrat. Vam predstoit samostoyatelno poznat vse osobennosti i mekhaniku igry, prodvigayas k postavlennoy tseli. 

- Igra vypolnena v zhanre Rogue-lite - oformlenie i struktura kazhdogo urovnya vybiraetsya khaotichno pri kazhdoy novoy popytke proyti igru do kontsa. 
Nesmotrya na to, chto sistema "sluchaynykh urovney" ne dast vam privyknut k urovnyam i zapomnit raspolozhenie elementov, ona pozvolyaet sokhranit interes k igre. Sobiraya almazy, vy smozhete uluchshit raznoobraznye pokazateli glavnogo geroya, ispolzuya dlya etogo ekran zaversheniya ocherednoy igry. 
Takie uluchsheniya ostayutsya s vashim geroem navsegda i pozvolyayut igrat bolee effektivno i provorno. 

- Bolee 100 sluchaynykh urovney dlya igry 

- Neveroyatno slozhnyy, no deystvitelno stoyashchiy geympley 

- Velikolepnaya grafika, vdokhnovlennaya retro-igrami 

- Ispolzuyte knigi masterstva, chtoby poluchit novye navyki

title: Betomis [NSZ][ENG]
description:
進入危機重重的像素風地下城－－Betomis，你得要小心翼翼地觀察和探索環境，才得以逃脫！《Betomis》是一款復古的 2D 平台動作遊戲，錯綜複雜的地下城裡，每一間密室都是單畫面的環境解謎關卡。光源受限、武器短缺，但致命的陷阱卻是源源不絕，包含尖刺、電鋸、怪物和肉食植物！

特色：

• 探索數十關像素風格的單畫面平台關卡！
• 找出武器和鑰匙，來克服各個地下城的挑戰。
• 斬殺漫步的怪物和食肉的植物！
• 善用二段跳來抵達刁鑽的平台，躲開致命的陷阱。
• 不用煩人的讀取時間，死亡後即可立即重試！

title: Brotherhood United [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Seychas nelegkie vremena: odnogo iz vashikh druzey pokhitili. Vam predstoit osvobodit ego: s Bratstvom shutki plokhi, i zlodei zaplatyat za svoi postupki.

Khvatayte oruzhie, berite pivo i vpered, cherez ordy vragov. V etoy klassicheskoy strelyalke vy – chlen Bratstva, kotoryy ne ostavlyaet druzey v bede.

Osobennosti:
- 20 urovney, na kazhdom po 3 zadaniya
- 5 raznovidnostey kastomizatsii, bolee 4 predmetov v kazhdoy iz nikh
- Lokalnyy kooperativ
- Krutoe oruzhie i granaty. Spalite vse na svoem puti!
- 8 bossov, odolet kotorykh ne tak-to prosto
- Prevoskhodnyy saundtrek, kotoryy nikogo ne ostavit ravnodushnym

title: Mastho is Together [NSZ][ENG]
description:
在動作平台遊戲之中化身為超甜蜜的無糖棉花糖！《Mastho is Together》中包含精準的平台挑戰，你將在這款溫馨的橫向卷軸遊戲中指引白白嫩嫩的主角 Mastho 跨越各種障礙物。在精準的謎題關卡中，使用跳躍與騰空衝刺來穿越闖關，而且螢幕上沒有擾人的介面！

平衡極簡視覺效果與抽象藝術，《Mastho is Together》的遊戲玩法非常簡潔，且沒有選單與載入畫面。死亡後立即重生，想嘗試幾次就嘗試幾次，同時在 40 個精心打造且難度不斷提升的關卡中享受輕盈的旋律音樂。你能幫助 Mastho 完成這場健康而甜蜜的旅程嗎？

特色：

• 完成 40 個關卡中具挑戰性的精準平台遊戲玩法。
• 從牆上跳下，並朝 8 個方向使用騰空衝刺來最大化你的機動性！
• 直接進入遊戲，沒有選單、沒有擾人的介面、不用載入。
• 掌握每 5 個關卡推出的新功能！
• 享受精緻的音效和輕鬆的音樂來幫助你保持冷靜。

title: Robozarro [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Robozarro是一款基於物理的2D動作遊戲，其中機器人B0-3和0-Ramatron進行了一次史詩般的探索，穿越了Mech Angeles的郊區，最陰暗面和屋頂，以探索有關Zarro博士失踪的謎團。

特色：

• 使用動態的2D物理引擎，在生活中探索不可預測的世界。
• 掌握“ Grab N Blast”物理操縱工具，將周圍環境變成爆炸性武器！
• 冒險時收集垃圾，以此交易健康，武器或升級。
• 獨特恢復的小工具，以幫助您穿越Mech Angeles的旅程。
• 把計時賽解鎖，並嘗試在沒有檢查點的情況下突破等級或遭受零傷害！

title: King Krieg Survivors [NSZ][ENG]
description:
結合能力來創造無限的法術可能性並消滅成千上萬的敵人。 King Krieg 是一款自上而下的競技場 Roguelite 遊戲，您是國王，您可以購買神秘物品、找到強大的槍支並製作新咒語。
      你是戰爭之王。 成千上萬的敵人試圖殺死你。 保護你的城堡。 創建你自己的咒語

特徵：
- 創建自己的咒語
- 數以千計的敵人
- 大量獨特的武器
- 物品商店
- 可選的無盡波浪

title: Crash Puzzle Hammer San [NSZ][ENG]
developer: Success Corporation 株式会社サクセス
description:
基本操作僅需方向鍵和A鍵。
有一個5分鐘就能掌握遊戲玩法的教學。
利用編輯功能創建自己的關卡，並上傳讓全世界的人來遊玩。
你也可以下載並遊玩其他用戶創建的關卡。

title: Escaping a Kid's Room: Escape Game Series, Cape's Escape, Cape's Escape 2nd room, Cape's Escape 2.5th Room [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Legkaya i milaya igra-pobeg.
Zhili-byli dve fei chuchela zhivotnykh: Nyanzo i Kumakichi.

title: Gunslingers & Zombies [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Apparently there was nothing special at the Whiskey last night this time. This time it is for real. Welcome to the Wild West where the rules have changed.

Gunslingers & Zombies is an action-packed and adventurous strategy game that comically combines two themes beloved by pop culture: the Wild West and the Undead. Become one of the gunslingers fighting zombies. Plan your combat tactics and put them into practice in turn-based battles. Explore the crazy world of the Wild West, shown with a pinch of salt, where nothing is normal. Take on the weirdest types of zombies you've seen so far, such as the mighty Buffalo Zombie! Give zombies a taste of your pistols, shotguns, rifles or knives. Let them regret the day they… yyy… the day they became undead!

title: Nazi Zombies Portable (na Quakespasm) [NSP][ENG]
description:
Demeyk «Call of Duty 5: Zombies», rabotayushchiy na usovershenstvovannoy versii dvizhka Quakespasm; igra razrabatyvaetsya s 2011 goda po sey den. Sam proekt stremitsya byt pokhozhim na «Call of Duty: World at War» v obshchey stilistike, no komponenty igrovogo protsessa realizovany s nekotorymi razlichiyami.
Osnovnaya komanda razrabotchikov — Blubswillrule: programmirovanie, modelirovanie, graficheskie effekty, zvuki, muzyka, Justice: dizayn kart, modeley, vizualnykh effektov, Jukki: programmirovanie, Biodude: zvuk, Dr_Mabuse1981: programmirovanie, Naievil: porty na Switch i 3DS, MotoLegacy: programmirovanie, vizualnye effekty, muzyka, Derped_Crusader: modelirovanie i graficheskie effekty.
Vklyuchyonnye karty (13 sht.):

title: Dobutsu Shogi World (Dobutsu syogi, 物将棋, どうぶつしょうぎ, Catch the Lion) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
S nami vy legko osvoite igru syogi!
Nauchites igrat s nashimi 3-mya rezhimami igry!

・ Dobutsu syogi (Vozrast: ot 4 let i starshe)
Igra na doske 3kh4 s 8 figurami.
Milye figury s otobrazheniem vozmozhnykh khodov i
prostye pravila pomogut vam legko osvoit osnovy igry v syogi.

・ Goro-goro Dobutsu syogi (Vozrast: ot 5 let i starshe)
Igra na doske 5kh6 s 16 figurami.
Prodvinutaya versiya igry «Dobutsu syogi».
Idealno podkhodit dlya izucheniya dvizheniy «Sobaki» (Zoloto) i
«Koshki» (Serebro), klyuchevykh figur dlya ataki i zashchity korolya.

・ Lesnye Dobutsu syogi (Vozrast: ot 6 let i starshe)
Igra na doske 9kh9 s 40 figurami.
Pravila – kak v obychnoy igre v syogi.
Osnovy dvizheniya figur ne otlichayutsya ot tekh zhe v «Dobutsu syogi» i «Goro-goro Dobutsu syogi», chto pomozhet vam primenit izuchennoe na praktike i po-nastoyashchemu debyutirovat v syogi.

title: Trip World DX [NSP][ENG]
description:
*本作品沒有中文版本。
在Trip World DX中，讓我們一起探索幻想的四個土地和充滿疑點的Dubious山吧！
象徵世界和平與幸福的Maita花被偷走，將Trip World拋入混亂之中！
現在，主人公Yakopoo的冒險即將展開。

飛翔於天際，奔跑於大地，游泳於水下，同時收集特殊物品，以奪回Maita花，並恢復Trip World的和平。

利用Yakopoo的變身能力，將Trip World從黑暗中解救出來吧！
變成球狀以滾過地形，長尾巴以攻擊敵人，或者使用花朵使敵人友好化吧！

全新的Trip World DX彩色版本！
博物館模式包含從未見過的設計資料、原始開發者的視頻訪談、音樂視頻、包裝掃描等。
放送原始音軌，全新編曲，以及其他Sunsoft經典作品的驚喜音軌的音樂播放器！
嶄新的呈現和藝術風格。
這款遊戲是與建立Sunsoft經典的導演上田雄一合作開發和設計的。

title: Explosive Candy World [NSZ][ENG]
developer: Marcos Game Dev, Brabo Game Creations
description:
忘了奔跑跳躍。在《Explosive Candy World》中，你需要摧毀障礙物，讓自己飛越陷阱，並翻過高牆才能抵達終點！這是一款打破物理規則卻又嚴謹的平台遊戲。《Explosive Candy World》以可愛繽紛的像素風格呈現，配上懷舊音樂，混合了經典風格和現代機制，打造出獨樹一幟的平台體驗。

調整爆炸的強度和方向，然後擲出威力強大的爆炸糖果。讓自己飛向空中、切換開關、突破障礙、啟動開關並忘了腳下的平台！關卡都很簡短且友善，即便遇到一些小困難，也能透過快速重生和無限次挑戰盡情享受遊戲樂趣。

特色：

• 使用爆炸糖果摧毀障礙物或讓自己前進！
• 在 4 個以上的世界中，挑戰 80 個單一畫面的物理關卡。
• 沒有選單或說明，直接開始遊戲！
• 享受以懷舊 4 色像素風格呈現的可愛畫面。
• 立即重生，無限次挑戰關卡！

title: We Are Doomed [NSP][ENG]
description:
Dive head-first into the action with reckless ambition, charge the SUPERBEAM, and zap everything out of existence in an instant. Chase high scores or just enjoy the beautiful explosion of geometry, colour and light.

* Pure arcade action. No cutscenes, storylines, or lengthy tutorials.

* An overpowered laserbeam weapon, and the more ridiculous SUPERBEAM.

* Waves mode: 30 waves that range from chill to hyper-intense.

* Endless mode: An endless barrage of baddies. How many zones can you survive? 

* Quick to start, and quick to restart for "just one more" game.

* A vibrant world of neon colours, bold shapes, and glitching geometry.

* A beautiful, chill, and occasionally glitchy soundscape.

title: Race Die Run [NSZ][ENG]
Kharon's Crypt Even Death May Die [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Kharon's Crypt - Even Death May Die是一非線性迷宮探索遊戲，充滿了謎題，奧秘和致命的挑戰。靈感來自於傳奇掌機Game Boy的像素風格圖形。

在這個遊戲中，你化身成卡戎，一個被認為是死亡化身的人。你被一個想要尋求永生的瘋狂國王密封在地穴裡，而你的使命則是衝破地穴重獲自由。

作為卡戎，你可以飛行，穿過物體和眩暈你的敵人。此外，為了擊敗敵人，逃出地牢，你還可以附身你的敵人，竊取他的身體。你將能夠用蝙蝠的身體飛行，在骷髏的身體裡打架，在寶箱怪的身體裡偽裝自己，還有更多的可能性。

你準備好逃出地穴，讓瘋狂的國王面對他的命運了嗎？

title: Will Die Alone [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Congratulations! You just got hired by Dewitt Corp. for their memory program, your job starts tomorrow.
Our customers come to us to solve their current problems. Your task is to dig into their past and find the right memories to erase to change their present and future.
For each customer, you will receive a series of personal information on your PC that you can analyze. Choose carefully, every memory removed can have enormous effects on the present and future of the customer.
You will be sent to an isolated place to be able to work with peace of mind, we will keep in touch via email.

title: Bunny Must Die! Chelsea and the 7 Devils [NSP][ENG]
description:
The year is 1999X. After a curse causes Bunny to grow cat ears when a purrmodynamic power plant explodes, she is led by a chubby and divine messenger into the Cave of Devils so that she can remove the hex.
However, a mad bull appears out of nowhere, killing the messenger after stabbing him 24 times!

An improved version of the dungeon-crawling action game 'Bunny Must Die! Chelsea and the 7 Devils' is now coming to the Nintendo Switch™.
March through the Cave of Devils together with Bunny, her five weapons, and her ability to manipulate time however she pleases!

title: Ammo Pigs Cocked and Loaded / Armed and Delicious [NSZ][ENG]
description:
所有生命形式都滅絕了——除了反對敵對的人工智能控制機器的豬。 機器人應該被摧毀，但更重要的是，已經找到了最後倖存的雞。 必須不惜一切代價拯救它們！

Ammo Pigs: Cocked and Loaded 是一款動感十足的跑槍遊戲，非常強調跳躍和射擊元素。 它帶來了 80 年代和 90 年代 2D 動作遊戲的感覺，充滿樂趣、爆炸和培根——以防你無法將那些可憐的雞從致命的討厭雞的機器中拯救出來。 如果你準備好迎接一些觸摸挑戰，不妨試一試！

title: Marmoset [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Marmoset is a mystery-filled survival game set a century after the events of World War III, a little 15-year-old Luna and her friend AI (Artificial Intelligence) Chimbra embark on a grand and dangerous adventure to reclaim their old home, the Caves of Marmoset, for without them the City of Marmoset can have its days numbered.

Open world.
Cave exploration with unique biomes full of monsters, treasures, and traps.
A story full of mysteries that are revealed throughout the game.
Agriculture, fishing, cooking, and construction.
Playable Minigames on Luna's notebook and Bar arcade.

title: OctaFight (Octa Fight) [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
OctaFight 是一款爆炸性戰鬥遊戲。向舊式沙發多人遊戲致敬，提供緊湊、毀滅性的對戰比賽。

以各式各樣的炸彈類型、瘋狂遊戲模式及巨大的競技場，從公平競爭到美味的混亂，創立你自己的戰鬥規則。

OctaFight 靠著其驚艷的超像素畫風，宣揚了對極簡主義及精緻設計的熱愛，並探索超低像素的承諾！

特色：
- 簡單的操作、深入的遊玩過程
- 可同時供 2 至 8 名玩家遊玩
- 創立你自己的戰鬥規則
- 超像素化的畫風

title: Diorama Dungeoncrawl Master of the Living Castle [NSZ][ENG]
description:
受 16 位元動作遊戲啟發，《Diorama Dungeoncrawl》將經典老牌的挑戰與風格帶入低多邊形的場景中！在你的探險途中與怪物戰鬥、躲開陷阱，並奪回屬於生命城堡的心臟。探索被籠罩的森林、神秘的殿堂、高塔與地城，面對控制黑暗之力而強大的死靈法師！

以橫向卷軸的砍殺冒險為核心，《Diorama Dungeoncrawl》為大家熟悉的動作遊戲機制帶來煥然一新的美術風格！對抗成群的骷髏、蝙蝠和哥布林！巧妙地躲開狡猾的陷阱並迎戰嚇人的魔王。奔跑、跳躍並揮舞你強力的鎚子，但同時也要小心敵人從四面八方向你發射的投射物！你能夠活下去並為你的王國帶來和平嗎？

特色：

• 以低多邊形 3D 的風格探索中世紀的奇幻世界！
• 奔跑並跳躍來穿梭於各個輕度平台跳躍的場景中。
• 拿起你可靠的鎚子，在即時戰鬥中擊敗成群的敵人。
• 擊敗骷髏、巨大蝙蝠和哥布林等敵人！
• 在戰鬥中快速地想出策略以面對險惡的魔王。
• 打敗控制著生命城堡的死靈法師！

title: Wild Romance [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Kazuma leaves Tokyo and returns to his hometown in search of something more fulfilling. Reconnecting with his four childhood friends, he discovers a well-hidden fluffy secret. When the girls accidentally reveal that they are not mere humans but actually magical animal spirits in human form, Kazuma gets embroiled in a summer of fun and adventure he can’t resist.

Sumire is the fox and leader of the pack. She has a motherly instinct and a deep desire for romance. Tsubaki is the cat and second in command. She knows what she wants and she's determined to get it. Aoi is the dog and full of life. She's obedient, full of energy and always up for an adventure. The final girl, Nazuna is the tanuki or Japanese raccoon. She's smart with a seductively creative mind but also a bit of a troublemaker.

This authentic Japanese visual novel follows the story of Kazuma as he learns the hidden secrets of his hometown and discovers a supernatural world within it. His adventures include mountain picnics, summer festivals, run-ins with the gods and swimming in a natural hot spring. 

Features include:
•Translated version of the original Japanese Visual Novel
• English, Spanish and Japanese language option
• Upscaled high resolution graphics
• Enhanced with character sprite animations
• Hours of story content
• Main female characters fully voiced with original Japanese dialogue
• Gallery and Scene selectors

Also including Scene Studio
Play with the cast of Wild Romance in a totally new way. Set the scene, create the text and formulate their fresh dialogue however you please.

title: Wild Seas [NSZ][ENG]
description:
在Wild Seas這款自上而下的2D塔防遊戲中，你扮演一隻友善的鱷魚，擁有一顆代代相傳的珠寶，需要加以保護，因為它是家族的遺物，同時也保護附近的島嶼。現在，你需要盡一切可能的幫助來擊退那些想要征服一切並取得珠寶碎片以出售的海盜。
使用你可靠的木棍來閃避敵人的子彈，購買強大的砲塔並使用你沿途找到的扳手來升級它們，這裡有4個島嶼，你將面臨著眾多挑戰：

*打開寶箱發現偉大的寶藏
*引爆炸藥
*按照你喜歡的方式建立防禦
*購買新的砲塔來抵擋敵群的攻擊

你能否在面對這些可怕而危險的敵人時幸存並拯救你的家園？

title: Dune Sea [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Dune Sea predstavlyaet soboy unikalnyy priklyuchencheskiy gusinyy saydskroller, dayushchiy vozmozhnost letat podobno ptitse.

V Dune Sea vy upravlyaete pereletnoy ptitsey, otstavshey ot svoey stai v silu proizoshedshego katastroficheskogo sobytiya. Chtoby vyzhit, vam ponadobitsya proletet sredi prekrasnykh peyzazhey chuzhikh zemel, sobiraya predmety i izbegaya pri etom khishchnikov.

Glavnyy geroy igry ― gus, letayushchiy na 12 individualno prorabotannykh urovnyakh, kazhdyy iz kotorykh snabzhen sobstvennoy originalnoy muzykalnoy dorozhkoy ot Dzheyka Butino, sozdayushchey unikalnyy atmosfernyy opyt.

Letayte v klassicheskom rezhime ili rezhime dzen: klassicheskiy rezhim obedinyaet polnotsennyy opyt s ispytaniyami, v to vremya, kak v rezhime dzen igrok stanovitsya neuyazvimym, chto oblegchaet issledovaniya i daet vozmozhnost prosto dvigatsya vpered.

Dannoe izdanie soderzhit rasshirenie "Neonovoe more" s 3 dopolnitelnymi urovnyami, kotoroe vklyuchaet novye retro-zony i muzyku v stile sintveyv.

title: A Street Cat's Tale [NSZ][ENG]
description:
一隻失去母親的小貓的故事登上Nintendo Switch！

玩家扮演的小貓必須在街上存活下去直到長大。

◆飢餓的小貓
路邊的小貓時常處於飢餓的狀態。
探索街道，尋找食物，不要讓小貓餓死。

◆結識人類
街上有許多性格不同的人類。
有人會疼愛你，有人會給你食物，他們也有各自的情況。
和街上的人們友好相處，聽他們講述自己的故事吧。

◆多種結局
在長大前的最後一天，你至今為止所做的選擇
會發展為各式各樣的結局。
小貓的未來就在你的手中！

title: Dragon Audit [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
Geympley v dukhe klassiki zhanra point & clicks s bogatym syuzhetom, vdokhnovlyonnyy anime 3D-vizualnyy stil i sovremennoe upravlenie s podderzhkoy kontrollerov.  

-- Osobennosti --

* Priklyuchencheskaya igra-brodilka s umilitelnoy, poteshnoy istoriey i neslozhnymi golovolomkami.
* Znakomsya s interesnymi personazhami i pomogay im s ikh prichudlivymi prosbami.
* Issleduy trekhmernyy mir. Nakhodi predmety, personazhey, mini-igry i skrytye shutki.
* Prodolzhitelnost primerno kak u tipichnoy komedii ( ~ 90 min.); dostupny raznye kontsovki. 
* Inogda emotsionalno silnye dialogi i stseny, inogda — shutki o shtanakh.

-- Istoriya --

V mire, kishashchem magiey i opasnostyami, est gorod bukhgalterov, otgorodivshiy sebya ot mira vysokimi stenami i neobshcheprinyatymi printsipami bukhgalterskogo uchyota. Tam na boevogo bukhgaltera Dzhordzha vozlagaetsya nezavidnaya zadacha – pokinut svoy bezopasnyy gorod, chtoby shturmovat blizlezhashchiy zamok, ubit drakona, spasti printsessu i (samoe vazhnoe) spasti nalogi ot neuplaty. Tem vremenem, Ayrou (drakonesse) nadoelo, chto postoyanno zayavlyayutsya kakie-to rytsari i pytayutsya eyo ubit, i pokhozhe, chto ona dazhe revnuet iz-za togo, chto nikto ne khochet spasti eyo. Poetomu ona pridumala plan, chtoby khitrostyu zastavit Dzhordzha spasti eyo vmesto printsessy. Kogda puti etikh dvoikh peresekayutsya, nachinaetsya veselukha. Neobyknovennyy duet vsyo vremya sblizhaetsya po khodu svoego priklyucheniya.

title: The Midnight Sanctuary [NSZ][ENG]
description:
"A ty… mozhet, tozhe iz mertvetsov?"
Uvlekatelnaya, zakhvatyvayushchaya istoriya.
Neset li Svyataya, kotoraya soshla v etu glukhuyu derevnyu, spasenie… ili eto konets vsego?
Misticheskiy i mrachnyy vizualnyy roman s zagadochnymi obrazami i golosami talantlivykh akterov.

"Kakogo finala zhazhdut eti glaza, malenkiy nablyudatel?"

--Tainstvennaya grafika--
Roskoshnaya grafika, razmyvayushchaya gran mezhdu realizmom i syurrealizmom.
Puteshestvie v zagadochnyy mir, odnovremenno i dvukh-, i trekhmernyy.

--Polnostyu ozvucheno i animirovano--
Midnight Sanctuary ozhivaet samym neozhidannym obrazom blagodarya animatsii, sdelannoy komandoy iz CAVYHOUSE, i ozvuchke ot komandy professionalnykh yaponskikh akterov. 
*Ozvucheno na yaponskom yazyke.

--Zagadochnye sobytiya--
Khamomoru Tatibana pribyla po priglasheniyu v derevnyu Dayusu, dolgoe vremya izolirovannuyu ot ostalnoy Yaponii, chtoby zapisat ee traditsii. No vskore posle ee pribytiya v derevne takzhe poyavlyaetsya sushchestvo, kotoroe zhiteli derevni nazyvayut Svyatoy. Chto by eto moglo znachit?...

title: The Forgotten Land [NSZ][ENG]
description:
"The Forgotten Land" is a turn-based "Combat & Puzzle Match 3" with streamlined RPG and Management elements in a Dark Fantasy setting.

⬤ Set up your camp!
⬤ Show your combat skills!
⬤ Develop your own strategy! 
⬤ Level up!
⬤ Test your mettle!

title: Flip It [NSZ][RUS/Multi16]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 16]
description: 歡迎來到“Flip It”，這是一款令人費解的平台解謎遊戲，重力是你最大的盟友，也是最狡猾的敵人！透過翻轉整個世界來改變重力方向，穿越複雜的關卡，引導你的角色到達終點。

title: Rogue Explorer [NSZ][ENG]
description:
自創一位大膽的冒險家，展開深入深淵的旅程吧！從不起眼的中央小鎮出發，進入一座比一座危險、生物群系各異的地下城。自訂角色外觀，替換顏色，使用收集來的戰利品打造武器和護甲，升級裝備並從各式各樣的技能強化中做出選擇。

Rogue Explorer 承襲經典 Rougelike 遊戲的挑戰元素，但屏除了苛刻的限制和無力的挫折感。Rogue Explorer 中每座「銀河戰士惡魔城」風格的地下城都具備分層設計：上層在一天之內不會改變，佈局只會在遊戲內的白天/黑夜交替時產生變化，而較深層的旅程則會帶你進入更危險的地下城，每次進入時都會隨機產生變化。但別太擔心！就算探索失敗，你親愛的角色也會復活並取回裝備，只會損失深入深淵之塔途中，前一趟旅程解鎖的狀態加成和特殊技能。

善用跳躍、滾動和蹬牆跳，完整探索遊戲中的每個角落！開啟寶箱獲得的大劍、長矛和棍棒能作為主要或次要武器。在面對每座地下城駭人聽聞的首領之前，依照你的喜好結合並合成更多威力十足的道具，畢竟地下城的首領可是包括巨大骷髏、牛頭怪、龍，甚至是更恐怖的存在！

特色：

• 探索 10 種以上的地下城類型，每種都有不同挑戰等級！
• 自訂你的角色外觀，從髮型、顏色，到他們的使用裝備都能自訂。
• 在橫向卷軸關卡中四處探索，靈活地跳躍、滾動和蹬牆跳！
• 收集戰利品，打造或升級你的武器和護甲。
• 升級時可選擇替換技能或增益效果。
• 擊敗守在深淵之塔最深處的巨大首領！

title: A Pretty Odd Bunny [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Pretty Odd Bunny — eto stels-platformer v 2D o krolike, kotoromu nravitsya est sviney. Tebe predstoit igrat za krasnoglazogo krolika, kotoromu nuzhno dobratsya do svini v kontse kazhdogo urovnya i pri etom ostatsya nezamechennym drugimi krolikami! 
 
Vybiray put, na kotorom tebya ne uvidyat drugie kroliki. Oni ne odobryayut tvoi predpochteniya v ede i postarayutsya pomeshat, esli razgadayut tvoi namereniya. 
 
Khodi, begay i prygay po etomu yarkomu i opasnomu miru, polnomu krasivoy grafiki i kachestvennoy animatsii. On sozdan pokadrovo s lyubovyu i entuziazmom.
 
Issleduy bolee 80 urovney v 4 unikalnykh mirakh, nakhodi spryatannye monetki i otkryvay novye chellendzhi s milymi personazhami, zhutkovatymi stsenami, krovyu i kuchey otrezannykh svinykh golov.
 
DOBAV V SPISOK IZBRANNYKh IGR UZhE SEYChAS! Chtoby sredi pervykh sygrat v igru posle ee zapuska.
Nu a tem, kto dochital do syuda, zhelayu krolichyu lapku na udachu!
 
Vsem lyubov!

Ob igre Pretty Odd Bunny
 - 80 urovney v 4 unikalnykh mirakh.
 - Otkryvay novye chellendzhi s milymi personazhami.
 - Krasivaya grafika i kachestvennaya animatsiya.
 - Uznay, khorosho li tebe dayotsya stels!
 - Chyotkoe upravlenie, kotoroe pomozhet tebe dobitsya tseli - sest vsekh sviney!

title: Midnight Remastered / Last Escape Dead Complex (Mad Jackal) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Dead Complex 是一款自上而下的生存恐怖遊戲。
潛行、掠奪和戰鬥，逃離出沒的公寓大樓，開始你逃離城市的最後之旅。

特徵：
- 經典的生存恐怖遊戲
- 戰利品系統
- 多重結局

title: Repit [NSZ][Multi]
description:
鮑勃是一個普通人，過著簡單而有節制的生活。 十二月中旬的外面，下著小雪。 在順路為他的女兒買了雜貨和一大包冰淇淋後，Bob 離開了商店，正準備去開車，但他滑倒了，讓我們離開了滿載的購物車。 手推車翻滾撞向一位上了年紀但衣冠楚楚、相貌堂堂的男子，把他撞倒在地。 鮑勃試圖站起來跑去幫助那個人，但眨眼間周圍的一切都凍結了，雲層變厚了，血腥的黑霧籠罩著這片區域。 來不及回過神來，鮑勃滿臉驚駭的看著老者，一個有著鮮紅眼眸的黑影從地面升起，張口用陰森森的聲音說道：

可憐的小子，我將剝奪你的人形，你將永遠試圖擺脫懲罰的閉環，唯有脫離痛苦的希望才能打動你！

在黑影結束之前，Bob 感覺自己開始失敗，墜入地下並開始翻天覆地。 鮑勃感到難以置信的疼痛，他的新腳落在一個有棱角的洞穴裡……

title: Fates of Ort [NSP][ENG]
description:
Magic is powerful, but it is not free. Every spell you cast requires a little bit of your life energy to spark it. Cast enough spells and you will extinguish your very soul. This means you need to be strategic when fighting, balancing the cost of magic with the risk of taking damage from your enemies.

How each spell manifests in the world depends on what divine power you choose to combine it with. For example, the Evoke Force spell will cause the ground to erupt with a series of sharp ice crystals, summon a thunderous lightning strike, or barrage the ground with a meteor shower – all depending on what the spell is combined with.

Use the magic spells at your disposal to defeat the demons spilling out from the underworld. In Ort, time is frozen whenever you stand still. This means you have the opportunity to plan your attacks and be strategic.

Like any RPG, you will be slaying enemies to collect loot and experience. The items you pick up will improve your magical abilities, though some come with curses... As you level up, you will learn additional magic spells to use against your enemies.

Ort is varied and expansive, an open world for you to explore. Choose the order of the quests you pursue, or just explore to meet new characters. The final battle is available whenever you choose, but... Are you strong enough?

Play as a novice mage, forced to take on the responsibility of saving the world and those that are important to you. Quests can be completed to gain access to new areas, save and unlock allies, gain items and powers, and more. Replays are encouraged because small decisions can have permanent and significant consequences, leading to different game outcomes.

title: Some Some Convenience Store + 3 DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
因為家庭因素的關係，遊戲的主角開始在便利商店工作。

接著有一天，他因為無聊在玩智慧型手機，碰巧下載了一款名為Some Some的軟體，這個神祕的應用程式吸引到了他的注意力。


隨著他開啟這個應用程式時，他與三名女子的關係也由此展開……

他在手機螢幕上看見了這樣的資訊：
比較年輕、看起來氣質賢淑溫柔的女性、
旅居海外的實習生、
還有身材壯碩的保鑣。

你會選擇誰呢？

◆ 在便利商店打工的主角戀愛了
玩家將扮演助理經理的角色，管理自家的便利商店。每個禮拜經營商店，可獲得固定利潤。使用這份收入來安排新商品的擺設、變更室內設計的風格、舉辦促銷特賣活動、支付自己薪水等。你的每月薪資能夠讓你買禮物送給女孩，藉此繼續發展故事後續的情節。

◆ 從Some Some應用程式展開的愛情故事
主角使用Some Some這款智慧型手機應用程式遇見了三名截然不同的女子。Some Some應用程式會分析每一位女性的喜好與心情，並顯示出能夠成功與對方交往的可能性。玩家可查看這款應用程式，看看能夠以什麼樣的方式跟各個女孩進一步發展關係。

◆ 三名個性鮮明的女角色

Soohee Pyeon
配音：Chae-ha Kim
個性甜美真誠的兼職員工

Adela
配音：Mi Jang
活潑開朗的偶像實習生

Yena Bang
配音：Myeong-ho Lee
有話直說的保鑣

劇情中的各種事件將會帶領你探索這三位女子的故事。此外，還有專業的配音讓故事感覺起來更生動有趣。

title: So Many Me [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Filo is Filo, one of a kind or so he thought as he is woken from his peaceful sleep and eat life to go on a quest of great importance. Which he doesn’t really care much for the details so he just does.

His journey however starts in a magical fountain which splits Filo’s essence into hundreds of clones each shaped by an individual part of his personality which are called Me’s. 

However they are all a part of him so they are compelled to move when he does. Me’s as well as Filo now also have the ability to turn into magical stone platforms which can be used for puzzle solving.

Eating transmitter fruits changes the properties of the transformations. Filo can also work with the other Me’s to do special dances to allow them to transform into creatures like the Jellysaur or the Tankephaunt. He runs into other characters like Flora who seems to be a fan girl. Filo is supposed to be going after The organization called Cloud 9 in the world of Xio, runny Baron Vost. The rest he is just goofing off.

So Many Me Extended Edtion includes the complete Adventure including expansion packs with improved visuals and controls, making this the perfect edition of the game.

title: Contract Killers [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Contract Killer is fast and hard top down shooter, where you will die fast and re-play faster as you become master and start feeling the flow! Learn how to dance with your enemies and pick their weapons on the fly.

Choose from your favorite weapons like katana, chainsaw, magnum or even minigun !

- 24 levels with different enemies and challenges!
- Cold Blood - Bullet time after killing your enemies.
- Akimbo mode - dual wielding small firearms shooting, where you can choose angle of your arms.
- Stun  your enemies by throwing weapons or beating them with bat or fist.

title: Laid-Back Camp Virtual: Lake Motosu, Fumoto Campsite (Yuru Camp [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Experience Laid-Back Camp in 3D!

Together, Nadeshiko (you!) and Rin embark on a new camping adventure at Lake Motosu, taking pictures and trying lots of delicious food.

About the Game
Set near scenic Mt. Fuji, Nadeshiko, Rin & co. encounter a variety of unique situations. Join them for a short 3D adventure game (each version is about the length of an anime episode), where the fully voiced characters and vibrant scenery will make you feel like you’re really there!

Cast
Nadeshiko Kagamihara (Yumiri Hanamori)
Rin Shima (Nao Toyama)
Chiaki Ogaki (Sayuri Hara)
Aoi Inuyama (Aki Toyosaki)
Ena Saito (Rie Takahashi)
Narration by Akio Otsuka

title: Red Rope Don't Fall Behind Plus [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Red Rope: Don’t Fall Behind is an arduous challenge, a cathartic ritual that only the most valiant players will be able to carry out, be they fearless lonely travellers or couples with a strong elective affinity.
Explore the Labyrinth, get acquainted with its bizarre inhabitants, its secrets and its rules. Face enemies, traps, puzzles and ferocious bosses. To escape the Labyrinth you will have but one weapon: the rope that binds you together.

Key Features:
- Play with a friend or try alone. It won’t be easy either way.
- You are trapped in the Labyrinth: more than 100 hand-designed levels full of tension, action and mystery separate you from the exit.
- The rope is the only weapon at your disposal.
- Battle dozens of unpredictable enemies, learn their moves and plan yours. No tactics means death.
- Solve puzzles: carefully observe and exploit the many mechanisms.
- Discover a world packed with symbols to decipher and bizarre inhabitants.
- Defeat 4 mini-bosses and 5 bosses on the path to triumph.
- Climb the global chart but beware: every action has consequences.
- The game continues beyond the screen: communication and complicity are paramount.
- At least 10 hours of gameplay. Or 100 if you are not up to the challenge.
- A true hardcore experience: only a few will succeed.
- BEAT THE GAME AND BECAME AN INHABITANT OF THE LABYRINTH

title: City Wars Tokyo Reign [NSZ][ENG]
description:
STRATEGY MEETS ACTION: a fresh take on a classic genre. Dynamic track-based battlefield where tactile mechanics meet turn-based card battling.

FROM BEGINNER TO WINNER: rules can be learned in minutes, opening the doors for players of all ages and skill levels. Strong customisation and a complex meta provide long-term depth, making it much harder to master.

ENDLESS CHOICE: design your own COMBAT CASE from over 140 CARDS (across 5 categories), 20 GUNS (with stat modifiers) and over 25 CHARMS (each with battle-altering perks).

DISTRICT RUN: a deep Roguelike single-player mode where you’ll build a collection, make key decisions and battle across 5 procedurally generated Districts. Will you survive the elusive SHADOW DISTRICT and conquer the city?

title: Pixel Noire: The Song Out of Space, It Could Happen to You [NSZ][ENG]
description:
V 1962 godu dvenadtsat astronomov iz observatorii dalnego kosmosa byli naydeny mertvymi. Iz-za blizosti vazhnoy voennoy bazy dva federalnykh agenta byli otpravleny dlya rassledovaniya… I to, chto oni nashli, bylo za predelami etogo mira!
Uznayte, chto na samom dele proizoshlo toy nochyu, issleduya gorod, polnyy podozrevaemykh, kotorym est, chto skryvat, i ne dopustite, chtoby eto kogda-libo povtorilos.
Igrayt za federalnogo agenta Ketrin Armstrong, molodogo rekruta s otlichnymi nauchnymi sposobnostyami ili za Styuarta Rossa, opytnogo veterana ulichnoy rabote «na zemle», i ikh osobye navyki i individualnost izmenyat khod istorii..

title: Jorel's Brother and The Most Important Game of the Galaxy [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Yarkaya poynt-klik advenchura o vosmiletnem malchike, kotoryy zhivyot so svoey ekstsentrichnoy semey, sozdannaya po brazilskomu multserialu «Brat Dzhorela».
Dzhorel - rebyonok s shelkovistymi volosami, chto delaet ego samym populyarnym parnem v gorode. Odnako shou vrashchaetsya ne vokrug nego, a ego mladshego brata, zastenchivogo i bezymyannogo malchika, kotorogo prosto zvali «brat Dzhorela». Syuzhet vrashchaetsya vokrug besporyadkov, proiskhodyashchikh v obychnoy brazilskoy atmosfere kontsa 80-kh, sredi syurrealisticheskikh i bessmyslennykh priklyucheniy.

title: Metaverse Keeper [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
interface_lang: 英语 [ENG] + 机器翻译 来自 most2820
description:
《元能失控》是一款融合了Roguelike 要素和動作元素的聯機合作冒險遊戲。玩家將和自己的隊友一起探索隨機生成的危險世界。收集資源，探索堡壘，用各種各樣神奇的武器去戰勝來自各個時空的怪物，揭開堡壘深處魔王的秘密！

玩家不僅僅需要和多種多樣的怪物進行戰鬥，還需在魔王堡壘中收集各種芯片，開發角色的天賦，提升自己的實力。隨著遊戲內容的不斷深入，對玩家的挑戰也越來越豐富，越來越緊張資源配給和環境壓力下，後面永遠有越來越兇殘的Boss在等著你！遊戲還融合了大量的影視劇，遊戲等彩蛋和梗的內容，仔細思索便會有很多樂趣。

title: First Queen 1 Next: Record of Ornic War [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Pole bitvy so mnozhestvom vragov i soyuznikov. Vashi soldaty budut srazhatsya ili otstupat v boyu po svoemu usmotreniyu. Vy — nablyudaete za deystviyami svoikh voysk i mozhete libo peremestit personazhey, nakhodyashchikhsya v opasnosti, v bezopasnoe mesto libo otpravit silnogo personazha, chtoby on pomog pobedit vragov — i privesti svoyu armiyu k pobede!
Igra byla vpervye vypushchena v 1988 godu na yaponskiy PC-9800 pod nazvaniem «First Queen». V novoy versii igrovoy ekran byl uvelichen, i v boyakh teper mozhno ispolzovat 2-y batalon voysk, a obshchiy igrovoy protsess byl modernizirovan!
Pervaya koroleva, rodivshayasya v Ornike. Koroleva polna ambitsiy po kontrolyu nad mirom i nachala pokhod na yug. Strany, kotorye stolknulis s ney, ne byli obedineny i pali pered ee armiey, idushchey k Orniku. S padeniem svoey strany graf Richmont nachinaet kontrataku s soldatami Krusibla. Pobeda nad vrazheskim liderom mozhet prevratit sootvetstvuyushchie vrazheskie voyska v soyuznikov!

title: Guild of Darksteel [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Guild of Darksteel – zrelishchnyy platformer s bokovoy prokrutkoy v mire temnogo fentezi, polnom detaley i nyuansov.

Otpravlyaytes v mrachnoe priklyuchenie v roli Sellsword – bessmertnogo voina, vstupivshego v gildiyu Darksteel v poiskakh smysla zhizni.

Stante odnim iz bessmertnykh naemnikov i issleduyte zagadochnye tonneli pod gorodom Ravenrock.

Osobennosti igry
Zakhvatyvayushchie boi: prodvinutaya boevaya sistema daet shans pobedit lyubogo, kto vstanet na vashem puti. Otkryvayte kombinatsii i povyshayte ikh uroven. Svyazyvayte ataki i ishchite strategiyu boya, kotoraya prineset pobedu.

Zhivoy i podvizhnyy mir: izuchayte gorod Ravenrock i obshchaytes s ego zhitelyami. Zdes u kazhdogo personazha est svoya istoriyu, vdykhayushchaya zhizn v mir Guild of Darksteel. V etom mire vam zapomnyatsya i druzya, i vragi.

Glubokaya i nebanalnaya istoriya: Guild of Darksteel rasskazyvaet zakhvatyvayushchuyu istoriyu o borbe za vlast i poiskakh sebya v dukhe takoy klassiki, kak Flashback i Vagrant Story. Ee personazhi prinimayut nelegkie resheniya, pomnya o smerti... ili bessmertii.

Potryasayushchie khudozhestvennye resheniya: mir Guild of Darksteel – eto mrachnyy, no vyrazitelnyy piksel-art na fone zloveshchey i intriguyushchey muzyki. Unikalnaya i smelaya tsvetovaya palitra zadaet idealnyy ton dlya togo, chtoby izuchat pritaivshuyusya pod gorodom tmu.

title: Gallic Wars Battle Simulator [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Gallic Wars is a Roguelike tactical strategy game. Fast gameplay, crazy rag-doll physics and challenging rouge-like approach to strategy. Fight your way through roman legions. DEPLOY your troops, PLAN their movement, use magic and items to give yourself an edge, and WIN.

Features: 
- One of a kind approach to the strategy genre
- Cartoony style - a true eye candy! 
- Fast gameplay
- Powerful magic and mighty generals
- Ragdoll physics - everyone likes ragdoll physics!
- Easy to play, hard to master!

title: Superfluous Returnz [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Priklyucheniya ochen bespoleznogo supergeroya v tikhoy derevushke v glubinke frantsuzskoy selskoy mestnosti.
S pomoshchyu svoey pomoshchnitsy Sofi, kotoraya pytaetsya kak-to umerit entuziazm svoego rabotodatelya, on (to est, vy) popytaetes zaderzhat tainstvennogo pokhititelya yablok, terroriziruyushchego mestnye sady!

title: Signs of the Sojourner [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Signs of the Sojourner – syuzhetnaya kartochnaya igra pro svyaz s lyudmi. S pomoshchyu kolody kart vy napishete svoyu istoriyu i postroite otnosheniya s drugimi.

Posle smerti materi vy prinimaete v nasledstvo ee magazin i otpravlyaetes v raznye mesta, chtoby popolnit zapasy dlya nego. Na svoem puti v postradavshem ot izmeneniya klimata mire vy vstretite schastlivye istorii, otzyvchivykh personazhey i chudesnye syurprizy.

Chto mozhno delat v igre
Stroyte druzhbu, sopernichayte i obshchaytes s pomoshchyu kart
Igrayte karty, podkhodyashchie k tonu sobesednika, ili pytaytes nastoyat na svoem
Prinimayte neprostye resheniya – ikh posledstviya menyayut kolodu i posleduyushchie razgovory
Vstrechayte nezabyvaemykh personazhey
Izuchayte mir i to, chto dlya vas znachit «vernutsya domoy»
Ishchite redkie i poleznye tovary dlya zhiteley vashego gorodka
Otkryvayte raznye kontsovki

title: Enjoy the Diner [NSZ][ENG]
description:
『享受這間餐廳吧』是一部選項冒險遊戲，
講述主角誤入了一家名為「月宮」的餐廳，而這裡的時間彷彿永無止境……不過別灰心，這裡有免費的自助飲料機哦！

關於本作品：
『享受這家餐廳吧』以選項與點擊作為主要的遊戲形式，是一部較為簡短的冒險遊戲。正常情況下，抵達結局需要的時間為2～2.5小時（Waku Waku Games獨家統計），結局共有兩種。至於分歧條件，想必可以在遊戲過程中有所察覺。強烈建議在做出某個選擇之前保留一個存檔。

title: Duke of Defense [NSP][ENG]
description:
STORY
Duke of Defense is a playful action-based tower defense game brimming with ample humor, cheeky villagers, egotistical wizards, and jaunty adventure. Build, roll, and slash your way through waves upon waves of goblins, ogres, golems, and more! Upgrade your character as you advance through the story with a plethora of enhancements available within the skill tree. These abilities also apply in co-op mode, so everybody benefits! Be sure to visit the Wardrobe Well and cycle between loads of quirky heads to customize your Duke, unlocking more choices as you progress. Unique towers, potent powers, and 8-bit flowers ensure you'll be back for more. 

CO-OP
Any true hero can call upon trusty companions in their time of need. Explore new strategies when you bring along a friend! Journey forth with a partner from the comfort of your couch, where you both can dash, slice, and build with local co-op multiplayer.

GAMEPLAY
This is an action-based tower defense like no other you've experienced. Slash goblins, ogres, wizards, and more with your sword, roll through waves of enemies, and build towers as fast as you can. Reap the rewards of combat by collecting coins from fallen foes, but tread carefully so as not to get walloped on the field of action! Turn the trees scattering the battlefield into a combination of the nine powerful towers, each with their own strengths and weaknesses against different monsters - so be sure to use your resources wisely! Prepare for fast-paced boss battles with some pretty angsty wizards, conversations with philosophical deer, and hordes of bit-constructed baddies. 

SOUNDTRACK
The whole experience is wrapped up in an unbelievable composition containing everything from sweat-inducing chiptunes to comedic ambience. Over 30 unique tracks!

title: Noel the Mortal Fate 1-7 [NSP][ENG]
description:
Noel the Mortal Fate is an adventure title which started serialization as a free game in 2016 and later spawned comics and novels. 
This version of the game has been remade for a console experience, with updated UI, story and dialogue. It follows the story from the prologue through Season 7 of the series where the real battle begins for Noel and her companions.
Furthermore it now supports full HD and so can be enjoyed in TV Mode as the epic story unfolds.
This version also features Season 3.5, a bonus season which takes place between the Burrows and Jillian storylines.

■Game System
Gameplay is made up of Adventure sections where you can experience the deep story and Game sections where you can enjoy various gimmicks and action sequences.
With simple, intuitive controls and challenging but fair puzzles, players will be able to focus on the story as they progress through the game.

■Plot Summary
The story takes place in the fictional town of Lhaplus.
Noel Cerquetti, the daughter of a prestigious family, takes part in a piano competition to decide the pianist for the city’s memorial ceremony, fancying herself the clear winner.
Little does she know that the competition was rigged by a mysterious party, and would lead her down a tragic path.
Racked by guilt, she nevertheless agrees to a contract with the devil Caron, in order to get revenge on those who wronged her by sacrificing herself.
The events that follow will drag Noel into the growing darkness that surrounds Lhaplus, where she will experience first hand the grief and hatred of those who have been caught up in the machinations of devils.

title: StepMania 5.x + 1025 melodiy [NSP][ENG]
description:
StepMania – eto zamechatelnaya igra s otlichnoy grafikoy i video, kotoraya proverit vashe chuvstvo ritma!..
StepMania rabotaet s muzykalnymi i videofaylami, kotorye mozhno zagruzit ili sdelat samostoyatelno. Posle togo, kak vy zapustili igru, vam predstoit nazhimat sochetaniya klavish v sootvetstvie s muzykalnym ritmom! Podderzhivayutsya rezhimy Dance, Pump, kb7, Para, Beat, Techno, Lights, Kickbox.
Ne dumayte, chto eto skuchno – vy dazhe ne predstavlyaete, naskolko eto mozhet byt veselo! Gotovy potantsevat?
V igre est sistema nastraivaemykh urovney slozhnosti, imeetsya neplokhaya baza dannykh i razvitoe otkrytoe kommyuniki. Ona obyazatelno ponravitsya i vzroslym, i detyam!

title: Ikki Unite [NSZ][ENG]
description:
在這款終極Roguelike遊戲中團結起來！

秋收時節，原本應該要為稻米豐收而高興，卻有蝗蟲大軍來襲！
村子瀕臨危機，但官員還是照樣來收租……
為了保護我們的村莊，起義討回稻米！
這一次，我們並不孤單！ 與多達16人一起“一揆團結”了！

「最休閒」的「線上合作玩法」，操作簡單、爽快！
避開彈幕攻擊、合作打倒敵人、收集道具，然後朝著代官宅邸前進。

★★ 遊戲概覽 ★★
【目標】
打倒各區 Boss，然後打倒最終Boss……邪惡的代官！

【操作方法】
僅方向鍵（攻撃和能力全部都會自行發動）

【特徵】
1：動作遊戲
透過簡單的控制擊敗成群的敵人和Boss！

2：16人同樂
引入四種屬性的夥伴：探索、攻撃、強化和恢復！
只要大家齊心協力，我們一定能變得越來越強大！

<16個不同的角色>
権兵衛：一個正義感很強的好青年，受到腰元的喜愛。一揆團結中揮舞棍棒起義。 
田吾：冷靜溫柔的少年，如原作一樣，用鐮刀攻擊！
丹波：一揆團結中忍者成為了夥伴！？伊伏銀的可怕忍者也參與起義！
坊主：面容可怕，但心地善良可靠的僧侶。會全力支援夥伴。
四郎：他用祈禱的力量來支援夥伴！他的魅力依然存在！
平八郎：他為那些因徵稅而受苦的村民挺身而出！他將用他的鎖鐮擊倒敵人！
用心棒：受某人僱用的保鑣。 薪資是起義成功的獎勵！？
秀頼：意想不到的大名也參與了起義！？他可以指揮隊友，提升實力！
女忍者：戰鬥力出色的女忍者！ 用分身術壓倒敵人！
孫一：傳說中的鉄砲組的老大來了！ 他也會使用刀。
與作：身體強壯的家夥，是権兵衛等人可靠的夥伴。
五右衛門：哪裡有錢，哪裡就有五右衛門。這個大盜擅長收集金錢。
吟遊詩人：一位戰場女歌手，用歌聲激勵同伴。她的三味線的聲音讓敵人嚇壞了！
陰陽師：他努力學習成為了陰陽道的大師！用陰陽元素的神秘力量消滅敵人！
藥師：既懂治療藥，又懂可疑藥（！？）。用特效藥支援夥伴！
腰元：她對権兵衛的愛沒有時間限制！她將用38年的思念來守護。

3： Roguelike 
每次玩都會面臨不一樣的關卡！這是一個可以可以重複玩的遊戲。

★★ 推薦點 ★★
最重要的是，可以16人的線上合作遊戲！
邀請你的朋友一起並肩作戰！

如果大家一起努力，我們會比一個人的時候更強大
但你或許很猶豫是否要和不認識的人一起玩……
我們的開發人員也有同樣的想法。

因此我們引入了“表情”按鈕！
有了這個按鈕，你可以了解氣氛並知道每個人在哪裡。

一起擊敗大量敵人的爽快感將會一氣加速！
這才是真正的團結rougelike動作遊戲！

只差一點點就能通關遊戲了……
只差一點點就能復活隊友了……
只差一點點就能見到隊友了……

“大家都跟得上嗎？”，當你腦海中閃過這句話時，
你距離沈迷於「團結」已經一步之遙了。

title: Best Friend Forever [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Best Friend Forever is the world’s first simulation game to combine pet care and dating (just not necessarily at the same time). Train, pat and play with your very own dog to form a bond that will last the ages. With your four-legged companion by your side, meet, woo and cherish the many cuties of Rainbow Bay’s thriving singles scene.

So what are you waiting for? Love is just a woof away!

- Fall in love with a diverse cast of local singles.
- Spend quality time with your dog to raise its stats and pass Paws Academy.
- Go everywhere with your best friend — your dog interacts with you and the narrative as it happens.
- Experience modern love at its finest! Be whoever you want, love whoever you want.

title: Qomp 2 [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
控制一個渴望擺脫卡在兩個球拍之間的乒乓球。探索一個危險的極簡世界，配備簡單的兩個按鈕控件：點擊按鈕以 45 度對角線改變方向，按住按鈕釋放向前衝刺。這就是解決環境難題和迷宮關卡所需的全部內容。每個角落都有一個新的挑戰，將測試您的兩鍵操作和解決問題的技能。當您穿越分佈在四個世界的 30 個關卡時，各種棘手的敵人和頭目會幫助您標記時間。

這款獨立的《Pong》遊戲的核心是一個腦力解謎遊戲。

主要特徵：

令人費解的大腦：簡單的兩個按鈕控制掩蓋了複雜而引人入勝的遊戲玩法。發揮你的反應能力並提前思考以避免危險，翻轉開關並彈跳通過 30 個棘手的關卡。隱藏的收藏品促使您探索極簡地圖的每一寸。

每個角落都充滿驚喜：隨著您深入遊戲，qomp 2 會不斷引入新功能、機制、敵人、陷阱和危險，為您帶來驚喜。不要自滿：一旦您掌握了遊戲玩法的一個方面，另一個方面就準備好挑戰您。

頭目：四個具有挑戰性的頭目在每個世界的盡頭阻擋你的道路。您將需要使用所有新發現的技能來掌握他們的攻擊和防禦。不用擔心。在街機風格的世界中，死亡並不是終結。快速重生可確保您在幾秒鐘內回到行動中。

寧靜的音景：環境即興的配樂讓您進入最佳狀態，並幫助您在穿過極簡主義迷宮時保持冷靜。

情感之旅：一個關於懷疑、恐懼和自我接受的神秘故事，通過簡單的效果和遊戲玩法無言地講述。

title: The Mystery of the Mayan Ruins [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Welcome to our new edition of The Mystery saga. This time we take to you The Mystery of the Mayan Ruins!

J. Smith is a retired treasure hunter until one day his family is kidnapped. The kidnappers have offered a deal: getting them the Medallion of Eternal Youth in exchange for his family. J. Smith now starts again one of his adventures, this time to recover the lost medallion and bring his family back home. According to legend, the medallion is hidden in the Mayan ruins. The trip will not be easy: many puzzles and riddles will need to be solved to find the medallion. The journey starts now. Are you ready?

Will you be able to recover the medallion?

Will J. Smith be able to get his family?

Find out in this amazing Point and Click!

FEATURES

- Based on the Point and Click games
- Great graphics that will immerse you in the story
- Lots of items to collect and puzzles to solve
- An incredible soundtrack
- Self-saved
- HD graphics
- All items tagged
- NO hidden objects
- Track book

title: Hei [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Hei 是一個有著人形外表的可愛生物。 他迷路了，從他最寶貴的地方掉下來了。 現在他迷失在一個充滿謎語和神秘人物的混亂世界中。 陪他通過 4 個不同的關卡。 每個級別都有自己的特點。 途中你會遇到形形色色好奇的朋友。

遊戲特色：
  - 超過 40 個很棒的地點。
  - 與觸摸屏和 Joy-Con™ 完全兼容。
  - 遊戲中的成就。
  - 手工製作、自然而有趣的配樂。
  - 具有鮮豔色彩的原創藝術風格。

title: Guard Duty [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Tondbert, vernyy Strazh v zamke Vrinkvud, mozhet za mnogoe otvetit. Vo vremya ego strazhi kto-to pronik v korolevstvo i pokhitil printsessu — sobytie, kotoroe budet imet posledstviya v budushchem.

Tysyachu let spustya chelovechestvo priblizhaetsya k svoemu kontsu — zlaya temnaya sila mozhet steret ego s litsa zemli. Prisoedinyaysya k agentu Starborn, chtoby spasti Zemlyu i pobedit zlo, sushchestvuyushchee vekami!

Uznay, kak sudby etikh dvukh igrovykh personazhey perepleteny, i ty smozhesh legko spasti chelovechestvo v etoy traditsionnoy igre-priklyuchenii!

Kharakteristiki:
 * Polnostyu otdelnaya igra, okhvatyvayushchaya dva raznykh perioda vremeni, s neobkhodimostyu tshchatelno produmyvat deystviya
 * Bolee 6000 fraz ozvuchennykh dialogov
 * Unikalnaya muzyka i zvuk
 * Integrirovannyy spisok tekushchikh zadach garantiruet, chto ty nikogda ne poteryaesh tsel iz vidu
 * Vypolnennaya vruchnuyu pikselnaya grafika s sotnyami prorisovannykh animatsiy

title: Star Seeker in the Secret of the Sorcerous Standoff [NSP][ENG]
description:
Good news: magic is real! Bad news: magic is highly illegal. Star Seeker is a wizard and you must solve a wizard crime or else get thrown in wizard jail by wizard- I mean, just regular police. In this short point 'n' click adventure, collect evidence and use it to clear up the useless detective's many confusions- and don't worry about getting it wrong. Every hare-brained idea you can possibly pitch to the detective prompts unique dialogue!

* A short, one-room point-and-click mystery dense with clues
* Unique responses for every combination of clue and question
* Customizable pronouns in the options
* Gorgeous pixelart and a magical original soundtrack
* There is a goat in it, and it goes "maaaaaa"
* If you don't think that last one is a selling point then I don't know what to tell you

title: Buck Bradley Comic Adventure 1-2 [NSZ][ENG]
description:
一切都很好

拿起任何你能在包裡找到的東西。你會驚訝於它們是多麼有用。它將説明你結交新朋友，避免危險或只是獲得免費的東西。

漫畫書圖形

如果你喜歡漫畫書和視覺小說，你應該毫不猶豫地嘗試一下這個遊戲。風格化的卡通圖形賦予它獨特的氛圍，一定會讓你保持興趣。

尋求協助

不要太擔心。如果你沒有立即找到謎語的答案，你可以隨時要求一個提示。記得！你不能經常獲得它們，因此請確保你確實需要它們時才使用。

主要特點：

- 簡單的控制
- 易於理解的遊戲玩法
- 風格化的漫畫書圖形
- 令人難以置信的音樂曲目
- 許多令人滿意的謎題

title: Demon Go [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
《Demon Go!》是橫向捲軸奔跑動作類遊戲，玩家使用簡單的控制按鈕就能快速闖關。

通往可愛貓咪天堂的道路走起來可不容易，協助小惡魔抵達他一直以來都夢想企及的烏托邦吧！

<遊戲介紹>

▶ 全速前進，沙沙給油！ 
只需要跳躍與衝刺兩種操作，就能夠永無止境地往前衝！使用這兩個動作逃離或擊敗惡魔，抵達可愛貓咪天堂！ 

▶ 精彩刺激的逃脫過程！ 
每個關卡都有各自的特色！在空中跳躍、轟飛敵人，並使用簡單的控制功能闖關成功！
 
▶ 使用物品破關更容易！
收集每個關卡的全部金幣可解鎖各式各樣的物品！地獄商店販賣著擁有各種不同能力的物品，配出屬於你自己的物品組合並挑戰關卡吧！ 

▶ 前往貓咪的烏托邦美好世界！
跟著迷失方向四散而逃的貓咪一起逃離地獄！獲救的貓咪決定跟著我們的小惡魔一起前往關卡的結尾。在逃離地獄的過程中，你說不定會找到幾隻特別的貓咪。

title: Fire Tonight [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Maya and Devin are separated in a city on fire. In the year 1990, before cell phones or Internet. They’re on their own, wondering about the choices that brought them here, how they met, and what the future might hold.

Inspired by Information Society's song of the same name, Fire Tonight is a lighthearted but thoughtful walk through the story of a relationship. A story about believing in each other when the whole world tries to keep them apart.

title: Grotto [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Nastali nespokoynye vremena. Plemya doliny obrashchaetsya k vashim silam predskazyvat budushchee i prosit soveta.

Sudba plemeni zavisit ot vashikh prorochestv. Porazmyslite nad kazhdym sozvezdiem ili pozvolte zvezdam voyti v vashe soznanie. Vy — Proritsatel, i vam suzhdeno prochitat budushchee.

Osobennosti igry
Smotrite v nebo so svyashchennoy skaly, risuyte sozvezdiya i chitayte poslaniya zvezd.
Nauchites chitat po kostyam i uznavat po nim budushchee. Svyazhites s temi, kto uzhe ushel v mir inoy.
Uznayte svoy narod i pomogite emu preodolet neuryaditsy.
Vybirayte otvety pravilno: v vashikh rukakh nastoyashchee i budushchee vashego plemeni. Ot vashikh slov zavisit ikh blagopoluchie ili pogibel.
Vizualnyy stil, sochetayushchiy v sebe 2D i 3D grafiku, udivitelnym obrazom ozhivlyaet mir Grotto.

title: Baobabs Mausoleum Grindhouse Edition: Pack - Ep. 1: Ovnifagos Don't Eat Flamingos / Ep. 2: 1313 Barnabas Dead End Drive / Ep. 3: Un Pato en Muertoburgo [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Follow Watracio Walpurgis, our fresh eggplant FBI agent, in this arc of three chapters that unifies the universe of Celery Emblem’s Jacob Jazz on the ultimate Baobabs Masoleum Grindhouse Edition.  

Go crazy in this 8-bit retro adventure set in Flamingo's Creek, a ghost town that only appears every 25 years on the Albatro’s Road and immerse yourself in the most out-of-touch, alienated neighborhood community you will ever know.   

Steal, fight, negotiate, solve puzzles... Anything goes to find Daphne and get out of that cursed town that will be kept, forever, inside your brain as one of the selected nightmares ever created.

title: Detective Case and Clown Bot in Murder in the Hotel Lisbon [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Delo ob ubiystve v otele «Lissabon» — igra, vdokhnovlennaya klassicheskimi point-and-click igrami 80-kh i 90-kh. Ona perenimaet kharakternyy dizayn etogo perioda i sozdana isklyuchitelno pri pomoshchi tekhniki piksel-arta. Eto — Det Ektiv, Robot-Kloun i ubiystvo v otele «Lissabon»!
Tainstvennoe ubiystvo sluchilos v otele, muzhchina sovershil samoubiystvo, nanesya sebe nozhom 14 udarov v spinu v tot samyy moment, kogda on mirno popival kofe. Eto delo s protivorechivymi faktami okazalos slishkom slozhnym dlya politseyskogo Garsiya, tak chto on reshil nanyat edinstvennyy na ves gorod duet, kotoryy sposoben raskryt ego: Detektiva Det Ektiva i Robota-Klouna.

title: The Knight Of Queen [NSZ][ENG]
description: Pogruzites v mir oldskulnoy rolevoy igry v virtualnoy realnosti (est vozmozhnost podklyuchit VR Labo), ili v obychnom rezhime. Stante geroem eyo velichestva Korolevy, issleduya vokselnyy mir, chtoby pobedit porochnogo Korolya-Demona!..

title: Bow to Blood Last Captain Standing [NSZ][ENG]
description:
V «Bow to Blood» vy srazhaetes za zvanie Chempiona Areny, poka nevidimye smotriteli proveryayut na prochnost vas i vashikh sopernikov v realiti-shou, gde pobeditelyu dostaetsya vse.

PRINIMAYTE REShENIYa SAMOSTOYaTELNO!
Vstante na mostike vashego moguchego korablya, otdayte ukazaniya komande, vyberite tsel, perenapravte potoki energii... Vam dazhe mozhet ponadobitsya vashe vernoe lichnoe oruzhie, kogda situatsiya nakalitsya ne na shutku!

VYBIRAYTE DRUZEY - ILI VRAGOV
Vashi soperniki v «Bow to Blood» nadeleny lichnostyami s iskusstvennym intellektom. Oni rukovodstvuyutsya sobstvennymi motivami i tselyami. Pomogayte svoim soratnikam i zaruchaytes ikh podderzhkoy - ili ispolzuyte ikh dlya svoey vygody. Vybor za vami, no on dolzhen byt mudrym! Vashi soperniki zapomnyat, kak vy obrashchalis s nimi, a na Arene obidy ne zabyvayutsya ochen dolgo.

KAZhDAYa IGRA UNIKALNA
Randomizirovannye skhvatki i menyayushchiysya sostav uchastnikov - garantiya bogatykh vpechatleniy!

title: Time Tenshi [NSP][ENG]
description:
Team up with Rose, Kyo and Michelle - the beautiful Time Tenshi (Time Angels) - in this exciting visual novel as you enter the amazing world of time travel, made possible by the work of Tensai Shiro, the genius inventor behind the Time Window: mankind's first functioning time machine!

Playing as Kenji - a young man who loses everything to a terrible house fire - you'll discover just how far the limits of time can be pushed as you join the Time Tenshi in their missions into history!

But a mysterious, malicious force soon emerges, seeking to alter the flow of time for their own purposes! What secrets does time hold, and what consequences await those who tamper with it? 

Choose wisely in decisions throughout the story to gain positive Affinity Points for the three girls, influence the story's outcome and maybe even unlock some secret endings!

We at Silver Cow Studio have worked hard to bring you a high quality production, and we're confident you'll really enjoy Time Tenshi!

Can mankind truly be trusted with the power to travel through time?

What dangers will Rose, Kyo and Michelle face on their adventures?

And can Kenji ever reclaim the reality he tragically lost?

title: Knock 'Em Down! Bowling [NSZ][ENG]
description:
揮舞您的Joy-con來體驗正統的3D保齡球！
在基本模式中，
您除了可以選擇最基本的10瓶制保齡球之外，也能挑戰來自世界各國的保齡球玩法，例如直瓶式保齡球、短瓶式保齡球等等。
本模式中只要一個Joy-con便能支援四人遊玩，加上畫面分割、團體戰、沒有球溝的球道…？等，提供各種設定等您來挑戰！
咦？使用輪盤來決定投球姿勢的綜藝保齡球模式又是什麼何方神聖呢……？

在派對模式中，您必須持有人數份的Joy-con來遊玩此模式。
遊戲對應1~4人遊玩及三種玩法任您挑選。
‧大亂鬥保齡球
投吧投吧快投出您手中的保齡球！打倒豪華瓶來一口氣贏過對手吧！
‧斜坡保齡球
球道怎麼是斜的？！結合大家的力量投球吧！
‧滑動保齡球
瞄準會移動的球瓶！和隊友同心協力贏得勝利吧！

從世界各國的保齡球到歡樂派對模式再加上各種綜藝要素，
千萬別錯過此款簡單上手並適合闔家玩樂的派對運動遊戲！

title: Gem Wizards Tactics [NSZ][ENG]
description:
引領戰鬥
寶石巫師戰術將熟悉的戰術遊戲公式與多種戰鬥機制以及隨機生成的地圖相結合，為單人遊戲帶來數小時的樂趣！你將參加一場不僅僅是搗碎敵人的戰爭 - 每場戰鬥都是一個複雜的難題。

來自地獄的公司
惡魔的東西從下面升起。這是邪惡的，他們穿著西裝 - 他們是商業惡魔。他們要用他們的企業之手征服一切！跟隨一位年輕實習生的冒險經歷，進行史詩般的任務，以找到有關Omni-Gem的真相！

與眾不同的戰爭遊戲
寶石巫師戰術擁有五個國家和數十個獨特的單位 - 每個單位都有特殊技能可供使用 - 戰鬥中可用的各種方法將讓你大吃一驚！

把你的對手從你剛剛凍結的河上的棋盤邊緣推開，用火焰阻擋他們的路徑，讓他們排成一排，用刺穿的攻擊結束他們，或者結合他們來統治對手 - 這取決於你如何創造性地領導軍隊！

主要特點：
- 隨機生成的地圖，將提供無盡的樂趣
- 多種戰鬥機制，允許各種戰術組合！
- 五個不同的國家，擁有數十個具有獨特力量的單位 - 將它們結合起來釋放地獄！
- 多種遊戲模式，包括故事模式，戰役和自定義遊戲
- 地圖編輯器，將允許你準備自己的戰爭場景
- 豐富多彩的像素藝術視覺效果和迷人的配樂！

title: Embracelet [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Embracelet is a puzzle adventure game with a gripping story, gentle and satisfying puzzles, characters you'll love and a beautiful, orchestral soundtrack.

You play as Jesper, a Norwegian teenager who lives with his mom in the city.

One day he is handed an old bracelet by his Grandfather who grew up in a fishing community up north. This bracelet has powers - strange, mysterious powers!

Jesper is given the task to unravel the mystery behind the bracelet. Where does it come from? Who does it belong to? And why did his Grandfather leave the island and his old life behind?

With its gentle difficulty level, intriguing story and beautiful soundtrack, Embracelet is a game for anyone who enjoys unique, heartwarming video games.

Embracelet is made by Mattis Folkestad, one man team behind the award-winning adventure game Milkmaid of the Milky Way.

title: Earth Wars (Earth's Dawn) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
In the year 2020
The world has become a nest for the unknown hostile organisms (E.B.E.)

No current weapons appear to make any impact on the E.B.E. leaving humanity powerless, and on the brink of destruction.
However, humanity has now got one last hope for survival
in the development of bioarmor which fuses the EBE's body tissue with metal.
These are the Special Enhanced A.N.T.I troops who have incorporated this weaponry with remodeling surgery.
With the power of the A.N.T.I., humanity for the first time successfully destroys the EBE Baron class.
In the wake of this victory, humanity has mounted a large-scale counteroffensive.
With the hopes of the new strength of the A.N.T.I.

title: Doodle Derby [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Doodle Derby— gonochnyy platformer s dyavolskoy fizikoy, vdokhnoveniem dlya kotorogo posluzhili bitvy igrushek iz vashikh detskikh zapasov. V naimenee realistichnoy gonochnoy igre vozmozhno vsyo! Vo Doodle Derby vy stroite trassy, a potom stremites dostich tseli urovnya. Dostroyte dobavochnye uchastki trassy i ispytayte svoyu sudbu! Ne poluchaetsya? Perestroyte trassu. 

Vo Doodle Derby est kampaniya dlya odnogo igroka s bezumnymi golovolomkami, a takzhe mnogopolzovatelskie rezhimy, kotorye proveryat vashu druzhbu na prochnost.

Stroit trassy vo Doodle Derby bystro i legko. Vybirayte iz 40 samykh bezumnykh elementov trassy, kotorye vy kogda-libo videli. Blagodarya beskonechnym sochetaniyam elementov vse urovni unikalny.

V mnogopolzovatelskom rezhime vam nuzhno pridumat sobstvennyy plan i rasstroit chuzhie. (Naprimer, podvesnym sharom, volshebnoy palochkoy ili prosto dlanyu gospodney). Poka kto-to ne dobralsya do finisha, igroki ne vykhodyat iz tsikla sozidaniya i razrusheniya. Perekhitrite sopernikov, postroiv skrytye puti ili proyaviv nebyvaluyu zhestokost. Pobezhdaet samyy kovarnyy igrok. 
Osobennosti:
•	Uvlekatelnaya kampaniya dlya odnogo igroka.
•	Rezhim setevoy i lokalnoy mnogopolzovatelskoy igry (do 4 igrokov)
•	Uchastvuyte v gonkakh i stroyte poperemenno samye epichnye i bezumnye urovni, poka ne doberetes do finisha.
•	Konstruktor urovney Doodle Derby: stroyte sobstvennye urovni, a zatem broste vyzov druzyam i proverte, spravyatsya li oni!
•	Chudovishchnye obezyany! Rakety! Pirani! NLO! Okolo 40 chastey trass i 60 millionov (ne podtverzhdeno!) sochetaniy!
•	Bezbashennoe zvukovoe soprovozhdenie
•	Mnogo sekretov, kotorye mozhno nayti. Vozmozhnost otkryt novye mashinki, prepyatstviya i urovni! 
•	Razrushaemoe okruzhenie, vklyuchaya klubniku i drugie frukty.
•	Nastolko krutoy fon, kotoryy mogli narisovat tolko deti — chto oni i sdelali.

title: Angel Whisper [NSP][ENG]
description:
"ANGEL WHISPER", released by Child-Dream in 1999, became a major topic of conversation with its system of playing the posthumous game while browsing actual websites, raising the question, "Did this really happen?". Its conclusion, seemingly predicting the modern era of 2023, led to mixed opinions and, along with the psychological horror "Scars of the Doll", it became a pioneering presence in indie Visual Novel.

[Video Letter from Mirai] (Voice Actor: Ai Shimizu)
This is more than just a video game trailer; it's a personal plea to you.
Due to circumstances, I am making this request alongside the release of the game.
Would you play this video game until the very end?
In 1999, my father, game designer Hiroaki Yushima, abruptly vanished from our lives, leaving behind a single video game.
"ANGEL WHISPER"... this is that video game.

Please, I need your help.
Will you uncover the truth... on my behalf?

[Remake for Nintendo Switch]
・Completely refreshed graphics, including characters and stills.
・Added an epilogue and hints for 2023. Designed for anyone to play to the end.
・Music provided from "epitaph" by composer H.Oshima. Also, remastered the original's popular BGM.
・Added a fortune-telling system by the original's popular character, the fortune-teller Laisa.

[From the Creator]
This game, in 2023, was refined at the request of my friend's daughter, Mise Yushima.

The truth behind the disappearance of the original creator, Hiroaki Yushima, remains unclear to this day. No suicide note or clues were left behind, only this game, "ANGEL WHISPER." 
The creators cannot be held responsible for any events that may occur as a result of playing this video game.

[Story]
"Why did he leave behind this game and disappear?"

Game creator Yushima suddenly vanished from this world, and the only thing left behind was a single game, "ANGEL WHISPER."

The content depicted in the posthumous work was an event Yushima experienced in 1998. He joined a certain game company and began producing a game based on Nostradamus's prophecy of the end of the world. However, in the midst of production, a mysterious incident occurred, and he lost his colleagues.

Within the game, the protagonist Yushima, while advancing development at the game company, chases after the mystery of the incident. Soon, Yushima confronts an inexplicable entity.

What was Yushima pursuing, and what kind of incident did he get entangled in? Why did he leave behind this work? Play until the end, and discover his final intentions.

[Child-Dream / Mister Stories Inc.]
Since 1997, they have been producing PC games focusing on RPGs and adventure games with a strong emphasis on narrative. Following their success, they became a corporation. Both of their adventure games for the Nintendo Switch received rave reviews, with many praising their poignant dramas.
"Scar of the Doll: A Psycho-Horror Story about the Mystery of an Older Sister"
"Senri no Kifu": Japanese Chess Mystery Visual Novel

title: GemaBoy Zero Origins [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Spustya paru let posle sobytiy PLOID i Uchusen, Ploids sformirovali patrul, kotoryy okhranyaet vremya i prostranstvo, chtoby izbezhat povtoreniya istorii V.O.I.D. i PLOID s doktorom Elo... Vy prevrashchaetes v sovershenneyshego PLOID X, no chto-to ne tak s vashimi vospominaniyami. Vy dolzhny otpravitsya v multivselennuyu v poiskakh svyashchennykh diskov, soderzhashchikh neobkhodimuyu informatsiyu, chtoby sdelat posledniy shag i razvivatsya.

✦Ozhivite klassicheskiy retro-geympley
✦Khardkornye platformennye urovni
✦Borba s bossami s unikalnymi slabostyami
✦Eshche bolshe udovolstviya s mini-igrami
✦Dopolnitelno i mnogoe drugoe!

title: Serin Fate [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Explore a retro-inspired world bustling with rich story, unique mechanics, and fearsome Monsters!
Encourages an adventurous spirit and offers greater difficulty to the brave who seek it.

Main Features
- Sprawling and large world.
- Epic storyline and narrative.
- Use of Magic and Spell casting.
- Capture 50 species of Familiars.
- Train, tend & level your Familiars to defeat formidable Monsters.
- Hone skills, spend points, and choose a perk path.
- Complex stats, calculations & combat build diversity.
- Pursue a deeper relation with NPCs and unravel their stories.

Sub Features
 - Craft all assortments of weapons, trinkets, armor, edibles and 
    furniture.
 -  Find side tasks and Witchery errands.
 -  Grow a sprouting potion garden.
 - Timing events, day night cycle, and weather patterns.
 - Choose to play Serin, Val, or Human and customize your 
   character.
 - Hard Mode: With greater risk & reward.

Evil is afoot...
Wielding your new Magic, bound into mysterious Monster-infested lands to uncover ancient relics and restore the Fate Stone. Along the way, explore the depths of every nook to find creatures, garner ingredients, train in Witchery, and craft new equipment.
