Moments before its destruction, by the hands of evil, the Fate Stone imbued you with Magic. Now it’s time to learn some Witchery, armor up, and aid Princess Starwen in finding the lost Shards of Fate.

It’s dangerous to go alone… Take your battle-worthy familiar, some unique friends, and wits for adventure! Or spend your days around town running errands for the Witches Guild, fishing, tending your familiars, and shaping up a potion garden.

Serin Fate is riddled with secrets, hidden depths, and deeper complexities in combat, exploration, items, and stats.
A Sun Amulet that slows time during the day, or a ring that bites Monsters who attack you? Yup.
Entertaining those fleeting "I wonder..." thoughts will aid your quest!

title: Shio [NSZ][ENG]
description: 《汐》是一款高難度的橫版過關遊戲，在這裏你將通過打擊燈籠對整個世界發起挑戰，雖然在遊戲中你不會遭遇任何戰鬥，但依然要面對諸多強大的“敵人”。當你越過齒輪、跳過懸崖、通過機關的考驗後，仔細回想，你將發現一段隱秘而憂傷的故事。

title: The Sealed Ampoule [NSZ][ENG]
description:
CAVYHOUSE, creators of Forget Me Not: My Organic Garden and The Midnight Sanctuary, presents their latest “Clicker-style Dungeon Agriculturalization Rogue-like Game”!

Level-up not only your character, but your dungeon itself to score huge bumper crops of items and Magic Circles galore!

By continuously exploring deeper and deeper into the dungeon, you can remake (agriculturalize) your dungeon, increasing your strategic efficiency and gradually transforming it into a bountiful and profitable farm in this extremely unique and original Rogue-like game combining elements of dungeon exploration and clicker-style gameplay.

▼ Story
There once was a novice alchemist named Irene.
Having recently lost her beloved mother, she decided to start her own business as a way to help take her mind off of her grief and become more independent.
One day, she found a cheap secondhand dungeon for sale in an online alchemist shop called "Mercuri", and bought it immediately.
However, if a deal seems too good to be true, well...
The dungeon turned out to be full of strange enemies, which Irene must defeat before gathering items for her alchemy practices.
Upon finally reaching the deeper depths of the dungeon, exhausted, she encounters a doll-like set of twins and the mysterious dead body of an unknown man.
This is where Irene's dodgy dungeon murder mystery begins...

▼ Game System
The basic game system is pretty simple: Explore the dungeon > Harvest items > Go back home and handle various “preparations” > Explore the dungeon some more.

During the preparation phase, you can develop and expand your dungeon or acquire new skills for Irene. Learning new skills will allow you to dive deeper into the dungeon and fight against tougher enemies and bosses.

▼ Dungeon Agriculturalization
There are two distinct “levels” for each dungeon floor: Farm level and Magic level.

Increasing Farm level will increase the number of items made available; Increasing Magic level will increase the number of useful magic circles.

Ultimately, if you manage to maximize both levels for a particular floor, you can then agriculturalize it. Once agriculturalized, the floor becomes a veritable paradise, providing large amounts of items and free of any enemies.

▼ Various Skills
There are over 100 types of skills, such as Attack, Heal, Enchant, Item Management, etc. Each player can develop their own unique play style based on how they manage and combine their various skills.

Prepare yourself well, go out and explore the dungeon, and level up both your character and your dungeon...

It’s an all-new type of Rogue-like exploration and adventure!

title: Dininho Adventures [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Only someone very evil could have the coldness to steal the eggs of a helpless dinosaur mom and Dininho cannot leave it at that.
Explore this colorful and dangerous world, rescuing all helpless babies. But be careful, "He" will be waiting for you at the end of each road.
I trust you! Go and be the hero of Dinolândia.

Features
- Take control of Dininho in this classic platform adventure, overcoming obstacles to deliver the eggs to the nest.
- Main campaign with 4 different worlds with their own characteristics and challenges.
- Special unlockable world for the best explorers.
- In-game timer (Speedrunners <3).
- Ranking of best times in each stage among your friends!

title: Secrets of Magic 1-5: The Book of Spells / Witches & Wizards / Happy Halloween / Potion Master / Back to School [NSZ][ENG]
description:
在學習了魔法藝術並成為真正的女巫後，維多利亞準備追捕艾格尼絲並釋放她的父母。女巫和巫師團結起來對抗邪惡！

踏上激動人心的冒險之旅，穿越神奇而危險的土地，擊敗終極邪惡。拿起你的魔杖，準備在《魔法的秘密 2：女巫與巫師》中進行戰鬥。

- 大量獨特且具挑戰性的關卡
- 刺激的三消遊戲
- 挑戰、放鬆、專家和休閒模式
- 收集金幣來增強你的能力

title: Sucker for Love First Date [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Oderzhimyy okkultnymi ritualami, vy nakonets-to poluchili poslednee, chto vam nuzhno, chtoby vyzvat to, chto presleduet vas vo snakh — strannuyu yarko-rozovuyu knigu Nekronomikon.
Provodya edinstvennyy ritual, kotoryy ne vyglyadit kak bezumnyy bred, vy sluchayno vyzyvaete simpatichnuyu monstrodevushku, Ln'etu.
Chto samoe uzhasnoe — ona soglashaetsya na nevinnyy potseluy tolko pri uslovii, chto vy snachala provedyote dlya neyo neskolko vesma razvratnykh ritualov!..Eshchyo vizualnykh novell na Switch (renpy).

title: Skellboy Refractured [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Life was peaceful in the Cubold Kingdom until the king's evil court magician got dumped by the princess. With his heart broken and his rage fueled, he called upon the evil spirits to resurrect the dead and the kingdom's long forgotten monstrosities.

What he doesn't realize in his fury is that he accidentally summoned an ancient hero as well... Skippy! Travel across the beautifully rendered kingdom of Cubold and take full advantage of your resurrected, skeletal body! Swap out body parts to acquire new abilities during your adventure or pick up a new weapon to vanquish the evil magician's lackeys. 

Onwards, Skippy, it's time to be a hero once more!

• A true action-rpg experience that will test your skill and reward exploration!
• An expansive singleplayer experience across the interconnected world of Cubold!
• Local two player Co-Op Mode for everything the game has to offer!
• The unique ability to swap out body parts to acquire special abilities!
• Several weapon types to clobber any foes you face!
• Special enemies and bosses that will truly test your mettle!
• A beautifully vibrant world alongside some rocking chiptune tracks!
• A brand new Randomized Dungeon!
• Massive New Game+ Mode with new Items, enemies and challenges!

title: Your Toy [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
還記得你童年時的玩具麼？還記得你把它們扔到了哪裡麼？它們曾是你最好的朋友，現在卻將成為你最可怕的夢魘。



《你的玩具》是第一人稱的驚悚解謎遊戲，通過永不重複的隨機謎題、令人心跳過速的逃脫關卡和懸疑詭異的巧妙敘事，你將直面潛意識中最深沉的黑暗世界。在完全沉浸的3D環境中，寫實的畫面風格將為你營造一個怪誕而又迷人的氛圍。而你，準備好踏入噩夢了嗎？



你從黑暗中醒來，發現自己被困於一個已被遺忘的地方，接連的神秘資訊引誘你走向未知的深淵，而有人正隱藏在現實之外看著你。在你自己的記憶和虛假的幻夢之間，已久被遺忘的受害者想要和你玩一個遊戲。但這一次，誰才是那個玩具？

title: Tap Tap Legions [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Devils destroyed the royal Wedding and taken our queen away. Fortunately, our king fled quickly...
Well, Knights, soldiers, and even farmers are ready to go! Our king needs his queen tonight!

• Easy to play! Tap tiles to summon soldiers. Explosive fun!
• Truly epic battles, fierce engagements!
• Choose your army for battle! How strategic can you be?
• 11 kinds of soldier. Upgrade and fight with any combination of soldier you want!
• 8 cards make things better ...or worse. Don't tap the wrong tiles!
• 5 special items to help keep you alive!
• 64 levels! You will love it!
• Variety of challenging monsters at every stage, INTENSE BOSS LEVELS!!
.....

You think you have the time to sit through this introduction?

Our queen can't wait! See you on the battlefield!

title: Guild of Ascension [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Craft weapons, learn skills, befriend critters, encounter bizarre creatures, and fight giant Bosses in your Ascension of the Tower!

Real-Time action combo system
The Tower grant you few seconds to act freely during your turn, make sure to use them wisely by learning and master your weapons combo and special attacks.

One player, Two characters
If your group wants to succeed in the Tower, it must plan and act in perfect armony, like they are sharing the same mind.

Collect the loot
The Tower will reward you after each fights, keep the money and materials for the guild.
But make sure to ask for privileges that will help you during your next challenges, as climbing the Tower is no easy task.

Craft better equipment
Once you are back from you lastest trip in the Tower, make sure to ask the Guild to craft you some new equipment.
You will need all the help you can get if you hope to Ascend to the top.

Battle Giants Bosses
Once you find the Guardians of the Tower floors, don't be afraid by their massive size, and used what you learn to overcome the challenge!

Good luck on your Ascension.

title: Swimsanity [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Obnovlenie 2.0 dlya Swimsanity!
- Pomimo rezhimov priklyucheniya, bezumnogo priklyucheniya i vyzhivaniya, byl dobavlen rezhim odinochnoy igry dlya solo-igrokov.
- Slozhnost sovmestnoy igry byla snizhena i sbalansirovana vo vsekh rezhimakh.
- Podbor servera, poisk po polzovatelskim komnatam i ispravlenie mnozhestva oshibok.

V rasporyazhenii vashego geroya – mnozhestvo unikalnykh vidov oruzhiya i usileniy. To, chto nuzhno dlya vyzhivaniya v podvodnom mire!

Igrayte sovmestno s druzyami v rezhime priklyucheniy ili srazhaytes drug s drugom. Chto by vy ni vybrali, vas zhdut bolee 150 razlichnykh ispytaniy v 8 rezhimakh igry! Vo vse rezhimy mozhno igrat v Internete ili po lokalnoy seti.

title: Embers of Mirrim [NSP][ENG]
description: To save their world from an alien threat, two proud races must set aside their differences and come together... literally. Embers of Mirrim is an adventure-platformer featuring a mystical creature with the ability to split into light and dark embers, each independently controlled by the analog sticks.

title: Torn Tales Rebound Edition [NSZ][ENG]
description:
You will wield the powers of Robin Hood, Snow White and Dr Jekyll & Mr Hyde as they fight together in the dark landscape assembled by the evil Bookbinder. He has bound enemies from across the fabled lands to stop you, so be ready for the unexpected.

Game features:
- Real time squad based RPG - lead a party of three heroes with distinct yet complementary skills.
- Set in the torn landscape of classic folk tales.
- Deep skill tree - unlock and upgrade the unique abilities of each character.
- Loot - thousands of possible artefacts to collect that boost your skills/abilities with unique combinations.
- Character swap mechanic - change your tactics mid-battle for different strategies and abilities.
- Arena mode - endless non-stop battles with a vast array of monsters and enemies.

title: Sir Eatsalot [NSZ][ENG]
description:
V roli v meru upitannogo i uzhasno poryadochnogo sera Itsalota vy, khrabro i uverenno pokinuv svoe uyutnoe mestechko, otpravites v trudnoe epicheskoe puteshestvie, chtoby povergnut Isteriyu. Eta staraya koldunya otravila kislym limonadom korolevstvo Glyuttington. Vasha tsel — polozhit konets ee koznyam i pakostyam v etom effektnom i appetitnom priklyuchencheskom platformere.
V korolevstve Glyuttington tsarili spokoystvie i schaste, poka odnazhdy Isteriya ne otravila izotonicheskie vody korolevstva kislym limonadom — vot ved zlaya vedma!
Urozhai korolevstva pogibayut, no otrava eshche ne uspela rasprostranitsya na vse zemli —   nadezhda eshche est! I eta nadezhda — ser Itsalot, samyy luchshiy, silnyy i khrabryy rytsar korolya Daytana III.
Issleduyte krasochnyy mir, polnyy raznykh prichudlivykh geroev, reshayte zakhvatyvayushchie golovolomki, ispolzuya vse vozmozhnosti konsoli Nintendo Switch™, i polnostyu pogruzites v igrovoy mir.
Osobennosti
- Interaktivnyy i raznoobraznyy igrovoy protsess blagodarya ispolzovaniyu vozmozhnostey konsoli.
- Yumoristicheskoe priklyuchenie, polnoe raznykh sladostey i drugikh prelestey, v smeshnom i multyashnom mire.
- Zakhvatyvayushchiy dizayn urovney s grafikoy, detalno prorisovannoy vruchnuyu.
- Vzaimodeystvie s igrovym mirom i prichudlivymi personazhami.
- Bolee 20 stikerov, kotorye raskryvayut vse tayny igrovogo mira i samogo sera Itsalota.

Dannaya igra polnostyu sovmestima s Nintendo Switch™ Lite.

title: Poopdie [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description: Sozdavayte svoi kuchki i komanduyte imi! Usilivayte ikh s pomoshchyu unikalnykh navykov. Vypuskayte drevnie zaklinaniya. Pobedite zlogo Samrona i ego armiyu zadovtsev!

title: Time Recoil [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Time Recoil — shuter s vidom sverkhu, gde, ubivaya vragov, vy zamedlyaete vremya i pogruzhaetes v zakhvatyvayushchie perestrelki v uragannom slou-mo. Vasha tsel — spasti mir ot Gospodina Vremya, sumasshedshego uchenogo, stavshego kovarnym diktatorom blagodarya sposobnosti upravlyat vremenem. Strelyayte, uklonyaytes ot pul, ispolzuyte osobye sposobnosti i sokrushayte ego imperiyu s oruzhiem napereves!

• Ubiystva zamedlyayut vremya — i kazhdyy porazhennyy protivnik prodlevaet etot effekt.
• Otkryvayte osobye sposobnosti: chem dlinnee kombo — tem moshchnee priem.
• Peremeshchaytes v proshloe cherez chervotochiny i ubeyte Gospodina Vremya!
• Poluchayte zvezdy i stavte rekordy v rezhime ataki na vremya.

title: Loco sports [NSZ][ENG]
description:
LocO-SportS is a fun sports game held at an Olympic stadium.

Compete with your friends and family to be the best while you laugh at the eShop's craziest and most surreal tests. Reach impossible records such as a 25-metre high pole vault. Compete with the most diverse athletes in the world - a jovial 90-year-old grandmother, a hippie, a clown, an emo, a biker, a thief, a policeman, a punk, a stripper, a diver, a boxer, a superhero...even a nightclub pimp, the list goes on.

LocO-SportS offers up to a 4 player multiplayer, global online ranking including a top-three world podium, tests for reflexes, pulse rates and balance, a quick time event and so much more  - don't miss out! 

Are you ready?

title: Chemically Bonded [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Vas zhdyot unylaya zhizn obyknovennogo yaponskogo shkolnika — do togo momenta, kak vas nachnut vse silnee vtyagivat v ssoru dvukh uchenits, zhivushchikh po sosedstvu.

Uznayte bolshe ob ikh sovmestnom proshlom, pomogite im vosstanovit druzhbu i zanovo postroit otnosheniya... i sozdayte pri etom sobstvennuyu svyaz s nimi. Vy stolknetes kak s obydennymi, tak i s nestandartnymi razvilkami i vyborami, kotorye povliyayut na razvitie vashikh otnosheniy s devushkami. 

Vy mozhete reshit pomoch vozrodit Nauchnyy klub, ili zanyatsya sportom... i v to zhe vremya sblizitsya s devushkoy, pokorivshey vashe serdtse. 


Osobennosti:
* Neskolko vetok i kontsovok
* Zhanr: Romantika, Drama, Komediya
*Romantika: M x D
*Interaktivnaya telefonnaya sistema dlya vyborov i svidaniy
* Bolee 5 kostyumov i neskolko poz dlya obeikh devushek
* Vysokokachestvennaya risovka v stile manga
* Ozvuchka

title: Catch a Duck [NSP][ENG]
description: Face the challenge of catching ducks in a funny hand drawn forest. Outsmart hunters, cause a brawl between a wolf and a bear, use hideouts, move through underground tunnels, avoid traps but make enemies fall into them ! Be a sly fox !

title: Shinjuku Soumei [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Glazami Torao issleduyte istoriyu, kotoraya podnimaet glubokie voprosy o tsennosti zhizni — sotrudnichestvo stsenarista Tomo Kataoki, sozdatelya igry goda na Galgame 2020 po versii CNGAL Christmas Tina, i Kokhaku Sumeragi, populyarnogo mangaki predstavlyaet vam novyy, neprevzoydennyy vizualnyy roman!..
Pogruzites v zakhvatyvayushchee povestvovanie, gde v yarkom Kabukicho est i trushchoby Sindzyuku Koulun, kotorye ego zhiteli nazyvayut Rayonom, domom dlya bednykh, izgoev i tekh, kto marginalizirovan iz obshchestva. Sindzyuku rastet na zhiznyakh i zhelaniyakh svoikh lyudey.
Sumeete li vy raskryt vse ego tayny?..Eshchyo vizualnykh novell na Switch (renpy).

title: Next of Kin [NSZ][ENG]
description:
«Otygrali zlye zimy — kryshka, mat!
Nastupay, nevyrazimyy shalyy mart.
Ty smeyalas, ty skazala: «Zhdu, pishi!»
Smyato serdtse restavratora dushi.
Za dushoyu — ni molitvy, ni kresta,
A oni neumolimy — poezda…» ©
Malenkaya, kamernaya emotsionalno-kinematograficheskaya 2D-advenchura s vidom sverkhu ot shvedskikh razrabotchikov, kotoraya sleduet za popytkami Tomasa nayti svoyu poteryannuyu zhenu, Martu.
Tomas i Marta reshayut pereekhat v Myolkebo, mirnuyu derevenku v selskoy glushi. Vsyo idyot prekrasno, poka odnazhdy Tomas ne prosypaetsya — no Marty s nim ryadom net.

title: Cabin Fever [NSZ][ENG]
description:
"Experience a slice of off-grid life, and the bittersweet taste of love...

You live in the mountains, spending your days tending a vegetable garden, looking after chickens, and working remotely as a computer programmer. You don't participate in society - or whatever's left of it. You're fine with being alone.

But when a young woman appears on your secluded property, injured and lost on a stormy night, you're understandably torn. Are you obligated to help her? Is it even safe to help her?

You have no idea what to do. Your brain is mush. And the fact that she's so pretty doesn't help...

Cabin Fever is a sweet, funny, romantic visual novel that's sure to give you all the feels. Experience a budding friendship - and a blossoming romance - as you open up, make choices, and explore multiple endings. The world may seem bitter and bleak… But your story doesn't have to be.

Features:
- Stunning artwork, including over 20 beautifully illustrated CGs, 140 character poses, and 60 unique backgrounds
- An unforgettable soundtrack with 14 original themes
- Beautiful voice performances in English, with the option to choose the protagonist's voice
- More than 3 hours of gameplay with a branching, replayable storyline"

title: Life in Willowdale Farm Adventures [NSZ][ENG]
description:
威羅戴爾曾是個充滿活力的村莊，現在卻深陷危機之中。鎮長那牙尖嘴利的女兒－－－潘妮－－－不喜歡鄉下，所以希望把威羅戴爾改變成一個現代的觀光景點。沒有人再照顧動物們，鎮上的居民也越來越不自在了。
 
威羅戴爾的鎮長是你的叔叔，他需要你協助恢復鎮上往日的榮光。要拯救威羅戴爾，你可以建立一座充滿朝氣的農場、在鎮上大興土木、與形形色色的居民做朋友。你可以將已經離開威羅戴爾、且已經野化的動物帶回農場嗎？開啟一趟探險旅程，並在威羅戴爾挖掘出讓人驚喜又美麗的生活。
 
回歸自然，回到根本
在農場上日出而作、日落而息的耕作來增進園藝，進而恢復農場舊日的榮景！在威羅戴爾你的新家裡，你可以契作農作物、採收成果、照顧動物來增進自己的技術，這裡的生活絕對精采可期。
 
重新建造 這個 村莊
威羅戴有許多美麗、各具風情的建築物，例如圖書館、有機商店、餐廳以及鎮公所。隨著遊戲故事的進展，你可以把建築物升等，也可以認識新出現的居民。
 
持續 一場 探險 、 持續探險
把你的探險帽戴好、再戴上你的望遠鏡。城鎮外有許多可以探險的地方喔！順著鎮外的小徑走，你可以抵達鮮花牧場、死亡沙漠、遺忘森林，還有大壯山。準備好迎接前方的挑戰吧！
 
跟朋友一起探險會更好玩喔
威羅戴爾可不是唯一會有各式各樣活動的地方呢。城鎮外也有很多可以去探險體驗的地方唷！在沙發上就可以邀請朋友一起來體驗多人探險的樂趣！
 
威羅戴爾 有 大家 都會喜歡的 事物
你可以想到一個充滿活力的村莊該有的事物，威羅戴爾都有。年度盛事、餐廳美食、池塘釣魚、烹調美酒佳餚等，在歡樂的威羅戴爾絕對不無聊！

title: Crypt of the Serpent King [NSP][ENG]
description:
Crypt of the Serpent King is a medieval first-person hack'n'slash dungeon crawler with roguelike elements.

Explore large, randomly generated dungeons. Fight goblins, orcs, skeletons, giant spiders and all sorts of underworld creatures using melee and ranged weapons. Jump over lava pits and spike traps. Level up your character's abilities and choose between 3 levels of difficulty, from casual to hardcore.

title: Ping Redux [NSZ][ENG]
description:
PING REDUX™是一款極具挑戰性的乒乓益智遊戲，由其兄妹PING 1.5+重新製作。這不是給内心脆弱的人玩的。跳出牆壁和障礙物，到達美味多汁的橘色。它還吹嘘著有一個優秀的配樂，非常洗腦。  PING REDUX擁有100多個關卡，其中包括12個受到經典遊戲啟發的大魔王，有助於保持遊戲的多樣性。有炸彈，岩漿，移動的危險，還有其他阻礙你前進的障礙物，你認為你能戰勝它嗎？

- 100+個關卡 
- 超復古像素的視覺效果 
- 一些甜美的音樂由Xonah提供 
- 大魔王階段提供了獨特的遊戲挑戰，回到80年代 
- 也許你的叔叔很難打敗他，儘管這是他那個時代的靈感。

title: Runestone Keeper [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Now on Nintendo Switch™, Runestone Keeper will keep you coming back for one more floor, one more run, as you try to push through the dangers of the dungeon!

Heroes, monsters, equipment, events, magic and skills, traps and devices, shrines and altars, Goddesses and merchants. Choose your weapon and begin an epic adventure!

Features:

●	Randomly Generated Dungeon Elements – almost everything is generated differently each time to ensure a unique experience!
●	Prefix and Suffix-based Equipment – Loot comes with random yet rare prefixes and suffixes. Fight, collect and combine for a killer setup!
●	Diverse Monsters - Tread lightly, or be ganged up on by monsters with complementary abilities that might drive you crazy.
●	Items, Traps, Devices and Events - Opportunities for a favorable turn even at the most desperate moment. Choose wisely and use the unwelcoming surroundings to your advantage!
●	Heroes and Goddesses – Create your hero’s attributes build! Sacrifice to receive your mighty God’s blessing (and later betray him to check out his fury)!
●	A Challenging Experience - Prepare to have a tragic (not to mention permanent) death!

title: Bingo [NSZ][ENG]
description:
BINGO comes to Nintendo Switch™!
4 bingo party games in one pack!

Buzzer BINGO
Buzzer BINGO is a game in which 4 players scramble for the number that appears.

Slide BINGO
Slide BINGO is a game in which you move the rows around to allign the red tiles on your card to make a row.

BINGO Poker
BINGO Poker is a game in which you try to get a BINGO using both the pre-existing red tiles and the new numbers you get.
However, when you acquire a new number, you must throw away one existing number in return.

Classic BINGO
Classic BINGO is a simple game in which you take in all the numbers that appear on your card.

Lay flat Mode
Place the Nintendo Switch on a table and play head-to-head!

title: Bem Feito [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Vy smozhete navestit Redzhinaldo v ego dome na kroshechnoy planetke B-613. Vozmite na sebya povsednevnye dela vo dvore. Rybachte, gotovte, polivayte svoy sad i tsvety, sobirayte frukty, vstrechaytes so mnozhestvom druzey!
A blagodarya revolyutsionnoy i innovatsionnoy OS Garotron, sozdannoy po eksklyuzivnomu zakazu MEGASOFT, vy smozhete nasladitsya MEGA-igrami Bema Feyto uzhe segodnya!
V B-613 Vy mozhete:

title: Crime Opera The Butterfly Effect [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Posle vnezapnoy smerti matriarkha mafioznoy semi ee synovya Dzherald i Ksander vynuzhdeny zashchishchatsya, poskolku byvshie partnery ugrozhayut zavladet ikh biznesom. Smotrite na proiskhodyashchee glazami detey Gallo, kogda oni stanovyatsya svidetelyami ubiystv, pokhishcheniy i drugikh prestupleniy, sovershennykh v ikh semyakh ikh sobstvennymi ottsami.

V prekrasno illyustrirovannom povestvovanii igry Crime Opera ispytyvaetsya sila i khrupkost semeynykh uz. Vy mozhete igrat v nee kak v kineticheskuyu novellu (prosto sledya za povestvovaniem), libo kak v vizualnuyu novellu (delaya vybor, vliyayushchiy na povestvovanie). V lyubom sluchae, eta slozhnaya i zaputannaya istoriya nepremenno zakhvatit vas ot nachala do kontsa, pokazyvaya, kak kriminalnaya zhizn vykhodit iz-pod kontrolya.

Osobennosti:

• Posmotrite na mir glazami 6 detey, rozhdennykh v prestupnom mire.
• Sledite za zamyslovatym povestvovaniem v 24 glavakh.
• Reshite, igrat li s variantami, vliyayushchimi na syuzhet, ili bez nikh.
• Naslazhdaytes krasivo illyustrirovannymi fonami i spraytami personazhey.

title: Beatus Creation Solitaire [NSZ][ENG]
description:
VTuber群組「Beatus Creation」
在經典撲克牌遊戲「蜘蛛紙牌」中登場！

使用通關關卡時能夠獲得的硬幣，
獲得各位成員的主題套裝、插畫和貼紙吧！

使用獲得的貼紙裝飾「貼紙書」，
制作專屬於你的相冊！

-收錄各位成員的通關語音！
-題目總計70題，難度從簡單到棘手應有盡有。
-為了能愉快地遊玩，特別準備了「提示」和「退回一步」功能。
-操作簡單，適合在短暫的空閒時間遊玩。

title: Beach Bounce / Beauty Bounce / Bunny Bounce remastered [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Tomoyo priezzhaet na plyazhnyy kurort svoey babushki Umi v nadezhde otlichno provesti leto, nakonets zabyt o proshlom i izmenit svoyu zhizn k luchshemu.

Odnako, kak vsegda, chto-to idet ne tak…
Pokhozhe, chto letnie kanikuly poshli ko dnu, tak i ne uspev nachatsya.

Edinstvennoe uteshenie — mnozhestvo prekrasnykh rabotnits kurorta.

Osobennosti
* Istoriya s neskolkimi variantami razvitiya
* Mnozhestvennye syuzhetnye vetvi i kontsovki
* Razlichnye lyubovnye linii
* Raznoobrazie personazhey

title: Buried Stars [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Buried Stars is a mystery adventure game from Studio LARGO—the creators of the beloved Korean titles Panic Room and City of Mist—in collaboration with LINE Games.

◆ Murder at a Survival Audition Gone Wrong
During a live broadcast of a survival audition show, the studio building suddenly collapses. Trapped beneath the rubble, the remaining contestants and crew face something even more terrifying: a murder among them.

Who is the culprit? Why did this happen? And how?

◆ Striking Visual Presentation with 3D x 2D Harmony
Dynamic 2D character illustrations are blended into detailed 3D environments to create an atmospheric and cinematic visual experience.

◆ Immersive Gameplay through Social Media Mechanics
Keep track of real-time public reactions via the in-game “Social Media” and “Timeline.”
These systems not only deepen the immersion but also provide crucial hints to help uncover the truth.

◆ Branching Scenarios and Multiple Endings
Your dialogue choices and actions shape the story.
With multiple routes, endings, and hidden stories, each playthrough reveals new truths—and new fates for the survivors.

◆ Powerful Soundtrack and Performances
Dive into the emotional intensity of the story with an original soundtrack, environmental sound design, and the gripping main theme, “Be Honest.”

◆ Stellar Voice Acting in Korean and Japanese
Featuring passionate performances by seasoned voice talent from both Korea and Japan:

Korean Cast
Park Sungtae, Ryu Seunggon, Nam Dohyoung, Kim Yeonwoo, Kim Haru, Lee Kyoungtae, Lim Yoonsun, and more

Japanese Cast
Tetsuya Kakihara, Takuya Eguchi, Hiro Shimono, Yoko Hikasa, Rina Sato, Soichiro Hoshi, Eri Kitamura, and more

title: Arctictopia [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
《極地樂園》是一款以北極冰洋為背景的益智解謎遊戲，你將規劃一條條順暢的路線，引領北極熊回到小熊的身旁。

當冰層不斷融化，北極熊的回家之路將變得越來越艱難⋯⋯

■遊戲特色
・10 幾種獨特的地圖機制交織成 150 個精心設計的關卡。
・沉浸在冷冽的極地氛圍與童趣的繪本風格中，橫渡冰洋。
・仔細斟酌每一步，因為逐漸融化的冰塊將減少你的下一步選擇。
・不限時、無壓力、不用追求高分、可以隨時悔棋或前往別關。靜心體驗每一個挑戰。
・可愛的小熊、海豹、海鸚！

title: Woodsalt [NSZ][ENG]
description:
"Woodsalt" is an adventure game set on the planet of Nu-Terra, 1000 years after Earth was evacuated during chaotic natural disasters and an attack by giant creatures.

You control Emcy, an Earth born man who is awaken from stasis into a new city in a bubble as they wait for a signal to return back home, but not everybody is as eager to return as thought.

A civil unrest grows in the city with a conspiracy to keep humanity from leaving, all the while Emcy is plagued by visions and messages from an unknown voice that nobody else can see or hear.

Multiple endings, numerous side-plots with their own branching storylines that can affect the main plot and hidden secret endings to discover.

Guide Emcy though conversation trees and free roam, explore the city and speak with the inhabitants to discover the secrets behind what happened on Earth, what lead to their arrival on this new planet and the mystery of the strange watcher who has an unknown but keen interest in Emcy and his journey.

title: Undead and Beyond [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Undead & Beyond is a game where you reanimate the death and cause chaos!

 Use the products of your research to create an army of the undead and cause havoc in the complex while you aim to accomplish your objectives to reach the next area. Use a wide range of methods to advance further, from creating undead that will attack the facility staff, to using gadgets or simply using stealth to pass through the guards without being noticed. But careful, the facility guards could call for reinforcements.

- Revive your enemies as fierce undead!
- Use items to support your undead forces or carefully killing key targets.
- Increase the hazard level to spawn deadlier mutants!
- Watch the undead rip apart the opposition with brutal death animations
- The NPCs are AI driven, every time you play is a different experience.
- Use stealth, carefully plan your moves to overwhelm your enemies with the hordes!

title: Inferno 2 [NSP][ENG]
description:
Poluchivshaya priznanie kritikov, Inferno 2 — beskompromissnaya strelyalka s RPG-mekhanikoy na dva dzhoystika — prodolzhenie igry Inferno+ ot Radiangames, predstavlyaet soboy eshche bolshe izoshchrennykh urovney, eshche bolshe oruzhiya, apgreydov i moshchi, vragov i bolshe kastomizatsii, a takzhe eshche bolshe bezumnykh vzryvov i effektov chastits.

Svyshe 80 urovney s nepriyatelyami i taynami, apgreydami dlya tvoego igrovogo korablya na tvoy vkus.

* Svyshe 80 urovney shikarnoy atmosfery

* Nastroyka arsenala obnovlyaemogo oruzhiya i boevoy moshchi korablya

* Odinochnaya igra i vpervye igra na dvukh igrokov po lokalnoy seti!

* Rezhim «Novaya igra+» dobavlyaet eshche bolshe shansov perepisat istoriyu

* 3 urovnya slozhnosti (kotorye mozhno menyat v lyuboe vremya)

* Sovershenno novye vidy urovney i tseley. Srazheniya na vyzhivanie i s bossom!

* Dyuzhiny vidov nepriyateley

* Mnozhestvo tayn, zhdushchikh raskrytiya

title: Salaryman Shi [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Traverse colorful environments, battle strange animals and master the power of your suitcases to... get to work on time? Salaryman Shi is a 2D platformer where you play as salaryman Takeshi Shi as you hurry to catch the bus to the office! Twenty challenging levels stand between you and a paycheck, but fear not, as you have your trusty suitcases on your side.

- A dozen levels with unique visuals, songs, gimmicks and enemies
- Complete mission objectives which let you tackle levels in cool new ways
- Beat the best times in Time Attack and complete your medal collection
- Try a much harder reworked adventure in Hard Mode
- Competitive multiplayer where you race your friend to win the game first
- Level the playing field with Assist Mode for less skilled players

title: Ruin Raiders [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Ruin Raiders is a turn-based tactical roguelike where you guide squads on a mission to explore an ancient, ever-shifting civilization. Explore ruins, demon-infested depths, and more while upgrading your raiders with unlockable gear before facing bosses that hide in the abyss.

Key Features

- Procedurally Generated and Highly Replayable: You never play the same game twice.

 -Tactical Combat: Manage military squads in turn-based ground battles on a no-return journey.

- 100+ Items: Unique weapons, grenades & accessories that you can loot, craft and equip.

- Enemies & Bosses: Tons of enemies on each floor plus unique bosses along the way.

- Strategic Base: Improve & expand your raider's base to achieve powerful upgrades for your characters.

- Unlockable Raider Classes & Abilities: Unlock more races & upgrade your race abilities to deepen yourself further into the ruins.

- Upgradeable Weapons and Units: Craft your own equipment and level-up your raiders.

title: Eclipse Edge of Light [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Crash-landed on a sentient planet, you awake to discover a dreamscape world, filled with alien wonder and the remains of a betrayed civilization.  You find a powerful relic, the Artifact, that can interact with ancient technology and grant you near-magical powers. Just what secrets does the planet harbor? What cataclysm befell its inhabitants? Using your jetpack-equipped space suit, investigate the ancient ruins to uncover the planet's perplexing past.

Immerse yourself in a fascinating and memorable new world. Can you rise to the challenge and solve the haunting riddle of this mysterious place?

title: Doug Hates His Job [NSZ][ENG]
description:
With 8 styles of gameplay, you get to decide how Doug responds to annoying coworkers, crazy clients, and a ruthless boss.

Features 8 different styles of gameplay:
Beat-Em up
Choose your own adventure
Bar Trivia
Quick Time Events
3d Melee combat
Stealth
2D Platformer
Top Down car Racer

title: Mr. Run and Jump [NSZ][ENG]
description:
在這款2D電子風格平台遊戲中，幫助Mr. Run and Jump打敗可怕的虛空，並從色彩王國集齊所有的能量寶石！在可靠夥伴Leap the Dog的陪伴下，一起穿越令人眼花繚亂的危險世界，躲避無數的敵人並征服數百個充滿挑戰的平台關卡，拯救這個世界！

Mr. Run and Jump 以精確的關卡設計、流暢的遊戲體驗和棘手的挑戰吸引玩家。絲滑的控制鼓勵玩家奔跑、跳躍、衝刺、雙重跳躍和翻滾，以風格鮮明的方式通關，讓這款遊戲成為速通玩家的夢想之作。收藏品隱藏在難以到達的地方，玩家需要發揮自己的聰明才智和角色的靈活性才能獲得。動態輔助選項允許玩家設定他們所需的難度級別。無論你如何遊戲，Mr. Run and Jump都為不同技能水平和方法的玩家提供引人入勝的遊戲選擇。

主要特色

精準的平台行動：越過障礙物，躲避致命敵人，並趁早集齊所有能量寶石！

色彩王國：每個世界都有獨具特色的風格，採用繪製精美的背景，輔以充滿活力的霓虹圖形特效。

危險的世界：形形色色的危險敵人，每一個都有自己的行動方式和個性。

娛樂時間：極具挑戰性的關卡、大量收藏寶珠和計時賽，提供30+小時的遊戲時間。

拯救你的狗，拯救世界：體驗一個改變世界、吞噬虛空和色彩王國所有奇蹟的原創故事。

title: Rogue Wizards [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Sovet nablyudaet za semyami elam, aristokratami, kotorye proizoshli ot pervykh lyudey v Rilfanore, i banlitami, kotorye iznachalno byli lyudmi, rozhdennymi bez magicheskikh sposobnostey. Gildiya nikogda ne prinimala banlitov iz-za otsutstviya u nikh magicheskikh sposobnostey; i oni nikogda ne dopuskali zhenshchin, potomu chto schitali, chto zhenshchiny slishkom slaboumny, chtoby kontrolirovat takuyu vlast.

Teper, mnogo pokoleniy spustya, magiya elama oslabevaet, i skrytyy magicheskiy talant snova proyavlyaetsya sredi banlitskogo naseleniya. Mnogie iz elama otritsayut eto, no nekotorye iz nikh khotyat sdelat radikalnyy shag, dopustiv banlitov, v tom chisle zhenshchin, v gildiyu.

V svoem kveste vy issleduete sluchayno sgenerirovannye podzemelya, sobiraete sokrovishcha, ovladevaete magiey, izbegaete lovushek, reshaete golovolomki i, konechno zhe, ochishchaete podzemelya ot vsekh zlykh minonov vnutri. Kazhdoe podzemele unikalno, nikakie dve lokatsii ne budut odinakovymi.

Eto ne tolko polzanie po podzemelyam. Pochuvstvuyte sebya kak doma v svoey sobstvennoy Bashne volshebnikov, gde vy mozhete uluchshit i nastroit svoy stil igry, postroiv protsvetayushchiy gorod, prigotoviv sobstvennye reagenty, sozdav ili kupiv sobstvennoe snaryazhenie, usiliv svoyu magiyu i nanyav pomoshchnikov.

title: The Long Gate [NSP][ENG]
description: 探索充滿神秘謎題的古老洞穴，穿越令人放鬆的大自然綠洲。 修復三種古老的電路，解開它們的創造者發生的事情的奧秘。 The Long Gate 是一款具有挑戰性且精心製作的益智遊戲，其謎題基於現實世界的物理和電路。

title: Supermash [NSZ][ENG]
description:
將2種遊戲類型加以混搭，創造一款提供有趣和創新玩法的遊戲。遊戲可依照障礙和裝備的組合而有所變化，還可透過3個難易度和遊戲時間來調整遊戲內容。

遊戲概要
經營電玩店的朱美和小智姊弟遭到房東要求搬離店鋪。為了賺取搬遷資金另起爐灶，姊弟倆開始在清倉大拍賣使用以前購買的遊戲混搭機，賣起為客戶量身開發的新遊戲。然而，對電玩產業的龍頭廠商XP Corp來說，這台遊戲混搭機蘊藏著相當不可取的秘密。
看著姊弟倆的生意因遊戲混搭機有了起色，XP Corp決定出手干預。

可提供混搭的類型為下列6種。
平台遊戲
動作冒險
射擊遊戲
類銀河戰士惡魔城
戰術諜報動作遊戲
日式角色扮演
上述遊戲經過混搭後，將可決定遊戲的大方向。遊戲類型內收錄多種模式，即便選擇同一組合也會有不同的結果。

在遊戲中，您可邊玩邊賺金幣抽取開發者卡片。卡牌類型包括玩家和敵人的角色、武器、等級、音樂、障礙和作弊。利用這些道具，更能幫助您製作出您想要的遊戲。遊戲共390張開發者卡片，快來完成大滿貫吧。

title: Adverse [NSZ][ENG]
description:
ADVERSE (VRAZhDEBNYY) – eto shuter-platformer ot pervogo litsa s sistemnym dvizhkom, obespechivayushchim legkie i plavnye peredvizheniya. Deystvie razvorachivaetsya v idillicheskoy Vselennoy, v kotoroy igrokam predstoit srazhatsya s vragami v vosmi unikalnykh mirakh i na 40 razlichnykh urovnyakh. Eto posledniy proekt v kataloge Loneminded, kotoryy ostaetsya vernym svoemu brendu, buduchi veselym, konkurentosposobnym platformerom s vnutriigrovymi tablitsami liderov i dobavleniem mnogourovnevoy sistemy podscheta ochkov.

Igra podderzhivaet tolko angliyskiy yazyk.

title: A Night at the Races [NSP][ENG]
description:
You’re invited to the arcades tonight. Compete illegally with other players for the top of the global leaderboards. You need the prize money to survive.

FEATURES:
● A unique narrative - you play as the player, and face their challenges on and off the screen.
● Challenging Arcade-Platformer gameplay - easy to learn, hard to master. Perfect for speedruns.
● Online ranking leaderboards - by level and global.
● Great playtime value - 200+ levels and additional game modes.

“This is a game you can't put down, mounted in a frame about a game someone can't put down. Play this game!” - Eurogamer

DEVELOPED BY Mushy Jukebox
“I wanted to create a wild and unpredictable story wrapped in engaging gameplay, where you become someone living in a dystopian world, spending his time playing a platformer in a warm summer night.” 
 - Umut Derviş, creator of A Night at the Races

PUBLISHED BY Nakana.io
“We publish games that aim to offer a new experience. The hybrid nature of A Night at the Races creates a unique synergy between the story and the action.” - Mikaël Bourget, founder of the publishing label

title: The Ambassador Fractured Timelines [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Vy igraete za Gregora, novobrantsa v Vechnom Sodruzhestve i Poslantsa vremeni. V to vremya kak vy potikhonku osvaivaete tolko chto obretennye navyki, stolitsu Sodruzhestva unichtozhaet tainstvennyy vzryv! Imenno vy, odin iz nemnogikh ostavshikhsya v zhivykh, dolzhny nayti vinovnikov etogo varvarskogo postupka i vernut gorodu Tamaris ego byluyu slavu.

Osobennosti igry
• Eta dinamichnaya boevaya igra-strategiya sozdana spetsialno dlya togo, chtoby vy uluchshili svoi navyki po zamorozke vremeni.
• Vas zhdet prostornyy mir, gde est i krepost, i vysokie gory, i dremuchie lesa, i dymyashchiesya ruiny razrushennogo goroda Tamaris.
• Zakhvatyvayushchaya igra s pyatyu unikalnymi landshaftami, dvumya liniyami vremeni i 55 urovnyami.
• Tselyy arsenal oruzhiya, volshebnye fintiflyushki, bronya — odin predmet luchshe drugogo.
• 20 spryatannykh letopisey, soderzhashchikh v sebe istoriyu korolevstva.
• Rezhim «Orda» posle zaversheniya osnovnoy linii — krepkiy oreshek, kotoryy ne vsem po zubam.
• Raznoobraznye nastroyki slozhnosti ot urovnya dlya pervoklashek do rezhima «chert-nogu-slomit»!

title: Wave Break [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Wave Break — eto pervaya v mire igra, v kotoroy personazh kataetsya na skeyt-lodke, sozdannaya po motivam klassicheskikh arkadnykh igr so skeytbordom. Vypolnyayte grayndy, greby, kikflipy i raschishchayte sebe put skvoz opasnyy mir, polnyy golovorezov, v stile «Politsii Mayami» 80-kh godov.

Dostupny razlichnye rezhimy: kampaniya dlya odnogo igroka, onlayn-multipleer, mnozhestvo polzovatelskikh igrovykh rezhimov i uluchshennyy konstruktor parkov. Ot tropicheskikh plyazhey do tundry s vechnoy merzlotoy — rassekayte volny i vypolnyayte luchshie v mire kombo v sobstvennom stile.

Kharakteristiki

KAMPANIYa DLYa ODNOGO IGROKA 
Ispytayte svoi sily v kampanii so znakomymi tselyami, kollektsionnymi predmetami i zadaniyami. Eto bitva nasmert (verkhom na skeyt-lodke!) vsyo s temi zhe temnymi lichnostyami iz Wave Break v syuzhete iz neskolkikh epizodov s oruzhiem, kikflipami i krovavymi dengami.

ONLAYN-MULTIPLEER
Sorevnuytes s druzyami za zvanie chempiona tryukov v onlayn-rezhime s podborom igrokov po urovnyu ili v polzovatelskikh rezhimakh.

MNOZhESTVO REZhIMOV IGRY
Stavte rekordy po ochkam v atake tryukov, uchastvuyte v boyakh nasmert i ottachivayte navyki v rezhime svobodnoy igry.

KONSTRUKTOR PARKA
Sozdayte park svoey mechty s pomoshchyu vstroennogo konstruktora parkov! Sozdavayte ONLAYN vmeste s druzyami ili v odinochku.

KASTOMIZATsIYa 
Razblokiruyte sotni unikalnykh predmetov odezhdy i sozdayte sobstvennyy stil. Takzhe dostupny mnozhestvo risunkov i ukrasheniy dlya lodki. Uluchshayte kharakteristiki i razblokiruyte novuyu ekipirovku po mere prokhozhdeniya igry i zarabatyvaniya deneg.

SAUNDTREK S PODDERZhKOY POTOKOVOY TRANSLYaTsII
Naslazhdaytes novym saundtrekom Wave Break, polnostyu sovmestimym s potokovoy tekhnologiey bez narusheniya avtorskikh prav. Vklyuchaet originalnye pesni tselogo ryada izvestnykh ispolniteley v stile sintveyv, takikh kak Timecop1983, Kalax i mnogie drugie!

PLAVNAYa KARTINKA S ChASTOTOY 60 KADROV V SEKUNDU NA NINTENDO SWITCH™ 
Naslazhdaytes bezuprechnym izobrazheniem s chastotoy 60 kadrov v sekundu — kak doma, tak i v doroge na Nintendo Switch™.

title: Dreamo [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
DREAMO - eto puteshestvie, napravlennoe na reshenie golovolomok cherez menyayushchiysya landshaft vospominaniy.

V DREAMO vy prosypaetes na ostrove, kak Dzhek Uinslou. Rukovodstvuyas golosom Tary Moro, izobretatelya/terapevta, vy reshili sobrat voedino nedostayushchie vospominaniya. Eti fragmenty zaperty v "Artefaktakh", kotorye proyavlyayutsya v vashem soznanii kak kuby s neumestnymi peredachami. Po mere togo, kak vy pogruzhaetes glubzhe v svoy razum, golovolomki uslozhnyayutsya, pytayas uderzhat vospominaniya zapertymi.

Mozhete li vy rasshifrovat ikh i raskryt sekrety vashego uma?

OSOBENNOSTI
- Priklyuchencheskaya igra-golovolomka ot pervogo litsa,
- Desyatki individualno razrabotannykh, slozhnykh 3D golovolomok s dvizhushchimisya komponentami i raznoobraznymi modifikatorami.
- Polnostyu ozvuchennaya, osnovannaya na povestvovanii istoriya, kotoraya issleduet temy pamyati, vybora i posledstviy,
- Yarkiy nizkopoligonalnyy art-stil.
- Zakhvatyvayushchaya syuzhetnaya liniya iz trekh chastey
- Rasslablyayushchaya formula geympleya...
- ...i rezhim ispytaniy, dlya tekh, kto khochet poluchit samye slozhnye golovolomki.

title: Rogue Singularity [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description:
Perezhivite unichtozhenie galaktiki i primite uchastie v beshenoy gonke cherez vselennuyu!

Sverkhmassivnaya chernaya dyra razryvaet kosmos na kuski, i odnomu khrabromu malenkomu robotu predstoit otpravitsya cherez oblomki beschislennykh mirov v samoe serdtse nepredskazuemoy singulyarnosti!

Igra Rogue Singularity — dan uvazheniya klassicheskim trekhmernym platformeram, no s sovremennoy osobennostyu: urovni v igre nikogda ne povtoryayutsya! Pomogite svoemu kroshechnomu metallicheskomu tovarishchu preodolet mnozhestvo sluchayno generiruemykh urovney, napolnennykh vyshedshimi iz pod kontrolya apparatami, prichudlivymi predstavitelyami inoplanetnoy zhizni, opasnymi prirodnymi yavleniyami i izoshchrennymi lovushkami.

Osobennosti
- Vozvrashchenie k istokam: zolotaya era trekhmernykh platformerov v samoy sovremennoy obrabotke.
- Galaktika, polnaya opasnostey: vozrastayushchaya slozhnost urovney trebuet bystroy reaktsii i tochnosti upravleniya.
- Vechnaya igra: beskonechno generiruemye sistemoy urovni s dzhunglyami, vulkanami, fabrikami i t. p.
- Sozdayte svoego geroya: sozdayte unikalnogo robota, podbiraya detali i perekrashivaya ikh.
- Kosmicheskiy ritm: nasladites elektronnoy muzykoy ot legendy chiptyuna Derrisa Kharlana.

title: Spacejacked [NSZ][RUS/Multi4]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 4]
description:
Spacejacked - super bystro razvivayushchayasya arkada v stile «ZAShchITA BAShNI». Igray za Deyva, odinokogo tekhnika, kotoromu porucheno zashchishchat svoy kosmicheskiy korabl ot vtorzheniya inoplanetyan, poka on gotovitsya prygnut v giperprostranstvo.

Igrokam, kotorye ishchut kombinatsiyu strelyalki i zashchity bashni, ponravitsya eta igra!

Kharakteristiki:
 * Strelyay i stroy bashni!
 * Zashchishchay kak pol, tak i potolok! Ni odno mesto ne zastrakhovano ot inoplanetyan!
 * Rezhim istorii, napolnennyy prichudlivymi personazhami na protyazhenii 2 osnovnykh syuzhetnykh deystviy.
 * Nerealno slozhnyy rezhim, podkhodyashchiy dlya samykh khardkornykh igrokov.
 * Dva beskonechnykh rezhima dlya eshche bolee bezumnogo geympleya i sorevnovaniya za vysokiy reyting s druzyami.

title: Undead Darlings [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Puteshestvuyte s komandoy devushek-poluzombi, vyzhivaya v postapokalipticheskom mire Undead Darlings! Syuzhetnaya chast igry soderzhit mnozhestvo vetvyashchikhsya dialogov, kotorye v zavisimosti ot sdelannogo vami vybora dayut glubokoe predstavlenie o personazhakh, v to vremya kak v rolevoy chasti igry ispolzuetsya znakomaya usovershenstvovannaya poshagovaya boevaya sistema s povorotami.
Redzhinald «Redzhi» P. Kheppenshtans prosypaetsya ot alkogolem komy, a emu govoryat, chto obshchestvo raskoloto iz-za vspyshki virusa, kotoryy prevratil pochti vsekh v zombi. Odnako, podruge detstva Perl udalos uderzhatsya za svoyu chelovecheskuyu naturu, i ona rasskazyvaet, chto ne edinstvennaya iz devushek v podobnom sostoyanii. Kak i vsyakaya devushka, s kotoroy vstrechalsya Redzhi, ona mozhet byt napolovinu strashnoy zombi, no ee serdtse — vsyo eshche chelovecheskoe!

title: The Childs Sight [NSP][ENG]
description:
Postepenno raskryvayte istoriyu togo, chto s vami proizoshlo, lezha v kolybeli nevinnym i neporochnym rebenkom. S kazhdoy minutoy vy budete vspominat novye podrobnosti. Uzhasy stanut realnymi i yasnymi.
Okhotilsya li za vami lish strakh neizvestnogo, ili eto bylo nechto bolshee?

Chto-to mozhet ostavatsya razmytym, no odna istoriya ostaetsya s vami vplot do segodnya.
Videt ne mogut dushi bez glaz,
I v tishine podzhidayut lish nas.
Svetly i chisty tak rebenka glaza,
Ulybkoy zamanit tebya navsegda.
No ne priblizhaysya, ved grekh tam taitsya,
Mladentsami khochet on tak pozhivitsya.

OSOBENNOSTI
Prostoe upravlenie
Sluchaynyy II
Svoboda peremeshcheniya
Razblokiruemye rezhimy

title: Fluffy Horde [NSZ][ENG]
description:
你是唯一站在神奇的兔子巫師“薩滿”和三個王國的徹底毀滅之間的人。

毛絨大群 是一款具有清晰目標的 2D 橫向捲軸遊戲。 抵禦具有過度繁殖傾向的神奇兔子部落。 停止他們的攻勢或死於尷尬。

通過指揮你的戰士、弓箭手和……許多瘋狂的人來阻止毛茸茸的軍隊。 說真的，我們甚至有一個人形胡蘿蔔可以為你擋下一顆兔子子彈。

如果你解放了足夠多的城市，你甚至可能會發現這場瘋狂入侵背後的原因。 第一次兔子大戰開始於 3...2...1！

主要特徵
- 獨特的遊戲玩法
- 二維美學
- 橫向捲軸遊戲
- 成噸的兔子
- 迷人的幽默
- 迷人的像素藝術
- 實時策略與塔防機制相結合

title: To the Top Mammoth [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Sorevnuytes s drugimi igrokami v voskhozhdenii na bashnyu! Tvoi milye pitomtsy-alpinisty gotovy pokorit spiralnuyu lestnitsu bashni zamka s lovushkami! Sorevnuytes s drugimi v mnogopolzovatelskoy igre ili beyte sobstvennoe vremya, sobirayte monety, otkryvayte bonusy i kosmetiku! Nauchites izbegat oshibok svoego proshlogo, uvidev na lestnitse sobstvennoe prividenie!
 
Samye uvazhaemye (a takzhe samye ocharovatelnye) alpinisty sobralis, chtoby brosit vyzov drug drugu! Prisoedinyaytes k nim i zarabotayte svoe mesto v tablitse rezultatov mnogopolzovatelskoy igry!
 
Vyberite svoe lyubimoe zhivotnoe, chtoby preodolet smertelnye prepyatstviya. Na vashem puti budut ostrye shipy, katyashchiesya bochki, tyazhelye kamni, padayushchie platformy, ognennye lovushki i prygayushchie bomby, i vse zavisit ot vashikh navykov, strategii (i, konechno zhe, udachi!), chtoby preodolet ikh vse. Sobirayte poleznye instrumenty i sposobnosti na svoem puti, chtoby vyzhit i protsvetat!
 Gotovy li vy k predstoyashchemu vyzovu?
 
 - Odinochnaya igra - broste vyzov sebe v gonke na vremya ili soperniku NPC v rezhime gonki
- Mnogopolzovatelskaya igra - sorevnuytes s realnymi igrokami v mnogopolzovatelskom rezhime Versus
- Krasochnaya grafika dlya detey
- Razblokiruemye personazhi i bonusy!
 - Intuitivno ponyatnaya skhema upravleniya
- Randomizirovannaya sistema perkov, blagodarya kotoroy podemy prokhodyat po-raznomu

title: Inukari Chase of Deception [NSZ][ENG]
description:
重要使命
在人們不再尊重野生動物的時候，世界上已經開始發生不好的事情。但是有人點燃了你神社里的小蠟燭，所以他們在召喚你！恢復秩序，和平，將人們與自然聯繫起來，你是他們最後的希望。

遵循舊方法
《犬塚 - 欺騙的追逐》提供了經典的復古平台體驗。跳躍並運行關卡，像風一樣難以捉摸，收集好東西，與敵人和BOSS戰鬥。動作流暢而動態。越來越快！

由於仔細的像素藝術視覺效果和原始的8位音樂，包括帶有一點現代氣息的經典音效，冒險以時尚的方式栩栩如生。讓自己沉浸在這個世界中，這個世界將以其藝術視野讓你感到高興。

你知道該怎麼做。在為時已晚之前採取行動！

主要特點：
- 24個級別分為3個世界
- 可愛的復古像素藝術視覺效果
- 具有獨特節奏的動態遊戲玩法
- 流暢的動作和BOSS戰鬥
- 輕快的8位配樂

title: The Wake [NSZ][ENG]
description:
《The Wake 浪痕：回憶密碼》是遊戲開發者 Somi 「負罪感三部曲」的最後一部，前作分別是 Replica（《指尖戰爭》）和 Legal Dungeon（《律法之地》）。

倘若讓我簡短地概括自己的一生，我會說，「我說的一切都是謊言。」

在爺爺的三天葬禮上，一道陳年的傷疤被揭開，那是一切愧疚感的源頭。

這是一本記錄了祖孫三代回憶與他們間感情糾葛的日記。
這本日記的部分內容使用簡易替換密碼進行了加密。
玩家只有在破譯之後才能獲悉真相，並感受作者埋藏在字裏行間的深沉情感。
這本日記的內容影射著作者矛盾的一生。

title: Adios [NSP][ENG]
description:
Adios is a cinematic first-person game about sticking to a complicated decision.

You're a pig farmer in Kansas. It's October. Cold, crisp mornings are the norm, and you have decided that you're no longer okay with letting the mob use your pigs to dispose of bodies. When your old friend - a hitman - arrives with his assistant to deliver another body, you finally screw up the courage to tell them that you're done.

Your friend doesn't want you to stop. He knows that there's no such thing as quitting, so he'll try to convince you that you're making a mistake. You spend the day together, doing chores and exploring the nooks and crannies of an authentic environment in the American Midwest alongside the man who will be forced to kill you, if he can't convince you to stay.

How you respond will determine the rest of your life.

Adios means goodbye.

title: Roomie Romance [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Mira ustraivaetsya na novuyu rabotu v novom gorode i izo vsekh sil staraetsya prisposobitsya k novym usloviyam.

No vse bystro oslozhnyaetsya, kogda ona vlyublyaetsya v svoyu krasivuyu sosedku po komnate i senpaya po rabote. Sledite za razvivayushchimisya otnosheniyami mezhdu Miroy i ee novym senpaem v techenie goda.

Vashi resheniya budut opredelyat ne tolko sobytiya, proiskhodyashchie na protyazhenii vsey igry, no i to, kogo vy vstretite na svoem puti, kak vy budete vzaimodeystvovat s nimi, i, v konechnom schete, kakoy budet final.


Kharakteristiki
* Vizualnyy roman s vozmozhnostyu vybora
* Milaya romanticheskaya istoriya v zhanre yuri
* Iskusstvo mangi

title: World for Two [NSZ][ENG]
description:
某一天，突如其來的大災害，令所有的生物慘遭滅絕。
數年之後，在地下的某個研究所裡的博士，這荒蕪世界上唯一的倖存者，開始嘗試創造生物。
為了採集創造生物所必須的能量，他創造出了能在外部活動的智慧型機器人。
在這人類文明已然停止的世界上，植物繁茂地生長著，既殘酷又美麗。
博士與智慧型機器人，兩個人的生命創造之旅，就在這樣的世界上開始了。


在瀕臨毀滅的世界上創造生命的故事


本作中新增了 14 種生物，可以創造更豐富的生命。

Nintendo Switch版通關主線劇情後，可遊玩描述博士過去的「前塵舊憶」！
遊玩為了這次作品而寫的新曲和故事吧。

通關特典中，可將主線劇情的BGM變更爲鋼琴五重奏(鋼琴、第一小提琴、第二小提琴、中提琴、大提琴)。
透過充滿現場感的BGM感受著美麗的世界吧。

title: Work from Home [NSZ][ENG]
description:
「在家扮工」是一個可供1至4名玩家遊玩的合作派對遊戲。
扮演著員工的玩家，面對老闆時拼命「扮工」，背著老闆時盡情「偷懶」。
適當的分配「偷懶」及「扮工」時刻，是「在家扮工」玩家的職場生存法則！
隨手拿起工作環境中的物資來跟同事享受偷懶時光！「在家扮工」是一個讓您領著薪水來偷懶的最佳地方！

title: Timingooo [NSP][ENG]
description:
Davayte vyberemsya iz ada, voydya v svoy ritm!
Eto prostaya dlya osvoeniya yaponskaya ritmicheskaya muzykalnaya igra, v kotoroy vy smozhete igrat za kazhdogo iz strannykh personazhey, naselyayushchikh krugi ada, poskolku vse oni podchinyayutsya ritmu neobychnoy muzyki..

title: There will be No Turkey this Christmas [NSZ][ENG]
description:
在平安夜裡，一隻小火雞鑽進桶子，逃過 Silva 家族把牠抓起來烤的命運。現在小火雞要偽裝起來，展開一場逃跑躲藏的驚險之旅，跑得快才能獲得自由。

遊戲特色：
- 隱身！別忘了你正在逃跑。
- 穿越房子裡的隱藏地道，以免被敵人發現。
- 收集物品，就能獲得新的外觀。
- 通過 30 個關卡和挑戰，避免成為桌上的烤火雞。

title: Theft Ride Legacy [NSP][ENG]
description:
準備好在“Theft Ride Legacy”中進行一場充滿腎上腺素的冒險吧！
作為一名熟練的摩托車手，您將穿越廢棄的倉庫，從銀行搶劫案中找回被盜的戰利品。使用廢棄的倉庫作為您的遊樂場，躲避障礙物並爭分奪秒地收集盡可能多的戰利品。
在雙人模式中與朋友競爭，看看誰能成為終極戰利品獵人。
憑藉激動人心的遊戲玩法、具有挑戰性的關卡和追逐的刺激，這款遊戲非常適合任何尋求令人心跳加速的挑戰的人。

準備好踏上動感十足的旅程，成為終極戰利品獵人！

title: The Galactic Junkers [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Being the captain of a spaceship can be hard, especially when there’s a price on your head. Bounty hunters, space pirates, and even the Galactic Union are trying to hunt you down. All that stands between you and oblivion is your wits, your crew, and your trusty ship.

The Galactic Junkers is a comedic action-adventure space combat game that puts you in the role of a space captain on the run. Your ship might be falling apart and your crew isn’t the best but with a little luck you can keep everything ship-shape. Upgrade your ship, hire new crew, steal supplies and equipment, and keep searching for the truth of why everyone wants you dead.

Explore

Take a journey across the solar system exploring all nine planets and their neighboring sectors. Discover mysterious asteroids, creaking space stations, abandoned shipwrecks, deadly pirates and much more.

Mine, Salvage, Steal, and Trade

Running a spaceship is never easy and there’s always bills to pay. Keep your bank balance looking healthy by mining asteroids, salvaging derelicts, and trading with disreputable characters. Maybe you’ll even partake in a little theft, but don’t worry - we don’t tell anyone.

Battle and Board Enemy Ships

Space is a deadly place so you’ll have to fight for your life. Set your crew to operate the guns and show those pesky pirates what you are made of! Board enemy ships to smash and grab essential resources or hack systems from the shadows.

Hire and Maintain your Crew

A happy ship needs a happy crew, so look after your band of useful idiots. Nurture their skills to keep everything running smoothly, or if you don't like them, show them the airlock and hire new crew.

Buy, Upgrade, and Repair Ships

Maybe you need a little more juice in the engine department or your guns are falling short. Upgrade your ship to take control of the sector and make a name for yourself. Or if you prefer something a little fancier, trade in your ship for a better model. Just don’t forget your maintenance routines!

Protect You and Your Ship at all Costs

Try not to get yourself blown up, captured, or otherwise incapacitated. We’re counting on you to find the truth behind the bounty on your head and see if there’s a bigger destiny for you out there. Explore strange new worlds, meet weird new people, try dodgy food, and boldly fumble where no space captain has fumbled before, just don't get your exhaust ports blown off!

title: Ten (10, Ten Rooms, Ten Seconds) [NSZ][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
TEN — eto zakovyristyy platformer, v kotorom vy popadaete v bezzhalostnuyu cheredu desyatisekundnykh komnat-lovushek v otchayannoy borbe za to, chtoby izbezhat svoey sudby i raskryt pravdu!

Sobirayte zhetony, pokupayte uluchsheniya i prikidyvayte, kak preodolet na kazhdom etazhe natisk pil, pushechnogo ognya, lazerov, prichudlivykh monstrov i mnogogo drugogo. Kazhdaya komnata — ispytanie. Kazhdaya smert — urok. Razvivaytes i uchites preodolevat vse prepyatstviya, umiraya, pytayas, umiraya i pytayas snova.

Pokoryayte razlichnye sredy i pobezhdayte v usloviyakh rastushchikh ugroz, ispytaniy i smertonosnykh bossov, probivayas na poverkhnost — i k svoey svobode.


Kharakteristiki
* Bezumnyy 2D indi-platformer
* Voznagrazhdayushchee ispytanie, v kotorom proveryayutsya vashi navyki
* Epicheskiy, napolnennyy adrenalinom originalnyy saundtrek ot legend na dBXY
* Vklyuchaet rezhim spetsialnykh vozmozhnostey, daby obespechit nenapryazhnyy igrovoy protsess

title: Super Crush KO [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Super Crush KO 是一款節奏明快的橫向卷軸動作遊戲。為了從綁匪手中救回你家那隻可愛的貓咪，順便保護人類不被來自天外的機器人毀滅，你必須穿上你最愛的閃亮外套，在五顏六色的未來城市裡擊退一波又一波的致命機器人。

* 快速的遊戲節奏，完美融合彈幕射擊與橫向卷軸動作遊戲。

* 出拳、飛踢、開槍，簡單流暢的操控讓你享受一次打多個敵人的快感。

* 使用強大的地面攻擊，或是在空中連續接技，或是發射超級光束 KO 敵人讓分數持續爆表！

* 在粉彩絢爛的城市中闖關並拯救世界。

* 在超過 20 個關卡中挑戰 S 級通關，並透過線上排行榜與等級系統讓你和全世界各地的玩家一較高下。

title: Space Raiders in Space [NSZ][ENG]
description:
簡單的機制

太空中的太空掠奪者 是 類盜 和塔防機制的混合體。專注和適當的管理對於保持您的小隊活力至關重要。

你現在是隊長！

控制多達八位具有獨特怪癖和天賦的英雄。向個人或整個群體發出命令。你的選擇將決定誰活著，誰最終成為蟲子飼料。

這是免費的房地產！

建立你的行動基地，收集資源並尋找新武器。不要擔心彈藥不足，但要確保你的槍不會在敵人的浪潮中折斷。好吧...如果涉及到這一點，您總是可以將您的船員派到英勇的混戰中

主要特徵

- 簡單的遊戲循環
- 有趣的故事模式
- 近乎無限的可重玩性
- 獨特的審美
- 成人幽默

title: Sockventure [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Stante Supergeroem v etom slozhnom dvukhmernom platformere, i pomogite Malomu otyskat vse noski, poteryavshiesya v proklyatoy stiralnoy mashine. V Sockventure vas zhdyot yarkaya i krasochnaya grafika, narisovannye ot ruki urovni, tochnoe upravlenie, a takzhe razvesyolyy i beskonechno menyayushchiysya igrovoy protsess.

Sockventure — istoriya o malyshe, chi lyubimye noski byli sozhrany proklyatoy stiralnoy mashinoy. Teper maloy nuzhdaetsya v srochnoy pomoshchi i zovyot supergeroya, pribytie kotorogo otkryvaet dveri v mir priklyucheniy. Proydite cherez opasnye urovni, chtoby otyskat vse poteryannye nosochki vnutri stiralki!

Proydite bolee 200 urovney khardkornogo platformera, razyskivaya nosochki i obretaya novye sposobnosti, takie kak dvoynoy pryzhok, pryzhki po stenam, ryvok i udar po zemle. Otkroyte Tyomnye glavy, soberite Monetki, preodoleyte Ispytaniya i otyshchite vse poteryannye noski.

• Bolee 200 urovney — v 7 glavakh vas zhdut bolee 200 sozdannykh vruchnuyu urovney.
• 4 Osobykh sposobnosti — izuchayte novye sposobnosti v protsesse prokhozhdeniya: pryzhki po stenam, dvoynoy pryzhok, ryvok i moshchnyy udar o zemlyu.
• Monety — nakhodite i sobirayte monetki, chtoby otkryt Tyomnye glavy.
• Tyomnye glavy — tri dopolnitelnye Tyomnye glavy gotovy predstavit bolee slozhnye urovni dlya ispytaniya vashikh navykov.
• Ispytaniya — v kazhdoy glave vas zhdut mnogochislennye ispytaniya.
• 20 noskov — ishchite spryatannye noski i ne stesnyaytes ikh nadevat.

title: Seeds of Resilience [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Postroyte derevnyu na neobitaemom ostrove i prigotovtes protivostoyat besposhchadnym stikhiynym bedstviyam! V etoy poshagovoy upravlencheskoy igre vy nauchites primenyat pravilnye predmety, ponimat prirodnye tsikly, a takzhe ispolzovat nastoyashchie srednevekovye stroitelnye i remeslennye tekhniki.

Postepenno postroyte tsivilizatsiyu: ot kamennykh toporov i primitivnykh khizhin — k proizvodstvu s pomoshchyu vodyanogo kolesa! Vse na osnove realnykh tekhnologiy.

Osobennosti
 — Poshagovost. Obdumyvayte sleduyushchiy shag stolko, skolko vam nuzhno. Kogda budete gotovy, prosto zavershite khod i nachnite novyy den.
 — Detalno vosproizvedennoe stroitelstvo. Vybirayte prirodnye resursy soglasno ikh svoystvam. Sozdavayte stroymaterialy na ikh osnove.
 — Realistichnye srednevekovye stroitelnye i remeslennye tekhniki. V igre oni rabotayut tak zhe, kak i v zhizni.
 — Okruzhayushchaya sreda reagiruet na vmeshatelstvo cheloveka. Vozmozhno, ne stoit kazhdyy den rybachit v odnom i tom zhe meste ili srazu vyrubat tselyy les.
 — Vyzhivanie v surovykh usloviyakh, gde buri i prochie bedstviya — norma zhizni.

title: Running on Magic [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Daleko-daleko, v kakom-to volshebnom tsarstve mag izo vsekh sil pytaetsya sbezhat. Mrachnyy Zhnets na nego. K schastyu dlya nego, neuklyuzhiy zhnets nikuda ne toropitsya. No kak dolgo?

V Running on Magic vy upravlyaete otchayavshimsya magom, preodolevayushchim polosu prepyatstviy, chtoby izbezhat Mrachnogo Zhnetsa. Pereprygivayte cherez sushchestv-kapli, ispolzuya svoi sposobnosti poleta, i vyzhivayte do kontsa v etom platformere-rannere s yarkoy pikselnoy grafikoy i dinamicheski sozdavaemymi urovnyami.

Problemy s pryzhkami. Prolozhite svoy put, pereprygivaya cherez yamy i platformy v igre, kotoraya dolzhna byt dostupna kazhdomu igroku.

Vozdushnoe deystvie. Prygayte, plavayte i topayte, chtoby preodolet vse prepyatstviya. Sobirayte magiyu, razbrosannuyu po vsemu urovnyu, chtoby pitat eti sposobnosti i adaptirovatsya k lyuboy situatsii.

Krasivye peyzazhi v pikselnoy grafike i zapominayushchayasya muzyka. Otkroyte dlya sebya kazhdyy iz 5 tematicheskikh mirov.

Nebolshoy rasskaz s yumoristicheskim ottenkom. Poznakomtes s Mrachnym Zhnetsom, kogda oni pytayutsya ubedit maga poyti s nimi i kazhdyy raz terpyat neudachu.

Vy mozhete nasladitsya legkim i uyutnym priklyucheniem, no esli vy khotite poprobovat sebya...

4 raznykh slozhnosti! Podnyat vyzov!

Kazhdyy rezhim uskorit igru, i vy budete vstrechat menshe pikapov na svoem puti. Vash volshebnik takzhe budet imet menshe khp.

V samom slozhnom rezhime u vas budet tolko odin udar, chtoby zavershit svoe puteshestvie!

Beskonechnyy rezhim, gde skorost budet postoyanno uvelichivatsya! 

Tak ty ubezhish ili protyanesh ruku pomoshchi nashemu magu? Prikhodi i otpravlyaysya v malenkoe volshebnoe priklyuchenie!

title: Road Builder [NSZ][ENG]
description:
The player's task is to connect selected entry and exit roads by creating complex structures of intersections and junctions so that traffic interferes with each other as little as possible.

Are you frustrated with traffic jams on the road? In this game, you will play the role of an architect, and the fate of the drivers will be in your hands only. Think and create optimal roads so that as many cars as possible pass through them in the shortest possible time. Don't forget about the budget!

- Thoughtful levels that can be passed in different ways.
- Different variations of roads, intersections and traffic lights make each game unique. Your wits and planning skills count.
- Relaxing music to keep you from getting tired while playing!
- Level editor.

title: Rift Adventure [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Rift Adventure 是一款具有復古像素藝術風格的動作、冒險和 RPG 元素的 2D 平台遊戲，適用於移動設備，旨在教育和提高年輕人、青少年和思鄉玩家對稅收、稅收教育、公民身份以及行為的因果關係的認識。

為此，在所有眾多冒險階段結束時，玩家將被帶到他的城市，在那裡他可以休息、治療、與 NPC 市民互動並用冒險中獲得的錢購買物品和資源。正是在這一點上，玩家的行為不僅開始影響他，而且開始影響整個城市。我們購買的產品內置稅的真正作用是什麼？做出更便宜、更直接的決定只會影響我，從長遠來看真的很有趣嗎？

玩家將在整個遊戲中以一種自然而有意義的方式自行找到這些問題的答案。

至於故事，遊戲發生在一個幻想的中世紀宇宙中，所有角色都被動物化了。主角是一個尋求寶藏和刺激的冒險家，卻看到他最好的朋友和冒險夥伴被來自冥界的強大而邪惡的存在所附身和綁架。

title: Retrograde Arena [NSZ][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
在遊戲中，殺死敵人不是通過子彈，而是利用子彈的慣性力將敵人彈向可以殺死他們的方塊！

在這裡，武器是你的終極工具。不只可以用來轟擊敵人，還可以讓你的飛船在競技場裡利用後坐力快速移動！想要在佈滿霓虹的逆行競技場世界裡肆意穿行？掌握反作用力原則，將是你勝利的關鍵，

快來和陌生人、朋友或者AI戰鬥吧！

三種不同的遊戲模式，最多支援6個玩家同場競技，不同的玩法，搭配不同風格的遊戲模式，期待你在遊玩中擦出更多火花，同時，更多的模式將在搶先體驗階段加入遊戲！

◆基於物理定律的有趣規則！
善用物理定律！使用你的武器後座力來躲避或急速推進你的飛船。利用精準的射擊位移來擾亂敵人的攻擊，通過碰撞和躲避來對抗難纏的對手。當然，你也可以利用這一點，向毫無準備的敵人發起突襲。

◆暢快的線上/本地多人連線
Retrograde Arena競技場支援線上和本地兩種多人遊戲模式！你可以與朋友在同一台電腦上利用多個控制器進行連線，也可以使用區域網路/網際網路與他人連線。每台電腦最多支援4個控制器(4個玩家)，一場遊戲最多支持6個玩家進行同場競技。

◆多樣化的武裝
擅於利用各種不同風格的武器，將增加你獲勝的機率，不管是直接射擊、威力大小、或者反彈，以及黑洞武器。每個武器都有可能在競技場裡發光發熱，掌握每種武器的特性，將是你成為競技場冠軍的關鍵!

◆多樣化的競技場地圖和模式
在遊戲中，每個競技場地圖都有不同的佈局，有些地圖擁有非常獨特的環境，需要你使用不同的策略來應對。操縱開關移動重要的場景物，通過狹窄的走廊，在致命的角落處決你的敵人，任何錯誤的移動和預判都將讓你身陷危機。

• 在“極巨之戰”中與巨型飛船戰鬥
• 在“王之冠”模式中加冕為王
• 在“最終勝者”模式中存活下來。

◆個性化的外觀設定
解鎖和選擇不同的外觀，推進器和粒子效果來個性化你的飛船。從某種程度上講，或許好看也可以增加自己的戰鬥力(並沒有)！

title: Raspberry Mash [NSZ][ENG]
description:
心裡暗自發誓要向「神明」進行「復仇」的少女。
使用劍、槍、鐳射光線、火箭筒等等
性能各異的武器，來將擋在前進道路上的敵人擊倒！

使用翻滾迴避來躲避敵人的攻擊！
高難度的近身戰＆射擊
極具挑戰性！

在進程中根據觸發各種劇情來開啟的路線！
你能到達真正的終點嗎！？

★將獲得的道具與武器、以及各種技能組合起來吧！
★將盤踞在地牢中的大群怪物們打爆的超爽快感！
★超酷炫的血腥暴力！像素畫的角色們血肉橫飛的絕命場景！

title: Rainbow Yggdrasil [NSZ][ENG]
description:
彩虹世界樹是一款Roguelike遊戲 
女主角，怪物甚至地牢的顏色會變成各種顏色。
我們用“RGB”作為縮寫來表達顏色。在這個彩虹世界樹的世界裡，RGB本身就成為了參數。請體驗這個全新的遊戲設計。

# 深度世界觀和場景
場景模式由總共30個地牢組成。
一個女孩在一個白色的世界中探索一棵彩虹世界樹。她能找到世界的真相嗎？

# Roguelike遊戲無盡的旅程等著你
自動生成的地下城，Roguelike遊戲的最大特色，將邀請您進入世界樹的無限迷宮。
您可以增強/合成物品並與世界各地的其他玩家競爭您的過關數目。

=== 序幕 ===

——那天, 我在一個白色的世界裡醒來。

入睡前, 我沒有任何記憶。
我唯一記得的是……我是“人類”。

在我的視線中, 有一個虛無的世界...
和一棵在彩虹中閃耀的巨大世界樹。

為什麼世界變成了這個樣子？
那世界樹有什麼用？

為什麼我一眼就能認出 
“那個”是世界樹？

我必須明白...

這個世界。 
關於我自己。

反正我無處可去, 
所以我開始向樹走去。

title: Kuso [NSP][ENG]
description:
kuso is a challenging yet fair platformer with a simple aesthetic. You have the ability to run, jump, and leave your own checkpoint. Make your way through acid, long jumps, disappearing platforms, bouncers, giant saws, and much more in this dreadful mechanical world. If you're looking for a game that'll challenge your platforming skills, something excellent to listen to, and a game to master, kuso is the game for you.

Features:
• 41 Unique Levels
• 26 Unlockable Achievements
• 2 Player Local Race Mode, perfect for Tabletop or TV Mode
• A soundtrack composed by James Bennett with music crafted for each level
• Hidden secrets and collectibles to find
• A dedicated Speedrun Mode for individual levels or level sets with stat breakdowns for easy screenshot sharing

title: Dungeons & Bombs [NSZ][RUS]
interface_lang: 俄语 [RUS], 德语 [DEU], 英语 [ENG], 日语 [JAP], 中文 [CHI]
description:
這是經典拼圖與盒子和炸彈的動態融合。 當敵人將人們拖到黑暗的巢穴中並在那裡做惡事時，英雄和他忠實的劍總是會來拯救他們。 但是，如果英雄沒有劍，只有大量的熱情和無盡的炸藥供應呢？ 好吧，對他們不利。 穿越迷宮般的黑暗迷宮，不要把自己炸飛！

特色：
-50個糾纏的拼圖關卡
-完成每個拼圖的動作數量有限
-堅不可摧的邏輯定律
-炸彈和爆炸！

title: Shakes on a Plane [NSZ][RUS]
interface_lang: 俄语 [RUS], 德语 [DEU], 英语 [ENG], 西班牙语 [ESP], 法语 [FRA], 意大利语 [ITA], 日语 [JAP], 韩语 [KOR], 荷兰语 [DUT], 葡萄牙语 [POR], 中文 [CHI]
description:
Shakes on a Plane 是一款混亂搖晃，令人震撼的合作型遊戲，適合一至四名玩家參與。跟你的機組人員一起在各種飛機上飛行，在飛機降落機場前，為乘客送上奶昔、漢堡、薯條和許許多多的美食，你的乘客將對你的服務評分。 
但是，製造混亂的可不只你一人。外星人總是派出它奇怪的人民盯著我們閃亮亮的地球，不過它們製作與烹飪的食物不僅美味還讓人難以抗拒。銀河系社群角逐讓人揚名立萬的烹飪比賽，推出最最精緻餐點的物種即告獲勝。此時，正是人類在這非凡的活動中一展長才的時刻，讓銀河系知道真正速食的滋味與樣貌。


- 與最多四名玩家一起為乘客服務，並共同合作說服他們相信與你一起飛行絕對是最好的決定。

- 餐點種類繁多，包括奶昔、漢堡、咖啡以及各式各樣更美味的速食，所有你供應給乘客的都是最好的品質。

- 整個飛行期間，時間就是關鍵，你的客人對各種商品都有很高的需求。拿著托盤同時接受各式各樣的點餐，不讓客人等太久。

- 飛行期間會發生的不只是氣流製造混亂而已，還有走來走去的乘客、移動的桌子、以及許許多多會讓你的飛行技能疲於奔命的事。

title: May's Mysteries: The Secret of Dragonville [NSZ][ENG]
description:
May's Mysteries: The Secret of Dragonville — zakhvatyvayushchaya priklyuchencheskaya golovolomka. V etoy igre vas zhdut: syuzhet, kotoryy provedyot vas cherez chetyre narisovannykh ot ruki mira, 80 lokatsiy, 50 personazhey, 10 minut animirovannykh syuzhetnykh stsen i 270 logicheskikh golovolomok, sposobnykh uvlech igroka na 25 chasov igry.
Pomogite Mey, samostoyatelnoy i obayatelnoy devochke, nayti eyo propavshego brata. Okunites v priklyucheniya v stile multfilmov i preodoleyte 270 zagadok, zamyslovatykh ritm-igr i narisovannykh vruchnuyu stsen poiska predmetov. Ishchite zatsepki, kotorye pomogut Mey otyskat brata, puteshestvuyte po tainstvennym mestam i vstrechayte zhivopisnykh personazhey, gotovykh priyti na vyruchku.
OSNOVNYE OSOBENNOSTI:
•	Bolee 270 mini-igr: 230 golovolomok, 25 stsen poiska predmetov i 13 ritm-igr.
•	Proydite cherez 4 zateylivykh mira i raskroyte tayny 80 zagadochnykh lokatsiy.
•	Povstrechayte 47 lyubopytnykh personazhey, kotorye pomogut v vashikh stranstviyakh.
•	Dlya vas narisovano vruchnuyu 7 minut animirovannykh stsen.
•	Ocharovatelnaya grafika ruchnoy raboty.
•	8 muzykalnykh tem.
•	Bolee 25 chasov igry.

title: Pink Explorer [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Gameplay of Pink Explorer is made to be fun & satisfying! Use double jumps, wall jumps, gravity to beat all 20 different levels! Every level has something different to offer. Many unique enemies & puzzles across all the levels!

Easy but fun controls:
Movement in this game has been made very easy to learn, no need for complex dashes or anything! The movement is very smooth and responsive to inputs!

Saving system:
No time to play all the levels in one session? Don't worry! Pink Explorer has a saving system so every level you unlock stays unlocked!

High quality arcade music:
Pink Explorer offers the highest quality retro arcade soundtracks. The game has many different full length soundtracks for you to listen to while playing!

title: Pangeon [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Fight your way through to the bottom of the so-called Pangeon - an organization located in a dungeon that we know very little about (well, except the fact it contains something that has the potential to destroy the entire planet Earth) - eliminate the evil, and save the World from a potential tragedy.

- A mix of many roguelike games combined into a fun (although short) experience
- 8+ levels, various in looks, enemies and loot
- 10+ weapons to use - ranging from daggers, swords and ending on magic staffs, bows, etc

title: Wonder Blade [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Oh my god! The princess was captured by villainous maniac again! What are you waiting for? Grab your weapon and free the princess, save the world! You really do not know what’s waiting for you!
With all those sweet combos, killer finishing moves and devastating magic abilities the bad guys won't know what hit them. Don't forget to wear a costume to make you a one-of-a-kind adventurer. Will you be a sneaky ninja, smacking enemies with a frozen fish? Or a lightsaber-wielding fighter with a score to settle? It's all up to you!
A variety of designed game scenes, stages and experiences - more than just whacking bad guys with a sword.
Ever rode a pig? A battlebot? A fire-breathing dragon!? Now you can!
And that's just a taste! You'll have to discover the rest for yourself. The only question is, are you ready? Good luck, adventurer.

title: Orbitblazers [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Vmeste s Orbitblazers ty pouchastvuesh v futuristicheskikh sportivnykh gonkakh vysshego klassa, kotorykh tebe v podobnom vide eshche ne dovodilos vstrechat! 
Ty smozhesh s golovokruzhitelnoy skorostyu skolzit po futuristicheskim trassam i preodolevat vse prepyatstviya na svoem puti! Ty budesh gospodstvovat na gonochnom treke kak v rezhime odinochnoy igry, tak i v rezhime igry vdvoem.
Jump-’n’-Roll… Jump-’n’-Drive… Jump-’n’ Fly…  Jump-’n’ Shoot!...
Orbitblazers – eto stremitelnyy i trebovatelnyy arkadnyy gonochnyy sport. Sadis za shturval svoego kosmicheskogo korablya i pokazhi, na chto ty sposoben! Kuvyrkaysya, ezdi, skolzi ili leti po voskhititelnym kosmicheskim dorogam! Preodolevay vse prepyatstviya i, esli ponadobitsya, prolozhi svoy put k pobede! Prygay s platformy na platformu, nakhodya pri etom vozmozhnost bystro i bezopasno preodolevat slozhnye uchastki marshruta. Skolzi po raznoobraznym tsvetovym polyam i soberi kak mozhno bolshe poleznykh predmetov. Potomu chto dobratsya do finisha ty smozhesh, tolko esli ty dostatochno khorosh.
Arkadnoe igrovoe udovolstvie chistoy vody!
•	V odnopolzovatelskom rezhime ty kataeshsya po 4 galaktikam s obshchim kolichestvom trekov bolee 20, chtoby dostich samogo bystrogo vremeni ili maksimalno vozmozhnogo kolichestva ochkov!
•	V mnogopolzovatelskom rezhime ty odnovremenno srazhaeshsya za pobedu s drugim igrokom! 
•	Naslazhdaysya plavnostyu grafiki i fantasticheskimi vizualnymi effektami!   
Onlayn reytingi igrokov! 
•	Pokazhi miru, naskolko ty khorosh, i sorevnuysya s luchshimi igrokami! Brosay vyzov svoim protivnikam i pobey vse rekordy!
Ty gotov prinyat vyzov?
•	Nachni pryamo seychas i pokazhi, na chto ty sposoben!

title: Off and On Again (OAOA) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
With the dawn of the internet the digital universe experienced exponential growth. The citizens basked in their new wealth and power, with access to previously unimaginable knowledge. For a while it seemed as if anything was possible.

This golden age did not last. Knowledge became corrupt, much of it was lies dressed up as truth. Fear, paranoia and hate infected the world with Programs becoming jealous of the resources allocated to others. Throughout this turmoil the real threat went by unseen.

A silent invader watched and waited, planning its attack. The war that followed was brief and devastating. Now there is but one hope. A hero must reboot the system, to turn it "Off And On Again" resetting time to before the corruption ever began. Are you that Hero?

Off And On Again tells the story of a hero tasked with rebooting time. The game world is created and destroyed during play, with the hero having the ability to turn parts of the world off and on again. You will be required to use both brains and skill to overcome the enemies and obstacles in your path.

title: Octo Curse [NSZ][ENG]
description:
OctoCurse 是一款動作平台遊戲，講述了海盜船長被惡靈變成章魚的故事。 小章魚踏上了拯救其他船員並扭轉詛咒的旅程。
體驗史詩般的海盜冒險。 隨著您越來越接近最終決戰，探索關卡、收集金幣、解鎖大門並攀登神秘的塔樓。
穿過熱帶叢林，勇敢地度過嚴冬，度過風暴並忍受其他令人興奮的環境。 拯救你的朋友，一路上結識新朋友。

- 超過 100 個有趣和驚險的關卡等你發現
-5 個激動人心的不同動作章節
-擊敗頑強的敵人並避開致命的陷阱
- 收集金幣並解鎖新關卡
- 用時尚時髦的帽子自定義你的角色
- 特殊的困難模式來測試你的技能

title: Windscape [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Windscape — priklyuchencheskaya igra ot pervogo litsa s elementami ekshen, deystvie kotoroy proiskhodit na zhivopisnykh ostrovakh, paryashchikh v nebe. Odnako etomu chudesnomu miru grozit beda — ostrova razrushayutsya i padayut vniz! Uznayte, chto za zlo stoit za vsem etim, i predotvratite katastrofu.

Issleduyte chetyre unikalnykh ostrova, sobirayte resursy, sozdavayte raznoobraznye predmety, bronyu i oruzhie, srazhaytes s monstrami i bossami, reshayte zaputannye golovolomki.

Vas zhdet nezabyvaemoe priklyuchenie!

title: My Divorce Story [NSZ][ENG]
description:
我們的主角是個普通人，過著平凡的生活。
某天收到了一條訊息，得知自己的配偶出軌了。
 
  “遊戲什麼的先放一放。”
 
  “你的另一半有了外遇。”
 
訊息是誰發來的？這不可能……

在這款獨特的冒險遊戲中，搜集你配偶的出軌證據並順利達成離婚。
 
 遊戲特色：
◆與配偶的鬥智鬥勇開始了！
　在發現外遇後的六個月內，你必須搜集證據，將其呈上法庭。
　生活如同一場夢靨，你必須與對方保持良好關係。
　但在平淡日常的背後，你正默默搜集著離婚證據。
 
◆緊張刺激的小遊戲
　趁著還沒被發現，在短時間內破解電腦的開機密碼！
　或是在配偶睡覺時屏住呼吸，檢查手機，千萬別吵醒對方！
　通過各種小遊戲來搜集證據。
 
◆你我二人的回憶
　尋找對你們倆意義不凡的物品！
　它們明明敘說著過去的美好回憶……
　最後卻化作了痛苦和憤怒，見證了婚姻的破裂。
 
◆一系列結局等你解鎖
　看看這段婚姻會走向何處。解鎖多個不同的結局。
　這一切都取決於你找到的證據、與配偶的感情和手頭上的資金。
　幸福的結局、不幸的結局，甚至還有幾個讓人驚掉下巴的結局——
　它們都在等著你！

title: Mixolumia [NSZ][ENG]
description:
閃亮的視覺效果和精緻的音樂將在你遊玩中反應和變化！Mixolumia帶給你全新的益智遊戲體驗!
迷人的視覺效果、多種遊戲模式、以及可定製的玩法和風格，讓你調整到最適合你自己的玩法！

左右移動磚塊，快速降落磚塊！排出3或4個連成一排並清空，說不定還能打出Combo呢？為你帶來在寶石形狀的棋盤上全新的益智遊戲體驗。

每首歌都有不同的和聲效果。同步的SFX和BGM將隨着你的遊戲而增長。當你獲得更高的分數和Combo時，就會有更多樣的變化!

選擇適合你心情的遊戲模式，從最輕鬆的模式到最激烈的模式都有!

Nintendo Switch版本包含一個新添加的功能：調色板編輯器。用你最喜歡的顏色來玩! 你還可以保存它們並創建你自己的畫廊。使用顏色代碼與社區分享你的最佳調色板吧！

title: Mahjong Stories: Vampire Romance [NSZ][RUS/Multi4]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 4]
description:
Na protyazhenii dolgikh let Edvarda terzali bessonnitsa i strannye videniya togo, chto sokryto ot vzorov obychnykh lyudey. Zhelaya sbezhat ot samogo sebya, on otpravilsya v dolgoe puteshestvie na mototsikle. Sudba privela geroya k zabroshennomu kladbishchu, nepodaleku ot kotorogo slomalsya ego zheleznyy kon. Udastsya li Edvardu spasti neschastnye dushi, izmuchennye drevnim proklyatiem? Ili zhe on sam stanet odnim iz vechnykh uznikov grafa Orloka? Vse zavisit tolko ot vashego uma, soobrazitelnosti i nastoychivosti!

Chtoby razrushit zacharovannye pechati, priblizitsya k razgadke tayny misticheskogo kladbishcha i vstreche s ego povelitelem, vam predstoit reshit desyatki uvlekatelnykh golovolomok v stile madzhong. Udalyayte s igrovogo polya odinakovye plitki, razdrazhaya svoimi uspekhami nedovolnogo grafa, i vnimatelno slushayte rasskazy mestnykh obitateley. Neozhidannaya razvyazka uzhe blizka!

• Uvlekatelnye zadachki v stile madzhong
• Neozhidannye detali etoy mrachnoy istorii
• Vampiry, privideniya i drugie uzhasayushchie obitateli
• Krasivaya grafika i muzyka

title: Magicians Chase Missing Curry Recipe [NSZ][ENG]
description:
女僕機器人 MAY 善良的吸血鬼獵人 LAYKA 和她的槍手女僕 SAKURA 正在追捕偷食譜的神秘小偷 Garam Masala！
與此同時，ETHYL、RIPPE、NAYUTA也在尋找小偷破案。
他們能恢復咖哩食譜和城市的和平嗎？

-系統-
在這個遊戲中，你從 6 個性格獨特的女孩中選擇 1 個作為主角。

6 個角色中的每 1 個都可以使用自己獨特的動作和子武器。
使用他們的獨特技能，在各個階段奔跑並以時尚的方式擊敗老闆！

遊戲中的所有像素藝術都是由 StudioX 新創建的！
在這款遊戲中享受 Pixel-Art 的複古感覺和動作速度。

title: Lost Wing [NSZ][ENG]
description:
在殘酷的環境中駕駛超級快船，並嘗試在排行榜上名列前茅！Lost Wing 具有無數挑戰、船隻、敵人和陷阱，是一針純正的腎上腺素。Lost Wing 結合了超高速的射擊和飛行。 各種各樣的軌道，以你的方式躲避和射擊一切，如果你達到最終的目標，消滅首領就可以獲得大量分數。

特色：

•三個世界，四種軌道，幾種難度模式和無限小時的遊戲時間。
•當變得有點接近舒適時，在強烈的速度和時間減速下，感受腎上腺素的衝擊。
•高清晰度霓虹科幻氣氛。
•解鎖多艘戰艦並升級。
•展現自己的威力並摧毀巨人。
•與在線排行榜上的其他玩家競爭。
•專注於加速注入的原創電子音樂。

title: Light of Life [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Light of Life — slozhnyy platformer na metkost. Glavnyy geroy — elfiyka Elanor, obladayushchaya neveroyatnoy siloy!

Volshebnye fragmenty zhizni ukradeny zlobnymi goblinami i Elanor so svoim vernym lukom i strelami dolzhna vernut ikh.

V igre Light of Life bolee 100 sozdannykh vruchnuyu urovney s yarkoy i miloy pikselnoy grafikoy, kotorye stanut interesnym vyzovom dlya lyubogo igroka. 
	
		
Kharakteristiki:
* 2D-platformer na metkost
* Ispolzuyte luk s volshebnymi silam
* 100 slozhnykh urovney
* Sobirayte kristally, chtoby razblokirovat potryasayushchie naryady dlya Elanor!
* 5 raznykh mirov s raznymi mekhanikami

title: Landflix Odyssey [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Landflix Odyssey is an action platformer in which players play as Larry, a lazy binge-watcher who, after using special batteries, finds himself trapped inside the streaming service he was watching, Landflix!
In order to return home, his mission will be to recover all five batteries that ended up inside the TV shows of the Landflix platform.

title: Invercity [NSZ][ENG]
description:
【遊戲介紹】
《倒立城市(Invercity)》是一款“重力反轉益智遊戲”，
玩家要透過「倒立」和「世界反轉」來解決難題。
 
【倒立】
・主角Urara能夠隨時「倒立」。 當她這樣做時，奇怪的現象發生了。
各種物體竟然「從天而降」！
 根據Urara的說法，
“因為在我的角度看來就是這樣。這不是理所當然的嗎？”

【世界反轉】
當按下「世界反轉開關」時，
反轉信號將傳到廣播室，導致世界反轉。
當世界顛倒過來時，你倒立時看起來會像是「倒掛」著，
你可以去到以前無法抵達的地方。

title: Host 714 [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Host 714 是一款潛行遊戲，您可以在其中控制 Squid，這是一個吸毒的流浪漢，受政府組織 Orange Institute 的邀請，加入了一個進行實驗性治療和重新融入社會的毒癮康復中心。

到達遙遠島嶼上的研究所，烏賊意識到這個提議並不是他們聲稱的那樣。 現在你是一個測試對象，命運不確定。

從廢棄的地牢到現代實驗室。 從虐待守衛到沒有靈魂的病人。 Host 714 的聲音和視覺效果將讓您在研究所走廊內感受到持續的緊張、被遺棄和加速的心。

探索這些地區，找到鑰匙，門禁卡，與其他囚犯交談並解開謎團，以找到逃離這個充滿鎖門和無法進入的地方的地獄般的地方的出路。

遊戲特色

- 具有挑戰性的隱身遊戲
- 講故事和令人毛骨悚然的氛圍
- 獨特的遊戲機制
- 熟悉的主角和反派

title: Gluck [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Milaya korotkometrazhnaya advenchura: prokopayte sebe put skvoz zemlyu, izbegaya travm i vyzhivaya den za dnem. Beregite sebya... Konvertiruyte rudu v dengi i vyzhivayte pod zemley, razgadyvaya taynu glubin shakhty..
Chtoby vosstanovit vodu, kotoraya kogda-to svobodno tekla v vashey derevne, vy probiraetes v samye glubokie ugolki pod zemlyoy. Odnako shakhty — mesto, polnoe opasnostey. Royte tunneli, polagayas na pomoshch svoikh tovarishchey-shakhterov, i preodolevayte vse trudnosti, chtoby vosstanovit osnovu zhizni.
Osvoyte kirku i konveyernuyu lentu, chtoby dobyvat rudu, ispolzuyte metallicheskoe elektromagnitnoe buksirovochnoe ustroystvo, chtoby sortirovat svoyu dobychu. Ruda, kotoruyu vy pravilno otsortiruete, ostanetsya u vas — no vam eshchyo nuzhno budet kupit batarei dlya shlema, instrumenty i edu!
I beregite sebya..

title: Guns N' Runs [NSZ][ENG]
description:
V Guns N' Runs vy upravlyaete 8 iskusnykh chlenov Conspiracy Squad v stilnoy igre v zhanre platformera, ekshena i shutera, polnostyu narisovannoy vruchnuyu v pikselnom stile, gde vremya yavlyaetsya pervostepennym faktorom v borbe protiv tekhnopata-chudaka i ego armii robotov.

Pomogite nashim geroyam vo vtorzhenii v bunker posredi pustyni Atakama v missii zakhvata i spaseniya, polnoy vyzovov i opasnostey. Igra prednaznachena dlya odnogo igroka, s bolee chem 200 ispytaniyami, 23 bossami i fokusom na individualnoy povestvovatelnoy linii kazhdogo chlena otryada.

Upravlenie prostoe i dostupnoe - vy mozhete prygat, strelyat, manevrirovat i ispolzovat spetsialnye sposobnosti - no ne sovershayte oshibku! Igra imeet urovni slozhnosti, trebuyushchie bolee glubokikh navykov dlya prodvizheniya na sleduyushchie urovni. V etoy igre vy uznaete novyy urok s kazhdoy smertyu.

Ispolzuyte raznoobraznoe oruzhie, zashchishchaytes shchitom, vosstanavlivayte manevr, chtoby ispolzovat ego posledovatelno, unichtozhayte nekotorykh vragov usilennym manevrom (esli naydete) i naslazhdaytes kazhdoy sekundoy igry s originalnym saundtrekom, kotoryy zastavit vas volnovatsya na kazhdom novom urovne.

Tak chto gotovtes umirat neskolko raz i preodolevat svoi predely.

title: Gum Plus [NSZ][ENG]
description:
棘手的情況

一團神奇的口香糖，需要您的幫助。解決任何阻礙他的難題。推和拉塊，使其成為一個整體到下一個樓梯。

小心點

您遇到的陷阱將是致命的。不過不要擔心犯錯誤。您可以隨時回溯或重新開始關卡。

挑戰自己

贏得獎杯，幫助您解鎖新世界。要獲得它們，您需要以盡可能少的動作完成關卡。有很多秘密要發現，所以一定要密切關注。

芯片音樂

如果沒有很棒的配樂，一個很棒的謎題就不會那麼有影響力。在整個旅程中享受所有 33 首獨特的音樂曲目。

關卡編輯器

如果您對 Gum+ 的 76 個關卡感到厭煩，不妨試試內置關卡編輯器。提出自己的挑戰並與您的朋友分享。

主要特點：

- 很多聰明的謎題
- 單人故事模式
- 功能齊全的關卡編輯器
- 33 首原聲帶
- 復古圖形

title: Gold Crusader [NSP][ENG]
description: Jump into procedurally generated dungeons and fight the creatures who stole your gold. Kill them to gain experience and grab your gold. Craft over 20 swords with different attributes to fight the growing threat.

title: Glitchhikers the Spaces Between [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Glitchhikers: The Spaces Between – eto igra o myslyakh, kotorye voznikayut u vas na puti ot odnogo mesta naznacheniya k drugomu, o meditativnykh stranstviyakh, kogda soznanie otreshaetsya ot tela i issleduet glubiny nashego vnutrennego «ya». Otpravlyaytes v put po polunochnomu shosse, v utrennem tikhom poezde, skvoz zalityy lunnym svetom park ili zaderzhites, ozhidaya samolet v pustom aeroportu, i pod strannuyu muzyku i beskonechnye obyavleniya o perenose reysov zadumaytes o svoem meste vo vselennoy.

Dolgaya doroga – luchshee mesto dlya razmyshleniy. Glitchhikers predlagaet vam zaglyanut vnutr sebya, nayti otvety na volnuyushchie vas voprosy i zanovo pereosmyslit ikh. Zadumatsya o zhizni, vselennoy i vashem meste i tseli v ney. Povestvovanie igry obeshchaet vam opredelennyy uroven svobody, vstrechu s beskonechnoy neizbezhnostyu i ogromnyy, polnyy nadezhd mir dlya issledovaniya.

Glitchhikers: The Spaces Between pereosmyslivaet i dopolnyaet vyshedshuyu v 2014 godu odnoimennuyu igru, teplo prinyatuyu igrokami i kritikami.

• Puteshestvie v ramkakh svobodnogo povestvovaniya
• Beskonechnoe stranstvie
• Syurrealistichnye personazhi
• I ochen strannaya muzyka
• Polnoe prochtenie kultovoy igry

Avangardnaya rabota narrativnykh dizaynerov iz Silverstring Media
Gruppa Silverstring Media ne tolko predlagaet vashemu vnimaniyu sobstvennye unikalnye narrativnye korotkometrazhnye proekty, no i otvechaet za povestvovanie v takikh izvestnykh indi-shedevrakh, kak Celeste, Crypt of the Necrodancer, Where the Water Tastes Like Wine, Manifold Garden i Wandersong.

title: Gemini [NSZ][Multi]
description:
黑暗吞噬星空，孤星降臨大地；驀然回首，一縷熟悉的光芒； 新的生命，守望一段美麗的旅途； 他們將如何劃過天宇，點亮世界？

《雙子》是一部由國人團隊開發的交互詩歌，是一場雙星伴舞寫就的詩意旅程。

在《雙子》中，玩家將操縱其中一顆小星，和同伴一起在空中飛舞，克服困難，點亮世界。沒有語言與文字，也沒有手把手的指南，學會飛翔，尋求意義，都是遊戲體驗的一部分。

兩顆星星的旅程， 彼此心靈的羈絆， 在一起， 我們就能飛翔……


• 為全年齡設計，簡單易上手
• 原創的體驗式遊戲玩法
• 沒有語言與文字，用圖像和音樂講述美麗故事
• 抽象絕美的畫面並配以精緻感人的音樂
• 通關單人模式後會有雙人模式，體驗和樂趣加倍

title: Garbage Pail Kids: Mad Mike and the Quest for Stale Gum [NSP][ENG]
description:
