二十世紀八零年代，兩樣事物主宰了世界：NES 和《Garbage Pail Kids》卡片。不分年齡，不問身份，各個孩子的午餐盒中都會出現這些可愛的的怪物孩童。而與此同時，北美地區的起居室則為 NES 所佔據。二十世紀八零年代的兩大主流流行文化合二為一 – 這是完全可以理解的事情... 對吧？你是不是也這樣想？？？
 
咳，然而事情其實是這樣：這樣的事情從來沒發生過，一直到現在。
 
iam8bit 誠意巨獻，和 Retrotainment 的開發者/時光穿梭者以及我們在 Topps 的朋友們一道，自豪地向您呈現這個闊別已久而又新鮮出爐的《Garbage Pail Kids》NES 遊戲：《Garbage Pail Kids: Mad Mike and the Quest for Stale Gum》。
 
• 四個可遊玩角色
• 六個精彩關卡
• 卡片交易系統
• 對《Garbage Pail Kids》的忠實致敬
• 數位版本特性 + 獎勵內容

title: Frost [NSZ][ENG]
description:
IGN Greece 7.9/10
GamePitt 9/10
HandsomePhantom 8/10
GamingTrend 8/10

Frost — kartochnaya igra o vyzhivanii v surovom kholodnom mire, opustoshennom razrushitelnoy burey. Vam predstoit vozglavit gruppu kochevnikov, ishchushchikh Ubezhishche — priyut vdali ot lda i kholoda. Probirayushchiy do kostey moroz — ne edinstvennaya opasnost: v puti vam budut ugrozhat volki, lyudoedy, golod i ustalost, i tolko umeloe upravlenie spaset vyzhivshikh i pomozhet im dobratsya do tseli. 

Osobennosti 
• Slozhnyy igrovoy protsess, kotoryy potrebuet ot vas strategicheskogo myshleniya, planirovaniya i khoroshey pamyati.
• Desyatki kart, sredi kotorykh — resursy, oruzhie, idei, ispytaniya i regiony. 
• Interesnyy mir i zakhvatyvayushchiy syuzhet. 
• Potryasayushchie illyustratsii, narisovannye ot ruki. 
• Mnogochasovoy igrovoy protsess s raznymi urovnyami slozhnosti, beskonechnym rezhimom, stsenariyami i novymi kartami. 
• Mnozhestvo personazhey, kazhdyy so svoimi umeniyami.

title: Feral Flowers [NSZ][ENG]
description:
「Feral Flowers」是一款快速的平台遊戲，共有 92 個關卡。 它有很多花，會向你發射花粉球！

如果時間用完了，它就會變成彈幕，花粉會讓你打噴嚏。 如果你打噴嚏，遊戲結束，你必須重新開始。

然而，如果你走得夠遠，你會找到快速收回進度的方法。

title: Extinction Eclipse [NSP][ENG]
description:
Explore space, conquer asteroid fields to mine and extract resources. Build a fleet of spaceships and destroy the enemies in this new space action strategy adventure. Defend Humanity against an alien invader who aims to freeze Earth. 

The Story Mode is divided into campaigns with several missions each. Completing a campaign will unlock others so you can play in a non-linear way. You decide the path to victory.

The Skirmish Mode allows you to configure the match: map size, goal, initial fleet and upgrades, etc. The world will then be procedurally generated, offering a unique experience everytime!

Extinction Eclipse is a space action strategy game, where you are in command of the human forces in their effort to find the necessary resources to build a fleet. You start with only a couple of miner ships and a probe, and your mission is to find and conquer asteroid fields that can be mined, in order to extract their precious metals and water.

You will build your fleet gradually, and before each mission, you can choose which ships to use. After you build your ships, any of them that manage to survive during the mission will become part of the available fleet.

You will also accumulate unused metal and water to trade for upgrades and power ups in the store. These upgrades will make your ships faster and stronger, increasing your chances of succeeding.

But be careful, the aliens will not sit back and relax while you expand. They will attack your bases by surprise, so be prepared to defend them constantly!

title: Exodemon [NSZ][ENG]
description:
扮演一個在宇宙邊緣並被外星人感染的科學家。共生力量正試圖控制你的身體和心靈，但是你仍然可以找到方法來馴服這隻野獸。抵抗感染，並通過各種各樣的危險地方暴走至最後一個逃生艙！

受“黃金90年代的FPS動作遊戲”的啟發，Exodemon是一款節奏明快的射擊遊戲，可為你提供獨特的近戰和遠程的能力擊落異型。穿越迷宮般的關卡，用巨大的共生爪消滅成群的敵人。回顧流派的經典，這種FPS體驗著重於敏銳的控制，速度和敏捷性，所有都以低多邊形的風格呈現，使幀率保持了驚人的增長！

特色：

• 敏銳的FPS控制和快速的角色移動！
• 通過動態粒子和高品質的光效享受低分辨率/低多邊形的體驗。
• 用超讚的外星爪可以炸開，斬殺和撕開你的敵人！
• 通過老式挑戰和零手持來測試你的技能。
• 探索經過精心設計的關卡，並提供多條路徑，而不是生成的程序！

title: Exertus Redux [NSZ][ENG]
description: Through use of the fluid movement set within the game and the dynamic level elements, players have the simple aim of getting from point A to point B, either by using the beaten path or the off-path environment in the semi-linear levels.

title: Escape String [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Escape String 是一款 2D 益智遊戲，設定在未定義的時間和地點。一個小型人形機器人在一家大型工廠內的垃圾填埋場的廢墟中醒來。
他從一個顯然想幫助他的人那裡收到奇怪而神秘的信息。機器人的目的是探索他所在的大型工廠，尋找關於他和他神秘的遠程助手是誰的答案。
玩家不會直接實時控制機器人，而是在其顯示屏上方插入移動命令，以便告訴機器人何時該跳躍、何時蹲下等等。
因此它是一個基於透視的益智遊戲：玩家必須計算機器人和障礙物之間的空間。障礙最初是完全靜止的，但隨著它們的前進，它們將變得越來越動態和多樣。
例如，我們將擁有守衛機器人，它們將以鏡像方式執行與我們的機器人相同的動作。目前有 40 個關卡，有 8 種障礙。
真正的挑戰在於以盡可能少的指示（輸入）數量完成關卡，並在單行（字符串）中提供這些命令，在滿足這些條件的同時結束關卡將解鎖該特定關卡的“金芯片” .
“金芯片”將用於為我們的機器人解鎖新皮膚。因此，考慮到非動態遊戲玩法，該標題既適合那些尋求輕鬆解謎的人，也適合那些因其街機性質而尋求挑戰的人。

- 原創益智遊戲
- 適合所有年齡段
- 許多類型的障礙
- 放鬆但具有良好的挑戰水平
- 40 個級別，可擴展
- 原創藝術領域
- 角色皮膚
- 沒有微交易

title: El Gancho [NSZ][ENG]
description:
波戈梵帝國入侵了可可杜星球並抓走了可可龍！波戈梵星人在銀河的各物種間尋找能量的無限來源時，發現了可可龍的無限幸福能量。如今他們訂定了邪惡的計畫，要萃取幸福能量並使用在毀滅性的武器上。

《El Gancho》和《Task Force Kampas》的故事背景屬於同一個的宇宙，但這次沒有幫手。你將扮演找到實驗性雷射鈎的可可龍，在復古像素風格的宇宙平台關卡中擺盪！你的移動速度越快，移動軌跡就越長，而軌跡可以用來掃蕩敵人！每趟旅程都是隨機生成、獨一無二的關卡，這給了你無數個可以一再遊玩並增進技巧的理由。

特色：

• 在隨機生成的平台中跳躍並使用雷射鈎擺盪。
• 拯救你的朋友，解鎖 10 名擁有獨特技能的可可龍角色。
• 尋找無效化開關，擊敗 6 大首領類型！
• 超過 15 種提升存活率的升級項目任你選擇。
• 在充滿特製關卡的「挑戰模式」中測試你的技巧。
• 享受每趟絕不重複且令人欲罷不能的無限輪迴遊戲體驗！

title: Dyna Bomb 1-2 [NSZ][ENG]
description:
傑克和埃拉正在一個美麗的熱帶小島上度假。他們不知道 DR.Brutus，他們啜飲果汁並談論他們過去的冒險經歷。他們被布魯圖斯博士的聲音打斷了。一聲巨響摧毀了他們放鬆的亭子，因此他們決定讓壞人為此付出代價。於是他們開始了新的冒險，你將成為主角。如果你喜歡和朋友一起玩，請選擇兩個英雄之一或兩者兼而有之。在 8 個不同美麗多彩的關卡中飛行和射擊炸彈。發現秘密關卡並找到通往秘密世界的道路。購買有助於你冒險的新武器和其他類型的升級。擊敗 Dr.Brutus 的所有追隨者，幫助 Jack 和 Ela 清理他們所在的美麗島嶼。

8個不同的世界。
每個世界有 8 個不同的關卡。
每個世界都有一個獨特的BOSS。
秘密關卡。
秘密世界。
隱藏區域。
驚人的合作模式。

title: Dungeon Rush (ot Rapiz1) [NSP][ENG]
description:
Lyubite «Zmeyku»? Togda sobirayte geroev, uvelichivaya svoyu kolonnuyu armiyu, i zashchishchayas ot monstrov! U kazhdogo urovnya est tselevye pokazateli tsepochki geroev. Kak tolko on budet dostignut, vas otpravyat na sleduyushchiy uroven: tut est mnogo shtuk, kotorye budut korrektirovatsya v zavisimosti ot vashego urovnya, vklyuchaya faktory zdorovya i nanosimogo urona, dlitelnost usileniy i oslableniy, kolichestvo i silu monstrov, i tak dalee.
Monstry sluchayno dropayut oruzhiya. Raznye geroi mogut byt osnashcheny razlichnym vooruzheniem, naprimer, Gromopalkoy. Krutoy posokh, kotoryy zastavit vashego volshebnika vyzyvat uzhasnyy grom, porazhayushchiy vsekh vragov vokrug! Est baffy i debaffy — veroyatnost, chto ataka oruzhiem aktiviruet opredelennoe usilenie na nyom samom, ili oslablenie na protivnike.
Ledyanoy mech mozhet zamorazhivat vragov.

title: Destructivator SE [NSZ][ENG]
Dark Sauce [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Dark Sauce is a cubical platforming game that delivers everything the true gamer needs: colourful 3D graphics with voxels, challenging levels, memorable NPCs, dungeons, dragons and valuable loot!

Delve deep into the dungeon full with villainous monsters and lethal traps. Mountains of gold will be your reward, but beware — ancient and dangerous dragon relentlessly guards them.

Take this challenge if you dare. You'll have to overcome complex levels and take down the powerful dragon, who keeps gold treasures safe. And one more thing — you don't have any super-abilities. You are just a small piggy who ventured deep into the dark and dangerous dungeon. Try to survive it!

title: Crypto Is Dead [NSZ][ENG]
description:
This morning, on the newspaper:

"Crypto Is Dead", this is what you can read everywhere on social networks and in the street. A 51% attack against the global cryptocurrency succeeded yesterday, paralyzing the entire global economy.
To remedy the problem and give itself time to get the system back on track, the Central Bank has decided to put the old physical currency back into circulation.
In order to do this, it is asking the banks to equip themselves and to find people qualified in banknote verification.

The World Bank estimates that the situation will remain in this state for a month.

We will follow this situation closely to keep our loyal readers informed."

Article by Ranf Bardern

Finally, the opportunity you've been waiting for has come to you. You, notaphilist since your youngest age, will finally be able to make a living out of your passion and who knows, maybe even get rich?

Armed with your encyclopedia on old bill, you set up your new business, acquire your bill sending machine and open your bank, the day after this news.

For the next month, you'll have to help the financial system get back on its feet by checking whether the bills deposited in your bank are real bills... or fake ones.
For thirty days, you will have to avoid bankruptcy, upgrade your equipment and who knows? Have a lots of clients.
Maybe cryptocurrency is dead, but you are alive and well and ready to work.

title: Skycadia [NSZ][ENG]
description: 天空卡迪亞的世界充斥著天空海盜 - 而且有利潤可以賺取！在這個輕鬆的飛行冒險中，通過擊落惡棍來飛向天空並收集賞金。

title: Morphie's Law: Remorphed [NSP][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Morphies Law is a 3rd person 3D shooter where you can steal mass from other players making them shrink while you grow, which balances the game. Size affects everything! What you can do, how you can navigate the different maps, how to play each gamemode and more. 
Customize your Morphie, make your weapons and go steal some mass!

title: Bunker Life [NSZ][ENG]
description:
地堡生活是在末世裏生存的生存遊戲。

・為了獲得新的卡片，要探索多個地區。
・獲得搭乘物，擴展可探索範圍吧。
・遇見眾多職業的同伴，為了生存而齊心協力吧。
・同伴的組合也可以對生存產生很大的影響。
・請把握好或許有危險的同伴的性格吧。
・有可能持有暴食，酒癮，殺人魔等性格也不一定。
・請找出每次都變化的末世的原因吧。
・有可能找到生存方式的大提示。
・定期清掃地堡吧。
・地堡越受污染，健康越危險。
・體驗500個以上多種事件吧。
・準備了40個以上的結局。
・請找出有名電影的模仿吧。
・包含著多個以末世為題材的作品。

即使遊戲艱難，也不需要擔心。
失敗後可以繼承之前使用的卡片，重新開始。
反覆進行遊戲，讓人感動的結局等待著您！

序幕
我醒過來的是在地堡。
那裏準備好為了生存而需要的物品。
但只用這些物品是沒辦法堅持長時間。
不管怎樣，要收集必須物品。
現在才起了疑問。
地堡外的世界變成什麼樣了呢？

title: Blow & Fly [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
化身為河豚並探索以物理原理為基礎的益智關卡，您必須同時移動和瞄準。主人頑皮的兒子毀了您的水族箱，現在您迫切地需要水！利用地上剩餘的少量液體前往馬桶避難，那也許能拯救您的性命，或將您沖至更具挑戰性的領域，逃離時需要您的靈敏度和創造力！

您有兩種方式可以在《Blow & Fly》的關卡中移動，滾動和噴射。您可以沿著地面滾動並從口中噴出水柱，藉此往反方向移動。每次接觸地面時，您將重新獲得少量液體，這足以讓您再次升空。活用這項能力來避開陷阱和尖刺等危害物，善用彈跳床、重力開關、鑰匙和水滴來抵達每個水源避難所。如果您想存活下來就必須熟悉您的能力，而每通過一個障礙都將迎來更困難的挑戰！

特色：

• 體驗輕鬆上手但挑戰性十足的益智冒險！
• 精準掌握以物理原理為基礎的控制，在關卡中移動。
• 使用噴射水柱在空中飛行，或沿著地面滾動！
• 征服超過 70 個關卡，關卡難度將逐漸提升。
• 尋找祕密區域，並以高超的技巧收集珍珠獎勵。

title: Aquatic Rampage [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Become an aquatic animal and join these frenetic fights in the depths of the Ocean.
Complete the missions and defeat each boss in this arcade retro game.

title: Apre Lapli (After the Rain) [NSP][ENG]
description:
在Apré Lapli，瑪雅和她的祖父分享了她的父母，騎著巨龍拖著的馬車，在一個稀缺而乾燥的世界的路上。他告訴她他們是如何相遇、一起成長的，以及為什麼水如此稀有。

與此同時，瑪雅夢想著水和植被。她清楚地看到了水流豐富的場景。當她揭開冒險的 10 首詩之一時，植物在她的腳下生長。

Apré Lapli 是一次短暫的體驗。該遊戲主要是敘述性的，提供四種體驗，每種體驗都比前一種更輕鬆：

有時，您控製手推車並且必須到達營地。一個小指示器將幫助您找到自己的方式，但這個沙漠是一個開放的世界，所以沒有什麼能阻止您探索它。有時，爺爺和瑪雅會互相交談；您只需要和他們一起騎行，聽聽他們的故事..

有時，您可以控制瑪雅並與她一起體驗她的一個夢想；隨著 Maya 在短關中的推進，您會揭開一首短詩。

在其他情況下，您可以同時控制兩個角色。 Maya，通過移動控制器的左搖桿；爺爺，通過移動控制器的右搖桿。您必須解決簡單的謎題，找到食物或水。每個角色都有自己的特點；只有爺爺有能力舉起石頭，只有瑪雅有足夠的速度捕捉甲蟲......

完成營地目標後，您可以坐在火堆旁，繼續講故事。但是，您確定找到了該營地的所有收藏品嗎？

title: The Deer God [NSZ][ENG]
description:
The Deer God is a breathtaking 3D pixel art adventure that will challenge your religion and your platforming skills. It's a game about survival, reincarnation, and karma; all set in a breathtaking and unique 3D pixelized world. Feast your eyes on the beautiful lighting, day and night system, and vast landscapes.

Become one of the most beautiful animals on planet earth.

LIVE AS A DEER.

SURVIVE AS A DEER.

title: Will You Snail [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Will You Snail — eto dinamichnyy ekshen-platformer na osnove II, obespechivayushchego unikalnyy opyt kazhdomu igroku. Eto neprostoe i zakhvatyvayushchee priklyuchenie v neonovoy stilistike sochetaet v sebe skhvatki, golovolomki i iskrometnyy yumor.

OSOBENNOSTI:

UVORAChIVAYTES OT LOVUShEK II! Zlobnyy Kalmar s iskusstvennym intellektom pytaetsya proschitat vashi dvizheniya na neskolko sekund vpered i ne dat proyti uroven. Smozhete vyigrat etu bitvu umov ili dadite Kalmaru novyy povod poglumitsya nad soboy?

OBYGRAYTE II! Iznachalno bolshinstvo urovney v «Will You Snail?» pusty — prepyatstviya na puti igroka voznikayut za schet vzaimodeystviya so zlobnym II. Blagodarya etomu, vy smozhete v lyuboy moment izmenit slozhnost igry, ili pozvolit Skvidu vybrat naibolee podkhodyashchiy variant za vas.

REShAYTE DOPOLNITELNYE GOLOVOLOMKI! Prostye golovolomki pozvolyat otdokhnut posle boya. Po doroge vam vstretyatsya zadachi i poslozhnee, no ni odna golovolomka v Will You Snail ne yavlyaetsya obyazatelnoy. Ikh vse mozhno propustit.

UZNAYTE PRAVDU! Raskryvayte tayny, sobirayte podskazki i postaraytes vyyasnit, kto vy i chto proizoshlo. Will You Snail rasskazyvaet dovolno strannuyu istoriyu ob iskusstvennom intellekte, teorii simulyatsii i budushchem chelovechestva, i vam predstoit ee uznat.

Issleduyte — prygayte — umrite — povtorite! I proydite vse dinamichnye urovni v etom zakhvatyvayushchem platformere. Golovolomki, okhota za sekretami, nelineynaya istoriya tayn vselennoy, smeshnaya ozvuchka i prekrasnyy dizayn urovney — vse eto v korotkoy, no napryazhennoy igre, lomayushchey chetvertuyu stenu! Zvuchit interesno? Togda vopros odin…

Will you snail?

YaZYKI: Blagodarya nashemu neveroyatnomu soobshchestvu igra dostupna na mnogikh yazykakh! V ikh chisle: madyarskiy, finskiy, serbskiy, polskiy, katalanskiy, estonskiy, turetskiy, bolgarskiy, norvezhskiy.

title: Legends of the Eternal Flame [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Welcome to an exciting 2D platformer game where you must embark on a perilous journey to rekindle the Eternal Flame and save the world from the brink of chaos. As one of the Children of the Eternal Flame, it is your mission to collect flames and face six bizarre worlds filled with obstacles and puzzles that will test your skills to the limit. 

Throughout the game, you will encounter increasingly difficult challenges and obstacles that will require quick reflexes and strategic thinking to overcome. From dodging deadly traps to solving intricate puzzles, you will need to master a variety of skills to progress through the game and reach your ultimate goal of restoring balance to the world.

The game boasts a unique graphic style that brings the worlds to life, and a captivating soundtrack that immerses you in the adventure.

With its challenging gameplay, this platformer game is an epic adventure that will keep you hooked until the very end. So, gear up for a thrilling ride as you take on the role of the Children of the Eternal Flame and set out to save the world from chaos!

title: Farm Mystery [NSZ][ENG]
description: The Happy Orchard Farm is trapped in a nightmare! People are disappearing into the mist that surrounds the town at night in this Farm Mystery. It's up to you to solve the chilling case of this haunted place. Search for clues, solve puzzles and play mini-games to uncover the secrets of the Happy Orchard nightmare. Will you solve the Farm Mystery?

title: Ghost: Elisa Cameron [NSP][ENG]
description:
You wake up in a cold, desolate bathroom without any memory of your whereabouts, as a surveillance camera tracks your every move. Can you piece together the mystery and find your way to safety? As Elisa Cameron, you must work to save your sister, your future, and possibly the world. From the best-selling Dark Horse graphic novel, "Ghost", comes a story of supernatural proportions in form of hidden objects puzzle adventure.

-Over 50 gorgeous locations
-Richly detailed environment and scenes
-Solve 14 unique mini-games
-Hours of gameplay

title: OS Omega [NSZ][ENG]
description:
OS OMEGA is an action-adventure game set in a hostile operating system environment. You are Binary Boy, an agent of OS Omega and your goal is to defeat the virus that wants to format the C drive of the computer you must protect.

The game mixes perma-death twin-stick shooter with RPG-style quest fullfilling.

The gameplay consists mostly of fighting and exploring, but there's also talking, puzzle-solving and quests fullfilling.

Get the computer rid of the virus minions named Mega Evil Chip, Uber Generic Villain, Hyper Elastic Eliminator or Ultra Creepy Cursor. 
Fight the statues of an ancient device known as Joystick and defeat bosses like Random Cube Mega-Lith, Electro Exterminator or Monolith Eye Of Slow And Painful Death.

The game features 
- 76 original weapones (Split Ricochet Gun, Homing Crawlers Gun, Random Floater Gun, Rope Jumper Gun, Spill Disc Gun, Big Bullet Blaster, Electro Laser SMG, ...)
- dozen of abilities (Turbo Mode, Power Save Mode, Force Field Absorb CPU, Dash Random, Pain Wave Ultra, ...)
- and many quests

title: Super Squidlit [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Super Squidlit imitates the Game Boy™ Color's capabilities and limitations for a squishy adventure! The colorful world of Squishu and its invertebrate inhabitants need your help! Play as Plip and your old foe, Skwit Skwot, as you set sail to banish a great evil.

- Squip your way through the islands of Squishu as Plip, a wee squidlit that can double jump to ink on things below you!

- Plip's new roll tackle lets you manipulate foes and gain a burst of speed!

- Blast your way through enemies as the wizardly Skwit Skwot, GOD EMPEROR, in ray-casting 3D RPG levels!

- Meet lots of goofy Squidlits!

Like the first Squidlit game did with the Game Boy™, Super Squidlit adheres to the limitations of the Game Boy™ Color:
* No more than 10 sprites in a horizontal line
* No more than 40 sprites at any time
* 3 colors per sprite
* 160 x 144 pixel resolution
* 4 sound channels for music and SFX
* All sounds were recorded on a real Game Boy™ Color!

Can you guide Plip and Skwit Skwot to victory and save Squishu?

title: Closer Anagnorisis [NSZ][ENG]
description:
CLOSER 是一款創意性的冒險遊戲。

這是一款美術和玩法都非常有特點的遊戲。包含了非常多創意性的設計。

遊戲嘗試通過不戰鬥的方式將遊戲做的有意思，玩家需要思考如何通過“以巧取勝”的方式完成目標。

遊戲的每一區域都會有不同的體驗玩法，讓玩家在每一個環節都能體驗到新鮮感，並且可以思考情緒的暗示，來展示主角當前的心境。

在整個遊戲過程中玩家需要躲過敵人帶來的危機，並且運用一些微量的知識來應對一個個解謎的挑戰。

title: Dogworld [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Shoot, jump, and slide your way through a ruined, mysterious, dog-filled world as you fight to save humanity from the clutches of a rogue AI named Daddy. Acquire new weapons, upgrade them to be more powerful, collect secrets, meet bizarre characters, and explore the ruins of a destroyed world.


After a catastrophic event on Earth, humanity is directed underground and into pods for their safety. You are told that the surface world is dangerous and uninhabitable, and inside the pods is the only safe place to be. But when you are launched from the underground in a freak accident, you realize that the surface is just fine and there's more to this world than you thought. The surface is teeming with life, except... they all seem to be dogs. And some of them talk.


Explore a world where all the living creatures seem to be some variety of dog

Slide to dodge through enemies and projectiles

Uncover secrets and abilities to help you on your journey

Traverse difficult platforming and combat challenges

Collect and upgrade various powerful weapons

Take on a multitude of powerful bosses

Pet dogs

Stark 1bit pixel art

Full original chiptune score

title: Night Book [NSP][ENG]
description:
Night Book — eto interaktivnyy triller o perevodchitse, kotoruyu vtyanuli v chtenie drevney knigi, vyzyvayushchey demona. 

Loralin po nocham rabotaet iz doma, perevodya videozvonki s angliyskogo na frantsuzskiy i obratno. Seychas ona zhdet rebenka i ukhazhivaet za psikhicheski bolnym ottsom, a ee muzh rabotaet v drugom gorode. Ona otchayanno pytaetsya sokhranit i zashchitit svoyu semyu — no kem ona gotova pozhertvovat, chtoby vyzhit? Muzhem, rebenkom, ottsom ili soboy?

•	Odna istoriya, neskolko raznykh putey i finalov.
•	Ot prodyuserov The Complex i Five dates.
•	Razrabotano sovmestno so studiey Maid of Sker.
•	V glavnykh rolyakh: Dzhuli Drey («Avenyu 5») i Kolin Selmon («Obitel zla», «Khroniki khishchnykh gorodov»).
•	Polnostyu zhivoy interaktivnyy film, snyatyy udalenno vo vremya lokdauna.

title: Super Mega Zero [NSP][ENG]
description:
未定義小姐被卑鄙的當機畫面王抓走了。你將會扮演一個零號小卒，在這個需要快速反應的平台遊戲在最短時間獲得最高分，並挑戰當機畫面王。

Super Mega Zero 是一個需要高精確度且帶有射擊元素的解謎平台遊戲。你只需要獲得升級道具就可變身，從經典的平台遊戲方式轉換為使用動作數字系統的解謎遊戲，或是卷軸射擊遊戲。

特色
•挑戰上百個精心打造帶有平台、解謎及射擊元素的關卡。
•帶你回到80年代的大型電玩圖像風格
•熱血沸騰的晶片音樂原聲帶
•可收集的圓周率（最美味的數字）

title: Cardful Planning [NSZ][ENG]
Snakes and Ladders [NSZ][ENG]
description:
蛇和梯子 是一款全球經典有趣且易於玩的棋盤遊戲
適合所有年齡段的家人和朋友。

遊戲規則簡單，從一開始就導航自己的遊戲塊
通過輪流擲骰子，方格 1 到終點方格 100。

一百個充滿陷阱和技巧的方格，擲骰子試試你的運氣，
降落在梯子上然後上升但是如果你降落在一條蛇上你就會下降
第一個到達方格 100 的玩家贏得遊戲。

蛇和梯子可以在 1 到 6 名玩家之間玩
播放器也可以由智能（Ai）人工智能播放器播放。

title: Cat Girl Without Salad Amuse Bouche [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Blast everything that moves in this genre-defying action extravaganza! Take control of Kebako, a cat-eared intergalactic bounty hunter, as she patrols the galaxies with her faithful companion Squiddie in search of ridiculous space criminals. 

Combining classic 2D shoot-'em-up gameplay and a hilarious story with weapons inspired by game genres such as puzzle, sports, platformer, rhythm, and RPG, this bombastic side-scrolling experience pushes the absurdity meter to its limits and beyond! Prepare for an action-shooter unlike anything you’ve ever played before...just watch out for salad!

Key Features:
•Nonstop side-scrolling action starring an adorable, bounty-hunting cat girl!
•Collect game cartridges to wield insane weapons inspired by various game genres: puzzle, sports, platformer, rhythm, arcade, and RPG!
•A wide variety of outrageous enemies including highly requested palette-swapped variants!
•Multiphase boss battles against the universe's most preposterous criminals!
•Ludicrous, non-interruptive character banter!
•Available for the first time on console!
•Space cow!!

title: Without Escape [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Without Escape 是對90年代初的第一身圖形冒險遊戲作致敬的作品，其互動的故事通過預渲染的背景和全動態的視頻去講述。 在自己的家中探索限制，於平凡的生活和恐怖的異世界之間遊走。 你準備好接受恐怖的狀況嗎？

特色：

• 通過經典的點擊形式去探索，並與過去建立聯繫。
• 解開考驗智慧的謎題。
• 通過富有情調的配樂，將自己沉浸在的壓抑氛圍的家中。
• 尋找多個結局，秘密和彩蛋。
• 在你的舊屋－裡凝視著美麗的背景。這已成為地獄般的噩夢。

title: The Man With The Ivory Cane [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Paris, city of lights turned dark on you. You're young artist enjoying your life until one evening your girlfriend Sasha goes missing! 
You're the prime suspect. Only way to figure out what's going on is to take things into your own hands and investigate the whole case.
Is she being murdered or kidnapped? Who's the criminal mind behind everything? 

Use your detective skills and solve the mystery!

The game features dozens of puzzles and riddles to solve by finding clues, combining items and cracking the case bit by bit.
Thrilling adventure and story full of twists where only you can discover ends of it.

- Play the role of detective and investigate the tricky murder case
- Investigate locations in Paris and find clues to solve the crime
- Interview dozes of suspects in full interactive dialogues with voice overs
- Enjoy full cinematics as you move forward through your investigation 
- Earn achievements and find special items

title: The Last Days [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Can you defeat the enemy and save the earth? An ancient enemy returns and the fate of the world is in your hands when you play The Last Days. Learn about the mysteries of the Bermuda Triangle, and discover clues left by advanced civilizations eons ago.

You're long overdue for a vacation, so you head out to the Bahamas looking for the refreshment of sun, sea, and sand. Your diving excursions reveal mysterious artifacts strangely out of place. Can you piece together the clues in time?

title: The Tower of Beatrice [NSZ][RUS/Multi3]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 3]

title: Loopindex [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Prishlo vremya issledovat virtualnuyu stranu Loopindex! Ee obshirnye neizvedannye zemli polny golovolomok! Igrayte v odinochku ili v komande s drugom-robotom i ispolzuyte logiku i sinkhronizatsiyu, chtoby ochistit kazhduyu oblast.

Vasha nakhodchivost budet podvergatsya vse bolee slozhnym ispytaniyam po mere togo, kak vy budete osvaivat unikalnuyu «mekhaniku zatsiklivaniya», lezhashchuyu v osnove igrovogo tsikla.

Vam predstoit proyti urovni, polnye lovushek i otkrytiy, podruzhitsya s virtualnymi sushchestvami i dazhe srazitsya s krutymi bossami.

Kharakteristiki:
* Bolee 70 urovney
* Slozhnye boi s bossami
* Poluchite pomoshch ot robo-pitomtsev, chtoby proyti urovni
* Kooperativnaya mnogopolzovatelskaya igra dlya dvukh igrokov
* Unikalnaya «mekhanika zatsiklivaniya»

title: Woodcutter [NSZ][ENG]
description:
This classic platformer, tells the story of Woodcutter whose child was kidnapped. Embark on a magical adventure through the land of Aaran and help Woodcutter retrieve his firstborn.

-There are 50+ levels to complete, filled with coins and enemies (including 2 levels with bosses and 5 bonus levels),

-3 weapons to use (Boomerang, Wooden pegs, Exploding barrels) and your body to smash your enemies,

-You can: run, jump, double jump, wall jump, wall slide, swim and more.

title: The Seven Chambers [NSP][ENG]
description:
The Cosmos turned the fate of the Earth’s inhabitants every day.

Elasaid didn’t believe in astrology but the force of the planets and constellations entered into her life and many previous lives regardless of what she thought.
After getting hit by a blast in the London riots she falls into a coma. In the coma’s sub-conscious she experiences a past life as a Highland Warrior where, after reading a passage of ancient text from a magic book, an underworld portal opens.
Terrifying clawed beasts, the Flying Furies, clutch Elasaid and throw her through this first portal of The Seven Chambers.

Her only escape is to navigate her way to the Seventh Chamber in time for the rising of the phoenix along the passageways and chambers for the souls of the dead.
Along the way she battles with fallen angels, jealous planets, tricky alchemists and manipulative lost souls.
Overcoming the darkness in the chambers opens her heart to a lost soul, but the lost soul has been sentenced to spend eternity in the chambers.
What will prevail; her love for the lost soul or her desire for freedom?

Become Elasaid and battle to change your destiny within The Seven Chambers by mastering the karmic influence of the planets and the mysterious paths of the alchemists.

-Find the pieces of a past life, overcome the planets and learn alchemists' secrets in an intriguing story fully voiced and with beautiful cinematics.
-Find clues in beautiful and strange sceneries
-Hunt for the 4 great powers

title: Angel's Punishment [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Nintendo Switch™ Exclusive Game

In this game you play as an Angel who got his wings taken away from him by archangels when he refused to follow his superiors' orders of not interfering in the cruelties of the evil beings on Earth.

title: Bricky to Me [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Bricky to Me 是一款益智平台遊戲，它帶來了隨機佈置房間的想法。 加入城堡中的騎士和一隻神秘的貓，整個場景被動態修改，創造出令人難以置信的挑戰來克服的房間。

遊戲呈現了一個簡單但懲罰性的遊戲玩法。 避開陷阱，消滅敵人，解決謎題，收集硬幣，進行正確的跳躍，並確保在打到boss戰之前保持活力，否則你將不得不重新做所有事情。

遊戲特色
- 60多個房間隨機組合；
- 有趣的謎題；
- 一隻需要撫摸的小貓；
- 一個迴旋鏢來擊敗敵人；
- 非常不尋常的boss戰；


由 IdunaSoft 開發並由 QUByte Interactive 發布

title: Keen One Girl Army [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Kim is a lovely 8 year old girl that lives in a peaceful insular island with her grandmother. Abandoned by her mother not long after birth, she must put grievances aside to focus on something of utter importance 

The pink heart on the cheeks is their birthmark and the protection of Village, their duty. 
Following a trail of brainwashed minions and high-tech robot soldiers, she would soon find herself in the middle of a world-domination plot carried on by an evil secret society!

Unveil Kim's story as she tries to save the day!
Discover secret items, unlock secret levels and get special powers!
Slash your way through several unique enemies! Also...boss battles!

BIG, maze-like dungeons, spanning from mysterious forests to top-secret underwater labs!

title: Hunter's Legacy Purrfect Edition [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Otpravtes na koshachiy kvest v dinamichnoy fentezi-vselennoy,  napolnennoy svirepymi vragami i napryazhennymi bitvami na mechakh, gde vy pochuvstvuete atmosferu klassicheskogo priklyucheniya-metroidvanii! Hunter’s Legacy — eto platformer, gde vam predstoit igrat za Ikki, silnuyu okhotnitsu-koshku s dvumya mechami, lukom i magicheskimi sposobnostyami. Ona dolzhna spasti korolevstvo Irimur ot zlogo Morodira.

V Hunter’s Legacy Purrfect Edition dobavleny novye syuzhetnye linii, dialogi, novye animatsii, obnovlennyy dizayn urovney i mini-karta i novyy rezhim! Takzhe uluchshena mekhanika blizhnego boya. Issleduyte vse regiony grotesknogo korolevstva v otkrytom mire, ot spokoynykh lesov do zasnezhennykh verkhushek vulkanov, i ne zabyvayte rubit vragov moshchnymi mechami, vstav na put legendarnogo okhotnika.

title: Serious Scramblers [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
出現了一個看似無底的坑洞，並且洞的深處傳來真真令人毛骨悚然的尖叫。深洞之中到底有什麼？唯一合理的做法是跳進洞中一探究竟！

在這個極具挑戰力的平台遊戲中，克服難以逾越的勝率！歡迎來到混亂大冒險！

特點：
• 快節奏的街機動作
• 各種障礙和生物多樣性
• 挑戰的遊戲 
• 超級boss大戰
• 解鎖各種人物，每一個都有改變遊戲的能力
• 甜美的芯片音樂

title: Fairy Knights [NSZ][ENG]
description:
故事發生在所有生命枯萎的瓦德爾王國。
少年少女打敗魔王，復興王國的冒險即將開始！

◆解謎&RPG！
解謎與RPG的動態結合！
在快節奏的戰鬥中移動石板打倒敵人！

◆即時進行的即時戰鬥！
消除石板即可發動多種技能和魔法！
迅速判斷狀況，讓戰鬥變得更加有利！

◆使用連段造成大量損傷！
消除石板時成功連段即可發動連續攻擊！
依靠強大攻擊擊退敵人！

◆這是友情、努力及小小勇氣的故事！
在粉彩色調的世界中冒險！

title: Killer Chambers [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Chtoby dobitsya korony korolya i spasti korolevstvo, Brave Lord dolzhen stolknutsya litsom k litsu s prizrachnym privideniem Lord Grave i prorvatsya skvoz smertonosnye komnaty Korolevskogo dvortsa, ryano oberegaemye beschislennymi mekhanizmami lovushkami.

Killer Chambers eto gibrid ekshen-platformera/igry dlya trenirovki pamyati. Ty dolzhen vyzhit v malenkikh komnatakh, zapolnennykh lovushkami, do odnogo oborota pesochnykh chasov.
Bud ostorozhen, dazhe esli v tebya popadut tolko odin raz, ty umer! Smozhesh li ty vystoyat v uzkom prostranstve etogo besposhchadnogo "bullet-hell"?

Nichego ne ostavleno na volyu sluchaya, kazhdaya lovushka sdelana tak, chtoby byt slozhnoy i v to zhe vremya zabavnoy dlya resheniya, no chtoby vyzhit nedostatochny odni bystrye refleksy.
Vooruzhis mazokhistskim uporstvom i khoroshey (myshechnoy) pamyatyu, korolevskaya korona zhdet tebya!

- Bystryy i trudnyy ekshen-platformer s elementami golovolomki i "bullet-hell".
- Bolee 40 komnat, v kazhdoy iz kotorykh 3 urovnya slozhnosti.
- 5 etazhey s samymi raznymi i nepovtoryayushchimisya lovushkami i bossami.
- Bolee 500 tochno nastroennykh modeley lovushek.
- Zabavnaya istoriya v dialogakh v stile vizualnogo romana.
- Mnozhestvo predmetov, kotorye pomogut Brave Lord v ego priklyucheniyakh.
- 12 shlyap, kotorye nadelyayut tebya spetsialnymi kachestvami, pri uslovii chto oni ne spadut s golovy!

title: Operation Zeta [NSZ][ENG]
description: Operation Zeta is a space action game. The great battle codenamed 'Operation Zeta' has been lost. Your ship is in shambles and you have to act quickly to collect all of the parts and repair your ship before the warzone is completely destroyed by the enemy's death laser. Play and unlock 13 playable characters from space monkeys to mischievous slugs each with their own unique set of skills and challenges. As well unlock new abilities and upgrades with credits you earn during each run. Each time you play the universe is randomly generated with random quests from wacky local aliens who have stolen the parts of your ship. All in a physics based battlefield, but beware as you only have ten minutes until the death laser fires!

title: Crossbow Bloodnight [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Sozdateli POSTAL: Brain Damaged i ELDERBORN predstavlyayut CROSSBOW: Bloodnight, skorostnoy arkadnyy shuter ot pervogo litsa v atmosfere klassicheskogo khorrora. Osvoyte okkultnye sposobnosti avtomaticheskogo arbaleta i srazhaytes za kazhduyu sekundu vyzhivaniya s neprimirimoy ordoy demonov!  
Osobennosti:

- Tainstvennyy arbalet s razlichnymi rezhimami strelby, vykachivayushchiy dushi ubitykh vragov.
- Svobodnoe peredvizhenie s ryvkami, pryzhkami i podskokami.
- Moshchnaya osobaya ataka s dlitelnoy perezaryadkoy, kotoruyu sleduet ispolzovat s umom.
- Mgnovennoe vozrozhdenie posle gibeli pozvolyaet ostavatsya v ritme igry.
- Shest vidov vragov v dvukh variatsiyakh, beskonechno navodnyayushchie temnye dvory starogo oskvernennogo abbatstva, stavshego polem bitvy.
- Globalnye tablitsy liderov, pozvolyayushchie sostyazatsya s druzyami i neznakomtsami.


Klan arbaleta – drevniy orden okhotnikov, poklyavshikhsya oberegat ravnovesie mezhdu silami raya i ada, – torzhestvuet nesmotrya ni na chto. 1666 god. V Londone svirepstvuyut pozhary i chuma. Klanu predstoit proyti samoe tyazheloe ispytanie. Drevniy potustoronniy uzhas priblizhaetsya k nashemu miru. Legiony koshmarnykh tvarey poyavlyayutsya vo tme. Nastupaet Krovavaya noch. Da nachnetsya okhota!

title: That's My Family Family Fun Night [NSP][ENG]
description:
《Family Fun Night》是《That 's My Family》授權的第一款遊戲，它把最受歡迎的童年桌面遊戲和原創遊戲組合在了一起！你可以玩到14種不同的遊戲，包括十字戲、蛇梯棋、西洋棋和四子棋等等。這些你都玩到不想玩了嗎？我們也有原創遊戲哦！比如列王圍攻。在本地多人遊戲中與你的親朋好友切磋，或者對戰AI提升你的棋藝！

特色
•14款遊戲特色鮮明，兼顧古典與現代
每款遊戲都有獨特的設定，以歷史、神話和流行文化為靈感。挑選你喜愛的桌遊，比如以希臘神話為原型的西洋棋，在歷史悠久的四子棋中戰勝你的好友，在列王圍攻中摧毀幻想城堡，在蛇梯棋中探索南美叢林，還有更多精彩世界等你挑戰！
•向親朋好友發起對戰！
根據你選擇的遊戲，在本地多人遊戲中最多可與2或4名玩家一起遊玩。沒有第二個控制器？沒關係！有了我們的傳遞遊玩機制，你在本地多人模式中就可以遊玩大部分《That’s My Family》遊戲！想來點練習？也可以透過對戰AI來提升你的棋藝，讓你的好友在下次對決中刮目相看！
•6個不同的角色
扮演這個新家庭中的一員，阿公、阿嫲、爸爸、媽媽、兒子或女兒。每個角色在每款迷你遊戲都有不同的主題皮膚！
•玩累了？休息一下
四處轉轉，探索你的公寓，選擇你最愛的遊戲，換個角色，看看風景！

這就是《Family Fun Night》！在不同的時代與環境中重溫家庭遊戲之夜！

title: Criss Cross [NSZ][ENG]
description:
角色立繪和CG使用了E-mote動畫系統。
呼吸、眨眼、說話，栩栩如生。
所有角色，全日語配音。

喜歡一個人，真的是那麼幸福的事情嗎？我不這麼認為。
我們或許只是喜歡上了那種感覺罷了。

我生活在一個安詳和平的小鎮裡。
這裡沒有戰亂，一切都是如此美好，猶如世外桃源一般。
在這樣的世界裡，我們相遇了，結識了。
彼此的感情，縱橫交錯。

到底我們為什麼而活？又是為什麼誕生於此？
為了得到一切而不擇手段，這真的就是勝利的方法嗎？
在接連的感情漩渦中，我迷茫了......

如十字般縱錯的故事，就這樣展開了——

title: Amoeba Battle [NSP][ENG]
description:
Unlike other RTS games, there are no bases to build - new amoebas are created through the miracle of binary fission! 

First though, your amoebas must forage for food in the beautiful yet alien environments that make up their world. Once well fed, these amoebas can replicate into two identical amoebas of the same type, doubling your army with a press of a button!

But multiplying amoebas won't always be enough. You will need to introduce mutations to evolve your weaker amoebas into stronger species. Experiment with different amoeba combinations to field a diverse force that can face any threat!

title: Profane [NSP][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Profane – epicheskaya bitva s bossami v zhanre «bullet hell», gde vse reshaet vremya! Vasha zadacha – pobedit bossov odnogo za odnim, ulozhivshis v otvedennoe vremya. No vremya – ne prosto dengi, no eshche i zdorove! Pokupaya sposobnosti i poluchaya uron, vy raskhoduete svoy zapas vremeni. Deystvuyte s umom!

UMENIYa

Pobezhdaya vragov, vy otkroete bolee 40 unikalnykh sposobnostey. Pered kazhdoy bitvoy vy smozhete sostavit nabor iz nuzhnykh sposobnostey, chtoby optimizirovat svoy stil igry i zadeystvovat moshchnye kombinatsii, usilivayushchie drug druga!

SYuZhET

V Profane vam predstoit prozhit istoriyu Talaal, posledney iz semi masok Boga. V tele svoego novogo nositelya Talaal dolzhna dat boy svoim sobratyam, kotorye stremyatsya zavladet siloy, chto taitsya v maske. Sam zhe nositel vynuzhden snova i snova uchastvovat v chuzhoy voyne, ne vidya vykhoda iz etogo zakoldovannogo kruga.

REKORDY

Esli surovye ispytaniya i napryazhennaya borba – vash konyok, to nam est chto vam predlozhit! Brosayte vyzov drugim igrokam i srazhaytes za pervoe mesto v spiske rekordsmenov!

OSOBENNOSTI

Modifitsiruemye nabory sposobnostey pozvolyayut igroku sozdat svoy sobstvennyy stil igry.
Igrovoy protsess s uporom na sorevnovatelnost – brosayte vyzov druzyam i beyte rekordy.
Shirokiy nabor igrovykh rezhimov, vklyuchaya sluchaynuyu posledovatelnost boyov!

title: Corridor Z [NSP][ENG]
description:
Obyknovennaya shkola, obyknovennoe nashestvie zombi – i kuchka vyzhivshikh... khotya naschet vyzhivshikh eshche babka nadvoe skazala...

V etot raz rech ne o prepyatstviyakh, a o nastoyashchey pogone. Ne day zombi poymat sebya. Kidaysya v nikh predmetami – i postaraysya popast v golovu prezhde, chem tebya nachnut kusat. Da, i ne zabud sobrat poteryannye zapisi zvukovogo dnevnika i vyyasnit, otkuda v vash gorodok pronikla eta zaraza.

OSOBENNOSTI
* Samyy unikalnyy predstavitel zhanra runner za poslednie gody
* Proniknis unikalnym i napryazhennym geympleem
* Pomogi vyzhit devchonke-chirlideru, shkolnomu kachku i morpekhu
* Otkroy taynu zombi-zarazheniya cherez zvukovoy dnevnik
* Soberi potryasnyy uluchshaemyy arsenal: pistolety, pistolety-pulemety, droboviki i ne tolko
* U kazhdogo personazha svoya zadacha. Vypolni ikh vse...
* …i perestrelyay ordu zhutkikh mertvyakov v protsesse!

title: Winnie the Pooh: Honey for All [NSP][ENG]
description:
V etom vizualnom romane v Lesu Sto Akrov proiskhodit zagadochnoe sobytie. Pukh i ego druzya nachinayut deystvovat, kogda obnaruzhivayut, chto med ischez.
Obespokoennye tem, chto eto mozhet oznachat, Pukh, Pyatachok, Tigra, Krolik i drugie otpravlyayutsya na zakhvatyvayushchee rassledovanie. Po puti oni nakhodyat neozhidannye uliki, stalkivayutsya s podozreniyami drug druga i vstrechayut novykh druzey.
Po mere togo, kak tayna raskryvaetsya, personazhi uznayut vazhnye uroki o druzhbe, sotrudnichestve i vazhnosti zaboty ob ikh obshchem dome.
Eta polnaya priklyucheniy istoriya polna zabavnykh, iskrennikh i mudrykh....

title: Holyhunt (Holy Hunt) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
HOLYHUNT is a roguelike shooter game that unites the nostalgic and fun 8-bit aesthetic with modern and deep shooting mechanics. 

Make your way into the church hall to shoot and dash-holy-punch through different species of demons and bosses with unique mechanics that keeps challenging your abilities each run. 

Buy improvements and different bullets suited to exploit your enemies weakness and recieve blessings from angels as you keep fighting to get even stronger. 

Trust your faith and keep shooting to save the world from the doomsday prophecy!

Feature

8-Bit Love Letter
Relive the nostalgia of an 8-bit game with a modern and challenging arena gameplay.

Roguelite meets Old School
Shoot your way through a large variety of demons in a fast-paced roguelike structure that encourages the player to improve and understand enemies in each run while keeping its 8-bit feel.

Bullet-Driven Strategic Gameplay 
Earn and change on-the-fly the different types of bullets that best fits your enemies weakness.

Holy Risk-Reward 
Finish staggered enemies with a risky melee Holy Punch to earn bullets, and use bullets to get enemies Staggered. Maybe you'll even receive blessings from angels?

title: Line Time [NSP][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
在遊戲中，玩家需要讓場景中的小球沿著格子移動順利到達終點。
小球擁有自己的「時間軸」，時間軸包含「上」、「下」、「左」、「右」以及「不動」這五種行動指令，玩家可以任意排列行動指令的順序，由此改變時間軸的運行，讓球到達終點。有些關卡，玩家需要操縱的球會變為兩個，兩球相撞會產生額外的位移，由此帶來更加靈活多樣的移動策略。

遊戲中還加入了「傳送帶」機製，傳送帶本身也有自己的時間軸，如何合理規劃它的行動順序也是需要仔細考慮的一點。

怎麽樣，是不是很簡單，學會了嗎？
那麽剩下的200+有趣多樣的關卡，就交給你了！~

title: Hamsterdam Paws of Justice [NSZ][RUS/Multi12]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 12]
description:
扮演倉鼠英雄Pimm並且施展高強的武術技巧。在令人心跳加速的旅程中，擊敗敵人，掃蕩黑幫，拯救爺爺並且恢復哈姆斯特丹小鎮的和平。

曾經和平的哈姆斯特丹小鎮正處於危險之中!邪惡的栗鼠馬洛和他的嘍囉正在肆虐。

在哈姆斯特丹小鎮街道上體驗瘋狂的動作，完美的使出連續技，成為倉鼠功夫的傳說。

-用你自己的風格史詩般地擊敗敵人
-經典的格鬥動作、節奏和快速反應
-掌握倉鼠門的獨門功夫:倉鼠爪九式
-令人心跳加速的重拳頭目出現。炸彈如雨下!試著躲避1,483次激烈的攻擊
-齜牙的栗鼠頭目加上一幫穿著垃圾桶的嘍囉，對馬洛特調成癮的敵人
-拯救鎮民和爺爺。帶領大家保衛哈姆斯特丹小鎮
-從高級時裝到街頭潮流服飾-提供各式倉鼠裝備，在戰鬥中大顯神威
- Ham-Mobile 風格：騎著二輪滑板車，在水管中跳躍和滑行

title: DOG Takes the Hindmost [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
publisher: TREVA, Markt plus Technik Verlag GmbH
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
Na vid eto Ludo, no na samom dele eto DOG®. V etoy igre tozhe nuzhno dostavit fishki v «domik». Raznitsa v tom, chto dvigat ikh nuzhno s pomoshchyu kart, i tut vas zhdut vnezapnye syurprizy! Komandnyy dukh ochen vazhen: vyigrat mozhno tolko vmeste.

Vazhnye osobennosti
• Raznye rezhimy igry.
• Krasivye igrovye polya.

title: Legal Dungeon [NSZ][ENG]
description:
This place is a labyrinth of
crime and punishment - and quotas.
As a police detective working a veritable
dungeon composed of eight separate cases,
dive into the huge plethora of documents awaiting you.
Gather evidence, go up against suspects,
and submit your official verdict of "guilty" or "not guilty".
Your judgment will greatly sway the fate of the accused,
as well as your own.

Is justice always justified?

Legal Dungeon is a game about organizing Police Investigation Documents.

The player must review and provide an Investigation Verdict on reports ranging from petty theft to murder, in eight different criminal cases. Legal Dungeon will teach players that apprehending and punishing criminals is the very essence of Public Safety. Players will quickly become experts in revealing true criminals.

title: Seers Isle [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Seers Isle is an interactive graphic novel, set in a fantasy version of medieval northern Europe, where your choices impact the fate of a group of characters.

• Story:
“The island… It was my prison.
For ages, I roamed the land, helpless, looking for a way out.
And then, they arrived.”

A group of shaman apprentices set foot on the shores of a sacred island to be initiated to magic. 
As they progress through the wilderness, looking for the “Seers”, their spirit-guides, they realize they’re not alone.
Who is this strange horned woman they are seeing in their dreams?

• Features:
— Explore the island through a diverse group of characters, depicted in a gorgeous European comic book art style.
— Every choice matters. Each decision you make slightly alters the mood and personality of the main character as well as her relationship with the rest of the group.
— A huge amount of content: with each playthrough, discover a novel-sized adventure and a slice of the hundreds of hand-drawn images created for the game.
— An immersive and finely crafted soundtrack: the music adapts and shifts according to your choices and the mood of each scene.
— Try out our dynamic dialog system: read the story like a comic book.
— High replayability: choose your soulmate and discover the outcome of your decisions through multiple story paths and endings.

title: Along the Edge [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Along the Edge is a visual novel set in the European countryside, where your choices impact the main character's personality and appearance.

• Story:
Daphné is at a dead-end. She's unsatisfied by her personal and professional life. So, when she inherits an old family house in a remote part of the country, she jumps at the opportunity to start anew.

Does she decide to embrace her legacy or does she hang to her old way of life?

title: Aquadine [NSP][ENG]
description:
Posle togo, kak ego mat popala v bolnitsu iz-za neizvestnoy bolezni, Robin Liyun nanyalsya rabotat gondolerom, chtoby svodit kontsy s kontsami; on vzyal sebe psevdonim Siel.

Odnazhdy nochyu, posle raboty, tainstvennyy golos zamanivaet ego na vstrechu s prekrasnoy rusalkoy. Ona nyryaet pod vodu vskore posle ikh vstrechi, chto zastavlyaet ego poverit, chto Drevnyaya Akvadina sushchestvovala na samom dele.

Robin prodolzhaet zhit dvoynoy zhiznyu, zavodya novykh druzey i uznavaya bolshe o tsivilizatsii merfolkov.


Kharakteristiki
* Ozvuchka
* Blagonravnaya istoriya vzrosleniya podrostka
* Krasivaya grafika v stile anime / mangi
* Obaldennyy muzykalnyy saundtrek

title: Gunbrick Reloaded [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
Gunbrick: ruzhe s odnoy storony... shchit – s drugoy. 

V budushchem, gde ischezli vse avtomobili, Gunbrick stal mirovoy sensatsiey!
Vstrechayte odichavshikh mutantov, svikhnuvshikhsya nerdov, politseyskikh i vse vozmozhnykh kubo-protivnikov v etom dinamichnom pazl-platformere. 


• Proydite tesnyy mir s pyatyu unikalnymi lokatsiyami.
• Poraskinte mozgami, reshaya khitroumnye zagadki.
• Ispolzuyte svoy shchit dlya zashchity i ruzhe dlya napadeniya! (Podkhodit protiv oruduyushchikh nozhami pankov i bezumnykh mutantov)
• Napravte ruzhe vniz, chtoby VZMYT KAK RAKETA!
• Epicheskie boi s bossami, vklyuchaya poedinok s tsepnoy piloy.
• Otkroyte skrytye urovni, otkryvayushchie sovershenno novuyu perspektivu! Smozhete nayti ikh vse?
• Muzyka Erika Sukhrke (sozdatelya Ridiculous Fishing i Super Crate box)

title: Package Inc [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Connect between different hubs and destinations, like factories, police stations, cafes, libraries, boutiques, saloons, hotels, pizzerias, pet shops or schools.

As new hubs become active, an increase in demand will occur. You must upgrade and redistribute destinations to keep your cargo system flowing.

title: Unit 4 [NSZ][ENG]
performance: 是 (在 6.2.0 Atmosphere) s ignorirovaniem versiy

title: Eqi [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
You find yourself in a digital world that twists and changes around you, challenging your senses, focus, and reflexes. Interface with the great mystery and transcend.

- Explore and solve over 20 stages, increasing in size and difficulty.
- Control your own movement and shift the world around you.
- Solve puzzles, see through illusions, and master challenging obstacle courses.
- Immerse yourself in the electronic pulse of the game's OST.

title: Perchang [NSP][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
It's a puzzle action strategy game with some lovely contraptions to really make you ponder. A beautifully balanced mix of difficulty and fun.

The game revolves around getting little balls from the emitter to their home in the goal. Blocking their way are a heap of obstacles and some helpful elements coloured red or blue. So simple ... yet so tricky.

title: Deru the Art of Cooperation [NSP][ENG]
genre: 解谜, 街机, 派对聚会
description:
Deru — kooperativnaya logicheskaya igra, v kotoroy yarkoe abstraktnoe iskusstvo obedinyaetsya s uvlekatelnymi golovolomkami, sozdavaya unikalnuyu igrovuyu atmosferu.

V etoy sovmestnoy igre dva igroka obedinyayutsya, chtoby vyyti za granitsy sveta i teni i preuspet, deystvuya sovmestno, soglasovanno i takticheski.
Blokiruyte potoki dlya svoego naparnika i peremeshchayte massu, chtoby uvelichivat drug druga i preodolevat bolshie potoki. Chtoby dostignut uspekha, vam nuzhno obshchatsya i planirovat svoi deystviya vmeste, napryagat mozgi i proyavlyat poistine fenomenalnuyu slazhennost. Deru — eto bolshe, chem obychnyy nabor golovolomok; chtoby nayti vykhod s urovnya, vam ponadobyatsya lovkost, tochnost i strategicheskoe planirovanie.

Prisoedinitsya mozhet kazhdyy: i druzya, i semya, i vragi!

- Krasota. Naslazhdaytes abstraktnym iskusstvom, reshaya neprostye golovolomki.
- Elegantnost. Iz prostoy i ponyatnoy mekhaniki sozdayutsya slozhnye i interesnye zagadki.
- Prorabotka. Atmosfernoe zvuchanie ot Michel Barengo, otmechennoe nagradami.
- Sovmestnaya igra. Obedinyayte myslitelnye usiliya, chtoby preodolevat potoki i pregrady.
- Odinochnaya igra. Ispytayte sebya v upravlenii dvumya dzhoystikami srazu, poprobuyte reshat golovolomki v odinochku.

title: Mission 1985 [NSZ][ENG]
description:
在這款向 80 年代街機遊戲致敬的遊戲中，重溫復古的 Run "N Gun 體驗。

您必須單獨或與其他玩家一起擊敗可怕的赫克托將軍並解救被扣為人質的士兵。
穿越 11 個不同的關卡，面對許多敵人、坦克、直升機、飛機……
提高你的火力；使用你的手榴彈在關卡結束時擊敗不同的老闆。
避開不同的陷阱（礦井、洞口）並面對反覆無常的氣候（冰、熔岩......）。
遊戲包含 9 個 2D 關卡和 2 個 3D 縮放關卡（Space Harrier 風格）。
可以同時與 2 名玩家一起玩。

title: Escape Goat [NSP][ENG]
description:
Fear not, for with your supreme agility, sturdy horns, and the help of a magic mouse friend, you can turn the tables on foes and use the environment to your advantage.

Ten unique zones to conquer. Can you reach and rescue the friendly sheep in each?
Tackle over 50 rooms of puzzles. Find hidden machinery and destructible elements to transform them and reach the exit!
Built-in, fully featured level editor. Create and modify entire game worlds.

Escape Goat reigned for 20 months at the #1 spot on the IndieGamerChick leaderboard (November 2011-July 2013)!

The sheep are slumbering... can you awaken them all?

title: The Mysterious Case of Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde [NSZ][ENG]
description:
After a respected member of Parliament is found murdered, it’s up to you to go on the search for the killer, the notorious Mr. Hyde! Step into the shoes of an inspector from Scotland Yard, and dive deep into the case to try to find out why Sir Danvers Crew has been killed. Search beautiful Hidden Object scenes in The Mysterious Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde! Can you crack the case and discover the horrifying truth?

- Immersive atmosphere
- Fun detective mini games
- Discover a horrifying secret!

title: The Drama Queen Murder, Mary Kay Andrews The Fixer Upper [NSZ][ENG]
description:
There's been a murder in the world famous Eastville Opera House, which is the hub of high society in Eastville. 
Everyone who's anyone is a regular visitor. But tonight it's the final curtain for someone... because Dolores Molinero, the Queen of Drama, has been cruelly murdered. 
As the new crime investigator in town, it is your job to unravel this tale of love, passion and intrigue to unmask a murderer. Interrogate suspects, search for clues and run DNA checks; Find fingerprints, hair samples, and a mask. Play Eastville Chronicles: The Drama Queen Murder today!

title: Arcade Machine: Gopher's Revenge [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Gophers are here to avenge their brothers massacred by humans in cruel arcade machines! Your mission is simple: face the attack and take as many gophers with you as you can!

Features:
- absolutely mad giant gopher boss thirsting for your blood!
- cute little wombats which you shouldn't hit!
- crazy gophers armed with kalashnikovs and rocket launchers!
- thunder and icy gophers which increase game's speed or slow it down!
- enough hammers to pick up and fight with for up to 2 players!
- high score which lets you show off your skill!

Say farewell to the living and prepare yourself to rest in peace or rest in pieces... 

See you on the battlefield!

title: Polygod [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Polygod is a rogue-like, randomly generated, single & multiplayer FPS with a brutal difficulty curve!

Blending a fast-paced, Quake-esque feel with randomness, difficulty and our handcrafted power-up system, Polygod is a hardcore gamer and speedrunner's dream. Only the most skilled and strategic players will defeat the Trial of the Gods.

You are a Faceless One: a one-armed, gun-wielding assassin of legend. The seven deities of Polygod will test your skill with randomly generated arenas of hostile minions, followed by a boss fight against a ruthless Holy Champion.

Each of the arenas features five Altars of Worship, offering you Blessings in exchange for Souls you have collected along your journey. Blessings combine and stack to create unique gun effects, but each has consequences, so choose wisely if you wish to survive each wicked challenge. And don’t forget, death is permanent in this purgatory of the gods!

The art style is inspired by the meta-physical surrealist artist Giorgio de Chirico who is famously revered for his eerie mood and strange artificiality of cityscapes.

Main Features:
A unique, randomly generated experience every time. Randomise the levels, blessings offered and enemy placement with our seed system, or challenge others on specific seeds!

Gun customisation with 100 unique blessings. Each seed will offer you a different selection of blessings as you progress through the levels. Strategically combine and stack them to fit your personal playstyle. Ever wondered what it would be like if your bullets were bubbles? Well, what if they were bubbles AND proximity mines? And you shot 3 of them at once? AT THE SPEED OF LIGHT? The options are endless! Do you choose a lethal sniper build, or a bullet wall of death? How will you survive: lifesteal, jump-strafe dodging, tank-like health? How do you want to navigate the environment: double jump, helicopter boots, teleportation?

Additional Features:
Splitscreen co-op
Gyroscope aiming supported
35 unique enemies
15 unlockable playable characters
7 epic boss fights against Holy Champions
7 even harder Red Holy Champions
Special Boss Blessings
Experimental soundtrack
Minimalist, colourful artstyle
Quirky NPCs

title: Hindsight 20-20 Wrath of the Raakshasa [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Hindsight 20/20 - Raakshasa 之怒是一款 3D 第三人稱動作 RPG，玩家可以在其中修復過去遊戲中的錯誤並重溫這些錯誤，以獲得截然不同的遊戲玩法和故事體驗。在選擇和行動產生有意義後果的每一次旅程中發現道德的力量。

Hindsight 20/20 建立在五個支柱之上：

1.戰鬥中的選擇：
決定兩個王國的命運，作為單臂戰士傑漢。他會選擇通過尊重各種形式的生活來尊重他故居的價值觀嗎？還是他會選擇衝突和暴力的道路？在每場戰鬥之前，有意識地決定使用非致命的眩暈棒來安撫敵人，或者使用無情的劍將他們永遠擊倒。

2. 一個可塑的世界：
尚帕內爾及其居民在對傑漢的幾種蔑視或接受狀態之間切換。每個遊戲都只展示了一個版本的世界，因為城鎮及其居民都會體驗 Jehan 的選擇和行動的影響。

3. 有趣的 AI 和 Boss：
所有 NPC 都會對 Jehan 塑造的世界做出反應。對話選項和武器選擇只是影響 AI 行為的兩個因素。Hindsight 20/20 的老闆表現出情感，使他們更容易相處。隨著傑漢繼續他的旅程，他們個性中的細微差別逐漸顯現出來。當他們對 Jehan 做出反應時，善惡之間的界限變得模糊。

4. 體驗引擎：
體驗引擎是由玩家選擇驅動的手工製作的內部遊戲引擎。該引擎全權負責創造 Jehan 見證的動態遊戲和故事體驗。體驗引擎會觀察和記錄所做的每一個動作和選擇，從而實現高水平的可重玩性。這種選擇、行動和反應的反饋循環會影響故事的流程並推動《Hindsight 20/20》的遊戲玩法。

5.十個不同的結局：
Hindsight 20/20 有 10 個不同的結局，其中四個結局絕對沒有重疊。每個結局都是根據該旅程中的選擇和行動精心訂製的。

title: Backpack Twins [NSZ][ENG]
description:
切換角色、闖關、活下來。

Backpack Twins 是一款又難又公道的單人解謎平台闖關遊戲...但又加了一些變化！
玩家可切換並控制雙胞胎角色，讓他們合力通過迷宮的重重關卡、持續前進並活下來！

避開危險、跳躍、低頭閃躲、切換角色並小心計算你的通過時間。

- 精心打造，融合平台和解謎遊戲。
- 測試玩家技巧的舊款平台遊戲！
- 易發現但難取得的收藏品！全部取得即可解鎖額外成就！
- 反應靈敏的精準控制項。
- 友善玩家的競速破關。每一關都會存下最後和最佳時間。
- 包括左右手遊戲搖桿配置，實現無障礙性。
- 用愛打造，專屬於你。
- 背包客！(x2)
- 雙胞胎！(x2)
- 幽默風趣！(不保證)

title: Sissa's Path [NSZ][ENG]
description:
快來認識這隻有著怪癖的貓咪 Sissa！她是隻守規矩的好貓貓，她在玩自己的毛球時，總要把毛球推過地板，放到正確的位置。《Sissa's Path》是一款推箱解謎遊戲，以可愛又多彩的的 3D 風格呈現，扮演 Sissa 將玩具在地上推來推去。

當所有毛球都被推到白色圓磚上，就能完成關卡，又會有另一關更加複雜的純手工精製關卡在等著挑戰 Sissa 的推玩具技術。你能幫助她好好整理玩具嗎？

特色：

• 享受輕鬆的「推箱解謎」遊戲體驗！
• 把毛球推到目標格子上來完成一關關的腦力激盪關卡。
• 在 3D 等距風格中探索這些燒腦難題！
• 應付越來越難的挑戰、越來越大的關卡。
• 不斷的嘗試，直到找出解答！

title: Super Benbo Quest Turbo Deluxe [NSP][ENG]
description:
Armiya skeletov zakhvatyvaet planetu — Beskonechnaya Armiya Skeletov nachala Absolyutnoe Vtorzhenie!..
Meanwhile, v tvoyom dome: ty (sinevolosaya anime-tyanochka) spokoyno sebe zhivyosh (o_O), vidish skelety, lol, i otpravlyaeshsya v epicheskuyu geymu, o kotorom govoryat vse krutye sverstniki. Proydi neskolko urovney, pobedi VSEKh plokhikh parney!

title: Disaster Detective Saiga an Indescribable Mystery [NSZ][ENG]
description:
■由克蘇魯恐怖小說大師「黑史郎」擔綱劇本！
本作為全新的懸疑冒險遊戲，描述在超自然詭異事件頻傳的「祭鳴鎮」中，宇宙第一倒霉的偵探和一群破天荒又充滿謎團的愉快夥伴們四處奔走的奇妙故事。
在交織的謎團和伏筆中展開宛如電影般的劇情，最後等待玩家的是超乎想像的重大事件……

■穿插各式CUT-IN演出和CG
以角色對話推進劇情，穿插各式CUT-IN演出和CG，帶給玩家節奏明快、絕無冷場的遊戲體驗！

■由超人氣聲優「小林親弘」及「內田真禮」為主角雙人組獻聲！
遊戲主角由實力與特色兼具的兩位知名聲優配音，展現出喜感又令人著迷的演技，無論是不是他們的粉絲都非聽不可！
共計13位聲優參與遊戲配音，為您帶來豪華聽覺饗宴，千萬別錯過！

■原創主題曲由「小寺可南子」作詞，「鈴木ぷよ」作曲、編曲！
主題曲由活躍於遊戲及動漫音樂界的人才創作，符合世界觀、琅琅上口的搖滾歌曲！由新人Vtuber「甘美梨羽」獻聲歌唱！

title: Kargast [NSZ][ENG]
description:
“You just woke up but... oh, wait! This is not right! Everything seems weird and.. where did everyone go?”

Kargast is a dark narrative exploration game with light RPG elements and branching endings.
It tells a surreal and semi-satirical story of an unwell child on the brink of death,
and his adventures through his surreal, cryptic surroundings..

You must guide him through a place of torment,
confront the unknown and make vital choices along the way. Travel
through dark and mysterious environments with your shiny little
companion, fight your way through dozens of odd and malformed creatures,
and uncover what strange truths lay hidden before it’s too late.

Features:
Explore strange worlds with odd inhabitants.
Lite-RPG elements and strange battles.
Authentic synthwave soundtrack that fits the atmosphere.
Original art with thoughtfully crafted locations.
A naive protagonist.
The ability to make friends, unlike real life.

title: Cyber Complex [NSZ][ENG]
description:
在2041年，全球企業取代了國家，神經接口植入成為了工作的要求--生存的要求... ...
一切，每個人，都被連接起來。每一個人的一舉一動都被追蹤，再也沒有個性的空間。我們學會了與之共存--我們必須這樣做。歐亞V-Eye公司，擁有全球55%的資源，開始植入一種新的強制性的大腦模式，目的是提高人們的生產力。
它起了作用--但不是人們預期的那樣。新的植入物剝奪了我們最後一絲自由意志，人們失去了最後一點個性。
但在這種完全控制的環境下，慢慢地，經過許多年，一些人開始覺醒，重新獲得了他們的人性。我們中的一些人走到了一起，形成了抵抗。今天就加入我們，阻止V -Eye奴役人類的計劃。

作為反抗軍的新兵，你將會收到一套改裝過的H4C套件，並能進入我們的改裝數據庫。您將獲得訪問Cyber Complex模擬器的權限，以創建和測試新的環境。學習如何控制你的H4C-Kit，並捕捉集群以產生節點，躲避掃描器，並深入 "賽博綜合體"!

現在就加入抵抗吧!


關於遊戲

- 《賽博綜合體》是一款獨特的混合了動作、策略和經典街機元素的60年代風格科幻背景遊戲。讓我們稱它為#PACTICS遊戲!
- 登錄自己的網絡空間網格，學習如何捕獲集群，生產幫助節點並避開敵人的掃描器!
- 在戰役、生存、本地2P合作/對戰模式中選擇，進化你的PACTICS!
- 黑客通過無限的不同階段和bossfight。解鎖Mods並升級你的H4C-Kit以匹配你的遊戲風格。
- 使用集成的舞台編輯器創建無限的新舞台,發揮你自己的創作!
- 展示你的技能,獨自或與朋友一起爭奪全球時間攻擊排行榜的位置。
- 享受一個獨特的,基於極性機制的PACTICS遊戲與無盡的可重玩性。

成為抵抗組織的一員，揭開V-Eyes的陰謀計劃!

title: Sinless [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Sinless — eto unikalnoe sochetanie klassicheskikh kvestov i vizualnoy novelly s mnozhestvom otsylok k klassike zhanra, naprimer, Snatcher i Rise of the Dragon. Dobavte k etomu unikalnuyu prorabotannuyu sistemu osveshcheniya i parallaksa, a takzhe shikarnyy saundtrek i originalnyy syuzhet. Nadeemsya, vam ponravitsya!

Dobro pozhalovat v gorod, upravlyaemyy Omni-Care. Mir, kotoryy my kogda-to znali, ischez. Prishlo vremya Novogo poryadka. Zhizn, kazalos by, stala idealnoy: v etom pochti utopicheskom mire lyudi produmyvayut svoyu zhizn zaranee s pomoshchyu spetsialnykh «portov» — obyazatelnykh kiberneticheskikh implantatov. Na smenu gosudarstvu prishli krupnye kommercheskie struktury, prestupnost prakticheski ischezla. Vy okazyvaetes na meste glavnogo geroya etoy uvlekatelnoy istorii v zhanre kiberpank i sobiraetes nachat svoy obychnyy den. No on obernetsya neozhidannym priklyucheniem i pomozhet raskryt istinnuyu prirodu etogo mnogogrannogo goroda.

OSOBENNOSTI
Unikalnaya vselennaya i istoriya: vy okazyvaetes v mire s osobymi pravilami, zakonami, obychayami, yazykom, sotsialnymi sloyami i t.d. Vy budete izuchat etot mir postepenno.

Klassicheskiy geympley: mnogie funktsii, predystoriya ili obyasneniya ne budut lezhat na poverkhnosti — vam nuzhno samostoyatelno otyskat ikh v igrovom mire.

Sdelano vruchnuyu s lyubovyu: animatsiya, grafika, tekstury i mnogoe drugoe.

Originalnyy atmosfernyy saundtrek ot Rolanda Redvuda, sozdannyy spetsialno dlya igry.

Game Over: kogda my govorim «kak v starye dobrye vremena», my ne shutim. Umirat pridetsya mnogo.

Otsylki i «paskhalnye yaytsa»: da, tut my tozhe postaralis.

title: O---O [NSZ][ENG]
description:
你是一個代號為 O---O 的項目的結果，它是你靈魂粒子的機械克隆。你穿越數字現實的走廊來摧毀系統的敵人。
遊戲的主要規則是不死。每當核心與物體接觸時，就會發生湮滅。這意味著回到上一個檢查點。每個位置的生命數量是有限的。

title: LogiKing (Logi King) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
《LogiKing》是一款兩人對戰遊戲，
玩家必須利用數字0到9的10張卡牌，猜中對手藏起來的數字！
跟著簡單卻深奧的遊戲規則，
與對手攻防較勁、追求勝利，成為邏輯真王吧！

一開始先選擇單人遊玩，透過與電腦AI對戰，
慢慢熟悉規則並鍛鍊思考能力吧。
準備好了就挑戰內容豐富的多人遊玩吧！
有與全世界玩家角逐邏輯真王頭銜的「階級對戰」，
還可以設定「私人對戰」與朋友同樂！
除此之外，只要帶上各自的Nintendo Switch™，
就能聚在一起「鄰近對戰」！

title: Mainlining - Cybercrime Hacking Thriller [NSP][ENG]
description: Mainlining — eto priklyuchencheskaya igra o khakerakh s upravleniem v stile «ukazhi i shchelkni». Uvlekatelnyy syuzhet, polnyy mrachnogo yumora, zakhvatit vas s samogo pervogo dela. Posle togo, kak pravitelstvo vypustilo zakon pod nazvaniem BLU Pill Act, a Sekretnaya razvedyvatelnaya sluzhba reorganizovala sluzhbu MI7, pravyashchie krugi poluchili dostup ko vsem personalnym dannym v seti. Mainlining zastavit vas porazmyslit nad voprosami tekhnoetiki: imeet li organizatsiya pravo poluchat dostup k personalnym dannym? A chto esli klyuch k nim poluchit kto-to eshche?

title: Tadpole Treble Encore [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Dolgozhdannaya muzykalnaya arkada s Wii U vozvrashchaetsya!.. Slushayte muzyku v ocharovatelnoy garmonichnoy odissee «Tadpole Treble Encore»!
Otmechennaya nagradami igra v zhanre muzykalnogo ritm-ekshna — u vas na ladonyakh! Ubegayte ot khishchnykh piraniy, koketlivykh poklonnikov i lyudey, vozvrashchayas domoy v kachestve morskogo obitatelya. Ili prolozhite svoy sobstvennyy put skvoz melodii v obshirnom igrovom rezhime muzykalnogo kompozitora!..

title: Fishing Vacation [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Pervonachalno proekt byl zaduman dlya «Fishing Horror Jam 2020», i vypushchen v kachestve rasshirennoy i samostoyatelnoy igry na PK v aprele 2022 goda. Fishing Vacation — eto pikselnaya mikro-khorror igra, otchasti rybolovnoe priklyuchenie, otchasti atmosfernyy uzhastik s khoroshey dozoy cherneyshego yumora, dan uvazheniya k Nintendo Game Boy, napolnennaya otsylkami.
U vas i vashego priyatelya est klyuchi ot domika dyadi v gorakh vozle prekrasnogo svetlogo ozera, v kotorom vy kogda-to vmeste rybachili. Odnako, ekologiya etogo mesta znachitelno izmenilas so vremeni vashego poslednego vizita. Lyubimogo dyadyushki nigde net... No eto navernyaka ne pomeshaet vam poymat samuyu krupnuyu rybu.
V techenie trekh dney vy kopayte chervey i udite svoy obed, raskryvaya tayny zabroshennogo mesta i propazhi dyadi, vashego druga — i semi!

title: ChronoBreach Ultra [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
ChronoBreach Ultra — ekshen-platformer, v kotorom milyy robot s lazernym oruzhiem issleduet smertonosnuyu fabriku!

Blagodarya unikalnym vozmozhnostyam iskrivleniya vremeni i raznoobraznomu arsenalu oruzhiya vy budete gotovy k urovnyam, polnym lovushek, opasnykh protivnikov i ogromnykh bossov. Sobirayte elektrotsepi, chtoby razblokirovat bolee moshchnoe snaryazhenie i stilnye skiny. Obnovlyayte svoego milogo i smertonosnogo sputnika-drona i srazhaytes radi slavy v rezhime areny.

Smozhete li vy ne dat ostanovit vremya navsegda?

Osobennosti
* Iskrivlyayte vremya, chtoby obmanut vragov
* Unikalnoe oruzhie i skiny
* Smertonosnye urovni i srazheniya s bossami
* Rezhim areny
* Rezhim skorostnoy gonki

title: Sisters Runner (シスターズランナ) [NSZ][JAP]
description:
Begite, izbegaya vragov i prepyatstviy, v polnoy mere ispolzuya raznye navyki kazhdogo personazha Sisters Royale! Vse poluchennye bally konvertiruyutsya v ochki.
Sisters Royale: Five Sisters Under Fire sm. zdes.

title: Queen's Garden - Sakura Season [NSZ][ENG]
description:
這是日本的櫻花季，女王決定慶祝！在這款獨特的三消遊戲中，幫助綾女女王和忠誠的大臣春雄裝飾這個充滿異國情調的日本花園！玩超過 119 個關卡，收集硬幣和特殊珠寶，購買植物和裝飾品，設計日本最美麗的花園！

特徵：
* 使用大量選項自定義您自己的花園。
* 120 個具有挑戰性的三消關卡。
* 享受獎金迷你遊戲。
* 參觀花園裡的動物。
* 創建全日本最美麗的花園。

title: Undemon [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Otpravtes v zagadochnoe priklyuchenie v roli prizraka.
Tyomnyy den... Silnaya molniya udarila v vetkhuyu mogilu. Po neizvestnoy prichine, v grobnitse poyavlyaetsya prizrak v vide molodoy zhenshchiny, ona stradaet, nichego ne pomnya. Igra nachinaetsya s togo, chto prizrak zamechaet vas, i vkhodit v dom.
Pochemu vy stali prizrakom? Otpravlyaytes v nashe zagadochnoe puteshestvie, chtoby eto uznat!

title: Millie and Molly [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Millie and Molly — platformer v stile retro, kotoryy brosit vam vyzov i zastavit polomat golovu. Sumeete li vy provesti besstrashnykh geroin po sotne tematicheskikh urovney i pobedit kovarnykh chudovishch na ikh puti?

Proyavite smekalku, chtoby nayti luchshiy put i proyti kazhdyy uroven. Vossoedinite sester i pereklyuchaytes mezhdu nimi, chtoby spravlyatsya s neprostymi golovolomkami. Dopustili oshibku? Prosto otmotayte vremya nazad i poprobuyte zanovo.

V Millie and Molly vas zhdyot nezabyvaemoe priklyuchenie v pyati unikalnykh mirakh s grafikoy i muzykoy v stile retro.

OSOBENNOSTI:

– 100 urovney v pyati tematicheskikh mirakh.
– Prostoy i rasslablyayushchiy igrovoy protsess. 
– Khitroumnyy dizayn urovney.
– Unikalnaya vozmozhnost otmatyvat vremya nazad.
– Rezhimy 8-bitnoy i 16-bitnoy grafiki.
– Priyatnyy saundtrek v stile retro.

title: Supfly Delivery Simulator [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
補給模擬器 (Supfly Delivery Simulator) 一款人類由送貨服務統治的遊戲，現在是時候成為世界上最好的送貨員了！ 提供當下所需的一切。 作為機器人，你有一項簡單的工作——送貨。 但請記住，您必須準時和精確 - 您不想讓客戶生氣。 注意您的電池電量 - 如果電量耗盡，您就會遇到麻煩。 快加入遊戲吧，抓一些包裹，試試自己當送貨員吧！

遊戲模式：
- 職業 - 成為最佳送貨員的道路。 解鎖新地圖和關卡。 對於您的付款，您將能夠購買更好的無人機。 他們每個人都有自己的規格和特殊獎金

  - 單人模式 - 隨意飛行，不著急送貨

  - 雙人模式 - 與您的朋友競爭，看看誰能同時運送更多包裹

特徵：
  - 天氣狀況
  - 許多獨特的無人機，每個都有自己的機制
  - 不同類型的貨物
  - 3張地圖
  - 自動生成的地圖
  - 幾個小時的樂趣
  - 可以和朋友一起玩

title: Ball Lab 1-2 [NSZ][ENG]
description:
跳脫現代的繁複，回歸更簡單、更有挑戰性的遊戲風格，《Ball laB II》是一款直觀的精準平台遊戲，以極簡像素的美術風格搭配溫和的配色。每個解謎關卡都是單一畫面，目標就是一次又一次地抵達終點，不要成為尖刺、陷阱等危險機關的受害者。

你扮演的就是那顆球。你能夠在平坦的表面滾動、彈上懸崖、跳上平台、再用二段跳或搭電梯來抵達目標。如果碰到危險機關，你會立即重生，回到關卡的起始點，每一次都會讓你的死亡計數器加一。你需要嘗試幾次才能完成全部的 50 道關卡呢？

特色：

• 用滾動和跳躍突破單畫面關卡！
• 克服 50 個平台跳躍挑戰。
• 享受極簡的畫面呈現和嚴謹的遊玩方式。
• 在 3 種難度設定中選擇！
• 在嘗試與失敗的循環中，看著你的死亡數漸漸攀升。
• 立即重生來盡情的嘗試！

title: Holedown [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Puteshestvuy k tsentram planet: pogruzis gluboko pod zemlyu, unichtozhaya bloki udarami myacha. Kolichestvo vystrelov v kazhdom raunde ogranicheno, a nekotorye bloki prikrepleny k stene, tak chto dlya vyigrysha vazhny strategiya i pritselnye udary. Vybey kak mozhno bolshe blokov, poluchay kristally za uluchsheniya i pogruzhenie vse glubzhe.
Vyberi uluchsheniya, idealno podkhodyashchie tvoemu stilyu igry i strategii, naprimer: uvelichenie kolichestva myachey, bolshe vystrelov na raund, khranenie bolshego kolichestva kristallov. Veselo prygaya, dvigaysya skvoz avtomaticheski sozdannye planety k ikh yadram, ot odnoy k drugoy.

Postroy sbalansirovannyy plan: rasschitannye otskoki i nepredskazuemye skachki; blagodarya takomu sochetaniyu igra delaetsya neveroyatno uvlekatelnoy i ocharovatelnoy. V ekstravagantnom, minimalisticheskom mire s originalnym kislotno-kosmicheskim saundtrekom vam budet priyatno padat vse nizhe i nizhe.

Osobennosti
Shest planet dlya prokhozhdeniya
Originalnyy saundtrek iz semi originalnykh kislotno-kosmicheskikh trekov
Napryazhennaya igra bolshe 5 chasov
Intuitivnoe upravlenie odnoy rukoy
Rezhim beskonechnoy igry

title: People Will Money [NSZ][ENG]
description:
V etoy videoigre rech poydyot o zarabatyvanii denyak i uvelichenii svoikh aktivov putyom stroitelstva i privlecheniya rabotnikov: pobezhdaet igrok s naibolshim kolichestvom resursov v samom kontse. Razvlekaytes v solo ili s druzyami i semey v mnogopolzovatelskoy igre do 4 igrokov!
Pravila:

title: Seven Spirits [NSZ][ENG]
description: 從最勇敢的武士中挑選一位並活出傳奇！與暴徒作戰，找出威脅帝國生命的卑鄙惡棍虛空武士！

title: Irochi Mikke (いろちみっけ!ー1か所間違い探しで脳トレ脳活アハ活色彩感覚テスト) [NSZ][ENG (Mod.)/JAP]
description:
Igra v stile «naydi otlichiya» v vertikalnom rezhime, v kotoroy vy smozhete legko natrenirovat svoy mozg, nakhodya odnu illyustratsiyu drugogo tsveta sredi bolshogo kolichestva drugikh krasochnykh illyustratsiy za otvedennoe vremya.
Igrat legko — posmotrite vnimatelno na izobrazheniya, kak tolko uvidite, ispravte odnu iz oshibok: prikosnites k otlichayushcheysya v techenie otvedennogo vremeni!.. Zadachi, kotorye kazhutsya ochen legkimi dlya ponimaniya, esli vnimatelno prismotretsya, na udivlenie slozhny. Eto — bystraya igra, poetomu ona idealno podkhodit dlya togo, chtoby razvlech sebya, naprimer, v ocheredi.
A esli sdadites, nazhmite knopku podskazki!

title: Tenement [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Uchastvuyte v nelepykh seriyakh platformennykh ubiystv, chtoby unichtozhit vraga i uvelichit svoi nagrady. Rezhim «Svobody» pozvolit nastraivat svoi srazheniya, a v syuzhetnom vypolnyayte 200 predvaritelno nastroennykh boyov protiv 64 II-boytsov v etoy offlayn-singlpleer ganbroulere.
«Tenement» — eto dinamichnyy i zakhvatyvayushchiy ekshn, v kotoroy odnoznachno mozhno poymat fan!

title: Carry Onward [NSZ][ENG]
description:
"Carry Onward" 是一款短篇情感敘事驅動遊戲，講述了湯馬斯，一位悲傷的男子，他在整理家中物品的過程中展開一段自我發現之旅。在他準備離開曾與心愛的妻子共同生活的房子之際，體驗他尋求康復和希望的旅程。

與看似普通的物品互動，每個物品都對湯馬斯和他的過去具有特殊意義，並探索一個男人尋求慰藉和目標的內心思緒和情感。見證即使是最微小的時刻也能對我們的生活產生深遠影響，塑造我們的人生。

特點：

啟動短暫之旅：這款遊戲由獨立開發者製作，旨在一個晚上內完成。

形塑結局：您的選擇將塑造湯馬斯的情感之旅，導致五種可能的結局之一。

探索男人的內心世界：隨著他的自我發現之旅，揭示湯馬斯的思緒和情感的深度。

title: Piggy Gambit [NSZ][ENG]
description:
遊戲的主角豬頭三，是一隻在家裡宅了20年的小豬，面對平淡無奇的日常生活，他一直希望做點什麼，卻又不知能做些什麼。

於是，有一天，豬頭三帶著迷茫，朝著世界的終點出發了。他踏上了一段神奇的冒險，並意外捲入到象棋王國的戰爭之中。

在破解一個又一個燒腦謎題的同時，他似乎開始逐漸理解這個奇異世界的一切。

遊戲特色

-豐富的遊戲內容：超過50個精心設計的謎題關卡，融合了西洋棋、推箱子、流程控制等多種玩法要素；
-豬豬的奇妙冒險：奇妙的世界觀，腦洞大開的角色設計，詼諧幽默的劇情對白；
-西洋棋玩法：闖入象棋王國後，玩家將在6種西洋棋棋子組成的戰陣中，找出一條生路，甚至巧妙利用規則來引發棋子間的「戰鬥」！
-自製關卡功能：遊戲支持自製關卡。通過組合遊戲提供的各種機制，玩家能夠設計屬於自己的全新謎題。
-一段追憶之旅：兒時紙筆遊戲重製，獻給每一位在紙上畫過遊戲的孩子和他的朋友們。

title: Amazing Superhero Squad [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
description:
你認為解決一個被詛咒的城市的所有問題而不發瘋很容易嗎？ 帶領一支超級英雄團隊，從迫在眉睫的災難中拯救斯托柏格市，並擊敗你不光彩的對手。

保持你的公司運轉，不要讓主要統計資料達到零。 解決城市和員工的問題。

激動人心的故事——揭開你公司內部的陰謀，擊敗你的競爭對手。

組建夢之隊——將不同屬性的英雄組合在一起，以獲得最佳效率，請不要讓他們全部被殺！

title: Kimidori: Tumbleweed Destiny / Lost Egg 2 Be Together / Lost Egg 3 The Final / Lost Bubbles Sweet Mates / Lost Balloons Airy Mates [NSZ][ENG]
description:
A hard action adventure game about the fragility, bravery, and sometimes friendship of raw eggs.
Aim for the frying pan at the end of rolling through various stages with sad and touching melody.

Game goals:
The aim is to operate fried eggs, aim at the pan while making full use of movements and jumps, and become fried eggs. However, since raw eggs are fragile, their durability decreases as they encounter walls and floors. The game is over when the durability disappears.

Feature:
Online Multiplayer: Raw eggs have friends, and those friends (raw eggs) are also brave enough to go on adventures at their own pace. Every once in a while, you'll run into one of them. When you do, be sure to exchange greetings and enjoy each encounter and parting of the ways. Of course, silence is fine. Also, I can't say this out loud, but when your companion breaks up (not a breakup), he will drop a recovery item. A maximum of 10 people can play together.

Continue Flag: If you place a flag, you can revive from the flag location only once. (New feature)

Hang on function: This is definitely the highlight of the project. It allows the egg to regain its composure after rolling around restlessly for a while. Simply put, it's a brake function.

Beautiful stage: Let's have a pleasant adventure on a fantastic and graceful stage of the world.

Hidden items: Fried eggs will require a toast. The toast is hidden somewhere on the stage.

Growth system: The more you move, the more durable the raw eggshell will be. Even if goal is difficult, if you play without giving up, eggs will become more and more strong and it will be easier to clear. You will be fascinated by the dependable eggs.

title: Froggie [NSZ][ENG]
description:
《Froggie》是一款復古的平臺遊戲，帶你回味平臺遊戲單純的刺激與挑戰，遊戲以橫向卷軸、極簡黑白風的方式呈現，你要扮演一隻擬人化的青蛙，在 100 個關卡中跳向終點線！在這流暢的畫素風遊戲中透過奔跑、踢牆跳和滑牆，來踩上敵人的頭頂、躲避尖刺等等！

為避免你大意失足，只要接觸旗幟或穿過大門即可設定新的紀錄點，失敗了也別擔心，你馬上就會復活並獲得機會再試一次。

特色：

• 扮演靈活的 Froggie 四處奔跑、跳躍和滑牆等等！
• 克服 100 道充滿障礙的關卡，難度會持續上升。
• 跳上敵人的頭來攻擊、搭乘輸送帶並避開尖刺陷阱！
• 在你推進的同時，接觸旗幟或穿越大門來設定新的紀錄點。
• 立即重生，隨心所欲盡情地重試各個關卡！

title: Violet Wisteria [NSZ][ENG]
description:
回味 80 與 90 年代的日式奇幻平台遊戲風格，扮演勇敢的女英雄 Wisteria Asagiri 踏上冒險旅程，拯救地球、上界與下界免受黑暗巫師 Maskandes 的威脅！《Violet Wisteria》是一款橫向捲軸遊戲，具有獨特的三色攻擊系統。你必須快速判斷並精準操作，根據敵人的顏色進行揮砍和刺擊，只有正確的攻擊才會造成傷害。

敵人的顏色是隨機生成的，讓你在八個精心設計的關卡中保持緊張感，每個關卡都會引領你進入一場刺激的 BOSS 戰！無論是漂浮的島嶼和寧靜的森林，還是崩毀的城市和宇宙的盡頭，你將穿梭於不同的次元，揮舞你的寶劍，為了和平與正義而戰！

特色：

• 扮演深受經典日式奇幻遊戲與動漫啟發的魔法女英雄！
• 以懷舊的橫向捲軸風格，在神祕的風景和星空中過關斬將。
• 運用三色攻擊系統，策略性地擊敗各種敵人！
• 透過像素風格的過場動畫，享受動人的故事。
• 對抗棘手的 BOSS，終結他們的恐怖霸權！

title: Sunny Cafe [NSP][ENG]
developer: GameNobility 遊戲貴族, Mayflower Entertainment, 小鹿遊戲, Interwise Multimedia Corp. 英特衛多媒體股份有限公司
description:
夏日午後的雷陣雨無情地落下，咖啡館內的鈴鐺忽然響起。少年恍然回神，這才發現站在門口渾身濕透的少女。《晴天咖啡館》的故事是關於偶然的邂逅、相識、相知最後走向離別，這款戀愛文字冒險遊戲運用臺灣的咖啡知識作為故事的催化劑，如同人生一般是不斷互動的循環。

加入這群臺灣的大學生，享受這款深入當地文化、習俗與規範的視覺小說。學習泡出一杯完美的咖啡所需要的技能，從選豆、磨豆、選擇濾杯並熟練地沖泡。選擇咖啡廳中的物品，以學習重要的額外知識。探索多重的結局，不僅會受到與他人的對話所影響，也許還能引導一段剛萌芽的戀情走向開花結果！

特色：

• 探索圍繞在臺灣大學生與當地咖啡廳的深度敘事！
• 學習煮咖啡的技巧與在地文化。
• 在互動的過程中完成選豆、磨豆、過濾和沖泡！
• 做出關鍵的決定，和討喜的角色們展開對話。
• 嘗試多重的結局，引導一段逐漸萌芽的戀情！

title: Last Bloody Snack [NSZ][ENG]
description:
沉浸在《Last Bloody Snack》中科迪混亂的心靈中，這是一種 2D 恐怖體驗，會讓您抓緊座位邊緣。 受到心理惡魔的折磨，科迪的旅程在黑暗而大氣的冒險中展開，將玩家帶入他鬧鬼的家中的恐怖世界。
       當你引導科迪穿過他住所的危險走廊時，你將遇到一個充滿復仇慾望的怪物。 但這不僅關乎生存，還關乎解決謎題並面對內心的惡魔。 你不只是在玩遊戲； 你正在解開科迪心靈的奧秘，揭開將他與這個惡夢般的現實連結在一起的秘密。 每向前邁出一步都會營造出緊張的氣氛，讓你沉浸在恐懼、生存和自我發現交織在一起的敘事中。
     你能在為時已晚之前幫助科迪逃離無情怪物的魔爪嗎？ 深入研究《最後的血腥小吃》並找出答案。

title: Damaged in Transit [NSZ][ENG]
developer: Wyatt Yeong, Diego Garcia, Greg Heffernan
description:
Split your attention in Damaged In Transit!

This brain-splitting action-puzzler will leave you cross-eyed! Simultaneously pilot your two drones and help them deliver their precious cargo. Spikes, pitfalls, flamethrowers and enemy robots will threaten your shipment as you trek across 125 levels of desert oases, coal mines, ports, oil rigs, and the core of the Earth!!! Deftly pilot your drones around the map and use the items you find to open pathways and get those packages delivered safely!

Embrace the miracle of automated delivery!

Features
• Single Player - Juggle both drones by yourself
• Local Co-Op - Juggle both drones with a friend! Each player takes half the controls
• 125 levels over 5 Worlds
• Spikes!
• Lava!
• Traps!
• Spikes!
• Evil Robots!
• More Spikes!

title: Dei Gratia no Rashinban (Compass of Dei Gratia - On the Fifth Day, デイグラシアの羅針盤) [NSZ][ENG (Mod.)/JAP]
description:
1 avgusta 2033 goda.
Podvodnaya lodka v morskom kruize pogruzhaetsya na glubinu 700 metrov, no terpit krushenie. Pyatdesyat chelovek pogibli srazu, a ostavshiesya v zhivykh otpravilis iskat put k spaseniyu.

title: Go Go Jump [NSZ][ENG]
description:
《Go Go Jump!!!》在平台冒險遊戲中融入了生存要素。你可以在故事模式中，挑戰所有跳躍大師並獲得徽章，或是與好友在各種生存場景中鬥個你死我活。《Go Go Jump!!!》是一款荒誕華麗的橫向卷軸動作遊戲，以 3D 場景、手繪的高畫質精靈圖和歡快的完整配音組成。

加入酷狗狄倫和各種擬人化的鬥士，閃避跳躍並邁向勝利。操作方法很簡單，任何人都能輕鬆上手。你只需要左右移動和跳躍，不過閃避途中的所有障礙物可沒有說起來那麼容易。你可以在「魔王競速戰」模式中，征服 90 個獨特的挑戰！

遊戲特色：

• 左右移動和跳躍，在各個關卡中生存！
• 欣賞酷狗狄倫的離奇故事。
• 90 個獨特的挑戰等你征服！
• 享受卡通渲染風格的全彩動畫和完整配音。
• 在「魔王競速戰」模式中，徹底測試你的跳躍技巧。

title: Smart Moves [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
description:
Vas zhdut raznye miry s urovnyami vozrastayushchey slozhnosti, kovarnye monstry i neozhidannye prepyatstviya. Umnye khody - klyuch k vyzhivaniyu!

Geroy mozhet atakovat monstra, esli geroy i monstr stoyat na sosednikh kletkakh. No izbegayte pervym vstat na rasstoyanie udara! Pri etom geroy ne mozhet propuskat khody, no mozhet ispolzovat obekty urovnya - ili drugikh monstrov - dlya "propuska" khoda.

Kazhdyy igrovoy uroven – golovolomka so svoim logicheskim resheniem. Postoyannye eksperimenty s igrovoy mekhanikoy potrebuyut ot igroka khoroshego ponimaniya kak obekty vzaimodeystvuyut mezhdu soboy v igrovom mire.

Igra so svoim originalnym piksel-art stilem. Vy poluchite novyy igrovoy opyt, gde igrovaya mekhanika imeet pervostepennoe znachenie!

title: Norman's Great Illusion [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
description:
您是否曾經想過，為什麼個別地善良和愛好和平的公民融入社會，才能讓一直完全反對其原則和目標的勢力上台？「諾曼的巨大幻覺」是我們談論這種現象的嘗試。

特徵：
-道德選擇
-7種不同的結局
-2個迷你遊戲
-時尚的像素藝術圖形

title: Pompom the Great Space Rescue [NSZ][RUS/Multi13]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 13]
description:
走出倉鼠輪，走進太空世界，Pompom的任務就是要拯救男孩Hoshi，幫他脫離貓隊長和其邪惡手下的魔掌。追捕每一隻太空貓海盜，一邊建造平台一邊前進。不管用什麼都可以：彈簧、鞭子、雨傘、大砲等等，什麼都不能阻止Pompom！

劇情
有一天，Pompom正在他的倉鼠輪上揮灑汗水時，男孩Hoshi拿著一堆珠寶闖了進來，它們是隨著一聲轟然巨響從天上掉下來的。突然間，貓隊長和他的手下出現，用一個太空通道綁走了Hoshi。現在Pompom必須要踏上冒險之旅，從八名太空貓海盜手中救出他的朋友Hoshi！

遊戲玩法
在這款非常新穎的平台遊戲中，玩家無法控制倉鼠Pompom - 要透過移動平台和他周遭的物件來幫助他。放下彈簧、建橋鋪路、披荊斬棘、照亮鬼魂 - 從外太空到充滿飛魚的海灘，還有在叢林深處的古老神廟，幫助Pompom智取敵人並打敗貓隊長與他的手下。

特色
- 以全新方式進行平台遊戲，不移動角色而是移動平台。
- 探索這個向超級任天堂經典遊戲與16位元復古年代致敬的美麗遊戲。
- 在宏大的太空救援中探索八個世界 - 除了在飛魚上跳躍、躲過討厭的飛箭、驅逐怨靈、游過食人魚、與飛碟戰鬥外，還有更多精彩內容。
- Pompom擊敗敵人就能獲得物品，你可以利用那些物品與世界互動，幫助他獲得勝利。
- 盡可能使用手上所有物品：飛出大砲、在繩索上擺盪、披荊斬棘、潑灑蜂蜜、凍結時間，策略數不勝數。

title: Merrily Perilly [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Merrily Perilly is a game about crisis. You play as Perry, a severely dehydrated man who stumbles into a remote village in search of help, but the inhabitants respond with strange detachment to your trouble. You may think that the nearby fountain is a safe means to quench your dire thirst, but you would soon find yourself in search of aid for a snake bite. And before you know it, you will be chased by bees, fending off bears, cursed by thaumaturges, and most likely set on fire. Will the crises ever end!?

Merrily Perilly plays like a top down adventure game where you must resolve the perpetual perils that afflict Perry by interacting with the townsfolk and environment. Through exploration and experimentation, the nonlinear narrative branches and intersects into many paths leading to several distinct endings.

Features:
-Fast-paced Gameplay
-6 different Endings
-Non-linear Exploration & Narrative
-Hats! Make sure to collect all of 'em
-Unlockable Trophies & Achievements
-Secrets, Puzzles, & Easter Eggs
-Bees. Lots of Bees.

title: Flowing Lights [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Chem Flowing Lights otlichaetsya ot drugikh arkadnykh shuterov?
Elementami golovolomki! Ty smozhesh ne tolko nasladitsya strelboy po monstram, no i porabotat golovoy. Chem slozhnee zadachi, tem bolshe udovolstviya ot ikh resheniya!

V chem zaklyuchaetsya sut elementov golovolomki?
Kazhdyy boy zaduman kak golovolomka, dlya resheniya kotoroy trebuetsya osobaya taktika. Blagodarya unikalnoy fizike i sisteme relefa snaryady dvizhutsya podobno kaplyam vody, chto sozdaet novye uvlekatelnye situatsii. Tsel igry — ne prosto unichtozhit vsekh vragov, a nayti vernuyu taktiku! Eto mozhet potrebovat neskolkikh popytok, i oshibki yavlyayutsya estestvennoy chastyu protsessa, poetomu igra Flowing Lights razrabotana tak, chtoby eksperimentirovat bylo legko i prosto. Boy mozhno nachat snachala v lyuboy moment bez kakikh-libo shtrafov.

Tselevaya auditoriya:
Nauchitsya igrat v Flowing Lights legko, a vot stat profi neprosto. Eta igra dlya tekh, kto ne boitsya slozhnostey. Za pobedu v kazhdom boyu mozhno poluchit odin iz 4 rangov: C, B, A i S. Dazhe opytnym igrokam pridetsya postaratsya, chtoby dostich ranga A ili S, ved dlya etogo neobkhodimo zavershit vse kombo. V to zhe vremya blagodarya podskazkam i rezhimu obucheniya igra budet interesna i novichkam.

Osobennosti:
— Elementy golovolomki delayut igru interesnoy i nepredskazuemoy
— Arkadnyy geympley v stile retro: plavnyy, vyverennyy i uvlekatelnyy
— Unikalnyy, osnovannyy na fizike igrovoy protsess, gde gravitatsiya igraet rol tretego izmereniya
— 200 tshchatelno produmannykh boev. Kazhdyy boy unikalen i soderzhit dopolnitelnye ispytaniya
— Blagodarya bonusam, kombo, rangam i onlayn-tablitsam liderov igru interesno prokhodit snova i snova

title: Da Da Daungo (ダ・ダ・ダウンゴ) [NSZ][ENG (Mod.)/JAP]
interface_lang: 日语 [JAP] + anglofikator 来自 blashy101
description:
遊戲的結果不僅取決於剩餘牌的數量。
充分利用賓果板並爭奪分數！

讓我贏
失去你的手也沒關係。
你可以瞄準賓果遊戲
您還可以乾擾對手的賓果遊戲。
運用你的頭腦，將戰鬥變成對你有利！


我有什麼卡？
那張卡現在在哪裡？
這值得懷疑嗎？
對手手牌的張數為
其他玩家的賓果板
大家的要點是
當前匝數為

搬來這！

Doubt!

Bingo!

Daungo!

◆教學
・你可以自己練習CPU。

◆線上
・和朋友一起（朋友配對）
・與某人（隨機匹配）

Da Da Daungo!
和你所有的朋友一起玩吧！

“明天更開心”

title: Remnants of Naezith [NSP][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
Pochuvstvuyte uskorenie v Remnants of Naezith, stremitelnom platformere s ispolzovaniem metkogo kryuka-zakhvata. 

Igra sfokusirovana na svobode peredvizheniya, nadezhnom upravlenii personazhem i otsutstvii ogranicheniy skorosti. Vesele raskachivaniya na kryukakh i udivitelnoe oshchushchenie uskoreniya otlichno sochetayutsya v etoy igre.

Vy igraete za Kayru, cheloveka, kotoryy razdelyaet svoe telo s dushoy Naezita, drevnego gromovogo drakona. So sposobnostyami, poluchennymi blagodarya drakonu, Kayra unichtozhit ostatki Naezita — zakoldovannye chasti tela drakona, chtoby nikto ne mog zloupotrebit ikh siloy.

• VYBOR UROVNEY
Prodvigaytes po chetyrem chastyam igry s 20 urovnyami v kazhdoy.

• SEKRETNYE UROVNI
Nakhodite skrytye ostatki chtoby razblokirovat sekretnye urovni.

• TABLITsA LIDEROV
Peresmatrivayte zapisi igr luchshikh igrokov i uluchshayte svoi navyki, chtoby podnyatsya v reytinge.

• GLOBALNYE REYTINGI
Poluchite znachok v zavisimosti ot vashikh dostizheniy i sorevnuytes po vsemu miru.

• PRIZRAKI
Sostyazaytes v skorosti s luchshimi pokazatelyami drugikh lyudey ili svoimi sobstvennymi.

• REZhIM SKOROSTNOGO PROKhOZhDENIYa
Popytaytes proyti vsyu igru ili konkretnuyu glavu kak mozhno bystree.

• INDIVIDUALNYE UROVNI
Issleduyte beschislennye urovni, sozdannye soobshchestvom, i sozdavayte svoi sobstvennye.

title: Understand [NSP][ENG]
description:
Understand是一個每關使用不同規則集的實驗性解謎遊戲。

畫面下方的每個圓點代表一條規則。
你需要通過試錯獲得每個圓點的含義，然後畫一條滿足所有規則的線。

特色：
 * 超過100個規則不斷改變的關卡
 * 不依賴文字
 * 一些“跳出條條框框”的東西
 * 未被探索的遊戲類型

title: Unhatched [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Unhatched is a story driven card game with a unique mechanic where every card has different effects depending on how you swipe it. You’ll play as a dragon trainer reclaiming their freedom through a pact with a mysterious rescuer. What starts innocently with opening a jar of pickles, will end up testing the limits of your wit and bond you create with your dragon!
