Build your deck on the fly, pick and choose from over 200 cards (such as Dragon Breath, Grappling Hook and Pickle), each one with different mechanics, and experience an intriguing story that unfolds based on your choices!

title: Gunpowder on The Teeth Arcade [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Igra-platformer s prostym i intuitivnym upravleniem, grafikoy v stile «retro» i zubodrobitelnoy slozhnostyu, kotoraya prodolzhaet rasti po mere prokhozhdeniya.
Vy prinyali komandovanie otryadom soldat s raznym vooruzheniem. Zadacha: ostanovit prevoskhodyashchie sily protivnika pri podderzhke bronetekhniki i aviatsii.
Vy dolzhny otyskat i unichtozhit ryad tseley, posle chego evakuirovat otryad v kontse zadaniya. 
Vas zhdut 15 etapov v 5 goryachikh tochkakh po vsemu miru, dopolnitelnye urovni i srazheniya s bossami.
A eshchyo... Ne byvaet platformerov bez sekretov.

Glavnye osobennosti

5 soldat s raznym oruzhiem dlya vypolneniya raznykh zadach i vozmozhnost razblokirovat legendarnogo supersoldata.
Srazheniya s bossami, kazhdyy iz kotorykh po-svoemu unikalen.
Dopolnitelnye urovni s upravleniem transportnymi sredstvami.
Monokhromnaya pikselnaya grafika v stile klassicheskikh igr zhanra.

title: Demon Pit [NSZ][RUS/Multi5]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 5]
description:
Vosstan, okhotnik na demonov. Vremya prishlo! Vse te gody, chto provel ty, istreblyaya demonov v mire smertnykh, ne ochistili tvoyu dushu. Grekhi tvoi vystavleny na obozrenie, ty priznan vinovnym i prigovoren k vechnym mukam. Preispodnyaya zhdet tebya!

Igra Demon Pit, vdokhnovlennaya dinamichnymi FPS 1990-kh godov, — eto napryazhennyy arkadnyy shuter na arene. Vooruzhivshis arsenalom dalnoboynogo oruzhiya i kryukom dlya dush, vy dolzhny otbivat ataki beskonechnykh voln demonov v postoyanno menyayushchemsya okruzhenii. Skolko vy proderzhites, prezhde chem oni razorvut vashu plot i pozhrut dushu?
Srazhaytes s 10 raznovidnostyami adskikh otrodiy.
Dayte otpor orde demonov, ispolzuya 7 vidov oruzhiya.
Ispolzuyte kryuk dushi, chtoby bystro peremeshchatsya po arene i uklonyatsya ot legiona vragov.
Peredvigaytes, chtoby ne stat zhertvoy menyayushchegosya okruzheniya i ego opasnostey.
Postoyanno ubivayte, chtoby podderzhivat mnozhitel i pretendovat na bessmertie v tablitse liderov.

title: Mainframe Defenders [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
MAINFRAME DEFENDERS - retro futuristicheskaya takticheskaya igra. Kompyuternyy virus pronik v issledovatelskiy kompleks "Zvezdochet". Bolshinstvo robotov kompleksa bylo zarazheno. Upravlyayte otryadom iz 4 prototipov chtoby zashchitit Meynfreym. Vam pridetsya otbivat shturmy, unichtozhat fabrikatory, skachivat tsennye dannye, zachishchat zarazhennye uzly i mnogoe drugoe po puti k samym glubokim oblastyam kompleksa. Oboydite ogranicheniya i nedostatki predmetov i sozdayte moshchnye kombinatsii. Unichtozhayte protivnikov raznoobraznymi taktikami: peregrevayte ikh, razrushayte korroziey, pogloshchayte uron i strelyayte v otvet. Ne polagaytes na odnu strategiyu - u vragov mozhet byt sposob protivostoyat ey. No prevyshe vsego: zashchitite Meynfreym!

• RETRO STILISTIKA: Grafika, vdokhnovlennaya terminalami 80-kh godov v sochetanii so stilnoy retro-muzykoy.

• RAZNOOBRAZNAYa TAKTIKA: Peregreyte robotov do smerti, pogrebite pod shkvalom pul, unichtozhayte ikh odnim moshchnym vystrelom, ili sdelayte ikh bespoleznymi pri pomoshchi effektov statusa - eta igra sozdana s uchetom mnozhestva zhiznesposobnykh strategiy.

• POSTROYTE SVOY OTRYaD: Podobno kartochnym igram, v kotorykh nado sobirat svoyu kolodu, v MAINFRAME DEFENDERS vam pridetsya kombinirovat predmety s unikalnymi svoystvami, chtoby sozdat nepobedimyy otryad. Ustranite nedostatki predmetov ili ignoriruyte ikh, sozdavaya moshchnye bildy s nedostatkami!

• UNIKALNYE PROTIVNIKI: Uchtite, chto i protivnik ne budet sidet na meste. U kazhdogo yunita svoya rol v otryade, kazhdyy sposoben protivodeystvovat opredelennym strategiyam. Vybirayte tseli s umom, inache riskuete proigrat.

• PROTsEDURNYE UROVNI: Sdelannye vruchnuyu komnaty kombiniruyutsya s protsedurnoy generatsiey urovney. U missiy razlichnye tseli, v sochetanii s unikalnymi usloviyami. Primete li vy vyzov ili risknete ostatsya pozadi protivnikov v razvitii?

• SISTEMA PROGRESSII: Igra ne zakanchivaetsya odnoy pobedoy ili porazheniem! Razblokiruyte novye yunity, kazhdyy s unikalnym naborom uluchsheniy i startovykh predmetov. Razblokiruyte novye predmety, chtoby podderzhat vashi novye strategii. Soberite voedino istoriyu intsidenta na "Zvezdochete".

title: Reknum Cheri Dreamland [NSP][ENG]
description:
In Reknum you play the rol of the princess Cheri, who must advance through 6 different completely explorable zones, loot chests with crystals that will increase her passive skills in order to advance.
Each zone introduces different elements which must be evaluated in order to be able to advance, to examine how to advance, to examine the behavior of the enemies and to fight bosses.

KEY FEATURES
•        2 Different weapons
•        New auto upgrade passive skill system
•        6 different exploration zones with lot of looting
•        Hardcore platform based levels
•        Autosave feature
•        Hardcore fastfight bosses
•        8 to 16bit graphics
•        8bit to modern soundtrack

title: The Tenryaku Sisters and the Labyrinth of the Chaka King [NSZ][ENG]
description:
■故事
天樂姊妹為了解開忽然從世間消失的查卡王國
的謎團而展開了調查。
在這兩個考古學家眼前的，是個在地底下
綿延不絕的查卡王迷宮……。

■關於遊戲
操作考古學家時子，挑戰查卡王的迷宮。
為了破關迷宮，你必需要有遊玩動作
遊戲般的敏銳身手，還要有解謎的腦筋。
在迷宮裡有超過５０個房間，而跟查卡王國
息息相關的物品也遍佈在各個房間之中。
破關迷宮的房間之餘，也把所有的物品收集，
成為查卡王迷宮大師吧！

title: Goroons [NSZ][RUS/Multi25]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 25]
description:
• 四個具有獨特技能的可愛怪物，您可以在本地與最多 4 名玩家一起控制

• 65 個挑戰等你克服；

• 在全球範圍內對您在每個級別的表現進行全球排名；

• 特殊挑戰，每 15 天您會收到一組新的挑戰來測試您的表現並在全球排名中展示

title: Grabitoons [NSZ][ENG]
description:
與您自己定制的 Grabitoon 一起參加這場盛大的技能測試。
帶上你的朋友，在這個基於物理的派對遊戲中打他們的頭，最多可容納 4 名玩家！
在超過 15 種不同的迷你遊戲中抓取、投擲、擊打和擊打，征服不同的變體並解鎖新部件來構建您自己的 Grabitoon！

title: Horned Knight [NSZ][ENG]
description:
啟發自側向滾動的街機經典黃金時代，Horned Knight是一款硬核，復古風格的2D平台遊戲，不需動用你的拳頭。扮演英雄騎士，並用劍去除城堡的鬼怪和潛伏在黑暗大廳各處的不死物。憑藉直觀的控制和類解迷的戰鬥，Horned Knight 鼓勵玩家在慷慨的檢查站和令人振奮的配樂的支持下，去克服獨特像素藝術的難關。

敏捷是關鍵！一小步的失誤就會導致你死在這32個令人脈搏加速的關卡，其中包括從揮舞火球的骷髏頭到毒蛇，尖刺陷阱，熔岩池等等的各種挑戰！嚴緊的操控使你可以輕鬆地跳躍，空中衝刺或砍劈你的前路，但是限時的砍劈或跳躍攀牆等先進技術將需要更大的掌控力！

一定要抓住英雄騎士的心臟，因為他的生命取決於它！克服巨大的首領並尋找未知途徑的秘密，以找到更多的心臟碎片。如果你的健康狀況惡化了，那就回到上一個檢查站，來再一次證明你的價值！

特色：

• 穿越4個獨特世界的32個關卡進行冒險！
• 消滅阻礙你前進的各種強敵。
• 與強大的首領進行激戰，充滿挑戰性和史詩般的規模！
• 在2個難度模式之間進行選擇，以專注於故事或將你的技能發揮到極限。

title: Catacomb Kitties [NSP][ENG]
description:
In a nutshell:
 - A micro RPG with about 2-4 hours of play for each run
 - Randomized worlds, dungeons, and cities
 - A cool personality profile at the end of each game based on your actions during play
 - 6 Kitty classes to choose from! Some are easier to use, some make the game so much harder. Experiment and find out which works best for you. You might be surprised!

The purrfect 8bit RPG with Kittens - There is a Big Bad Evil (tm) that has come to destroy kitten land. A cosmic horror from beyond the litter box wastes. And only one brave hero hears the call, to come forth and put an end to all the suffering across the meowtiverse.  Choose your class, name your kitty, and set off on an adventure!

Be warned, you only have nine lives to live. If they run out, so does your game, and you'll have to start over again with a new kitten, in a new randomly generated world, with a whole new quest to complete.

title: Flying Soldiers [NSP][RUS/Multi7]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 7]
description:
在這個趣味遊戲中，一切都並非你所見那般簡單 – 因為這些「會飛的士兵」連滑翔幾吋都堪稱困難，完全沒有投入戰鬥的能力。所以嘛，由這些「狠角色」組成的部隊沒法從自己惹的亂子裡脫身也就一點不奇怪。他們唯一的希望就是你的戰術能力 – 幫助他們前進吧。

在總數 45 個任務中，這些菜雞必須避開尖刺、陷阱、電網還有火圈 – 而這些不過是眾多危險中的一小部分而已。三種擁有不同技能的鳥兒供你驅策 – 而沒有你的幫助，哪怕最大膽的鳥兒都沒法成功全身而退。

一切就要看地形上有限物件的戰略安排。同時，你還要思考士兵的站位與技能，將他們的移動時機和與對象的互動搭配起來。

title: Half Dead / Half-Dead 3 [NSZ][RUS/Multi18]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 18]
description:
Proshlo neskolko let spustya predydushchego sezona. Ty prosypaeshsya v strannoy komnate so svoimi druzyami i probuesh otkryt dveri, no ne vidish nichego krome pokhozhikh komnat. "Chto za zloveshchiy kompleks?" - sprashivaesh ty sebya. "Kazhetsya, chto eto chya-to shutka!" No s kazhdoy minutoy tebe prikhodit ponimanie, chto zdes vse serezno.  I tebe ne stoit ostavatsya na odnom meste. Vam obyazatelno nuzhno vyzhit. Tak deystvuy. Pomogi sebe i svoim druzyam nayti vykhod. Shou nachinaetsya!

KLYuChEVYE OSOBENNOSTI:

-Multipleernyy kooperativ, Odinochnyy rezhim igry.
-Novyy stil kompleksa komnat.
-Bolee 100 razlichnykh tipov lovushek.
-40 tipov biomov.
-12 konstruktsiy komnat
-Novaya sistema kastomizatsii personazhey
-Mnogourovnevaya sistema etazhey

title: Her Majesty's Spiffing [NSZ][ENG]
description:
In the wake of political developments during the summer of 2016 Britain found itself increasingly isolated from global society. Frustrated by the demise of this once great nation Her Majesty the Queen concluded that the elected representatives at Westminster were no longer fit to govern her United Kingdom.
Establishing S.P.I.F.F.I.N.G. (Special Planetary Investigative Force For Inhabiting New Galaxies) Her Majesty has turned to the stars in a bid to establish a new, Galactic British Empire!
Assuming command of the near futuristic space ship HMSS Imperialise and her crew (distinguished veteran and gentleman Captain Frank Lee English and Aled, his mild-mannered South Walean colleague) YOU will venture into the cosmos, solving puzzles, engaging in witty banter, deal with crippling claustrophobia, gradually succumb to the sustained exposure of cosmic radiation and so on, all for Queen and Country.

title: Luckslinger a Fistful of Fortune [NSZ][ENG]
description:
在狂野的西部，要維持生命就需要很多運氣。幸運的是，在Luckslinger，好運是可以測量的，可收集的並且在你最需要的時候使用。殺掉土匪，偷走他們的運氣，並為自己謀福利。你的運氣越好，越有機會逃過敵人的子彈，你會從一次糟糕的跳躍中獲救，或者更好的戰利品掉在了你的腳下，但是要當心！當你的特殊手鐲沒有太多運氣時，橋樑可能會倒塌，岩石可能會塌落，或者不法分子可能會找到辦法讓你跳起來！

來自不切現實的快槍手，黑暗幽默和貪婪驅使的意大利西部經典作品的啟發，Luckslinger充滿了動感和嬉戲，穿越了堅韌不拔的邊界，並具有獨特的嘻哈風格。塗鴉噴塗，尋找黑膠碟，緩慢的鼓聲和爵士樂的採樣為西部提供了一種現代而又過時的風格。

三葉草鎮被搶劫了！六名臭名昭著的罪犯偷走了該鎮的寶貴運氣，由你決定將其帶回。不過，你不會孤單。除了你的幸運手鐲的功能外，你還將獲得羽毛朋友布治鴨 (Duckbridge) 的幫助，幫助你分散敵人的注意力，並在鴨子告訴他的時候抓住額外的健康物品。得勝並得到黃金的回報，因為賞金獵人是不做慈善工作的！

特色：

• 探索在狂野西部的像素藝術再現。
• 收集運氣並用它來欺騙死亡！
• 享受嘻哈音樂配樂配上現代的義大利式西部風情。
• 從有時可信賴的鴨子同伴獲得幫助。
• 除掉不法分子，從災難中拯救三葉草鎮！

title: Unables [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Dobro pozhalovat v mir, isporchennyy krayney lenyu, gde personazhi nastolko lenivy, chto dazhe igrok ne v sostoyanii imi upravlyat. Vozmite delo v svoi ruki i kontroliruyte okruzhayushchuyu sredu s pomoshchyu nashey innovatsionnoy igrovoy mekhaniki!
Predstavte sebe kazhdyy uroven kak krasivo nakrytyy stol. Ne imeya vozmozhnosti napryamuyu upravlyat personazhami, skhvatite stsenu za eyo nedra i perevernite stol vverkh dnom.
UNABLES soderzhit v sebe svezhie aspekty igrovogo protsessa i dizayna, kotorye vy nikogda ranshe ne videli, a takzhe nekotorye idei, kotorye, veroyatno, videli chasto. Ispolzuyte kachestvennuyu fiziku, chtoby reshat golovolomki i vypolnyat kvesty, otkryvaya vsyo bolee neobychnye urovni i raskryvaya vse sekrety!

title: The Mims Beginning [NSZ][ENG]
description: Experience the mysterious and mystical by taking on a journey with Mims in this strategic god-like video game. Create structures, plant vegetation, breed animals, take care of your minions, use divine PSI powers, triumph in face of natural disasters, fight monsters, predict the future, reveal secrets and so much more. Assume the lead over Mims as they journey across the galaxy in their epic quest!

title: Gastro Force [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Nad kosmicheskimi koloniyami navisla ugroza unichtozheniya: gigantskie prisheltsy iz zagadochnoy tumannosti vtorglis v nashu galaktiku, i ikh edinstvennyy instinkt — pozhirat i perevarivat tselye kosmicheskie korabli!

Vy igraete za poslednego soldata elitnogo otryada Gastro Force, boytsy kotorogo obucheny pronikat v kishechnik chudovishchnykh prisheltsev i srazhatsya s nimi iznutri!

Blagodarya zhertve vashikh tovarishchey vam ostalos unichtozhit lish odno pozhirayushchee kosmicheskie stantsii chudovishche. Vasha missiya — ustanovit bombu, kotoraya vzorvet monstra, no udastsya li vam perezhit ataku beskonechnykh ord...


Osobennosti:
* Prokhodite 30 slozhnykh urovney, propitannykh zheludochnym sokom!
* Ispolzuyte raznoobraznoe oruzhie ot obrezka truby do raketnitsy!
* Sistema uluchsheniya oruzhiya
* Shuter staroy shkoly
* Zakhvatyvayushchie srazheniya s bossami!
* Razgadyvayte tayny zabroshennoy kosmicheskoy stantsii

title: Vera Blanc Full Moon / Ghost In The Castle [NSP][ENG]
description:
Vera Blanc – eto detektivnaya igra, okutannaya taynoy. Glavnyy geroy – Vera Blank, devushka, umeyushchaya chitat mysli. Eta igra – smes vizualnoy novelly i advenchury. V ney vy naydete nabor zamyslovatykh mini-igr, no pri zhelanii ikh mozhno otklyuchit, prevrativ igru v polnotsennuyu vizualnuyu novellu. V etom epizode nasha geroinya otpravlyaetsya v derevushku v tsentralnoy Italii. 

Legendarnyy gorodskoy prizrak schitalsya obyknovennoy prichudlivoy nebylitsey, no proizoshla chereda ubiystv i samoubiystv, ukazyvayushchaya na nalichie v zamke privedeniya, i mestnye nachali boyatsya.

Udastsya li vam razgadat etu taynu? 

Osobennosti
* Vizualnaya novella s neskolkimi kontsovkami
* Vozmozhnost razgadat taynu
* Raznoobrazie mini-igr (no ikh mozhno otklyuchit)
* Vizualnyy stil, vdokhnovlennyy komiksami

title: Her Majesty's Ship [NSZ][ENG]
description:
RISE THROUGH THE RANKS TO FLEET ADMIRAL!
In this resource management game, you Start your career as a Captain on a 3rd rate Ship of the Line, then work your way up to become the next Admiral of the Fleet.The primary objective of the game is to be promoted to Admiral of the Fleet, without having any mutiny nor losing the vessel.
The player will receive tasks from the admiralty which will need to be executed in order to get the desired promotion.

LOOK AFTER YOUR CREW AND PREVENT A MUTINY AT ALL COSTS
The Navy doesn't take lightly to having a crew mutiny onboard one of their vessels, its a career limiting move.Along the way, the player will be challenged with various tasks and tempted with targets of opportunity, whilst keeping the crew happy and not ending with a mutiny.

title: Freeride (试玩版) [NSZ][DEMO][RUS/Multi6]
publisher: Flighty Felon Inc., Future Friends Games
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 6]
description: Perenesites v tainstvennyy Mir Dukhov, kazhdyy iz kotorykh presleduet svoi tseli i imeet svoi motivy. Poka vy, sami togo ne soznavaya, budete prinimat resheniya, kotorye budet diktovat vash kharakter, pered vami budut razvorachivatsya mnogie i mnogie vetki syuzheta. V otdelnye uchastki igry smogut popast tolko lyudi s opredelennymi chertami kharaktera!

title: Space Grunts [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Space Grunts sochetaet v sebe dinamichnuyu arkadnuyu igru s poshagovym igrovym protsessom.

V 2476 godu kosmicheskaya federatsiya Zemli stroila lunnye bazy po vsey galaktike.

Odna iz novykh lunnykh baz posylala signaly bedstviya.
Vy igraete za odnogo iz kosmicheskikh pekhotintsev, komandy «reshateley problem», i vasha missiya - nayti put na lunnuyu bazu i vyyasnit, chto proizoshlo.
Naydite nizhnie urovni lunnoy bazy i doberites do suti problem.

Klyuchevaya osobennost:

- Bystryy, mgnovennyy poshagovyy igrovoy protsess
- Tri unikalnykh klassa pekhotintsev, kazhdyy iz kotorykh imeet unikalnye kharakteristiki, kogda delo kasaetsya ispolzovaniya oruzhiya i predmetov.
- Perma-death i protsedurnaya generatsiya
- Ezhednevnoe ispytanie, novaya missiya so spiskom liderov, otslezhivayushchaya vash progress i vremya

title: Outbreak [NSZ][ENG]
description: Issleduyte koshmarnuyu sredu, ishchite pripasy i srazhaytes s nezhityu v Outbreak - khardkornoy igre uzhasov na vyzhivanie. Chasy nikogda ne ostanavlivayutsya, kogda vy pytaetes upravlyat chrezvychayno ogranichennym inventarem s ordami ubiyts na okhote. Vybirayte mezhdu priobreteniem dopolnitelnogo oruzhiya, lechebnykh predmetov ili neobkhodimymi instrumentami dlya prodvizheniya. Igrayte v rezhimakh kampanii i natiska v odinochku ili s drugom v lokalnom kooperativnom rezhime, vklyuchaya vozmozhnost dlya tovarishchey po komande AI. Takzhe ispytayte malenkie vinetki uzhasov vyzhivshikh v rezhime Koshmarov. U tebya tolko odna zhizn. Sdelayte eto v schet!

title: Planet RIX-13 [NSP][RUS/ENG]
description:
Vy – pilot kosmicheskogo korablya, kotoryy ishchet i izuchaet miry, potentsialno prigodnye dlya zhizni. K sozhaleniyu, skanirovanie ocherednoy planety poshlo ne po planu. Korabl poteryal upravlenie, i vy byli vynuzhdeny sovershit avariynuyu posadku. Krome togo, bystro stalo yasno, chto vy daleko ne pervyy chelovek, pobyvavshiy na etoy planete…

Vam predstoit izuchit ruiny davno pogibshey tsivilizatsii i zabroshennye laboratorii issledovateley, okazavshikhsya na etoy planete ranshe vas. Izbegayte smertelnykh opasnostey, izuchayte mestnuyu floru, borites s gallyutsinatsiyami i naydite sposob ustranit prichinu avarii. Sdelayte vse vozmozhnoe, chtoby pokinut etu planetu i vernutsya domoy!

Osobennosti:
- Zagadochnaya planeta, polnaya sekretov i lovushek
- Mnozhestvo razlichnykh sposobov umeret
- Dve kontsovki

title: nx-VVVVVV + 170 kastomnykh urovney + redaktor [NSZ][ENG]
description: V etoy igre vy budete khodit po potolku i smotret v pol. VVVVVV — eto neobychnyy dvukhmernyy platformer s odnoy obmanchivo prostoy osobennostyu. Kapitan Viridian ne mozhet prygat, poetomu emu pridetsya manipulirovat gravitatsiey, chtoby proyti sotni komnat i po puti razgadyvat golovolomki.

title: Red Siren: Space Defense [NSP][ENG]
description:
My v 2138 godu, syrevye resursy Zemli ischerpany. Pri podderzhke grazhdanskogo obshchestva chastnye kompanii kolonizirovali sosednie planety dlya ispolzovaniya prirodnykh resursov. Tak kak dobyvayushchie tekhnologii dostupny ne vsem, mnogie organizuyut gruppy, chtoby vorovat iskopaemye s planet. Chtoby borotsya s reyderami, organizatsiya Exacorp sozdala otryad Red Siren. Vy - novobranets Red Siren, i vam neobkhodimo zashchishchat bazy i srazhatsya s reyderami, kotorye stremyatsya k pobede lyuboy tsenoy...

Red Siren: Space Defense - eto kosmicheskaya voennaya igra s fantasticheskimi robotami, mashinami, korablyami i boevymi sooruzheniyami! Naslazhdaytes velikolepnoy grafikoy, realistichnymi spetseffektami, zakhvatyvayushchimi poedinkami i neprostymi missiyami! Otkroyte chudesnye planety, zashchishchayte stroyashchiesya bazy, unichtozhayte robotov vragov! Proydite vse urovni v chetyrekh razlichnykh mirakh, poprobuyte vse korabli i oruzhie i prevratite ikh v nastoyashchikh razrushiteley robotov! Postaraytes sokrushit vsekh svoikh vragov kak mozhno bystree, vypolnyayte missii, chtoby poluchit nagrady! V etoy kosmicheskoy voyne vam predstoit srazhatsya protiv mashin, nazemnykh i letayushchikh robotov, voinstvennykh planet i mnozhestva drugikh vragov s razlichnym oruzhiem i snaryadami! Zapoluchite vse korabli i boepripasy i uluchshite ikh, chtoby sravnyat vraga s zemley!

title: What Comes After [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Ot sozdatelya Coffee Talk, v sotrudnichestve s Rolling Glory Jam sozdatel Rage in Peace.

What Comes After - eto opyt, trogatelnaya istoriya i lyubovnoe pismo, adresovannoe vsem, kto schitaet vas obuzoy dlya drugikh lyudey.

Pomogite Vivi proyti cherez puteshestvie, kotoroe vedet ee tuda, kuda lyudi idut posle smerti, k tomu, chto prikhodit posle. Prokatites na poezde, napolnennom dushami lyudey, zhivotnykh i rasteniy, kotorye nakhodyatsya na puti, chtoby pokinut etot mir, i pogovorit s nimi, chtoby uznat o lyubvi, sozhaleniyakh, zhizni i smerti, kotorye presleduyut nas kazhdyy den, poka ne pridet nashe vremya. Vse eto predstavleno v bezzabotnoy manere s kropleniem komedii i filosofii.

Osobennosti:
- Korotkaya serdechnaya istoriya, kotoraya ostanetsya v vashem serdtse i pamyati.
- Lichnoe puteshestvie, chtoby nauchitsya lyubit sebya
- Skazka, napolnennaya lyubovyu i komediey...
- Krasochnoe iskusstvo, chtoby soprovozhdat vashe puteshestvie v poezde ne svyazannyy s zhivoy
- Legkiy v ponimanii geympley

title: Self [NSZ][ENG]
description:
《SELF 自己》是一款充滿懸疑氛圍的文字冒險遊戲。

遊戲雖然以文字劇情為主線，但也加入了許多超越文字的解謎與挑戰內容，這些謎題挑戰與劇情休戚相關，玩家需要通過收集主人公遺失的記憶碎片，逐步揭開主人公內心的秘密，一點一點還原整個故事的全貌。

我的爸爸悄然失蹤，但是周圍的人，甚至連媽媽，都對爸爸的失蹤無動於衷，我不得不走上獨自尋父的道路。

在尋父過程中，我遭遇黑幫追捕，遇到了形形色色奇怪的人，身邊發生的事情也越來越光怪陸離。我一點一點走入爸爸的世界，深埋自己心底的秘密也逐漸浮出水面。

在遊戲中，玩家在不同的劇情節點做出不同的選擇。這個遊戲裏除了你自己沒有任何人，你可以選擇面對，也可以選擇逃避。每一個選擇，每一個行動，都會稍稍改變故事的走向。

- 整個遊戲都發生在一臺復古顯示器中。
- 獨特而充滿感染力的演出。
- 簡潔的像素風線條畫。
- 細致而恰到好處的配樂與音效。
- 內置原聲音軌播放器。
- 碎片敘事，通過多個獨立結局拼湊來慢慢了解迷離的劇情。

title: Evolings [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
★ 隨機地圖探索：
在《Evolings》中，每一次闖關都會產生一個全新的關卡地圖，準備好讓你迎接無盡的刺激！你可以發掘獨特的進化生物，獲取稀有物品，參加驚心動魄的戰鬥，創造難忘的旅程。沒有兩場冒險會相同，保證你每次都能獲得無限的驚喜與驚險刺激的體驗！

★史詩級的回合制RPG戰鬥：
展現出你的戰略天分，組建一支強大的隊伍來對抗邪惡的進化生物吧！然後讓可愛與暴力完美結合，投入令人興奮的回合制戰鬥之中！指揮好你的小隊，展示出你的戰略天分，想辦法在史詩般的戰鬥中拿下勝利！

★無限的世界正等待著你：
踏上三段截然不同的旅程吧！每一段旅程都充滿了獨特的進化生物、超凡的道具以及令人著迷的關卡內容。做好準備吧！你即將體會到一場沒有暫停的動作冒險，沉浸在精美的點陣圖藝術、可愛的場景與迷人的8-bit音樂中，讓你的戰鬥之心徹底燃燒起來！

★揭開進化圖鑑的秘密：
掌握進化圖鑑的知識之力吧！進化圖鑑是一本很詳細的百科全書，收錄了你遇見的所有進化生物。無論是閃亮亮的進化生物、超級閃亮亮的進化生物、還是夢幻彩虹版的進化生物都有，持續將你的發現記入其中吧。你還可深入了解他們那些有趣的介紹，揭開他們隱藏的特徵與能力，成為這些迷人生物的真正主人！你有本事抓住這些可愛的小傢伙嗎？

★榮耀殿堂中的永恆榮光：
只有征服所有三種冒險的最強玩家才能在頗具盛名的榮耀殿堂中享有一席之地。將你獲勝團隊的成就永遠載入史冊，讓天下人都能看見，並為你慶賀取得了進化生物能擁有的最高榮譽！你也可以與朋友分享你的策略，激起熱烈的討論，也許還能夠讓那些尚未沐浴勝利光輝的人感到羨慕又嫉妒！

title: Biolab Wars [NSZ][ENG]
Cadavers for Dinner (屍喰らいの冒険メシ / Shikabanegurai no Boukenmeshi) [NSZ][JAP]
description:
Rolevaya videoigra o vyzhivanii v podzemelyakh, razrabotannaya i izdannaya Nippon Ichi Software. Sobirayte ingredienty i materialy v katakombakh, kishashchikh monstrami, gotovte edu i vyzhivayte dostatochno dolgo, chtoby nayti svoy put pod zemley.
Poedanie paykov ukrepit kharakter; a monstrov mozhno oslabit gnilymi ochistkami. Klyuch k uspekhu zaklyuchaetsya v tom, kak verno vy raspredelite svoyu proviziyu!
Seshte chto ugodno, lish by vybratsya otsyuda!..

title: Shinrai Broken Beyond Despair [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Gruppa iz desyati druzey sobiraetsya na uedinennom gornom kurorte, chtoby vmeste provesti noch v kanun Vsekh Svyatykh.

Odnako to, chto iznachalno zadumyvalos kak veselaya vecherinka na Khellouin, bystro prevrashchaetsya v nastoyashchuyu noch uzhasov. Kogda odnogo iz uchastnikov nakhodyat mertvym, sredi gruppy rasprostranyayutsya strakh i podozritelnost, poskolku druzya ponimayut, chto oni poymany v lovushku vmeste s ubiytsey.

Rassleduyte, doprashivayte i predstavlyayte dokazatelstva, razgadyvaya razlichnye tayny v techenie nochi.

Mozhet byt, vam dazhe udastsya spasti zhizn! Ili vashi vyvody zastavyat vas obvinit kogo-to sovershenno nevinovnogo...?

Kharakteristiki:
* Zagadochnyy vizualnyy roman na 150 000 slov
* 5 razlichnykh kontsovok, v tom chisle 4 plokhikh i 1 s istinnym vinovnikom
* Bloknot s ulikami, chtoby otslezhivat fakty po delu
* Detektivnaya sistema ranzhirovaniya
* Razblokiruemyy bonusnyy kontent
* Originalnyy saundtrek

title: Esports Life Tycoon [NSZ][ENG]
description:
SOZDAYTE SVOYu KIBERSPORTIVNUYu KOMANDU
Produmayte vse do melochey po svoemu vkusu: sozdayte gerb, sproektiruyte kibersportivnoe snaryazhenie, sozdayte avatar i igrokov s nulya... Soberite komandu svoey mechty i srazhaytes za pobedu v chempionate!

PODPIShITE KONTRAKT S LUChShIMI ZVEZDAMI
Pervoklassnoy komande nuzhny pervoklassnye igroki. Esli vy deystvitelno khotite stat velichayshim menedzherom v istorii, vashey komande nuzhny zvezdy. Nanimayte perspektivnykh igrokov i ubezhdayte deystvuyushchikh chempionov prisoedinitsya k vashey komande. I esli kto-to iz nikh podvedet... Vam predstoit prinyat reshenie: ostavit ikh v komande ili iskat zamenu. Nikto ne govoril, chto stat chempionom budet legko. 

TRENIRUYTE IGROKOV I ZABOTTES OB IKh ZDOROVE 
Superzvezdy ne poyavlyayutsya niotkuda: dazhe samym talantlivym igrokam nuzhno mnogo truditsya, chtoby razvivat svoi navyki! Vyrashchivayte chempionov, ukreplyayte komandnyy dukh, nablyudayte za sopernikami... I ne propuskayte zavtrak! V kontse kontsov, luchshie komandy — ne prosto kuchki igrokov, a slazhennoe vzaimodeystvie (i pravilnyy obraz zhizni) — to, chto otlichaet khoroshuyu komandu ot deystvitelno velikoy.

OT EDINITs K MILLIONAM…
Vyigryshnye matchi privlekut bolshe poklonnikov, uvelichat dokhod i otkroyut novye vozmozhnosti! Uluchshayte svoy igrovoy dom i otkroyte dlya sebya zhizn superzvezdy. Psikhologi, trenery, menedzhery po marketingu... Professionaly svoego dela prisoedinyatsya k vam na vashem puti k slave!

STANTE LEGENDOY SPORTAOtsenite rezultaty vashikh tyazhelykh trenirovok, sorevnuyas s professionalnymi kibersportivnymi komandami. Reshite, stanete li vy nablyudatelem matcha ili budete rukovodit komandoy, gotovit chempionov i prinimat resheniya v rezhime realnogo vremeni vo vremya simulirovannykh kibersportivnykh matchey. I pomnite: uspekh prinadlezhit vashim igrokam, no za neudachi otvechaet trener.

title: This is the Zodiac Speaking [NSZ][ENG]
description:
This is The Zodiac Speaking - eto osnovannyy na faktakh psikhologicheskiy triller dlya odnogo igroka, sozdannyy na osnovanii istorii Zodiaka, odnogo iz samykh izvestnykh, nikogda ne poymannykh seriynykh ubiyts. On sochetaet v sebe klassicheskie vidy iz Kalifornii 70-kh godov s originalnym epicheskim saundtrekom i igrovymi elementami, vklyuchayushchimi klassicheskiy uzhas, rassledovanie, mekhaniku podkradyvaniya i razlichnye okonchaniya, kotorye mozhno otkryt.

SYGRAYTE V THIS IS THE ZODIAC SPEAKING I:

    • Ispytayte istoriyu s tochki zreniya vyzhivshego v napadenii seriynogo ubiytsy, spravtes s travmoy i provedite rassledovanie, kotoroe privedet vas k istine Zodiaka
    • Otkroyte dlya sebya detali, svyazannye s ubiystvami, posetite mesta, vdokhnovlennye originalnymi stsenami prestupleniya, ispytayte nastoyashchie seansy terapii, kotorye pomogut vam spravitsya s travmoy
    • Otkroyte dlya sebya tri raznykh zaversheniya, kazhdoe iz kotorykh prodiktovano vashimi resheniyami pri rassledovanii.
    • Poluchayte udovolstvie ot atmosfernoy muzyki iz filmov i originalnoy grafiki v stile retro.
    • Posetite zolotye 70-e gody i pochuvstvuyte staromodnyy stil pri poseshchenii samykh izvestnykh mest v Kalifornii.

title: Hamster on Rails [NSZ][ENG]
description:
在《鐵軌上的倉鼠》中，你將加入最優秀、最勇敢的鐵路建造師，展開一場驚奇的旅程，尋找寶貴的礦石，拯救心愛的倉鼠村。穿越四個引人入勝的世界，包括森林、沙漠，甚至中世紀時代，總共有64個具有挑戰性的關卡。

快來看看《鐵軌上的倉鼠》的主要特點：

使用不同的部件建造鐵路，克服障礙解決有趣的挑戰。使用槓桿改變軌道的方向，按鈕來啟動或停用不同的機制，如門和陷阱。
在旅途中幫助朋友，找到隱藏的寶箱，並獲得新的造型。將你的倉鼠打扮成草莓、條紋，甚至有牛斑點。
有著可愛角色的《鐵軌上的倉鼠》是一款有趣而具有挑戰性的解謎遊戲，將考驗你的技巧。你的倉鼠將有多種互動方式，如建造模式、互動模式、X光和加速。
加入這個冒險，享受建造非凡的鐵路、幫助其他倉鼠朋友、定制你的英雄，並拯救倉鼠村！

title: White Wings [NSZ][ENG]
description:
角色立繪和CG使用了E-mote動畫系統。
呼吸、眨眼、說話，栩栩如生。
并且，收錄了由茶太、逢瀬アキラ演唱的主題曲！
所有角色，全日語配音。

這是一首苦澀的冬季戀歌。

支離破碎的家庭，
遭遇霸淩的經歷，
笑容背後的眼淚。

初戀的味道究竟是甜蜜還是苦澀？誰會得到救贖，誰會走向深淵？
被吸引、被離間、被分開、被傷害。

少年與少女，三個人的相遇，各自背負著辛酸的秘密在寒冷的季節裡，互相擁抱著，汲取著世界上最後的、小小的溫暖。

OP主題歌「Pure White」
歌：茶太
作編曲：Meis Clauson
作詞：茶太

ED主題歌「Guilty Snow」
作曲/作詞/歌：逢瀬アキラ
編曲：藤神敬也

title: The Big Con Grift of the Year edition [NSZ][ENG]
description: Hustle your way across the ‘90s as a runaway teen con artist. Choose how to make your scratch as you don disguises, pick pockets, and rip people off in this comedic crime-filled adventure.

title: Wetory [NSZ][ENG]
description:
被世界拋棄的孩子
在壞蛋搶走這世界上所有顏色後
意識到從自己腳上流出的顏料擁有可以打倒壞蛋的力量。
一起去冒險，找回被壞蛋搶走的顏色吧！

title: ReTouring (Re Touring) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Re:Touring是一個第一人稱的拼圖遊戲，您將探索被遺棄的Luoni Energy能力中心，並揭示該設施的歷史，通過總共26個各式各樣的關卡。使用復古風格的電腦，您將創建顏色模式來控制如門，平台和激光等元素。每一個機制都被仔細介紹，使遊戲對每個人都容易上手。

跳出框框思考。
除了熟悉的拼圖元素外，遊戲的核心是生成顏色模式的復古電腦。雖然一開始您只創建簡單的模式，例如開門，在後面的遊戲中，您將同時自動化許多元素以穿越關卡。

讓我們開始冒險。
通過每個拼圖之間的環境敘事，探索被遺棄的Luoni Energy能力中心，並揭露Luoni Energy及其動機的歷史。

可及性。
除了適用於視覺障礙的不同色板和描述音頻的封閉式字幕外，還有一個提示系統，可以提供當前拼圖的線索或完全解決它。

title: Rift Racoon [NSP][ENG]
description:
你是扮演一隻叫塔克（Tucker）的兇猛浣熊，請做好準備，他具有特殊的能力-瞬間移動！塔克需要你的幫助去找回家的路，並逃脫那些緊纏著的神秘機器人。他的爪子可以爬上牆壁，越過陷阱和尖峰，用瞬間移動穿越障礙物，以跨越50個手工製作的關卡。

塔克也許很可愛，但他所面對的挑戰也不少。這些充滿危險的關卡，將挑戰最優秀的平台愛好者！控制是易於上手，但難於精通。每次失敗時，你都會從之前的錯誤中吸取教訓，並迅速再次行動。你有能力讓塔克活著過關嗎？

特色：

• 掌握精準的控制方法。
• 瞬間移動以穿越巨大的縫隙和陷阱，甚至穿過牆壁！
• 享受經典遊戲和動畫啟發的復古視覺效果。
• 10首充滿節奏感的獨特音樂！
• 發現隱藏在50個關卡中的鑽石，為塔克解鎖新顏色。

title: Rifter [NSZ][ENG]
description: Rifter is a logic based game in which you need to complete all the levels using a duplication ability. Use the rift sword to create a copy that if touched will destroy you! Be clever and work out the levels in this cool platformer!

title: Star Sky [NSP][ENG]
description:
Star Sky – eto unikalnaya i ochen priyatnaya igra. S momenta, kogda vy nachinaete igru, vy stanovites rasskazchikom netoroplivoy istorii, kotoraya raskryvaetsya s kazhdym vashim shagom. Esli vy budete toropitsya poskoree zavershit igru, to propustite mnogochislennye sekrety i taynye vybory, vpletyonnye v etot interesnyy mir: zdes vam potrebuetsya terpenie. Audiosignaly i vizualnye effekty dadut vam znat o momente nachala volshebstva. Ne propustite!

Spokoynoy nochi, i puskay vy naydyote to, chto ishchete pod zvyozdami.

title: Super UFO Fighter [NSZ][ENG]
description:
在銀河系中非常流行的宇宙運動 “SUPER UFO FIGHTER”。
乘坐飛碟的選手、今天也將展開超現實戰鬥！

◆爭奪物品，1vs1的對戰動作遊戲！
勝利的條件是將成為“目標”的東西丢進自己的目標。
用引力吸上去，比對方更早帶回“目標”！
控制輕飄飄的東西移動，是為勝利的關鍵！
你爭我奪，丟來丟去，互相攻擊…
為勝利不擇手段的白熱化戰鬥！
靈活運用各種機關和特殊道具，來爭取勝利！

◆一個人也好，兩個人也好，線上也好！
通過Joy-Con™分開玩的本地戰鬥自不必說，還搭載了兩種線上模式，可以和各地的玩家戰鬥。

◆其他還有很多
還有助於熟悉戰鬥的訓練模式，可以看到蒐集成果的收藏模式！

title: Crashnauts [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Crashnauts is a hard-hitting 2D Arena Shooter for 1-6 players. Crush your enemies with your Crashpod or obliterate them with an array of satisfying weaponry. Simple at first but boasting deep mechanics, Crashnauts delivers fun for players of any skill level!

- Crash with friends in local PvP and with CPU players!
- Gib your enemies with beloved weapons such as rocket and rail guns, and new entries like the Crackshot!
- 4 Races to choose from with a plethora, yes, plethora of customizations!
- Play on scrolling maps that keep you on your toes.
- Respawn on your enemies with a devastating crash pod that rockets down from outer space!
- Tight and responsive gameplay.
- Get hundreds of headshots

title: Hell's High Harmonizers [NSZ][ENG]
description:
地獄是一個死人居住的地方。
居民們總是忙於清除他們的罪孽，反思他們的罪孽，懈怠和反叛。
你成為一名 "調和者"，一名地獄的官員，為你被分配到的69371區的和平而工作。有時你會與居民協商，有時你會與他們合作，你會儘情地享受地獄的生活。

◆人物妝容
人類或無機物，什麼都可以! 自由而獨特的角色化妝!

◆探索
選擇你的角色，探索地獄! 陷阱、敵人和美妙的寶藏等著你!

◆獨特的居民!
人、蜥蜴、骨頭和機器？地獄的居民在外觀和環境上都是多種多樣的。

title: Golfinite [NSZ][ENG]
description:
開始您的職業高爾夫球手生涯。參加培訓課程，磨練你的技能，展示你的天賦，以獲得參加比賽的資格，讓你取得成功。

真正的高爾夫機械師
高爾夫球杆的類型、風的角度、速度和方向，甚至表面。這些只是接近拍攝時要考慮的幾個重要因素。此外，您需要仔細檢查高爾夫球場的佈局。請記住，從裝滿沙子的沙坑中擊球是具有挑戰性的，當球落在水中時，您必須從最後一個已知位置擊球。

不同的地點
參觀原始松樹，塵土飛揚的沙丘，大樹林和寧靜的天空。這些地圖中的每一張都有獨特的障礙物，如蠍子和陣風，它們會試圖阻止或摧毀你的高爾夫球。要想在地圖上取得進展，你需要在每張地圖上贏得一場錦標賽，在排行榜上排名前三。

title: Stardash [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Not just the looks of a classic game, also the gameplay of a classic platformer. This game is NOT EASY! you have an endless amount of lives, so you can quickly restart a level when you miss a jump, get hit by an enemy, get bitten by a plant, get hit by a spiky-ball, crushed by big statues, run onto spikes, get hit by a wasp, or any of the other many ways you'll get stopped in your run.


BUT when you do complete a level, the rush you get will keep you coming back for more, and more, and more, and.. 

Unlock special temple levels by finding hidden keys, unlock a flip-mode by completing a level both within the time set, and also by collecting all the coins in a level.

Stardash is all about the gameplay thrown at you in awesome retro graphics and original chiptunes.

title: Dolmenjord Viking Islands [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
邏輯和組織解謎

經過多年的戰鬥，一群維京人決定是時候征服新的土地了。在神祇 Njord 的保護下，一個專門從事導航的新部落啟程尋求榮耀！

遊戲玩法

《多爾門約》是一款靈感源自北歐神話的遊戲，維京人需要幫助來組織他們的村莊，從而解決謎題，並征服新的土地。

根據以下規則設置每個村莊：

- 放置所有可用的房屋和人行道板塊。
- 每棟房屋必須面向人行道。
- 完整的人行道必須通往港口。

最早的島嶼中，解謎相對簡單，但隨著您的探險進展，挑戰也會增加。如果您更傾向於輕鬆的旅程，那也沒問題！

您可以隨時在選項菜單中啟用休閒模式。將會有一個提示按鈕。
選擇後，它會顯示出人行道的建議形狀。

title: Gun Crazy [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Gun Crazy - eto dinamichnaya arkadnaya igra-strelyalka v zhanre ekshn, otdayushchaya dan klassicheskoy staroy shkole!

Stan samoy zhestokoy damoy v politsii! Srazhaysya s plokhimi parnyami na 4 unikalnykh urovnyakh, napolnennykh slozhnymi bossami i moshchnym spetsialnym oruzhiem.

Kharakteristiki:
 * Proydi 4 urovnya s unikalnym dizaynom
 * Srazhaysya s bossami, kazhdyy iz kotorykh – otdelnyy vyzov
 * Podbiray spetsialnoe oruzhie, kotoroe privedet tebya k pobede
 *  Zhestkoe upravlenie pozvolyaet legko igrat, chtoby pobedit vragov

title: Plan B from Outer Space a Bavarian Odyssey [NSZ][ENG]
description:
《Plan B from Outer Space》是以經典的科幻故事和巴伐利亞文化為藍本，以互動書籍為形式的星際冒險遊戲。設計自己的外星人，在這段獨特的科幻喜劇文本冒險中，嘗試從「巴瓦利人」的魔掌中逃脫。你的每個決策都會影響任務的結果；是毫髮無傷地離開這個奇怪的星球... 還是要選擇「計畫B」？

遊戲內容

這是一個致敬：《Plan B from Outer Space》是對經典科幻和巴伐利亞文化的致敬，擁有注重劇情的冒險和多種精心繪製的美妙背景和動態角色。

阿爾卑斯對戰外星人：設計擁有獨特背景故事、屬於你自己的外星人，做好準備，去將小小的巴伐利亞小鎮「Unter-Hinterobersbach」掀個底朝天。

每個選擇都很重要：作出的每個選擇都會對劇情產生持久的影響。你要做一個善良的星際旅行者、殘忍的征服者... 還是與這些完全不同的存在？

再來一關：將你的外星人腦子投入檢驗，這裡有一系列精選小遊戲與裝備物品，它們都會對劇情和選擇選項造成影響。

白金外星人：解鎖19個結局，填滿飛船中的獎盃房間；沿途還會發現歡樂的種種彩蛋。

title: Unimime Unicycle Madness [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Unimime 是一款有趣但不太容易掌握的基於物理的平衡遊戲。

作為一個簡單的啞劇演員開始你的冒險，幾乎無法保持直立。掌握獨輪車的藝術，並在危險的平坦表面、最小的坡度和袖珍本大小的板條箱中冒險！

我聽到蹺蹺板、跳躍和彈射的聲音了嗎？你很快就會把它弄下來的。好吧，也許晚一點。或者也許不久之後。哦，親愛的，請不要恨我們。

期待 90 個手工設計的關卡、可解鎖的角色，以及一款難以精通但也難以放下的遊戲。

祝你好運，你會需要它的。

title: Super Planet Life [NSZ][ENG]
description:
在宇宙不同角落尋找新同伴，讓你成為一片樂土。在過程中，你需要管理星球資源，不斷升級不同工具。

潛入自己星球的地核 (!!!)，開展地下城戰鬥，讓神秘的宇宙神明對你另眼相看。

整場太空冒險共有三節，有豐富的故事、刺激的歷險旅程和精彩的遊戲角色。

說到遊戲場景，玩法就多不勝數 — 惡貫滿盈的地下城、幽靈交易所、牌組構築戰鬥、惡靈問答遊戲等等！

提供其他強勁功能，包括收集不同成就、加入更多音樂和全新獎勵。

title: Diabolic [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
Pixelbot Extreme [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Retro-ekshn-platformer s bokovoy prokrutkoy i krasochnymi povorotami! Stante edinym tselym so svoimi dzhoykonami, vyuchite naizust vse tsveta raket i osvoyte strelbu na osnove tsveta! I samoe glavnoe... Nikogda Ne Sdavaytes!
Chto zhe delaet Pixelbot osobennym?..

title: Shalnor Legends Sacred Lands [NSP][ENG]
description:
On a quest to prove herself to the goddess Illeria and becoming her champion, the young Elf Rynna has ventured into the Sacred Lands. This beautiful yet treacherous place can only be left by finishing the trial designed by the goddess herself.

While exploring the nine zones, Rynna will encounter many wanderers who came before her. Some are already dead, with their ghosts lingering about, while others have survived and set up shop to assist anyone brave enough to finish the trial.

The trial of the Sacred Lands is not a simple one. Our heroine must venture into dark dungeons, solve puzzles, and battle ancient horrors. If she succeeds, she will not only become Illeria's champion but she will also free all others trapped in the Sacred Lands..


Features:
- Explore 9 large zones and caves.
- Upgrade your gear by talking to the inhabitants of the land.
- Craft Potions and Elixirs.
- Find Artifact Orbs to permanently increase your stats.
- Venture into dark dungeons and face ancient bosses.
- Discover Lore Books to better understand the world of Shalnor.
- Encounter many enemies, puzzles, and traps.

title: Roller Katz BF, Episode 1 [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Our protagonist is Diana Katz, a child prodigy who invented a robot with unique qualities. Kiara is a robot capable of jumping, skating, rolling, and destroying everything in her path. With these abilities she will keep the peace safe in Clean City.

Roller Katz gameplay mixes the genre of platforms with high speed, skating and different gadgets with which to defeat your enemies.

The long levels have multiple paths full of surprises, places to skate, bars over which to grind, rivers to jump over, etc. All this accompanied by enemies who will try put an end to the adventures of our partner Kiara.

- Skating, grind, jump and do tricks!
- Fight, use weapons and destroy your enemies.
- Dynamism, speed and fun.
- A big world with different paths to explore.
- Anime style cinematics.
- 3D gameplay graphics.

This is the first episode of Roller Katz: BF.

title: The Wizard and The Slug [NSP][ENG]
description:
Beglyy volshebnik vstrechaet lesnogo sliznyaka, i zarozhdaetsya strannaya druzhba.

Vmeste eti iskateli priklyucheniy puteshestvuyut po strannomu fenteziynomu miru, razgadyvaya taynu drevnego proklyatiya.

Igrayte za samogo bystrogo i provornogo sliznyaka v istorii videoigr vmeste s naparnikom-volshebnikom. Prygayte, mchites i strelyayte v etom 2D-platformere s unikalnoy sistemoy zdorovya i vspomogatelnym rezhimom so spetsialnymi vozmozhnostyami.

Uvlekatelnyy platformennyy geympley etoy igry sochetaetsya s prichudlivoy i nelepoy istoriey, v kotoroy kruto zameshany vesele i epichnost.


KhARAKTERISTIKI
* Prisoedinites k volshebniku i sliznyaku v grandioznom priklyuchenii
* Platformennyy geympley
* 3-aktnaya istoriya s neskolkimi kontsovkami
* Unikalnaya sistema zdorovya
* Spetsialnye vozmozhnosti
* Dlitelnyy originalnyy saundtrek

title: Xanchuchamel [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Xanchuchamel 是一款解謎平台遊戲，你需要技巧，還需要智慧來克服每一個挑戰。Xanchuchamel可以捕捉方塊並將它們放置在不同的地方以進入新區域。50個關卡等著你！

Xanchuchamel是一款老式的益智平台遊戲，就像90年代的那些遊戲一樣，重要的是玩得開心。在Xanchuchamel中，您需要在平臺上的技能，這是真的，但在此之前，您必須將它們放置在正確的位置。
遊戲機制很簡單。Xanchuchamel不僅能夠移動和跳躍，而且還可以抓住他觸手可及的特殊塊。之後，可以將該塊放置在另一個位置，以便您可以跳上它並向前移動。
但這僅僅是個開始。當注入三種運動動力之一時，一些特殊的塊可以成為移動平臺：水平、垂直或對角線。Xanchuchamel可以從另一個已經在行動的塊或電源獲得這些能量。
等等，因為還有更多。除了移動塊，Xanchuchamel還可以使用其他不同的特殊塊。它們中的每一個都有不同的特徵，因此您必須使用所有神經元才能成功使用它們。
Xanchuchamel專為每個人按照自己的節奏演奏而設計。如果您只想擔心完成關卡，則可以這樣做。即使您陷入了困難之一（還有一些），您也可以跳過它並繼續在遊戲中前進。另一方面，如果您是想要更多挑戰的人之一，您可以嘗試以最高分完成每個級別，即帶喇叭的杯子。為此，您需要在時鐘低於 100% 之前到達關卡的終點。不僅如此。如果你想獲得完美的關卡，你還需要找到隱藏在每個階段的三個獎章。
Xanchuchamel由5個不同的世界組成，每個世界包含10個級別。一開始，你只能在第一個世界中玩，其餘的將被鎖定。但是在Xanchuchamel中，解鎖關卡的方式和往常一樣：玩。在每個關卡的末尾，你會發現一個力量球。隨著你得到的越來越多，新的世界和新的關卡將被解鎖。
除了每個關卡中的力量球外，遊戲中還隱藏著更多的力量球。但獲得它們並不容易。首先，您必須在遊戲的某些關卡中找到隱藏（並且非常隱藏）的獎勵獎章之一。找到這些獎章之一只是第一步：通過觸摸一個，Xanchuchamel必須克服與時間的挑戰才能獲得寶珠。

title: Geojelly [NSZ][ENG]
description:
幾何果凍 (GeoJelly) 是一款具有挑戰性的平台遊戲，您可以在其中扮演出生在未知反烏托邦實驗室中的實驗缺陷。 你的目標是找到離開實驗室的路，通過克服各種障礙和收集鑽石獲得自由。 該遊戲混合了平台和解謎元素，沿途需要避開許多障礙。

環境充滿挑戰，包括大砲、長釘、跳台和風車。 玩家在採取行動之前必須非常小心並三思而後行，因為一個錯誤的步驟可能會使他們回到關卡的開頭。 遊戲還設有各種邏輯謎題，將挑戰玩家解決問題的能力並測試他們的敏捷性。

收集鑽石是解鎖下一關並在遊戲中取得進展的關鍵。 玩家有機會通過掌握平台元素並利用他們的快速反應來克服障礙，成為熟練的導航員。 要在遊戲中跳躍，玩家需要按住跳躍按鈕為跳躍蓄力，然後鬆開跳躍。 這為平台元素增加了額外的控制層和精確度。

幾何果凍 (GeoJelly) 是一款需要技巧、耐心和策略的遊戲，對於所有技能水平的玩家來說都是一種激動人心的體驗。

title: Towertale [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Towertale is a 2D, story-driven action game that has a heavy focus on boss battles. Fight your way up the elusive Tower and challenge the bosses of each level. Unveil the mystery that lies up in its peak. Play four different stories and unlock multiple endings. Join Lionel, Faindrel, Lord Snicklefritz and "Dark Echo" in their quest to get to the top!

The Tower is known to have been created by an ancient being. Legends say that whoever defeats all of the guardians and get to the top will have the right to be granted the ultimate wish - "The ability to change one's fate". In the past 100 years, many have tried and never been heard from ever again. Until one day, four brave souls came forth and challenged their fate.

FEATURES:
- Fast-paced 2D boss battling action.
- 4 Playable Characters, many different ways to play.
- 17 Fightable bosses designed with multiple phases.
- 12 beautifully-crafted levels.
- 25+ CGs that are used for the storyline.
- 34+ Music tracks from bosses, characters and story themes.
- Over 120+ story in game cutscenes.
- Multiple story endings.
- Arcade Mode for those who want to play the tower but not the tale!
- Boss rush mode
- Freemode that enables you to fight the bosses at your own pace and difficulty.
- Full controller support + rebindable controls.

title: Backworlds [NSP][ENG]
description:
Move between two parallel worlds, each with its own unique set of properties, using your brush to flow seamlessly from one to the other. Solve environmental conundrums by using your own creativity to craft original solutions to the game’s puzzles. 

Features 

• Unique painting puzzle mechanic - let creativity flow in your solutions 
• Non-linear - choose your own path to explore and play 
• 4 distinct worlds - each with their own atmosphere and mechanics 
• Boss levels and secrets 
• Beautiful soundtrack by BAFTA nominated composer David Housden 
• Unleash your creativity with new touch screen support 
• Control your brush with the built-in gyroscope

title: DingDong (Ding Dong) [NSZ][ENG (Mod.)/JAP]
description:
Vesyolaya igra v 3D-salochki!
Ponachalu u vas net drugogo vybora, krome kak bezhat, no esli vy soberyote vse dragotsennye kamni, poluchite usilenie, i situatsiya v korne izmenitsya! Presleduyte vraga i lovite ikh vsyo bolshe i bolshe! Po istechenii vremeni vklyucheniya vozvrashchaetes v iskhodnuyu formu?!
Povtorite tsikly pogoni s begstvom, sovershenstvuyte personazhey s raznymi sposobnostyami, naprimer «Bata-batabata», kotoryy mozhet pereprygivat bloki!.. Ispolzuyte raznykh zhivotnykh v zavisimosti ot soderzhaniya urovney, i proydite ikh vse — tselykh 40 shtuk!

title: Nonet Ensemble Magicwork Labyrinth [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Davnym-davno, kogda zemlya byla pusta, a morya — vysokhshie, nebesa poslali na planetu boginyu. Ona ne tolko istselila vsyu zemlyu i more, no i nadelila magicheskimi silami lyudey — pri uslovii, chto oni perestanut srazhatsya drug s drugom.
Odnako, lyudi v kontse kontsov vstali na put razrusheniya iz-za tainstvennykh podzemnykh miazmov. Podobno semechku, sleza bogini pustila korni v zemlyu i dala zhizni poslednee pristanishche — devushke, Yulii, kotoraya sobiralas nachat novoe priklyuchenie!
Vashe (i eyo) priklyuchenie nachinaetsya zdes, v mechtakh o nevidimom vneshnem mire..

title: Akihabara Feel the Rhythm Remixed [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Take a trip through engaging music and intense puzzle action, set in Tokyos Electric Town! Stack blocks to build combos, tap in rhythm with the music to break them. Play trough the campaigns, go for the high score!

Can you master the rhythm in Akihabara?

* Challenge yourself with intense, fast-paced rhythm gameplay
* Several original soundtracks
* Enjoy high-quality art
* Earn achievements in different game modes
* Master the beat in Tokyo’s own Electric Town

title: Rogue Star Rescue [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
Novyy tip rogalika-shutera. Rogue Star Rescue predstavlyaet soboy unikalnoe sochetanie bullet khell i TD igr. My dobavili silnye elementy strategii v bezumie adskikh strelyalok. Eto igra, v kotoruyu ty vtyaneshsya i u tebya uydut mesyatsy na izuchenie mnozhestva khitrospleteniy i kontsovok. My khotim, chtoby ty kayfoval ot igry, dazhe posle 50+ igrovykh chasov.

Onlayn i lokalnyy kooperativ! Ty mozhesh odnovremenno issledovat galaktiku igry c drugom! Takoy funktsii net v drugikh shuterakh-rogalikakh. Issleduy miry, raskryvay sekrety i progressiruy v igre vmeste s tvoimi druzyami.

Zvezda-Izgoy. Massivnaya Zvezda-Izgoy obrazovalas iz kosmicheskoy pyli i teper nakhoditsya na puti pryamogo stolknoveniya s nami. Eto grozit ispepeleniem vsego zhivogo. Lidery planet galaktiki sobrali luchshuyu komandu voinov, chtoby lyuboy tsenoy ostanovit Zvezdu-Izgoy. 

Tvoy vybor, tvoya kontsovka. Vyberi na kakie planety otpravitsya i primi vazhnye resheniya, kotorye opredelyat sudbu vsey galaktiki! V zavisimosti ot vybrannogo toboy puti, est desyatki razlichnykh kontsovok. Zvezda-Izgoy mozhet unichtozhit vsyu galaktiku, otrazitsya na galaktiku protivnika, byt pogloshchennoy chernoy dyroy, otpravitsya v prostranstvenno-vremennye tunneli i mnozhestvo drugikh zabavnykh vozmozhnostey.

Lovushki i zashchita. Strategicheski razmeshchennye lovushki zamedlyayut, blokiruyut, tolkayut, prokalyvayut, podzhigayut, zamorazhivayut i strelyayut po vragam. Ty mozhesh apgreydit lovushki, chtoby sdelat ikh silnee. 

Geroi. Vyberi odnogo iz chlenov elitnoy komandy s unikalnym naborom spetsialnykh sposobnostey, kazhdyy iz kotorykh obladaet lichnoy motivatsiey spasti svoyu rodnuyu planetu ot unichtozheniya. Spasi novykh igrokov, dobivshis konkretnykh rezultatov.

Prokachaysya! V otlichie ot traditsionnykh rogalikov, my dobavili sistemu prokachki navykov. S kazhdym urovnem ty zarabatyvaesh atributivnye ochki, kotorye mogut uluchshit tvoyu silu, skorost, nanosimyy uron, zdorove i udachu.

Oruzhie i predmety. Razblokiruy sotni unikalnykh predmetov! Pomimo osnovnogo oruzhiya, u tebya budet arsenal granat i naparnikov. 

Tri rezhima slozhnosti. Vyberi mezhdu Prostenkim, Normalnym i Sumasshedshim rezhimov, chtoby brosit vyzov svoim navykam i pri etom prodolzhat kayfovat ot igry.

title: Paperball Deluxe [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Paperball is a highly challenging ball roller that will put your balance skills to the test. Whether you like to play it safe to make it through with the least amount of falls, or you risk it all to obtain the fastest time - a plethora of stages and game modes will keep you coming back for a long time.

• 250 all unique stages
• Over 15 different environments
• Seven different game modes, rewarding different kinds of play
• Local co-op and competitive multiplayer
• Motion controls and HD rumble support
• Many different skins to customize your ball

title: Subsurface Circular / Quarantine Circular [NSZ][ENG]
description:
A group of scientists interrogate an alien discovered at the heart of a global pandemic. Work with your team, make decisions and uncover the alien’s true intentions.

Inspired by classic adventure games and modern dialogue systems, Bithell Games has created another single session story which respects your time and your intelligence.

Key Features

* A one-sitting game for adults in search of a polished new world to discover.
* Developed by the award-winning team behind Thomas Was Alone and Subsurface Circular.
* Social dynamics and greater choice enhance this twist on classic text-based adventures.
* Responsive soundtrack by Dan Le Sac.
* Atmospheric use of HD Rumble.
* Art Gallery showcasing the development of this new story.
* Unlockable ‘Mr Commentary’, our next generation take on a developer’s commentary.

title: Shutter Nyang Enhanced edition [NSZ][ENG]
description:
某個秋日，貓咪發現自己的朋友心灰意冷，便跑過去安慰她。

就在這時，一陣強風將貓咪和它朋友的相機卷走。

就這樣掉進了未知世界的貓咪主角，決心找到相機並回到女孩身邊，
讓她重展笑顏。

“靈活利用相機，複製並粘貼物品！”
利用好友那具備神秘力量的相機拍攝照片，
複製物品，將它們粘貼到你想要的位置。
闖蕩未知領域，發揮天馬行空的想像力，克服千難萬險。

“修復破碎的記憶”
墜落造成的巨大衝擊力，破壞了相機裏的珍貴記憶。
收集各個關卡中散落的記憶，將照片復原如初，還給好友。

“解鎖各種迷人服裝”
在探索關卡期間，收集海報等物品來解鎖各種服裝。
千奇百怪的服裝在等著你，
從主角最喜歡的魚再到背著禮物袋的聖誕老人。

“你的遊玩風格決定冒險結局”
我們的貓咪主角渴望回到原來的世界，給好友送去歡樂。
你的遊玩風格將決定不同的故事結局。
它能否與好友團聚，復原所有的美好回憶？

title: CARL (Computer Automated Resource Locator) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Vdokhnovlennyy klassicheskimi videoigrami, C.A.R.L. — eto priklyuchenie v retro-stile, sochetayushchee v sebe klassicheskiy platformer s prichudlivom pazlom i syuzhetnymi elementami kvesta, stol zhe zhivogo, kak i robotizirovannogo!..
Zaprygivayte v blestyashchie metallicheskie bashmaki Kompyuterno-avtomatizirovannogo lokatora resursov (KARLa), malenkogo robota, zateryannogo na obshirnom predpriyatii Kent Industries. Brosayte vyzov kazhdomu opasnomu fabrichnomu tsekhu, chtoby dobyt tekhnicheskie edinitsy dlya svoego druga-inzhenera, otkryvaya po puti novye oblasti i sposobnosti. Podruzhites s neispravnymi robotami v D.U.M.P. (Sklade Neispravnogo Oborudovaniya i Zapchastey), sobirayte predmety i pobezhdayte svirepykh vragov, chtoby raskryt zloveshchie tayny zdeshnego supersekretnogo obekta!

title: Jisei The First Case HD / Kansei The Second Turn HD [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Podrostok, sposobnyy ozhivit lyuboy trup, kotorogo on kasaetsya, okazyvaetsya vovlechennym v drugoe delo ob ubiystve, kogda vladelets solidnoy korporatsii umiraet pri zagadochnykh obstoyatelstvakh.

Odnako na etot raz on vynuzhden obedinitsya s gruppoy detishek s takimi zhe strannymi sposobnostyami, kak i ego sobstvennye. K sozhaleniyu, ego novye tovarishchi po komande mogut byt bolee opasnymi, chem ubiytsa, na kotorogo oni okhotyatsya.

Kazhdomu est chto skryvat, a proshloe nikogda ne ostaetsya skrytym nadolgo. Doprashivayte podozrevaemykh, issleduyte dom bogatogo pokoynika i raskryvayte sekrety drugikh, pytayas skryt svoi sobstvennye.


Kharakteristiki
* Vizualnyy roman i priklyuchencheskiy geympley
* Razgadayte taynu
* Potryasayushchaya grafika v stile anime
* Polnaya ozvuchka na angliyskom yazyke
* Originalnaya muzyka

title: Cookie's Theory of Super Evolution [NSZ][ENG]
description: Kunikhiro Kavasima vmeste so svoim koronnym nomerom: predstavlyaem prostuyu, no glubokuyu igru-golovolomku, kotoraya razvivaetsya vmeste s vami — snova i snova!.. Beskonechnyy rezhim, rezhim ataki na vremya, boevoy rezhim dlya dvukh igrokov, rezhim 991 s ogromnym kolichestvom etapov i mnozhestvom pazl-elementov.

title: Code Shifter [NSZ][ENG]
description:
遊戲公司「Awesome Rainbow Corp」作為舞臺，
遊戲完成後發生的神奇故事。

這是一款透過操作「Code Shifter」，消除錯誤的橫向跳躍動作遊戲。

一邊消除程式世界裡發生的錯誤，一邊進行現實世界的故事吧。

工作人員的目的是讓遊戲順利完成。

■不同視覺表現
「水彩畫風觸控的藝術風格」
「色彩鮮豔的時尚藝術」
「懷舊感性的像素藝術」
快節奏的嶄新視覺效果，讓人激動不已！

■遊戲系統
不斷擊倒敵人的快感，橫向跳躍動作。
以變身能力克服各種花招。
使用30種角色變身能力的多元動作，為每個關卡帶來全新體驗。

■戲劇
主角工程師是史黛菈。
此外還有遊戲設計師莫茲、美術設計師露荻、
前輩工程師哈德森、總監葛利格。
充滿笑容愉快的遊戲工作人員之間的詼諧戲劇！

■份量十足的聯動
ARC SYSTEM WORKS遊戲角色總集合！
擁有不同攻擊和動作的30名角色。
以多元的必殺技幫助主人公的70名助攻人物。
可遊玩的角色中各自收錄了此次遊戲獨有的8位元風的歌曲(共30首)！

Guilty Gear、BLAZBLUE、雙截龍、熱血硬派國雄等人氣遊戲角色登場。

■搭載對戰格鬥模式
可以盡情享受對戰格鬥遊戲「Colorful Fighters」。
沉浸在遊戲中出現聯動角色的對戰遊戲吧。
最多4人戰鬥的熱鬧的慶典氣氛中，一起熱血沸騰起來吧！

title: Synergia NextGen edition [NSZ][ENG]
description:
A neon-lit dystopian cityscape becomes the stage for thrilling adventure and deep yuri romance in this cyberpunk-themed visual novel. The complex personalities and experiences of more than 20 characters are interwoven across multiple paths and possible endings. Your choices matter, not only to you, but to all those with whom you struggle to connect.

Cila, a veteran cop with a sour outlook and anger issues expects nothing more from life besides the smell of ozone, blinding neon lights and the ever-present manhole steam. That is, until a shady friend replaces her broken-down housedroid as a favour. Advanced, more efficient and remarkably perceptive, unit M.A.R.A. begins to penetrate Cila's toughened exterior and possibly even heal her new owner's old wounds – if Cila can decipher the recurring nightmare the process brings. Soon Cila and Mara forge a unique, if sometimes uneasy bond.

Unbeknownst to Cila, just as her life begins to find its new normal, the technological giant Velta Labs gets wind of Mara's existence and takes a mysterious interest in the android. A war unlike any before is brewing on the horizon, its players are silently being selected and one android's fate may spell the difference between peace, war, the blossoming of a new religion or a technological singularity beyond comprehension.

----

Plus, one year after the events of the Synergia Incident, Cila and Mara's lives have drastically changed, as have the lives of all those around them. This edition includes SUNRISE, a small glimpse into their future outside of The Empire, and the repercussions of their actions during the main game.

Bathed in the ultraviolet lights of the European Travel Union, Yu, the Emperor's right-hand, prepares to reunite with the reviled Cila and Mara and finally settle things with The Empire's most wanted terrorist: Yoko. 

Features:
• Journey through a cyberpunk setting of neon-lit corruption.
• Explore 100s of unique backgrounds and CGs between SUNRISE & the main game
• Meet 20+ characters with personal histories woven into the narrative.
• Experience a vivid soundtrack composed by Andy Andi Han.
• Make key choices that impact the story and lead to multiple endings.
• Features in-game artbook & bonus comic, with 64 pages of content
• In-game Music Room featuring the full OST
• Includes the full "SUNRISE" expansion
• High resolution graphical remaster

title: Spectator [NSZ][RUS/Multi27]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 27]
description:
在您的小辦公室內，您將通過閉路電視攝像頭監控異常活動。
您必須監控受控地點，並在異常現象出現時採取對策。
但要小心，如果錯過太多異常，則您的生命將受到威脅！

我們的視聽技術會加強並深化您的體驗，幫助您更好地感受。
逼真的圖形，實用的用戶界面和深邃可怕的聲音將確保您沉浸其中。
穿越6個基於受歡迎的恐怖故事的獨特關卡！
每個關卡都有60多種不同的程序生成異常！

title: No Longer Home [NSZ][ENG]
description:
No Longer Home is a game about letting go of the life you've built due to circumstances beyond your control. Immerse yourself in the lives of Bo and Ao and learn about their dreams, frustrations and fears. Welcome the magic of the everyday and somewhat extraordinary.

Bo and Ao are graduating university and preparing to leave the flat they’ve lived in together for a year. Thanks to visa limitations, Ao is forced to return to Japan, leaving Bo in England. Disillusioned by post-educational life and shoved aside by a government who doesn’t want them there, both are trying to come to terms with their uncertain futures. And deep under their South London flat, something grows...

As they pack their belongings in the home they've shared, they'll unleash more than just memories

Wander through an intimate flat and examine the everyday belongings of Bo and Ao. Have BBQs, play video games, and stay up late just talking in bed. Follow the day to day activities and conversations of two queer, non-binary students and their friends. Get to know Lu, the multi-eyed, animal-like new flatmate.

A semi-autobiographical game
No Longer Home was born when the developers were similarly forced apart after university, and decided to stay in touch by working on a game together. Development duo Hana and Cel chose this project as a way to explore and express the emotions that came with saying goodbye.

title: From Orbit [NSZ][ENG]
description:
In From Orbit you'll manage the crew of a small spaceship. Stranded deep in uncharted space, they need to make their way home. Journey from planet to planet, each procedurally generated with unique environments, challenges, and alien creatures. 

Explore 
Scout out the richest resources and the deadliest critters, and discover unique challenges and powerful artifacts. 

Extract 
You're going to need all the Ore and Crystal you can carry if you're going to mount a successful defense or purchase the upgrades you'll need to make it home alive. 

Excape 
Err... Escape. The resources on each planet won't last forever, but the alien creatures willing to bite your legs off never seem to end, eventually overwhelming even the most stalwart crew. Hold out as long as you can... but don't throw your resources - or the lives of your crew - away to a lost cause. Always be prepared to make a timely exit when things start getting hairy.

title: Vektor Wars [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Dobro pozhalovat v zalitoe neonovym svetom budushchee, polnoe kiberboev s vidom ot pervogo litsa.
Za oknom 2024 god, i vy komandir kosmicheskikh reyndzherov Dzheyms Mozes. Vasha zadacha – unichtozhit armiyu smertonosnykh robotov, pomoch Robokoresham i spasti mir!
Berite v ruki oruzhie i derites na predele vozmozhnostey, chtoby ostanovit potok obezumevshikh robotov. Igra sozdana v luchshikh traditsiyakh takikh znamenitykh arkad. Neistovye perestrelki i shumnoe razrushitelnoe oruzhie – smert zhdet vas za kazhdym povorotom!
- Igra v luchshikh traditsiyakh arkadnogo zhanra: ottachivayte igrovye navyki i pokoryayte vershiny tablitsy rekordov!
- Stremitelnye boi s vidom ot pervogo litsa. 
- Zalityy neonovym svetom vektornyy mir, nepokhozhiy na drugie. 
- Ogromnyy arsenal shumnogo razrushitelnogo oruzhiya. 
- 9 raznykh zon, kotorye vam predstoit osvobodit, kazhdaya s novymi protivnikami. 
- Potryasayushchaya muzyka.

title: Glam's Incredible Run Escape from Dukha [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Glam is a hard, action packed acrobatic platformer game where you have to run, jump, climb and swing to make it to the exit without falling into the emptiness, getting hit by spikes and bullets, caught by goblins or squeezed by items.

In this game you play as Glam, her goal is to rescue her mother from the realm of Caterina. She is being held captive by the evil witch to prevent Glam’s and her mother’s power to unite.

Glam has the most unique ability in the video game history. She can grab branches and swing by using her hair. Controls are simple: three buttons and a joystick. Master your, swinging and jumping skills on the epic obstacles courses where each death is a lesson.

The levels are made with various items and enemies, each level rewards your climbing skills and agility. The levels are packed into 11 chapters, each chapter has its own unique peril: hanging cubes, goblins and skulls, sliding and spinning platforms, false floors, cannons, crates.

Teamwork is crucial in local co-op mode, where you will have to work together to reach the portals to unlock the next level. 60 challenging levels are waiting for two of you to explore.

Features:
Hand crafted obstacle courses to test the limits of your acrobatic skills
Tight, precise and simple controls: just three buttons and the joystick,
220+ Single player levels, split into 11 chapters each has its own unique peril
60 multiplayer levels that demands endurance, flexibility and exceptional precise coordination of your movement
Customizable character hero: Glam
Charming music

title: Defunct [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
Defunct 是一款獨立冒險遊戲，著眼於一個漂浮著的美麗世界。你是一臺壞掉的機器人，意外地從一艘巨大的貨船上掉到後人類時代的地球上，這裡已成了機器人的棲居地。你要趁一切太遲之前回到飛船上！

你裝備了一個超重形態引擎。它可以在你周圍製造一片單獨的重力場，也是你主要的速度來源。在下坡時使用可以加速。但當心，在上坡時使用會減速。此外，這個世界充滿不同的速度增益，例如能量飲，拾起它可以讓你跑得更快。

這些工具能讓你在世界上行駛，遇見奇怪的機器人，飛過垃圾場，一路回到飛船。

特色
使用獨特的「超重形態」引擎進行高速遊玩
探索 11 個各異的關卡，有著不同的氣候、生態與挑戰。
為主角色解鎖外觀。
使用特別的特技（可解鎖）來給大家上一課。
在限時試煉模式（有 5 個額外關卡）挑戰你的最佳用時。

title: Boat Attack (移植版 Universal Render Pipeline Unity Techdemo) [NSZ][ENG]
developer: Unity Technologies, Andre McGrail, Alex Best, Stintah
description:
Universal Render Pipeline — eto gotovoe k ispolzovaniyu reshenie ot Unity s shirokim naborom instrumentariya khudozhnika po sozdaniyu igrovogo kontenta. Nebolshaya igra Boat Attack predstavlyaet soboy sozdannuyu na ego osnove arkadnuyu gonochnuyu igru na motornykh lodkakh protiv 3-kh II v okruzhenii roskoshnoy lazurnoy bukhty zaliva posredi Atlanticheskogo okeana.
V neyo mozhno sygrat samomu / ili posmotret polnostyu avtomaticheskiy demoprotsess, chtoby v polnoy mere oprobovat predlagaemye funktsii Unity URP.
Pokazany sleduyushchie ispolzuemye tekhnicheskie resheniya:

title: Alpha [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Prosto, no slozhno! Sobiratsya s druzyami, srazhatsya s bossami — eto vsyo kruto, no vydelit nemnogo vremeni dlya sebya eshchyo kruche. Kazhdomu nravitsya provodit vremya v odinochestve, a prinyat vyzov v etoy igre — otlichnyy sposob eto sdelat!
Mozhet byt, prishlo vremya otdokhnut ot igr dlya drugikh lyudey.

title: Spirit Arena [NSZ][ENG]
description:
關於這個遊戲
作為兩個巫師試圖從一個秘密的境界召喚和馴服強大的怪物，他們的實驗失敗，並導致惡魔波進入我們的世界。加強他們的意志，他們決定面對這個巨大的威脅，並擊敗了現在運行免費的災難！

遊戲
精神競技場是在單人模式或本地兩個玩家的遊戲可玩。每個角色能火是物理法術（紅色）或精神魔法（藍色），將只有碰撞匹配的敵人。清潔波，收集物品，並提高你的力量來擊敗所有四個領域的老大。

特徵
 - 四個世界各帶四個難度等級
 -  100+項目
 -  2玩家本地合作
 -  9遊戲人物
 - 短遊戲會議（10-20分鐘）
 - 成就無比！
 - 無微交易

title: Frontier Quest [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Story:
A young adventurer journeys out into the frontier in search of legendary artefacts, however they quickly find their path blocked by the various monsters living there. To make matters worse the frontier town is in no shape to provide support, so our adventurer ends up helping repair the town in exchange for better equipment to take on the frontier.

Gameplay:
Listen to the requests of the townsfolk before journeying out into the frontier, figuring out monster’s weaknesses in turn-based combat and collecting materials to help restore the town and ultimately uncover the mystery of the artefacts. 

Using the right equipment is key in progressing through the dangerous frontier. By choosing the right weapons, armour, gear and allies, you’ll be able to make short work of the monsters blocking your path.

Through completing quests for the townsfolk, you'll be rewarded with new equipment that you’ll need to succeed on your adventure, and as you complete quests and get to know the townsfolk, you'll be able to help them better themselves and grow the tiny village into a prosperous town. You might even learn more about the frontier’s past and its inhabitants along the way too!

Features:
- Turn-based combat with puzzle elements that focuses on choosing the right equipment for the job
- Vibrant 2D art set within a colourful fantasy world
- A cast of quirky characters to meet and become acquainted with through 30+ quests
- 50+ roads across many different environments to explore
- Watch the town slowly improve and expand as you complete quests 
- A variety of different gear to collect and equip

title: Jet Pin [NSZ][ENG]
description: Probeytes na naivysshiy uroven, spasayas ot navodneniya. Sobirayte dopolnitelnye punkty i vybivayte milliony v bonusnykh zonakh. Vy igraete ne obychnym sharikom ― u nego spetsialnye vozmozhnosti. Razgonite ego do maksimalnoy skorosti i poluchayte bonusy. Otkroyte novye, bolee vysokie urovni, a kogda navodnenie vas nastignet i vy okazhetes v vode, vospolzuytes «reaktivnyy pryzhkom» (jet jump) i vzveytes nad vvoznoy gladyu. Pomnite, pri pogruzhenii v vodu elektricheskoe napryazhenie sharika povyshaetsya. Snizhayte ego do urovnya 0% v spetsialnykh portakh. Padaete i vidite, chto voda uzhe blizko? Ispolzuyte spasatelnyy puzyr i dayte sebe shans! Igrayte dalshe, beyte rekordy. Vy gotovy k takomu vyzovu? Navodnenie uzhe blizko!

title: Cosmo Player Z [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Nauchno-fantasticheskiy anime-ekshen, v kotorom vam predstoit srazhatsya v epicheskikh kosmicheskikh voynakh! Razlichnye vidy umeniy pozvolyat vybirat boevuyu strategiyu — dalniy boy, blizhniy ili oborona, — a nekotorye kombinatsii umeniy generiruyut novye sposobnosti.
Odezhdu, kotoruyu vy pereodevaete, mozhno prosmotret na ekrane pauzy i na glavnom ekrane. Takzhe mozhno poluchit bonusy, esli vy odenetes v odnom stile verkha i niza (v odnom naryade).
Plyus mnozhestvo personazhey-bossov: diktator, kotoryy pozvolyaet tolko samym silnym nosit krasivuyu odezhdu, printsessa, voruyushchaya mototsikly s pyati let, i modnyy dizayner, vedushchiy voynu so svoey udalennoy rabotoy. Korotkie istorii, sotkannye osobymi personazhami, a takzhe khorosho otpolirovannyy dizayn ocharuyut vas v etoy igre!..

title: Chameneon [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Chameneon 是一款 2D 平台遊戲/跑步遊戲，具有令人難以置信的多彩和美麗的像素藝術。 在遊戲中，病毒感染了 Cyber Space，現在由您啟動協議 CHAMENEON。 在網絡空間的霓虹線上沖浪並在為時已晚之前擊敗病毒。

憑藉獨特的物理特性，Chameneon 創造了一個巨大的挑戰，需要良好的精度和反應才能超越它。 通過簡單而殘酷的遊戲玩法和大量的關卡，您將受到極限考驗！

奔跑、跳躍、躲避和收集霓虹燈盤，向所有人展示誰才是老大。 是時候讓您煥發光彩了！

特徵：
- 玩過 80 個關卡
- 4種不同的環境
- 輕鬆直觀的遊戲玩法
- 一隻可愛的貓來幫忙


Burning Goat Studios 開發，QUByte Interactive 發行

title: Light Tracer [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Proydi vse prepyatstviya i dostav printsessu k eyo tseli! 

Mir Light Tracer: 7 glav: Mir Gravitatsii i Mekhanicheskiy Mir, ledyanye stupenki i Gorod Angelov.

Raznoobrazie deystviy: ot platform do zagadochnykh golovolomok, kotorye ispytayut ne tolko tvoyu reaktsiyu, no i myshlenie.

Bashni i tayny: printsessa s missiey, zagadochnyy geroy i istoriya s izyuminkoy! Uznay o printsesse i misticheskoy bolezni, porazivshey eyo stranu.

title: Maze [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Fight your way through to the bottom of the so-called Pangeon - an organization located in a dungeon that we know very little about (well, except the fact it contains something that has the potential to destroy the entire planet Earth) - eliminate the evil, and save the World from a potential tragedy.

- A mix of many roguelike games combined into a fun (although short) experience
- 8+ levels, various in looks, enemies and loot
- 10+ weapons to use - ranging from daggers, swords and ending on magic staffs, bows, etc

title: Inferno Climber: Reborn [NSZ][ENG]
description:
以前有了內涵強大的魔力的5塊煉獄之石。
各國家擁有一個煉獄石，保持了世界力量的平衡。
但是，世界的歪曲越時間過去越強大了。
煉獄石從弱者的心裡開始支配。
人們變成魔物，世界崩壞了。

從那天100年後...
與死神契約的，不知不純的靈魂開眼。

這是「地獄」世界的故事。

title: Slinki [NSZ][ENG]
description: Slinki is a hard-as-nails 2.5D action-platformer where your own prosthetic arm is the ultimate multipurpose weapon: Use it as a bladed boomerang to control the population of mutated critters, pull levers towards you to get through puzzles and zip-line across grappling surfaces. Furthermore, instead of having your weapon return to you, why not return to it instead with the power of Slinki's slingshot? All this to find out what happened to the once peaceful forest you used to live in.

title: Ragtag Adventurers [NSZ][ENG]
description: Ragtag Adventurers — eto igra s bossami, v kotoroy 4 geroya srazhayutsya s uzhasnymi monstrami v mnogopolzovatelskom rezhime s obshchim ekranom. Igrayte v odinochku ili s druzyami protiv slozhnykh bossov, kotorye proveryat vashi navyki.

title: Technosphere [NSP][ENG]
description:
Control the TECHNOSPHERE, roll, jump, balance, solve puzzles and go through the mazes.
Atlas Corporation is mining crystals in the core of an asteroid in the orbit of the Earth.
Due to a failure in the asteroid systems, orbit correction was disabled.
Only the TECHNOSPHERE is able to reload the asteroid system and restore the orbit.
You have 10 hours to save the earth from disaster!

title: Asemblance [NSP][ENG]
description:
Ochnuvshis, geroy ponimaet, chto popal v lovushku vnutri eksperimentalnoy mashiny, postroennoy dlya imitatsii vospominaniy. On ne pomnit, pochemu voshyol v etu virtualnuyu sredu, no golos iskusstvennogo intellekta napravlyaet ego.
Pytayas sbezhat, protagonist stalkivaetsya s vospominaniyami iz proshlogo, kotorye, vozmozhno, ne khotel by vspominat. Igra sozdana pod vpechatleniem ot serialov «Sumerechnaya zona», «Sekretnye materialy» i «Chyornoe zerkalo» i predlagaet svoy vzglyad na nekotorye filosofskie voprosy..

title: Mega Party a Tootuff Adventure [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Za den do togo, kak nachalis zanyatiya v shkole, Tootuff uznal, chto uchenye nauchilis klonirovat ovets, otbiraya samye luchshie obraztsy. On prishel v uzhas ot mysli, chto ego mozhno razmnozhit na beskonechnoe chislo kopiy, i podelilsya opaseniyami s druzyami.

K schastyu, Hugo [Gugo] v golovu prishla otlichnaya ideya. Esli dlya klonirovaniya vybirayut tolko luchshikh, to nado stat plokhim, i togda tebya tochno ne vyberut.

Tootuff i ego druzya berutsya za delo: ustroit kak mozhno bolshe bezumnykh prokaz, chtoby ikh nikto ne kloniroval!

5 rezhimov igry
Uchebnyy god: igrayte v odinochku ili s drugom, vyberite personazha i ustroyte kak mozhno bolshe prokaz, chtoby vas ne klonirovali! Uchebnyy god sostoit iz 3 epizodov, kotorye nuzhno otkryt. 
Vypolniv vse zadaniya v epizode i zapolniv shkalu megakrutosti, vy perekhodite v sleduyushchiy epizod.

Poedinki: u vas net vremeni, i vy prosto khotite poveselitsya? Ustroyte poedinok s kompyuterom ili drugom. Vyberite odnu iz 48 dostupnykh miniigr, chtoby vyyasnit, kto khuzhe! Imeyte v vidu, chto ispytaniya nado otkryvat v rezhime «Uchebnyy god». Poedinki prednaznacheny dlya 2 igrokov.

Megapoedinki: priderzhite koney! Chtoby otkryt dostup k megapoedinkam, nuzhno snachala perezhit uchebnyy god! Posle etogo vy smozhete vybrat lyuboe kolichestvo ispytaniy: oni budut idti odno za drugim, i pobeditelem megapoedinka stanet tot, kto vyigraet bolshe vsekh. V megapoedinkakh mozhet uchastvovat do 4 igrokov.

Poedinki smerti: eti poedinki prednaznacheny dlya luchshikh iz luchshikh. Chtoby ikh otkryt, nuzhno proyti igru s opredelennym protsentom. Srazhaytes s neskolkimi protivnikami v kazhdom ispytanii (ispytaniya vybirayutsya sluchaynym obrazom), chtoby nabrat maksimalnoe chislo pobed. V poedinkakh smerti mozhet uchastvovat do 4 igrokov.

Mega-as: tri tipa ispytaniy dlya samykh luchshikh s uchastiem do 4 igrokov.

Malenkiy as: chetyre ispytaniya dlya odnoy klavishi.

Super-as: chetyre ispytaniya dlya klavish napravleniya.

Super-mega-as: grandioznoe ispytanie dlya super-mega-asov! Ispolzuyte klavishi napravleniya i eshche vsego odnu knopku, chtoby dokazat, chto vy dostoyny zanyat mesto sredi luchshikh!

title: Summer Days [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Briana has been craving some time off all summer, and finally, with her shoot wrapped for hiatus, she can relax at her summer cottage on the lake. She even drags her female film co-stars along for the ride to enjoy herself.

Summer Days is a yuri visual novel story of fun and sun at the lake, with multiple routes and choices to explore.

See the girls relax in the lake and maybe do some dipping too.

Features
* Gallery with beautiful illustrations to unlock
* Visual Novel style gameplay
* Multiple choices to make
* Secret routes to unlock

title: Pizza Titan Ultra [NSZ][ENG]
description: Pizza Titan Ultra is a fast paced 3rd-person action platformer focused on fighting and smashing through a futuristic city, in a giant mech, to deliver pizza. Experience arcadey action with speedy attacking and dodging, while attempting to control the massive weight of a 10 storey mobile pizzeria - just try not to make too much of a mess!

title: Chop [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Accessible in its mechanics, it offers a real strategic dimension and a depth of gameplay that will put your skills to the test. 
One hit to kill, respawn almost instantly. CHOP gives a feeling close to the constant adrenaline rush you can experience in fast FPS.
It speaks to those who like gore, comics, post-apo and are looking for a supercharged party game!

The game offers a unique twist with the Rush Out mode. Here, no matter how many players you kill. Your goal is to rush out through your portal as fast as possible. Don't worry, you still need to kill, as it's the only way to open the portal. 

Features:

- From 1 to 4 player local multiplayer
- Glorious dismemberments, delightful executions, silly gory graphics all wrapped up in a comic book style.
- 3 game modes
- 4 playable characters
- 4 special abilities
- Blistering moves
- Various arenas 
- Random bonuses to spice up battles
- Many options to customize your games

title: Kuroi Tsubasa [NSP][ENG]
description:
Kogda Chernokrylyy dyavol pokinul mir ognya i sery radi solnechnogo mira lyudey, ego zlaya tenevaya storona vyrvalas vmeste s nim. Vskore nachalsya khaos!

Chernokrylyy dyavol dolzhen obedinitsya s mestnoy ofisnoy ledi Kurekhoy Kurono i ee druzyami, chtoby pobedit zluyu ten. Vas zhdet vizualnyy roman iz 120 000 slov s bolee chem 50 originalnymi pesnyami, desyatkami vysokokachestvennykh kartinok, unikalnym akterskim sostavom i trogatelnoy istoriey!


Osobennosti
* Priklyuchencheskiy vizualnyy roman iz 120 000 slov
* Poznakomtes s milymi devushkami i zapominayushchimisya personazhami
* Khudozhestvennaya estetika anime / mangi

title: Jade Order [NSZ][ENG]
description: 結束流亡之旅，令這與世隔絕之地的力量恢復平衡吧。扮演一位古代戰士，肩負神聖使命，點燃千年教團的封印燈塔。玩家需協助翡翠女神淨化受疫獸火焰污染的大地，沿途完成 50 種不同的謎題，迴避迫在眉睫的厄運。學習活用 4 種不同的祝福，這些是由女神聖光授予的強力閃電技能，每種祝福都有其獨特用處，能應付不同障礙，有助擊敗灰燼疫獸大軍。謎題難度會逐步提升，玩家可運用策略和直覺，按個人步伐完成這些謎題。求助呼聲清晰可聽。你是否有能力跨越被遺忘的翡翠教團古老遺跡，令和平降臨此地？

title: Elevator to the Moon Turbo Champions Edition [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Ty — kosmicheskiy kadet, kotoromu Prezident mira vnezapno otdal prikaz «otvoevat» Lunnyy lift. Vypolniv prikaz, ty navlechesh na sebya gnev samogo moshchnogo na Zemle Iskusstvennogo intellekta...

Vystoish li ty v etoy skhvatke i smozhesh li pochinit Lunnyy lift?

Poslushaysya! Vypolni bezumnyy prikaz Prezidenta mira Daga-Sleytera Rossmiera, reshaya uvlekatelnye golovolomki, ili…

Narush prikaz! Ustroy veselyy kavardak ili sygray v «svoyu igru». V kveste bolshe krutykh povorotov, chem na gornom serpantine, — kazhdaya strategiya imeet svoi preimushchestva!  Vybiray, otvazhnyy kadet, kak prolozhit put… na Lunu!

title: Cubic Dweller (移植版 ) [NSP][ENG]
description:
Clozhnyy 2D-platformer, sozdannyy dlya togo, chtoby byt veselym, uvlekatelnym i vyzyvat zdorovuyu zlost!
Tut est bitvy s bossami i neobychnye mekhaniki, s kotorymi vy stolknetes s kazhdym novym mirom.
Grafika tut v stile retro, no vyglyadit akkuratno. Poprobuyte, i poluchayte udovolstvie!

title: Air Bounce [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Pereyti ili umeret!
AIR BOUNCE - THE JUMP 'N' RUN CHALLENGE - eto bystro razvivayushchiysya, bezumno slozhnyy, inogda vyzyvayushchiy yarost trekhmernyy platformer ot pervogo litsa. Ty gotov k ispytaniyu?

title: Jungle Z [NSP][ENG]
description:
[Game Features]
●Life or Death?
Your choice! You need to be survived on the last day of Earth with limited backpack space. Supplies are hidden somewhere around you, look for them. Be careful! Every decision you make may be related to your life and death.

●Battle with a variety of zombies
Remember to always be ready and prepared to face variety of zombies coming from nowhere.

●Zombies who know the sound
In addition, zombies also have hearing ability to recognize the surroundings. Your running, exploring, shooting or attacking will attract their attention. You can attack zombies by sneaking.

●Overall arrangement strategies
Night is the real battlefield! The zombies are extremely powerful in the night. You need to arrange and build your own defenses before dark.

●Cooperate with your friends
Exchange your supplies with other survivors and make friends with them when you meet them. They could be your partners but remember that not all survivors are friendly. 

●Maps Diversity 
You will be reborn in a different location, face different maps and new experience if you die.

title: Epitaph [NSZ][ENG]
developer: Jonathan Moormann, Jingjin Liu, Wyatt Yeong, Kailin Zhu
description:
Battle for control of the afterlife in Epitaph, a competitive, fast-paced tactical game. Pick three Reapers, the aspects of death, and fight your opponent in real-time, cooldown-based combat. You'll control all three characters at once, sequencing their abilities and setting up explosive combos to decimate your opponent. But be careful - every time a Reaper dies, they come back stronger, so moving closer to victory will make your opponents even more deadly.

Fast-Paced Tactical Combat:
Epitaph’s combat is a unique mix of strategy and timing. You’ll have to outwit and outsmart your opponent in real time, planning and sequencing your abilities carefully to land devastating combos and counter your opponent’s intentions.

Battle Among Deaths:
Epitaph takes place in the afterlife, where the many faces of Death are fighting against one another in a battle for souls. There are 13 different Reapers in Epitaph's roster, and you’ll draft a team of three to fit your personal strategy. Will you take Becilla, the Commander, who charges into battle and calls her allies to her side, or Ezzim the Executioner, who relentlessly hunts down his victims with his mighty ax? Stylish abstract character designs add to Epitaph's ambiance and make it look and feel like to no other competitive game.

Death is a Strategy:
You can kill a Reaper, but in Epitaph, nothing stays dead for long. If your Reapers die six times, you’ll lose the match - but dead Reapers come back bigger and angrier, making them even more threatening. You may be down early, but are you actually on the verge of losing, or just setting up an amazing comeback for your empowered squad?

Features:
• Local Multiplayer
Capture the souls of your friends in intense fast-paced tactical combat.
• 13 Unique Reapers
There's a reaper for every kind of player, from the brutal, in-your-face style of Unch, The Glutton, to the evasive and supportive strategies of Ziyan, the Martyr.
• Single-Player Puzzle Mode
If you’re looking for a more individual challenge, try and solve over 150 puzzles in a single set of moves, ranging from introductory and informative to devilishly hard.

title: Dungholes [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Find all Diamonds in this Top Down Dungeon game.
Can you get them all ? 

Over 60+ dangerous levels are waiting for you. 
And it requires all your skills:
- Be fast sometimes
- Think about the right way you need to choose

Features:
- 60+ Levels full of Diamonds, Keys and Traps
- Handmade Pixel Art
- Easy Gameplay but hard to master

title: Miner Warfare [NSP][ENG]
description:
Are you ready for this 8 players local multiplayer bonanza?
Miner Warfare is a frantic 2D multiplayer arcade game.
Up to 8 miners have to dig their way through dirt blocks and other miners's face to be the wealthiest gold digger at the end of the match!
You have 4 minutes to dig as much gold as you can, breaking dirt blocks with your trusty pickaxe or using the crazy weapons you'll find inside the crates that are randomly teleported through the battlefield.
This multiplayer mayhem will test your skills and friends!
Main Features:
- Up to 8 local players!
- 20 maps + 14 mini maps for the small screen!
- 40+ weapons!
- 30+ WACKY COSTUMES!!!
- CUSTOMIZABLE WEAPONS DROP!
- Explosive bananas and a nuclear bombs!
- The Holy Grail!

title: Domiverse [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Face off against up to 3 friends locally in this fun and frenetic arena fighting game. A single mistake can be fatal, and there’s no room for mercy in Domiverse. Your friends are obstacles you must destroy in order to get the power crown. So go for it and become the ultimate champion!

Play as one of Domiverse’s 12 completely crazy heroes. There's Shluuuuups the sausage prince with his laser beams, Uzal the karateka starfish, Snakity the half-cat half-snake hybrid who’s as cute as it is cruel... The selection of fighters is extensive and unique. Discover each character’s special abilities and choose the one that best suits your style!

• Arena fights for 1 to 4 players locally
• 12 completely crazy characters, including 4 to be unlocked
• 3 competitive multi-player modes
• Arcade and challenge modes for solo players
• Comics to unlock

title: Conjurer Andy's Repeatable Dungeon [NSP][ENG]
description:
Conjurer Andy's Repeatable Dungeon is a peculiar adventure game, where you, the hero will journey into the depths of a repeating dungeon to collect loot, defeat unusual creatures like the Jelly Cube, Pizza Golem and recruit unlikely heroes such as the Mathemagician to aid you in going the deepest into the dungeon.
C.A.R.D is a card-based Roguelike with fast paced, easy to learn gameplay featuring an ensemble cast of quirky and humorous heroes to join your questing adventures deep into Andy’s dungeon. With push your luck mechanics, the real question is…How much loot can you bring back without perishing!
Featuring:
· 80 unique characters to recruit and upgrade
· Over 50 enemies to encounter
· Simple 1 touch dungeon battling gameplay
· 18 total Armor sets and weapons to unlock giving you greater abilities
· Randomly generated rooms with enemies, treasure and more!

title: Quench [NSP][ENG]
description:
Each generation, the Elephant Tribe makes a grand pilgrimage. But this time, something is different... 

Help Shaman, the young Elephant leader, convince the other animal tribes to join her. Protect your herds as they are beset by flood, fire, drought, and the dark smokebeasts that have spread across the land. Control the environment to guide herds of animals and restore their home in this colourful narrative puzzle game!

Features

- Change the environment around the animals with the powers of the Elder Tree: grow grass and trees, start forest fires, shift sand dunes, or create new rivers and lakes.

- Overcome treacherous encounters with creatures and obstacles while carefully guiding your animals to safety.

- Fall in love with a papercraft-inspired landscape set to a joyful original score by Adam Sakiyama.

- Through gorgeous illustrated cinematics and in-game dialogue, explore how kindness, compassion, and forgiveness are powers unto themselves in this fable about overcoming differences to restore the world.

title: Must Dash Amigos [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Experience a Loco top-down Battle Racer filled with Piñata Stampedes, Avocados and mayhem for up to 4 Players! Must Dash Amigos is a humorous, family friendly fun-fest with controls so simple that anyone can play!

- Leave rivals eating your dust as you blaze past them in Race Mode!
- Dish out the damage in Battle Mode to prove your might!
- Compete in Tournaments to truly uncover the worthiest champion!

To survive in this world you cannot just run; you Must Dash Amigos!

title: Beefense Beemastered [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Milaya krasivaya arkada pro pchyolok v stile «zashchity bashen»!.. Zashchitite svoyu krepost ulev ot ugrozy os. Pchyoly vernulis… bolshe, kruche, i luchshe!
