Zashchitite svoyu krepost ulev ot ugrozy os i shershney! Komanduyte vashimi pchelami, chtoby stat, stroya svoyu zashchitu. Poprosite ikh sobrat medovuyu rosu — konechno, samyy tsennyy resurs v mire — chtoby uluchshit i nastroit ukrepleniya. Bezumnaya koroleva Khornetta ne prosto agressivna — ona ne ostanovitsya ni pered chem, chtoby dostich svoikh gnusnykh tseley!.. Vyzhivanie pchelinoy semi zavisit tolko ot vashey strategii. Vy takzhe stolknyotes so zlym generalom Khornusom i ego groznymi minonami na shesti sovershenno novykh urovnyakh.
Soprovozhdayte pchel v ikh puteshestvii v Stranu Svetlyachkov i pomogite im zashchitit svoyu territoriyu ot voysk generala i zloy korolevy. Kak master sveta i tmy, vy smozhete rasshiryat svoy arsenal oruzhiya, chtoby dat otpor zlym zakhvatchikam, dobaviv ikh svetyashchiesya boepripasy i poleznye navyki.

title: Mimic Hunter [NSP][ENG]
description:
Playing as legendary Mimic Hunter Ratimousse, the task is now yours to face a mysterious threat that emerged long after the end of the Witches' Wars. To unveil the secrets and save the mortal world, you'll have to overcome the puzzles, traps, and mind-bending cylindrical labyrinths of the Seven Towers of the Unbound, master your fencing skills and occult powers, and defeat the corrupt minions of a terrible adversary.

Mimic Hunter is a puzzle-platformer that focuses on wits, exploration and precise technique, rather than speed or combos. The Seven Towers all have their distinctive themes, and challenges, accordingly. You have to collect keys, avoid, disable, or survive traps, find secrets, perform high-stake jumps over deadly heights, slay various, tricky Mimics, and, most importantly, not lose your bearings to scale the towers.

Key features:
-- 7+2 cylindrical, truly "2.5D", carefully hand-made towering levels
-- lore-rich secrets and an engaging main story
-- precision platforming and fighting mechanics--you have to plan and execute your jumps and other actions carefully
-- a handful of unique enemy types with variants and surprises
-- 3 difficulty levels

title: Zero Strain [NSP][ENG]
description:
Zero Strain 是一款由上而下且快節奏的射擊競技遊戲，進攻和防禦的戰略使用對每個挑戰都至關重要。多人在線戰鬥競技 (MOBA) 元素與狂熱的射擊動作相結合，可提供獨特和獎賞的體驗，在霓虹燈線框中演示出來。

你所駕駛的每一個“架構”都提供了不同的武器裝備，這些武器可以根據你所造成的損害來交易，從而使你能夠針對最強大的敵人部署更強大的火力！ 制定戰略計劃，以消滅一波又一波的敵人並到達未知的領域！

• 在多人在線戰鬥競技 (MOBA) 風格的戰鬥中取得平衡攻守！
• 駕駛各種船隻，每艘都擁有3種獨特武器和被動的能力。
• 通過有效處理傷害更快地把武器充電。
• 在屏幕裡躲避著充滿敵人子彈的射擊遊戲。
• 觀察並應對具有挑戰性的首領並做出戰略反應！

title: Emma Lost in Memories [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Poeticheskiy, syurrealisticheskiy i melankholichnyy, EMMA: Zateryannyy v Memories predlagaet unikalnyy opyt v strannom i opasnom mire, gde steny neuvyadayushchiy kak vy kasaetes ikh.

Glavnyy geroy, Emma, molodoy, yarkiy i intriguyushchiy: ona pokidaet svoy dom posle sovy, i vskore teryaet sebya v mire, kotoryy ona medlenno nakhodit vse bolee i bolee opasnymi.

Osobennosti:
- Odin bystryy i prostoy mekhanik: vse platformy i steny nachinayut ischezat, kogda vy kasaetes ikh!
- Kharakter zapuskaetsya avtomaticheski pri fiksirovannoy skorosti! Kontrolirovat svoi spetsialnye sposobnosti (dvoynoy pryzhok, tire i nabora vysoty) i sdelat vse vozmozhnoe, chtoby reagirovat na pravilnoe vremya.
- Minimalistichnyy 2D khudozhestvennyy stil polnostyu narisovany vruchnuyu.
- Dinamichnyy geympley v poeticheskom i ekstsentrichnom mire.
- urovni odnoekrannykh, kotorye sochetayut v sebe masterstvo i izobretatelnost s planifikatsiey i strategiey.
- Dva rezhima igry: Glavnaya Istoriya i pamyat Chest. Zavershit osnovnoy syuzhet pervogo naslazhdatsya urovnyami v sunduke pamyati!
- Chuvstvitelnaya refleksiya na poteryu pamyati.

title: Many Faces [NSZ][ENG]
description:
讓多面天王償還，喚醒你美麗睡眠的代價！ Many Faces是一款受街機經典啟發的多方向射擊遊戲，將單屏動作與隨機關卡結合在一起，可讓你保持警覺。 隨時隨地自定義角色的武器和能力，進一步確保不會每次都有相同的體驗。

特色：

• 挑戰50個以上的隨機關卡，但每次只會通過其中17個。
• 留在戰鬥中躲避危險！
• 與十多種面孔的敵人戰鬥，每種面孔都有獨特的動作和攻擊方式。
• 以無法預測的次序，克服7位具有挑戰性的老闆。
• 戴上帽子以獲得獨特的能力或槍械改良。
• 享受豐富多樣的懷舊8位配樂！

title: Destrobots [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Destrobots is an easy-to-play, hard-to-master top-down shooter that will make every party a blast. Three core actions of Move – Spin – Shoot make for an explosive combination that ensures every match is fast-paced, challenging, and fun. Watch out for traps or exploit them against your opponents, be quick to hunt down scales-tipping power-ups, and forget the words “fair play”. Sharpen your reflexes so you can dance between enemy laser beams, land your own shots, and grab that sweet victory!

DESTROBOTS MAIN FEATURES

• EASY TO PICK UP: move, shoot and spin to defeat your rivals

• ARCADE FUN: simple rules, game-changing power-ups, trap-ridden battle arenas, and non-stop action

• GET COMPETITIVE: destroy your friends in local multiplayer Deathmatch and Last Man Standing modes for up to 4 players

• TAKE ON THE HORDE: fight against relentless hordes of Destrobots alone or in 2-player co-op and go for the high score

• THE WORLD AND BEYOND: unleash your shooting skills across 36 arenas set in beautiful and often surprising places, from a serene farm to a pirate ship and even the Moon!

title: Gerty [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Gerty is a top-down rogue-lite twin-stick shooter with fully destructible environment. Carve your own path through replayable procedurally generated levels and create tactically advantageous situations to eliminate the alien threat in intense, tough but fair, action packed gameplay. Mine Juice crystals to upgrade your gear, discover alien structures, and eliminate the source of the alien threat in singleplayer or local co-op mode.

- Test your mettle in skill based combat and try to avoid clutches of permanent death. Adjust the level of challenge to your liking with 5 difficulty levels and advanced settings.
- Choose between 4 different characters all with unique skills and style of play. Further customize your character during your run with perks and purchasable gear.
- Explore collapsed Juice mines that are teeming with alien life and structures. Interact with abandoned infrastructure, alien runes and altars.
- Unlock new gear and characters with each tightly packed run. Ramp up the difficulty and brave the dangers once again!

title: Noble Armada Lost Worlds [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Noble Armada: Lost Worlds is a strategy title based on the Noble Armada miniatures game. Set in the Fading Suns Universe, where the suns themselves are dying, humanity battles to revive its lost greatness, or just take what is left. The five great Royal Houses dominate human space as they battle each other for control of the greatest resource... humanity itself.

In Noble Armada: Lost Worlds, players take on the role of a noble in one of the five Royal houses, vying against rival fleets and houses for control of human space. They battle pirates, barbarians, heretics and others in their quest for supremacy. Noble Armada is a game of broadsides and boarding actions, as players maneuver their ships to line up their best shots, fire off broadsides of fiery energy and then board their enemies to end the battle with desperate boarding actions. As they travel from planet to planet, making allies and building up their fleets, they also gain the experience they need to make their crews and marines truly formidable.

title: Reverse Crawl [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Vy pogibli! No takoe dosadnoe stechenie obstoyatelstv ne pomeshaet Prizrachnomu korolyu vernut svoy tron. Reverse Crawl — eto stremitelnaya poshagovaya strategiya s elementami rolevoy igry, gde vam predstoit vozglavit armii chudovishch i golovorezov s togo sveta i privesti ikh k pobede nad obraztsovymi voinami podloy Krasnoy korolevy.

Vklyuchaet novyy lokalnyy rezhim PvP, sozdannyy eksklyuzivno dlya Nintendo Switch™.

Osobennosti:

  Poshagovaya boevaya sistema, pozvolyayushchaya produmat glubokie strategicheskie resheniya dlya vpechatlyayushchikh pobed nad vragami.
  Armiya iz obitateley temnogo podzemelya: skeletov, zombi, goblinov i mnogikh drugikh.
  Stremitelnye i nepovtorimye kampanii s interesnym mnogostoronnim syuzhetom.
  Rezhimy «Kampaniya» i «Beskonechnyy», a takzhe novyy lokalnyy rezhim PvP.
  Novye slugi, osobennosti i sily, kotorye mozhno otkryt po khodu igry.
  Sozdano studiey Nerdook, sostoyashchey vsego iz odnogo cheloveka i podarivshey nam    Monster Slayers i Vertical Drop Heroes

title: Feathery Ears [NSZ][ENG]
description:
A cute little project made by 2 people in 3 months.
A retro styled 3D platformer that let's players come at challenges from whatever angle you want. Ashley Dengra is a 9nth grade artist with a sketchbook to doodle her "Original Characters" like Misa Ikko, the green-haired, feathery-eared fire sword girl with a great fluffy green tail.

Features:

- Soothing Original Soundtrack made by talented the Naoya Sakamata
- Beautiful Art
- Free Form 3D Platforming Action
- Blade Wave Sword Combat
- A climb from an underground beach below the planets core all the way to the sky!

title: Mon Amour [NSZ][ENG]
description:
[故事劇情]
快從渴望得到愛情滋潤的三位魔女手中救出公主吧！
公主與全國的人民被突然出現的三位魔女帶去惡夢的世界無慾
能夠拯救大家的竟然是你的一吻！

[遊戲系統]
初次遊玩的死亡率高達99%　親不到就得死！
然而卻怎麼也停不下來！
而且越玩越有趣！越玩越強！
讓人想不到的接吻中毒即死遊戲！

[遊戲音樂]
散佈著不可思議的旋律迴圈無限循環！配合場景轉換相繼變化出間不容髮的旋律層層交疊！
即興變化的歌聲流淌其中，無限重複著不可思議的音調！

[夢幻後宮]
被帶往惡夢的世界無慾的公主與64位國民們將全部成為男爵的夢幻後宮！
大怪獸橫行、巨大的風車甚至是火山地帶！跳舞的鯨魚以及鬼屋！！拯救散落在惡夢世界各處的夢幻後宮們，攻略所有的機關吧！

[連網競賽]
無慾之中隨時都有人喪命。玩家並非孤身一人身處其中！
在世界各地死亡的玩家情報將成為「郵件通知」，發送至您的國家！
與世界各地的玩家共同競賽，以成為高分榜上的第一名為目標吧！

title: Deleveled [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 11]
description:
Chto podnimaetsya vverkh, rano ili pozdno opustitsya vniz… A chto opuskaetsya vniz, obyazatelno podskochit! Poshlite impulsnyy tolchok ot odnogo kubika k drugomu, chtoby peremeshchat ikh po karte. Raspredelyayte impulsy s umom, chtoby ne zastryat posredi karty i dobratsya do vsekh vyklyuchateley. Tolko ostorozhnee: esli kubik opustitsya vniz, vverkh emu uzhe ne podnyatsya - na etom platformere net knopki pryzhka.

Na kazhdom iz bolee chem 120 urovney raspolozheny chetyre pary vyklyuchateley, no kakoy iz nikh s kakim svyazan?

10 raznykh mirov so unikalnoy mekhanikoy, bonusnymi urovnyami, zadaniyami i sekretami. Prishlo vremya razdvinut ramki gravitatsii!

title: Standby [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
STANDBY is an ‘easy to learn, hard to master’ adrenaline rush precision platformer, with devious levels that will challenge your reactions and concentration.

- Master the flow of the game and navigate through the vibrant, high-contrast levels with precision!
- Interact with levels in unique ways -- slide, crush, dash and teleport through your surroundings!
- Get through 54 challenging levels of a world falling apart!
New gameplay twist on each course!
- Fluid movement -- master your way around obstacles and get through the level without slowing down!
- Ecstatic EDM soundtrack to match your adrenaline levels!

title: Black Jack World Tour [NSZ][RUS]
interface_lang: 俄语 [RUS], 德语 [DEU], 英语 [ENG], 西班牙语 [ESP], 法语 [FRA], 意大利语 [ITA], 葡萄牙语 [POR]
description:
Feel lucky today! Now, you can play BLACKJACK World Tour, your favorite 21 card game - anywhere and anytime.

Bet without spending money, and enjoy a unique experience!
If you are a fan of casino table games, you will love our black jack. 

Today, luck is on your side. Develop a good strategy and achieve victory!

Become a professional real blackjack 21 blitz player by betting just like in other casino table games without risking your real money! 

BLACKJACK FEATURES:
♣ Bet without spending money. The best blackjack 21!
♦ Real blackjack 21 card game to test your strategies, poker face and honing your abilities for a gambling adventure.
♥ A wide range of chips that allow you to simulate the real blackjack 21 blitz experience!

Now is the time to try your luck at our blackjack!

Place your bets, put all cards on the table and become a professional player of casino card game!

title: Meanders [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 8]
description:
• 40+ levels of instant play with no loading times: relax or speedrun to the exit!
• Jump, bounce, slide, teleport! Cannons too are a totally safe mean of transportation
• Enjoy the company of an all-powerful AI God, unless you find out how to destroy it
• Original Soundtrack both funky and soothing
• Use the ATOMIC STUFF to activate the insane game and visual modes!!

title: Stacks on Stacks on Stacks [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 9]
description:
Vy igraete za glavnuyu ukladchitsu Roketu, kotoraya dolzhna vospolzovatsya psikho-shlemom i skladyvat yarkie bloki, padayushchie na ee bezumnyy mir.

STROYTE ustoychivye bashni, sovershaya arkhitekturnye podvigi v poiskakh ravnovesiya.

VSTRAIVAYTE v svoyu bashnyu raznye materialy: proizvedeniya iskusstva, akvariumy, magnity i dr.

ZAShchIShchAYTE bashni ot prizrakov, ognedyshashchego drakona i drugikh dikovinnykh opasnostey.

RAZBIVAYTE svoi gotovye bashni shar-baboy.

Rezhimy igry
-Syuzhetnyy rezhim: 36 urovney s neobychnymi usloviyami ukladki, naprimer, na zybuchikh peskakh ili gigantskikh pruzhinnykh vesakh.
-Sovmestnaya igra: igrayte i prokhodite igru s partnerom.
-Duel: odoleyte druga ili chlena semi, igraya protiv nego na odnom ekrane.

title: Fractured Minds [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语 [RUS / ENG / Multi 10]
description:
«Fractured Minds» – zakhvatyvayushchaya igra o dushevnykh rasstroystvakh. 

Igru Fractured Minds, poluchivshuyu premiyu BAFTA Young Game Designers, sozdala 17-letnyaya Emili Mitchell v nadezhde privlech vnimanie k psikhicheskim zabolevaniyam.

Issleduyte chelovecheskuyu dushu v 6 atmosfernykh glavakh o razlichnykh rasstroystvakh, ot izolyatsii do trevogi, i vyzyvaemykh imi povsednevnykh problemakh.

Fractured Minds podderzhivaet initsiativu Safe in Our World, prizvannuyu privlech vnimanie k voprosam psikhicheskogo zdorovya.

title: Brogue CE (Brian Walker, nativnyy port) [NSP][ENG]
description:
Rogue («roug») — videoigra, napisannaya v 1980 godu Mayklom Toyem, Glennom Vichmanom i Kenom Arnoldom. Eyo osnovnoy temoy yavlyaetsya issledovanie podzemeliy. Ona byla neobychayno populyarnoy na universitetskikh Unix-sistemakh v nachale 1980-kh godov i porodila tselyy zhanr, izvestnyy kak «Roguelike» (Rogue-podobnye igry, t.n. «rogaliki»).
Brogue — izvestnaya sovremennaya otkrytaya, besplatnaya i svobodnaya igra v zhanre rogalik, sozdannaya Brayanom Uokerom. Kak i v ego predshestvennike, Rogue, tsel Brogue sostoit v tom, chtoby igrok (predstavlennyy personazhem «@») spustilsya na 26-y etazh Dungeons of Doom, zabral Amulet Yendora i vernulsya na poverkhnost. U igrokov takzhe est vozmozhnost uglubitsya v podzemele, chtoby nabrat bolshe ochkov. Eta zadacha uslozhnyaetsya nalichiem monstrov i lovushek v protsedurno generiruemom podzemele.
Razrabotka igry nachalas v 2009 godu, a eyo interfeys, dizayn i grafika personazhey poluchili vysokuyu otsenku za ikh odnovremennuyu gibkost, mnogochislennye vozmozhnosti, prostotu vospriyatiya i krasotu.

title: Ceilless [NSZ][ENG]
description:
我們要不要冒險去尋找珠寶？
鋪滿地磚的神秘遺蹟等著你。
沒有什麼可以傷害危險的叢林或沼澤，但你可以通過盒子。
你覺得這沒什麼特別的嗎？ 仍然，但它是一個神奇的盒子！

Ceilless 是一款屏幕旋轉解謎平台遊戲。
你所要做的就是將盒子推入水晶中。
然而，這個世界並沒有輕易允許。
儘管如此，神秘的遺跡還是會隨心所欲地移動。
這是一種解脫，對吧？
讓我們在旋轉的廢墟中很好地使用盒子。
那麼我們去尋找珠寶嗎？

title: Takorita Meets Fries [NSZ][ENG]
description:
V korolevstve Tako, zataivshemsya gluboko pod vodoy, sup - edinstvennaya eda, k kotoroy vse privykli. No printsessa Takorita etim gluboko nedovolna i trebuet nayti novoe vkusnoe blyudo, chtoby pridat svoey zhizni ostroty.

Ona reshaet otpravitsya v zemli s neobychnoy i udivitelnoy kulturoy. Kogda printsessa tuda pribyvaet, ee zhdet sudbonosnaya vstrecha s kartofelem fri!

Printsessa Takorita prodolzhaet svoe priklyuchenie, chtoby sdelat kartofel fri eshchyo i eshchyo bolee vkusnym!

Kharakteristiki
* Raznoobraznye animirovannye personazhi
* Animirovannyy interfeys
* 4 syuzhetnykh linii, 3 kontsovki i 1 bonusnyy epilog
* Romanticheskie interesy s variantami yuri i yaoy
* Kartoshka fri povsyudu!

title: Life of Boris Super Slav [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Crazy adventures of YouTube legend Boris await!

Jump into the hilarious world of YouTube personality Boris the Slav King in the official game of Life of Boris! In Super Slav you will learn about the life of the Slav phenomenon Boris and his adventures. Meet his unique family such as cousin Anatoli and babushka, or his neighbour Vadim, and find out what it means to be Cheeki Breeki!

Features

• EXPERIENCE a true Slav life with one and only Boris. He will show you the true way!
• COMPETE with other Slavs in SlavOlympics. Show the gopniks how much mayonez you can intake.
• COLLECT all of the Boris’ favorite HardBass hits from Uamee, Gopnik McBlyat and DJ Blyatman.
• LEARN special recipes from Boris’ babushka’s kitchen.
• CUSTOMIZE Boris’ appearance with specially made balaclavas.
• DISCOVER all the possible endings of Boris’ adventures. Some may let you continue, some will leave you scratching your head.

title: Best Day Ever [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Best Day Ever is a narrative game in which you will play 4 characters. Your goal? Manage their daily life and help them overcome their difficulties to create their best day ever.

EXPERIENCE 4 RICH STORIES
In Waters City, the picture is not all bright. Emma, Jordan, Paul and Jenny won't say otherwise: they face many injustices on a daily basis and need your help to face these trials. Get to know them and achieve their goals by making good decisions with them.

YOUR CHOICES HAVE A REAL IMPACT
Each story has multiple endings. It is YOUR decisions that will change the events experienced by the characters and trace their path to their best day ever. And what if these seemingly independent stories were finally linked together?

ENDEARING CHARACTERS
• Emma Nadger: Manager in the food company KraKer, Emma provides quality work and doesn't count her hours. However, she regularly receives sexist remarks from some of her peers and can no longer stand it.
• Jordan Neal: Jordan is a key player in the Waters University basketball team. The team has qualified for the big university tournament, a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for the team members. His partner feels this is the perfect opportunity for Jordan to finally introduce him to his teammates.
• Jenny: As a student at the prestigious Waters University, Jenny has always had good grades. However, a few weeks before her midterms, she can no longer focus on her studies and is anxious about getting to class.
• Paul Hitik: Paul is one of the 5 candidates in the Waters mayoral election. He is aware that his city is the place of many injustices and intends to defend his candidacy to change things on a large scale.

KEEP IN TOUCH WITH THEIR RELATIVES
With dozens of side characters, Best Day Ever deepens many relationships of friendship, love and rivalry. To stay in touch with Emma, Jordan, Jenny and Paul's friends, the phone is your best ally. You can send and receive calls, messages or keep an eye on important appointments.

title: Soul Searching [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Sail away from your homeland, visit new islands, discover the stories of their people, and learn about souls.

DO IT YOUR WAY
The gameplay is about exploring and surviving, alone or as a crew of up to 4 travelers. You must deal with hunger, thirst, energy loss, merciless beasts, and the weather. You can fish, purchase new boats and tools, and even cast magic spells. There is not one correct play style or path to follow. Go where the wind blows and experiment on your own. Can you actually get lost when the journey is the destination?

WHAT IS LIFE?
The "Story Mode" of Soul Searching invites you to reflect on existence and search for meaning with contemplative moments and thought-provoking dialogues. Seven extra “short stories” also introduce you to various art and storytelling experiments. You may find them innovative and inspiring.

ASSEMBLE A CREW
The "Random Mode" generates a unique map at the beginning of each new game, to explore by yourself or with up to 3 other players. But beware if you choose to cooperate: more people means more mouths to feed, and only good teamwork will lead to your survival.

FEATURES SUMMARY
- Meaningful single player “Story Mode”
- “Random Mode” for 1 to 4 players with auto-generated maps for more replay value
- Blend of contemplative experience with rough survival conditions
- Fascinating creatures: dragons, killer whales, dolphins and more
- Many islands, some inhabited by people with intriguing stories to tell
- Magic skills which can only be acquired by worthy souls
- Day-and-night cycle that subtly affects the gameplay
- Seven extra “short stories” with an experimental indie vibe
- “Soul-Soothing Donation” DLC for music lovers, which sales help the UN Refugees Agency

DEVELOPED BY Kayabros
“Soul Searching is about growing up, leaving your homeland, standing on your feet. It deals with themes like isolation and search for direction.” - Talha Kaya

PUBLISHED BY Nakana.io
“We gather games that share a strong experience to remember, and try to motivate real changes with Donation-DLCs” - Mikaël Bourget

title: Roommates [NSP][ENG]
description:
Igrayte za boga roka Maksa ili za umnuyu Annu, poka oni odolevayut pervyy god obucheniya v kolledzhe.

Ot nastoychivykh prepodavateley do otvlekayushchikhsya po melocham studentov, potrebuetsya sdelat nevozmozhnoe, chtoby pereyti na vtoroy kurs.

Geroi zhivut v obshchezhitii s chetyrmya drugimi studentami. Vybirayte uchebnuyu nagruzku, rabotu i, vozmozhno, dazhe togo, s kem mozhno nemnogo poveselitsya vne zanyatiy.

Kharakteristiki:
* Igrayte za Annu ili romantichnogo Dominika, Rakesh, Maksa i Izabellu
* Igrayte za Maksa ili romantichnuyu Salli, Annu, Izabellu i Rakesh
* Legkaya yumornaya komediya garantiruet nemalo ulybok
* Geympley s simulyatsiey zhizni s plotnym grafikom i statistikoy
* Originalnyy saundtrek Leetstreet Boys, vklyuchaya glavnuyu temu My Name In Lights

title: Astebreed [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Vydelyaytes na pole boya so vkusom v svoem kostyume Crossbreed — spetsialnom skafandre, sozdannom s ipolzovaniem chelovecheskikh i vnezemnykh tekhnologiy. Vse dvizhetsya na vas!

V igre predstavleny elementy vertikalnykh i gorizontalnykh skroll-shuterov, a takzhe perspektiva relsovykh shuterov, kotorye bezuprechno sochetayutsya drug s drugom v blestyashche vylozhennykh izobrazheniyakh 2,5D.
Postoyanno izmenyayushchayasya dinamika geympleya predstavlyaet soboy evolyutsiyu zhanra «perestrelyay ikh vsekh», chto pomogaet perenesti igru v sovremennuyu epokhu, no uroven masterstva, neobkhodimyy dlya ukloneniya ot pul i razgroma sopernikov, ostaetsya vysokim.

title: Earthlock [NSZ][RUS/MULTI9]
genre: 冒险, 角色扮演 (RPG), 策略
interface_lang: 俄语, 英语, 西班牙语, 法语, 意大利语, 日语, 葡萄牙语, 德语, 中文
description:
Enter a beautiful world haunted by its fateful past and join a party of unlikely heroes on their journey to rescue Amon's uncle from an ancient cult and uncover the secret of EARTHLOCK.

• Explore the magical world of Umbra.
• Fast-paced and highly strategic turn-based battles.
• Harvest magical materials to craft helpful items and perks on your home island.
• Utilize Your Talent Table: combining a classic 'skilltree' and equipment to customize your character's progression.
• Alternate between 6 playable characters.
• Grow your friendships between different character pairs for a strategic advantage in combat.
• Help the people of Umbra along they way to unlock more useful items.
• 25-40 hours of gameplay.

title: Rainswept [NSP][ENG]
description:
Detektiv Maykl Stoun priezzhaet v gorodok Paynvyu, chtoby pomoch mestnoy politsii s na pervyy vzglyad neslozhnym delom: naydena myortvaya para na kukhne. Mestnye zhiteli schitayut eto samoubiystvom, osnovyvayas na slukhakh ob ikh burnykh otnosheniyakh. 

Pomogi detektivu Stoun i ego privetlivoy pomoshchnitse Emi Blant dobratsya do istiny, skryvayushcheysya za istoriey Krisa i Dayany. No bud ostorozhen: chem dalshe k istine, tem blizhe proshloe i strashnee ispytanie.

- Zakhvatyvayushchaya istoriya v pogloshchayushchey atmosfere igrovogo mira.
- Shirokiy spektr personazhey s glubokimi istoriyami, raznoobraznymi kharakterami i sudbami.
- Originalnaya detektivnaya istoriya v luchshikh traditsiyakh Tvin Piks i Vospominaniy ob ubiystve.
- Originalnyy saundtrek ot Micamic (Downfall, The Cat Lady, Lorelai).
- Sosny, kofe i dozhd. Mnogo dozhdey.
